text: Le nqubomgobo ivezwe Ohlakeni Lokulawulwa Kokusetshenziswa Komhlaba. I-IDP ihlonza isidingo sokweseka ukunikezelwa kwezidingongqangi futhi kuqaliswe intuthuko ezindaweni ezibaluliwe ngokusungulwa kweZikhungo Zokunikezela Ngezidingongqangi Ezindaweni Zasemakhaya. Lezi zikhungo zizoba namahhovisi amaningi azohlinzeka ngeizidingongqangi ezisemqoka, ezinjengezikhungo zokuholela impesheni, amahhovisi ezokuphepha nokuvikela, ezamaposi, imitholampilo kanye namahhovisi omaziphathe endawo. Enye ingqinamba enkulu mayelana nokuhlelwa kwendawo ukubakhona komhlaba, ikakhulu maqondana nokwakhiwa kwezikhungo. Uhlelo lokubuyekezwa komhlaba lungasiza ukudedela lo mhlaba. Okuhlobene nalokhu yisidingo sokulawula ukwabiwa komhlaba kanye nemijondolo. I-IDP ihlonza isidingo sokwethula izinhlelo zokungenelela ekuhlelweni kwedolobha ukuze kulawulwe ukuhlala kwabantu ngokwethula nokuqalisa ukusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zohlaka Lwentuthuko (DFP). Ukungabibikho Kwezihlelo Zokulawulwa Kokusetshenziswa Komhlaba (LUMS) kuthinta abantu abaningi bendawo kamasipala waseBaqulisini. Osomabhizinisi kanye nabatshalizimali abamnkatshubomvu baxakwe ukwentuleka kwemikhombandlela yokuhlela engasiza ekuthuthukiseni kanye nasekwandiseni imisebenzi ezikhungweni zasemadolobheni, ikakhulu eVryheid. I- IDP yethula imibiko mayelana nendlela enezigaba ezimbili ehlongozwayo ukwakha i-LUMS elungile, ngokuqaphela ukuthi ukusungulwa kwale nqubomgomo kwaba nesandla hlakazekeni koMkhandlu ngoLwezi wezi- 2006.

Uma umphakathi unquma ukuklama intela yezindlu, kufanele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1, akhe intela yezindlu kuzo zonke izakhiwo noma ezindaweni ezibophelelwe intela yezindlu ngaphakathi komphakathi noma endaweni ngaphansi kokuphathwa komphakathi wendawo obophelelwe intela yezindlu. i uma umphakathi uqobo noma omunye umphakathi ungumnikazi; noma ii njengoba kuxoxiwe esigabeni b encazelweni yendawo noma impahla esigabeni 1; noma iii lapho ilungelo lokuba umnikazi lendawo lingavikelwa ngokomthetho ngenxa yemithetho yokucwasa edlule noma ezinye izizathu ezenza kube nzima noma kungenzeki ukuthola inani; noma b ukuvimbela umphakathi ekunikezeni amalungelo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14 mayelana nezimali zokubuyiselwa, noma ukukhokha okweqile noma ukunciphisa ekukhokheni intela yezindlu ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1. b ukusetshenziswa okukhuthazwayo kwempahla noma indawo; noma c indawo lapho impahla ikhona. Inani lentela yezindlu ohlelweni lwendawo lapho yakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela endaweni eyodwa kufanele iklanywe ngendlela ehlukile ngokuya ngosayizi waleyo ndawo okufanele ibophelelwe yalesi sistimu futhi hhayi iklanywe njengemali eyodwa ehlanganisa yonke indawo. a kufanele kube inani elisekelwe ekuthuthukisweni kwenani lentela yezindlu yaleyo mpahla njengoba kuboniswe ephepheni lokuhlola lezakhamuzi ngaleso sikhathi; noma b intela efanayo empahleni noma endaweni esigabeni esithile esibekwe, kuye ngokuthi leyo ndawo ingaphansi kwenani lokuhlola elisemthethweni.

Noma imuphi umuntu osafunda noma oqeqeshelwa ubuhlengikazi kufanele afake isicelo eMkhandlwini sokubhaliswa njengomhlengikazi osafunda noma umbelethisi osafunda. UMkhandlu kufanele ubhalise njengomhlengikazi osafunda noma umbelethisi osafunda noma imuphi umuntu osehlangabezene noma oseyifezile imibandela enqunyiwe nosenikeze imininingwane efanele yohlelo loqeqesho esikhungweni sokufundela ubuhlengikazi. Umuntu ophethe isikhungo sokufundela ubuhlengikazi kufanele kuthi esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingama-30 azise futhi athumele eMkhandlwini imininingwane enqunywe uMkhandlu mayelana nabahlengikazi abasafunda asebeqale, asebeqede, nabadluliselwe noma abashiye uhlelo lokufundela ubuhlengikazi nokufundiselwa ubuhlengikazi. Umuntu ohluleka ukunikeza uMkhandlu imininingwane edingekayo yokubhalisa, esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezingama-90, umhlengikazi osafunda noma umbelethisi osafunda okukhulunywa ngaye kusigatshana 3 noma owephula lokho okushiwo yisigatshana 5 uyakuba necala uma elahlwa yicala uyokhokha inhlawulo noma aphonswe ejele isikhathi esingeqile ezinyangeni eziyi-12 noma kokubili inhlawulo nokubhadla ejele. Amaziko ezempilo kufanele avumele ukutholakala kwezinto zokuqeqeshwa kunoma ubani obhaliswe ngaphansi kwaloMthetho. UNobhala kufanele asuse kulejista igama lomhlengikazi osafunda, noma enze uphawu elegisteni egameni lanoma imuphi umuntu, omisiwe ukunquba izifundo zakhe futhi abhalele azise lowo mhlengikazi osafunda noma umuntu ngalokho. c enalo lonke ulwazi lomsebenzi, amakhono nobuciko; noma d ekulelizwe laseRiphablikhi okwesikhashana esincane ukuzosebenza, ezocwaninga noma ezofunda.

Lokhu kuholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu, futhi ezikhathini ezinzima zomnotho, izikole eziningi ziba nezinselelo zokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye izikole zidinga ukusiza ngemali ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ukudla okunempilo. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zokudla, kubalulekile ukuthi kudliwe ukudla okunempilo, futhi izikole zidinga ukucabangela izidingo zabafundi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kube nokuhlukahluka kokudla okukhona, ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zokudla ezahlukene, njengezidingo zabantu abane-allergies noma abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ukungabi nalokhu kuhlukahluka kungaholela ekudleni okungafanele, okungaba nomthelela omubi empilweni yabafundi. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni kufanele luhambisane nezifundo eziphathelene nokudla. Abafundi kufanele bafundiswe ngokuqonda okuhle kokudla okunempilo, ukuze baqonde ukuthi kungani kudingeka ukudla okunempilo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi kuzokwandisa ukuqonda kwabo ngezingozi zokudla okungafanele. Uhlelo lokondla kufanele luhlanganiswe nezifundo zokuphila, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufunda ngempilo enempilo. Ngokuphathelene nezinsizakalo, kubalulekile ukuthi izikole zibe nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindawo zokupheka ezihambisana nezidingo zokupheka, nezinsiza zokugcina ukudla. Izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, ngaphandle kokubangela izinkinga ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlelo lokondla luhambisane nezinhlelo zomphakathi.

Inani lengcindezi yamathayi libalulekile, kodwa ukusebenzisa ithayi enengcindezi ehlukile kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubambeni kwamavhili nasecingweni sayo emhlabeni. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona izitshalo nezimpande ngaphansi komhlaba, kungaba kuhle ukusebenza ngethayi elibanzi elinengcindezi ephezulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzovumela imishini ukuthi ithwale umthwalo ofanayo njengethayi elincane ngobubanzi kodwa eliqinile emoyeni - leli thayi lizojwayela ukunyakaza kalula emhlabeni futhi liqinise umhlabathi. Ngokufanayo, esihlabathini, ithayi elibanzi elingaqinile kakhulu lizobamba kangcono ngoba linendawo enkulu yokubamba - lihamba phezu kwesihlabathi, lingadli. Kungcono ukusebenzisa ukudlula kwemoto ezimeni lapho umhlaba ungaphatheki kahle, kodwa ungasebenzisa lokhu emgwaqweni ophukile noma emgwaqweni eqinile ngoba kudala ukuguga okungalingani kumathayi aphambili, okwenza ukushayela kube nzima nokusebenzisa ezinye izingxenye ngendlela elahlekile amandla.

Unkz Jane uthi... Ngokwedlula kwesikhathi kufanele sime sizibuze ukuthi senzani. Uma sifuna ukuthola impendulo ekhanyayo, kufanele sisho futhi ukuthi kuyini esingakwenzi. Asisebenzisi abankontilaki abamhlophe emapulazini abantu abamnyama. Asizami ukupha abantu abalimile ngaphambi kwayizolo amathuba ukuphinda ukulima. Asisazami ukwenza izinto ezihlobisayo kuphela (window dressing). Asizami ukuthola izinhlamvu zeBEE ngoba kukhona abantu abazithengayo lezi zinto. Asizami ukuthola izinhlamvu zeBEE ngoba kukhona labo abanikeza izinto. Kodwa, kuyini esikwenzayo? Sithuthukisa abakhiqizi abamnyama - abazisebenzela ngokwamanje nangokusasa. Siqeqesha abakhiqizi abamnyama ukuqonda nokuthola ukuthi ziyini izizathu zokwenza umsebenzi wokulima. Sibhibhizela abakhiqizi ukusebenzisa izingcebo zemvelo ngokugcwele. Sikhombisa abakhiqizi abamnyama ukunaka umhlaba bawusebenzisayo. Sisekela abantu ngalokhu abanakho, sibasiza ukuthola inzuzo yokuphila nokukhiqiza ukudla kwabo, umuzi wabo nezwe labo. Sibasiza ukushintsha ubuso bokulima - sifuna basuke ebusweni lapho kukhona abalimi abamhlophe kuphela, sifuna ukuthi bonke abantu lapha ezwini lethu balimele thina sonke. Sisiza abantu abanomhlaba - umhlaba womuzi wonke, umhlaba oqashiweyo noma labo abanomhlaba (amapulazi) wabo ukusebenzisa lowo mhlaba ngendlela ezoletha inzuzo nakusasa. Ukuzama ukusebenzisana nayo yonke iminyango kagavumente ukuhlanganisa ukusekela okunikezwa kubalimi. Ukwakha amasu ukuze abalimi bazokwazi ukuthola imishini. Ukwakha amasu ukuthola amagranti kuleyo minyango. Kulukhuni kimi lapho ngizwa ukuthi abantu balimela abakhiqizi abamnyama.

Lokhu kwagcina kuholela ekwandeni kwenani labantu abangasebenzi, okwakukhathaza kakhulu uhulumeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi i-load shedding ayisiyona nje inkinga yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kodwa futhi ibonisa izinkinga ezinzima zempilo yomnotho. Izimboni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezincike kakhulu kumshini, zathola ukuthi zidinga ukwenza izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwezindleko, njengoba izinkampani zazingakwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela we-load shedding wawungaphezu kwezomnotho kuphela. Umphakathi waba nezinselelo ezinkulu zokuphila, njengoba abantu behluleka ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka. Izikole, izibhedlela, nezikhungo zokusebenza zaphinde zathinteka, okwakwenza kube nzima kubantu ukuhamba phambili empilweni yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokukhathazeka, okwakuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokukhathazeka emphakathini. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhulumeni uqala ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuphendula kulolu hlobo lwesimo. Kwakukhona imizamo yokwandisa ukukhiqizwa kukagesi, ngokwakha iziteshi ezintsha zokukhiqiza ugesi. Nokho, lezi zinyathelo zathatha isikhathi, futhi umphakathi waqhubeka ubhekana nezinkinga zokuhoxiswa kukagesi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphila ezihlakaniphile, ezifana nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzisa amandla elanga, zathuthukiswa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizimele zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okwakusiza abantu ukuba baphile ngaphandle kokuncika kuphela kumphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esihle, kodwa umphakathi wawusadinga isikhathi ukuze ubuyisele emuva umnotho. Ngesikhathi sokugcina, umphakathi uqhubeka nokufunda ngezifundo ezitholakele.

Iminingi imishini isebenzisa amagiya. Isibonelo esihle yibhayisikili elinamagiya okwenza ukuthi kubelula ukuhamba, kakhulukazi lapho ufika emqansweni. Ngokwejwayelekile ibhaysikili linegiya elikhulu lapho kukhona isinyathelo, bese kukhona amagiya ahlukene ngobukhulu esondweni langemuva. Lapho kunyathelwa igiya langaphambili, iketanga lidonsa amagiya angemuva esondweni, bese ibhaysikili liya ngaphambili. Bheka ubukhulu begiya lapho isinyathelo siboshelwe khona bese ukulinganisa nobukhulu bamagiya asesondweni langemuva. Ubona ini? Abaningi abantu bahambe ngebhayisikili lapho kunomqanso khona. Lapho umqanso ubanzima ukunyathela nakho kubanzima - ngokwejwayelekile umuntu ohamba ngebhasikili uzoshintsha amagiya. Lapho umhambi eshintsha amagiya, iketango lisuka kwegiya elincane liye egiyeni elikhudlwana elinamazinyo amaningana, bese kubalula ukunyathela izinyathelo. Lapho kukhona igiya elinamazinyo amaningi, kubalula ukuhamba kodwa ibhayisikili lona alisagijimi kakhulu. Sifuna ukubuza lokhu: kuzokwenzekani lapho umhambi ekhuphuka emqansweni eshintsha igiya lisuke egiyeni elikhulu esebenzisa igiya elincane Kuzobanzima noma kuzobalula ukuhambisa ibhayisikili? Isizathu sokwenza ukuthi kubelula ukukhuphuka emqansweni kwenzeka ngoba kushintshwa amagiya - ireshiyo lamagiya liyashintsha. Ireshiyo lamagiya lingatholakala uma kubalwa inani lamazinyo akhona esondweni legiyeni elithile - akubalwa isakhi seketango. Ngaphansi kuzochazwa ngesiNgisi ukuthi inani lelo lizotholakala kanjani. Uma igiya eliletha amandla (pedal) lijika kanye, igiya lesphrokete lizojika kangakani?

Ukuphila Emadolobheni Ngiyavuma, ukuphila emadolobheni kuyajabulisa, kodwa futhi kunobunzima obukhulu. Ucabanga kanjani ngalokho? Ngithanda ukubona abantu behamba ezitaladini eziphithizelayo, behlabelela, izimoto ziqhubeka, kanye nezinkulungwane zabantu. Nokho, uyazi ukuthi kulapho kuphila khona imizwa ehlukahlukene? Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngempilo yomphakathi. Emadolobheni, ungahlangana nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, okwenza kube mnandi ngoba ungafunda izinto ezintsha, ubone izindlela ezahlukene zokuphila. Ucabanga ukuthi umphakathi ungaba umthombo omuhle wokuxhumana? Impela, ungathola abangane abasha, ungaxoxa ngezinto ezithokozisayo. Nokho, kwesinye isikhathi, abantu bangabhekana nezinselelo ezinzima, njengoba umphakathi ungase ube nezinkinga zawo. Ngokuphathelene nezinsiza, amadolobha anikeza okuningi. Izindawo zokudlela, izitolo, nezikhungo zokuzijabulisa zikhona, okwenza ukuphila kube lula. Uma udinga okuthile, ungakuthola kalula. Kodwa-ke, khumbula, konke lokhu kudinga imali, futhi lokho kungaba yinkinga. Ucabanga kanjani ngalokho uma uzama ukuthola ibhajethi yokuphila? Futhi, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukuphila emadolobheni kuza nezinkinga zempilo. Uthola izinga eliphezulu lokukhathazeka, ngoba abantu bahlala bejolise emsebenzini, ezindleleni, nasezindabeni, okungaholela ekwandeni kokucindezela. Uzwa kanjani uma ubona abantu behluleka ukujabulisa? Lokhu akukukhathazi? Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngempilo yokuhlala, amadolobha anokuhlukahluka kwezindawo zokuhlala. Kukhona izindlu ezinkulu, ezincane, nezindawo ezibizayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bahlala kanjani ezindaweni ezinjengalezi?

IRejista yokuVikelwa kweziNgane inohlu lwezingane ezisebucayini, ezingaphansi kweminyaka yobudala eyi-18, ezidinga ukuvikeleka. IRejista ihlala igcinwe isisebenzi sezenhlalakhale esisebenza phakathi koMnyango osendaweni wezeNhlalakahle nokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi. Imininingwane equkethwe kuleli Rejista iyimfihlo kanti ingabelwa labo kuphela abayingxenye yethimba lokuVikelwa kweziNgane (isibonelo, uthisha, umhlengikazi, udokotela, umnakekeli/ isiphathimandla sasemaphoyiseni/ imantshi, nabanye). Kugcinwe uhla lwezingane ezisebucayini ezidinga usizo lwezenhlalakahle. Kuxhumaniswe ingane nomndeni wayo nabezenhlalakahle ngokushesha (ohlinzeka lolo lusizo). Kuqashwe leso naleso sigigaba ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlinzekwa izinsizakalo zeqophelo emndenini nasenganeni. NgokoMthetho owengamele ukunakekelwa kwezingane, (uNo. 74 ka-1983) laba bantu abalandelayo abangongoti banesibopho sokubika noma ikuphi okusolisa sengathi kunezinkomba zokuxhashazwa kwezingane kumbe ukuhlukumezwa.. uDokotela wamazinyo, udokotela owejwayelekile, umhlengikazi, usonhlalakahle, uthisha, nanoma imuphi umuntu oqashwe kumbe owengamele iKhaya leziNgane kumbe indawo yokuKhoselisa kumbe ukuNakekela izingane. Uma ngesikhathi eyihlola, ebhekene nayo, kumbe eyihlenga ingane, kube nezinsolo zokuthi kungase kube iyaxhashazwa, kufanele lokho kubikwe kusonhlalakahle oseduzane nalapho ihlala khona ingane.

Njengoba ama-ambulensi esondela endaweni, abezokwelapha baphuthuma ukuze banakekele impilo yomuntu odinga usizo. Okwesibili, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zidinga ukuhamba kahle phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza kufanele zihlanganyele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo. Izinhlangano zempilo, ezokuphepha, kanye nezinsizakalo zamasipala kumele zisebenze ngokubambisana ukuze kuthuthukiswe imiphumela. Uma ama-ambulensi edlula, izinqubomgomo kufanele ziqondise imithwalo yokusebenza kwawo, kuhlanganise nokuhlela izindlela ezihle zokuhamba, ukuqinisekisa ukufinyelela eziteshini zokwelashwa, kanye nokuhlonipha imithetho yokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zihlanganisa nezinsizakalo zokuqapha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza kahle. Abaphathi bezinsiza kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi ama-ambulensi ahlola izimo zawo njalo, aqinisekisa ukuthi abezokwelapha banazo zonke izinsiza ezidingekayo. Okwesithathu, ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabantu kubalulekile. Abantu abathintekayo, abezokuphepha, nabashayelayo ama-ambulensi kumele babe nezindlela eziphumelelayo zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezisheshayo ezibalulekile ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kufaka phakathi ukusungulwa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo, ezivumela abantu ukuthi bathumele izicelo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kalula, okunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo.

Kubalulekile ukuzisusa; ziqinile futhi zikh competition ngokuqinile nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi nezakhi. Ukuhlanya kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuphindaphinda, ngakho kufanele siqaphele ngalokhu uma sizama ukuzisusa. Ukuhlanya kungakhiqiza imbewu (ngokuvamile ngokushesha nangokulula), ezinye izinhlobo zine-rhizomes phansi, ezinye zine-stolons phezulu, ezinye zine-tubers, kanti ezinye zineziphuzo ezinkulu. Omunye umhlobo, njenge "nut grass," unazo zonke lezi - ukhiqiza imbewu, unama-tubers, futhi unama-rhizomes phansi - lokhu kwenza kube nzima ukuzisusa. Imbewu yokuhlanya ivame ukuhlala iphila futhi ingaphila emhlabathini isikhathi eside kuze kube izimo zifanele ukuvuthwa. Imbewu yokuhlanya nayo ayivuthi ngasikhathi sinye - ezinye zizovutha ngokushesha, kanti ezinye zizolinda. Ngokuvamile, ziqala ukuvutha uma umhlabathi uphazamisekile. Izimpande zokuhlanya zivame ukungena phansi emhlabathini, zidlula izimpande zezithako zokudla, zivumela ukuhlanya ukuba kukhule ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ukuhlanya okukhula unyaka nonyaka kugcina izakhi ezimpandeni zazo ngaphansi komhlabathi - ngesikhathi sokukhula okunzima, zingaphumelela. Ukuhlanya kungaba yonyaka (kukhiqiza unyaka owodwa), ezinye izinhlobo ziyi-biennial (kukhiqiza iminyaka emibili), kanti ezinye ziyi-perennial (kukhiqiza iminyaka eminingi). Kungani kubalulekile ukulawula ukuhlanya ezitshalo zokudla? Ukuhlanya kukh competition nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi emhlabathini, ngezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini, nendawo yokukhula, nangokukhanya (ilanga). Le competition ibangela ukuthi izitshalo zingakhuli kahle, futhi umkhiqizo wehla.

Inkantolo ingazin- qumela ukuvuma noma ukwala ukubuyisela ingane. lconvention isebenza kuphela kulabo abasuswel bathunjwe ngokungemthetho emva kokuba isivumelwano siqalile ukusebenza phakathi kwamazwe asayinile.. imilayezo yezinqumo eziphuma kubafiki ezabhaliswa noma zaqinisekiswa. nyango uthole ezingu 34,831 izikhalo malunga nesigaba 6 soMthetho. Noma iyiphi inkantolo kamantshi, inkantolo ye- sondlo kule ndawo eya yakhelwe kuyona ngendaba yokubhekana noMthetho wesondlo futhi namuphi umshushisi uyisiphathamandla sesondlo kwinkanto- lo aphethe kuyona. lsiphathimandla sesondlo senza ucwaningo ngecala emva kokwethulwa kwesikhalo esihlangene nesondlo esingakhishwa. Isiphathi- mandla sesondlo singakhipha isinqumo sesamanisi eliyalela abantu abathintekayo bavele phambi kom- antshi ukuze azwe isikhalo singani. Ekulalelweni kwecala, ubufakazi buyangena ma- cala wonke yabe abafuna abameli bangenze njalo. Abakho abantu abavunyelwe enkantolo ngaphandle kwabathintekayo. ezimisiweyo zesondlo, izinqumo ngokuvumelana noma ngengcindezi noma izinqumo ezilayela ukuthi kuhlolwe ukuthi kuhlolwe ukuthi obekwa icala ngem- pela ngabe nguye ongubaba wengane. EziNkantolo zeSondlo kukhishwa izinqumo ezin- gakhalelwa eNkantolo ePhakeme suka lapho uye kukhalela eNkantolo yaJaji okuGcina. lsinqumo esikhishwe yiNkantolo yeSondlo uyaphoqwa usenze ngokunye bangakuthimbela izimpahla zakho, badonse kwimali yomholo, noma bakufakele icala lokukhoka nyanga zonke ngenkani enkantolo. Ukungasebenzisani nesinqumo sesondlo (eg. Ungayikhokhi imali yesondlo) kukwenza icala lobugebengu.

Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu uma izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zinobudlelwano obuqhubekayo ngoba ubuhlungu obungazwiwa yilolo hlangothi oluhluliwe bungenza ukuthi bungabibikho ubudlelwano obuhle. Awukho umthetho olawula ukulamula kodwa izinhlobo ezithile zokulamula sekuya ngokuya zihlinzekwa umthetho, isibonelo izinxushunxushu zabasebenzi zihlinzekwa umThetho owengamele ezabaSebenzi bese kuthi izinxushunxushu zezindawo phakathi kwezinhlaka zombuso zihlinzekwe umThetho wezokuPhathwa kweziNdawo we-1998. Uma ungekho umthetho othile oqondene, inqubo kanye nokukhethwa komlamuli kuba sezandleni zezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Isivumelwano sokulamula singenziwa uma kuba nenxushunxushu, noma izinhlangothi ezithintekayo uma zibona ukuthi kungasekube nenxushunxushu phakathi kwazo esikhathini esizayo, bese ziyavumelana ngokuthi leyo nxushunxushu kumele kubhekanwe nayo ngokuthi kufunwe umlamuli. Isivumelwano sokuhambisa inkinga kumlamuli akudingeki ukuthi sibhalwe phansi, kodwa isivumelwano esibhalwe phansi singaba usizo ngoba sisiza ukubeka obala yonke inqubo elandelwa yilabo ababambe iqhaza. Umlamuli unomsebenzi wokuthi aqinisekise ukuthi uyazigcina izimfihlo zezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Ngeshwa, umThetho waseNingizimu Afrika awubaniki abalamuli ilungelo lokwenqaba ukuveza ubufakazi enkantolo ngolwazi abaluthole ngesikhathi belamula. Uma kuqhutshwa izinto zomphakathi ilungelo elisebenza kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezisetshenziswa ukuqeda izinxushunxushu lingasetshenziswa. Izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zingakusebenzisa lokho ngokuthi zivume ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana eziyingxenye yenqubo yokulamula ezingayisebenzisa.

Ngalesi sikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yayihlanganisa izigcawu ezinjengokuhlola izimo zomphakathi, izinkinga zempilo, nezifundo ezithile ezazithinta abantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yafika eRoma, lapho izinkanyezi zashintsha izindlela zokudlala. E-Roma, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola umoya omusha, yahluka ngokwengeziwe, futhi yathokozisa izithameli ngezinto ezihambisana nezokuzijabulisa. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola ukuthandwa okukhulu, futhi izinkanyezi zafaka phakathi izigigaba ezinjengokulwa, ukugijima, nezinkanyezi ezikhangayo. Ngemuva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathuthuka futhi yahluka kakhulu. Ngesikhathi seMaphakathi neNkathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola indlela yokwakha izigcawu ezihlekisayo, ezinjengama-morality plays, lapho izifundo zempilo zafundiswa ngendlela ehlekisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemidlalo yeshashalazi eyaziwa kakhulu eNgilandi, njengezinkanyezi zikaWilliam Shakespeare, owaba nomthelela omkhulu emlandweni wemidlalo yeshashalazi. UShakespeare, ngezingoma zakhe ezithokozisayo, izinkulumo ezijulile, kanye nezimo ezithakazelisayo, waphendula izinkinga zomphakathi, uthando, nobuhlungu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola izinguquko ezinkulu. Ngesikhathi seMhlabeni Wokugcina, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola ukufinyelela okukhulu ezingeni lempucuko. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yathuthuka yaba yinsiza yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba ngezinyawo, behlangana ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulisa izithameli ngezigcawu ezahlukahlukene.

ezigcina amazinga angekho ngaphansi kwamazinga asezikoleni ezingaqhathaniswa nezixhaswa yizimali zombuso. Isigatshana (3) asizivimbeli izimali zombuso ezixhasa izakhiwo zemfundo ezizimele. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokusebenzisa ulimi alukhethayo futhi abambe iqhaza empilweni yamasiko ayikhethayo, kodwa akekho ovunyelwe ukusebenzisa lawa malungelo ngendlela engahambisani nanoma yisiphi isimiso soMqulu wamaLungelo. ukuthokozela amasiko abo, ukuqhuba inkolo yabo nokusebenzisa ulimi lwabo; futhi (b) bakhe, bajoyine futhi bagcine izinhlangano zamasiko, zenkolo nezezilimi kanye nezinye izinhlangano zomphakathi. Leli lungelo kwisigatshana (1) malingasetshenziswa ngendlela engahambisani nanoma yisiphi isimiso esikuMqulu wamaLungelo. nanoma yiluphi ulwazi olusezandleni zomunye umuntu oludingekayo ekusetshenzisweni noma ekuvikelweni kwanoma yimaphi amalungelo. kazwelonke futhi lomthetho ungahlinzekela izinyathelo ezifanele ezinganciphisa umsebenzi wokwengamela izidingo zalelilungelo kanye nezindleko kumbuso. Yilowo nalowo muntu unelungelo lokuphathwa yiminyango nezakhiwo zombuso ngendlela esemthethweni, efanele futhi elandela inqubo egculisayo. Yilowo nalowo muntu onamalungelo athintwe yisinyathelo sokuphatha, unelungelo lokunikezwa izizathu ezibhaliwe zaleso sinyathelo. ukhuthaze ukuthi kubenombuso osebenza ngokukhuthala. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthi noma yiyiphi ingxabano engaxazululwa ngokusebenzisa umthetho, inqunywe yinkantolo yomthetho ecaleni eligculisayo elivulekele umphakathi noma, lapho kulungile, leyo ngxabano ingaxazululwa yinkundla ezimele nengavuni hlangothi.

Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemibhikisho emikhulu, efana neMarch on Washington for Jobs and Freedom ngo-1963, lapho uKing ethula khona isikhumbuzo sakhe esidumile, "I Have a Dream." Kuleli zinga, waphakamisa umbono wokuthi wonke umuntu kufanele athole amathuba alinganayo. Umlando kaKing awukhona nje kuphela wokulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo, kodwa ubonisa ubuholi obuqinile bokuhlanganyela nezinkinga ezinzima. Waba yisithonjana sokuthula emhlabeni wonke, futhi imiyalezo yakhe yathinta izizukulwane eziningi. Waphinde wathola iNobel Peace Prize ngo-1964, okuyisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuhlonishwa komsebenzi wakhe. Nokho, impilo kaMartin Luther King Jr. ayizange iphelele ngaphandle kwezithiyo. Ngonyaka we-1968, uKing wabulawa eMemphis, eTennessee, ngesikhathi esebenza ekulwisaneni nokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu abamnyama. Lokhu kwashiya umhlaba ubuhlungu, kwaholela ekutheni abantu baphinde bacabange kabusha ngempilo kaKing, nokuqonda ukuthi imizamo yakhe ayizange iphelelwe isikhathi. Umlando kaMartin Luther King Jr. usafundisa izifundo ezibalulekile namuhla. Ubonisa ukuthi ukulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo akuyona impi yokuhlukumeza, kodwa kungumzamo wokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. UKing usikhumbuza ukuthi ubulungiswa buyisidingo esibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sibe nesibindi sokulwela amalungelo ethu, njengoba yena waba nesibindi sokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. Ngamafuphi, uMartin Luther King Jr. ungumholi ophawulekayo, owashiya umthelela omkhulu emhlabeni. Imigomo yakhe yokuthula, ubulungiswa, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu izoqhubeka iphila ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa izindawo zokupheka ezihambisana nezidingo zokupheka, nezinsiza zokugcina ukudla. Izikole kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezinsiza ezanele ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, ngaphandle kokubangela izinkinga ezithile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi uhlelo lokondla luhambisane nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Izikole zingasebenza ngokubambisana nezikhungo zomphakathi, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthola ukudla okunempilo. Ekugcineni, uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luyinselelo, kodwa futhi luyithuba. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikole ziqhubeke nokusebenza ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bathola ukudla okunempilo, futhi lokho kudinga ukucabangela izidingo zabafundi, izinsiza ezikhona, kanye nezinhlelo zomphakathi. Ngokuphumelela, singathuthukisa impilo yabafundi, sithuthukise ikhwalithi yokufunda, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lungaba yinsika yempumelelo, uma luphathwa kahle futhi luhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni olunempilo, olukhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi luhlinzeke ngesisekelo esiqinile sokufunda. Lokhu kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu hhayi kuphela kubafundi, kodwa nakumphakathi jikelele. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luyinsika eqinile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kufanele sibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni lesi sikhathi sokondla.

duma ngabe eke waxhoshwa kwesinye isikhundla ngesizathu sokungaziphathi kahle. g elilahlwe icala lokungaziphathi kahle ngemva kokuqulwa kondaba mayelana nesenzo esingahlambalaza iSikhungo, kodwa leli lunga lingeze lashiya isikhundla kuze kufike umhlangano wonyaka olandelayo lapho lokhu kushiywa kwesikhundla kufanele kuvezwe emaphepheni ezinqumo. h ngokuhambisana nokushiwo yilesi sigaba othumele isaziso esibhaliwe noma incwadi yokushiya kwakhe isikhundla wayithumela kuMongameli futhi noMkhandlu wamukela lokho kushiywa kwesikhundla uma zonke izimali zobulunga zikhokhiwe. Noma iliphi ilunga loMkhandlu elifisa ukushiya isikhundla sobulunga kufanele lilethe isaziso sokushiywa kwalo sibhaliwe sibhekiswe kuMongameli kanti uMkhandlu kufanele usamukele isaziso uma ngabe zonke izimali zobulunga okufanele lizikhokhe zikhokhiwe. Uma ngabe isikhundla selunga loMkhandlu sisele singenamuntu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sobulunga salelo lunga, uNgqongqoshe ngokuhambisana nokushiwo isigatshana 1 kufanele kuthi zingakapheli izinsuku ezinga-60 aqoke umuntu oyobe ephakanyiswe uMkhandlu ukuba athathe leso sikhundla kuleso sikhathi esisale kuleli lunga elishiye isikhundla. UMkhandlu ungasungula ikomiti elilodwa noma amaningi, angasebenzisa amandla noma enze noma imuphi umisebenzi weSikhungo eliwuthunywa nguMkhandlu. Ikomiti okukhulunywa ngalo kusigatshana 1 liyokwakhiwa amalunga athile eSikhungo kanye nabasebenzi beSikhungo uMkhandlu oyobona befanele, uma bekhona, uMkhandlu ungachitha noma usungule kabusha ikomiti noma ingasiphi isikhathi uma ubona kufanele.

Siyabonga ngokubamba iqhaza ocwaningweni lwentsha lweBokamoso Ba Rona! Angeke kuthathe isikhathi eside ukuqeda lolu cwaningo, futhi ngokuphendula le mibuzo ngokwethembeka uzobe ufaka isandla kuphrojekthi ebaluleke kakhulu. Khumbula ukuthi izimpendulo zakho ngeke zaziwe; ngakho-ke angeke sazi ukuthi ungubani. Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi uyifunde yonke lemibuzo ngokuqikelela bese uphendula ngokwethembeka. Lolu cwaningo lwenzelwe abantu abaneminyaka ephakathi kweyi-12 kuya kwengama-24. Lolu lwazi lubalulekile ukuze siqonde ukuthi ingabe abantu abasha abehlukene bazizwa ngendlela efanayo yini ngezindaba ezithize, ngakho-ke sicela uyiphendule yonke imibuzo kulesi sigaba. Uhlala kusiphi isifundazwe? Sicela uyiphendule yonke imibuzo ekulesi sigaba socwaningo. Lapho kukhona khona uhlu longakhetha kukho, kokezela lokho okukhethayo. Ingabe uyaziqhenya ngokuba owaseNingizimu Afrika? Kulezi zindawo ezilandelayo, iziphi obhekana nezingqinamba kuzo empilweni yakho? Ezempilo Igciwane lesandulela ngculaza / ingculaza, Izidakamizwa, njl. ENingizimu Afrika jikelele, ikuphi ocabanga ukuthi izona zindaba ezibalulekile ezibhekene nabantu abasha? Uke uzizwe sengathi ungafaka isandla ekwenzeni iNingizimu Afrika ibengcono? Kungumsebenzi kabani ukwenza iNingizimu Afrika ibe indawo engcono? Uma ungaba nenkinga enkulu, ungaya kubani ukuyofuna usizo? Uma umuntu omethembayo ephakamisa ukuthi uye kulezo zinhlangano ezisiza abantu ngalezo zinkinga ungaya na? Unalo ulwazi ngenhlangano esiza abantu ngalezo zinkinga? Ngokwakho ukubona, ingabe abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayafunda ukuzwana?

Ubuye wabhala ukuthi imicimbi eyanelisayo ibalulekile ukuze abantu baziqhenye ngamasiko abo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi onezinhlelo ezihluke-hluke ezithuthukisayo. Ngemuva kokuphela kokuhlangana, umphakathi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emisebenzini ethile ebanzi, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzithandela, imifundaze, nezinhlelo zemfundo. Lokhu kube yithuba elihle lokuthi abantu abasha basebenze ndawonye, bajule emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa izindawo zabo. Uhlelo lokusebenza kwezemfundo lwaluhloselwe ukusiza abantwana nabantu abadala ukuba bathole amakhono abalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukukwazi ukuphila kahle. Ubhishobhi wombiko, uMnu. Sipho Dlamini, uthe: "Sizokwenza imicimbi enjalo njalo ukuze siqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano, ubumbene, futhi ophumelelayo. Imisebenzi eyenzekayo iyayiqhakambisa imiphakathi yethu, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile." Kuhlanganiswe futhi izinsiza ezahlukene ezitholakala emphakathini, phakathi kwazo izikhungo zezempilo, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinsiza ezihlinzeka ngokuqashwa. Abaholi bomphakathi bacacisile ukuthi kunemisebenzi eminingi ezayo, okuhlanganisa nokwakha izikhungo eziningi zokuphila, ezokwelapha, nezokuthuthukisa amakhono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi nezikhungo ezizimele, kuboniswe njengomgomo obalulekile. Ngaphakathi kwemihlangano, abaholi baphinde bakhuthaze abantu ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza ezitholakala emphakathini. Lokhu kuba isixhaso sokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho zonke izakhamizi ziba neqhaza elibucayi.
