Uma igiya elinyathelwayo lijika kanye, igiya lesphrokete lizojika kangakanani? Ireshiyo legiya linomthelelo onjani maqondana nokugijima komshini? Ireshiyo legiya lisitshela ukuthi ukugijima kwegiya elilodwa lilingana kanjani nokugijima kwelinye igiya. Uma igiya lethu eliletha amandla (elinamazinyo angu-10) lijikezela nga-5 rpms, futhi lihlangene negiya elinikeza amandla (elinamazinyo angu-50), igiya elinikeza amandla lizondiyaza nga-1 rpms. Lapho igiya lethu elincane lindiyaza 1x, igiya lethu elikhulu lindiyaza 1/5. Kudingeka ukundiyaza oku-5 kwegiya elincane ukulingana nokundiyaza oku-1 kwegiya lethu elikhulu. Kanjalo-ke igiya lethu elikhulu ligijima ngespidi elingu-1/5 lespidi elilingana na-1rpm. Kuzokwenzekani uma ireshiyo legiya lethu lingu-1:3? Lapha ubukhulu begiya eliletha amandla bu-3x ngaphezu kobukhulu kwegiya elinikeza amandla.

Uma ukhomishina wokufungisa ebona ukuthi umuntu owenza isitatimende akathandi ukufunga, kufanele angafungisi. Kwake kwaba nesimo lapho owayemangalelwe owayeboshwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikeleka Ngaphakathi, okwathi emva kokuvalelwa egunjini lokuhlalisa umuntu ngamunye futhi aphenywe, waphoqelelwa yiphoyisa ukuthi afunge ngaphambi kukhakhomishina wokufungisa. Inkantolo yakubekela eceleni lokho kuboshwa kukammangalelwa lapho kutholakala ukuthi wayephoqelelwe ukuthi afunge phambi kukakhomishina wokufungisa. Kuyicala ukwenza isitatimende esingamanga ku-afidavithi wazi ukuthi singamanga, isifungo esiqinisekisiwe noma sesizotha, noma esifungelwe, uma nje isitatimende sisembhalweni, iqiniso laso elifungelwe, eliqinisekisiwe, noma elishiwo ngaphambi komuntu onikezwe amandla ngumthetho ukuthi afungise noma enze izifungo eziqinisekiswe. i ngokuhluleka ukusayina amazwi afungelwayo kanye nokubhala igama lakhe ngokugcwele kanye nekheli lomsebenzi ngezansi kwesignesha yakhe, kanye ii nokuhluleka ukusho isikhundla sakhe kanye nendawo lapho aqokelwe khona kanye nehhovisi akulo uma kungukuthi uqokwe ngokwesikhundla sakhe. Isikhalo esiphikisana nokuboshwa saphumelela. Ukhomishina wokufungisa oqinisekisa i-afidavithi kudingeka ukuthi angachemi, angenzeleli futhi azimele ehhovisi lapho kwenziwe khona i-afidavithi. Esimeni lapho ummeli esebenza njengokhimishina wokufungisa kumlingani wakhe, kwatholakala ukuthi akakwazi ukuzimela ngokuphelele futhi unothando. Inkantolo yayalela ukuthi i-afidavithi iqinisekiswe ukhomishina wokufungisa okwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe kahle.

Akumangalisi ukuthi, izithombe ezibhalwe uMbeki zikhumbuza izizukulwane ezizayo mayelana nemithwalo ethwala ubuholi. UThabo Mbeki, njengomholi, ukhumbuleka ngokukhuthaza izakhamuzi ukuba zithathe izinyathelo ezizothuthukisa isimo sabo, nokwakha umphakathi onokuthula. Kulo mhlaba wezezimali eziguqukayo, uMbeki ubalulekile ekuphakamiseni umqondo wokubambisana kanye nokwakha izixazululo ezizinzile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ugxile ekuxhumaneni phakathi kwe-Afrika nezinye izifunda zomhlaba, edinga ukuqaphela ngokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile, futhi uphakamisa umqondo wokuthi wonke umuntu uyakwazi ukufaka isandla ekwakheni izwe elingcono. Noma kunini lapho uThabo Mbeki edlula, uthinta abantu ngezwi lakhe elinamandla, elikhuthaza. Umsebenzi wakhe usaqhubeka nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezintsha, ubafundisa ukuthi ubuholi buhamba nezinhlelo ezithile, futhi kufanele kube nokuzimisela okukhulu ukuze uphumelele. UThabo Mbeki ungumholi obekwe emlandweni, futhi izenzo zakhe zikhumbula izifundo ezibalulekile ezizothinta umhlaba ngezizukulwane ezizayo. Ngaphandle komqondo wakhe, izinto eziningi ezikhona namuhla zingase zingabikhona. Ngokubhala lokhu, sikhumbula uThabo Mbeki, umholi owayenobuhlakani, ubuholi obuqotho, nothando lwempilo yomphakathi. Uhambo lwakhe luhlala lukhumbuleka, njengoba ethinta abantu abaningi ngeqhaza lakhe emlandweni wobumbano, ekwakheni umphakathi onokuthula, nolwazi oluqinile. UThabo Mbeki uyisibonelo sokuthi ubuhlakani, ubuholi, nokuzimisela zingaholela ekuthuthukiseni izwe.

UMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke kanye nomthethosivivinywa we-WUA kulawula ukuphathwa nokusebenza kwale nhlangano. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngokusungulwa kwe-WUA kunoma yisiphi isimo sokusetshenziswa kwamanzi njengoba kuchaziwe kuMthetho. Nokho, kunezinhlobo ezimbili ze-WUA ezingasungulwa, i-WUA yomsebenzisi oyedwa kanye ne-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi. I-WUA yomsebenzisi abaningi ihlinzeka ngezidingo zabantu abahlukene abasebenzisa amanzi, njengokulima, ukuhweba, ukukhiqiza, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwasekhaya. I-WUA isungulwa nguNgqongqoshe kulandela izinqubo ezichazwe kuMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke. UNgqongqoshe angafuna ukuhlinzeka ngezisebenzi, ukuphatha, nokubhekelela uhlelo lukamasipala emphakathini wendawo. Lokhu kungenzeka uma uhlelo luhlelwe ukusiza leyo miphakathi futhi lungaphathwa kahle yi-WUA efanele. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukweseka imizamo yezinye izigaba zikamasipala ngokuzinzisa abalimi abasha noma ngokuthuthukisa amaphrojekthi okutshala ukudla. Lapho kukhona ukuthuthukiswa okungahambisani, uNgqongqoshe angase anqume ukuthi i-WUA isebenze njengendlela yokuphatha engcono futhi igweme izingxabano ezingase zibe khona. I-WUA isungulwa ngemva kokuxhumana nomphakathi. Uma uNgqongqoshe exhumana nomphakathi, izindleko zokuxhumana zingabuyiselwa uma i-WUA isunguliwe. I-WUA eyasungulwa ngenhloso ethile ivamise ukusungulwa ngemva kokuthi kube nephakamiso elenziwe kuNgqongqoshe ngababhekene nakho.

Le mpi yaphinde yadalwa yizizathu eziningi, kodwa ikakhulukazi yaphakanyiswa yizinhlelo zika-Adolf Hitler eJalimane. Iziphumo zalesi simo zashintsha umhlaba, zashiya izigidi zabantu zishonile, futhi zashiya izwe nezifunda zikhubazekile. Le mpi yaphinde yakhulisa umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwezizwe, kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweZizwe Ezihlangene, okuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi izimpi zingaholela ezinhlelweni ezinkulu zokuthula. Impi YaseVietnam (1955-1975) Impi yaseVietnam ibonisa indlela izimpi zomlando zingashintsha ngayo izwe. Le mpi yahlasela iVietnam, lapho amaMelika abamba iqhaza elikhulu, efuna ukuvikela iVietnam enhlangothini ye-Communist. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu, hhayi kuphela eVietnam, kodwa naseMelika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Imiphumela yale mpi ibonakala emlandweni, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukiseni umqondo wokuthula phakathi kwezizwe. Izimpi Zase-Afrika Izimpi eziningi zenzeka e-Afrika, zidalwa yizizathu ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa ukulwela inkululeko, izimpi zempucuko, nezimpi zendawo. Isibonelo, impi yaseNigeria phakathi kuka-1967 no-1970, eyaziwa nangokuthi iBiafran War, ibonisa izinkinga ezinzima ezihlobene nezombusazwe, ubuhlanga, nezomnotho. Le mpi yashiya izigidi zabantu bengenamakhaya, futhi yadalela izwe izinselelo ezinzima ezithinta ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Imiphumela Nezifundo Izimpi zomlando zifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile. Zikhombisa ukuthi izinkinga ezinkulu zingavela uma abantu behluleka ukuvumelana, futhi zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi ukuthula kubalulekile.

Uma unesikhalo ngomonakalo owenziwa kwimvelo nohambisana nokwephula ilungelo lesintu, ungabhala noma ushayele leKhomishani ucingo uyicele yenze uphenyo ngodaba. Uvule icala ngomuntu owephule umthetho wezemvelo kanti umthetho uyakuvuna uthi lesosenzo siyicala. Usuwabikele futhi amaphoyisa ngalesenzo. Ungaxhumana namaphoyisa izikhathi ngezikhathi ukuzwa noma icala liyaqhubeka yini. Ungaxhumana namaphoyisa lapho uvule khona icala, iphoyisa noma umseshi ophenya ngecala. Uma kunezinkomba zokuthi umshushisi ngeke eqhubeke necala, thatha isinqumo sokuziqhubekela wena necala noma uyekela kuye. Bhalela uMvikeli-woMphakathi umazise ukuthi ufuna ukushushisa othile ngokwakho. INGXENYE 8: Yini eyenzekayo ngemuva kokuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amalungelo akho ezemvelo ngaphansi kweNEMA? Kulesi sigaba sizokuthatha sikukhombise ezinye zezinhlobo zezinyathelo ongazithatha uma uvikela amalungelo akho ezemvelo. Isinyathelo ngasinye ngokulandelana zimi kanje. Izinqumo eziningi ezithinta imvelo zenziwa ngomasipala. Izindawo zikamasipala zimelwe yimikhandlu ekhethwe ngentando yeningi kanti imelwe ngamakhansela ezigcemeni ezehlukene. Umsebenzi wokuphatha umasipala nsuku zonke wenziwa ngabasebenzi abenza lomsebenzi ngokugcwele kanti bathola amandla negunya kuye umaziphathe. Amanye alamandla awedluliselwa kubo, lawa yilapho ezenzela ngokwakhe umaziphathe ngokusizwa ngamakomidi avame ukubunjwa ngamakhansela aqokiwe. Amakomidi amaningi akhethiwe adingida izinto ezithinta imvelo, njengekomidi lokuhlela nje. Lamakomidi enza izincomo ekomidini eliphakeme nokuyilo elithatha izinqumo ezingujuqu.

Zigqugquzela intuthuko kwizizinda zobuciko ezinhlobonhlobo. Isigungu sikazwelonke sezobuciko. Ngokomthetho we- National Arts Council ka- 1997, umkhandlu ulungiselela amathuba ukuze abantu bekwazi ukwenza futhi bajabulele ubuciko. Umkhandlu uphinde futhi uthuthukise ezobuciko emphakathini, uphinde ugcizelele ukuqhama ngobuzwe ngokusebenzisa ubuciko, uphinde uthuthukise ukukhululeka kobuciko, uphinde unike amathuba abantu ababengenawo ngaphambili ukuthi bekwazi ukufinyelela kwezobuciko. Omunye umsebenzi uhlanganisa ukulungisa amadala ngokunika ingqalasizinda futhi uphinde uthuthukise ubuzwe kanye nokuxhumana nomhlaba. Amalibrary aqwashisa futhi alondoloze amagugu kazwelonke abuye anikeze usizo ezindabeni/ ezintweni ezifuze lezo. Zifaka iLibrari kazwelonke yabangaboni, enikezela ngemisebenzi ephathelene nolwazi kanye nelibrary. Ungqongqoshe wethula imithetho sivivinywa emithathu kwi-Sishayamthetho ngesikhathi sokwethula umbiko. Wamhlangana nabanentshisekelo kwezobuciko kanye namasiko begcizelela ukubaluleka kolwazi lwesintu kanye namafilimu. Umthetho kazwelonke wama wezinqolobane zaseNingizimu Afrika. Umthetho wokwakhiwa kwezimpawu. Umthetho wesichaza mazwi solimi lwesibhunu. Umthetho webhodi ephethe izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Umthetho wokugqugquzelwa kwamasiko. Umthetho wezikhungo zamasiko. Umthetho wokuthuthukisa amasiko. Umthetho kazwelonke wezigcina zincwadi zabangaboni. Umthetho wesigungu samagugu kazwelonke. Ziyisithupha izingxenye ezisemqoka uma kuchazwa isu eliwumkhombandlela woPhiko.

Ukuhlanganyela kwethu kumaphrojekthi akwemukelekanga kuzodingeka. Asiphambukeli kulokhu, sibheka phambili, sithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, nezinsiza, ukuze kube nezinto ezizokwenziwa ngeqiniso. Ingxenye 8: Ukuphetha Siyavuma ukuthi lezi zindlu ze-RDP zingasiza ukuvuselela umphakathi, kodwa kudinga ukuba nesivumelwano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani. Le ngxoxo inikwe amandla ukuhlinzeka ngedlanzela elikahle lempilo yetu. Ukubambisana, ukuziqhenya, nokwenza izinqumo ezinhle kuzo zonke izigaba kuwufanele, ukuze sithole ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngiyabonga ngalesi sikhathi sokuxoxa ngalesi sihloko esibalulekile. Ngabe ungakhetha izindlela ezitholakalayo zokwenza ngcono i-RDP? Njengoba sisondele ekugcineni, ngabe unganikeza isithombe sesikhathi esizayo sokwakhiwa kwezindlu?

Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa siwubufakazi bokubhaliswa isikhathi esiwunyaka kusukela ngosuku okubhalwe ngalo ngemuva kwalokho kuyokuba isitifiketi sokusebenza sonyaka esiyokhishwa ngemuva kokukhokhwa kwemali enqunyiwe yonyaka nokuthunyelwa kwemininingwane engadingwa uMkhandlu ukuze ugcine amanani aliqiniso ngabantu abasebenza kwezobuhlengikazi kuwubufakazi bokubhaliswa ngaphandle uma kunobufakazi obunqada ikhanda obuphikisana nalokhu. Amarisidi akhishwe ngegama loMkhandlu mayelana nezimali ezikhokhelwa ukubhalisa, ayakuba ubufakazi emacaleni ngokomthetho ukuthi lowo muntu ubhaliswe ngokwalo Mthetho, kodwa uma lapho noma imuphi umuntu ogama lakhe... a livela kulejista nowehlulekayo ukuveza irisidi, irisidi ngesandla sikaNobhala ingubufakazi bokuthi lowo muntu obhalisiwe ngokwaloMthetho; noma b lisuliwe kulejista kusukela ngosuku okukhishwe ngalo irisidi futhi ingazange libuye libhalwe kulejista, isitifiketi esikhishe ngesandla sikaNobhala sokuthi lelo gama lesusiwe kulejista ngubufakazi bokuthi lowo muntu akabhalisiwe ngokwaloMthetho. UNgqongqoshe, ngezincomo ezenziwe uMkhandlu anganquma iziqu ezitholakale ngokuhlolwa okwenziwe isikhungo sokufundisa ubuhlengikazi esiseRiphablikhi, okuyothi uma enazo zodwa noma nezinye iziqu zivumele lowo muntu onazo ukuba abhalise ngokwaloMthetho uma ngemuva kokuthola lezi ziqu okukhulunywa ngazo ehambisane nemibandela noma izidingo ezinganqunywa. b uhlobo nobungako bokuqhubeka nokuthuthuka ngomsebenzi okufanele kwenziwe yilabo abanquba umsebenzi; kanye c nenqubo yokwamukelwa nguMkhandlu kwezenzo noma izinhlelo zokuqhubeka ukuthuthuka ngokomsebenzi nezikhungo ezigunyazwe ukuba zinikeze lezo zinhlelo.

Ngalo mzamo sikwazile ukusheshisa ukuqalisa loluhlelo. Sikwazile ukusuka ekwakheni uhlelo, siye ekudluliseleni izimali kanye nasesigabeni sokuqaliswa kohlelo esikhathini esiyizinyanga ezimbili. Silindele ukuthi ekupheleni kukaSephtemba, sibe sesakhe amathoyilethe angama-252 ashaywayo kuwona wonke amakhaya analenkinga yalamathoyilethe. Ngalolu hlelo kuzokwazi ukuthi kulawuleke izifo ezifana nekholera kubuye futhi kwenziwe ngcono ezempilo kanye nenhlalakahle yomphakathi othintekayo. Abantu bakithi lapha eNdaka bafanele ukuthola amathoyilethe angcono njengalabo abasemadolobheni. Lo hulumeni uzoqinisekisa ukuthi kunokulingana ekuhlinzekweni kwezidingo kungabhekwa ibala lesikhumba. Akekho umuntu okumele athole izidingo ezingekho ezingeni ngenxa yendawo akuyo. Njengohulumeni kumele singakuvumeli ukuphathwa ngendlela engalingani kwezakhamuzi zethu. Esikwenzayo namuhla ukubuyisa isithunzi nokuletha impilo engcono ebantwini bakithi njengoba kuqinisekiswe umthethosisekilo wethu. Sengilubonile uhlelo lokusebenza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi indlu ngayinye izothola ithoyilethe elishaywayo kanye nendawo yokugezela enezinsiza ezifanele. Nginxenxa wonke umuntu ukuba afunde kulolu hlelo lukazibambele ukuthi singaba abasunguli bamasu ekulethweni kwezidingo. Ngikhuthaza bonke ababambe iqhaza ukuba basebenzisane ekuqinisekisweni ukuthi ukulethwa kwezidingo kuyasheshiswa. Esikufundile lapha ukuthi imithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo kukhonela ukusinikeza uholo ekuletheni izidingo, hhayi ukusinqinda ekuletheni izidingo. Sifundile ukuthi sidinga ukuba sisuse izingqinamba eziqondene nengqalasizinda.

Ngakho, kuncike kithi, abanikazi beTaxi, nabashayeli ukuba sihlolisise ukulimala futhi silungise ngaphambi kokuthi kubangele izinkinga! Amawheels ezimoto asetshenzisiwe ahluke kuma-wheels ajwayelekile. Amawheels ajwayelekile awaqinile ngokwanele ukuthwala abagibeli beTaxi. I-wheel ye-vehicle inencwadi C emva kwenombolo yesisindo. Uma i-wheel incane kakhulu noma inkulu kakhulu, ingaphuma emgibeni we-wheel. Kumele ibe nosayizi ofanele. Buza umthengisi wakho we-tire ngosayizi ofanele we-vehicle yakho, noma ufunde incwadi yakho. Uma i-wheel incane kakhulu, ingaphuma emgibeni we-wheel. Ungazifaki engcupheni yokuphuma okungaba yingozi. Njalo uma ufaka itayi elisha, futhi ufake ne-air valve entsha. Ama-air valves awabizi kakhulu, ayabiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi umgibeli we-wheel uphila kahle. Uma umgibeli we-wheel ulimele, ungabangela itayi ukuthi ilahleke umoya ngokushesha noma iphume emgibeni. Hlola ama-wheel rims e-vehicle yakho njalo. Uma kukhona ukulimala, shintsha noma buza othile onolwazi ukuthi alungise. Umoya ongafanele ubangela itayi yakho ukuthi igqoke ngokungafanele futhi ingagqoka ngokushesha. Ukuhlola umoya njalo uma ugcwalisa uphethiloli nokufaka umoya ofanele kukunika ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi itayi yakho izohlala isikhathi esifanele - okwenza ukusindisa imali! Itayi yakho ingagqoka ngokushesha esontweni lokuqala uma ingafakwe kahle noma uma i-valve igxuma umoya. Hlola umoya kuma-tires akho nsuku zonke esontweni lokuqala ngemuva kokufaka ama-tires amasha. Ngemuva kwalokho, hlola umoya kuma-tires akho njalo. Njalo umshayeli kufanele abe ne-air pressure gauge yakhe.

Lengqophamlando yomsebenzi iwubufakazi bokuthi sesithathe elikhulukazi igxathu ekufezekiseni umbono wethu wokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu bakithi ikakhulukazi labo abampofu kakhulu. Indlu phela inika umuntu isithunzi nokuziqhenya, iyindawo ongayibiza ngekhaya, ikuvikela kwiziphepho, nesimo sezulu esibi, iyindawo yakho yokuphepha nekunika ubunikazi. Ngaphezu kwalokhu loluhlelo luzophinde ludale amathuba emisebenzi amaningi emphakathini lapha Ngaloluhlelo sizoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bakhelwa izindlu ezindaweni lapho behlezi khona abazukushintshelwa kwezinye izindawo. Indlu ngayinye izoba ngu 40 square metres nokuyindlu enkulu ngokwanele futhi engcono kakhulu nangokwesakhiwo. Lezizindlu zizohambisana nezindlu zangasese zohlobo oluhambisana nezinga elibekwe uMasipala woGu. Ngokohlelo silindele izindlu ezingu 150 nezindlu zangasese ezingu 150 zibe sezakhiwe ngasekupheleni kwalonyaka. Ngonyaka ozayo silindele kwakhiwe izindlu ezingu 600 nezindlu zangasese ezingu 600. Ngonyaka ka 2008 silindelele kwakhiwe izindlu ezingu 250 nezindlu zangasese ezingu 250. Lokhu kuveza ngokusobala ukuthi kuleminyaka emithathu ezayo kuzobe kusetshenzwa kulendawo. Mangisho ngithi lomsebenzi kanye neminye eminingi esiphezu kwayo iyigalelo lika Hulumeni lokuguqula izimpilo zabantu. Kusekuningi okufanele sikwenze ngokubambisana kulesisikhathi esizayo ukuze ekugcineni sinqobe yonke imiphumela yemithetho nemigomo yezikhathi zobandlululo. Sibonga kakhulu ukubambisana esinakho nobuholi kanye nomphakathi lapha okusenze safinyelela kuleliqophelo esikulo namhlanje. Ngalamazwi kuyintokozo enkulu kimina ukuba ngethule ngokusemthethweni uhlelo lokwakhela abantu bakithi izindlu lapha endaweni yaseSimahla.

Isingeniso Izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lihlala libalulekile empilweni yethu. Njengoba sikhula, sithola ukuthi ukufunda akukhona nje ukuthola ulwazi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umqondo, ukwazi ukuqonda izwe esiphila فيه. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinga lokufunda lihlala liwumgogodla wobuchwepheshe, inhlalakahle, kanye nezinga lempilo elihamba phambili. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukucabangela izimbangela zokuhluleka noma zempumelelo kwabafundi, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizothuthukisa izinga lokufunda. Izici ezithinta izinga lokufunda Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lidinga ukubhekwa kumqondo obanzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izici eziningi, njengokufundiswa, ukuphathwa kwezikole, kanye nezimo zomndeni. Uma sifunda, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abafundi bangabantu abahlukene, abanezimo ezihlukile, izifiso, nemikhuba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, indlela abafundi abaqondiswa ngayo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo, kudinga ukuba zihluke ukuze zifanele wonke umuntu. Ngokwesibonelo, izikhungo zokufunda ezihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe, njengezincwadi, amakhompyutha, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukufunda. Lokhu kuyabakhuthaza abafundi ukuba bazibandakanye, bahlakulele amakhono okucabanga, nokufunda ngendlela ethokozisayo. Nokho, uma lezi zinsiza zingatholakali, abafundi bangasala bejwayele ukungafundi kahle. Indima yomfundisi Ngakho-ke, indima yomfundisi ibalulekile. Umfundisi onekhono akavuli nje umnyango wokufunda, kodwa futhi udala isimo esikhuthazayo. Umfundisi kufanele abe khona ukuze akhuthaze, ahlolisise, futhi abheke ukusebenza kwabafundi.

Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye (GEMS dependent member classification) Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-GEMS dependent member classification, kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zempilo. Lezi zinsiza zihlala zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi amalungu anikezwa usizo olufanele, ikakhulukazi uma engakwazi ukuziphatha ngokwakhe. Ukuze siqonde kahle lokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole ukuthi amalungu ancike kwabanye ahlukaniswa kanjani, izinzuzo ezihambisana nalokhu, kanye nezidingo ezithile ezibhekelelwa. Ukuhlukaniswa Kwamalungu Ancike kwabanye Amalungu ancike kwabanye ahlukaniswa ngokwemigomo ethile, okungukuthi, ubudlelwano bawo nomuntu ophakamisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavela ezimweni ezihlukahlukene, njengezingane, abakhubazekile, noma abanye abadinga usizo, bangathola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukuze umuntu abe ngumuntu ohlanganyela, kufanele kube khona ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komuntu ophakamisayo nomuntu ohlanganyela. Izinhlobo Zamalungu Ancike kwabanye Ngokwesiko, amalungu ancike kwabanye ahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene. Lezi zigaba zifaka phakathi: 1. Izingane: Lezi zihlukaniswa njengamalungu ancike kwabanye uma zineminyaka engaphansi kwengu-21, noma uma zifunda. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zithola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo ukuze zikhule kahle. Abantu Abakhubazekile: Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuziphatha ngenxa yokukhubazeka, angabhaliswa njengomuntu ohlanganyela. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele, oluhambisana nezidingo zakhe. Abantu Abadala: Abantu abaphezulu kweminyaka ethile, ikakhulukazi abakhubazekile noma abadinga usizo, bangabhaliswa njengamalungu ancike kwabanye.

Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyazwe khona. Phetha ifomu lesicelo bese ulithumela ehhovisi lakho eliseduzane le-South African Revenue Service Customs and Excise. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwento yokuncishiswa 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10, kanye ne-607.04. Inkampani - bonke abaqondisi, kuhlanganise nomqondisi ongumphathi kanye nomqondisi wezezimali. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salensizakalo. Le nsizakalo itholakala mahhala. Uhlobo lweklayenti 4 - Umkhiqizi Ngaphansi kwe-AGOA, DA185. Imininingwane yokuphepha, DA185.

Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Abantu baphenduka bezobona imidlalo, bejabulile, bezwa ukuthi imidlalo ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, lapho abalingisi, abaqondisi, nababukeli behlangana ukuze bakhe umhlaba ophilayo. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yabe isiyindawo yokuxoxa, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezifiso, futhi yathola indawo ebalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu. Njengoba imidlalo yeshashalazi iqhubeka, kwavela abalingisi abasha, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. UThandiwe, intombazane eyayiphuma emakhaya, waba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi imidlalo ingashintsha impilo yomuntu. Waqala ukudlala indima encane, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waba yinkanyezi enkulu. UThandiwe wayenenhloso yokudlala, futhi wayefuna ukwabelana ngempilo yakhe nabanye. Waqhubeka nokukhula, waba yisithombe sokuphumelela, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuba balandele amaphupho abo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola izinkanyezi eziningi. Kwakukhona uSipho, owayengumculi, noNandi, owayengumqondisi. Bobabili babebambisene, behlanganisa umculo, ukudansa, nezinkanyezi eziphilayo. Imidlalo yabo yabe ibonisa ubuhle bokuphila, ubudlelwano, nezinkinga zomphakathi. Ababukeli babebonisa uthando, behlabelela, bejabulile, futhi bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo. Kodwa, njengazo zonke izinto, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibhekana nezinselelo. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho abantu bebengakuthandi, noma imidlalo ingatholi ukwesekwa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola, sokubuyisela emuva, nokucabanga ngempilo.

Phambilini, ukubaluleka kwezilwane nemvelo endaweni yezilwandle njengokudingeka okubalulekile kokuthuthukiswa akukabhekwanga kahle ezinqumweni ezithathwe eNingizimu Afrika. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubona izinzuzo ezivela ezilwandle. Inani lezinsiza ezitholakala ezilwandle, ngonyaka ka-1998, lalilinganiselwa ku-R168 billion ngonyaka, okuyinzuzo elinganiselwa ku-35% yomkhiqizo kazwelonke wezomnotho wezilwandle. Umnotho obalulekile uxhumene nezilwandle futhi uqhubeka usebenzisa ngendlela engafanele, okungabandakanya ukwakhiwa nokuhamba. Amathuba okuthuthukiswa abalulekile noma kukhona inkinga yokuphuma kwawo, futhi ukuvumelana kwamathuba kubantu bonke kuyalahleka, futhi izilwane nemvelo yezilwandle nazo ziyaphazanyiswa. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ugcizelela futhi ukuphathwa kwemvelo okuzoqinisekisa ukuthi imvelo yezilwandle isetshenziswa ngendlela esheshayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi impilo yemvelo nezitshalo, ukuhamba kwenzeke ngendlela efanele. Ukuze impilo yezilwane nemvelo ibe nephephile ukuze isetshenziswe ngendlela esheshayo, akufanele kuholele ekuphileni kwezilwane nemvelo. Ukuze amathuba okuzijabulisa ezilwandle atholakale kubo bonke ngokulinganayo, umphakathi osebenzisa izilwandle kufanele ufundiswe ukuze ubambisane futhi unakekele, ikakhulukazi ukuvuselela abampofu kanye nemiphakathi abavela kuyo, kubandakanya abesifazane nezingane. Ukuze le sistimu isebenze, umphakathi kufanele ube namathuba angcono, imisebenzi, futhi ube neziqhamo ezizuzisayo. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni awuzange uveze kuphela umbono, imigomo, nezinhloso mayelana nokuphathwa okufanele kwezilwandle eNingizimu Afrika.

Umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi kumele aphendule ezinsukwini eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo sakho. Uma umphathi wolwazi ekwenqaba ukufinyelela kulwazi oluceliwe, ungafaka isikhalazo kumphathiswa wezobulungiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho. Uma unganelisekile ngemiphumela, ungafaka isikhalazo enkantolo. Umphathi wolwazi noma umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi uzokweseka kulolu hlelo. Uma ulwazi oluceliwe lungatholakali emnyangweni kahulumeni kodwa lukhona enhlangano kahulumeni, umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi uzothumela isicelo sakho kumphathi wolwazi waleyo nhlangano kahulumeni ezinsukwini eziyi-14. Inhlangano kahulumeni efanele kumele iphendule isicelo sakho ngesikhathi. Uzokwaziwa uma lokhu kwenzeka. Xhumana neNhlangano Yokufinyelela KwiNgcaciso yeMnyango Wezobulungiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho ngenombolo: 012 315 1715, ukuze uthole ukuthi izimali zishintshile yini. Izimali ezikhokhwayo kumarekhodi enhlangano kahulumeni zikhona njengoba kuchaziwe ezinhlinzekweni zamanje zomthetho.

Ukuqinisekisa inombolo yempesheni kahulumeni (GEMS government pension number verification) KwaZulu-Natal, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi kahle le nqubo, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlose ukuthola izinzuzo ezihambisana nokusebenza kwabo. Uhlelo lwezempilo lukahulumeni, oluhlanganisa izinsiza ezifana noGEMS, lunikeza ulwazi olubalulekile kubasebenzi, okukhuthaza ukuthola impesheni. Ukuze umphakathi uqonde kahle, sizobheka ngokuqondile ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni, futhi sihlole imithetho nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izidingo zempesheni zifinyelelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenzisa kahle izinsizakalo zempesheni, ikakhulukazi uma beqinisekisa izimali ezithile. Uma uhlose ukuqinisekisa inombolo yakho yempesheni, kudinga ukuthi ulandele izinyathelo ezithile. Ungasebenzisa izinsiza eziku-inthanethi, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi unayo ikhadi leGEMS, noma ubhalise online. Izikhangiso ezithile zingasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngalezi zinyathelo. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu abasha baqonde imithetho edingekayo ukuze baqedele le nqubo. U-GEMS uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezibalulekile kubasebenzi, futhi uthola ukufinyelela kumalungelo nezinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uyakwazi ukuhlela kahle izimali zawo, futhi uhulumeni uqinisekile ukuthi ulwazi lutholakala kalula. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, futhi abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi umphakathi uhlanganise izixazululo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Ukukhokha izindleko zemishwalense nezempilo kudinga ukuqonda ukuthi inombolo yempesheni iyaphuthuma, futhi abantu badinga ukukhuthazwa ukuze bazi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo ziyatholakala.

Sifunda kulokho okusehlelayo ngesikhathi siqalisa umgomo esinikwe igunya lawo lokulungisa kabusha impahla yombuso, nokuhlola udaba ngalunye ngokuphathelene nezinhloso zokuhlela kabusha kanye nentuthuko. UMnu. Masilela waba negalelo ekukhululekeni kwezwe lakithi futhi wayeyisisebenzi esithembekile sabantu bakithi kanye nohulumeni waseNIngizimu Afrika kusukela sithole intando yeningi. Empeleni ngifuna ukuthi lokhu kwaziwe ukuthi ngakutshela uJenene Knobel, wabukeka ethukile impela ngesikhathi evuma ukuthi lezi yizikhali zokubulala. I-GDP kuqikelelwa ukuthi ngokuqhathaniswa kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwemininingo ehlukene eqoqiwe, ehlanganisa nochungechunge lwemininingo yakamuva yezomnotho nezezimali yakwa-Statistics SA. Bathola imiklomelo ephezulu kumaphrojekthi yomabili, kwiphrojekthi yezendawo kanye nezinhlelo zokusiza umphakathi. Akukho emthethweni ukuthi usebenzise imali yakho yesibonelelo sikahulumeni ukuthi uthole imalimboleko komashonisa. Ubudlelwane namakhasimende ethu buqiniswa ukuxhumana njalo. Zonke lezi izindaba ezidinga ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zombuso kanye nokubandakanywa kwabantu abaningi ukuze kwakhiwe kabusha umphakathi wakithi kuyo yonke imikhakha. Ukufaka izinhlelo zokuzifundela ngokucebiswa ngalokho okufuneka ukwenze kanye namacebo lapho kungenzeka khona, kuzongena endaweni yendlela encike kakhulu kubasebenzi neyindlela yokufunda ejwayelekile. Ukuhlonza ama-flashpoints, amaphethini obugebengu kanye nalokho okuphambili okuphambene nobugebengu kwasemphakathini kanye nokukhuluama ngalokhu nohulumeni wasekhaya kanye namaphoyisa kanye nokuzibandakanya ekusombululeni izinkinga. Yebo, impela sazi ukuthi kwakuphezulu kakhulu kunalokho okwakuklanyiwe.

Akukho ingxenye yale ndatshana engaphindwa noma idluliselwe nganoma iyiphi indlela noma ngabe iyiphi indlela ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhalwe phansi efanele. Umthetho ophathelene nobufakazi uyithuluzi elibalulekile kunoma ubani ofisa ukuba uchwepheshe bezomthetho futhi asebenze ngaphakathi kwalo. Ukusebenzisa leli thuluzi kahle nangokwaneliseka, kubalulekile kumuntu ukuba nolwazi ngezisho ezithile ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa njalo ngababhali bezomthetho eMthethweni Wobufakazi. Inhloso yalolu shwankathelo ukuhlela nokufundisa abantu ukuze bakwazi ukubona nokujwayela lezi zisho ezibalulekile ezisetshenziswa eMthethweni Wobufakazi futhi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emifushane ebasiza ekulandeleni izindaba eziphathelene neMthethweni Wobufakazi. Ubufakazi buhlanganisa ulwazi olukhonjiswe phambi kwecala ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi ikomidi lenze isinqumo esisekelwe ezimweni zecala. Ubufakazi obubalulekile bukhuluma ngawo wonke ulwazi nezinto ezingasetshenziswa njengobufakazi enkantolo. UMthetho Wobufakazi uphathelene nokwethulwa kwezimfanelo nokulawulwa kokuthi izimfanelo zethulwa kanjani ngokwethembeka. Izimfanelo zingathulwa zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto ezibonakalayo. Umfanekiso olandelayo ubonisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezikhala zomthetho; ubonisa ukuthi uMthetho Wobufakazi uhamba kuphi, incazelo yeMthethweni Wobufakazi, kanye nophawu lokuthi yini eyenza ubufakazi obubalulekile nokuthi yini equkethwe. Impikiswano ethulwe ngombuso kanye neqembu lokuvikela ayithathwa njengobufakazi kodwa iyisithako esisiza enqubweni yokwenza izinqumo.

Kungani amahlamvu ommbila engaluhlaza? Kulokhu, izitshalo zommbila zikhule kakhulu kangangokuthi singabona uma kunokushoda kokudla emhlabathini noma cha. Le nkathi ikunika ithuba elihle lokuhamba emapulazini akho ukuze ubone uma kungase kube nezinkinga futhi ucabange ukuthi ungazivimbela kanjani lezi zinkinga (njengokushoda kwe-nitrogen okungalungiswa ngokufaka i-LAN phezulu) nezinye izindaba ezingalungiswa ngaphambi kokufika konyaka omusha. Lapho sibheka izitshalo, kuzoba sobala ngokushesha uma kunenani elanele le-nitrogen emhlabathini ngoba zizoba namahlamvu aluhlaza kakhulu. Ukushoda kwe-nitrogen kuyabonakala uma uthola izitshalo ezincane ezinomhlamvu omncane oluhlaza noma ophuzi. Lokhu kuphuzile kuvame ukwenzeka ekugcineni kwamahlamvu (lapho kukhulu) bese kuncipha phakathi kwamahlamvu. Uma lokhu kushoda kubi, lezo zindawo eziphuzile ziba mnyama futhi ihlamvu iyafa. Amahlamvu amadala avame ukukhombisa lokhu kushoda kuqala. Ukushoda kwalokhu kubonakala ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezinye zikhombisa ngamaqhwa amasha amhlophe. Ukuphuzile kuboniswa nasezindaweni ez sides phakathi kwamahlamvu. Lokhu kushoda kuyabonakala futhi uma amahlamvu aphezulu ephuza. Iz sides, maphakathi, nezikhala ngokuvamile zihlala ziluhlaza. Ngokuvamile, izitshalo azikhuli kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile phakathi kwe-amino acids kanye ne-proteins. Ngoba kudingeka ekukhuleni kwesitshalo, kuba ingxenye yesakhiwo sesitshalo. Ukushoda kwalokhu kuyabonakala uma amaqhwa amasha emhlophe, ngokuvamile wonke amahlamvu esitshalo avame ukuba nombala ophuzi oluhlaza - akukho mehluko omkhulu phakathi kwamahlamvu amasha namadala.

Abalimi bakhuluma ngempumelelo nemithwalo ethile yokulima. Izifundo ezenzakalayo, ezifana nezibalo zezimali, ukwenza kahle kwezinsiza, nakho konke okubhalwe phansi, kuxhumene nendlela yokubambisana yokugcina imiphumela. Ubulili buphawulekayo phakathi kokufunda kwezimpawu, ukwakha izindlela ezikahle zokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokulima. Umphakathi ubheke ukuze ube neqhaza elikhethiwe elikulandelayo, ukuze uzame ukucubungula nezixhumanisi zempilo eziqinile. Ngesikhathi somcimbi, imifino eyanele yalethwa ezindaweni ezahlukahlukene, ibhizinisi lokuphuma kwamasiko azihambisani namatekhnoloji amasha. Lokhu kuhlangenwe nakho kwezivakashi kukhombisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende, osomabhizinisi, nabalimi, ukuveza impilo efanele nezikhungo ezivulekile. Abalimi baphinde bamba iqhaza emihlanganweni ebusuku, bexoxa ngokushintshwa kwemikhuba, izimidlalwana, nezinguquko ezethulwayo emhlabeni wezolimo. Uphenyo lokugcina lwaholela ekutheni bahlanganyele imicabango, bahlola izinkinga zokulima impilo okuthinta abaninimzi, nezehlakalo ezicebile. Izixazululo eziphakanyisiwe zafaka ezokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi komphakathi nabalimi, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokulima, nokwakha amathuba okusebenza. Ngemva kwalokhu, umbono omusha uphumelele, uhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithokozisayo zemvelo yokulima. Ukwenziwa kokugcina kumqoka kakhulu ukwazisa imikhiqizo ezishayabala ubuso bomhlaba, ukuqinisekisa ukuzenzela nokukhula kwezokuhlala. Ubusuku bahlale bebambisene, besebenzisa izinsiza eziphansi, abafuna ukuba babonise izifundo ezihamba phambili ezinjengokwakhiwa komphakathi ukuze benze ibhizinisi elihle.

Ngesikhathi kukhishwa izitifiketi , ukusikazwa kokuthi uMthethosisekelo osebenzayo wawehluleka ukusungula izinkantolo zendabuko (njengoba kubiza umgomo woMthethosisekelo XIII) waphikiswa. Ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo osebenzayo izinkantolo ezisebenza ngaphansi komthetho ophathelene namasiko zichazwa njenga 'noma iyiphi inkantolo eyakhiwe noma eyaziswa wumthetho njengoba kuhlonza iPhalamende.' Kodwa-ke, ngenxa yokuthi ababusa ngendlela yendabuko babuye babe abashayi bemithetho, kushiwo ukuthi njengamajaji, abakwazi ukungathathi hlangothi njengoba kufunwa yiFCs 156 . KuBangindawo nabanye ebhekene Ikhanda leNyanda Regional Authority nabanye 1998 SA 262 (Tk), abamangali basebenzisa le nkulumo ukuphikisana nenkantolo yesifunda yaseTranskei. Inkantolo enkulu yakuchitha lokhu kuphikisa ngesizathu sokuthi ukuhlolwa komthetho wokuhlalisana ngokuzimela nokungathathi hlangothi yayisetshenziswa. E-Afrikha, nakuba ungacacile kahle umehluko phakathi kokwakhiwa kwemithetho nokusetshenziswa kwayo kodwa akukho muntu oke akhononde ngendlela abaholi bendabuko abasebenzisa ngayo amandla abanawo ekushayweni kwemithetho. nesesi 1017 - 18 inkantolo yagcizelela ukuthi abaholi bendabuko abanaso isiqiniseko sokuthi umsebenzi wabo uzohlala ukhona njengamajaji nokusekelwa yisigaba se-177 soMthethosisekelo. Icala likaMhlekwa alihambanga ngaphezu kwelikaBangindawo, nelaligxile ekuphathweni kwamacala emibango. NgokukaBennet, lo mphumela uyiwo emacaleni emibango, ukuthi uyahambisana yini noMthethosisekelo kumele kukalwe ngokuqhathaniswa nokutholakala kosizo lomthetho.

noma ukuthi kufanele kube kukhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 10; noma iii yenqubo noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi. a umngcele wezindlela noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi ekhombisa kuphela eyodwa ethinta ngaphandle kwezindawo ezikhonjiswe esigabeni -, iMEC ingakhetha ukungashintshi le ndlela; noma b kokubili indlela noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi ekhombiswe ngaphezulu kwezinga lokwakha ibonakale ngaphandle kwezindawo ezikhonjiswe esigabeni -, ukubekwa kwendlela ngokuhambisana nezigaba 6 kuya ku-k kufanele kwenziwe ngendlela yokuthi indlela noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi ekhombiswe ngaphezulu kwezinga lokwakha ibonakale ngaphandle kwezindawo ezichaziwe. kanye nezintshisekelo zabanikazi ababhalisiwe nalabo abanamalungelo abhalisiwe kulezo zindawo c Izintshisekelo nemisebenzi yezikhandla nezinsizakalo ezizokwazi ukuthi zingathinteka ngqo noma ngqo ngaphezulu kwezinga lokwakha; futhi d Imvelo. a uhlelo lwezinga lokwakha kanye nombiko obhalwe phansi kufanele kulungiswe; futhi b uphenyo lwezemvelo kanye nombiko obhalwe phansi ngakho kufanele kwenziwe njengoba kukhombiswe yisikhungo esifanele esigabeni 22 se-ECA, noma isikhungo esikhonjiswe ezigabeni ezifanele ze-NEMA, uma lezi zigaba zisebenza, zingathatha isinqumo, futhi iMEC kufanele ilandele inqubo echazwe kulesi sigaba. d ngezindlela zokuphatha ezenzeka ngaphansi kwesigaba 9 lapho ukuvunywa kwezinga lokwakha kukhishwa ngaphansi kwesigaba -; futhi e ithuba, ngesikhathi nangendlela efanele, yokudlulisa imibono mayelana nohlelo lwezinga lokwakha kanye nombiko wezempilo.

Lezi zithangami zemithetho ephathelene nobulungiswa, ezisebenza ngaphansi kwezizinda zezinkantolo ezingama-217 ziphethwe yizimantshi, zilalela amacala angaphakathi kwama-80 nama90% okungezwani. Uhlobo lokungezwani oluvamise ukulethwa phambi kwenkantolo yendabuko kujwayele ukuthi kube yilawo amayelana nemindeni, imibango yemihlaba nezimpahla. Izithangami zemithetho yendabuko zibhekelela. Nakuba uhlelo lwemithetho yase-India luhlelwe kahle futhi lusebenza ngendlela, izinkantolo zibhekene nezinkinga ezine ezisemqoka; inani lezinkantolo namajaji kuwo wonke amazinga akwanele, kube nokwenyuka emacaleni okumele alalelwe kule minyaka ngenxa yezenzo ezinokungethembeki ezenziwa yilabo abakuhulumeni, imali edleka ngokushushisa amacala ezinkantolo zezimantshi iphezulu ngenxa yezimali ezikhokhelwa abammeli nezimali ezongezwa ngaphezulu, nokulibaziseka kokuthethwa kwamacala ngenxa yokuthi ahlala ehlehla nokugcina kwenze izinkantolo zasalela emuva ngenani lamacala athethwayo. Abahlwempu bakuthola kunzima ukushushisa icala ngenxa yokubiza kwezinto. Amajaji asezinkantolo eziphakeme alokhu egcizelela ukuthi abantu abahlwempu kumele bathole ukummelwa mahhala. Okunye okungenziwa, ukuthi kusetshenziswe izinkantolo zabantu, lapho kwenziwa khona ubulungiswa ngaphandle kokulandela ubuchule bomthetho. Uhlelo lwezinkantolo zabantu lwaqalwa eGujarat ngoNdasa kowe-1982 kanti manje selusabalale kulo lonke izwe. Ukushintsha kwalolu hlelo kwakuyingxenye yobuciko bokuphungula imithwalo yamacala alindele ukulalelwa ezinkantolo. Lezi zinkantolo zakhiwa ukuze zibhekane namacala asalinde ukuthethwa futhi zihlinzeke ukukhululeka kulabo ababasela izikweletu.

Uhlelo lwe-Victim Empowerment Programme lugqugquzela ukusungulwa kanye nokuxhumanisa izinhlelo nokusebenzisana phakathi kweminyango kahulumeni ehlukene noma kwezinhlelo zemikhakha ehlukene kanye nemigomo yosekelo, ukuvikela kanye nokusiza ngamandla kwabahlukunyezwe wubugebengu nodlame. I-VEP igxila kakhulu kwabesimame nezingane. Abahlukunyezwe wudlame lwasekhaya abakusimo esiphuthumayo bangahlala endaweni yokukhosela isikhathi esiphakathi kwamaviki amabili nezinyanga eziyisithupha, kuye ngezimo zabo. Uhlelo lutholakala kwabahlukunyezwe wubugebengu nodlame. Xhumana nanoma yisiphi isikhungo sabahlukunyeziwe , maqondana nendawo yokukhosela yabesimame abahlukunyeziwe kanye nezingane, ukuthola abanikeza ngenkonzo kahulumeni noma izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni zama-NGO, ezibhekene nonakekelo lwabantu abahlukunyezwe wudlame lwasekhaya. Umeluleki onikeza ngenkonzo yezempilo, ilunga lenkonzo yamaPhoyisa abe-SAPS, noma isikhulu sephoyisa, usonhlalonhle, uthisha, noma omunye umuntu obhekene nezenhlalakahle yabantu abakhalazayo bangena izicelo zomyalelo wokuvikelwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi lapho umuntu ongeyena ohlukunyeziwe eletha isicelo somyalelo wokuvikelwa, kukhona incwadi yokuvuma ebhalwe ngumenzi wesikhalazo, ehambisana nesicelo. Alikho ifomu elibekwe lalokhu kuvuma - incwadi ebhalwe ngumkhalazi yokuvuma yenele. useyingane ngeminyaka ngokomthetho ukhubazekile ngokwengqondo uqulekile noma uma inkantolo ineliseka ngokuthi lowo muntu akakwazi ukwenza ukuvuma ngokwakhe noma ukunikeza imvume.

Ngihlanganyela izifundo zamahhala nabantu abasha abathanda ukuqala amabhizinisi. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma sabelana ngolwazi, siphumelela sonke. Ngithanda ukusiza abantu ukuba bazi ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani, futhi ngiyabavumela ukuba babuze noma yini. Umbuzo 7: Yini oyibona njengomgomo wakho wokugcina? U-Sipho: Umgomo wami wokugcina ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo emiphakathini. Ngifuna ukusungula ibhizinisi elizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhubekayo, futhi ngithanda ukusiza abanye ukuba bathole amathuba. Ngifuna ukuba isibonelo sokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaba nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Isiphetho U-Sipho Mthembu ungumuntu ophumelelayo, futhi izifundo zakhe zikhombisa ukuthi amabhizinisi amancane angaba nomthelela omkhulu. Ukusebenza kanzima, ukufunda, nokuxhumana nabanye kuyizinto ezibalulekile empumelelweni yakhe. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha umnotho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze amabhizinisi amancane, ngoba ayisisekelo somphakathi. U-Sipho ungumfanekiso omuhle wokuthi, uma sinesifiso, singakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu.

Ungqongqoshe angawaqeda amandla okukhulunywa ngawo kwisigatshana 2, uma ibandla kumbe inhlangano icelile ukuthi makasuswe futhi loko kufanele akushicilele kwiGazethi. UNgqongqoshe kanye nanoma imuphi umphathi-hhovisi wakwahulumeni ogunyazwe nguNgqongqoshe angamnikeza umuntu ongumfundisi wanoma yiluphi ukholo, uma ethole isicelo esibhalwe phansi, ukuthi abe ngumshadisi, inqobo nje uma engumfundisi noma enesikhundla esithize kulelo bandla, amandla okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi ngokwaleSahluko nangokosiko-mpilo lwalolo kholo. Onke amandla omuntu ongumshadisi ngaphansi kwesigatshana 4 kufanele abhalwe kumqulu futhi kufankwe nosuku lokuqala kwalawo Mandla kufakwe nemikhawulo abekelwe yona ifakwe kulowo mqulu. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphathi-hhovisi wakwahulumeni ogunyaziwe nguNgqongqoshe, uma ethola isicelo esibhalwe phansi somuntu ogunyaziwe ngaphansi kwesigatshana 4, angawaqeda amandla alowo muntu okushadisa ngokubhala phansi maqondana nokuthi ahlanganise ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi ngaphansi kwale Sahluko. Le sahluko, inqobo ngokuhambisana nesigatshana , asimphoqi umshadisi ukuthi asingaqhe umcimbi wokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi: Inqobo nje uma emazisile uNgqongqoshe ngokubhala phansi ukuthi unembeza wakhe uyaphikisana nokuhlanganisa ophathini ngokwale Sahluko. Isigatshana 1 asisebenzi kubashadisi ababekwe ngaphansi kwale Sahluko.

Noma nini uma umsebenzi ubandakanyeka engozini ephathelene nomsebenzi wabo engaziwa, le ngozi ingaholela ekulimazweni noma ekufeni. Noma nini uma umsebenzi ebika ukulimala kwabo kumqashi wabo, uma ngesikhathi sokubika bephawula ukuthi le ngozi yenzeka ngenxa yomsebenzi ongaziwa. Uma le ngozi iholela ekufeni, ekulahlekelweni kokuzizwa, noma ekusikeni ingxenye ethile yomzimba futhi lapho umuntu olimele ebhekwa njengongenakusebenza okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14, umphathi wesifunda wezokusebenza kufanele futhi aziswe ngokuphuthumayo ngefeksi noma ngefoni. Qedela "Ingxenye A" yekhasi lokuqala le fomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele, ubhale igama, futhi ufake usuku lapho kukhonjiswa khona. Susa "Ingxenye B" efana kakhulu ne "Ingxenye A" ekhasini 1 ngokuyikweleta lapho kunezikhala, nikeza umsebenzi "Ingxenye B" bese umcela ukuthi ayinikeze kudokotela noma esibhedlela lapho baphathwa khona. Ezigamekweni ezinzima, "Ingxenye B" kufanele ithunyelwe kudokotela noma esibhedlela ngokushesha. Qedela "Ingxenye A" ekhasini lesibili le fomu ngokuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yakho ephelele lapho. Thumela umbiko ophelele we-engozi kanye neMbiko Yezokwelapha Yokuqala W.CI. Qedela ifomu elisha mayelana nomsebenzi olimele. Le fomu akufanele ibambezeleke ngoba kulindeleke ukuthi umsebenzi uqale ukusebenza noma imibiko evela kudokotela ilindelwe.

(Lokhu kuyinkinga evamile kubantu abadala ezindaweni zasemakhaya, ikakhulukazi kulabo abantwana babo bahlala emadolobheni noma ezweni elizungezile). I-stigma ehambisana neHIV/AIDS ibangela abantu abadala ukuba babe nezinselelo ezinkulu njengoba bezama ukubhekana nokufa kwamalunga omndeni. Njengoba abantu abadala kufanele babhekane nokusiza izingane zifunde ukujwayela indawo entsha ngaphandle kwabazali bazo. Abantu abadala bangaba abanikeli bemvelo futhi kufanele banikezwe ukwesekwa okuyisisekelo abakudingayo ukuze bakwazi ukubhekana nomthwalo owengeziwe wokunakekela amalunga omndeni agulayo kanye nezizukulwane zabo ezingenabazali, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS. Kubalulekile ukubona abantu abadala ngendima yabo emnothweni wezwe ngezandla zabo futhi banakekele izizukulwane zabo lapho abazali babo besebenza noma befileyo ngenxa yeHIV/AIDS. Izinsizakalo zokwelulekwa kwezempilo yengqondo zemindeni ethinteke yiHIV/AIDS. Lokhu kwenziwa futhi ngamaqembu omphakathi asiza, ebhekana nezinkinga zengqondo nezomzwelo zamalunga omndeni athintekile. Ulwazi olusabalalisiwe ngama-brochure anolwazi mayelana nokuthi ungafinyelela kanjani usizo lomphakathi nokwazi amalungelo akho njengomthwalo kubalulekile. Umkhakha wezebhizinisi, izwe, izinhlangano zenkolo, kanye nezinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni ziye zasiza ngokunikeza usizo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abadinga usizo bayawuthola.

Ungase uzithole ufinyelela emathubeni e-nicotine noma ube nephutha elithinta igazi lakho. Uma ufinyelela ku-nicotine, kusho ukuthi umzimba wakho nomqondo wakho kudinga i-nicotine ngaso sonke isikhathi. Uzizwa udinga lokhu nsuku zonke. Uma uthinteka yinto ethile egazini lakho, kuba nzima ukuyeka. Yingakho abantu abaningi behluleka ukuyeka ukushisa. Kuthiwani nge-snuff (utshwala obungena emathunjini)? I-snuff iqukethe zonke izinto ezilimazayo ezitholakala ezigubhu. Abantu abashisayo i-snuff bangathinteka ngezifo ezithile, ezifana nezifo zomlomo, umphimbo, nezifo ezithinta umoya. Kuthiwani nge-marijuana? Odokotela bathole ukuthi i-marijuana ilimaza umzimba wakho ngendlela efanayo nokushisa utshwala. Uma ufinyelela ekushiseni i-marijuana, uzogcina ungakwazi ukusebenza, ukufunda, ukudlala, noma ukujabulela. Kukhona izinhlobo zembewu ezingalimazi? Cha, azikho. Izigubhu, ama-cigar, amathuluzi, kanye ne-snuff konke kulimaza impilo yakho. Uma umuntu eshisa izigubhu ezimbalwa ngosuku, ingabe lokho kungamphazamisa? Nokho, ukushisa isigubhu esisodwa ngosuku kungalimaza! Ungaqali ukushisa! Umonakalo emzimbeni wakho uqala lapho uqala ukushisa. Ungase ubukeke unempilo iminyaka eminingi ngaphambi kokuthi izimpawu zesifo ziqale ukuvela. Ingabe kubi ukufaka umoya ophuma kubantu abanye? Yebo, ungathola izifo eziningi uma uphila noma usebenza nomshisi. Lokhu kungenzeka ngoba uphefumulayo umoya wabo nsuku zonke.

Ipasipoti enkulukazi yidokhumende enamakhasi angu-64 elungiselelwe abantu abahamba njalo . Ipasipoti enkulukazi iyefana nephasipoti yabavakashi , ngaphandle kokuthi yona inamakhasi aphindwe kabili ukuze kube namakhasi amaningi evisa. isebenza iminyaka engu-10 ukusukela ngosuku ekhishwa ngalo. Lapho wenza isicelo, kumele ube nomazisi wakho noma isitifikedi sokuzalwa. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-73 ulihambise wena mathupha ehhovisi eliseduzane loMnyango wezaseKhaya. Lihambise kwiNxusa yeNingizimu Afrika noma i-mission uma wenza isicelo ungaphandle kwezwe. Yenza ukuthi kuthathwe izigxivizo zeminwe yakho ukuze irekhodwe kuhla lwabantu ezweni. Fakela nezithombe ezimbili zosayizi wepasipoti. Uma ungakabi nawo umazisi , nakhona uxinwe yisikhathi, ungenza isicelo sakho kokubili ngasikhathi sinye, ipasipoti kanye nomazisi. Izicelo zingathatha isikhathi sokufinyelela kumaviki ayisithupha.

Akukho meluleki ozobamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo sokugcina sokunikeza ibhidi. Akukho ukuthatha izinqumo kogunyaziwe okumele kunikezwe umeluleki. Uhlelo olulandelayo lubhekene nawo wonke amabhidi okuncintisana, okusho ukuthi lawo edlula inani elilinganisiwe elingama-R100,000 (kufakwa ne-VAT). I-ofisa Enegunya izakumisa ikomiti lokwakha izincasiselo zebhidi ukuze lakhe izincasiselo zebhidi. ilungu elingaguquki eli-1 (uma nje Ihloko Yesigaba: Impahla ayikho, Inhloko Yesigaba: Yokuthenga izakuba khona), kanye namalungu afanele evela emnyango okutholiswa kuwo impahla nezinsiza. Uma amalungu omnyango afanele engekho, izihloko zaleyo minyango izakudluliselwa emhlanganweni olandelayo. Akukho lungu lekomiti lokucacisa elingaba yilungu lokunquma lekomiti elibheka noma yimaphi amabhidi empahla nezinsiza ezifanayo. Izincasiselo kumele zilungiselelwe ngendlela engabandlululi futhi ziqukethe imininingwane eyanele yamakhotheshini namathenda okumele ahlolo ngokunomqondo. Uma unaka Uhlaka Lwenqubomgomo Lokutholiswa Kokukhethwayo, izici ezicacisiwe zokunikeza amaphuzu kumele zifakwe embhalweni webhidi. Izincasiselo zizawuvunywa yi-Ofisa Enegunya ngaphambi kokukhangisa ibhidi. Uma kungekho i-Ofisa Egunyaziwe lomsebenzi unganikezwa UMqondisi: Wezinsiza Zomphakathi noma i-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu. I-Ofisa enegunya izakumisa ikomiti lokuhlola ibhidi ukwenza imisebenzi yokuhlola ebekwe ku-4.7 ukuya 4.9 ngenhla. Umgcinisihlalowekomiti lokuhlola ibhidi uzakukhethwa yi-Ofisa Enegunya futhi uzakushintshwa shintshwa njalo ngonyaka.

Noma ubani ofuna ukuveza ukuphikiswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa njengabangane kufanele akhiphe lokho ebhalwe phansi kumphakathi wokushada ozohola umcimbi walobo budlelwano. Kumele kube ukuthi uma umphakathi wokushada ethola lokho ukuphikiswa, kufanele afune izizathu zalo ukuphikiswa ngokuphikisana nenhlangano kuze kube athola ukwaneliseka ukuthi awekho amaphikiso omthetho kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa, bese angaphumelela ukuhlela umcimbi wobudlelwano. Uma futhi enganeliseki, kufanele aphikise ukuhlanganiswa kobudlelwano futhi abhale phansi izizathu zalo. Umphakathi wokushada angahola umcimbi futhi abhalise nganoma yisiphi isikhathi futhi ngosuku oluthile lwesonto, kodwa akaphoqelekile ukuhlela umcimbi nganoma yisiphi esinye isikhathi ngaphandle kokuphakathi kuka-8 a.m. no-4 p.m. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele ahole umcimbi futhi abhalise endaweni yomphakathi noma endlini yangasese noma endaweni ebekwe phansi ngalokho, ngezicabha zivulekile kanye nezinsizwa zikhona kanye nezifakazelo ezimbili ezingafakaza, kodwa lezi zimo zangaphambilini kule ngxenye azivimbi umphakathi wokushada ukuba ahole ubudlelwano babantu kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwalokhu okukhuluma lapha, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwalesi sikhala esikhuluma ngaso, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngenxa yokugula okukhulu noma ukungabikhona okude, noma uma kukhona ukulimala komunye wamaqabane, noma kulabo abesilisa nabesifazane abafuna ukuhlanganiswa. Akekho ovunyelwe ukungena esivumelwaneni sobudlelwano ngaphansi kwale ngxenye egameni lomunye umuntu emcimbini. Mayelana nobudlelwano noma umshado ngesikhathi sokufunda amazwi okuhlanganisa.

Ukusetshenziswa kwalesi sigaba kusebenza lapho iMEC ikhipha amandla ngaphansi kwesigaba a mayelana nokubekwa kwendlela nokuklama izindlela zomphakathi noma izindlela zokuhamba zomphakathi. a Ukubekwa kwendlela; futhi b ukuklama njengemigqa. Ukubekwa kwendlela kufanele kuhambisane nanoma iyiphi infrastruktur noma enye uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi olwakhiwe ngaphansi komthetho wokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, uma kungenjalo, ukuvunywa kwamalungu eNhloko, okuwukuthi, leyo ehlela ukuthuthukiswa, kufanele kutholakale ngaphambi kokubekwa kwendlela ngaphakathi kwalesi sigaba. Ekukhishweni kombiko mayelana nendlela ngaphansi kwesigaba-. Ukukhuthazwa Kwezokuphatha Ubulungiswa, 2000 (Umthetho 3 ka-2000), noma ukungahambisani nale mfuneko, njengoba kuchazwe yiMEC; khona-ke b wenze uphenyo ngokuhambisana nenqubo echazwe. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana nomphakathi, ikhomishini kufanele ilungise umbiko obhalwe phansi ngakho, ihlinzeka ngama-policy asunguliwe esigabeni 3 soMthetho Wokuthuthukisa Ukuhlinzeka, 1995 (Umthetho 67 ka-1995) kanye noMthetho Wokuhlela Nokuthuthukisa wesifunda. Uma kukhona ukungavumelani kwekhomishini mayelana nokusetshenziswa komhlaba okumele kuxoxwe embikweni, le ndaba kufanele ixoxwe ngendlela echazwe yiBhodi Yezikhandla ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo ngaleyo ndaba. Ngenxa kwesigaba 7, "indaba yokusetshenziswa komhlaba" kusho indaba ephathelene nezinguquko ekusetshenzisweni kwanoma yiluphi umlandela olungathinteka ngokubekwa kwendlela. Imithetho yale ndawo ayisebenzisi ezindleleni ezincane. b Ikhono lokushintsha indlela kanye nezindleko zayo, uma kwenzeka isicelo samukelwa.

Lokhu kudale ukuthi ukufunda kube lula, futhi kube nemiphumela emihle. Kodwa-ke, kufanele kucaciswe ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona njengokuphela kwendlela yokufunda. Kubalulekile ukubhekisisa ukuthi kungani abafundi behluleka ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza, futhi kuthiwani uma umphakathi ungakabi nesiqiniseko sokuthi ukuthola ubuchwepheshe kuyatholakala kubo bonke. Ukubambisana komphakathi Uhlanga olukhulu lokuthuthukisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi lutholakala ekubambisaneni phakathi kwemiphakathi. Uma imiphakathi ibambisana nezikole, kudala izinhlelo zokuxhasa abafundi, ngaleyo ndlela kuthiwe kulula ukuvuselela izinga lokufunda. Izinhlelo ezifana nezokubambisana phakathi kwabazali, umphakathi, kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ziwusizo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe neqhaza elikhulu, sihlinzeke ngezinsiza, futhi siphendule ezidingweni zabafundi. Isiphetho Njengoba sithanda ukufunda, kubalulekile ukuba siqonde ukuthi izinga lokufunda kwabafundi alikona nje ukushaya amaphuzu ezivivinyweni, kodwa kuyindlela yempilo. Kuhle ukuqonda ukuthi abafundi bahluka, banelungelo lokufunda ngendlela ehlukile. Umphakathi, izikole, nabafundisi badinga ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze kube nempumelelo. Ngakho, kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze sithuthukise izinga lokufunda, siqinisekise ukuthi sonke sithola ithuba elifanele lokuhlola, ukufunda, nokuqhamuka nezinqumo ezithembekile. Lokhu akusizi nje abafundi, kodwa kuthuthukisa umphakathi wonke.

Ngokufa, ukuqedwa, ukungenzi kahle kwebhizinisi noma ukubasezikweletini zelungu elinamalungelo. Uma ngabe amalungelo amade esekhishiwe, umnyango ubukwazi ke ukuvuma ukuthi amalungelo adlulielwe phambili.kwesikhathi sokuqala , kuhlangene lezizizathu ezingaphezulu. Basaqhubeka nokudlala indima ebalulekile emphakathini, kanti nohulumeni wentando yeningi naye uzibophezele ethuthukiseni intsha, njengabaholi bakusasa kanye nabagcini benkululeko yethu esayithola kanzima. Izinselelo intsha ebhekene nazo. Ukungatholakali kwezinsiza eziyisisekelo. Umthelela wegciwane lesandulela-ngculaza kanye nesifo sengculaza uqobo iwuzwele kakhulu intsha. Imizi ephethwe yintsha nezingane ezincane iyanda ngenxa yokushona kwabazali bebulawa yizifo ezingosomathuba, ezifana nesifo sofuba ezisondelene negciwane leandulela-ngculaza nesifo sengculaza uqobo. Ethula iNkulumo kaMongameli ngeSimo seZwe, uMongameli uJacob Zuma uthe unyaka wezi-2011 owokwenza amathuba emisebenzi. Uthe ukuqashwa kwabantu kumele kubhekiswe ekukhuliseni ukuthuthukiswa kwentsha. Ukubhekana nokusweleka kwemisebenzi, uhulumeni ufaka imali ukukhokhela izindleko zokuqasha abantu abasha ukugqugquzela abaqashi ezinkampanini ezizimele ukuthi baqashe abantu yize noma bengakaze basebenze ngaphambilini. Indaba yokuthuthukiswa kwezemfundo, amakhono kanye namabhizinisi amancane entsha kukhulunyiwe ngayo kakhulu enkulumweni yesabiwomali eyethulwe nguNgqongqoshe wezeziMali uPravin Gordhan, sangonyaka wezimali wezi-2011/2012. UNgqongqoshe wezezimali uveze ukuthi usizo lwezimali zabafundi luzokhushulwa ukuze kunikezwe intsha eningi ithuba lokuqhubeza izifundo zabo kanye nokuqeqeshwa emakolishi, ukuze bathuthukise amakhono. Kwafakwa imali eyengeziwe esiKhwameni sikaZwelonke samaKhono, okuyimali ebekelwe ukuqeqesha abafuna umsebenzi.

Hamba emgwaqweni. Uma kungekho umgwaqo, sebenzisa uhlangothi olufanele lomgwaqo kude nomgwaqo. Uma uhamba emgwaqweni, qiniseka ukuthi uhamba ohlangothini olufanele kude nomgwaqo, ngamagama amanye, ubheke ezimotweni ezisondela. Izimoto eziningi zihamba ngezikhathi ezahlukene emigwaqweni ehlukene, ngakho kubi kakhulu ukuba izingane zidlale emgwaqweni/ohlwini lomgwaqo. Uma ingane idlala emgwaqweni, umshayeli osondela angase angakwazi ukuhamba noma ukumisa ngokushesha. Lokhu kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Hamba njalo ubheke ezimotweni ozihlangabezana nazo ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezisondela ngesikhathi. Izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-12 azinakho ukukala ukuthi kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze imoto ifike kuzo. Konlya cross emgwaqweni uma kuphephile ukwenza njalo. Ungagijimi. Ungacross emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezifihlekile ezifana nezikwele nezintaba ngoba kunzima kubashayeli ukubona ngesikhathi. Abahambi ngezinyawo abavunyelwe EMIGWQWENI ENGAMAKHANDA. Linda ibhasi/taxi ukuba ime ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokuphuma. Linda ibhasi/taxi ukuba ihambe ukuze ukwazi ukubona izimoto ezivela kokubili ohlangothini lomgwaqo. Le bhasi/taxi ophumayo ingakushaya. Ungashaywa/ushaywe imoto edlula lapho ibhasi/taxi ophumayo likhona. Konlya cross uma uphakamisa isignali yomphakathi eluhlaza futhi kuphephile ukwenza njalo. Uma isignali yomphakathi ishintsha ivela eluhlaza iye kubomvu ngesikhathi uhamba, qhubeka ubheke emuva nasemaphakathini ukuze ubone izimoto ezisondela. Uma isibani somgwaqo esibomvu sishintsha sibe luhlaza, izimoto ezivela phambili nasezandleni nazo zinegunya lokuhamba manje.

Ukungabi namithetho emileyo kulezi zinkantolo kwenza ukuthi zithandeke futhi zisebenziseke kalula nabantu bazibuke njengezabo, hhayi njengento abaxhilwa ngayo." Abaholi bendabuko basawagcinile amandla abo okuthetha amacala abaqhubeka nokuwasebenzisa nakuba kwaqedwa izinkantolo zendabuko ngeminyaka yokuqala wenkululeko. Nakuba uMthethosisekelo ungazigunyazi izinkantolo zomdabu, abaholi bendabuko nemikhandlu yendabuko sebezandisile izindawo lapho bebusa khona badlula nezinto eziphathelene nemindeni nemibango yezimpahla, lapha singabala nezehlukaniso, ukuthi ubani ozothola ukuhlala nezingane nezemihlaba. UMnyango wezobulungiswa noMnyango woMmeli-Jikelele bakhombisa ukuthi lolu hlelo kumele luhambe kanjani ekubuyiseni uhlelo lwezinkantolo zendabuko olwakhiwa ngaphansi komthetho owashaywa ngo1883 owaziwa ngele-Native Jurisdiction Ordinance. Ukuqeqeshwa kwiADR nakwezinye izinto ezithinta umthetho sekukhuphukile nohlaka lomthetho kuzokwakhiwa ukusimamisa lolu hlelo olubalulekile. Ukubona leli phuzu elimqoka kangaka lamandla okubusa endaweni ethize, izikhungo ezingazodwa njengeBhange loMhlaba zinike umdlandla ekuhlinzekweni koqeqesho lomthetho emakhosini endabuko. Lokhu kusize kakhulu eGhana. Embhalweni othi Information Bulletin oshicilelwe nguhulumeni waseNingizimu Australia, uJohn Tomaino wabhala ukuthi izinkantolo zemisinsi yokuzimilela eNingizimu Australia, ezakhiwa njengohlelo lokuhlola ngonyaka ka1999, zathuthuka ngenxa yokuthi kwakungekho ukwethemba izinkantolo zezimantshi. Abantu bakuleyo ndawo babona ukuthi, njengabaxazululi, babeneqhaza elincane ababelibambile ekushayweni kwemithetho nasekuthathweni kwezinqumo.

Kukhona izizathu eziningi zalokhu, kuhlanganise nezomiso ezivame ukuhlasela le ndawo. Kodwa kuze kube namuhla, uhulumeni wethu usebenza noMkhandlu weGu ukuze kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu lapha banokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile. Umnqopho wethu njengohulumeni uwukuthi wonke umuntu abe nendawo ephephile yokuhlala. Njengohulumeni, sisebenza ngokuzikhandla ukuze sakhe izindlu zabantu bethu ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuzigqaja ngokuba nezindlu ezisemqoka futhi babuyisele ubuqotho babo. Umsebenzi esiwethulayo namuhla uhlanganisa nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kuhambisana kahle nenhloso kahulumeni yokuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Inani labantu abadinga izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kule ndawo liphansi kakhulu, liphakathi kuka-73% wezindlu zonke lapha. Njengoba ngichazile, ikhaya kumele libe nolwazi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezifanele kubeka ezimpilweni zabantu engcupheni futhi kunciphisa ubuqotho babantu bethu. Ngalesi sizathu, sithathe izinyathelo ezibanzi ukusiza wonke amakhaya ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola ngokushesha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlanganisa izindlu, amanzi, ugesi, nezinsiza zokuhlanzeka eziphephile. Njengoba sifeza lo msebenzi wokwakha izindlu zabantu bethu lapha, lo msebenzi uzophinde ube nezinye izidingo zomphakathi ezibalulekile. Siyajabula ukubona ukuthi uMkhandlu weGu usuhambe phambili ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela komphakathi ezinsizeni zokuhlanzeka ezifanele. R4.6 million ukusiza umphakathi wethu lapha eZinqoleni ukuze uthole izinsiza zokuhlanzeka ezihlanzekile. Njengomphakathi, kuyajabulisa ukubona isivinini sokuthi umsebenzi wenziwa sikhula ngoba abantu bethu baphinde balinde lezi zinto isikhathi eside.

Uhlelo Lokutshala Imali ku-Just Energy Transition: Iphrofayela kaSipho Mthembu USipho Mthembu, ongumuntu ophakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu kwezokusebenza kagesi, ungumholi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezokuphatha izinsiza zamandla. Njengomuntu oneminyaka engu-34, udumo lwakhe lukhanya kakhulu emkhankasweni wokuguqula indlela esisebenzisa ngayo amandla. U-Sipho ubonakala njengomholi ohlonishwa kakhulu, egqugquzela imfundo, amandla amasha, kanye namathuba emisebenzi. Wazalwa eThekwini, eNingizimu Afrika, lapho aqala khona ukufezekisa amaphupho akhe okwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe eNyuvesi yaseNatal, uSipho wagxila ezokuphathwa kwezinsiza zezimali, eqonda ukuthi umhlaba udinga izixazululo ezinqala ukuze ubhekane nezinkinga zezimali. E-KwaZulu-Natal, ubona izinkinga ezijulile zokushoda kwamandla, okuholela ekutheni abe nesithakazelo esikhethekile kumkhankaso we-Just Energy Transition, owawuhloselwe ukuguqula indlela esisebenzisa ngayo amandla. U-Sipho uzwa ukuthi izinguquko ezimbonini zamandla zingaba nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini, ngakho udinga izinyathelo ezihlakaniphile. Uhlelo lwe-Just Energy Transition lugxile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisa amandla ahlanzekile, ukunciphisa ukufudumala komhlaba, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. U-Sipho ufuna ukuthi lezi zinguquko zifinyeleleke kuwo wonke umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lempilo. Ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezithuthukisa amandla amasha, uSipho usebenza kanzima ekwandiseni uhlelo lokutshala imali kulolu hlelo.

Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bathole usizo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinkinga ezithinta imizwa. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo akuyona into eyodwa kuphela, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi ukwelashwa akupheli, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube yinto eqhubekayo empilweni yabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele bahlale bexhumana nodokotela, baphinde bahlale bephokophele phambili, beqonda ukuthi izinkinga zingavela futhi zidinga ukwelashwa ngokuqhubekayo. Ekugcineni, ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo kudinga ukuba kube yinto ejwayelekile, hhayi into ethusayo. Umphakathi kumele ube nesithakazelo ekwakheni indawo evulekile, lapho abantu bezwa bekhululekile ukuveza izinkinga zabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola usizo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukubhekana nezinkinga ezithinta imizwa. Ngakho-ke, masisebenzisane ukuze sakhe umphakathi onempilo, lapho wonke umuntu engakwazi ukuthola usizo oludingekayo, futhi wonke umuntu ehlonishwa. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi kuyinqubo yokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ohloniphekile, nolwazi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baphile impilo enempilo, futhi kube lula ukuthi sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke nokukhuluma, masiqhubeke nokufundisa, futhi masiqhubeke nokwakha umphakathi onempilo.

Umhlaba uhluka ngezindlela eziningi: njengokujula nesimo. Kumele sazi uhlobo lomhlaba kanye nokujula kwawo endaweni ngayinye lapho sifuna ukufaka - ungacabangi ukuthi umhlaba wakho ufana kuwo wonke amakhaya! Uhlobo nokujula komhlaba kubalulekile kakhulu lapho ukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo okufanele ufake - ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo azinakufakwa emhlabeni ophakathi. Uma unamahektare anomhlaba ophakathi, akusho ukuthi uphakathi kokuphila - kusho nje ukuthi kufanele uqaphele iqiniso mayelana nezithelo ongazifaka kulezo zindawo ukuze uthole inzuzo (ngamanye amazwi, uhlobo lwezinyosi ezingafakwa emhlabeni ongenamandla ukuze kudaleke izinkomo ezizokuletha inzuzo). Zonke izitshalo zithola izinto ezidingekayo emhlabeni ukuze zikwazi ukukhula. Ezinye izinto ezifana nezimvula nokunyakaza kwamanzi ngaphakathi komhlaba zingathinta ukutholakala kwezinto emhlabeni. Uma umalimi ethatha amasampula omhlaba, bazokwazi ukubona ukuthi isimo sezinto sihamba kanjani nokuthi izinga le-pH likuphi emhlabeni. Uma umhlaba unokushisa kakhulu kodwa kukhona izinto ezanele, isitshalo ngeke sikwazi ukuthola lezo zinto. Uma singazi ukuthi isimo somhlaba sikhona, asikwazi ukukala ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo nokuthi zingaki izinto ezidingekayo ukuze kukhule ukudla okuhle. Zonke izinhlobo zezithelo zinebhande lokushisa elingaphezu kwalokho okukhona, ziba nezinselelo zokukhula kahle. Sidinga ukwazi ukuthi izinga lokushisa nezinga lokubanda kuzoba kanjani unyaka wonke, nokuthi lapho kuzoqala khona ukushisa. Uma sesinayo yonke le mininingwane, singakhetha ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lwezithelo oluhambisana nesimo sezulu nobude besikhathi sokukhula endaweni esilima kuyo.

Isigaba 10 soMthetho oyinhloko sishintshwa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" kunoma yisiphi isigaba lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6".

Simelane. Inombolo yerefurense yezikhalazo, kumele kube nesidingo ukuze ubuze uye phambili ngesikhalazo. Empeleni bazokhuluma nabesilisa abasebancane bese bencinza isitho sangasese, owesifazane uzobe eselunguza aphinde abuyele emuva. Isikolo siyihabhu lomphakathi njengoba abantu benikwa amandla ngolwazi futhi amalungu omphakathi futhi amalungu omphakathi asebenzisa igumbi lekhompuyutha. Ngingesho ukuthi bekukhona yini isignali yokuthi bekumele sidubule nini. Siyanibonga kakhulu ngakho konke lokhu - okusenza sizizwe siluphele. Vakashela i-Bird Island Group yeziqhingi kwindawo esempumalanga kakhulu ne-Algoa Bay. Waphinde wahalaliselwa ngu-Commander wakhe, uKaputeni Strydom ngomsebenzi omuhle awenzile. Ngaphambi kokuba ngiqhubeke ngiphendule abezindaba, ngingathanda ukukhombisa ukubonga eNingizimu Afrika kakhulu ngobungani kanye nemfudumalo abasikhombise kona. Itemu noma isisho esithi udlame lomnyama komnyama impela sasisebenza, futhi kunjalo. Siyethemba ukuthi umgomo ofanayo osebenza ezikoleni zamabanga aphezulu kuzosiza ukugqugquzela isiko lokufunda kubafundi bamazinga aphakeme. Isivumelwano sigcina uhlu lokwengamela okuvunyelwane ngalo kanye nokusebenzisa okumbaxa mbili kwezinto ezibonakala zihambisana nezinhloso zakho, lolu luhlu luhlanganisa namakhemikhali enganyelwe. BoSotswebhu Abakhulu siyanibonga kkahulu ngokungivumela ukuthi ngenze lokhu namhlanje. Umphakathi kanye nomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika kwenziwe ukungalingani kokwabiwa komnotho kanye nezinsiza. Womabili amaqembu azinikela ekuxhumaneni okuqhubekayo ngeso lokwakhiwa kobudlelwane obuhle. Empeleni, ngicabanga ukuthi sizovumelana ukuthi lokhu kuthaza kakhulu izithixo.

Akavunyelwe uhulumeni ukwenqaba nolwazi ngaphandle kwalapho ufuna into angakwazi ukuyithola noma enganamqondo noma ulwazi olufunwayo lunobungozi kwezokuphepha ezweni, emvelweni noma luyimfihlo. Isibonelo: Ufuna ukwazi ngendawo ongaya kuyo ukuyobona izihlahla ezisengcupheni yokushabalala kanye nemidwebo yaBathwa esematsheni. Isicelo sakho solwazi siyenqatshwa ngokwesabela ukuthi ukuveza lolulwazi kungaholela esimweni lapho umphakathi ungantshontsha khona lemvelo, noma ekulinyazweni kwemidwebo. Isicelo solwazi ngenhloso yokuhweba singenqatshwa uma ulwazi luyimfihlo ngempela ngangokuba ukudalula lololwazi kungabeka esimweni esibi lowo ongumnini nonentshisekelo ngalo. Akavunyelwe umuntu ukwenqaba nolwazi lwamazinga okukhiqizwa kwentuthu neminye imikhiqizo kanye nodoti. Isibonelo: Ukudalula imfihlo yokuhweba, okuyisithako noma "ifomula" eyimfihlo ngenhloso yokuhweba ngomkhiqizo kungenqatshwa. Kubalulekile ukuthola ulwazi ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo. Umthelela ongaba mkhulu wokunukubeza imvelo, isigameko esisobala sengozi ephuthumayo noma isimo esicacile sokukholelwa wukuthi umsebenzi olayelwa ukuwenza ungaholela ekulimaleni kwemvelo. Ukusukumela phezulu ulwazi olutholiwe kungaholela ezinyathelweni eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kungenziwa wuhulumeni noma izinhlangothi ezithintekayo ekunqandeni umonakalo emvelweni. I-NEMA ikusiza ezikhathini lapho kungaba lukhuni futhi kuthathe isikhathi ukuqongelela ulwazi olufanele. Eziwombeni ezifana nalezi, iNEMA ithi uhulumeni noma lowo olimaza imvelo kumele aphenye noma aveze ulwazi. Kulesi simo, okufanele ukwenze wukufaka isikhalo.

Ukuthuthukisa amandla obuciko kwezokufundiswa kanye nokuqeqeshwa kanye nokuxhasa imicimbi ebanzi yezobuciko. Ukwakha imboni engeke iphele yobuciko esamdlalo egxile ekutholakaleni kalula, yezinga eliphezulu, ehlukahlukene kanye nelinganisayo kuleyomiphakathi eyayingenawo amathuba, ukuze kuqguqguzeleke inqubekela phambili kanye nokugujwa kwawowonke amagugu asamdlalo aseNingizimu Afrika. Ukudala amathuba kwezobuciko ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ebingenawo amathuba ngaphambili, ukulingana ngobulili, intsha kanye nabakhubazekile. Ukuzama ukuqhakambisa izinto esiziqhenya ngazo kanye nokuvikela amalungelo ngokugcina izinqolobane kanye namagugu esikwazi ukuwabona siphinde siwalalele ukuze asetshenziswe ngabantu kanye noHulumeni waseNIngizimu Afrika ezingeni likazwelonke. Ukuthuthukisa izinga eliphezulu, ukuzibophezela kanye noHulumeni ophethe ngokungenamfihlo ngokusebenzisa izindlela eziphezulu zokuphatha kanye nokugcina amabhuku. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zonke kanye nokuthuthuka kolimi kanye nokuphathwa ngendlela kokuhlukana kwezilimi ngokusebenzisa umgomo wolimi kanye nezenzo zokuhlela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthuka ngokulinganayo kanye nokugcina, ukongiwa, ukuvikeleka, ukuthuthukisa kanye nokwenza waziwe umlando wethu sonke, izimpawu zikazwelonke kanye namagugu. Ukuthuthukisa uhlaka lokusebenza olufanayo lwenzelwe amaBhodi ezikhungo zobuciko okusamdlalo. Ukuqinisekisa ubukhona beNingizimu Afrika ezingeni lomhlaba lobuciko kanye namasiko, futhi kuphinde kunakekeklwe izivumelwano nezwe ngalinye kanye nezamazwe onke, kanye nokushinsthwana ngubuciko namasiko okuvela ezivumelwaneni.

Kuzokwengezwa amabhiliyoni angama-R55,7 ekukhiqizweni kwempahla yasekhaya yonke (gross domestic product) ngo-2010. Enye imali engamabhiliyoni ama-R2 emali esetshenzisiwe ngokwakha izinkundla zezemidlalo ezintsha izosiza ngqo amakhaya ahola kancane. Izivakashi zamazwe angaphandle zizochitha amabhiliyoni ayi-R8,5 eNingizimu Afrika ngo-2010. Phakathi konyaka ka-2007 no-2015, iNingizimu Afrika izosingatha abavakashi bamazwe omhlaba abayizigidi ezimbili ezengeziwe ngenxa yokusingatha amathonamenti. Kwaziwa njengomgubho wamaqhawe, lokhu kuzilolela iNdebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA kudlalwa ngabanqobi bama-Confederation e-FIFA ngayinye kumathonamenti ezifunda, abanqobi be-Ndebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA eyedlule kanye nabasingathi bethonamenti ye-Ndebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA elandelayo. Ngokuxutshwa okuthokozisayo kwamathimba asezingeni lomhlaba - kubandakanya amathimba amathathu kumathimba amane aphezulu emhlabeni - kanye namandla esizwe nemfiva yebhola lezinyawo, iNdebe yeNhlangano ye-FIFA ulwazi okungafanele ukuthi umuntu aluyekele lumeqe. IGibhithe ngokungabuzwa ingenye yamandla amakhulu ebholeni lezinyawo e-Afrika. Iyithimba elinempumelelo kakhulu emlandweni we-African Cup of Nations inamathayithili ayisithupha. Umqeqeshi: u-Hassan Shenat. Ukukalwa ngokwezinga le-FIFA: 22. Ukuvela ku-Ndebe yeNhlangano ye-FIFA: Kanye. Abadlali abavelele: u-Hossam Hassan, Ahmed Hassan, Amr Zaky, Mohamed Zidan. Indlela abahlasela ngayo nesu labo elihlangene libenza bafaneleke ukuzibiza ngamaqhawe ase-Eshiya.

UThandiwe waba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wamafilimu ngemuva kokuphumelela kweyakhe ifilimu yokuqala, ethi "Umoya Wothando," eyakha umbono omusha mayelana nothando phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukahlukene. Le filimu yahamba phambili, yaholela ekubeni ithole imiklomelo eminingi, okuhlanganisa ne-International Film Festival, lapho yafaka khona isithombe esiqhakazile sokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu bezenhlalo ezihlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amaningi, kwavula iminyango yokuxhumana nabanye abaqondisi nabakhiqizi bamafilimu emhlabeni jikelele. Njengomqondisi, uThandiwe unokuhlakanipha okukhulu ekubambeni izimo ezinzima, okunikeza izithombe ezikhangayo nezikhumbulekayo. Uhlonipha izinkolo, izilimi, nemikhosi yamasiko eNingizimu Afrika. Izinhloso zakhe zokwenza amafilimu zifaka ukufundisa, ukukhipha imilayezo ethile, kanye nokukhuthaza abanye ukuze bahlale bephokophele phambili. Ubumbano lwakhe nolwazi oluwusizo lwakha izindaba ezibucayi, ezihambisana nemizwa yeqhawe, ukungabaza, nobunzima obuhambisana nezimo zempilo. Ithuba elilandelayo elalikhankasela uThandiwe kwakungokwakhiwa kwefilimu ethi "Izinyembezi Zothando," ethokozisa izilaleli ngendaba yeqhawe elihamba ngebhasi lothando, elihamba ngaphakathi kwezinselelo ezivamile. Le filimu yashukumisela izincwadi zomphakathi, yanikeza ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngamaqhawe abo, kube nezimo ezithinta ubuhlungu nothando. UThandiwe wayefuna ukwakha ikholwa phakathi kwezilaleli, eyazi ukuthi amafilimu angaba yindlela yokuxhumana ngempela.

Abaholi bendabuko abaqashelwe ukushaya imithetho, kodwa baqashelwe ukuhlala ezihlalweni zobukhosi. Ngakho-ke okudinga babe nakho, ukuthi babe abantu abakulungele ukusebenza, kanti ukukhushulelwa ezikhundleni nokuxoshwa kwabashayi bomthetho akubathinti abaholi bendabuko. UMthethosisekelo ka1993 wahlinzeka ukuthi kukhishwe umyalelo wokuphathwa komthetho wezifundazwe, uma lowo mthetho uwela ngaphansi kwendawo echazwe esigabeni sesi-6 eMthethosisekelweni ka1993, "abasezikhundleni ngokwendabuko" kanye "imithetho yemisinsi yokuzimilela nemithetho ephathelene namasiko" yayibaliwe kulezi zindawo ezichaziwe. Iningi lemithetho ephathelene nokuphathwa kwemithetho zazinikezelwe ezifundazweni. Ukuze kube nohla olulodwa lwemithetho esebenzayo kuzwelonke (hhayi imithetho yeNingizimu Afrikha endala nezabelo esezaphela ebhekelene nezinkinga ezifanayo ezindaweni ezehlukene ezweni), ngemva nje kuka 1994 iMinyango eminingi kahulumeni yakhulisa imithetho yokufanisa imitheshwana yasezabelweni neyaseNingizimu Afrikha. Ukufaniswa kwale mitheshwana kwacisha leyo eyayisebenza ezabelweni, eyayisebenza kulezi zindawo, nemithetho evumelana nayo yaseNingizimu Afrikha yayisebenza kulo lonke izwe. Kodwa-ke lokhu akwenzekanga kuleyo mithetho eyayihambelana nendima nokusebenza kwabaholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Lokhu kwaba ngenxa yokungabi lula kwalezi zindaba nokulinganisa isikhungo sabaholi bendabuko nohlelo olusha loMthethosisekelo, kuzodinga ukubuyekezwa kwenqubomgomo ezoholela emthethweni omusha.

Lokhu kwenza uNandi wacabanga ukuthi akufanele kube nezinselelo, kodwa kufanele kube nesikhathi sokujabula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha azigcini nje ngokubeletha kuphela, kodwa zifaka phakathi ukwelashwa kokuphila kwengane. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikhumbula ukuthi ingane iyisibusiso, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane izalwa iphilile. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. Ngesikhathi esebenza nezinhlaka ezahlukene, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nokuhlinzwa uma kudingeka. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bangathola izinsizakalo zokwelashwa ezikhethekile, ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphumula, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana nezingane. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi zihlala zikhumbula izidingo zomama. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. Njengoba uNandi ehlola izinsizakalo, wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo.
