Ukwengeza: Izingxenye Zokwenza Imfundo Ye-Inthanethi Ikhule Ukuze uthole impendulo efanele kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bakhuthazwe ukuba badlule imikhawulo, bakhulise amazinga abantu abahlinzeki, futhi benze izivumelwano ezihambelana nezinhloso. Ukuze kube nezifundo eziphumelelayo, kuhloko ezimeni ezikhethekile, kuyasiza ukuhlela izinhlelo ezinqunyiweyo, kugcizelelwe abaphathi bezemfundo. Uhlaka olusebenza kahle kumele luhlanganise zokugcina uhlanga lwezimo ezahlukene nabafundi. Njengoba imfundo ye-inthanethi ikhulisa amathuba, kumele kube kube nesikhathi sokuxhumana nokuxhumana phakathi kwabafundi nabafundisi, ukuze kudaleke indawo yokufunda eqinile. Umqondo Wokugcina: Ukufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Njengemfundo Ephuhlisayo Ekugcineni, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kungaphathwa njengendlela ethokozisayo yokufunda, eyandulelayo ekufundeni kwabafundi namuhla. Njengoba sivele besithole izindlela ezintsha zokufunda, kufanele sihloniphe ukukhetha ubuchwepheshe esibutholayo. Kumele silungise izifundo zethu ukuze sikhulise ukukhula kwethu siqhubeke nobunjalo obuphumelelayo. Ngalo mkhuba, le ndlela yokufunda uzokhulisa umfundi, imfundo yethu namuhla iyinsika yokuhlela impilo yazo zokuyivuma emiphumeleni engokwenziwa. Ukufunda nge-inthanethi kuyithuba elimangalisayo, futhi kube nemiphumela emihle ngayo yonke imikhakha yempilo.

Khumbuza iqembu ukuthi umqulu wokuqeqesha uyithuluzi abangabuyela kulo, kanti kumele bangalikhohlwa uma sebehamba oqeqeshweni. Kumele babuyele kulona balisebenzise ngezikhathi zonke uma kunokwenzeka. Batshele futhi ukuthi kungaba isu elihle ukwabelana ngolwazi abalutholile namanye amalungu amakomidi ezigceme angaphumelelanga ukubakhona oqeqeshweni. Gcizelela futhi ukuthi ulwazi lungarnandla nokuthi kumele bafunde kakhulu kunalokhu akulindeleke kubona emisebenzini yabo. Batshele ukuthi yize umqulu wokuqeqesha uyindawo enhle yokuqala, kumele bafunde ngolunye ulwazi ngokungangamandla. Kumele bacele ulwazi kumakhansela abo ezigceme olungabasiza ukuthi benze kahle imisebenzi yabo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu uma sekuyiwa emthethweni okhishiwe - kumele babe nolwazi oluhle ngemithetho ebathintayo ezindimeni zabo. Thola uvo lweqembu ngoqeqesho. Banike amafomu okubhala uvo lwabo ngoqeqesho. Mema imibuzo eqenjini. Babuze imibuzo uma bona bengenayo.

Isithunzi somuntu. Ngokuphelele. umuntu omdala oyilungu lomndeni noma umngane walowo ovalelwe kufanele atshelwe ngokushesha okungase kwenzeka ngokuvalelwa kwalowo muntu. Umuntu ovalelwe unelungelo lokuvela qobo lwakhe phambi kwenkantolo, ukumelwa ngummeli kulolo daba futhi nokwethula izizathu eziphikisa ukuthi aqhubeke esekuvalelweni; futhi (h) Umbuso kufanele wethule phambi kwenkantolo izizathu ezibhalwe phansi zokuthi kubaluleke ngani ukuvalelwa noma ukuqhubeka nokuvalela lowo muntu, ikhophi yezizathu zinikwe lowo ovalelwe okungenani esikhathini esiyizinsuku ezimbili ngaphambi kokuthi inkantolo ibuyekeze ukuvalelwa kwakhe. Uma inkantolo idedela obevalelwe, lowo muntu angeke aphinde avalelwe ngezizathu ezifanayo, ngaphandle uma umbuso ungethula phambi kwenkantolo isizathu esiqinile esenza kube nesidingo sokuthi lowo muntu aphinde avalelwe. Izigatshana (6) no (7) azisebenzi kubantu abangezona izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika futhi abavalelwe ngenxa yempi phakathi kwamazwe Esikhundleni salezo zigatshana, umbuso kufanele uhambisane nemigomo ebophe iRiphabhuliki ngaphansi komthetho wobuntu wamazwe ngamazwe mayelana nokuvalelwa kwalabo bantu. nenhlangano efaka isicelo ngenhloso yokuzuzela amalungu ayo. ingabuka umthetho wezinye izizwe. Uma kuhunyushwa nanoma yimuphi umthetho, futhi uma kuthuthukiswa umthetho owejwayelekile noma umthetho wesintu, yileyo naleyo nkantolo, noma inkundla kumele ikhuthaze umoya, inhloso kanye nezinjongo zoMqulu wamaLungelo.

Uma ethole isjeziso sokwehliswa esikhundleni angakwazi ukubuye afake isicelo sokukhushulelwa esikhudleni ngaphandle kuucwaseka. c. Umqashi akanayo imvume yokukhipha isijeziso uma ummangalelwa efake isicelo sokuba icala lidluliselwe phambili. Umqashwa kumele, afake isicelo sokudluliswa kwecala zingakapheli izinsuku ezinhlanu emva kokuba ethole umphumela, ifomu lesikhalo kumele alilethe kwisiphathimandla esikhiphe isinqumo, noma kumphathi wakhe, yenake ozosedlulisela wkisiphathi-mandla esibhekelene nezikhalazo. a iziphathi-mandla zabaqashwa zabasebenzi noma b isisebenzi esiqokwe iziphathi-mandla, esingakazange sithathe nxexheba ekuthathweni kwesinqumo. Uma ngabe umqashwa engumphathi womnyango othile, noma eyenhloko yomyango isinqumo mayelana nesicelo siyothathwa unDunankulo ofanele noma uMongameli. Uma umuntu ochazwe esigatsheni 8.3 ukuzizwela icala umqashwa kumele asiswe ngosuku kanjalo nangesikhathi. sisekela isikhalo.noma sinciphisa isijeziso, noma gcizelala nge sinqumo/ isiphetho secala. Qaphela: umqashwa unelungelo lokusebenzisa izindlela zokuxazulula ukungaboni, ngasolinye elandela imigudu etholakala ngaphansi komthetho wokuphathwa nokuvikelwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi. Uma ehluleka ukuvumelana noma ukuhambisana nezibopho zomthetho. Uma ephatha izimali zikahulumeni budedengu, ngokungacopheleli ebe enza ngamabomu. Etholakala nepmahla kahulumeni, noma etholakala esebenzisa impahla kahulumeni, abasebenzi noma izivakashi ngaphandle kwenvume. Ngokulahla, ukubulala impahla kahulumeni ngamabomu, ngenhloso noma ngokuthanda.

Kubalulekile ukuthatha isampula kuyo yonke imifula. Isampula yomhlabathi ejulile engu-15 cm isisindo sithola cishe amakhilogremu angama-2,400 kuye ngokuthi umhlabathi uthambekela kangakanani, ukuhlanganiswa kwawo, nokujula. Isampula yokugcina ethunyelwe lab ingase isisindo sibe amakhilogremu angu-0.5, ezokwenziwa zibe ngamagramu amancane. Ngenxa yalokhu, kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwemithombo enejula nezinhlobo zomhlabathi ezahlukene nezindawo ngaphakathi kwemifula, ezingeyona ingxenye yendawo yonke evunyiwe. Kusengumkhuba kubalimi ukufaka ama-fertilizers ngokuya ngezinga elabelwe ku-block yonke yomhlaba, ngaphandle kokuthi kube nezindawo ezitholakala nge-satellite (GPS) nezindlela ezingaguqulwa zokufaka i-fertilizer, ezingaphrintiwe endaweni esetshenziselwa ukutshala. Akukhulunywa ukuthi lokhu kuhlola kungcono kunesampula eqoqwe kulolo mhlaba. Khumbula ukuthi kukhona umehluko omkhulu emhlabathini ezindaweni. Esikhathini esedlule, isampula eqoqwe kumahhactha ayishumi kuyo yonke i-block yomhlaba yayibhekwa njenganele. Nokho, kuyas recommended ukuthi uthenge noma uboleke ithuluzi lokumba (auger) ukuze wenze imihla ukusuka phezulu phansi kulolo mhlaba nabantu ababili, omunye ethwele ibhagi yesampula ngayinye futhi ethatha i-core yomhlabathi efika ejulile phakathi kuka-15 no-20 cm kodwa ingadluli ku-20 cm. Ibhokisi lesampula kufanele libe nelayisense ecacile enombolo yefield, igama, ikheli lefama, izinombolo zokuxhumana, nosuku lokuqoqwa kwesampula, ukuze kugwenywe noma yikuphi ukudideka e-lab.

Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani, uhulumeni ubonise ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlanganyelwe, ezihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. I-Operation Vulindlela ibuye ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi. Uhlelo Lwebhizinisi lusetshenziselwa ukuthatha imibono yakho yebhizinisi elisha uyibhale phansi, wanda ngemininingwane yakho. Zama ukubhala uhlelo lwakho lebhizinisi ngoba lena yimibono yakho. Kodwa, uma uzwa ukuthi udinga usizo ngalo mbhalo osemqoka, kukhona izinkampani eziningi ezingaphandle esingakusiza. Senze uhlu lwazo ekupheleni kwalesi sigaba. Uhlelo lwakho lwebhizinisi luqukethe ulwazi olwaziswayo ngokuphathelene nomkhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zakho futhi ayisoze yasebenza kuphela njengombhalo ozokwazi ukuthola ngawo ukuxhaswa ngezimali kodwa ingasetshenziswa njengomhlahlandlela ozowulandela uma usumisa ibhizinisi lakho. Izakucacisa izinto ezifana nokuthi uzosebenzisa hlobo luni lwesakhiwo kubhizinisi, uma uzodinga abasebenzi nokuthi ibhizinisi lakho kumele libe kuyiphi indawo. Ucwaningo lokungenzeka noma ukuzimela - Uzosebenza kanjani umbono wami? Ukuhlela Amasu kanye nomhlahlandlela wokubheka - Lizokukhula kanjani ibhizinisi lami kanye nokuthi abantu engizobhekana nabo emakethe yibaphi? Umhlahlandlela Wokusebenza - Uhlelo lokwenza losuku ngosuku. lizobonisa abazalisi zimali ukuthi uyazazi zinjhongo kanye nezinhloso zakho kanye nokuthi ibhizinisi lakho ukuzalisa imali okuhle. Njengo lubekwe lwacaca ngaphansi kwezihloko ezahlukene futhi uma ukuthi halamuzi kumele kukunikeze abaxhasi bezimali kanye nabazalisi zimali ngolwazi olwanele ngesu lebhizinisi yakho. Proprietor noma Inkampani (Pty) Ltd. Kusemqoka ukukhetha isakhiwo esifanele izinhloso zakho. Incazelo yezakhiwo zamabhizinisi ahlukene zenziwe uhlu Esahlukweni sesi-5.

Ezokuvikeleka Kwemininingwane (Cybersecurity) - Isingeniso Ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane, okwaziwa nangokuthi i-cybersecurity, kubaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni obumbene nobuchwepheshe. Njengoba sikhula futhi sithuthuka kwezehlakalo zobuchwepheshe, kubalulekile sithole izindlela ezisebenzayo zokuvikela ulwazi lwethu. Esifundweni sethu, sizobe sihlola incazelo ye-cybersecurity, izinselelo ezihambisana nayo, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze sivikele ulwazi lwethu. Yini i-Cybersecurity? I-cybersecurity iwumkhakha ophathelene nezindlela, izinqubo, nezinsiza ezisetshenziselwa ukuvikela amasistimu, amanethiwekhi, nemininingwane ethinta i-intanethi. Umgomo omkhulu we-cybersecurity ukuvikela ulwazi kanye nokusebenza kwemishini esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe. Lokhu kudinga ulwazi olunzulu ngezingozi ezahlukene, ezifana nokuhlaselwa kwama-hacker, ukuvuza kwem秘密, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezingasebenzi kahle. Izinhlobo Zokuhlasela Kunezinhlobo eziningi zokuhlasela ezithinta ezokuvikeleka kwemininingwane. Omunye ovame ukubonwa ngu-kephula iphephabhuku, lapho umuntu engena kokungemthetho kulwazi lwemfihlo. Kukhona futhi i-malware, efaka phakathi ama-virus, ransomware, neminye imishayo emibi ethinta ulwazi lwethu. Lezi zingozi zingaholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu nasekuphazamisekeni kwezinkampani kanye nemibuso. Izingozi Eziyinhloko Izingozi zihlala zikhona emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi ziyaqhubeka zikhula njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula. Izinkampani ezithola uxhumano nabangani be-inthanethi, njengokuthenga nge-inthanethi, zikhona engozini yokuhlaselwa.

Izingane ezikhulayo zidinga ukudla okunempilo ukuze zikhule kahle, kanti ukuntuleka kokudla okwakha umzimba kuholela ezinkingeni zempilo ezifana ne-anemia, ukungakhuli kahle, nezinkinga zokucabanga. Lokhu kubangela imiphumela emibi emphakathini, njengoba izingane ezingenamandla zingakwazi ukufunda kahle esikoleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nokudla okwanele kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, okwandisa izindleko zezokwelapha. Lokhu kuyalwa nezindleko ezinkulu emndenini, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezinye izidingo ezisemqoka. Izixazululo Ezingenzeka Ukuze lezi zinkinga zixazululwe, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi basebenze ndawonye. Ukuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi emisha kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola imali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokususwa kwezithiyo ezifaka phakathi ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuhamba. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi kube nokwaziswa ngempilo phakathi kwemindeni, ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi yikuphi ukudla okudingekayo ukuze bakhe imizimba enamandla. Izinhlelo zokufundisa ngemikhuba yokudla okunempilo zingabasiza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezinhle uma bezikhetha ukudla. Ukwakha izitolo zokudla eziseduze nezindawo ezisemaphandleni kungasiza kakhulu ekwehliseni izinkinga zokushoda kokudla, njengoba zingahlinzeka ngamakhasimende ukudla okuthengiswayo ngezindleko eziphansi. Isiphetho Izinkinga zokudla emindenini engaphansi kwemali zidinga ukuba zibhekwane ngokubambisana ukuze zixazulwe. Ngokubambisana, uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi bangakha izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi imindeni ibhekane nezinkinga zokudla.

Ukuchibiyela ukwenganyelwa ngokweqile kwemboni ngokubeka ehhovisi elilodwa izimvume zabantu abathengisa amatshe anagmagugu kanye namawashi ngaphakathi koMnyango Wezimbiwa Namandla. Ukwengeza kulokhu kungenelela sizobhekelela kakhulu abatshal zimali, amadizayina kanye nabanye abakhiqiza imikhiqizo emisha yemboni kanye nokusetshenziswa jikelele. Le phrojekthi ihlose ukukhomba kanye nokuchaza izimo sezitshalo ezincintela ezinye. Ukuvumela abantu ukuthi bazi ngezinkundla zezemidlalo kwemukelwe abathandi bebhola likanobhutshuzwayo abathokozile abangakwazanga ukufihla intokozo yabo. Inani lezinhlobo zezinyoni ezitholakala ezindaweni ezinotshani ezitheke ngokungekuhle kanye nakahle ukutshalwa kabusha kwehlathi. Futhi lokho uhlobo lokubuyisela emphakathini-lokho kwenza okuhle-esikudinga ngamandla. I-Aquatic biota uhlobo lwamaqembu ezitshalo kanye nezilwane ezihlala emifuleni kanye nasemaxhaphozini. Abantu abasha asebethe, ngenxa yezizathu ezithile bazibandakanya kwezocansi badinga ukugqugquzelwa ukuba bazithibe. Umsebenzi womkhosi wasemanzini, okungaba ukusebenza kwawo wodwa noma ngokuhlanganyela neminye imikhosi yensiza yokuvikela. Ukuhlomisa kanye nokukhuthaza abasebenzi ukuthi basebenze ngokwanele, kanye nangendlela efanele, nokuthuthukisa kanye kusebenzisa lokho abangakwazi ukukwenza ngokusezingeni eliphezulu. Abanye babeboshelwe ubugebengu obuphakathi kokushaya abany kanye nokutholakala nezimpahla okusolwa ukuthi zebiwe ukuya ekuphuzeni uphuzo oludakayo emphakathini. I-FIFA yakugqamisa kodwa ukuthi izobe isinesitokwe esiphelele ngoMsombuluko. Isikhungo se-e-Innovation sihlanganisa izinhlaka ze-information technology kanye ne-e-government Kahulumeni Wezifundazwe.

Ezindaweni lapho umsebenzi engahogela amakhemikhali noma intuthu, kunezinyoka, ukulunywa izinambuzane noma izicabucabu nezinye izingozi, ukuqeqeshwa ngokosizo lokuqala kumele kwenziwe umuntu oqeqeshiwe. Amabhokisi osizo lokuqala anezinto zakhona kumele ahlale ekhona endaweni yokusebenzela futhi avikelwe ekonakalisweni wumswakama. Kumele kuhlinzekwe izintuba zokuphuma ngokushesha uma kukhona olimele noma ogulayo odinga ukwelashwa. Izithuthi noma indlela yokuxhumana kumele zibe khona endaweni yokusebenzela ukuze kuthintwe abatakuli uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo. Kunobungozi bokuthola ukugula ezinketshezini ezinobungozi nasenkucunkucwini nemikhiqizo yezilwane. Uma unabasebenzi abaqashwe ngokugcwele, nabayitoho kumele uzihlinzeke lezi zinto. Imishini yokuwasha ephathekayo, izindwangu zokusula zabasebenzi abasebenza kude nezindawo zokuwashela. Izindawo zokushintsha ezindaweni lapho kugqokwa khona izingubo ezehlukile. Izifo ezithile ezibangwa wumsebenzi kumele zibikwe emnyangweni wezabasebenzi. Izinto zemvelo: isifo sesifuba somoya esisuswa wuthuli lwezinhlamvu, izinambuzane ezisetshenziselwa ukubulala izilwanyana, umquba namakhowe. Ezinye izinto: isifo sesikhumba esisuswa okuphathelene nomsebenzi njengezibulali magciwane. Imishini: ukungqangqazela kwesandla nengalo ngenxa yokusebenza ngobhemubhemu (isaha likaphethiloli) noma amasaha esandla. Uma udinga eminye imininingwane thintana nehhovisi labasebenzi noma ihhovisi lesifundazwe.

UMthetho wokuphathwa kwabaMnyama, njengensalela yokwakuyisisekelo sokuhlukanisa ngokobuhlanga, wachithwa ngoLwezi kowe-1995. Lokhu kwaveza isidingo sokufaka isimiselo somthetho kazwelonke sokuqhuba ngendlela indima edlalwa ngayo kanye nemisebenzi yabaholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Ibhukwana lenqubomgomo liyinhlanganisela yomphumela ovele ocwaningweni lwemibhalo, isifundo sokuqhathanisa ezinye izindawo lapho kumele umthetho usebenze khona, ukufakana imilomo nabaholi bendabuko, leyo Minyango kahulumeni ebhekelele izindaba zendabuko nabanye abanentshisekelo emkhakheni womthetho ophathelene namasiko. UNgqongqoshe kanye nezinye izikhulu bavakasha ngenhloso yokuyofunda ukuze bazibonele ngokwabo indlela okuqhutshwa ngayo eNdiya naseBotswana. Olunye ulwazi lwasuselwa kokwatholakala engqungqutheleni yomhlaba yezikhungo zendabuko, eyayibanjelwe eThekwini kuNhlaba kowezi-2007, kanye nengqungquthela yeziMantshi eyalandela lapho, eyayibanjelwe eMidrand kuMandulo kowezi-2007. Kulezi zingqungquthela, kwaxoxwa ngeqhaza lezi zikhungo ezilibambile ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Ukhetho lwentando yeningi lowe-1994 lwaholela enqubweni entsha. Le nqubo entsha yaba yisisekelo sokubuyekeza umthetho nezinqubo ezazikhona ngaphambi konyaka we 1994. Le ncwadi yenqubomgomo igxile endimeni edlalwayo kanye nemisebenzi yabaholi bendabuko kulesi sikhathi sentando yeningi, ekuphathweni kwemithetho.

Kufanele futhi litholakale emahhovisi e-SAHRC kanye nakuwebhsayithi ye-SAHRC ku- http://www.sahrc.org.za. Ukwengeza, iyoshicilelwa futhi kuGazethi kaHulumeni. Lingabhekwa mahhala kulezi zikhungo ezingenhla, yize-ke izindleko zokwenza amakhophi zingakhokhwa. Isicelo sokuthola amarekhodi e-DHA kufanele senziwe kufomu eshiwo ngokusemthethweni eshicilelwe kuSaziso sikahulumeni No. R. 187 kamhla ka-15 Februwari 2002. Umthetho ukhomba kabanzi kumsebenzi wolwazi njengomuntu okufanele amukele futhi ahleli zicele, kodwa kufanele kwaziwe ukuthi isigaba 17 sivumela ukuthi kukhethwe abantu abengeziwe ukuthi basize umsebenzi wolwazi. Laba bantu abafanele abakhethiwe babizwa ngokuthi amasekela omsebenzi wolwazi. Le fomu kulula ukuyigcwalisa, kodwa uma kunesidingo kungabizwa isekela lomsebenzi wolwazi ukuthi azosiza lowo ocelayo. Uma kungenzeka ocelayo angakwazi ukwenza isicelo esibhaliwe, isekela lomsebenzi wolwazi uzogcwalisa ifomu bese enika ocelayo ikhophi. Abacelayo kufanele bazi ukuthi yimaphi amarekhodi abawafunayo. Uma ocelayo engakwazi ukunikeza imininingwane ngamarekhodi adingekayo ukuthi asheshe akwazi ukuthi abonakale kalula, i-DHA izokwazi ukusiza ocvelayo ngokushesha. Abacelayo kufanele bathole ukuthi ubani onamarekhodi. Kufanele basebenzise uhlu lwezihloko kanye nezigaba zolwqazi oluphethwe isekela lomsebenzi wolwazi ngalinye ukuze bakwazi ukunquma ukuthi yiliphi isekela lomsebenzi wolwazi ongahle kube unerekhodi, bese bebhala izicelo zabo baziyise kulelo sekela lomsebenzi wolwazi. Isekela lomsebenzi wolwazi ngalinye libhekene nomsebenzi wokunquma ukuthi linikezele yini ngemvume yokuthola amarekhodi angaphansi kolawulo lwalo.

Imibuzo elandelayo iphathelene nomndeni wakho nabangane, ikakhulukazi labo abangahlali nawe kulo muzi. Imindeni nabangane kwenye inkathi iyelekelelana ngezindlela ezinhlobo nhlobo, kanti lolo nalolo lusizo lungaba mqoka. Ingxenye yalolu cwaningo lwethu imbandakanya ukuthola ukuthi ikwenza kanjani lokhu. Manjena-ke singathanda ukubuza imibuzo eyidlanzana mayelana nomndeni wakho nabangane abangahlali nawe, nezindlela ezehluka hlukene enisizana ngazo. Imibuzo elandelayo iphathelene nosizo olutholwe umuzi wakho ezinyangeni ezingu 12 ezedlule. Ezinyangeni ezingu 12 ezedlule, kungabe kukhona ekhaya owemukele usizo lwezimali noma olunye kumndeni wakho (izingane, izelamani kumbe abazali) nezihlobo (abanye bozalo) abangahlali nawe? Lusizo luni lwemali kumbe olunye uhlobo oluye lwemukelwa umuzi wakho? Uma kungu YEBO, yisho inani. a. Imali, imali ebolekisayo, uxhaso ngemfundo, ukukhokhelwa izikwenetu, inkokhelo noma intela (lokhu kusho ukheshe)? b. Inani lokudla nezinye izimpahla (lokhu kusho okungesiyona imali)? c. Ukusiza ekhaya nemisebenzi (ukulungiselwa ukudla, ukuyelwa esitolo, ukuhlanza, ukuwashelwa), ukuhlinzekelwa unakekelo kumbe ukuhanjiswa (ukusizwa ngokuya ezindaweni ezingaphandle komuzi)? UMBUZI MIBUZO: Lokhu AKUMBANDAKANYI usizo olukhokhele kumbe oluqashile. Maqondana nosizo osanda kulubala, kungabe lokhu ukubona kuwungeniso mali/lusizo umuzi ongathembela kulo esikhathini esizayo?

Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi ikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi izokwazi kanjani ukuqapha ukusebenza komhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi ukuze ihambisane nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 27 seMthetho. Lesi sivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi uhlinzeka ngolwazi olungase lwenziwe yikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuze uqaphe ukuhambisana nesivumelwano ukuze ikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zayo zokubika kuMphathiswa kanye nohulumeni wesifunda ukuthi umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi uyahambisana nomthetho kanye nalezi ziqondiso. a lungisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi ezimali nezitatimende ngokulandela incwadi yemithetho ethathwa njengokufanele kwezindaba zezimali futhi yamukelwe Ngokuvamile Yamukelwe Ukubalwa Kwezimali eNingizimu Afrika noma uma kukhona ezingeni elithile likahulumeni, landela umthetho ofanele wokubalwa kwezimali; futhi b ivumele ikhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi ukuthola wonke amarekhodi nezitatimende zezimali ezidingekayo ukuze zihlolwe futhi zibhalwe phansi ngaphansi kwesivumelwano. a qopha bonke abantu abasebenzisa amanzi nalabo abake bawasebenzisa ngokuhambisana nesivumelwano b uhlu lwezimpahla nezakhiwo zezinsizakalo zamanzi kuhlanganise nezimo zazo nezindawo zazo futhi c qopha imisebenzi, ukugcinwa kwemishini nezinsiza, ukuhlolwa, nokucubungula kwezimo zemishini. Umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi kumele ngaphansi kwesivumelwano uqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oludingekayo ngabantu abasebenzisa amanzi kanye nalabo abangase bawasebenzise

Ukhetho Lukazwelonke: Izinyathelo Zokulandela Ukhetho lukazwelonke luwumcimbi obalulekile empilweni kazwelonke, unikeza abantu ithuba lokukhuluma ngemibono, izifiso, nezidingo zabo. Ukuze ukhetho lube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kulandelwe izinyathelo ezithile. Nansi indlela yokuhlela ukhetho lukazwelonke ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Ukulungiselela Ukuvota Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuthi zonke izakhamizi zibe nolwazi olufanele mayelana nezinyathelo zokuvota. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zibhale igama lazo ohlelweni lokuvota. Lokhu kungenziwa ngokuvakashela emahhovisi kahulumeni endaweni, noma ngokuqhafaza kwi-inthanethi uma kungenzeka. Abavoti kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi imininingwane yabo ihambisana, futhi uma kudingeka, benze izichibiyelo. Isinyathelo 2: Ukufunda Ngabadayisi Ngaphambi kokuvota, abavoti kufanele bazi kahle abadayisi abavela ezikhundleni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubandakanya ukufunda ngamaqembu ezepolitiki, izifiso zawo, nezinhlelo abakhipha uma sebekhethwe. Abavoti bangasebenzisa izinsiza ezahlukahlukene, njengamaphephandaba, iziteshi ze-TV, nezinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze baqonde kahle abadayisi. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuvota Uma usuku lokhetho lufika, abavoti kufanele bazi kahle indawo yokuvota. Lokhu kungatholakala kwi-akhawunti yomvoti noma ngezinsiza ezikhona emakhaya. Ngaphambi kokuhamba, kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baphathe izinsuku ezifanele zokuphuma, balungise iziqu zabo zokuvota, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi banezinto ezidingekayo, njenge-ID yomvoti.

Abalimi BaseNingizimu Afrika: Umgogodla Wokuphila Kwethu Ekuqaleni, kufanele siqonde ukuthi abalimi baseNingizimu Afrika bangabantu ababalulekile empilweni yethu. Bahlala bephakathi kwezinkanyezi ezikhanyayo zomnotho wethu, benza umsebenzi onzima ukuze sihlale sithola ukudla okwakhiwe ngothando, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nemizamo yabo. Abalimi bethu, abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, bahlala bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngokweqiniso, abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ezimeni ezinzima. Ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwemithombo, kanye nezinkinga zokuthola izinsiza, konke lokhu kudala ubunzima obukhulu. Nokho, abanye bethu basakhumbula izinsuku ezinhle lapho umhlaba wawugcwele izithelo nezitshalo, lapho imifino yayikhula kahle, futhi lapho umoya wawugcwele iphunga lempilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nokuqonda okujulile nokuhlonipha imizamo yabo. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, kodwa bahlala bephikelela. Ukusebenza kwabo akugcini nje ngokukhiqiza ukudla, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukugcina amasiko ethu, imikhuba, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene. Abalimi bethu bahlala bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi abanye abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ezindaweni ezikude, lapho ukufinyelela ezinsizeni ezisemqoka kungaba nzima. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sibe nokuqonda okujulile nokuhlonipha imizamo yabo. Abalimi bethu bahlala bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, kodwa bahlala bephikelela.

IKomidi Lezabasebenzi lePhalamende elibhekelela amandla kufanele lilandele futhi libike njalo futhi libuyisele ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo eziphakanyisiwe yiNhlangano Yezamandla YaseNingizimu Afrika (NERSA) ngoMeyi 2008 ngemuva kokuhlolwa kwezinkinga zokushoda kukagesi. Uhlelo lokuphakamisa ukuthi kungabikho izinguquko ezenziwayo ngemuva kokuhlolwa kwangaphambilini okuqale iHhovisi mayelana nezimo zokushoda kukagesi nokukhishwa kwezinsiza ugesi ngumnikazi wombuso, u-Eskom, umprotector womphakathi wacela uMphakathi weNdlu YezamaPhalamende ukuba athathe izinyathelo mayelana nalokhu. Ingxenye enkulu yaseNingizimu Afrika ibhekane nokushoda kukagesi nokukhishwa kwezinsiza ngenxa yokukhishwa kwezinsiza kusukela ngoJanuwari 2007 kuze kube nguFebhuwari 2008. "Imiphumela nezinsizakalo eziphakanyisiwe zalesi sihlolo zikhombisa ukuthi kube nokulibaziseka ngakolunye uhlangothi kukahulumeni ekuthuthukiseni amandla okukhiqiza ugesi kwe-Eskom ngenkathi futhi kunikezwa izixolelo zomphakathi mayelana nezinkinga ezidalwe ukukhishwa kwezinsiza," kusho u-Advocate Mushwana. Uthe i-NERSA, njengomphakathi ophathisa imithetho eqinile ethuthukiswe nguMthetho Wokulawula ugesi ka-2006, inamandla namandla okuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke iziphakamiso ezenziwe embikweni wayo zifezekiswa futhi ukuthi i-Eskom ihambisana nezimo zelayisensi yayo nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho.

Isimemezelo Sokunemba Kwefomu LeLungu (GEMS Member Form Accuracy Declaration) Uhlanga lwezempilo luyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, futhi ukufinyelela kwezinsiza zempilo ezinhle kuncike kakhulu emnothweni wezemali okwenziwa izinhlelo eziphathelene nezempilo. Ngalesi sizathu, kubalulekile ukuthi amalungu omphakathi aqonde kahle isu elibhekelele ukunemba kwefomu lelungu, ikakhulukazi kulabo ababhalisela uhlelo lweGEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nqubo ihloselwe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluhlinzekiwe ngamalungu luyiqiniso, futhi iyahambisana nezidingo eziningi ezimqoka. Ukuqala, kubalulekile ukuveza ukuthi ukuhlinzekwa kolwazi olunembile kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amalungu athola izinsizakalo zempilo ezifanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufaka imininingwane efanele, efana negama, ikheli, usuku lokuzalwa, nezibalo zempilo ezisemqoka. Ukungahambisani kwalolu lwazi kungaholela ekubeni izinsizakalo zinganikezwa ngendlela efanele, okuyinto engathokozisi amalungu. Ngakho-ke, uma ubhalisela leli thuba, kufanele uqaphele ukuthi wonke amafomu abhalwe kahle, ngaphandle kwamaphutha. Ukudlula emkhakheni wokunemba kwezifundo, kuyadingeka ukuthi ukufunda kahle imiyalelo ethile yeGEMS ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi yiziphi izidingo ezidingekayo ukuze ufake isicelo sokuba yilungu. Lokhu kuhlonipha umthetho, futhi kukhulu kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba okuthola izinsiza eziphawulekayo. Ngokuhamba phambili, uma ufaka le fomu, kubalulekile ukuthi uthathe isikhathi esanele ukuze uhlele kahle yonke imininingwane. Ukuhlola kabusha imininingwane yakho ngaphambi kokuyithumela kungasiza ekuqedeni noma yiziphi izinkinga ezingase zivele ngaphambi kokuba uqedele inqubo.

Uphenyo Lwabafundi: Ukuqoqa imibono yabafundi mayelana nezindawo zokufunda, izinsiza, nezimo zokuphepha. Uphenyo Lwezisebenzi: Ukuhlola imibono nezinkinga ezibhekene nezisebenzi ezikoleni, okuhlanganisa othisha, abaphathi, nabanye abasebenzi. Ukuhlola Izakhiwo: Ukuhlola izakhiwo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokwakhiwa, zihlala zisebenza, futhi zifanele izidingo zemfundo. Ukuhlola Izinsiza: Ukuhlola ukuthi izinsiza ezikhona zisebenza kahle, zifanele, futhi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu. Izindinganiso Zokwakha Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu, kufanele kube nezindinganiso ezithile zokwakha. Lezi zindinganiso kufanele zifake: 1. Izinga Lokuphepha: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zihlala ziphephile, zihlala zisebenza, futhi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokwakhiwa. Izinsiza Zokufunda: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zinezinsiza ezifanele zokufundisa, ezifana nezincwadi, amathuluzi, nezobuchwepheshe. Ukufinyelela: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zifinyeleleka kubafundi bonke, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezikole iyathuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuphathwa kwezimali. Lokhu kuhlanganisa: 1. Ukubeka Imali: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona imali eyanele yokwakha, ukugcinwa, nokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokufunda. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimali zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi zihlolwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zisetshenziswa kahle. Ukwabelana Ngemithombo: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zabelana ngemithombo nezinsiza ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo.

Uchaza amalungelo nezibopho zezingane njengoba ziqukethwe kuMthethosisekelo; uchaza umgomo ophathelene nokunakekelwa nokuvikelwa kwezingane; uchaza amalungelo nezibopho zabazali; ufaka nezinye izimo ezihlobene nezinkantolo zezingane; unikeza ukuhlinzekwa kwemiyalelo yokunakekela; unikeza uhlelo lwezingane ezidingayo; unikeza izingane ezitholwe kwamanye amazwe; uqala iHague Convention ephathelene Nokwamukelwa Kwezingane Ezivela Kwamanye Amazwe; uvimbela ukuhweba ngezingane futhi uqala iHague Convention ephathelene Nokuhlukunyezwa Kwezingane Emhlabeni; unikeza isimo somama ongumzali wempilo; udala nezinye izinhlinzeko ezihlelwe njengamacala aphathelene nezingane futhi unikeza izindaba ezihlobene. NGAKWAZI, iZizwe Ezihlangene zikhangisile ngalesi sikhathi ngeMvumelwano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Ngamalungelo Abantu ukuthi izingane zinekhono lokunakekelwa nokusizwa ngendlela ehlukile. Ngaphezu kokuchazwa okunikezwe ezichazweni "ukubheka", "ukufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho kanye nomthetho ojwayelekile, lezi zisho "ukubheka nokufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho kufanele zithathwe njengokuchazwa "ukunakekela nokuxhumana ngendlela echazwe kulesi Mthetho. Kulolu Mthetho, igama noma igama elithathwe egameni noma ngogama echazwe esigabeni 1, linencazelo efanayo ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ubonise ukuthi kukhona enye incazelo ehleliwe. Noma yisiphi isenzakalo esiqhubekayo esivela ngemuva kokusebenza koMthetho Wezobulungiswa Wezingane ka-1929 uMthetho 9 ka-1929, uMthetho Wokuhlukanisa, uMthetho Wokunakekela, uMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwendlu ka-1998 uMthetho 116 ka-1998 kanye noMthetho Wokushada Ngokwenkolo ka-1998 uMthetho 120 ka-1998, lapho lezi zMthetho eziphathelene nezingane zingakhulunywa ezinkantolo zezingane. Umthetho ojwayelekile, ukhuthaza isimo sokuvikela nokuthuthukiswa kwezingane lezi. Umthetho wezakhamuzi, izingxabano kufanele zixazululwe ngokulandela isigaba 156 seMthethosisekelo.

Yiziphi izinselelo ezibhekene nabakhiqizi abasha? Ukuphuma okuphansi kwemali yokuthola izitshalo uma kukhula kuphela ezimweni zokunisela, kanye nezinga lokwaziswa elikhuphukayo. Eminyakeni edlule, inzuzo etholakalayo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo ibinokwehliswa. Izindleko zokuqala zikhuphuka njalo, kodwa intengo yemakethe ayikhuphuki ngokufanele. Kukhona abalimi abambalwa abangakwazi ukuqala ukutshala ngaphandle kokubolekwa imali. Lapho izinzuzo ziqinile futhi izinga lokwaziswa lemali ebolekiwe liphansi, kuba nguyena obalulekile ukuboleka izimali ezinkulu ukuze ukwazi ukutshala imbewu emhlabeni. Abakhiqizi eNingizimu Afrika balwela emakethe yomhlaba, kodwa imithetho yokubambisana ayifani. Kukhona ukungabi nalwazi olufanele namakhono. Abakhiqizi abasha bangaba abafundi; badinga ukwesekwa, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nemfundo. Ngokuvamile, abantu abasebenza emaphakathini abhandling le misebenzi bangenalwazi olufanele. Abaningi abake basebenze epulazini, abanye bayavuma ukusiza, abanye bafundile kodwa abakwazi "ukubeka imbewu emhlabeni." Izinhlangano ezinikeza izinto zokulima zisebenza kahle, kodwa izindleko zazo ziphakeme. Abakhiqizi abasha abaningi babhekana nezinselelo lapho befuna uxhaso lokukhiqiza. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhasa ifuna ukuzibophezela epulazini ngaphambi kokuhlinzeka uxhaso. Abalimi abaqashile amapulazi noma abakhiqiza emhlabeni wombuso abakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngaleyo zibopho, ngaleyo ndlela behluleka ukuthola uxhaso. Imithombo eminingi yokuxhasa ehlinzeka ngoxhaso lokukhiqiza ifuna ukuqinisekiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe leyo mali. Nokho, ukuqinisekiswa kokukhiqiza kusebenza kuphela uma izitshalo ziqala ukukhula, lapho konke okukhona sekuvele kwenzekile.

Umhlahlandlela kumele ucatshangwe ngesikhathi sezisebenza izinhlelo nasesigabeni sokubuyekeza. Ikunika izeluleko ezinqala ngenhloso, ingqikithi nezici zokwakhiwa kwe-IDP, ukwengezela emibandeleni ebekwe eMthethweni weziNhlelo zoMasipala. Ukuqaphela nokubuyekeza - ngesikhathi kuhlelwa, kusungulwa izinkomba zokukala iqophelo lezithelo zomsebenzi, izinga lawo uqobo nemithelela. Ngesinye isikhathi umphumela wokuqapha umsebenzi uholela ekuguquleni iqhinga nohlelo. Inqubo yentuthuko edidiyele ihambisana nohlelo oluchazwe ngezansi. Kunomsebenzi wamalungiselelo okufanele enziwe ngaphambi kokuqala isigaba sokudweba uhlelo. Amalungiselelo abandakanya ukukhiqiza uhlelo lwe-IDP. Ukuhlela kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inqubo ye-IDP yenganyelwe ngendlela efanele. Umsebenzi nezibophezelo ngubani owenza ini? Njengengxenye yesigaba samalungiselelo, umkhandlu wesifunda, ngokubonisana nomasipala bendawo kumele bemukele uhlaka lohlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele. Uhlaka lunquma imigudu yokuxhumana, ukubonisana nokulumbanisa umbono kamasipala wesifunda nowendawo, ngaleyondlela babemdibi munye. Uhlaka lweluleka umasipala ngamunye ekuhleleni kahle inqubo yawo. Inkombandlela yesibili inika izeluleko ezinzulu ngamalungiselelo ohlelo. Isigaba sokuhlaziya sidingida isimo esikhona njengamanje. Lesenzo siqonde kakhulu izinkingai ezibhekene nabantu abakhele umasipala. Izinto eziphathekayo zisukela ekwentulekeni kwezinsiza-nqangi kufe kufinyelele ebugebengwini nasekwentulekeni kwemisebenzi.

Imisebenzi eminingi ye-DHA yenziwa kuwo wonke la mahhovisi. Amafomu okufaka izicelo atholakala kukhompyutha kanye nolunye ulwazi kungatholakala kuwebhusayithi yomnyango. Ulwazi lokubhaliswa maqondana nemisebenzi yokuhambela kwamanye amazwe kanye nemisebenzi yomphakathi nalo lukhona kuwebhusayithi kulabo abasebenzisa i-inthanethi. a Uma ngabe Umnyango ufuna ukungenisa izinqubomgomo ezinkulu ezintsha, ujwayele ukukhipha uhlaka lwenqubomgomo njengesiphakamiso esisafuna ukuthi kuxoxwe ngaso kuGazethi kaHulumeni kanti kwesinye isikhathi nakwezinye izindawo zokushicilela, bese kuthi noma yiliphi ilungu lomphakathi lamukelwe ukuthi lilethe imibono yalo ngalesi siphakamiso eMnyangweni. , b Imithetho sivivinywa esiwuhlaka noma ukufingqwa kwayo iyashicilelwa ukuze umphakathi ubeke imibono kuGazethi KaHulumeni ngaphambi kokuba kwaziswe ngawo iPhalamende. c Uma kwenziwa uhlaka lwenqubomgomo entsha noma lomthethosivivinywa, uMnyango futhi ukhomba bese ubonisana namaqembu athize athandayo, njengezinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni; izinhlangano ezisemphakathini kanye noMkhandlu Wamasonto WaseNingizimu Afrika. d Noma yimuphi umuntu wamukelekile, noma ngasiphi isikhathi, ukuthi abhalele i-DHA ngeziphakamiso maqondana nezinqubomgomo ezintsha kanye nezinguquko kuzinqubomgomo ezikhona uMnyango osicabangayo. Zonke iziphakamiso ezizwakalayo ziyobhekwa. a IBhodi Yezamafilimu kanye Nokushicilela ibandakanya abameleli bemboni yezamafilimu kanye nezokuthokozisa.

Ukufaka izinhlelo zokuzifundela ngokucebiswa ngalokho okufuneka ukwenze kanye namacebo lapho kungenzeka khona, kuzongena endaweni yendlela encike kakhulu kubasebenzi neyindlela yokufunda ejwayelekile. Ukuhlonza ama-flashpoints, amaphethini obugebengu kanye nalokho okuphambili okuphambene nobugebengu kwasemphakathini kanye nokukhuluama ngalokhu nohulumeni wasekhaya kanye namaphoyisa kanye nokuzibandakanya ekusombululeni izinkinga. Yebo, impela sazi ukuthi kwakuphezulu kakhulu kunalokho okwakuklanyiwe. Enye yezinselele ezinkulu kakhulu ezibhekana nazo, ikakhulukazi njengohulumeni, umbuzo wabantu abanekhono lokwenza umsebenzi. Umseshi uRead wengeza nokuthi amaphoyisa e-PTT ayevuseleleke kakhulu futhi kumele athokozele enye inyanga yokulwa nobugebengu kanye nokubhekana ngqo nezigebengu ngempumelelo. Kumele kuqashelwe ukuthi ukuba semthethweni kwezinhlaka ze-SDU kwaziswe ngokuphathelene neSivumelwano Soxolo SikaZwelonke (National Peace Accord). Kwatholakala izimpahla ezebiwe okungamaselula, ama-DVD, ama-amplifier kanye nezipikha. Uma ikhasimende lifaka isicelo ngaphandle kwekhowudi yekhasimende, ukunikeza ngensiza angeke kuvunywe. Itholakala endaweni eyikomkhulu lezimbali eKapa, okuyindawo encane kanye neyahluke kakhulu kumakomkhulu ezimbali ayisithupha emhlabeni. Ngaphandle kokuthi babebhekene ngqo nezimo ezinzima zempi yomzabalazo. Yebo, sikhona isitatimende esisibhale eSipingo. Kubhalwe kulo mbhalo futhi kuchazwe kulo mbhalo kwizigaba ezilandelayo. Eminye imiyalelo yami ukuthi uMnu. Houston uyalelwe ukuthi avele phambi kwekhomishani, futhi uzoba ufakazi, lapha uzonikeza noma ibuphi ubufakazi obudingwa kuyena yile khomishani.

Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle ngomsebenzi wakhe. Iziphakamiso - Kumele abambe iqhaza ezinsukwini zomkhiqizi nasemahhovisi ukuze athole ulwazi ngezindlela ezintsha ezinhle. Amandla - ungumuntu omkhulu - unamaqhawe amakhulu - izinyathelo ezilandelwayo. Ungumthombo wokuqwashisa ongakhuthaza abanye ukuba bamlandele - ikakhulukazi abafana bakhe. Uthumele iqiniso lokuthi ikusasa lezolimo ezandleni ezifana nezakhe lizokhanya futhi liqhubeke. Ubephumelela ngaphandle kokuhlupheka iminyaka eminingi ngaphandle kokuba nethuba lokuthuthuka. Ngiyamhlonipha, ungumuntu onobungcweti. Phambili nabantu. Usakhula ukuba abe umkhiqizi wezohwebo, kodwa akesabi ukubona izindawo lapho engakhululekile khona nokucela usizo - futhi uzimisele ukuthola lokho kusizo. Iziphakamiso - Umkhiqizi Wonyaka 2008!

Isitshalo esisodwa sinekhono lokhukhiqiza ukudla okuthile - izinto ezenza ukuthi singakwazi ukumila kahle zifana nalezi: inani lamanzi emhlabathini, ukudla okukhona emhlabathini, ukukhanya (ilanga) nokushisa. Kakhulukazi inani lezitshalo ensimini ethile lihambelana nobumanzi obukhona emhlabathini. Inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile libaluleke ukudlula ububanzi kwemisele lapho zitshalwe khona. Ububanzi bemisele ezindaweni ezibheka imvula kuphela, ziyahluka, zisuka ku-0,9 m, ziye ku-2,1 m noma ku-2,3 m. Lokhu kuhambelana futhi nemishini esetshentziswayo noma indlela yokulima kuleyo ndawo. Imisele ebanzi ivama ukutshalwa lapho inani lemvuno liphansi, lapho kukhona ukuhebhuka komhlabathi ngenxa umoya, lapho inani lezitshalo endaweni ethile lifanele libe ngaphansi kwezinye izndawo nalapho kusasetshenziswa imishini ukuhlakula ngaphakathi kwemusele. Imisele esondelene ivama ukutholakala lapho kukhona imvula engconywana futhi konomwehlela emasimini ukuhambisa amanzi nalapho ukhula lubulawa ngamakhemikali (akulula ukuhlakula ngemishini ngobo imisele isondelene kakhulu bese ugandaganda akakwazi ukuhamba ngaphakathi kwemisele). Inani lemvuno oqonde ukulithola lihambelana nenani lezitshalo ozitshalile. Uma utshale inani lezitshalo elingaphansi, awungeke uthole umvuno oqonde ukuwuthola, futhi uma utshale inani elingaphezulu izitshalo izitshalo ziyacintisana ukumila bese umvuno uyehla. Izitshalo ezisondelene kakhulu zivama ukuthola izifo (njengokubola kwezinhlanga) futhi zivama ukuwa. Izindawo ezithile nohlobo lwesitshalo esithile sinenani elifanelekile.

UThandi wacabanga ngalesi simo, wathi, "Kungani abantu bengenakuthola ithuba lokuphila kahle? Kungani kufanele bahlupheke?" Njengoba uThandi eqhubeka noSipho, waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo yabafuduki. Wathola ukuthi abanye babezama ukuhamba bengenamali, bengenamakhaya, kodwa bephupha ngempilo engcono. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu abavela emazweni ahlukene bahlala bejolisa emaphusheni abo, bephupha ngempilo engcono, kodwa bahlushwa yizinkinga eziningi. Ngemuva kwesikhathi, uThandi wathola umngane omusha, uSipho, futhi baqala ukuhamba ndawonye. Bafunda kakhulu komunye nomunye, futhi uThandi waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuwumsebenzi wokwakha impilo entsha. U-Sipho wakhombisa uThandi izindawo ezinhle eGoli, izimakethe ezimnandi, nezindawo zokudlela ezihlukahlukene. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulela ubuhlobo obusha, futhi bephila impilo enothile. Ngesikhathi uThandi noSipho behamba, bahlangana nabanye abafuduki, ababeveza izindaba zabo. UThandi wathola ukuthi uNandi, owesifazane ophuma eMozambique, wayephila impilo enzima, kodwa wayenamaphupho amakhulu. "Ngifuna ukuvula ibhizinisi," kusho uNandi, "ngifuna ukusiza umphakathi wami." UThandi wathola ukuthi uNandi wayengumuntu onamandla, futhi wayefuna ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. UThandi waqala ukuqonda ukuthi abantu abafuduki bahlala bephila impilo enobunzima, kodwa bahlala bejolisa emaphusheni abo. U-Sipho, uNandi, noThandi babebonisa ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuwumsebenzi wokwakha impilo engcono.

b. Umsebenzi kumele asisayine isaziso esimazisa ngosuku lwecala. Uma enqaba ukusisayina kumele anikezwe phambi komonye umsebenzi nozosayina kube nokufakazi bokuthi owonile usutholile isaziso. incazelo ephelele yokungaziphathi kahle, ubufakazi umqashi azothembela kukho. Ulwazi lwamalungelo omsebenzi, ozomela abasebenzi noma omele inhlangano yabasebenzi esemthethweni, kanye nozokwethula ubufakazi. a. umqashi angamumisa okwesikhashana umqashwa noma amkhokhele ngokugcwele, noma amuse kolunye uphiko lwalenkaphane. Ngaphansi kwalemibandela; uma umqashwa ebekwe nomaenze icala elinzima, futhi umqashi ekholwa ukuthi ukubakhona komqashwa emsebenzini kungaphazamisa uphenyo ecaleni abekwe lona, noma kubeke engozini isimo sokuphepha , somuntu othile noma impahla kahulumeni. c. Uma umqashwa obemisiwe emsebenzini noma ethunyelwe kwenye indawo umqashi kumele enze ukulalelwa kwecala ingakapheli inyanga. Umphathi wokulalelwa kwecala onquma ukuba lizodluliselwa yini phambili. a. Ukuqulwa kwecala kumele kubanjwe aingakapheli izinsuku eziyishumi ngemuva kwesaziso esisesiqeshini. u-7.1 (a) esitholile umqashwa. b. Umphathi sihlalo ecaleni kumele abe sezingeni elingaphezulu kunelalowo omele umaqashwa . Uma umqashwa obekwe icala eyinhloko yophiko owengamele kumele abe I-executing authority noma akube umuntu onolwazi olwanele futhi othunyelwe yikhabhinathi noma isingungu esiphezulu sesifundazwe. c. Uma umqashwa ethanda angamelwa ecaleni omunye umsebenzi noma omele inhlangano esemthethweni. d. Uma kunesidingo utolika engabakhona ecaleni.

sidingo, futhi kufanele isebenzise yonke eminye imigudu ekhona ngaphambi kokudlulisela udaba enkantolo ukuba ixazulule leyo ngxabano. Uma inkantolo ingagculisekile ukuthi izidingo zesigatshana (4) zigcwalisiwe, ingayibuyisela leyo ngxabano kuleyo ngxenye yombuso ethintekile. noMkhandlu kaZwelonke wesiFundazwe. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke kanye noMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe babamba iqhaza ekushayweni kwemithetho ngendlela ebekwe kulo Mthethosisekelo. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke ukhethelwe ukuba umele abantu futhi noqinisekisa umbuso wabantu ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo Ukwenza loku ngokukhetha uMongameli, ngokuba yinkundla kazwelonke yokucwaningwa kwezindaba phambi komphakathi, ngokushaya imithetho kanye nokuhlolisisa nokuqapha izenzo zikahulumeni. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke eziFundazwe umele izifundazwe ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zezifundazwe ziyaqikelelwa emkhakheni kahulumeni kazwelonke Sikwenza loku ikakhulukazi ngokubamba iqhaza ekushayweni kwemithetho kazwelonke nokuba yinkundla kazwelonke yokucwaningwa kwezindaba ezithinta izifundazwe phambi komphakathi. UMongameli angabizela iPhalamende emhlanganweni ongejwayelekile noma ngasiphi isikhathi ukuze lenze umsebenzi ongejwayelekile. Indawo yokuhlala kwePhalamende ise Kapa, kodwa umthetho wePhalamende oshaywe ngendlela ehambisana nezigaba 76(1) no (5), unganquma ukuthi iPhalamende lihlala kwenye indawo. emkhakheni kahulumeni wendawo linikezwe ezigungwini zikamasipala, njengoba kushiwo esigabeni 156. owamukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke. sokuvimbela isenzo esingafanele esithathwa yisifundazwe esingakhinyabeza esinye isifundazwe noma izwe ngokuphelele.

Kwesinye isikhathi ziyavalelwa noma zishaywe futhi ziphoqwe ukuthi zenze into ezingathandi ukuyenza. Ezinye zalezi zinto zibandakanya ukuya ocansini nabantu abadala noma ukwenza amafilimu noma imidlalo noma ukuthatha izithombe ezikhombisa izinto ezinjalo. Zonke lezi zingane zilinyaziwe futhi ziyesaba zidinga usizo. Zonke izingane kudingeka zazi ngalezi zinto ukuze zizoqaphela ukuthi zingakhulumi nabantu ezingabazi futhi zazi ukuthi KULUNGILE ukuthi HHAYI uma umuntu efuna ukuzithinta. Ohulumeni kufanele basebenzisane ngayo yonke indlela ukuthi bavimbele ukuthi izingane zingantshontshwa, zingathengwa futhi zingathengiswa nganoma ngasiphi isizathu noma ngananoma iyiphi indlela. Sibonile ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi izingane zisetshenziswa abantu ababi kakhulu. Ngenxa yalokhu, kwesinye isikhathi izingane ziyantshontshwa noma zithengwe futhi zithengiswe njengezigqila. Ohulumeni kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lokhu kuyaphela. Cabanga ngezindlela ezahlukene abantu abangathatha ngazo izingane ezweni nokuthi kungaqedwa kanjani lokhu. Lesi isihloko esimnandi somdlalo ekilasini. Cabanga sengathi uyisisebenzi sasemngceleni bese kuza iloli elikhulu. Uzwa ingane iyakhala ngaphakathi elolini... Ohulumeni kufanele bavikele izingane kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuxhashazwa okungazilimaza noma kuzimoshe. Ukuxhaphaza kusho lapho abantu besebenzisela izingane izinzuzo zabo. Isibonelo, bayazisebenzisa bese bezinika imali encane. Cabanga ngezindlela ezahlukene abantu abaxhashazwa ngazo empilweni. Kwesinye isikhathi izingane zixhashazwa ngoba zincane kakhulu ukuthi zikwazi ukuzivikela zona ngokwazo. Izingane ezinenkinga nomthetho zinelungelo lokuvikeleka okuyisipesheli. Kunezizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani kwenziwa kanjalo.

Ekhaya elincane eliseNingizimu Afrika, lapho izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, kwakukhona isikole esincane sika "Isizotha Primary School." Lesi sikole sasingaphansi kwezintaba ezimhlophe, sikhula phakathi kwemiphakathi ehlukahlukene, lapho isiZulu nesiNgisi kwakungamakhaya ezilimi eziningi. Abafundi be-Isizotha babenhlobonhlobo, behlanganyela izilimi ezahlukene ezikhuluma ezindlini zabo. UThandi, umfundi ophumelelayo, wayekhuluma isiZulu ekhaya, kodwa esikoleni, wayefunda isiNgisi. Lokhu kumjabulisa, ngoba wayeziqhenya ngamasiko akhe, kodwa wayefuna ukufunda isiNgisi kahle ukuze akwazi ukuhamba phambili empilweni. Ngelinye ilanga, uthisha uMsizi, owayenothando lokufundisa, wanquma ukuthi kudingeka kube nokuxhumana okungcono phakathi kwezilimi. Wafuna ukwenza umcimbi wokuhlanganyela, lapho abafundi bengahlanganyela khona izinhlelo zabo zokufunda, bezokhuluma ngezindlela ezahlukene zokufunda isiNgisi nesiZulu. Umcimbi wawuhlelwe kahle, futhi wonke umfundi wathokozisa. UThandi wathola ithuba lokukhuluma phambi kwezigidi zabafundi, wabelana ngendaba yakhe yokufunda isiNgisi. Wathi: "Ngesikhathi ngiqala ukufunda isiNgisi, ngazizwa ngingekho. Kodwa ngafunda ukuthi ukufunda izilimi eziningi akukhona nje ukwazi ukukhuluma, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nabanye abantu." Umfundi omncane, uSipho, waphakamisa isandla, wathi: "Ngiyavuma, Thandi! Ngithanda isiZulu, kodwa ngiyazi ukuthi uma ngifunda isiNgisi, ngizokwazi ukubona umhlaba omkhulu." Lokhu kwavusa umdlandla phakathi kwabafundi, njengoba bonke bejabulela ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene.

Sebenzisa imephu yeNingizimu Afrika ukukhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape itholakala kuphi. Isithombe 1: Iqembu Lokufunda iKhanyayo emhlanganweni walo. Isithombe 2: Umongameli weqembu Lokufunda iKhanyayo, uMnu. Magidela, phambi kwemifino yakhe. Le nqola yokufunda itholakala kuphi? Le nqola yokufunda itholakala endaweni yasemaphandleni lapho kungekho izindlela ezinhle nezitolo. Itholakala cishe ngamakhilomitha angama-60 ukusuka eBizana eNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape. Kukhona amalungu angama-100 kule nqola. Kukhona amahektare angama-100 angavunwa. Yini imbangela yokungavuni yonke imhlaba engavunwa? Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokutshala. Ukuntuleka kwezinto zokwakha izithiyo. Izimo zezulu - ekuqaleni kwesizini yokutshala ngo-2010, imvula yayinzima kakhulu, yenza kube nzima ukuthumela. Ibanga elide lokuxhumana nalabo abahlinzeka ngezinsiza zokutshala, njengezithelo, imbewu, nezikhemikhali. Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kaninginingi? Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kanye ngenyanga neGrain SA, futhi lihlangana ngeviki ukuze lixoxe ngezindaba zokulima. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda? Ikakhulu, izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda zihlanganisa ukwabelana ngolwazi, ukuxoxa namanye amalungu eqembu, ukuthola izindlela ezifanele zokusebenza ezifana nokuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukutshala, ukufaka izibulala-zinambuzane, nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha. Iqembu lokufunda iKhanyayo lenze kahle ukuvakashela iSeshini Yokuqala Yokufundisa Ngokutshala Imifino. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweqembu lokufunda nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Okwamanje, awekho abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo!

Ngokwesibonelo, uma kwenzeka icala lokweba, amaphoyisa kufanele abheke izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ahlole ubufakazi, futhi axhumane nabantu abahlobene. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umsebenzi wabo awupheli nje ekutheni bavikele abantu, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuxazulula izinkinga ezinzima. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi busemqoka. Amaphoyisa akhuthazwa ukuba abe nezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene zokuxhumana, ezifana nezinhlelo zokubambisana nomphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya imicimbi yokwakha ubudlelwano, lapho amaphoyisa ahlangana nabantu, abaxoxe ngezinkinga ezikhona, futhi babonise ukuthi bahlonipha izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kusebenza njengendlela yokwakha ukwethenjwa, okubalulekile ukuze abantu bazizwe bephephile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaphoyisa abamba iqhaza elibalulekile ekufundiseni umphakathi. Lokhu kubandakanya imihlangano yokufundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuzivikela, ukuxhumana nabantu abanezinkinga, kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule kahle ezimweni ezinzima. Imihlangano yokufundisa ibalulekile ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi bangabathola kanjani usizo, futhi bazi ukuthi amaphoyisa akhona ukuze abavikele. Nokho, akukhona konke okukhanyayo emsebenzini wamaphoyisa. Bahlala bephakathi kwezinselelo ezinzima, ezifana nokucindezelwa, ukungabi nabantu abavumelana nabo, kanye nezimo ezinzima ezibandakanya izigameko eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba amaphoyisa babe nesibindi, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabhekana kanjani nezimo ezinzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi bahlale bephila impilo enempilo, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini wabo. Ekugcineni, amaphoyisa adlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo.

Umculo ungumthombo omuhle wokukhombisa imizwa yakho. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuxhumana Ngezinga Lomculo Umculo unethonya elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi. Khetha umculo okukhombisa umoya wesiko lakho. Ungabambisana nabanye, udale amaphrojekthi omculo, noma udlale emikhosini. Lokhu kuzokwenza ufinyelele ezindleleni eziningi zokuxhumana nezinye izinkolo nezinkanyezi. Isinyathelo 5: Phumelela Ngezifundo Zomculo Ukufunda umculo akupheli. Bheka izifundo ezithuthukisa amakhono akho. Ungafunda ngezincwadi ezahlukene, ubhalisele izinhlelo, noma uhlale uthola umculo ongena mahhala kwi-inthanethi. Hamba nemicimbi, hlola izikhala ezitholakalayo, nomphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ufunde izitayela ezahlukene, imiphakathi, nezinkanyezi zomculo. Isinyathelo 6: Yabelana Ngomculo Njengoba uqhubeka nokuqonda umculo, ungakhuthaza abaculi abasha. Yabelana ngolwazi lwakho, uqhubeke nokuqinisa izindlela zokudlala, futhi ukhuthaze abanye ukuba baziqhenye ngemicabango yabo. Umculo unika ithuba lokwakha ubudlelwane, futhi ngokubambisana ungadala imiphumela emihle. Isinyathelo 7: Jabulela Umculo Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezakhiwo Umculo ungumnikazi wezinto ezinhle; ungama-banda, izinhlelo zokwakha, noma izigcawu ezinkulu zemicimbi. Gcina uhlanganisa okuthandayo, ujabulele izinsuku ezihlukile zokwakha umoya. Ujule ekuthuthukiseni ukuzijabulisa ngamaqhawe nezinkanyezi ezivelele emculweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza uhambisane nesiko nomculo. Isiphetho: Ukuqhubeka Nokufunda Umculo Emhlabeni wamanje, umculo ungendlela ebalulekile yokuxhumana; ungasiza empilweni yethu.

Emva kokhetho, umhlangano wokuqala woMkhandlu kaZwelonke kufanele uhlale ngesikhathi kanye nangelanga elibekwe nguMongameli weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, kodwa lingabingaphezulu kwezinsuku ezingu-14 emva kokumenyezelwa komphumela wokhetho UMkhandlu kaZwelonke ungabeka izikhathi nobude beminye imihlangano yawo kanye namakhefu awo. UMongameli angabiza ngokushesha uMkhandlu ukuba uze emhlanganweni ongajwayelekile noma ngasiphi isikhathi ukuze wenze umsebenzi ongejwayelekile. Imihlangano yoMkhandlu kaZwelonke ivunyelwe ezindaweni ezingeyona indawo yokuhlala kwePhalamende kuphela ngezizathu eziyizidingo zomphakathi, zokuphepha noma ubulula bamalungiselelo, futhi uma kuhlinzekelwe emitheshwaneni yoMkhandlu. Emhlanganweni wokuqala woMkhandlu ngemuva kokukhethwa kwawo, noma uma kudingekile ukuze kuvalwe isikhala, uMkhandlu kaZwelonke kufanele ukhethe uSomlomo nesekela likaSomlomo phakathi kwamalungu awo. UMongameli weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo kufanele engamele ukhetho lukaSomlomo, noma aqoke elinye ijaji ukuthi lengamele USomlomo wengamela ukhetho lweSekela likaSomlomo. Uhlelo olubekwe kwingxenya A kuSheduli 3 lusebenza nalapho kukhethwa uSomlomo nesekela likaSomlomo. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke ungasusa uSomlomo noma iSekela likaSomlomo esikhundleni ngokuthatha isinqumo sokwenza njalo Iningi lamalungu oMkhandlu kufanele abekhona lapho kuthatha lesi sinqumo. Ngokusho kwemitheshwana nezibopho, UMkhandlu kaZwelonke ungakhetha phakathi kwamalungu awo abanye abangangamela imihlangano yoMkhandlu ukuze basize uSomlomo neSekela likaSomlomo.

Isigaba sokuhlaziya sidingida isimo esikhona njengamanje. Lesenzo siqonde kakhulu izinkingai ezibhekene nabantu abakhele umasipala. Izinto eziphathekayo zisukela ekwentulekeni kwezinsiza-nqangi kufe kufinyelele ebugebengwini nasekwentulekeni kwemisebenzi. Izinkinga ezitholakele zibhekwa ngokuphuthuma nangokubaluleka kwazo bese kuqokwa lezo eziyobhekelwa kuqala. Ngesikhathi sokuxilonga izinkinga, umasipala kumele acabange ukuthi abantu bazibona kanjani lezinkinga kanye nezidingo zabo kanjalo amaqiniso nezinkomba zezibalo. Kulesigaba, kusemqoka ukuba umasipala ungaqondi nje kuphela izimpawu zezinkinga kodwa wazi nembangela yazo ukuze uthathe izinqumo eziphusile. Kubaluleke kakhulu ukunika ithuba labobantu abaneqhaza nentshisekelo ngentuthuko. Abantu abathintekayo kumele babe yingxenye yokubeka izinkinga nokuchaza umthelela wazo. Ukunquma izidingo-nqangi yinselelo yomasipala ngoba ngeke ube nazo izinsiza ezenele zokubhekana nazo zonke izidingo eziphawulwe yimikhakha ehlukene yomphakathi. Ukuklelisa izidingo kusiza umasipala lapho esaba izinsiza eziyindlala nokuhlomulisa lezozinto ezikleliswe phambili. Umasipala kufanele aqonde izinsiza ezikhona nezitholakalayo kanjalo neziyindlala ukuze aqhamuke nezisombululo ezinobuqiniso nezingenzeka. Uma umasipala sewuqonda kahle izinkinga zabantu abawakhele kanye nembangela, sekumele uqhamuke nezisombululo zokubhekana nalezinkinga. Umbono - umbono yisitatimende esikhomba isimo esifiswa wumasipala noma iphupho alifisela isikhathi eside esizayo. Lesi yisimo umasipala ayozithola ekuso ngesikhathi esexazulule zonke izinkinga ezikhona neziphawulwe esigabeni 1.

Ophathini abarejistiwe kufanele lowo nalowo wabo babhale phansi bafunge ukuthi bafuna ukubuqeda ubuhlobo babo bomndeni oburejistiwe ngokusayina umqulu phambi kukamgcini-hhovisi. Umgcini-hhovisi orejistayo kufanele asayine umqulu obekiwe ukufunga ukuthi ukufunga okukhulunywa ngako kwisigatshana 3kwenziwe ngokuzikhethela futhi kwenziwe phambi kwakhe. Umgcini-hhovisi orejistayo kufanele anikeze ophathini abarejistiwe isitifiketi esishoyo ukuthi ubuhlobo babo sebuqediwe futhi enze nesaziso ngesivumelwano sokubuqeda ubuhlobo, lapho kwenzeke kanjalo, kwisitifiketi. Lowo nalowo mgcini-hhovisi orejistayo kufanele agcine irejista yabo bonke ubuhlobo oburejistiwe bomndeni abuqedile futhi enze nesaziso ngesivumelwano sokubuqeda ubuhlobo, lapho kwenzeke kanjalo, kwirejista. Umgcini-hhovisi orejistayo kufanele khona manjalo irejista kanye nemiqulu eqondene ayithumele kumgcini-hhovisi wakwahulumeni onamandla okurejista amandla awanikeziwe kwisifunda sakhe. Isivumelwano sokuqeda ubuhlobo kufanele kube esibhalwe phansi, sasayinwa yibo bobabili ophathini abarejistiwe futhi bafunge ukuthi senziwe ngokuzikhethela kwabo bobabili ophathini. c amalungiselelo maqondana nekhaya lomndeni; kanye d nanoma iluphi udaba olumaqondana nomphumela wokuphela kobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe. Uphathini orejistiwe onezingane ezincane zobuhlobo oburejistiwe futhi abaqonde ukubuqeda ubuhlobo babo kufanele bafake isicelo sokuqeda ubudlelwano enkantolo.

Isivumelwano sokuqeda ubuhlobo kufanele kube esibhalwe phansi, sasayinwa yibo bobabili ophathini abarejistiwe futhi bafunge ukuthi senziwe ngokuzikhethela kwabo bobabili ophathini. c amalungiselelo maqondana nekhaya lomndeni; kanye d nanoma iluphi udaba olumaqondana nomphumela wokuphela kobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe. Uphathini orejistiwe onezingane ezincane zobuhlobo oburejistiwe futhi abaqonde ukubuqeda ubuhlobo babo kufanele bafake isicelo sokuqeda ubudlelwano enkantolo. Inkantolo ingesikhiphe isinqumo sokuqedwa kobuhlobo bemndeni oburejistiwe ngaphandle uma yaneliseka ukuthi imigomo eyenziwe kumbe ecatshangiwe maqondana nenhlalakahle yezingane kumbe ingane eyondliwayo yobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe iyazenelisa izidingo zaleyo ngane. Ngaphambi kokukhipha isinqumo sokuqeda ubuhlobo, inkantolo kufanele iqale icabangisise izincomo okukhulunywa ngazo kwisigaba 41 somThetho wokuLamula kuMacala Athize kwiDivosi. Ukuze ikwazi ukusithola isimo esibekwe kwisigatshana 1 inkantolo ingase inqume ukuthi kube nomuntu ovela phambi kwayo futhi ingase ikhiphe sinqumo sokuthi omunye wophathini kumbe bobabili mabakhokhe izindleko zophenyo nokuvela phambi kwekantolo.

I-Ofisa enegunya izakungenisa umbiko wonyaka ngonyaka ebandleni nokusetshenziswa Kwenqubomgomo Yokuphatha Ukunikezela Imisebenzi ngomhla ka-30 kuJulayi enyakeni ngamunye. Lo mbhalo uzofaka umbiko wenqubekela phambili ekufinyelelweni kwezinhloso ezibekwe kunqubomgomo Yebandla NoHulumeni kuZwelonke. Uma kuba khona izinkinga zokokwenza nezinzima kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwenqubomgomo yokuphatha ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi, i-Ofisa Enegunya izakubika izinkinga ezinje ebandleni ngokushesha. I-Ofisa Enegunya izowuphinde ibike ngenqubekela phambili ngokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo Ekomitini Lesigungu njalo ngekwata, ezinsukwini eziyi-10 emva kokuphela kwekwata ngayinye. I-Ofisa Elinegunya lizakuthi ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezingama-60 emva kokuphela konyaka wezimali ngamunye, lingenise yinoma yiluphi ulwazi oluphathelene nokuphatha ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi kumcwaningi zimali wesifundazwe ngendlela ezwube ibekwe Ngumcwaningi Zimali kuZwelonke. Ibandla lizakushicilela imitheshwana efanele edingekayo ukunikeza amandla inqubomgomo yokuphatha ukunikezela ngemisebenzi. Le nqubomgomo iqala ukusebenza ngomhla ka-1 kuJulayi ka-2005 futhi ihambisana nokubuyekezwa ngokulandela amazinga omhlahlandlela ezinqubomgomo zokunikezela imisebenzi zikamasipala ezishicilelwe Ngumcwaningi Zimali Kuzwelonke. Umasipala uzokwakha inqubomgomo yokutholiswa okukhethwayo. Kumakontileka anenani lerandi elilingana noma elingaphansi kwenani elibekiwe, eliwubuningi obungamaphuzu angama-20 anikezwe ngezinhloso ezithile, njengoba kucatshangwe ngezansi, uma nje ithenda ephansi evunyiwe ithola amaphuzu angama-80 entengo.

Umphakathi wokushada angahola umcimbi futhi abhalise nganoma yisiphi isikhathi futhi ngosuku oluthile lwesonto, kodwa akaphoqelekile ukuhlela umcimbi nganoma yisiphi esinye isikhathi ngaphandle kokuphakathi kuka-8 a.m. no-4 p.m. Umphakathi wokushada kufanele ahole umcimbi futhi abhalise endaweni yomphakathi noma endlini yangasese noma endaweni ebekwe phansi ngalokho, ngezicabha zivulekile kanye nezinsizwa zikhona kanye nezifakazelo ezimbili ezingafakaza, kodwa lezi zimo zangaphambilini kule ngxenye azivimbi umphakathi wokushada ukuba ahole ubudlelwano babantu kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwalokhu okukhuluma lapha, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwalesi sikhala esikhuluma ngaso, uma ubudlelwano kufanele buhlanganiswe kwenye indawo ngenxa yokugula okukhulu noma ukungabikhona okude, noma uma kukhona ukulimala komunye wamaqabane, noma kulabo abesilisa nabesifazane abafuna ukuhlanganiswa. Akekho ovunyelwe ukungena esivumelwaneni sobudlelwano ngaphansi kwale ngxenye egameni lomunye umuntu emcimbini. Mayelana nobudlelwano noma umshado ngesikhathi sokufunda amazwi okuhlanganisa. Uma amaqembu engavumelani, umphakathi wokushada kufanele, uma efunda inqubo, akhulume ngobudlelwano bomthetho. Uyakufunga, A.B., ukuthi ngokwazi kwakho awekho amaphikiso omthetho avimbela ukuba ube nobudlelwano bomthetho / umshado no-C.D. okukhona lapha phambi kwakho nakubantu abakhona lapha kanye nalabo obamema ukuba babe izifakazelo ukuthi uthatha u-C.D. ukuba abe ngumlingani wakho / umkakho noma umyeni?

i eqophelo lomoya wemvelo, kuhlangene nenani elamukelekile noma amanembe alezo zici noma ingxube yazo etholakala emkhathini; noma ii esisi esikhiqizelwa emoyeni lapho kwazeka khona umsuka waso noma kwisimo lapho umsuka ungaqondakali khona. maqondana nomsebenzi oqhutshwa ngomasipala mayelana nokulandela lo Mthetho. v ukuhambisana nezibophezelo zaseNingizimu Afrika ngokulandisa kwezivumelwane zomhlaba jikelele. i neqophelo lomoya wemvelo, kuhlangene nenani elamukelekile noma amangcozu ayingxenye yezici noma ingxube yezici etholakala emoyeni; noma ii izici ezikhiqizelwa emoyeni ezisuka endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa esifundazweni noma kunoma iyiphi indawo ngaphakathi kwesifundazwe.. Uma amazinga kazwelonke esebunjiwe ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 7 sesici esithile noma ingxube yezici, uNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ongamele lo mnyango ngeke akwazi ukuguqula lelo zinga likazwelonke ngaphandle kokusungula amazinga aqine kakhulu aleso sifundazwe noma indawo ethile eyakhele isifundazwe. Ngokwalesi sigaba, isaziso singadweba umehluko phakathi kwezindawo ezehlukene ezakhele isifundazwe. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isaziso ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, noma yisiphi isichibiyelo esenziwe esazisweni, uNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ngaso ngokuhambisana nezigaba zama-49 na 50. Isigatshana- 4 asidingi ukusetshenziswa ezinguqukweni ezincane zesaziso. b angasungula amazinga asekhaya aqondene nemikhiqizo yesisi esuka endaweni eyaziwayo noma engaziwa kumasipala, ngesici ngasinye noma ngengxube yazo.

Noma yiliphi ilungu leBhodi kumele, ngaphambi kokungena ehhovisi futhi ekuqaleni kwayo yonke iminyaka yezimali yesiKhungo, lilethe isimemezelo esibhaliwe esisho ukuhlomula okuqondile noma okungaqondile kwalo kunoma iyiphi inkampani noma ibhizinisi ngendlela ehlinzekelwe esigabeni 234(3)(a) soMthetho weziNkampani, 1973 (uMthetho No. 61 ka 1973). Lapho ilungu leBhodi lifuna ukuhlomula kunoma iyiphi inkampani noma ukuhlomula kwelinye ibhizinisi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi sokusebenza kwalo njengelungu leBhodi kumele, ngaphambi kwezinsuku eziyishumi kusukela osukwini elithole ngalo lokho kuhlomula, lilethe isimemezelo esibhaliwe esisho kwiLungu lomkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali lokho kuhlomula. Noma yikuphi ukwehluleka ohlangothini lwelungu lokuveza ukuhlomula kwalo njengalokhu kuhlongoziwe esigatshaneni (3) kanye no (4) kumele kuholele ekuhoxisweni kokuqokwa kwalelo lungu ngokwesigaba 10(2). ILungu lomkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali kumele ligcine irejista ngokufanele yokuhlomula kwamalungu eBhodi azivezile ngokwalesi sigaba. (1) Ilungu leBhodi elehluleka ukwenza isimemezelo esikhonjiswe esigabeni 7, ngokususela kwisigatshana (2) lingahoxiswa ekuqhubekeni nokuba seBhodini. ILungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali, uma lithola ukuthi ilungu leBhodi lehlulekile ukuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 7, kumele liphenye lolo daba futhi lithathe izinyathelo ezifanele zokuqondisa izigwegwe.

Angazi ukuthi bangaki bethu abazi noma basakhumbula lezi zifiso, njengoba ingxenye enkulu yesiko lethu lendabuko ilahlekile eminyakeni edlule yohulumeni. Ngiyakwazi ukusho ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezibalulekile ekubuyiseni isithunzi samakhosi. Ngibhalile izinyathelo zomthetho nezinye esizithathile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi isakhiwo sethu sobuholi bendabuko sithola indawo yaso efanele. Le mizamoyo ifaka phakathi ukuthi ekugcineni indima yamakhosi ekuletheni intuthuko ihlonishwe. Siyazi ukuthi uNkosi uNgcobo kanye nekhansela lakhe, kanye namanye amakhosi, njengengxenye yesakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko, sevele baqale imizamo yokuthuthukisa, ngakho manje iOndabezitha iyamenywa ukuphatha ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ukuhlela nokubambisana nezakhiwo zezakhamuzi ukuze kusheshiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwentuthuko ezindaweni zokuhlala zamakhosi. Uhulumeni ukholelwa ukuthi intuthuko nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo kungasheshiswa ngokuhlanganisa imizamo yamakhosi kanye nezikhulu ezikhethwe. Imizamo kaNkosi uNgcobo ekuletheni intuthuko kule ndawo, ngiyakholelwa nonke niyazi. Akukho shwa ngokuqinisekile ngokuqhubeka kukaNkosi ekuthuthukiseni. I-IDP, sibona izoba nomthelela omuhle kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabantu ngokusheshisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezidingo. Bonke sibona ukuthi nakuba inkosi izama, isikhundla senkosi, njengabanye abaningi, sishiywe ngemuva uma kuziwa ekuhlinzekweni kwezinsiza zentuthuko. Lesi simo asivumelekile. Njengohulumeni, sikholwa ukuthi umphakathi kufanele uthuthuke ngokulinganayo; akufanele kube nezilwandle zempumelelo phakathi kobumpofu nokuhlupheka. Futhi akufanele kube nabantu abaphila kahle kakhulu kanti abanye bahlupheka kakhulu.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sithola ukuthi abalimi bethu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, kodwa bahlala bephikelela.
