Ngaphezu kwalokho, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele zikhulume ngamasiko enkampani, izimiso, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi abasha baqonde isiko lenkampani, futhi bakwazi ukuhamba phambili ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibekwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi, izifundo ezitholakalayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana nabaphathi, kuzobasiza ukuhlela ikusasa labo enkampanini. Izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele futhi zibe nezixhumanisi ezibalulekile, ezifana nezinsiza zokuxhumana, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze bahlale bexhumene nethimba labo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi oludingekayo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini. Ekugcineni, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele ziqedele ngombhalo ohehayo, ohlanganisa izifiso ezinhle zokuphumelela emsebenzini. Lokhu kuzokwenza abasebenzi abasha bazizwe bejabulile futhi bephakanyisiwe, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuhamba phambili ngokuzethemba. Ukubhalwa kwezincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele kube yisibonelo sokuhlonipha, ukwamukela, nokukhuthaza, ukuze kube nesithombe esihle sokusebenza enkampanini. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zincwadi zibhale ngendlela efanele, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi abasha bahlala bejabulile futhi bephakanyisiwe emsebenzini.

Lokhu kuhlonipha umthetho, futhi kukhulu kakhulu ekwandiseni amathuba okuthola izinsiza eziphawulekayo. Ngokuhamba phambili, uma ufaka le fomu, kubalulekile ukuthi uthathe isikhathi esanele ukuze uhlele kahle yonke imininingwane. Ukuhlola kabusha imininingwane yakho ngaphambi kokuyithumela kungasiza ekuqedeni noma yiziphi izinkinga ezingase zivele ngaphambi kokuba uqedele inqubo. Lokhu kuphinde kuqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi oluhlinzekiwe luhambisana neziqondiso ezisemthethweni, okuzothuthukisa ithuba lokuthi uhlelo lweGEMS lwenze kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uma uthola izinguquko emindenini yakho, njengokushintsha kokuhlala, izinguquko ezithintekayo ezimweni zempilo, noma ushintsho kusemsebenzini, kubalulekile ukuthi ube nesineke futhi uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zinguquko zikhonjiswa okufanele efomini lakho. Lokhu kuzovikela izinkinga ezingase zivele esikhathini esizayo futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi uhlangabezana nezidingo zempilo zansuku zonke. Ngokuphathelene nokuhlola, kufanele uqaphele ukuthi ithimba leGEMS linikeza ukuhola okudingekayo kubalungu ukuze baqonde kahle indlela yokufaka izimemezelo zokunemba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzekwa ngemininingwane ethile yokuxhumana kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze uqonde kahle izidingo ezifanele. Ukuxhumana nezisebenzi zeGEMS akugcini nje ngokukusiza, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza ukuhlanganiswa komphakathi, okubalulekile ekwakheni isikhala sokuxhumana esivulekile phakathi kwebhodi yeGEMS namalungu. Ekugcineni, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ukunemba kwefomu lelungu akukhona nje ukugcina imithetho, kepha kuyindlela yokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kweGEMS nabantu abawasebenzisayo.

Uma iKomidi Labalamuli livumelana ngoMthethosivivinywa oshintshiwe njengoba wamukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke, uMthethosivivinywa kufanele uyiswe eMkhandlwini kaZwelonke, futhi uma wamukelwa uMkhandlu, kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. Uma iKomidi Labalamuli livumelana ngenye inhlobo yoMthethosivivinywa, lowo Mthethosivivinywa kufanele uyiswe kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke nakwisiGungu kaZwelonke, futhi uma wemukelwa nguMkhandlu kanye noMkhandlu, kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. Uma uMthethosivivinywa oyiswe eMkhandlwini kaZwelonke njengokusho kwesigaba (f) noma (h) ngenhla awemukelwa uMkhandlu, uMthethosivivinywa uphelelwa yisikhathi ngaphandle uma lowoMthethosivivinywa wemukelwa nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke ngokwesekwa yivoti okungenani lababili kwabathathu bamalungu awo. Uma uMthethosivivinywa oyiswe kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke njengokusho kwengaba (g) no (h) ngenhla, ungemukelwa nguMkhandlu, lowoMthethosivivinywa uphelelwa yisikhathi, kodwa uMthethosivivinywa owawamukelwe nguMkhandlu ekuqaleni ungaphinde futhi wamukelwe nguMkhandlu kodwa wesekwe yivoti okungenani lababili kwabathathu bamalungu awo. UMthethosivivinywa owamukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke njengokusho kwesigaba (e), (i) noma (j) ngenhla kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. UMthethosivivinywa owamukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke njengokubeka kwesigaba (a)(i) ngenhla kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume.

Izilwane EziFuywayo: Injongo Yokuthanda Nokuphila Njengobungane Izilwane ezifuywayo, ezaziwa ngokuthi izilwane zokuzijabulisa, zibalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke yomuntu. Namuhla, abantu abaningi bavame ukuzithanda lezi zilwane, njengezinja, amakati, nezilwane ezahlukene, futhi zithathwa njengengxenye yomndeni. Nokho, ingabe izinzuzo zokuba nezilwane ezifuywayo zidlula izinkinga ezihambisana nazo? Izinzuzo Zokufuywa Kwezilwane: Okokuqala, izilwane ezifuywayo zicebisa impilo yethu ngezindlela eziningi. Zisiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwabantu, zikhuthaza ukuhamba, futhi zinciphisa ukucindezeleka. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi abantu abanezilwane ezifuywayo bahlala bejabule futhi banempilo engcono. Umphenyi uJohn C. T. Mackenzie ubonisa ukuthi abantu abanezinyoni bahlala bejabule kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abangafuywanga. Okwesibili, ukufuywa kwezilwane kukhuthaza umoya wokunakekela. Ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, ukudla, nokuvikela izilwane kudinga umzamo omkhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuthenga ukudla okufanele, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, nokuzijabulisa. Le mikhankaso inika abantu umqondo wokuphila, ibanikeza isizotha ngezinzwa zabo. Izinkinga Ezivela Ekufuyweni Kwezilwane: Nokho, akukhona konke okukhanya. Ukufuywa kwezilwane kudinga izinsiza eziningi, ezifana nesikhathi, imali, nezinsizakusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufuywa kwezilwane akulula, futhi lokho kungaholela ezinkingeni ezithile empilweni yomuntu. Ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyanele kubalulekile ukuze izilwane zihlale zikhona futhi ziphila kahle. Okwesithathu, kunezinkinga zokubuyiselwa.

Ukuguqulwa kwalezi zinsiza kubalulekile emnothweni nasemasikweni. Ukuhlanganiswa nokwakha izimnyango ezinhlanu zomlando ezimnyangweni ezithile nezithombe ezintathu eKapa: umlando wemvelo, umlando wesiko, kanye nomlando wezempi, kubonise inzuzo enkulu. Kuphakanyiswe futhi kwethulwa kwiCabinet. Le ndlela iphakanyiswa njengendlela yokuxhumana phakathi kwezilimi eziyi-11 zesiZulu njengoba kuqinisekiswe ngumthethosisekelo. Le ndlela ihlinzeka ngendlela yokuhamba phakathi kwezilimi. Kule nhlelo, isigaba ngesigaba, kulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ukwandisa ukwaneliseka kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi. Ulwazi lwasekhaya/olwakazwelonke ngakolunye uhlangothi lungaba umthombo wokukhula nokuthuthukiswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kukhona ingozi yokuthi kuzochithwa ngamandla angaphandle angabheki ulwazi lomphakathi njengolwakhe. I-ethnomedicine ne-ethnopharmacology iqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezitshalo, izilwane, nokuhlukahluka kwamasiko kanye nokuhlonipha izinkampani, imvelo yokudla kwezitshalo, indlela amasiko aphathwa ngayo, nokwakhiwa/ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezithile. Kukhona ifa lokukhuthaza ucwaningo lwezokwazi imvelo nezimiso ezisunguliwe ngaphansi kwe-Human Research Council ukuze kuthuthukiswe futhi kuvikelwe ulwazi lwasekhaya/olwakazwelonke. Ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba bokuthula nokuvikela iziqoqo. Lezi zicabango zashintsha zaba izenzo ngonyaka odlule? Umnyango usungule indlela eqinile yokuphatha eholelwa ngumenzi, ixhaswe ngumsizi wemenzi kanye noMphakathi-Jikelele.

Ithemba lokuthi umkhiqizo uzodayiseka kanjani emazweni angaphandle ukuze kungene izimali zangaphandle. Lokhu okulandelayo kwavela ophenyweni. Ukunikezwa kwamandla ezomnotho. Ukutholakala kolwazi jikelele. Ezemfundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa. Lokhu kukhomba ngokusobala ukuthi kunesidingo sokuba izakhiwo ezindala kumelwe zithuthukiswe ukuze zikwazi ukusetshenziswa yiwo wonke umuntu. Inkulumo-mpikiswano ngesihloko Access-ability yamukelwa futhi yandisa nokuxhumana kubantu abangezwa ababeyithamele. Inkulumo mpikiswano yaveza ukuthi ukuze kuxhumaneke kahle kumphakathi okhubazekile kanye nalowo ongakhubazekile kumele kubekhona ukubhekelana ngezindlela ezahlukene: ukufinyeleleka kalula ezakhiweni, olwazini, nakuzozonke izinto ezibhekene nenhlalakahle yabakhubazekile. Lelikhonsathi laba isicongo sokuveza amakhono abantu abahlukahlukene, abakhubazekile beqhamuka kuwowonke amasiko kanye nezifundazwe. I-Playhouse okwakubanjelwe kuyo umcimbi yakwazi ukubhekelaizidingo zalabo abahamba ngezihlalo. Ezinhlelweni zayo zokuthuthukiswa kwenquboMgomo I-Subdirectorate yagxila ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelo ezihlanganisa amasiko ahlukene. Lezinhlelo zimbandakanya ukuqwashisa ngendlela abantu abaphila ngayo nevezwa izinto ezingamagugu kubo, izakhiwo zabo, kanye nemikhuba yabo. Isibonelo ubuchwepheshe kanye namagugu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo kufaka ukuhlela ukusetshenziswa kohlelo kanye nokulawula. i.e ukuthuthukiswa kokuhlaziywa kwamasiko ngokuxhumana ukuxilonga kanye negalelo lohlelo.

Engenasizo lwalutho: Ukuqoqa lonke uhlobo lwemininingwane kuyabiza futhi kuchitha isikhathi kanti kugcina ngolwazi oluningi oluphelela emashalofini ngaphandle kokusetshenziswa. Umthelela walokhu kwaba wumcabango ongafanela lapho ukuhlela kwahlaluka njengento engabalulekile, ikakhulu uma kunezidingo eziphuthumayo nokwentuleka kwezinsiza. Ukwethula ulwazi lokuphatha oluwusizo: Uma I-IDP ithathwa njengengxenye yohlelo lokuphatha oludidiyele, kusemqoka ukuzwakalisa imibuzo ngohlobo lolwazi ngesimo esikhona njengamanje ukuze kufinyelelwe ezinqumeni ezifanele zokuphatha. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi kusemahlombe abaphathi bakamasipala, hhayi ochwepheshe bokuhlela noma abalawuli besifundazwe ukunquma imibandela yolwazi. Yimiphi imiphumela elindelwe esiGabeni sokuHlaziya Ngamanye amazwi, yini okufanele yaziwe ngomasipala ukuze bafinyelele ezinqumeni zeqhinga elibhekele ikusasa nokuqhuba ngempumelelo umsebenzi nokusebenzisa ngendlela efanele izinsiza ezinyindlala Umthetho weziNhlelo zikaMasipala awuphoqeleli ngalokhu. Udinga kuphela ukuba kuhlolwe izinga lentuthuko elikhona njengamanje kuhlangene nokuqagula imiphakathi engenazo izinsiza-nqangi zikamasipala? Ukufinyelela esinqumeni esiphusile ngezinto ezikleliswe phambili. Ulwazi kumele lukwazi ukusiza umasipala ekuthatheni izinqumo ngezidingo-nqangi noma izinkinga, ngemuva kokucabangela imibono yezakhamuzi/imiphakathi nangolwazi nezibalo ezikhona. Abathatha izinqumo kumasipala kumele babenolwazi ngezinkinga noma izinto ezikleliswe phambili, njengezinkomba, ingqikithi, imbangela nomthelela ohambisana nezinkinga noma izinto endaweni ngenhloso yokuthatha izinqumo ezifanele nokuveza izisombululo.

Ivele ku-Ndebe yeNhlangano ye-FIFA okokuqala. Abadlali abavelele u-Fabio Cannavaro, Andrea Pirlo, Luca Toni, Gianluigi Buffon. Thokozela ibhola lezinyawo elisezingeni lamazwe omhlaba ngokukhokha kusuka kuma-R70 nje - Bekisa isihlalo sakho emlandweni ube yingxenye yeQhawe Lamaqhawe. Faka isicelo ku-internet kuleli kheli: www.FIFA.com noma kunanoma yiliphi igatsha le-First National Bank ezweni lonke. Igama elithi "Kopanya" elisho ukuthi "ukuhlanganyela ndawonye" liphuma olimini lwesiSuthu. Limelele ukuthi umhlaba webhola lezinyawo uhlangana ndawonye okokuqala ngqa e-Afrika ngoNhlangula 2009. Idizayini yebhola ithathelwe emsebenzini wobuciko wejiyometri yabantu abangamaNdebele.

Ukubuyekeza umthetho olawula iqophelo lomoya ngenhloso yokuvikela, yokuvuselela nokwenza ngcono iqophelo lomoya eNingizimu Afrika, ukwenza konke lokhu ngokubhekela isidingo sentuthuko emileyo; ukuhlinzekela inkambo kazwelonke namazinga alawula ukuqashelwa kwamaqophelo omoya, ukuphatha nokulawula okwenzeka kuzo zonke izinhlaka zikahulumeni; inkambo yemizamo ethile yamaqophelo omoya; nokubhekela zonke izinto ezithintekayo ngalolu daba. Kudingeka izindlela zomthetho ezintsha nezinobuchule obusha zokuvikela, zokuvuselela nokwenza ngcono iqophelo lomoya eNingizimu Afrika. b noma yimuphi umgomo oshaywe ngaphansi kwesigaba -46 noma- 47; kanye c neminye emincane eshaywe ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho. Kulo Mthetho, igama noma isisho esithathelwe egameni noma kwisisho esichazwe esigatshaneni -1 linencazelo efanayo ngaphandle kokuba indikimba ikhombe ukuthi kuqondwe incazelo ehlukile. Inhloso yalo Mthetho wukuvikela, ukuvuselela nokwenza ngcono iqophelo lomoya eNingizimu Afrika, kube kubhekelwa isidingo sentuthuko emileyo. a ngokusebenzisa izinhlaka zikahulumeni eziqhuba lo Mthetho, uhulumeni kufanele avikele, avuselele futhi enze ngcono iqophelo lomoya eNingizimu Afrika; noma b uhulumeni kufanele aqhube umsebenzi walo Mthetho ukuze azuze impumelelo yalawo malungelo. b kuzo zonke izenzo ezithinta iqophelo lomoya eNingizimu Afrika. a emkhakheni kahulumeni kazwelonke nasekhaya; kanye b nasemkhakheni kahulumeni wesifundazwe, ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 146 soMthethosisekelo.

Ngako-ke "umzabalazo wokuqedwa kobumpofu kuyinto enkulu kanti futhi kusaqhubeka kuyinto enkulu yemizamo kahulumeni ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika entsha". Ukufaka isandla ekucazululweni kwezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu bonke emhlabeni. Kunginika intokozo enkulu ukunazisa ukuthi mayelana nalezibopho, uhulumeni usebenza kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhloso zesizwe ziyafezekiswa. Umnotho wezwe lethu ukhule ngamapesenti amane nesigamu (4.5%) kuleminyaka emibili nesigamu adlulile, kanti-ke loku wukukhula okudlule yonke eminye iminyaka seloku sathola umbuso wentando yeningi ngo 1994. Ngakwezomnotho, ukutshalwa kwezimali emisebenzini yezwe kanye nakumabhizinisi azimeleyo kukhule ngamapesenti ayishuminanye (11%) kanti-ke imali esetshenzisiwe ekwakheni izinto ezisetshenziswa ngumphakathi yona ikhule ngo 15.8%. Ukutshalwa kwezimali uma kulinganiswa nemali yezimpahla ezikhichizwa kuleli ngomnyaka ingu 18.4%, iphezulu kakhulu kusukela ngo 1991. Inani labantu abasebenzayo likhule ngo 500, 000 ngomnyaka eminyakaeni emithathu edlulile. Abantu abansundu babonakele bathuthuka ngakwezomnotho ngendlela emangalisayo. Abantu abansundu bebanamashezi angu 3% ngo 2004, kodwa-ke lelinani likhuphukile laze lafika ku 5%, kanti-ke ukukhushulelwa kwabantu abansundu ezikhundleni ezikhulu zobumenenjala kuthuthuke kwasuka ku 24% kwaya ku 27%. Kodwa-ke kufuneka ukuthi kuhlale kusikhathaza ukuthi lenani lisesephansi kakhulu. Ukuthuthuka kwezomnotho kusiphosele inselele thina sonke. Ukukhula kwezidingo zabantu okusolo kuqhubeke njalo kuchaza ukuthi inqubekela phambili eyenzeka kumphakathi wonkana iyajabulisa.

Uhulumeni ubhekene nengcindezi enkulu kokubili emhlabeni nasemhlabeni jikelele ngenkathi ubhekene nezinga elingalindelekile lokuphazamiseka okwenze kwaba nzima ukuhulumeni kuleli. Ama-Automatic Teller Machines (ATMs) azokwamukela amakhadi amaningi ezinkampani zangaphandle kuhlanganise neVisa, iCirrus, neMaestro. iNingizimu Afrika ngeke ikwazi ukubhekana nale nselelo enkulu ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izinsiza ngokubambisana, ibe nezibambiso ezilinganayo, ulwazi, nezakhono ezivela ezindaweni ezingaphansi kokulawulwa kukahulumeni. Labo abahileleke emaphusheni kanye nemali ezokhula zibe nezihlahla ezinkulu. Ngenkathi sizama ukuvimbela okuthile ukuthi kwenzeke mayelana nezidakamizwa, sisesha futhi senza uphenyo ubusuku nemini, sithumba futhi sishaye icala labo abathengisa futhi abasebenzisa izidakamizwa. Izikhala zizohlinzekwa ngaphandle kwemikhawulo futhi izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo kufanele zibe lula ukuhamba kwezinsiza zokuthutha udoti ezinsizeni. E-Ningizimu Afrika, umthelela wezinhlelo ezisekelwe kubuhlanga ushiye ukusabalalisa ingcebo kungalingani njalo, kudala izingxabano ngamagama ahlotshaniswa nokuphathwa kabusha komnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ochwepheshe beQembu Lezisebenzi Ezithile bahlangene ukusiza abenzi bomthetho ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwabo olunzulu nezakhono. Izinkinga ezizobekwa phambili zikhuluma ngezinkinga abazikholelwayo, kanye nokuhlolwa okujwayelekile kokuqonda kwabo iNingizimu Afrika, edlule, manje, nekusasa. Kumele sithole indlela yokufinyelela nokuhlinzeka ngempahla yesifunda. Kumele sikwenze, ukuze singavumeli amanzi ukuthi athwale umoya wokuzithoba kwezinto esingakwazi ukuzifeza ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi edolobheni lethu.

I-header ejikayo iyimishini enhle yokujikeleza izitshalo, kodwa uma ingaphathwa kahle, ingaba yingozi, njengezinto zonke. Okulandelayo kuchaza ezinye izici okufanele uzicabangele uma usebenza ngalomshini. Lo mshini unikeza ithuba lokujikeleza ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze izitshalo zikhule, ukufaka ama-herbicides, ama-pesticides, nezinye izifo, kanye nokufaka umanyolo ofana ne-nitrogen kancane kancane ngokuya ngezidingo zezitshalo. Lo mshini ungafaka amanzi amancane njalo, kodwa lokhu kungaphindwaphindwa. Uma umlimi eqala ukujikeleza ngalomshini, kufanele ashintshe indlela yakhe yokujikeleza. Bangase babe neziqondiso zokufaka amanzi angu-30mm noma 50mm njalo, manje kufanele bafake lezo zinga kodwa hhayi konke ngesikhathi esisodwa - bangafaka amanzi ngokuphindwe kabili noma kathathu. Uma amanzi amaningi efakwa ngesikhathi esisodwa, kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwamanzi futhi kwenze izinsika zibe nzima. Futhi khumbula ukuthi umlimi uphatha inani lamanzi ezimpandeni. Uma bethatha isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi baqale ukujikeleza, kuzoba nzima ukuvimbela umonakalo ezitshalo. Lokhu kungaba yinkinga kulabo abaqalayo abajikeleza ngalendlela ngoba abazi ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukuze isandla sihambe sifikile lapho siqale khona. Ungazikhathazi ukuhamba i-header ejikayo, izokulethela inzuzo. Njengoba le ndlela ivame ukuhlinzeka ngethuba lokugcina amanzi uma ijikeleza kahle. Njengoba zonke izindlela zokujikeleza, lapha futhi izinga lokumuncwa komhlaba kufanele lihlolwe njalo futhi kufanele ujikeleze kuphela uma amanzi edingeka. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukugcina amanzi namandla ngesikhathi izitshalo zikhula.

Isigaba 3 sikhuluma ngokuhlela nemininingwane ngemisebenzi eqokelwe ukwenziwa. Umasipala kumele aqiniseke ukuthi imisebenzi ekhethiwe inobudlelwane obuqondile nezinto noma nezinkinga ngokunjalo nezinjongo eziphawulwe esigabeni sokuqala. Makucace emathimbeni aqokiwe ukuthi umsebenzi oyokwenziwa ukuphi, uyoqala nini futhi uphele nini, inani lawo nokuthi imali iyovela kuphi. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, okumele kuzuzwe nezinkomba mazisungulwe ukuze izinga nomthelela womsebenzi ukaleke. Ukuqapha imisebenzi kudinga ukuba ochwepheshe basebenze namathimba okuqalisa uhlelo lomsebenzi. Labo ababambe iqhaza nomphakathi othintwa yilomsebenzi banendima abayidlalayo kulesigaba nokuphonsa imibuzo ehambisana nokubunjwa komsebenzi. Ngemuva kokuqoka imisebenzi, umasipala kumele aqinisekise ukuthi imisebenzi iyahambisana nezinjongo namaqhinga kamasipala, nohlaka lwezinsiza kanye nemibandela yomthetho. Ngaphezulu kwalokhu, lesigaba siyithuba elihle lomasipala ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi mayelana nengqikithi yayo, izindawo zemisebenzi, isikhathi ngenhloso yokulumbanisa nokudidiyela izinhlelo, isibonelo: uhlelo lwentuthuko yezomnotho endaweni. Ukwengezela, ngaphambi kokwemukela I-IDP, umasipala kumele anike ithuba umphakathi ukuba uveze imibono ngeziphakamiso ezenziwe kwi-IDP. Ngemuva kwezinguquko ezingaqhamuka ngenxa yeqhaza lomphakathi, umkhandlu ucubungula izichibiyelo ze-IDP ukuze iphasiswe. Zingakapheli izinsuku eziyishumi umasipala emukele I-IDP, kumele ethule umbiko ofanayo we-IDP ohlangene nohlelo lweNqubo, kuNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ukuze uhlolwe.

(a)UMkhandlu uyakuba namalunga angeqile kwangama-25, ayi-14 kulawo kufanele kube ngabhaliswe ngaphansi kwesigaba 31 (a) no (b), aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe ngokubheka ulwazi lawo kwezokufundisa abahlengikazi, ubuhlengikazi, ezempilo emphakathini, usizo lwezempilo lokuqala, ezempilo emsebenzini nezempilo ngokwengqondo. Amalunga kufanele aqokwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokuba amagama aphakanyiswe yilabo bantu abathintekayo, nangemuva kokukhipha isaziso ephephabhukwini lombuso simema ukuba kuphakanyiswe amagama amalunga amasha. b Uma kwenzeka uNgqongqoshe engatholi magama noma kuphakanyiswe amagama angenele esikhathini esinqunyelwe isimemo sokuphakanyiswa kwamagama, uNgqongqoshe angaqoka isamba esidingekayo samalunga afanele ukuqokwa njengamalunga ngokwesigatshana 1. Ilunga liyophatha leso sokhundla isikhathi esingqile eminyakeni emihlanu kusukela ngosuku eliqokwe ngalo. Amagama amalunga oMkhandlu, usuku aqale ngalo esikhundleni nesikhathi aqokwe ukuba asihlale esikhundleni kufanele kukhishwe nguNgqongqoshe ngesaziso ephephabhukwini loMbuso ngokushesha ngemuva kokuba beqokiwe. UNgqongqoshe angaphinda aqoke umuntu osephelelwe isikhathi sakhe, aqokelwe esinye isikhathi esingeqile eminyakeni emihlanu. Lelo nalelo lunga kufanele uma lingena esikhundleni lisayide isethembiso sokuthi lizolandela okushiwo yiloMthetho kanye noMqulu wokuziphatha a UNgqongqoshe angachitha uMkhandlu uma uhluleka ukulandela noma ikuphi okushiwo yiloMthetho. b Yonke imisebenzi yoMkhandlu iyakuba semahlombe kaNgqongqoshe kuze kuqokwe uMkhandlu omusha.

Ngenxa yokuthi izimboni zamasiko ziyingqikithi yamasu kaHulumeni kwezokuthuthuka, i-DACST izoke igxile kulomkhakha. Lokhu kusho ukuthuthukiswa kokubambisana phakathi komphakathi kanye nezimboni ezizimele, ngokukhandwa kohlaka lokuthuthukisa imikhandlu yokudayisela amanye amazwe, kuphinde futhi kulethelwe izimboni zomculo kanye nezamafilimu, izinto ezimbili ezithuthukisa ezomnotho ukuze kuzuze izimboni zamasiko. Ukongiwa kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezamagugu kunikeza inkundla yezamasiko emelele wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuthuthukiswa kwecebo likazwelonke ukuze kuvuselelwe iminyuziyemu ezindaweni zokuhlelwa, imibukiso ukwethulwa kwezinto ezisiza umphakathi kanye nezinhlelo zemfundo enye indawo ebhekiwe ngenxa yokuthi ingaba namandla yokuba nezinhlelo eziphapheme ekuvezweni kwesithombe mayelana nezamagugu aseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla ezomnotho ezobuciko kanye nezamasiko, ngalokhoke kunciphisa ubuphofu. Ukuthuthukisa amandla obuciko kwezokufundiswa kanye nokuqeqeshwa kanye nokuxhasa imicimbi ebanzi yezobuciko. Ukwakha imboni engeke iphele yobuciko esamdlalo egxile ekutholakaleni kalula, yezinga eliphezulu, ehlukahlukene kanye nelinganisayo kuleyomiphakathi eyayingenawo amathuba, ukuze kuqguqguzeleke inqubekela phambili kanye nokugujwa kwawowonke amagugu asamdlalo aseNingizimu Afrika. Ukudala amathuba kwezobuciko ikakhulukazi emiphakathini ebingenawo amathuba ngaphambili, ukulingana ngobulili, intsha kanye nabakhubazekile.

Umphakathi ungaxhumana nalesi sikhungo ukuze uthole usizo ngokushayela inombolo engenamkhawulo: 0800 005 133. Lesi sikhungo sokuxhumana kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphezulu sinezisebenzi ezinganikeza umphakathi izeluleko nolwazi mayelana nezempilo nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi nemininingwane edingekayo kumshayeli. Njengoba kuhlobene nezempilo, uzothola usizo. Lesi sikhungo, esitholakala ebhizinisini iNatalia, okuyiHhovisi Elikhulu leMnyango Wezempilo e-uMgungundlovu, sinezisebenzi eziqeqeshiwe ezilungele ukusiza noma ubani oxhumana nazo. Inhloso yokwakha lesi sikhungo ukuhlinzeka umphakathi wonke ngosizo lwezempilo ngaso sonke isikhathi ngensiza zokuxhumana ezifana neradiyo, ithelevishini, i-imeyili, i-SMS, kanye nezinsizakalo zocingo. Uqhubekile wathi, "Lesi sikhungo sisiza kakhulu kithi ekusizeni uma kukhona okuphuthumayo ngoba uma umphakathi uvusa isixwayiso, singafika ngokushesha lapho kudingeka khona njengoba lesi sikhungo sinezixhumanisi ezisiza abasebenzi bezimo eziphuthumayo ukuba baqondiswe lapho usizo ludingeka khona ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi befuna lelo ndawo." Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi sikhungo singathumela imiyalezo yokwazisa uma kwenzeka izimo zokuphuthuma, kuchaza uNtsobi. Ingxenye enkulu yezingcingo ezitholakala kulesi sikhungo ivela kubantu abafuna ulwazi nosizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, kanti abanye bafuna ulwazi mayelana nemithi. "Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi lesi sikhungo singasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi kubantu abafuna usizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, okusho ukuthi siphinde sibe nesandla ekufundiseni umphakathi.

Lesi sivumelwano kumele siqinisekise ukuhlela kwabasebenzi abakule khandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi abahilelekile ekuhlinzekeni ngamanzi nalabo abathintekile ngesivumelwano mayelana nokuthi bazokhokhwa kanjani ngokuhambisana nomthetho wezabasebenzi. i futhi kuzoletha izinguquko ezimamounts ezikhokhwayo, amaholo, noma kuzoletha izinguquko ezindinganisweni noma ezingeni lokusebenza ii lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuveza ulwazi emphakathini mayelana nezinguquko nezichibiyelo eziphakanyisiwe ku-I ngenhla; futhi h noma yiziphi izijeziso ezingafanele zikhokhwe noma yimuphi umuntu onenhlangano yokwehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi noma iyiphi uhlelo olubhalwe phansi, incwadi yemiyalo, isizinda solwazi, uhlu olunembile, amarekhodi ezimali, kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi oluqoqwe ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano kuzohlala kungokwakhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. a ivimbela ukuthengiswa, ukudluliswa kwamalungelo okuphatha, noma ukucindezelwa kwanoma iyiphi impahla eyindawo kanye nezakhiwo ezikhona noma ezizayo futhi engelona impahla yekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, kuhlanganise noma iyiphi ingxenye yezinsizakalo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ngaphandle kokuthi ukuthengiswa, noma ukudluliswa kwamalungelo noma ukucindezelwa kuhlelwe ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kwekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi noma ii kuvunywe ngesisekelo senhlangano yekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi.

IX. Isiphetho Izinhlelo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zibalulekile ekunakekelweni kwesiguli. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ziyahambisana nemithetho, futhi zikhuthaza impilo engcono. Ngokuhlonipha lezi zinyathelo ezisemqoka, izibhedlela zingathola impumelelo embonini yokunakekelwa kwezempilo, zigcine izinsizakusebenza zihlanzekile futhi ziphendule izidingo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa izinga eliphezulu lempilo nezenzo ezithobekile.

Izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika noma abantu abanelungelo lokuhlala unomphela ababeguqula ubulili ngaphambi kokuba umthetho wokubhaliswa kuzalwa nowokushona i-Birth and Death Registration Act, 1992, uqale ukusebenza, bangenza isicelo zokushintsha ubulili babo. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-526E kunoma yiliphi ihhovisi lezaseKhaya eNingizimu Afrika. Yenza isicelo kwinxusa noma imission uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Khipha isitifikedi sokuzalwa. Kwisimo somuntu izitho zakhe zangasese esezishintshiwe ngokuhlinzwa noma ngokunikezwa imithi, angafakela imibiko echaza uhlobo nemiphumela yaleyo nqubo eyenziwe noma ukwelashwa okusetshenzisiwe noma okulungiselelwe ngodokotela abenza leyo nqubo noma abasebenzisa lokho kulashwa. Kwisimo nesimo, nikeza umbiko ochaza indlela ubulili umuntu angayo okwamanje, ukuthi uhambisane nesicelo. Lo mbiko kumele wenziwe ngudokotela ohlole umenzi wesicelo ukuze aqinisekise ubulili abonakala eyibo. Khipha umbiko okhishwa ngudokotela wezingqondo oweluleke umenzi wesicelo onikeza imininingwane ephelele yodaba, ikakhulukazi umlando walo, kanye nesimo umuntu abonakala ekuso ngokwemizwa nomqondo maqondana nokushintshwa kwakhe. Uma umenzi wesicelo eneminyaka engu-16 noma ngaphezulu kwayo, kumele kwenziwe isicelo somunye umazisi. Kumele kuthathwe izigxivizo zeminwe ukuze kwenziwe isiqinisekiso ngokomthetho, kanye nokufakela ulwazi olusha kwi-HANIS database. Le nkonzo ingathatha amaviki angu-8. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali kulayini we-internethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze lonyango.

Ikakhulukazi, usizo lungahlinzekwa lapho ukuthuthukiswa kudingeka ukukhuthazwa ngokusungula i-WUA (njengoba kwenzelwa abalimi abasha). Zonke izikhungo zokulima namabhodi amanzi abekade ekhona ngaphambi kokuqala komthetho kufanele aguqulwe zibe yi-WUA. Amabhodi amanzi athile asunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi ukuze akwazi ukulima nawo azoguqulwa abe yi-WUA. Ukuhunyushwa kwamabhodi amanzi kusho ukuthi kufanele baphinde basungule izindawo zabo zokusebenza nezinhlelo zokuphatha ukuze bamele kahle ukuhlukahluka kwabantu kuleyo ndawo, ngokwezizinda nezobulili. INingizimu Afrika inembali yokufinyelela ezinsizeni ngokungafani. Ukuguqulwa kuyindlela eyodwa yokufeza ubulungiswa. UNgqongqoshe uphumelele imihlahlandlela yokusungula ikomidi lokuphatha le bhodi yokulima eguquliwe. Kubalulekile ukuthi i-WUA ibe nezezimali ezizimele ukuze iphumelele. Ukusungulwa kwe-WUA kungenzeka kuphela uma amalungu ekwazi ukukhokhela izindleko zokusungula i-WUA kanye nezindleko zokusebenza nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi emikhulu ephathelene ne-WUA. Ngakho-ke, i-WUA ivamise ukuxhaswa ngezimali ezikhokhwa kumalungu ezaziwa ngokuthi "izindleko zokusetshenziswa kwamanzi." Ezinye izinsiza ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zosizo nokuxhaswa kwezimali okuvela kubaxhasi. I-WUA ingabuyekeza izindleko ezikhokhwa minyaka yonke kumalungu ayo uma isivumelwano sayo sinikeza lokhu. Lezi zindleko kufanele zihambisane nesu lokubiza lokusetshenziswa kwamanzi elibekwe nguNgqongqoshe.

Uma indawo eyigugu noma indawo ethathwa njengeyiGugu ngokomlando, iba yindawo kaHulumeni ngokokwabiwa komhlaba njengoba kuhlongozwe esigatshaneni (1), indawo kusukela ngosuku lokwabiwa komhlaba, ithathwa njengekhethwe njengeNdawo enomlando noma njengeSakhiwo esinomlando esiFundazweni. kumele idluliselwe ngumphathi kamasipala othintekayo eMkhandlwini ukuze kubekwe imibono ngaphambi kokuthi lowo mthethodolobha noma lowo mthethonqubo uvunywe ngumasipala. kulethwe futhi kusayinelwe ngumphathi kamasipala othintekayo. nomthethonqubo osewuhlaka, uMkhandlu kanye nomasipala kumele othintekayo kumele bazame ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni ngokuxoxisana futhi umphathi kamasipala wamasipala kumele abize umhlangano phakathi koMkhandlu nomasipala. Uma kungekho sivumelwano okufinyelelwa kusona phakathi koMkhandlu nomasipala othintekayo emva kwezinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu emva kokukhishwa kwesaziso esibhalwe phansi okukhulunywe ngaso esigatshaneni (2), umphathi kamasipala kumele, ngokubhalwe phansi, azise iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezamagugu kanye neLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ohulumeni basekhaya ngesaziso sokubiza umhlangano phakathi koMkhandlu nomasipala ngelinge lokufinyelela esivumelwaneni. Omunye umhlangano okukhulunywe ngawo endimeni (b) kumele ube khona ezinsukwini ezingamashumi amathathu emva kokuthi amaLungu oMkhandlu oPhethe azisiwe. Uma kungavunyelwana, umasipala angeke uqhubeke nomthethodolobha noma nomthethonqubo osewuhlaka.

Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungelona lutho esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Nokho, kukhona nezifo ezivela endleleni esiphila ngayo. Uma singadli ukudla okunempilo futhi singanakekeli imizimba yethu, singathola lezi zifo. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwe yindlela yethu yokuphila. Le bhukwana contains ulwazi lokuthi ungakwenza kanjani ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho ungowakho. Impilo yakho isandleni sakho. Ngakho-ke, unakekele. Kumele sithathe ukunakekela thina. Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika lidla utshwala obungaphezu kwabantu kwamanye amazwe emhlabeni. Abantu abaningi baphuza utshwala ngendlela engafanele. Abanye baphuza kakhulu kanti abanye baphuza njalo. Lokhu kudala izinkinga eziningi. Abanye abantu bayakhishwa emsebenzini ngenxa yokuzibophezela kwabo kutshwala. Abanye bathi bangaba nodlame uma bephuzile futhi balwe namalungu omndeni, abangane, nabangane. Kwabanye, utshwala bungaba yingozi, futhi ukuqhubeka nokuphuza kungaholela ekufeni. Kungcono ukungaphuzi utshwala nhlobo ngoba contains ama-toxins ayingozi angaphazamisa impilo yakho. Ukuphuza utshwala kungaba nemiphumela emibi emndenini wakho. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile uma ungumuntu ophuzayo, uphuze ngokuziphatha kahle. Funda le bhukwana ukuze ufunde ukuthi ungaphuza kanjani ngokuziphatha kahle. Bheka uDudu, laba bantu sebesesaba utshwala obusele emshadweni wokuqala. Pic. UBongi uthatha yonke imali anayo ukuze athenge utshwala kanti umndeni wakhe uyalila ngoba le mali kufanele ibe isetshenziselwa ukudla, izingubo, nokukhokhela izifundo zezingane. Uyazi sengilahlekelwe ukuhlonipha yena. Pic.

Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo esikhishiwe kwisigatshana 3 kufanele izanelise ngokuthi esinobuqiniso nesifanelekile ngenxa yokuthi uphathini orejistiwe nokhishelwa isinqumo esimvunayo ufakile ngqo nangenyezinye izindlela ukwakha umnotho wempahla yabo kumbe kwingxenye yempahhla kaphathini wobuhlobo oburejistiwe. Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo ngokubekiwe kwisigatshana 3 ingaluhlehlisa usuku lokugcinwa kwesinqumo senkantolo, okungahambisana nokukhokhwa kwenzalo, ukukhoka kancane kancane kanye nokuhanjiswa kumbe ukudluliswa kwempahla ethize, ngaleyo ndlela inkantolo eyibona inobuqiniso futhi ifanelekile, uma uphathini obhekene nesinqumo efake isicelo sokuhlehliselwa usuku lokuqala ukugcina isinqumo senkantolo. Ngaphandle uma kubekiwe kule sigaba, isicelo esifakiwe enkantolo sokuthi kukhishwe isinqumo ngaphansi kwesigaba 34 kufanele senziwe ingakapheli iminyaka emibili kusukela buqediwe ubuhlobo oburejistiwe. Noma yingasiphi isikhathi, emveni kokudlula kwesikhathi okukhulunwa ngaso kwisigatshana 1, inkantolo ingasivumela isicelo ukuthi sikamkhalazi enkantolo ngaphanssi kwesigaba 33, uma yaneliseka kuzo zonke izinto, ukuthi umkhalazi uzobhekana nobunzima obukhulu kakhulu uma singamukeleki isicelo sakhe kunalobo azobhekana nabo okuwuye isicelo nesinqumo senkantolo esizobe sibhekiswe kuye. Uma oyedwa kumbe bobabili ophathini befa, uphathini osaphila orejistiwe kumbe umphathi wefanwanoma yimuphi uphathini orejistiwe kufanele akhiphe isaziso esibhaliwe asithumele kubantu abanentshisekelo.

Isiqiniseko ukuthi imali yonyaka elinganiselwa ku R2,5 bhiliyoni wamarandi, kudingeka ukuba iphidwe okungenani kabili esikhathini esilinganiselwa eminyakeni eyishumi ezayo. Ukusesthenziswa ngendlela ubuchwepheshe obuvelele, kungumthelela obalulekile ekwehliseni izindleko emnothweni. Lokhu kwenza ukuba kusebenzeke ngempumelelo kuHulumeni kanye nakubantu bon ke (kubandakanywa nezikhungo) ukugqugquzela Ukulingana. lzinjongo ezinkulu zalo Mthetho yilezi: Ukungavumeli kanye nokugwema ukucwasana okungalungile; Ukungavumeli kanye nokugwema inkulumo enen- zondo; Ukugwema ukuhlukumezana; Ukugqugquzela ukulingana; kanye Nokuhlinzeka izisulu zokucwaswa okungalungile, zen kulumo enenzondo nezokuhlukumezeka intuba yokuphunyula. Lapho efile, sazi ukuthi uMama Adelaide Tambo usanda kukhishwa esibhedlela. Nokho, saphinda sagcizelela ukuthi wayenomphefumulo wokubekezela nokufuna okuqinile ukuqhubeka nokuphila phakathi kwethu. Sihlose ukumamukela yena kanye namalungu omndeni wakhe njengababukeli emcimbini ngenyanga kaFebhuwari, kodwa lokho akuphumelelanga. Kusasa sizokwenza ukuhlonipha okokugcina njengoba simfaka emathuneni. Ngakho, uzobe ekhona nathi emoyeni ngenyanga ka-Okthoba kulo nyaka njengoba sibhiyozela usuku lokuzalwa kukayise, owayezobe eshaya iminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalolunye, ubaba bezingane zakhe, umngane wakhe, umlingani wakhe, kanye nezingane ezidumile zethu, u-Oliver Reginald Tambo. Sizophinde sikhulumele umndeni wakwaTambo. Ngiyajabula futhi ukumukela uMama ophakanyisiwe u-Albertina Luthuli, okhona phakathi kwethu namuhla ekuseni. Ung daughter kaChief Albert Luthuli, owawuqala ukuthola iNobel Peace Prize emhlabeni. Ukufa okudabukisayo kukaChief Luthuli, eminyakeni engamashumi amane edlule, kukhunjulwa kulo nyaka, futhi usizi lwaleso sikhathi lwazwakala lapho sathola ukuthi ushaye umshini ophumayo emapulazini esukari eKwaDukuza. Ukufa kwakhe bekuyimfihlo futhi kwashaqisa nomzimba, kodwa impilo yakhe bekuyisibonelo esikhulu esasisiholela enkululekweni esibhiyozela namuhla. Ngiyaziqhenya ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ekhululekile inombono ocacile wokubonga ngalokho uAlbert Luthuli noOliver Tambo abakwenze ezweni lethu ngokusungula izimiso ezimbili zendawo ukuze kuhlonishwe amaqhawe - isimiso sikaLuthuli kanye nesimiso sabangane bakaO.R. Tambo.

Ukwakha izitolo zokudla eziseduze nezindawo ezisemaphandleni kungasiza kakhulu ekwehliseni izinkinga zokushoda kokudla, njengoba zingahlinzeka ngamakhasimende ukudla okuthengiswayo ngezindleko eziphansi. Isiphetho Izinkinga zokudla emindenini engaphansi kwemali zidinga ukuba zibhekwane ngokubambisana ukuze zixazulwe. Ngokubambisana, uhulumeni, izinkampani, kanye nemiphakathi bangakha izixazululo ezizokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi imindeni ibhekane nezinkinga zokudla. Kubalulekile ukuba sibe nesibopho sokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze imindeni ikwazi ukuphila kahle, okuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.

Izinkinga Zokudla Emindenini Engekho Nezinsiza Ngemva kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokudla zibe yinkinga enkulu emindenini engaqondile eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kudala ukukhathazeka okukhulu kubantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude nasemakhaya. Ukuhlaziya le nkinga kudinga ukuthi sibheke izimbangela, imiphumela, kanye nezixazululo ezikhona ukuze sithole indlela yokuphendula lesi simo. Izimbangela Zezinkinga Zokudla Enye yezimbangela eziyinhloko zokushoda kokudla emindenini engaphansi kwemali ibangelwa ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi. Abantu abaningi bahluleka ukuthola imisebenzi efanelekayo, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zokudla eziyisisekelo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni imindeni ibhekane nezinkinga zokungabi nemali eyanele yokuthenga ukudla okudingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izimo zokuphila ezinzima, ezifana nokungabi namanzi ahlanzekile, zenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ukudla okunempilo. Futhi, izinkinga zendawo yokuhlala zibe nomthelela omkhulu. Ezinye izindawo, ikakhulukazi ezisemakhaya, zidinga ukuthuthwa kwezinsiza zokudla ezifana nezitolo ezithengisayo, okwenza kube nzima ukufinyelela ukudla okunempilo. Imiphumela Yokushoda Kokudla Ukushoda kokudla kubangela imiphumela emibi emindenini engaphansi kwemali. Izingane ezikhulayo zidinga ukudla okunempilo ukuze zikhule kahle, kanti ukuntuleka kokudla okwakha umzimba kuholela ezinkingeni zempilo ezifana ne-anemia, ukungakhuli kahle, nezinkinga zokucabanga. Lokhu kubangela imiphumela emibi emphakathini, njengoba izingane ezingenamandla zingakwazi ukufunda kahle esikoleni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nokudla okwanele kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, okwandisa izindleko zezokwelapha.

Ukuqinisekiswa Kwezenzo Zesisebenzi Sikahulumeni: I-GEMS Isixazululo Esibalulekile Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili ngeshesha, izinqubo ezivamile zidinga ukuhamba nalesi sikhathi. Ngakho-ke, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kuyinto ebalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme). Le nhlangano idlala indima enkulu ekwenzeni kube lula ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bathole izinsizakalo zezempilo eziphakeme, kodwa lokho kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kwempumelelo nasemsebenzini. Ukuqinisekisa isimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kubalulekile kakhulu, hhayi kuphela ukuze kugcinwe ubufakazi bokusebenza, kodwa futhi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bayakwazi ukujabulela izinsiza ezifanele. Lokhu akukhona nje ukwenziwa kwesitoreji, kodwa kudinga ukuba kube nomqondo ophusile wokuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ziqinisekisa ukukhula nokuphila kahle kwalezi zisebenzi. Ukusiza abasebenzi ukwazi ukuthi bahlala bexhaswa, kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yabo ngendlela efanele. Ngokwe-GEMS, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi kukhombisa ubulungiswa bokusiza abasebenzi, njengoba kuqinisekisa ukuthi kuphela labo abasebenza emsebenzini kahulumeni abangathola lezi zinsizakalo. Lokhu kudala isimo sokwethembana phakathi kwabaphathi nezisebenzi, ngoba abasebenzi bazi ukuthi izinsizakalo abasithandayo zikhona futhi zikhona ngezinqubomgomo ezicacile. Lokhu akugcini nje ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle, kodwa futhi kusekela umqondo wokusebenza ngempumelelo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi lezi zinhlinzeko azibheki kuphela izidingo zabasebenzi; zihlola futhi izidingo zempumelelo kahulumeni.

Khipha le mali usebenzisa ifomu lokukhokha lentela elingu-IRP6, ngaphambi kosuku lokukhokha. I-SARS izothumela abakhokhi bentela yesikhashana ababhalisiwe amafomu afanele. Intela yesikhashana ingakhokhwa ehhovisi lesigaba sentela esiseduze kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu phakathi kwe-8:00 AM no-3:00 PM, ngaphandle kwezinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi. Uma abantu bekhokha ngeposi noma beyifaka ebhange, kufanele bavumele isikhathi sokulethwa kweposi noma sokucubungula izinkokhelo zebhange. Uma ukukhokha kuthunyelwa ngocingo, abantu kufanele bakhumbule ukuthi ibhange linomkhawulo wesikhathi salolo suku futhi kudingeka isikhathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umthumeli unama-funds anele, okungathatha izinsuku ezimbili kuya kwezintathu. Inombolo yentela kufanele ibe nezinombolo eziyishumi, kanti inombolo lapho imali izokwenziwa khona ibhekisela ku-akhawunti ezothola imali. Noma iyiphi inkokhelo eyenziwe engahambisani nalokho okubhalwe ngenhla, ngokuhambisana nenombolo yentela kanye nenombolo ye-akhawunti ethola, ngeke yamukelwe. Uma usuku lokugcina lokukhokha luhlangana nosuku lokuphumula noma iMgqibelo, abantu kufanele bakhokhe ngosuku lokugcina lokusebenza ngaphambi kosuku lokuphumula noma iMgqibelo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi olunembile, vakashela ku-website ye-SARS ku-www.sars.gov. Amafomu e-IRP 6 esikhathini sokuqala kufanele athunyelwe, noma uma ucabanga ukuthi akukho ntela yesikhashana okufanele ikhokhwe. Uma ukukhokha kwentela yesikhashana kwenziwa ngokusekelwe emalini ehleliwe engaphansi kwenani lokuqala, kufanele kwenziwe isicelo nencazelo.

(1) Umhlangano wokuqala weBhodi kumele ubanjwe ngosuku nangesikhathi esinqunywe yiLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali ngemuva kwalokho yonke imihlangano elandelayo kumele ukuba inqunywe nguSihlalo. Isibalo esivumelekile ukuba sibambe umhlangano webhodi yiningi lamalungu eBhodi. Ukuqhutshwa komhlangano weBhodi kumele, ngokweyame ezihlinzekweni zalesi sigaba, kunqunywe nguSihlalo kubandakanya ilungelo lokunquma ukuthi noma yiluphi udaba okuxoxwa ngalo lungamiswa ngaphambi kokuthi luvotelwe. USihlalo kumele engamele yonke imihlangano yeBhodi: Kuncike ekutheni uma engekho iSekela likaSihlalo kumele lengamele futhi esimweni laphouSihlalo noma iSekela likaSihlalo lingekho emhlanganweni weBhodi, amalungu akhona angakhetha, kuwona, umuntu ozobamba njengoSihlalo ngesikhathi salowo mhlangano. Isinqumo sebhodi kumele ukuba sithathwe yiningi lamavoti amalungu akhona emhlanganweni futhi, esimweni lapho kunokulingana kwevoti kunoma yiluphi udaba, uSihlalo uyakwazi ukufaka ivoti ukwengeza evotini alihlosile. IBhodi kumele lihlele ukuba kugcinwe amaminithi emihlangano yalo. Asikho isinqumo seBhodi esingeke semukelwe ngesizathu sokuba khona kwesikhala somsebenzi eBhodini: Kuncike ekutheni isinqumo sithathwa yiningi elidingekayo lamalungu eBhodi akhona futhi navumelekile ukuhlala njengamalungu eBhodi. USihlalo , noma iningi eBhodini, lingabiza umhlangano oyisipesheli weBhodi esimweni lapho izihlinzeko zalesi sigaba zihambisana noshintsho oludingekile.

Nokho, ngesikhathi besathokozisa impumelelo yabo, baqala ukuzizwa bejulelwe yizinto ezimbi. Umhlaba wawusiphendulela, ubabulela izinkinga ezinzima. Babona ukuthi ukujula phansi kwenza kube nzima, futhi umhlaba waba izingxaki ezinkulu. UThandiwe wagcizelela, “Sipho, kufanele sibuyele emuva! Umhlaba akusona isikhala sokuhlala, kodwa kusetshenziswa kahle! Kulula ukujula, kodwa kunzima ukuphuma.” Baphuma bejule, bejabulisa umuzwa wokuthi umhlaba wawungathanda, kodwa kufanele bazi kahle izinzuzo nezingozi. Ekugcineni, uMnumzane Mthethwa waba nezinkumbulo ezinzima. “Umhlaba ufundisa ukuthi izinsiza zidinga ukuhlonishwa. Akukona konke okukhanyayo okuhle. Sizobe sithuthukisa imiphakathi yethu ngokuhlonipha umhlaba, kanye nezinsiza zawo. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile,” waphika. Ngemuva kwalokho, abahlali baseMahlabathini baqhubeka nokuhlala, bejabuliswa yimpilo yabo, behlonipha imvelo nokuqonda kahle izinzuzo nezingozi zokumbiwa phansi. UThandiwe noSipho bahlala bejabulile, bejabulela umhlaba wabo, beqonda ukuthi umhlaba ungumngane uma uhamba naye, kepha ungumshoshaphansi uma ufisa kuphela ukuthola izinto ezikhanyayo. Umhlaba udinga ukuhlonishwa, futhi abahlali bazi kahle lokho ukuze baqhubeke nokuphila kahle, banganaki izimanga ezikhanyayo kuphela, kodwa futhi bahloniphe leso sikhala esibalulekile.

Umnyango wezobulungiswa ungowesigaba sokuphepha lapho indawo yokusebenza kweziteshi zamaphoyisa ihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezincane, ezilawulwayo ezaziwa njengamasektha. I-SAPS izothumela uphoyisa, owaziwa njengomphathi wesigaba, kuzo zonke izigaba. Imiphakathi nabaphathi bezigaba bazoba ngababambiqhaza abenza okuthile ukuze baqinisekise ukuphepha nokuvikeleka endaweni abahlala kuyo. Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela umphakathi esigabeni ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo zokulwa nobugebengu bendawo njengokuhlanganyela. Ukuze kube nesixhumanisi phakathi komphakathi wesigaba kanye nesiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo. Ukuze usebenze njengomphakathi ophumelelayo, ophatha zonke izinhlelo nezinhlelo ezibhekene nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze uxoxe ngezinhlelo zokusebenza nomphathi wesigaba ukuze ubhekane nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze uqinisekise futhi ubambe iqhaza emicimbini yasendaweni ukuze ugcine indawo abahlala kuyo iphephile. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane nezicebiso zokuvikela ubugebengu esigabeni. Ukuze usekele ngempela umnyango wezobulungiswa wezivolontiya ezindaweni. Ukuze uxhumane nomphathi wesigaba wakho ukuze wenze indawo ophila kuyo iphephile. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi bendawo, amaqembu omphakathi, izinhlangano zabahlali, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi bencitshwa ukuba babambe iqhaza emizamweni yokubhekana nezinkinga eziholela ebubini esigabeni sakho. I-NAFVSA inengxenye yokweseka umphakathi, ehlinzeka zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo ababuya emiphakathini eyayithintekile ngodlame, ngemininingwane nezidingo.

Ukwengeza, ama-smartphone asiza ekuxhumaneni kwempilo yansuku zonke. Ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlela izibopho, balandele impilo yabo, noma baphathe imisebenzi ehlukahlukene eyahlukeneyo. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubekele phambili kabili futhi baphendule emaso. Ngokwengxenye, ama-smartphone abe nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Abantu bakwazi ukuxhumana kalula, kungakhathaliseki ukuba baphila kuphi emhlabeni. Lokhu kuxhumana kwesiteshi esisodwa kubavumela ukuba babelane ngemicabango, izincwadi, nezithombe, okwenza kube lula ukuthi baze baphinde bahlale bedlalisa. Izingozi Nezingqinamba Zama-Smartphone Kodwa-ke, nakuba ama-smartphone enezinzuzo eziningi, akulula kodwa futhi eza nezingozi. Ukuxhumana okungafunwa kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kwezinsuku zethu, kungase kuphumele izinkinga zokuphila kwansuku zonke. Ukubamba ngaphandle kokuhlala sibukeka, sithathele izithombe, kungaba yingozi, kungenzeka campa emiphakathini yangempela. Okunye okukhathazayo wukuthi ama-smartphone azama ukufaka umthelela ekukhuleni kwengqondo. Abanye abantu baqala ukuthola ukuphazamiseka kokucabanga ngenxa yokusebenzisa ama-smartphone kakhulu, okukhomba ukuthi kudingeka ukuba sihlale sikhumbula ukujula kubona. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ama-smartphone awavulekile nje amathuluzi okuxhumana, kodwa akhiwe ngezici ezividlaysisayo empilweni yethu. Njengoba siqhubeka, kubalulekile ukubheka izinzuzo nemikhawulo yama-smartphone njengengxenye yemvelo yethu. Ukusebenzisa kahle lezi zinsiza, singathuthukisa impilo yethu, sisize abanye, futhi sigcine isikhalazo esithokozisayo ngaphansi kwenguquko ye-intelligent technology.

UMartin Luther King Jr.: Umholi Wokulwa Nezobulungiswa UMartin Luther King Jr. ungomunye wabaholi abavelele emlandweni waseMelika, owaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yakhe ekulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo. Impilo yakhe yayigcwele ukuzinikela ekufuneni ubulungiswa, ukuthula, kanye nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu bonke. Wazalwa ngoJanuwari 15, 1929, eAtlanta, eGeorgia, wakhulela emndenini ophila impilo yokholo. Uthole imfundo ephakeme, waphothula izifundo eMorehouse College, eCrozer Theological Seminary, naseBoston University, lapho athola khona iPhD. UKing waba yisithonjana sokulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo phakathi kweminyaka yama-1950 kuya kwama-1960. Ngonyaka we-1955, waqala ukukhombisa amandla akhe njengomholi kwezombusazwe ngesikhathi sokubhikisha eMontgomery, eAlabama, ngemva kokuthi uRosa Parks engavuma ukuhamba esikhwameni somphakathi. Le bhikisho, eyaziwa njengeMontgomery Bus Boycott, yaphumelela futhi yakhuthaza abaningi ukuba balwe nezinhlelo zobandlululo. UMartin Luther King Jr. wayenombono wokuthi ukulwa kwezenhlalakahle kufanele kube nokuthula. Wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphatheke kahle, baphendule ngokuthula, futhi bahlale bephila ngokuhlonipha. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemibhikisho emikhulu, efana neMarch on Washington for Jobs and Freedom ngo-1963, lapho uKing ethula khona isikhumbuzo sakhe esidumile, "I Have a Dream." Kuleli zinga, waphakamisa umbono wokuthi wonke umuntu kufanele athole amathuba alinganayo. Umlando kaKing awukhona nje kuphela wokulwa nezinhlelo zobandlululo, kodwa ubonisa ubuholi obuqinile bokuhlanganyela nezinkinga ezinzima.

Lezi zinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi abahambi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle, okukhona phakathi kwazo izikhumbuzo ezithokozisayo, izikhumbuzo zokuhamba, kanye nezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Izinkampani zikhuthaza umkhankaso wokuhamba ophumelelayo, zifaka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zabo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuphepha nokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Izinguquko Ezinzima Naphezu kokukhula, umkhakha wezindiza ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukwehla kwemali yokuhamba, izindleko eziphezulu zokuphepha, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima, konke lokhu kuthinta ukusebenza kwezindiza. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umkhakha uyaphumelela, izinkampani zidinga ukuhlela izindlela zokubhekana nalezi zinguquko. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle kwezindiza. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezobuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe buye babaluleka kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izindiza. Izinkampani zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuhamba, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuphatha izindiza, izinhlelo zokuqapha izimo zezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezindiza nezikhumulo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izindiza zisebenza kahle, ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabahambi, futhi zinciphisa izindleko zokusebenza. Umthelela Kwezomnotho Izindiza zineqhaza elikhulu emnothweni wezwe. Zikhuthaza ukuvakashelwa kwezivakashi, okukhuthaza imboni yezokuvakasha. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ukuphucula izinga lokuphila kwabantu, kanye nokwandisa umnotho. Izinhlangano ezahlukene, ezibandakanya uhulumeni, zisebenzisana nezinkampani zokuhamba ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umkhakha wezindiza uthuthuka futhi ufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude.

Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zindleko zikhokhwa ngokuqhubekayo, futhi umsebenzisi unelungelo lokubona izinguquko emholweni wakhe. Uma umholo ushintsha, i-GEMS izobuyekeza inani elidonswayo ukuze lihambisane nezinguquko ezenzekayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala benokuthola okulinganiselwe kwezinsizakalo zezempilo, ngaphandle kokubhekana nezinkinga zokukhokha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS inikeza izinzuzo eziningi kubasebenzi. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufinyelela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezihloniphekile, ukwelashwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelapha ezithuthukile. Abasebenzi bangakhetha phakathi kwezinhlelo ezahlukene zokwelashwa, okuvumela ukuthi bakhethe okuthandayo ngokwezidingo zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba izidingo zezempilo zihluke kakhulu phakathi kwabantu. Nokho, kunezimo ezithile ezidinga ukunakwa. Uma umsebenzisi engathandi ukuqhubeka nokudonswa kwemali, kufanele abike lokhu kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kungenziwa kalula, futhi umsebenzisi uzothola iziqondiso ezicacile zokuthi angakwenza kanjani. Kubalulekile ukuthi abhalise izinguquko ngesikhathi, ukuze kungabi nezinkinga zokukhokha ezizovela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS inikeza ithuba lokubuyisela imali uma umsebenzisi engasebenzisi izinsizakalo ezithile. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abasebenzi ukuthi bahlale benokuthula, bazi ukuthi uma bengasebenzisi izinsizakalo, bangathola imali yabo emuva. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo ezithile, futhi umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ulandela lezi zinyathelo ukuze athole leli thuba. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni.

Ukulandela izinqubo ezilandelanayo zokubika kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kahle kwenqubo. IV. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi Abasebenzi bezempilo badinga ukuqeqeshwa njalo. Ukuze bagcine izinga eliphezulu lemfundo, kubalulekile ukuthi bahlale befunda ngezinguquko ezintsha emkhakheni wezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amathuba okuthola ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo. V. Uxhaso Lwempilo Esikhathini sokuzenzakalelayo, uxhaso lwezimo eziphuthumayo luyadingeka. Ukuqonda izimo eziphuthumayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwakhiwa kwesikhala sokwelapha esikhulu. Uxhaso luhlanganisa izinsiza zomphakathi nezinhlelo zokuxhasa ezikhona. VI. Ukufaka Izobuchwepheshe Ukufaka izobuchwepheshe kwezokwelapha kuqinisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Izibhedlela zingathuthukisa izinqubo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo engcono. Lokhu kudinga izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. VII. Ukuxhumana Neziguli Ukuxhumana phakathi kwezisebenzi neziguli kubalulekile. Abasebenzi bezempilo badinga ukuxhumana kahle neziguli ukuze baqonde kahle izimo zempilo zabo. Lokhu kuzokwandisa ukubonisana phakathi kwabo, kunciphise izinkinga, futhi kudale umuzwa oyiqiniso wokuphila. VIII. Ukuhlola Izimo Nemiphumela Ukuhlola izimo zomsebenzi wezimo eziphuthumayo kudinga ukuhlola imiphumela yokwelashwa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola imiphumela esigulini, ukusebenza kwezinqubo ezisetshenzisiwe, nokuqonda izinkinga ezivela. IX. Isiphetho Izinhlelo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zibalulekile ekunakekelweni kwesiguli. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinqubo ziyahambisana nemithetho, futhi zikhuthaza impilo engcono.

Ukufika kwabantu abavela eYurophu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini yaseNingizimu Afrika. UbuSuthu Nezinguquko Zamasiko Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkinga zokuqala zashintsha zaba yizinkinga ezinzima. UbuSuthu, obuhlanganisa izizwe eziningi, bahlaselwa yizinhlekelele ezivela ngaphandle. Ubugebengu, ukungabi nabulungiswa, nezinhlekelele zempilo zaba yizinto ezazithinta kakhulu abantu. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemibono emisha, lapho abantu beqala ukufuna izindlela zokuphila ezihlukile, ezazihambisana nezidingo zabo. UbuMthetho Nezinguquko Zombusazwe Ngonyaka we-1910, uNingizimu Afrika waba yizwe elizimele, kodwa lokhu akuzange kube yisixazululo. Uhlelo lwe-apartheid lwavela, lwaholela ekwahlukanisweni kwabantu ngokobuhlanga. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi esinzima, lapho abantu abamnyama babekhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, bezama ukufuna amalungelo. UNelson Mandela, umholi ophakeme, waba yisibonelo sokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. Uhlelo lwe-apartheid lwagcina luphukile ngonyaka we-1994, lapho uMandela ewina ukhetho lokuqala olukhululekile. Ukwakha Isizwe Esisha: Izinsuku Zamanje Ngemuva kokuphela kwe-apartheid, uNingizimu Afrika waba yizwe elisha, elizama ukwakha ubumbano phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Nokho, izinselelo zikhona. Ukungabi nabulungiswa, ubuphofu, nezinkinga zomnotho zihlala zikhona. Kodwa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bahlala bephokophele ekwakheni ikusasa el better, elihlanganisa wonke umuntu. Isiphetho: Umoya Wokubumbana Umlando waseNingizimu Afrika ungumlando ogcwele izifundo.

Ilejista kufanele igcinwe ehhovisini likaNobhala, futhi uMkhandlu ungayala ukuba kweziwe imifanekiso yelejista noma uhlu olwengeziwe olukhombisa okwengeziwe, okusuliwe, isichibiyelo noma ukubukezwa okwenziwe kusukela kukhonjiswe imifanekiso welejista ephelele, kwenziwe, kubhalwe noma kusakazwe noma kukhonjiswe kumakhompuyutha ngesikhathi ezingamiswa yiwona uMkhandlu ngokubona kwawo. a aliveli kulowo mfanekiso, noma ogama lakhe lengeziwe kulejista ngemuva kosuku lokugcina lokukhishwa kwalowo mfanekiso, umfanekiso oqinisekisiwe ngesandla sikaNobhala wokufakwa kwegama lalowo muntu kulejista kungubufakazi bokuthi lowo muntu ubhalisiwe ngokusho kwaloMthetho; noma b lisisiwe kulejista, kusukela ngosuku lokugcina lokukhishwa kwaleyo legista futhi elingabuyiselwanga kulejista, isitifiketi esisayidwe ngesandla sikaNobhala sokuthi igama lalowo muntu lisuliwe kulejista siyoba ubufakazi bokuthi lowo muntu akabhalisile ngokwaloMthetho. Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa siwubufakazi bokubhaliswa isikhathi esiwunyaka kusukela ngosuku okubhalwe ngalo ngemuva kwalokho kuyokuba isitifiketi sokusebenza sonyaka esiyokhishwa ngemuva kokukhokhwa kwemali enqunyiwe yonyaka nokuthunyelwa kwemininingwane engadingwa uMkhandlu ukuze ugcine amanani aliqiniso ngabantu abasebenza kwezobuhlengikazi kuwubufakazi bokubhaliswa ngaphandle uma kunobufakazi obunqada ikhanda obuphikisana nalokhu. Amarisidi akhishwe ngegama loMkhandlu mayelana nezimali ezikhokhelwa ukubhalisa, ayakuba ubufakazi emacaleni ngokomthetho ukuthi lowo muntu ubhaliswe ngokwalo Mthetho, kodwa uma lapho noma imuphi umuntu ogama lakhe... a livela kulejista nowehlulekayo ukuveza irisidi, irisidi ngesandla sikaNobhala ingubufakazi bokuthi lowo muntu obhalisiwe ngokwaloMthetho; noma b lisuliwe kulejista kusukela ngosuku okukhishwe ngalo irisidi futhi ingazange libuye libhalwe kulejista, isitifiketi esikhishe ngesandla sikaNobhala sokuthi lelo gama lesusiwe kulejista ngubufakazi bokuthi lowo muntu akabhalisiwe ngokwaloMthetho.

Ngokwenhlolombono kaBarbara Oomenendaweni kaSekhukhune, amalungu omphakathi kuleyo ndawo akhetha izinkantolo zendabuko ukunalezo eziphethwe yizimantshi. Amaphesenti angama-65 abantu abaphendulile ezindaweni ezisemakhaya bathanda "izinkantolo zamakhosi" futhi basekela uhlelo lokuba izinkinga zabo zokungezwani zixazululwe ezinkantolo zendabuko. Kuyakhombisa ukuthi abantu basemaphandleni bazizwa bephephile ngendlela amacala abo aphathwa ngayo, ngoba ayalalelwa nezinqumo ziphume ngokushesha. Enye into eyenza abantu abaningi bathande izinkantolo zendabuko ukuthi bakwazi ukusebenzisa ulimi lwabo, nokuyinto imiphakathi ephila isintu eyithanda kakhulu. Ezinye izinkinga ezivamise ezixazululwa ezinkantolo zendabuko wubusela, ukushaya abantu, ukulimaza impahla, ezemihlaba, ukuhlukunyezwa ngokushaywa abomndeni, ubuthakathi, eziphathelene nemishado kanye nokucokofulwa, nakuba amacala amaningi efaka imibango ngenxa yomonakalo odalwa yizilwane ezifuyiwe ezidla ukudla kwabantu, kodwa kukhona nokukhulelisa inkosikazi yomuntu, ukukhulelisa intombazane esencane nemibango ephathelene nokukhokhwa kwamalobolo. Endaweni kaSikhukhune, enye yezimantshi yacacisa ukuthi abanawo umsebenzi omningi ngoba abantu abaningi baxazulula izinkinga zabo emakhaya. Washo nokuthi uvamise ukuba necala elilodwa ngesonto nokuvamise ukuthi kube elobusela, njengabo bonke ozakwabo ubona ukuthi amacala okumele alalelwe ngaphansi komthetho wendabuko yilawo ambandakanya imibango yemihlaba, izimpi emndenini nokucokofulana. Ngaphambi kokufika koMthethosisekelo omusha kwabonakala ukuthi umthetho owawukhona ngesikhathi sokhetho lomhla ka 27 kuMbasal 1994 emva kwesikhathi.

Amaphuzu awubukhulu obungama-20 afakwa emaphuzwini angenhla, kwesekwa ngokuhlolwa maqondana nekhadi lenani Lokunikeza Amandla Kwabansundu Kwezomnonotho Ngokweseka.
