kwesishayamthetho, noma ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokusebenza kwaleso sishayamthetho. ezingu 90 ngemuva kokudlula kwalesosikhathi noma kosuku ukhetho olwamiswa ngalo. iminyaka emithathu isidlulile emuva kokukhethwa kwalesosishayamthetho. 30 ngemuva kokuvela kwesikhala. singanquma isikhathi nobude bemihlangano yaso eminye kanye namakhefu aso. ongavamile noma ngasiphi isikhathi ukuze senze umsebenzi oyisipesheli. likaSomlomo phakathi kwamalungu aso. ukukhethwa kukaSomlomo USomlomo wengamela ukukhethwa kwesekela likaSomlomo. uma kuthathwa leso sinqumo. ngokwesekwa yiningi lamavoti afakiwe. okungenani lababili kumalungu amathathu. esimile sibekhona kwisishayamthetho noma emakomidini aso. singasungula noma silungise umthetho ngaphandle kweMithethosivivinywa yemali. noma yiyiphi ingxenye yombuso. wudaba noma izikhungo. obala nokuthintwa komphakathi. amaqembu amancane kwisishayamthetho kwiKhabinethi. ikomidi lawo noma yiliphi. zingabekwa ngumthetho kazwelonke. esishayamthetho kuvela ngqo esiKhwameni seMali sesiFundazwe. ukuba angene noma ukususwa kwanoma yimuphi umuntu. kusemthethweni ukwenza lokho emphakathini wetando yeningi. koMthethosisekelo, angawuthumela kwisishayamthetho ukuba siphinde siwubeke. ezinye izinkokhelo zombuso unguMthethosivivinywa wemali. noma izigwebo nezinye izijeziso zemali. isishayamthetho sesifundazwe sishintsha iMithethosivivinywa yemali. kwisishayamthetho ukuze siwucwaninge kabusha. noMthethosisekelo, uNdunankulu kufanele awuvume futhi awusayine. sewushicilelewe, uMthetho, owamukelwe yisishayamthetho awuhambisani noMthethosisekelo.

Izinkinga ezizokhishwa zikhuluma ngezinkinga abakholelwa kuzo, kanye nokuhlola okuphindaphindiwe kokuqonda kwabo ngeNingizimu Afrika, edlule, okwamanje, nekusasa. Kumele sithole indlela yokufinyelela nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yesifunda. Kumele sikwenze lokhu, ukuze singavumeli amanzi ukuthi athwale umoya wokuzithoba kwezinto esingakwazi ukuzifeza ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi edolobheni lethu. Izikhungo zezokuphatha zikahulumeni eziphakathi, njengezinkampani zezimayini, zizophulwa. Abasolwa banikeza amaphoyisa imali ngaphansi kokubheka kwamehlo ikhamera bese bethunjwa ngaleso sikhathi. Ukuvuselela udoti uhlelo lapho izinto ezazizobekwa eceleni ziqoqwa, ziqalwa kabusha, bese zisetshenziswa futhi. Ngakho, into kuphela esele kubo ukuba bayoshiyela izwe ukuze bagweme ukubulawa noma ukuhlukunyezwa. Ukwakhiwa kwezinto ze-asphalt zokwakha imigwaqo nezinye izinjongo; zokuvikela umlilo nezinsiza zokucima umlilo nezokuvikela umlilo ezivela kumalahle athengwe noma i-lignite. U-Mnu. Koboekae ugcizelele ukuthi kuzoba nemihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi ezoqhubeka ngababambiqhaza abaqeqeshiwe ukuze baqeqeshe labo abazohileleka ngaphambi kokuba umkhosi omkhulu uqale. Imiphumela yalezi zinhlelo ibonisa ukuthi isisekelo sokuhlanganyela nababambiqhaza sikhulisiwe. Amalungu azokwazi ukuthi umhlangano wokulungiselela owenziwe kubabusi obubanjwe eBali, e-Indonesia muva nje wenze intuthuko enkulu ekufinyeleleni esivumelwaneni sokuthi kwenzeke ini ukuze kuthuthukiswe.

Wonke amalunga akhona eSikhungo kuyodingeka ukuba avote, ngokwevoti eliyimfihlo, asho ukuthi ayamamukela noma awamamukeli umuntu othile odluliswe nguMkhandlu noma akhombise uma esesimweni sokungavuni muntu noma ukungakhethi muntu neutral. Amalunga eSikhungo angavotanga athathwa njengafake ivoti lokungavuni muntu. Umuntu oyoba namavoti okungenani aphindwaphindwe kathathu uyothathwa njengoseqokiwe njengelunga leSikhungo, inqobo nje uma okungenani ingxenye yamavoti beyamukele yena. a "Mina amagama ngokuphelele ngiyathembisa ukuthi ngizothuthukisa isimo eNingizimu Afrika ngemicabango yezesayensi kanye nokuthuthukisa izinjongo zalesi Sikhungo seSayensi saseNingizimu Afrika ngokusemandleni ami; futhi b Ngiyohlonipha umthethosisekelo omisiwe kanye neziyalo ezimisiwe zeSikhungo uma nje ngiseyilunga leSikhungo." Noma iliphi ilunga lalesi Sikhungo liphoqelekile, ngale kokungudluka kulokho okushiwo isigatshana 9 ukuba libambe iqhaza okhethweni lwamalunga amasha alesi Sikhungo kanye namalunga oMkhandlu. ISikhungo sizophathwa futhi silawule nguMkhandlu ngokulandisa kwalo Mthetho. UMkhandlu kufanele uqiniseke ukuthi izinjongo zeSikhungo ziqhutshwa ngenkuthalo futhi kufanele usingathe ukuqhutshwa kwawo wonke umsebenzi weSikhungo. e namanye amalunga ayisikhombisa; kanye f nelunga elilodwa loMkhandlu woKwaluleka kwezokuQamba kuZwelonke eliyokhethwa ngoNgqongqoshe. Amalunga oMkhandlu, ngaphandle kwalawo malungu okukhulunywa ngawo kusigatshana 3 f ayoqokwa ngamalunga eSikhungo komunye wabo bese ekhethwa nguNgqongqoshe.

Ekuqaleni, isitshalo ngasinye sibonakala ngokuhlukile, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ziyaqhagamshelana. Lolu bhubhane luvame ukuvela ezindaweni ezithile zensimu. Ngoba izitshalo zingabola ngokushesha ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningi zokungena kololu bhubhane, izimpawu zingabonakala ngokushesha. I-lesion ethwele amanzi ikhula ethishelweni (ngaphansi) kwesitshalo. I-lesion inombala ophuzi-oluhlaza bese ibanjwa mnyama ifana nomqolo ophakathi komqolo. Uma ukuwa kuqhubeka, umqolo uba mhlophe futhi ungabonakala ungena. Ukuwa kungabonakala endaweni eyinhloko engaphezu kwezandla ezimbili ubude. Kukho ukuwa ngaphansi komqolo futhi izakhi eziqinile ezibizwa nge-sclerotia (ezilingana nosayizi ukusuka ku-1/8 kuya ku-1/4 inch ububanzi) zitholakala. Ama-sclerotia akhiqizwa yisifo futhi anikeza uphawu balolu bhubhane. Uma kuningi, i-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ikhula ethishelweni somqolo, ngakho ibizwa ngokuthi: "i-mold emhlophe." Ukuwa kwezimpande kubonakala ngokushesha ngoba imvamisa isitshalo siphuma emhlabathini kalula uma pulled. Isikhumba sezimpande sitholakala kalula, sikhombisa i-pith yangaphakathi. Ukuwa kuvame ukwenzeka emiqolweni futhi ama-sclerotia abonakala kuzo zonke izimpande. Ekugcineni, isitshalo esithintekayo sifa. Isitshalo singakhiqiza kuphela ukudla, okuhambisana nesikhathi sokungena kololu bhubhane esitshalo. Amakhanda ezitshalo ezithintekayo ancane kunezempilo. Ukuwa kwehlisa inani lembewu, ikakhulukazi ngoba imbewu ilula. Izitshalo ezithintekayo zehla kalula uma kunomoya omkhulu.

Iphrogramu Lokuthuthukisa Abalimi linikeza abalimi izibhalo ezinemininingwane maqondana nokulima njalo ngenyanga ngale ncwadi yethu - iPula/Imvula. Amakhopi ePula/Imvula angu-18 000 amukezelwa kubalimi ngezilimi ezingu-7 njalo ngenyanga - IsiNgisi, IsiBhunu, Sesotho, Setswana, Sesotho sa Leboa, IsiZulu nesiXhosa. Njalo ngenyanga iPula/Imvula linamakhasi angu-8 asekelwa iMaize Trust. Kukhona futhi amakhasi angu-4 acishelelwa ngeSesotho ngoMashi, ngoJuni, ngoSepthemba nangoDisemba asekelwa iWinter Cereals Trust. IOPOT nalo linamakhasi angu-4 achishelelwa ngazo zonke izilimi (ngaphandle kwesiXhosa) ngoJanuwari, ngoAphreli, ngoJulayi nangoOkthoba. Sizama njalo ukufaka izibhalo ezizosiza abalimi ngaleyo nyanga. Lezi zibhalo zixoxa ngezindaba eziqondene nomhlaba, ukulima, izindlela zokukhiqiza, ukumaketha, okwezimishini nokuphatha ipulazi. Siyaphinda futhi ukubonga abasekeli bephrogramu lethu ngoba basinikeza ithuba lokunikeza umnikelo kulo msebenzi wethu wokuthuthukisa nokuguqukisa umsebenzi wokulima ezweni lethu.

Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba nebhizinisi elincane? U-Sipho: Izinzuzo ziningi. Okokuqala, ungakwazi ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho ngendlela oyithandayo, okuvumela ukuba ube nezinqumo ezisheshayo. Okwesibili, ungakwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende akho. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma ngithanda amakhasimende ami, bayazizwa bekhululekile futhi baphinde babuyisele. Lokhu kudala umphakathi onempilo. Umbuzo 4: Uthola kanjani izixazululo ezinzima? U-Sipho: Ngithanda ukufunda. Ngihlala ngifunda izincwadi, ngibuka izifundo eziku-inthanethi, futhi ngihlanganyela nabanye osomabhizinisi. Ngiyazi ukuthi akekho owazi konke, ngakho ngiyazama ukufunda kwabanye. Ngithola izixazululo ezinzima ngokuxhumana nabantu abahlukene, futhi ngiyazama ukusebenzisa izindlela ezintsha. Umbuzo 5: Yiziphi izifundo ezibalulekile ozifundile? U-Sipho: Okwokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba necebo eliqinile. Ngithole ukuthi uma ungenalo uhlelo, ungase ungaphumeleli. Okwesibili, ukuxhumana kubalulekile. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabanye osomabhizinisi, amakhasimende, kanye nabahlinzeki bangeza impumelelo. Okwesithathu, kufanele uhlale uvumelana nezinguquko. Umhlaba ushintsha njalo, futhi kufanele ube nesimo sokuzivumelanisa. Umbuzo 6: Uthanda kanjani ukusiza abanye osomabhizinisi? U-Sipho: Ngiyakholelwa ekutheni umphakathi kufanele usebenze ndawonye. Ngihlanganyela izifundo zamahhala nabantu abasha abathanda ukuqala amabhizinisi. Ngiyazi ukuthi uma sabelana ngolwazi, siphumelela sonke. Ngithanda ukusiza abantu ukuba bazi ukuthi bangakwenza kanjani, futhi ngiyabavumela ukuba babuze noma yini.

Ungabi nqunu, faka ukhilimu ovikela ukuhlaba kwelanga esikhunjeni. Bheka izinsumpa nokujika kwesikhumba. Bonana nodokotela uma izinsumpa njll, zikhula, zopha noma ziluma. Izingubo zokusebenza azakhiwe ngendwangu egcina imizimba yabasebenzi yomile futhi inezinga lokushisa elemukelekile. Uma imisebenzi izokwenziwa elangeni noma emakhazeni, izingubo ezilungele kumele zisetshenziswe ukugwema ukuba nentukuntuku nokuvumela ukuphefumula. Izingubo zokuvikela ezanele kumele zihlinzekelwe abasebenzi uma kunobungozi bokushiswa yilanga njengezitshalo eziyingozi, izilwane nezifo. Ukuthintana nezilwane kungaholela ezifweni ezidluliselwa yizilwane kubantu. Izilwanyana ezinjengamagciwane, izimuncagazi nesikhunta kungabanga ukugula emzimbeni uma zihogeliwe, zigwinyiwe noma uma zingena esikhunjeni. Izimpawu zibandakanya izinkinga zesikhumba noku "samkhuhlane" okungagcina kube wukugula okukhulu uma kungelashwa. Yikuphi ongakwenza ukunciphisa ubungozi? Nciphisa ubungozi bokuthelelana ngokugcina izilwane zinempilo. Qinisekisa inhlanzeko. Njalo geza izandla ngaphambi kokudla, ukuphuza nokubhema. Gqoka izingubo zokuvikela ezinjengama-ovaloli uma usebenza ngezilwane, ikakhulukazi uma ugula, namagilavu nephinifa likaseyili uma usebenza ngezinto ezinjengemithi yokuzalisa. Vala konke ukusikeka nemihuziko ngamabhandishi angangenwa amanzi. Ukuba seduze nezinto eziyingozi njengamakhemikhali, isib.

Unyaka odlule ubone ushintsho olubalulekile, ekutheni I-DACST izibheka kanjani? Singumyango osebenzisa okungenani u 90 wamaphesenti esikhw esingu (R 1billion), ezinhlelweni zangapandle kunezangaphakathi izizinda ezingaphandle kanye nalezo ezithola ukuxhaswa yi-DACST zithola ukuxhaswa kuwona lo 90%, zisukela kwinhlangano eyenza ucwaningo kwezesayensi, ibhodi eliphathelene nezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrikha, amamuziyemu kanye nezingxenye eziphathelene nokukhonjiswa kobuciko. Ukwakha ukuthelelana emyangweni enezinhlelo eziningi ehlukahlukene ekutheni ziqale ukuthuthukisa inqubo efanayo yokuphatha nokubusa. Kwikhabhinethi I-Lekgotla yenyanga ka-January 2001 kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi esikhathini esizayo izizinda zamasiko njengemisebenzi wezandla, umculo kanye noomboniso kanye namaFilimungokuzayo zizombandakanywa nezinhlelo zomnotho ngezindlela ezimbili, intuthuko/ ukukhuliswa kanye nokudala amathuba emisebenzi. Sekumane kwazicacela ukuthi izizinda zamasiko zingadlala indima ebaluleke kakhulu kwezomnotho ezisafufusayo ngokufanayo nezizinda zemvelo ezinjenge zimayini kanye nezolimo. Amazwe ahlukene njenge Sweden, neMexico asinikeza isiqiniseko esingangabazisi salokhu. Ukuqhubekisela phambili kocwaningo kanye nezizinda zentuthuko. LoMnyango udinga ukunakekelwa ekuwubhekeleni kanye kanye nasekuwubhekeleni, ngokwezidingo zasekhaya nangokwezidingo zenkambiso yomhlaba ekuyibhekeleni/ekuyigadeni kanye nasekuyikhuliseni, ngokwezidingo zasekhaya nangokwezidingo zenkambiso yomhlaba.

I-National Electricity Regulator (NER) isivele yaqaphela isidingo sokusungula izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi; izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zingalindelwa ngabathengi bempahla ehlukahlukene kanye nezinga okufanele lihlangabezane nalokho okukhona. Abahlinzeki bamanzi kufanele babike ku-NER ngezinga labo lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo uma kuqhathaniswa nezindinganiso ezibekwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bayalandela izindinganiso. Le bhukwana ihlose ukuveza kubathengi abakhokha ngogesi ngezindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ezilindelekile abangazilindela kubahlinzeki bamanzi futhi ukuze inikeze abathengi ukuqonda okungcono kwekholomu ye-NRS 047 ngendlela ethinta ngayo. Ukukala ugesi okhokhelwayo kuvumela abathengi ithuba lokuthenga ugesi ngamanani abawakwazi ukukhokha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abathengi abangahlangabezani nezikweletu zabo zogesi ekupheleni kwenyanga bangase baphuthelwe ukukhokha. Le bhukwana iphinde ichaze izindlela ezitholakalayo kubathengi uma kwenzeka izinkinga phakathi kwabahlinzeki bamanzi nabo mayelana nezindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqokomisa ukuthi i-NER ilindele ukuthi abathengi nabahlinzeki abathintekayo bazame ukusombulula izinkinga zabo ngaphambi kokufaka isikhalazo ku-NER. Ngokuvamile, i-NER ngeke ingenelele ngaphandle kokuthi leyo nkinga ingaxazululwa ezingeni lendawo. Ezinye izisho zisetshenziswa kakhulu embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi kubalulekile kubathengi bamanzi ukuba bazi ngencazelo yalezi zisho.

a UMkhandlu , ngokuhambisana nokushiwo kusigatshana 4, ungadlulisela ekomitini elisingulwe ngokwesigaba 1 noma kunoma imuphi umuntu amandla awo ongabona efanele. b UMkhandlu ngeze wephucwa lawo mandla adlulisiwe futhi ungachibiyela noma uchithe isinqumo saleyo komiti esithathwe kusetshenziswa lawo mandla adlulisiwe. Ikomiti lokwedlulisa undaba lokuqondiswa izigwegwe okukhulunywa ngalo kusigatshana 4 linamandla okuguqula, ukuqinisekisa noma ukuchitha isinqumo sekomiti elisingulwe ngokwesigatshana 1 noma ukuphindisela emuva undaba ekomitini neziyalo elingabona zifanele. Isinqumo sekomiti lokuqondiswa izigwegwe, ngaphandle uma lwedlulisiwe, siyisibopho esisebenzayo kusukela ngosuku olumiswe ikomiti kodwa uma kwedluliswe isikhalo ngenhlawulo yokusulwa noma ukumiswa kokusebenza, leyo nhlawulo iyasebenza kuze kube usuku okuphethwa ngalo ukwedluliswa kondaba. Amalunga oMkhandlu namalunga amakomiti oMkhandlu kufanele aholelwe iholo noma inkokhelo emiswe nguNgqongqoshe ngokubonisana noNgqongqoshe weziMali. aNoma imuphi umuntu ongekho ngaphansi kwemithetho elawula abasebenzi bombuso kuyofanele aholelwe iholo kumbandakanya nezimfanelo zokuhamba nokudla angene kuzo uma esebenzisa amandla , noma enza umsebenzi noma efeza izibopho abelwe zona noma azithweswe nguMqondisi-Jikelele, ezimiswe uNgqongqoshe ngokubonisana neNgqongqoshe weziMali. bNoma yiliphi elinye iholo okungakhulunywa ngalo noma elingabaliwe endimeni a kufanele likhokhwe uMkhandlu. c Noma iliphi ilunga elingaphansi kwemithetho elawula abasebenzi bombuso kufanele lithole isikhathi sokuphumula esikhethekile noma ilivu ukuze lenze umsebenzi woMkhandlu.

Ibhukuda labesifazane libonise ukukhula okukhulu, njengoba izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi abesifazane balandela izifundo zokubhukuda, beshaya amamaki amasha emiqhudelwaneni. Lokhu kudala isikhala sokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo ukuze zisebenzisane futhi zihambisane nemithetho yokuphila. Izinselelo Zokubhukuda Nokho, nakuba sikhula, kunezithiyo ezibhekene nababhukudi. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, ubungozi obuhlangene nemvelo, kanye nezinkinga zokungabi khona kwemifula ephephile, kusewuya kumkhankaso wokubukuda eNingizimu Afrika. I-‘Water Safety Initiative’ iqhubeka ibhekana nezingozi ezahlukene, iqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu, ikakhulukazi izingane, bazi ukuthi amanzi kufanele ahlale ephephile. Isifinyezo Ngesikhathi iNingizimu Afrika ibheja phambili, ukubhukuda akukhona nje umkhuba wokuzivocavoca, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi. Ukuze sithole impilo enempilo, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka senza imikhankaso yokukhuthaza ukubaluleka kokubhukuda. Lokhu kuzokuvula indlela yokuba amazwe afunde kahle, emkhakheni wobuchwepheshe, noma ubani angaba yibhukudi abazi kahle izinto ezinjengalezi. Ibhukuda, njengoba sesikubonile, liyingxenye ebalulekile yokuhlonipha impilo, impilo emphakathini, kanye nempumelelo yephupho lokubona zonke izigaba zomphakathi zenza kahle.

Umqulu weNqubomgomo wesimo sobulungiswa sezendabuko ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo. Umbono nenhloso yalolu hlaka lwenqubomgomo 7 1. Izimiso zamasiko ezikhuthaza ukuxhumana kwemiphakathi, uxolo nokuhlalisana kahle. Indlela yobuholi bendabuko elungele iNingizimu Afrikha nesikhathi esisha sentando yeningi. Ukuqinisekisa kwemigomo yokubuyiselwa kwemithetho ngaphakathi kohlelo lomthetho wendabuko. Ukuhlinzekwa kwamacebo afanele ukuze kwenziwe lula indima nemisebenzi yabaholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kobulungiswa. Umbiko weKhomishana ebhekene nokuguqulwa komthetho ezinkantolo zendabuko eNingizimu Afrikha nemisebenzi yabaholi bendabuko ekushayweni kwemithetho. Abaholi bendabuko kumele babeke yonke into obala uma benza imisebenzi yabo ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Izinkantolo zendabuko zinelungelo zokulalela izindaba ezimayelana namacala emibango asuselwa emthethweni ophathelene namasiko neminye imithetho namacala egazi. Izinkantolo zendabuko zeleka unswinyo oluphathelene nokuguqulwa kobulungiswa. Ukukhishwa kwezaziso nezinhlelo zokusebenza nokuqinisekiswa kokusebenza kwezinqumo ezithathwe ezinkantolo zendabuko. Ukushiywa ngaphandle kwabammeli ekulalelweni kwamacala ezinkantolo zendabuko. Izinqumo zasezinkantolo zendabuko kumele zibe ngezingujuqu futhi kuvunyelwe ukudluliswa kwamacala ngaphansi kwemigomo ethize. Ukubuyekezwa kwezinqumo zezinkantolo zendabuko. Izindlela okumele zenziwe ukuze kususelwe kuzo emacaleni asuka ezinkantolo zendabuko ayiswe ezinkantolo zezimantshi, ngokushintshana. Indima edlalwa izinkantolo zendabuko ohlelweni lokuthethwa kwamacala egazi.

Ngingasho nje ukuthi I-inthanethi yinhle jkabi ekunikezeni ulwazi ngebhizinisi lakho, noma ingekho yinhle kakhulu ekuthengiseni ngqo komkhiqizo wakho. Ngandlela thize lezi izindaba ezimnbandi kumabhizinisi amancane ezokuvakasha. Kushibhe kakhulu ukuzenzela iwebhusayidi elula yebhizinisi lakho. Kukhona imibukiso yezokuvakasha kanye nezingqungquthela zemisebenzi umhlaba wonke jikelele, ezifana ne-Indaba, i-ITB kanye ne-WTM. Ungakwazi ukuxhumana Nezokuvakasha ZaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze uthole uhlu lwemibukiso eminye. Ukubonisa embukisweni kunikeza ithuba elihle lokubonisa ibhizinisi lakho bese ukhuphula ukuthengisa. Kodwa kumele uthathe isinqumo zokuthi umbukiso wemisebenzi ufanele yini futhi kuyafuneka yini ukuya kuwo noma ukubukisa kuwo. I-Networking - noma i-'Notworking' okuyindlela ebizwa ngayo kwesinye isikhathi, ubuciko bokuxuba(ukuhlangana) nalabo abangaba ngamakhasimende kanye nabanikezeli edilini elithile. Qinisekisa ukuthi wenza okuthile emphakathini wakho ngokuhambela yonke imicimbi yokuvuma imikhiqizo ephathelene nezokuvakasha, amakilabhu endawo ezamabhizinisi, amaforamu, izinkulumo kanye namakhonferensi ezimboni zokuvakasha. Kumele ucabangisise nangokuya emihlanganweni yezinhlangano zendawo zezokuvakasha. Khumbula ukwenza ukuthi inkampani yakho ifakwe ohlwini lenqolobane yemininingwane Yeboifunda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uthole izimemo. Ukuqhubekisa ukuthengisa yimisebenzi Yeboikhathi esincane ehlose ukugqugquzela uthando emkhiqizweni nakubhizinisi lakho. Kungenzeka ukuba uthathe izinqumo sokunikeza ukuphungulelwa noma izipho ezifana nohanbo olungakhokhelwa, ibhodlela lewayini.

Lokhu kudala amathuba kubantu abasha ukuthi bathole izifundo, bazifundise, futhi baphumelele emculweni we-jazz. Abaculi abasha bazama ukwenza izinguquko, bejolisa emasikweni omculo, benza kube lula ukuba umculo we-jazz ube yinto ephilayo, ethokozisayo, nengashintshi. Umgubho we-jazz ungumcimbi obalulekile wokuhlanganisa abantu abanokuthanda umculo, futhi uhlanganyela izinkumbulo ezinhle. Njengoba umcimbi uphothulwa, izithameli zishiya zikhumbula umoya ophilayo, zihamba nezinhliziyo ezijabulile futhi zibalela izinkumbulo eziveza ubungani obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Umculo we-jazz ungumsebenzi ohloniphekile, futhi umcimbi lo ubonisa kahle ukuthi umculo ungaletha kanjani abantu ndawonye, uhlanganise izizukulwane, futhi ube umthombo wokujabulela izimpilo zethu.

Phakathi kwemidumba, ubhontshisi wesoya, obuye uhlelwe ngaphansi kwembewu kawoyela, ugqamile ngamaphrotheni aphezulu aqukethwe (38 - 45%) nangowoyela wawo ophezulu oqukethwe (20%). Ubhontshisi wesoya ubamba indawo yesibili ngemuva kommbila phakathi kwemikhiqizo ebalulekile yolimo ethunyelwa ngaphandle yi-United States. Ingxenye enkulu yesitshalo sikabhontshisi wesoya ilinyelwa umkhiqizo kawoyela, kanti amaphrotheni aphezulu asuswa amafutha ukuze impuphu yesoya egazingiwe isetshenziselwe ukondla imfuyo. Iphesenti elincane likabhontshisi wesoya libhekiswe ngqo ekusetshenzisweni ngabantu. EShayina, eJapan naseKorea ubhontshisi kanye nemikhiqizo kabhontshisi kuyingxenye ethandwa kakhulu yokudla okudliwayo. AmaShayina enza i-tofu nezinhlobonhlobo zokusanhlama kabhontshisi wesoya okusetshenziswa njengesinongo. KwelaseKorea, amahlumelo kabhontshisi wesoya nawo ayasetshenziswa ekudleni okwahlukahlukene. Ubhontshisi ungalungiswa ngezindlela ezahluka-hlukene. Izinhlobo ezivamile zesoya zibandakanya impuphu yesoya, ufulawa wesoya, ubisi lwesoya, i-tofu, amaphrotheni emifino ezwakala kamnandi esandleni (ebizwa ngokuthi yi-TVP, eyenziwa izinhlobo zokudla okungenanyama, ezinye zenziwa ukuthi zifane nenyama) i-tempeh, i-lecithin yesoya nowoyela kabhontshisi wesoya. Ubhontshisi wesoya ubuye ube yisithako esiphambili emkhiqizweni wesosi yesoya. Imbewu kabhontshisi wesoya iqukethe uwoyela oyi-19%.

Ngokuhambisana nale Sahluko, umphathi-hhovisi unawo wonke amandla awanikezwe umthetho woMshado ukusingatha umcimbi ngokwale Sahluko. Noma yiliphi ibandla kumbe inhlangano bangambhalela uNgqongqoshe bafake isicelo sokubekwa babe yibandla elingasingatha ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi. UNgqongqoshe angalinikeza amandla ibandla kumbe inhlangano ukuthi bakwazi ukusingatha imicimbi yokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi ngaphansi kwalo mThetho, futhi, kufanele kuthi njalo emva kwezikhathi ezithize, ashicilele imininingwane yazo zonke izikhundo ezinikwe laow Mandla kwiGazethi. Ungqongqoshe angawaqeda amandla okukhulunywa ngawo kwisigatshana 2, uma ibandla kumbe inhlangano icelile ukuthi makasuswe futhi loko kufanele akushicilele kwiGazethi. UNgqongqoshe kanye nanoma imuphi umphathi-hhovisi wakwahulumeni ogunyazwe nguNgqongqoshe angamnikeza umuntu ongumfundisi wanoma yiluphi ukholo, uma ethole isicelo esibhalwe phansi, ukuthi abe ngumshadisi, inqobo nje uma engumfundisi noma enesikhundla esithize kulelo bandla, amandla okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi ngokwaleSahluko nangokosiko-mpilo lwalolo kholo. Onke amandla omuntu ongumshadisi ngaphansi kwesigatshana 4 kufanele abhalwe kumqulu futhi kufankwe nosuku lokuqala kwalawo Mandla kufakwe nemikhawulo abekelwe yona ifakwe kulowo mqulu.

I nkantolo kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa kusukela ngosuku lokuthi udaba luphindiselwe emuva enkantolo, iqondise ukuthi udaba luzoxoxwa kanjani. Umregistrar kumele ngokushesha wazise labo abathintekayo kulolu daba ngosuku lokulalela ngemihlahlandlela ezolandela ngendlela ebhekiswe esigabeni (6). Ngemuva kokwenza isicelo esibhaliwe kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, uma udaba luphuthumayo, umphathi ophakanyisiwe angaqondisa ukuthi isikhathi esibekiwe ezinqubweni sikhululwe. Ngokuthumela nge-imeyili, uma ubufakazi bokuthi bathole i-imeyili ethunyelwe kubo bungaboniswa nguthumeli, ubufakazi bokuthumela kumele bugcina, futhi ifomu eliyinhloko kumele lithunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo ngokushesha ngeposi elibhalisiwe. Kumele lithunyelwe kumfaki-sicelo noma lifakwe enkantolo nganoma iyiphi enye indlela elawulwa umphathi ophakanyisiwe. Ngokuthumela nge-imeyili noma ngeposi, ubufakazi balokhu kumele bugcina, futhi ifomu eliyinhloko kumele lithunyelwe ngaphandle kokulibala kumfaki-sicelo ngeposi elibhalisiwe. Isikhumbuzo esibhekiswe esigabeni 6(6) kumele sinikezwe kumphakathi wenkantolo noma kumregistrar kuzo zonke izigaba ezithintekayo ngalolu daba mathupha. (1)(a) Umuntu ofuna ukuthumela isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi ukuze bavele phambi kwenkantolo kumele, okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-14 ngaphambi kosuku lokulalela udaba, acela umregistrar wenkantolo ukuba akhiphe futhi asebenze isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi ngokushesha. Isikhumbuzo sokubiza ubufakazi esikhiphwe kumele sibe sifana neFomu 6 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Ngubani omunye ongathunyelwa umregistrar ngokuphakamisa komphathi ophakanyisiwe?

Ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kungase kungahambisani nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Ugesi ophansi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekuhlinzekeni abathengi bezindlu noma amabhizinisi amancane. Ugesi ophakathi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekusabalaliseni ugesi nasekuhlinzekeni izimboni noma abathengi abangathengisi. I-voucher yegesi: Lokhu kuwufakazi lokukhokha (ibhilidi) elitholakala ngemva kokukhokha ugesi futhi livumela umthengi ukuthi asebenzise inani elithile legesi. Isebenza ngokuthi ilayishwe kumitha yegesi ekhokhelwayo. Umitha yegesi ekhokhelwayo: idivayisi yokukala ugesi ekhokhelwayo. Izimali ezahlukene zogesi ezithengwe zifakwa kule mithathu. Isikhungo sokuhweba nokuqasha ugesi: imishini exhunywe ezindaweni zebhizinisi esetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amanani kagesi athengwe ngababhalisile ugesi ekhokhelwayo. Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngogesi: izinga elilindelekile lokuhlinzeka ngogesi, njengezinga lamandla kagesi, ukuhoxiswa, ukwehla, nokwenyuka kwamandla, njll., njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 2 se-NRS 048. Ikhredi/Abathengi abasebenzisa ama-voucher kagesi ekhokhelwayo: laba ngabathengi abasebenzisa ugesi ngekhredi futhi umhlinzeki kagesi uza ukufunda inani legesi elisetshenzisiwe. Izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezichazwe ngaphansi kwe-NRS 047 esigabeni 1 yilezo okufanele umhlinzeki kagesi azame ukuzihlangabeza, kodwa abahlinzeki bamanzi bencitshwa ukuba baphumelele izindinganiso eziphakeme ezibekwe.

Incwadi yokuxoxisana nabaholi bendabuko kanye nezikhungo. Isu likazwelonke lamafilimu, amaVideo, kanye nezinqolobane zemisindo. Incwadi yokubusa/ yokuphetha nokuqhutshwa nokubambisana kwezeSayensi kanye noBuchwepheshe. Itebula 2: Inombolo yamakhasi eyahungushwa kanye neyahlelwa ngaphakathi kanye nengxenye eyahunyushwa ngesingisi/ nesibhunu. Uphiko lwezilimi zangaphandle lwathola imibiko izikhashana esiningana izincwadi zokubheka, ukuxhumana okwejwayelekile, izivumelwano ezimbaxambili, ukulawula. Ukushaya lomthetho, ama (Artiches) imibuzo, amarekhodi noma imininingwane yokuqhubeka enkantolo kanye nokubeyeliswa komuntu ezweni ezekulo icala, amaphoyisa omhlaba. Ucedo lwamajaji/ lokuhlulela. Inombolo enkulu yezivumelwano ezithulwa iyinkomba yokudlondlobala / yokukhula kweningizimu Afrika ebudlelwaneni namazwe omhlaba. Izivumelwano ezimbaxambili zatholwa nasemikhakheni yezentela, ezindabeni zezempilo, yezokwandisa emoyeni, ezindabeni zamaphoyisa, ezokuhwebelana / ezohwebo kanye futhi nezilwane kanye nezitshalo /nezihlahla ezilimini ezinjenge Lithanian, Spenish, French, Chinese, Arabic kanye neForsi. Uphiko kweSayensi kanye nobuciko nobuChwephesha lulwela ukufaka / ukuqalisa izindlela zokuqala ezizobeka ukuthi isayensi kanye nobuchwephesha kusebenza ngendlela ezodala umehluko ekukhuleni nasekuthuthukiseni ngendlela eqhubekayo izindawo ezibalulekile kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

Thola ukudla okunomsoco nezidingo zempilo. Ukuphepha nezidingo zezenhlala kahle. Ukunakekelwa abasebenzi bezempilo. Ukwaziswa ngokwelashwa nokunakekelwa ngendlela ingane engakwazi ukuqonda kalula lapho kufanelekile. Ukuhlonishwa ngokobuntu, ingasese, imfihlo, isithunzi, okomoya nokukholelwa emasikweni. Ngemvume yesiguli ukuthola ulwazi ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokwelashwa kwesiguli isihlobo sawo. Lokuphathwa ngenhlonipho nangesizotha ngokuqikelela izidingo zokomphefumulo nokukholelwa emasikweni. Ukubeka Imibono yokukhathazeka nokuthola incazelo ngokuphuthumayo. Ukwaziswa ngezigameko ezingajwayelekile ezenzekayo ngesikhathi isiguli silashwa, njengo kuwa embhedeni nokunjalo. Ilungelo lokungena bazobona isiguli ngesikhathi okungesona sokuhambela iziguli lapho isimo siphoqa noma siphuthuma. Lokuxhaswa ngomoya, nokwaziswa lapho isimo siphoqa noma siphuthuma. Lokuxhaswa ngomoya, nokwaziswa lapho lingatholakala khona usizo ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwesibhedlela. Sokunikezela ngolwazi olufanelekile mayelana nempilo yesiguli nokwelashwa kwangaleso sikhathi lapho kudingeka khona. Ekukhishweni kwesiguli esibhedlela umndeni ubophezelekile, ngokuqiniseka ukuthi sithatha imithi, sibuya ngokufanelekile ukuqhubeka nohlelo lokulashwa njengalokhu kuyobe kuhleliwe. Ukuhlonipha ezinye iziguli, izivakashi nezisebenzi sasesibhedlela. Ukwamukela ukuthi izidingo zezinye iziguli neminye imindeni kungaba okuphuthumayo kunezabo izidingo. Ukwazisa nokuhlonipha izakhiwo, nemphahla nokuhambisana nemithetho. Ukwazisa isibhedlela ngokushintsha kwemininingwane yesiguli isibonelo kheli, inombolo yocingo nokunye.

i izindawo zomnotho ii izindawo zezimboni; noma iii izindawo zokulima izinga elikhulunywe esigabeni 1 b lingashicilelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali nangesaziso, abeke umkhawulo kumaphesenti lapho inani lentela yezindlu kufanele likhuphuke unyaka nonyaka. a kanye nezinhlobo zamamasipala angase, kulandela lesi sigaba, achazwe esazisweni njengokuhambelana nezigaba noma izinhlobo zamamasipala ngaphansi kokuchazwa komthetho wezakhiwo zamamasipala nakwezinye izindlela; noma b izinhlobo zomphakathi/izigaba uma kukhona isizathu esihle, uNgqongqoshe angavuma ukubuyiselwa kumamasipala ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ebekwe kulandela isigaba 1. Inani lentela yezindlu elakhiwe endaweni entsha ebophelelwe intela yezindlu noma endaweni lapho umnikazi enamalungelo ngaphansi kohlelo lokulungiswa komhlaba kufanele ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zes

Uma ufuna ukuba umphakathi wezolimo, akuzothi kudlule isikhathi eside ukuze ubone ukubaluleka kokusebenzisa imishini - okuhlanganisa yonke imishini yokulima. Ekuqaleni, lapho usalima endaweni encane, ungaphumelela ngokusebenza ngezandla noma usebenzisa amajuba noma amahhashi. Kodwa lapho uqala ukulima amahektha amaningi, kuzodingeka usebenzise imishini ukwenza umsebenzi omningi ngesikhathi esifushane. Sivame ukubona ukuthi abalimi abaningi bahluleka ukuqhubeka ngoba abanayo imishini noma imishini yabo ayisebenzi kahle. Itraktori engakwazi ukusebenza ayisizi umbulali nhlobo. Bheka inani lamanzi nomoya. Thola irekhodi lesevisi lelo mshini. Bheka isimo samathayi. Bheka noma yikuphi ukuvuza kwe-oyili - akudingeki. Qala injini futhi ulalele ukuthi ikhuluma kanjani. Sebenzisa i-clutch namagiya - ingabe konke kusebenze kahle noma cha? Xhuma imishini (njenge-plow) futhi uyiphakamishe ukuze uhlole ukuthi uhlelo lwe-hydraulic lusebenza kahle. Ingabe i-PTO iyasebenza kahle? Ingabe wonke amagiya namaleveli asebenza kahle? Donsa imishini ukuze ubone ukuthi itraktori inamandla. Ingabe le traktori isasebenza kahle? Bheka ukuthi i-planter isebenza kanjani - ingabe inama-plates, ingabe isebenza nge-vacuum (umoya), noma ingabe isebenzisa iminwe? Ingabe i-planter ifaka imigqa emingaki? Xhuma i-planter ku-traktori. Faka imbewu ne-fertilizer kumahopper. Phusha itraktori endaweni eqondile engaba ngamamitha angama-10 bese uhlole ukuthi zonke imigqa zisebenza. Uma imbewu ne-fertilizer zingaphumi kahle, bheka izingxenye ezifanele futhi uthole ukuthi yini inkinga. Bheka uma kunezinye ama-plates (lapho isebenzisa ama-plates).

(1) Ilungu loMkhandlu kumele lihoxe odabeni lapho, ilungu lomndeni walo noma osondelene nalo noma kulindeleke ukuthi ahlomule ngokwezezimali noma ngenye indlela esinqumweni soMkhandlu. Noma yimuphi umuntu angafaka isicelo, noma angacela ngomlomo, ukuthi ilungu loMkhandlu lihoxe uma lowo muntu enesizathu sokukholwa ngukuthi ilungu loMkhandlu, ilungu lomndeni walo noma osondelene nalo kulindeleke ukuthi ahlumule ngokwezezimali noma ngenye indlela esinqumweni soMkhandlu. Umuntu ofaka isicelo okukhulunywe ngaye esigatshaneni (2) kumele anikeze izizathu zesicelo sakhe. Uma isicelo okukhulunywe ngaso esigatshaneni (2), uSihlalo woMkhandlu kumele anqume ngalolo daba, ngaphandle uma isicelo sithinta uSihlalo woMkhandlu udaba kumele lunqunywe yiLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe noma ngoqokwe yilona. Izikhala, ukususwa kanye nokusula esikhundleni kwamalungu oMkhandlu 14. (1) Ilungu loMkhandlu kumele lishiye isikhundla uma lingasafaneleki njengoba kuhlongozwe esigabeni 8(4). ILungu loMkhandlu oPhethe, emva kokunikeza ilungu ithuba lokuzikhulumela, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi lingakhipha esikhundleni lelo lungu uma, ngokubona kwalo, kunezizathu ezizwakalayo zokwenze njalo. Ilungu kumele lishiye isikhundla uma liphuthe, ngaphandle kokuthi ilivu liyinikezwe nguMkhandlu, emihlanganweni emibili elandelanayo yoMkhandlu isaziso sayo esasinikezwe ilungu uqobo noma esasiposiwe.

Kubhalwe njalo kubalulekile ukuhlola kahle ukuthi ingabe kukhona inkinga ethile yokukhula kwezihlahla emapulazini akho. Izindlela zokulima, izindlela zokulawula izihlahla ngezikhemikhali, kanye nokuphindaphinda izitshalo kuyahluka ezindaweni ezithile nasemapulazini athile. Kungenzeka ukuthi inkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla epulazini lakho ihluke ngokuphelele kunenkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla emapulazini asendaweni. Hlola njalo ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezihlahla ezikhona epulazini lakho bese uhlanganisa izikhemikhali ezifanele zokusebenzisa. Sicela ubheke ithebula elingezansi ukuze ubone ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ze-herbicides ezitholakalayo lapha eNingizimu Afrika ezilawula izihlahla emakhanda. Izikhemikhali ezitholakalayo kanye nohlu lwezikhemikhali zinezingxenye ezisebenzayo ezibulala izihlahla ezifana nezitshalo zonyaka noma izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. Ingxenye esebenzayo iyisikhemikhali esilawula izihlahla ngokuvimba ukufinyelela kwazo elangeni, okwenza izihlahla zingakwazi ukuqhubeka nokukhula. Lezi zikhemikhali zihlanganiswa lapho izinkambu zomkhiqizi zinezingqinamba ngezihlahla nezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi. Ezinye izindawo, ungaba nenhlanhla ngoba usebenzise uhlelo oluhle lokuphindaphinda izitshalo noma ulawule izihlahla kahle, futhi kuzoba nenkinga kuphela ngezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi emakhanda. Kulokhu, uzophosa imali uma uphonsa izitshalo. Ukuhlola ngqo inkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla kuzokusiza ngezindleko zakho uma ulawula izihlahla. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi i-pH yomhlabathi ikuphi kuyo yonke imikhakha epulazini lakho.

Ufulawa wesoya onamafutha asezingeni eliphezulu nawo ungakhiqizwa ngokwengeza uwoyela kufulawa ongamuncwanga amafutha ngokwezinga eliyi-15%. Ukudla kwabantwana okunesoya (i-Soya-based infant formula) (i-SBIF) kusetshenziswa ezinganeni ezinegazi elingezwani namaphrotheni obisi lwenkomo olubulewe amagciwane ngokushiswa. Lokhu kudla kuthengiswa ngezinhlobo eziyimphuphu, elungele ukudliwa kanye nangezinhlobo eziluketshezi olushubile. Ubhontshisi wesoya uyakwazi ukucoliswa ukuze uzwakale futhi ubukeke njengazo zonke ezinye izinhlobo zokudla. Ukwenza isibonelo, ubhontshisi wesoya uyisithako esiphambili emikhiqizweni eminingi esetshenziswa esikhundleni sobisi lwezilwane (isibonelo, ubisi lwesoya, umajarini, u-ayisikhrimu wesoya, iyogathi yesoya, ushizi wesoya nokhrimu owenziwe ngoshizi wesoya) kanye nasemikhiqizweni yezinto ezisetshenziswa esikhundleni senyama (isibonelo, amabhega adliwa ngabantu abadla imifino). Lezi zinhlobo zokudla zitholakala kalula kumasuphamakethe. Ubisi lwesoya alunawo amathamo amakhulu e-calcium egayekayo emzimbeni. Abenzi abaningi bobisi lwesoya baluthengisa nemikhiqizo enothiswe nge-calcium. Imikhiqizo yesoya ibuye isetshenziswe njengokudla okubiza kancane okungena endaweni yemikhiqizo yenyama neyenkukhu. Ukucolisiswa kakhulu kungaba nomphumela wokunambitheka okwehlisiwe, kepha amafutha ne-cholesterol kuyehla.

Qaphela iminyaka yabo, ukuphakama, umbala wezinwele, izilonda, izingubo, ukukhuluma, nezindlela. Zama ukushiya ubufakazi obuningi ngangokunokwenzeka mayelana nendawo okwenzeka kuyo. Kungani ukuhlanya kungase kulawulwe kahle? Kukhona izinto ezintathu ezingaholela ekulawulweni okungasebenzi kahle - eyokuqala ingaba indlela yokuhlanza kanye nomshini osetshenziswayo, eyesibili ingaba i-herbicide efakwe, futhi yokugcina ingaba izimo zezulu. Izilungiselelo zomshini zingase zingabi seduze, futhi kungase kube nezikhala, okuvumela umhlabathi phakathi kwezithako ukuthi ungahlanzi kahle (uma ziqinile, azizokwazi ukusebenza kahle). Ubude bokuhlanza bungase bungefiki kahle - izimpande zokuhlanya eziphakeme zihlala ziqinile emhlabathini, futhi ukuhlanya kungase kuqale kabusha. Isivinini somshini singase sibe siphansi kakhulu - kufanele run ngokushesha ukuze uphazamise umhlabathi kahle. Umhlabathi ungase ube manzi kakhulu - izitshalo ezihlanziwe zihlala zisebenza nomhlabathi ongenamanzi futhi zingase ziqale kabusha. Ukulungiswa komshini kungase kube okungafanele. Isikhathi sokuphuzisa ukuhlanya singase singabi sesimweni esifanele. I-herbicide esetshenziswayo ingase ingasebenzi kahle ngokumelene nohlobo oluthile lokuhlanya. I-filter ye-nozzle yokuphuzisa igcwele (isithombe 4). Izikhala zomshini ophuzisa zivalekile (isithombe 5). Izinsiza ezingafanele zisetshenziswa (khumbula ukusebenzisa i-nozzle enobumba uma uphuzisa phezu kwezithako, futhi i-nozzle ye-fan elula uma uphuzisa phezu komhlabathi). Umshini ungase ungakahlanzwa kahle ngonyaka odlule - izinto eziningi zingavala, futhi ngeke usebenze kahle uma kukhona okushiywe okungahlanzwanga. Ingxenye yekhemikhali idinga imvula emva kokuphuzisa ukuze isebenze kahle - uma kunganaki, i-herbicide ayikwazi ukuqala ukusebenza.

Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi buvunyelwe noma abuvunyelwe sincike ekutheni buhambisana yini noma ukuthi ukuvunyelwa kwabo kuzobeka umsolwa engozini. Kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi ngokusekelwe ezimweni ezizokweneliseka ekupheleni kwecala. Uma isimo singanelisi, lelo bufakazi alithathwa njengelungile. Ikhampasi yathatha isinqumo sokuthi idokhumenti ingasetshenziswa ekubuzweni komsolwa nakuba ubuqiniso bedokhumenti buphikiswa yiqembu lokuvikela. Ngemuva kokuphela kwecala, umsolwa uzoba nethuba lokwethula ubufakazi mayelana nobuqiniso bedokhumenti. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo nobuqiniso bedokhumenti, noma yisiphi esinye ubufakazi obuphuma ngemuva kokubuzwa kuzobekwa eceleni yikhamphani. Ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esisekelwe kubufakazi obufanele, ikhamphani izocabanga ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe buhambisana nezimfanelo zecala. Amandla kuyilungelo noma isibopho esidingekayo ngobufakazi noma iqembu lapho kuthulwa ubufakazi enkantolo. Kukhona izinhlobo ezimbili zamandla. Amandla abantu kanye namandla ombuso. Ukungena kwenkantolo kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphakathi kwenkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqinile futhi obungaphikiswa noma bukhishwe ngaphandle kokuthi izimfuneko zomthetho ezithile zifezekiswe. Ukungena kwangaphandle kubhekisela ekungeni okwenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo okuthintekayo ekuphikisaneni noma empikiswaneni. Ukuvuma kweqiniso kuwumsebenzi lapho umsolwa evuma ngokuphelele futhi ngaphandle kokungabaza emsebenzini, okungaba uma kwenziwa phambi kwenkantolo kuzothathwa njengokuvuma ukuvuma.

ukucela usizo lwenu nokuzimbandakanya kanye nokwehhovisi lakho elikhulu ekudluliseni kahle imiyalezo ebalulekile ngemfuluwenza i-A (H1N1) 2009 emasontweni enu nasemiphakathini yenu. Igama elisemthethweni lesayensi lalesi sifo yi-Pandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Yaqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka. Ekuqaleni yayaziwa njengomkhuhlane wezingulube (i-swine flue) ngenxa yokuthi kwabe kucatshangelwa ukuthi yaqala ngezingulube. Manje sekuyaqondwa ukuthi umsuka wayo uvela kubantu nakuzinyoni. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kufa akunalutho yokwenza nokudliwa kwengulube noma imikhiqizo yengulube. Manje sekubizwa nje kalula njengemfluwenza engubhubhane noma ibizwe ngegama layo elisemthethweni i-A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka, le vayirasi isisabalele ngokushesha kumazwe ayi-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje le vayirasi isisabalalele emazweni ayi-16 kuphela. Ngalesi sikhathi sokubhala le ncwadi, le vayirasi isisulele abantu abayi-177 457 (abaqinisekiswe yizindlu zokuqhuba ucwaningo lwesayensi) emhlabeni wonke, phakathi kwabo osekufe abayi-1 457 abaqinisekisiwe. ENingizimu Afrika kuze kube yimanje, sesiqinisekise izimo eziyi-2 844 osekufe kuzo abantu abayisithupha. Ngemuva komhlangano wesine weKomidi Lwesimo Esisheshayo owawubanjwe ngomhla we-11 Juni 2009, iNhlangano Yomhlaba Yezempilo (i-WHO) yaphetha ngokuthi ikhratheriya yokuthatha lokhu kufa njengobhubhane lomhlaba seyanelisekile futhi uMnqondisi-Jikelele, uDkt Margret Chan, usesigunyazile lesi simo njengoBhubhane (izinga lesi-6).

Kwakhiwe uhlelo lokuphenya ngemuva kokushiswa kwesakhiwo eGoli ezinsukwini ezedlule, lapho umphakathi ub faced isikhumbuzo esibi somlilo. Umlilo, owenzeka phakathi nosuku, waba nemiphumela emibi, waholela ekulahlekelweni kwezimpilo nokulahleka kwezimpahla eziningi. Uphenyo olwenziwe ngabeZithombe, iziphathimandla, kanye nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, lukhombisa ubunzima bokuphila emadolobheni amakhulu. Uphenyo luveze ukuthi umlilo uqale ngezizathu ezingaziwa, nokho kukhona izinkomba ezikhombisa ukungahleleki kwezokuphepha. Izinhlelo zokuphepha, ezifana nama-alamu nezinhlelo zokuphuma, zibonakale zingasebenzi kahle, okwenza kube nzima kubantu abaphakathi kwesakhiwo ukuphuma ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izakhiwo ezinkulu eGoli zidinga ukuvuselelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha kwabantu. Abaphenyi baphinde bathola ukuthi izinhlelo zokwakha zazingahambisani nezindinganiso ezidingekayo, okukhombisa ukuthi abathengi, abaklami, nabakhi kufanele babe neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izakhiwo eziphephile. Izinhlelo zokuhlola izakhiwo zidinga ukuqiniswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezibucayi. Ukwengeza, umphakathi ubhekene nokungabi nolwazi olunembile ngezindlela zokuphuma uma kwenzeka umlilo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa umphakathi ukuze bakwazi ukuqonda kangcono izingozi ezihambisana nomlilo. Izikhungo zomphakathi, izikole, nezikhungo zokwakha kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu indlela yokuphuma ngokushesha uma kuvela izimo ezinjalo.

Imibuzo ejwayelekile iphendulwa ngosuku, bese kuthi imibuzo enzima kakhulu iphendulwe esikhathini esiyiviki noma amabili kuye ngohlobo lombuzo kanye nokubakhona kweklayenti ukuze linikezwe impendulo. Yonke imibuzo ifakwa kunqolobane yemininingwane yamaklayenti, bese kwenziwa ukulandela ngokuwashayela ucingo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iklayente lilutholile ulwazi olufanele. Imibuzo ingehluka ukusukela kwejwayelekile, isib. 'Ngubani ongangiusiza ngezimali ebhizinisini lami' ukuya kwenzima kakhulu emayelana nezinqubo zokukhipha, izimakethe zamazwe ngamazwe, ukwaphulwa kwemvume, njll? Isikwama Sentsha soMsobomvu samiswa ngo-2001 nguHulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika ukubhekana nezinselele zokuntuleka kwemisebenzi okuphezulu kwentsha eNingizimu Afrika. I-Ntsika Yeboeka izikhungo Zezinsizakalo zebhizinisi Lendawo ezingaphezu kweziyi-140 (ama-LBSC). Sebenzisa inombolo engakhokhelwa engezansi ukuthola ukuthi yiyiphi i-LBSC eseduzane nawe. Emva kokuba usunohlelo lwakho lwebhizinisi, ungalusebenzisa ukuthola ukwesekwa ngezimali ebhizinisini lakho. Qaphela ukuthi noma kukhona izinhlelo ezahlukile ezikhona, zonke zeseka izindawo ezithile zebhizinisi lakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi ufundile waphinde waqonda zonke izici ngaphambi kokuxhumana nabaxhasa ngezimali noma ungamosa isikhathi kanye namandla.

Ukuqinisekiswa Kwenombolo Yempesheni Kahulumeni Isingeniso Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo bayakwazi ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zabantu abathola impesheni. I-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) iyinsiza ebalulekile ehlinzeka ngezinhlinzeko zezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni kanye nezimpesheni zabo. Le mbiko igxile ekubalulekeni kokuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni, izinqubo ezihambisanayo, kanye nemiphumela yokungaqinisekiswa okuhle. Ukubaluleka Kokuqinisekiswa Kwenombolo Yempesheni Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile ukuze abathola impesheni bakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo abazidingayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo yezezimali iyasetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, futhi abathola impesheni bathola izinzuzo zabo ngaphandle kokubambezeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kunciphisa amathuba okukhwabanisa, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali kahulumeni. Izinyathelo Zokuqinisekisa Inombolo Yempesheni Ukuze kuqinisekiswe inombolo yempesheni, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe. Okokuqala, umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi unayo inombolo yempesheni efanele, etholakala ezincwadini ezisemthethweni noma kumarekhodi ezemali. Okwesibili, umsebenzisi kufanele avakashele iwebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-GEMS noma abize ucingo kumphakathi wezinsizakalo ukuze athole imiyalelo yokuhambisa isicelo sokuhlolela. Ngemva kokuhambisa isicelo, umsebenzisi uzothola impendulo, evamise ukuthatha izinsuku ezimbalwa. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane efakiwe iyahambisana nezincwadi ezisemthethweni, futhi uma kunokungahambelani, umsebenzisi uzocelwa ukuthi alungise imininingwane.

Lowomsebenzi uzakuqhubeka kulishumi leminyaka lesibili lenkululeko yethu". Eminyakeni engamashumi amahlanu adlulile, ngenkathi balungisela umhlangano omkhulu wabantu owamukela incwadi yemvume yenkululeko, omashanhliziyo zangalezonsuku zathi Asikhulumeni sonke kanye-kanye, ama-Afrika, bangaphesheya eYurophu, amaNdiya namaKhaladi, bonke abantu base Ningizimu Afrika, asikhulumeni sonke sikhulumele inkululeko, sikhulumele nenjabulo engalethwa wukuthi abantu bahlale ezweni elikhululekile. Namhlanje kufanele sivuselele isethembiso sethu, sikhulume kanye-kanye sikhulumele inkululeko, sisebenze ngobudlelwano ukuze kufezekiswe intokozo eza nenkululeko, sisebenzisana ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labo bonke abantu elifanayo, sisho kanye-kanye nangezenzo sithi - sekwanele konke loku okwenza izwe lethu elikuqukethe ngaphakathi kwalo, kanti futhi lisebenzela okubi nokunyanyekayo emphakathini. Kufanele ukuthi siqhubeke sikhulumisane nalombono esakhuluma ngawo mhlazana lohulumeni wanamhlanje angena esikhundleni, kusobala ukuthi izinkinga ezisihaqile zenhlalakahle yabantu azingeke zisombululwe uma singeke sidale amathuba emisebenzi, nokuhliswa noma ukuqedwa kobumpofu phakathi kwethu. Ngako-ke "umzabalazo wokuqedwa kobumpofu kuyinto enkulu kanti futhi kusaqhubeka kuyinto enkulu yemizamo kahulumeni ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika entsha". Ukufaka isandla ekucazululweni kwezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu bonke emhlabeni. Kunginika intokozo enkulu ukunazisa ukuthi mayelana nalezibopho, uhulumeni usebenza kanzima ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhloso zesizwe ziyafezekiswa.
