Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokukwazi ukuthola indlu efanelekile. ngokusemandleni ombuso ukwenza ukuba ukuphumelela kwaleli lungelo kuqhubekele phambili. umthetho oyovumela ukususwa abathintekayo benganikwanga ithuba lokuziphendulela. labo okufanele abondle. ngokusemandleni ombuso ukuze ukuphumelela kwalelo nalelolungelo kuqhubekele phambili. Akekho umuntu ongalelwa ukuba athole usizo lwezokwelashwa oluphuthumayo. Kuzona zonke izinto ezithinta umntwana, kuyobekwa phambili izidingo zakhe. Kulesisigaba "umntwana" kusho umuntu oneminyaka yobudala engaphansi kwengu-18. intuthuko ibe khona kunoma ngubani. nezixhaswa yizimali zombuso. Isigatshana (3) asizivimbeli izimali zombuso ezixhasa izakhiwo zemfundo ezizimele. ngendlela engahambisani nanoma yisiphi isimiso soMqulu wamaLungelo. yisiphi isimiso esikuMqulu wamaLungelo. noma ekuvikelweni kwanoma yimaphi amalungelo. wokwengamela izidingo zalelilungelo kanye nezindleko kumbuso. ngendlela esemthethweni, efanele futhi elandela inqubo egculisayo. lokunikezwa izizathu ezibhaliwe zaleso sinyathelo. ukhuthaze ukuthi kubenombuso osebenza ngokukhuthala. lapho kulungile, leyo ngxabano ingaxazululwa yinkundla ezimele nengavuni hlangothi. udokotela oqokwe nguye. lokufaka isicelo sokudlulisa icala noma ukuhlaziywa kwalo yinkantolo enkulu. alunikwe ngolimi aluqonda kahle. bufakazi bungenza ukuthi icala lingagculisi noma kungakhinyabeza ukuphathwa kobulungiswa.

Sithokoza kakhulu ngokunethulela le ncwadi. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni wethu wasayina Isivumelwano Senhlangano Yezizwe Esiphathelene Namalungelo Ezingane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi sivumile ukuhlonipha imithetho ekhethekile ephathelene nokuthi kufanele izingane ziphathwe kanjani emhlabeni jikelele. Uma singayihloniphi le mithetho, sizoba sengxakini enkulu eNhlanganweni Yezizwe! Kodwa into esiyiqaphelile lapha eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi, nakuba Isivumelwano sikhuluma ngezingane, asibhaliwe ngendlela izingane ezingayizwa kalula. Sazibuza ukuthi, yini usizo lwalokhu Ngokweqiniso, izingane kufanele zikwazi ukuqonda amalungelo azo? Yingakho sinqume ukukubhalela le ncwadi. Amalungelo akule ncwadi ngawakho. Ngawazo zonke izingane eziseNingizimu Afrika nayo yonke ingane esemhlabeni wonkana. Akekho umuntu ongakwephuca la malungelo. Ngakho-ke qiniseka ukuthi uyawazi! Sisize ekwakheni ikusasa lezwe lethu! Futhi uqiniseke ukuthi uyazithokozisa kakhulu! Nginezingane okungezami. Ngakho-ke ngiyazi ukuthi into ebaluleke kakhulu enganeni ukuthi izizwe iphephile futhi ivikelekile. Le ncwadi ikhuluma ngamalungelo ezingane ukuthi zizizwe ziphephile futhi zivikelekile ezweni lethu. Ngizinikele ukuthi ngiqinisekise ukuthi niyawazi amalungelo enu nokuthi wonke umuntu emnyangweni wami usebenza kanzima ukuvikela nina, imindeni yenu nabangane. Nami futhi ngiyabona ukuthi njengezingane eniyizo manje, nidinga kakhulu ukuthi nizizwe niphephile, nivikelekile, naziswa futhi ninakekelwa. Ngiyazi ngoba nami ngake ngaba ingane. Ngakho-ke kuwumsebenzi wami ukuthi ngiqinisekise ukuthi laba abenza ubugebengu ezinganeni bayaboshwa bajeziswe ngendlela efanele.

Kubalulekile futhi ukuhlinzeka ngama-workshops nabantu abasha, ukuze bakwazi ukuthola amakhono afanele. Isiphetho Imakethe yemisebenzi eNingizimu Afrika ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kodwa kunezixazululo ezingase zisetshenziswe ukwenza ngcono isimo. Ngokuhlanganisa imfundo nezidingo zomsebenzi, kanye nokudala amathuba amasha, sizokwazi ukwakha imakethe yemisebenzi ezinzile. Ngokuqhubeka nokusebenza ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi, sithuthukise umnotho, futhi sakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uhlelo lokwenza izinguquko luzodingeka, futhi kungakhathaliseki ukuthi izinhlelo zidinga isikhathi, impumelelo izofika uma sisebenza ndawonye. Ukwazisa ukuthi imisebenzi iyinto ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi kufanele siqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuqinile ukuze sithole izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, okwaziyo ukubhekana nezinselelo zamanje.

Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi izinselelo zikhona, kodwa zikhona nezixazululo. Baphakamisa amaphuzu, bahlanganyela, benza imihlangano, bekhuluma ngempumelelo. Umoya wabo wawufana nemvula ebusika, ulethela uMkhumbane isivuno esikahle. Ngemva kwesikhathi, uMkhumbane waba yisibonelo sokuphumelela. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, imikhuba yendawo yathuthukiswa. Izikhungo zempilo zikhula, imfundo yayigqugquzela. Uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa lwaluphumelele, lwandisa impilo yezakhamuzi. Izinsuku zanyamalala, kodwa ukwakha umphakathi ongcono kwaba yinkumbulo engapheli. UMkhumbane waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, bahlala bejolise empumelelweni, bangashintsha noma iyiphi indawo. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwalukhanya phezulu, lukhuluma ngezindaba zempilo, uthando, nokubambisana. Umoya wokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya wawukhanya, futhi abahlali baqhubeka nokuthokozisa, bejabulile ngempilo yabo entsha. Ngalolu hambo, uMkhumbane waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma bephikelela, bahlala bejolise, bangathola impumelelo. Iminyaka yathuthuka, kodwa indaba yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya yaqhubeka, isingatha izimpande zesikhathi eside. Njengoba izinkanyezi zikhanya, umphakathi unqoba, uthokozisa impilo.

UThandi noSipho babona ukuthi, noma ubani angaba nesandla ekuphuculeni umhlaba, uma kuphela ebekezela, futhi enza okuthile. Ekugcineni, umhlaba wabo waba ngcono. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephila ndawonye, bexhumana. UThandi noSipho babazi ukuthi, uma abantu behlangana, baphikisana, kodwa bephila ngokuhlanganyela, umhlaba ungaba ngcono. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi noSipho baqonda ukuthi, ukuphucwa komhlaba akupheli, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Futhi, njengoba besebenza, babona ukuthi umhlaba ungahlala uphucwa, uma kuphela abantu bephila ndawonye, behlanganyela, futhi behloniphana. Ngale ndlela, uThandi noSipho bahlala bephusha umhlaba phambili, bejabulile, bephila impilo enokuthula. Umhlaba wabo waba yindawo yokwamukela, yokufunda, nokukhula. Ngakho, ukuphucwa komhlaba kwaba yimpumelelo enkulu, futhi uThandi noSipho baba yizibonelo zabanye, bephila impilo enobuntu, beqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaleso sikhathi, umhlaba wabo waba yisibonelo sokuthi, uma abantu behlangana, baphikisana, kodwa behloniphana, umhlaba ungaba ngcono. Futhi, lokho kwaba yisifundo esikhulu sokuphila.

Amarisidi akhishwe ngegama loMkhandlu mayelana nezimali ezikhokhelwa ukubhalisa, ayakuba ubufakazi emacaleni ngokomthetho ukuthi lowo muntu ubhaliswe ngokwalo Mthetho, kodwa uma lapho noma imuphi umuntu ogama lakhe... a livela kulejista nowehlulekayo ukuveza irisidi, irisidi ngesandla sikaNobhala ingubufakazi bokuthi lowo muntu obhalisiwe ngokwaloMthetho; noma b lisuliwe kulejista kusukela ngosuku okukhishwe ngalo irisidi futhi ingazange libuye libhalwe kulejista, isitifiketi esikhishe ngesandla sikaNobhala sokuthi lelo gama lesusiwe kulejista ngubufakazi bokuthi lowo muntu akabhalisiwe ngokwaloMthetho. UNgqongqoshe, ngezincomo ezenziwe uMkhandlu anganquma iziqu ezitholakale ngokuhlolwa okwenziwe isikhungo sokufundisa ubuhlengikazi esiseRiphablikhi, okuyothi uma enazo zodwa noma nezinye iziqu zivumele lowo muntu onazo ukuba abhalise ngokwaloMthetho uma ngemuva kokuthola lezi ziqu okukhulunywa ngazo ehambisane nemibandela noma izidingo ezinganqunywa. b uhlobo nobungako bokuqhubeka nokuthuthuka ngomsebenzi okufanele kwenziwe yilabo abanquba umsebenzi; kanye c nenqubo yokwamukelwa nguMkhandlu kwezenzo noma izinhlelo zokuqhubeka ukuthuthuka ngokomsebenzi nezikhungo ezigunyazwe ukuba zinikeze lezo zinhlelo. Umuntu oyisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika ofisa ukubhalisa okokuqala ukuba enze umsebenzi kulemikhakha enqunyiwe kufanele enze umsebenzi wokusiza umphakathi okhokhelwayo isikhathi esingunyaka owodwa ezikweni likahulumeni elinika usizo lwezinto zempilo. Umuntu okukhulunywa ngaye kusigatshana 1 kufanele abhalise emkhakheni wokusiza umphakathi.

Ama-Amapiano: Uhambo Lwezinguquko Nezintuthuko Emculweni. Ama-Amapiano abhalisela umlando ophawulekayo, adumile emhlabeni, futhi aqhubeka nokukhula. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinguquko zomculo, kufanele sibuyele emuva ezinsukwini lapho la magama aqala khona. I-Amapiano, igama elihlanganisa izitayela eziningi, yaziwa njengenhlobo yomculo ophuma eNingizimu Afrika. Izimpande zayo ziqala ezikhathini zokuqala zekhulu leminyaka, lapho umculo we-house uqala ukuthandwa. Ngokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene, ama-Amapiano ahlukaniswa njengohlobo oluhlukile, olunezici ezinzima ze-bass, izigubhu ezimnandi, kanye nezimvumi ezikhangayo. Ukuqala kwama-Amapiano kwenzeka eminyakeni yama-2010, lapho abaculi abanjengo DJ Maphorisa, Kabza De Small, no-Vinny beqala ukukhipha imisebenzi ethokozisayo, behlola izihloko ezifana nempilo, uthando, nezinsuku zansuku. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umculo ophilayo, owenze abantu bajabule. Lokhu kwaba yinsika yokwazisa abathandi bomculo ngalesi sikhathi esisha. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, ama-Amapiano aqhubekile nokukhula, abe yinsika ebalulekile emakhaya ama-Afrika. Ukuhamba phambili kwawo kuholele ekuxhumaneni nezinye izinhlobo zomculo, njengemizwelo ye-gospel, i-jazz, ne-kwaito, okwakha imisebenzi emisha ethokozisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umculo ogcwele injabulo, okwazi ukudansa abantu ezikhathini eziningi. Njengoba ama-Amapiano ekhula, abantu basemakhaya nabafudukela emadolobheni baqala ukusebenzisa lezi zindlela zokuphila ukuze baphile izimpilo zabo.

Ukubhekelwa kwendlela yokulawula ukuhamba kanye nokuhambela kwamanye amazwe okusemthethweni kanye nokungekho emthethweni. Amahhovisi ezifunda anikezela ngenhlanganisela yemisebenzi yayo yonke iminyango, kusukela emisebenzini yomphakathi ukuya ekuphathweni kokuhambela kwamanye amazwe, neminye imisebenzi okujwayeleke ukuthi ibe ngaphakathi kwemisebenzi abagunyazwe ukuyenza. La mahhovisi ezifunda aphinde ahlukaniswa futhi aba amahhovisi angaphansi kwezifunda kanye namahhovisi ezigodi lapho umphakathi ungathola khona izindaba zokuhambela kwamanye amazwe kanye nezemisebenzi kaHulumeni ye-DHA. Amachweba okungena abhekene nomsebenzi wokuphatha ukungena kanye nokuphuma kwabantu, ikakhulukazi abantu basemazweni angaphandle, emingceleni yaseNingizimu Afrika. Baqinisekisa ukuthi abantu basemazweni angaphandle abangafanelekile ukungena noma ukuphuma ezweni kubhekwana nabo njengoba kushiwo. Kuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu kumnyango ukuthi imisebenzi yawo utholakale kubantu jikelele, kungenxa yalokho kunamahhovisi ezifunda, amahhovisi ezigodi kanye nezindawo zokusiza abantu ezweni lonke. Imisebenzi eminingi ye-DHA yenziwa kuwo wonke la mahhovisi. Amafomu okufaka izicelo atholakala kukhompyutha kanye nolunye ulwazi kungatholakala kuwebhusayithi yomnyango. Ulwazi lokubhaliswa maqondana nemisebenzi yokuhambela kwamanye amazwe kanye nemisebenzi yomphakathi nalo lukhona kuwebhusayithi kulabo abasebenzisa i-inthanethi.

Esikulindeleke kuleBhodi entsha ukuthi igcine izinhlelo zoqeqesho eziqondene nabasebenzi kanye neBhodi yabaQondisi abazobe beseziMpikweni zeziChazamazwi kuZwelonke. AmaKomidi eziLimi kuZwelonke kanye namaLungu eziMpiko zeziChazamazwi kuZwelonke kufanele banikezwe izinqubongqangi ngokuphelele maqondaa nokusebenza kwalemigwamanda futhi nemisebenzi yawo iyiqhube bgokubekiwe kwinqubo migomo ewasingethe. Imigwamanda yokwaluleka yomibili izokwelekelela kokubili iBhodi kanye nezishaymathetho zezifundazwe ukuthola ulwazi maqondana nezihloko ezithinta izilimi emiphakathini emelwe yile migwamanda. Le Bhodi ekhona njengamanje yiqinisekisa futhi ukuthi izinqubonggangi kulowo nalowo mkhakha okugxilwe kuwo ziyahlanganiswa uumelekelela u-PANSLB emsebenzini wakhe awunikeziwe. Imisebenzi eyenziwa kunyakamali odlule, okubala ucwaningo nemikhankaso yokuthuthukisa kuzomelekelela u-PANSALB ukuthi aqhubeke nokuhlola amasu akhe maqondana nokuthuthukisa nokukhuthaza izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ngaphansi kokuhlelwa kwezilimi ucwaningo maqondana "nokusetshenziswa nobudlelwano bezilimi eNingizimu Afrika" lwayelekelela iBhodi ukuthi isiqonde kangcono isimo sezilimi yakwazi nokuhlanganisa ngokucacile izinqubongqangi nenqubo migomo yolimi, ukusetshenziswa nokulandelwa. Kwashicilelwa incwadi emayelana nenqubongqangi engujikelele ukwelekelela izikhungo eziphezu komsebenzi wokwakha imithethomigomo yezilimi.

Ngalesi sikhathi, uMbeki wahola izifundo eziningi zamazwe ase-Afrika, ethuthukisa umbono wokwakha umnotho oqinile nokuxhumanisa amazwe. Ngemva kokuphothulwa kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili njengomengameli, uThabo Mbeki wabhekana nezihe ezinzima. Iziphikiso ezivela emiphakathini mayelana nezinqumo zakhe, ikakhulukazi ezimayelana nezindaba zokusebenza kazwelonke, zakhumbuza abanye ukuthi uMbeki ungumholi ongenamahloni, ophikisana nezimvo zomphakathi. Nokho, akumelanga kulahlekelwe umbono omuhle owawuhambisana noMbeki. Waziwa nangokusebenzisa izindlela eziphusile zokuxazulula izinkinga ezinzima, okuholele emthethweni omkhulu empilweni yabantu. UThabo Mbeki ubalulekile emlandweni wombuso waseNingizimu Afrika, futhi umbono wakhe wokwakha i-Afrika eqinile usaqhubeka nokuphila. Njengomholi, wayenobuhlakani obumangalisayo, ezama ukuhlanganisa abantu bezizinda ezihlukene ukuze bakhe ikusasa eliqinile. Ubuye abe yisibonelo sokuthi ubuholi obuhle busekelwe ekuthandeni abantu, ukuhlonipha izidingo zabo, kanye nokuphila ngokuhlanganyela. Izimvo zikaMbeki mayelana nezindaba ezinjengobandlululo, umnotho, nezokuphepha zihlala zikhona emqondweni wabantu. Akumangalisi ukuthi, izithombe ezibhalwe uMbeki zikhumbuza izizukulwane ezizayo mayelana nemithwalo ethwala ubuholi. UThabo Mbeki, njengomholi, ukhumbuleka ngokukhuthaza izakhamuzi ukuba zithathe izinyathelo ezizothuthukisa isimo sabo, nokwakha umphakathi onokuthula. Kulo mhlaba wezezimali eziguqukayo, uMbeki ubalulekile ekuphakamiseni umqondo wokubambisana kanye nokwakha izixazululo ezizinzile.

Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uhulumeni uzimisele ukuvikela amalungelo abantu bonke, futhi akekho ozoshiywa ngaphandle. Umcimbi ugcizelela ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho azifanele kube yinto eyenziwa nguhulumeni kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube neqhaza labantu. Abantu baphakanyiswa ukuba baphathe izinkulumo, baveze imibono yabo, futhi babambe iqhaza ekwakheni umthetho. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinqubweni zomthetho, futhi kukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba ube nesibopho sokuziphatha kahle. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonisile ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho zidinga ukusebenzisana okuqhubekayo phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ukuze lezi zinguquko zibe nempumelelo, umphakathi, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani kufanele basebenze ndawonye. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukwakha amathuba emisebenzi, nokuthuthukisa izimo zokuphila. Ngokubambisana, umphakathi ungakwazi ukwakha umthetho ophumelelayo, ovumelanayo, futhi ohloniphekayo. Izinguquko zomthetho zikhombisa ukuthi umphakathi uyakwazi ukuhamba phambili, futhi ubuchwepheshe obusha bungasiza ekwenzeni lezi zinguquko zibe ngempumelelo. Umcimbi ubonisile ukuthi umphakathi unamandla, futhi uma abantu bebandakanyeka, izinguquko zomthetho zingaba yinsika yempumelelo. Ngakho-ke, umcimbi wezinguquko zomthetho awuqedi nje kuphela izinkulumo, kodwa uveza umbono omusha wokuthi umphakathi ungakwazi kanjani ukuhamba phambili. Lezi zinguquko zikhombisa ithemba, zikhuthaza ubumbano, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ithuba lokuphila kahle. Umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke nokubambisana, futhi izinguquko zomthetho zidinga ukugqugquzela abantu ukuba baphathe izinkulumo ezibalulekile ukuze kube neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono.

Ngaphansi kwehlelo lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo, uhulumeni uzohlinzeka ngosizo ezixukwini ezithintekayo ezingakwazi ukufinyelela ukudla okwanele nokunempilo ngenxa yobuphofu nokwenyuka kwamanani okudla. Uhulumeni ubeke imali engu-R1.2 billion eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Imali engu-R400 million isivele yabelwe unyaka wezezimali ka-2002/3, lapho u-R170 million usetshenzisiwe ukusiza abadinga usizo ezweni elizungezile. U-R230 million ubekwe eceleni ukuze kusebenze imindeni engama-200,000 ethintekayo ezinyangeni ezintathu ezizayo. Izikhwama zokudla zizophakanyiswa emakhaya angenayo imali nokuthi lawo angakwazi ukukhokhela ukudla okungafika ku-R200 ngenyanga. Le mikhankaso eqhubekayo ibonwa ngokuxoxisana nezithakazelo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezinhlangano zenkolo, amaqembu emisebenzi, izinhlangano ezingekho kuhulumeni, kanye nohulumeni uqobo. Inhloso enkulu yale hlelo ukuthuthukisa izinga lempilo yabantu bonke ngokwandisa amakhono angaphakathi emindenini ethintekayo ukuze ibhekane nobumpofu nokungabi nokudla, ukufinyelela ukudla okunempilo, nokuthola ukuvikelwa ezindleleni eziphakeme zokudla. Usizo lokudla luzohlinzekwa ngokusabalalisa izikhwama zokudla emakhaya athintekayo phakathi nezinyanga ezintathu. Ukwabelana kwezimpande kuzohlinzekwa ukusiza le mideni ikhulise ukudla kwabo futhi ithuthukise izimpilo zayo. Kuzohlinzekwa ukwesekwa kwemisebenzi yokwenza imali. Ukuqinisa umnikelo weHlelo Lokudla Esikoleni. Ukuze ubhalise ukuze uthole usizo lokudla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ingafinyelela ukudla okunempilo okunothile ngamavithamini nezimayini.

Ulwazi kwinkonzo nenkonzo luhlelwe ngokulandela imikhakha eyisikhombisa ebalulekile, okuyilena: izincazelo, izinyathelo okumele zilandelwe, imithetho nemigomo, amazinga okwenziwa komsebenzi nesikhathi sokwenziwa komsebenzi, izindleko, amafomu okumele agcwaliswe kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi lwaqala lwabhalwa nge-English kwathi emuva kwalokho lwaseluhunyushelwa kwezinye izilwimi. Ulwazi ngezinkonzo kwezinye izilwimi lufakelwa kwi-website ngemuva kokuba seluhunyushiwe. Sebenzisa ikhasi elithi xhumana nathi ukuphawula noma ukubuza nge-website yeziNkonzo zikaHulumeni. Imephu ye-website, ihlinzeka ngezithombe nemifanekiso yokuhleleka kwe-website. Ihleleke ukusuka phansi ukuya phezulu, lokhu okubeka ulwazi kwi-website ngemikhakha nemikhakha yezihloko ezithile. Lokhu kusiza ukuthi ukwazi ukubona kahle nokuqondisisa kahle ukuhleleka nengqikithi ekuqethwe yi-website. Ikhasi lokuqala libeka uhla lwezinkonzo ezifinyeleleka kakhulu. Lezi zindawo zokungena zisiza ukufinyelela kwizinkonzo ezinhlanu eziphezulu ezivakashelwa ngabasebenzisi. Uhla lubekwa nokuhlelwa ngokubonelela amanani amakhasi avakashelwe. Ibhokisana lokusesha litholakala kuwo wonke amakhasi e-website. Lapho ufakela ithemu lokusesha, kuzoseshwa kuyo yonke i-website ukubheka lawo magama , ngokukhetha ukuxhunyaniswa lapho khona kuthi Usesho lwezinga eliphambili. Umsebenzi wokusesha, wukusesha ulwazi kwamanye ama-website kahulumeni. Ukuxhunyaniswa namanye ama-website angaphandle, nakho kukhonjisiwe ngamagama athi 'ukuxhunyaniswa kwangaphandle - kuvula kwelinye ifasitela' elizovela kwibhokisana, uma i-cursor yakho ihanjiswa phezu kwalokho kuxhunyaniswa.

Umthetho kanye nezinqubomgomo zenkampani kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi ubumnyama bemininingwane busebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene, kuhlanganisa osomabhizinisi, othisha, nabaphathi bezempilo. Ukuze siphumelele kulokhu, kudingeka uhlelo oluqinile lokufundisa abanicikile nabakhiqiza ulwazi. Ukuqonda izikhathi ezinzima kudinga ukuphendulwa ngobuchule, futhi imfundo ngosizo lweGEMS izoba nomthelela omkhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukufundisa abancikile ukuthi bangafaka kanjani izicelo zezinsizakalo, ukubhalisa kahle, nokuzicabangela ngokucophelela empilweni yabo. Izinselelo zokuthi ubani ofanele ukufinyelela kulwazi nokuthi izinsizakalo ezithile zingasetshenziswa kanjani ukuze kuvikelwe ubumfihlo, kudinga ukuqashelwa. Izinhlangano kufanele zihlale zibheke izinqubo zokuphakela, uqobo lwabazali, nokuqonda phakathi kwabafuna imisebenzi. Kubalulekile ukugxila ezimweni zamanje ezinzima, njengoba sinesimo esinzima esihlobene nezempilo nezokwelapha. Ukuze abantu balwe nezehlakalo eziphuthumayo, izinhlelo zokubhalisela izinzuzo zempilo, okubalwa kuzo neGEMS, zidinga ukuhlonishwa, okuhlanganisa nokuqinisekisa ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Ukuphepha kwezimali nabanganikazi bezempilo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa ukuze kuzuze impumelelo. Uma ubumnyama bolwazi lungalandelwa kahle, imiphumela engalindelekile ingase ibekhona, okudinga ukuqapha ngokucophelela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iphephile, izinkampani zidinga ukuvuma ukufundisa abancikile ngokuqondile mayelana nokuphatha ubumfihlo, ukuze babe nemithetho yokuvikela.

Uma bengakwenzi kusenesikhathi, ungacela inkantolo ibaphoqe. Kodwa kubalulekile ukubazisa ngezinyathelo zokubayisa enkantolo kusasele isikhathi esiyizinsuku ezingu30. Ungafaka isikhalo kuMqondisi-Jikelele noma eNhlokweni yomnyango wesifundazwe ngaphansi kwezimo eziningi eziseNgxenyeni, inqobo nje uma isikhalo sibandakanya ukunukubeza okukhulu noma ukudicilelwa phansi kwemvelo. Ngamanye amazwi, lokhu kungenzeka ngaphansi kwezimo eziningi ezichazwe kulomhlahlandlela. Singabala kokunye isehlakalo sengozi ephuthumayo, emsebenzini lapho wenqabe khona ukwenza umsebenzi oyingozi noma ongadala umonakalo kwimvelo nakunoma yisiphi isimo lapho kwephulwa khona umthetho wezemvelo. Isicelo sokusingatha ukusombulula ingxabano, Isibonelo umxazululi/ukugqugquzela ukuxazulula inkinga/ukwahlulela noma ukuphenya. Ukusingatha inqubo yokuxazulula ingxabano kwenzeka lapho umuntu ongachemile ezama khona ukusombulula ukungezwani phakathi kwabantu ababili noma ngaphezulu abenze bavumelane ngento ethile. iNEMA ivumela uhulumeni ukwedlulisa ingxabano ethize isiwe kubaxazululi, kubagqugquzeli bokusombulula izinkinga, kubehluleli kuthi kwezinye izikhathi kuqokwe abaphenyi abayisipesheli abangathola imininingwane egcwele ngodaba. Okwenzeka kulenqubo kuzochazwa kabanzi eziNgxenyeni ezilandelayo u8 no 9. Inqubo yokugqugquzela ukusonjululwa kwenkinga wuhlelo lweNEMA lapho uhulumeni ebiza khona umuntu okhuthaza izingxoxo phakathi kwabantu ababili noma ngaphezulu abangaboni ngeso elilodwa ngesimo noma into ethile engaba yingozi kwimvelo.

Ukugcinwa kwemibhalo ngokomthetho eNingizimu Afrika kwaqala ngo-1842 ngokwethulwa kokuqala kweMithetho ye-Copyright yaseBrithani, evikela ilungelo lombhali lokuba ngumthombo wemibhalo kuyo yonke iMpumalanga yaseBrithani. Kwakukhona futhi izichibiyelo emthethweni phakathi kweMithetho ye-Copyright ka-1965 kanye neMithetho ye-Legal Deposit of Published Documents ka-1982. Okwamanje, iMithetho ye-Legal Deposit of Documents (Umthetho 54 ka-1997) yamenyezelwa ngoJulayi 1, 1998. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqhuba kwemibhalo, izincwadi, neminye imithombo equkethe ulwazi olufana namafilimu, amavidiyo, ama-CD omculo, nama-DVD, wonke ashicilelwe noma akhiqizwe eNingizimu Afrika. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngesisekelo esibanzi somthetho mayelana nenani lemikhono okumele igcinwe, isimo sokufika kwayo, ulwazi oludingekayo kubashicileli nabakhiqizi, isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwemikhono, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo uma abashicileli nabakhiqizi behluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho. Imibhalo iyinto ethile ehlelelwe ukugcinwa noma ukudluliswa njengolwazi olubhalwe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi luyimibhalo, izithombe, noma irekhodi elenzelwe ukulalelwa, futhi kunoma iyiphi enye ifomethi eqondakalayo nangemithombo ethile.

Kubalulekile ukuthola izindlela kanye nezimo zokunquma eziveza konke ngokusobala ngokuklanywa kwendawo yokundiza izindiza kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwama-ATS kwindawo yokundiza izindiza efana nalena. Ngokuqinisekile abenza imigomo abafana nami kanye nabanye abadlala indima kulokhu sidinga imininingo ephathelene nesilinganiso kanye nokuqhathanisa ukuze siqonde uhlobo lwento etsha okuqhanyukwe nayo nokuthi ishintsha kanjani ngemuva kwesikhathi. Kuzoba iphutha elikhulu kimina ukuthi ngiphethe ngaphandle kokwazisa umsebenzi omuhle owenziwe Ukhomishani Wamalungelo Esintu kanye Nehhovisi Lobubhalane lakhe. Imithetho yokulawula kanye nemihlomulo yemali okungenele kuzovimba ukwemukelwa kokuphinda kusetshenziswe imfucuza kanye nokuncishiswa kwemfucuza. Nathi siyabandakanyeka kuhlelo lokulungisa umonakalo owenziwe ukuhlehliselwa emuva kanye nokudlanga kwezinto ezasehlela eminyekeni engamakhulu eyedlule. Amapheshana emiphumela agcwaliswa isikhulu esengamele bese esayinwa isekela lesikhulu esiqokelwe ukwenza lokhu. Uphenyo lophenyo lwezinto zasendulo lufakazele ngokungephikiswe ukuthi abukho ubufakazi obubgaqinisa lokho okusolwayo. Nginxusa futhi abaphathi Bohlelo lwe-Incubator ukuthi bagcine ukuxhumana nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme abakuzona, ikakhulukazi ngonyaka wabo wezifundo wokuqala emanyuvesi. Iningizimu Afrika ibone ukuzalwa kwesilwane sayo sokuqala esizalaniswe ngokuthatha iseli eyodwa yesilwane esingumzali (cloned), inkonyane elibizwa ngokuthi uFuthi. Isikhulumi asizwakali, isikhulumi asisebenzisi umbhobho.

Isithombe esilethwe iViki Lomculo Waseningizimu Afrika sikhombise ngokusobala ukuthi liyindlela enempumelelo okungahlanganiswa ngayo bonke abanentshisekelo ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana ezinhlelweni zokuthuthukisa imboni yezomculo. I-DACST izoqhubeka nokukweseka / nokuxhasa I- South African Music Week inqobo -nje uma izohlanganisa lemboni ukuba isebenze inenhloso efanayo futhi yenyuse ukudayisa komculo waseNingizimu Afrika. Umgomo wezokuxhumana kwamazwe omhlaba kwezamasiko. i- INCP uhlelo longqongqoshe bezamasilko abavela kuwo wonke umhlaba. Ukwehlukana ngamasiko yikhona okubonakala kuyingqinamba enkulu ebhekene nokuthuthukiswa kwesiko kumazwe omhlaba kanye nasezingeni likazwelonke. INingizimu Afrika ibambe iqhaza eqenjini leziphathimandla elasungulelwa ukuba liqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo yamazwe omhlaba ephathelene nokuhlukana kwamasiko. I-DACST iyona ezoba usokhaya womhlangano we-INCP ngo-September 2002. Ezemfundo yobuciko kanye nokuqeqeshwa. Abasebenzi kanye nabaqashi. Abazoletha izidingo zophiko ukwengamela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa uphiko. Ukwenza izipahkamiso zalokho okumele kufundwe kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Ukwenza iziphakamiso nakwezinye izinto ezingakhulisa imizamo yentuthuko. Ukwenza iziphakamiso nezinye izinhlelo zentuthuko ezingathathwa. Ukwethula izikhalo kanye neziphakamiso. Ukwenza izivumelwano kanye nelungelo lokushicilela. Ukunikeza izeluleko kanye nokuqeqesha. Ukwakha / ukuveza amathuba emisebenzi. Ithemba lokuthi umkhiqizo uzodayiseka kanjani emazweni angaphandle ukuze kungene izimali zangaphandle. Lokhu okulandelayo kwavela ophenyweni. Ukunikezwa kwamandla ezomnotho.

Ekugcineni, ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile emlandweni wezokwelapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo. I-GEMS ibonisa ukuthi, ngokubambisana, singakha izixazululo ezinhle ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi. Ukukhula kwe-GEMS kubonisa ukuthi umphakathi unethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezithuthukile, futhi lokhu kuyisibonakaliso sokuthi umsebenzi omuhle ungakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

"Ibhasi" lisho imoto eyakhelwe, noma eyakhelwe ngokomthetho ukuze ifanele, ngumkhiqizi obhalisiwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1989 Umthetho No. 29 ka-1989; "Umimporter" ubonisa umuntu obhalisiwe ukuze athumele ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1996 Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996; "Umkhiqizi" ubonisa umkhiqizi [umimporter noma umakhi wezimoto] obhalisiwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1996 Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996; "Izinsuku ezihlosiwe" zokuhlela kabusha ikilasi lezimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi. "Ukuhlanganiswa kwezithuthi nokusetshenziswa kwelizwe ngaphakathi komqondo weMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezokuhamba ka-1995 Umthetho No. 67 ka-1995 noma noma yimuphi umthetho wesifunda ofana nalokhu. "Usuku lwezinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe zeqembu elithintekayo esigabeni 1(c) kuya (g) kumele lixhunywe kumgomo wezokuhamba wesifunda futhi kumele uvunywe ngamaMEC." Okuqukethwe kwemigomo nezinhlelo ezithintekayo esigabeni (c) kuya (g) kumele, njengoba kudingwa yile mthetho, kodwa uNgqongqoshe angase, ngokuxhumana noMEC ofanele noma amaMEC, ahambise izidingo zalezi zinhlelo, ngendlela ethile, mayelana nezindawo zasemaphandleni ezindaweni ezithile. Iziphathimandla zokuhlela ezisungulwe nguMEC ukuze zenze lokhu kumele zihlomule ngezinhlelo zokuhamba ezifanele kubhodi futhi zenze iziphakamiso kulowo bhodi mayelana nokuhlela kabusha izimvume zokusebenza, njengoba kudingwa nguSigaba 9.; nokususa isigaba 6.

Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukufuywa kwezilwane akulula, futhi lokho kungaholela ezinkingeni ezithile empilweni yomuntu. Ukuhlinzeka ngemali eyanele kubalulekile ukuze izilwane zihlale zikhona futhi ziphila kahle. Okwesithathu, kunezinkinga zokubuyiselwa. Ezinye izilwane zidinga ukunakekelwa okukhulu, futhi lokhu kudinga isikhathi esiningi. Lokhu kungaholela ezinkingeni uma izilwane zingakwenzi okwakulindelwe, okungadala ubandlululo kwabanye. Ukukhuluma Ngemiphumela Yemvelo: Okokugcina, abafuphi nezilwane abathembekile bahlala benomthelela omubi emvelweni. Izilwane ezifuywayo zingadala izinkinga zemvelo, kuhlanganise nokwanda kwezimboni ezishaya izilwane. Noma izilwane zinelungelo lokuphila, izenzo zethu zingaba nemiphumela emibi. Ushowe umhlangano wezinsiza eziluhlaza uthe “ukuthanda okuphumelelayo kuncike ekufundeni izinto ezinhle, ngezikhathi zokwelapha.” Lokhu kusho ukuthi abanikazi bezilwane kufanele baziqhenye futhi baphathe kahle izilwane zabo. Isiphetho: Ekugcineni, izilwane ezifuywayo zinezinzuzo ezinkulu, zikhuthaza ubungane, kodwa zinezinkinga ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Njengomphakathi, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ukufuywa kwezilwane kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuncishiswe imiphumela emibi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphila okuhle kwabantu nezilwane. Ngakho, imali, umqondo, nesikhathi kudinga ukwakhiwa ukuze kube nobudlelwano obuphumelelayo. Ngale ndlela, sizoba nomthelela omuhle emvelweni, sithuthukise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nezinye izilwane, futhi sakhe izimpilo ezingenza impilo ibe ngcono kubo bonke.

I-European Union: Uhlaka, Imisebenzi, Nezimpikiswano I-European Union (EU) yisixhumanisi esihlanganisa amazwe aphesheya kweselwandle eYurophu, futhi yaziwa ngemisebenzi yayo yokulawulwa kwezomnotho, isimo sezepolitiki, namalungelo abantu. Iqale ukusungulwa ngonyaka ka-1993 ngesikhathi sokubhalwa kweTreaty of Maastricht, lapho ihlanganiswe khona izici ezahlukene zempilo yaseYurophu. Le misho yalandela ukwakheka kweEuropean Economic Community (EEC) ngonyaka ka-1957, eqale ukusungulwa njengokuhlanganyela kwezomnotho phakathi kwezwe. I-European Union ihlanganisa amazwe angama-27, lawo ahlukeneyo ngemibono, ngezimo zempilo, nemigomo. Lokhu kuhlela kuvumela ukuhwebelana okukhululekile phakathi kwamazwe, okwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, umnotho, nokuhweba. Ukusebenza kwama-akhawunti ahlukene kuyiqiniso elibalulekile; umkhankaso wezingxoxo wekhulu elisha ukhombisa ukuzama kokuhlanganyela ezombusazwe, ukunqoba izithiyo zempilo, nobumbano lwezizwe. Ngaphandle kwezimali, i-EU iphinde yaziwa ngemithetho ethile efanele ukuthuthukiswa kwezempilo, imfundo, nezinye izigaba ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-European Union igxila kakhulu kumakhasimende ayo nakuqinisekisa ukuthi kunobufakazi obuphumelelayo bokwazisa ngezinhlelo ezithile. Isizathu sokwakheka kwayo sihamba phambili ekwandiseni ubudlelwane phakathi kwamazwe akuqhamukayo. Ubulungiswa bokuhlanganyela, ukunciphisa ukungabi nabulungisa, nokulondolozwa kwemvelo kuhamba phambili emibhalweni eyingqayizivele yamazwe angaphansi kwe-EU.

I-MEC inelungelo lokuphikisa isinqumo, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-28 zokuthola isinqumo nezizathu zokwamukela isicelo, ngokuhambisa ngenqubo echazwe ngumthetho ofanele futhi benza izinguquko ezidingekayo, ukuze bayithumele kwi- authority noma kwi-council yokudlulisela izikhalazo ezihlinzekwe kumthetho ofanele, uma umthetho ofanele uthi izikhalazo kufanele zithunyelwe kuMphakathi, noma kunoma yiliphi ilungu leKomidi Eliphezulu, Ummeleli Kahulumeni esifundeni, isikhalazo kufanele silalelwe futhi siqedwe yiBhodi Yezikhandla Zomphakathi njengokuthi le Bhodi Yezikhandla inenhloso yokugcina mayelana nendaba yezomthetho ephathelene nesikhalazo. a ukuthi kukhona imvume ebhaliwe evela kwiMEC futhi ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezisunguliwe yiMEC; noma b ngokuhambisana nendlela ekhona ebhalisiwe. noma ukuthi kufanele kube kukhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 10; noma iii yenqubo noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi. a umngcele wezindlela noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi ekhombisa kuphela eyodwa ethinta ngaphandle kwezindawo ezikhonjiswe esigabeni -, iMEC ingakhetha ukungashintshi le ndlela; noma b kokubili indlela noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi ekhombiswe ngaphezulu kwezinga lokwakha ibonakale ngaphandle kwezindawo ezikhonjiswe esigabeni -, ukubekwa kwendlela ngokuhambisana nezigaba 6 kuya ku-k kufanele kwenziwe ngendlela yokuthi indlela noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi ekhombiswe ngaphezulu kwezinga lokwakha ibonakale ngaphandle kwezindawo ezichaziwe. kanye nezintshisekelo zabanikazi ababhalisiwe nalabo abanamalungelo abhalisiwe kulezo zindawo c Izintshisekelo nemisebenzi yezikhandla nezinsizakalo ezizokwazi ukuthi zingathinteka ngqo noma ngqo ngaphezulu kwezinga lokwakha; futhi d Imvelo.

Amalunga e-FEDHASA izindlu zemisebenzi yokuhlala kanye nezindawo zokudla. Ukusebenza Ngemfanelo Kwezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika (i-FTTSA) yiphrojekthi ezimele ye-IUCN (Inyunyana Yokulondoloza Yomhlaba) yaseNingizimu Afrika efuna ukulungiselela ukufinyelela kuzimakethe zokuvakasha zamabhizinisi ezokuvakasha akhiwe aba sesimweni esibi. Amabhizinisi afanelekayo azokwazi ukusebenzisa uphawu lokuthengisa le-FTTSA njengethuluzi lokumaketha. I-FTTSA izakwazi ukukhumbula nokuhahisa ukwenza ngemfanelo ukuqondiswa kwezokuvakasha, ibe ngokuhambisanayo ixhumanisa amabhizinisi ahlumayo kanye/noma ayisilinganiso esincane Ekusebenzeni Ngemfanelo okubhekene nezimakethi zabathengi kanye namabhizinisi angaphansi (isib. Abahloli bohambo). Inhlangano Yezokuhlala Kazwelonke yaseNingizimu Afrika iyinhlangano kazwelonke, eletha ngokuhlanganisa zonke izinhlangano zezokuhlala zendawo nezesifunda, ibhekela izindlu zomsebenzi ezincane. Amalungu e-NAA-SA aqinisekisa laboabafuna indawo yokuhlala kuzindlu zemisebenzi ezincane ukuthi bangalindela izinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kanye nenani lemali yabo- kanye nokuphindiselwa imali uma kungenjalo. Inhlangano Yase-Afrika eseNingizimu Yezimboni Zekhonferensi (i-SAACI) yamiswa ngo-1987. Le nhlangano izinikele ekugcineni nasekulungiseni amazinga okwazi ukwenza ngemfanelo kanye nobungcweti ezimbonini zamakhonferensi zase-Afrika eseNingizimu. Sinikeza ulwazi kubafundi, othisha, izitshudeni, izikhugo zemfundo kanye nezimboni. Ezokuvakasha ZaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAT) yinhlangano esemthethweni yokumaketha yanmazwe ngamazwe njengendawo yokugcina Yeboihambi.

Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi eGauteng Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo, njengoba zithinta impilo yabantu abadinga usizo lwezokwelapha. E-Gauteng, okuyisifunda esinabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika, izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi zihlala zihlolwe futhi ziqhathaniswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukubaluleka kwezikhathi zokuphendula Izikhathi zokuphendula zisho isikhathi esithathwa yi-ambulensi ukusondela endaweni yokuphuthuma. U-Lionel Messi: Umcimbi Wokuhlonipha Umqeqeshi Omkhulu Ngomhla ka-30 kuNcwaba 2023, umhlaba wezemidlalo waphakanyiswa ngempumelelo enkulu, lapho uLionel Messi, umphakathi wezinyoni, ehlonishwa ngempumelelo yakhe emhlabeni jikelele. Lo mcimbi, obubanjelwe e-Estadio Monumental, eBuenos Aires, wawuhlanganisa izinkanyezi eziningi zezemidlalo, abalandeli, kanye nabathandi bezemidlalo abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomhlaba. U-Lionel Messi, owaziwa njengomunye wabadlali abakhulu bebhola emhlabeni, ubuyile eArgentina ngemuva kokuphumelela kwiFIFA World Cup ngo-2022. Lokhu kwaba yithuba elihle lokuhlonipha lo mlingani, obonise ubuchule obuphakeme, ukuzinikela, nokusebenza kanzima emsebenzini wakhe. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izinkulumo ezivela kubantu abahlukene, okuhlanganisa abaqeqeshi, abaphathi, kanye nabadlali abavela eminyakeni edlule. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo ethokozisayo kaDiego Maradona Jr., owakhumbuza bonke ngempumelelo kaMessi, wathi: "U-Lionel akasiyena nje umphakathi, kodwa ungumfanekiso wempumelelo, uthando, nokuzinikela." Lokhu kwavusa umoya ophakeme phakathi kwabantu, kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uMessi ungumuntu ophumelelayo, kodwa futhi ungumuntu ophumelelayo. U-Lionel Messi, ngesikhathi esebenza, wathola izindondo eziningi, okuhlanganisa neBallon d'Or, okuyisikhumbuzo sokuba ngumdlalisi ophakeme emhlabeni. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izithombe ezinhle zempilo yakhe, kusukela ezinsukwini zakhe zokuqala eRosario, kuya ezinsukwini zokugcina eParis Saint-Germain. Abantu babebonisa uthando lwabo, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezinkulu ezazikhona.

Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa anendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, ngakho-ke kubalulekile ukugxila kulezi zinhlelo. Le ndawo, enezinsiza zemvelo eziningi, ibonisa izidingo zethu zokwakha ikusasa elihlanzekile nelinobulungiswa. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo angaba yisisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Okokuqala, kufanele sihlole izinzuzo ezithile zokusebenzisa amandla avuselelekayo, njengezinhlelo zamandla elanga, amanzi, kanye namandla omoya, ezihlinzeka ngamathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu akwandisi amathuba emisebenzi kuphela, kodwa futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu basendaweni bayakwazi ukuziphilisa. ENyakatho Kapa, lapho umnotho ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi, amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo angase abe yisixazululo esihle sokukhuthaza ukukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, la mandla ahlinzeka ngesisekelo sokunciphisa imithelela emibi yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu. Njengoba umhlaba ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, kubalulekile ukuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo. Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo awakhulisi umkhiqizo kuphela, kodwa futhi anciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi ebamba ukushisa, okuqinisekisa ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zinezinsiza ezihlanzekile. Ngokubheka izinhlelo ezithile, sinesibonelo esihle sephrojekthi ye-‘Solar Water Heater’ ehlanganisa izindlu eziningi, esize abantu banciphise izindleko zokushisa amanzi. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekongeni imali, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza umqondo wokuzimela. Uma abantu bekwazi ukwenza izinto zabo, bayakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ozimele.

Uma ushayela imishini ephakamisa ngaphambili, kumele uyiphakamise into yokucaphuna impahla uma ingenalutho, uyehlise uma igcwele, ngaphandle kwalapho ingadala khona ubungozi, isib. emgwaqweni. Ukuba semsindweni omkhulu kungalimaza ukuzwa kwakho unomphelo, isikhathi esiningi lowo ohlaselwe yilokhu akaboni kanti lokho kungaholela ekubeni yisithulu. Khetha imishini engenawo umsindo uma ukhetha izindlela zokukhiqiza noma imishini emisha. Valela imishini enomsindo ngezinto ezehlisa umsindo noma uyifake endlini yayo yodwa. Lapho umsindo ufika ku90 dB noma ngaphezulu, beka izimpawu ezikhombisa ukuthi lena "yindawo okumele kuvikelwe amadlebe kuyo" ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu abangena khona bayazivikela. Ukuhlale usebenzisa amathuluzi angqangqazelayo njengobhemubhemu, nezinto zokusika kungaholela esifweni sokungqangqazela komunwe, umuzwa noma umsipha.

Ubufakazi obungaphikiswa buchaza ukuthi kukhona olunye ubufakazi olungcono noma ukuthi bekukhona. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ithathwa njengobufakazi obuqinile, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti athathwa njengobufakazi obungaphikiswa. Igama elithi "prima facie" liyisisho sesiLatini esisho "ngokokuqala." Isisho sobufakazi obucacile ezimweni zomthetho sisho ukuthi ubufakazi obukhulunywe phambi kwekhamphani bufanele ukusungula iqiniso noma icala ngaphandle kokuthi kube nobufakazi obuphikisanayo. Uma kungabikho bufakazi obuphikisanayo, ubufakazi obucacile luzothathwa njengobufakazi obugcwele. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, ubufakazi bungase bukhombise ukuthi u-A wayenomgomo wokubulala u-B futhi wabonwa eqhuba ephuma endlini ka-B enokhuni olugcwele igazi. U-X uyafakaza ukuthi wezwa ingilazi iphuka futhi waphendukela ukubona u-Y emi phambi kwefasitela eliphukile lika-Z, lapho u-Y ebamba itshe esandleni sakhe. Ubufakazi obuqondile buyilokho okufakazelwe um witness. Isibonelo: Ecaleni lokubulala, u-C ufakaza ukuthi wayemi phandle kwendlu ka-B ngesikhathi ebona u-A ehlula u-B. Ukuvunyelwa kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi, futhi akukho standard yokulinganisa izinga lokuvunyelwa kobufakazi. Ubufakazi buvunyelwe noma abuvunyelwe. Isinqumo sokuthi ubufakazi buvunyelwe noma abuvunyelwe sincike ekutheni buhambisana yini noma ukuthi ukuvunyelwa kwabo kuzobeka umsolwa engozini. Kubhekisela ekwamukelweni kobufakazi ngokusekelwe ezimweni ezizokweneliseka ekupheleni kwecala. Uma isimo singanelisi, lelo bufakazi alithathwa njengelungile.

Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abasebenzi ukuthi bahlale benokuthula, bazi ukuthi uma bengasebenzisi izinsizakalo, bangathola imali yabo emuva. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinqubo ezithile, futhi umsebenzisi kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ulandela lezi zinyathelo ukuze athole leli thuba. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. I-GEMS inikeza indlela elula yokukhokha izindleko zezempilo, iqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala benempilo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abasebenzi baqonde lezi zinqubo, ukuze bakwazi ukuzenza kahle. Ngokuqhubeka nokuthuthukisa lezi zinqubo, i-GEMS izoqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi, iqinisekisa ukuthi bahlala benempilo futhi bejabule emsebenzini wabo. Ngakho-ke, uma ungumsebenzi kahulumeni, qiniseka ukuthi uyazi kahle lezi zinqubo, ukuze uthole okungcono kakhulu kwi-GEMS. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela izimali zakho, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uthola izinsizakalo ezidingekayo ukuze uphile impilo enempilo.

Ukufinyelela esinqumeni esiphusile ngezinto ezikleliswe phambili. Ulwazi kumele lukwazi ukusiza umasipala ekuthatheni izinqumo ngezidingo-nqangi noma izinkinga, ngemuva kokucabangela imibono yezakhamuzi/imiphakathi nangolwazi nezibalo ezikhona. Abathatha izinqumo kumasipala kumele babenolwazi ngezinkinga noma izinto ezikleliswe phambili, njengezinkomba, ingqikithi, imbangela nomthelela ohambisana nezinkinga noma izinto endaweni ngenhloso yokuthatha izinqumo ezifanele nokuveza izisombululo. Abathatha izinqumo kumasipala kumele baqonde amafa, izinsiza nezinqinamba ezikhona ngaphambi kokuthatha izinqumo ngamaqhinga ayosetshenziswa. Ulwazi ngamafa nezinsiza ezikhona nezingatholakala. Yiningi inqubo ekhona nengafani engasetshenziswa ukufinyelelwa kulemiphumela. Kunesidingo sokuhlanganisa iqhinga lokuhlaziya esigxile emininingwaneni eqoqiwe noluncike ekubonisaneni. Kubalulekile ukwazi indlela umphakathi ocabanga ngayo lokho okuyizidingo kuwo. Bona Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1/2. WokuHlela 1 /1. Izinqumo ezinhle angeke zincike kuphela emibonweni noma ezibalweni kodwa kufanele kubhekwe kokubili ngokuhlanganyela ukuze kutholwe incazelojikelelei nengaba nomthelela onegalelo elikhulu Bona Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /3. Kunesidingo sokubheka isimo ngombono obanzi kamasipala kungagcini kuphela ngeso lomphakathi nalabo ababambe iqhaza. Izindaba ezibucayi kumasipala zingaphezulu kwenhlanganisela yezidingo zamathimba omphakathi nababambe iqhaza abayizakhamuzi zomasipala.

Uma usomabhizinisi efuna ukuvula ibhizinisi lesibili bese ebeka umenenja ozolibheka). Iklayenti liya ehhovisi Lokweluleka Lesifunda le-Khula ukuze lithole usizo mayelana nohlelo Lwebhizinis noma usizo lokwelulekwa. Umqondisi wesifunda uphakamisa umeluleki emva kokuhlola Uhlelo Lwebhiozinisi noma izicelo sokwelulekwa. Uyacelwa ukuba uqaphele ukuthi lolu lwazi lunikezwe yi-Khula. Uma ufuna ulwazi olwengeziwe, xhumana nabo ngqo lapha 807 8464. Igunya kanye nomsebenzi we-RFI ukwenza kusheshe imali mboleko kanye nemali yokuthenga eqongelelweyo kumabhizinisi amancane, aphakathi nendawo kanye namakhulu ngokuwanikeza izinhloboi ezahlukile zemithombo yezimali kanye nolwazi kumphakathi. Imishani ye-Khula ukuqinisekisa ukuba khona okwenziwe ngcono kwemali mboleko nemali ethengayo eqongelelweyo kuma-SMME ngokuwanikeza imalimboleko, izikhwama eziyizitshalo kanye nokuqinisekisa kuma-RFI adinga imali eqongelelweyo kanye nobukhulu. I-Development Services 336 0047 amabhizinisi ezinyangeni ezingaphezu kweziyi-6 . Akukho imali eqongelelwayo yokusebenza enikezwayo. Isikhwama Sokunikeza Amandla Sikazwelonke samiswa Umthetho wwe-105 Wesikhwama Sokunikeza Amandla SikaZwelonke ka-1998 ukunikeza amandla ebantwini ababndlululiwe esikhathini esedlule ngemisebenzi yokunikeza nokuzalisa imali. Isikhwama sizonikeza imali elinganayo kanye nekungathi kuyalingana kuzimali zokunikeza amandla omnotho ngemisebenzi ephathelene Nabantu Ababebandlululwa Esikhathi Esedlule (ama-HDP).

Izinkinga ezihlobene nezombusazwe, umthetho, nobuhlakani bempilo zidinga ukuqaphela ukungqubuzana okukhona, ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke ubonisa amandla okuletha izinguquko ezibalulekile. Isidingo senqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo sibe nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni isidakamizwa esiphezulu, ngokuhlanganisa izwi ofuna ukudala igugu elisha. Futhi, lokhu kuholele emsebenzini omusha wokwakha umthetho ofanele nezindlela zokuphatha ezikhiqiza umphakathi ophilayo. Ngenxa yesi sikhathi esibalulekile sokubamba iqhaza komphakathi, umkhiqizo owakhiwa kulezi zinguquko udinga ukuhlolwa, ukuze kuhlale kutshalwa umoya omusha emiphakathini nasezweni. Ngokubambisana, izimvo zikhula ngokuphumelelayo, zithinta imiphakathi ezithile, zikhuthaza ukuba umphakathi ube nomthelela omkhulu ekuchibiyelweni, kwempumelelo, nokwenziwa. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza elikhulu, ube neqhaza elivelayo ekwakheni isimo esihle sokuhlonipha nokwandisa ubuhlakani bazo. Kuze kube namuhla, inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo isazogcina isebenza, ifaneleka njengemodeli yolwazi lokwandisa ubuhlakani nolwazi phakathi kwabantu. Umphakathi, uma uhlanganyela, ubonisa amandla okuletha izinguquko ezibalulekile, okugqugquzela isibopho somphakathi, nezokuphatha eziyisisekelo. Le ndlela ivula amathuba okwenziwa kwezinto ezibalulekile emhlabeni, xa kuthiwa izikhathi zishintsha. Ngakho-ke, inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo ibalulekile, ibonisa ukuthi amandla omphakathi avulekile futhi akwazi ukuyakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, umphakathi onothando nezinto ezimangalisayo.

Emva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha sizosuswa ezincwadini zemininingwane yakho bese sicekelwa phansi. Uma ungahambelani nalesisexwayiso ungadlulisela isikhalazo sakho ku [igama] ngaphaphi kokuba kuphele izinsuku ezinhlanu zomsebenzi. Lapho unikezwe isaziso sokuba uze ecaleni lokuqondisa izigwegwe ngokwemisho 6 no 7 ngaphansi komthetho wokuziphatha emsebenzini. Umhlangano uzobe use [indawo] ngo [usuku] ngo [iskhathi]. Uma ungezanga futhi wanganikeza sizathu sokungabibikho kwakho, umhlangano uzoqhubeka ngaphandle kwakho. Ungabuveza ubufakazi bakho okubhaliwe noma ngokuba ulethe ubufakazi. Uyonikezwa ithuba lokuba ufake imibuzo noma yimuphi ufakazi olethwe umnyango. Mina, [ igama lomqashwa ] ngalamazwi ngiletha isikhalazo ngiphikisana necala engabekwa lona ngo ngomhlaka... E [ indawo]. Nginikeza incwajana enesaziso mayelana nophenyo isesixwayiso esibhaliwe. Ngifisa / angifisi (khetha okukodwa) ukunikeza obunye ubufakazi obungakabibikho kulesisikhathi secala.

Ngakhoke kubalulekile ukudala izindlela ezingasesthenziswa ekudluliseleni ulwazi kanye nobuchwepheshe emabhizinisini (ikakhulukazi ku- SMMEs). Ukuthuthukiswa kwezimboni zamasiko. Izinhlelo zoMnyango onyakeni wezimali ka - 2000/ 2001 zifake izinhlobonhlobo zemicimbi ezindaweni zomphakathi. Singabalula ukucacisela umphakathi ngesayensi, ukusungulwa kohlelo ukujovela ingculazi kuya ekuthuthukiseni kwenqubomgomo yezilimi kazwelonke kanye nokusungulwa kohlelo lwe-Oral History. Ukonga kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamagugu. Amagugu yingxenye ebalulekile yobuzwe. IningiZimu Afrika inezakhiwo zamagugu ezithuthukiswe ngokwanele nanxa zitshekile (njenga- mamyuziyemu, imikhakha elawulayo) Ukuguqulwa kwalezizakhiwo kubaluleke kakhulu emnothweni kanye nasemasikweni. Ukuhlanganiswa kanye nokuqiniswa kwemuziyemu emihlanu eKapa eyomlando wezemvelo kanye namagalari amathathu. amathathu e-Gauteng: eyomlando wezemvelo, eyomlando wamasiko, kanye neyomlando wezempi, sekwenze kwabonakala inzuzo enomehluko omkhulu. Isithuthukisiwe futhi yethulwa kwikhabinethi Lendlela itshelwe ngendlela yokulinganiswa phakathi kwezilimi ezingu 11 zase Ningizimu Afrika njengoba kuqinisekisa umthetho sisekelo. Le ndlela inikezelwe indlela elingene yokujikeleza phakathi kwezilimi. Ohlelweni, isigaba ngesigaba kulindeleke ukuba siqale ukukhuphula ukugcwalisa ukungafani kolimi. Ulwazi lwemvelo/ lwasekhaya ngakwelinye icala lungaba umyombo wokukhula kanye nentuthuko. Ngakwelinye icala lusengozini yokuthi luxhashazwe ngamazwe angaphandle angenaluzwelo ngokulusebenzisa okunganikinzuzo emphakathi olwazi lungolwawo.

Yiya emakomidini. Kungenzeka kube yikomidi eliqondene nokuhlela noma elezemvelo. Bhala futhi wenze uhlelo lokubonana nekomidi eliphakeme uma ikomidi eliqondene lehluleka ukuphendula izincomo zakho. Baqwashise uma ukholwa wukuthi abalandelanga inqubo ebekiwe noma bephula izimiso zeNEMA, batshele ukuthi ungase uye enkantolo uyophikisa isinqumo sabo. Lindela isinqumo, kuthi uma singahambisani nawe bese ucabanga ukusiphikisa. Ungafaka isicelo somxazululi kuthi ekugcineni unqume ukuya enkantolo ukuze kubuyekezwe noma kumiswe leso sinqumo. Ngemuva kokufaka isicelo sokuphikisa isinqumo esibandakanya ukuvikela imvelo, uyokwaziswa ngomphumela wesimangalo. Ngokulandisa komthetho-sisekelo, ungazifuna izizathu zomphumela wesinqumo. Umthetho-sisekelo kanye neNEMA bakupha ilungelo lokunikwa ulwazi ongadinga ukulusebenzisa ukuthola eminye imininingwane kuhulumeni nekhombisa ukuthi kufinyelelwe kanjani esinqunyweni. Uma ungenelisiwe wumphumela wesimangalo, unegunya lokucela uhulumeni ukuba athole futhi akhokhele umxazululi ongakusombululela lenkinga. Uma ucabanga ukuthi isinqumo sephula umgomo weNEMA noma kulandelwe inqubo echemile noma engekho emthethweni ngesizathu esithile, unethuba lokwedlulisela udaba enkantolo ngenhloso yokubuyekeza noma ukumisa isinqumo. Ngemuva kokwethula isikhalo ngokunukubezeka okunqala noma ukuguguleka kwemvelo kwesinye salezikhulu ezimbili, kumele bakunike ithuba lokubachazela ngonenkinga ngakho. Uma sebesizwile isikhalo, bayolandisa onukubezayo/olimazayo ukuba athathe izinyathelo ezifanele njengoba kuchazwe endimeni 7.4.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola izinguquko ezinkulu. Ngesikhathi seMhlabeni Wokugcina, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola ukufinyelela okukhulu ezingeni lempucuko. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yathuthuka yaba yinsiza yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizwe, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba ngezinyawo, behlangana ezindaweni ezahlukene, bejabulisa izithameli ngezigcawu ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezinkulu, ezinjengeBroadway eNyakatho Melika, neWest End eNgilandi, lapho imidlalo yeshashalazi ithokozisa abantu abaningi. Namuhla, imidlalo yeshashalazi isikhona ezindaweni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezinkampanini ezihlukahlukene, ezikhangisa izigcawu ezithokozisayo, ezihlekisayo, nezifundisayo. Imidlalo yeshashalazi isengumthombo obalulekile wokuxhumana, ukufundisa, nokuhlekisa, futhi isiza abantu ukuba bahlale behlakaniphile. Izinhlobo ezahlukahlukene, njengezinkanyezi ezihlekisayo, izinkanyezi ezinzima, nezinkanyezi zezenzakalo zempilo, zikhona ukuze ziqhube imizwa yabantu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi ayigcini nje ngokuba yinsiza yokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi iyinsiza yokuxhumana phakathi kwezizukulwane. Iphinde ibaluleke ekwakheni umphakathi, lapho abantu behlangana khona, bejabulela izigcawu ezithokozisayo, futhi behlanganyela izinkumbulo ezizohlala zikhumbuleka. Imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsiza engapheli, ehlangene nezidingo zomuntu, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni izimo ezinhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsiza ebalulekile emlandweni, futhi iyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo.

Iya enkantolo eseduzane nalapho uhlala noma use-benza khona. Uma ngabe kuwukuthi waphoqwa ukuthi ushiye inda-wo ohlala kuyo ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa futhi uhlala kwenye indawo okwesikhashana, ungaya enkantolo eseduzane nendawo ohlala kuyo okwesikhashana. Uzothini Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka wesikhashana? Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka wesikhashana uzocela Ummangalelwa (umuntu ohlukumeza-yo) ukuthi angakuhlukumezi ngendlela ecaciswe eshiwo ku-Affidavit yakho. Ezimweni ezimbi kakhulu, iMantshi ingakubona kufanele ukuthi iphoqelele Ummangalel-wa ukuthi aphume endlini abahlala kuyo bonke noma amvimbele ukuthi angene ez-indaweni ezithile zendawo abahlala kuyo. Uma ngabe yizingane ezihlushwayo kuloku kuhlukunyezwa, Inkantolo ingaphoqelela uku-thi Ummangalelwa angabonani nezingane nhlobo noma azibone okwesikhashana nje. Inkantolo ingenza umyalelo wokusizwa ngezimali esheshayo. Loku kusho ukuthi uma ud-inga ukufaka isicelo sezindleko zokugula noma imali yokuhlala kwenye indawo ezivele ngokuqondene ngqo nokuba ngumphumela wokuhlukunyezwa, kumele unikeze ubu-fakazi bezindleko obe nazo bese ucela inkantolo ukuthi ibheke lesi sicelo. eke wenza nanoma yikuphi ukwesabisa impilo yakho ngaso. Ukuze ibhekele ngokugcwele uhlobo lokuhlukunyezwa okucacile okwenziwa kuwe inkan-tolo ithembele kuSifungo osenzile lapho ufaka isicelo sakho. Ngenzani ngoMyalelo Wokuvikeleka Wesikhashana? Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka wesikhashana kumele unikezwe Ummangalelwa (umuntu ohlukumezayo) ngokushesha okukhulu. Awukwazi ukuya ngokwakho uyonikeza Ummangalelwa Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka njengoba lokhu kungeke kube indlela yokwenza umsebenzi elungile.

Ngokuqhamuka nokukhathazeka komphakathi, abaholi bamele baphendule ngokuziqhenya, bahlale beqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo yezezimali iyaphathwa ngokucophelela. Lokhu kungabonwa kahle ezinhlelweni zabo ezisemthethweni, izinqubomgomo, nezinhlelo ezitholakalayo, kuze kube isimo seNingizimu Afrika sithola ubulungiswa. Abantu baphinde bakhumbuze ukuthi uMnyango wezokuhlalisana udinga ukusiza ukukhipha izikhalazo kumphakathi, nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyakwazi ukufinyelela ezintweni ezibalulekile. Ngokwenza lokhu, kuba nokwethenjwa okwandayo phakathi komphakathi, okwandisa umoya wokuxhumana nokubambisana. Kuphinde kwaphumela isimo sokuthi kumele kube nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa imiphakathi ibamba iqhaza ekunqandeni inkohlakalo. Ngokuqhubeka nokukhuluma ngale ndaba, imiphakathi iyakhumbuza ukuthi izithiyo zingazinqamukela uma zinemigomo ecacile nezinhloso ezifanele. Ekugcineni, kumele kukhumbulelwe ukuthi inkohlakalo kuhulumeni akudingi ukuthengiswa, kodwa kufanele kube ukusebenzisana okuhle phakathi kwezimanga zombuso nezinhlangothi zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekukhuleni kokwethembeka, okuthuthukisa umphakathi ngokubaluleka kwakho konke. Kodwa, akuphumelelanga ngaphandle kokubambisana nezinhlangano zikamasipala, izinyunyana, nezinyathelo ezisemthethweni. Kubalulekile ukukholwa ukuthi umphakathi unawo amandla okwenza umehluko, noma kunjalo, udinga izinsiza nokwesekwa okuqhubekayo ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zinkinga ezikhathazayo. Inkohlakalo kuhulumeni ingalawulwa, kodwa udinga ukuguqulwa okukhulu nokuqhubekayo kweshintsho emiphumeleni.

Ilungelo lokwenza ibhizinisi lokumba liyavunywa nguhulumeni, lishiywe yiMnyango wezamaMinerali noMoya, elikunika igunya lokwenza ucwaningo lwezinto ezisemhlabeni endaweni ethile. Uhlelo lwezezimali luhambisana nomsebenzi wokucwaninga kanye nokwenzeka kwezezimali ngaleso sikhathi. Uma kungekho ukungcoliswa komoya nemvelo noma ukulimala kwesimo semvelo okuzokwenzeka ngenxa yomsebenzi wokucwaninga. Faka isicelo ehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wesifunda weMnyango wezamaMinerali noMoya endaweni lapho umhlaba utholakala khona. Qedela Ifomu D: Faka isicelo sephermiti yebhizinisi lokumba etholakala ehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wesifunda. Ifomu lingatholakala futhi kule webhusayithi, kuleli khasi. Ifomu kumele lihambisane nemali ekhokhelwayo yokufaka isicelo njengokubekwe nguMphathi wesifunda. Xhumana futhi uthumele izaziso kubo bonke abathintekayo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-180 kusukela ngosuku lokwaziswa. UMphathi wesifunda uzokwazi ukukwazisa ngokubhalwe phansi uma isicelo sakho sivunyiwe, okusho ukuthi isicelo sakho sihlangabezana nazo zonke izidingo, okuzokwenziwa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kokuthola isicelo futhi ukulungele ukuxhumana nomnikazi womhlaba, ophatha lowo mhlaba ngokomthetho, nabanye abathintekayo. Uma ungeniswa isicelo sokumba izinto ezisemhlabeni, kumele bakwazise ngokubhalwe phansi, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-30, bechaza izizathu zokwenqaba. Umnyango uzobeka izindleko, futhi le mali ayibuyiswanga. Inani lezindleko lihluka kuye ngento oyifunayo ukuyisebenzisa.

Ukuqeqeshwa okunganele kungaholela emaphutheni nasekwehleni kokusebenza. Ukubambisana Nezinye Izinhlaka Ukubambisana nezinye izinhlaka kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukungabikhona Kwezokuxhumana: Ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhumana phakathi kwe-Transnet Freight Rail nezinye izinhlaka. Ukungabikhona kwezokuxhumana kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni nasekwehleni kokusebenza. - Izinkinga Zomthetho: Izinkinga zomthetho zingathinta ukusebenza kwezitimela. Kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo ezicacile zokuhlangabezana nezidingo zomthetho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Isiphetho Izinselelo zokusebenza kwezitimela zakwa-Transnet Freight Rail zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuqonda lezi zinselelo nokuhlinzeka ngamasu okuthuthukisa ukusebenza kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokuphumelela. Kubalulekile ukuthi i-Transnet Freight Rail ibambisane nezinye izinhlaka, ihlaziye izinqubo zayo, futhi ithuthukise izinsiza zayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle, ziphephile, futhi zisebenza ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo emkhakheni wezokuhamba kwezimpahla, kuqinisekise ukuthi izidingo zabathengi zikhuthele, futhi kuthuthukiswe umnotho wezwe.

INGXENYE 2: Wubani ongafaka isikhalo (afune usizo lwabaxazululi, afake isikhalo noma athathe izinyathelo zomthetho) ngaphansi kweNEMA? Umuntu kuhlangene nohulumeni bephula umthetho wezemvelo. Uhulumeni ehlulekile ukushushisa umuntu ophula umthetho wezemvelo, nalapho unenkolelo khona yokuthi lowomuntu unecala. Ukuxazulula wuhlelo lapho kuthathwa umuntu ongachemile asize abantu ababili ukuze basombulule impikiswano. Lapho ufake khona isicelo sokwedlulisa udaba ngokuphikisa lokho okwenziwe noma isinqumo esithathwe wuhulumeni. Kulomhlahlandlela sizokhuluma kabanzi ngezinyathelo ezinqala ezinomthelela emvelweni. Akuzona zonke izenzo eziyingozi emvelweni ezifukanyelwe yiNEMA. Isigaba esilandelayo sizoveza imininingwane eminingi ngalezo zenzo ezihlaziywe kuNEMA. INGXENYE 3: Kungabe isenzo noma isinyathelo okukhalwa ngaso sephula amalungelo akho ezemvelo agodlwe yiNEMA? Engxenyeni 2, sichaze izimo ezingu 7 lapho ongakwazi khona ukuthatha izinyathelo ezithile (ukukhononda, umxazululi noma izinyathelo zomthetho) ukuze uvikele amalungelo akho ezemvelo. ukushushisa ngasese lapho uhulumeni ehlulekile ukubopha noma ukushushisa othile owephule umthetho wezemvelo. Yonke lemisebenzi esishiwo ingagamanxelana. Isibonelo, umuntu odala umonakalo omkhulu ngokunukubeza umoya kungenzeka abe necala lokwephula umthetho ovikela imvelo. Kodwa kulencwajana, sizozama ukwenza izinto zibe lula ngokuhlale njalo sikhuluma ngalezizimo ezingu 7 esizisho ngasenhla, futhi zizohlaziywa ngokwehluka kwazo.

Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngesincomo sikadokotela. Iziguli ezidinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lukahulumeni lezempilo akufanele zicele ukuhlolwa kwasendlini yocwaningo lwesayensi. Siyazi ukuthi yilokhu okwenzeka njengamanje emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akukhokona okufunwa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele belaphe izimo ezisolekayo ngokwamazinga okwedlulisa ulwazi (protocol) ahlinzekwe nguMnyango Kazwelonke Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa onelungelo lokuzikhethela kona yi-Tamiflu. Ukwelashwa kukawonke wonke nge-Tamflu kuzoholela ekuqabeni kokulapheka uma kusetshenziswa lo muthi futhi kungenza ukuthi ungasebenzi nakulabo ongahlenga izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi olutholakale emhlabeni wonke ngukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikole nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, amamoli okuthenga nezindawo zokusebenzela akusebenzi kusukela ekusabalaleni kokufa. Kodwa, lokhu kudala ukuthikamezeka okukhulu enhlalweni. Seluleka ukuthi noma ngabe yimuphi umfundi, umfundisi noma umsebenzi onezimpawu ezingcono ukuba ahlale ekhaya. Uma bebaningi abafundi futhi/noma abafundisi abaphuthayo, isikhungo esithintekayo kuzofanele sithinte uMnyango Wezemfundo, ozobe ngokuhlanganyela neziphathimandla zezempilo usululeka ngokufanele kwenziwe. Uma unezimpawu ezingcono, hlala ekhaya futhi nqanda ukuhlangana nabantu. Ngifisa ukuniqinisekisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemndleni emhlabeni wonke besebenzisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola ikhambi. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, ikhambi elifana naleli lingakhona ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Kodwa, kunesindingo esikhulu kabi sekhambi nokukhiqizwa obukhulu bako bunganele - ubukhulu obungekho e-Afrika.

Izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni (GEMS salary deduction procedures) Ezweni elikhulayo, izinhlelo zokuphatha izimali ziba yisici esibalulekile sokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni, ezinjenge-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme), ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ukuze siqonde kahle lezi zinqubo, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinyathelo ezithathwayo, izinzuzo, kanye nezimo ezihambisana nazo. Ukuqala, i-GEMS iyinhlangano eyakhelwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali emholweni ziqala lapho umsebenzisi ebhalisela le nhlangano. Lokhu kubhaliswa kudinga ukuthi umsebenzisi anikeze imininingwane ethile, efana negama, isibongo, inombolo ye-ID, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, umsebenzisi uzothola incwadi yokwamukela, eqinisekisa ukuthi ubhaliswe ngempumelelo. Ngemuva kokubhaliswa, izinqubo zokudonswa kwemali ziqala. I-GEMS idonsa imali ethile emholweni wabasebenzi ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zikhokhwa ngesikhathi. Le mali idonswa ngenyanga, futhi ibalwa ngokususelwa kumholo wabasebenzi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bangathola izinsizakalo zezempilo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokukhokha izindleko zazo ngasikhathi sinye. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zindleko zikhokhwa ngokuqhubekayo, futhi umsebenzisi unelungelo lokubona izinguquko emholweni wakhe. Uma umholo ushintsha, i-GEMS izobuyekeza inani elidonswayo ukuze lihambisane nezinguquko ezenzekayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala benokuthola okulinganiselwe kwezinsizakalo zezempilo, ngaphandle kokubhekana nezinkinga zokukhokha.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-European Union igxila kakhulu kumakhasimende ayo nakuqinisekisa ukuthi kunobufakazi obuphumelelayo bokwazisa ngezinhlelo ezithile. Isizathu sokwakheka kwayo sihamba phambili ekwandiseni ubudlelwane phakathi kwamazwe akuqhamukayo. Ubulungiswa bokuhlanganyela, ukunciphisa ukungabi nabulungisa, nokulondolozwa kwemvelo kuhamba phambili emibhalweni eyingqayizivele yamazwe angaphansi kwe-EU. Lokhu kudinga izinqumo ezilungiswa ngokubambisana nezwe ngalinye, kuthumele izimemo ezisemqoka ukuba zilandela izinqumo eziqhamuka kumamele. Ukubambisana kwakho i-EU kuyasiza kokuqeda gap phakathi kwemiphakathi eminingi ehlukene, nakuba iqukethe izinselelo ezihlukahlukene. Kubalulekile ukuqonda izimifications zalesi sikhungo ezivela ezimweni ezinjengokuphepha, umnotho, nezenhlalo. I-EU ibheka izinkinga ezithinta abantu, njengezinhlekelele zemvelo, ukuhlukunyezwa kwabantu, nokungabi nabulungisa. Amathuba okubambisana nezizwe zangaphandle nawo akuwela emkhakheni wakamuva we-EU. Nokho, i-European Union ibhekene nezivunguvungu ezithile. Izinkinga ezikhona phakathi kwamazwe azimele ziqinisa izinkulumo ezahlukahlukene. Ukuphikiswa иkuhlelo lwe-Common Agricultural Policy, umthetho ophathelene nezolimo kanye nezinsizakusebenza, kudala ubunzima ekuphathweni kwezimali zakwa-EU. Kulokhu, izinkampani nezwe lonke kumele ziqhube izinhlelo eziphumelelayo ukuze ziphumelelayo ezicini zemvelo. I-EU ibuye ibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthokoziswa kokubambisana kwabantu.
