UThandiwe Ndlovu ungumqondisi, umfundisi, nempumelelo - ungumuntu obalulekile emhlabeni wamafilimu, ohlonishwa kakhulu, futhi ophawula indlela ezayo.

I-CFO izakwenza njengokwemibiko ebhaliwe elungiselelwe nguMenenja Wezezimali, kumakhotheshini ayinani elingaphezu kwama-R30,000, emva kokubheka intengo yohlelo lwamaphuzu akhethiwe Okunikeza Amandla Kwabansundu Kwezomnotho Okwesekwe Ngokubanzi. Ikhotheshini ehambisana nencasiselo izakuvunywa, uma nje i-Ofisa yezezimali Ephezulu, ngokuxhumana nenhloko yomnyango ofanele, yenelisekile ukuthi inikeza inani eligcono kakhulu lemali yomasipala nokuthi imali eyanele ikhona ebhajethini elifanele. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi kungabikho khotheshini efanelekile yencasiselo. ukuphinde ibize amakhotheshini, noma ukuvuma ikhotheshini eseduzane kakhulu nencasiselo, uma nje i-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu yenelisekile ukuthi (i) inikeza inani elingcono kakhulu lemali, (ii) imibandela fanele yebhajethi yenziwe, (iii) izawufinyelela izidingo zikamasipala, nokuthi (iv) inhloko yomnyango efanele iyavumelana nesinqumo. Wonke amathenda edlula ama-R1,000,000 azakunqunywa Yikomiti Lokunquma Lebhidi, njengoba limiswe ngokulandela isigaba se- 5 ngezansi, lase livunywa yibandla elenza ngokubheka imibiko ebhaliwe neziphakamiso ZeKomiti Lokunquma Lebhidi. Nenani elingcono kakhulu lemali likamasipala. Ikomiti lizawuphinde futhi lihlole ukuthi ziznkaphani ezifaka amathenda ziyakwazi yini ukwenza ikontileka ngempumelelo, bese libhekela imibandela Yomthetho Wokunikeza Amandla Ezomnotho Kwabansundu Ngokweseka Okubanzi. Ikomiti Lokuhlola lizakuhlola amabhidi bese lifaka umbiko neziphakamiso Ekomitini Lokunquma elicaciswe esigabeni se-7.

Isu lokubonelela ukuthi amaKomidi eziLimi eziFundazwe akhuthaza ulwazi ngezilimi kulao abakhuluma izilimi ezinomlando wokucindezelwa liyasetshenziswa. Impumelelo yalo izobonakala kule minyaka embadlwana ezayo bese kusetshenzelwa phezu kwayo, uma kunesidingo, ukwenza ngcono isimo. U-PANSALB uphinde wabambisana nemigwamanda eminingi eyahlukene ukuze akwazi ukuphumelela. Ubudlelwano abakhile nemigwamanda efana ne-National Arts Council (umKhandlu wobuCiko kuZwelonke), ne-National Film and Video Foundation (Isikhungo seNgqayi namaVidiyo kuZwelonke) kanye nama-NGO (iziNhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukaHulumeni) kufanele buqiniswe. Umsebenzi onikezwe iBhodi ungefezwe yiBhodi kuphela;kufanele isebenzisane neminye imigwamanda esebenzela izimpokophelo ezifanayo nezeBhodi. Le bhodi ekhona njengamanje ibangukuthakasela ukuba nobudlelwano obungcono nemigwamanda efana no SABC, abaShicileli neminye imigwamanda ezimele. Nakuba kunjalo, siyalikhuthaza le qembu elisha ukuthi liqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano bokusebenzisana nemigwamanda yalo luhlobo. Ukuba nabasebenzi abenele, isipiliyoni sokusebenzisana nokuxhumana, kuyokwelekelela ukuzuza le njongo. Ukuphetha, ngibonga iphini likasiHlali uNks. Zubeida Desai, onke amalungu eBhodi, uMphathi Omkhulu, uSolwazi u-Cynthia Marivate, nabasebenzi bakhe baseHhovisi ngomsebenzi oseqophelweni abawenzayo kanye nokuzinikela kwabo ekuthuthukiseni izilimilimi kanye nezilimi zendabuko eNingizimu Afrika.

Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leli qembu lokufunda? Ngithole ukumangala okukhulu lapho ngiya ukubona lokho abakwenza; ngathola ukuthi basebenzisa izindlela zokulima zesimanje ukuze bakhiqize (ukulima ngaphandle kokulima) ngempumelelo ngo-2009/2010. Lo nyaka baqala ukutshala ngaphandle kokulima besebenzisa indlela yokulima ngaphandle kokulima futhi bathola umkhiqizo ophakeme kunowonyaka odlule. Ukuzimisela kwabo nokufuna ukushintsha, ukushiya izindlela zokutshala zendabuko, nokuzama izindlela ezintsha kukhombisa ukuthi abashiyi emuva ekushintsheni futhi babona ukuthi ukufunda kwabo nentuthuko kubanika impumelelo enkulu. Bayazi lokho okukhuluma abadala: 'Ulala uhlezi emuva' - labo abangahambi phambili bazoshiywa emuva. Abakhiqizi bathola ukuthi bathola ulwazi oluningi uma beyiwo amalungu eqembu lokufunda futhi behambele izinsuku zabakhiqizi lapho kukhona izifundo. Enye indlela yokuthola ulwazi ukusebenzisa izindawo zokubonisa, ezikhombisa abalimi indlela entsha eqondile yokutshala ufulawa. Ingabe kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwale qembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Kukhona ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu eqembu nabanye abalimi bezomnotho abaseduzane, kodwa abanye bahlala kude futhi abakwazi ukuhlangana nabo kalula - lokhu kuyinkinga. Iqembu lihamba kahle neMnyango Wezolimo kaHulumeni nabanye abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo.

Kodwa, njengazo zonke izinto, imidlalo yeshashalazi ibhekana nezinselelo. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho abantu bebengakuthandi, noma imidlalo ingatholi ukwesekwa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola, sokubuyisela emuva, nokucabanga ngempilo. UMthembu, noThandiwe, noSipho, babebonisa ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi ayigcini nje ngokuba yindawo yokuzijabulisa, kodwa iyindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, yokubhekana nezinkinga, nokwakha umphakathi. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezinzima, imidlalo yeshashalazi yaphinde yaphumelela. Ababukeli babebuyela, bejabulile, futhi bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo. UThandiwe, uSipho, noNandi baphinde bakha imidlalo emisha, ethokozisayo, futhi eyakhayo. Imidlalo yabo yabe ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bejabulile, futhi baphile izinkanyezi eziphilayo. Ekugcineni, imidlalo yeshashalazi yahlala iyinsika yamasiko, ibhuloho phakathi kwezizukulwane. Yaba yindawo yokuxoxa, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezifiso. Abantu bahlala bejabulile, bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo, futhi bejabulisa abanye. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yahlala ibalulekile, futhi izinkanyezi zayo zihlala zikhanya, zikhombisa indlela kubantu abahlala emadolobheni amakhulu. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsika, ibhuloho, futhi iyindlela yokuphila. Ibonisa ukuthi, noma izinkinga zikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhamba phambili, bahlale bejabulile, futhi baphile izinkanyezi eziphilayo. Lokhu kuyisifundo esibalulekile, esifanele ukuba sikhumbule njalo.

Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo okubalulekile okuqhubekayo eMnyangweni, ikakhulukazi ukubekwa koMthethosivivinywa ozayo, ikakhulukazi ukudluliselwa kwezinye izindawo kwemisebenzi yezindaba zomphakathi ezinhlanganweni zamazinga amathathu kaHulumeni kanye nokuqalwa ukusetshenziswa kwendlela entsha yomazisi yoMnyango Wezasekhaya i-Home Affairs National Identification System, kuyodinga ukuthi kuphinde kwenziwe ngokungenakuvinjelwa isakhiwo senhlangano yomnyango kanye nohlelo lwebhizinisi. Imisebenzi ihlala njalo ibalulekile kunesakhiwo kanti i-DHA iyaqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo luhlala lulungiswe ngokwezidingo zomsebenzi. Ngakho-ke uhlelo olufakwe Ohlelweni Oluyisu lwe-DHA, yize lukhombisa kakhulu isakhiwo samanje, lungolwesimo sezinguquko futhi kufanele lubhekwe ngesimo soguquko esiphilayo esesiqalile eMnyangweni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukucaciswa kokugcina kwesakhiwo senhlangano esisha sizoqondisa ukuzimisela konke koMnyango okwenziwe okuzofuneka kwenziwe ngenxa yokwenziwa kwenqubomgomo. NgokoMthetho, uMqondisi Jikelele ungumsebenzi wolwazi we-DHA. Usizwa amasekela abasebenzi bolwazi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yakhe. Amagunya oMnyango agxile emthethweni kanjalo nasemibhalweni yenqubomgomo. Nokuhambisana negunya lawo, uMnyango Wezasekhaya usebenzisa umsebenzi obalulekile Wemisebenzi Yomphakathi kanye Nokuhambela Kwamanye Amazwe. Lesi sigaba sinikezwe umsebenzi wokwenza ngcono izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokwenza umsebenzi ngokubonisana noMnyango Wezinkonzo Zikahulumeni kanye Nokuphatha. Unikeza uMqondisi Jikelele ngokuhlaziya kobungcweti, ngokuhlola, ngokuhlela kanye nosizo lokuxhumanisa, futhi kubalulekile ekuphatheni ngempumelelo kanye nakahle kwemisebenzi ehlukene yekhethelo yoMnyango.

Okona kuphambili kulo Mthethosivivinywa ukungafani kwemibono nohlelo lobulungiswa kumacala athize afanelekile. Okuyikhona obe- hlukile ukuvumela ukuthi noma ingane yonile ingajeziswa ngejele ivunyelwe ibuyele emphakathini lokho kuyinika ithuba lokuba izifune ingabuye yone rnasinyane, L. gumndlandla wengane nokudingwa ngumphakathi ekuwo, kuqalwe kumezekile ukuthi baqale uhlelo lobelapheka, kwelapheke bona malungelo engane. nemindeni yabo kanjalo nomphakathi ngokubanzi. ezanele ezilungele lezi zindawo, okuyikho okudale ukuthi uMnyango la samajele sokuhlola esiqinisekisa noNlCRO osolwayo ukulungele woBulunaiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo (DoJ&CD) uaal- ukufakwa phansi kohlelo lokungavalelwa. Abenzi bamacala bazibona benesibophezelo ngamacala abawenzile eliphela kanjalo uma bephelela emajele. yehlombe. "Ngo1994 sacishe sasempini yombango. Manje siyakwazi ukudlala igalofu ndawonye. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba thina siyisizwe sanquma ukuthi angeze sakhetha indlela yempi," uchaze kanjalo uSekela Ngqongqoshe De Lange. KuNgqongqoshe wami, esesiqede iminyaka engu 15 singabangane manje, ngithi asisebenze nje nda- wonye. Ungumuntu omangalisayo. Sibe nenhlanhla ngokuthi kuqokwe yena. Uletha umusa kulo msebenzi ngendlela asebenza ngayo ebonisana nab0 bonke abathintekayo, uchaze kanjalo uSekela Ngqongqoshe De Lange.

uMfula iNile Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa indlela yokuphila. Emhlabeni ophakeme, lapho izintaba zikhuphuka khona, uMfula iNile waqala khona, uhlezi njengomgudu ophilayo. Ubuya emithonjeni emikhulu, uhambe ngezinyawo ezithambile, udlula ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, ulethe impilo, ubuhle, nezindaba eziningi. Ngaphambi kokuba uMfula iNile ube yindawo yokuphila, kwakukhona izinkanyezi ezikhanyayo, ezazikhumbuza abantu ukuthi izimpilo zabo zixhumene. Abantu bahlala eduze komfula, bejabulile, bephila impilo enothile. Ubuye ube yindawo yokuhlangana, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze babelane ngezindaba, baphinde baphumule emanzini anothile. Ubuye uMfula iNile waba yisithombe sokuphila kwabantu baseGibhithe. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwaluhlala lukhanya, lukhombisa indlela yokuphila. Abantu baseGibhithe babebona uMfula njengomama wabo, owabathokozisayo, owabathokozisayo. Ubuye waba yindawo yokukhumbula, lapho izinkumbulo zikhumbuleka khona, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhumbuza abantu ngezikhathi ezinhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMfula iNile waba yindawo yokuhweba. Abantu behamba ngezikebhe, bejabulile, bephila impilo enothile. Ubuye waba yindawo yokuhlangana kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, behlangana ukuze babelane ngezindaba, baphinde baphumule emanzini anothile. Ubuye waba yindawo yokufunda, lapho abantu befundisa abanye ngezindlela zokuphila, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa indlela yokuphila.

Ndlovu: Ngiyavuma. Isinyathelo sokuqala ukufunda ngezinsiza ezikhona. Kukhona izifundo, ama-workshop, kanye nezinsiza eziku-inthanethi ezitholakalayo. Kubalulekile futhi ukuba nomqondo ocacile, kanye nesikhathi sokuhlaziya ukuthi yini abazama ukuyifinyelela. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuthi bathuthukise iziqu zabo. I-Moderator: Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkampani zikamasipala kanye nohulumeni bangafaka isandla ekukhuleni kwama-podcast? Mnu. Ndlovu: Yebo, ngicabanga ukuthi izinkampani zikamasipala zingabamba iqhaza elibalulekile. Bangase bethule izinhlelo zokuxhasa ama-podcast, noma banikeze izinsiza ezithile ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kumuntu ofuna ukuqala, futhi kuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni umqondo wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. I-Moderator: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Ndlovu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ama-podcast ayinsika yokukhuluma, ukufundisa, nokuxhumana. Ngabe unesiphetho esithile ofuna ukusisho kubalaleli bethu? Mnu. Ndlovu: Njengoba ama-podcast ekhula, ngiyafisa abantu ukuthi bangesabi ukufaka izwi labo. Ukukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta impilo zabo, ukuxoxa ngezindaba ezibalulekile, nezinkinga zomphakathi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, masibambisane ukuze sikhulise ama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika, sikhulume, sifunde, futhi sithuthukise impilo yethu. I-Moderator: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Ndlovu, ngale ngxoxo eyakhayo. Ngiyabonga futhi kubalaleli bethu, sibheke phambili ekutholeni izindaba ezinhle ezivela ema-podcast. Mnu. Ndlovu: Ngiyabonga!

Izinkinga Zokusebenza Ekhaya Nokho, ukusebenza ekhaya akukhululekile kuphela. Kukhona nezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalolu hlobo lokusebenza. Okokuqala, abantu abaningi babhekana nezithiyo zokuxhumana, njengoba ukungabi khona komphakathi kungaholela ekudambiseni umoya wokubambisana. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abasebenzi bazizwe bedabukile futhi bephuma emsebenzini. Okwesibili, ukusebenza ekhaya kungaholela ekunciphiseni umkhuba wokuziphatha kahle, njengoba abantu bengase bahlale bephuza noma bengenzi imisebenzi efanele, okungaholela ekwehliseni ukusebenza kahle. Ukubaluleka Kokuphathwa Kwezikhathi Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukusebenza ekhaya kuyimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuphatha kahle izikhathi. Abasebenzi kufanele babeke imigomo ethile yokusebenza, balungiselele izikhathi zokuphumula, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bahlala bexhumana nabanye. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuthi bagweme ukucindezeleka nokukhathala, okungaholela ekwehliseni umkhiqizo. Ukwakha umkhuba wokusebenza ofanele, okukhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, kubalulekile ekuphumeleleni kokusebenza ekhaya. Isiphetho Ukusebenza ekhaya kuyindlela ethokozisayo nekhuthazayo yokwenza umsebenzi, kodwa kudinga ukuhlela kahle ukuze kuzuze bonke. Izinzuzo zikhona, kodwa izinkinga nazo zidinga ukunakwa. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale beqaphela, behlola izindlela zokuphila zabo, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi bayakwazi ukuphatha kahle izikhathi zabo ukuze bakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ukusebenza ekhaya kuzoba yinsika ebalulekile emsebenzini wanamuhla.

Izingxoxo zekomidi lePhalamende mayelana nokungasebenzi kwentsha Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kungamanga ukuthi ukungasebenzi kwentsha kube yinkinga enkulu eNingizimu Afrika. Le nkinga ithinta izigidi zabantu abasha futhi ithinta kwazulu danosube, ikakhulukazi emzamweni wabo wokufuna imisebenzi. Ukuze sihlonze izizathu ezisemqoka eziholela kulokhu, umcabango ophucukile udinga ukubhekwa. Okokuqala, ukukhula kwezinga lokungasebenzi kwentsha kuhlobene nokuqhamuka kwezinhlelo zokufunda eziphezulu. Abantu abaningi baqeda izifundo eziningi, kodwa uma befika emhlabeni wokusebenza, behlangabezana nenkinga yokungatholi izikhala eziyimfanelo. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokuthi izikhungo zemfundo ziguqule ukuhlakulela amakhono ahambelana nezidingo zemakethe. Umthetho wobuchwepheshe uphinde uveze ukuthi imfundo kufanele ikhulise amakhono awusizo okungasebenzi, ukuze khona ukufika okungapheli emsebenzini. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo zezomnotho ezinzima zibeka umthwalo omkhulu kulesi sikhala. Ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, izinkinga zokukhula komnotho, kanye nezinhlekelele ezinjengezimo ze-Covid-19 zibe nomthelela omkhulu. Lokhu kufaka umfutho omubi kwezobuhlakani, ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zemakethe, kanye nokwakhiwa kwezikhundla ezintsha. Umphakathi kufanele uhlaziye lokhu ukuze uhlonze izixazululo ezinhle zalesi simo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zokuphila zomphakathi, okuhlanganisa ububha, ukungalingani kwezomnotho, kanye nemithetho eqinile yokusiza, nazo zibalulekile. Inani elikhulu labantu abasha abahlala ezindaweni ezinjengama-township alahlekelwe yithuba lokuthi baphumelele emsebenzini.

a ivimbela ukuthengiswa, ukudluliswa kwamalungelo okuphatha, noma ukucindezelwa kwanoma iyiphi impahla eyindawo kanye nezakhiwo ezikhona noma ezizayo futhi engelona impahla yekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi, kuhlanganise noma iyiphi ingxenye yezinsizakalo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi, ngaphandle kokuthi ukuthengiswa, noma ukudluliswa kwamalungelo noma ukucindezelwa kuhlelwe ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kwekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi noma ii kuvunywe ngesisekelo senhlangano yekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi. b Lesi sivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokuqhuba ukucindezelwa kwempahla futhi sichaze amasu okugcina impahla isesimweni esisebenzayo ukuze kukhombise ukuthi umsebenzi wokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ugcinwa esimweni esifanele; bese c sichaza inqubo yokuthola impahla, ukuthengisa, ukudlulisa amalungelo okuphatha, nokulahla impahla ecindezelwe. c kumele kuhlangabezane nokubuyekezwa kwezimali ezikhathini ezichaziwe mayelana nendlela esetshenzisiwe; futhi d hlinzeka ngokwabelana ngezinzuzo zezimali ezizotholwa ngokwenza umsebenzi kahle nangaphakathi kwezinga lomhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi. banohlelo lokubhekana nezikhalazo zabasebenzisi bamanzi iii chaza ilungelo lomsebenzisi wamanzi lokuthi kube neziphazamiso zilungiswe b qapha ukuhamba kwenqubo ezovumela abasebenzisi bamanzi endaweni lapho lesi sivumelwano sisebenza khona ukuba babambe iqhaza ekubhaleni idokhumenti yamalungelo abasebenzisi bamanzi, futhi ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kufanele kuhlelwe ukuthi i kube nemihlangano nemiphakathi lapho, uma ibanjwe, kubhekwa ulimi abathanda noma olukhuluma abantu bendawo lapho lesi sivumelwano sisebenza khona; bese ii kube nendlela yokwamukela, ukuhlaziya, nokubheka imibono neziphakamiso zabantu abasebenzisa amanzi ezethulwe mayelana nedokhumenti yamalungelo ephakanyisiwe.

Kudingeka ini ukuqhubekisa ibhizinisi? Ukuhlanganisa uhlelo lwezinto ezidingekayo ukuhambisa ibhizinisi ngendlela efanelekile kungaba umsebenzi omkhulu owehlukile. Izidingo nezingcebo zingashintsha maqondana nohlobo lwebhizinisi, ubukhulu balo, isikhathi esikhona, njll. Ibhizinisi lokulima lizoba nezidingo ezinjengomhlaba, amanzi, idlelo, izindlu, indawo yokusebenza (workshop), indawo yokusenga, imishini yokufafaza, izimoto, imishini, ogandaganda, amatulusi, abasebenzi, izimali nabaphathi. Lezi zingcebo ezidingekayo zingahlukaniswa ngendlela elandelayo: kukhona ukuphatha, kukhona izindaba zezomhlaba, izindaba zezimali nezindaba zabasebenzi. Umhlaba - lokhu kungaba ipulazi noma amasimu, amadlelo, izindlu nokunye okwakhiwe njengezibaya, amashedi, izindawo zokulalisa izimfuyo nothango. Imali yokuqhuba umsebenzi - kusho imali uqobo nezimpahla ezinye njengogandaganda, izimoto, izinkomonezimvu. Okwezomsebenzi - kusho abantu abasebenza epulazini ngaphansi komnini noma umphathi. Abaphathi - umuntu noma abantu abaphatha ukuqhuba kwebhizinisi. Ngaphandle kwezinto zezomsebenzi, konke okunye okuhambelana nokukhiqiza kuyizinto zebhizinisi noma kubolekiwe noma kuqashwe kwenye indawo. Lapho umhlaba, imali yokuqhuba ibhizinisi nabaphathi kubolekiwe noma kuqashiwe, kubizwa ngokuthi izingcebo ezingekwakhona (ezivela kwenye indawo - omunye ngumnini). Lowo mnini wangaphandle bese kufanele akhokhelwe imali yokusebenzisa leyo ngcebo - kusho ukuthi kukhona izindleko. Amaholo - inkokhelo yokusebenzisa abasebenzi/abaphathi abavela kwenye indawo.

Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithinta umphakathi, futhi abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile. Lokhu kuzodinga ukuthi umphakathi uhlanganise izixazululo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezibalulekile. Ukukhokha izindleko zemishwalense nezempilo kudinga ukuqonda ukuthi inombolo yempesheni iyaphuthuma, futhi abantu badinga ukukhuthazwa ukuze bazi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo ziyatholakala. U-GEMS unendima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni impilo yomphakathi, futhi uhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo. Ukuqinisekisa inombolo yempesheni akuyona nje inqubo, kodwa kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile empilweni. Lokhu kudinga ubuhlakani, ukuzimisela, kanye nemithombo efanele ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yomphakathi. Ekugcineni, qinisekisa inombolo yakho yempesheni ukuze uthole umbono omuhle empilweni yakho, futhi usebenzise izinsizakalo zeGEMS ukuze uthuthukise impilo yakho. Ngiyabonga.

Izindleko zokufaka njenge-diesel nezinsiza zokulima ziyasibulala. Ezolimo akuyona insimu ethokozisa intsha yabantu abamnyama; abawuboni umbono wesikhathi esizayo kuyo. Uma izindleko nezimpahla ezingenayo zingalawulwa, ukuncintisana okukhona ezimpahleni ezixhaswayo kuzobhubhisa umkhiqizi waseNingizimu Afrika. Uthola kuphi izinsiza zakho? Ngithenga kulabo abamele abahlinzeki bezinkampani ezinikeza lezo zinsiza, ngemuva kokuthola nokuhlonza amanani aphakanyisiwe nokucabangela ukwesekwa abakunikeza ukusiza ngezinkinga ezivela ngemuva kokuthenga kubo. Yini indima kahulumeni kwezolimo futhi ubani uyiqedela kanjani? Uhulumeni kufanele anakekele abakhiqizi. Abakhiqizi benza amathuba emisebenzi nokuzinza ezindaweni zasemaphandleni. Kumele babheke umhlaba onikezwa abakhiqizi abasafufusa kanye nokwesekwa okunikezwa ukuze babasize baphumelele kwezimali nasemathulini okusebenza. Kumele kube nokukhuthazwa kulabo abakhuluma ngokwenza imali. Kumele kukhokhwe amanani afanelekile, futhi usizo kufanele lucelwe lapho kudingeka. Uhulumeni uyazama, kodwa okwamanje akaphumelelanga. Yini obona njengokuthinta impumelelo yakho? Ikhono lami lokuphatha izinto eziningi lingenzele kahle. Izinkomo zikunikeza ukuzinza futhi zikusiza ngemali edingekayo. Ukuphisa izinkukhu nezinkomo zenyama kungisizile ukuhlangabezana nezindleko zami zenyanga. Nginephuzu elincane lomhlaba lokulima elingu-3 hectares engazi ukuthi ngingalima. Ngikhula imifino ukuze ngithole imali ngokushesha. Futhi, iqiniso lokuthi angigxile ngokuphelele kwezolimo, nginokunye umsebenzi ozinzile, kuyasiza. Uma ezolimo zingaba nezindleko ezinkulu, ngizoba umkhiqizi wesikhathi esigcwele.

I-Xhariep DM izokhetha abaxoxiswayo be-WSDP abazohlela izigaba zamanzi zomphakathi zendawo kuhlanganise neMohokare LM. I-municipality iyidolobha elithole inhlonipho kubo. Ama-Gorilla azobuyela ezweni lawo, eCameroon, kulandela isicelo esikhethekile esenziwe nguHulumeni waseCameroon, osekelwe yi-IFAW. Le mikhuba yokubhema ngokweqile ibonisa okuthile okusha mayelana nokuthi bangaki abantu abathinteka ezimeni ezinzima ezifana ne-bronchitis eyandayo, i-emphysema, ne-TB. Umbukiso ojabulisayo wezithombe zomlando zabantu njengophawu lokuzimela kweMelika, obizwa ngokuthi iSacred Legacy, wenziwa yiqembu lezithombe kanye no-Edward, umcwaningi ophawula isayensi ye-ethnicity namasiko abantu. Ama-light bulbs aphumelelayo kufanele athathe indawo yamalambu e-incandescent. Izimo zokuhlukumeza ezihlobene nezono zobugebengu ngaphansi komthetho. Izinsolo zokungahloniphi zihlobene nezijeziso zobugebengu ngokwezomthetho wethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-DSR izosayina izivumelwano zomhlaba mayelana nezemidlalo nokuzijabulisa. UHolst wabonga uMlaba ngensizakalo ekhombisa uMasipala eminyakeni edlule. Nakuba ingesinye sezikole ezinzima kakhulu eDurban, iDawnridge Primary inedumela elihle futhi inezifundo eziningi ezifunda lapho. Abantu abanezikhumba ezimnyama noma ezinsomi abakhathazeki ngezinkinga zomdlavuza wesikhumba njengoba isikhumba sabo sine-melanin pigment, kodwa abavikelwe ekushiseni ilanga. UNgqongqoshe-Jikelele weZizwe eziManyene kufanele athumele umPhakathi Okwesikhashana ukuze amele yena.

Koboekae ugcizelele ukuthi kuzoba nemihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi ezobanjwa ngababonisi abaqeqeshiwe ukuze baqeqeshe labo abazohileleka ngaphambi kokuthi umkhosi omkhulu uqale. Imiphumela yalezi zinhlelo ibonisa ukuthi isisekelo sokubandakanya ababambiqhaza sikhulisiwe. Amalungu azokwazi ukuthi umhlangano wokulungiselela owenziwe ngabaPhathiswa obubanjwe eBali, e-Indonesia usanda kwenza intuthuko enkulu ekufinyeleleni isivumelwano sokuthi kwenzeke ini ukuze kuqhubeke ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli. I-graphite engakaze ibe khona; i-graphite ye-colloidal noma ye-semi-colloidal; amalungiselelo asekelwe ku-graphite noma ezinye izinto ze-carbon ezifana namabhokisi, amapuleti, noma izinto ezingakhi. Sithole imibiko eminingi yokuthunjwa kwabo abatholakele ezikhwameni, ukuhlolwa kwabo phambi kwabantu bezokuphepha, nezinqumo zezempilo, njengoba uBetty echaza, zazivame ukuthathwa ngokusekelwe kulokho okwakudingeka kwezokuphepha. Ukucatshangelwa kumele kunikezwe ekususeni utshani ukuze kudaleke indawo eqinile endaweni yayo. Lokhu kuhluka emibonweni evela kwiPolokwane Conference futhi akuyona into engajwayelekile enhlangano enomlando ojabulisayo wokuphakamisa izingxoxo zamandla. Umphakathi uphikelela ukuthi kufanele kube nesikole esisha esikhundleni salokho okukhona, okugcwele kakhulu futhi okuphakeme. Amaphoyisa aqale ukusishaya, asiphushela ukuba sihlakaze odongeni, abanye bethu basiphushela. Lokhu kuholele ekubambisaneni phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene nokusungulwa kwezinyathelo ezithile ezihlobene nokugcina izindawo ezihlukene.

Nokho, kubalulekile ukuqokomisa ukuthi i-NER ilindele ukuthi abathengi nabahlinzeki abathintekayo bazame ukusombulula izinkinga zabo ngaphambi kokufaka isikhalazo ku-NER. Ngokuvamile, i-NER ngeke ingenelele ngaphandle kokuthi leyo nkinga ingaxazululwa ezingeni lendawo. Ezinye izisho zisetshenziswa kakhulu embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, futhi kubalulekile kubathengi bamanzi ukuba bazi ngencazelo yalezi zisho. Ukuhlukaniswa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi: ukuhlinzekwa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi okuhlelwe phambili okwenziwa ngumbhlinzeki wogesi lapho kwenziwa umsebenzi wokugcinwa noma uxhumana nezintambo zikagesi. Ukuhlukaniswa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi okwenziwe ngokuqinile: ukuhlinzekwa kokuhlinzeka ngogesi okwenzeka ngenxa yephutha elithile ezintanjeni zikagesi noma ngenxa yokungasebenzi kahle kwemishini kagesi. Izintambo zikagesi zasemaphandleni: izintambo zikagesi ezihlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni ezikude, njengezindawo zasemaphandleni nezifunda, ezivame ukungabi nezinsiza ezinhle ezifana nezindlela. Izintambo zikagesi zasemadolobheni: izintambo zikagesi ezihlinzeka ngezindawo zokuhlala ezihlotshiswe kahle ezivame ukuba nezinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Ukuhlinzekwa kwangaleso sikhathi: ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kubathengi ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile. Ukuhlinzekwa kukagesi kungase kungahambisani nezinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo. Ugesi ophansi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekuhlinzekeni abathengi bezindlu noma amabhizinisi amancane. Ugesi ophakathi: uvame ukusetshenziswa ekusabalaliseni ugesi nasekuhlinzekeni izimboni noma abathengi abangathengisi.

Ngale kweqhaza lokuhlela olwenziwe phambilini, uhlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele selubonakala njengomsebenzi wokusingatha omasipala nanjengengxenye yeqhinga lezinhlelo ezididiyele nokwethula imisebenzi emphakathini. Uhlelo lwe-IDP luqonde ukufinyelela ezinqumeni ngezinto ezifana nesabelo-zimali zomasipala, ukusingathwa komhlaba, ukuqhakambisa intuthuko yomnotho ezindaweni nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokubonisana, ehlelekile neqonde phambili. Izinhlelo zeNtuthuko eDidiyele ngeke isize kuphela impatho yomasipala kodwa kufanele ihlahle indlela yemisebenzi yezikhungo noma imikhakha esondelene nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhumene nohulumeni, abasiza abezimboni, kanjalo nemboni ezimele ezindaweni zomasipala. Esikhathini esidlule, omasipala besikhashana base bevele bemdibi munye ekulungiseni izinhlelo zama-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngalesi sikhathi lwalungekho uhlaka lomthetho. Omasipala bezindawo abaningi (ikakhulu iMikhandlu yesiKhashana) babengenazo izinsiza namandla okusingatha umsebenzi wenqubo yokuhlela. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ayengekho amaqhinga okuhlela asevivinyiwe ngalesimo ngokunjalo nezinhlelo ezinqala nezihloliwe zokuqeqesha. Ngaphandle kwazo zonke lezi zinqinamba, bonke abantu ababambe iqhaza kulendima bahlomule kakhulu ngolwazi abaluzuzile. Kunomaziphathe abambalwa asebehlabele phambili kakhulu ekusunguleni izinhlelo ezisiza ekusingatheni imisebenzi nezinhlelo esezisebenza. Amabhukwana eziNkomba ze-IDP, nasungulwe yithimba elinolwazi olwehlukile leDPLG ngokwesekwa yiGTZ, luhlongoza inqubo ehloliwe yokuhlela nokusingatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukusetshenziswa.

I-NAFVSA iyingqayizivele ngoba ingesinye sezikhungo ezincane emhlabeni ezigcina amafilimu, ividiyo, nezirekhodi ezilalelwayo ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa. Ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lolwazi olukhombisa umlando wesizwe sethu eNingizimu Afrika ngezithombe kube usizo futhi kuzokwenza kube umthombo omkhulu wezizukulwane ezizayo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Baphinde bakwazi ukubheka kalula emuva kulokho okwenzeka esikhathini esedlule, futhi lokhu kungab placing them in a position to speculate on what the film and tape industry will look like in the future. Ngenxa yokushintsha okusheshayo kwezobuchwepheshe, imishini esetshenziswe eminyakeni engama-20 edlule manje isiphukile, kodwa ingasetshenziswa ukuze ihlinzeke ngolwazi lomlando, kanye nokubonisa ukuthuthuka nezinguquko embonini ye-filimu, ividiyo, kanye ne-tape.

(Isu lesonto nezicwangciso zalesi sikhathi zixubene kuTebula 1). Susa izinkomo ezingu-100 emapulazini, uzibhalise, phatha ngemithi, qapha isisindo sazo. Lapho sihlela izicwangciso zesikhathi esifushane, kufanele kufakwe imininingwane eminingi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi izicwangciso azikwazi ukuhlala ziqinile, ikakhulukazi ezimbonini zokulima epulazini. Kukhona izinto eziningi ezingalindelekile ezingavela, ezifana nezikhukhula ezinkambu, ukuwa kwezakhiwo, izifo ezilwaneni, njll. Ukuhlela isu kuyisabelo sokuphatha ngoba kuyisisekelo sokuphatha nokufaka emsebenzini okuzoxoxwa ngakho embhalweni olandelayo. Ngaphandle kokuhlela isu, akukwazi ukuba khona ukuphathwa okusebenzayo ngoba izicwangciso ziyi sabelo sokuqala sokuphatha; ngezicwangciso, singaphatha umsebenzi kahle. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa, ukufaka emsebenzini, nokulawula okuqinile, umphathi kumele abe nesibindi ekwenzeni eminye imisebenzi yokuphatha efana nokuhlela, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi bakhe, ukubakhuthaza ukuba basebenze kahle, ukubanika amandla, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha ngokuqinile. Ukunakwa kuyo yonke le misebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi.

Labo abanamalungelo kuyodingeka ukuthi bakhiphe iziqiniseko ama statimente ezimali zabo.. Labo abafuna ukungena komele baveze ukuzibandakanya kwabo kwi sector esikhathini esidlule. Lapho kufanele umnyango uzofuna ukukhipha amalungelo ngendlela efanele wonke umutu alingane ukuze basebenze ngasogwini lwe south africa. Bonke abafake izicelo ku Cluster A, Cluster B naku Cluster C kwezokudoba komele bakhombise ukuthi banemvume noma imikhumbi yabo iyiyona na yokuthi ingavuna izinhlazi. Yonke imikhumbi komele iqale Ibhaliswe emnyangweni ngesikhathi umuntu etcela amalungelo ukuze lowomkhumbi wokuthi ungakwazi ukubamba.. Ikakhulu, amalungu abanemikhumbi yabo (ngokwanele noma ingxenye) afakwe ohlweni olungeluhle ngeke banikezwe imvume yokudoba. Abanamalungelo manje abangenawo ama l monitoring systems bayanxuswa ukuthi bakwenze lokho ngaphandle kokuthandabuza. Umnyango uzofuna wonke amalungu abanamalungelo okudayisa ukuba basebenzise imikhumbi leyo abayifunele ukuba bathole imvume ngayo. Ukushintsha kwemikhumbi kuyovunyelw kwezinye izikhathi.. Umnyango uphoqekile ukuthi wonke umhlaba wasolwandle marine living resources ngokomthetho weMLRA usebenzise izindlela ezingcono okuhlonipha abaphathi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinto. Into ehamba phambili ekuphatheni kanye nokonga umhlaba wasolwandle ukuthi izizinda zisebenziseke ngendlela. Kwesinye isandla , imikhumbi emidala ingase isuswe kuthengwe emisha ngenxa yokungaphephi kwayo.. Isimanjemanje iyasiza ukuthi ukwazi ukubamba kakhulu. Lapho okudingeke khona ukunciphisa ukuzama kuzobukwa nakho.. Ukunyuka kwe TAC ngeke inikezwe ngendlela efanayo.

Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uMthembu wathola impesheni yakhe yokuqala, wazizwa ejabule, futhi wathokozisa umndeni wakhe. Waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yabo, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. U-Mthembu waba nesifiso sokwabelana ngalesi sihloko nabanye, ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuqinisekisa izinhlelo zabo zempesheni. Ngaleso sikhathi, uMthembu waba umholi emphakathini, wabelana ngolwazi lwakhe nabanye abantu ababephakathi. Wafundisa abantu ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kubalulekile, futhi wakhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe izincwadi zabo kahle. Wazi ukuthi impesheni iyinsiza enkulu, futhi wayefuna ukuthi wonke umuntu akwazi ukuyithola. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMthembu waba nesithakazelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, futhi waba nesifiso sokuthi bonke abantu baphile impilo engcono. Wazi ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kwakuyisinyathelo sokuqala, kodwa impilo engcono yayidinga ukuzinikela, uthando, nokubambisana. Ngale ndlela, uMnumzane Mthembu waba yisibonelo esihle emphakathini, futhi wakhuthaza abanye ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo. Wazi ukuthi impesheni yakhe yayiyinsiza, kodwa uthando nomphakathi kwakuyisikhumbuzo esikhulu sokuphila. U-Mthembu waphila impilo egcwele, enethemba, futhi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ukuthi noma iyiphi uhlelo olubhalwe phansi, incwadi yemiyalo, isizinda solwazi, uhlu olunembile, amarekhodi ezimali, kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi oluqoqwe ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano kuzohlala kungokwakhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi.

Imibuzo ehlobene nesikhla esithile somsebenzi esikhangisiwe kumele idluliselwe kumuntu ochaziwe. Ukuqaliswa kohlaka lwalolu hlaka loHlelo Lokuqhamuka Nokusha Lweminyaka Eyishumi. Futhi unokwengamela kokubonwayo konogada ababekwe enkundleni. IPhalamende livume isiphakamiso esenziwe u-Sentech, kuze kube yileso sikhathi icandelo lesigneli le-SABC, uzokwehlukaniswa no-SABC bese uguqulwe ube yinkampani yomphakathi. Futhi ubani owayegade inkundla yezemidlalo ngesikhathi kushanelwa? Ukusebenzisana kwamacandelo ahlukene, kanye nokugqugquzelwa kwabo bonke ababambe iqhaza kwinsiza yokuxhasa ephokophele ukwenza ngcono ezempilo zezingane kanye nabesifazane, kuzokwenziwa. Uhulumeni ukhathazeke kakhulu ngezimo zemindeni ethintekile ngenxa yobhubhane oluyigciwane lesandulela ngculazi kanye nesifo sengculazi. Izimo Ngokuphathelene Nobugebengu: Kuboshwe umuntu ngezihlakalo ezine zokubulala. Udaba oluphambili kulokho ngakunye kulokho okubalulwe kakhulu, kodwa, kungathweswa cala okunikezwe umbuso. Umthetho, ogqugquzela imikhiqizo, esekelwe kwimithetho yezemvelo, nokusekelwe kumthetho wezendawo Legislation, ezothuthukiswa futhi iphinde ibhalwe komsomqulu bakahulumeni. Siyabonga kubalimi abathengisa imikhiqizo yabo abaningi abasebenzisana nathi ukuthi sisombulule izinselele eziningi zenguquko emphakathini wethu. Angeke, impela, ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ngenxa yaleli fomu eligayiwe. Imidwebo akumele ihanjiswe ngeposi kodwa kumele ifakwe kuhlelo umbhali wayo.

Isicelo esibhaliwe okukhulunywa ngaso kusigatshana 3 b, kufanele sibeke kucace inhloso yokubizwa komhlangano. Isibalo samalunga emhlanganweni yisigamu samalunga esephelele wonke nelunga elilodwa ngaphezulu.

Amalungu eNkampani kumele, ekuhlakazweni kweNkampani okukhulunywa ngakho esigatshaneni (1), phakathi kokunye, ahambisane nezigaba 349 kanye no 350 soMthetho weziNkampani, 1973 (uMthetho No. 61 ka 1973). Amalungu eBhodi yeNkampani kumele asebenze njengamalungu eBhodi yesiKhungo agunyaziwe kuze kube yisikhathi lapho iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali ngokwesigaba 5(2) liyoqoka khona iBhodi ngokwalo Mthetho.

- Ukwanda Kwezindleko: Izindleko zokugcinwa ziya zanda, lokhu kungenxa yokukhula kwezindleko zokusebenza, izinsiza, nezinto zokusebenza. Ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zindleko, kubalulekile ukuhlela kahle izinsiza nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ubuchwepheshe Ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengezinga elibalulekile lokusebenza kwezitimela. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukuntuleka Kwezobuchwepheshe: Ukuze kube nokusebenza okuhle, kubalulekile ukuthi izitimela zisebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ukuntuleka kwezobuchwepheshe kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza. - Ukuphazamiseka Kwamathuluzi: Ukuphazamiseka kwamathuluzi obuchwepheshe kungathinta ukusebenza kwezitimela. Ukuze kuncishiswe lezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuhlola nokugcina ubuchwepheshe. Izinsiza Zomsebenzi Izinsiza zomsebenzi zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukuntuleka Kwezisebenzi: Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuhle, kubalulekile ukuba nezinselelo zokusebenza ezanele. Ukuntuleka kwezimali ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi kungaholela ekwehleni kokusebenza. - Izinhlelo Zokuqeqesha: Ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abasebenzi bahlala bejwayele izinqubo ezisemqoka. Ukuqeqeshwa okunganele kungaholela emaphutheni nasekwehleni kokusebenza. Ukubambisana Nezinye Izinhlaka Ukubambisana nezinye izinhlaka kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitimela zisebenza kahle. Izinselelo ezihlobene nazo zifaka: - Ukungabikhona Kwezokuxhumana: Ukuze kube nokubambisana okuphumelelayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile zokuxhumana phakathi kwe-Transnet Freight Rail nezinye izinhlaka.

103 ka-1994) futhi ahambisane nenqubomgomo yokunikezwa leso sikhundla sokuba umregistrar kule Ndawo. Ukunikezwa kwabaregistrars kuncike ekuphothulweni kwezifundo ezithile ezivunyelwe nguMphathi-Jikelele. UMphathi-Jikelele anganikezela umuntu ukuba abe umregistrar isikhathi esivumelwene nguMphathi-Jikelele nomfaki-sicelo; umfaki-sicelo uzoba nelungelo lokuthola umholo ophelele ofana nenani eliphelele elitholwe ngabaregistrars kule Ndawo. Izimo zokunikezwa umuntu isikhundla sokuba umregistrar njengoba kuqondiswe ngalesi sigaba (1) ngenhla zifana nezimo zokemployment ezisetshenziswa kumuntu onikezwa isikhundla sokuba umregistrar enkantolo ngaphansi koMthetho Wesevisi Yomphakathi ka-1994 (Isikhumbuzo No. 103 ka-1994). Benza imisebenzi yomregistrar enkantolo ezimweni zomphakathi uma kudingeka ukuze kufezwe lokho okukhulunywe ngakho nguMthetho. Umuntu, inhlangano, noma ikhomishini ebhekiswe esigabeni 20 salo Mthetho, efuna ukulethela udaba enkantolo noma ukufaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ingakwenza lokhu ngokwazisa umregistrar wenkantolo ngentshisekelo yabo yokwenza lokhu besebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 2 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Kumele bacela umphenduli ukuba banikeze ulwazi olubhaliwe olukhulunywe esigabeni 3 seFomu 3 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 kusukela ngosuku lokwamukela leso sikhumbuzo. Umregistrar kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokwamukela impendulo evela kumphenduli obhekiswe esigabeni (2)(b) ngenhla, athumele ikhophi noma isithombe salo mpendulo kumfaki-sicelo noma kumuntu olethe udaba.

Ukuhlela kabusha umthetho wezwe wezemigwaqo ukuze kuqondiswe amagama futhi kuhlelwe kabusha incazelo ethile ukuze kwandiswe ulwazi olungafakwa ezinhlinzweni ezitholakala kumgomo wezwe wezemigwaqo; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lokuhlela; ukunciphisa inani lezinqubo ezidingekayo ngumthetho; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukukhetha iziphathimandla zokuhlela ezidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuhamba eziboardini ezifanele; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezokuhamba lwezwe kanye nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezokuhamba zamaphondo; ukususa izimo eziphathelene nezikhumbuzo zomphakathi zamanje; izindlela zokulawula ezisebenzayo, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngemicabango ethile nezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe; ukwengeza izikhathi ezithile; ukuhlinzeka ngamacategori amasha ezimoto angasetshenziswa ezinsizeni zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukwengeza ukuhlinzekwa kwemvume yokusebenza, ukwengeza imisebenzi yeziphathimandla zokulawula ukusebenzisa izimvume; ukujula ezimotweni ezingasetshenziswa ohambweni olude; ukuhlinzeka ngoshintsho lwezimvume zokusebenza; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukusetha izindinganiso zamamitha ezitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha nokuvumela amaMEC ukuthola izakhiwo zokukhokha izitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha, ukudala izimo zokwabelana ngemvume yokusebenza kwezinsizakalo zabavakashi; ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yesikhashana yezimoto ezithile; ukudala amacala amasha; nokwenza izinguquko kumadokhumenti; ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene.

U-Lionel Messi, ngesikhathi esebenza, wathola izindondo eziningi, okuhlanganisa neBallon d'Or, okuyisikhumbuzo sokuba ngumdlalisi ophakeme emhlabeni. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa izithombe ezinhle zempilo yakhe, kusukela ezinsukwini zakhe zokuqala eRosario, kuya ezinsukwini zokugcina eParis Saint-Germain. Abantu babebonisa uthando lwabo, bejabulisa izinkanyezi ezinkulu ezazikhona. Ngemuva kokukhuluma, uMessi wathola ithuba lokukhuluma. Wabonga bonke abamthandayo, wathi: "Ngiyabonga kakhulu, ngiyazi ukuthi ngingakwenza lokhu ngenxa yenu. Uthando lwenu lwenze ngaba yimpumelelo." Lokhu kwavusa umoya ophakeme, kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uMessi akasiyena nje umphakathi, kodwa ungumuntu ophumelelayo. Umcimbi wawuhlanganisa nemidlalo emincane, lapho abantwana bebhola bejabulisa izithameli. Lokhu kwaba yithuba lokukhumbuza abantu ukuthi uMessi akasiyena nje umphakathi, kodwa ungumuntu ophumelelayo. Abantwana babebonisa ubuchule babo, bejabulisa izithameli, futhi lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uMessi ungumuntu ophumelelayo. Ngemuva kokuphothulwa komcimbi, uMessi wathola izipho eziningi, okuhlanganisa neziqu ezihloniphekile. Lokhu kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uMessi akasiyena nje umphakathi, kodwa ungumuntu ophumelelayo. Umcimbi waphothulwa ngengoma ethokozisayo, lapho bonke abantu bejabulisa, bejabulisa, futhi bejabulisa. U-Lionel Messi, umphakathi wezinyoni, uhlala engumfanekiso wempumelelo, uthando, nokuzinikela.

Amalungu akakwazi ukusebenza kunoma yiliphi ikomiti lokunquma elinquma nganoma yisiphi sezihloko ezike zabhekwa ekomitini lokuhlola. Uma kungekho i-CFO, uMenenja Kamasipala uzakusebenza njengomgcinisihlalo, uma nje iMenenja: Yizinsiza Zezezimali ikhona. Uma bengekho bobabili i-CFO kanye noMenenja Kamasipala, i-CFO izawukhetha enye i-ofishali ephezulu ukuthi isebenze njengomgcinisihlalo, uma nje umseebnzi wokuphatha ukunikezela imisebenzi, ekhethwe yi-CFO, ikhona. Amalungu ekomiti lokunquma akasoze aba ngamalungu ekomiti encasiselo yamakomiti noma amakomiti okuhlola ebhekela noma yiziphi izihlelo okumela kunqunywe ngazo. Loku kuvimbela kufaka noma yiliphi ilungu elikhethiwe noma eligunyaziwe. Amalungu Ekomiti Lokuhlola Ibhidi angangenisa imibiko yawo Ekomitini Lokunquma Lebhidi bese becacisa okungazwakali. Kodwa, amalungu anje awasoze aba nawo amandla okuvota Ekomitini Lokunquma Lebhidi. Umnyango Wezinsiza Ezibumbene uzakunikeza ikomiti lesinzisa zonobhala kuwo wonke amakomiti. I-Ofisa Enegunya ingaxoxisana nombhidi obonisiwe njengombhidi okethiwe ngokusebenzisa inqubo yokubhida enokuncintisana, uma nje inqubo ingavumeli umbidi ukuba athole ithuba lesibili (elingafanele) kanye nokuthi ukwaziswa okunje akuyona ingozi kunoma yimuphi umbhidi noma umnikezeli. Amanye amaphuzu okukhetha azokunikezwa njengokuseKhadeni Lamanani Lokulinganisa Kumithetho Yokutholiswa Yomthetho Wenqubomgomo Ewuhlaka Yokutholiswa Okukhethayo, Umthetho weNo 5 ka-2000.

Ukubhema ugwayi kuyingozi enkulu kwizifo eziningi ezikhubazayo kanye nezibulalayo. Amaphoyisa asazama ukuthola abanikazi bempahla esasele. Uhlelo oluhlongozwayo lamafilimu kanye nezinhlelo ezihlelelwe ukuthi zibe khona zingahlelelwa ukuthi zitholakale kwi-Events Management Sub-directorate. AmaPaki asedolobheni azoqala ukubheka izindawo eziqala ukubukeka zingasekho esimweni esihle, futhi abasebenzi kanye nosonkontileka bazosebenza amahora engeziwe ukuzwe kuqedwe noma ikuphi ukusilela emuva ekugundeni utshani. Irestorenti yomndeni engabizi ehlinzeka ngesidlo sasekuseni, ngesidlo sasemini kanye nesidlo sasebusuku kanye nombengo njalo ngamaSonto. Indlela okulandelana ngayo imiqingo emihlanu yemibiko engale ndlela elandelayo. Lokho ebengikuchaza ngalokho ukuthi kumele aye kwi-d'Oliveira Commission bese enikeza ngolwazi. Hlanganisa ukugcinwa kanye nokusetshenziswa ngokuphindelela kwemvelo ngokwahluka kwayo kwizinhlelo zawo wonke amacandelo kanye namacandelo angenelela kwamanye, izinhlelo kanye nemigomo kuwo wonke amazinga kahulumeni kanye nemboni. Ukuphela kohlobo lwezinhlobo ezihlala ngazodwana endaweni ethile isb. esiqhingini noma olunye uhlobo lungatholakala kwenye indawo. Lezi zindlela zikhombisa imizamo kahulumeni yokubeka izinto zokuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kwe-IKS, kusho uDkt. Mangena. Imboni yezimayini kuzodingeka ukuthi yehlise ukunukubezeka komoya futhi kugqugquzelwe nosiko lokunciphisa imfucuza kanye nokuphinda kusetshenziswa kabusha imikhiqizo yemfucuza. Lokhu kuhlanganisa amabhizinisi amakhulu, izikhungo ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni, izinhlangano ezisekelwe zezenkolo, ezinye izikhungo zokuqinisa umthetho, imiphakathi.

Ucabanga ukuthi abantu abavela emakhaya bangenza umehluko kumphakathi. Bazokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, bahlale besekela omunye nomunye, baphinde bahlanganyele. Isiphetho UThandiwe Mthembu uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi abantu bangakwenza kanjani ukufuduka emakhaya baye emadolobheni. Ubuye athole izifundo ezibalulekile mayelana nokuphila, ubudlelwano, nomnotho. Ukufuduka akusiyona nje ukukhipha umuntu endaweni ethile, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha impilo engcono. UThandiwe ubona ukuzithoba njengendlela yempumelelo, ethokozisa, futhi evuma ukuthi ukufuduka kuyinselelo, kodwa kudinga isibindi nokuhlakanipha. Uthando lwakhe lwazaleka emakhaya, futhi luhlala lukhona, kubonisa ukuthi noma naphakathi kwezinkinga, abantu banamandla okuphila, baphila, futhi bakha.

UMphathi-Jikelele anganikezela umuntu ukuba abe umregistrar isikhathi esivumelwene nguMphathi-Jikelele nomfaki-sicelo; umfaki-sicelo uzoba nelungelo lokuthola umholo ophelele ofana nenani eliphelele elitholwe ngabaregistrars kule Ndawo.

Izinkinga Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela: Umqondo Wami Isikhathi sokubeletha sanyanga ezintathu sikhangisa umhlaba wonke. Lokhu kuyisikhathi esijabulisayo, kodwa futhi nizimo eziningi ezinzima kanye nezinkinga ezilindelekile. Ukubeletha ezibhedlela kube yinsakavukela kakhulu, kepha kumele sihlole indlela ezinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela ezifana nobuhlakani benhlalakahle. Ngiyafisa ukwabelana ngombono wami, okhombisa izinselelo nezixazululo ezenzeka ngalesi sikhathi esibalulekile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha zidinga ukuhlela kahle. Ngokusho kwezifundo eziningi, ukubeletha kahle kuthinta impilo yomama nabantwana. Abesifazane abaphethwe yizimo zokulwa kanzima, njengokukhulelwa okuphuthumayo noma ukungaphezi kahle, akufanele babhekane nezinkinga ezenzakalayo ezibhedlela. Umfazi ofuna ukuzalwa kufanele enze izinqumo ezibucayi, futhi kumele aphatheke kahle kulolu suku olukhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukunakwa kwezokwelapha okwengeziwe, lokho okufanele kuphikise izinqubomgomo ezithile ezibhedlela. Okwesibili, kubalulekile ukuqonda izimo zempilo ezibhekene nezinqubomgomo zokubeletha ezibhedlela. Ezinye izibhedlela zinezinkqubo ezibucayi zokwelapha, kepha kuthiwe uhla lwabakhiqizi bempilo lunalungelo lokugcina izinqubo ezilula nezenzakalayo. Ukusiza abesifazane nabantwana, izibhedlela kumele zisebenze ngokubambisana nabahlinzeki bezempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathintekayo bazi kahle izinqubo zabo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthuthukiswa kwezithuthukisi ezithinta izinkinga eziningi ezibhekene nezibhedlela. Okwesithathu, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukungena kwabantu abasha abahamba phambili kule mikhakha.

Konlya cross uma uphakamisa isignali yomphakathi eluhlaza futhi kuphephile ukwenza njalo. Uma isignali yomphakathi ishintsha ivela eluhlaza iye kubomvu ngesikhathi uhamba, qhubeka ubheke emuva nasemaphakathini ukuze ubone izimoto ezisondela. Uma isibani somgwaqo esibomvu sishintsha sibe luhlaza, izimoto ezivela phambili nasezandleni nazo zinegunya lokuhamba manje. Qiniseka ukuthi abashayeli bakubona futhi bame ngaphambi kokuthi udlule. Umgwaqo uhlinzekwa ukuze usebenze wonke umuntu; ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhamba ngokushesha ukuze abashayeli baqhubeke. Ukuhamba emgwaqweni ezindaweni ezingekho ezibekwe kahle kuyingozi futhi kungaholela ekulimazeni noma ekufeni. Abashayeli balindele ukukubona ezindaweni ezibekwe kahle zokudlula: njengokudlula kwabantu okuhlinzekwe ngama-block, lapho kukhona izimpawu zokumisa noma izibani zomgwaqo, nokho, kufanele uhamba ngokushesha ukuze abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo baqhubeke. Lokhu kubizwa ngokwabelana ngomgwaqo nokuhlonipha abanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo. Gwema ukusebenzisa umgwaqo ngemuva kokuphuza utshwala/nokwelapha ngoba kuthinta ukubona kwakho nokulinganisa, futhi okubaluleke kakhulu, cross umgwaqo ngokushesha. Ukuhamba uphuzile kuyingozi njengokushayela uphuzile. Yini ukugcwalisa? Ukugcwalisa kuwukwenza komuntu onebhizinisi lokuhamba usebenzisa umgwaqo, umshayeli noma umgibeli, ukudlula umkhawulo wezimpahla ezisemthethweni zemoto, kungaba ngenhloso noma ngengozi. Ukugcwalisa nezimpahla ezingalungile kuholela ekufeni nasekukhathazekeni emigwaqweni yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo ofika kumamili ama-rand emigwaqweni nasezimotweni ezigcwele.

Into emqoka kakhulu yalezi zinguquko wuku lungisa isiphosiso esaphawulwa ngunyaka ka 2002 yikomidi elaliphenya indlela lezinhlelo zisebenza ngayo eningizimu afrika. Isiphosiso lesi kwakuwukuthi inkongozelo eyayihambelana nalemiholo yabadala kanye nesondlo sezingane yayingekho noma-ke kwakungeyona abantu abaningi ababengathembela kuyo. Umgomo omkhulu ongumkhombandlela wukuthi uhulumeni kufuneka asungule izindlela zokusebenza ezingathuthukisa inkongozelo ehambelana nemiholo yabadala kanye nesondlo sezingane okuyinto ezolekelelana nazo lezimpesheni eziphuma esikhwameni sikahulumeni ukuze kube nokubambhisana nomphakathi. Loku kuzosho ukuthi bonke abantu eMzansi bazabangamalungu omshuwarensi womphakathi ophethwe kahle kanti-ke labo abasebenzayo abathola iholo elithe xaxa bazaqhubeka bakhokhele iminshuwarensi yabo. Uhulumeni aqhubeke alekelele abadala ngeholo labo, nezingane ngesondlo sabo kodwa indlela eliphethwe ngayo lithuthukiswe. Angezele labo abahola iholo eliphansi imali ikakhulu intsha esandukucala ukusebenza. Uhulumeni akhokhise intela ezobhekana nawo lomsebenzi wezimpesheni, ukukhokhela abafile, nabakhubazekile kanye nabaphelelwe ngumsebenzi. Ungqongqoshe ophethe izimali kahulumeni uzakuninika yonke imininingwane ngesikhathi akhuluma ngeziphakelo zezimali zikahulumeni. Okufuna sikukhumbule kakhulu wukuthi uhulumeni, ukuze aqedelele loluhlelo, uzakukhulumisana nabantu kanye noNEDLAC. Ngaphezu kwaloku esengikhulume ngako, kukhona olunye uhlelo esilibhekayo lokusiza izingane ezihluphekayo ezineminyaka engaphezu kweshumi nane.

Kukhona izindlu ezinkulu, ezincane, nezindawo ezibizayo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bahlala kanjani ezindaweni ezinjengalezi? Ngabe kuba nezinselelo zokuhlala emakhaya amakhulu noma ezincane? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kukhona izinzuzo zokuphila emadolobheni. Izindawo eziningi zinezinsizakalo ezithuthukile, njengezokuthutha. Uthola izitimela, amabhasi, nezinsizakalo zokuhamba ezisheshayo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emsebenzini nasemakethe. Kodwa, kufanele uqaphele, ngoba izithuthi zingaba yinkinga, ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zokuhamba. Ucabanga ukuthi kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhamba emadolobheni? Ngaphezu kwalokho, amadolobha anikeza amathuba amaningi emisebenzi. Uma ungumuntu ofuna ukwakha umsebenzi, ungathola amathuba amaningi, kodwa lokho kudinga ukuzikhandla. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu bahlala benza kanjani ukuze bathole imisebenzi? Ngabe lokho akuyinkinga? Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amadolobha anikeza izinto eziningi. Uthola imicimbi, izinkanyezi, nezinkanyezi. Lokhu kudala umoya ophilayo. Futhi, uma ungumuntu othanda ubuciko, ungathola izindawo eziningi ezihlobene nobuciko, njengemibukiso, amaholo, nezinkanyezi zomculo. Ucabanga ukuthi ubuciko busebenza kanjani emadolobheni? Ekugcineni, ukuphila emadolobheni kunezinselelo nezinsiza. Uthola imizwa eminingi, futhi kufanele uqaphele. Kodwa, uma ungumuntu onomoya ophilayo, ungathola ukujabulisa nokufunda. Ngabe uthanda ukuphila emadolobheni? Ucabanga ukuthi izinzuzo zikhona noma izinkinga? Lokhu kuyinkinga engaphendulwa, futhi ngithanda ukwazi ukuthi ubona kanjani. Ngiyabonga ngokuba nathi kulolu hambo lokuphila emadolobheni.

Sithokozela indima edlalwe ngamalungu onke esigungu esikhulu kanye nabomeninjala bamaphrovinsi, bohulumeni bezifundazwe kanye nohulumeni wezwe lonkana, ekuholeni lomsebenzi kanye nasekufezekiseni izinhlelo zikahulumeni. Qedelela umsebenzi wokuhlolisisa ulwazi lwethu lokuhlanganisa izimpawu zomnotho ezifana namandla emali yakithi, ukukhuphuka kwentengo yezimpahla ezitolo kanye nemalinzalo ukuze kwelekelelwe izimboni ezikhiciza izimpahla ezizosetshenziswa lapha ekhaya kanye nezizokuthunyelwa kwamanye amazwe. Lezimboni zizakuthola amandla okuqasha abasebenzi asebanamakhono omsebenzi othize. Qinisa ngamandla ukufezekiswa ekwelekeleleni izinhlelo zokutshala izimali kokuthi ukusebenza kwamabhizinisi kunikezwe oqhwepheshe abazi kabanzi ngaloko, ezokuvakasha, uwoyela owakhiwe ngezilimo, izithako kanye nokuqedelela izinhlelo zamahlathi namaphepha, izimpahla zokwembhatha nezithungiweyo, izinsimbi nezobunjiniyela. Kwakha amacebo okuthi izimbiwa- iphansi zingathunyelwa kwamanye amazwe zeseseluhlaza, kodwa kwakhiwe khona lapha ekhaya izimpahla esingazisebenzisa, kwakhiwe namesu okuthuthukisa ezolimo nokulungisela okuvuniwe ukuba kungasetshenziswa, nokuthuthukisa imboni yabasebenza ngezimpahla ezithize ezingakajwayeleki kanye nemboni yabantu abaziqambela imisebenzi emihle, nemisebenzi yomphakathi kanye nezamapilisi. Loku kufuneka ukuthi kube nokuzimisela okukhulu ukuthi sikhicize izimpahla esingazisebenzisa ukuze sakhe okunye njengemishini emikhulu yokubaza noma yokukhanda okuthize. Embonini yamadayimane, singabumbha ibandla lesizwe elizothenga u 10% wamadayimane kulabo abawembhayo, siwathengisele labo abazowasika bakhe izindandatho zemishado.

Okwesihlanu, izibhedlela zidinga ukwandisa ukuphuculwa kwezinsizakalo zabo zokubeletha. Ukubhekelela izidingo zempilo nezempilo kusemqoka, ukufaka phakathi ukugxila kumqondo ophumela endaweni yokuhlala. Ukukhethwa kokubeletha ekuhlobiseni okwenziwe amakhasi kumele kube okuphathekayo ukuze kwandiswe ubuchwepheshe bokubambisana, futhi sizame ukugcina ubungcweti kulokhu. Lokhu kufanele kumantshintshise izinqubo engagehluke ngobukhulu, okuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe bokubambisana. Ekugcineni, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukuhlonishwa nokubhekelelwa. Umama nomntwana kumele baphathwe njengabahlonishwa, futhi ubuningi bezinsizakalo zidinga ukuthuthukiswa nsuku zonke. Sizingelwa ngokuphuculwa kwezinsizakalo, okukhulumayo kumele kuhlanganywa nokuqondiswa kwemihlangano okukhombisa ukukhuluma nokuqonda okukhulu ngalokhu. Uma sithathela phezulu izidingo zempilo, kuzokwandza kuhle ukukhulisa umphakathi nohlelo lokuhlalisana. Ngakho, izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zidinga ukuba indawo yokuguqula – indawo yokukhazimula, hhayi ithuba lokuphoxeka. Ngaphandle kokubhalela obala izinkinga, sikhumbula ukuthi izinqubo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zingaphezu kwezincwadi. Kufanele kube isikhumbuzo sokuthi indawo yokubeletha iyindawo yokukhula, nothugela umntwana ophila kahle. Siyanakiqabula! Izinqubo zokubeletha azibhalwa ngezinkanyezi, kepha zihlala zifuna inkanyezi ezimbalwa, izinkanyezi ezihamba phambili ezimpilweni zethu.
