Ukuzalisa kusuka ku-R1 yezigidi kuye ku-R3 yezigidi. Inhloso yomkhiqizo ukulungiselela ukuguqula ukuba ngabanikazi bamafemu kanye nokugqugquzela ukuba ngabanikazi babaqashwa ngokubanzi. Ukuxhaswa kwezimali okuzokuba ngezimo zombili zokuba yisikweletu kanye nemali yokulinganisa, izokusetshenziselwa ukuthenga abaphumayo, ukuthenga abaphathi abeza ngaphakathi, ukuthenga abaqashwa abeza ngaphakathi kanye nokuba ngabanikazi bamasheya ngabaqashwa. Ifemu elifanelekile ukuthola lesi sikhwama kumele kube yinkampani engenziwanga uhlu enqunyelwe, abaqondisi kumele bazimbandakanye emisebenzini inani lebhizinisi kumele libe ngaphakathi kwama-R10 ezigidi kanye nama-R50 Ezigidi kanye nama-26% emali yokulinganisa okumele iqondiswe kubunikazi babamnyama. Izifundazwe eziningi zinezazo izikhwama zokuzithuthukisa. Sebenzisa lolu luhlu ukuxhumana nabo ngqo ukuthola ulwazi olwengeziwe. Ithala yenza ngokuphambanisa ukuthuthukisa kuyo yonke indawo esifundeni saKwaZulu-Natali futhi umsebenzi osemqoka ukuhambisa ukuzalisa kwezokuvakasha esifundeni. Manje njengoba ngimile ngiqalise Nokusebenza... Okubi ukuthi amaningi amabhizinisi amasha ayehluleka eminyakeni emithathu yawo yokuqala yokusebenza. Kusemqoka ukusebenzisa lonke usizo olukhona ukuqinisekisa impumelelo yakho. I-Khula, Ngohlelo Lokweluleka i-Thuso, isiza ngokukhokhelela izinsizakalo zomeluleki onolwazi ngempilo isikhathi esiyizinyanga ezi-3 ukuzukela ngenkathi unikezwa imali mboleko. Loku kweyeme ekutheni kwenziwe ikontileka phakathi kwe-Thuso kanye Nomeluleki, esho izinhloso zokweluleka kanye nesikhathi esizothathwa ukwethula loko.

Izinkinga Zamanzi Emiphakathini: Isidingo Sokubheka Ngezindlela Ezihlukahlukene Emiphakathini yethu, izinkinga zamanzi zibe yinkinga enkulu, ethinta impilo, ezemvelo, kanye nezomnotho. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi eziphukile, konke lokhu kudala izinselelo ezinzima. Njengoba sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, kubalulekile ukuthi sihlole izimbangela zazo, izimpawu, kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amanzi ayisisekelo sempilo. Ngaphandle kwamanzi ahlanzekile, impilo yomphakathi ibhekene nezingozi ezinkulu. Izifo ezithathelwanayo, ezifana ne-cholera ne-typhoid, zikhula lapho abantu bengenayo imithombo yamanzi ahlanzekile. Lokhu kubangela ukwanda kwezindleko zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okwenza kube nzima kumiphakathi ethwele kanzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantwana, ikakhulukazi, bahlaselwa kakhulu, njengoba izifo ezihlobene namanzi zingathinta ukukhula kwabo nokufunda. Ngokuphathelene nokungcoliswa kwamanzi, lokhu kuyinkinga ebonakalayo emiphakathini eminingi. Imithombo yamanzi iyahlaselwa ngukukhipha imfucumfucu, imfucuza yezimboni, kanye nezinsiza zokulima. Lokhu kudala umphumela omubi emvelweni, kuholele ekunciphiseni kwezinto eziphilayo, futhi kuphazamise izinhlelo zokuphila zabantu. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi akukhona nje kuphela okuthinta impilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kuthinta nezilwane nezitshalo, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imithombo yethu yamanzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Emiphakathini eminingi, izinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi zikhona, kodwa azisebenzi kahle.

C.2.14 akumele ibeke impilo yabanye noma eyayo engcupheni ngokungalandeli imithetho yokuphepha noma ngokuyigwema. C3.17 akumele ithathe ingxenye emibuthanweni ephikisana nezinga lokusebenza futhi engemthethweni. C.4.6 ingacela ukuthi ingathathi ingxenye ezinqumweni noma ezinyathelweni emsebenzini ezisemthethweni uma lokhu kungaholela ekutholeni inzuzo engafanele ngendlela engalungile, engakhethi, futhi ebandlululayo. C 4.16 ezimeni eziphuthumayo ingacelwa nguMphathi woMnyango ukuba enze imisebenzi ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi, noma uma kungesikhathi esijwayelekile sokusebenza kodwa kuyisimo esingaphansi kokulawulwa koMphathi woMnyango futhi sinesidingo esidinga isinyathelo esisheshayo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zeMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni. C.4.31 akumele iphule umthetho ezindaweni zomphakathi. C.5.3 akumele isebenzise isikhundla sayo emsebenzini ukuze ithole imiklomelo nokukhwabanisa umphakathi nezinye izinzuzo futhi ayikwazi ukwamukela noma yini uma kubonakala sengathi iyikhwabaniso. Yonke imiklomelo kufanele ibhalwe phansi futhi ifakwe kwi-rejista yemiklomelo. C.6.1 ngezizathu zokuxhumana ngaphakathi, kufanele usebenzise isiNgisi njengolimi lokuxhumana futhi lokhu kufanele kube sobala kuzo zonke izenzo zomsebenzi zangaphakathi (okungukuthi, imibhalo, imihlangano, njll.). C 6.5 kufanele ihambisane nezindinganiso zobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana ngekhompyutha njengoba kushiwo. C.7.11 kufanele ikhuthaze isiko lokwethembana ngokwazisa njalo nokuqinisa. D.1.

Ukupha Izihambi (indawo yokuhlala) kuphathelene nokunikeza indawo yokuhlala, isib. Ukulala kanye nokudla kwasekuseni, indlu yezivakashi, indawo lapho ungaziphekela khona, amahostela entsha, imothela, ihhotela, njll. I-MICE (Imihlangano, Incentives, Ikhonferensi kanye neZehlakalo) yisigaba inhloso yaso eqavile ukuhlela kanye/noma ukuphatha imihlangano kanye nezinye izehlakalo ezifana nemibukiso futhi ukwazi nokuhlela ukuthi abakhethwa bomhlangano bathole itiye kanye nokudla kwasemini. Sisonke sizokwakha umkhiqizo wezokuvakasha ongakwazi ukuthengiswa kwamanye amazwe ngemibukiso yamazwe ngamazwe, egqugquzela izivakashi ukuthi zize ukuzobona ukuthi izwe lethu elihle lingabanikezani isib. Usebe lolwandle oluhle kakhulu, izimpawu zomlando, abantu abanobungane, izindawo zokuthenga kanye nezindawo eziningi nezihehayo eziyingqayizivele yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ezokuvakasha ziphathelene cishe nenye nenye imisebenzi ezweni ngandlela thize. Kodwa asebenzisa eyodwa noma eziningi (umuntu ophakathi). Kanye nendlela ezisebenza ngayo zizonke, ukuletha izihambi ukusuka ezindaweni ezikuzo emhlabeni ukuza eNingizimu Afrika. Ngakho-ke kusemqoka ukuthi uthole ukuqonda okucacile kokuthi ngubani ozosebenzisa imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zakho ekugcineni, odinga ukubhekana naye endleleni yakho yokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi lakho. Sifake ngezansi umdwebo wokuthi le ndlela ingasebenza kanjani kumnikezeli wezokuhlala, nokuthi ngubani otholani kule nqubo. Uzobona ukuthi abaphakathi bonke bathola izinzuzo eveka kubanikezeli bezokuhlala - ngokwempela, bangabanikezeli bezinsizakalo zokumaketha kumnikazi wendawo yokuhlala.

Imikhiqizo yezolimo emikhulu etholakala kuMasipala Wendawo yasebaQulusini imbandakananya izingodo, amasimo okusanhlamvu (ummbila, amakinati, ubhontshisi, ujikanelanga, izithelo kanye namabele) kanye nemfuyo. Izingodo eziningi zihanjiswa ezindaweni ezingaphandle, futhi imbonyana yezingodo seyidlondlobele kakhulu kule minyaka emibalwa eyedlule. Amahlathi Ezingodo maningi kakhulu eNyakatho ye-Vryheid ne-Glukstad, kanye naseNingizimu yoKhambi. Uwatela yisona sivuno sezihlahla ebesilokhu sikhethwa kule minyaka emibalwa eyedlule ngenxa yokudingeka kanye nokubaluleka kwaso emakethe yezinkuni. Kunokwentuleka okukhulu kohlobo lwefayibha ezimakethe emhlabeni- jikelele, nokuyithuba elisazovuleleka embonini yezingodo EbaQulusini. Amathuba okuxetshulwa kwezinkuni endaweni noma ukushukwa kwamagxolo kawatela akabhekisiswa ngokwanele, nakuba kuvela ukuthi amathuba amakhulu awokukhiqizwa kwezinkuni ukuze kuhlomule i-Richards Bay. Okwamanje, inselelo enkulu ebhekene nezolimo ebaQulusini imayelana nokubuyekezwa komhlaba. Kubalulekile ukuthi izixazululo zitholakale ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umkhiqizo wezolimo usimeme. Iningi lamapulazi liyathinteka odabeni lwemizamo yokubuyekezwa komhlaba ebe kuyiwona anamasimu ezingodo ezidingekayo kanye nezimvume zokutshalwa kwezihlahla- okungummnotho omkhulu kwezolimo. Lokhu kubukeka sengazuthi nalezi zikhalo ezingakaxazululwa zivimbela ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwalezi zindawo. Imboni yezokuvakasha yasebaQulusini ikhula kancane kancane, futhi ikhombisa ukuqhubeka nokudlondlobala ngamandla amakhulu.

Imali ethile kufanele ihlinzeke izifunda ezinomthelela omkhulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana nabantu abasha bahlala bejolise emgibeni wokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuphatha, ezinjengokuhlinzeka ngezinyathelo zokuqapha, kudinga ukuthi zibukwiswe ngokukhalipha. Umphakathi wezomnotho uzoba nesandla ekwakheni umsebenzi, uma kubhekwa izindlela ezizokwazi ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubantu abasha futhi baphinde bakwazi ukuxhuma nezinhlelo ezinhle zokwenza abatekenya. Ekuhlaziyeni kwesimo sokutholakala kwentsha, kudinga ukubhekiselwa ezinhlelweni ezenzakalelayo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukukhuthaza uhlelo lokubjobiya ezikhundleni ezintsha, ukujikijela izifundo ezimfushane zokusebenza, nezinye izinhlelo ezikwenziwayo zokwakha indawo yokusebenza engcono nesikhala. Lokhu kuzokwenza umuntu ngamunye akwazi ukubona intuthuko, okuzenzakalelayo kunciphisa indlela yokusebenza eziningi. Ukufingqa, ukuhlola izimo ezizwakalayo nezokungasebenzi kwentsha kumele kube ugqozi oluqinile emphakathini nabaphathiswa. Iphalamende, izinkampani, nezinkampani zomphakathi kudinga ukuba baxhumane futhi bakhe izinkambiso ezizokhulisa iscripe sesikhathi esizayo. Uma siphuma kulesi simo, sizoba neziphumo ezihlangene, nezinhlelo ezenzakalelayo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwentsha. Lokhu kuzoletha ushintsho olusemthethweni, oluqinile nolwanelisayo, ukuze kwenzeke ukuguqulwa okudingekayo empilweni yabantu abasha. Ngalokhu, sizodinga ukuqhubeka nokuxoxisana, noma ngabe kuhlelwe imihlangano erhubhulayo nezinhlelo eziphambili, ukuze sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinethuba lokusebenza, noluthokozisayo.

Wokuhlinzekela ukusungulwa kwesikhungo sokuthuthukiswa komnotho esizokwaziwa ngokuthi isiKhungo sezoHwebo nokuTshalwa kweziMali saKwaZulu-Natali ukuze kuhehwe utshalomali lwalapha ekhaya nolwasemazweni angaphandle futhi kwandiswe impahla engenayo nephumayo esiFundazweni; wokunquma ngezinhloso, amandla, kanye nemisebenzi yesiKhungo; wokunquma indlela okuzophathwa, kubuswe, kuqashwe futhi kusekwe ngayo isiKhungo ngezimali; wokuhlinzekela ukwakhiwa kweNqubomgomo yesiFundazwe yokuTshalwa kweziMali neMpahla ePhumayo; nokuhlinzekela okunye okuphathelene nalokho. "iNkampani eseMthethweni" kusho inkampani njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 1(1) soMthetho weziNkampani eziseMthethweni, 1984 (uMthetho No. "inkampani" kusho inkampani njengoba kuchaziwe eMthethweni weziNkampani, 1973 uMthetho No. "INkampani" kusho inhlangano edidiyelwe ngokwesigaba 21 soMthetho weziNkampani, 1973 uMthetho No. "uMnyango kaMgcinimafa kaZwelonke" kusho uMnyango kaMgcinimafa kaZwelonke osungulwe yisigaba 5 soMthetho wokuPhathwa kweziMali zikaHulumeni, 1999 uMthetho No. "kohulumeni basekhaya abahleliwe" kusho inhlangano yesifundazwe emele omasipala KwaZulu-Natali, eyaziwa ngokwesigaba 163 soMthethosisekelo kanye nesigaba 2 soMthetho koHulumeni baseKhaya abaHleliwe, 1997 uMthetho No. "lo Mthetho" ubandakanya imithethonqubo.

Umuntu, inhlangano, noma ikhomishini ebhekiswe esigabeni 20 salo Mthetho, efuna ukulethela udaba enkantolo noma ukufaka isikhalazo ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho, ingakwenza lokhu ngokwazisa umregistrar wenkantolo ngentshisekelo yabo yokwenza lokhu besebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 2 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Kumele bacela umphenduli ukuba banikeze ulwazi olubhaliwe olukhulunywe esigabeni 3 seFomu 3 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-10 kusukela ngosuku lokwamukela leso sikhumbuzo. Umregistrar kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokwamukela impendulo evela kumphenduli obhekiswe esigabeni (2)(b) ngenhla, athumele ikhophi noma isithombe salo mpendulo kumfaki-sicelo noma kumuntu olethe udaba. Umregistrar kumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esibhekiswe esigabeni (2)(b) ngenhla, athumele udaba kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokwamukela wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nalolo daba, akhiphe isinqumo sokuthi udaba luzophakanyiswa enkantolo noma luthunyelwe kwenye iforamu. Uma umphathi ophakanyisiwe ethatha isinqumo sokuthi udaba kufanele luphakanyiswe enkantolo, kumele athumele udaba kumregistrar, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokwamukela lolo daba, abeke usuku lokulalelwa kwalolo daba. Umregistrar kumele, ngemuva kokubeka usuku lokulalelwa kwalolo daba, wazise umfaki-sicelo nomphenduli ngaleso sikhathi sokulalelwa besebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 4 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure.

Kwesinye isikhathi uhulumeni uyawashushisa lamacala, kodwa kuyenzeka aqoke ukuyekela. Isibonelo, uma ebona bungekho ubufakazi obenele ukumthola enecala umuntu. Wena ungazikhethela ukuqhuba icala ngoba ubona kusemqoka ukumshushisa lowomuntu. INEMA iyakusiza ke lapha ukwenza lento. Kube sekuthiwa lelicala ngelishushiswa ngasese noma ngokuzimela. Uyoludinga usizo lommeli ukulungiselela icala. Icala lifakwe ngokubhekela izifiso nentshisekelo yomphakathi noma ngenhloso yokuvikela imvelo. Ngeke wakwazi ukubeka icala ingxenye ewuphiko lukahulumeni, ngaphandle kweziwombe ezimbalwa kakhulu. Ungacela ummeli wakho ukwenza lokhu. Lapho likulahlile icala, ummangalelwa angacela inkantolo ukuba wena umkhokhele zonke izindleko zecala. Udaba lokukhokha izindleko zecala zingagwemeka lapho isenzo sakho sihlomulisa noma sihlose ukuvikela imvelo noma umphakathi. Eminye imininingwane ngokuzishushisela izokwethulwa endimeni 7.10. Ngemuva kokufunda lokho osekushiwo ngasenhla, uma ucabanga ukuthi kunokwephulwa komthetho wezemvelo, kungenzeka ukuthole kuyimfanelo ukuthatha isinyathelo sokunqanda umonakalo emvelweni, kungavela kuwe noma emphakathini. Ziningi izinto ongazenza ukuvimbela umonakalo ongase wenzeke noma uqhubeke. Ezinye zazo zingabandakanya ukuqasha ummeli ukuze akusize. Ungakwazi nokubhalela uhulumeni izincwadi ukuqiniseka ukuthi kwenziwa uphenyo bese kuthathwa nezinyathelo zokumisa umonakalo owenzekayo. Zingaba khona nezinye izindlela ongakwazi ukuzisebenzisa. Kubalulekile ukucabanga ngayo yonke imigudu ekhona kuhlangene nebhalwe phansi nengaqoshiwe. Izinhlangano eziningi zinemigudu yazo eziyilandelayo ukufaka izikhalo.

Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngesincomo sikadokotela. Iziguli ezidinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lukahulumeni lezempilo akufanele zicele ukuhlolwa kwasendlini yocwaningo lwesayensi. Siyazi ukuthi yilokhu okwenzeka njengamanje emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akukhokona okufunwa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele belaphe izimo ezisolekayo ngokwamazinga okwedlulisa ulwazi (protocol) ahlinzekwe nguMnyango Kazwelonke Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa onelungelo lokuzikhethela kona yi-Tamiflu. Ukwelashwa kukawonke wonke nge-Tamflu kuzoholela ekuqabeni kokulapheka uma kusetshenziswa lo muthi futhi kungenza ukuthi ungasebenzi nakulabo ongahlenga izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi olutholakale emhlabeni wonke ngukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikole nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, amamoli okuthenga nezindawo zokusebenzela akusebenzi kusukela ekusabalaleni kokufa. Kodwa, lokhu kudala ukuthikamezeka okukhulu enhlalweni. Seluleka ukuthi noma ngabe yimuphi umfundi, umfundisi noma umsebenzi onezimpawu ezingcono ukuba ahlale ekhaya. Uma bebaningi abafundi futhi/noma abafundisi abaphuthayo, isikhungo esithintekayo kuzofanele sithinte uMnyango Wezemfundo, ozobe ngokuhlanganyela neziphathimandla zezempilo usululeka ngokufanele kwenziwe ukuqhubekela phambili. Uma unezimpawu ezingcono, hlala ekhaya futhi nqanda ukuhlangana nabantu. Ngifisa ukuniqinisekisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemndleni emhlabeni wonke besebenzisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola ikhambi. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, ikhambi elifana naleli lingakhona ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Kodwa, kunesindingo esikhulu kabi sekhambi nokukhiqizwa obukhulu bako bunganele - ubukhulu obungekho e-Afrika.

Ukuqinisekisa ubulungisa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Umdidiyeli ungumphathi Wethuba Elilinganayo Nokwesekwa Kwabantu Abandile. Ukuphatha nokulawula iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi namakhono ahlobene nokuvikela umhlaba ukuze kuvikelwe iRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika (RSA) ngokuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa kwezokuphepha komhlaba nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukulungela kwempi ngosizo oluhlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo namakhono ahlobene nokwesekwa nokwelashwa. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa ngokusungula isikhungo sezinqubomgomo zokwesekwa kwezempilo ezimisweni zempi nokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina ukwesekwa kwezempilo okubalulekile kubalungu beNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF) kanye nezincike zabo noma labo abaxhaswe ngezimali nokusungula nokugcina izinsiza zokwesekwa nezinto ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezobuhlakani ekuphathweni nasekuphathweni kolwazi lwezokuphepha ngokusungula, ukuqeqesha, nokugcina uxhaso lwezobuhlakani kwiMpi, ukusiza ekusekeleni, nakwezinye izindaba ezihlobene nezinto zokusebenza. Ukuhlela umsebenzi wezisebenzi zeNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezemfundo kubo bonke amalunga eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela kanye nezincike zabo nokukhuthaza ukukhula komoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuqondisa okuvela enhlanganweni yempi.

Ngezizathu ezibikwe ngenhla izinqolobane zomlando zihlangabezana nobunzima ekuphatheni ngokukhalima ukudluliselwa kwemininingwane yomphakathi okuhlelekileyo. Ngezizathu esizithinte ngenhla. Ukudluliselwa okuningi kuze kwahlehliswa ngenxa yenkinga yendawo. UMthetho waseNingizimu Afrika wezinqolobane ufuna ukuthii zinqolobane zigcizelele inzuzo ekuqoqeni izinto okungezona ezompakathi omphakathi ngoba lokhu kuyogcwalisa izikhala ekubambeni kwabo imininingwane yomphakathi. izinqolobane seziseqalise izinhlelo ezinhlobonhlobo zomlando oxoxwayo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ingxoxo njengesiko lemvelo kanye nomtapo wamagugu, ingalahleki. ngo-2000 uhlelo lukazwelonke lomlando oxoxwayo (National Oral History) luholwa uMnyango futhi luxhunyaniswa izinqolobane lwasungulwa. Lokhu kwakungukupheleliswa kohlelo lokuqala lomlando oxoxwayo nolwabikwa ngo-1999. Kusenezithiyo ezikhona ekutholakaleni kwemininingwane, neyadalwa ngokomlando wubandlululo. Ngakhoke umthetho uphoqa izinqolobane ukuba zithole izindlela zokuxazulula lenkinga ngokugcizelela amalinge alungisayo nahlose ekutheni afinyelele kumalunga omphakathi anamathuba amancane. Zonke izinqolobane / izindawo zokugcina imininingwane ezakha izinqolobane zangena ezinhlelweni zokwandisa ulwazi eziningi ngonyaka ka-2000. lezinhlelo zazifaka amahora engeziwe ukulungiselela abantu abasebenzayo, ukuvakashela amaqembu, imibukiso, izifundo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, ukwethula amapepha (Conference Papers) ama-workshops. Izinqolobane zenza izinsiza ezisiza ekwethuleni abafundi basezikoleni ezinqolobaneni zesizwe.

Amaziko ezempilo kufanele avumele ukutholakala kwezinto zokuqeqeshwa kunoma ubani obhaliswe ngaphansi kwaloMthetho. UNobhala kufanele asuse kulejista igama lomhlengikazi osafunda, noma enze uphawu elegisteni egameni lanoma imuphi umuntu, omisiwe ukunquba izifundo zakhe futhi abhalele azise lowo mhlengikazi osafunda noma umuntu ngalokho. c enalo lonke ulwazi lomsebenzi, amakhono nobuciko; noma d ekulelizwe laseRiphablikhi okwesikhashana esincane ukuzosebenza, ezocwaninga noma ezofunda. a leso sikhathi esimiswe uMkhandlu, esingeqile eminyakeni emithathu; futhi b ngaphansi kwemibandela emiswe uMkhandlu. Umuntu obhaliswe ngokwalesi sigaba osebenza ngendlela eyaphula lokho okushiwe kusigatshana 2 uyakuba necala kanti uma elahlwa icala uyakuhlawuliswa noma aphonswe ejele isikhathi esingeqile eminyakeni emibili noma kokubili inhlawulo nokubhadla ejele. Ngokuhambisana nalokho okushiwo yisigatshana nokukhokhwa kwemali enqunyiwe, uMkhandlu ungabhalisa iziqu ezengeziwe zomuntu obhaliswe ngokwesigaba 31 nofake isicelo esibhaliwe sokubhaliswa, uma ehambisana nemibandela enqunyiwe nokunikezela ngemininingwane enqunyiwe. Yiziqu ezinqunyiwe kuphela ezingabhaliswa ngokwalesi sigaba. Ilejista kufanele igcinwe ehhovisini likaNobhala, futhi uMkhandlu ungayala ukuba kweziwe imifanekiso yelejista noma uhlu olwengeziwe olukhombisa okwengeziwe, okusuliwe, isichibiyelo noma ukubukezwa okwenziwe kusukela kukhonjiswe imifanekiso welejista ephelele, kwenziwe, kubhalwe noma kusakazwe noma kukhonjiswe kumakhompuyutha ngesikhathi ezingamiswa yiwona uMkhandlu ngokubona kwawo.

Ngemuva kokwenza isinqumo ngesicelo, umkhandlu noma enye inhlangano kufanele ibike iMEC ngokubhalwe phansi phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 ngemuva kokwenziwa kwesinqumo, futhi uma isicelo samukelwa, kufanele bahlinzeke ngezizathu eziphelele zaleso sinqumo ngokubhalwe phansi kwiMEC phakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe. I-MEC inelungelo lokuphikisa isinqumo, phakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-28 zokuthola isinqumo nezizathu zokwamukela isicelo, ngokuhambisa ngenqubo echazwe ngumthetho ofanele futhi benza izinguquko ezidingekayo, ukuze bayithumele kwi- authority noma kwi-council yokudlulisela izikhalazo ezihlinzekwe kumthetho ofanele, uma umthetho ofanele uthi izikhalazo kufanele zithunyelwe kuMphakathi, noma kunoma yiliphi ilungu leKomidi Eliphezulu, Ummeleli Kahulumeni esifundeni, isikhalazo kufanele silalelwe futhi siqedwe yiBhodi Yezikhandla Zomphakathi njengokuthi le Bhodi Yezikhandla inenhloso yokugcina mayelana nendaba yezomthetho ephathelene nesikhalazo. a ukuthi kukhona imvume ebhaliwe evela kwiMEC futhi ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezisunguliwe yiMEC; noma b ngokuhambisana nendlela ekhona ebhalisiwe. noma ukuthi kufanele kube kukhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 10; noma iii yenqubo noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi.

Ibhukuda Liyanda eNingizimu Afrika Isingeniso Uma ubheka eNingizimu Afrika, uyakwazi ukubona ubuhle bemvelo obuhambisana namanzi, kusukela ogwini lwezindawo ezithokozisayo ezifana ne-Kwazulu-Natal, kuya ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni ezifana nemifula nemithombo. Kulokhu, ukubhukuda sekubuye kwaba yindlela ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu, kungokwezempilo, ukuhlanganyela, noma ukujabulisa. Lokhu kubonakala ngempela emicimbini emisha yokubhukuda yeNingizimu Afrika, njengoba abantu abaningi bejabulela ubuchwepheshe obusha bokubhukuda. Ukukhula Kwezokubhukuda Ukubhukuda akusona nje umkhuba wokuzivocavoca, kodwa futhi kuyindawo yokuphumula, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona. Izikhungo ezahlukene zikhuthaza imicimbi yokwakha ubuqotho kanye neqhaza elibalulekile lokuthuthukisa impilo enempilo. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zendlela yokuphila ehloniphekile, imiphakathi iyazama ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokubhukuda ezisebenza kahle ezindaweni ezahlukene. Umphakathi wase-Ethekwini ugxile ekwakheni izikhungo ezithuthukisiwe zokubhukuda, kulandela umsebenzi omuhle owenziwe ngaphambilini. Othisha basebenza ngokubambisana nezinsiza zomphakathi ukuze kufundiswe izingane, futhi baqale imicimbi emisha yokubhukuda, okwanika ithuba lokuthakasela izipho zempilo. Izinzuzo Zokubhukuda Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi ukubhukuda kunenzuzo enkulu empilweni. Abahlali baveza ukuthi ukuhamba emanzini kubasiza ukuphumuza ingqondo, kwenze bazise ukuthi baphila kahle, ngokwenyama nangokwengqondo. Lo mkhuba ukhuthaza abasebenzisi ukuba babe nomoya opholile, bajabulele ubuchwepheshe obutholakala ezikhungweni zokubhukuda.

Isithombe 1: Lokhu kuzokwenzeka uma ushaya ummbila ngamakhemikhali ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Isithombe 2: Qiniseka ukuthi ushaya amakhemikhali ngendlela efanele. Amakhemikhali asetshenziselwa ezolimo angalimaza kakhulu izitshalo zakho uma engafakwa ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo nangokucophelela. Ukulandela izinyathelo ezifanele uma uthenga futhi ufaka amakhemikhali kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ukulimala kwezitshalo zakho. Ingabe kukhona ikhemikhali ethile ebhaliswe ukuze ifakwe emasimini athile (lapha eNingizimu Afrika) futhi ukuze ibulale izitshalo ezithile noma izifo ezithile? Ingabe ufake inani elifanele lekhemikhali ngokuhambisana nemiyalelo? Ingabe isimo sezulu ngesikhathi sokufaka nokuphuma kuhambisana nemiyalelo? Ingabe isikhathi sokufaka ikhemikhali sihamba kahle nemiyalelo, ngokwesibonelo: ekuseni noma ntambama? Ingabe isimo sehlathi lapho ifakwe sifeza izidingo zekhemikhali, ngokwesibonelo: umswakama nohlobo lomhlabathi? Ingabe ikhemikhali efakiwe ihambisana nemiyalelo mayelana nosayizi wezitshalo ofuna ukuzibulala? Imiphumela - ikhemikhali oyifakile akufanele ilimele ezinye izitshalo uma ushintsha izitshalo minyaka yonke - ingabe ngeke ibulale izitshalo zokudla ozohlela ukuzitshala unyaka ozayo? Ikhemikhali oyisebenzisayo ingahlanganiswa namanye amakhemikhali noma cha - ngokwesibonelo: ukuhlanganisa i-herbicide ethile namanye amakhemikhali abulala izinsongo nezifo? Imiyalelo yokufaka ikhemikhali kufanele ibhalwe phansi futhi isayinwe ngumfaki. Abalimi kufanele babe nenhlonipho uma beshaya amakhemikhali ngoba amakhemikhali angahamba. Kungaba nesixwayiso esikhulu ezitshalo eziseduze ezingalimala ngamakhimikali.

Kungani kubalulekile ukulawula ukuhlanya ezitshalo zokudla? Ukuhlanya kukh competition nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi emhlabathini, ngezinto ezidingekayo emhlabathini, nendawo yokukhula, nangokukhanya (ilanga). Le competition ibangela ukuthi izitshalo zingakhuli kahle, futhi umkhiqizo wehla. Kungase futhi ku contaminating imbewu futhi kwehlise izinga lezi zimbewu. Le competition iyahluka - ezinye izinhlobo zokuhlanya azibeki ubungozi obukhulu kwezinye izitshalo - ubungozi bungaba buphansi, njenge 10%, kodwa bungakhuphuka bube ngu 98%. Ukuhlanya kuqala ukukh competition nezinye izitshalo uma seziqinisekisile izimpande eziqinile - ngemva kokuvuthwa. Ukulawula ukuhlanya kusho ukuvimbela le competition, nokuvimbela ukuhlanya ekukhiqizeni imbewu ezovutha futhi zikh competition nezitshalo ezizotshalwa ngonyaka ozayo. Bonke abalimi abafuna ukuphumelela ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zokudla kumele balwe nezinye izitshalo ngaso sonke isikhathi - ukuhlanya kuyinkinga enkulu. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlanya kulawulwa kusetshenziswa imishini ngokuhlanza noma ngamakhemikhali - kuvame ukuthi zombili lezi zindlela zisetshenziswe. Uma umalimi elawula kahle ukuhlanya, insimu izoveza kuphela izitshalo ezitshalwe - akukho ukuhlanya! Kodwa kuvame ukuthi lokhu kungahambi kalula, futhi ukuhlanya kuqhubeka. Kungani ukuhlanya kungase kulawulwe kahle? Kukhona izinto ezintathu ezingaholela ekulawulweni okungasebenzi kahle - eyokuqala ingaba indlela yokuhlanza kanye nomshini osetshenziswayo, eyesibili ingaba i-herbicide efakwe, futhi yokugcina ingaba izimo zezulu. Izilungiselelo zomshini zingase zingabi seduze, futhi kungase kube nezikhala, okuvumela umhlabathi phakathi kwezithako ukuthi ungahlanzi kahle (uma ziqinile, azizokwazi ukusebenza kahle).

b. Inyama (inkomo, ingulube, izinyane lemvu, imvu, inkuku, ikakalikuni, idada, inyama yenyamazane, noma enye inyama - inhlanzi noma okunye kwaselwandle)? c. Izithelo nemifino? d. Ubisi namaqanda? e. Izinongo nowoyela usawoti, ushukela, ukhari, u-garlic, i-ginger, u-pepper, upelepele, noma okunye - ibhotela, amafutha, utelu amafutha kakhokhonathi, amafutha esundu, amafutha emifino, uwoyela kakolweni? f. Iziphuzo nokunue okungetshwala njengekhofi, itiye, ujusi, amanzi nonemenayidi. g. Ugwayi notshwala (kumbandakanya ubhiya, iwayini, nogologo)? h. Ukudla okudliwe ngaphandle komuzi (isibonelo, kwabadayisayo, emakhosombeni kumbe emathilomu)? Konke okunye ukudla. Singabonga uma ungasinikeza inani selilonke lamali eniyichitha ngokudla ekhaya lakho. Ezinsukwini ezingu 7 ezedlule, umuzi wakini usebenzise malini ngalokhu nokudla jikelele? Manje sengifisa ukudlulela kuzindleko zomuzi wakho kuzinsuku ezingama- 30 ezedlule. Esikubabele kakhulu ke yizindleko ezivamile ezingesizona zokudla zekhaya. a. Izindlu nezinsiza (i-renti, ibhondi, uGesi, okubaswa ngakho, amanzi, uthelefoni)? b. Okokugqoka (izicathulo, izigqoko, amayembe, amabhlukwe, amalokwe, izikhethi, amabhantshi, amajazi) nokunye ke nje komuntu (insipho, ishampu, izimonyo, ukhilimu wokushefa)? c. Izinto zokuhamba (imali yebhasi, imali yamathekisi, izindleko zokukhanda imoti, uphethroli)?

Ayikho into eyoyekelwa kuthathwe amashansi ekuvikeleni imicimbi kanye nezwe lethu. Ukutshalwa kwezimali kuzoqhubeka nokusiza amaphoyisa emizameni yawo yokulwa nobugebengu emva kwesikhathi eside iNdebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA yowezi-2010 yadlula. Kuzosetshenziswa izigidi ezingama-R665 ekuthengeni impahla enhle kakhulu, kubandakanya impahla yokulawula izixuku, izindiza ezingasebenzi, izindiza ezinophephela emhlane, amakhenoni asemanzini ayi-10, ama-BMW ayi-100 okuzulazula emgwaqeni owuthelawayeka kanye nabavikele umzimba abangomahamba nendlwana. Izikhungo ezine zemiyalelo yobuchwepheshe obuphezulu zizokhavwa bukhoma ezindizeni nakwamanye amakhamera. Umbutho onikezelwe wabasebenzi abayi-41 000 ozothunyelwa ngqo ku- Ndebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA yowezi-2010. Engqungqutheleni Yamazwe Omhlaba Yentuthuko Eqhubekayo eyayibanjelwe eNingizimu Afrika (World Summit on Sustainable Development, South Africa), iNingizimu Afrika yakhombisa isibonelo sezokuvikeleka esavunywa njengokufanele kuqhathaniswe ngakho izinga okuyinto entsha emhlabeni jikelele - osekwamukelwa Izizwe Ezihlangene njengesibonelo semicimbi emikhulu. Kutshalwe amabhiliyoni ayi-R1.5 ekwenzeni ngcono amazinga ezindawo zokungena, kanti namalungiselelo e-Ndebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA yowezi-2010 enza ngcono izinqubo zokungena ezweni ukuze kungenwe kahle kanye nokuphuma nokungena kwabantu ezweni. Sizoba nama-visa aqondene ngqo nalo mcimbi azokwenza ukuthi abanikazi bamathikithi bakwazi ukungena ezweni kalula.

Ezocwaningo: Ukubaluleka Kwayo Empilweni Yethu Namasiko Ezocwaningo, noma i-research, ibalulekile empilweni yethu nasemasikweni ethu. Izinselelo, izimfuno, nezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi zidinga ukuhlinzekwa ngolwazi olunembile nolwakha. Ngakho, ubuchwepheshe bokucwaninga buphakathi kwezinto ezibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yanamuhla. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokuqonda ukuthi le mikhakha ihlukaniseka kanjani, ibaluleke kanjani, futhi iziphi izindlela zokuthuthukisa izocwaningo ukuze zibe yinzuzo kulabo ezibhekene nazo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izocwaningo ziqala ngenhloso yokuthola impendulo ezinkingeni ezithile. Lokhu kuphumelela kuphela uma kudalwe izindlela eziphumelelayo. Imibuzo eminingi ibe yinqaba, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezithinta impilo yomphakathi, ezemvelo, kanye nezenhlalakahle. Ngokwesibonelo, uma sizama ukuqonda izizathu zokwanda kwezifo ezithile, kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola izici eziningi – ezempilo, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezomnotho. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izocwaningo akukhona nje ukwenza ngezinto ezithile, kodwa kudinga ukuqonda okunembile kwempilo yansuku zonke. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibalulekile ukufundisa abantu ngenhloso yokucwaninga. Itholakala emiphakathini eminingi ukuthi abantu bahlale bephikisana nemiphumela ethile yokucwaninga. Lokhu kungenzeka ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle, noma ukunganeliseki ngezinqumo ezithathwayo. Ukuze siphumelele ekutholeni ukwaziswa okunembile, kudingeka ukuba sithuthukise imikhuba yokuxhumana, siphinde siphinde sifundise umphakathi ngokubaluleka kwezocwaningo. Uma abantu behlale beyazi ukuthi izocwaningo ziqhuba kanjani, kuzoba lula ukuvuma imiphumela, noma ngabe ingahambisani nezinkolelo zabo zangaphambili.

Esikhathini esidelwe ubungozi, imizamo yokukhuluma ibikwenza kube nokwakha okungakafiki. Abanye babeyizinyanga abathintekayo ekwakheni umnotho, belindele ukuba nempumelelo eMphakathini. Lokhu kube yikushoda kobuchwepheshe, okwenza kube nezinkinga ezivela kumasu omnotho. Kodwa umhlaba wawuchophisa – kodwa owawa waqhubeka nokwenza ubuhlobo, kuze kube sekwitchini eziphakamisa izikhalo. Isimo sezinhlekelele sahlala sibhubha, kanti nabafuna ukuhamba bayavuma ukuvala izinkanyezi ezihlukile kanti nabashoshovi abayinyango bezama ukwakha ubuhlobo. Lokhu kuboniselayo ukuthi abantu bayakuthanda ukuphiwa inhlonipho, bese bakhuluma futhi bezwe umbuso wabo. Ithuba lokulahlekelwa, akujwayelekile; umnotho wafelwa uklekeliswa. Ababamba iqhaza bezama ukujabulisa kanye nezinhlangano ezikhethiwe. Kubuhlungu ukulindela, kodwa kanti isimo samanje sikhumbuza izinyathelo ezivumayo. Abantu bejabula kakhulu emadodeni kanti imiphumela ibingekho. Bese kuthiwa “phuma” kanjena, kwavela uhulumeni wamaZulu, kanti lokhu kube yisisekelo esiqinile sokwakha umnotho ofanele ukuvumpa. Umphakathi wawa ungenegozi, kanti kubizwa ukuhlonipha. Lezi zibhulu zangoJulayi 2021, zigxile emkhakheni wezokuhweba. Zonke lezi zinxushunxushu zaku luthando ezeqisa ukwehluka, kanti uMphakathi uthola ithuba lokuphikisa imiphumela emisha. Umnotho ugxile ekuthuthukiseni inhlalakahle, okuhlanganisa ukubambisana kukamasipala. Ngakho ke ngemva kwezinyanga ezinzima, ikhanda laphakanyiswa ngezimpande zokuvikela. Ekuhlonzeni kobuchwepheshe, lokhu kungenza kube nezinsizakalo ezinkulu, kanti umphakathi uthola umsebenzi omningi.

Kwakungekho ukuhlinzwa ngesikhathi sehlakalo, kodwa kubikezelwe ukuthi omunye wabantu ulimele ngemuva kokuhlaselwa omunye wababoshwa. Iphowuda yathunyelwa kwi-forensics ukuze ihlaziywe ukuze kutholakale ubuningi bayo. Izimo eziphakeme eWashington njengoba sekusele isonto elingaphansi ngaphambi kokuthi uBarack Obama aqale njengomongameli wokuqala omnyama wase-United States. Amalungu eWoodstock Police aboshwe ngesikhathi belandela abaphanga, babopha umsuspect owalimala endaweni yokuhlangana kweLansdowne neDuinefontein Roads eduze kweGugulethu. Ucwaningo olwakhiwe ezikoleni, ezikole, nasezikhungweni zemfundo ezifana ne-IWM ne-CSIR. Ngesikhathi sihamba eMalendela Road, wakhombisa ama-hostels futhi eduze kwawo kwakukhona ama-shacks. Umphathiswa weQueenstown Police Station, uMphakathi Osebenzayo uNikki Mlil

Abanikezeli abafisa ukufakwa ohlwini lokuba ngabanikezeli abavunyiwe ngaphandle kokulinda isimemo esilandelayo bangaqonda Esigabeni Sokutholiswa ukuze bafakwe, uma nje banikezela ngemibhalo efanele nolwazi lokuhlolwa. Emva kokuba lezi sidingo sezigculisiwe, isigaba Sokutholisa sizakuqinisekisa ukuthi okungaba ngabanikezeli bayahlolwa bese kuthi ezinsukwini eziyi-14 bazokwaziswa abanikezeli ukuthi ukuhlolwa kuvunyiwe noma cha. Okungaba ngabanikezeli abasoze bakwazi ukunikeza amakhotheshini baze bavunyelwe njengabanikezeli abavunyiwe. Okwehlukile emthethweni kungenziwa kuphela uma ongaba ngumnikezeli engumnikezeli oyedwa wempahla ethile noma izinsiza, futhi kungekho omunye umnikezeli onje ohlwini lwabanikezeli abavunyiwe. Uma ongaba ngumnikezeli enikeza umkhiqizo noma insiza engajwayelekile engaba nenzunzo eyisipesheli noma okuhle ngezindleko ukufinyelela izidingo ezibonisiwe, futhi umkhiqizo noma insiza enje ayikaze iboniswe njengesidingo ngesikhathi sezinqubo zokuhlela isu nezokubhajetha, umkhiqizo onje noma insiza ungatholiswa ngohlelo lokubhida ngokuncintisana. Kodwa, akukho gunya lokubhekana nebhidi enjena. Uma ibhidi inakwa, bobabili abacwaningi Bezimali kuZwelonke Nakusifundazwe bazokwaziswa bese benikezwa izinsuku ezingama-60 ukuthi bafake imibono ebhalwe phansi kanye neziphakamiso, ezizobhekwa ngaphambi kokuba umasipala enze izinqumo sanoma yikuphi ukuzimisela. Ukusuka kunoma yiziphi iziphakamiso Zomcwaningi Zimali kuZwelonke, kanye nezizathu zokusuka, zizokwaziswa emhlanganweni webandla olandelayo.

Nakuba ingesinye sezikole ezinzima kakhulu eDurban, iDawnridge Primary inedumela elihle futhi inezifundo eziningi ezifunda lapho. Abantu abanezikhumba ezimnyama noma ezinsomi abakhathazeki ngezinkinga zomdlavuza wesikhumba njengoba isikhumba sabo sine-melanin pigment, kodwa abavikelwe ekushiseni ilanga. UNgqongqoshe-Jikelele weZizwe eziManyene kufanele athumele umPhakathi Okwesikhashana ukuze amele yena. Ukuzibandakanya ngokwakho ekusekeleni ngezikhono zokukhombisa ukuhlanganisa izinkampani ngokusebenzisa abakhuthazi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi kubalulekile. Kucacile ukuthi ngokubambisana nokuphathwa kwamanye amazwe, ukubhekana nezinkinga zamehlo zomhlaba, ukungqubuzana komphakathi, ukuphathwa kwezomnotho okungaphumeleli, nokuhlukumeza abesifazane kube nomthelela omkhulu ekuntulekeni kokuthuthukiswa e-Afrika. Ukubona, ukudla kwasekuseni okunokudla okuningi nokwelashwa okuhle kokushisa kubalulekile ukukhumbula uma uvakasha. Ukuqhubeka nokubhekana nezisebenzi zabesifazane ezikhundleni eziphakeme zokuphatha. Ngokwaziyo, manje usukhululekile futhi uxolelwe. Sigxile ezinyathelweni zengqondo yethu mayelana nezinguquko zesimo sezulu nokuthi sishintsha kanjani nokuthi sithuthukisa kanjani lesi simo. Kwakungekho ukuhlinzwa ngesikhathi sehlakalo, kodwa kubikezelwe ukuthi omunye wabantu ulimele ngemuva kokuhlaselwa omunye wababoshwa. Iphowuda yathunyelwa kwi-forensics ukuze ihlaziywe ukuze kutholakale ubuningi bayo. Izimo eziphakeme eWashington njengoba sekusele isonto elingaphansi ngaphambi kokuthi uBarack Obama aqale njengomongameli wokuqala omnyama wase-United States.

Abantu Abakhubazekile: Uma umuntu engakwazi ukuziphatha ngenxa yokukhubazeka, angabhaliswa njengomuntu ohlanganyela. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi uthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele, oluhambisana nezidingo zakhe. Abantu Abadala: Abantu abaphezulu kweminyaka ethile, ikakhulukazi abakhubazekile noma abadinga usizo, bangabhaliswa njengamalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi bathola ukunakekelwa okudingekayo. Izinzuzo Zokuhlukaniswa Kwamalungu Ancike kwabanye Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye kunezinzuzo eziningi. Okokuqala, kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abadinga usizo bahlala benakekelwa. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu abavela ezimweni ezihlukahlukene badinga izinsiza ezihlukahlukene. Okwesibili, lokhu kuhlukaniswa kusiza ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zempilo zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Izidingo Zokubhaliswa Ukuze umuntu abhaliswe njengomuntu ohlanganyela, kunezidingo ezithile okufanele zifezekiswe. Okokuqala, kufanele kube khona ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komuntu ophakamisayo nomuntu ohlanganyela. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umuntu ohlanganyela uthola usizo olufanele. Okwesibili, kudingeka ukuthi kube neziqinisekiso ezithile ezikhombisa ukuthi umuntu ohlanganyela udinga usizo. Lokhu kungaba yizincwadi ezivela kumhlinzeki wezempilo noma ezinye izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalesi siza. Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukaniswa Kwamalungu Ancike kwabanye Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye kubalulekile kakhulu emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavela ezimweni ezihlukahlukene bahlala benakekelwa, futhi bahlala bethola izinsiza ezidingekayo.

Isiphetho: Ukukhanya Kwezenzakalo Zesayensi Ngaphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinsiza, kucacile ukuthi izesayensi zinemiphumela emikhulu empilweni yansuku zonke. Ukuze umphakathi ube nekhono lokuphendula izinselele ezenzakalweni ezinzima, kudingeka ukuthi ubambe iqhaza ngokugcwele ukufunda, ukwenza, futhi azizise izinsiza zesayensi ezintsha. Lokhu kudinga isimo sokubambisana, ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezizinda ezahlukene, nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo ukuba ziqhubeke nokufunda. Izesezizukulwane ezithuthukayo zidinga ukucabangela izimo ezinzima zomhlaba, ukuze zifake emathubeni amasha okwenyusa umphakathi. Empeleni, ukuqonda ubuqotho bemikhakha ehlukene yezenzakalo zesayensi kuyafaneleka, futhi kuyasiza ukuze siqonde ukuthi sizokwazi ukuhamba nezinselele ezizayo ezihambisana nezinsiza zokugcina izwe lethu liphila ngempumelelo.

Abantu bangaqonda kahle ukuthi bangakhetha kanjani izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle ekwandeni kwemfundo nokwazi. Ukuhlukaniswa kwaba yindlela yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe kahle izinsiza zabo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Njengoba izinsizakalo zempilo zanda, kubonakala ukuthi kukhona abantu abathola izinzuzo ezincane, noma abanye abangalitholi lutho. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwezinkinga ezithile, futhi kwavula ithuba lokuxoxisana ngalezi zinkinga. Abantu baqala ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zabo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Njengoba siqhubeka nokubheka le ndaba, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye akugcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo. Kukhona nezifundo ezibalulekile esizitholayo, ezifana nokuthi kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo, futhi kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bathole izinzuzo ezihambisana nezigaba zabo, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuphila impilo enempilo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye ku-GEMS kube yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. Kule ndaba, sithole izifundo eziningi, futhi sikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zibalulekile, kodwa ukufundisa abantu nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile kubalulekile kakhulu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi onempilo, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuxhumana, sifundise, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphathe kahle izinsizakalo zabo.

I-Summit izobe seyivuma uhlelo lokusebenza okuzosebenzisana ngalo i-Asia kanye ne-Afrika. Njengoba umbukiso uhamba emadolobheni amakhulu aseNingizimu Afrika abantu abaningi bazokwazi manje ukubona umnotho ohlukene wemibhalo yaseTimbuktu. Izibhedlela akuzolindeleka ukuthi zifake izimali ekuhlukanisweni kwazo kwisabiwo mali esikhona manje kuphela. Manje ingabe laba ababili yizisebenzi sezokuvikelela othe ekuqaleni wazibona? Itemu elijwayelekile lokubekwa kwithebula amanani omsoco ohlukene odingwa yizilwane ezahlukene. Bengicela ukuthi wonke umuntu ahlale phansi manje, sesingathanda ukuqala. Ikakhulukazi ngemuva Kwempi Yomhlaba Yesibili, ngokwanda kakhulu kwezimboni okwenzeka, ukuhlukaniswa kwekusasa lemiphakathi eyahlukene kwaya ngokuba yinto engenzeke. Angicabangi kanjalo, ngenze iphutha, kodwa angikhumbuli nhlobo. Uma kubhekwa ukubaluleka kodwa nobungozi bokucisha imililo, i-CapeNature izama ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqesha okuyisisekelo, okokuzikhumbuza kanye nokusezingeni elithuthukile ukuze kuhlonyiswe kangcono Abaphathi Bokulondwa Kwemvelo abasemazingeni aphansi. Izikhulu zedolobha zizosebenzisana nesonto lasemaRomeni ukuze kuhlelwe inkonzo yesikhumbuzo ehlangene, imininingwane izokhishwa ngokushesha. Ubudlelwane bokusebenzisana phakathi kwamaphoyisa kanye nomphakathi kwakha ingxenye yokusebenzisana okuhle. Lokhu-ke kuwuhlelo olubaluleke kakhulu oluzophetha kumhlangano olubaluleke kakhulu. Ukunyusa izindleko zokumba ezimayini kunoma yiziphi izinsiza, kunomthelela ekunyukeni kwe-cut-off grade ye-ore, ngalokho kuncishiswa impilo yemayini kanye nokugcina kuhlanzekile kwengcebo yamaminerali.

Ngifuna ukubonga bonke abasebenzi bethu abasebenza kanzima ukwenza lokhu kube yimpumelelo, futhi ikakhulukazi uAnneowayeh ophatha ukuhlela konke lokhu. Uma unokwesekwa komqashi okuhlanganiswe nezikweletu, kuzodingeka ukuthi usekele imali ebhange elikwenze. Amaqembu ezepolitiki alishumi nane azobamba ukhetho lwezishayamthetho zezifunda kuphela kwenye noma ngaphezulu. Ukuqina komkhiqizo - ukuba nezehlakalo zomkhiqizo kuyo yonke impilo yawo, kuhlanganise nokuba nezehlakalo zokulahla umkhiqizo njengodoti ngemuva kokuphuma. Usihlalo, sengiqedile imibuzo yami mayelana noMnu. Cachalia. Lolu hlelo luzofaka izicelo ze-amnesty kulabo abantu abatholakele nezimo ezihlobene nezepolitiki, futhi abangekaze banqandwa i-amnesty yi-TRC. Le dokhumenti yolwazi oluyiqiniso iqukethe imali evela kumabhange aseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuvela kulowo muntu owayekulowo mkhandlu futhi wamenywa ezinkantolo zikaMargo, futhi angifuni ukuphefumula ngalokho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izingxoxo nokubambisana nabo ngezindaba zomphakathi e-NEDLAC. INingizimu Afrika ibeke umphakathi ophatha umkhakha iminyaka emithathu. UDkt. Ramashala ungowokugcina ngaphambi kokuthi siye ekhempini. Sisafaka ubufakazi kuMphakathi Omkhulu uJoubert. Izingxenye ze-Vitamin zikhishwa ngokuvamile ngokusekelwe ematheni okuhlanganiswa okusebenzayo futhi zibizwa ngokuthi i.u. Lokhu kuyinto eyodwa yezinto ezikhuthaza kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwale ndlela yokuhamba komphakathi. Ukukhula okusheshayo ekuthuthukisweni komphakathi, futhi, ngokwenza njalo, utshalomali oluqondiswe kulokho okwenziwa abantu kuholela ekukhuleni kokukhiqiza nokukhula okuqhubekayo. Ngabe ngicela ukuthi

Le emblem yesizwe entsha isekelwe emoyeni walolu vuselelo lwesizwe. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanezakhono eziphakeme zobuciko nezokwakha, futhi abafeze amazinga aphezulu empumelelo ngendlela engajwayelekile. IMapungubwe - Ubukhosi beMapungubwe babutholakala engxenyeni enyakatho yezwe lethu eminyakeni eyinkulungwane edlule. Le nkosi yayinokuphathwa okuhle kakhulu, futhi yayithuthuke kakhulu kwezolimo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, le nkosi yayina nezimayini nezimboni zensimbi. Le nkosi yathengiselana namazwe akude afana neChina. Ngesikhathi salo bukhosi, babe nezinga eliphezulu lokwazi ekucabangeni okujulile nasekuthuthukiseni. IMapungubwe artifact - Singumgogodla kanye neqholo, i-artifact iyingxenye yendawo eyakhiwe ngamatshana agcwele umhlaba, endaweni eyomile nephakathini, engatholi imvula eningi yehlobo, njengoba kuboniswe ngesikhathi sokuhlola okukhombisa ubuciko obukhulu obutholakala endaweni yemvelo kodwa enezimo ezinzima. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi leMapungubwe - lenziwe futhi labonwa emathunjini egolide ohlangothini lwezimbobo - okuyinto eyodwa yezinto ezenziwe futhi zatholakala emathunjini abacwaningi abawahlola kule ndawo (indawo yokuhlola). Ibhodwe elihlotshisiwe lokungcwaba igolide - isimo sebhodwe esibonakala ebhodweni lokungcwaba igolide sikhombisa ubuciko obunothile, isayensi, kanye nekhono lokuthuthukisa, okuyisibonakaliso sempumelelo yasendulo ekukhiqizeni insimbi. Ilanga eliphakamisayo - limele ukukhanya okusha e-Afrika.

Chairperson, angifuni ukufaka isandla ezinsolweni zikaDkt. Wouter Basson mayelana nezinsolo zikaDkt. Riana Borman. I-PSDP ibonisa ubuthakathaka obuthile futhi yonke imali yayo ihambisana nezinga lokutshalwa kwezimali kanye nohlelo lwezinga. Wamthatha wamsusa emathafeni lapho emhlasela khona wabe esemhlukunyezwa. Umsebenzi onzima uqale ukuthuthukisa ukukhula kwalesi sigaba. Ukholwa ukuthi uKenny wabulawa, kodwa bekukhona izinsolo zokuthi uStompie wafa. Ngikhumbula ukuthi akukabi naseduze nalolo nombolo. Uhambo oluphezulu nolukhanyisayo lukhona kulolu dolobha. Ubusuku bethu bujwayele ukuba neziphuphu ezimbi njengoba isimo sabantu bethu siphila ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlupheka ezisusa isithunzi. Bekukhona indawo enkulu kakhulu ngaphezu kwalokho okukhulunywe ngakho umsolwa. Lesi simo sidale ukukhathazeka okukhulu mayelana nezindaba ze-OMU. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuxhumana, okwenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokufunda. Abantu bangafunda ngezinto ezintsha, izindlela zokuphila, nezindlela zokwenza izinto ngendlela engcono. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izifundo ezivela kubantu abanolwazi, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukuba bakhule futhi bathole ulwazi olusha. Lokhu kuhlobene nendlela ama-podcast akhuthaza ngayo ukufunda okuqhubekayo, okubalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla. Kodwa-ke, ukukhula kwama-podcast akukhona ngaphandle kwezinkinga. Njengoba abantu bephendula ezindleleni ezahlukene, kunezinto ezithile ezidinga ukulungiswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinselelo zokuhlonza ama-podcast aphumelelayo, njengoba kunezinketho eziningi ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga abantu ukuba bahlale bephendula futhi bahlolisise ama-podcast ukuze bathole lezo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zokuhweba zikhona. Njengoba ama-podcast eqhubeka nokukhula, abenzi bama-podcast badinga ukuthola izindlela zokwenza imali. Lokhu kudinga ukucabanga ngendlela yokuhlanganisa izikhangiso, izixazululo zokubambisana, noma ezinye izindlela zokuthola imali. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, ukuze ama-podcast akwazi ukuhamba phambili. Ekugcineni, ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayafuna izindlela zokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana.

wazisa labo bantu ukuthi bangenza iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe mayelana nokwenziwa kwendawo iNdawo noma iSakhiwo esinomlando esiFundazweni esikhathini esingeqile ezinsukwini ezingamashumi amathathu emva kokuthola isaziso. Ngaphandle uma uMkhandlu ubona kungafanele, zonke iziNdawo ezingamaGugu kumele zibe nophawu olukhombisa lokho. Umbhalisi wamatayitela njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 102 soMthetho wokuBhaliswa kwamaTayitela, 1937 (uMthetho No. 47 ka 1937), kumele ubhale lokho okubona kubalulekile kunoma iyiphi irejista, kunoma yisiphi isitifiketi noma kunoma yimuphi umbhalo ofanele okusehhovisi lakhe noma okubekwe phambi kwakhe ukuze kubonakale ukuba yiNdawo noma iSakhiwo esinomlando esiFundazweni kwanoma yimuphi umhlaba noma kwanoma iyiphi ingxenye yomhlaba onikezwe lelo gunya ngokwalesi sigaba. (8)(a) UMkhandlu ungahoxisa iNdawo noma iSakhiwo esinomlando esiFundazweni ngesaziso kwiGazethi. Uma uMkhandlu unquma ukuhoxisa iNdawo noma iSakhiwo esinomlando esiFundazweni, izinhlinzeko zezigatshana (3), (4) no (5) ziyosebenza ngezinguquko ezidingekayo. Uma indawo iNdawo noma iSaziso esinomlando esiFundazweni isinikezwe lelo gunya, iba yindawo yoMkhandlu noma kamaziphathe wasekhaya, indawo kusukela ngosuku lokudluliselwa kokubhaliswa, ithathwa njengeyenziwe iNdawo noma iSakhiwo esinomlando esiFundazweni. Indawo eyiGugu ngokomlando ithathwa njengesiGaba II samaGugu okukhulunywe ngawo esigabeni 7(1)(b) soMthetho wezamaGugu kaZwelonke, 1999 (uMthetho No. 25 ka 1999).

Ngikhuthaza bonke ababambe iqhaza ukuba basebenzisane ekuqinisekisweni ukuthi ukulethwa kwezidingo kuyasheshiswa. Esikufundile lapha ukuthi imithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo kukhonela ukusinikeza uholo ekuletheni izidingo, hhayi ukusinqinda ekuletheni izidingo. Sifundile ukuthi sidinga ukuba sisuse izingqinamba eziqondene nengqalasizinda. Sinenhlanganisela yezingqinamba, ezicatshangwayo kanye nalezo zangempela. Sinezingqinamba esizidalela zona ngokwethu. Kwezinye izindawo sithola ukuthi imikhandlu kamasipala isiqala ukusebenza ngokuchema ngokwezombusazwe. Lokhu kucaca kakhulu lapho khona umkhandlu wesifunda ungoweqembu lezombusazwe elehlukile kulelo lomasipala wendawo. Umasipala wesifunda udlala indima yesiphathimandal sezamanzi kanti ngaleso sizathu udweba uhlelo lokusebenza lokwabiwa kwezimali ze-MIG ngokuqondene nemiklamo yesifunda sonke bese ushiya ngaphandle ngamabomu umasipala wendawo ngenxa nje yokuthi ungena ngaphansi kweqembu lezombusazwe elehlukile kwelinye iqembu lezombusazwe. NjengoNgqongqoshe woHulumeni Basekhaya, Ezezindlu Nezindaba Zomdabu, kumele ngikusho ukuthi singacasula isimo lapho khona ezombusazwe zisetshenziselwa ukunquma (ekunqumeni) ukuthi ibaphi omasipala ababekwa phambili kanabanye ngokasipala bezifunda. Lesi yisimo engingeke ngasibekezelela. Uma abantu bedinga usizo (ukulethelwa izidingo) ababuzi ukuthi iyiphi inhlangano yezombusazwe ebalethele lezo zodingo. Ngibashayela ihlombe labo masipala abakubeke eceleni ukuchema ngokombusazwe ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo.

Lungisa umthetho weGauteng Constitution Amendment Act ka-2001 mayelana nezinsiza zokuhamba, ukuze ubuyekezwe futhi uhlanganise incazelo ethile; ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo adingekayo wokusebenzisa umhlaba mayelana neziteshi kanye namandla adingekayo kuMEC ukuze angene ezivumelwaneni zokwakha izivumelwano zomgwaqo nezokuhamba ngezitimela; ukuhlela inqubo mayelana nokumemezela umgwaqo; ukwenza ucwaningo lwesibili endaweni esigabeni somgwaqo wokuqala noma umgwaqo wezitimela lapho umbuso ungathola ukuthi ucwaningo endaweni kuleli gumbi lokumemezela luyadingeka; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezinkinga ezincane. Igama elithi 'umgwaqo wezitimela' libhekisela kumathuluzi omgwaqo asetshenziselwa umgwaqo onzima noma olula, futhi lapho isimo sikhombisa njalo, ilungelo lokuhamba, [lapho umgwaqo onzima noma olula usebenza, njengoba kukhombisiwe noma kumiswa ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho] noma phezulu noma phansi komhlaba futhi kufaka phakathi umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nokuphambukiswa kwawo okwethenjelwe. Ekuthatheni umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela, ukulungiswa okukhishwe komgwaqo ngokwesigaba noma okucatshangwa ukuthi kukhishwe ngokwesigaba, noma ukulungiswa komgwaqo wesifunda okukhona, uMEC kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amalungiselelo omgwaqo wokuqala enziwe, ngokuhambisana nebhuku elibhalwe njengoba kuchaziwe futhi kuhlanganise nezincomo mayelana nomgwaqo, bese uMEC kufanele alandele inqubo echazwe kulolu sigaba. Ngaphambi kokuthatha umgwaqo noma umgwaqo oguquliwe, uMEC kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lendawo kanye nebika kwenziwa njengoba kubhekwa umbuso owaziwe ngomsebenzi esigabeni 22 se-ECA, noma umbuso obheka izigaba ezihlobene ze-NEMA uma lezi zigaba zisebenza, ungathola.

kube noguquko oluzoqinisekisa ukuthi kufinyeleleka ngendlela egculisayo kuwo wonke umnotho wemvelo waseNingizimu Afrika. Umbuso kumele uthathe izinyathelo zomthetho nezinye izinyathelo, ezilungile, ngokusemandleni awo, ukweseka isimo esizokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukuthola umhlaba ngendlela egculisayo. Umuntu noma umphakathi onelungelo lomhlaba elintengantengayo ngokomthetho ngenxa yomthetho noma izenzo zesikhathi esedlule ezibandlulula ngobuzwe, unelungelo ngendlela eshiwo ehlinzikelwe ngumthetho wePhalamende, lokuthola ilungelo elime laqina emthethweni noma lokunikezwa usizo olungafaniswa nokuqiniswa kwalelolungelo. Umuntu noma umphakathi owathathelwa impahla emva kuka 19 June 1913, ngenxa yemithetho noma izenzo unelungelo njengoba kuhlinzekelwa ngumthetho wePhalamende lokubuyiselwa leyo mpahla, noma lokuthola usizo olufanele. Akukho okushiwo kulesisigaba okungavimba umbuso ekubeni uthathe izinyathelo zokushaya imithetho nezinye izinyathelo ngenhloso yokuphumelelisa uguquko kwezomhlaba, amanzi nokunye okuyelene nalokho, ukuze ulungise imiphumela yobandlululo ngobuzwe lwesikhathi esedlule, kodwa konke okuqhelile ezimisweni zalesisigaba kufanele kuhambisane nezimiso zesigaba 36(1). IPhalamende kufanele lishaye umthetho oshiwo kwizigatshana (6). Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokukwazi ukuthola indlu efanelekile. ngokusemandleni ombuso ukwenza ukuba ukuphumelela kwaleli lungelo kuqhubekele phambili. Akekho umuntu ongasuswa emzini wakhe noma kudilizwe indlu yakhe ngaphandle kwesinqumo senkantolo esenziwe ngemuva kokuba ibheke izimo ezithile ezifanelekile Awukho umthetho oyovumela ukususwa abathintekayo benganikwanga ithuba lokuziphendulela.

Amasampula omhlabathi akufanele aqoqwe ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ezifana nomhlaba ophuma olwandle, imifula eyomile, izindawo ezigcina izihlahla ezindala ezindaweni, izintaba eziphansi, noma izindawo eziphukile. Manje sekukhona ithuba lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokubeka (Global Positioning System) ohlelweni lwe-grid ezindaweni ezikhethiwe eziphakathi kuka-0.5 no-4 meters, noma ukuhlela ukuqoqa amasampula ohlelweni lwe-grid. Amasampula azobe eqhathaniswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nezinguquko ezenzakalayo ezingeni lokuvuthwa komhlabathi zingatholakala kahle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Imiphumela yokuhlaziywa ingatholwa ngokusebenzisa i-Geographic Information System (GIS) ukuze kutholakale imephu enombala yefield ekhombisa i-pH, i-calcium, i-magnesium, i-phosphate, i-sulfur, i-nitrogen, ama-micronutrients, nezinye izinguquko zokuhlola umhlabathi zingaboniswa ukuze zikhombise umfanekiso ophawulekayo wokuhlukahluka noma ubukhulu benkinga ethile emhlabeni. Ezindaweni eziningi, izindawo eziphakathi zikhonjwa zisebenzisa indlela ye-grid ngokusekelwe kumahhactha e-block. Isikhathi esihle sokuthatha amasampula yileso lapho uzoba nethuba lokwenza umsebenzi kahle, lapho ungakwenza izinqumo ngokuhl

- Ukubambisana nezindawo zomphakathi: Ukuhlela imicimbi yokwazisa umphakathi mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kungasiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukuthi bangabiza kanjani ama-ambulensi ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Isiphetho Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi e-Gauteng zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta lezi zikhathi, ukuhlola izibalo, nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphendula. Ngale ndlela, singaqinisekisa ukuthi impilo yabantu ibhekwa ngeso elibukhali, futhi izinsiza zempilo zisebenza kahle ukuze zifeze izidingo zomphakathi.

Ukubhujiswa Kwemvelo Ngenxa Kwezizimayini Ukukhula komnotho emhlabeni jikelele kuholele ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo, okukhombisa izidingo ezinkulu zokumba izinsiza ezinjengamalahle, insimbi, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka. Nokho, lezi zinyathelo zinezimpawu ezinzima, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekubhujisweni kwemvelo. Izimayini, nakuba zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa komnotho, zibuye zibe nomthelela omkhulu emvelweni, okungaholela ezinkingeni ezinzima. Umthelela Wokumba Izinsiza Uma izimayini ziqala ukusebenza, zidinga indawo enkulu yokumba. Lokhu kuholela ekuchithweni kwemvelo, njengoba izihlahla, izilwane, nezindawo zokuhlala zibhujiswa. Ukumba izinsiza kudinga ukwakha izindawo ezinkulu zokugcina, okwenza kube nezinguquko ezinkulu emvelweni. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezindawo zokuhlala zezilwane, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuthola ukudla nokuphila. Ukukhishwa Kwezinto Ezingcolisayo Izimayini zikhishwa izinto eziningi ezingcolisayo, ezinjengemfucumfucu, amanzi angcolile, nezinto eziphuma emoyeni. Lezi zinto zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Ngokwesibonelo, uma amanzi angcolile efakwa emifuleni, kungaholela ekubeni izilwane eziphila emanzini zife, futhi abantu abahlala eduze bangase bahlupheke ngezifo ezihlobene nokungcoliswa kwamanzi. Ukushintsha Kwezimo Zokuphila Ukusebenza kwezizimayini kuholela ekushintsheni kwezimo zokuphila. Izindawo ezazikhona ngaphambi kokumba zingase zishintshe zibe izindawo ezingenakuhlala. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu abahlala kulezi zindawo badinge ukuhamba, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemiphakathi nasemiphakathini.

lingaqashwa njengelungu loMkhandlu uma kutholakala ukuthi ophakanyisiswe ugodle ulwazi oluthile ngamabomu oluphathelene nokuhlomula ngokwezezimali nokunye okuhlongozwe kulesi sigaba. Ithuba elilandelayo elalikhankasela uThandiwe kwakungokwakhiwa kwefilimu ethi "Izinyembezi Zothando," ethokozisa izilaleli ngendaba yeqhawe elihamba ngebhasi lothando, elihamba ngaphakathi kwezinselelo ezivamile. Le filimu yashukumisela izincwadi zomphakathi, yanikeza ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngamaqhawe abo, kube nezimo ezithinta ubuhlungu nothando. UThandiwe wayefuna ukwakha ikholwa phakathi kwezilaleli, eyazi ukuthi amafilimu angaba yindlela yokuxhumana ngempela. Ngaphezu kokuba umqondisi, uThandiwe ungumfundisi wezobuciko, ehlanganyela ulwazi lwakhe nabafundi bezobuciko. Ubonisa ukuqonda okukhulu kwezifundo ezihlukile, ehlanganyela imibono yakhe nokuqonda kwakhe. UThandiwe ubona ukuthi ukukhiqiza amafilimu akuyona nje imisebenzi yokwenziwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokubeka impilo ebuhleni, ukudlulisa imiyalezo yemvelo, nokuhlanganyela izinkumbulo ezinhle. UThandiwe Ndlovu ungenisa umoya omusha emkhakheni wamafilimu eNingizimu Afrika, enza izifundo eziphathelene nomnotho, ubuhlobo, kanye nemikhuba yokuphila. Uhlale efuna ukuhlola izinkolelo ezahlukahlukene, kuhlanganiswe nezinkinga zomphakathi, ezithinta umphakathi nezwe. Njengoba uThandiwe eqhubeka nokwakha amafilimu, ubona ukuthi umhlaba uyashintsha, futhi izindaba zidinga ukuhamba nezikhathi. I-legacy yakhe izoqhubeka nokukhula, ibalulekile emhlabeni wamafilimu, ihlale ibonisa ukuthi amafilimu angaba yindlela yokuphila, yokufundisa, nokuhlanganyela. UThandiwe Ndlovu uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuciko bungasiza kanjani ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo, okhuthazayo, kanye nomhlaba obumbene.

Uzocelwa ukuthi ushaye iCrime Stop ngenombolo: 08600 10 111 ngesikhathi esithile ukuze uthole ukuthi ulwazi lwasetshenziswa yini futhi uthole umvuzo uma ufanelekela. Umuntu oxhumana naye ngefoni uzophuma uma engakholwa ukuthi ungumuntu ofanayo owashaya kuqala. Lokhu kuyisinyathelo sokuphepha esikhona futhi ngeke kuxoxwe ngakho. I-Crime Stop izothumela ulwazi olunikeziwe kwi-unit ethile yokuhlola ukuze ilandele leli cala futhi iphinde icela ukuthi babuyisele umbiko phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-24 mayelana nomphumela wokuhlola ngokushesha okukhulu. Uma ushaya ucingo ukuze ubike icala okufanele uthole umvuzo, umphakathi ophenyayo nguye okumele abhekane nendaba yomvuzo nokuthi ungawuthola kanjani, ngokulandela inqubo yomvuzo ye-NI2/2001. Akukho sidingo sokugcwalisa amafomu ngoba izono zibikwa ngefoni. Nokho, uma ubika icala usebenzisa iwebhusayithi ye-SAPS, gcwalisa ifomu lokubuyekezwa ngogesi.

Uma umphumela wokhetho loMkhandlu kaZwelonke ungamenyezelwanga phakathi kwesikhathi esibekwe kwisigaba 190 noma uma ukhetho luchithwe yinkantolo, uMongameli, kufanele abize abeke nezinsuku zolunye ukhetho ngesimemezelo esishicilelwe phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu 90 kusukela ekweqeni kwesikhathi sokumemezela umphumela noma kusukela ngelanga ukhetho olwachithwa ngalo. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke uyaqhubeka nokubanamandla okusebenza kusukela esikhathini ohlakazwe ngaso, noma ophelelwe ngaso yisikhathi, kuze kube yilanga elingaphambi kwelanga lokuqala lokuvotela uMkhandlu olandelayo. sekwedlule iminyaka emithathu emva kokukhethwa koMkhandlu. Emva kokhetho, umhlangano wokuqala woMkhandlu kaZwelonke kufanele uhlale ngesikhathi kanye nangelanga elibekwe nguMongameli weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo, kodwa lingabingaphezulu kwezinsuku ezingu-14 emva kokumenyezelwa komphumela wokhetho UMkhandlu kaZwelonke ungabeka izikhathi nobude beminye imihlangano yawo kanye namakhefu awo. UMongameli angabiza ngokushesha uMkhandlu ukuba uze emhlanganweni ongajwayelekile noma ngasiphi isikhathi ukuze wenze umsebenzi ongejwayelekile. Imihlangano yoMkhandlu kaZwelonke ivunyelwe ezindaweni ezingeyona indawo yokuhlala kwePhalamende kuphela ngezizathu eziyizidingo zomphakathi, zokuphepha noma ubulula bamalungiselelo, futhi uma kuhlinzekelwe emitheshwaneni yoMkhandlu.

Nakuba kukhona isahluko 2, uma amalungu eMpi efisa, angabekwa ezandleni zikaMsecretary Wezokuvikela ukuze angene ezikhundleni kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. Amalungu eMpi ezikhundleni kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela kufanele ahambisane nemithetho yonke efanele kubo kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye neziphathimandla eziphezulu. UPresident kufanele, ngokulandela imithetho ephethe izisebenzi zomphakathi, aqoke umuntu ukuze athathe isikhundla sikaMsecretary. UMsecretary Wezokuvikela uhlala kulolo sikhundla isikhathi esifanayo nesesikhundla sabaphathi bazo zonke izigaba kanye nemithetho abaphila ngaphansi kwayo, imiholo yabo namalungelo afana nalabo babaphathi. UMsecretary Wezokuvikela kufanele abe ngum citizen futhi akuvunyelwe ukuba abe ilungu leMpi. a Kumele abhekwane njengomsebenzi ngaphansi kwesahluko 1; b Qhubeka nokusebenza kulolo sikhundla ngaphansi kwemithetho efanele, kuze kube isikhathi sokusebenza kulolo sikhundla siphela. Ikomidi lePhalamende libheka ukuthi izigaba zilandela lokho okukhulunywe. e Kumele anikeze uMholi weMpi imiyalelo eningiliziwe edingekayo ukuze akwazi ukuhlela amalungu emisebenzi efanele kanye namandla okwenza imisebenzi ethile eyabelwe yena nguMsecretary Wezokuvikela njengomholi kanye nomphathi wezezimali kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. f Kumele aqinisekise ukuhambisana nemithetho ethunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe edluliselwa kuMholi weMpi ophinde athumele umbiko ngalesi kuNgqongqoshe; g Uthwala umthwalo wokuhola izinqubo zokuziphatha nokuphathwa kwezisebenzi, kuhlanganise nokusetshenziswa kwazo kahle nokuqeqeshwa.

Tshela iqembu ukuthi bayilezozindlela. Yenza imisebenzi esekugcineni kwesahluko ngamaqoqo o 4 noma 5. Buyisa wonke amaqoqo ndawonye uma eseqede yonke imisebenzi emine. Ukuhlukaniswa kusebenziseka kakhulu emzamweni wokuhlonza izindawo ezihlala inzima, ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi benze izinqumo ezifanele. Izinyathelo Zokuhlukaniswa Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu kuhlukaniswa, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe. Lokhu kudinga ukufaka phakathi ukuqoqa idatha ethile, ukuhlaziya le datha, kanye nokwakha izigaba ezihlukene. Ukuze le nqubo ibe nekhono, kudinga ukuba kuhlolwe futhi kuqondwe izimo ezahlukene zomkhakha, kuhlanganiswe nezinselelo nezinzuzo zokubambisana. Umsebenzi wokuhlola kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi izigaba ezingama-GEMS ziyahambisana nezinqubomgomo ezithile zomphakathi, ezokuphepha, kanye nemvelo. Izifundo Nokwenza Ngcono Ngokuhlanza kahle, isifundo esithathiwe kulolu hlobo lwezokuhlukaniswa sikhombisa ukuthi intuthuko yenkampani noma inhlangano ibondla kancane izigaba eziphezulu ezingama-GEMS. Ukuze kufezeke lokhu, kubalulekile ukuphatha ubuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu, karolo ebaluleke kakhulu empumelelweni yokuhlukaniswa. Izindlela zokusebenza ezilungile kufanele zisetshenziswe ukuze kudalwe isimo esihambisana nempumelelo, okuholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezilungile. Izifundo Ezivela Kwalolu Hlelo I-GEMS major member classification ikhuluma izaziso eziningi ezizohlonishwa. Ukuhlukanisa izigaba kulindeleke ukuthi kuthuthukise uhlelo lwezokuphatha, kokubili emkhakheni ophakeme nasezinhlelweni eziphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashisa mayelana nezimo ezithile ezikhona futhi kuhlale kwenziwa izinqumo ezihambisana neemfuno zabantu. Izingcindezi ezivela kwelokuhlalisana koluntu kudinga ukuhlolwa njalo, ukuze kube khona ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukile.

Ngalesi sikhathi sokubhala le ncwadi, le vayirasi isisulele abantu abayi-177 457 (abaqinisekiswe yizindlu zokuqhuba ucwaningo lwesayensi) emhlabeni wonke, phakathi kwabo osekufe abayi-1 457 abaqinisekisiwe. ENingizimu Afrika kuze kube yimanje, sesiqinisekise izimo eziyi-2 844 osekufe kuzo abantu abayisithupha. Ngemuva komhlangano wesine weKomidi Lwesimo Esisheshayo owawubanjwe ngomhla we-11 Juni 2009, iNhlangano Yomhlaba Yezempilo (i-WHO) yaphetha ngokuthi ikhratheriya yokuthatha lokhu kufa njengobhubhane lomhlaba seyanelisekile futhi uMnqondisi-Jikelele, uDkt Margret Chan, usesigunyazile lesi simo njengoBhubhane (izinga lesi-6). Kalula lokhu kusho ukuthi loku kufa sekusabalalele emazweni akuzo zonke izindawo ze-WHO futhi lokhu kwenzeke ngokukhulu ukushesha. Kodwa-ke ngithanda ukugcizelela ukuthi ukugunyazwa kohobhane akusho ukuthi ukufa kunamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuyaqhubeka nokusabalalela yonke indawo. Ngomhla wesi-6 ku-Julayi i-WHO yachaza ukuqhubeka kwalolu bhubhane emazweni athintekayo kanye nakumazwe amasha njengokungavumeleki futhi okungavimbeki. Ngenhlanhla, yize lokhu kunje, iphinde yasho ukuthi abantu abaningi abatheleleke ngevayirasi bazoba nezimpawu ezingconywana. Yize njengabasebenzi bezempilo, bomhlaba jikelele nabalapha ekhaya, sikhathazekile ngokufa okuvelile kuze kube manje (okungama-0,8% emhlabeni nama-0,2% abantu abesulelekile eNingizimu Afrika). Ivayirasi isulela abantu abaphakathi kweminyaka eyi-10 ukuya kwengama-29 - iningi labo ngabafundi noma ngabasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.

Amanani emakethe emakethe ayengazinzi - ayanda futhi ehla - lapha sikhuluma ngamanani okudla nezindleko zokukhiqiza ezifana nezithako, imbewu, ukudla kwezilwane, nezinye izinto ezidingekayo emasimini, kubeka umkhiqizi esimweni esinzima sezezimali ngoba akanawo amandla okuphatha izindleko ezibonakalayo nezifihlekile zokudla okukhiqizwayo emasimini. Uma intengo yemakethe yokudla okukhiqizwayo ngumlimi yehlile, ngeke uyibone lokhu ezitolo - lokhu kukhuphula ukungabaza ukuthi kuphela abathengi bokudla nabanye abazuza, hhayi abakhiqizi nabathengi bokudla. Lokhu kuzothinta kanjani abantu baseNingizimu Afrika? Uma abakhiqizi behluleka amabhizinisi abo nezindlu futhi abakhiqizi abasha behluleka ukungena kulomsebenzi, kuzoba nomthelela omubi kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Abakhiqizi bangumgogodla wesizwe sethu futhi bangesinyathelo sokuqala ekukhuleni kwezezimali. Uma amabhizinisi okulima ehla, amabhizinisi amakhulu nawo azohla. Lokhu kuphikisana nakho kuyasebenza - uma amabhizinisi okulima akhula, amabhizinisi amakhulu akhula, futhi izindawo ezinezamabhizinisi zikhula. Abakhiqizi ngempela bakha ingcebo, inani langempela ngokusebenzisa imbewu nokukhanya kwelanga futhi basilethela izinto ezondla imizimba yethu (ukudla) nezempilo yethu kwezezimali. Le ndlu yemindeni yokulima ibalulekile uma sifuna izwe eliqinile elikhulayo. Uma silahlekelwa ngumkhiqizi oyedwa noma senze kube nzima kulabo abasha ekulimaleni, noma singasekeli labo abasanda kuqala ukulima, sithumele imvelo yethu, ukuphepha kwezwe lethu, nezimo zethu zezezimali engcupheni.

Kunomqondo omkhulu wokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho bonke abasebenzi bekhululekile futhi bejabulile. I-GEMS iyisixazululo esibalulekile, kodwa kudinga ukujula kokuqonda ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo kumele zisebenze ngendlela eguquguqukayo, ukuze zihlale zithuthukisa isimo sabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngakho, uma sicabanga nge-GEMS kanye nokuhlolwa kwesimo sesisebenzi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kuyinto ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa elihle, hhayi kuphela kubasebenzi, kodwa nasemphakathini jikelele. I-GEMS akukhona nje ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi ibiza ukwakha ithemba, ukugcwalisa izifiso, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, izisebenzi kanye nohulumeni, ukuze sithole umphumela omuhle, obumbene, nonempilo. Ngalokho, ukuqinisekiswa kwesimo sesisebenzi sikahulumeni kufanele kube yinto esiyibheka ngeso elibukhali, ukuze sigcine izinsizakalo zezempilo zisebenza ngokufanele, futhi sithuthukise impilo yabasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kulezi zikhathi ezishintshashintshayo, kubalulekile ukuba siqhubeke sithuthukisa izinqubo zethu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubo bonke, futhi sibe nempilo engcono.

Imithombo yamanzi emvelo ikhona, nakuba kungumqansa kubalimi ukuchelela izitshalo zabo. Kunemifula namadamu amaningi aphakela izindawo eziseduze nezifunda ezithuthukile. Ukungavundi kwenhlabathi yisona sizathu esenza ezolimo zingabi sezingeni eliphezulu ebaQulisini. IVryheid yilona dolobha elikhulu ebaQulusini, elinengqalasizinda ethuthuke kahle ngokwezikhungo. Itholakala endaweni lapho kuhlangana khona imigwaqo emikhulu yezokuthutha engenela kwisifunda. Ngokuhambisana nohlaka lwendawo kaMasipala, imizila emibili emikhulu esifundazweni, idlula kuyo le ndawo, uR34 kanye noR69. UR34 yiwona omkhulu futhi yiwona obhekelela umsebenzi onqala wezomnotho. ICoal Line ixhumene nalo mzila odlula eVryheid, kanti nayo ihlinzeka ngamathuba amaningi ezomnotho emabhizinisini endawo. Le mizila yomibili emikhulu yesifundazwe inegalelo elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni inhlalo yasemadolobheni. Izindawo eziningi zasemadolobheni kanye nabantu basemakhaya basabalele kuyo yonke indaweni kamasipala. Lezi zindawo zokuhlala ezadaleka ngesikhathi sobandlululo, ngokujwayelekile ziba ngamahostela futhi bathembele ukuthola umsebenzi, izimpahla nezidingo eVryheid. Ngakho-ke iVryheid yiyona ndawo ekuthenjelwe kuyona. Lokhu kungumongo walokho okungathathwa njengendawo edidiyele ngokokusebenza, kodwa kuyindawo ehlukene ngokwesakhiwo. Imigwaqo ehlanganisa amahostela neVryheid ikhona yize ingathuthukisiwe noma inganakekelwa ngokwanele. Ukwandiswa kwalokhu kuxhumana kuzoba ngukungenelela okubalulekile kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni ukuhlangana kwalezi zindawo.
