Le nsizakalo ihlinzeka ngemininingwane yokuthi ungabhalisela ukuba umkhiqizi ngaphansi komthetho kanye nesivumelwano somthetho se-African Growth and Opportunity Act sase-United States of America kanye neSouth African Revenue Service. Umthetho uhlinzeka ngezikhuthazo ezithile ezizwakalayo ezizweni zase-Afrika ukuze ziqhubeke nomzamo wazo wokuvula umnotho wazo nokwakha emakethe ezikhululekile. Thola ifomu lesicelo ku-inthanethi noma ehhovisi lakho eliseduzane le-SARS. Ifomu lesicelo kumele liphothulwe ngumfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke processing. Sicela ubheke imihlahlandlela yesicelo ukuze ukukwazi ukusiza enqubweni yokuthola ilayisensi. Bheka umkhiqizi ebhokisini le-AGOA ngaphansi kokubhaliswa. Ikhodi yomgwaqo wesigaba lapho ibhizinisi likhona. Icala lokufaka isicelo kumele liphothulwe ngum owner yebhizinisi oyedwa, umqondisi, umlingani, ilungu, umtrustee, noma umphathi webhizinisi uma ufaka isicelo sokubhaliswa komkhiqizi okhethekile kwe-AGOA ukuze uthole izinkokhelo zokungenisa nezokuphuma. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ehambisa ibhizinisi, kumele kube yilo elivela kulolu hlobo. Lapho kukhona lesi simbolo (), susa okungafanele. Izifinyezo zamagama nesibongo somuntu ofaka isicelo se-layisensi. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyazwe khona. Phetha ifomu lesicelo bese ulithumela ehhovisi lakho eliseduzane le-South African Revenue Service Customs and Excise. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwento yokuncishiswa 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10, kanye ne-607.04.

Isakhiwo esiphelele seSiphandla Sezwe sihlanganisa ingxenye engenhla nengezansi yakhe isiyingi somumo weqanda okufanekisa ingunaphakade. Ukuhlangana konqenqema lombhalo olungezansi, namazinyo endlovu, nokomkhathizwe okuqhamuka kuwo ilanga likhuphuke, kwakha isimo seqanda okuqhamuka kulo intinginono. Lomfanekiso unomqondo osho ukuzalwa kabusha ngokomoya kwesizwe sethu esikhulu futhi esinobuqhawe. Igama elithi Batho Pele liwumushwana wesiSuthu ochaza ukuthi "Abantu kuqala", okubophezelela abasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi basebenzele bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukubaluleka nemimiso-migomo ye-Batho Pele uyisisekelo seSiphandla Sezwe. Ngomhlaka 1 Okthoba 1997, abasebenzela uhulumeni baqala umkhankaso we-Batho Pele ababehlose ukuwusebenzisa ukwenza ngcono izinsiza abaziphakela umphakathi. Ukwenza umsebenzi omuhle kangangemali nemali ekhokhiwe ukuze amakhasimende abone ukuthi imali yawo yentela isetshenziswa ngendlela eyiyo neyimpumelelo. I-Batho Pele imayelana nokuthi kukhishwe izindlela zokusebenza ezibiza kakhulu nezimosha imali ezingabeki izidingo zabantu phambili. Iphinde iphathelane nokuthi iqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zikahulumeni zokusebenzisa imali zihambelana nezidingo zabantu kanye nokuthi yiziphi ezidingeka masishane. Iningi lentuthuko efunwa ngabantu ayidingi mali ukuze ibe khona, njengokumoyizela, ukuphatha abantu ngenhlonipho ukwethembeka uma unikeza abantu ulwazi kanye nokuxolisa uma wenze iphutha. Lezizinto azidingi mali - zidinga ukuguqula indlela abantu baziphatha ngayo. Ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi eyenzelwa abantu wukuhlela kabusha indlela ophatha abantu ngayo.

Owesimame owenza isicelo sikamazisi nakhona ofisa ukusebenzisa esinye sezibongo ayaziwa ngaso, kumele anikeze nobufakazi bokuthi unelungelo lokusebenzisa leso sibongo. Umuntu obuya ngaphandle kwezwe, owenza isicelo sikamazisi , kumele afakele nemvume yokuhlala ezweni unomphela, kanye nesitifikedi sokuba nelungelo lokuba yisakhamuzi sezwe noma isitifikedi sokukhishwa phansi kwezibopho , isitifikedi somshado kwifomu le-BI-529. Izicelo zingathatha isikhathi sokufinyelela kumaviki ayisishagalombili. Le nkonzo ngeyamahhala ayikhokhelwa. Qaphela: Amafomu awatholakali kulayini we-internethi. Sicela uxhumane nehhovisi eliseduze lonyango.

Sipho Dlamini, owayekhuluma ngokuqhubeka kokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu. Uthe, "Siyazi ukuthi lezi zinguquko zidinga isikhathi, kodwa sizimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo." Ubuye wakhuthaza amalungu ukuba aqhubeke nokubamba iqhaza, ukuze kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabo. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi wokuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu weGEMS wawuwumcimbi obalulekile, owahlinzeka ngokuqonda okukhulu mayelana nezinguquko ezizayo. Kwakuwumcimbi owawuhlanganisa abantu abaningi, futhi wakhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwamalungu. Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu akukhona kuphela ukwehlukaniswa kwezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kuhilela ukuthuthukiswa kwezempilo yomuntu siqu. Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi iGEMS izimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungu ayo athola izinsiza ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, futhi lokhu kuzoqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa.

Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni komnotho, ekunciphiseni umthelela emvelweni, nasekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo. Umphakathi onamandla ungakha izixazululo ezinzima ezibhekene nezinkinga zethu. Ngakho-ke, ngiyabiza bonke abathintekayo, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nabantu bendawo, ukuba baphokophele ekwakheni amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekwakheni umphakathi ophelele, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinobulungiswa. Amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo eNyakatho Kapa akuyona nje indlela yokuthola amandla, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Masiphokophele lezi zinhlelo ukuze sibe neNyakatho Kapa engcono.

Uhulumeni ubhekene nengcindezi enkulu kokubili emhlabeni nasemhlabeni jikelele ngesikhathi ubhekene nezinga elingalindelekile lokuphazamiseka okwenze izwe lingaphathwa. Imishini yokukhokha ngokuzenzakalelayo (ATMs) izothola amakhadi okubhanga angama-foreign amaningi kuhlanganise neVisa, iCirrus, neMaestro. iNingizimu Afrika ngeke ikwazi ukubhekana nale nselelo enkulu ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izinsiza ngokubambisana, ibe nezinkampani ezilinganayo, ulwazi, nezakhono ezivela ezindaweni ezingaphansi kokulawulwa kukahulumeni. Labo abahilelekile ezimpini nezimali ezizokhula zibe nezihlahla ezinkulu. Ngesikhathi sizama ukuvimbela okuthile ukuba kwenzeke mayelana nezidakamizwa, sisesha futhi sithola izifundo ubusuku nemini, sithumba futhi sishaye labo abathengisa futhi abasebenzisa izidakamizwa. Izikhala zizohlinzekwa ngaphandle kwemikhawulo futhi izinsizakalo ezihlinzekwayo kufanele ziqhube ukuhamba kwezinsiza zokuthutha udoti ezinsizeni. eNingizimu Afrika, umthelela wezinhlelo ezisekelwe kubuhlanga ushiye ukusabalalisa ingcebo kungalingani njalo, kudala izingxabano ngamagama ahlobene nokwabiwa komnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ochwepheshe beQembu Lezisebenzi Ezithile bahlangene ukusiza abenzi bomthetho ngokwabelana ngolwazi lwabo olunzulu nezakhono. Izinkinga ezizokhishwa zikhuluma ngezinkinga abakholelwa kuzo, kanye nokuhlola okuphindaphindiwe kokuqonda kwabo ngeNingizimu Afrika, edlule, okwamanje, nekusasa. Kumele sithole indlela yokufinyelela nokuhlinzeka ngendawo yesifunda. Kumele sikwenze lokhu, ukuze singavumeli amanzi ukuthi athwale umoya wokuzithoba kwezinto esingakwazi ukuzifeza ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi edolobheni lethu.

I-Crime Stop inezikhungo eziningi zokubiza ezikhethekile ekuqoqeni ulwazi emphakathini mayelana nezono kanye nemisebenzi yabo yokwenza izono. Amalungu omphakathi athola usizo kubasebenzi bezikhungo zokubiza abaqeqeshiwe ekuphatheni izingcingo nasekutholeni ulwazi olufanele. Lokhu kuvumela abantu ukuba baziwe iSikhungo Sezokuphepha SaseNingizimu Afrika ngemicimbi yokwenza izono ngendlela ephephile engabafaki engozini. Uma uthanda, ungakhetha ukuhlala ungaziwa. Abameli baphawula futhi banikeza ulwazi ngesikhathi izingcingo, futhi labo abashaya izingcingo akufuneki bakhombise ubunikazi babo kuCrime Stop, okuvumela abashaya izingcingo ukuba bahlale bengaziwa uma befisa. Ulwazi olunikeziwe luthunyelwa eziphathimandla. Qaphela: lokhu kwenziwa kuphela ngenhloso yakho. Umuntu oxhumana naye ezikhungweni zokubiza uzokubuza imibuzo, futhi uma ulwazi olunikezwayo lungasetshenziswa, bazokunikeza inombolo yakho eyingqayizivele. Uma ulwazi lungasetshenziswa, umuntu oxhumana naye uzokuchazela ukuthi kungani lungasetshenziswa futhi anikeze izeluleko zokuthi ungathola kanjani olunye ulwazi. Ulwazi olusetshenziswayo luhlotshaniswa nenombolo yekhodi oyitholile. Uzocelwa ukuthi ushaye iCrime Stop ngenombolo: 08600 10 111 ngesikhathi esithile ukuze uthole ukuthi ulwazi lwasetshenziswa yini futhi uthole umvuzo uma ufanelekela. Umuntu oxhumana naye ngefoni uzophuma uma engakholwa ukuthi ungumuntu ofanayo owashaya kuqala. Lokhu kuyisinyathelo sokuphepha esikhona futhi ngeke kuxoxwe ngakho.

ukwazisa mayelana nanoma yisiphi isaziso, incwadi noma enye indlela ephathelene nezinhlinzeko zalesi Mthetho, uchaza ukwethulwa kwalokho kuzaziso, incwadi noma enye indlela ngokuhambisana nenqubo enikezwe yokwethulwa kwenqubo ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinkantolo ZamaMagistrate ka-1944 uMthetho No. umprofeshinali wezokuxhumana ufaka abasebenzi abaphethe umuntu ongagcwele, abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa, abasebenzi abaphethe izingane nentsha kanye nabasebenzi bezokuphepha komphakathi abhaliswe ngalolu hlobo ngaphansi koMthetho Wobuchwepheshe Bezokuxhumana ka-1978 uMthetho No. Isisekelo seMvumelwano yeZizwe Ezihlangene Sokuvikela Ukuhweba Ngabantu sichaza indlela yeZizwe Ezihlangene evimbela, icindezela futhi ibhujise Ukuhweba Ngabantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane nezingane, isekela iMvumelwano yeZizwe Ezihlangene ka-2000 ngokumelene Nobugebengu Obuhlanganisiwe ezwenikazi, umbhalo ofanayo owatholakala kuSheduli 3. Ngaphezu kokuchazwa okunikezwe ezichazweni "ukubheka", "ukufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho kanye nomthetho ojwayelekile, lezi zisho "ukubheka nokufinyelela" kunoma yimuphi umthetho kufanele zithathwe njengokuchazwa "ukunakekela nokuxhumana ngendlela echazwe kulesi Mthetho. Kulolu Mthetho, igama noma igama elithathwe egameni noma ngogama echazwe esigabeni 1, linencazelo efanayo ngaphandle kokuthi umongo ubonise ukuthi kukhona enye incazelo ehleliwe.

Kwesinye isikhathi ukuhola kunikezwa umkhuba wasekhaya noma isiko. Uma ingane isikhulakhulile noma ithe ukuvuthwa ngokomqondo, kulapho izobandanyeka khona ezinqumeni zalolu hlobo. Cabanga ngalokhu. Ucabanga ukuthi kufanele ibe ngakanani ingane ngaphambi kokuba wazi futhi usebenzise amalungelo akho Uma ukhuluma ngamanye amalungelo ekuhambeni kwale ncwadi, kungaba mnandi kuwe ukuthi ukhulume ngamanye nabazali bakho noma nabantu abakubhekayo. Kanti-ke izingane kufanele ziholwe kahle ngabantu abadala. Izingane esezithe ukuba ndala ziyaqala ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwamalungelo kanye nemisebenzi ezibhekene nayo? Lokhu kusho ukuthi ohulumeni kufanele benze konke ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke ingane iyaphila futhi iyakhula (ikhula iphilile futhi inamandla). Izingane ezizalelwa ezindaweni lapho kunezifo eziningi khona, okungenamanzi ahlanzekile kanye nosizo oluncane lwezokwelashwa zifa ziseyizingane kakhulu. Lokhu kwenza kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi omama kanye nezingane zabo banikwe usizo kulesi sigaba zempilo yazo. Zikhona yini izinto ongazicabanga ezingenza ukuthi impilo yomama nabantwana ibe ngcono ffuthi inikeze abantwana kanye nezingane ezisencane isiqalo sempilo esiphilile. Ukuzalwa kwazo zonke izingane kufanele kubikwe masinyane emva kokuba zizelwe. Izingane zinelungelo lokuba negama kanye nelungelo lokuba ngezezwe elithize (njengeNingizimu Afrika). Uhulumeni ngaamunye kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi kuyenzeka lokhu. Ngayo yonke indlela, izingane zinelungeelo lokunakekelwa abazali bazo nokwazi ukuthi abazali bazo bangobani. Ohulumeni bayavuma ukuhlonipha ilungelo lokuthi izingane zigcine ububona bazo. Ukuba negama kanye nobuzwe (ukuba isakhamuzi sezwe) kubizwa ngokuba nokwehluka kobuwena.

Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi inyama iyagcinwa kahle, qiniseka ukuthi ibhalwe kahle ukuze ungabi nekhanda lokuthi iyashintsha ukunambitheka. Isiphetho Inyama yenkomo iyinsika ebalulekile ekudleni kwethu, inikeza izinzuzo eziningi zempilo, futhi iyindlela enhle yokuhlanganisa izitsha ezahlukene. Ukukhetha inyama enempilo, ukuyipheka ngendlela efanele, nokuyigcina kahle, kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi uthola okunambitheka okuhle nokunempilo. Ngakho-ke, uma uthanda ukudla okuhle, ungaphuthelwa yithuba lokujabulela inyama yenkomo, eyenza kube lula ukujabulisa umndeni nabangane.

Ubani ozosizakala ngaleli bhukwana? Leli bhukwana lihlinzeka ngohlaka lokuthuthukisa amakhono ababambiqhaza oHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo (LED) endaweni kamasipala wasebaQulusini ngaphansi kweSifunda saseZululand esiseSifundazweni sakwaZulu Natali (KZN). Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kuyadingeka njengendlela yokweseka ukusebenzisana okuyimpumelelo, ukuhlela nokuqaliswa kokusebenza kohlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo (LED) okuzoholela ekukhuleni komnotho okulingene nokusimeme ebaQulusini. Kuleli bhukwana, siphakamisa ukuthi kube nohlelo lwamasu okusebenza olunezinhla ezine ukuze kusimamiswe umnotho wendawo yaseBaqulusini. Leli lisu limbandakanya, ukusungulwa koPhiko Lokulawulwa Komklamo (PMU) olwenganyelwe kwisifundazwe, oluhlanganisa ongoti bokuThuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo isikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu, kusukela mhla lu -1 kuNdasa wezi- 2011. I-PMU izosungula izinhlelo zesikhashana ukweseka i-LED, ezinjengegatsha elibhekekele ukuthuthukisa, kanjalo nokuqhakambisa ukuphathwa komnotho kwesikhathi eside kumbandakanya ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhungo, ukuthuthukiswa komklamo, ucwaningo, ukuqapha kanye nokuhlola. Ngokudlulisela amakhono afanele nengqalasizinda kuMasipala ingakapheli iminyaka emithathu iqalisile ukuze, uMasipala ube namandla anele okuqhubela phambili amasu okuthuthukisa umnotho esikhathini esizayo. Kucatshangwa ukuthi lolu hlelo luzohlangabezana nezidingo zokusimama zesikhathi eside ngokunjalo nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza okuyimpumelelo okufanele kokuphathwa ngempumelelo komnotho wendawo kwangomuso.

Esahlukweni esilandelayo (isahluko sesibili), indima eyayidlalwa wubuholi bendabuko ngokomlando inikeziwe. Lesi sahluko sizama ukucacisa futhi sinike nolwazi oluyisisekelo ngendima eyayidlalwa wubuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni komthetho ngaphambi kokuqala ukusebenza koMthethosisekelo. Lesi sahluko siveza nje kancane ngokwakwenzeka ngesikhathi sengcindezelo, isikhathi sobandlululo, nesikhathi sezabelo ezazinozibuse, nesikhathi esasingaphambi kancane kwesikhathi sohlelo loMthethosisekelo omusha. Isihloko sesithathu: sigxile esifundweni sokuqhathanisa sohlelo lwemithetho yendabuko emazweni akhethiwe ase-Afrikha nakwamanye amazwe aseNyakatho, kanjalo nalezo zinto eziveza uhlelo lwaseNingizimu Afrikha. Isihloko sesine sibheka intuthuko elethwe wuhlelo loMthethosisekelo omusha, bese kuthi isihloko sesihlanu sibheke izinselelo ngobubanzi, ubuholi bendabuko obubhekene nazo ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo omusha. Isihloko sokugcina (isihloko sesithupha) sigxile kwinqubomgomo engafanela uhlelo lwaseNingizimu Afrikha lwemithetho yendabuko bese sinika nohlaka lomthetho obhekiswe ekunikeni amandla uhlaka lwenqubomgomo. Isihloko sesikhombisa: sinesiphetho esinika isithombe sokukade kudingidwa ohlelweni lokufakana imilomo olwenziwa ukuze kuqhanyukwe nalolu hlaka lwenqubomgomo. Isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko ngesikhathi sombuso wengcindezelo. Indima edlalwa yizikhungo zendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho isuka endulo.

i-Workshop ngokuphepha engwaqeni lapho imnyango wezokuphepha owabamba khona iqhaza. Izikhulu ezingongothi ziqhamuka kwiminyango yezokulawulwa kwezimoto ngohulumeni basekhaya babamba iqhaza ekunikeni izincazelo zezimpawu zemingwaqo kanye nemiqondo yezokuphepha engwaqeni. I-Workshop ephathelene namatemu asetshenziswa ephalamende. Otolika / abahumushi ababephuma eHovisi I-Hansard kanye nasemahovisi olimi ezifunda athola / anikwa ithuba lokuxoxisana nongoti bezihloko ezithile ngomqondo okuyiwonawona wamatemu kanye nokuthatha izinqumo ngalawo anomqondo ovumelanayo futhi avumelekile. Inxoso yoMqondisi omcane ukunikeza imisebenzi yokuhumusha kanye nokuhlela ezilimini eziyisishiyagalolunye ezisemthethweni kanye nezilimi zangaphandle eminyangweni kahulumeni kuzwelonke. Njengakuqala ingxenye yagxila kumabhuku/ ezinhlangothi ezibanzi zezihloko, kusukela emithethweni ekhishwayo kuya ezincwajaneni ezinikeza ulwazi /. Lokhu kusubalala kukhonjiswe yizibonekeliso ezilandelayo zemisebenzi eyenziwe kulonyaka. Umthetho sivivinywa kazwelonke wabaqeqeshelwe eze-Sayensi. Umthetho sivivinywa kazwelonke wokuchitshiyelwa kwemithetho yamahlathi kanye nemmihlaba kuzwelonke. Ukulungisa umthetho wokusokwa eMpumalanga Kapa. Ukulungisa komthetho wokufakwa kwezinto ezinobungozi obukhulu. Incwadi yokuxoxisana nabaholi bendabuko kanye nezikhungo. Isu likazwelonke lamafilimu, amaVideo, kanye nezinqolobane zemisindo. Incwadi yokubusa/ yokuphetha nokuqhutshwa nokubambisana kwezeSayensi kanye noBuchwepheshe.

Nakuba kungenzekanga ukuthi kuphembeke ubudlelwano bokusebenzisana phakathi kweBhodi neHhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ngesikhathi thina sisasesikhundleni, siyethemba ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izokwazi ukwenza lobo buhlobo. Lokho kuyoqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yocwaningo nemikhankaso ebeyixhaswe ngaphansi kwezilimi maqondana nezemfundo kule minyaka emihlanu edlule kuyabelwana ngayo nalabo abasezikhundleni kwezemfundo kuzwelonke nasezifundazwe. Kungakwazi ukuthi kusetshenzwe ngemikhankaso enokuba yimpumelelo ukuthi umthethomgomo wolimi kwezemfundo ukwazi ukusebenza kugwemeke nokuphindaphinda into eyodwa okudla umnotho, kanjalo nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemigwamanda. Maqondana nokugqugquzelela ubungcweti kwezokuhumusha nokutolika, u-PANSALB uphumelele ukukhipha usomqulu ozosetshenziswa ukubhala umthethosivivinywa ozoba yinqobomgomo yobungcweti. Lokhu kwethuliwe ehhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wobuCiko, amaSiko, iSayensi nobuChwepheshe ukuze kuqhutshekwe nohlangothi lwezomthetho kulokhu. Ibhodi entsha kuzofanele ikwazi ukusebenzisana nomgwamanda ozobe usungulelwe ukukhuphula izinga lokuhlonipheka kwalobo bungcweti. Inselele enkulu u-PANSALB abhekene nayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi ebezinokubuyiseleka emuva esikhathini esidlule, ikakhulukazi izilimi ezisemthethweni zendabuko zosishiyagalolunye, ziyathuthukisa. Lokhu kuyozelekelela le zilimi ukuthi nazo zikwazi ukusebenza njengezisemthethweni. Ukusungulwa kweziMpiko zeziChazamazwi kungenye yalezo zinyathelo.

Ngenzani ngoMyalelo Wokuvikeleka Wesikhashana? Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka wesikhashana kumele unikezwe Ummangalelwa (umuntu ohlukumezayo) ngokushesha okukhulu. Awukwazi ukuya ngokwakho uyonikeza Ummangalelwa Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka njengoba lokhu kungeke kube indlela yokwenza umsebenzi elungile. Ngamanye amazwi, ukunikeza Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka wesikhasha-na ngumsebenzi womunye umuntu osesikhundleni sokuba semthethweni okusho ukuthi Iphoyisa. Kumele umukise Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka wesikhashana Ehhovisi likaSherifu noma esiteshini samaphoyisa esiseduzane nekheli lom-mangalelwa lasekhaya noma lasemsebenzini. Esiteshini sama-phoyisa, uyacelwa ukuba ukhumbule ukubhala phansi igama kanye/noma inombolo yebheji yomuntu oyiphoyisa omnikeza lo-Myalelo. Lokhu kuzokusiza ukuthi ukwazi ukulandelela kalula Umy-alelo esikhathini esizayo. Iziteshi eziningi zamaphoyisa zineSisebenzi esiGunyaziwe sokuphatha izindaba zokuhlukunyezwa kwemindeni. Hlela nePhoyisa ukuthi liqoqe, Incwadi Ebuyiswayo,(Ubufakazi Bokunike-za). Lobu wubufakazi bokuthi Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka uye wanikezwa Ummangalelwa nokuthi lowo muntu uwamukele ngokwakhe. Ungahleli ukuthi iphoyisa lithumele noma lipose Incwadi Ebuyiswayo iye Enkan-tolo ngoba lokhu kuhamba kancane kakhulu futhi akufiki enkantolo ngaphambi kosuku lokubuyiswa.

Lezozakhiwo ezithathwa njengabantu ngumthetho zingabanamalungelo akuMqulu wamaLungelo kuphela ngendlela edingwa uhlobo lwelungelo kanye nolwaleso sakhiwo esithathwa njengomuntu ngumthetho. Wonke umuntu uyalingana phambi komthetho, futhi unelungelo elilinganayo lokuvikelwa ngumthetho nenzuzo yomthetho. Ukulingana kubandakanya ukuthokozela onke amalungelo nenkululeko ngokugcwele nangokulingana Ukuze kukhuthazwe impumelelo yelungelo lokulingana, kungathathwa izinyathelo zokushaya imithetho nezinye izinyathelo okuqondwe ngazo ukuthi kuvikelwe noma kuthuthukiswe abantu noma imikhakha yabantu abancishiselwe amathuba ngenxa yobandlululo olungafanele. Umbuso ungebandlulule noma yimuphi umuntu ngokungafanele, ngendlela esobala noma ngendlela ecashile, ngesizathu esisodwa noma ezingaphezulu, ezibandakanya ukubandlulula ngokobuhlanga, ubulili, ukukhulelwa, isimo somuntu kwezomshado, isizwe kambe umphakathi umuntu adabuka kuwo, ibala, ubulili umuntu azifanisa noma afaniswa nabo, iminyaka yobudala, ukukhubazeka, inkolo, unembeza, inkolelo, isiko, ulimi kanye nokuzalwa. Akekho umuntu ovunyelwe ukubandlulula omunye ngokungafanele ngendlela esobala noma ecashile ngesizathu esisodwa noma ngaphezulu njengokusho kwesigatshana (3). Kufanele kushaywe umthetho kazwelonke ukuze kugwenywe noma kunqandwe ubandlululo olungafanele. Ubandlululo ngesizathu esisodwa noma ezingaphezulu ezibalululwe kwisigatshana (3) akufanele ngaphandle uma kuboniswa ukuthi lolo bandlululo lufanele. Wonke umuntu unesithunzi ngokwemvelo futhi unelungelo lokuthi isithunzi sakhe sihlonishwe futhi sivikelwe. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuphila. lokungaphathwa noma ajeziswe ngendlela enesihluku, engenabo ubuntu nelulazayo.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi uzokuqinisekisa ukuthi abadlali abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene bazoba nokuheha ezimakethe zabo, okukhuthaza ukuhamba phambili komkhiqizo kanye nokusebenza kohlelo lokuthengisa. Ngaphezu kokuphumelela komcimbi, kuzophinde kube nezinhlelo zokwazisa ezithinta abathengisi abasha, kube yithuba lokubakhuthaza ukuba babe ngabathengisi abaqavile esizweni. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izinsizwa ezintsha kanye nomoya wokuthuthukisa. Umcimbi uzokwazisa abathengisi mayelana nezinhlelo ezidingekayo ukuze benze ukuthengisa kwabo kube nokusebenza okuhle kakhulu, bobuqu nemikhawulo abayithola emsebenzini wabo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ekwandiseni ibhizinisi, kudale umbono wokwakha okwamanje. Umgomo wethu ukwakha indawo yokuxhumana ezokuthengisa, ukuxhumanisa ulwazi nemibhikisho, okugqugquzela ukusebenzisana nokuqonda okukhulayo. Sinethemba lokuthi lo mcimbi uzoba nempumela ejabulisayo, okuhloswe ngayo ukwakha izimpendulo ezinemisebenzi emisha nokwenza ngcono amasu okuthengisa. Ababamba iqhaza bayamenywa, kanye nalabo abakhathazekile ngokuthengisa, ukuze basebenzise ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye abathengisi ezingakabalungeli. Ukuze uqophele imicimbi, sikhuthaza bonke ukuthumela izicelo zabo zokubamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuzokwakha isikhala sokukhuluma ezimeni ezithinta intuthuko yezokuthengisa, kanti ukuthola izixazululo ezinqala kuzoba yindlela eyodwa yokukhweza izinyathelo zokuthengisa ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Umcimbi uzobe ubukeka njengethuba lokubambisana okukhuthazayo, sibambisene ukuze sithuthukise umqondo wezezimali nezokuthengisa.

Ngesikhathi sokuphumelela, iSundowns iyakha izinkanyezi ezizayo, ikhulisa abasha, futhi ibakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kubonisa ukuthi ibhola akusikho nje ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, umoya, nokubambisana. Ngakho, uma ubona amaMamelodi Sundowns edlala, khumbula ukuthi akukhona nje umphakathi ophilayo, kodwa kuyisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Ngale ndlela, amaMamelodi Sundowns ahlale engumkhumbulo omuhle, uphiko oluqinile, nolwakhiwo oluqinile emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Umoya wabo uhlala uzwakala, izinkanyezi zabo zihlala zikhanya, zikhuthaza abalandeli, futhi zikhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza empilweni. Lokhu kuyindaba yeSundowns, futhi le ndaba izohlala ikhuluma ngezizukulwane ezizayo.

Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokukwazi ukuthola indlu efanelekile. ngokusemandleni ombuso ukwenza ukuba ukuphumelela kwaleli lungelo kuqhubekele phambili. Akekho umuntu ongasuswa emzini wakhe noma kudilizwe indlu yakhe ngaphandle kwesinqumo senkantolo esenziwe ngemuva kokuba ibheke izimo ezithile ezifanelekile Awukho umthetho oyovumela ukususwa abathintekayo benganikwanga ithuba lokuziphendulela. lenhlalakahle okubandakanya, usizo olufanele uma umuntu engakwazi ukuzondla nokondla labo okufanele abondle. Umbuso kufanele uthathe izinyathelo zomthetho ezifanele nezinye izinyathelo ngokusemandleni ombuso ukuze ukuphumelela kwalelo nalelolungelo kuqhubekele phambili. Akekho umuntu ongalelwa ukuba athole usizo lwezokwelashwa oluphuthumayo. Kuzona zonke izinto ezithinta umntwana, kuyobekwa phambili izidingo zakhe. Kulesisigaba "umntwana" kusho umuntu oneminyaka yobudala engaphansi kwengu-18. lemfundo engaphezu kweyisisekelo, sokuthatha izinyathelo ezinqala, kufanele wenze intuthuko ibe khona kunoma ngubani. isidingo sokulungisa imiphumela yemithetho nenqubo eyedlule eyayibandlulula ngokobuzwe. ezigcina amazinga angekho ngaphansi kwamazinga asezikoleni ezingaqhathaniswa nezixhaswa yizimali zombuso. Isigatshana (3) asizivimbeli izimali zombuso ezixhasa izakhiwo zemfundo ezizimele. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokusebenzisa ulimi alukhethayo futhi abambe iqhaza empilweni yamasiko ayikhethayo, kodwa akekho ovunyelwe ukusebenzisa lawa malungelo ngendlela engahambisani nanoma yisiphi isimiso soMqulu wamaLungelo.

Izinsiza Zobuchwepheshe: Abalingisi Abajabulisayo Ngasikhathi sinye, ubuchwepheshe buye baba yingxenye ebalulekile yeziqu zezesayensi. I-automation, i-AI (Artificial Intelligence), nezinye izinhlelo zobuchwepheshe bokuqonda zishintsha indlela esisebenza ngayo. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha emhlabeni wethu, kusiza ukuthuthukisa imiphumela emisha emikhakheni efana nezokwelapha, ezinhlelweni zokulima, nezokuthutha. Ngokuthuthukiswa kwemishini, izazi zivula amathuba amasha, ziqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ehambisana nezicwangciso zayo ibangelwa ukucwaninga okujulile nobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Izinkinga Zezemvelo: Ukubhekelela Isikhathi Esizayo Nokho, izinsiza zesayensi azigcini nje ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olusha, kodwa zibuye zihlola nezinkinga ezibhekene nomhlaba. Ukushintsha kwesimo seplanethi, imuvuzo yokungcoliswa komoya, nokwehla kwemithombo yemvelo kuzoba nemiphumela emikhulu emnothweni nasempilweni yabantu. Izazi zesayensi zihlola ngendlela eqondile indlela lezi zinkinga ezingaxazululwa ngayo, zihlinzeka ngamasu nezixazululo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusayinwa kwezivumelwano zokuvikela imvelo, ukuphucula izinqubo zokwenza izinto, kanye nokwenziwa kwezinto zokuqwashisa umphakathi mayelana nezimo zemvelo. Ubuchwepheshe Belwazi: Ukuxhumana Komphakathi Ukuze umphakathi uthole indlela efanele yokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo. Ubuchwepheshe belwazi, obuhlanganisa i-inthanethi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nemithombo yabezindaba, bunika umphakathi ithuba lokuhlaziya, ukufunda, nokuxhumana ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuphakamisa ukuqonda kwezesayensi, kuvula amathuba amasha okuxoxa ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwemiphakathi ehlukene.

Uqala ngomhlaba - ufake futhi ukhethe uhlobo lwezithelo ofuna ukufaka, bese ukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo, ukhetha inani lomquba ofuna ukufaka, ukhetha izinto ozohlela ukuzisebenzisa, kanye nesikhathi salokho - konke lokhu kudinga isikhathi, amandla, kanye nemali eningi. Bese uthola ukudla ezindaweni ezidinga ukuvuna nokuthengisa - manje kufanele ubale kahle ukuthi izindleko nge-ton zikhona kanjani bese uthola ukuthi uthole inzuzo kangakanani. Ngale ndlela, kuzovela kahle ukuthi uthole imbuyiselo yomsebenzi wakho noma cha? Ohlelweni lwethu lokuthuthukisa abalimi, sithola abalimi abaningi abangazi ukuthi bangaki amahektare ezindawo zabo, abazi ukuthi umhlaba ujula kangakanani, abazi isimo sezinto zomhlaba, umquba abazowufaka, inani lezitshalo, njll. Zonke lezi zinto ziding

Walima isoya eduze neSavanna, eGeorgia wenza nesinongo esiyisosi lesoya wasithengisa eNgilandi. Isoya yaqala ukubaluleka kakhulu e-United States ngemuva kweMpi Yomhlaba Yokuqala. Ngesikhathi seNdlala eNkulu, izindawo ezazikhungethwe yisomiso (i-Dust Bowl) e-United States, zakwazi ukusebenzisa isoya ukuvuselela umhlaba wazo ngenxa yekhono layo lokuvuselela i-nitrogen. Ngonyaka we-1932 ukuya kowe-1933 iNkampani yeziMoto yakwaFord yasebenzisa cishe i -$1 250 000 ocwaningweni lukabhontshisi wesoya. Ngonyaka we-1935 imoto ngayinye yakwaFord yayibandakanya isoya ekwakhiweni kwayo. Isibonelo, uwoyela kabhontshisi wesoya wawusetshenziselwa ukupenda izimoto kanye noketshezi olusetshenziselwa izindawo zemoto ezithwala ukukhahlamezeka kwayo (ama-shock absorber). Ukubandakanyeka kukabhontshisi wesoya kwaFord kwavula iminyango eminingi yokuxhunyaniswa kwezolimo nezamabhizinisi okwaba mandla kunangaphambilini. Ubhontshisi wesoya ungezinye zezitshalo zokudla zobuchwepheshe obusebenza ngezinte eziphilayo "i-biotech" eziye zaguquguqulwa ngokofuzo futhi ubhontshisi wesoya oguquguqulwe ngokofuzo, uyanda ekusetshenzisweni emikhiqizweni eminingana. Ngonyaka we-1995 iNkampani ye-Monsanto yethula ubhontshisi wesoya obizwa nge-Roundup Ready (RR) owawuguquguquliwe ngokofuzo ukuze ukwazi ukumelana nesishabalalisi sokhula i-Roundup esenziwe ngabakwaMonsanto. Ngonyaka we-1997, cishe i-8% awo wonke ubhontshisi wesoya olinyelwa ukuhwebela ukuthola inzuzo e-United States aguguguqulwa ngokofuzo.

Lokhu kwakufaka nezikhungo zokubusa ezazizovumelana nenqubo entsha yentando yeningi nemigomo yoMthethosisekelo enjengokulingana, nokungacwasani. Esinye salezi zikhungo esobuholi bendabuko. Njengalabo ebabehambe le ndlela ngaphambili kuleli zwekazi lase-Afrikha, sisabhekene nenselelo enkulu yokuchaza indima eyayizodlalwa isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko ohlelweni olusha lokubusa. UMthethosisekelo omusha usibekile isisekelo salokhu kanjalo wabambisana nohulumeni omusha ukuthuthukisa umthetho ozobhekana nalolu daba ngokugcwele. ukugcizelela ukubaluleka kobuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho nokusungula isibuko sobulungiswa bendabuko esifanele uhlelo olusha loMthethosisekelo. Ukwakha isisekelo sokumiswa komthetho ogunyaza indima nemisebenzi yabaholi bendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho yobulungiswa, ehambelana nohlelo olusha loMthethosisekelo. Ukungabi khona kwazo zonke izinto ezidingekayo ezinkantolo zendabuko makulungiswe ngendlela yokuthi kugcine kuhambelana nezidingo zoMthethosisekelo omusha. Esahlukweni esilandelayo (isahluko sesibili), indima eyayidlalwa wubuholi bendabuko ngokomlando inikeziwe. Lesi sahluko sizama ukucacisa futhi sinike nolwazi oluyisisekelo ngendima eyayidlalwa wubuholi bendabuko ekuphathweni komthetho ngaphambi kokuqala ukusebenza koMthethosisekelo. Lesi sahluko siveza nje kancane ngokwakwenzeka ngesikhathi sengcindezelo, isikhathi sobandlululo, nesikhathi sezabelo ezazinozibuse, nesikhathi esasingaphambi kancane kwesikhathi sohlelo loMthethosisekelo omusha.

Abanye abalimi baphonsa i-seradella phakathi komumbu. I-seradella iyisitshalo esinothile ngemifino esinokudla okuhle, okungahlinzeki kuphela ukudla okuhle kodwa futhi kwakha i-nitrogen emhlabathini ukuze isetshenziswe emvuthwandaba elandelayo. Inyanga kaMashi ingemuva kwesikhathi sokuphonsa umumbu wokudla (ama-oats) kanye ne-seradella, kodwa kusasele isikhathi sokuphonsa uhlobo lwe-rye. Nokho, khumbula ukuthi le ndlela ye-rye akufanele iphonseke yonke ngesikhathi esisodwa ngoba ikhula ngokushesha kakhulu futhi endaweni ethile, uzoba nokudla kwezilwane okweqile, okuzolandela isikhathi sokuhlupheka lapho kungasatholakali ukudla okwanele kwezilwane. Le ndlela ye-rye ayinambitheki uma inezithelo njengoba imicu yayo iklwebha umlomo, izindlebe, nezinyembezi zezinyoni. Uma unamapulazi aphonswe nge-eragrostis, inyanga kaMashi yisikhathi esihle sokuwagawula okokugcina. Isimo sebhande ngeke sibe kuhle kulolu suku, ngaphandle kokuba ubenze kahle, kodwa okungenani uzoba nokudla okuhle okungasetshenziswa ezinyangeni ezibandayo. Khumbula ukuthi ungakwazi ukuqhubeka nokwengeza ukudla okuhle ukuze izinkomo zikwazi ukukusebenzisa kahle njengokudla okungesihle. Nokho, uma ungenakho ukudla okuhle, ngeke ukwazi ukunakekela kahle izilwane zakho ukuze zibe sesimweni esihle ngesikhathi sebusika. Ngokugawula utshani ngokuhambisana nemigqa, uzokwazi uku fertilize umhlabathi entwasahlobo futhi uthole izitshalo ezinhle zotshani esizeni esilandelayo. Uma kungenzeka, vikela imigqa yotshani ezimeni zezulu ngokuyigcina ngaphansi kwempahla, noma okungenani, kufanele uyifake ngendlela enciphisa ukuvezwa kwayo emvula.

Asingeke siyekele ukufuna izindlela ezintsha zokulwisa ubumpofu nokwenza impilo yabantu ibengcono. Into emqoka yalezinhlelo wukuthi sigqugquzele abantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi basebenzisane ukuze inhlalakahle ithuthuke. Kulomnyaka esikuwo kugujwa umnyaka wamashumi ayisithupha wesivumelwano sabodokotela okungabaholi base Afrika naseNdiya (AB Xuma, GM Naiker kanye no Yusuf Dadoo), umnyaka wamashumi amathathu wokubulawa kuka Steve Biko kanye nomnyaka wamashumi amabili wokuvakashela eDakar kwezihlakaniphi zamabhunu ukuyahlangana neANC. Indaba yokwehlukahlukana kwethu kanye nentshisekelo enkulu yokuzizwa singabase Ningizimu Afrika ifuna ukusetshenzwa kahle kuwo wonke umphakathi ngendlela eqinisa ukuzwana kwethu njengesizwe esisodwa. Kanti futhi kulomnyaka kugujwa umnyaka wamashumi amathathu wokwenqatshelwa ukuthengiswa kwamaphephandaba iWorld ne Weekend World, sifanele ukubuza lombuzo - ingabe sonke siyaqondosisa yini, umsebenzi osimele wokuthi sakhe ubumbhano, nokugqugquzela ukuthi simunye, kuze kuqiniseke into esigcina sibambene. Ngamanye amagama, ubumbano angeke lugqugquzelwe nguhulumeni yedwana, sifanele ukuthi sonke kanye-kanye singabaseNingizimu Afrika sikhulume ngokuthi sikhululekile ekufuneni nasekwenzeni amanyala, sisebenzele ukuzuza injabulo ezanobumbano. Ngiyethemba ukuthi siyavumelana sonke ukuthi ukusebenza ngokubumbana ukuze sizuze injabulo elethwa yinkululeko, kusho ukuthi sifanele ukubambisana ukubhekana nenselele yobugebengu. Ukugqugquzela ukuthula nokulondolozeka kungumsebenzi ka wonkewonke.

Ngiyavuma ukuthi le mbiko yokulimala ethi yenzeke emsebenzini, ngokwazi kwami, iyiqiniso. Ukubhalwa kulolu suku lweminyaka... Ukubhalwa... Igama elibhalwe kwiKomidi Lokukhokha... Umuntu oxhumana naye... Inombolo yefoni ()9. Inombolo ye-fax (...)... Indawo yebhizinisi noma farm... Inombolo yephasiwedi 16. Usuku lokuzalwa... Inombolo yefoni ()... Isikhathi esisebenze eminyakeni/ezinyangeni/... Usuku lapho kwenzeka khona le ngozi 30. Isikhathi... Indawo lapho kwenzeka khona le ngozi 32. Isifunda... Usuku lapho umsebenzi abika khona le ngozi 34. Isikhathi... Yimuphi umsebenzi umsebenzi awawenza ngesikhathi le ngozi yenzeka... Bangaki ubude besikhathi abawenza lo msebenzi eminyakeni/ezinyangeni... Babenza ngesikhathi sokulimala okuhlobene nomsebenzi wakho noma ibhizinisi lakho... Incazelo emfushane yokuthi le ngozi yenzeka kanjani. Ingabe le ngozi yenzeka emgwaqweni womphakathi... Uhlobo lokulimala olwenziwe, isibonelo, ukusika esandleni ngesikhathi besebenza... Ingabe wanelisekile ukuthi umsebenzi ulimele ngendlela abachaze ngayo... Umqashi: Usuku lwe-engozi... Ngokusho kwesigaba 47 seMthetho, umqashi unomsebenzi wokukhokhela umsebenzi imali ephelele ezinyangeni ezintathu zokuqala ngenkathi engasebenzi ngenxa yokugula noma ukulimala. Ingabe ukulungele ukuqhubeka nokukhokhela emva kwezinyanga ezintathu zokuqala ezilandelayo? Uma usukhokhele umsebenzi imali, bhala inani R... Inani lezinsuku/amahora ngesonto abawasebenzelayo... Usuku lapho umsebenzi eyeka ukusebenza... Ingabe baphothule ukushintsha ababephakathi ngosuku abeyeka ukusebenza...? Usuku ababuya ngalo emsebenzini... Uma umsebenzi kufanele aziswe ngezinsuku zokuphumula emsebenzini, umbiko ophathelene nalokho kufanele uthunyelwe njalo ngenyanga ngefomu W.CI.

Isithombe 1: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa engakaze iphuzwe nge-herbicide, ngakho-ke izitshalo eziphukile. Isithombe 2: Insimu eMpumalanga Kapa ephuzwe nge-herbicide ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala. Isithombe 3: Zama ukuthola isitshalo se-maize kulesi sithombe! Isithombe 4: I-filter ye-nozzle yokuphuzisa igcwele. Isithombe 5: Izikhala zomshini ophuzisa zivalekile. Isithombe 6: Ukuvaleka kwezi zikhala kungenzeka uma umshini ungcolile futhi ungagcinwanga kahle. Izithombe 1 no-2 zithathwe ensimini efanayo eMpumalanga Kapa - isithombe 1 sikhombisa lapho i-herbicide ingafakwanga - isithombe 2 sikhombisa lapho iphuziswe khona ngokushesha ngemva kokutshala - umehluko ubonakala kahle! Singasho ukuthi zonke izitshalo ezikhula ezindaweni lapho zingafuneki khona ziwukuhlanya. Ukuhlanya kuyinkinga uma kukhuliswa izitshalo zokudla ngoba zikh competition nezinye izitshalo zokudla ngamanzi nezakhi, okwenza kube nezinkinga ngesikhathi sokuvuna, z contaminating izitshalo zokudla, imbewu yazo ingafaka ama-toxins ekudleni, futhi zingagcina izilokazane nezifo ezibeka ubungozi. Ukuhlanya kukhula ngokushesha futhi kuqina kalula. Zivame ukuba nezimpande eziqinile futhi zikhula kahle ezimeni zezulu ezahlukene. Kubalulekile ukuzisusa; ziqinile futhi zikh competition ngokuqinile nezinye izitshalo ngamanzi nezakhi. Ukuhlanya kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuphindaphinda, ngakho kufanele siqaphele ngalokhu uma sizama ukuzisusa. Ukuhlanya kungakhiqiza imbewu (ngokuvamile ngokushesha nangokulula), ezinye izinhlobo zine-rhizomes phansi, ezinye zine-stolons phezulu, ezinye zine-tubers, kanti ezinye zineziphuzo ezinkulu.

Iningi lala mabhizinisi asebenzayo nahlelekile atholakala eVryheid, futhi lawa ambandakanya ezohwebo, ezolimo, ezokuthengisa kanye nemisebenzi yezokukhiqiza, futhi ikakhulu ilawo asebenza ngawodwana. Kudala, lawa ayemelwe yi- Chamber of Business, eseyihlelwe kabusha yaba yi- Vryheid/ Besigheid. Angeke libukelwe phansi igalelo lama-SMME (amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi namakhulu) emnothweni wasebaQulusini. Inkinga ekhono nokho ileyo yokungameleleki ngendlela efanele kwale mboni ezinhlakeni zokuhlelwa kwamabhizinisi. Isinyathelo esibalulekile ekubambisaneni nabanye ababambiqhaza ngukwaziswa kwale mboni emathubeni ezamabhizinisi afanele. Njengalokhu izindawo eziningi zihlonzwe njengezingathuthukile, imboni engekho emthethweni ifaka isandla ngokubonakalayo ekuqedweni kobubha njengoba iletha imali engenayo edingekayo emindenini ehlwempu. UHlelo LokuThuthukiswa kwesifunda saseZululand lowe-1998 lusho ukuthi "umnotho wasemakhaya kanye nowezinye izindawo ezingamadolobha amancane ungachazwa njengomnotho ongekho emthethweni". Le mboni, yize ibalulekile, ayihlelekile ngendlela futhi ayikaleki. Abantu abasebenza kule mboni, ngokuvamile , abaqeqeshekile ngendlela futhi baqhuba ibhizinisi labo ngokungayigcini imali. Imboni isebenza kahle kakhulu ezindaweni zasemadolobheni, yize noma zikhona ezinye izindawo zasemakhaya ezihlinzeka ngamathuba laba bahwebi abasafufusa. Imifelandawonye emincane, isb. leyo eyakhiwe ngabantu abangekho ngaphansi kweshumi nanye inhloso yazo ukuhlinzeka ngomsebenzi noma izidingongqangi kumalungu awo. Imifelandawonye emikhudlwana, isb.

Ezinyangeni ezinhlanu ngemuva kokwethulwa kombiko, izithunywa ezibandakanya namalungu okungenani amabili eBhodi kumele bachazele iKomidi lesiShayamthetho elibhekele ezezimali ngombiko wonyaka. uqukathe imininingwane efanele yokusebenza maqondana nezomnotho, ukunikezelwa kwezinsiza okube wusizo nempumelelo kanye nokuqhathanisa phakathi kokuhleliwe kanye nokwenziwe okukhombisayo njengokuba kubekiwe kulolo hlelo lwebhizinisi. 28. (a) IsiKhungo ngokuthintana nelungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali, singasungula futhi sigcine izimali ezikhethekile, kubandakanya izimali ezejwayelekile ezisetshenziselwa ukufaka abantu ababencishwe amathuba emkhakheni wokungeniswa kwempahla kuleli nempahla ethunyelwa kwamanye amazwe. IsiKhungo kumele silawule lezo zikhwama zemali ngendlela enqunywe yiLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali. Unyaka wezimali wesiKhungo uqala mhla lu-1 kuMbasa ngalowo nyaka futhi uphela mhla zinga-31 kuNdasa ngonyaka olandelayo. IsiKhungo ngokwenqubomgomo kanye nangezinqubo ezinqunywe yiBhodi futhi nangokuvuma kweLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele, singathola, sithathe noma silahle impahla engenakususwa ekusebenzeni kwaso. 31. (1) Noma yiziphi izinyathelo zomthetho ezithathelwa isiKhungo kumele kwenziwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho wesiKhungo sokuThathelwa iziNyathelo zoMthetho kweziNhlaka ezithile zikaHulumeni, 2002 (uMthetho No. 40 ka 2002). IsiKhungo, ngokwezihloso zesigatshana (1), sithathwa njengohlaka lukahulumeni oluhlongozwe endimeni (c) yencazelo yalokho okusesigabeni 1 salowo Mthetho. 32.

Uma ufuna ukungenisa izimoto ezisetshenzisiwe noma ezindala eNingizimu Afrika, udinga imvume ekhethekile evela kuNgqongqoshe wezeMali nezeMboni noma abamele wakhe. Ihhovisi leNgqongqoshe lizokwenza isinqumo sokuhlinzeka izwe ngezimoto ezindala noma ezisetshenzisiwe ezingangeniswa ezweni. Kufanele uthumele ifomu elichaziwe ukuze ufake isicelo semvume yokungenisa. Imvume yokungenisa iyadingeka kuyo yonke impahla engaphansi kokulawulwa kwemikhiqizo engenisiwe. Imvume ibalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impahla ezindala ezingeniswa aziphazamisi umkhakha weMali wezeMali waseNingizimu Afrika. Le nsizakalo ithuthukisa ukuhambisana nezinyathelo zokuphepha nezindinganiso. Nikeza ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yeMazisi yakho. Nikeza uMnyango ngekopyi eqinisekisiwe yecebo lokubhaliswa kwezimoto. Kungathatha izinsuku ezintathu ukuze processing yesicelo sakho. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa.

Kulinywa lokhu okulandelayo (umbila, ubhontshisi nokolo- kuniselwa ngenkasa kanye nezitshalo ezidinga umhlaba owomile), izitshalo eziluhlaza, kuyasengwa futhi kukhiqizwa inyama yenkomo neyemvu. Uhwebo ngezingodo lwenzeka endaweni encane elinganiselwa koku 1.9 kokungu100. Indawo esele elinganiselwa koku 30 kokungu 100 , ngaphandle kwamadolobha amancane , igcwele abantu abakhe ezabelweni kanye nezindawo zamaKhosi lapho imikhiqizo yezolimo ngeyokondla imindeni kuphela. Ukuvuleleka komnotho weNingizimu Africa ngonyaka ka 1994 kwaqeda ukuvikeleka kwabalimi ngokuphela kwezimali zoxhaso, lokhu kwadala ukuba ukudla okuvela emazweni angaphandle kubize kangcono kunokudla kwangaphakathi. Lokhu kudale ushintsho ezindleleni zokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo, ukusintsha kwamabhizinisi, ukwehla kwezindleko bokubuyela ezindleleni zokulima izindawo ezinkulu. Izindleko zomhlaba bezilokhu zehla nakuba kubonakala sengathi lokhu kuba ngcono. Imikhiqizo yenyama yenkomo yilona bhizinisi elike labhekana nesidingo sokuba kwehliswe izindleko , lokhu kwenza ukuba kubuyelwe kulolohlobo lwezinkomo oludinga ukuphiwa kancane ukudla . Ngenkathi kwenzeka lokhu zehlisiwe izindleko zomsebenzi owenziwa kulenyama. Umoya ongemuhle phakathi kwabanikazi bamapulazi nabasebenzi bamapulazi kanye nomakhelwane; kanye nokuphoqwa kwabalimi ukuba bakhokhe intela yamapulazi. Izindawo ezinobunini obuhlanganyelwe zinenkinga yokungabi namnini oyedwa, bacishe bacinae abantu ezindaweni ezihlelelwe ukuhlaliswa kwabantu, baye nggokuqgaqgana kulezozindawo eziqhelile kulezo ezihleliwe.

Uma zikhona ezinye izindlela zokuletha intuthuko 'ezinye izindlela', nazo ziyacwaningwa. Ucwaningo luvame ukwenziwa wuchwepheshe ongahlangene nomsebenzi owenziwayo noma ohlongozwayo, kanti ubizwa ngo "meluleki ozimele. Umphakathi uyatshelwa ngomsebenzi bese uvunyelwa ukwethula imibono yawo. Bangabeka imibono ngezindlela nemigudu eyehlukene yokunciphisa umonakalo ongadaleka emvelweni. Ngemuva kophenyo lohlaziyo lomthelela, uhulumeni ubuyekeza konke okushiwo wumphakathi bese enquma noma intuthuko ingaqhutshwa yini noma imiswe. Kungabekwa imibandela ethile yokuvikela imvelo uma siqhutshwa isenzo. Uma kungaba nomthelela omkhulu emvelweni. i-NEMA ibuye ithi uma kwenziwa uhlaziyo lomthelela akumele kubhekwe kuphela umthelela oyokwenzeka emvelweni kodwa makubhekwe nendlela umphakathi nezinto zamasiko ezingathinteka ngayo. Akavunyelwe uhulumeni ukushaya indiva izincomo ezenzwe ophenyweni lokuhlaziya umthelela emvelweni. Okunye futhi, akavunyelwe ukunganaki imigomo yeNEMA, lapho inquma okumele kwenziwe. Uma kwephulwa lemigomo, ungathatha izinyathelo zomthetho. Ungacela inkantolo ibeke eceleni imvume ekhishwe wuhulumeni. Kuchaza ukuthini "ukunukubeza umoya okunqala"? i-NEMA ithi ukunukubeza kungenzeka ngezindlela eziningi. Ukulethwa kwezidingo zomphakathi. Ukunukubeza kungadalwa ngabantu noma wuhulumeni. Ukuze kubizwe ngokunukubeza, kufanele kushintshe imvelo njengamanje noma esikhathini esizayo ngendlela ephazamisa impilo yakho noma inhlalonhle, noma kulimaze imvelo uqobo. I-NEMA ayikusizi kuzo zonke izimo lapho kwenzeka khona ukunukubezeka. Yilezo zimo ezinkulu kuphela ongathola usizo kuzo.

Ozokuba uphathini kufanele yena yedwa futhi abhale phansi afunge ukuthi uyathanda ukuburejista ubuhlobo bakhe bomndeni ngokusayina umqulu obekelwe konaphambi kukamgcini-hhovisi orejistayo. Umgcini-hhovisi orejistayo kufanele awusayine umqulu obekiwe ukufakaza ukuthi ukufunga okukhulunywa ngako kwisigatshana 3 kwenziwe ngokuzikhethela futhi phambi kwakhe. Umgcini-hhovisi kufanele enze isaziso sokuthi kunesivumelwano sobuhlobo bomndeni, uma sebakhiwe, kwisitifiketi sokurejista. Umgcini-hhovisi kufanele akhiphe isitifiketi sokurejista esishoyo ukuthi barejiste ubuhlobo bomndeni, uma sebakhiwe, anamathisele ikhophi esethifayiwe yesivumelwano sobuhlobo oseburejistiwe kwisitifiketi sokurejista. Isitifiketi sokurejista esikhishwe umgcini-hhovisi ukukhishwa kwaso kuwubufakazi bokuthi kunobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe phakathi kophathini. Lowo nalowo mgcini-hhovisi kufanele agcine irejista yazo zonke izivumelwano zobudlelwano bemindeni oburejistiwe ezisingathwe uye bese enza isaziso salezo zivumelwano zobuhlobo oburejistiwe, uma kwenziwe, kwirejista. Umgcini-hhovisi kufanele khona manjalo irejista ayithumele kumgcini-hhovisi wakwahulumeni onikwe umsebenzi wokurejista abantu kwisifunda abekwe kuso. Kufanele kuthi lapho ifika kuye irejista aqikelele ukuthi imininingwane yobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe iyafakwa kwirejista yabantu ngowkwemigomo yesigaba 8e yomthetho yoKwazisa. ngaphandle kwaloko okubekiwe kule sigaba, awukho umthetho jikelele omaqondana nempahla phakathi kophathini abawumndeni orejistiwe.

I-Fund ye-Competitiveness (CF) iyigxathu yokwabelana ngezindleko ehlinzeka ngosizo lwezezimali ukuze kusekelwe osomabhizinisi abasungula amabhizinisi ukufinyelela ku-50% wezindleko zabo. Osomabhizinisi abafanelekile kumele bakhiqize imikhiqizo noma banikeze izinsizakalo kumabhizinisi anezici ezithile noma iziqu. Ukukhuthaza ngokwezimali amabhizinisi ukuba athuthukise amazinga awo okusebenza, kanye nokufinyelela ezinsizakalweni zokwazi zangaphandle nezifundo. Ukuthuthukisa izinkampani (ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphatha noma lokuphathwa, ukuthola amazinga ajwayelekile), ukuqeqesha ukuze kwakhiwe amazinga okuncintisana. Ukwandisa izinsizakalo ze-NGOs, izinhlangano zamabhizinisi, nezimboni ezizama ukuthuthukisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zezigaba/izimboni ezithile. Ukuhlinzeka ngama-grant ukuze kufinyelelwe ezingeni eliphezulu le-R600,000 emkhakheni nasemkhakheni ofanele. Ukusiza izimboni ukuthi zifeze amazinga aphezulu okuncintisana emakethe zangaphandle emkhakheni wemakethe yasekhaya nasemakethe yokuthumela ngaphandle.

Emakethe, kukhona ama-herbicides ahlukahlukene anamagama amahle amaningi, kodwa wonke anohlu olufanayo lwezingxenye ezisebenzayo. Uma uqhathanisa amanani ezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-herbicides, cabangela futhi ukusebenza kahle kwalawa mahlanganisela bese uthola intengo emakethe ukuze uqhathanise nayo ingxenye esebenzayo ukuze unqume izindleko ngehektare. Ikakhulukazi ngezihlahla zonyaka. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka ngokushesha emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke kanye nezinye izinhlobo ezifana nezitshalo. Acetochlor/atrazine terbuthylazine (nange noma ngaphandle 'kwesafener'). Kukhona izixazululo eziningi. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka ngokushesha emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Awukwazi ukulinda ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezimbili. Izinhlobo eziningi zezihlahla zikhula minyaka yonke. Ngaphambi kokuphuma. Faka ngokushesha emhlabathini olungisiwe kahle. Awukwazi ukufaka emhlabathini one-pH engaphansi kuka-16%. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Ngemuva kokuphuma. Kuphela eKwaZulu-Natal. Izinhlobo zezihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi kanye nezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla. Faka ezihlahleni eziphelele. Ikakhulukazi izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke. Ngaphambi kokuphuma noma ngokushesha ngemuva kokuphuma. Ikakhulukazi izihlahla ezinehlamvu ebanzi ezikhula minyaka yonke.

Abammeli bangakusiza futhi uma ufuna ukuya enkantolo. Uma unquma ukuthatha izinyathelo, kungaba ngezomthetho noma olunye uhlobo, ngokwakho noma ngokusizwa wubungoti babathize, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi yisikhalo sakho lesi futhi nguwe okumele uthathe izinqumo ngenqubo. Ukuthola ulwazi nemininingwane eminingi kukubeka esimweni esilula sokuthatha izinqumo. Kubalulekile ukuthola ulwazi olufanele ngoba lukusiza ekwenzeni izinqumo eziyizo ngokumele ukwenze ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo. Lokhu kungasheshisa, kunciphise izindleko nomonakalo. Umthethosisekelo omusha ukunika ilungelo lolwazi olugcinwe wuhulumeni noludingela ukuvikela elinye lamalungelo akho. iNEMA isitshela ngokugcwele ngolwazi esingaluthola kuhulumeni noma kubantu abazimele maqondana nezemvelo. Ulwazi ngokudaleka kukadoti oyingozi, ukugcinwa nokulahlwa kwawo. Uhulumeni angathola ulwazi ngezemvelo kunoma yimuphi umuntu ozimele. Lokhu kungahlanganisa isisi noma udoti ochithekele emoyeni, emhlabathini nasemanzini nokuphathwa kwawo. Wena uyobe usuthola lolulwazi kuye uhulumeni. Akavunyelwe uhulumeni ukwenqaba nolwazi ngaphandle kwalapho ufuna into angakwazi ukuyithola noma enganamqondo noma ulwazi olufunwayo lunobungozi kwezokuphepha ezweni, emvelweni noma luyimfihlo. Isibonelo: Ufuna ukwazi ngendawo ongaya kuyo ukuyobona izihlahla ezisengcupheni yokushabalala kanye nemidwebo yaBathwa esematsheni. Isicelo sakho solwazi siyenqatshwa ngokwesabela ukuthi ukuveza lolulwazi kungaholela esimweni lapho umphakathi ungantshontsha khona lemvelo, noma ekulinyazweni kwemidwebo.

Uma kungekho sivumelwano okufinyelelwa kusona phakathi koMkhandlu nomasipala othintekayo emva kwezinsuku ezingamashumi amathathu emva kokukhishwa kwesaziso esibhalwe phansi okukhulunywe ngaso esigatshaneni (2), umphathi kamasipala kumele, ngokubhalwe phansi, azise iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezamagugu kanye neLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ohulumeni basekhaya ngesaziso sokubiza umhlangano phakathi koMkhandlu nomasipala ngelinge lokufinyelela esivumelwaneni. Omunye umhlangano okukhulunywe ngawo endimeni (b) kumele ube khona ezinsukwini ezingamashumi amathathu emva kokuthi amaLungu oMkhandlu oPhethe azisiwe. Uma kungavunyelwana, umasipala angeke uqhubeke nomthethodolobha noma nomthethonqubo osewuhlaka. Uma uMkhandlu kanye nomasipala othintekayo befinyelela esivumelwaneni, umasipala othintekayo kumele emhlanganweni wawo olandelayo, ngokuhlonipha noma yisiphi isivumelwano, ucubungule umthethodolobha noma umthethonqubo osewuhlaka njengoba uchitshiyelwe futhi ungaqhubeka nawo. Uma uMkhandlu uhluleka ukukhombisa ngesikhathi esibalulwe esigabeni (2) ukuthi weseka noma uphikisa umthethodolobha noma umthethonqubo osewuhlaka, umasipala othintekayo ungaqhubeka nomthethodolobha noma nomthehonqubo. umuntu maqondana nanoma yimuphi umsebenzi owenziwe nanoma yini eyenziwe noma ehlinzekwe nguMkhandlu.

Umculo wesintu, ngokwesibonelo, ubonisa ubuciko bendabuko, lapho izinsimbi zesiZulu zisetshenziswa khona ukudala umculo ophilayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umculo wepop uhlanganisa izitayela ezithokozisayo, ezivame ukudlalwa emicimbini nasematheni. Umculo Njengomthombo Wokuxhumana Umculo ungumthombo omkhulu wokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Ezinye izinkanyezi zomculo zisetshenziswa emicimbini, ezikhumbuzweni, nasemihlanganweni, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlangane, bakhumbule izikhathi ezinhle, futhi bazwakalise imizwa yabo. Umculo uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, ubakhuthaze ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi ubavumele ukuba babonise uthando nemizwa yabo. Umculo Njengomthombo Wokwelapha Ngaphezu kokuba umculo uyinsiza yokuzijabulisa, ucwaningo luveze ukuthi ungumthombo wokwelapha. Umculo ungasiza ekunciphiseni ukukhathazeka, ukunciphisa ubuhlungu, nokuthuthukisa impilo yengqondo. Abantu abanezinselelo ezinzima, njengokukhathazeka noma ukucindezeleka, bangathola ukuthula emculweni. Izinhlelo zokwelapha ezisebenzisa umculo zikhombisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila engcono. Izinselelo Zomculo Wamanje Noma umculo unamandla amakhulu, ubhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Ubulungiswa bokwakha umculo, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwemali, kanye nezinguquko zamasiko zenza kube nzima kubaculi abasha. Umculo wokwakha ungaba nezinselelo eziningi, njengoba abaculi behluleka ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze bakhe umculo ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa abaculi, ukuze umculo uqhubeke uthokozisa.

Le phrojekthi esekelwe kwinkolelo yokuthi uma benesipiliyoni, abafundi bakwamatikuletsheni bazokwazi ukuba yikhona kokubili ukuqasheka kanye nokuzisebenza. Ohlukunyeziwe wachazela umama wakhe ukuthi wadlwengulwa ngumalume wakhe. Iphrojekthi yamakheli yokunikeza izinombolo kanye namagama imigwaqo futhi kwizindawo ezisemalokishini amadala ukuze zingene kuhlelo oluhlelekile lwamakheli. Kuyisikhathi esinothile ngezibonakaliso zezenkolo kanye namasiko asukela kwimigubho yokuqala yokubanjwa, ukuqulwa kwecala, ukushona kanye nokuvuka kukaJesu. Ukuze ababazi bakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele kuzolindeleka lokhu okulandelayo kubona: ikhono lesandla, ukusebenzisana kahle kwehlo nesandla kanye nolwazi bendawo kanye nokubumba. Lena yingxube ye-bagasse ne-molasses ngamazinga aphansi amandl okungaba izinhlayiya ze-molasses noma i-molasses eyimpuphu. Ukuhlanganiswa ngokuphathele nendlela, indawo kanye nesikhungo kumele kugqugquzelwe, kubhekiswe ngokukhethekile kwizindlela zokuthuthukiswa, kanye nokusetshenziswa kwendlela kanye nomthamo. Ayikho i-automatic cistern noma i-tipping tank engasetshenziselwa ukushaya umcamo. Imboni yamahhotela ilindele ukubona izinguquko ezinkulu, ezivimbela ukuquka kokufadabala komnotho osekwenze bambalwa abantu abafuna ukuvakasha. Ngingaphinda kuphela uktuhi angikholelwa ukuthi ungacindezela abantu nge-avionic equipment. Ukukuze kusombululwe ukususwa kwekati eziko kanye nokungathuthukiswa ngokwenele ngokugxila kwizinsiza zabo bonke ohulumeni basezindawei ezisemadolobheni. Ukuvinjelwa kokungagunyaziwe, okungekho emthethweni futhi nokungatheli izithelo kanye nokulahlekelwa okusukela ekungaziphathini kahle.

Umqashi wakho noma omunye umuntu akavunyelwe ukwethembisa noma yini ewusizo ngenhloso yokukuncenga ukuthi wenza lowomsebenzi. Uma uthathelwa izinyathelo, njengokuxoshwa, unelungelo lokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho. Ukushaya ikhwela/ukuhlaba umkhosi ngezenzo ezingadala umonakalo emvelweni. Uma ubika noma ukhipha ulwazi ngokuthile okholelwa futhi okubona kungaba yingozi emvelweni, angeke wabophezelwa kukho yinkantolo noma uxoshwe, ujeziswe noma uhlukunyezwe. Kodwa qiniseka ngokuveza ulwazi ngendlela efanele ukuze uvikelwe. Kwakulusizo kakhulu emphakathini ukuveza ulwazi kunokuthula. Uma ukhiphe ulwazi oluvele selwaziwa wumphakathi. Akekho umuntu ongakwethembisa okuthile okuwusizo ukuvala umlomo wakho ukuze ungahlabi umkhosi. Isibonelo: Usebenzela inkampani elima izitshalo. Omunye wabaphathi bakho usebenzisa ngokungafanele isikhuthaza-khaba emasimini akhe esingavunyelwe enzela ukuthi izitshalo zande. Kunomthetho kulenkampani othi uma ungezwa ngaloluhlobo lwesenzo kumele utshele osingethe ezabasebenzi enkampanini. Kodwa wesaba ukuthi uma wenza njalo, ungahlukunyezwa nobufakazi bugqibeke. Unquma ukuyobikela uMshushisi-Jikelele. Ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle noma lokhu koyixazulula yini inkinga, ubikele neKomidi lasePhalamende eliqondene nezoLimo. Izigameko zengozi ephuthumayo zingadala ingozi enkulu emphakathini noma emvelweni esikhathini samanje nakwesizayo. Ungafuna ukuthatha izinyathelo zokunqanda umonakalo esikhathini esizayo noma uthole ulwazi ngomonakalo owenzeke empahleni noma empilweni yakho ngenxa yesehlakalo esifana nalesi.

Isitifikedi somshado sinenhloso yokuba wubufakazi bokuthi ushadile. Umshado kumele kube wenziwe phambi kwabantu abashadayo, ofakazi ababili abanamadokhumende omazisi kanye nesikhulu sokushadisa. Abantu abashadayo kumele babenamadokhumende omazisi kanye nokugcwalisa ifomu le-BI-31. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-130 kunoma yiliphi ihhovisi lezaseKhaya eNingizimu Afrika. Yenza isicelo kwinxusa noma i-mission uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Umshado ungenganyelwa yisikhulu esishadisayo enizikhethela sona kwiqembu elithize lezenkolo, inhlangano noma omele aboMnyango wezaseKhaya. Umshado kumele kube wenziwe esontweni, ebhilidini elisetshenziselwa inhloso yezenkonzo kuphela, ihhovisi likahulumeni noma indlu yangasese. Uma umuntu okumele kushadanwe naye elimala kakhulu noma egula kakhulu, umshado ungenzelwa esibhedlela. Abantu bangaphandle abashada eNingizimu Afrika, kumele babenamapasipoti kanye nokugcwalisa ifomu lesicelo elingu: BI-31. Abantu ababili abashadayo, ofakazi ababili kanye nesikhulu esishadisayo, kumele basayine iRejista yeMishado ngokushesha ngemuva kokuba umshado uqhutshwe. Abancane ngokomthetho, ngabantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21, abangakaze bashade ngaphambilini. Ngokulandela umthetho, abantu abake bashada ngesikhathi esedlule, okanti imishado yabo ihlakazwe wukushona noma idivosi, ngeke besathathwa ngokuthi ngabancane ngokomthetho. Bafakele incwadi yokuvuma ebhaliwe, yabo bobabili abazali kanye/noma umnakekeli osemthethweni, ngokugcwalisa ifomu lesicelo elingu-BI-31.

Mayelana nokukhuluma ngendlela entsha yephakathi kanye nomgwaqo wezitimela, isigaba 4 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubuqotho Bezemisebenzi, 2000 (Umthetho No. 3 ka-2000) ubhekisisa izinqubo ezimbili ezishintshashintshayo lapho umphathi wehhovisi kumele akhiphe isinqumo esingase sithinte amalungelo omphakathi kahle noma kabi, eshilo nje ukuhlohla komphakathi noma inqubo yokuphendula. Isigaba esikhona 6 sikhetha inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi. Le nqubo ingaba nezinkinga futhi ithathe isikhathi eside futhi ingase iphinde idlulele isidingo solwazi olufanele ekwenzeni izinqumo okukhulunywe ngakho kahle ngale nqubo ehambisana nokuhlolwa kwesayithi kanye nebhuku elihlongozwayo esigabeni 6(a) soMthetho oyinhloko. Ngalesi simo, inqubo yokuhlohla nokuphendula njengoba kubonisiwe esigabeni 4 soMthetho 3 ka-2000 izosebenza futhi izosebenza kahle uma umbiko wendawo usuphothuliwe, kuyilapho inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi ingagcinwa kulezi zimo lapho izinkinga zivelayo ngqo enanini lokuhlohla futhi emibikweni emibili eminye, engase idinge ukuhlolwa nokuphendulwa okwengeziwe. Ngakho-ke, isigaba 6 sishintshwa ukuze kusetshenziswe inqubo yokuhlohla nokuphendula ukuze i-MEC yenze isinqumo, futhi kusebenze inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi kuphela ezindabeni ezihlobene nezinkinga ezithile. Ngakho-ke, ubuqotho bezemisebenzi obuphumelele buhamba phambili kunalokho okudingekayo nguMthetho 3 ka-2000 ngokuthi zombili izinqubo zilandelwa. Umthetho okhona awubheki kahle isivumelwano esidingekayo nguNgqongqoshe mayelana nokwakha, ukwakha, ukusebenza, ukuphathwa, nokubhekwa kweGautrain Rapid Rail Link ephakanyisiwe.

Ibhande lesizwe liyisithombe esibonakalayo, esikhulu kunezinye zonke izithombe ezisemhlabeni. Ibhande lesizwe liyingxenye ebalulekile ye-emblem enkulu, evame ukubhekwa njengophawu oluphezulu kunezinye zonke ezweni. Ibhande elinophawu oluphezulu linikezwa amandla amakhulu ngoba libonisa ukuthi livunyelwe nguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika. Ibhande lesizwe laseNingizimu Afrika lanikelwa ezweni ngosuku lokukhululeka, ngoMsombuluko 27, 2000. Lokhu kukhombisa umgomo wombuso wokugqamisa ushintsho lwezokhetho eNingizimu Afrika kanye nothando olusha lwezwe lethu. Ibhande lesizwe ingxenye yochungechunge lwezinto ezihlelwe ukuze zenze isimo se-oval esibekwe ngendlela yokuthi ingxenye eyodwa iphakama phezulu kwezinye. Isinqumo sokuqala siyi-motto esiyingxenye ephakathi kwedolobha eliluhlaza. Ibekwa ngendlela efanele, enezinhlangothi ezimbili zezilwane ezibheke phezulu, ukuze igcwalise le dolobha. Emfanekisweni ongafani nowe-egg owenziwe ngezinsingo zezilwane, kukhona izindlebe ezimbili zekhabe ezakha umqhele wegolide ophakathi. Umfanekiso womqhele uhlobene nedrum futhi ubonisa abantu ababili abenziwe ngobuciko bevumelana, bephakathi kwabantu baseKhoisan. Laba bantu baveza ubuso obubheke komunye, bejabulisa ngokuhlanganyela. Phezulu komqhele, kukhona umkhonto nesihlangu ehleliwe ukuze kudaleke isithombe se-cross. Lezi zinto zihlelwe ukuze zihambisane nomqhele ukuze kuqedwe isithombe sesisekelo esingaphansi esifana ne-egg. Inhlanga enezinyawo ezinde ibekwe phezulu kwehlathi eliluhlaza, nezimbali zakha isifuba senhlanga.

Umholi wendawo, uMnumzane Khumalo, wakhuluma ngokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi. Wathi: “Abasebenzi bethu bayisibopho sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphandle kwabo, asizukwazi ukufinyelela phezulu. Namuhla, sizobabonga ngempela.” UThandi wayezwa umoya wokuhlonishwa, futhi lokhu kumjabulisa. Wazi ukuthi imiklomelo ayitholi kuphela, kodwa futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni umoya omuhle emsebenzini. UThandi wayefisa ukuba yisibonelo kwabanye, ukuze bonke bazi ukuthi imizamo yabo iyavuma. Lapho kufika isikhathi sokwethula imiklomelo, uThandi waphakanyiswa. Umholi wendawo wathi: “Ngiyajabula ukumemezela ukuthi uThandi ungumsebenzi ophakeme kakhulu kulo nyaka. Ubonise ukuzinikela, ubuchule, nokusebenza kanzima. Ngiyamhlonipha, futhi ngiyamnika le miklomelo.” UThandi waphakamisa izandla zakhe, ejabule kakhulu. Wazi ukuthi le miklomelo ibalulekile, kodwa okwakubaluleke kakhulu wukuhlonishwa. Wabonga umphakathi, wathi: “Ngiyabonga kakhulu. Lokhu akukhona kuphela okwenziwe ngami, kodwa nakwabanye. Sisebenza sonke, futhi ngiyazi ukuthi sizoqhubeka sikhula.” Ngemuva kokwethulwa kwemiklomelo, umcimbi waqhubeka. Abantu bajabula, behlanganyela izindaba zabo, futhi bejabulela impumelelo yabo. UThandi wathola ithuba lokukhuluma noMusa noNandi, abanye abasebenzi abavelele. Bahlanganyela izifundo zabo, baphinde baxoxa ngezinto ezithokozisayo ezenzakalayo emsebenzini. UThandi wathola ukuthi imiklomelo ayigcini nje ngokuhlonishwa, kodwa futhi iyakhuthaza. Abasebenzi bahlala bejabule, futhi umoya wokusebenza kahle wawukhula. UThandi waba nesifiso sokwenza kahle njalo, ukuze aqhubeke nokuhlonishwa. Njengoba umcimbi uphela, uThandi waphuma ethokozile.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungaqinisekiswa kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali kahulumeni, njengoba izinsizakalo ezithile zingatholakali kubathola impesheni. Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze abathola impesheni bathole izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe inombolo yempesheni, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abathola impesheni bazi izinkinga ezivamile ezihambisana nale nqubo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi ahlale eqaphile futhi alandele izinqubo ezisemthethweni.

Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu, njengoba abantu bephikisa ukuthi izimo zomthetho kufanele zihlale ziqinile, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abavumelekile ukwenza izenzo ezinjalo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uPistorius wathola ithuba lokuphila impilo entsha, kodwa umphakathi wawungakholwa kalula. Isinqumo sakhe saphinde savusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezobudlelwane, izokuphepha, kanye nezimo zomthetho. U-Pistorius waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinkantolo zidinga ukucacisa ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuvikelwa, nokuthi izimo zomthetho kufanele zisebenze kanjani. Ngokuphetha, ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kudinga ukuba sihlole izici eziningi ezithinta umphakathi, izokuphepha, kanye nezimo zomthetho. Lesi senzo saphinde savula izinkulumo ezinzima ezithinta ubudlelwane, futhi saphinde sakhumbuza abantu ukuthi izinkantolo zidinga ukucacisa ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuvikelwa. U-Pistorius waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu abavumelekile ukwenza izenzo ezinjalo, futhi lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho. I-Ofisa Enegunya izakufaka ukuvumela okubhaliwe kokutholwa kwesikhalazo kofake isikhalazo ngaphakathi kwezinsuku ezinhlanu zokusebenza ekutholweni kwesikhalazo futhi isikhalazo ezingaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyishumi nanhlanu zokusebenza emva kokutholwa. I-Ofisa Enegunya izakwazisa ukuthi ofake isikhalazo nganoma yiziphi izikhathi zokumosakala ekuqedeni umphumela wesikhalazo, bese unikeza izizathu zokuhanjiswa kwesikhathi. Uma isikhalazo sesekwe ezindabeni ezinzima zobuchwepheshe, I-Ofisa Enegunya ingasebenzisa umeluleki wangaphandle ongabandluli, uma nje ukuhlangana okulandelayo kulandela inqubomgomo nemibandela eyanele yebhajethi ikhona. I-ofisa Enegunya ayibophezelwa yinoma yimuphi umbono enikezwa ngumeluleki ongaphandle. I-Ofisa Enegunya izakuthatha isinqumo sokuthi isikhalazo siqukethe ukwesekwa okwanele kokuchithwa kwesikhathi sokutholiswa kumnikezeli ovunyelwe, nokuthi ukuchithwa kwesikhathi okunje kungenzeka yini. Uma i-Ofisa Enegunya ithola ukuthi ukumoswa kwesikhathi kuneqinisiwe, umnikezeli ovunyiwe uzakwaziswa ngokubhalwelwa ngezizathu zokuchithwa kwesikhathi. Uma umphumela wesikhalazo usuwenziwe, i-Ofisa Enegunya izakwazisa ofake isikhalazo ngokumbhalela amazise ngomphumela. Wonke ama-ofishali okuphatha ukunikezela kwemisebenzi azokulandela Ikhodi Yokuziphatha ebekwe ngaphakathi Komthetho Wezinhlelo Zomasipala, Kuhlaka Lokuphatha Ukunikezwa Imisebenzi kanye Nekhodi Lokuziphatha Lokuphatha Ukunikezela Imisebenzi. hlonipha Ikhodi Yokuziphatha yomasipala; futhi azaku hlala angenzi nganoma yiyiphi indlela eyehlisa izinga lokwethembeka nobuqotho bekomiti (bamakomiti).

Inyama Yenkomo: Ukubuyekezwa Kwekhwalithi Nempilo Inyama yenkomo, eyaziwa ngesiNgisi ngokuthi "beef," iyinsika ebalulekile emndenini wethu, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Iphakathi kwezithako ezisemqoka ezithokozisa izibiliboco zethu, futhi ibalulekile ekudleni kwansuku zonke. Kulokhu, sizobheka izici ezahlukene zenyama yenkomo, kuhlanganise nekhwalithi yayo, izinzuzo zempilo, nezindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuyipheka. Ikhwalithi Yenkomo Ukukhetha inyama yenkomo ehamba phambili kubalulekile. Inyama enempilo ibonakala ibomvu, inamafutha alinganiselwe, futhi inamathambo aqinile. Ukuze uthole inyama engcono, kubalulekile ukukhetha izinkomo ezikhuliswa ngendlela efanele, ngaphandle kokusetshenziswa kwemithi yokukhulisa. Izinkomo ezikhuliswa emapulazini anokunakekelwa kahle, ezithola ukudla okuphumelelayo, zikhulisa inyama enempilo, enezinga eliphezulu lezinhlayiya ezidingekayo emzimbeni. Izinzuzo Zempilo Inyama yenkomo iyinsiza enkulu yokudla okunempilo. Iqukethe amaprotheni aphezulu, avumela ukukhula kwemisipha kanye nokwakhiwa kwezicubu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iqukethe amavithamini ahlukahlukene, njenge-B12, ebalulekile ekusebenzeni kahle kwezinzwa. Iphinde ibe nezinhlayiya ezibalulekile, ezifana ne-iron, ezisiza ekwakheni igazi elinempilo. Nokho, kubalulekile ukuyidla ngokulinganisela, ngoba amafutha amaningi angaholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Izindlela Zokupheka Inyama yenkomo ingaphekwa ngezindlela eziningi, futhi lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuyihlanganisa nezitsha ezahlukene. Ukupheka inyama yenkomo kuhlanganisa izindlela ezinjenge-grilling, roasting, frying, noma slow cooking.

AmaMamelodi Sundowns: Umthelela Omkhulu emhlabeni Wezemidlalo Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle ePitoli, umoya opholile wehlobo uhamba phansi emigwaqweni. Abantu bejabulile, behamba ngezinyawo, bejolisa emakhaya abo, bezama ukujoyina umphakathi. Kodwa phakathi kwalokhu, kwakukhona okunye okwakuphakathi kwengqondo zabantu – amaMamelodi Sundowns. I-Sundowns akuwona nje umphakathi wezinkanyezi zezemidlalo, kodwa ibhizinisi elwakha izimpilo. Lezi zinkanyezi zifana nezinhliziyo zomphakathi, ziphila ngokubambisana, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphumelele. Sithanda ukukhumbula ukuthi leli qembu laqala kanjani. Eminyakeni engama-50 edlule, iSundowns yaqala njengenhlangano yezeMidlalo eThekwini, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, baqala ukuhamba phambili besuka ezindaweni ezincane baya ezinkulu. Uhlelo lwabo lwamaSundowns lwaluhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengoba ibhola lalingumsebenzi ophilayo, futhi lwaluhlobene kakhulu nezimpilo zabantu. Ngonyaka we-1990, iSundowns yabhaliswa kuPremier Soccer League, kwaba yisikhathi sokuphila okusha. Kwakuyisikhathi sokukhula, lapho umphakathi wathola ithuba lokubona izinkanyezi zedolobha zidlala. Abalandeli babejabulile, behlabelela, baphakamisa izithombe, futhi bekhumbula izikhathi ezinhle. Njengoba isikhathi sishintsha, iSundowns yathola iziqu eziningi, nezindondo. Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi abalandeli babenokholo olukhulu. Umdlalo wabo wawuhambisana nezinkanyezi ezinkulu, njengabathandekayo abanjengoTeko Modise, Pitso Mosimane, noKhama Billiat. Lezi zinkanyezi zashintsha umqondo wabantu, zakhuthaza abasha ukuba babe nezifiso ezinkulu.

(Pic.3). Umonakalo odalwe ukushisa utshwala ngaphakathi emzimbeni wakho usuku nosuku ubonisa umonakalo enhliziyweni yakho, emaphashini, emithanjeni yegazi, nakwezinye izingxenye zomzimba wakho. Ekugcineni, impilo yakho yonke iyashintsha. Ukushisa utshwala kubulala izigidi zabantu emhlabeni wonke unyaka nonyaka! (Pic.3). Lokhu akusho lutho ngoba sonke sizofela ekugcineni. Angiboni inkinga uma ngibulawa yinto engiyithokozelayo. (Pic.4). Ungakhohlwa ukuthi ukushisa utshwala kuphinde kuhlanganyele nabantu abakuzungezile futhi kubenza babe sengozini yezifo ezifanayo ezithinta umshisi. (Pic.5). Futhi njalo khumbula uma ushisa isigubhu ukuthi ungase ungafeli ngokushesha ngenxa yokushisa, kodwa ungase uhlupheke ngesifo esiholela ekuchithweni kweminyaka eminingi ubuhlungu, noma ungase ufe ubuhlungu ngenxa yesifo samaphaphu. Cabanga ngalokhu ngenkathi usenethuba lokuyeka ukushisa okwamanje! (Pic.6). Igama lami nguDudu. Ngifuna sikhulume ngokuqhuba utshwala. Ake siqale ngokubheka amaphuzu ahlobene nokushisa utshwala. Unyaka nonyaka, abantu abangu-12,000 eNingizimu Afrika bafa ngenxa yezifo zenhliziyo, umdlavuza wamaphaphu, nezinye izinhlobo zomdlavuza, kanye ne-bronchitis. Ukushisa utshwala kukhuthaza umuntu ukuba abe sengozini yalezi zifo. Ezinye izindawo, ukushisa kubulala abantu abaningi kunezibalo ezihlanganisiwe zabantu abafa ngempela ngenxa ye-HIV/AIDS, utshwala, nezidakamizwa ezifana ne-heroin ne-cocaine, kanye nezingozi zomgwaqo.

Izikhungo ezahlukene, ezifana ne-Advocacy Group for Land Rights, zabelana ngemininingwane yokuthi abantu bangazithola kanjani izinsiza zomthetho uma bephikisana nokuthathwa komhlaba. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu bazi kahle amalungelo abo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabathola kanjani usizo uma kudingeka. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonakale uphumelele ekwakheni indawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, okuhlanganisa iziphathimandla, izazi, kanye nomphakathi. Uhlelo lokuxoxa lwaluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokwabelana ngemicabango, futhi lwenze kube lula ukuthi abantu baziqonde izinqubo zomthetho ezithinta ukuthathwa komhlaba. Ngokuphetha, umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu, ubonisa ukuthi izinkulumo zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba zidinga ukuxoxwa ngokujulile, futhi zidinga ukubandakanya wonke umuntu. Umphakathi ubonise isifiso sokubamba iqhaza ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo, ezihlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi ezithuthukisa izimo zokuphila zomphakathi. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi, nakuba izinkinga zikhona, umphakathi unamandla okwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuthathwa komhlaba kwenzeka ngendlela efanele. Umcimbi ubonisa ukuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono, elihlonipha amalungelo abantu, futhi elithuthukisa umphakathi wonke. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umhlaba, njengomthombo wezimpilo, uhlonishwa futhi uvikelwe.

Uhlelo lweminyaka emihlanu lokulungiselela umthelela wesimo sokushintsha kwezulu lwemukelwe. Bonke abasebenzi bakhombise ukuzinikela okungaguquki kumsebenzi wabo futhi benza imisebenzi ngenhloso ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukuthi ukwakhiwa komgomo kazwelonke wokwengamela izikhumulo zezindiza kanye nezindawo yokundizela izindiza.
