Okufanele babe ngabokuqala ukuthola lezi zinzuzo kufanele kube izingane ezeswele kanye nalabo abazinakekelayo. Izingane zinelungelo lokuphila okusezingeni okwenza ukuthi zikwazi ukukhula ngokwemiqondo nemizimba yazo. Abantu ababaluleke kakhulu ekuhlinzekeni lokhu kuphila okusezingeni abazali kanye nalabo abanakekela izingane. Ukuthi umsebenzi abazowenza muhle kangakanani kuncike ekutheni banamalini nokuthi bakwazi kangakanani ukunakekela izingane. Ohulumeni kufanele basize abazali kanye nabanye abanakekeli bezingane kangangoba bengakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngentuthuko yengane. Lapho kudingeka khona, ohulumeni kumele banikeze abazali usizo nokubeseka, ikakhulukazi lapho okudingeka khona ukudla, izimpahla zokugqoka kanye nezindlu. Ngokucacile, abanye abazali banemali eningi kunabanye. Kodwa izingane akufanele zihlupheke ngenxa yalokhu. Izingane aziceli ukuzalwa emindenini ehluphekile. Zinelungelo lokuthola ithuba elifanayo njengawo wonke umuntu. Yingakho nje Isivumelwano sithi ohulumeni kufanele basize imindeni, ikakhulukazi imindeni ehlupheke kakhulu ukuthi ithenge ukudla, izimpahla kanye namakhaya ezingane zabo. Ohulumeni kufanele benze yonke into ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abazali okufanele bakhokhe imali yesondlo sezingane bayakwenza lokho. Lapho umzali ongakhokhi ngengane ehlala kwelinye izwe, ohulumeni kufanele bavumelane ukuze imali izocelwa egameni lengane. Kuyadumaza kabi ukuthi abanye abazali abafuni ukukhokha imali yokondla abantwana babo. Lokhu kushiya umzali oyedwa nomthwalo wokunakekela umntwana futhi esebenza ukuze azonakekela umntwana futhi. Ohulumeni kufanele baqiniseke ukuthi bobabili abazali babhekene nomsebenzi wezingane zabo. Lokhu into izingane okufanele zicabange futhi zikhulume ngakho.

Equgcineni labo abaqeqeshwa bakhokhelwa ukuthi badlulisele abakufundile kwamanye amalunga omphakathi. Ngo-December 2000 i-DACST yabelwa enye imali neyayizoyisebenzisa iminyaka emithathu ezinhlelweni ezithembisa ukuthi zingawakha amathuba emisebenzi futhi zinciphise indlala / ubuphofu. Isigungu Sokuthunyelwa komsebenzi wezandla emazweni angaphandle. efana nokuthuthukiswa komkhiqizo kanye nokuqinisekisa izinga lomkhhiqizo eliphezulu, ukuphathwa kwamabhizinisi, ukwandiswa kwezimakethe kanye nokudayisa. I- DACST yaqoka iSigungu siKazwelonke semisebenzi yezandla ngenjongo yokuthuthukisa incwadi yolwazi ngemisebenzi yezandla engasetsshenziswa kalula kanye nencwadi enamakheli ezindawo ezinababazi. Ngalencwajana kuqondwe ukuba kuxazululwe izinkinga zokutholaka kwezinto kalula kanye nobunzima bokungatholakali kolwazi ngababazi. Umbukiso wesikhombisa wamazwe ngamazwe wezobuciko kanye nemisebenzi yezandla e-Ouagadougou (SIAO 2000). Indawo okwakukhangisa kuyo i-Ningizimu Afrika yazuza umklomelo wesibili yaba enhle kunanazozonke ezazimele amazwe. umbumbi wesitolo I-Potter esiseKapa wazuza umklomelo wesibili ohleni/ emkhakheni wezitsha ezibunjiweyo. Kanti ubhasikidi wesiZulu owenziwa umndeni wakwaNdwandwe kwaZulu Natali wazuza umhlomelo wokuqala emkhakheni wokwalukwa kwezimbenge embukiwseni oyisipesheli wamakhono. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, uhulumeni wesifundazwe wakwazi ukuthola inkontileka nabadwebi bokuxhakaxhaka bezindlu ukuze kwakhiwe izakhiwo ezintsha zikahulumeni wesifundazwe saseMpumalanga.

Kodwa siyaqhubeka sithuthukisa izinga lezindlu ezakhiwayo siphinde sivulele labo abashiyekayo kulezihlelo zikahulumeni nenhlelo eziphuma kumabhizinisi azimele. Umsebenzi awuhambi ngezing besifuna ngalo. Kufuneka sisebenze ukuze silungise loludaba. Njengoba amalungu ahloniphekile azibonela, sesiqalile kuleminyaka embalwa edlulile sifezekisa izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izithuthi zabantu. Loku kufaka uhlelo loku khipha amatekisi amadala isikhundla sawo sithathwe amatekisi amasha, nemizamo yamaphrovinsi yokufaka isipolo sesitimela ezindaweni ezinjengase moloto empumalanga. Uphenyo lokuthi lomsebenzi uzokulunga yini sewuqalile. Uhlelo lwaseKlipfontein e Kapa seluqalile nalo kanye nesitimela esihamba ngesivinini phakathi kweGoli naseTshwane kanye neminye imizila exhumana nayo. Lezinhlelo kanye nezinye ziyingxenye yohlelo olukhulu olumayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwezindle zokuthutha umphakathi ezihlanganisa imizila yesitimela kanye nemigwaqo yezimoto. Sizakuzinika isikhathi sokuthi sibone lezinhlelo ziphumelela ukuze impilo yabantu abasebenzayo ibengcono. Inani labantu abathola ugesi, amanzi nokuhanjiswa kahle kwendle lithuthukile. Ngonyaka ka 2005 iNingizimu Afrika besi ifinyelele ezidingweni zohlelo lwe " Millennium Development Goal" oluphathelene nokutholakala kwamanzi kubo bonke abantu. Sithuthuke sasuka ku 59% ngo 1994 saya ku 83% ngo 2006 ekwabeni amanzi kubantu bakithi. Ngokusho kohlelo lwentuthuko luka mhlabuhlangene (UNDP) iNingizimu Afrika ingenye yamazwe ambalwa achitha imali encane kwezempi, isebenzise eningana imali ekwabeleni isizwe amanzi nasekuhanbiseni indle kahle.

Ngokomthetho olawula ezobugebengu, indlela yokuz- iphatha komuntu ozinikelayo kufuneka kube ngumuntu owonile ngendlela yokuthi angagwetshwa okungenani unyaka owodwa ejele, kusho isivumelwano. Ukuzinikela kungenqatshwa uma ukona noma ubugebengu bufanele isigwebo sentambo. Ngokomthetho olawula izaphuli mthetho zopolitiko unganqatshelwa ukuzinikela uma usi- saphuli mthetho soplotiko. Ngokusekwe phezu kokungathi kusamthetho, kunesidingo sokuba ubufakazi bommangali bonele ukuze kubekho ukuthethwa kwecala ngokomthetho walowo ungummangalelwa. Ngokomthetho ongavamile, lowo ozinikezelayo makan- gashushiselwa amanye amacala ngaphandle kwalowo azinikezele ngawo, kuso isivumelwano. Ukuziphatha komuntu ozinikezelayo kudinga ukuthi enze ubugebengu ekufanele bujeziswe ngokumbopha ithuba ubuncane elin- gangonyaka, ngokomthetho wesivumelwano. Ukuzinikela kunganqatshwa uma isigwebo sombaleki singaba yisig- web0 sentambo. Usizo ekuvunyelwene ngalo kumacala obugebengu bufaka ukukhomba nokulandelela abantu ubazi bahlala kuphi, ukufaka isamani, ukuthola ubhalise istatimende nokusithumela kosimqondile, ubufakazi nez- incwadi zenkantolo. sni noma yini edingekayo uma uya kulezi nkantolo. Ukhulume nangezindlela zobandlululo ezihlukile. yoSizo Kwezomthetho. UMantshie Didymus Nompandana wamkele bonke abebekhona emcimbini. "Leli lilanga elisemqaka ngoba siletha usizo kubantu bethu emnyango." Ukhuthaze abantu bathathe incwajana ezicacisa nge Small Claims Court baye naza ekhaya ukuze banikeze nalabo abangakwazanga ukufika kulo mgubho. "Sizani nizithathe izincwadi zolwazi niye nazn ekhaya ukuze bazi ngezidingo esiziletha kubo."

Khuluma ulimi lwakho. Kuyilungelo lakho. Yimuphi umsebenzi owenziwayo? I-TISSA yenza umsebenzi wokutolika ngocingo ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela kuyo yonke imisebenzi kaHulumeni kuzona zonke izakhamuzi. Kungani i-TISSA yenza lo msebenzi? ITISSA yelula amalungelo okuthuthukisa ulimi nokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwazo zonke izilimi zendabuko ezisemthethweni. Umphakathi ungakwazi ukucela imisebenzi kahulumeni ngolimi lwawo lwebele? Yebo, inqobo nje uma kungulimi lwendabuko olusemthethweni. Ingabe ulimi lokukhuluma ngezandla lwabantu abangezwa lufakiwe? Yebo, abantu abangezwa bayothola izinga elifanayo lomsebenzi njenganoma yimuphi umuntu ozwayo. Izindawo zokusebenzela zisezikhungweni zikazwelonke ezinkulu. Usebenza kanjani lo msebenzi? Umsebenzi uhlinzeka ngotolika ozohumusha isicelo sakho. Ngizokwazi kanjani ukuthi umnyango kahulumeni ungangisiza yini? Kuzoba nezimpawu ezizokhombisa ehhovisi likahulumeni ukuthi imisebenzi yokutolika iyatholaka. Uma ihhovisi likahulumeni lingalukhombisi uphawu lwe-TISSA, ngisangawucela lo msebenzi? Yebo, ungawucela lo msebenzi, kuphela nje uma abasebenzi bekwazi ukuwusebenzisa. Uzongisiza kanjani mina lo msebenzi? Utolika oqeqeshwe kahle uzokusiza kanye nesisebenzi sikahulumeni ukuthi sibe nolwazi olulungile. Unelungelo lokukhuluma ulimi lwakho. Uhulumeni uyosiza ekuvaleni noma yimaphi amagebe okuxhumana akhona. Khuluma ulimi lwakho, kuyilungelo lakho. Umsebenzi wokutolika ngocingo ukhona lapha. Ukutolika ngocingo kukhona lapha.

Amakhosi abamba umoya wempumelelo, futhi abalandeli bawo bahlala bekhuthazekile, bekhombisa uthando olukhulu emidlalweni. Umdlalo wabo ophakathi kweKaizer Chiefs ne-Orlando Pirates, owaziwa ngokuthi "The Soweto Derby," uhlala uthokozisa izinkulungwane zabalandeli, uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-Orlando Pirates, eyasungulwa ngo-1937, iyinhlangano enomlando omude futhi ophumelelayo. Le nqola ibhizinisi elikhulu, ibonisa ubuhlakani obukhulu emidlalweni, futhi ibamba izicoco eziningi. Abalandeli bayo baziwa ngokuba neqhaza elikhulu emidlalweni, bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Umdlalo phakathi kwePirates neChiefs ungowokugcina izinkumbulo ezinhle, umoya ophakeme, nokuhlangana kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, iMamelodi Sundowns, eyasungulwa ngo-1970, iyinhlangano edume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. I-Sundowns ithole udumo emhlabeni jikelele, ikakhulukazi ngempumelelo yayo kwiCAF Champions League. Le nqola ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme, futhi inezinkanyezi eziningi ezidumile. Abalandeli bayo baziwa ngokuba neqhaza elikhulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana, bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuhlanganyela. Umdlalo wezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika awubandakanyi kuphela amaqembu amakhulu, kodwa futhi kunezinqola ezincane ezithokozisayo. Amaqembu afana ne-Black Leopards, i-TS Galaxy, ne-SuperSport United nawo anomlando omuhle, futhi abalandeli bawo bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Lezi zinqola zikhombisa ukuthi ibhola alikona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, yokuhlanganyela, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu.

sifake lapho yonke imali etholwe ngokwesigatshana (1). yesiKhulu esiPhezulu kanye namanye amalungu abasebenzi besiKhungo. IsiKhungo singatshala izimali ezifakwe kwi-akhawunti yaso ezingadingi ukusetshenziswa ngokushesha: Kuncike ekutheni iBhodi kumele lithathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukutshalwa kwezimali akukona kohlobo olungaqondakali lokuzalanisa imali. IsiKhungo senqatshelwe ukuboleka imali noma ukukhipha iziqinisekiso, izinxephezelo noma izibambiso noma ukungena kunoma yinhloboni yokusetshenziswa kwemali okwenqatshelwe isiKhungo ngaphandle uma lokho kuboleka, isiqinisekiso, isinxephezelo, isibambiso noma okunye ukusetshenziswa kwemali kugunyazwe kulo Mthetho futhi kungashayisani noMthetho wokuPhathwa kweziMali zikaHulumeni. 26. (1) IsiKhulu esiPhezulu kumele sakhe amabhuku agcwele futhi afanele e-akhawunti kanye nayo yonke imininingwane edingekile ephathelene nayo ukuba igcinwe. IsiKhulu esiPhezulu kumele siqinisekise ukuthi umbiko wezabelomali zesiKhungo waminyaka yonke, izinhlelo zenhlangano, imibiko yonyaka kanye nezitatimende zezimali ezicwaningiwe ziyalungiswa futhi zilethwa ngokuhambisana noMthetho wokuPhathwa kweziMali zikaHulumeni, 1999 (uMthetho No. 1 ka 1999). maqondana neminyaka emithathu elandelayo yezimali. Kunoma yimuphi unyaka wezimali isiKhulu esiPhezulu singaletha eBhodini ukuze kugunyazwe izitatimende zemali eyongeziwe noma esetshenzisiwe engenisweni noma ezindlekweni zesikhungo zangalowo nyaka wezimali.

Ukuze amathuba okuzijabulisa ezilwandle atholakale kubo bonke ngokulinganayo, umphakathi osebenzisa izilwandle kufanele ufundiswe ukuze ubambisane futhi unakekele, ikakhulukazi ukuvuselela abampofu kanye nemiphakathi abavela kuyo, kubandakanya abesifazane nezingane. Ukuze le sistimu isebenze, umphakathi kufanele ube namathuba angcono, imisebenzi, futhi ube neziqhamo ezizuzisayo. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni awuzange uveze kuphela umbono, imigomo, nezinhloso mayelana nokuphathwa okufanele kwezilwandle eNingizimu Afrika. Lo mbiko uthathile esinye isinyathelo mayelana nalokho okufanele kulandelwe lapho kuqala le sistimu yokuphatha izilwandle. Enye indlela kwakuwukuthuthukiswa kwesikhungo kanye nemithetho ephathelene nalesi sikhungo. Ngemuva kokuba amalungu ePhalamende avumelene ngalombiko, uhlaka lwezomthetho lwahlaziywa. Lokhu kwenziwe ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi lo mbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ungavulwa ngokuhambisana nezimiso zomthetho ezivele zakhululwa. Ngemuva kwalolu hlolo, kwatholakala ukuthi kudingeka imithetho ephathelene nokuphathwa kwezilwandle ukuze kuqale lo mbiko. Inhloso yalombiko kanye nokusebenza kwengqalasizinda yokuphatha izilwandle ephakanyisiwe kuxhomeke kumaphuzu akhulunywe ngemininingwane ngenhla. Lesi sigaba sichaza imigomo nezivumelwano, futhi siphinde sibe umthetho ozosiza ekuhumusheni kwalombiko, sikhanyisa indima kahulumeni ekuphathweni kwezilwandle, futhi sichaze ukuthi lo mbiko uhambelana nani futhi ubathinteka kanjani. Lo mthetho ophumelele kufanele ufundwe kanye nomthetho wezokuphatha imvelo kazwelonke, futhi lo mbiko uphinde uchaze ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe kanjani uma kungahambisani nalomthetho nakwezinye.

Imigomo Yokugoma Kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngemuva kokugoma, ngakho ngithanda ukwabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nemigomo yokugoma. Njengoba sikwazi, ukugoma kuyindlela yokuvikela impilo yethu, kodwa kukhona izinto ezithile okudingeka sizazi. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda umgomo wokugoma. Imigomo yokugoma ibhekisela ezinjongweni eziyisisekelo zokuvikela abantu emithini nasezifo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuvimbela ukusabalala kwezifo ezithathelwana kalula, njengezifo ezifana nokhuhlaza, i-flu, kanye ne-COVID-19. Ukugoma kusebenza ukuvikela labo abakhathazekile, njengezifo zenhliziyo, abakhulelwe, nabanye abathinteka kakhulu. Ngokubheka emuva, ukugoma akuwona umqondo omusha; isiko lokugoma lisekela emlandweni omude. Ukuqala, abantu babefuna ukuvikela umphakathi ezifo ezincane ezazihlasela. Ngesikhathi esithile, besenobuchwepheshe obuncane, kodwa benza konke okusemandleni ukuze baqonde ukuthi ukugoma kungaba indlela efanele yokuphila. Kubalulekile futhi ukukhuluma ngendima yokugoma emphakathini. Ukugoma akuyona into eyenzelwa umuntu oyedwa kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukubambisana komphakathi. Uma umphakathi ugoma, uthola ukuvikeleka, okwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Futhi, uma abantu bebona imiphumela emihle yokugoma, lokho kuholela ekuqiniseni ukuthi kuyadingeka. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokugoma; abanye abantu bahlala bephikisa ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle noma izimangalo ezingelona iqiniso. Lokhu kudinga ukukhulumisana okuhle ukuze sabelane ngemininingwane efanele. Kumele siqonde ukuthi ukugoma kudinga ukubhekelelwa, futhi kunezindlela ezinhle zokuphendula imibuzo yabantu abangenalo ulwazi olucacile.

Imidlalo Yeshashalazi: Uhlanga Lwenkanyezi Kwakhanya ilanga, izinkanyezi zikhanya phezulu, zikhombisa indlela kubantu abahlala emadolobheni amakhulu. Phakathi kwezinkanyezi, kukhona umhlaba owawungaziwa – umhlaba weshashalazi. Imidlalo yeshashalazi, noma i-theatre, iyinsika yamasiko, ibhuloho phakathi kwezizukulwane, futhi ibonisa ubuciko bokuphila kwabantu. Ekuqaleni, imidlalo yeshashalazi yayiyindlela yokukhumbula izenzakalo ezibalulekile, izinganekwane, nemfundo ethile. Abantu babebuthana emithonjeni, ezindaweni ezikhethekile, ukuze babone abalingisi bephila izindaba ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kwakungelula, ngoba abalingisi babephila izinkanyezi, bephila izimpilo ezahlukene, futhi bezama ukudlulisa imizwa yabo kubabukeli. Imidlalo yeshashalazi yayiyindlela yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezifiso zabantu. Ngonyaka owodwa, umqondisi ophumelelayo, uMnumzane Mthembu, waphakamisa umbono omusha. Wathi, “Ngifuna ukudala umhlaba lapho abantu bezokwazi ukuzwakalisa imizwa yabo, bahlabe umxhwele, futhi bakhumbule ukuthi baphila kanjani.” Waqala ukuhlela imidlalo ehlobene nezinkinga zomphakathi, efaka izindaba zothando, ubuhlungu, nempilo yansuku zonke. Lokhu kwavula umnyango omusha, lapho abalingisi bephila izinkanyezi eziphilayo, behlola izimo ezinzima, futhi bezama ukuthola izixazululo. Uhlelo lwakhe lwaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Abantu baphenduka bezobona imidlalo, bejabulile, bezwa ukuthi imidlalo ibalulekile empilweni yabo. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, lapho abalingisi, abaqondisi, nababukeli behlangana ukuze bakhe umhlaba ophilayo.

B.3 Nakuba le Khodi Yokuziphatha ibhalwe ukuhlanganisa konke, ayiyona iqoqo eliphelele lemigomo elawula izinga lokuziphatha. Nokho, uMphathi-Jikelele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 7 (b) seMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-1994, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle koMnyango kanye nokugcina umthetho, phakathi kwezinye izinto, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza ukuthi ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi bakhe kuhambisane nokwethembeka nezimiso ezilawula amahhovisi kahulumeni kanye nemigomo efanele kanye nezinqubo njengoba kushiwo kulo Mthetho. B.4 Inhloso enkulu yale Khodi ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle. Ngakho-ke, umsebenzi angatholakala enecala lokuziphatha okungafanele futhi abhekane nenqubo yokwethulwa kwezinyathelo zokudinga uma izenzo zabo zingahambisani neKhodi Yokuziphatha noma uma kutholakala ukuthi baphule ezinye zezidingo zale Khodi. C.1.7 akuphuli noma iyiphi ingxenye yeKhodi Yokuziphatha ebekwe kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. C.2.11 ingaxhumana namalungu omphakathi nganoma iyiphi ulimi olusemthethweni uma nje kukhethwe umphakathi. C.2.14 akumele ibeke impilo yabanye noma eyayo engcupheni ngokungalandeli imithetho yokuphepha noma ngokuyigwema. C3.17 akumele ithathe ingxenye emibuthanweni ephikisana nezinga lokusebenza futhi engemthethweni. C.4.6 ingacela ukuthi ingathathi ingxenye ezinqumweni noma ezinyathelweni emsebenzini ezisemthethweni uma lokhu kungaholela ekutholeni inzuzo engafanele ngendlela engalungile, engakhethi, futhi ebandlululayo.

Baningi abantu asebezwakalise ukukhathazeka ngalesi sinqumo sokuqhubeka nechweba ngemuva komphumela wokuhlaziya umthelela wesakhiwo. Laba bantu sebecela uhulumeni ukuqoka umxazululi ozosombulula lengxabano. Sekubizwa lowo ozokhuthaza izingxoxo asize izinhlangothi zombili ngodaba okufanele lwedluliselwe kubaxazululi. Inqubo yokuxazulula yenzeka uma izinhlangothi ezimbili ezingezwani ziqonda kumxazululi owenza umzamo wokuletha isisombululo nokuthi kufinyelelwe esivumelwaneni. Njengoba iNEMA imvumela uhulumeni ukwedlulisa ingxabano iye kumxazululi noma kumgqugquzeli wezingxoxo, ungaya kuhulumeni ucele aqoke umxazululi noma umkhuthazi-ngxoxo ngezingxabano ezithile. Isibonelo: Uhulumeni uvuma isinqumo sokwakhiwa kwedamu eliyolimaza indawo lapho kuhlala khona abantu kanye nemvelo esendaweni. Uhlaziyo lomthelela kwimvelo alizange libhekele udaba oluphathelene namasiko, njengokuthi uma idamu ligcwala amanzi angagobhoza avale amathuna kanye nezindawo zokukhonza ezisondelene nalo. Umphakathi ufuna isiqiniseko sokuthi izindawo ezibalulekile zokukhonza ziyovikeleka futhi ucabanga ukuthi uhulumeni akazange abonisane nawo ngokwenele ekutholeni izindlela ezikahle zokuvikela lezizakhiwo. Indima yomxazululi kungaba wukuthola indlela lapho uhulumeni engakhipha khona imvume yokwakhiwa kwedamu ngaphansi kwemibandela ethile, engagcina futhi ivikele lezizakhiwo. Imiphakathi ingamsiza uhulumeni ukuqhamuka nezisombululo okuyomele zicaciswe kulemibandela. uma kunempikiswano ngokuvikela imvelo ngemuva kokufakwa kwesicelo sokwedlulisa udaba.

Unganikela ngesikhathi sakho ufake isandla ngokusiza izikhungo. Bheka isikhungo emphakathini wangakini ongafaka isandla kuso. Ungathola olunye ulwazi ngezinhlangano ongazisiza kule webhusayithi: www.csvr.org.za. Iminikelo: Unganikela imali ezinhlanganweni ezisebenzela ukuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane ngokufaka isandla eSisekelweni samalungelo eSintu. Alikho izinga elibekiwe lemali engakhokhwa - konke kuncike kuwe! Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, bheka iwebhusayithi ethi: www.fhr.org.za noma shayela le nombolo 012 440 1691. Beka uvo lwakho ngokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane: Gqugquzela abesifazane abahlukunyeziwe abathule ukuthi bamelane nakho. Bika ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane emaphoyiseni. Joyina izinkundla zokusebenza kwamaphoyiza emphakathini noma izinkundla zokuphepha komphakathi: Umphakathi neziteshi zamaphoyisa ezisemphakathini babambisene ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kunokuphepha nokuvikeleka emphakathini. Ngokujoyina lezi zinhlaka, ungasiza ukulwa nobugebengu endaweni yangakini. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi ngendlela ongajoyina ngayo, thintana nesiteshi samaphoyisa sangakini. Uma uhlukunyezwa noma ngabe yingayiphi indlela noma uma kukhona omaziyo ohlukunyezwayo, siza - thola usizo.

Le sahluko sisebenza kubuhlobo obuphakathi kophathini naphakathi komunye wophathini kumbe bobabili kanye nomuntu noma abantu abaseceleni. Umuntu angaba uphathini wobuhlobo oburejistiwe obubodwa kuphela ngesikhathi. Njengobufakazi bokuthi umshado odlule sekuqediwe. UNgngqongqoshe nanoma imuphi umgcini-hhovisi ogunyaziwe wakwahulumeni angawanikeza amandla kunoma yimuphi umggcini-hhovisi kumbe umsebenzi wakwahulumeni kumbe inxusa leRiphabhlikhi abe umphathi-hhovisi orejistayo, kube yinto ayenzela wonke umuntu kumbe endaweni ethize, ngokwamandla ahambisana nesikhundla sakhe inqobo nje uma esahleli kuleso sikhundla. Wonke umuntu onikezwa amandla njengomgcini-hhovisi orejista ubuhlobo kufanele lawo Mandla abhalwe phansi kufakwe nosuku lokuqala kwalawo Mandla kanjalo nemikhawulo abekelwe yona ifakwe kulowo mqulu. Makuthi kubhekelelwe isigaba 16, noma ibaphi abantu ababili bavumeleke ukurejista ubuhlobo babo njengobuhlobo basekhaya njengokubekiwe kule sigaba. Umgcini-hhovisi orejistayo kufanele umcimbi wokurejist awugcine kwisikhungo esibekelwe lokho nangenqubo ebekiwe kule sigaba. Ozokuba uphathini kufanele yena yedwa futhi abhale phansi afunge ukuthi uyathanda ukuburejista ubuhlobo bakhe bomndeni ngokusayina umqulu obekelwe konaphambi kukamgcini-hhovisi orejistayo. Umgcini-hhovisi orejistayo kufanele awusayine umqulu obekiwe ukufakaza ukuthi ukufunga okukhulunywa ngako kwisigatshana 3 kwenziwe ngokuzikhethela futhi phambi kwakhe. Umgcini-hhovisi kufanele enze isaziso sokuthi kunesivumelwano sobuhlobo bomndeni, uma sebakhiwe, kwisitifiketi sokurejista.

Uhulumeni weNdawo uneqhaza eliphakeme ezinhlelweni zentuthuko lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lwezinguquko zokusungula omasipala abangabandlululi nabaphokophelele intuthuko wumnyakazo oqavile ekusizeni ohulumeni bendawo bafake igalelo elifanele entuthukweni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwenqubomgomo ekhuthazayo ngokwethula Umthethosivivinywa woHulumeni beNdawo. Ukwethula uhlaka olusha lomthetho wohulumeni bendawo ngokuphakamisa Umthetho weziNhlaka zoMasipala kanye noMthetho weziNhlelo zoMasipala. Ngemuva kokhetho lohulumeni bendawo olwabanjwa ngomhlaka 5 Disemba 2000, isigaba soguquko sesiphelile kanti uhlelo lohulumeni basekhaya selungaqala ukusebenzela esizeni esiqinile. Uhlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele (IDP) ngelinye lezikhali zikahulumeni wendawo zokubhekana neqhaza lokuletha intuthuko. Ngale kweqhaza lokuhlela olwenziwe phambilini, uhlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele selubonakala njengomsebenzi wokusingatha omasipala nanjengengxenye yeqhinga lezinhlelo ezididiyele nokwethula imisebenzi emphakathini. Uhlelo lwe-IDP luqonde ukufinyelela ezinqumeni ngezinto ezifana nesabelo-zimali zomasipala, ukusingathwa komhlaba, ukuqhakambisa intuthuko yomnotho ezindaweni nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokubonisana, ehlelekile neqonde phambili. Izinhlelo zeNtuthuko eDidiyele ngeke isize kuphela impatho yomasipala kodwa kufanele ihlahle indlela yemisebenzi yezikhungo noma imikhakha esondelene nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhumene nohulumeni, abasiza abezimboni, kanjalo nemboni ezimele ezindaweni zomasipala.

Umnyango Wezinsiza Ezibumbene uzakunikeza ikomiti lesinzisa zonobhala kuwo wonke amakomiti. I-Ofisa Enegunya ingaxoxisana nombhidi obonisiwe njengombhidi okethiwe ngokusebenzisa inqubo yokubhida enokuncintisana, uma nje inqubo ingavumeli umbidi ukuba athole ithuba lesibili (elingafanele) kanye nokuthi ukwaziswa okunje akuyona ingozi kunoma yimuphi umbhidi noma umnikezeli. Amanye amaphuzu okukhetha azokunikezwa njengokuseKhadeni Lamanani Lokulinganisa Kumithetho Yokutholiswa Yomthetho Wenqubomgomo Ewuhlaka Yokutholiswa Okukhethayo, Umthetho weNo 5 ka-2000. Leli khadi lamanani liqukethwe Kuzijobelelo zale nqubomgomo futhi linikeza ukuthi uma inani lezamba ze-BBBEE lingaphansi kwama-40% ngaloko amanani azokunikezwa. Uma wonke amabhidi elula ama-R1,000,000, isimemo sebhidi sizakuchithwa bese kuphinde kufakwe isimemo ngamaphuzu akhethiwe afanele. Ngaphambi kokunikeza ibhidi, umasipala angachitha ibhidi ngenxa yokuguquka kwezimo, noma izimali zokuxhasa ezingenele ukuthi kungaqhutshekwa, noma uma ibhidi efanele ingatholakalanga. Ngaphambi kokunikeza ibhidi, umasipala angachitha ibhidi ngenxa yokuguquka kwezimo, noma izimali zokuxhasa ezingenele zokuqhubeka, noma uma kungekho ibhidi evunyiwe etholakele. Emva kokuthi umnyango ofanele usuyiolungisile incwadi edingekayo, umgcinisihlalo wekomiti lokunquma lebhidi uzakwazisa ababhidi abaphumelele ngokubabhalela abazise ngomphumela webhidi yabo ngokushehsa emva kokuba Ikomiti Lokunquma Lebhidi livumele ibhidi. Asikho isidingo sokulinga ukuvunywa kwamaminithi omhlangano Wekomiti Lokunquma Lokubhida.

Ukubuyekezwa kwezinqumo zezinkantolo zendabuko. Izindlela okumele zenziwe ukuze kususelwe kuzo emacaleni asuka ezinkantolo zendabuko ayiswe ezinkantolo zezimantshi, ngokushintshana. Indima edlalwa izinkantolo zendabuko ohlelweni lokuthethwa kwamacala egazi. Abaholi bendabuko nezinkantolo zendabuko kumele ziqhubele phambili izimiso kanye nemigomo ekuSomqulu wamaLungelo abantu. Isidingo sokuthi umthetho kazwelonke olawulayo uqinisekise ukufanana. Ukuthuthukiswa komthetho ezinkantolo zendabuko. 40 7. Ukubaluleka kwesikhungo ekugcineni uxolo nokuxhumana emphakathini wasemaphandleni. Umphakathi wasemaphandleni udlala indawo ebalulekile nebucayi ekuphathweni kwemithetho. Uyingxenye yefa lamasiko labantu base-Afrikha kanti lokhu kuvunywe nawuMthethosisekelo. Umthetho ophathelene namasiko wawukhona kusukela esikhathini sasendulo futhi uvunywa nawuhlelo lwezemithetho lwaseNingizimu Afrikha. Iningi labantu abahlala emiphakathini yasemakhaya egunyazwe yimigomo yemithetho ephathelene namasiko nokusingatha uhlelo lwenkantolo yendabuko, usebenzisa lolu hlobo lomthetho. Abantu abangalinganiselwa ezigidini eziyishumi nane bazoba yingxenye yomphakathi wendabuko kuzo zonke izifundazwe zaseNingizimu Afrikha ngaphandle kwaseNtshonalanga Kapa. Isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko sidlala indima ebalulekile ekwenyuseni izinga lezokuhlalisana komphakathi, uxolo nokuxhumana emphakathini. Kulesi sikhundla sokuphathwa kwemithetho yobulungiswa, abaholi bendabuko baxazulula izimpikiswano ezinkantolo zendabuko (Inkundla).

Amagama agqokwe ahlola izichibiyelo ezenziwe emthethweni olemukelekile. Kubandakanya ukuphathwa kukamasipala ngokuphumeza ukuqoqa intela yezindlu; ukuhlela umthetho weMiphakathi: Umthetho Wamasipala ka-2000, ukuze kuqhubeke nokwakha izigaba zokuthi amamasipala athumele izaziso; ukuhlela noma ukususa eminye imithetho; nokubhekana nezinkinga ezithile ezihlobene. Isihloko esifingqiwe kanye nokuqala komthetho. Umphakathi omkhulu noma umphakathi wendawo ungakha intela yezindlu ezindaweni ezibekwe yibo. Umphakathi wesifunda awukwazi ukuklama intela yezindlu ngaphandle kokuthi indawo ibe ngaphakathi kwesifunda esibekwe kulowo maphakathi. Ezinye izigaba zomthetho; kanye nenqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu okufanele amamasipala ayamukele ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 3. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele yamukele inqubomgomo ehambisana nomthetho mayelana nokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu ezindaweni noma ezindaweni ezibophelelwe intela yezindlu kumamasipala. Ivumela amamasipala ukuba akhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwendawo; futhi kulandela ukuhlaziywa okujulile mayelana nezindleko nezinhlelo zokubuyisela, zonke izakhiwo noma izimpahla ezingase zingafakwa ngaphansi kwesistimu yokuhlola ngenhloso yokwakha intela yezindlu. Noma iyiphi imali yokubuyiselwa, yokubuyiselwa, noma yokunciphisa okukhulunywe ngesigaba 2 futhi kubhekwa enhlanganweni yenqubomgomo eyamukelwe ngumasipala kufanele ihambisane nezinga likazwelonke elingase lilawulwe ukuze lisetshenziswe. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele lihlole zonke iziphakamiso ezamukelwe nezibhalwe ezithunyelwe kulo ngesikhathi sokucubungula isikhala senqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu.

I-PMU izosungula izinhlelo zesikhashana ukweseka i-LED, ezinjengegatsha elibhekekele ukuthuthukisa, kanjalo nokuqhakambisa ukuphathwa komnotho kwesikhathi eside kumbandakanya ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhungo, ukuthuthukiswa komklamo, ucwaningo, ukuqapha kanye nokuhlola. Ngokudlulisela amakhono afanele nengqalasizinda kuMasipala ingakapheli iminyaka emithathu iqalisile ukuze, uMasipala ube namandla anele okuqhubela phambili amasu okuthuthukisa umnotho esikhathini esizayo. Kucatshangwa ukuthi lolu hlelo luzohlangabezana nezidingo zokusimama zesikhathi eside ngokunjalo nokuthuthukisa ukusebenza okuyimpumelelo okufanele kokuphathwa ngempumelelo komnotho wendawo kwangomuso. Ibhukwana lisuselwe embikweni owahlanganiswa ongoti bezokuthuthukiswa komnotho base-KZN, abesekwe yiNyunyana yase-Europe egxile emandleni omnotho wendawo yaseVryheid (Umasipala wasebaQulusi). Imiphumela yocwaningo yayincike ekubuyekezweni kwebhuku, ukubheka i-inthanethi, ukuxhumana kwababambiqhaza ngezingcingo, imibuzo ephoswa ubuso nobuso, isikhathi seqembu elihlelekile, ukudluliselwa kohlaka lwemiphumela; ngokunjalo nokuphothulwa komqulu oqukethe imibono yababambiqhaza. Abakhiphi bolwazi abasemqoka esifundazweni nabo baphonswa imibuzo ukuze kulungiswe indlela ethandekayo yesikhathi esifushane i-PMU okuyiyona eyakha amasu okusebenza esikhathi eside. Isinqumo esivalelekile sathathwa nmaqondana noHlelo Lwentuthuko Edidiyelwe lukaMasipala Wendawo (iVryheid) (IDP) kanye Nohlaka Lokuthuthukisa Kwendawo (SDF).

isidingo sokungenisa amareferensi entela angempela, izitifiketi zokuveza ukukhokhwa kwentela, izinombolo zokuzibhalisela i-VAT nezinombolo zikamazisi noma zokuzibhalisa amakhophi aqinisiwe angangeniswa nemibhalo yebhidi, uma nje angempela azokuba khona ngesikhathi sokuvula ibhokisi lebhidi. izinqubo namasu okuphatha amakontileka, kufakwa nombandela ogunyaza i-Ofisa Enegunya ukuchitha ikontileka ngokweseka ngokungasebenzi ngemfanelo; kanye noma yiziphi izidingo Zomthetho we-MFMA Nokuphatha Ukunikezelwa Kwemisebenzi. Amakhonsalithenti inqubo yokuqasha amakhonsalithenti kumele ilandele ngokufanayo inqubo yokubhida enokuncintisana yenye impahla nezinsiza njengoba kubekiwe kule nqubomgomo. Imihlahlandlela enemininingwane iyatholakala ehhovisi Lokuphatha Ukunikezelwa kwemisebenzi Lomcwaningi Zimali Kuzwelonke, Inombolo yeNoti Yokusebenza- SCM 3 ka-2003. Le mihlahlandlela ifaka imibandela yokuthi iqembu lamakhonsalithenti/ uhlu labanikezeli bezinsiza abavunyiwe kumele bamiswe uma kudingeka izinsiza ezijwayelekile neziqhubekayo zidingeke. Leli qembu kumele libuyekezwe okungenani njalo eminyakeni emibili. Ukuqashwa kwabeluleki kuzokulandela inqubo efanayo yokubhida okunokuncintisana njengoba kuchazwe kule nqubomgomo. Akukho meluleki ozobamba iqhaza kunoma yisiphi isinqumo sokugcina sokunikeza ibhidi. Akukho ukuthatha izinqumo kogunyaziwe okumele kunikezwe umeluleki. Uhlelo olulandelayo lubhekene nawo wonke amabhidi okuncintisana, okusho ukuthi lawo edlula inani elilinganisiwe elingama-R100,000 (kufakwa ne-VAT).

Kucacile ukuthi lokhukungenelela kumele kuhlonzwe, kukhuthazwe bese kuqaliswe ukusebenza emazingeni anhlobonhlobo axhumene. Okunye ukungenelela kunomfutho ngokwesimo sako kanti okunye kungokwesekayo kwesikhathi esifushane, esiphakathi nendawo kanye neside. UHlelo 1: Ukungenelela Ezikhungweni nakwezokuphatha- lokhu kubhekelela uhlaka lomumo wokulawulwa kwezomnotho endaweni kanjalo neqhaza lababambiqhaza abehlukene. UHlelo 3: Ukungenelela Ekuthuthukisweni Komnotho- leli yiqoqo lemiklamo yesikhathi esifushane kuya kweside ehlinzeka umphakathi wendawo ngamakhono aphathelene nezezimakethe, amathuba omsebenzi azinzile, kanye namathuba okuthuthukisa amabhizinisi anesisekelo. Izinhlelo 1 no 2 ziyizinhlelo eziluphawu lokuchuma komnotho kwesikhathi eside endaweni kanti futhi kumele ziqaliswe kanye kanye nezinhlelo zentuthuko eziqukethwe wuHlelo 3 okulindeleke ukuba zona zihlangabezane nezidingo zomklamo wesikhathi esifushane. Nakuba iZinhlelo 1 no 2 kuyizo ezidingekayo kuqala ukuze kukwazi ukuqaliswa ngokuphelele uHlelo 3, kumele kuqaliswe kanye kanye ukungenelela okuningi kuzo zonke izinhlelo, ngaphandle uma kunezizathu ezithile eziphikisa lokhu. Izinqumo mayelana nokulandelana kokungenelela ziyothathwa yisikhungo esifanele ngokuxoxisana ne-KZN DEDT kanye noMasipala Wendawo yaseBaqulusini. I-PMU yelekelela uhlelo lokuthathwa kwezinqumo njengengxenye yomsebenzi wawo osemqoka. Kucacile ukuthi, lezi zinqumo zincike ekutholakaleni kwezimali, ukubambisana kanye nokwanda kwamandla.

komasipala okuphawulwe kwisigaba 156(1). kazwelonke noma wesifundazwe. ngendlela lezo zinto anelungelo lokuziphatha. kufanele uthathwe ngokuthi usemthethweni ngasosonke isikhathi lowomthetho ungakasebenzi. umasipala enamandla okulwengamela lolo daba. ngendlela ehambisana nesigatshana (i) sale pharagrafu. etholakala uma kuqhathaniswa noluhlu lwabavoti lukazwelonke. ukuba imelwe ngendlela efanele esiGungwini sikaMasipala ozoqasha. emiswe ngumthetho kazwelonke. njengokusho komthetho kazwelonke. ungaqasha abasebenzi abadingekile ekwenzeni umsebenzi wawo. ukufaka isicelo semali ebolekisayo. kokuthathwa kwevoti lwanoma yiluphi udaba. ngesinqumo esithathwe uMkhandlu kamasipala ube wesekwe yivoti lobuningi bamalungu. umthetho kamasipala osongozwayo ushicilelwe ukuthola uvo lomphakathi. ukumiswa, ukwakhiwa, inqubo, amandla kanye nemisebenzi yamakomidi aso. sodaba okusuke kuxoxwa ngalo. bamelwe ngendlela efanele. ingalungiswa ngumthetho kazwelonke. amalungelomvume nokuvikeleka kweziGungu zoMasipala namalungu azo. ushicelelwe ephephandabeni likahulumeni elisemthethweni kulesosifundazwe. Imithetho kamasipala wendawo kufanele ifinyeleleke emphakathini. uphakamise abantu abangaba kwiKhomishana yezimali nesiKhwama semali kaHulumeni. Igunya lokuphathwa komthetho waseRiphabhuliki lisezinkantolo. Akukho muntu noma ingxenye yombuso okufanele iphazamise ukusebenza kwezinkantolo. kwezinkantolo, ngokushaya imithetho nangezinye izindlela. nezingxenye zombuso ezithintekile. noma luhlangene yini nesinqumo sodaba lomthethosisekelo.

Ukunakekelwa Kwezingane Ezisanda Kuzalwa Ezibhedlela Kwavela umntwana omusha emzini omncane ogcwele imizwa. UZanele, umama wengane, wayezithwele ngothando, kodwa wayenokukhathazeka. Wafika esibhedlela, lapho abanye abesifazane bejabulisa izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Lezi zinsuku zazigcwele ukuhlola nokwenza konke okusemandleni ukuze uZanele akwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kumntwana wakhe. Ngesikhathi efika, wathola izinsiza ezikhona, kodwa ubuhlungu bokuzalwa bukhona. UZanele wayezizwa engakhululeki, kodwa abaphathi bezokwelapha bamkhuthaza. Wathola usizo oluningi kumadokotela nabahlengikazi, ababeqonda kahle izidingo zomama nezingane. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuxoxa nokuhlanganyela. Njengoba ehamba phakathi kwezibhedlela, uZanele wafunda kakhulu. Abahlengikazi bamfundisa indlela yokunakekela umntwana, bebonisa indlela yokubamba, ukubheka, nokuhlinzeka ngezidingo eziyisisekelo. Wabona ukuthi umntwana udinga uthando, ukunakekelwa, nokuphepha, okwakufanele kube khona ngaso sonke isikhathi. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha empilweni yakhe. Izinsuku zokuqala zazinzima, kodwa uZanele waba nesibindi. Ngemva kokuhlinzekwa, wathola ithuba lokuhlala eduze komntwana wakhe, ebuka indlela abesebenza ngayo. USipho, umntwana wakhe, wayenobuso obuhle futhi wakhuluma kahle. Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina umntwana ephilile, kodwa kubandakanya nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uZanele waqala ukubona izinguquko. USipho waqala ukujabulisa, ethokozisa abahlengikazi nabanye omama.

Ayikho indlela ephoqelela ukuthi imithetho isetshenziswe ngendlela ethile, noMthetho woBufakazi ngesikhathi kusabhekwa amaphuzu abalulekile ecaleni. Abathintekayo odabeni, noma bemelwe abammeli basemajajini, kodwa basangaya enkantolo yabantu, bafike bachaze isimo sabo nokuyinto engenzeki ezinkantolo zezimantshi. Izinkinga zingalethwa ngqo phambi kwenkantolo yabantu esikhundleni sokuthi kuqalwe kuyiwe ezinkantolo zezimantshi. Isinqumo sasenkantolo yabantu siyabopha kwabathintekayo kanjalo nokuthi ziyakwazi ukushaya umthetho ngezinhlelo ezifanele zomthetho. Akuvunyelwe ukudlulisa amacala athethwe ezinkantolo zabantu (Lok Adalat), kanti ezinkantolo zezimantshi kuhlezi kunethuba lokudlulisela amacala ayiswe ezithangamini eziphezulu ukuze kubuyekezwe isinqumo esithathwe ecaleni, okuholela ekuphuzeni ukuthola isisombululo sokungaboni ngaso linye. Nakuba kwaziswa ubukhosi, izinkantolo zendabuko zaphela emva kokuba izwe lithole uzimele geqe. Isikhungo asinawo amandla okushaya, ukuphatha noma ukukhipha izigwebo ngokomthetho. Nakuba kunjalo, inkosi isenamandla amakhulu, isahlonishwa abantu bomphakathi, isakwazi ukuqondisa izigwegwe. Amakhosi nemikhandlu yendabuko anwebe amandla awo aba ngaphezu kokubheka izindaba zobukhosi, ezomndeni, ezezimpahla, izehlukaniso, nokuthi ubani ozothatha izingane emva kwesehlukaniso nemibango yomhlaba. Banquma ikakhulu amacala abizwa ngokuthi awangasese nawemibango ukunalawo egazi.

Umgwaqo ohlanganisa indlu onamathuluzi avulekile angcono kunezindonga eziphakeme ngoba umgwaqo uyabonakala. Ucingo lokusika, ucingo olunemibimbi, izinkomishi ezingenalutho noma amahhashi angaxhunywa emgwaqweni ukuze kubonakale ngokushesha uma kukhona umgibeli. Khumbula ukuthi iminyango kufanele ihlale ivaliwe. Izing doors zokuphepha emnyango ngamunye kufanele zibe nezivalo eziqinile phambi kwawo wonke umnyango kanye nasezindongeni, nezinsiza zokuvimbela ukungena. Izing doors zokuphepha kufanele zihlale zivaliwe. I-door yokuphepha ngaphakathi kwendlu ehlukanisa indawo yokulala nezinye izingxenye zendlu ingasiza kakhulu uma kukhona abavakashi bendlu. Kungaba kuhle futhi uma indlela yokuxhumana yokuphuthumayo ingafakwa kule ndlu. Izikhali kufanele zihlale zitholakala kalula futhi, uma kungenzeka, zigcinwe kumuntu. Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhali zihlale zigcinwa kahle futhi ukuthi umuntu ozisebenzisayo uqeqeshwe ukuze azisebenzise. Umsindo we-alamu ophakeme ophakeme phezulu kwendlu onezindawo lapho ungafaka khona ngaphakathi kwendlu ungatholakala kude uma ezinye izindlela zokuxhumana ziqhume. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zinto zihlale zihlolwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zingatholakala noma uma umuntu ekude nendlu. Izinja nezinkunzi ziwusizo kakhulu ekwaziseni uma kukhona okungahambi kahle. Lezi zinyoni kufanele zigcinwe eduze kwendlu ukuze izivakashi ezingaziwa zingakwazi ukufika kalula. Abantu abangaziwa endaweni, bephuma bengenhla, kungenzeka bangabonakali kulokho abakwenzenayo. Izimoto ezingaziwa ezihamba emgwaqweni wezolimo kwesinye isikhathi zihlala endaweni. Qaphela amawheels ongawazi. Izinguquko endleleni umqashi enza izinto.

Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye (GEMS dependent member classification) Ngaphakathi komphakathi wethu, izinsiza zempilo zibalulekile ekwakheni impilo engcono, futhi zikhona ezindaweni eziningi. Kule ndaba, sizobheka indlela ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-GEMS dependent member classification, kwaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze siqonde kahle le ndaba, kufanele siqale ngemuva, sibuye sithathe isinyathelo esibheke phambili. I-GEMS, okuyi-Government Employees Medical Scheme, yasungulwa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakukhona umqondo wokuthi abasebenzi bangathola izinzuzo ezihlukahlukene, hhayi kuphela bona, kodwa nakwabanye abantu abaxhumene nabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwesigaba sokuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukiswa ukuze ihambisane nezidingo zezikhathi. Izinqubomgomo zayo zashintsha, zafaka phakathi ukuhlela kahle amalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni izigaba ezahlukene zamalungu, okuhlanganisa abashadile, abantwana, kanye nabanye abaxhumene nabo. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi kubantu abangenamali eyanele yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinguquko azizange zibe lula. Abantu abaningi babebhekene nezinselelo ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekutholeni izinzuzo ezihambisana nezigaba zabo.

Naphezu kwezinkinga ezikhona ohlelweni lokuthola imithi mayelana nokuhlonipha ukusetshenziswa kwemithi efanele, uhlelo lusebenza kahle kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zitholakala kuzo zonke izifunda eziyi-11 zalesi sifunda. Lezi zikhungo zinezimiso ezihlinzeka abantu abadala, izingane, kanye nabesifazane abakhululiwe. UNzuza uthi abantu abathola imithi ngabantu abanokuhlola kwe-CD4 okungaphansi kuka-200. Inani le-virus ye-HIV emzimbeni womuntu libizwa ngokuthi i-viral load. Odokotela bahlola i-viral load emzimbeni uma bephatha isiguli ngoba ukwehla kwayo kusho ukuthi imithi iyasebenza. Ukwanda kwe-viral load emuntwini osebenzisa imithi kungase kubonise ukuthi isiguli sinezinkinga lapho imithi ingasebenzi kahle noma ukuthi imithi ayithathwa kahle. Imithi isebenza kahle uma ithathwa njengoba kuyalwa udokotela noma um nurse. Ukushiya izikhathi zemithi kungaholela ekwandeni kwe-virus futhi kungase kubangele ukuthi ingasebenzi emzimbeni. Ngaqala ukusebenza eMnyangweni Wezempilo ngoJanuwari walonyaka ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami eStellenbosch University eWestern Cape. Okwamanje, ngisebenza e-Osindisweni hospital, lapho ngenza khona unyaka wami wezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ngiyajabula kakhulu ngalokho engikwenza. UDr. Suraya Naidoo weza ukuzongazisa ngenhloso eyinhloko yalolu hlelo futhi wakhombisa isifiso sokuthi ngibe yingxenye yalo njengoba sengiyisazi sokudla. Njengengxenye yomsebenzi wami, kufanele ngikwazi ukusiza labo abadinga ukudla nokusiza imindeni ekulweni nendlala ekhaya. Ngemuva kwalokho, njengengxenye yalolu hlelo, saqala uhlelo kulesi sikhungo ngoJulayi walonyaka, futhi ngiyena ophatha ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle.

lo Mthetho kumbandakanywa nomthethonkambiso. Kusungulwa Isikhungo njengomuntu ophilayo ngokomthetho oyakubizwa ngeSikhungo seSayensi eNingizimu Afrika. b khuthaza ngokuphelele ubuhlakani babo bonke abantu; kanye c nikeza izaluleko eziyizo kanye nokwenza lula izinyathelo mayelana nezidingo zokuhlanganyela, amathuba kanye nezinselelo ababhekene nazo bonke abakhele iNingizimu Afrika. Lesi Sikhungo yisona kuphela isikhungo seSayensi esamukelwe nguHulumeni. UNgqongqoshe angayala lesi Sikhungo ukuba senzele uHulumeni imisebenzi ethile ehamisana nezinjongo zaso. Kunohlobo olulodwa lwamalunga aleSikhungo, kodwa amalunga angaba ngamalunga aphunyuziwe (asethathe umhlalaphansi asahlonishwa) kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka lawo malunga ahlanganisa ngawo iminyaka engama-70. Ilunga leSikhungo ngumuntu okulindeleke ukuba asize iSikhungo ekutheni sikwazi ukufeza izinjongo zaso. Inqubo eyolandelwa uma kuqokwa amalunga eSikhungo kuyoba impumelelo evelele ekuthuthukiseni noma ukusentshenziswa kwesayensi. Abantu abaphakanyiswe ukuba babe ngamalunga amasha eSikhungo bayophakanyiswa futhi baklonyeliswe ngesitifiketi esinqunyiwe sasayindwe ngamalunga angekho ngaphansi kwamalunga amane, okungenani amabili kulamalungu kufanele abe nolwazi ngokwawo qobo mayelana nomsebenzi wesayensi nendima ebonakalayo edlalwe yilowo muntu kwezesayensi. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele siqukathe umbhalo owuhlaka ochazayo ukuthi ukuqokwa kwalowo muntu ukuba abe yilunga leSikhungo kuzoziqhubela kanjani phambili izinjongo zeSikhungo.

Umphumela walolu simo kube ukungalingani, lapho ubuholi be-English kanye ne-Afrikaans kudala ubudlelwano obungalingani phakathi kwezilimi zabo zomdabu nalezi zilimi. Ngakho-ke, inqubomgomo yolimi yeziqhingi kanye ne-apartheid, ezihlanganiswe nezinhlelo zomphakathi, zomnotho, nezombusazwe, zaveza ubuholi bezilimi, ukungalingani okukhonjiswe ezakhiweni zobuhlanga nezamakhono ezakha umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke lezi zimo zehlisa isimo sezilimi zomdabu kanye nezinhlobo zezizilimi zabantu bomdabu nezinye izigaba ezaziphikisiwe, kuhlanganisa neKhoi kanye neSan - okuqhubeka nokwakha umbono omubi wezilimi ezimnyama, okungabangelwa kuphela ngababhalisi be-Afrikaans kanye ne-English, kodwa futhi nabanye abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu uqobo. Isimo siba sibi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngenxa yezizathu ezingacacile nezimpi zamandla eziphikisana nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi eziningi, uhulumeni nezikhungo ezizimele zine ndlela ethile yokwenza izinqumo zolimi eziphikisana nezingxenye zeSisekelo kanye nezidingo ezihambisana nezilimi. Isigaba 6 seSisekelo sinikeza isikhungo esiphezulu esisemthethweni sokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni, kanye nokukhuthaza ukuhlonishwa nokubekezela kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika.

Kungani kukhona izinsuku zabafuyi nezifundo zokubonisa? Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabafuyi luhloselwe ukuvuselela nokuphatha abafuyi abancane ukuze babe izibonelo neziboniso lapho abafuyi bengabona usizo olukhona uma umhlabathi ulungisiwe kahle, uma umanyolo ofanele ufakwa, uma uhlobo lwezithelo oluhambisana nomhlabathi nesimo sezulu saleyo ndawo kukhethwa, uma izilokazane nezifo ziphathwa kahle, futhi uma ukuvuna kwenziwa ngendlela efanele. Uma izindawo zokubonisa zisungulwa, kubalulekile ukuthi abakhiqizi abasha abasondelene naleyo ndawo bakwazi ukubona konke okukhona mayelana nokutshala nokubheka izitshalo ezizotshalwa kulezo zindawo. Izinsuku zabafuyi zinikeza abafuyi ithuba lokuhlangana nabanye abafuyi, nezinkampani ezinikeza izinto zokutshala, kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza embonini - abafuyi bathola ulwazi oluningi kulezi zinsuku zabafuyi. ULawrence Luthango (oqale ukusebenza ngoMeyi 2008) eMpumalanga Kapa wayenazo izinsuku ezine zabafuyi abancane. Phakathi nalezi zinsuku zabafuyi, izihloko ezahlukene zaxoxwa. Umshuwalense wokuqala wokufuya. Kulolu hlelo, sizama ukubringela abantu abaningi abahlukene abasebenza ebhizinisini lezolimo ukuze basekele abakhiqizi - banezindawo zabo ezithile futhi banikeza ulwazi olunenzuzo. Kumele kube nokuhlanganiswa kwazo zonke lezi zenzo ukuze kuqinisekiswe intuthuko phambili kokwakha ikusasa elizinzile.

Ukufinyelela kolwazi kuthintwa yizithiyo ezithile, ngokwesibonelo, uma irekhodi liceliwe ukuze lisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zomthetho eziphikisanayo noma ezingezona eziphikisanayo noma uma izinqubo zomthetho eziphikisanayo noma ezingezona eziphikisanayo seziqale, lapho ulwazi lungasetshenziswa khona enkantolo, ikakhulukazi uma inkantolo ikholelwa ukuthi kungalimaza inqubo yobulungiswa. Amarekhodi wekhabhinethi noma amaqembu ayo. Amarekhodi ahlobene nokusebenza kwezinkantolo kanye nezijaji. Ulwazi olutholakala ezinkantolo ezikhethekile ezinquma izingxabano ezithile nezicelo, ezisungulwe ngokulandela umthetho. Futhi ulwazi oluphethwe ngumuntu ongumMember of Parliament noma umphakathi wesifunda. Nokho, iMthetho Wokufinyelela KwiNgcaciso idlula eminye imithetho engase ivimbe ukuthola noma yiluphi ulwazi. Cela usizo kumphathi weMibiko oPhakathi kwemnyango efanele ukuze akusize uthole ulwazi noma amadokhumenti owadingayo. Gcwalisa futhi uthumele Ifomu A: Isicelo Sokufinyelela KwiRekhodi Kahulumeni. Ungayithola ehhovisi leMnyango Wezobulungiswa. Uma ulwazi olufuna lungatholakali mahhala, kuzodingeka ukuthi ukhokhe. Ungase udinge ukukhokha imali yokusesha ukuze ufinyelele ulwazi. I-Mthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiNgcaciso, 2000 kanye Nezinhlinzeko ezihlobene. Umphathi weMibiko oPhakathi kumele aphendule ezinsukwini eziyi-30 zokuthola isicelo sakho. Uma umphathi wolwazi ekwenqaba ukufinyelela kulwazi oluceliwe, ungafaka isikhalazo kumphathiswa wezobulungiswa nokuthuthukiswa kwemithetho. Uma unganelisekile ngemiphumela, ungafaka isikhalazo enkantolo.

Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni Kwakukhanya emini, izinsuku ezikanye, lapho izwe lethu, iNingizimu Afrika, lathola khona ukudabuka okuningi. Emini yamaJulayi ngonyaka wezi-2021, abantu bahlala em street corners, emizileni nasemakhaya bejabulile futhi bejabulisa omunye nomunye. Kodwa emhlabeni ka 2021, lapho konke kubukeka kuhle, wafika umoya wezinhlekelele, ubhubhisa ithunzi lemphilo yamaZulu. Kwathi uma izinsuku zidlula, umkhiqizo wezokungcebeleka oqhakazile, uthathelwa phezulu ngezingxabano ezivame ukuhlupha abantu. Kukhumbuleka ukuthi lezi zibhulu zokuqala zazihambisana nemijikelezo yokulwa nokwephula umthetho, okwakuthuthukisa ukungavumi kwezinhlelo zamanje. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinkinga zomnotho ezazithinta amadola yonke, nezimo zalabo ababephila emizileni, nezimo zalabo ababeziqhubeka nayo. Izinsuku zokuqala zomhla zingakaphumi phakathi kwezinsuku ezinkulu. Abantu bejoyina imizamo yokukhombisa ukuzwakala kwabo, ngokuzibophezela empilweni yomqondo wokwakha izinyathelo zamakhaya. Kwaba nezingxabano phakathi kokukhangwa, lapho abanye bekhangwa ukwemukela imithethonqubo ehlukile. Izinhloso zazidlondlobala, nokukhathazeka ngabantu bemizamo yempilo yabo kwavela. Abaxhasi bakhuluma ngezinhlelo zokuthuthuka umnotho ezalotshwe yizo ezikhumbulayo – izinga lokukhula komnotho belikwazile, kodwa kwaba nezahlulelo ezinzima ezazithinta imisebenzi. Kodwa ka sekwenzekile, izinhlelo zamaphathiswa azithintekanga kahle. Kwathathwa imizamo yokwandisa ukuhweba, kodwa ivumelwano elingaqedi kangako lwenze abantu bavele babe nokukhathazeka.

Ukusebenzisa izindawo ezintsha ukuheha ababukeli abasha abaningi. Ukwenza bonke abaneqhaza ukuthi balwemukele loluhlelo. Ukuhlanganisa amazinga ehlukene ukkuze kuthuthukiswe iqhaza abanalo kwezobuciko. Ukuhlela kanye nokufaka izinhlelo ezizodonsa isikhathi ngoba ziyingxenye yesiko elingusingaye ingqungquthela yamazwe omhlaba yengculazi imihlangano ehlukahlukene yokuvulwa kwemilomo imithandazo ebhaliwe emaphepheni kanye izizingqwembe zabadwebi bamalungelo esintu. Abantu abaphila nengculazi. Ukukhiqizwa kwemidlalo yeshashalazi. Ukubheka igalelo lezomnotho ezobuciko ezinalo ekubhekeleni inhlalakahle. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amasiko athola indawo ayifanela emphakathini. Ukusungula ukuxhumana nokwandisa ukusebenzisana. Ukukhiqizwa kwemiqangala yangaphakathi ezweni. Ukuveza izikinga zomphakathi ngokucula , ukudansa, izikondlo, ukuxoxwa kwezindaba kanye nokunandisa. Ukubheka izingqinamba esikweni mayelana nokufakwa kohlelo nokuqhamuka nezindlela zokubona ukushayisana okungavela nezokwazi ukukulawula. Uhlelo lokuqeqeshwa nokuphathwa kwababukisa ngamaciko. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesu lokwandisa amakhono okuphathwa kwababukisa ngobuciko ngama-NGOs kanye nezizinda zobuciko kuzwelonke. Ukulawula kanye nokuqinisekisa. Ukulandelela kanye nokubhekela intuthuko engavela. Ukuhlela kanye nokufaka izinhlelo ezizodonsa isikhathi ngoba ziyingxenye yesiko elingusingaye. Ukuvula izimakethe zemikhiqizo emisha ezoba nomthelela emnothweni. Ukubuyisela ubunjalo bomphakathi ngezinto ozenzayo. ukuvuselelwa komphakathi kwezomnotho, imvelo, nenhlalo.

Kuncane kabi okwenziwe ukuthi umhlaba wabiwe ngendlela eyiyo. Sizakuvula uphenyo olubanzi ukuze sithole ukuthi kungabe yini ephazamisa loluhlelo bese sizama ukuliphangisa. Zonke lezinhlelo zenhlalakahle yabantu nezomnotho zingaphansi kwamasu ethu okunciphisa nokuqeda ubumpofu obuhlasele isizwe sakithi. Umsebenzi owenziwe ngonyaka ophelile, okungumsebenzi owenziwa ngamakhosikazi ngaphansi kohlelo "lwamakhosikazi aseNingizimu Afrika akhulumisana" basebenzisana namagatsha kahulumeni ahlukahlukene, okufaka nokuvakashela emazweni anje ngo Tunisia neChile lapho umsebenzi omkhulu sowenziwe wokulwa nobumpofu, uyasikhombisa ukuthi kukhona isici esithize kulendlela esisebenza ngayo. Siphuthumise ukufundisa ononhlalakahle babe ngoqhwepheshe ukuze lemindeni empofu izuze ngolwazi lwabo. Loku kuzakuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke abantu abaphila ngesondlo sabantwana bazakuzwelwa ubuhlungu nasekukhokheni imali yamanzi nerenti, baphinde bakhunjulwe uma amathuba emisebenzi evela. Sizoqhubeka sibeke imicabango yethu ekukhipheni laba bantu ebumpofini bakwazi ukuzisebenzela. Asingeke siyekele ukufuna izindlela ezintsha zokulwisa ubumpofu nokwenza impilo yabantu ibengcono. Into emqoka yalezinhlelo wukuthi sigqugquzele abantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi basebenzisane ukuze inhlalakahle ithuthuke. Kulomnyaka esikuwo kugujwa umnyaka wamashumi ayisithupha wesivumelwano sabodokotela okungabaholi base Afrika naseNdiya (AB Xuma, GM Naiker kanye no Yusuf Dadoo), umnyaka wamashumi amathathu wokubulawa kuka Steve Biko kanye nomnyaka wamashumi amabili wokuvakashela eDakar kwezihlakaniphi zamabhunu ukuyahlangana neANC.

Iyunithi ye-EMIS izofaka ulwazi olusha kunanoma yiluphi ulwazi olushintshile ngaphandle kwegama lesikole. Ikheli Leposi: 1. Ikhodi yeposi Ikheli lendawo: 1. Khombisa inamba yabafundi abaseBangeni 1 neBanga 2 esikoleni sakho ngokweminyaka yabo. Sicela wazi ukuthi isamba sonke salaba bafundi kufanele sifane nenamba yonke yabafundi bamaBanga afanayo eThebulini 3. Leli Thebuli lisesthenziselwa ukuqapha ukuba ngaphezu kweminyaka nokungaba ngaphansi kweminyaka yabafundi abangena ohlelweni. Khombisa inamba yabafundi ebangeni ngalinye, inamba yamayunithi ekilasi (amaqembu abafundi ngebanga ngalinye) kanye nenamba yabaphindayo, okungukuthi abaphinda okokuqala, abaphinda okwesibili, njll. Amakilasi okulungisa/osizo kusho ikilasi labafundi abathola ukufundiswa kokulungisa okwesikhashana. Izinamba zabafundi sezivele zifakiwe emakilasini ebanga. Khombisa inani umfundi ngamunye okuzofanele alikhokhe njengezimali zesikole kulo nyaka. Ezimeni zezikole ezingenazinsizakalo zamahositela, lokhu akufaki izimali zamahositela. Khombisa inamba yabafundi abaxolelwe ukukhokha izimali ngonyaka ka-2008. Khombisa inamba yabafundi abadluliswe besuka kwezinye izifundazwe noma kwamanye amazwe beya eGauteng. Bala kuphela labo bafundi abajoyine isikole ngonyaka ka-2009. Khombisa inamba yabafundi ngokwebanga abalihambayo ukuya esikoleni. Lokhu kubandakanya abafundi abahlaliswe emahositela. Inamba seyiyonke yabafundi kuleli thebuli kufanele ihambisane nenamba yonke yabafundi emathebulini 3 no-8. Leli thebuli lisebenza kubazali/ababheki abahlala nomfundi. Ungabali ngokuphindwe kabili lapho abazali/ababheki behlala futhi besebenza endaweni.

E-GEMS, silalela lapho amalungu ekhuluma khona. Sijabulela inani lokuxhumana okuhlanzekile futhi sizama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinzuzo zethu nezinsizakalo zihlangabezana nezidingo zamalungu ethu. Ngiyajabula ukwethula izinzuzo zika-2010 kini. Kule bhrosha, olunye ulwazi lunikezwa mayelana nok coverage okuthengekayo nokubanzi ongakuthola njengelungu le-GEMS ngo-2010. Siyanxusa ukuthi ukhethe inketho efanele izidingo zakho nezomndeni wakho. Ukuzibophezela kwethu ekuthuthukiseni kuyisibonakaliso sokuzinikela kwethu kuwe, ezidingweni zakho zempilo, kanye ne-CHOICE yakho. Kule mhlahlandlela, sikhombisa izinketho zethu ezinhlanu ezithengekayo - ukusiza ukuthi wenze ukukhetha okunolwazi mayelana nenketho yeziqu ezizohlangabezana nezidingo zomndeni wakho ngo-2010. Izinzuzo eziyisisekelo ezitholakala kumalungu ngo-2009 zigcinwe zikhona ngo-2010. Siphinde sakhulisa imikhawulo yezinzuzo ezitholakalayo futhi sangeza ezintsha, njengezinzuzo ezintsha zeBlock enkethweni ye-Emerald. Sijabulela ukwazi ukuthi noma ngabe isikhathi somnotho sikhulu, siqhubeka nokukunika ukunakekelwa kwezempilo okuthengekayo nokwakhiwe kahle. Imali yokufaka ka-2010 iqala ku-R424, futhi siphumelele ukugcina ukukhuphuka kwemali yokufaka kuyo yonke inketho ku-10.8%. Amathebula emali yokufaka ka-2010 afakiwe kulomhlahlandlela, ukuze ubone ukuthi ukukhuphuka kuzothinta kanjani iphakheji yakho. Ngithanda ukubonga ngokuqhubeka kokwesekwa kwakho futhi ngikufisela impilo enhle ngo-2010. Khumbula ukuthi i-GEMS iyinsizwa yakho empilweni enhle.

Ngale ndlela, uhulumeni uqale ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezizinkulu ezihlanganyela nezobuciko bendawo. Lokhu kuyisizathu esibalulekile sokuthi amazwe ase-Afrika avumele iSivumelwano. Imakethe yaseTshwane iyindawo ehlukile lapho amanani ebekwe khona futhi lapho imifino nezithelo zithengiswa khona, kuzuza abakhiqizi, abathengi, nabathengisi. Njengoba kuhlale kunjalo, sibhekene nezinselelo zesikhashana, kodwa akukho okuzosivimba ekuthuthumeleni phambili ukuze sibe nekusasa elingcono, futhi simema abaqalayo ukuba basihambise kulolu hambo. Izindawo ezisemngciphekweni ophakeme ohlelweni lwezindawo eziningi zizokhunjuzwa futhi zihlolwe, ukuze kuncishiswe isidingo somsebenzi wezobunjiniyela ukuvikela izakhiwo noma abantu. Ngithanda ukwabelana nabameli ekugubheni bonke ababekhona eMhlanganweni, ikakhulukazi abamele abahlonishwa abavela kwamanye amazwe ababekhona lapha. I-SABC ibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima zezimali, futhi isu lokubheka isikhathi somsebenzi lalihloselwe ukuhlola izindlela ezahlukene zokwenza kube nokuzimela nokukwazi ukwenza umsebenzi ngendlela efanele. Abantu abasha abaneziphumo zengqondo bangafaka izicelo zokungena ohlelweni lweTraining Workshops Unlimited. Ngaphandle kweqiniso elingaphikiswa lokuba khona kwabo eNingizimu Afrika, kwenziwa uphenyo olukhulu. Kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zesayensi zibe nendima ebonakalayo ekwakheni ubuchwepheshe obusha nasekuqhamukeni nemibono emisha phakathi kwentsha yethu. Inani labafundi lenyukile phakathi kwabafundi abamnyama, kodwa lokho kukhula kwenani labafundi abamnyama akuhambelani nezikhangiso ezidingekayo kulabo bafundi.

Ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle noma lokhu koyixazulula yini inkinga, ubikele neKomidi lasePhalamende eliqondene nezoLimo. Izigameko zengozi ephuthumayo zingadala ingozi enkulu emphakathini noma emvelweni esikhathini samanje nakwesizayo. Ungafuna ukuthatha izinyathelo zokunqanda umonakalo esikhathini esizayo noma uthole ulwazi ngomonakalo owenzeke empahleni noma empilweni yakho ngenxa yesehlakalo esifana nalesi. Ngemuva kwesehlakalo esifana nalesi, lowo othintekayo kuso unesibophezelo sokutshela umphakathi neziphathimandla zikahulumeni ngokushesha achaze ngokwenzekile nangemikhiqizo eyingozi echitheke emoyeni, emanzini noma emhlabathini. Kumele bazise uMqondisi-Jikelele ngokwenzekile zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu14, ngomkhiqizo ochithekile nezinyathelo ezithathiwe ukunciphisa umonakalo nokwethula umbiko ophawula ngembangela yengozi. Ukwaziswa ngomkhiqizo okungenzeka uchithekele emoyeni noma emhlabathini kubalulekile uma ufuna ukuvikela impahla yakho, ukuthola indlela yokwelashwa noma ukuthatha isinqumo sokuthi ungashiya nini endaweni. Uma lowo ofanele engalungisi ngokushesha ngemuva kwesehlakalo, ungaya enkantolo umphoqe ukuthi akwenze. Uma bengathathi izinyathelo ezifanele ungaya enkantolo ubaphoqe. Kodwa kumele uqale ngokufaka isikhalo sakho kuhulumeni, ucele usizo. Umthetho-sisekelo uhlinzekela indawo kaMvikeli-Mphakathi. Umsebenzi kaMvikeli-woMphakathi wukuphenya ukuthi uhulumeni ngabe wenze kahle noma udale ukubandlululeka ngandlela thize. Izibonelo zokungaqhubi kahle wukukhwabanisa, ukwenza into ngesizathu esingafanele noma ukuchema. Ukwenza ngokubandlulula wuhlobo lomonakalo olungavunyelwe noma olungemukelekile emthethweni.

Loku kuhambelana nokuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zabantu, nokwehliswa kwezinga lobugebengu, ukufundiswa kwabantu ukubala nokubhala, kanye nokuvula amasango okufunda namasiko kawonkewonke.. siyanethembisa nonke maqhawe namaqhawekazi ethu enazinikela ukuze sithole inkululeko, kanye nani bangane bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, singeke sidazulule ithemba enilibeke kithina ngenkathi niselekelela ukuthi siguqule iNingizimu Afrika ukuze ibe ngumbuso wentando yeningi, izwe loxolo, lapho kungabandlululwana ngebala lesikhumba, nangobulili, izwe elinenqubekela phambili, elizinikele entshisekelweni yobumbano lwabantu. "Umsebenzi wokwakha leyoNingizimu Afrika usuqalile. Lowomsebenzi uzakuqhubeka kulishumi leminyaka lesibili lenkululeko yethu". Eminyakeni engamashumi amahlanu adlulile, ngenkathi balungisela umhlangano omkhulu wabantu owamukela incwadi yemvume yenkululeko, omashanhliziyo zangalezonsuku zathi Asikhulumeni sonke kanye-kanye, ama-Afrika, bangaphesheya eYurophu, amaNdiya namaKhaladi, bonke abantu base Ningizimu Afrika, asikhulumeni sonke sikhulumele inkululeko, sikhulumele nenjabulo engalethwa wukuthi abantu bahlale ezweni elikhululekile. Namhlanje kufanele sivuselele isethembiso sethu, sikhulume kanye-kanye sikhulumele inkululeko, sisebenze ngobudlelwano ukuze kufezekiswe intokozo eza nenkululeko, sisebenzisana ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labo bonke abantu elifanayo, sisho kanye-kanye nangezenzo sithi - sekwanele konke loku okwenza izwe lethu elikuqukethe ngaphakathi kwalo, kanti futhi lisebenzela okubi nokunyanyekayo emphakathini.

Izinkinga Zamanzi: Ukubaluleka Kokubhekisisa Nokuxazulula Emhlabeni wethu wanamuhla, izinkinga zamanzi ziba yinkinga enkulu ethinta abantu, izilwane, nezitshalo. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, kudala izinselele ezinkulu empilweni yethu. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi awawona nje umkhiqizo, kodwa ayisisekelo sempilo. Okokuqala, kufanele sikhulume ngentengo yokuntuleka kwamanzi. Emazweni amaningi, abantu abathola amanzi ahlanzekile bahlupheka. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwezifo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezihluphekayo. Izingane zikhathazekile, zikhula zinganempilo, futhi imindeni ibhekana nezinkinga ezinzima zokuphila. Ngakho, izinkinga zamanzi zikhombisa ukuthi ziningi izinselelo ezihambisana nezomnotho, ezempilo, kanye nezokuthuthukiswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kuyinkinga enkulu. Imifula nezilwandle zikhathazekile ngenxa yokukhishwa kwemfucumfucu, amakhemikhali, nezinsalela zezimboni. Lokhu akuthinti kuphela impilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kuthinta izilwane nezitshalo ezisebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi kudinga izinyathelo zokuqinisa imithetho yokuvikela imithombo yamanzi, ukuze sigweme ukulimala okukhulu. Izinguquko zesimo sezulu zenza kube nzima ukufinyelela emanzini. Ukushisa okwandayo, imvula engapheli, kanye nezimo ezimbi zomoya, kudala ukungabikhona kwamanzi emithonjeni ethile. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho imithombo yamanzi ingatholakali kalula. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinguquko zesimo sezulu zikhombisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni.

Izinga lokuhlinzeka ngogesi: izinga elilindelekile lokuhlinzeka ngogesi, njengezinga lamandla kagesi, ukuhoxiswa, ukwehla, nokwenyuka kwamandla, njll., njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 2 se-NRS 048. Ikhredi/Abathengi abasebenzisa ama-voucher kagesi ekhokhelwayo: laba ngabathengi abasebenzisa ugesi ngekhredi futhi umhlinzeki kagesi uza ukufunda inani legesi elisetshenzisiwe. Izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezichazwe ngaphansi kwe-NRS 047 esigabeni 1 yilezo okufanele umhlinzeki kagesi azame ukuzihlangabeza, kodwa abahlinzeki bamanzi bencitshwa ukuba baphumelele izindinganiso eziphakeme ezibekwe. Ezimweni lapho umhlinzeki kagesi ehluleka ukuhlangabezana nezinga elilindelekile ngenxa yezizathu ezingaphansi kokulawula kwabo, ngeke babhekelele ukwehluleka ukusebenza ezingeni elibekwe. Lezi zimo zifaka phakathi izenzo zokulwa, ukuhweba, nokuvukela, izingozi zemoto, kanye nezimo zezulu ezinzima. Lezi zimo ezibalwe ngenhla aziphelele kodwa ziqondwa njengezibonelo zalokho okufanele kulawule isimo. Uma kwenzeka impikiswano nomthengi mayelana nezinga lokuhlinzeka elikhonjisiwe, umthwalo wokuzama ukusombulula le nkinga usemuhlinzeki kagesi usebenzisa izindlela ezifanele zokubonisana. Ngale ndlela, uma isikhalazo sesifakiwe, umhlinzeki kagesi kufanele azise inkantolo, isikhathi, nendawo lapho kuzokwenziwa khona ukuzama ukusombulula udaba. Kubalulekile ukuqokomisa ukuthi i-NER izongena kuphela uma izingxoxo zokuxazulula zingaphumelelanga. Kubalulekile kubathengi ukuhamba ngezimo ezibekwe ngabahlinzeki bamanzi, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane, ukuqedela yonke imibhalo edingekayo, nokukhokha zonke izindleko ezibekwe.

Kungabe amalungu omuzi kumbe ekhaya lakho kukhona izikwenetu anazo njengamanje noma ezemali ebolekisayo? Q0726a. Singakanani lesikwenetu sesisonke nesemali ebolekiwe? Mayelana nemali engena kuleli khaya, ucabanga ukuthi yenele ukubhekana nezidingo zansuku zonke nezibopho? Ungasho ukuthi isimo sezimali emzini wakho? Ngifisa ukukubuza imibuzo eyidlanzana mayelana nezindleko zomuzi wakho namalungu awo eziqondene nensizakalo yezempilo nokunye. Izindleko zingaba yimali kumbe okunye. Inani lezindleko ezingesiyona imali kanye nelokukhiqiziwe, nokusetshenzisiwe ekhaya, kufanele kulinganiswe nako kufakwe. Sibuza ngezithuba ezehluka hlukene, ngakho-ke, siza ulalelilisise ukuthi iyiphi inkathi okukhulunywa ngayo. Mayelana nayo yonke imibuzo ekulesi sigaba bhala onke amani ngemali yala ezweni, noma ngabe ikhokhwe ngokheshi nangezinye izindlela. Ngizothanda ukuqala ngokubuza mayelana nezindleko zasendlini ezinsukwini ezingu 7 ezedlule. Imibuzo elandelayo imayelana nokudla okuthengwe ikhaya. Ngifuna ukuqale ngibuze imininingwane ngezinhlobo zokudla ezithengwe umuzi wakho ngokheshi noma ngenye inhlobo yenkokhelo kanye/noma enizikhiqizele kona ezinsukwini ezingu 7 ezedlule. b. Inyama (inkomo, ingulube, izinyane lemvu, imvu, inkuku, ikakalikuni, idada, inyama yenyamazane, noma enye inyama - inhlanzi noma okunye kwaselwandle)? c. Izithelo nemifino? d. Ubisi namaqanda?

Uhulumeni kufanele azame ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane ezikhubazekile zithola ukufunda, ukuqeqeshwa, ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukubuyiselwa esimeni (ukwakha amandla azo nokuthi zisinde kangangoba kungenzeka), amalungiselelo omsebenzi kanye namathuba okudlala. Izingane ezikhubazekile kufanele zinikwe wonke amathuba okukhula njengabantu ngabodwana nanjengamalungu omphakathi. Mhlawumbe uyingane ekhubazekile. Mhlawumbe wazi ingane ekhubazekile. Noma mhlawumbe akunjalo. Noma ngabe ungubani, zama ukucabanga futhi ukhulume ngalezi zinto. Ukukhubazeka akusiyo inkinga nje abantu okufanele babhekane nayo. Inselele okufanele sihlangabezane nayo sonke. Sonke singamalungu omndeni wabantu. Kanti-ke unolwazi oluningi kabi emhlabeni jikelele. Amazwe kudingeka abelane ngalolu lwazi. Ngale ndlela singafunda ukunakekelana futhi sakhe umhlaba ongcono womndeni womuntu. Izingane zinelungelo lempilo enhle kakhulu enokutholakala. Zinelungelo futhi lokuphathwa kahle futhi ziphiliswe lapho zigula. Ohulumeni kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi akukho ngane encishwa ilungelo layo lokuthola impilo enhle. Kufanele basebenzele ekuphokopheleni ukuthi zonke izingane zibe nalo leli lungelo. Ohulumeni kufanele baqede ukushona kwabantwana abancane nokwezingane. Ohulumeni kufanele bagcine izingane ziphilile futhi zikahle ngokuhlinzeka ngokunakekela impilo, ukulwa nesifo kanye nesifo sendlala (ukungadli kahle) nangokuhlinzeka ngokudla ounempilo kanye namanzi ahlanzekile okuphuza. Ohulumeni kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi omama bayanakekelwa uma bekhululwe nangemuva kokuba bethole abantwana babo. Lokhu kusiza ukugcina abantwana babo bephilile.

Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius Isingeniso Lo mbhalo uqukethe ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo esithathwe yinkantolo engamaNgesi sokushwele sikaOscar Pistorius, owayengumjaho ophumelelayo, obhekene nezinsolo zokubulala. Ukuhlaziywa kuzogxila ezicini ezihambisana nesinqumo, imiphumela yezomthetho, kanye nemithelela kulezi zenzo emphakathini. Isizathu Sokuhlola Ukubheka isinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kubalulekile ngoba kuveza izinkinga ezinkulu zokubusa, ubulungiswa, kanye nokuhlukumeza kwabantu. U-Pistorius, obemelwe njengomfanekiso olandelwayo, uyisibonelo sokuthi izinqumo zomthetho zingabhekwa ngezindlela ezihlukene, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngezinkanyezi zomphakathi. Uhlaka Lwenqubomgomo Uhlaka lwezomthetho olusemthethweni lukhombisa ukuthi isinqumo sikaPistorius sathathwa ngokuhlonipha zonke izinqubo zomthetho. Nokho, ubufakazi obuhlinzekiwe, izimpikiswano zokuqonda, kanye nezimpendulo zezinhlangothi ezahlukene zikhombisa ukuthi kukhona izinkinga ezihlobene nokuqonda kobulungiswa. Ukuhlinzekwa Kobufakazi Ubufakazi obuhlinzekiwe phakathi kophiko lwezomthetho lubonisa ukungabaza okukhulu. Ubufakazi bokuphila bukaPistorius, izimo ezimkhulumayo, kanye nemiphumela yokushaya kukhombisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezomthetho aluhambisani nezimfuno ezifunwa umphakathi. Ukubaluleka kokuhlinzekwa kobufakazi obanele, obuqinisekisiwe, kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe umehluko obalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezilungile. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nezombusazwe Isinqumo sikaPistorius sibuye saphakamisa izinkinga ezihlobene nezombusazwe.

Uma umphumela wesikhalazo usuwenziwe, i-Ofisa Enegunya izakwazisa ofake isikhalazo ngokumbhalela amazise ngomphumela. Wonke ama-ofishali okuphatha ukunikezela kwemisebenzi azokulandela Ikhodi Yokuziphatha ebekwe ngaphakathi Komthetho Wezinhlelo Zomasipala, Kuhlaka Lokuphatha Ukunikezwa Imisebenzi kanye Nekhodi Lokuziphatha Lokuphatha Ukunikezela Imisebenzi. hlonipha Ikhodi Yokuziphatha yomasipala; futhi azaku hlala angenzi nganoma yiyiphi indlela eyehlisa izinga lokwethembeka nobuqotho bekomiti (bamakomiti). Noma yiziphi izifungo ezingenhla ezenziwe yi-Ofisa Enegunya kuzokubhalwa kurejista futhi kuzogcinwa yi-Ofisa Enegunya. Noma yiziphi izifungo ezenziwe yi-Ofisa Enegunya kuzakwenziwa kumeya. UMeya uzakuqinisekisa ukuthi izifungo ezinje zirekhodwe kurejista futhi zethulwe emhlanganweni Webandla Lesigungu. Noma yiliphi ilungu elingakulandeli noma yikuphi kokungenhla uzakuba necala lokuziphatha budedengu bese ekhiswa emsebenzini ngokufingqiwe. I-Ofisa Elinegunya eliphathekayo kule nqubomgomo nguMenenja Kamasipala, ngaphandle kokuthi i-ofisa eliphezulu noma elingumphathi ophezulu ligunyaziwe amandla okuthatha izinqumo anjena ngokubhalelwa, futhi ukugunyazwa ngokubhalelwa okunje kulandela izigaba zama-79 neze-06 ze-MFMA. Akukho ukugunyazwa okungenziwa komunye umuntu ongeyona i-ofishali enjena. Ikomiti ikhansela noma umqondisi wanoma yimuphi umasipala eyilungu lalo. I-Ofisa uzakudlulisa igunya ngokubhalela Ikomiti Lokunquma ukuthi linikeze amabhidi ayinani lama-R7,500,000 (kufakwae ne-VAT).

Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo ethile yokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene banethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Kodwa-ke, i-GEMS yahlala ihlola izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izinzuzo zifinyeleleka kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlola njalo izinqubomgomo zayo kwavumela i-GEMS ukuba ibheke izidingo zomphakathi, futhi yenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokufaneleka ezazihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithuthukile zokuhlola, ezazisiza abantu ukuthi baqonde kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS yaziwa kakhulu ngokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphezulu, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Naphezu kwezinkinga ezithile, i-GEMS yahlala ibheke izidingo zomphakathi, futhi yenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo, futhi kwavula amathuba amasha kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Ekugcineni, ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile emlandweni wezokwelapha eNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi onempilo. I-GEMS ibonisa ukuthi, ngokubambisana, singakha izixazululo ezinhle ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi.

Lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka emindenini, lapho kukhula khona umuzwa wokwehluleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi imfundo eyanele ikhalipha abantu ekutholeni imisebenzi, kodwa emiphakathini yasemakhaya, ukuqeqeshwa kwemicabango namakhono akabikhona. Izikhungo zemfundo azitholi ukweseka okuningi, futhi abantwana balahleka ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusilela kwezinto ezifanele ezidingekayo ezikoleni, okubangela ukuba abafundi bahlale behluleka emikhakheni ethile. Iziphathimandla ziqhamuka nezinhlelo ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa izimo zemisebenzi, njengokwakha izikhungo zokuthuthukisa amakhono. Nokho, imiphumela yazo zihlala ziphansi, ngenxa yokuthi imithombo ethile ibonakala iyisitshalo esithile esithola ukufinyelela. Kubalulekile ukuba kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezakhamizi neziteshi zezimali, ukuze kube nokuqonda okukhululekile phakathi kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlelo ezithuthukisa umnotho wahulumeni zithinteka futhi zandiswa, kodwa akukhona okwanele. Umnotho omncane wezifunda ezisemakhaya uhlale ungapheli, nezinselele ezivela kumazinga aphakeme zihlala zibonakala. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwehluka kwezifunda nemicabango, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuphila, eziklanyelwe ukwehla kwezinga lokuphila. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izinhlelo zokuhlala kwezokuthuthukiswa kumele ziqinise imiphakathi yasemakhaya. Lokhu kumele kufake phakathi ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi, ukuphakanyiswa kwezinga lemfundo, nokukhuthazwa kokusebenza komphakathi. Umugqa wokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka zomphakathi, izinkampani, kanye nosomabhizinisi kumele uqhubeke, ukuze kwandiswe amathuba okwakha imisebenzi.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaholela ekwandeni kokungathembeki. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, abantu bangase baphendule ngokungathembeki, okungaholela ekwandeni kokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokwethembeka emiphakathini, uma abantu bengakholwa ekutheni izinhlelo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omubi ekuphathweni kwezinsizakalo, njengoba abantu bangase baphendule ngokungafuni ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Kubalulekile futhi ukuqonda ukuthi umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaholela ekwandeni kokuphazamiseka kwezinsizakalo. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, izinsizakalo ezibalulekile, ezifana nezokwelapha, ezokuthutha, nezokuxhumana, zingase zingatholakali. Lokhu kungaholela ekwandeni kokunganeliseki kwabantu, okungaholela ekwandeni kokuphazamiseka emiphakathini. Izinsizakalo ezibalulekile zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo. Ngokuphetha, umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaba mkhulu ezindaweni ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezomnotho, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuphathwa kwemithombo. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinhlelo ze-SITA zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imisebenzi ihamba kahle, abantu bathola izinsizakalo ezisemqoka, futhi umnotho uthuthuke. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokubuyekeza, ukuhlela, nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo ezikhona. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo ze-SITA, okuzoholela ekwenzeni ngcono impilo yabantu kanye nomnotho jikelele.

Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo olufanele, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola izimpendulo ezinhle ezivela kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi ibhizinisi layo likhule, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi izinsizakalo zayo zibe ngcono. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqala ukubona izinzuzo ezinkulu zokuba ne-GEMS, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa ngale mfundiso. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Kwakukhona izinhlelo ezahlukene ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo olufanele, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola izimpendulo ezinhle ezivela kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi ibhizinisi layo likhule, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi izinsizakalo zayo zibe ngcono. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqala ukubona izinzuzo ezinkulu zokuba ne-GEMS, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa ngale mfundiso. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Kwakukhona izinhlelo ezahlukene ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo olufanele, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa impilo yabo.

Engqungqutheleni Yamazwe Omhlaba Yentuthuko Eqhubekayo eyayibanjelwe eNingizimu Afrika (World Summit on Sustainable Development, South Africa), iNingizimu Afrika yakhombisa isibonelo sezokuvikeleka esavunywa njengokufanele kuqhathaniswe ngakho izinga okuyinto entsha emhlabeni jikelele - osekwamukelwa Izizwe Ezihlangene njengesibonelo semicimbi emikhulu. Kutshalwe amabhiliyoni ayi-R1.5 ekwenzeni ngcono amazinga ezindawo zokungena, kanti namalungiselelo e-Ndebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA yowezi-2010 enza ngcono izinqubo zokungena ezweni ukuze kungenwe kahle kanye nokuphuma nokungena kwabantu ezweni. Sizoba nama-visa aqondene ngqo nalo mcimbi azokwenza ukuthi abanikazi bamathikithi bakwazi ukungena ezweni kalula. Lokhu kubandakanya ukusheshisa izinhlelo zokungena ezweni ezindaweni zokungena ngokuthi kusheshiswe imizila nokuhlelwa kwabagibeli okuqhubekile lapho abahambi behlolwa khona ngaphambi kokuba bagibele indiza eya lapho beya khona. FIFA.COM Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi: www.sa2010.gov. Kunemisebenzi emisha eyi-415 000 ezokwenziwa ukusingatha amathonamenti. Kuneminye imisebenzi emisha eyizinkulungwane ezingama-80 000 embonini yezokudla neyizinkulungwane ezingama-40 000 embonini yezokwakha. Kuzokwengezwa amabhiliyoni angama-R55,7 ekukhiqizweni kwempahla yasekhaya yonke (gross domestic product) ngo-2010. Enye imali engamabhiliyoni ama-R2 emali esetshenzisiwe ngokwakha izinkundla zezemidlalo ezintsha izosiza ngqo amakhaya ahola kancane. Izivakashi zamazwe angaphandle zizochitha amabhiliyoni ayi-R8,5 eNingizimu Afrika ngo-2010.

Lokhu kungaba yizincwadi ezivela kumhlinzeki wezempilo noma ezinye izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngalesi siza. Ukubaluleka Kokuhlukaniswa Kwamalungu Ancike kwabanye Ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye kubalulekile kakhulu emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavela ezimweni ezihlukahlukene bahlala benakekelwa, futhi bahlala bethola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lokhu kuhlukaniswa kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye (GEMS dependent member classification) kubalulekile ekuphathweni kwezinsiza zempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abadinga usizo bahlala benakekelwa, futhi bahlala bethola izinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukuze lokhu kuqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle izidingo ezihambisana nalokhu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu bahlala benakekelwa ngendlela efanele. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi onobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ethola ithuba lokuphila impilo enempilo.

Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezisheshayo ezibalulekile ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi ziqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kufaka phakathi ukusungulwa kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza eziphathwayo, ezivumela abantu ukuthi bathumele izicelo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kalula, okunciphisa isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ekugcineni, ukuhlela izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe, ukubambisana, nokuxhumana okuhle. Umphakathi kufanele uqwashiswe ngalezi zinqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokuphila kwabantu. Njengoba sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthuka, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka sikhumbula ukuthi impilo yomuntu ibaluleke kakhulu, futhi izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi le mpilo iyaphepheka.
