Umuntu otholwe enecala lokwephula umthetho ophawulwe ngaphansi kwesigaba -44 engahlawuliswa noma abhadle ejele isikhathi esingevile eminyakeni eyishumi noma athole isijeziso sakho kokubili. ubukhulu begalelo ekunukubezeni jikelele ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile okwenziwe yilowo otholwe enecala. k nokugwema noma nokunciphisa imithelela eyingozi eqophelweni lomoya ezenzweni ezingalawulwa ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho; noma l olunye udaba olubalulekile ukuqhuba lo Mthetho. Ungqongqoshe wesiFundazwe angashaya imigomo engashayisani nalo Mthetho mayelana nodaba oluqulwe esigabeni- 46 (c) kuya ku- (n). d ididiyele ngokuhlela ngenqubo yokuziphatha noma ngamazinga kazwelonke noma ezinga lomhlaba mayelana neqophelo lomoya. c ngakho kokubili, inhlawulo nokuboshwa. Ngaphambi kokushicilela noma yimuphi umgomo ngaphansi kwesigaba- 46 na- 47, noma esinye isichibiyelo emigomweni, uNgqongqoshe noma uNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana ehambisana nezigaba sama- 49 ne- 50. Isigatshana 3 asidingi ukusetshenziswa ezinguqukweni ezincane zomgomo. Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa amandla agunyazwe ngaphansi kwemibandela yalo Mthetho nokufanele asetshenziswe ngokuhambisana nalesi sigaba kanjalo nesigaba- 50, uNgqongqoshe noma uNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni kufanele alandele inqubo yokubonisana efanele isimo esikhona.

E-Afrika, kuze kube manje le vayirasi isisabalalele emazweni ayi-16 kuphela. Ngalesi sikhathi sokubhala le ncwadi, le vayirasi isisulele abantu abayi-177 457 (abaqinisekiswe yizindlu zokuqhuba ucwaningo lwesayensi) emhlabeni wonke, phakathi kwabo osekufe abayi-1 457 abaqinisekisiwe. ENingizimu Afrika kuze kube yimanje, sesiqinisekise izimo eziyi-2 844 osekufe kuzo abantu abayisithupha. Ngemuva komhlangano wesine weKomidi Lwesimo Esisheshayo owawubanjwe ngomhla we-11 Juni 2009, iNhlangano Yomhlaba Yezempilo (i-WHO) yaphetha ngokuthi ikhratheriya yokuthatha lokhu kufa njengobhubhane lomhlaba seyanelisekile futhi uMnqondisi-Jikelele, uDkt Margret Chan, usesigunyazile lesi simo njengoBhubhane (izinga lesi-6). Kalula lokhu kusho ukuthi loku kufa sekusabalalele emazweni akuzo zonke izindawo ze-WHO futhi lokhu kwenzeke ngokukhulu ukushesha. Kodwa-ke ngithanda ukugcizelela ukuthi ukugunyazwa kohobhane akusho ukuthi ukufa kunamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kuyaqhubeka nokusabalalela yonke indawo. Ngomhla wesi-6 ku-Julayi i-WHO yachaza ukuqhubeka kwalolu bhubhane emazweni athintekayo kanye nakumazwe amasha njengokungavumeleki futhi okungavimbeki. Ngenhlanhla, yize lokhu kunje, iphinde yasho ukuthi abantu abaningi abatheleleke ngevayirasi bazoba nezimpawu ezingconywana. Yize njengabasebenzi bezempilo, bomhlaba jikelele nabalapha ekhaya, sikhathazekile ngokufa okuvelile kuze kube manje (okungama-0,8% emhlabeni nama-0,2% abantu abesulelekile eNingizimu Afrika). Ivayirasi isulela abantu abaphakathi kweminyaka eyi-10 ukuya kwengama-29 - iningi labo ngabafundi noma ngabasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.

Idokhumende kamazisi , yidokhumende efakazela ubuyena bomuntu. Amadokhumende kamazisi anikezwa kwizakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika noma kubantu abanezimvume zokuhlala ezweni unomphela, abaneminyaka engu-16 nangaphezulu. La madokhumende anganikezwa nakunoma ngubani omunye umuntu osebenzela uhulumeni noma inhlangano esungulwe ngokulandela umthetho ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika, noma umuntu ocelwe ukusebenza egameni likahulumeni kwelinye izwe. Lokhu kunikezwa nakowakwakhe noma ezinganeni. Yenza isicelo kwihhovisi eliseduzane leZangaphakathi noma imission uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Gcwalisa ifomu le-BI-9. Fakela isitifikedi sakho sokuzalwa noma ipasi lakudala elalinikezwa ngaphambi komhlaka-1 kuJuly 1986. Uma ukuzalwa komuntu kungabhaliswanga , kanti futhi singekho isitifikedi sokuzalwa, gcwalisa ifomu le BI-24/15 ebese uhambisa nenye yamadokhumende asekelayo, isibonelo, isitifikedi sokubhabhadiswa, incwadi yesikole, noma isitifikedi sokukhulelwa. Fakela izithombe ezimbili zosayizi kamazisi. Kuzothathwa iminwe ukuze ifakelwe kuhla lwabantu ezweni. Abenzi bezicelo abashadile kumele bakhiphe namakhophi ezitifikedi zomshado. Owesimame owenza isicelo sikamazisi nakhona ofisa ukusebenzisa esinye sezibongo ayaziwa ngaso, kumele anikeze nobufakazi bokuthi unelungelo lokusebenzisa leso sibongo. Umuntu obuya ngaphandle kwezwe, owenza isicelo sikamazisi , kumele afakele nemvume yokuhlala ezweni unomphela, kanye nesitifikedi sokuba nelungelo lokuba yisakhamuzi sezwe noma isitifikedi sokukhishwa phansi kwezibopho , isitifikedi somshado kwifomu le-BI-529. Izicelo zingathatha isikhathi sokufinyelela kumaviki ayisishagalombili.

Lesi yisikhungo esisebenza amahora angu-24 sokubika ubugebengu, esibhekana nemibiko nezikhalazo ezivela kubantu. Izingcingo zingashayelwa ngokusebenzisa ulayini wakwa-Telkom noma ngeselula . Zonke izingcingo ezingena esikhungweni ziyarekhodwa. Qaphela: Shayela kule nombolo kuphela uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo. lokhu kuvimbela izingcingo ezishayelwa ngabantu abakwisimo esiphuthumayo nesiyingozi, kanti futhi abadinga ukusizwa ngamaphoyisa masishane. lokhu kuchitha isikhathi samaphoyisa ngoba kudingeka izikhulu zithathe imoto noma zindize ziye kuleyo ndawo okubikwa khona ubugebengu lokhu futhi kuchitha izimali ngoba izikhulu zingathunyelwa ukuthi ziye endaweni lapho okungekho khona isimo esiphuthumayo. Uma unesikhalazo esingaphuthumi noma ukubuza imibuzo nje ngokunabile, shayela esiteshini samaphoyisa sendawo yangakini. Shayela inombolo ethi: 10111 noma ngabe ukuphi eNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi luyaqoqwa ebese unikezwa inombolo yereferensi njengobufakazi kanye nokulusebenzisa ngesikhathi esizayo. Zonke izingcingo ziphendula ngokushesha ngendlela okukhonakala ngayo. Awekho amafomu okumele agcwaliswe.

Kunezifo eziningi esizithola kubazali bethu nabokhokho bethu. Kukhona okuncane noma okungelona lutho esingakwenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Nokho, noma sithatha ukunakekela imizimba yethu, lezi zifo zingangena. Lezi zifo zithi zidalwe yindlela esiphila ngayo. Le bhukwana innehla ulwazi ngezinto ongazenza ukuvikela lezi zifo. Khumbula, umzimba wakho uwakho. Impilo yakho isezandleni zakho. Ngakho, qaphela wena. Uma ungashisi, ngeke ube nezinkinga zempilo. Abantu abaningi lapha eNingizimu Afrika bayazi lokho. Ngakho, abashisi izigubhu noma amathuluzi, futhi abakhwabanisi utshwala noma bashise i-snuff (utshwala obungena emathunjini). Le bhukwana innehla amaphuzu abalulekile mayelana nokuphila impilo enempilo. Into engcono kakhulu umuntu angayenza ukuvuma ukuthi angashisi noma ayeke uma eseshisa. Sithemba ukuthi uzokhetha ukuphila kahle ngokungabheki izigubhu noma ukushisa. Funda indaba kaDudu... Um husband wakho uyakhwehlela kakhulu, Gugu. (Pic.1). Kungcono uma engashisi! (Pic.1). Uyazi ukuthi ngishise iminyaka eminingi futhi akukho okwakuhambile kimi! (Pic.2). Uyakubona uDudu, le yimpilo yami ngakho nginamalungelo okushisa ngendlela engiyifisayo! (Pic.3). Kulungile, uyakhumbula ukuthi uDkt. Zondi, udokotela ophakeme, uthi abantu abaningi abafika esibhedlela ukuze bathole ukwelashwa banezifo ezidalwe ukushisa? (Pic.3). Umonakalo odalwe ukushisa utshwala ngaphakathi emzimbeni wakho usuku nosuku ubonisa umonakalo enhliziyweni yakho, emaphashini, emithanjeni yegazi, nakwezinye izingxenye zomzimba wakho. Ekugcineni, impilo yakho yonke iyashintsha.

Irekhodi yokuqala izawugcinwa ehhovisi LikaMenenja Wezezimali, bese ikhophi lerekhodi kumele linikezwe i-ofishali yomnyango ofanele. Ezehlakalweni zezamba ezinkulu zamabhidi ezithatha isikhathi eside ukufundwa, yilabo babhidi abaceliwe kuphela abazafundwa, bese isheduli eqediwe izakunikezwa ngokushesha okungaphumelelwa ngako. Imiphumela yebhidi izakushicilelwa kuwebhusayidi noma ibhodi yesaziso kamasipala. Kumaphrojekthi amakhulu anzima noma amaphrojekthi awuhlobo olusipesheli, lapho kungadingeki futhi kungongi izindleko ukulungisa izincasiselo eziwubuchwepheshe ngaphambi kwesikhathi, ukubhida kungenziwa ngezigaba ezimbili. Isigaba sokuqala ukumema iziphakamiso zobuchwepheshe ezingenazo izintengo ezesekwe ekufanekisweni kwemiqondo noma izincasiselo zokwenza ngemfanelo. Iziphakamiso ezinjena zeyeme ekulungisweni kanye nokucaciswa nokulungiswa kwezobuchwepheshe nezokuthengisa. Isigaba sesibili ukucela ukungeniswa kwemibhalo yebhidi eguquliwe kanye nokungeniswa kweziphakamiso zokugcina zobuchwepheshe kanye namabhidi anezintengo. Isigaba sokutholiswa sizakumele siqinisekise ukuthi uhlu lwabanikezeli abavunyiwe luyagcinwa futhi luyabhekwa uma kunezidingo zako konke ukutholiswa -. Uhlu luzakufakelwa imininingwane ngekwata ngokubonisa isaziso emabhodini abekelwe loku kanye nakuwebhusayidi yebandla. Izimemo zokwenziwa kohlu lwabanikezeli abavunyiwe luzakukhangiswa kanye ngonyaka kumaphephandana endawo ajwayelekile2. Izaziso ezinje zizakumema abanikezeli ukuthi bafake izicelo zokuhlolwa kanye nokwenziwa uhlu kwabanikezeli abavunyelwe.

Ubhontshisi wesoya, njengezitshalo eziningi eziyimidumba, usebenzisa i-nitrogen ngokusungula ubudlelwane bokuphilisana ndawonye nebhakthiriyamu eyi-Bradyrhizobium japonicum. Kodwa-ke, ukuze kube nemiphumela emihle, kufanele kuxutshwe iconsana lebhakhthiriya elinembayo nembewu kabhontshisi wesoya (noma eyanoma yimuphi umdumba) ngaphambi kokuthi kutshalwe. Inhlanganisela yezitshalo zanamuhla imvamisa ifinyelela ubude obucishe bube yimitha elilodwa futhi isebenzisa izinsuku ezingama-80 ukuya kweziyi-120 ukukhula ukusuka ngesikhathi sokuhlwanyela kufikwe kwesokuvuna. Ubhontshisi wesoya ungowendabuko eMpumalanga Eshiya kodwa ngamaphesenti angama-45 kuphela emikhiqizo kabhontshisi wesoya eqhamuka lapho. I-U.S. yakhiqiza izigidi zamathani kabhontshisi wesoya ezingama-75 ngonyaka we-2000, okwathi kuwo kwathunyelwa ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu emazweni angaphandle. Abanye abalimi bawo abaphambili yiBrazil, i-Argentina, iParaguay, iShayina ne-Indiya. Izitshalo zikabhontshisi wesoya zitheleleka kalula yizifo zamagciwane athile, izifo zokukhunta, izifo zamagciwane ayi-virus nezifo zezidalwa eziphila ngokudla umzimba wezinye. Ubhontshisi wesoya wawuyisitshalo esibalulekile eMpumalanga Eshiya kudaladala ngaphambi kokuthi abantu bakwazi ukubhala. Useyisitshalo esiphuma phambili eShayina, eJapan naseKorea.

U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Ngalesi sikhathi, uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ukuphila kwezingane kubalulekile. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bahlala bejabulile, futhi lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo.

Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngokuqhuba kwemibhalo, izincwadi, neminye imithombo equkethe ulwazi olufana namafilimu, amavidiyo, ama-CD omculo, nama-DVD, wonke ashicilelwe noma akhiqizwe eNingizimu Afrika. Lo Mthetho uhlinzeka ngesisekelo esibanzi somthetho mayelana nenani lemikhono okumele igcinwe, isimo sokufika kwayo, ulwazi oludingekayo kubashicileli nabakhiqizi, isikhathi sokuthunyelwa kwemikhono, kanye nezinyathelo ezithathwayo uma abashicileli nabakhiqizi behluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho. Imibhalo iyinto ethile ehlelelwe ukugcinwa noma ukudluliswa njengolwazi olubhalwe, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi luyimibhalo, izithombe, noma irekhodi elenzelwe ukulalelwa, futhi kunoma iyiphi enye ifomethi eqondakalayo nangemithombo ethile. Lokhu kubhekisela kwimibhalo eyakhiwe ukuze isetshenziswe emphakathini, ehlelelwe ukukhiqizwa nokusabalalisa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika, egcina noma idlulisa ulwazi olubhalwe, ulwazi lwezithombe, ulwazi olurekhodiwe lokulalela, olufundwa ngama-mishini, noma lwethulwa kunoma iyiphi enye ifomethi ehlolwe noma esanda kushicilelwa ehlukile kakhulu kulokho okwakukhona ngaphambili ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi luhlukile noma indlela nesimo sokuthi luthunyelwe kulolu shicilelo eNingizimu Afrika noma ehlelelwe ukusetyenziswa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcinwa kwemfihlo ebhalwe phansi kanye nemvelaphi ye-rekhodi kusiza ukufinyelela kwabantu emisebenzini yonke eshicilelwe eyakhiqizwa ezweni labo. Ngakho-ke, ukugcinwa kolwazi ngokomthetho kuyisici esisodwa semigqa yokukhululeka kolwazi.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaKomidi Amancane Ezeluleko Lwemininingwane (IAASC) nawo asunguliwe ukuze anikeze izeluleko kubaphathi bezezimali mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. I-Centre Yemininingwane yeMnyango Wezokuvikela isunguliwe njengendawo yokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. I-Centre Yemininingwane izosiza labo abathumele izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi. Inhloso yale bhukwana ukuvumela amalunga omphakathi ukuba babone uhlobo noma uhlobo lwezikhumbuzo eziphathwa yiMnyango Wezokuvikela futhi kufaka phakathi izinqubo zokuthi bangafinyelela kanjani kulwazi nezikhumbuzo nokuthi bangazithola kanjani ngqo noma ngokuqondile. Ulwazi ngokweSahluko 14 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela Kulwazi ka-2000 (Umthetho No. 2 ka-2000). Ngokuhambisana noMthethosisekelo, iMnyango Wezokuvikela iqinisekisa ukuvikelwa okusebenzayo kwedemokhrasi yaseNingizimu Afrika, ithuthukisa ukuphepha kwezwe, futhi ikhuthaza ukuphepha ezingeni lesizwe, lesifunda, kanye nezwe jikelele ngokulandela amandla avikelekile, anamuhla, anokufinyelela kanye nobuchwepheshe obuphambili. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inikezwa ukuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, kanye nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule futhi ethuthukayo kubo bonke. Iphinde ibheke noma iyiphi iminyango kahulumeni ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela ihlanganisa uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF).

Ukwengezela, ngaphambi kokwemukela I-IDP, umasipala kumele anike ithuba umphakathi ukuba uveze imibono ngeziphakamiso ezenziwe kwi-IDP. Ngemuva kwezinguquko ezingaqhamuka ngenxa yeqhaza lomphakathi, umkhandlu ucubungula izichibiyelo ze-IDP ukuze iphasiswe. Zingakapheli izinsuku eziyishumi umasipala emukele I-IDP, kumele ethule umbiko ofanayo we-IDP ohlangene nohlelo lweNqubo, kuNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ukuze uhlolwe. UMthetho weziNhlelo zoMasipala awudingi ukuba uNgqongqoshe weNdawo esiFundazweni aphasise I-IDP, kuphela uhlola ukuthi I-IDP iyahambisana yini nemibandela yomthetho nokuthi ayishayisani nama-IDP, amaqhinga abanye omasipala noma izinhlaka zikahulumeni. Uhlobo nengqikithi yombhalo we-IDP lulawulwa kakhulu ngomasipala ngokwabo. Ngakho-ke, alukho uhlu lwezinto oluyimpoqo lokumele kuqukathwe ngamaqoqo amabhukwana e-IDP. Uhlu lokufanele kube yingxenye ye-IDP lungaba yisikhali esincomekayo sokunika isithombe sokuthi I-IDP ingabunjwa kanjani. Isibonelo esilandelayo singakusiza ekucabangeni izinto ezingabaluleka kodwa azinqandi muntu ekuzisunguleleni umcabango ohlukile. Umnyango KaHulumeni weNdawo eziFundazweni (DPLG) unikwe amandla asemthethweni okusiza omasipala bakwazi ukufeza izinhloso nezibophezelo zokulungisa ama-IDP. Iqhinga lokweseka iDPLG lakhiwe yizinsika ezine nezivele emdwebeni ongenhla. UMthetho weziNhlelo zoMasipala nohlaka lwenqubomgomo unika omasipala uhlaka lokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zentuthuko edidiyele.

Imantshi ingathatha isinqumo sokuqinisekisa Umyalelo ibekele eceleni Umyalelo bese iphoqelela ukuthi kulalelwe ubufakazi bomlomo. Khumbula ukuthi ngokoMthetho, Amaphoyisa ku-mele akusize nganoma yiyiphi indlela echazwe kuMy-alelo Wokuvikeleka, isibonelo ekuthathweni kwezinto okungezakho, incwadi yakho yomazisi, izincwadi noma izimpahla zabantwana njll. Uma uthola ukuthi Iphoyisa alikusizi noma liyenqaba ukusebenzisana nawe ngokulandela Umyalelo, ungakwazi ukuku-bika lokhu eBandleni leziphathimandla Lomgondisi Elizimele (Indepedent Complainysa Directorate). uMmangalelwa uzoboshwa yini ngoMyalelo Wokuvikeleka? uMmangalelwa angeke aboshwe lapho enikezwa Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka. Yini ukwephulwa koMyalelo Wokuvikeleka? Yini Ukudelela Inkantolo? Lokhu kwenzeka uma Ummangalelwa engalandeli Umyalelo, noma ehluleka ukuvela eNkantolo Yamacala Obugebengu ukuzophendula ngamacala abekwe wona. ungasifaka kanjani isicelo soMyalelo Wokuvikeleka. ikunikeze Umyalelo noma cha. ngezinsiza abangakweluleka bakusize ngokuphathelene na-lokhu inikeziwe ekuqaleni kwalo Mhlahlandlela. UNobhala weNkantolo uzokusiza ekugcwaliseni amafomu adingekayo kanye noku-kusa ngaphambi kweMantshi. Kumele ngiye kuyiphi Inkantolo? Iya enkantolo eseduzane nalapho uhlala noma use-benza khona. Uma ngabe kuwukuthi waphoqwa ukuthi ushiye inda-wo ohlala kuyo ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa futhi uhlala kwenye indawo okwesikhashana, ungaya enkantolo eseduzane nendawo ohlala kuyo okwesikhashana. Uzothini Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka wesikhashana?

Ukuze ibhizinisi liphumelele, kumele liphathwe kahle. Ukuba nezicwangciso ezicacile kubalulekile ngoba ziyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zokuphatha ibhizinisi. Ukuphathwa kahle kusho ukuthi imisebenzi emine yokuphatha ibhalwe kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi liyaqhubeka nokukhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lifinyelela ezinjongo ezifunwayo futhi lenze inzuzo. Imisebenzi yokuphatha ibandakanya: ukuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa isu, ukufaka isu emsebenzini, nokuhlola njalo ukusebenza (ukugcina ukulawula). Ukuhlela isu kuyisabelo esibalulekile kumkhiqizi ngoba kuyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zabo zokulima. Singathi ukuhlela isu kuzokhombisa indlela phambili nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezibekiwe ezinhlelweni zakho zokuhlanganisa lezi zenzo. Njalo sithi asikwazi ukuhlela izicwangciso ezicacile zokulima. Izizathu zalokhu zimi kanje: kunezinto eziningi ezingalawulwa, ezifana nezimo zezulu, izifo, ukuguquguquka kwemakethe, nezinguquko ezintengo zezimali nezokukhiqiza. Lezi zingozi zingavela ekulimaleni; zikhona, futhi sibhekana nazo lapho sizama ukwakha ibhizinisi lokulima. Nokho, siphinde sisho ukuthi isu elingaphelele lingcono kunokungabi naso nhlobo. Kungcono ukuhlela izicwangciso mayelana nonyaka ojwayelekile, bese sikwazi ukuhlela lezi zicwangciso uma izimo zishintsha phakathi kwalonyaka. Yini okufanele kwenzeke? Kuphi okufanele kwenzeke? Nini okufanele kwenzeke? Malini okufanele kwenzeke? Kanjani okufanele kwenzeke? Ukuba nekhono lokuhlela izicwangciso kudinga ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zibhalwe phansi futhi ziphathwe ngokuqinile. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kuyo yonke impilo yakho.

Umuntu oshadile akakwazi ukurejistela ubuhlobo. Umuntu ozoba uphathini kubuhlobo bezakhamuzi oseke washada ngaphambilini kumbe oseke waba uphathini kobunye ubuhlobo kufanele aqale akhiphe ikhophi efakazelwe yokudivosa kumbe isitifiketi sokufa kwabeshade naye kumbe obengumhlobo wakhe, loko nje okuqondene, anikeze umshadisi njengobufakazi bokuthi lobo budlelwano sebuqediwe. Umshadisi angeqhubeke nomcimbi nokurejista ubudlelwano ngaphandle kokuthi aqale anikezwe le mmiqulu okukhulunywa ngayo kwisigatshana 3. Ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi bungarejistwa abafuna ukuhlanganiswa uma, ngaphandle kokuthi bawubulili obubodwa, kungekho okunye okubanqabelayo emthethweni ukuthi bangashada. Noma ubani ofuna ukuphakamisa isivimbezelo kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa njengabahlobo kufnele asifake ngokubhalela umshadisi ozosingatha umcimbi walobo buhlobo.. Kufanele kuthi lapho umshadisi ethola leso sivimbezelo afune isizathu saloko kuphikisana nenhlanganiso kuze kube uyazidelisa ukuthi asikho isivimbezelo esisemthethweni kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa, ube esekwazi-ke ukusingatha umcimbi wobuhlobo. Uma naye engenako ukwaneliseka kufanele anqabe ukuhlanganisa ubudlelwano futhi azirekhode ngokuzibhala phansi izizathu zalokko. Umshadisi angawusingatha umcimbi futhi awurejistenganoma yisikhaathi sini nanganom yiluphi usuku evikini, kepha akaphoqelekile ukusingatha umcimbi ngezinye izikhathi ngaphandle kwaphakthi kwehora le-8 ekuseni nangehora le-4 ntambama.

Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle nokungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwabantu nemithetho. Ukuze sithuthukise le nkantolo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngokuqhubekayo ngezindlela zokwenza abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo iyinsika yokuvikela amalungelo abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise ukufinyelela kwale nkantolo. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, bahlushwa ukungabi nolwazi olufanele ngezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokufundisa umphakathi ngamalungelo abo, ukuze bakwazi ukuwasebenzisa lapho kudingeka. Ngaphandle kokwaziswa, abantu bangase bahlupheke, bephoqeleka ukuba bahlale benamathele ezinqubweni ezingalungile. Kodwa-ke, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ayinakho ukufinyelela kuphela; kufanele futhi ibe nezinqubo ezicacile nezisebenzayo. Izinqubo ezinzima nezinde zingadala ukuthi abantu baphoxeke, futhi lokhu kungaholela ekutheni baphumelele emacaleni abo. Ukuze sithuthukise le nkantolo, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokwenza izinqubo zibe lula, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zayo kalula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo kufanele ibonise ubuholi obuqinile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abahluleli bayo kumele babe neziqu eziphezulu, kodwa futhi babe nekhono lokuphatha izindaba ezinzima. Ukuze kube nezinguquko ezithile ezidingekayo, abahluleli kufanele babe nekhono lokuhlola izimo ezithile, bahlolisise izimo ezihlukene, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesisombululo esihambisana nomthethosisekelo. Ekugcineni, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Isebenza njengesikhumbuzo sokuthi sonke sinesibopho sokuhlonipha amalungelo omunye nomunye.

Luqaliswe ukusebenza ngokoMthetho Osadingidwa kwiNqubomgomo Yezomhlaba yaseNingizimu Afrika (1997) kanye nenqwaba yemitheshwana kanye nezinqubomgomo. I-IDP kamasipala wasebaQulusini yowezi- 2007/ 2008 ibeka ukuthi, njengalokhu kuvamisile ezindaweni ezazihlukaniswe ngokungalingani kudala nakulezo ezinomphakathi omningi otshalayo, ilinganiselwa kuma- 80% indawo kaMasipala wasebaQulusini okungeyabamhlophe. Kule ndawo sekube nekube nezihlakalo eziningi kakhulu zabantu abafuna ukubuyiselwa umhlaba kule minyaka elishumi edlule. Kahle kahle, uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba (DLA) usuhlonze indawo yasebaQulusini njengendawo okuyiyona ezoba nseqhulwini uma sekubhekelelwa lolu daba lokubuyiselwa abantu umhlaba. Nakuba lokhu kuletha amathuba emiphakathini efake izicelo zokubuyiselwa umhlaba, kuletha izinselelo ezinkulu kuMasipala wasebaQulusini. Lokhu kwenziwa ukwentuleka kwamandla ngaphakathi, amakhono kanye nemali yokubhekana nengqalasizinda ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwendawo okumele ikwanywe kabusha nguMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba. Kumele kuqhanyukwe nezisombululo zokwakha kabusha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lokubuyiselwa komhlaba ebaQulusini luba nomthelela omuhle ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Mabili amathuba entuthuko acacile ahlobene noHlelo Lokubuyekezwa Komhlaba ebaQulusini, ikwezolimo nezokuvakasha. Amathuba okubuyekezwa komhlaba kumele ahlelwe aqondaniswe kanye namanye amathuba entuthuko ahlonziwe. Indawo yasebaQulusini isemathubeni amahle okuveza amathuba ezimakethe zezokuvakasha futhi lokhu kumele kuhlolwe ngokwamathuba omklamo wokubuyekezwa komhlaba.

Umnyango uyabona futhi kwesinye isikhathi amalungelo benikeza izinto zokuzifisha. Isizathu sokuthi kukhishwe amalungelo amade ukuthi kubekhona ukuthuthuka kwebhizinisi kanti futhi umnyango uthanda ukusebenza ngokuhlangana. kuma sector amaningi. Abantu abasha bangakhipha laba abadala labo abangenzi kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenzeka kulabo abadala abangakwazanga ukuphumelela ngokwe transformation. Kwamanye ama sectors, labo abangenele bazoncipha ngokungabaniki amalungelo kulabo abathole amaphuzu amancan, ngokuthi ama sector amancane, izinombolo eziningi ukunikeza amalungelo. abafaka izicelo komele bakhombise ukuthi bakhokhe izimali ngokufanele ezinhlanzini ezibanjiwe (ngakho kumele balethe lokho abakubambile uma benze kangcono) ngesikhathi se medium term. Lapho izimali bezingakhokhwa isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinsuku eziwu 60,ofake isicelo uyopanishwa. Uma ngabe ungatholi ukunikezwa kwamalungelo, umnyango ngeke unikeze amalungelo aphelele kuze kukhokhwe izimali lezo. Umnyango unama rekhodi ezinto eziphula umthetho we MLRA uzonikezwa ukuthi ubhekwe ngaphambi kokunikeza amalungelo. Labo abasha nalaba abasekhona bayacelwa ukuthi bazazise ngendlela umnyango oqaphela ngakho, ukuphatha, kanye nokufaka izipopolo nangendlela amabhizinisi amele ahambe ngayo.. Lawo amalungu angavuni izinhlanzi ngesikhathi saso noma engatholanga imvume kusosonke isikhathi baziovele bakhishwe. Ukubamba ngaphansi kungasetshenziswa ngendlela embi. Umnyango uzokhipha izinombolo zokuthi kubanjwe kangakanani kuzokhishwa ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwezimvume,. Umnyango uyokhipha futhi abantu abamile nje "ngaphambili" ukuze bazuze ngezinye izinto. Ukuba phambili kwenziwa uma ngabe umceli I transformation yenzeka kwezinye izindawo noma abantu abangu HDP.

Kwakuhle kakhulu ngalesi siqembu sokuthi bobabili abazali nabafundisi babo baye basishiya ngenxa yokubandakanyeka kwabo ebubini nasezinye izenzo zokuphazamisa. Ingabe lokho kwenza babheke ngakolunye uhlangothi? Izindawo zokufika kwezindiza ezivela kwamanye amazwe nendawo zabe sezihlanganiswe ngokuphelele e-OR Tambo airport ngaphambi kukaApril ngonyaka ozayo, lapho isikhungo esikhulu sokwakhiwa kwesikhumulo sezindiza sikhona. Ngicela zonke izikhungo zabazali eziphatha izikole zikusize ngokuba khona ezikoleni ngoLwesine. Umuntu onobubele kakhulu oneminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili ophila eflethi ngaphansi kwami njalo unginika izeluleko. Ukukhuthaza ukwabiwa kwempahla ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi nokwabiwa kwempahla ngezimali. Bonke amalungu bayabongwa ngokuba nesibindi nokuqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo. Ukungenelela kufaka phakathi ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo kwiMnotho Yesibili lapho iningi labantu bethu lithola khona izimpilo zabo. Noma yiliphi uphawu olusemthethweni kulolu hlelo luzobekwa esisekelweni esakhiwe ngabaqondisi bokwakha abaqinisekisiwe. Kuphela amaqembu ezepolitiki abhalisiwe azokwazi ukufaka amagama abaqokelwe ukhetho. Ngifuna ukubonga bonke abasebenzi bethu abasebenza kanzima ukwenza lokhu kube yimpumelelo, futhi ikakhulukazi uAnneowayeh ophatha ukuhlela konke lokhu. Uma unokwesekwa komqashi okuhlanganiswe nezikweletu, kuzodingeka ukuthi usekele imali ebhange elikwenze. Amaqembu ezepolitiki alishumi nane azobamba ukhetho lwezishayamthetho zezifunda kuphela kwenye noma ngaphezulu.

UMhlonishwa I-Meya KaMasipala wesiFunda uGu, uKhansela S.B. Kuyintokozo enkulu kithina ukuba sihlanganyele nomphakathi wakithi lapha eSimahla, kulengqophamlando yomcimbi wokwenza ngcono izimpilo zabantu bakithi ngokubakhela izindlu. IsiZulu sithi ayikho impunga yehlathi, lokhu kukubeka ngokusobala ubumqoka nokubaluleka kokuba umuntu abe nekhaya. Ungaya noma yikuphi kodwa ekugcineni kufanele ubuyele ekhaya. Ikhaya liyisisekelo sempilo yanoma yimuphi umuntu. Namuhla silapha ukuzokwenza umsebenzi obalulekile wokuhlinzeka umphakathi ngezindlu ezizoba yisisekelo samakhaya abantu bakithi lapha. Uma umuntu ehlezi ekhaya kufanele azizwe ephephile futhi ehlezi ngokukhululeka, hhayi ngokwesaba. Inkinga ekhona ezindaweni zabantu bakithi emakhaya yizakhiwo zezindlu umphakathi ohlala kuzo. Ngenxa yokushaywa indiva nguHulumeni wobandlululo abantu bakithi emakhaya bazama ngokwamandla abo bazakhela izindlu, iningi lazo okungezodaka. Inkinga ebhekene nemiphakathi yakithi emakhaya ngukuthi ngezikhathi zesimo sezulu esibi, izindlu ezikhona kuye kubenzima ukuba zibhekane nesimo sezulu esibi. Ngaleyondlela imiphakathi yakithi iye ihlalele ovalweni, inokwesabela izimpilo zayo. Ikhaya yikhaya ngokuba nendlu ephephile, asifuni ukuthi abantu bakithi bahlale njalo bebikelwa ngokungahle kwenzeke uma nje kuke kwashintsha umoya ngenxa yokuthi bahlala ezindlini ezingekho esimeni esifanelekile. Mphathi wohlelo, Umnyango wethu uphume umkhankaso wokubuyisa isithunzi sabantu bakithi ikakhulukazi labo abahlukunyezwa kakhulu wumbuso wobandlululo ngokubahlinzeka ngezindlu.

Wonke umuntu owephula isigatshana (1) noma (2) unecala. noma yimuphi umsebenzi odingeka kwiLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali ngalo Mthetho, ngaphandle kwanoma yimiphi imisebenzi ephathelene nokuqokwa, kanye nokunqanyulwa kokusebenza, kwamalungu eBhodi okuhlongozwe esigabeni 5(2) kanye no 10(2). IBhodi, ngesisombululo esikhethekile, lingadlulisela esiKhulwini esiPhezulu noma kwilungu labasebenzi besiKhungo, noma yimaphi amandla noma imisebenzi edingeka noma ephathelene neBhodi ngalo Mthetho. IsiKhulu esiPhezulu singadlulisela kunoma yiliphi ilungu labasebenzi besiKhungo noma yimaphi amandla noma umsebenzi odingeka noma ophathelene nesiKhulu esiPhezulu ngalo Mthetho, ngaphandle kwanoma yimuphi umsebenzi wesikhulu esinesibopho sokubika sesiKhungo. Noma yimaphi amandla noma umsebenzi odluliselwe ngokwesigatshana (1), (2) noma (3) kumele ukuba usetshenzwe noma wenziwe ngokweyame kuleyo migomo njengalokhu umuntu noma umgwamanda owenze ukudluliselwa ekubone kunesidingo. noma ngasiphi isikhathi kungahoxiswa noma kuchitshiyelwe ngokubhaliwe yilowo muntu noma umgwamanda. nanoma yikuphi ukuphathwa noma izindaba eziphathelene nenqubo edingekile ukuba iqalise kwizihlinzeko zalo Mthetho. 37. (1)(a) IsiKhungo sezoHwebo kanye nokuTshalwa kwezimali saKwaZulu-Natali esiqukethe iNombolo yokuBhaliswa kweziNkampani 98/11946/08, esungulwe ngokoMthetho weziNkampani, 1973 (uMthetho No. 61 ka 1973), singahlakazwa ngokuzikhethela futhi sibhaliswe kabusha.

Ohulumeni kumele baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zinokuvikeleka kanye nokunakekelwa ezikudingayo. Kodwa akusho ukuthi kufanele bangabanaki abazali kanye nabanye abantu ababhekele izingane. Ohulumeni kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi izindawo kanye nezinsiza abazinikezelayo ukuthi zibheke noma zivikele izingane ziphephile futhi zinempilo. Kufanele njalo baqinisekise ukuthi njalo kunabantu abaqeqeshwe kahle nabafanele ababheka izingane kanye nabantu abalungile abaphethe ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ayikho into engahamba kabi. Ohulumeni banomsebenzi wokuhlinzeka izingane ngosizo eziludingayo. Hlobo luni lwabantu okufanele baqashwe ukuze banikezele ngalolu sizo Uma kufanele izingane zihlale ezindaweni ezikude nasekhaya, kufanele zibe njani lezi zindawo Khumbula ukuthi lezi zingane kungenzeka zibe ngazodwa futhi zesabe. Kungenzeka futhi uma bethukuthele ngoba bazizwa belimele noma beshiywe bodwa? Bobabili ohulumeni, ompofu nocebile, kufanele benze konke okusemandleni ukuthi bathole izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuthi amalungelo akulesi Sivumelwano asebenza kuzo zonke izingane. Uma ngabe izwe lingenayo imali eyanele yokukhokhela zonke izinto ezidingwa yizingane zalo, nangale kwemizamo yalo yonke, kufanele licele amanye amazwe ukuthi alisize. Kubaluleke ngani ukuthi amazwe enze konke okusemandleni awo ukuthi abeke lokho okulungele izingane phambili? Ohulumeni kufanele bakuhloniphe ukuthi abazali kanye nabanye ababheka izingane babhekene nomsebenzi, ilungelo kanye nomsebenzi wokuhola izingane ekutheni kufanele ziwasebenzise kanjani amalungelo azo. Kwesinye isikhathi ukuhola kunikezwa umkhuba wasekhaya noma isiko. Uma ingane isikhulakhulile noma ithe ukuvuthwa ngokomqondo, kulapho izobandanyeka khona ezinqumeni zalolu hlobo. Cabanga ngalokhu.

Uma udaba lokwehlukaniwa kwempahla yabo bobabili, inkantolo kufanele ikhiphe isinqumo sokwehlukaniswa kwaleyo mpahla okufanele kube yileso esibona sinobuqiniso futhi sifanelekile uma kubhekwa zonke izinto. e Ukuba khona kwesivumelwano esirejistiwe sobuhlobo oburejistiwe nesiqukethe, uma sikhona; kanye f nanoma yiziphi ezinye izinto ezingafuna ukubhekwa. Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo esikhishiwe kwisigatshana 3 kufanele izanelise ngokuthi esinobuqiniso nesifanelekile ngenxa yokuthi uphathini orejistiwe nokhishelwa isinqumo esimvunayo ufakile ngqo nangenyezinye izindlela ukwakha umnotho wempahla yabo kumbe kwingxenye yempahhla kaphathini wobuhlobo oburejistiwe. Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo ngokubekiwe kwisigatshana 3 ingaluhlehlisa usuku lokugcinwa kwesinqumo senkantolo, okungahambisana nokukhokhwa kwenzalo, ukukhoka kancane kancane kanye nokuhanjiswa kumbe ukudluliswa kwempahla ethize, ngaleyo ndlela inkantolo eyibona inobuqiniso futhi ifanelekile, uma uphathini obhekene nesinqumo efake isicelo sokuhlehliselwa usuku lokuqala ukugcina isinqumo senkantolo. Ngaphandle uma kubekiwe kule sigaba, isicelo esifakiwe enkantolo sokuthi kukhishwe isinqumo ngaphansi kwesigaba 34 kufanele senziwe ingakapheli iminyaka emibili kusukela buqediwe ubuhlobo oburejistiwe.

Uma umkhumbi ungakhethwanga ngokwezimiso zamalungelo, umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele ifomu lokudlulisela umkhumbi kwenye indawo. Ukuze umkhumbi uthole amalungelo okudoba, umfaki-sicelo kumele aqedele ifomu elihlobene nomkhakha wezokudoba womkhumbi azodoba kuwo. Ekugcineni, uma umfaki-sicelo ekholelwa ukuthi lo mkhumbi uzodoba ezindaweni ezinamaza aphezulu olwandle, kumele aqedele ifomu lokudoba lezo zindawo. Isicelo sokusebenzisa umkhumbi wangaphandle singathatha izinsuku eziyi-14 uma wonke amadokhumenti ephelele.

Izinyathelo Zokuthunyelwa Kwama-Ambulensi: Ukuqinisekisa Impilo Yabantu Umphakathi uthole ulwazi olubalulekile mayelana nezinyathelo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi, ezisemqoka ekuphumeleleni kwezinsiza zezempilo. Ukuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi akugcini nje ngokukwaziwa kokuthola usizo lwezokwelapha, kodwa kudlala indima ebalulekile ekuvikeleni impilo yabantu. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinqubo ezihlukahlukene ezihilelekile ekuthunyelweni kwama-ambulensi, ukuze siqonde kahle imithetho nemigomo ehambisana nale nqubo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi kuqala ngokuqonda isimo esiphuthumayo. Uma umuntu ethola ukulimala noma ebhekene nesimo esiphuthumayo, usizo kufanele lufike ngokushesha. Lokhu kudinga ukusondela phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo, okubandakanya abezokwelapha, abezokuphepha, nezinsizakalo zama-ambulensi. Uma umuntu ebanga usizo, kufanele akhumbule ukuhlinzeka ngomyalezo onembile, okukhuluma ngesimo, indawo, nemininingwane yomuntu odinga usizo. Ngemva kokuthunyelwa komyalezo, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi ziqala ngokushesha. Ama-ambulensi anamalungelo nezinsiza ezithile ezifana nodokotela, abezokwelapha, kanye nemishini ethile. Njengoba ama-ambulensi esondela endaweni, abezokwelapha baphuthuma ukuze banakekele impilo yomuntu odinga usizo. Okwesibili, izinqubo zokuthunyelwa kwama-ambulensi zidinga ukuhamba kahle phakathi kwezinsizakalo ezahlukene. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza kufanele zihlanganyele ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo.

UMqulu wamaLungelo usebenza kuyo yonke imithetho futhi uphoqa isishayamthetho, isigungu sokuphatha sikahulumeni, abaphethe izinkantolo, nazozonke izingxenye zombuso. Isimiso kuMqulu wamaLungelo sibopha abantu bemvelo nalezozakhiwo ezithathwa ngumthetho njengabantu uma, futhi kungadluli ezingeni okungenzeke ngakho lokhu, uma kubhekwe uhlobo lwelungelo nanoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwa yilelo lungelo. Uma isebenzisa izimiso zoMqulu wamaLungelo kubantu bemvelo nakulezozakhiwo ezithathwa ngumthetho njengabantu, ngokubeka kwesigatshana (2), inkantolo-B. ingathuthukisa imitheshwana yomthetho ojwayelekile ukuze ikhawule ilungelo, kodwa lowo mkhawulo kufanele uhambisane nesigaba 36(1). Lezozakhiwo ezithathwa njengabantu ngumthetho zingabanamalungelo akuMqulu wamaLungelo kuphela ngendlela edingwa uhlobo lwelungelo kanye nolwaleso sakhiwo esithathwa njengomuntu ngumthetho. Wonke umuntu uyalingana phambi komthetho, futhi unelungelo elilinganayo lokuvikelwa ngumthetho nenzuzo yomthetho. Ukulingana kubandakanya ukuthokozela onke amalungelo nenkululeko ngokugcwele nangokulingana Ukuze kukhuthazwe impumelelo yelungelo lokulingana, kungathathwa izinyathelo zokushaya imithetho nezinye izinyathelo okuqondwe ngazo ukuthi kuvikelwe noma kuthuthukiswe abantu noma imikhakha yabantu abancishiselwe amathuba ngenxa yobandlululo olungafanele.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinsiza ezihlakaniphile zingashintsha impilo yabantu. USipho waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uma abantu benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi i-smart meter ayisiyona nje indlela yokulawula izindleko, kodwa iyithuluzi elihlanganisa abantu, elikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye, wathi: “Siyakwazi ukwenza umehluko, uma sithatha izinyathelo ezincane.” Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko ezincane zingaba nomthelela omkhulu, futhi umphakathi wakhe waba yindawo lapho abantu bejabulile, bephila kahle, futhi bephila ngokuhlanganyela. I-smart meter yaba yinsiza ebalulekile, futhi uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma sithatha izinyathelo ezihlakaniphile, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

B.1 Le Khodi iyengezo kuKhodi Yokuziphatha ebhekiswe esigabeni 2 seMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-2001, ehlanganisa bonke abasebenzi bakahulumeni. Kuhlanganiswa ukuthi ibhekisela ngqo ezidingweni zikaMnyango Wezokuthutha. Uma kukhona ukungqubuzana phakathi kweKhodi Yokuziphatha YamaHhovisi Kahulumeni, njengale etholakala kuMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-2001, neKhodi Yokuziphatha kaMnyango, le yokugcina izolandela. B.2 Kunomneed wokufundisa abasebenzi mayelana nezixhumanisi zabo nomthetho, kanye nabaphethe amandla ezepolitiki nabaphathiswa, abanye abasebenzi, kanye nomphakathi, futhi kufanele bafundiswe nomoya okumele abasebenzi basebenze ngawo, nokuthi yini okufanele bayenze ukuze bagweme ukungqubuzana nezithakazelo, nokuthi yini elindelekile kubo mayelana neziziphatha zomphakathi nasempilweni yabo yangasese nasekusebenzeni. B.3 Nakuba le Khodi Yokuziphatha ibhalwe ukuhlanganisa konke, ayiyona iqoqo eliphelele lemigomo elawula izinga lokuziphatha. Nokho, uMphathi-Jikelele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 7 (b) seMthetho WamaHhovisi Kahulumeni ka-1994, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle koMnyango kanye nokugcina umthetho, phakathi kwezinye izinto, unomthwalo wemfanelo wokwenza ukuthi ukuziphatha kwabasebenzi bakhe kuhambisane nokwethembeka nezimiso ezilawula amahhovisi kahulumeni kanye nemigomo efanele kanye nezinqubo njengoba kushiwo kulo Mthetho. B.4 Inhloso enkulu yale Khodi ukukhuthaza ukuziphatha okuhle.

Ikholera yisifo umuntu asithola ngokuphuza amanzi nokudla ukudla okunegciwane lekholera. Igciwane elibangela ikholera litholakala kwindle yabantu. Isabalala kanjani ikholera? Ungawusebenzisi umfula njengendlu yangasese, kodwa sebenzisa indlu yangasese. Geza izandla zakho emanzini abilayo noma elashiwe emva kokusebenzisa indlu yangasese nangaphambi kokuthinta ukudla. Ungamsiza kanjani umuntu ovele esenekholera? Mnikeze amanzi amaningi afakwe ushukela/nosawoti ukuthi awaphuze. Thatha ilitha eyodwa yamanzi abilisiwe, ufake amathespuni agcwele ngokungaqongile ayi-8 kashukela nohafu wethespuni likasawoti bese ugovuza. Nikeza ogulayo lenhlanganisela aphuze kancane kancane kaningi kangangoba kungenzeka. Khumbula, qhubeka nokumnikeza lenhlanganisela kashukela/usawoti umuntu onekholera. Mphuthumise ngokushesha emtholampilo noma kwindawo yokwelapha ngokushesha okukhulu lowo muntu. Uma ufuna eminye imininingwane, noma uma ucabanga ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi unekholera, vakashela umtholampilo, isibhedlela, udokotela noma umsebenzi wezempilo eduze nawe.

Isiphetho Uphuthu, obalulekile emiphakathini yethu, uhlanganisa imfihlo ekahle yokuphila kahle. Ngamafuphi, izinzuzo zawo zikhula phansi kwezinsiza ezahlukene. Ukuwa nogwadule lwezinkanyezi kuzoletha ukujabuliswa nokwenziwa kwezinto eziyinqaba. Ukuhlola izindlela zokwakha uhlanga lwephuthu, nokuqonda izinzuzo ezihambisana nalo, kubalulekile ukuze sibe nomphakathi ophilayo. Ngakho-ke, abavakashi kufanele baqonde indlela ezithinta ngayo izinqubo zempilo, ukuze uphuthu luthuthukise impilo ezinkulu. Ngale ndlela, uphuthu ulindeleke ukuba ube yisibonelo esihle sokuphila, ukubonisa emhlanganweni wezokudla, nesiko lakhe. Abantu bahlala bengahamba phambili, kwehlisa isithombe sokukhiqiza, ukuze uphuthu luthokozise kumphakathi.

Enye yezinto uhulumeni okufanele ayenze ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kweyi-15 azizilwi izimpi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akufanele ukuthi bavumele izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-15 ukuthi zijoyine umbutho wabo wezempi. Uma ubheka umabonakude uzobona amasotsha ayizingane kwezinye izingxenye zamazwe omhlaba. Lezi zingane sezilahlekelwe ubungane bazo. Azifundi. Azidlali. Zahlukaniswe nemindeni yazo. Imibutho yezempi ezifunile abasinakanga Isivumelwano kanye nemithetho yamazwe omhlaba. Uma kufunwa izingane eziphakathi kweminyaka eyishumi nanhkanu kanye neyishumi nesishiyagalombili, ohulumeni kufanele bazame ukufuna izingane ezindadlana (lezo ezicishe zibe neminyaka eyi-18) ngaphambi kokuba bafune ezincane (lezo ezicishe zibe neminyaka eyi-15). Ohulumeni kufanele benze konke abangakwenza ukuvikela nokunakekela izingane lapho okunezimpi khona nalapho kuliwa khona ngezikhali. Ungakwazi ukucabanga uhlala endaweni okuliwa kuyo Kungenzeka ukuthi abanye babazali benu bake bahlala kulezo zindawo esikhathini esedlule. Abanye benu bangakhumbula ngesikhathi besebancane kakhulu. Ake ubone ukuthi ungamthola yini umuntu ongakhumbula lesi simo eNingizimu Afrika ngezikhathi zeminyaka yo-1980 noma ekuqaleni kweminyaka yo-1990 bese uyabacela ukuthi bakutshele ukuthi kwakunjani. Lezi zinhlobo zezimo ziyethusa kakhulu ezinganeni ngoba azazi ukuthi kwenzekani? Ohulumeni kufanele benze konke okusemandleni ukusiza izingane ezihlushiwe ukuthi zilulame ekulinyazweni. Kwesinye isikhathi kuba imizimba yazo elinyaziwe kwesinye isikhathi kube imiqondo. Kufanele zisizwe futhi ukuthi zibuye zijoyine umphakathi. Ziningi izindlela izingane ezilinyazwa ngazo. Kwesinye isikhathi azinakwa noma zixhashazwe noma zihlukunyezwe.

Ukusetshenziswa kwe-smart meter kwa-Eskom Ngolunye usuku, uSipho, ohlala eGauteng, wathola incwadi ethunyelwe kwa-Eskom. Le ncwadi yayikhuluma ngokuqhamuka kwezinsiza ezintsha ezibizwa ngokuthi "smart meters." USipho waba nolaka, ngoba wayesevele eqaphela ukuthi izindleko zikagesi zikhuphuka njalo, futhi wayengazi ukuthi lezi zinsiza zizomnika usizo yini. Ngemuva kokufunda incwadi, uSipho wanquma ukuya ehhovisi le-Eskom eliseduzane ukuze abuze kabanzi. Lapho efika, wathola uNandi, umphathi wezokuxhumana. UNandi wamamukela ngenjabulo, wathi: “Sawubona, Sipho! Ngiyajabula ukukwazi. Ngabe ufuna ukwazi kabanzi nge-smart meter?” USipho wavuma, wathi: “Ngiyabonga, Nandi. Ngicela ungichazele ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kanjani.” UNandi waqala: “I-smart meter iyithuluzi elihlakaniphile elikuvumela ukuthi ubone kahle ukuthi ugesi wakho usebenza kanjani. Ibonisa ukuthi ungakanani ugesi osebenzisa, futhi ikwazisa uma izindleko zikhuphuka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukukhokha izikweletu zakho.” USipho wathokoza, kodwa wabuza: “Kodwa, kuzodingeka ngikhiphe imali eningi ukuze ngifake le meter?” UNandi wamchazela: “Cha, Sipho. Ukuze ufake i-smart meter, kuzodingeka ukuthi ube ne-application, kodwa akudingeki ukuthi ukhokhe imali eningi. Futhi, uma usuyifakile, uzothola izinzuzo eziningi.” Ngemuva kokukhuluma noNandi, uSipho wanquma ukuthi kufanele azame le smart meter. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, umakhelwane wakhe, uThandi, wamsiza ukuthi afake i-smart meter.

e nezimo, inqubo yesivivinyo nemikhuba yaselabholethi okummele ilandelwe ekuthatheni ingxenyana eyisibonelo seqoqo lento, ukuhlaziya, uhlola, ukalwa noma ukulandelela ingxube yezici zomkhiqizo. Ngegama lelunga elimmele izindaba zangaphandle, uNgqongqoshe angeluleka uhulumeni welinye izwe elithintekayo noma elihlomulayo ngalokho okuqaguliwe, ngesaziso noma ngomgomo ngaphambi kokuba ushicilelwe. e ephambana noma ehluleka ukuhambisana nesimo anikwe ngaso igunya lokushwelezelwa ekuhambisaneni nombandela othile walo Mthetho, ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 51. Umuntu osebenza ngesikhiqizi-sisi esilawulwayo uyoba necala lokwephula umthetho uma abakhiqizi-sisi abachaziwe beqe izinga elithile elimisiwe lengxube yaleyo mikhiqizo yesisi evela esikhungweni sabo esilawulwayo. Umuntu osebenza ngesenzo esisohlwini uyoba necala lokwephula umthetho uma abakhiqizi-sisi abachaziwe beqe izinga elithile elimiswe kwimvume yokukhiqiza isisi nokuwumkhiqizo odalwa yisenzo esibhalisiwe. Umuntu otholwe enecala lokwephula umthetho ophawulwe ngaphansi kwesigaba -44 engahlawuliswa noma abhadle ejele isikhathi esingevile eminyakeni eyishumi noma athole isijeziso sakho kokubili. ubukhulu begalelo ekunukubezeni jikelele ngaphansi kwezimo ezijwayelekile okwenziwe yilowo otholwe enecala. k nokugwema noma nokunciphisa imithelela eyingozi eqophelweni lomoya ezenzweni ezingalawulwa ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho; noma l olunye udaba olubalulekile ukuqhuba lo Mthetho.

Amalungu eViolent Crime and Terrorism aqhubeka nokuhamba lapho umsolwa ehlala khona. Noma yisiphi isicelo sokubuyisela umhlaba ngeke siphumelele ngenxa kokuba khona kwalesi simo esiqhubekayo. Umkhankaso wokubamba abasolwa abahamba-hamba uholelwa nguMphakathi wePhoyisa we-Ikageng, uNsumpa J C Scholtz. Imikhankaso yokubhalisela abavolontiya izovulwa ngokusemthethweni kuzo zonke lezi zinkalo ezihlukahlukene ezihlosiwe. Ukudoba izinkanyezi kudlwengulwa kakhulu ngabadobi abawudoba ngenjabulo nalabo abathengisa ngakho. Umnyango uthe ukuthola imidlalo ebukwayo kakhulu emhlabeni kufanele kudlalwe ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu engikukhuluma ukuthi uhlu olukhuluma ngendawo esivele yadlalwa, awukhulumi ngalolu xhumano. Izinhlelo zomhlangano ezikhulunywe ngaphambili azikakaphothulwa. I-Olympia Park Stadium eRustenburg. Kuzotshalwa izigidi ezinga-R25 ekuthuthukisweni kwamakilabhu kumakhodi onke ezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini empofu, ukuze kutholakale futhi kunakekelwe amathalente ethu ezemidlalo, futhi sense ngcono ukuncintasana kwethu kwezemidlalo. Izigidi ezungama-R212 zitshalwa esikoleni nakwezimidlalo emphakathini kuleso sikhathi ukufika ku-2010. Uhlelo Lwezikole luzoletha isiko le-Ndebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA yokudlala kahle, izindlela zokuphila ezinempilo kanye namasiko amaningi ezinganeni zesikole ngokusebenzisa ezemidlalo, ubuciko namasiko. Amabhiliyoni ayi-R11.7 atshalwe ohlelweni lwengqalasizinda yezokuthutha ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba kahle kwabalandeli, amathimba kanye nabezindaba. Amaphrojekthi ezokuthutha e-Ndebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA ayingxenye ehlanganisiwe jikelele ekutshalweni kwezimali zikahulumeni kwezokuthutha okwenza izinguquko ohlelweni lwethu lwezokuthutha ukuze kusizakale abahamba ngezithuthi kanye nezomnotho isikhathi eside. Imigwaqo yethu, imizila yezitimela kanye neyamabhasi izohlinzeka ngohlelo lwezokuthutha oluhlangene. Lokhu kubandakanya izinguquko ezifana ne-Rapid Rail ne-Bus Rapid Transit Systems, ezihlinzeka ngemizila yezithuthi zomphakathi eziyisipesheli kanye nezindawo zokushintsha kubagibeli abashintsha kwesinye isithuthi baye kwesinye. INdebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA yowezi-2010 izohola ukusetshenziswa kwamathikithi e-elekthronokhi okuhlanganisiwe okuzokwenza ukuthi abagibeli basebenzise ithikithi elilodwa ukufinyelela emabhasini, emabhasini, ezitimeleni nasematekisini.

Ohulumeni kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi ukutholwa kwezingane ngokusemthethweni kwenzeka ngendlela ebhekela ingane. Kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi abantu ababhekana nalo msebenzi ngabantu abaphethe. Kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi kukhethwa abantu abalungile ukuthi bamukele izingane ukuthi bazikhulise. Kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi umzali noma abazali abanikela ngengane ukuthi ikhuliswe ngabanye abantu bayathanda ukukwenza lokho. Ohulumeni kufanele nabo bakuqonde lokhu ukuthi, uma ingane ingeke ikhuliswe abanye abantu noma ifunelwe elinye ikhaya ezweni layo, ingane ingathathwa ikhuliswe abanye abantu kwelinye izwe. Ohulumeni kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi abantu abatholi imali ngokuthathwa kwezingane zikhuliswe ngomunye umuntu. Ukuqeda lokhu ohulumeni kufanele benze isivumelwano nabanye ohulumeni ukuthi ukuthathwa kwabantwana bakhuliswe kwenziwa ngokuqaphela okukhulu. Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi izingane ziya emizini enothando nenakekelwe kahle. Abantu abaningi bayavuma ukuthi izingane akufanele zithengwe noma zithengiswe. Zingabantu, hhayi amabhayisikili nonodoli. Kuyenzeka kodwa ukuthi abantu bakhokhele izingane imali. Ucabanga ukuthi kufanele kwenziweni ngalokhu? Ohulumeni kumele baqinisekise ukuthi izingane ezicashile ezivela kwamanye amazwe zivikelekile futhi ziyasizwa. Lokhu kusebenza ezinganeni ezicashile ezihamba zodwa kanye nalezo ezinabazali bazo noma abantu abazinakekelayo. Isifiki esicashile umuntu oshiye izwe lakhe kaningi ngoba ephoqekile ukuthi ashiye ngenxa yempi, futhi uzama ukuthola imvume yokuhlala kwelinye izwe. Abantu abacashe kwelinye izwe kaningi basuke belahlekelwe yiyo yonke into yabo futhi behlukaniswe namanye amalungu emindeni yabo. Abaningi babo izingane. Inhlangano Yezizwe inohlelo olusebenza nezifiki emhlabeni jikelele.

Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zisebenze ngokubambisana nezimboni zendawo ukuze ziqinise ukufinyelela kwezempilo. Lokhu kungenza kube nokuthula emiphakathini nasezindaweni ezithintekayo ngezindawo ezingama-72. Ngaphandle kokuthi izikhungo zezempilo zisetshenziswe kanjani, abasebenzi bezempilo nabo banendima ephawulekayo. Abasebenzi bahlala bephakeme, behola inqubomgomo yokwelapha nokuqeqesha umphakathi. Lo msebenzi ungabhekwa njengomsebenzi onzima, kodwa uma abasebenzi beba nekhono lokukhuluma kahle, lokhu kungenza kube lula ukuthola ukuxhaswa yilabo abakwaziyo. Ukuze lezi zikhungo zisebenze kahle, kubalulekile ukuqonda imiphakathi ezungezile. Ndawonye, sizokwazi ukuzama ukwakha izixazululo ezenzakalelayo ezisemqoka, futhi siphendule izidingo ezihlukahlukene zempilo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukumemezela izinsizakalo zezempilo ezihloniphekile, njengoba lokhu kuzoholela ekuthandeni nasekuphathweni okuhle. Ngokukhalipha, imithombo yokuxhumana ibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwezikhungo ezingama-72, sikhuluma ngebhizinisi lokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele, olukhuthaza abantu ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ezindabeni ezithinta impilo. Lapho abantu benolwazi, bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, futhi basebenzisa izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo ukuze baqinisekise impilo yabo. Esikhathini esizayo, kubalulekile ukugcina imisebenzi yethu ibambisene. Izikhungo zezempilo zingaba yizikhangiso ezinkulu zokuhlanganisa imiphakathi, futhi zinhle kakhulu uma zigijima ngokubambisana. Ukusebenza ngasikhathi sinye kuyaqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziswa futhi ubalulekile, okuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Ngendlela, izindawo zezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zithinta impilo yethu, ngempela.

Le ncwadi Yesekelwe olwazini olunikezwe yizikhungo ezifanele, ngokuqondene ngqo noma ngokusebenzisa amawebhusayidi abo. Abacwaningi bazicabangele ukuthi lonke ulwazi lunikezwe ngenkolelo enhle nokuthi lulungile. Asikwazi ukuba nesibopho ngokulunga kanye nangokuphelela kolwazi olunikezwe kithi. Uma ufisa ukuthi inhlangano yakho ifakwe ekubuyekezweni kwesikhathini esizayo kwale ncwadi, uyacelwa ukuba uthumele I-emeyili ku: kmosweu@deat.gov. Imisebenzi yohwebo emincane, ephakathi nendawo kanye nemikhulu ama-SMME ayizinjini zokuthuthuka. Ifakela okuthile ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi kanye nomnotho. Ngaloko kusemqoka kakhulu ukuthi ama-SMME ezokuvakasha asekwe ukuze akwazi ukuzimela aphinde ande. Ukusiza kuloku, Umnyango Wezemvelo Nezokuvakasha ngokusebenzisa Igatsha lawo Lezokuvakasha, uthuthukise iqoqa lezisetshenziswa ezihlose ukusiza abahwebi bezokuvakasha ukuthuthukisa ukuthuthukisa amabhizinisi aqinile nenza inzuzo. Le ncwadi isemqoka kakhulu uma kubhekwa ukuthi inikeza indawo eyodwa efanele yokufinyelela ulwazi ikakhulukazi kubahwebi bezokuvakasha, ngosizo lwebhizinisi olukhona kubo. Uma kuqaliswa, le ncwadi izawutholakala nangezinye izilimi ezisemthethweni, okuyisiZulu, isiTswana kanye nesiBhunu. Sizoqhubeka nokuyibuyekeza le ncwadi njalo ngonyaka, bese siyihumushela kwezinye izilimi eziningi. Anginako ukungabaza ukuthi uzoyithola le ncwadi iyisikhalo esisizayo emizamweni yakho yezebhizinisi, futhi ngikufisela ngokwempela impumelelo ekumiseni ibhizinisi lezokuvakasha elandayo nelinenzuzo. Uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza kwathiwa "Iyasebenza" lenza izinyathelo eziyinqaba. Lokhu kwavumela abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene ukuba basize ekuhleleni imigomo namagugu ezobulungiswa kumthetho. Empeleni, umphakathi waba ngumsebenzi ongokwayo, umbono ophakeme wokukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkanyezi zawo kokwazisa lokuthuthukiswa. Umkhosi, ogcwele imihlangano, wasungulwa ukuze kuhambisane nezinsuku ezisemqoka zenqubo yokuchibiyela komthetho. Ngaphezu kwakho konke, ukuxhumana ngokukhululekile phakathi kwabantu bomphakathi neziphathimandla kwakhuthaza inhlonipho nemigomo emisha. Abaningi babebonisa ukuvuma izinqumo ezicomekayo, beqhakambisa izifiso zabo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni izinyathelo ezithile zivyathwa yizinto ezinkulu ezazisicking phakade ekwakheni imithetho yezokuphatha engaba yokuhlaleka. Uma edlula eminyakeni, abaqhamukeli abahamba phambili baveza ubuhlakani obumangalisayo ukuze babonge izimvo ezivela komphakathi, behlukana nokubukeka kwezimvo ezinhle ezihambisana nezindikimba ezahala. Lokhu kuhlangana kwavula indlela yokuhlola imithetho, ovame ukuba nempumelelo emithonjeni ebonwa komphakathi, uhambisana nezidingo zempilo ezibalulekile. Kanye nokubambisana okulindelekayo, ukuhlobana komphakathi nezinhlelo ezibucayi zaphinde zavuma izigaba ezihlukahlukene. Abesifazane, izinsizwa, ubuhlakani bezifunda, nezindlalifa zaba phakathi kwezingxenye eziyinhloko zendaba ebalulekile yezehlakalo. Lezi, zaqhubeka zikhula zodwa, zibhalela izimvo ngezindaba ezahlukahlukene ezibandakanya ubumqoka bezombusazwe, izinsiza, nezinsiza.

Isinyathelo 3: Ukuvota Uma usuku lokhetho lufika, abavoti kufanele bazi kahle indawo yokuvota. Lokhu kungatholakala kwi-akhawunti yomvoti noma ngezinsiza ezikhona emakhaya. Ngaphambi kokuhamba, kubalulekile ukuthi abavoti baphathe izinsuku ezifanele zokuphuma, balungise iziqu zabo zokuvota, futhi baqinisekise ukuthi banezinto ezidingekayo, njenge-ID yomvoti. Endaweni yokuvota, abavoti bazodingeka baphendule kumabhalane ukuze baqinisekiswe ukuthi baphuma kokuqala, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukhetho luhamba kahle. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuhlola Imiphumela Ngemva kokuvota, kuqala inqubo yokuhlonza imiphumela. Lokhu kwenziwa ngababheki bokhetho, abaqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela ibhalwe phansi kahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi lezi zinsuku zibalulekile, ukuze kukhuthazwe umoya wokubambisana. Isinyathelo 5: Ukwamukela Imiphumela Lapho imiphumela isitholakele, kubalulekile ukuba ibikwe ukuze abantu bazi ukuthi ubani ophumelele. Lokhu kukhuthaza umphakathi ukuba bahloniphe izinqumo ezenziwe, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu baphatha kahle imiphumela, beqonda ukuthi ukhetho lungukukhetha kwabantu. Lokhu kubambisana phakathi kwabantu kungakhuthaza ukuthula emiphakathini. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubambisana Ngezinye Izinsuku Ngemva kokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale bexhunywe ukuze baphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imihlangano yokuxoxisana, lapho abantu bangabakhona khona ukuze bacele imiphumela, futhi bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni ezizayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi kuzokwakha umoya wokuhlanganyela, okuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu.

Ngomhla ka-15 kuNcwaba 2023, eMnyangweni Wezokuphathwa Kwezimali, kwaba nomcimbi obalulekile wokuhlolwa kwamabhuku komasipala. Umcimbi wawuhloselwe ukuhlola ukusebenza kwezimali kumasipala, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Ukuhlolwa kwamabhuku kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithetho nezinhlinzeko zokuphatha izimali ziyalandelwa, futhi kuhloswe ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwemali. U-Nkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, uMenenja wezeMali, uvule umcimbi ngekhulumo echaza izinjongo zokuhlolwa, wathi: “Sihlose ukwakha ukwethembeka nokuphumelela ekuphathweni kwezimali zomphakathi. Ukuhlola amabhuku kumasipala akusizi kuphela ekuthuthukiseni izinqubomgomo, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni ukwethembana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni.” Ngemva kwalokho, kwaba nezigaba zokuhlola, lapho abahloli benza iziphakamiso ezithile. Ukuhlolwa kuhilela ukubuyekezwa kwamarekhodi, izincwadi zezimali, nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Abahloli bahlola izindleko, izinzuzo, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakala kumasipala, ukuze baqonde kahle indlela izinsiza ezisetshenziswa ngayo. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa ibonise ukuthi, nakuba kunezinkinga ezithile ekuphathweni kwemali, kumasipala amaningi kube nezinqumo ezinhle ezithathwe. Kukhona amaphuzu abahloli abawafakazile, njengokungabi khona kokubhaliswa kwezimali ezithile, okukhombisa izinkinga ekuphathweni kwemali, okudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandela kwemithetho. Ubulungiswa bokuphathwa kwemali bukhombisa ukuthi kumasipala amakhulu, ukuphathwa kwezimali kusebenza kahle, kodwa kunezikhala ezidinga ukunakwa.

Amakhansela kufanele abe ngamakhanda enqubo ye-IDP. I-IDP ayisiso nje kuphela isikhali sokuthatha izinqumo kodwa iqukethe izidingo zemiphakathi ewavotele nezifiso zayo. Amakhansela kumele abambe iqhaza ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izindaba ezithinta imiphakathi ayimele ziyacutshungulwa futhi zibhekelwe. Amathimba kamasipala abambe iqhaza i-IDP isebenza ngokunquma izidingo zamathimba abambe iqhaza nomphakathi nokuklelisa izidingo-nqangi ukuze kuthuthuke izimpilo zabantu emphakathini. Iqhaza lomphakathi nabanye abanesandla ekunqumeni izidingo yinto ewukhiye kwinqubo ye-IDP. Umthethosisekelo noMthetho weziNhlelo zikaMasipala zikubeka ngokucacile ukuthi umasipala kufanele ukhuthaze ukusebenzisana phakathi kwamathimba aneqhaza ngokusungula inqubo yokubambisana. Umasipala kumele aqiniseke ukuthi labobantu ababecindezelwe esikhathini esiphambili babamdibi munye nohlelo, isibonelo, abesifazane, abakhubazekile njalonjalo ukuze izwi labo lizwakale. Ngokuziqhelanisa nokubamba iqhaza, abantu banika abanye amandla okubathathela izinqumo nokungenzeka zibe nomthelela ongahambisani nabo. Iminyango yezimboni zikahulumeni eziFundazweni nakuZwelonke i-IDP kumele ihlahle indlela lapho iminyango ifaka khona izinsiza zayo ezingeni lohulumeni bendawo. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, umasipala kumele acabangele inqubomgomo nezinhlelo zeminyango lapho esungula imigomo namaqhinga. Kuyithuba leminyango yezimboni ukubamba iqhaza enqubeni yohlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezisungulwayo nombono kamasipala kuyahambisana.

UBongi uthatha yonke imali anayo ukuze athenge utshwala kanti umndeni wakhe uyalila ngoba le mali kufanele ibe isetshenziselwa ukudla, izingubo, nokukhokhela izifundo zezingane. Uyazi sengilahlekelwe ukuhlonipha yena. Pic. Kungenzeka ukuthi udinga usizo kunokugxekwa. Pic. Inkinga yokuphuza ngokweqile iyinkinga evamile eNingizimu Afrika. Kumele sifunde futhi sifundise izingane zethu ukuthi utshwala luphazamisa kanjani imizimba yethu nemiqondo yethu. Kumele sikwazi ukujwayela ukuphuza kwethu futhi sifunde ukuphuzisa ngendlela efanele. Pic. Empeleni, uBongi ubukeka njengomuntu ogulayo futhi uvame ukubonakala ejabule. Uyazi abantu benza iphutha lokucabanga ukuthi utshwala lwenza umuntu ajabule, kodwa empeleni, lwenza ube nokukhathazeka kakhulu ngemuva kwesikhathi futhi kungaholela ekukhathazekeni okweqile emqondweni wakho. (Pic. 5). Abantu abanjengoBongi banenkinga yokuphuza ngokweqile, inkinga abangayilawuli futhi badinga ukufuna usizo ngokushesha, ngaphandle kwalokho utshwala luzobabulala. (Pic. 6). Ngiyabonga, kunezinhlangano ezisizile abantu abaningi abanezinselelo zokuphuza utshwala, zibasiza baphinde baphile impilo ejwayelekile. (Pic. 7). Ngakho umndeni nozakwethu kaBongi kumele bazame ukufuna usizo olufanayo ukuze basindise impilo yakhe futhi baphinde baphile njengobaba onesibopho. (Pic. 7). UBongi, woza, masikuthathe uye ekhaya. (Pic. 8). INingizimu Afrika kumele ibhekane ngokuphuthumayo nalesi simo sokuphuza utshwala, mhlawumbe ulwazi lokuphuza kufanele lungene ezikoleni nakho. (Pic. 8). Igama lami nguDudu. Sizokhuluma ngokuphuza utshwala.

Uma kucatshangwa ngemboni, umphumela kungaba wuhlu olude lwezinto kunokugxila kakhulu ezintweni eziphuthumayo nezithinta abantu. Kudingekile ukuhlaziya isimo somnotho nenhlalo, ikakhulu isimo sobuphofu, ukwehlukana ngobulili, izinto eziphathelene nesandulela-ngculazi/ingculazi njengeqhinga lentuthuko elididiyele nelihambisana nemihlahlandlela yenqubomgomo kazwelonke ekulweni nobuphofu kanye nokulingana ngobulili (Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /6). Abanye omasipala (ikakhulu beSigaba A noC) banganquma ukulandela uhlelo lokuhlaziya okuhlelekile nokugamanxayo embonini kanjalo okubandakanya izinguquko zomnotho, inhlalonhle nemvelo (Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /4a -c). Ngesizathu sokuthi omasipala abancane bangaklinyeka noma behluleka ukulandela lenqubo efana neyabakhulu, asiyincomi lenqubo okwamanje. Okungenani singancoma ukuba kulandelwe inqubo yokugxila odabeni noma ezinkingeni zangaphakathi kuMasipala nezivela ohlaziyweni. (1 /4) nokuyindlela esebenzisa kahle ulwazi olukhona nengasebenzisa ukuqagela okwenziwa ngolwazi lochwepheshe kunohlaziyo olungaphazami. Ulwazi olunesiqiniseko nezibalo ngohlelo lwenhlangano, isimo somnotho nezinto zemvelo kumele zibe yingxenye yolwazi oselukhona. (1 /1). Inselelo enkulu eSigabeni sokuHlaziya wukuthatha isinyathelo esithathelwe ezicucwini zokuhlaziya okwenziwe emazingeni nasezindaweni ezehlukene nezenziwe ngamaqhinga anhlobonhlobo nokuholela ohlwini olubumbene lwezidingo-nqangi lapho wonke umuntu obambe iqhaza ebona ubulungiswa.

Izibalo zakamuva zabantu zikhombisa ukuthi ubunjiniyela bezakhiwo buyisigaba esinabakhi abaningi, kanti ukwakhiwa kwezindlu kunabantu abambalwa. Ngokwezinsiza ezitholakele, umufi wahlasela umfowabo omncane. Izinga lokungcoliswa "liphansi" futhi lingaphansi kwenani le-CMA. Konke kukhombisa ukuthi ngelinye ilanga uJay Pather uzofinyelela iphupho lakhe. Sashaya kuphela labo bantu abaphosa amatshe. Ingabe kungaba umphakathi ophansi noma umphakathi ophakeme? Uma uzokhuluma ngesi-Afrikaans, kufanele sinikeze labo bantu abangakhulumi isi-Afrikaans ithuba lokufaka ama-earphones ukuze bamukele lokho okukhuluma. Uhlelo oluhle nolwakhiwe lokuhlela ukusatshalaliswa komhlaba luzolungisa amaphutha abekade enzeka mayelana nokuba nomhlaba. UMnu. Pat Curran, uMholi Wesifunda weMnyango Wezimoto, uzosebenza ngezimo zokuphepha nezokuphatha umthetho. Ukuhlolwa kwecala lokuhlela kuzobuyekezwa phakathi kwenyanga njengoba isimo sishintsha futhi njengoba kuvela ukuhlola okusha okubonakala kungenzeka. Lokhu kudale isidingo sokuphrinta amakhasi amavoti angaphezu kwezinkulungwane ezimbili. Izinsiza zezindaba zembula ukuthi kukhona izinxushunxushu e-Athene ngenxa yabakhaliphile. Siyanxusa abaphreporti bezindaba zomsakazo uKhwezi, uBraveman Mhlaba, noMabutho Ngcobo abawina imiklomelo emkhakheni wezindaba zomsakazo nasemkhakheni wokubika izindaba ezikhanga nezithembekile ngokulandelana. Ukuvalelwa nokubonakala kwecala likaKock kwafihlwa ezimweni aziphumelele kuzo lapho akhalaza khona ngabo abathi uzobakha izikhwama. UMnu.

Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kohlelo lwe- LED kuhambisana nazo zozimabili izinhlelo zokwenza umsebenzi zesikhathi esifushane neziqhubekayo ukuze kunikezwe uMasipala amandla okuhlela nokuqalisa umsebenzi ngokusebenzisa ulwazi lwawo. iNEMA ivumela uhulumeni ukwedlulisa ingxabano ethize isiwe kubaxazululi, kubagqugquzeli bokusombulula izinkinga, kubehluleli kuthi kwezinye izikhathi kuqokwe abaphenyi abayisipesheli abangathola imininingwane egcwele ngodaba. Inhloso yokukhuthaza lezingxoxo wukuzama ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni lapho zombili izinhlangothi zizwana ngokuya kumxazululi. Isibonelo: Uhulumeni usenqume ukwakha ichweba elikhulu ngokugubha isizalo somfula. Lesisenzo sinomthelela omkhulu kubantu abehlukene ngezindlela eziningi, isibonelo; amabhishi, izindawo eziyizimfuma, ukufa kwezilimo nezilwane, ukungcola kwemvelo esemanzini okuholela ekuphazamisekeni kwendawo yokudweba, ukulahleka komhlaba ikakhulu owabalimi oyontanta amanzi. Okunye futhi ngamafemu ayokaniswa kulendawo nayoholela ekunukubezekeni komoya nomthelela omubi ezitshalweni zabalimi bendawo. Baningi abantu asebezwakalise ukukhathazeka ngalesi sinqumo sokuqhubeka nechweba ngemuva komphumela wokuhlaziya umthelela wesakhiwo. Laba bantu sebecela uhulumeni ukuqoka umxazululi ozosombulula lengxabano. Sekubizwa lowo ozokhuthaza izingxoxo asize izinhlangothi zombili ngodaba okufanele lwedluliselwe kubaxazululi.

Izimoto ezingaziwa ezihamba emgwaqweni wezolimo kwesinye isikhathi zihlala endaweni. Qaphela amawheels ongawazi. Izinguquko endleleni umqashi enza izinto. Ukuthenga noma ukusebenzisa kakhulu ukudla ngasohlangothini lwabasebenzi. Izinguquko ekuziphatheni kwabasebenzi abadala ngemva kokuba beqashwe emsebenzini omusha. Ukufa kwekhaya lezinja ngendlela engacacile. Hlala uqaphele izimpawu zabantu abangaziwa abafika endaweni, njengezimbiza noma izinkomishi ezingenalutho, amaqanda, izicubu zephepha, izingubo ezikhaliphile, izinyathelo noma izicathulo, indawo esanda kuphazamiseka, izikhwama zokudla, nezinye izinto ezisemqoka. Ukuhlukumeza kokudla, uphethiloli, izinkomo, nezilwane. Abantu abangaziwa befika endaweni yakho bephakamisa izizathu ezivumayo kodwa kungenzeka babephakathi. Sebenzisa amalungelo akho njengomnikazi wepulazi. Abantu abangaziwa abafika epulazini noma bevakashela abasebenzi kufanele bathole imvume yakho kuqala. Xhumana nezomthetho zendawo ukuze uthole ukuthi yini ongenza ngayo ngokomthetho nokuthi ungakwenza kanjani lokho epulazini lakho. Yakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi bakho. Gcina amakhophi wezikhwama zabasebenzi bonke. Khuthaza bonke abasebenzi ukuba bahlale beqaphele ngokuphepha futhi babike noma iyiphi imisebenzi ephawulekayo. Khokha abasebenzi bakho ngazo zonke izinzuzo zabo futhi ubagcine bekwazisa. Ungavumeli muntu ukuba angene endaweni yakho noma epulazini ngaphandle kokubona kahle ukuthi bangobani, ikakhulukazi ebusuku. Zonke amathuluzi angasetshenziswa njengezikhali kufanele zihlale zivalwe lapho engasetshenziswa. Uma uhambe endlini, yenza kube isiko ukusazisa umndeni wakho ukuthi uhamba kuphi, indlela ozoyithatha, nokuthi uzobuyela nini.

Iqhinga elibhekele ikusasa alipheleli esiGabeni sokuHlela kodwa lenqubo yokuhlela ichaza ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezentulekayo ngokucabangela izimo nemihlahlandlela yenqubomgomo. Ezimpilweni zangasese, wonke umuntu wejwayele ukuklelisa izinto ezihamba phambili, ukubheka imbangela yezinkinga, ukucabangela izinsiza ezikhona (okwentulekayo) ngokucophelela nokufuna indlela efanele yokuzixazulula. Kuvamile nokho ukuba lapho kuxazululwa izinkinga esimweni senhlangano sisebenzise budlabha izinsiza noma kusetshenziswe indlela ethathelayo nebiza kakhulu. Inselelo yamalungiselelo ohlelo lweQhinga elibheke phambili akusilo nje iqhinga kuphela kodwa ngelenhlangano kanti ngesinye isikhathi lilawulwa ngezombusazwe. Ukubeka phambili, ukuqonda okufunwayo nokuzikhethela kudinga inkulumo-mpikiswano ngokusabalalisa nokwaba izinsiza eziyingcosana phakathi kweminyango, amathimba abantu uma ekhona. Uma ubugebengu benzeka, ababulali bleave imikhondo endaweni ngokungena noma ukuphuma ngendlela ethile. Ukuhlola ubugebengu kuhilela ukuqoqa ubufakazi bokwazi kanye nezimpawu ezibonakalayo. Ubufakazi obubonakalayo bungaba impahla noma izinto ezithile ezingasetshenziswa ngamaphoyisa ukuze axazulule icala. Amaphoyisa asebenzisa isibonelo sokuthi uma izinto ezimbili zihlangana, kukhona imiphumela engajwayelekile efana nezinwele, ushokoledi, ukuhamba komlomo, uthuli, nezimpawu zokuthinta. Lezi yizinto ezidinga ukuhlolwa ngamaphoyisa. Ubufakazi bungaba obubonakalayo, njengephuzu lesikhwama, noma bungabonakala kahle ngaphansi kwemicroscope, njengezintambo noma imikhondo yegazi. Ubuchwepheshe besimanje buwenza kube lula kumaphoyisa ukuhlanganisa abantu nendawo kanye nezinto. Ukuze kusebenze ubuchwepheshe, izindawo zokwenziwa kobugebengu kumele zigcinwe futhi zivikelwe ekungeneleleni okungadingekile okungaphazamisa ubufakazi. Ngokugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, amaphoyisa azokwazi ukuqoqa ubufakazi obuqondile.

Utshwala lungaphazamisa impilo yakho kakhulu. Ukuphuza ngokweqile isikhathi eside kungalimaza umzimba wakho futhi ungase ungabuyeli esimweni sokuqala. Ukudla okungaphansi: Kukhona okuncane okukhona kutshwala. Ngakho-ke, ukuphuza utshwala kakhulu kungakwenza ungakudli. Lokhu kudala ukuthi ugule futhi uzizwe ungenamandla. Ukuphazamiseka kwengqondo: Utshwala lwenza ubuchopho buphazamiseke. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside, utshwala lungaphazamisa ukusebenza kwengqondo yakho. Isifo senhliziyo: Ukuphuza kungase kwenze inhliziyo yakho isebenze kanzima futhi ungase ube nesifo senhliziyo. Umhlola: Utshwala lungadala umhlola womlomo. Ukulimala kwesibindi: Uma uphuza njalo, kungadala ukulimala kwesibindi. Utshwala lungalimaza ne-pancreas futhi uma unegciwane. Ukungasebenzi kahle kokuphuma: I-organ yesilisa ayisebenzi kahle futhi ubhekana nezinkinga zokufinyelela ekuphuzweni. Izenzakalo eziningi zokudlame nokuhlukumeza zenzeka ngoba abantu baphuza ngokweqile. Abantu abakwazi ukuzilawula uma bephuza. Ezinhlungwini eziningi zomgwaqo eziholela ekufeni, kuvame ukutholakala ukuthi abashayeli abaningi baphuze ngaphezu komkhawulo ofanele. Iningi labagibeli abafa ezinhlelweni baphuze. Ukufa nezifo ezidalwe utshwala kubiza uhulumeni imali eningi unyaka nonyaka. Le mali ingasetshenziswa kangcono emfundweni, empilweni, nasemakhaya. Khumbula ukuthi iziphuzo ezahlukene zineziphuzo ezihlukene. Ungakhetha ukuthi iyiphi ofuna ukuyiphuza phakathi kwalezi ziphuzo.

Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuthi bafake lezi zinsiza, wathi: “Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezincane, sizokwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zethu.” Ngemuva kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng waqala ukwamukela i-smart meter. Abantu baqala ukujabulisa izindleko zabo, futhi kwavela umoya omusha wokubambisana. U-Eskom naye wathola ukuthi izindleko zawo zinciphile, njengoba abantu beqala ukukhokha izikweletu zabo ngesikhathi. USipho, owakha umphakathi wakhe, waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinguquko ezincane zingaba nomthelela omkhulu. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphela izindleko zabo, futhi wathola ukuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi be-Eskom bukhula. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waba nesithakazelo esikhulu emisebenzini ye-Eskom. Waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo yebhizinisi, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsiza ezihlakaniphile zingasiza ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Waqhubeka nokuxhumana noNandi, futhi baqala ukuhlela imihlangano yokwazisa umphakathi ngalezi zinsiza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng waba yisibonelo sokuthi izinsiza ezihlakaniphile zingashintsha impilo yabantu. USipho waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi uma abantu benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho wathola ukuthi i-smart meter ayisiyona nje indlela yokulawula izindleko, kodwa iyithuluzi elihlanganisa abantu, elikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu nabaphathi.

Uma kunempendulo ebhaliwe engaphezu kweyodwa esicelweni, umfaki-sicelo ofuna ulwazi mayelana nesinqumo ngenye indlela, isibonelo; ngocingo, kufanele achaze lesi sigaba -182e. Amaphoyisa - Umsebenzi Wabo Nendlela Abaphila Ngayo Amaphoyisa, njengezikhungo ezisemthethweni zokugcina ukuphepha emphakathini, adlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Umsebenzi wabo awugcini nje ekutheni bavikele abantu, kodwa futhi babhekelele ukugcina umthetho, ukuvikela impilo, nokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukuze siqonde kangcono umsebenzi wabo, kubalulekile ukubheka izici ezihlukahlukene ezihlanganisa izinsuku zabo, izinselelo abahlangabezana nazo, kanye nomthelela abawenza empilweni yomphakathi. Ekuqaleni, amaphoyisa ahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, njengezokuphepha, ezokuhlola, nezokuphatha. Umsebenzi wabo uvame ukuqala ekuseni, lapho behamba ezitaladini, bezama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi uphephile. Kubalulekile ukuthi bahlale bebonisa ubuhlakani, futhi bakhombise ukuzimisela emsebenzini wabo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuhamba ngezinyawo, ukuxhumana nabantu, nokuzama ukuqonda izinkinga ezikhona emphakathini. Amaphoyisa avame ukuxhumana nabantu ukuze baqonde izinkinga ezibhekene nabo, futhi lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaphoyisa abhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Izimo ezinzima, njengez crime, zidinga ukuthi amaphoyisa abe nesibindi, futhi kube nezinqumo ezisheshayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba babe nekhono lokuxazulula izinkinga, futhi bazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani abantu abahlangabezana nezinkinga ezinzima. Ngokwesibonelo, uma kwenzeka icala lokweba, amaphoyisa kufanele abheke izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ahlole ubufakazi, futhi axhumane nabantu abahlobene. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umsebenzi wabo awupheli nje ekutheni bavikele abantu, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukuxazulula izinkinga ezinzima. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwamaphoyisa nomphakathi busemqoka.

Esikwenza namuhla lapha eNdaka kuwungenelela ngqo ekuqedeni wonke amathoyilethe asebenzisa amabhakede ngokusebenzisa amathuba adalwa ngohlelo lokuzibambele. La mathuba afaka phakathi ukuhlinzekelwa kwengqalasizinda eyengeziwe komasipala esikhathini esifushane. Loluhlelo lulethe ukusebenzisana okuqinile phakathi kukamasipala wendawo, umasipala wesifunda kanye nohulumeni wesifundazwe nokwenze ukuba uxhasomali lukwazi ukukhishwa esikhathini esifushane. Konke lokhu kungamasu amasha okumele siwalandele futhi siwafunde sibuye siqinisekise ukuthi ayalandelwa ekulethweni kwezidingo. Esikufundile ngalolu hlelo lwaseNdaka kusinikeze isu lokusheshisa ukubhekana nokulethwa kwezidingo emiphakathini yethu. Ngamanye amagama, ngilindele ukubona zonke izindlu zangasese zamabhaked ziphuma emphakathini kulandela esikufunde lapha eNdaka. Esikwenzile kulula kabi. Okokuqala nje, senze kwaba khona ukuxoxisana phakathi komasipala bezindawo kanye nabezifunda. ibheke uhlelo lokulethwa kwamathoyilethe asebenzisa amanzi kumphakathi walapha. Sonke siyazi ukuthi uhlelo lwamathoyilethe asebenzisa amabhakede aluhambisani nenhlanzeko yezempilo kanye nokuphepha kwabantu bakithi. Ayikho incazelo ezwakalayo enganikezwa lo mphakathi ngokuthi kungani ungawatholi amanzi kanye namathoyilethe asebenzisa amanzi esimanjemanje. Lo mphakathi uyazi kunomakhelwane abaqhelelene abalapha eduzane nje ngamamitha angama-200 abakwaziyo ukuthola amanzi nezinsiza zokuthutha indle.

Umculo: Izindlela Zokuwuqonda Nokuwudlala Umculo ungumthombo obalulekile wokwazisa, ukujabulela, kanye nokuxhumana. Ukuze umqondo wakho umculo ube sobala, kubalulekile ukuhlola izizinda zawo, izindlela zokuwudlala, nezimpande zawo. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka izinyathelo ezahlukene zokufunda, ukuwudlala, nokuwuqonda ngempela. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Uhlanga Lomculo Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umculo unohlanga olunhlobonhlobo. Uhlanga lomculo lungahlukaniswa ngezindlela eziningi, njengegitar, ibhendi, noma emkhakheni wombhoshongo wezokuziqhenya. Qonda ukuthi ubani umculi, yiziphi izinsimbi ezisetshenzisiwe, kanye nesiko elihambisana nomculo. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde kahle umculo. Isinyathelo 2: Thola Izinsimbi Nezindlela Zokudlala Izinsimbi zomculo zihluke kakhulu. Zifaka phakathi izinsimbi ezinjengepiyano, igitar, nezinsimbi zomoya ezifana nama-trumpets nama-flutes. Qala ngezinsimbi ezilula ukufunda, njengegitar. Thola izincwadi zokufunda noma sebenzisa izifundo ze-inthanethi ezikufundisa izisekelo zokudlala. Uma usulungele, phambili ufunde ukudlala izigqi ezinzima. Isinyathelo 3: Ukucula Noma Ukuqamba Umdlalo Uma ungumculi, ungakhetha ukuhamba phambili ngokucula. Ukucula kudinga umoya, uthando, kanye nezindlela zokucacisa imicabango yakho. Bheka isigaba sokuqala sikanombolo 1 wesahluko. Khuluma kafushane ngesikhwama sikazwelonke sokuthuthukisa amakhono NSDF khomba kunombolo 5 nokuthi singanikeza umphakathi amathuba emfundo yabadala. Khomba iqembu esijobelelweni 23 futhi, bese ubatshengisa imininingwane yokuxhumana yoMnyango wezeMisebenzi ongabanika ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Phetha uqeqesho ngendlela obona ifanele naleyo ozizwa ukhululekile ngayo. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amalungu eqembu ahamba enokuzethemba ukuthi angawusebenzisa umqulu wokuqeqesha ngokungabasiza. Khumbuza iqembu ukuthi bangeke bafundiswa konke ngomsebenzi wamakomidi ezigceme ngezinsuku zokuqeqesha ezintathu, nokuthi lokhu abakunikiwe kuyingubo yolwazi oluqoqiwe abaludingayo ukuze basebenze kahle. Umqulu wokuqeqesha uphawula izindima nezibopho zamakomidi ezigceme, kanye nezinhlobo zemibuzo okumele bayibuze ukuze basebenze kahle. Khumbuza iqembu ukuthi umqulu wokuqeqesha uyithuluzi abangabuyela kulo, kanti kumele bangalikhohlwa uma sebehamba oqeqeshweni. Kumele babuyele kulona balisebenzise ngezikhathi zonke uma kunokwenzeka. Batshele futhi ukuthi kungaba isu elihle ukwabelana ngolwazi abalutholile namanye amalungu amakomidi ezigceme angaphumelelanga ukubakhona oqeqeshweni.

Emhlabeni Wokumbiwa Phansi, endaweni eshaya khona izinkanyezi, kwakukhona umuzi omncane owawubizwa ngokuthi uMahlabathini. Lo muzi wawaziwa kakhulu ngempahla eyahlukene eyatholakala phansi, ikakhulukazi igolide, insimbi, kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile. Abantu bakwaMahlabathini babejwayele ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze baphile impilo engcono, kodwa bazi kahle ukuthi lokhu kudinga umsebenzi onzima. Ngaphambi kokuba kube nezinkampani ezinkulu zokumbiwa phansi, abahlali baseMahlabathini babephila ngokuthengisa imikhiqizo yemfuyo, izitshalo, nezinsiza ezitholakala emhlabeni. Kodwa njengoba izinsiza ziqhubeka zincipha, kwavela umcabango wokuthi umhlaba ungangena kalula kuwo ukuze uthole izinto ezinkulu. Abantwana babejabulisa ngendaba yokuthi emhlabeni kunamathafa okukhona izimanga. Nokho, uMnumzane Mthethwa, umholi wendawo, waphakamisa, “Asizame ukujula, sithole lokho okukhona phansi. Kungase kube nento emangalisayo, mhlawumbe igolide elincane elizothuthukisa impilo yethu.” Ngakho, kwaba nesimemezelo sokuthi bonke abakhokheli baphume bajule emhlabeni. UThandiwe, intombazane encane enezifiso ezinkulu, wayebona izinsiza ezinjengokhuni nezinsimbi. Wayethemba ukuthi uma umhlaba uthola igolide, kuzothuthukisa umuzi wabo. UThandiwe wakhuluma noSipho, umngani wakhe, “Ngabe uyavuma? Uma sithola igolide, sizokwazi ukusiza abazali bethu!” USipho waphendula, “Yebo, uThandiwe! Lokhu kuzoba yithuba elihle! Kodwa kufanele siqaphele ukuthi umhlaba ungasinika noma ungasidela.” Kwathi ngosuku olukhulu, bonke abathanda ukuthola izinsiza bahlangana edwaleni elikhulu. Umoya opholile wawukhona, futhi abantu babejabulile.

Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni i-GEMS ibheke izindlela zokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zayo, ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola izimpendulo ezinhle ezivela kubasebenzisi bayo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi ibhizinisi layo likhule, futhi kwavula amathuba okuthi izinsizakalo zayo zibe ngcono. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqala ukubona izinzuzo ezinkulu zokuba ne-GEMS, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa ngale mfundiso.
