Le nhlangano izinikele ekugcineni nasekulungiseni amazinga okwazi ukwenza ngemfanelo kanye nobungcweti ezimbonini zamakhonferensi zase-Afrika eseNingizimu. Sinikeza ulwazi kubafundi, othisha, izitshudeni, izikhugo zemfundo kanye nezimboni. Ezokuvakasha ZaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAT) yinhlangano esemthethweni yokumaketha yanmazwe ngamazwe njengendawo yokugcina Yeboihambi. Ezokuvakasha ZaseNingizimu Afrika zibamba iqhaza kumibukiso yokuvakasha, zethula izifundo ezifundisayo kumalungu omsebenzi wokuhamba, zikhiqiza okokwenza kokuqhubekisa okuningi ziqalisa ziphinde ziqondise imibono yokumaketha ukwakha isimo sokumaketha esiphosithivi sokumaketha ngempumelelo imikhiqizo eminingi yezokuvakasha yaseNingizimu Afrika. Inhlangano Yezinsizakalo Zokuvakasha Zase-Afrika ese-Ningizimu (i-SATSA) iyinhlangano eyilunga elingenzi nzuzo, elimele abadlali abasemqoka kanye nezimiso ezifaka ezomoya, abasebenzisi bamakhoshi, abahloli bezokuhamba, izindlu zemisebenzi yokuhlala, izinkamapni zokuqasha izimoto, abakudonsayo, abahleli bamakhonferensi kanye nezinhlangano ezimaketha okuhlobene naloku. I-SATSA izimisele ukubeka amazinga embonini yezokuvakasha ukuze labo abangamalunga e-SATSA babonise ukuthembeka, ukungaguquki kanye nobuqotho kanye nokunikeza ukuphumula komqondo kulabo abafuna ukwenza ibhizinisi nezinkampani ezivunyiwe njengamalunga azothwala uphawu (i-logo) ye-SATSA. Ibandla Lokuhlela laseNingizimu Afrika lamiswa nguNgqongqoshe Wezemvelokanye Nezokuvakasha ngo-Septemba ka-2000 ehlanganyele namalungu ezimboni zezokuvakasha.

Ngakho-ke kusemqoka ukuthi uthole ukuqonda okucacile kokuthi ngubani ozosebenzisa imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zakho ekugcineni, odinga ukubhekana naye endleleni yakho yokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi lakho. Sifake ngezansi umdwebo wokuthi le ndlela ingasebenza kanjani kumnikezeli wezokuhlala, nokuthi ngubani otholani kule nqubo. Uzobona ukuthi abaphakathi bonke bathola izinzuzo eveka kubanikezeli bezokuhlala - ngokwempela, bangabanikezeli bezinsizakalo zokumaketha kumnikazi wendawo yokuhlala. Khuluma Nenhlangano Yezokuvakasha Yeboifunda sakini ukuze welulekwe ukuthi ungaliqhubekisa kanjani ibhizinisi lakho. Ulwazi olwengeziwe lufakiwe esigabeni Sokumakethe Esahlukweni sesi-4. Lizokumiswa kanjani isu nokuthi umsebenzisi uzoyithenga kanjani iholide. Kuye kwabakhona ukwaziswa okuningi esikhathini samanje ngokuphathelene nemboni yezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika futhi siyaziqhenya kakhulu ngokwanda kwamanani ezihambi ezivakashela izwe lethu elihle. Izehlakalo ezisemqoka Njengendebe Yomhlaba Yebhola likanobhutshuzwayo ka-2010 nayo ezokuba nomthelela omkhulu embonini yethu, futhi kumele kube namathuba womthengisi okwazi ukuveza imithombo. Esikhathini esiningi uzokuzwa umuntu othile esho okuthile okugqamisa umbono ekhanda lakho. Kungenzeka uziqhenye ngalo mbono, kodwa into esemqoka ukuthola umuzwa wokuthi lo mbono uzosebenza yini empilweni yangempela, futhi izowuba nomphumela oyibhizinisi elenza inzuzo. Lesi isigaba lapho isifundo esisheshayo sokungenzeka okumele sikusize ukuba uthathe izinqumo sokuthi uqhubekise lo mqondo ngemininingwane eyengeziwe. "Ukungezeka" kusho nje ukufinyeleleka okungenzeka noma okungenziwa kalula.

Ukungena eNingizimu Afrika kuvunyelwe ngaphandle kwemvume noma ngokulandela izimo ezibekwe kwiphepha lokuvuma elinikezwe yena noma ngumuntu omnikezeleyo. Izicelo zamaphepha okuvuma ukuhambisa impahla, impahla engaphansi kokulawulwa kwezifiso kufanele zithunyelwe kufomu elibekiwe. Inhloso yalesi sevisi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impahla esebenzisiwe ethunyelwa ingaphazamisi imboni yeSouthern African Customs Union. Le nqubo iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona ukulawulwa kwezempilo kwemvelo kanye nezizathu zokuphepha, ukuphepha, nokuhambisana nezindinganiso, kanye nokuphathwa ngenhloso yokuhambisana nezizathu zemvelo. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela kuwebhusayithi: International Trade Administration Commission. Amafomu ezicelo kufanele agcwaliswe futhi athunyelwe. Amafomu kufanele athunyelwe kwi-Directorate of Import and Export Control, ITAC. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahhala.

Ngale ndlela, umphikisi uyavuma ukuba alawulwe yimithetho yenkantolo. Isigaba 28(f) soMthetho WamaKhosi Wendawo No. 32 ka-1944, njengoba kuguqulwe. Nokho, uma umphikisi engenalo ummeli, igunya eliphethe linomsebenzi wokubuza ngakho (mero mutu) mayelana namandla okukhuluma udaba kulenkantolo. Ngakho-ke, uma kukhona ummeli womphikisi, igunya eliphethe lenkantolo ngeke libuze ngakho ngempela mayelana namandla enkantolo okukhuluma icala. Uma kwenzeka kudaleke udaba lokuthi inkantolo ingenawo amandla okukhuluma icala, umuntu owafakile kufanele alethe ubufakazi bokuthi ngempela le nkantolo ifanele ukukhuluma icala. (Bheka, Malherbe v Britstown Municipality 1949 SA 281). Umbiko weKomidi Lomthetho ngamaKhosi Wendabuko, ekhasini 3. Indlela umphikisi azivikela ngayo ngokukhuluma ukuthi inkantolo ayinamalungelo okukhuluma icala ingamphoqelela ukuba alethe ubufakazi bokuthi kungani esho kanjalo. Umqondo wokuvinjelwa kwamandla uhambisana nokuhlelwa kwezinkantolo zethu eNingizimu Afrika ngokwazisa ngamandla nemithetho yenkantolo ethile. Ngokwezinga lamandla okulawula nokuvinjelwa, inkantolo yombuso ihlala njengenkantolo eyinhloko elalela udaba noma njengenk

Kulesi sifunda kukhona imifelandawonye emincane nemikhulu. Emazingeni aphansi, ukuthuthukiswa kwekhono lebhizinisi kanye nekhono lokuzidayisa nokwesekwa kuhlinzekwa kwimifelandawonye esezimbonini yeZolimo, yeZindwangu kanye neyezeMikhiqizo. Ukukhiqiza kuncane kakhulu endaweni kamasipala, futhi lokho okukhona kugxile kakhulu eVryheid. Ukukhiqiza okukhona yilokho okugxile kakhulu ekukhiqizweni kokudla kanye neziphuzo, izingubo kanye nezindwangu, imikhiqizo yesikhumba, iphepha kanye nemikhiqizo yephepha, ukuprinta nokushicilela, imikhiqizo imishini kanye nezimpahla zensimbi, Umahluko phakathi kwezimakethe zendawo ezisafufusa kanye nezikhondlakhondla zezimakethe zase- Richards Bay, eThekwini nase Goli, kanjalo nokwenyuka kwentengo yezokuthutha, yikho okufakela le mboni ingcindezi. Izimayini zamalahle ezisendaweni kamasipala waseBaqulusini zazingumgogodla womnotho wendawo kwaze kwaba uhhafu wesibili weminyaka yo-1990. Isizinda samalahle sasihlanganisa izimayini zamalahle ezingama-21 ezirejiste noMnyango Wezokumbiwa Namandla. Umnotho wendawo wathikamezeka kakhulu ngokuvalwa kwezimayini i-Coronation kanye neHlobane ngowe-1997 kanye nowe-1998 ngokulandelana. Okwahlonzwa njengembangela yalokhu kuvalwa kwalezi zimboni ngukwehla kwenzuzo kanye nokungalawuleki kwemvelo. Izimayini ezincane zamalahle alukhuni kuphela ezisaqhubeka nokusebenza njengamanje. Khona manjalo, uthando lwezimayini zamalahle seluvuselelekile ngenxa yabantu abasebenzisa amalahle, nezimayini eziningi zamalahle seziphinde zavulwa.

Ulimi lwabantu ngandlela-thile luyisiqinisekiso "sesibili," lumele okuthile okungokwemvelo kwabantu, lapho sikhuluma khona ngezithemba nezifiso, sibhala imicabango yethu nemigomo, sihlola ulwazi lwethu namasiko, futhi sakhe imiphakathi yethu nemithetho yokubusa. Ngolimi, singasebenza njengabantu emhlabeni ohlanganyela njalo. Ilungelo lokusebenzisa izilimi ezisemthethweni ozikhethayo liqinisekiswe yiBill of Rights kanye neSisekelo sethu, esiqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi zabantu bethu ziyinsiza okufanele zisetshenziswe. Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ukuthi, ngemuva kwenqubo yokubonisana eqotho, sikwazi ekugcineni ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo senqubomgomo yolimi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Lokhu kuwukuphetha komsebenzi oqale ngo-1995, lapho ngithumele khona iLanguage Planning Working Group (LANGTAG) ukuba inikeze izeluleko ngesakhiwo esihambisanayo senqubomgomo yolimi. Lesi sinyathelo sibalulekile ngokombono wokungabi khona kokuphikiswa ekuhlukahlukaneni kwezilimi kanye nemiphumela yokuthi "ukusebenza kwezilimi eziningi kuyindaba yokukhokha" njengoba kubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu, kanye nezikhalazo ezikhulayo ezivela kubanikazi bezilimi mayelana nokubusa kolimi olulodwa eNingizimu Afrika. I-National Language Policy Framework isekelwe emiphumeleni yokubambisana ngokubonisana, isebenzisa kokubili iLANGTAG nezinsiza zeMnyango ngokuhlanganyela neLanguage Policy Advisory Group. Lesi sikhungo senqubomgomo sibalulekile ekuphatheni izinsiza zethu ezihlukahlukene zolimi nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kukahulumeni ezinjongo zokukhuthaza ubud democracy, ubulungiswa, ukulingana, kanye nobunye bezwe.

Ukuncika kwemayini yamalahle, kanye nenani elincane lezimboni zomnotho ezisebenza kahle, kwachaza ukuthi ukuwa kwemboni yamalahle kwadala isikhala esikhulu kakhulu emnothweni wendawo. Isithombe esikhona njengamanje yileso sokuthi ezolimo nezohwebo yizona zimboni ezifaka isandla ku-GGP yesifunda, kanti nezokuvakasha nazo zinalo iqhaza elingatheni. Ezolimo zingqindwa, kolunye uhlangothi, yizinselelo zesimo sendawo kanye nenhlabathi, kanti ngakolunye uhlangothi, ngukwentuleka kokungenelela kwabazolekelela kwezolimo. Ingama-15.19% kuphela indawo evumela kahle ezolimo, nakuba kungumhlaba ongamakwata amathathu osetshenziselwa ukutshala kokuzodayiswa. Ukutshala kuchazwa ngokunamandla kakhulu kodwa akukhathalelwe. Mancane kakhulu amapulazi anamanzi, futhi izingqinamba eziphathelene namalungelo okukwazi ukusebenzisa amanzi kanye nemvume yezindlela zamanzi endaweni yikona okuphazamisa abalimi abasebancane. Izimo zemvula ena izikhawu nenhlabathi engavundile kungezinye izinqginamba zezolimo. Ukonakala kwenhlabathi kugqamile ezindaweni eziningi kuMasipala Wendawo yasebaQulusini. Nakuba kunjalo, iBlack Mfolozi Valley inendawo enhle yezolimo. Imikhiqizo yezolimo emikhulu etholakala kuMasipala Wendawo yasebaQulusini imbandakananya izingodo, amasimo okusanhlamvu (ummbila, amakinati, ubhontshisi, ujikanelanga, izithelo kanye namabele) kanye nemfuyo. Izingodo eziningi zihanjiswa ezindaweni ezingaphandle, futhi imbonyana yezingodo seyidlondlobele kakhulu kule minyaka emibalwa eyedlule. Amahlathi Ezingodo maningi kakhulu eNyakatho ye-Vryheid ne-Glukstad, kanye naseNingizimu yoKhambi.

Yini ukuhweba komphakathi? Le yindlela elula, lapho indawo eqashisayo ihlukaniswe yaba izingxenye ezincane ezilula ukuzilawula ezaziwa ngokuthi ukuhweba komphakathi. Umphakathi umphathi ubekwa ukuze abheke umphakathi othile futhi ungumuntu osebenzisana ngokubambisana nezakhamuzi kanye nazo zonke izithakazelo ekuvimbeleni ubugebengu obujwayelekile kulowo mphakathi. Bonke ababambiqhaza bangenela ekutholeni izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha ezithile zomphakathi wabo futhi bazame ukuthola umthombo wobugebengu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubugebengu buphathwa kahle kulowo mphakathi othile. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buphathwa kahle emphakathini wenu. Ukubamba kwenu kuzokhiqiza imiphumela, futhi ngeke nibe nesaba sobugebengu emphakathini wenu futhi nithole izixazululo kubugebengu obujikelezayo endaweni yenu uma ninenhlangano zomphakathi zokulwa nobugebengu, ninikeza amaphoyisa ulwazi ngemicimbi yobugovu eyenzeka emphakathini wenu ukuze basebenzise izindlela ezinhle nezisuselwa emphakathini ekutholeni izixazululo zobugebengu emphakathini wenu; futhi lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana phakathi kwenu nomphathi wenu wombuso wezepolitiki waseNingizimu Afrika. Nina bobabili ninomthwalo wemfanelo wokuhlonza izidingo zokuphepha nezokuphepha kanye nokubheka umthombo wobugebengu, ngaleyo ndlela nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ubugebengu buphathwa kahle emphakathini wenu.

- Ulwazi ngezindlela zokuphuma ezimeni ezinzima. Ukuxhumana nalezi zikhungo kungaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuphuma emathubeni. Isinyathelo 7: Ukukhuthaza Abanye Ngemuva kokuthola usizo, ungaba yisibonelo kwabanye. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukwabelana ngempilo yakho nabanye. - Ukukhuthaza abesifazane abanye ukuba baphume emathubeni. - Ukuxhasa imikhankaso yokulwa nodlame. Ukukhuthaza abanye kuzokwenza kube lula ukuba sibe nomphakathi ophilayo, ophilayo, futhi onobudlelwano. Isinyathelo 8: Ukuphila Impilo Engcono Ekugcineni, kubalulekile ukuphila impilo engcono. Lokhu kungabandakanya: - Ukuzivocavoca ukuze uthole amandla. - Ukudla kahle ukuze ugcine impilo. - Ukuthola isikhathi sokuphumula nokuzijabulisa. Impilo engcono izokwenza kube lula ukuphila ngaphandle kokwesaba udlame. Isiphetho Udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane luyinkinga enkulu, kodwa sinesibopho sokuzivikela nokuphuma emathubeni. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, singakwazi ukusiza abesifazane abahlukunyezwayo, sikhuthaze abanye, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophilayo. Khumbula, akuwona umthwalo wakho kuphela, kodwa umphakathi wonke unomsebenzi wokulwa nodlame. Sihlanganyele ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabesifazane, sikhulise umphakathi onobudlelwano, futhi sithuthukise ikusasa elingcono.

Izinkinga ezizobekwa phambili zikhuluma ngezinkinga abazikholelwayo, kanye nokuhlolwa okujwayelekile kokuqonda kwabo iNingizimu Afrika, edlule, manje, nekusasa. Kumele sithole indlela yokufinyelela nokuhlinzeka ngempahla yesifunda. Kumele sikwenze, ukuze singavumeli amanzi ukuthi athwale umoya wokuzithoba kwezinto esingakwazi ukuzifeza ezweni lethu, ikakhulukazi edolobheni lethu. Izikhungo zomthetho zikahulumeni, ezifana nezinkampani zezimayini, zizophulwa. Abasolwa banikeza amaphoyisa imali phansi kwemibono eqaphelekayo yekhamera bese bethunjwa ngokushaya ngaleso sikhathi. Ukuhlanzwa kwemfucumfucu uhlelo lapho izinto ezazizophuma ziqoqwa, ziqalwa kabusha, bese zisetshenziswa futhi. Ngakho, into kuphela esele ukuyenza kwakuwukuhamba phesheya kwezwe ukuze bagweme ukubulawa noma ukwenziwa kabi. Ukwakhiwa kwezinto ze-asphalt zokwakha imigwaqo nezinye izinjongo; zokuvikela umlilo nezithako zokucisha umlilo kanye nokuvikela umlilo okuvela kumalahle athengwe noma i-lignite. U-Mnu. Koboekae ugcizelele ukuthi kuzoba nemihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi ezobanjwa ngababonisi abaqeqeshiwe ukuze baqeqeshe labo abazohileleka ngaphambi kokuthi umkhosi omkhulu uqale. Imiphumela yalezi zinhlelo ibonisa ukuthi isisekelo sokubandakanya ababambiqhaza sikhulisiwe. Amalungu azokwazi ukuthi umhlangano wokulungiselela owenziwe ngabaPhathiswa obubanjwe eBali, e-Indonesia usanda kwenza intuthuko enkulu ekufinyeleleni isivumelwano sokuthi kwenzeke ini ukuze kuqhubeke ukuthuthukiswa okungapheli.

Izimpi Zomlando: Ukubuyekezwa Kwezigameko Eziyinhloko Izimpi zomlando zihlala zibalulekile ekwakheni umlando wezwe, zikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu ezithinta abantu, izizwe, nezindawo. Lezi zimpi zihlala zikhumbuleka ngenxa yokuthi zishintsha izimpilo zabantu, zidalela izwe izinselelo ezintsha, futhi zishintsha ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizwe. Kulokhu, sizobheka izimpi ezithile ezibalulekile, izizathu zazo, nemiphumela yazo emhlabeni. Impi Yezwe Yokuqala (1914-1918) Impi Yezwe Yokuqala, eyaziwa nangokuthi iGreat War, yenzeka phakathi konyaka ka-1914 no-1918. Le mpi yadalwa yizizathu eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukungaboni ngaso linye phakathi kwezizwe, izinkinga zezimali, kanye nezinkinga zempucuko. Izwe elikhulu elalibandakanyeka kule mpi kwakungamaNgisi, amaJalimane, amaFrentshi, kanye namaRashiya. Imiphumela yale mpi yahlasela kakhulu, yashiya izigidi zabantu zishonile, futhi yadalela izwe izinguquko ezinkulu kwezombusazwe, ikakhulukazi ukwakhiwa kwezimpi ezilandelayo. Impi Yezwe Yesibili (1939-1945) Impi Yezwe Yesibili, eyaziwa nangokuthi iWorld War II, yenzeka phakathi konyaka ka-1939 no-1945. Le mpi yaphinde yadalwa yizizathu eziningi, kodwa ikakhulukazi yaphakanyiswa yizinhlelo zika-Adolf Hitler eJalimane. Iziphumo zalesi simo zashintsha umhlaba, zashiya izigidi zabantu zishonile, futhi zashiya izwe nezifunda zikhubazekile. Le mpi yaphinde yakhulisa umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwezizwe, kwaholela ekwakhiweni kweZizwe Ezihlangene, okuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi izimpi zingaholela ezinhlelweni ezinkulu zokuthula.

Thola izimpendulo ezivela kubabukeli, bese usebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze uthuthukise okuqukethwe kwakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuheha abantu nokubavusa ukuba baphendule. Isinyathelo 3: Hlela Okuqukethwe Ngemuva kokuba usunokwazi ngalesi sihloko kanye nababukeli, hlela okuqukethwe kwakho. Lokhu kungafaka izigaba ezihlukene, izihloko ezincane, nezithombe ezizokwenza kube lula ukufunda. Hlela kahle izigaba zakho ukuze kube nokuhleleka, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umqondo wakho uhamba kahle. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubabukeli ukuba baqonde kahle lokho okukhuluma ngakho. Isinyathelo 4: Bhala Okuqukethwe Manje sekuvele isikhathi sokubhala. Qala ngokubhala isingeniso esikhangayo, esizokwenza abantu bafune ukufunda okwengeziwe. Bese uqhubeka nezihloko ezihlukene, uqinisekisa ukuthi ubhala ngendlela ecacile, enembile, futhi ethokozisayo. Sebenzisa izibonelo, izithombe, noma amavidiyo ukuze uthuthukise okuqukethwe kwakho. Qiniseka ukuthi ugcina umoya wokuxhumana, ukuze ababukeli bakwazi ukuzizwa behlanganyela. Isinyathelo 5: Hlela Futhi Uhlola Ngemuva kokubhala, kubalulekile ukuhlola nokuhlela okuqukethwe kwakho. Bheka amaphutha okubhala, iziphazamiso, noma izinkinga zokuhleleka. Ungasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zokuhlela, noma ucele omunye umuntu ukuba abuke umsebenzi wakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amaphutha ongawazi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi okuqukethwe kwakho kuhlelekile futhi kulungile. Isinyathelo 6: Yabelana Ngokuqukethwe Uma usuhlele futhi uhlolile okuqukethwe kwakho, sekuvele isikhathi sokwabelana. Sebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, amabhulogi, noma amawebhusayithi ukuze ufinyelele ababukeli abaningi.

Ngiyethemba ukuthi nizojabulela ukwengeza kwe-facets. Usizo lwe-AIDS (AfA) yinkampani ephatha ukuxhumana kwe-HIV/AIDS esebenza ne-GEMS ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oluyimfihlo oludingayo ngenkathi uphila ne-HIV. Bangakusiza futhi uma udinga olunye ulwazi ngalesi sifo. Ngokubheka kubo ukuze uthole usizo, uyazisiza ngokukhipha umthwalo we-virus ezikhumbeni zakho bese ubuyisela esandleni sakho. EUnice, uthisha, uthole ukuthi uphila ne-virus eminyakeni eyisikhombisa edlule ngesikhathi ethatha isinqumo sokuhlolwa ngemva kokushona komunye umndeni. "Kunzima kakhulu ukwazi ukuthi unale virus. Ukubhalisela uhlelo lokuphatha isifo se-HIV lwe-GEMS, oluphathwa yi-AfA, kusho ukuthi ngizoholwa futhi ngaziswa ngodokotela abaqeqeshiwe futhi ngizokwazi ukuthola ukuphumula." Naphezu kwemiphumela yesifo, kukhona indlela yokusiza. "Ngabe ngikhathazekile futhi ngikhathazekile ngengqondo ngenxa yesifo," kusho uEunice, "ngangingakwazi nokulala ebusuku ngenxa yokukhathazeka. Ngesikhathi ngibhalisela uhlelo lwe-AfA, babenobubele futhi baqonda isimo sami. Bangenza ngazi ukuthi ukuba ne-HIV nokungathathi imithi lapho kudingeka njengokushiya amasango neminyango yendlu yakho ivulekile wazi ukuthi abaphangi bayafika. Ngijabule ukwenza isinqumo sokuzibophezela, nakuba ngazi kahle ukuthi akuwona umphumela wami ukuba ne-HIV." Baphinde banginika ulwazi olubalulekile engingase ngingazi ngalesi sifo. USifiso, ilungu, uthole ukuthi i-AfA imsize ukubuyisela impilo yakhe esimweni esihle. "Bangifundisa 'Ukuphila Ngokuhle,' okungifundisa ukuthi ngiphile impilo yami entsha.

Umnyango KaHulumeni weNdawo eziFundazweni (DPLG) unikwe amandla asemthethweni okusiza omasipala bakwazi ukufeza izinhloso nezibophezelo zokulungisa ama-IDP. Iqhinga lokweseka iDPLG lakhiwe yizinsika ezine nezivele emdwebeni ongenhla. UMthetho weziNhlelo zoMasipala nohlaka lwenqubomgomo unika omasipala uhlaka lokubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zentuthuko edidiyele. Ukwenyusa amandla nomfutho kulabo abaneqhaza kuma-IDP, ikakhulu amakhansela nabasebenzi, iDPLG seyisungule uhlaka lukazwelonke lwezifundo zentuthuko oluqonde ukusiza ochwepheshe uma beqopha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ngama-IDP. Umnyango (DPLG) sewuqale uhlelo lokuqeqesha oluthathelwa ohlakeni lwemfundo. Lemizamo yenziwe ngokubambisana neNhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika yoHulumeni beNdawo (SALGA). Loluhlobo loqeqesho lusungulwe lwabhekiswa emaqenjini athile abantu. Uhlelo lwenziwe lwaqondana nezidingo kanye nemisebenzi eyenziwa yilamaqembu abantu kanye namakhono adingekile ukuze bafeze kahle imisebenzi yabo. Uma kufuneka ulwazi ngezinhlelo zoqeqesho, omasipala bangathintana neThimba lokuQhuba imisebenzi. Amalungiselelo ama-IDP wumbandela obekwe nguHulumeni weNdawo eNingizimu Afrika. Iningi lomasipala alinawo amandla enele okwenza ama-IDP ngokwawo. Ukweseka omasipala, iDPLG yaqalisa ngohlelo lwePIMSS. IPIMMS wuhlelo lukazwelonke lokwesekela ama-IDP nolusungulelwe ukusiza omasipala lapho benza amalungiselelo noma sebengamela ukusebenza kwama-IDP.

Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi awazwakali kuphela ezindaweni zokusebenza, kodwa ahambisana nomnotho jikelele. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa, bazokwenza ngokuzikhandla, okwandisa imiphumela emihle. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo zokuba nezinhlangano zabasebenzi. Lezi zinhlangano zenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa izwi labantu, ziqinisa amalungelo abo, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkampani zihlala ziqinisekisa izimo ezinhle zokusebenza. Ngokuhlanganyela, abasebenzi bangakwazi ukulwa nezimo ezingezinhle, futhi bahlanganyele emizamweni yokuthuthukisa izimo zabo. Nokho, kumele sikhumbule ukuthi akukhona konke okulungile. Kwezinye izimo, izinkampani zingase zibe nezinhloso ezithile zokuvikela izinzuzo zazo, zishaye indiva amalungelo abasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nesixazululo sokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, ukuze kube nesithunzi esihle sokusebenza. Abasebenzi kumele babe nezinqumo ezithile, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izimo zabo. Kubuye kube nesidingo sokucabangela izimo zomhlaba wonke. Njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, izimo zabasebenzi zihlala zishintsha. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi aqhubeke nokuvuselelwa, ukuze ahambisane nezidingo zamanje. Izinkampani kufanele ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala ziqonda izinguquko, futhi ziqhubele phambili ekuthuthukiseni izimo zokusebenza. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umnotho ozinzile, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Ngokuhlanganisa, amalungelo abasebenzi awasiyona into engathathwa kalula. Kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde ukuthi ahlanganisa izici eziningi ezithinta impilo yomuntu, umphakathi, kanye nomnotho.

Ukuze uxhumane nomphathi wesigaba wakho ukuze wenze indawo ophila kuyo iphephile. Abanikazi bamabhizinisi bendawo, amaqembu omphakathi, izinhlangano zabahlali, kanye nabaholi bomphakathi bencitshwa ukuba babambe iqhaza emizamweni yokubhekana nezinkinga eziholela ebubini esigabeni sakho. I-NAFVSA inengxenye yokweseka umphakathi, ehlinzeka zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi labo ababuya emiphakathini eyayithintekile ngodlame, ngemininingwane nezidingo. Ngokwakha ubudlelwano nezinye izikhungo ezikhiqiza amafilimu, le ndawo ihlose ukufinyelela kubantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. I-archive kazwelonke egcina amafilimu, ividiyo, nolwazi olurekhodiwe lwezwi ibamba iqhaza emikhankasweni ehlukene. Izikhungo zemfundo zimenyiwe ukuba zibuke amafilimu futhi zixoxe nganoma yimaphi amagatsha abona kufanele abhekwe. Lokhu kwenziwe ngokuxhumana nothisha nabafundisi. Inhloso enkulu yale ngxenye yokweseka umphakathi ukulethela "izindawo zokubuka amafilimu kubantu," okuzoletha inzuzo emiphakathini. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokubambisana nezinye izikhungo ezifana nezikole, imikhakha efanele, amaqembu omphakathi, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukufinyelela emiphakathini yasemakhaya engazi ukuthi le archive ingakwenza kanjani njengoba nayo inamalungelo okuthola ulwazi. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukusebenzisa Izikhungo Zobuciko Bomphakathi, ezisungulwe nguMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, ukuze ifinyelele le njongo. Izikhala zomphakathi, izikole, nezindawo zomphakathi nazo zizosebenza.

Umnyango wezokuxhumana uxhasa abanikazi bemvume iminyaka emine ngezinsiza zokukhuluma nokukhiqiza, kodwa kuphela uma behlonipha izidingo zomnyango. I-ICASA izokhipha isikhumbuzo sokufaka izicelo zezinsizakalo zokukhuluma komphakathi futhi ihlinzeke ngezinsiza ezikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene. Susa iqembu elisebenzayo elizophatha inqubo yokufaka izicelo futhi lisebenze njengomfaki-sicelo egameni lomphakathi. Qoqani izimpawu zomphakathi ukuze nibhale uhlelo lwebhizinisi lokuphromotha ukhetho lwamalungu eBhodi ngenqubo yokhetho olukhululekile ukuze kubhekwane nendawo yesiteshi sokukhuluma ezokwenziwa khona. Qedela ifomu lesicelo ngocingo, usebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinkulu. Thumela ifomu lesicelo sokuqala kanye nezincwadi eziyi-16 ezivunyiwe ku-ICASA kanye nemali yesicelo. Izicelo ezingaphelele zizobuyiselwa kumfaki-sicelo, futhi asizokwamukela noma yiziphi ukuphazamiseka okungase kwenzeke. Kungathatha ezinyangeni ezi-3 kuya kwezi-4. Kuzokwenziwa imali engu-R250 yokukhipha imvume ngemva kokuvunywa kwayo. Ifomu lesicelo lizoba yingxenye yesikhawu seGovt Gazette.

Ezokuvakasha: Ukwakha Uxhumano Phakathi Kwezingxenye Zethu Nezizwe ZakwaZulu Ezokuvakasha zidlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yomphakathi nasekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ubuchwepheshe bukhombisa indlela ezokuvakasha ezishintsha ngayo, njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka unomoya ophakeme. Akukhona nje ukuphuma siye ezindaweni ezinhle, kodwa futhi ukuzama ukuqonda izimpilo, amasiko, nemicabango yabanye. Lokhu kudinga umqondo ovulekile, umoya wokufunda, kanye nesifiso sokuxhumana. INingizimu Afrika inezindawo eziningi ezithakazelisayo ezokuvakasha. Kusukela enhlokodolobha, iPretoria, kuze kufike ezintabeni eziyinqaba zeDrakensberg, nezindawo ezihlekisayo eWestern Cape. IKwaZulu-Natal ikhangwa kakhulu ngemvelaphi yayo, ikhetha impilo yasemaphandleni neyesimanje, ibhizinisi, kanye nemfashini yezenhlalakahle. Ukwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwezingxenye zethu nezizwe kudinga izinhlelo ezithuthukisayo ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika. Lolu hlelo lokwakha uxhumano lukhombisa ubuciko, ikhono, nempumelelo yomdabu. Abantu abaningi bakha imibukiso, imicimbi, nabahambi bembula izimfihlo zamasiko amasha. Lokhu kudinga ukusizwa ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phezu kwezithiyo ezibhekene nomphakathi. Nokho, izithiyo zikhona. Ezokuvakasha zidinga ukufundwa kwezifundo ezichaza amabhuku akhombisa ubukhona base-Afrika ukuze sifunde amagugu okuvakasha. Kubahloli bezifundo, izazi zenza imfundo esemqoka, futhi lezi zifundo zingase zifake iminyango emisha ezindaweni ezithile eNingizimu Afrika. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ezokuvakasha ziqhubeka nokwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu.

Ngikhula imifino ukuze ngithole imali ngokushesha. Futhi, iqiniso lokuthi angigxile ngokuphelele kwezolimo, nginokunye umsebenzi ozinzile, kuyasiza. Uma ezolimo zingaba nezindleko ezinkulu, ngizoba umkhiqizi wesikhathi esigcwele. Yini obona njengengozi empumelelweni yakho? Ngikhathazekile ukuthi ukungabi nezinqubomgomo ezinzile, ukukopela, kanye nezindaba ezithokozisayo zingaphazamisa amathuba ami empumelelo. Ukuthola inzuzo kuyinto ebalulekile. Yiziphi izingxenye zokuhweba kwezolimo ofuna ukuzithuthukisa? Ngifuna ukuba nolwazi oluningi lwezobuchwepheshe mayelana nokuphathwa komhlaba, ukonga amanzi, nokunakekela izinkomo. Ngifuna futhi ukuthi abasebenzi bami bathole ukuqeqeshwa. Yisiphi isu ozophila ngaso kulo nyaka? Ngifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lwami lokwesekwa lukhona. I-Grain SA neqembu lami locwaningo kubalulekile ekunikezeni usizo. Ngifuna futhi ukwandisa ukulima izinkomo zami, okuyizinkomo zenyama. Uma ukukopela kungasuswa, ngifuna ukuqala ukuphisa izimvu.

Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius Ngonyaka ka-2014, umhlaba waphenduka waba nesithombe esibi kakhulu lapho umgibeli odumile, uOscar Pistorius, ethola isinqumo sokwahlulela ngemva kokubulala uReeva Steenkamp, intombi yakhe. Lesi senzo saphendula izinkulumo eziningi mayelana nezokuphepha, ubudlelwane, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho ezithinta abantu abadumile. Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kudinga ukuba sihlole izici eziningi, kuhlanganise nezimo zomthetho, izinkolelo zomphakathi, kanye nemiphumela yalesi senzo. UOscar Pistorius, owaziwa kakhulu njengomgibeli ophumelelayo, waba yisibonelo sokuphumelela emhlabeni wobunzima, njengoba enezinyawo eziphukile. Waba yisithonjana sokuzimisela, futhi wathola udumo emhlabeni jikelele. Nokho, impilo yakhe yaguquka ngokuphelele ngemuva kokubulala uReeva Steenkamp ngonyaka ka-2013. U-Pistorius wathi wacabanga ukuthi uReeva ungumthakathi, futhi waphosa isibhamu, okwaholela ekufeni kwakhe. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho. Isinqumo sikaPistorius sathathwa ngemuva kokuhlolwa kwecala, lapho abameli bakhe bezama ukufakazela ukuthi ubulale uReeva ngokungafanele, ngenxa yokucindezeleka okukhulu. U-Pistorius waphikisa ukuthi wayengazi ukuthi uReeva ubekhona endlini, futhi lokhu kwaba yisisekelo sokuvikela kwakhe. Nokho, umphakathi wawungavumi lezi zinsolo, futhi izinkulumo zaba ziningi. Abantu abaningi babebona lokhu njengokungafanele, futhi baphikisa ukuthi uPistorius wayenokwazi okukhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, uPistorius wathola isijeziso sokuvalelwa emzini, esikhundleni sokuba aboshwe.

Ukufuduka Kwezakhamuzi Zangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika Kwakukhanya ilanga elishisayo eGoli, lapho izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, zikhumbuza abantu ukuthi usuku luhamba. UThandi, intombazane encane enomoya opholile, wayehamba edolobheni, ebuka abantu abahlukene abahamba phambili. Leli dolobha lalihlukile, linabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomhlaba. UThandi wayehlala eThekwini, kodwa uGoli wawumhlaba omusha, owawumthokozisa. Wazithola esebhoda phakathi kwabantu abavela eZimbabwe, eMozambique, naseNigeria. Abanye babebonakala bejabulile, bejabulela ithuba lokwakha impilo entsha, kanti abanye babebonakala benokukhathazeka, bejolisa amehlo abo emigwaqweni, befuna ithuba lokuphila. Ngemva kwesikhathi, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, umfana ophuma eZimbabwe. U-Sipho wayenokukhanya emehlweni akhe, kodwa ubuhlungu bempilo yakhe babubhalwe ebusweni bakhe. Wakhuluma ngoMthetho, umphakathi wakhe owawunokuhlukumezeka, nokuthi uhambe eNingizimu Afrika efuna amathuba. "Ngifuna ukufunda, ngifuna umsebenzi," kusho uSipho, "ngifuna ukuphila impilo engcono." UThandi wathola ukuthi uSipho wayengumfana onamaphupho, kodwa ubunzima bokufuduka bukhona. Abantu abavela kwamanye amazwe babebhekana nezithiyo eziningi, ezinjengokungamukelwa, ukungabi namathuba, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlala. UThandi wacabanga ngalesi simo, wathi, "Kungani abantu bengenakuthola ithuba lokuphila kahle? Kungani kufanele bahlupheke?" Njengoba uThandi eqhubeka noSipho, waqala ukufunda kabanzi ngempilo yabafuduki.

Ubumfihlo Nokuvikelwa Kolwazi lwe-GEMS Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi sekuba yizinto ezibalulekile kakhulu. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS, okuyinsiza yokunakekela impilo ehloswe ngokuqinile ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu. Kodwa-ke, uma sikhuluma ngempilo, sikhuluma ngemininingwane ethinta abantu, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuvikelwa okukhulu. Ubumfihlo bukhona ezindabeni eziningi, kodwa uma sikhuluma nge-GEMS, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi le nsiza ibhekene nemininingwane eyimfihlo kakhulu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa imininingwane yokwelashwa, izimo zezempilo, kanye nemininingwane yomuntu siqu. Ngakho-ke, ukuvikela le mininingwane akusikho kuphela isibopho, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu abathola izinsiza zayo. Ngokubheka izinqubomgomo ze-GEMS, kubonakala ukuthi le nsiza ibeka phambili ukuvikelwa kolwazi. Izinyathelo ezithathwayo zifaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili bokuvikela imininingwane, kanye nezinhlelo eziqinile zokuphatha ulwazi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane yomuntu ayitholakali kalula, futhi ivikelwe ezinsongweni eziningi ezikhona emhlabeni wanamuhla. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ubuchwepheshe obubalulekile; abantu abaphatha le mininingwane badinga ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwayo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ku-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze baqonde ukuthi imininingwane yomuntu ayiyona nje into ethile, kodwa iyingxenye yokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuziphatha okuhle, ukucophelela, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile.

f namazinga eqophelo lomoya noma umkhiqizo wesisi onqunywe ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho. c unike izizathu ezibhaliwe ngesinqumo noma wazise umphakathi ngezizathu, lapho ucelwa yilowo ophawulwe endimeni a noma b. Lapho isicelo semvume yokukhiqiza isisi siphumelele ngokwesigaba- 33 (a), umkhandlu wemvume kufanele ukhiphe imvume yesikhashana yokukhiqiza isisi ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokufaka noma ukuqalisa isenzo esibhalwe ohlwini. b ezingase zinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni esithintekayo ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- 46 no- 47 wezenzo ezisohlwini nokuphawulwe ngazo. Umninimvume yesikhashana yokukhiqiza isisi emoyeni unelungelo lemvume yokukhiqiza isisi uma isikhungo esigunyaziwe sihambisana ngokugcwele nezimo nemibandela yemvume yesikhashana yokukhiqiza isisi emoyeni. c ezingase zinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni esithintekayo ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- 46 ne- 47 wezenzo ezisohlwini nokuphawulwa ngazo lapha. g eminye imibandela ebalulekile ukuvikela iqophelo lomoya. noma yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathiwe noma ezizothathwa ukunqanda isimo sokuphindeka kwalokho kwehluleka noma amalinge okunciphisa umthelela wokwehluleka. Imvume yokukhiqiza isisi emoyeni ingedluliselwa komunye umuntu ngumnikazi wayo, ngokuthola imvume yomkhandlu okhipha izimvume.

Lo mbhalo kufanele ufundwe njengengxenye yesitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo zezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni). Umnyango Wezemfundo uveza ngokuqhakazile lesi sitatimende sokuhlola esibuyekeziwe seziqu zezifundo zezigaba R-9 (ezikoleni) ngazo zonke izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhumusha kwalesi work akukaze kube umsebenzi olula nhlobo. Izikhathi eziningi, abantu abake basebenza kule msebenzi yokuhumusha baphoqeleka ukuba benze amagama amasha ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Lezi zimpapasho zithunyelwe futhi kubachwepheshe kulezi zilimi ukuze zihlolwe. Umnyango Wezemfundo ubheka lezi zimpapasho njengesisekelo sokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa izilimi zethu. Ngakho-ke, sikhuthaza wonke umuntu emkhakheni wezokufundisa ukuba asebenzise lezi zimpapasho njengesisekelo sokuthuthuka nokuzithuthukisa. Ukuhlola umfundi - lesi sahluko sinikeza umhlahlandlela wezinga lokuhlola lemfundo elisekelwe eziphumeleni, sikhuluma ngokuqhubekayo kokuhlola, futhi siphinde sinikeze izibonelo zemikhuba yokugcina amarekhodi. Uhlu lwezinto okufanele zifundwe lunikeza uhlaka olujwayelekile lwezifundo kanye nohlu lokuhlola noluhlu oluhambisana ngqo nezifundo ezithile. Umzimba walencwadi uhlukaniswe ngezihloko eziningi. Isahluko ngasinye sithinta izinga elithile lokuhlanganiswa kwemfundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa okujwayelekile - izinga eliyisisekelo, izinga eliphakathi, nezinga eliphakeme. Isahluko ngasinye kulezi zinga sihlanganisa ingxenye yokwethula eyamfushane, izindlela zokuhlola zezigaba ngazinye. Izindlela zokuhlola zezigaba ngazinye zethulwa ngendlela yokwenza intuthuko yokufunda ibonakale.

Izimfanelo zingathulwa zisebenzisa izinhlobo ezahlukene zomthombo noma izinto ezibonakalayo. Umfanekiso olandelayo ubonisa kahle izinhlobo ezahlukene zezikhala zomthetho; ubonisa ukuthi uMthetho Wobufakazi uhamba kuphi, incazelo yeMthethweni Wobufakazi, kanye nophawu lokuthi yini eyenza ubufakazi obubalulekile nokuthi yini equkethwe. Impikiswano ethulwe ngombuso kanye neqembu lokuvikela ayithathwa njengobufakazi kodwa iyisithako esisiza enqubweni yokwenza izinqumo. Le mpikiswano yakhiwa ngemicabango noma iziphakamiso ezihlosiwe ukugqamisa isimo somthetho noma izimfanelo zecala futhi isetshenziswa ukuze ithonya ukucabangela kwekhamphani lapho ikhipha isinqumo. Ngaphambi kokuthi isinqumo sithathwe, izinhlangothi zinekhono lokwethula impikiswano yokugcina ephathelene nobufakazi obukhulunywe ngempela. Izimfanelo zecala yilezo ezethulwe yiphathi ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngobufakazi ukuze iwine leli cala. Izimfanelo zivame ukulethela ubufakazi noma ziqhubele phambili. Isibonelo: Ecaleni elihlobene nobudlelwane bomzali, ubuhlanga bababa kuzoba yindaba ezoxoxwa, futhi ubudlelwane bezocansi nobaba kuzoba iphuzu elihlobene nendaba yobudlelwane bomzali. Ubufakazi obuqinile buchaza ubufakazi obunamandla noma ukuthi akukho olunye ubufakazi olungcono kunalokho okukhona. Ubufakazi obungaphikiswa buchaza ukuthi kukhona olunye ubufakazi olungcono noma ukuthi bekukhona. Isibonelo: Idokhumenti yokuqala ithathwa njengobufakazi obuqinile, kodwa amakhophi edokhumenti athathwa njengobufakazi obungaphikiswa. Igama elithi "prima facie" liyisisho sesiLatini esisho "ngokokuqala."

Lezi zingozi zingaholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu nasekuphazamisekeni kwezinkampani kanye nemibuso. Izingozi Eziyinhloko Izingozi zihlala zikhona emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi ziyaqhubeka zikhula njengoba ubuchwepheshe bukhula. Izinkampani ezithola uxhumano nabangani be-inthanethi, njengokuthenga nge-inthanethi, zikhona engozini yokuhlaselwa. Futhi, izingozi ezihlobene nemisebenzi yokuvula ubuchwepheshe, njengokungena ezinkampanini, ziyaqhubeka zikhukhuma. Ukuzwisisa lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuthathwe izinyathelo ezifanele zokuvikela. Izinyathelo Zokuvikela Ukuvikela ulwazi lwethu kudinga izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza nezinhlelo zihlala zisesikhathini. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwelashwa kwezibuyekezo ezikhona nokugwema izinhlelo zokusebenza ezingathandeki. Okwesibili, amagama anamandla kufanele asetshenziswe ukuvimbela abantu abangagunyaziwe ekufinyeleleni kulwazi lwethu. Amagama aqinile avikela okokusebenza nemininingwane yethu. Ukwengeza, ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela i-cyberspace, njenge-firewalls nemisebenzi yokuhlonza izingozi, kubalulekile ukuze kube lula ukubona nokuvimbela ukuhlasela ngaphambi kokwenza umonakalo. Kubalulekile futhi ukufundisa abasebenzi noma amalungu omphakathi ukuze baqonde izingozi nezindlela zokuphatha imininingwane yabo ngendlela ephephile. Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Nezinguquko Ubuchwepheshe bukhula njalo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekwandiseni kwezinselelo ezivela kumasistimu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sigcine ulwazi lwethu luqinile ngokuhlala silungisa izinqubo zethu zokuvikela. Izinhlelo ezintsha ziyaqhubeka zithola izisebenzi ezijulile ezizothola izixazululo ezenzakalayo ezithinta izingozi ezikhulayo.

Isinyathelo 6: Ukubambisana Ngezinye Izinsuku Ngemva kokhetho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bahlale bexhunywe ukuze baphendule izidingo zomphakathi. Lokhu kungahlanganisa imihlangano yokuxoxisana, lapho abantu bangabakhona khona ukuze bacele imiphumela, futhi bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni ezizayo. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezakhamuzi kuzokwakha umoya wokuhlanganyela, okuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Isiphetho Ukhetho lukazwelonke luyisigameko esibalulekile, esiqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banesikhala sokuzwakalisa izifiso zabo. Ukuze le nqubo ihambe kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi izinyathelo ezichaziwe zilandelwe ngokunembile. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngenkundla efanele yokuvota, sithuthukise isimo sezepolitiki eNingizimu Afrika. Ukhetho akusikho nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqinile nezwe elikhaliphile.

Isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya singadinga umnini wemvume yokukhiqiza isisi ukuba aqoke isisebenzi esilawula ukukhiqizwa kwesisi, kuye ngobukhulu nohlobo lwesenzo esisohlwini nesikhishelwe imvume. b senze ngakho konke okusemandleni aso ukuhambisana nezimo kanye nemibandela yemvume. Ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba, akukho okuthambisa izibophezelo nokulindelwe kumnikazi wemvume mayelana nokulandela izimo nemibandela yemvume. c ukuhlola ukuthi esikhathini esiphambili noma njengamanje umuntu akayena umqondisi noma umphathi wenkampani noma ibhizinisi elithintwa yindima- a no b ; noma d ukuhlola ukuthi ukusingathwa kwesenzo esisohlwini esifakelwe isicelo siyoba sezandleni zomuntu onobuchwepheshe obufanele noma ngeke kube njalo. a ekunukubezeni umoya okweqa umngcele wezwe; noma ekunukubezeni umoya okuphambene noma okungenzeka kuphambane nesivumelwane esisezingeni lomhlaba esibophezela iNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokunqanda, ukulawula noma ukulungisa isimo sokunukutshezwa komoya okuwumphumela wesici esithile noma izici ezichithwe emoyeni zisuka esikhungweni esithile. Uma kwenzeka ngemuva kophenya Ungqongqoshe enombono wokuthi ukukhiqizwa kwesici esithile emoyeni okudabuka eNingizimu Afrika kunomthelela omkhulu eqophelweni lomoya, kwimvelo noma empilweni yabantu ezweni elingumakhelwane neNingizimu Afrika, ngokulandisa kwesigaba-46, uNgqongqoshe anganquma imigomo ehlose ukunqanda, ukulawula noma ukulungisa isimo somkhiqizo ngaphakathi ezweni laseNingizimu. noNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni esithintekayo.

Izimpawu ezintsha zalesi sizwe ziwuhlonzo oluphakeme, olunikezwa nguMongameli kubantu, kanye nakwabanye abantu abahlonishwa kakhulu abakwamanye amazwe. UMongameli ungumthombo (umgibeli, isibambiso, nomthombo omkhulu) wokuhlonipha ezweni, yingakho uMongameli engumuntu ophakamisayo imiklomelo futhi enikeza izimpawu zokuhlonipha. INingizimu Afrika idlulelwe uhambo olude lokuhlukanisa nesikhumbuzo sokukoloni esisekelwe ebudlelwaneni, umbala, nenkolo. Izwe lethu liya phambili ngokuzinzile endleleni yokwamukela ubuntu nobuqotho kubantu bonke. Kulolu hambo lokuhlonipha ubuntu bonke, kukhona isiko elisha lemidlalelo yamalungelo abantu bonke, kanye nokuhlonishwa kobuqotho bomoya womuntu, okuyinto echaza ubunikazi bethu njengeNingizimu Afrika. Imithombo yezimpawu zokuhlukanisa nesikhathi esedlule ibonakaliswe ngokuphakanyiswa kweflegi entsha ngo-1994. Leso sikhathi saqinisa ukuzigqaja kwethu nobuqotho besizwe esijabulela ukuhlonishwa kwabantu bonke. Enye indlela yokuphumelela kwaba ukusungulwa nokuphothulwa kwe-emblem yesizwe entsha, ehlanganisa umlando wabantu bonke besizwe, ngoMgqibelo 27, 2000. Ngokwenza kanjalo, lokhu kuhlinzeka ngobuhle bonke base-Afrika, futhi izimpawu zayo ziba yingxenye yesiko elisha elihola ukuvuka nokuvuselelwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Le emblem yesizwe entsha isekelwe emoyeni walolu vuselelo lwesizwe. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanezakhono eziphakeme zobuciko nezokwakha, futhi abafeze amazinga aphezulu empumelelo ngendlela engajwayelekile. IMapungubwe - Ubukhosi beMapungubwe babutholakala engxenyeni enyakatho yezwe lethu eminyakeni eyinkulungwane edlule.

UThandi waba umholi, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba phambili. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma abantu behlangana, bangakwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ekugcineni, uThandi nozakwabo baqeda ukujula kwezinkinga zomphakathi, umphakathi wawuthola amandla, futhi abantu baqala ukuvula amehlo abo. Ubugebengu buphuma obala, futhi abantu baqala ukuvuma ukuthi inkohlakalo ayivunyelwe.

Ukudingida izindaba ezigamanxele kweminye imingcele nokulumbanisa izinto ezithinta izinhlaka ezehlukene zikahulumeni kanye nalemboni. INHLOSO: Ukuqinisekisa amaxhama ahlelekile okuhlela nokwethula imisebenzi ngokuveza ithuba lokudweba inqubo egcwele neqinile yokuhlela imisebenzi lapho amathimba emisebenzi, ochwepheshe nababambe iqhaza beyofaka khona igalelo ngeziphakamiso ezinezibalo, iqophelo lomsebenzi, indawo yezakhiwo, isikhathi nesilinganiso sezindleko. Lesi sigaba siyonika ongoti balemboni umsebenzi ofanele kwinqubo yokuhlela nokuyinto eholela ezinhlakeni ezifanele zokuxhumana nokulawula inqubo ngempumelelo. INQUBO: Amathimba Emisebenzi axuba abasebenzi abavela ezikhungweni ezibhekele ukuqhutshwa kwemisebeni esiqaliwe (iminyango, izikhungo zezimboni ezizimele) nochwepheshe bemboni abanesibophezelo somsebenzi wokuhlaziya iziphakamiso ngokubonisana nongoti bezifundazwe/izikhungo zikazwelonke, imiphakathi noma abathintwa wumsebenzi. Izinga lencazelo nokuqonda kwemiphumela liyoshiyana ngoba eminye imisebenzi idinga uphenyo lwesiqiniseko sempumelelo nesidingo salowo msebenzi nokungenzeka singasingatheki ngesikhathi sokuhlelwa kwe-IDP. Kuyokwenziwa isilinganiso semiphumela esithathelwa ezinqumeni zesikhashana ngesakhiwo somsebenzi. UKUPHAWULA: Nakuba inqubo ye-IDP igxile kakhulu kulezo zinto ezikleliswe phambili, miningi imisebenzi yeminyango evamile futhi ebalulekile kodwa engakleliswa phambili (isibonelo, ukugcina isimo sezinto, njengomgwaqo). Lezi zinto kufanele zicatshangwe esigabeni 3, zibuyekezwe ngokulandela imibandela yezimali lapho sekukleliswa izidingo, izinhlelo nemisebenzi encikile.

Emva kokuphumelela, kumnandi ukuvuma ukufinyelela empumelelweni, umphakathi uqhubeka phambili. Umbono wempumelelo ubonisa kahle umoya wendawo eyaziwayo, futhi ugcwalisa umoya wezilimi ezihlekisayo ezivumelanayo. Iqhaza lokuqopha le midlali liveza ubuncane bokuhlonishwa, okwenza izinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Lo mcimbi, ibhola lombhoxo, uyinkumbulo enkulu yokubambisana, ukukhulumisana, nokuhlanganyela, uthokozisa imiphakathi ngezinsuku ezinhle ezizayo, ugxile emphakathini, nasezahleni. Umhlaba ubhalwa, izinselele zibhakabhaka, futhi ibhola lombhoxo lihlala libonisa umoya obalulekile wokubambisana.

Kukhona izinsuku ezibekiwe okumele kufakelwe ngazo amadokhumende kanye namametheriyali ezingxenye ezisetshenziswa ukwandisa, ukuze zifakelwe ku-Registrar . Lezi zinsuku, amanani ematheriyali okwenziwa izinqanyana zokwandisa izitshalo, nalapho okumele zidiliviwe khona, kutholakala lapho kucelwa ku-Registrar. Uma kudingeka ukuvikeleka ngokulandela amalungelo abandisi bezitshalo , abenzi bezicelo belulekwa ukufaka izicelo kanye-kanye ukonga isikhathi kanye nemali. Inqubo yokufakelwa kuhla kwezinhlobo, izothatha okungenani isikhathi esisoswa sesizini yokutshala nokukhula kwezitshalo.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. I-Operation Vulindlela ibuye ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani, uhulumeni ubonise ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlanganyelwe, ezihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokufunda. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, uhulumeni usebenzise izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banamakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini, okwandisa amathuba okukhula komnotho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi.
