Abathengi abakwazi ukubona, ukuthinta noma ukuhlole umkhiqizo ngaphambi kokuwuthenga, okungaholela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo engahambisani nezilindelo zabo. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukwakha ukholo phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, njengoba abathengi bezithola besebenzisa izithombe ezithile neziqubulo ezingase zingakhombisi kahle imikhiqizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kwenza kube nzima ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile, njengoba abathengi bengenakho ukubona umkhiqizo ngokwakhe. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukujabulisa abathengi, ikakhulukazi uma imikhiqizo ingafiki ngesikhathi noma ingahambisani nezilindelo zabo. Ukuze kuphumelele ukuthenga online, kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi baqaphele izingozi ezihambisana nayo. Ukufunda izibuyekezo, ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nokubheka izitolo eziyaziwayo kuyasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi abathengi benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Ekugcineni, ukuthenga online sekuphenduke indlela ebalulekile yokuthenga emhlabeni wanamuhla. Noma kungezona zonke izinzuzo ezithathwayo, izinselelo zikhona, futhi abathengi kufanele babe nekhono lokuhamba phakathi kwemithombo ehlukene ukuze benze izinqumo eziphusile. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, ukuthenga online kuzoba nethonya elikhulu emnothweni, futhi sizobona izinguquko eziningi ezizayo kulolu hlelo lokuthenga.

Babebonisa ubufakazi bokuthi iCheckers ingaba umphakathi owodwa. U-Sipho waphakamisa ingxenye ethakazelisayo - "Umdlalo akukhona nje ukuwina, kodwa ukuhamba ndawonye. Lokhu kudlula impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abavuma ukusiza." Izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga. U-Sipho noThandi baqhubeka bedlala, bezikhandla nezinye izizukulwane. ICheckers yabe isiyinsiza yokubambisana, yokuhlanganyela, nokuqonda ukuthi ubuhlobo bukhulu kakhulu kunokuthola amaphuzu. USipho waqala ukufaka izifundo ezithile kumfundo, asho ukuthi umdlalo ufundisa umqondo wokuhlanganyela, ukweseka, nezinto ezinhle ezidlalwayo. Njengoba uSipho noThandi bephumelela, umphakathi waqhubeka nokukhula. Umdlalo wawubalulekile, kanti abantu baqala ukucabanga ngamasu amasha. U-Sipho wafunda indlela yokubambisana, nokuthi umphakathi ungakhula uma wonke umuntu enza isinyathelo. Ngakho-ke, umuzi waqhubeka nokukhanya, ubuhlobo bukhulisa izinsuku ezinhle. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho waqonda ukuthi ubuhlakani buvela ebudlelwaneni. ICheckers yabe isikhalazo sokuphila, yokuhlanganyela, nokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho noThandi baphokophela phambili, bekhuthaza abanye ukuba baphokophelele, besebenzisa umdlalo ukuze bakhe izixhumanisi ezinzima. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esiyingqayizivele sokuthi umphakathi ungakha umhlaba ophumelelayo uma wonke umuntu edlala ndawonye. Ngakho-ke, izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga, kodwa umgibeli owayethanda iCheckers wahamba phambili. U-Sipho noThandi bahlala bejabule, bephokophela phambili, bathe izinkanyezi zihamba, bezama ukuhamba ndawonye, ukuze umphakathi ube ngcono.

Isithombe 1: Umkhiqizo endaweni ephakathi (evamile) ngo-2008 nango-2009. Abalimi banikeza izizathu ezahlukene zokungasebenzisi ama-hybrids: imbewu ibiza kakhulu, ukuntuleka kwemali ngesikhathi sokutshala, ukungakwazi ukuthola imbewu ye-hybrid, ukuthenga umanyolo, umkhiqizo ophansi, ukungaphumeleli ukukhula ezindaweni zonke, ukufakwa kabi, ukuntuleka kwekhwalithi efanele. Lokhu okukhulunywe ngenhla kuphakamisa umbuzo wokuthi ama-hybrids angcono kunezinhlobo ezivulekile zokupollinate (OPV) kubalimi abaphumelelayo - lapho imbewu ingatholakali kalula, lapho izindleko zokufaka ziphansi, nalapho umkhiqizo uvame ukuba phansi. Umbuzo oqondile uzokhetha uhlobo lwemibewu: ama-hybrids noma ama-OPVs yizinkanyezi ezizokwazi ukweseka umlimi ukuba abe nokudla kwesikhathi esizayo futhi axhaswe ngenzuzo eqhubekayo. Imbewu enhle iyisihluthulelo sokutshala nokukhiqiza yonke imikhiqizo yokudla. Zivula umnyango wokukhiqiza yonke imikhiqizo yokudla. Zonke izenzo zokulima ziqondiswe ekwandiseni ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zemvelo ezisemibewwini etshaliwe. Akukho zenzo zokulima (njengokulima kahle, ukulawula izihlahla, ukufaka umanyolo, nokuphatha izifo) ezingakhuphula umkhiqizo ngaphezu kwekhwalithi yemibewu. Ngakho-ke, yonke imisebenzi yokulima ezoba nomphumela omuhle noma ophansi ihlotshaniswa nemibewu etshaliwe. Ukuze ufinyelele umkhiqizo omuhle, kufanele utshale imbewu yekhwalithi enhle. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola imbewu yekhwalithi enhle, kufanele uthenge imbewu eqinisekisiwe - noma ngabe ama-hybrids noma ama-OPVs.

Imibandela esemqoka yomthetho ijotshelelwe kule nqubomgomo. b 'Ibhidi' isho isicelo esibhaliwe efomini elibekiwe noma elishiwo ngokuphendula isimemo esivela esithweni sombuso ngokunikezelwa kwezinsiza, imisebenzi noma impahla. m 'Abasebenzi Bokuphatha Ukunikezelwa Kwemisebenzi' basho futhi bafaka I-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu, Inhloko Yesigaba: Impahla, Omabhalane Bezikweletu Nomabhalane Bezitolo kanye Nomenenja Wezezimali; kanye n 'Nethender' esetshenziswe ezijobelelweni esho 'ibhidi' engqikithini yenqubo yokubhida kanye 'nekhotheshini' ngokulandela inqubo yokutholiswa kwempahla noma izinsiza ukufinyelela ezindlekweni ezingama-R100,000. Isigaba sokutholiswa sinesibopho sokulungiselela okungabhekiwe komsebenzi wokuphatha. Oyinhloko nguMenenja Wezezimali owela ngaphansi kophethe oyi-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu kamasipala. amanzi avela EMnyangweni Wezindaba Zamanzi noma inhlangano yomphakathi, omunye umasipala noma inhlangano kamasipala; kanye nogesi ovela kwa-Eskom noma kunhlangano yomphakathi, omunye umasipala noma inhlangano kamasipala. ngokubhaliwe, zichaza ngokucacile uhlobo nenani/isikhathi sempahla nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukulungiselelwa kokucacisiwe okuhlose ekutholisweni impahla noma izinsiza zabanikezeli abathize kanye/noma amagama ohlanga kumele angasetshenziswa. Kuqinisekiswe ngokuphelele yinhloko yomnyango ephathekayo, noma umuntu ogunyaze ubuphathimandla, ukuthi umbandela owanele uye wenziwa kubhajethi yokutholiswa okunje.

INEMA ichaza imvelo njengento yendalo kanye nezinkomba ezibonakalayo, ezesiko, ukuheha okuthile okunomthelela empilweni yomuntu noma kwinhlalonhle. Usetshenziswa kanjani lomhlahlandlela? Indlela yokufaka isikhalo, ukufuna umxazululi noma ukuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho ngokuthile okuzokwenzeka noma osekwenzekile nokulimaza imvelo. Indlela ongabamba ngayo iqhaza emzamweni wokufinyelela kwizinqumo eziyoba nomthelela emvelweni namaqhinga okuvikela imvelo ngezivumelwane nohulumeni. Uma ufuna ukwazi kabanzi ngeNEMA, funda lemihlahlandlela. Uma ufuna ukufaka isikhalo ngomonakalo owenzeke emvelweni noma okungase kwenzeke esikhathi esizayo, kunezinyathelo ezinhlanu kulomhlahlandlela. Lezinyathelo zizokubonisa ukuthi ungayisebenzisa kanjani iNEMA. Uma ungayazi impendulo yombuzo noma udinga olunye ulwazi, guqukela engxenyeni ekulomhlahlandlela lapho kunenombolo efanayo nalowombuzo bese uyafunda. Buyela emuva futhi embuzweni. Uma ukwazi ukuphendula uthi yebo, embuzweni, qhubekela phambili kolandelayo. Uma uqhubeka nokungayiqondi impendulo ngombuzo, noma sewuyifundile lencwadi, noma ufuna olunye ulwazi, thintana noMnyango Wezemvelo nokuVakasha, phenya eSahlukweni 10 lapho uzothola khona ikheli. Uma uphendule wathi Yebo kuyo yonke imibuzo, funda Isahluko 8 no 9 ukuze uthole kabanzi ngalokho okwenzekayo ngesikhathi uthatha izinyathelo. Ukuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho. Uma ungayazi impendulo yombuzo noma ucabanga ukuthi impendulo inguCha, ungalahli ithemba. Funda lesigaba somhlahlandlela futhi noma uxhumane noMnyango wezeMvelo nokuVakasha wesifundazwe sakho noma kazwelonke.

Uyaphikisana yini nokuthatha isifungo/ngokufunga njengoba kumisiwe? Ngabe isifungo esigciniwe usithatha njengesikubophayo kunembeza wakho na? Ngiyaqinisa ukuthi lona othatha isifungo uvumile ukuthi uyakwazi futhi uyakuqonda okuqukethwe yilesi simemezelo esibhaliwe. Lona othatha isifungo usho lamazwi alandelayo: "ngiyafunga ukuthi lokhu okuqukethwe yilesi simemezelo esibhaliwe kuyiqiniso, inkosi ingisize"/ Ngiqinisile ngiqinisile ngithi lokhu okuqukethwe yilesi simemezelo esibhaliwe kuyiqiniso". Lona othatha isifungo usayinde/wenze uphawu phambi kwami ngikhona. Amagama nesibongo ngokuphelele...

Khiqiza izinkomo ezingu-200 ezineminyaka engama-20 ezivela emapulazini ezizothengwa yiYYY Supermarket. Khiqiza izinkukhu ezingu-40,000 zenyama ngenyanga ezizothengwa yiXXX Chicken Wholesaler. Penda iworkshop ne-tractor shed. Wakha idamu endaweni enamahektare angama-9. Lungisa futhi uphathe zonke izakhiwo. Ngokusebenzisa isu lonyaka - elijwayelekile futhi elibheke ukukhiqiza - isu lwenyanga lungathuthukiswa. Ngokuvamile - penda iworkshop ne-tractor shed. Isu lokukhiqiza - ummbila: hlola zonke izinkambu; amabhontshisi: thina amahektare angama-100. Izinkomo - nikeza ukudla kwentwasahlobo kuzo zonke izilwane, nikeza izinkomo ezincane izithako, susa izinkomo ezindala, hlola isisindo sazo, uzibhalise, phatha izinkomo ezincane ngemithi, qapha isisindo sezo zonke izilwane. Izinkukhu - yenza zonke izinkonzo zansuku zonke, thengisa ezindlini ezimbili, lungisa izindlu ezintathu zezinhlobo ezintsha. Ekuqaleni kwenyanga, izicwangciso zamasonto zingathuthukiswa zalesi sikhathi. Isisekelo sezicwangciso zamasonto yizicwangciso zenyanga, izicwangciso ezivamile, nezicwangciso zokukhiqiza. Isu sokugcina singaba isu lwenyanga elenziwa ekupheleni kwesonto elidlule elichaza kahle konke okufanele kwenziwe esontweni elizayo. Isibonelo: Isonto lesi-9 - Meyi 13, 2011. (Isu lesonto nezicwangciso zalesi sikhathi zixubene kuTebula 1). Susa izinkomo ezingu-100 emapulazini, uzibhalise, phatha ngemithi, qapha isisindo sazo. Lapho sihlela izicwangciso zesikhathi esifushane, kufanele kufakwe imininingwane eminingi.

UKing usikhumbuza ukuthi ubulungiswa buyisidingo esibalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sibe nesibindi sokulwela amalungelo ethu, njengoba yena waba nesibindi sokulwa nokungabi nabulungiswa. Ngamafuphi, uMartin Luther King Jr. ungumholi ophawulekayo, owashiya umthelela omkhulu emhlabeni. Imigomo yakhe yokuthula, ubulungiswa, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu izoqhubeka iphila ezizukulwaneni ezizayo. UKing ungumfanekiso wokukhuthazela, futhi izifundo zakhe zihlala zikhumbuleka, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba balwe nezinhlelo zobandlululo, baphinde bakhe umhlaba ongcono. UMartin Luther King Jr. ungumfanekiso wezinto ezinhle, futhi umbono wakhe wokuthi "sonke singabantu" usaqhubeka nokukhanya njengophawu lokuphila okuhle.

Lezangqumo zibekwe ngokufanelana ukuze kuqondiswe ehawini kugcwaliswe umfanekiso wesisekelo ongaphansi ofana neqanda. Inyoni yemilenze emide ibekwe ngaphezu kwehlathi eliluhlaza, izimbali zakha isifuba salenyoni. Inyoni yemilenze emide imise izimpiko zayo ngendlela yobukhosi. Izimpawu ezibonakalayo zalenyoni ziyimbathise ikhanda eliqinile ungathi ngumqhele. Ilanga eliphumayo ngaphezu kwesibhakabhaka libekwe ngaphakathi kwezimpiko zenyoni enemilenze emide ukuze igcwalisele umfanekiso ofana neqanda wokwenyuka. Inhlanganisela yemifanekiso efana neqanda yangaphezulu nangaphansi ihlangana yakhe umzila omude ongenasiphetho kanti nokuhlelek a kahle phakathi kwezingqumo ezingumsusa kwakha umklamo onamandla, omuhle kakhulu nongafanani neminye. Kanti-ke ugcina ukusimama, nobuzotha, nobunzima abudingwa yisiphandla sezwe. Isiqubulo - !ke e: /xarra //ke, sibhalwe ngolimi lwabathwa besizwe sabantu okuthiwa i-/Xam. Lesiqubulo sichaza ukuthi: ukubumbana kwabantu abahlukahlukene. Lokhu lowo nalowo mzamo wokuhlanganisa isenzo nomcabango kube yinto eyodwa. Kubiza isizwe, kuthi masihlangane sonkana sibe nomqondo ofanayo wokuzwana futhi sibe nokuziqhenya ngobuzwe baso. - ubumbano ekwahlukahlukaneni kwethu. Ukolo umele ukunonophala, ukukhula nokuthuthuka okunokwenzeka, ukondleka kwabantu kanye nezinye izinto eziqondene nozolimo. Amele ubuhlakani, amandla, ubumnene kanye nobungunaphakade. Linemisebenzi emibili: ukukhombisa ubuqobo kanye nokuvikela ngokomoya. Liqukatha uphawu elikhulu lezwe.

Kwezinye izizwe ezinjengaBakwena, aBatawana namaBamalete, kukhona izinduna namasekela amakhosi. Esizweni saBakwena, la masekela amakhosi abekwa emazingeni asukela ku A aye ku C. Yileso naleso sikhulu somthetho sinamalungelo omthetho okulalela amacala, okwenza bakwazi ukuxazulula ukungezwani. Izinkantolo zezinduna zibizwa ngokuthi izinkantolo zokuxolelana , okungenzeka ukuthi umthetho we-12 wezinkantolo zemithetho yesintu waba nomthelela ekuqalweni kwalolu hlelo. Izinkantolo zendabuko, ziholwa ngomongameli abakhethwa nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango woHulumeni bezaseKhaya zisebenza ezikhungweni ezinkulu ezisemadolobheni (Gaborone, Francistown, Lobatse, Selebi-Pikwe, Jwaneng, Ghanzi naseKasane). Lezi zinkantolo zisebenza ngamacala amancane afaka imibango yemihlaba, imishado nezimpahla. Amacala ezifikanamthwalo angalalelwa kulezi zinkantolo. Ukuthola abammeli akuvumelekile ezinkantolo zemithetho yendabuko kanti futhi ayikho imithetho elawula ukwethulwa kobufakazi. Amajaji asezinkantolo zamakhosi akhethwa yinkosi noma umphakathi, anquma izigwebo, ezingedluliselwa enkantolo yamacala emibango. Ikhwalithi yesinqumo esithathwa kulolu hlobo lwenkantolo luyehluka kulowo nalowo mphakathi. Kwezinye izikhathi amajaji akulezi zinkantolo akhipha izigwebo ezinjengokushaywa kwabantu esidlangaleni. Kunezinkantolo ezimthethweni ezasungulwa nguNgqongqoshe woMnyango woHulumeni baseKhaya njengoba kuhlonza umthetho wezinkantolo. Lo mthetho uyibeka ngokusobala ukuthi imingcele yezindawo lezi zinkantolo ezinamandla kuzo.

Ukungena kwenkantolo kuyinto eyenziwa ngaphakathi kwenkantolo ethula ubufakazi obuqinile futhi obungaphikiswa noma bukhishwe ngaphandle kokuthi izimfuneko zomthetho ezithile zifezekiswe. Ukungena kwangaphandle kubhekisela ekungeni okwenziwa ngaphandle kwenkantolo okuthintekayo ekuphikisaneni noma empikiswaneni. Ukuvuma kweqiniso kuwumsebenzi lapho umsolwa evuma ngokuphelele futhi ngaphandle kokungabaza emsebenzini, okungaba uma kwenziwa phambi kwenkantolo kuzothathwa njengokuvuma ukuvuma. Isaziso senkantolo sikhombisa ukuthi ikhamphani yamukela izimfanelo ezaziwa kanye nolwazi oluthathwa njengobufakazi obuqondile kodwa alukwazanga ukufakazelwa ngobufakazi ngesikhathi sokubuzwa. Isinqumo sokukholwa siwukwenza isinqumo esisekelwe ezimfanelweni ezithile ezisunguliwe ngumthetho. Umthwalo wobufakazi ubhekisela emsebenzini noma isibopho sephathi sokwethula ubufakazi obuqinile, emthethweni wobugebengu lo mthwalo ubekwe ezindleleni zabaphenyi. Umthwalo wobufakazi obubalulekile ubhekisela emsebenzini noma isibopho sokukhiqiza ubufakazi obanele ukuze ikhamphani ibize umsolwa ukuthi aphendule ezinsolweni futhi ithole ubufakazi obanele ukuze iphikise lelo bufakazi elicacile elikhulunywe yiphathi evula leli cala.

Kokubili, amanani nezindleko, akhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kodwa ezingeni elihlukile. Isibonelo: ngoMashi 26, 2010, uJ Willemse wabhala kuLandbouweekblad ukuthi ngonyaka ka-2009, inenzuzo yamabhizinisi ezolimo emhlabeni jikelele yakhula ngo-2.6% kulonyaka, kodwa izindleko zakhula ngo-8%. Lezi zilinganiso zihluka minyaka yonke kodwa zakha okuthiwa "ukucindezela kwezindleko-nani." Uma sibheka iminyaka neminyaka, lokhu kungaboniswa njengokuhlelwa okulandelayo (Isithombe 1) (Uhlu lwezinsiza: Willemse, J. 2010, Ukwehla kwezimali kudlulela ezolimo. Landbouweekblad: Mashi 26, 2010). Uma umsebenzi epulazini uqhubeka ngendlela efanayo unyaka nonyaka, umgapho phakathi kwemali engenayo nezindleko zokuhlinzeka izindleko uzovalwa, okwenza kube nzima kakhulu ukufinyelela inenzuzo. Uma sibheka umsebenzi wethu sigxile ezindabeni zezimali, kubonakala ukuthi ukuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo kufanele kuthuthuke futhi kuqhubeke kukhula ngokuqhubekayo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ibhizinisi lakho ngeke likwazi ukuqhubeka liphumelele esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kungenzeka uma siqhubeka nokunaka le ndaba ukuze ukuphathwa kwemikhakha yebhizinisi kuqhubeke kukhula ngaso sonke isikhathi. Inhloso kufanele kube ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imali engenayo ihlale iphakeme kunezindleko (izindleko) ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Lokhu kuboniswa ku-Isithombe 2 ngezansi. Lokhu akusiyo umsebenzi olula ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezingaphandle kokulawula komphathi wepulazi ezingashintsha umkhondo webhizinisi. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuyinselelo enkulu kumnikazi/umphathi webhizinisi lezolimo.

Njengoba kusho umbiko we- Human Resource zonke izinhloso zokumelwa kwabaphathi sezifeziwe. Sikholwa ukuthi inhloso ebalulekile yazo zonke izingxenye ezixhaswe yi-DACST (isayensi, ubuciko, amagugu, izilimi) ukuba zihlanganise indlela yokuphatha nesuselwe kumbono ofanayo nentshisekelo ukuhloniphnana kanye nokuthembeka. Ulwazi kanye noMnyango. Lezi zizinda kumele zakhe inqubomgomo ezokwamukela futhi yonge zonke izimpahla noma ngabe ezinhlobeni ezingaphansi kwesandla sabo, ngisho amaspeciments, ukuqoqwa noma iziphi ezinye izimpahla kufanele bengamele yonke impahla ka-hulumeni enokuthatheka noma enikezwe abantu base Ningizimu Afrika. Lezi zindawo zomiphakathi ezilandelayo isabelo sazo sezimali noma ukuxhaswa okufakwe kubakaki zethula imibiko yazo kungqongqoshe wezobuciko, amasiko, isayensi kanye nobuchwepheshe. Ezinye izikhungo eziyishumi nanye nezibusa ngemithetho nazo zethula imbiko yazo kungqongqoshe. Ngokwe Section 21 ye Companies Act, ka- 1973 izizinda zobuciko zisiza ukwakha izimboni zobuciko zibheke ukuthi zitholakala kalula, iqophelo eliphezulu, ukuhlukahlukana kanye nokulungisa isimo / ukubuyisela isimo endaweni. Zigqugquzela intuthuko kwizizinda zobuciko ezinhlobonhlobo. Isigungu sikazwelonke sezobuciko. Ngokomthetho we- National Arts Council ka- 1997, umkhandlu ulungiselela amathuba ukuze abantu bekwazi ukwenza futhi bajabulele ubuciko.

Ukuthola intengo efanele kusemqoka. Intengo eqondakalayo yileyo ekunikeza inani lemali yekhasimende (i-VFM). Isici sesithathu indawo okusho ukuthi umkhiqizo kumele ukwazi ukufinyeleleka nokubakhona kumakhasimende ukuze bakwazi ukuwuthenga. U-'P' wesine wenhlanganisela ukuqhubekisa. Uma usunomkhiqizo ofanele, ngenani elifanele kanye nasendaweni efanele, kumele uyiqhubekise. Kumele wazise amakhasimende akho ukhona unomkhiqizo osulungelwe ukuthengwa. Njengokupheka ngemfanelo, ukumaketha okunempumelelo kuhlanganisa izithako zizonke ngezilinganiso ezifanele. Akusho ukuthi ukuthi kuhlala kuneresipi engaguquki. Ezikhathini ezahlukile inhlanganisela yokumaketha edingekayo izokwehluka. Kuzomele uthathe izinqumo ngomkhiqizo wakho, indawo, intengo kanye nokuqhubekisa. Okusemqoka okuphambili ekumaketheni ibhizinisi lakho ukuthi ubone izidingo nezimfuno zamakhasimende akho. Kusemqonda ukubonisa ukuthi ngobani abazothenga imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo zakho. Amakhasimende akho kungaba... Ngokuhlola okungaba ngamakhasimende uzokubona ukuthi bangaqoqelwa endaweni eyodwa. Lezi zibizwa izimakethe eziyimigomo. Imakethe yakho engumgomo ngabantu ozama ukubahehela kubhizinisi lakho. Njengebhizinisi elincane kuzomele ubheke ngqo kuzingxenye ezicacile zemakethi, njengoba ungakwazi ukunikezela yonke into kuwo wonke amakhasimende. Siyini isiphakamiso sokuthengisa esiyingqayizivele (i-USP) Zibuze - ukuthi yini okukwenza wehluke koncintisana nabo I-USP itshela ikhasimende okuthile ngomkhiqizo owenza ube ngaphezulu komncintiswano?

Isikhwama singokunye ukuzibonakalisa kokuzinikela kwethu ekuvuselelweni kabusha kwe-Afrika. Ngakho-ke kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ulandele ngokucophelela amalebuli emithi yokuchela izitshalo. Obekukuhle kakhulu ngaleli qembu ukuthi bobabili abazali kanye nothisha babo basebebalahlile ngenxa yokuzibandakanya kwabo kubugebengu kanye nenye indlela yokuziphatha yokuba yimidlwembe. Ingabe lokho kwakunge yini kubenze babheke ngakwikhona elisenyakatho mpumalanga? Izindawo zokufikela izindiza ezivela emazweni aphesheya kanye nakuleli zasesikhumulweni sezindiza sase-OR Tambo zizobe sezihlangene ngokuphelele ngo-Ephreli ngonyaka ozayo, uma sekusebenza isikhungo eziphakathi nendawo sebhilidi lesikhumulo sezindiza ezisukayo. Ngicela zonke izigungu zabazali eziphethe izikole ukuthi zilekelele ngokuthi zibe khona ezikoleni ngoLwesine. Umuntu omuhle kakhulu oneminyaka yobudala eyevile kwengamashumi ayisishiyagalombili ohlala kei-flat elingezansi kwelami uhlale engikikeza izeluleko. Ukugqugquzela ukuphinda kwabiwe kabusha ngokuthi kudalwe amathuba emisebenzi kanye nokuphinda kunikezwe kabusha ingcebo ngesabiwomali. Wonke amalungu anconywa ngesibindi kanye nokuzinikela kwawo emsebenzini wawo. Ukungenelela kuhlanganisa ukunika umfutho Umnotho Wesibili lapho iningi labantu bakithi bethola khona imali yabo yokuziphilisa. Noma iluphi uphawu oluvumelekile kuleli qoqo lizobekwa kwisisekelo esidizayinwe bamiswa Unjiniyela Wezakhiwo Obhalisiwe. Amaqembu abhaliswe Nekhomishani Yezokhetho kuphela azokwazi ukuthumela amagama abantu bawo abazongenela ukhetho.

Ukunqunywa kwendawo njengekleliswe phambili kufanele kudwetshwe uma indawo ihambisana namazinga eqophelo lomoya endaweni. a silungise isu lokuphatha laleyo ndawo mayelana neqophelo lomoya ngemuva kokubonisana neziphathimandla zamaqophelo omoya ezifundazweni ezithintekayo nomasipala b zingakapheli izinyanga eziyisithupha idaluliwe indawo noma singakapheli isikhathi esivunywe nguNgqongqoshe, sethule isu kuNgqongqoshe ukuze ligunyazwe. b zingakapheli izinyanga eziyisithupha leyo ndawo idaluliwe noma singakapheli isikhathi esinganqunywa nguNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe, ethule isu kuNgqongqoshe ukuze ligunyazwe. Ngaphambi kokugunyaza isu leqophelo lomoya lendawo ekleliswe phambili, uNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe angafunda ukuba isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya sichibiyele isu singakapheli isikhathi esinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe. uNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe kufanele ashicilele isu kwiGazethe zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu- 90 ligunyaziwe isu. Isu eligunyaziwe liqala ukusebenza ngosuku elishicilelwe ngalo. Isu lokuphatha iqophelo lomoya endaweni ekleliswe phambili liphelelwa yisikhathi uma isinqumo sokuklelisa indawo sihoxiswa ngaphansi kwesigaba- 17 5. d ukubuyekeza ngezikhawu ezithile lawo masu. ngokwenza izinguquko ezithile emininingwaneni yohlu. Uhlu olushicilelwe nguNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke lusebenza ezweni lonke kanti uhlu olushicilelwe nguNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe lubusa kuphela esifundazweni.

Uma ukhomishina wokufungisa eqinisekile ukuthi ngempela ikhophi iyikhophi eyiqiniso yombhalo wokuqala futhi akunazichibiyelo ezingagunyaziwe ezenziwe, ukhomishina wokufungisa kufanele abhale phansi ukuthi uyakufakazela ukuthi umbhalo uyikhophi eyiqiniso yombhalo wokuqala nokuthi akukho zinkomba zokuthi umbhalo wokuqala uke washintshiwa ngabantu abangagunyaziwe. Emva kwalokho-ke ukhomishina wokufungisa kufanele eleke ngesignesha futhi abhale igama, isikhundla, imininingwane yokumthinta kanye nosuku. Isigxivizo esesilungile siyatholakala ukuze kufakazelwe imibhalo. Uma isifungo noma isiqinisekiso, singenziwanga ngendlela elungile njengoba kunquma umthetho, bese udaba luya enkantolo, i-afidavithi iyothathwa njengengelona iqiniso futhi ingaba nemiphumela enzima, njengokuthi nje emacaleni obugebengu, ingaholela ekutheni lowo omangalelwe aphume phambili. Uma ukhomishina wokufungisa ebona ukuthi umuntu owenza isitatimende akathandi ukufunga, kufanele angafungisi. Kwake kwaba nesimo lapho owayemangalelwe owayeboshwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wokuvikeleka Ngaphakathi, okwathi emva kokuvalelwa egunjini lokuhlalisa umuntu ngamunye futhi aphenywe, waphoqelelwa yiphoyisa ukuthi afunge ngaphambi kukhakhomishina wokufungisa. Inkantolo yakubekela eceleni lokho kuboshwa kukammangalelwa lapho kutholakala ukuthi wayephoqelelwe ukuthi afunge phambi kukakhomishina wokufungisa.

Ngonyaka ka 2005 iNingizimu Afrika besi ifinyelele ezidingweni zohlelo lwe " Millennium Development Goal" oluphathelene nokutholakala kwamanzi kubo bonke abantu. Sithuthuke sasuka ku 59% ngo 1994 saya ku 83% ngo 2006 ekwabeni amanzi kubantu bakithi. Ngokusho kohlelo lwentuthuko luka mhlabuhlangene (UNDP) iNingizimu Afrika ingenye yamazwe ambalwa achitha imali encane kwezempi, isebenzise eningana imali ekwabeleni isizwe amanzi nasekuhanbiseni indle kahle. Iningizimu Afrika ikhombisile ukuthi amalungelo abantu okuthola amanzi kungaba yindle yokusiza abantu ukuthi bazimele iphinde ibengumkhombandlela ekufezekiseni imigomo kahulumeniinguquko yokutholakala kwamanzi ethwele amalungelo abantu, yenze ukuthi kubelula iNingizimu Afrika ikhulise inani labantu abathola amanzi ize inqobe umlando omubi wokuhlukana ngebala owashiywa ubandlululo. Kufanele sithathe ikhefu sitshakadule ngenxa yalempumelelo. Kuyangidabukisa ukuthi ngiphawule ukuthi kesenabantu abangu 8 million abangenawo amanzi ahlobile, baningi abanye abangenaye ugesi nokuthuthwa kwendle. Siyaziqhenya ngukuthi esikhathini esingangonyaka sikwazile ukunciphisa ngesigamu umsebenzi obungakaqedwa wokuthutha indle ngamabhakede ezindaweni lapho kuhlala khona abantu. Sisendleni yokuthi seqede lempilo ekhiphana isithunzi kubantu ungakapheli umnyaka noma-ke ekupheleni kwawo. Sizakuqhubeka silwe nalezinkinga ukuze siqishe ezweni lethu imimoya emibi nenyanyakayo sizokwazi ukukhuluma ngazwi linye lenkululeko nenjabulo elethwa ukukhululeka. Uma sibukisisa imfundo nukuthola amakhono emisebenzi, sibona inqubekela phambili ngumnyaka ka 2004 noma ijubane laloko lithi ukubaphansi nje.

Ekugcineni, ukuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS kudinga ukusebenza okuqinile, okuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe, imihlahlandlela efanele, kanye nezinhlelo zokuhlola. Sizofakaza kahle ukulandela lezi zinyathelo ukuze umahluko uhlale uphila, kuyilapho singabheki phezulu ukuvikeleka kwempilo yethu. Ngakho, asikhumbule ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo yinsiza ebalulekile, kufanele lukhululeke, kodwa kuphela uma lutholakala ezandleni eziphephile. Siphakamisa i-GEMS nezinye izinhlelo ezizobheka izinqubomgomo eziqondile nezisezingeni eliphezulu zokuvikela ulwazi lwemiphakathi. Ukwakha umuzwa wezimiso ezizothuthukisa ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kusemqoka, futhi kufanele kube ngumphumela wethu sonke. Asiwuqhakambiseni umphakathi wethu, kodwa sigcizelele ekufundiseni ababambiqhaza mayelana nezidingo zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo. I-GEMS iyindawo eqala imizamo yokwakha ikusasa elinokuphepha nolwazi oluqinisekile lokwenza ngcono impilo yethu somphakathi. Lokhu kuncike kithi, futhi kungenzeka kuphela uma siqaphela izinselelo nokubambisana ekwakheni izinhlelo ezenza umthelela omuhle. Ngakho sizobe siye phambili, siqhubeke nokusela izinyathelo zethu, kuya emhlabeni osembili, lapho suntu sithola ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo, siphumelela ngokweqiniso. Ukusiza omunye nomunye empilweni, ukuhlonipha ukubaluleka kolwazi lwezempilo, kuyindlela yokubuyisela. Lokhu kufanele kube yinsizakalo yethu esiyenzayo, ukuze siqhubeke nokukhulisa umphakathi ophephile.

Baphinde banginika ulwazi olubalulekile engingase ngingazi ngalesi sifo. USifiso, ilungu, uthole ukuthi i-AfA imsize ukubuyisela impilo yakhe esimweni esihle. "Bangifundisa 'Ukuphila Ngokuhle,' okungifundisa ukuthi ngiphile impilo yami entsha. Kukho ulwazi lokugcina izinto zami zihlanzekile nokudla izithelo nemifino ukuze ngingatholi ukutheleleka. Baphinde bangitshele ukuthi yiziphi izidlo ezinhle engingazidla nokuthi kufanele ngisebenze kangakanani nokuthi kufanele ngilale isikhathi esingakanani. Impela, ngizizwa ngcono kakhulu manje. Ngempela, kubonakala sengathi ngiqala impilo kabusha." Uhlelo lokuphatha isifo se-HIV lwe-GEMS, oluphathwa yi-AfA, lwenza uEunice noSifiso bazifundise ngenkathi iScheme iphatha ezinye izici. Imithi ibhekwa ngokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe imiphumela efanele. Odokotela nabasebenzi bezinhlaka baqinisekisa ukuthi isiguli ngasinye sithatha imithi efanele ukuze impilo yabo iqhubeke ngokujwayelekile. Isiguli ngasinye sithola izeluleko zempilo yengqondo, njengoba impilo yabo yok emotional nepsychological ibalulekile hhayi kuphela kubo kodwa nakwabanye abaseduze nabo. "Ngaphambi kokuthi ngibhalisele uhlelo lwe-AfA, ngangingasokhathazekile ngoba ngazi ukuthi ngiphila ne-HIV, futhi umndeni wami wawubona ukuthi ngikhathazekile ngengqondo. Kwakufana nenhlwathi emnyama eyayiphakeme phezu kwendlu yami, futhi ngazizwa ngathi kwaba wumthwalo wami. Manje njengoba ngise-ART, izinto seziwubuyile ejimini. Impela, kufanele ngithi ukuthi ukushintsha impilo yami kancane kancane kuyinto enhle.

Lokhu kudala imfashini ehlukahlukene, ethokozisayo, futhi ethinta imizwa. Ukuze imfashini ibonakale, kudingeka ukuba kube nokucabanga okukhulu, kanye nezindlela eziningi zokwakha. Lokhu kudala umhlaba ogcwele ubuciko, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukuziveza ngendlela abathanda ngayo. Imfashini Nezimo Zokuphila Imfashini ayigcini nje ngokuba yindlela yokugqoka, kodwa ibonisa futhi izimo zokuphila. Abantu bahlala bekhetha izitayela ezihambisana nezimo zabo, kanye nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba imfashini ingaba yindlela yokukhombisa ubuntu bomuntu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bahlala bejolisa emigomeni ethile, njengezokuhlala, izomnotho, kanye nezimo zomphakathi. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuhlanganyela, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi imfashini ingaba yindlela yokuxhumana. Isiphetho Imfashini iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yomuntu, futhi ibonisa indlela abantu abaziveza ngayo. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imfashini akukhona nje okugqokwayo, kodwa kuyindlela yokukhombisa ubuciko, izinkolelo, nezimo zempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu bahlala bejolisa ezitayeleni ezintsha, futhi imfashini iqhubeka nokuhlangana nezimo zomphakathi. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sihloniphe imfashini, siqonde izizathu eziholela ekwakhiweni kwayo, futhi sihlole indlela esiyithanda ngayo. Imfashini iyindlela yokukhombisa ubuntu bethu, futhi kufanele siyijabulele, siyihloniphe, futhi sithokozise.

Amanzi Ahlanzekile: Izinyathelo Zokuthola Nokugcina Ukuhlanzeka Kwamamzi Amanzi ahlanzekile ayisidingo esikhulu empilweni yethu. Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sithola amanzi ahlanzekile, kubalulekile ukulandela izinyathelo ezithile. Lezi zinyathelo zizosiza ekugcineni impilo yethu iphila kahle, futhi zivikela nezilwane kanye nemvelo. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuhlonza Umthombo Wamanzi Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde umthombo wamanzi ethu. Uma usebenzisa amanzi avela emthonjeni, ichibi, noma emtapweni, kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi lezi zindawo zihlanzekile. Ukuze uhlonze umthombo, ungenza lokhu: - Bheka ukuthi umthombo ubonakala kanjani. Ingabe amanzi acwebile, noma kukhona okukhathazayo njengokungcola, izinsalela, noma umbala ongajwayelekile? - Qinisekisa ukuthi uthola amanzi endaweni engaphansi kwezindawo ezitholakala khona izinkuni, izinhlamvu, nezinye izinto ezingadala ukungcola. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlanzeka Kwamamzi Uma umthombo wamanzi wakho ubonakala uhlanzekile, lesi sikhathi sokuhlanza amanzi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi akunayo imiphumela emibi empilweni yakho. Ungakwenza lokhu ngezindlela ezilandelayo: - Ukusebenzisa amabhodlela apholile: Qinisekisa ukuthi ubhidliza amabhodlela angcolile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa. - Ukuhlanza ngemuva kokuphosa: Uma udinga amanzi ahlanzekile, ungawaphosa ngentambo yokuhlanza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubulukhuni bamanzi abuphazamiseki. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlola Izinga Lokuhlanzeka Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi amanzi akho ahlanzekile, kufanele uhlale uhlole izinga lokuhlanzeka.

Kuyovulwa icala lobugebengu noma kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuqondiswa izigwengwe kulowo muntu omangalelwe icala lokungena ezindlekweni ezingagunyaziwe, ezingaqondile noma ezingenazithelo neziyincithakalo ngale kokuthi zesuliwe noma ezengesulwanga ngokwesigatshana 2. a izindleko ezingaqondile ezingavulelwa icala lobugebengu; kanye b nokweba nokukhwabanisa okwenzekayo eMkhandlwini. UMkhandlu kufanele ubhale umhlahlandlela wenqubomgomo okufanele uMkhandlu uwulandele noma usebenze phansi kwawo uma uphethe izimali ezisezandleni nezitshaliwe, futhi utshale izimali ezingakadingeki ngaleso sikhathi. a uma kunezizathu ezizwakalayo zokuthi leyo mpahla ayisadingeki ekuqhubeni umsebenzi woMkhandlu ; nokuthi b kuzotholakala imali efanele leyo mpahla. Ukudluliswa kobunini noma ukuchithwa kwempahla okukhulunywa ngakho kusigatshana 1 kufanele kube ngokufanele, okulinganayo okuvulelekile nokunokuqophisana okuhambisana nemihlahlandlela wenqubomgomo yoMkhandlu okukhulunywa ngawo esigabeni 27. i zindlela ezisebenzayo nezinekhono nokuvulelela zokuphathwa kwemali nobucayi nezokulawula ngaphakathi. indlela yokuhlola zonke izinhlelo ezimbandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwemali ngaphambi kokuthathwa kwesinqumo ngalolo hlelo. UMkhandlu kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi kuyahlangatshezwana nezidingo zesigatshana 2 futhi ziyaphumeleliswa ngendlela. Noma imuphi umuntu othikameza uNobhala noma uMkhandlu ekufezeni izidingo zesigatshana 2 no 3 uyakuba necala kanti uma elahlwa yicala uyakukhokha inhlawulo noma ahlale ejele isikhathi esingeqile eminyakeni emibili noma kokubili inhlawulo nokubhadla ejele.

I-virus ye-HIV iyinkinga enkulu njengamanje ngenxa yesikhathi esihlala egazini, okuholela ekudlulisweni okungathandeki nemiphumela yayo eyingozi. Izivakashi zikhuthazwa ukuba ziqinisekise ukuthi zinezikhwama zokuvikela ngaphambi kokuhamba uma kudingeka. Uma ukuvaccine kudingeka, izivakashi kufanele zizamile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-vaccine nemithi kuvela ezipakisheni ezivaliwe zemithi ezihlanzekile. Abanokukhuluphala kufanele bathwale izikhali ezihlanzekile (ezihlanzekile) ngesikhathi sokuhamba futhi babe ne-authorization kadokotela yokuzisebenzisa. Ukuhlanzwa kwegazi kwenziwa ngokuphepha eNingizimu Afrika futhi akubeki ingozi ezivakashi. Akudingeki ukugcizelela izinguquko zokuziphatha nezinyathelo zokuphepha. Ukusebenzisa isikhwama sokuvikela kuyindlela enye yokuzivikela. I-malaria ingenye yezifo ezivamile ezibangelwa yiphilisi edluliselwa kumuntu ngomuntu ngokugwaza kwesikhukhukazi sohlobo lwe-Aedes Aegypti, oluhamba ne-malaria. Nakuba kukhona ubufakazi bokuthi ukudluliswa kwe-malaria kwenzeka eNingizimu Afrika, isikhukhukazi esithwala lesi sifo sitholakala lapha. I-malaria ibonakala e-Afrika eningizimu-ntshonalanga, emaphakathi, nasempumalanga naseNingizimu Melika. I-ngozi yokuthola lesi sifo ingancishiswa ngokuthatha izinyathelo ezijwayelekile zokuvikela noma zokunciphisa ukugwazwa kwesikhukhukazi. Ukuvaccine: Ngokwemigomo yeMnyango Wezempilo Womhlaba, i-International Certificate of Vaccination against Yellow Fever iyisicoco esisodwa esidingekayo sokuhamba emhlabeni jikelele. I-International Certificate of Vaccination against Yellow Fever iyasebenza iminyaka eyishumi, iqala ezinsukwini eziyishumi ngemuva kokuvaccine. Ifunwa kubo bonke abahambi abaphezulu kweminyaka eyodwa.

Noma yikuphi ukuxhumana okunje kuzakurekhodwa bese kufayilwa ngokufanele nemibhalo yebhidi. Izigaba ze-14 kanye nama-90 ze-MFMA ibhekana nokulahlwa impahla yemali eqongelweleyo. Izigaba ezibekiwe, ngaphambi kokudlulisa noma ukulahlwa impahla eqongelelweyo, Ibandla lizawuthi emhlanganweni ovulekile, lithathe isinqumo sokuthi impahla ayisadingeki ukunikeza izinsiza zikamasipala eziyisisekelo eziselevelini eliwubuncane. Ibandla lizakuphinde libhekele inani elifanele lempahla kanye nenani lezomnotho nomphakathi oluzotholakala ngokushintshiselana ngempahla. Ikomiti Ivume Ukuphatha Izikhali Eziguquliwe KuZwelonke kanye nokulahlwa kwezibhamu kuZwelonke; kanye nokuthi kutholwe izintengo eziphathelene nezimakethe ezitholakala ngenqubo yokubhida enokuncintisana. Uma umhlaba namabhilidi ethengiswa ngenani lezimakethe, inani lezimakethe lizawukwazi: (a) ukuthola onikeza amanani ozibhalisile novunywe yi-Ofisa Enegunya esenanini lama-R100,000 noma (b) uma inani ledlule ama-R100,000, ukuba lithunyelwe Yibandla lokuvunyelwa ngaphansi kwesigaba sama- 14 se-MFMA.

Kuwumbono womnyango ukuthi ukudluliswa kwamasheya noma ubulungu kungashintsha ekwangeleni komuntu (noma I trust) ephethe amalungelo , lokho kudinga imvume. Njengoba kuchazwe kwi General policy, umnyango ufuna ukukhipha ama "paper quotas". Amalungelo ayokhishwa kusasa, abaceli bayobhekisiswa ukuze kubonakale ukuthi bake bafaka yini izicelo zabo zokuthola amalungelo ukuthi adluliswe.. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi kunganikezwa amalungelo kulabo abake banikezwa kuqala base bewadlulisela kwabanye.. Izindawo ezivikelekile zizosiza ukuthi abantu bangadiobi ngokungemthetho.

Thina esingabasebenzi lapha kuGrain SA ngephrogramu Lokuthuthukisa Abalimi siyathokoza futhi sinenhlanhla ngoba sikholwa ukuthi leli phrogramu lizoletha ukuguquka ekulimeni eNingizimu Afrika. Iphrogramu leGrain SA Lokuthuthukisa Abalimi libophekile ukuthuthukisa abalimi abamnyama ukuze bazokhula ukuba abalimi bezomnotho, abanekhono, abazoqhubeka nakusasa. Umsebenzi wokukhiqiza ukudla okuzinhlamvu, kakhulukazi kubalimi, ubhekene nezinkinga eziningi ngokwamanje nakusasa. Sibhekene nokwaba kwemihlabo, ukuguquka komthetho wobunini bomhlaba, sifanele silwe nentengiso yokudla yasengaphesheya, izindleko ezandayo zokuqala ukulima, silima ezindaweni eziningi ezingatholi imvula, futhi kukhona lento ebizwa ngokuthi "global warming" eyenza ukuthi isimo sezulu naso siguquke. Ngokumfusha, kukhona izinkinga eziningi, asishodi ngazo - ngokwamanje sifuna imixazulo, siyashoda ngayo! Sifanele siqhubeke ukubala izinhlanhla zethu kule phrogramu, sibusisiwe - sinethimu elinabantu abahle kakhulu. Kufanele siqale ngamalunga eGrain SA Executive (abaphathi abakhulu). Usihlalo omkhulu wethu nguMrs Jenny Mathews, umuntu onolwazi osekela zonke izinto esizenzayo. Sibusisiwe futhi ngoba uMnz Schalk Viljoen waseWestern Cape uvumile ukusebenza nathi kuleli qembu lethu. Wakhethwa futhi ukuba umsekeli-sihlalo wekomiti lethu. Kuyasijabulisa ukuba noSchalk Viljoen noAndries Theron, bobabili baseKapa ngoba baletha izindlela ezinsha nemibono emisha ekuthuthukisweni kwabalimi.

Abaxhasi bakhuluma ngezinhlelo zokuthuthuka umnotho ezalotshwe yizo ezikhumbulayo – izinga lokukhula komnotho belikwazile, kodwa kwaba nezahlulelo ezinzima ezazithinta imisebenzi. Kodwa ka sekwenzekile, izinhlelo zamaphathiswa azithintekanga kahle. Kwathathwa imizamo yokwandisa ukuhweba, kodwa ivumelwano elingaqedi kangako lwenze abantu bavele babe nokukhathazeka. Lokhu kwadala ukucasuka nokungaqondi kahle okwabulala ithemba labantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinhlekelele zindawo zikaMphakathi zatholakala ngendlela ezibuhlungu. Lezi zinkinga bebebavimbela ekuhwebeni nasemsebenzini, kanti abadluli bezishoshovu bazama ukuthola izixazululo. Ukuhlaziywa kukhombisa ukuthi umnotho walokhu kwamahlekelele uyaqhamuka ezingeni eliphakeme, kodwa nakho lokho ngenxa yokufuna ukwehlisa okwenziwa ngabadlula ngaphandle. Lokhu kuyadabukisa, kubanga imiphumela eminingi empilweni yabo. Kwakungezinkanyezi ezidlagitha ezingajazi, ezichaza izifundo ezihlukaniselayo. Abantu abaningi bahlala bezama ukuthola izinzuzo zokuhweba, nokhulumela izinjongo zomphakathi, kodwa izinto zathola imiphumela emibi. Ukungabi naluthando lwezinsongo ezithwala izinkanyezi ezinhle, kwakhuthaza impilo engapheli. Abantu bahlala behluleka ukufunda ukuze baphinde bangene ezinhlelweni eziphuthumayo, ukuze baphinde bazitholele izikhala ezinkulu. Esikhathini esidelwe ubungozi, imizamo yokukhuluma ibikwenza kube nokwakha okungakafiki. Abanye babeyizinyanga abathintekayo ekwakheni umnotho, belindele ukuba nempumelelo eMphakathini. Lokhu kube yikushoda kobuchwepheshe, okwenza kube nezinkinga ezivela kumasu omnotho.

Mthembu: Yebo, uhlelo lwenziwe ngokucophelela ukuze luhambisane nezinye izinqubomgomo zikamasipala, zikazwelonke, kanye nezomhlaba. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezihlangene ukuze sithole impumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokufunda, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, kanye nokuphucula imisebenzi. Umxoxi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uhlelo luhlobene kakhulu nezidingo zomphakathi. Ingabe kukhona izinyathelo ezithile ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abampofu bayathola usizo? Mthembu: Ngempela, umphakathi ophila ngaphansi kwemithwalo yokuqashwa kancane udinga ukunakwa okukhethekile. Uhlelo luhlanganisa amaphrojekthi akhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi, ikakhulukazi kumasifundisane. Kulolu hlelo, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo efanele iyatholakala kubantu abampofu, kuhlanganisa nezinhlelo zokufundisa amakhono. Umxoxi: Lokhu kuhle kakhulu. Ngabe uhlelo luhlelwe kanjani ukuze luqinisekise ukuthi lusebenza kahle, futhi lubuyekezwa njalo? Mthembu: Uhlelo luzobuyekezwa njalo, futhi kukhona izigaba ezithile zokuhlola. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinkomba ezicacile zokusebenza ukuze sithole ukuthi imiphumela iyafinyelelwa yini. Izinhlaka ezahlukene zizosiza ekubuyekezweni nasekusebenzeni kahle komqondo. Umxoxi: Lolu hlelo lungaba namathuba amakhulu emiphakathini. Kukhona yini izinhlelo ezithile eziqondene nezokwakha? Mthembu: Yebo, izinhlelo zokwakha zibalulekile. Uhlelo luhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu, izikole, nezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, ukufunda, nokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okuyizinto eziyisisekelo kubantu.

uThabo Mbeki - Umholi Ohloniphekayo UThabo Mbeki ungumholi ophawulekayo kwezombusazwe eNingizimu Afrika, owabamba isikhundla sikaMengameli phakathi kweminyaka ka-1999 no-2008. Wazalelwa eMbizana, edolobheni eliseMpumalanga Kapa, ngomhla ziyi-18 kuMfumfu ngowe-1942. Uthando lwakhe kwezombusazwe lwaqala ngesikhathi esenhlangano eNyuvesi yaseTshwane, lapho athola khona ukuqonda okujulile ngezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokwehlukaniswa kwabantu. Lokhu kwehlukaniswa kwaba umthombo wezinkinga ezinkulu phakathi kwezakhamuzi ezahlukene. Njengomholi we-ANC (iAfrican National Congress), uThabo Mbeki wathatha izinyathelo ezibalulekile zokuvikela amalungelo abantu besifazane, edlala indima ebalulekile ekuphishekeni nasekukhululekeni. Umsebenzi wakhe wahlanganisa nokusekela uNelson Mandela, futhi waba yisikhumbuzo esinamandla ekuphikisaneni nobandlululo. Ukwaziswa kukaMbeki kwaba nomthelela omkhulu emhlabeni, njengoba waba nobudlelwano obuhle nezinye izizwe. Uhlanga lwakhe lokubambisana lwaholela ekwakheni izivumelwano ezithinta ubuchwepheshe, umnotho, nezokuhlalisana. Ngalesi sikhathi, uMbeki wahola izifundo eziningi zamazwe ase-Afrika, ethuthukisa umbono wokwakha umnotho oqinile nokuxhumanisa amazwe. Ngemva kokuphothulwa kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili njengomengameli, uThabo Mbeki wabhekana nezihe ezinzima. Iziphikiso ezivela emiphakathini mayelana nezinqumo zakhe, ikakhulukazi ezimayelana nezindaba zokusebenza kazwelonke, zakhumbuza abanye ukuthi uMbeki ungumholi ongenamahloni, ophikisana nezimvo zomphakathi.

Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. I-Operation Vulindlela ibuye ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani, uhulumeni ubonise ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlanganyelwe, ezihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi.

Zikhuthaza ukuvakashelwa kwezivakashi, okukhuthaza imboni yezokuvakasha. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, ukuphucula izinga lokuphila kwabantu, kanye nokwandisa umnotho. Izinhlangano ezahlukene, ezibandakanya uhulumeni, zisebenzisana nezinkampani zokuhamba ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi umkhakha wezindiza uthuthuka futhi ufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, izindiza zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuxhumaneni kwabantu, ekuthuthukiseni umnotho, nasekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zokuhamba. Noma kunezinselelo ezithile, ukukhula komkhakha wezindiza eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa ikusasa elikhanyayo. Ukuqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, izinkampani zokuhamba, kanye nezikhumulo zezindiza, kuzoqhubeka nokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezindawo, okuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi nasemnothweni. Izindiza zihlala ziwumgogodla wokuxhumana, futhi umkhakha wezindiza uzoba nendima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika.

Isinqumo sizoba khona ngokushesha okungenzeka, kodwa-ke ngezinye izimo ezinsukwini ezingama-30 zokuthola isikhalo sangaphakathi, kuncike kwezinye izinto ezithile ezishiwo esigabeni 77 soMthetho. Uma kungakaze kutholakale mpendulo ekupheleni kweikhathi, kufanele kwamukeleke ukuthi isikhalo sangaphakathi sichithiwe ngokomthetho. Uma isicelo sivunyiwe kodwa abantu abangaqondene ngqo nesicelo base befaka isikhalo, umuntu ocelayo uyonikezwa isaziso ngesinqumo. izizathu ezanele zesinqumo, zizocaphuna izinto ezihlinzekwa ngumthetho, kanye nesitatimende sokuthi izingxenye ezibandakanyekile zingafaka isicelo enkantolo sokuphikisana nesinqumo. Umuntu ocelayo noma abantu abangaqondene nalokhu abaphikisanayo bangafaka isicelo sosizo enkantolo esifanele ngemuva kokuba sebenze konke ngenqubo yesikhalo sangaphakathi. Izicelo kufanele zifakwe ezinsukwini ezingama-30 enkantolo enamandla omthetho okwenza lokho. Isicelo kufanele silandele inqubo eshiwo esigabeni 79 soMthetho. Lokhu kuzobandakanya, kokunye, incwadi yokufungela okulotshiwe, amakhophi ayiqiniso afakazisiwe ayo yonke imibhalo eyesekwayo kanye nesifungo sokuthi zonke izinqubo zesikhalo sangaphakathi ezishiwo esigabeni 74 sezisetshenziswe zonke. c enikeza ukwenqatshelwa ngokomthetho, usizo lwesikhashana noma olushiwo ngqo, umyalelo ofungayo nomaisinxephezelo; kanye d ekushoyo ukukhokhwa kwezindleko. Ngokwesigaba 15 soMthetho (uma ukhona) kudingeka ukuthi isaziso sishicilelwe kuleli bhukwana. Ngesikhathi sokushicilelwa kwaleli bhukwana, besingakabi bikho isaziso esinjalo esase sishicilelwe. nasenhlanganweni ngaphandle kwemali.

Izindlela zokuhlola Umsebenzi Wokubambisana ziqhubeka nokuhlinzeka ngenhloso yokwakha engxoxweni yezepolitiki eqhubekayo phakathi kwamazwe amabili ezingeni eliphezulu, esifundeni, nakwezinye izigaba. NgoDisemba, kwaba nokwabiwa kokonakala komhlaba, kubandakanya izinsiza zokumboza ama-robot ashiye izintambo zikagesi zivele. Izinto ezibucayi zezimboni kanye nezixube zezimboni ekwakhiweni, ukuhlanganiswa, ukusabalalisa, ukusetshenziswa, nokulahla zenza ubungozi empilweni yabantu nasemvelweni. Lapho ufaka emkhakheni, imbewu kumele ibe namanzi kodwa ingabi namanzi amaningi. Ababambiqhaza kulolu hlelo bazovunyelwa ukuhola izimali ezingeni elihle eminyakeni emithathu yohlelo. Lokhu bekungenye indlela yokwethula udaba olwenziwe ngamaphephandaba azimele, amaningi awo engamabhizinisi amakhulu, athuthukise imibono yabantu abamhlophe abafika lapha ukuze baphathe leli lizwe. Kubantu basePalestine, lokhu kusho ukusungula izimo zokugcina zokuletha ukuthula ezizobandakanya izindaba ezibalulekile kakhulu. Ukugeleza okuqondile kwamanzi abandayo phansi eziphethweni eziphezulu nezivunguvungwini ezinamandla, zitholakala entshonalanga naseningizimu naseNingizimu Afrika. Ngale ndlela, uhulumeni uqale ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezizinkulu ezihlanganyela nezobuciko bendawo. Lokhu kuyisizathu esibalulekile sokuthi amazwe ase-Afrika avumele iSivumelwano. Imakethe yaseTshwane iyindawo ehlukile lapho amanani ebekwe khona futhi lapho imifino nezithelo zithengiswa khona, kuzuza abakhiqizi, abathengi, nabathengisi.

Lokhu kuveza inkinga yokuthi abantu abaningi abakwazi ukufinyelela lesi sikhwama ngenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi noma izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphathwa kwesibonelelo kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi amafomu ahlanzekile, ukuhamba kwezimali kuhamba kahle, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyaziswa kahle. Ubululelwe bokuphatha buvame ukuba yinkinga, lapho imiphakathi ethile ibonwa ingatholi kahle ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nokuwa kokuthola imiphumela engafanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhamba kwesikhathi nesabelo sesikhwama seSocial Relief Grant kuveza umbuzo, "Ngabe sikhona isidingo sokuphinde sihlolisise le mibandela?" Le ngxoxo ibalulekile ngoba umphakathi kufanele uqhubeke uhlinzeka ngensizakalo ehambisana nezidingo zabo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele abheke kabusha imigomo yokufaneleka, futhi abheke izindlela zokuphathwa okungcono ukuze avumele abantu abaningi ukufinyelela kulezi zibonelelo. Nokho, kufanele sazi ukuthi lokhu kuzoba nezindleko ezihambisana nakho. Umphakathi uzodinga ukufaka imali eningi kuzo zonke izinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke nokusebenzisa. Nakuba ithonsi leSocial Relief Grant likhona, alikwazi ukwenziwa kabusha. Lesi sikhwama siphumelelayo emphakathini, njengoba singasebenza njengensizakalo esheshayo yokuhlinzeka ngosizo. Lokhu kuveza isidingo sokugxila ekwakheni izinhlelo ezizosiza lesi sikhwama, njengoba sizokwenza izinqumo ezibeka izidingo zabantu phambili. Futhi, ukugxila kwethu emiphumeleni yeSocial Relief Grant kubalulekile. Ubuwena bubalulekile, njengoba kuvele kudinga ukukhumbula ukuthi iGrant ithuthukisa izimo zabantu abathintekayo ngqo.

Njengoba izinsuku ziqhubeka, waqala ukuqonda ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akukhona nje kuphela ukugcina umntwana ephilile, kodwa kubandakanya nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, uZanele waqala ukubona izinguquko. USipho waqala ukujabulisa, ethokozisa abahlengikazi nabanye omama. Wawuqonda kahle umhlaba omjikelelayo, futhi uZanele wathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwakhe kumntwana kwakuyinsiza enkulu. Abahlengikazi bahlala bemkhuthaza, bemfundisa indlela yokuphatha izikhathi ezinzima, futhi benza kube lula ukuba abesifazane baphile kahle. Ukwazi ukuthi uSipho uyakhula, uZanele wathola ukuthi udinga ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lokunakekela. Waqopha izifundo azitholile, efunda ngezindlela ezahlukene zokukhulisa umntwana. Wafunda ukuthi ukunakekela umntwana kuqhubeka kuze kube sekupheleni. Waqonda ukuthi umama kufanele abe nesineke, athole usizo lapho kudingeka khona, futhi aqhubeke nokufunda. Ngesikhathi uZanele esebenza, wathola umphakathi obalulekile. Abanye omama bamthokozisa, bemxhasa ngezikhathi ezinzima. Kwakukhona izingxoxo ezijabulisayo, lapho behlanganyela izifundo zabo, izinkinga, nezixazululo. UZanele waba nesibindi sokukhuluma njengoba abanye abesifazane babebhekene nezinkinga ezifanayo. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, uZanele wathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kudinga ukuxhumana. Waqonda ukuthi umama nomntwana badinga ukuxhumana ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. UZanele wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana komzimba, njengokubamba, ukuxoxa, nokuhamba, kube yindlela yokwakha uthando phakathi kwakhe noSipho. Ekugcineni, uZanele waphuma esibhedlela, esebenzisa konke akufundile.

Umshadisi kufanele ngaleso sikhathi irejista kanye namarekhodi lawo akumbise kumphathi-hhovisi wakwahulumeni onikezwe umsebenzi wokurejista abantu kwindawo leyo akuyo. Kufanele kuthi lapho umgcini-hhovisi eyithola irejista okukhulunywa ngayo kwisigatshana 6 a ngokwemigomo yesigaba 8e yomThetho woKwazisa. Imiphumela eba khona kumshado iyo esebenzayo, okuwushintsho oluyisidingongqangi lapho kwakhiwe ubuhlobo obusemthethweni. a ngomshado kunoma yimuphi umthetho, okubandakanya nokumthetho wosiko ongabhaliwe kubandakanya, ngokoshintsho olungadingwa yisimo, ubuhlobo obusemthethweni njengokwencazelo yalo mThetho; futhi b umkhwenyana, unkosikazi kumbe oshadile kunoma yimuphi umthetho, okubala nokomthetho ongabhaliwe, kubandakanya ubuhlobo obusemthethweni njengokwencazelo yalo mThetho. c vikela okuyintshisekelo yabo bobabili ophathini basekhaya kanye nabanye abathintekayo lapho ubuhlobo bophathini buphela; futhi d kunquma kokugcina ngobudlelwano kwezezimali phakathi kophathini basekhaya naphakathi kophathini nabanye abathintekayo lapho ubuhlobo basekhaya buphela. Le sahluko sisebenza kubuhlobo obuphakathi kophathini naphakathi komunye wophathini kumbe bobabili kanye nomuntu noma abantu abaseceleni. Umuntu angaba uphathini wobuhlobo oburejistiwe obubodwa kuphela ngesikhathi. Njengobufakazi bokuthi umshado odlule sekuqediwe.

Ubulunga bakho baziwa kangakanani ngezingxenye ze-planter? Funda lokho okukhuluma lapha ukuze uthuthukise ulwazi lwakho ngama-component e-planter. Zonke izingxenye zikhonjiswa futhi imisebenzi yazo ichaziwe. Le yindawo lapho ingxenye ye-planter ixhunywe khona, futhi ihluke kulapho i-planter izoxhunywa khona ku-tractor. Lezi yizinto ezibhekana nezitshalo nez fertiliser. Zenziwe ngopulasitiki oqinile noma zakhiwe ngensimbi. Lezi zingaba yizinyawo ezihamba phezu kwe-planter. Le nyawo iqhutshwa uma ixhumana nomhlaba njengoba i-planter idonswa. Le nyawo ihamba ngendlela efanayo ne-tractor. Umsebenzi wale nyawo uwukusebenzisa zonke ezinye izingxenye ze-planter - izinto ezithumele izinga lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Ukuze ukwazi ukukala isivinini sezingxenye ezithumele izitshalo nez fertiliser, kukhona uhlelo lweziqhumane nezikhala ezisebenzayo. Konke lokhu kungahlanganiswa ngendlela ehlinzeka ngenani elifanele lezitshalo nez fertiliser. Kukhona ama-plates ahlukene ahambelana nezinhlobo zezithombo nezilinganiso zazo (asikhulumi lapha ngama-planters asebenzisa umoya ukuhlinzeka ngezithombo). Lezi ngokuvamile zikhona phambili kwe-planter futhi zihlala zikhona kulawo ma-planters asetshenziswa ezimweni zokungafaki umhlabathi ngoba kunezinhlobo eziningi phezulu komhlabathi. Lezi zifaka izitshalo nez fertiliser emhlabathini. Umcimbi omkhulu walesi sikhathi wenzeka eGoli, lapho izikhulu zikamasipala, abamele izinkampani, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi behlangana ukuze baxoxe ngalezi zinguquko. Abamele izinkampani baphakamisa iziphakamiso zokuthi izinguquko zomthetho zingasiza kanjani ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, kanti abamele izakhamizi bagcizelela ukuthi imithetho kufanele ibheke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zempilo.

Ukuhlanganisa nokuhlela umphakathi esigabeni ukuba wenze okuthile ukulwisa ubugebengu bendawo bebonke. Ukuba ngumxhumanisi phakathi komphakathi wesigaba kanye nesiteshi samaphoyisa sendawo. Ukuba abe njenge-ofisa yokuvikela ubugebengu, obuphathelene nokuba nesibopho sazo zonke izinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi ukubhekana nobugebengu esigabeni. ukuxoxisana ngezinhlelo zokuzokwenziwa nomphathi wesigaba ukuze kubhekwane nobugebengu esigabeni. Ukumisa nokubamba iqhaza ezehlakalweni zendawo yomakhelwane ukugcina kuphephile indawo abahlala kuyo. Ukunikeza ulwazi neziphakamiso zokuvikela ubugebengu esigabeni. Ukweseka ngomdlandla isigaba sokuphoyisa samavolontiya ezigabeni. Bamba iqhaza ngokuxhumana nomphathi wakho wesigaba, ukuze wenze indawo yakho yokuhlala iphephe. Kubizwa osomabhizinisi bendawo, amabandla, izinhlangano zabahlali kanye nabaholi bomphakathi ukubamba iqhaza emizamweni yokubhekana nezimpawu ezifake okuthile ebugebengwini esigabeni sakho. I-NAFVSA inoHlangothi Lokusiza umphakathi, oluhlinzeka zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi lezo ezibuya emiphakathini ebikhishwe inyumbazana ngaphambilini ngolwazi nezidingo.

E-Cabinet Lekgotla kaJanuwari 2001, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi esikhathini esizayo, izinsiza zamasiko ezifana nezandla, umculo, nezinkonzo, kanye nezithombe, zizofakwa ezinhlelweni zomnotho ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuthuthukiswa/ukukhula nokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi. Ukuze kusizakale le nhlelo, kufanele kwenziwe ukuhlola okufanele nokuhlola (isibonelo, ukubheka phambili) ngokubambisana neNational Advisory Council for Development. Ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi ibhajethi eyinhloko yonyaka ye-R2.5 billion kufanele ibe okungenani kabili eminyakeni eyishumi ezayo. (Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi ayihambisani naleyo yeziqukathi ezizimele).

Ngonyaka ka1994, umthethosisekelo omusha wabeka ilungelo lemvelo njengelungelo-nqangi ebantwini. Uma umthetho uthi into iyilungelo-nqangi kuchaza ukuthi konke okwenziwa wuhulumeni kumele kuhambisane nalokho okubalulwa yilelo lungelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa umthetho imithetho eshaywayo nezinyathelo ezithathwayo. Abantu ngabanye, kuhlangene nezakhamuzi, izinkampani kanye nososeshini kumele benze ngokulandela ilungelo. Inkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ingabeka eceleni umthetho oshayisana nalelilungelo kanti nezinkantolo zingabeka eceleni izenzo zikahulumeni noma zomphakathi lapho kwephulwa lomthetho. Ukubeka eceleni kuchaza ukungashayi ndiva noma ukuguqula. Ilungelo-nqangi emvelweni lithi wonke umuntu unelungelo kuleyomvelo engeyona ingozi empilweni noma kwinhlalonhle. Libuye lithi uhulumeni kufanele enze izinto ezinomqondo nezilindelekile ukuvikela imvelo njengokuvimbela ukunukubezeka komoya, ukugqugquzela ukongiwa kwemvelo, intuthuko eqhubekayo kube kwakhiwa umphakathi nomnotho. Ngaphandle komthethosisekelo, kuneminye imithetho eminingi evikela imvelo njengalowo wokonga imvelo, umthetho wamanzi, umthetho wokunukubezwa komoya. Lemithetho isivikela ezintweni eziningi ezingalimaza imvelo. Noma ngabe awukho umthetho ovikela ingxenye ethile yezemvelo, kodwa kuhlale kukhona ilungelo elisemthethweni-sisekelo ongalisebenzisa ukuvikela impilo yakho nenhlalonhle nokuqikelela ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu baziphatha ngendlela efanele ukuvikela imvelo. INEMA wumthetho osemusha nokusiza ukuba ukwazi ukuvikela kangcono amalungelo akho ezemvelo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokudalwa kwemigomo yemvelo ebonisa uhulumeni ukuthi kufanele enzeni.

Udaba lungafingqwa ngaphansi kwezihloko ezifana nomnotho, imvelo noma inhlalonhle (Qhathanisa Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /4a). Ikomidi eNgamele I-IDP kumele iqagule izihloko okuyokhulunywa ngazo embuthanweni wokufunda. Abeluleki abanolwazi kumele bamenyelwe ukwenza amalungiselelo, ukugqugquzela nokubhala lokho okwenzeka ezifundweni. Omasipala bemikhakha A no C kanjalo abakhulu nabanezinsiza ezithuthukile bangenza izifundo zokuhlaziya imvelo, umnotho, inhlalonhle nesikhungo njengengxenye yeSigaba sokuHlaziya inqubo yeIDP noma babenamandla okusebenzisa izifundo eziqhubekayo. Izifunda kumele ziqhube ukuhlaziya umnotho nemvelo nokuyinto eyophelela esifundeni nengahlomulisa bonke abanye omasipala endaweni (bona 1 /4a -c). omasipala abancane nabentula izinsiza kufanele bazame ngakho konke okusemandleni ukusebenzisa ulwazi olukhona nabaluzuze empilweni kanjalo nosizo lochwepheshe abakwazi ukuqagela izinto ezithile. Izinsuku ezine (kwenzeka ngesikhathi esisodwa nomsebenzi wokuhlela - 1 /2). Amalungiselelo okuhlela ukuhlaziya ezomnotho kwenziwa ngaphandle kokuhamba nokuba izifundo. Omasipala abaningi ngeke babenamandla okwenza ucwaningo lwezomnotho nokuthola ulwazi olwengeziwe njengengxenye yenqubo ye-IDP. Uma kunesidingo esiphuthumayo sokuthola eminye imininingwane nokuhlaziya okujulile, umasipala wendawo angahlangana nowesifunda baqale uhlaziyo olusabalale isifunda. Loluhlaziyo bangalwenzela udaba lwezomnotho nolubathinta bonke (makwenziwe njengengxenye yoMsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /9). Yenza abantu abathintekayo, ochwephweshe neSigungu sabaMmeli boMphakathi babe yingxenye yohlelo.

Valela imishini enomsindo ngezinto ezehlisa umsindo noma uyifake endlini yayo yodwa. Lapho umsindo ufika ku90 dB noma ngaphezulu, beka izimpawu ezikhombisa ukuthi lena "yindawo okumele kuvikelwe amadlebe kuyo" ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu abangena khona bayazivikela. Ukuhlale usebenzisa amathuluzi angqangqazelayo njengobhemubhemu, nezinto zokusika kungaholela esifweni sokungqangqazela komunwe, umuzwa noma umsipha. Izimpawu zokuxwayisa zibandakanya ukukitazeka eminweni, iminwe ingajika ibe mhlophe, kulandelwe ukuqaqamba nokubheja ibe bomvu. Ukushayela ogandaganda nemishini ezishintshayo kungabeka umzimba esimweni sokungqangqazela okungaholela ekuphathweni yiqolo noma ubuhlungu enqulwini nasedolweni. Izimpawu zokwexwayisa zifaka ubuhlungu nokuqina kweqolo emva kokusebenza ngogandaganda. Sebenzisa imishini efanele umsebenzi. Lungisa imishini ngendlela efanele isib. faka izinsimbi ezivimbela ukungqangqazela kobhemubhemu. Ukuvikela ukulimala imizwa, imisipha namathambo ezandleni nasezingalweni okudalwa wukungqangqazela. Hlela umsebenzi ngendlela ozokwazi ukugwema ukusebenzisa amathuluzi angqangqazelayo. Khetha amathuluzi angqangqazela kancane. Fudumeza izandla ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi bese uzigcina zifudumele. Ukuba sesimweni sezulu esingesihle, njengelanga elibalele noma amakhaza amakhulu kungalimaza. Uma ilanga libalele gqoka izimpahla ezilula nesigqoko esinompheme omkhulu. Ungabi nqunu, faka ukhilimu ovikela ukuhlaba kwelanga esikhunjeni. Bheka izinsumpa nokujika kwesikhumba. Bonana nodokotela uma izinsumpa njll, zikhula, zopha noma ziluma.

Umthetho Wezikole WaseNingizimu Afrika umthetho oshoyo ukuthi kufanele kwenzekeni ezikoleni zethu. Lo mthetho awukuvumeli ukuthi izingane zishaywe ezikoleni. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kubonakala njengesijeziso esinonya nesingenabuntu esilimaza isithunzi sobuntu ezinganeni. Uyavumelana nalokhu Ucabanga ukuthi kufanele zijeziswe kanjani izingane uma ziziphatha kabi? Ohulumeni kufanele bakhuthaze ukuhlanganyela kwamazwe omhlaba emfundweni. Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi umhlaba usebenze ndawonye ukusiza wonke umuntu ukuthi afunde futhi afunde ngezinto ezibalulekile njengesayensi nobuchwepheshe kanye nezindlela zesimanje zokufundisa. Ohulumeni bayavuma ukuthi ingane kumele ifunde ngalezi zinto ezilandelayo. Imfundo kufanele yenze okuhle kakhulu ngobuntu bezingane, amathalente kanye namandla omqondo nomzimba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ngemfundo elungile ungakwazi ukuzenza umuntu ongcono kakhulu futhi usebenzise onke amathalente akho namandla akho ngokuphelele. Njengedayimane elimbiwe enhlabathini, ungapholishwa bese uyacwebezela ube itshe eliyigugu. Cabanga ngokuthi ungubani nokuthi yini okwazi ukuyenza kahle nokuthi imfundo ingakusiza kanjani ukuthi usebenzise la mathalente ngokugcwele. Imfundo kufanele ithuthukise inhlonipho yezingane yamalungelo omuntu kanye nenkululeko nalokho inhlangano yezizwe ekukholwayo. Imfundo ikusiza ukuthi ufunde ukuhlonipha umndeni wabantu sonke esingena ngaphansi kwawo. Imithetho yalowo mndeni ukuthi onke amazwe nabantu kufanele bahlale ngobungane, uxolo kanye nokuqonda. Imfundo kufanele ithuthukise inhlonipho yezingane kubazali bazo, ukwazi amasiko, ulimi namagugu, amagugu esizwe ezwe lapho ingane ihlala khona kanye nezwe evela kulo.

Ezimeni ezidumaza kakhulu, isizathu sokwahlukanisa kungaba ukuthi uhulumeni uvalele ngaphandle kwesigwebo, ubophe, udingise, noma ubuyisele ezweni lakubo noma mhlawumbe ubulele umzali oyedwa noma abazali bengane bobabili. Ezimeni ezinjalo uhulumeni kufanele anikeze abazali kanye nengane ulwazi ngomunye nomunye ngaphandle uma ngabe lokho kuzoyilimaza ingane. Ukucela ulwazi akufanele kubange ingozi kunoma yiliphi ilungu lomndeni. Ake uzame ukucabanga ukuthi kufanele kube njani lokhu. Mhlawumbe kufanele ubhale indaba ngengane abazali bayo abafakwa ejele ngesikhathi sempi nokuthi ingane yaya kanjani ukuyobuza kuhulumeni ukuthi ngabe babe bekuphi. Le ngane yayazi ukuthi Isivumelwano sasithi inelungelo kulolu lwazi. Ingabe yaluthola ulwazi Ingabe yabathola abazli bayo? Uma ingane kanye nabazali bayo besemazweni ahlukene kodwa befuna ukuhlangana njengomndeni, ohulumeni bobabili kufanele benze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyenzeka lokhu masinyane nangendlela elunge kakhulu enokwenzeka. Ingane abazali bayo abahlala emazweni ahlukene kufanele ibe nelungelo lokubona abazali bayo bobabili njalo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ohulumeni bala mazwe kufanele bahloniphe ilungelo lengane nelabazali lokuvakashelana. Ohulumeni kufanele benze konke okusemandleni abangakwenza ukuvimbela ukuthathwa kwezingane zikhishwe ezweni ezihlala kulo ngokungemthetho futhi zingabe zisabuyiswa. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ohulumeni kumele bavumelane ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi, uma izingane zithathwe ngale ndlela, zizobuyiswa ngokushesha. Uhlobo lwale nto lungenzeka uma ngabe omunye umzali efuna ukuthatha ingane komunye umzali noma ngabe inkantolo ithe angamthathi. Lokhu kufana nokweba ingane.

Ngaphandle uma kubekiwe kule sigaba, isicelo esifakiwe enkantolo sokuthi kukhishwe isinqumo ngaphansi kwale Sahluko kufanele senziwe ingakapheli iminyaka emibili kusukela ukufa kubuqedile ubuhlobo oburejistiwe. Noma yingasiphi isikhathi, emveni kokudlula kwesikhathi okukhulunwa ngaso kwisigatshana 1, inkantolo ingasivumela isicelo ngaphansi kwale Sahluko, uma yaneliseka kuzo zonke izinto, ukuthi umkhalazi uzobhekana nobunzima obukhulu kakhulu uma singamukeleki isicelo sakhe kunalobo azobhekana nabo okuwuye isicelo nesinqumo senkantolo esizobe sibhekiswe kuye. Noma imuphi umgcini-hhovisi osingatha umcimbi wobuhlobo ebe engenalo igunya ngaphansi kwalo mThetho kumbe uma enolwazi lokuthi ophathini abuvumelekile emthethweni ukuhlanganiswa, futhi noma ubani othi engesiyena umgcini-hhovisi ongumshadisi kepha asingathe umcimbi owakha ubuhlobo, uyobekwa icala uma limlahla agwetshwe inhlawulo yemali, uma engayikhokhi, aboshwe isikhathi esingeqile kwizinyanga eziyishumi nambili. Umgcini-hhovisi ongumshadisi ofuna kumbe owemukela inkokhelo, isipho kumbe umklomelo ngenxa yanoma yini ayenzile njengomgcini-hhovisi ongumshadisi ngokwalo mThetho uyobekwa icala uma limlahla agwetshwe inhlawulo yemali, uma engayikhokhi, aboshwe isikhathi esingeqile kwizinyanga eziyisithupha.

IKomidi Lezinsizakalo Zobulungiswa liqukethe amaKomishina angama-25 (kuhlanganisa noMongameli noMphakathi) kanye noSekela. Uma udaba oluthinta iZigaba Eziphezulu luphathwa, uJaji Omkhulu waleyo Nkantolo kanye noMphakathi ofanelekile noma abathunyelwe babo bayabandakanywa. Uma inani labantu abafakizicelo besuka ezikhungweni zokwakha umthetho noma emkhakheni wezomthetho ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1 e noma f lingama-vacancies okufanele zigcwaliswe, uMongameli kufanele abakhethe. Uma inani labafakizicelo lidlula ama-vacancies okufanele zigcwaliswe, uMongameli, ngokuxhumana nomkhakha ofanele, uzokhetha inani elifanele lamagama aphakanyiswe ukuze agcwaliswe ama-vacancies ngemuva kokucabangela isimo sokuthi wonke imikhakha ibonakale. Amalungu eKomidi athunywe nguMphakathi Wasezindaweni Zikazwelonke asebenza kuze kube baphathwa ndawonye noma uma kwenzeka enye i-vacancy emkhakheni ophakanyisiwe. Amanye amalungu athunywe noma akhethwe yiKomidi asebenza kuze kube baphathwa yilabo abababekela noma abababekela. Isikhathi sokusebenza kwamanye amalungu eKomidi, uMphakathi, kanye nama-vacancies. Uma ilunga elithile lishiya isikhundla sawo ngokuhambisa isicelo esibhaliwe sokwazisa ngenyanga eyodwa kuMongameli. Ilunga leKomidi elithunywe ngale ndlela ngaphansi kwesigaba-178 1 e, f, g, h, kanye i yeMthethosisekelo lizoshiywa isikhundla sawo ngokushesha uma iziqu zawo zemfundo zingasasebenzi ukufakazela isikhundla ababeqashwe kuso.

Inqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo Ngonyaka ka-1994, emuva kokhetho lokuqala elivulekile, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika wawubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu. Lo nyaka wawufanekisela ukubuyiselwa kwezinto, kodwa futhi wawubeka phambili nesidingo sokuchibiyela emthethosisekelo wamaNgisi. Ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kulolu shintsho kwaba yigugu elikhulu. Lokhu kwavula amathuba wokuthi abantu bangenelele ngezwi labo emibuzweni ebalulekile ebhekene nezwe. Ngemuva kokukhululwa kukaNelson Mandela, indawo yokuxhumana phakathi komphakathi neziphathimandla yaguquka kakhulu. Uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza kwemiphakathi lwasungulwa ngokuhambisana nosuku olunqamukile, lapho kwabekwa umgomo wokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo nesithemiso esihle. Lokhu kwavula indlela yokwazisa abantu bengabathathi, bakhulume ngezinto ezibucayi ezibalulekile empilweni yabo. Ngesikhathi sokubambisana phakathi kwezifundazwe, abaklami bezinhlelo besebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene ukuze babambe iqhaza emphakathini. Izinkulumo, imihlangano, nezibopho zokuhlanganyela zabe zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bakhulume ngempumelelo yezehlakalo ezithinta impilo yabo. Umsebenzi wemiphakathi owawuhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene zomphakathi, uthintekayo empilweni nasemphakathini, waba yisixazululo esikhaliphile sokukhulisa izwi elibushelelezi. Uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza kwathiwa "Iyasebenza" lenza izinyathelo eziyinqaba. Lokhu kwavumela abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene ukuba basize ekuhleleni imigomo namagugu ezobulungiswa kumthetho. Empeleni, umphakathi waba ngumsebenzi ongokwayo, umbono ophakeme wokukwazi ukusebenzisa izinkanyezi zawo kokwazisa lokuthuthukiswa.

Ukugcwalisa kuwukwenza komuntu onebhizinisi lokuhamba usebenzisa umgwaqo, umshayeli noma umgibeli, ukudlula umkhawulo wezimpahla ezisemthethweni zemoto, kungaba ngenhloso noma ngengozi. Ukugcwalisa nezimpahla ezingalungile kuholela ekufeni nasekukhathazekeni emigwaqweni yethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo ofika kumamili ama-rand emigwaqweni nasezimotweni ezigcwele. Imoto egcwele ithatha isikhathi eside ukumisa uma kwenzeka ukuphuthuma. Uma ufuna ukuhamba ukuze ugweme ingozi, isikhathi sokwenza lokho sandele ngenxa yokugcwalisa. Kunzima ukulawula imoto egcwele futhi ngeke ukwazi ukwandisa kalula njengoba ungakwenza emoto ejwayelekile, okwenza kube yingozi ukudlula ezinye izimoto. Amathayi emoto egcwele afudumala futhi abe bushelelezi - lokhu kungabangela ukuthi amathayi aphuke. Ukugcwalisa kubangela ukuthi imoto yakho ibhujiswe, okwenza kube nzima kuwe ukubona izimbobo noma ezinye izithiyo emgwaqweni. Ukugcwalisa kubangela umonakalo emgwaqweni ngakho ungase ujeziswe kakhulu. Abantu abaningi bathuthwa emsebenzini noma ezindaweni ezahlukene behlezi ngemuva kwezithuthi nezivharo ezivulekile nsuku zonke - behlezi phezu kwezimpahla. Abanakho izikhwama zokuhlala, abanakho izihlalo nhlobo. Ngaphandle kokuthi lokhu kuthinta kakhulu inani eliphezulu lempilo nezingozi emigwaqweni yethu. Umthetho 247 uthi abantu bangathuthwa kuphela ngemuva kwemoto yezimpahla uma le ndawo abahamba kuyo ivikelwe ngezinto eziqinile ukuze ivimbele ukuwa kwabo. Abashayeli bezinhlaka nezithuthi bavame ukugcwalisa izimoto zabo. Sivame ukuzwa ezindabeni "I-taxi noma ibhasi elalilodwa eligcwele libe nengxabano".

Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuzibandakanya ngokukhululeka. nokukhankasela iqembu lezombangazo noma izinjongo ezithile zepolitiki. Yileso naleso sakhamuzi sinelungelo lokuthi kubekhona ukhetho olukhululekile nolubanjwa njalo ngezikhathi ezimisiwe lwanoma yisiphi isakhiwo sesishayamthetho esisungulwe ngokulandela umthethosisekelo. lokungenela ukhetho lwesikhundla sokumela umphakathi kuthi uma sikhethiwe, sithathe leso sikhundla. Asikho isakhamuzi okufanele sincishwe ilungelo laso lobuzwe. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuhamba. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokushiya iRiphabhuliki. Yileso naleso sakhamuzi sinelungelo lokungena, nokuhlala noma kuyiphi indawo eRiphabhuliki. Yileso naleso sakhamuzi sinelungelo lokuthola iphasiphothi. Yileso naleso sakhamuzi sinelungelo lokukhetha ngokukhululeka uhwebo, umsebenzi noma iprofeshini. Indlela yokuqhuba nokuphatha uhwebo umsebenzi noma iprofeshini ingahlelwa ngumthetho. Yilowo nalowo muntu unelungelo lokuphathwa ngendlela efanele emsebenzini. lokuxoxisana ngokuhlanganyela; futhi lokusungula nokujoyina imifelandawonye. Zonke izinyunyane zabasebenzi, izinhlangano zabaqashi kanye nomqashi zinelungelo lokuvumelana ngokuhlanganyela. Umthetho kazwelonke ungamiswa ukulawula isivumelwano esihlanganyelwe. Esimweni lapho umthetho unganciphisa ilungelo kulesi sahluko, ukuncishiswa kwelungelo makuhambisane nesigaba 36(l). Umthetho kazwelonke ungagunyaza ukuhlelelwa ezokuphepha enyunyanini okungavunyelwana ngakho ngokuhlanganyela. Esimweni lapho umthetho unganciphisa ilungelo kulesi sahluko, ukuncishiswa kwelungelo makuhambisane nesigaba 36 (1).

Ukukhanda isisekelo sokuthuthukiswa kwemikhandlu yezokuhwebelana namanye amazwe ezimbonini ezithintana namasiko. Ukuxhasa inhlangano kazwelonke ebhekene nokuthuthukiswa nemisebenzi yezandla. Ukwenza ucwaningo oluhlanganisa ukushicilelwa kwencwajana yabantu abenza imisebenzi yezandla, ukwenza ucwaningo ekwakheni ubuhlalu obuyingilazi kanye nomthelela obekhona ngenxa yesonto lezomculo waseNingizimu Afrika. Umnyango uye wanweba umbono we-CIGS ukuze kuhlanganise amaqhinga okubambisana ezweni lonke ukuze kukwazi ukusebenzisana neminyango ehlukene kaHulumeni njengalezizinhlelo ezilandelyo. Ukuvuselelwa kwamadolobha ngezobuciko. ukwaluleka kunomangabe isiphi isinyathelo esingathathwa ekuthuthukiseni imboni yomculo. Ngonyaka ka-2000 I-DACST yabelwa imali okokuqala neyayiphuma ohlelweni lokuqedwa kobuphofu/ kwendlala ngumphathi sikhwama kazwelonke. Kunomqondo ohlumayo eNingizimu Africa kanye nakuwo wonke umhlaba, wokuthi amasiko angadlala indima ebucayi /ebalulekile entuthukweni ekwakheni amagugu ayohlala njalo, ayogqugquzela izimboni zamasiko noma ebheke iqhaza isiko elinalo ekuchazeni ubuthina futhi kusinikeze amandla. Isiko linamadla okuthuthukisa izinto umphakathi oziqhayisayo ngazo futhi ithuthukise nokubambisana emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Isiko liyimboni ehlanzekile. Ukwaka amathuba emisebenzi eyandisa imali futhi ayipheli. Isiko linamadla okuthuthukisa imiphakathi enempilo. Izihlelo eziqhakambisa ubuciko bendabuko obunhlobonhlobo. Izinhlelo ezinikeza ukuqeqeshwa kwamabhizinisi kulabo abenza umsebenzi wamasiko.

Ukakhiwa Kwezindlu ze-RDP Ingxenye 1: Isingeniso Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP (Reconstruction and Development Programme) kube yinsakavukela ezweni lethu, njengoba izinsuku zikhula zihlala zihlaba umxhwele. I-RDP yenzelwe ukuthuthukisa impilo yabantu abahluphekayo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya nasemadolobheni amancane. Ngicela ukwazi, ngabe ungabala izinselele ezitholakala ekwakhiweni kwezi zindlu, nokuthi lokhu kudlula kanjani umqondo wempilo yabantu? Ingxenye 2: Ukuqala Kwesikhala Sichaza Uhlanga Sizisho njalo ukuthi umqondo wokwakha izindlu ezithuthukisiwe uqala kuleli zinga eliyinkimbinkimbi, lapho kudingeka ukuthi kubhekwe izidingo zomphakathi. Yini eyenza lezi zindlu zafaneleka kubantu, ikakhulukazi lezi ezibhalwe ku-RDP? Njengoba sixoxa, kufanele sikhumbule amandla nemikhawulo yalesi sikhala. Abantu abasha nabadala bahlala benelungelo lokuphila kahle, kodwa izinselele eziningi zikhona. Ingxenye 3: Inqubo Yokwakha Uma sithinta inqubo yokwakha, sigxila ezintweni ezibalulekile ezifana nemigomo, izithiyo, nokwakheka kwalesi sikhala. Uhlelo lwe-RDP lusebenza ngendlela ethile, kuhilela ukuthi izindlu zikhishwe kusukela ekuhloleni indawo, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, nokuhlinzeka ngemali. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi uma ubuhlobo phakathi kwezakhamuzi nosomabhizinisi buhle, akukwazi ukungabikho kwezinto ezixhasayo. Ingxenye 4: Ukubambisana Komphakathi Abantu basebenzisa kanjani amakhono abo ukuze basebenze ndawonye? Kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi imiphakathi iyakwazi kanjani ukubambisana ukuze ibuyisele amandla kulesi sikhala. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza nezinsizakusebenza kusiza ekwakheni udumo nolwazi, okwenza ukuba kube neqhaza elikhulu.

Imidlalo Yeshashalazi: Indaba Yomlando Imidlalo yeshashalazi, noma i-theatre, ingenye yezindlela ezidumile zokudlulisa izindaba, imizwa, nezifundo emphakathini. Ukuze siqonde kahle imvelaphi yalesi siko, kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi imidlalo yeshashalazi iqale kanjani, yakhula kanjani, futhi yaba yinsiza yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Imidlalo yeshashalazi inezimpande ezijulile emlandweni, ikakhulukazi eGreece lasendulo. Ngonyaka ka-534 BCE, uThespis, umqambi wezinkanyezi, waba ngumuntu wokuqala ophakamisa umqondo wokudlala, lapho abelaphi bezinkanyezi bahlala phansi besebenzisa izinkulumo ezibhalwe phansi, benza izigcawu ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wokudalwa kwemidlalo yeshashalazi, okwakuhlanganisa izinkanyezi, ababhali, nababukeli. Ngalesi sikhathi, imidlalo yayihlanganisa izinkulumo ezinzulu ezikhuluma ngezinto ezifana nobuhlungu, uthando, nezimfihlo zempilo. Ngemuva kwalokho, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathuthuka yaba yinsiza ebalulekile yokuxhumana. E-Greece, imidlalo yayidayiswa ezindaweni ezinkulu, ezaziwa ngama-theatre, lapho ababhali abanjengoSophocles, Euripides, noAristophanes bezama ukukhuluma ngezinkinga zomphakathi, imithetho, nobuhlakani. Ngalesi sikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yayihlanganisa izigcawu ezinjengokuhlola izimo zomphakathi, izinkinga zempilo, nezifundo ezithile ezazithinta abantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imidlalo yeshashalazi yafika eRoma, lapho izinkanyezi zashintsha izindlela zokudlala. E-Roma, imidlalo yeshashalazi yathola umoya omusha, yahluka ngokwengeziwe, futhi yathokozisa izithameli ngezinto ezihambisana nezokuzijabulisa.

Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi kuyigama elaziwa emhlabeni jikelele. Yini "ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni"? Ukubhaliswa okusemthethweni kuyisibopho somthetho sabashicileli bazo zonke izinhlobo zeziphakamiso ukufaka inani elithile lezi zikhumbuzo ezindaweni ezithile lapho lezi zikhumbuzo zibhaliswe khona ngokusemthethweni. Izincwadi kumele zithunyelwe ezindaweni ezibekwe ngokusemthethweni ngezindleko zomshicileli, futhi lokhu kumele kwenziwe ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziyi-14 zokushicilelwa. Inhloso yokubhaliswa okusemthethweni kwezincwadi ukuqoqa, ukugcina, nokwenza kube khona ulwazi nolwazi lwamasiko ezizweni, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela mahhala kuzo zonke izincwadi ezitholakalayo. Umthetho ophathelene nalokhu wakhululwa nguMthetho Wamalungelo Okushicilela ka-1965 kanye noMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni ka-1982, kuze kube umthetho wamanje, uMthetho Wokufaka Okusemthethweni washicilelwa ngo-1997, okukhuluma ngokufakwa kwezincwadi zedijithali nezo ezihambisana nomsindo. Iziphakamiso ziwumkhiqizo noma iyiphi impahla ehlose ukugcina noma ukudlulisa umyalezo ngombhalo, isithombe, umsindo, noma iyiphi indlela yokuxhumana enokuqukethwe okucabangekayo. Yini okufanele ifakwe? Amakhadi ezinkampani noma ama-check. Iqinisekisa ukufinyelela kuzo zonke izincwadi ezishicilelwe eNingizimu Afrika. Iyi-pillar eyodwa yolwazi olukhululekile. Iyi-rekhodi yezincwadi zonke ezikhiqizwe yizwe. Iqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yezisebenzi ezishicilelwe igcinwa futhi itholakala ukuze ibolekwe. Igcina umsebenzi wababhali nabashicileli ukuze usebenze ngocwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo.
