UDokotela Kobus Laubscher uqokwe njengomphakathi omusha weGrain SA oqala ngoJanuwari 1, 2008. Okwamanje, uDokotela Laubscher usebenza eNyuvesi yaseFree State. Unolwazi lwezinkambu ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi kwezomnotho wezolimo, futhi unolwazi olunzulu oluhambelana nezindawo zasemakhaya, izifundazwe, kanye nezwe ekubhekaneni nezinkinga zebhizinisi lezolimo; ungumhloli futhi uphinde afundise. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika, uphinde usebenze namabhizinisi ezolimo eNamibia naseBotswana. UDokotela Laubscher ungum member we-International Food and Agriculture Management Association (IAMA). Unolwazi lokuphatha amabhizinisi omnotho. Muva nje, uqokwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi ukuphatha iNational Productivity Institute (NPI) yaseNingizimu Afrika, lapho engumsekeli wezolimo. Phambilini, ubeyilungu lebhodi yeNyuvesi yaseFree State njengommeleli okhethwe ngabaxhasi bokusiza. UDokotela Laubscher ushade noAnnemarie, futhi banamadodana amabili nendodana eyodwa.

Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuxhaseni izikhungo zezempilo. Uma abantu bephumelela ekuxhaseni izikhungo, izikhungo zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma umphakathi ubambisene, impilo iyathuthuka. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bangasiza kanjani izikhungo zezempilo. Kukhona futhi izinhlelo ezihlinzekwa izikhungo zezempilo ezithile, ezifana nezinhlelo zokuhlola impilo, ezokwelapha izifo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo. Lezi zinhlelo zibalulekile, ngoba ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zihlala ziqhuba izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo, ezifana nezinhlelo zokudla okunempilo, ezokuzivocavoca, nokunye okuningi. Ngokuphetha, izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yethu. Zihlinzeka ngempilo, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, futhi zisebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlelo zempilo zomphakathi. Kodwa-ke, zikhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nazo, futhi umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuxhaseni izikhungo. Ngakho, kufanele siqhubeke sikhuthaza izikhungo zezempilo, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu. Ngiyabonga ngokungilalela, mngani! Ngiyethemba ukuthi uthole ulwazi oluningi ngalezi zikhungo ezibalulekile. Impilo iyinsika, futhi kumele sithi "yebo" ekuthuthukiseni impilo yethu kanye neyezizukulwane ezizayo. Hamba kahle!

Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezizimele zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okwakusiza abantu ukuba baphile ngaphandle kokuncika kuphela kumphakathi. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esihle, kodwa umphakathi wawusadinga isikhathi ukuze ubuyisele emuva umnotho. Ngesikhathi sokugcina, umphakathi uqhubeka nokufunda ngezifundo ezitholakele. I-load shedding yakhombisa ukuthi umnotho awungaphumeleli uma izinsiza zingaphathwa kahle. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni abantu baziqhenye ngezindlela zokuphila ezihlakaniphile, futhi baqonde ukubaluleka kokuba nezinhlelo ezizinzile zokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi uqhubeka nokwenza izinyathelo ezihlukahlukene ukuze ubhekane ne-load shedding. Kukhona ukuzimisela okukhulu phakathi kwabantu, okukhombisa ukuthi, nakuba izinkinga zikhona, umphakathi unamandla okuphendula. Umnotho, nakuba ubhekene nezinkinga, uqhubeka nokukhula, futhi abantu baqhubeka nokufuna izixazululo ezihlakaniphile. Ngakho-ke, i-load shedding ibonisa ukuthi umnotho awukwazi ukuhamba phambili uma izinsiza zingaphathwa kahle. Kodwa futhi ibonisa amandla abantu, ukuthi bangakwazi ukuphendula ezinkingeni, futhi baphile kahle, naphezu kwezithiyo ezibhekene nabo. Lokhu kwenza umphakathi uqhubeke nokukhula, futhi ubheke phambili, ungavumeli izinkinga ziwuphazamise. I-Load shedding, nakuba iyinkinga enkulu, iyisifundo esibalulekile kumphakathi, esifundisa ukubaluleka kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza, nokuthi umphakathi unamandla okuphendula ezinkingeni.

Kumele bazise zonke izigaba ezithintekayo kulolu daba ngamadokhumenti athunyelwe kule nkantolo abhekiswe esigabeni (a). Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo ezokulalela udaba itholile amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni (8)(a), le nkantolo kumele ikhiphe isikhumbuzo esibhaliwe esazisa zonke izigaba ezithintekayo ngalolu daba nomregistrar wenkantolo ngokuqinisekiswa kokwamukelwa kwalolu daba. I nkantolo ethunyelwe udaba kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokwamukela amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni (8), ithumele umbiko kumregistrar wenkantolo, ibika ngentuthuko eyenziwe kulolu daba. Uma udaba luphothuliwe yile nkantolo, le nkantolo kumele ngokushesha ibike umregistrar wenkantolo ngempumelelo yalolu daba. Uma le nkantolo ibuyisela udaba emuva enkantolo, le mbuyiselo yalo daba kumele ibe sibhaliwe kufomu efana nalokhu kuSigaba B seFomu 5 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure, inikeza izizathu zokuthi kungani udaba luphindiselwa. I nkantolo kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa kusukela ngosuku lokuthi udaba luphindiselwe emuva enkantolo, iqondise ukuthi udaba luzoxoxwa kanjani. Umregistrar kumele ngokushesha wazise labo abathintekayo kulolu daba ngosuku lokulalela ngemihlahlandlela ezolandela ngendlela ebhekiswe esigabeni (6). Ngemuva kokwenza isicelo esibhaliwe kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, uma udaba luphuthumayo, umphathi ophakanyisiwe angaqondisa ukuthi isikhathi esibekiwe ezinqubweni sikhululwe.

UThandi waba yisibonelo sokuthi ubuhlakani, uthando, nokubambisana kungaholela empumelelweni. Kwakukhona izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa uThandi wayenokholo. Wazi ukuthi ukwakha akukhona nje kuphela ukwakha izakhiwo, kodwa futhi ukwakha ubudlelwano, umphakathi, nempilo engcono. Ekugcineni, uThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokusebenza kanzima. Uthando lwakhe lokwakha lwasiza abantu abaningi, futhi umphakathi waba yisibonelo sokuthi, ngisho noma izinselelo zikhona, ukwakha kungenza umehluko. UThandi waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma abantu behlanganyela, banganqoba noma yini. Ukukhanya kwelanga kwaba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, izinsuku ezinhle ziza kulabo abakholelwa. Ngale ndlela, uThandi waba yisibonelo sokwakha, umphakathi, nempilo engcono. Umsebenzi wakhe wawuhamba phambili, futhi izinsuku zaba zinhle. UThandi wayephupha, futhi wayazi ukuthi, uma ubambisene, ungakha okukhulu. Lokhu kwakuyindaba yokwakha, indaba yokubambisana, nempilo engcono. UThandi, umakhi, waba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma sikhona umoya, konke kungenzeka.

Imakethe yakho engumgomo ngabantu ozama ukubahehela kubhizinisi lakho. Njengebhizinisi elincane kuzomele ubheke ngqo kuzingxenye ezicacile zemakethi, njengoba ungakwazi ukunikezela yonke into kuwo wonke amakhasimende. Siyini isiphakamiso sokuthengisa esiyingqayizivele (i-USP) Zibuze - ukuthi yini okukwenza wehluke koncintisana nabo I-USP itshela ikhasimende okuthile ngomkhiqizo owenza ube ngaphezulu komncintiswano? Uma usuwazi ukuthi ngobani amakhasimende akho nokuthi bafunani, kumele usebenzise amathuluzi okuqhubekiswa ahlukile ukubazisa ukuthi ibhizinisi lakho likhona. Kukhona amathuluzi ahlukile ukuqhubekisa ibhizinisi lakho. Amanye afanelekile kunamanye. Imfihlo ukukheta lawo mathuluzi azokwazi ukusebenza ngempumelelo enkulu. Abantu abasoze bawuthenga umkhiqizo wakho beqala nje ukuzwa ngawo. Kumele uzame ukwenza umlayezo wokuqhubekisa ukuthi uthandeke. Eyodwa yezindlela ezijwayelekile ezisetshenziselwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuqhubekisa kwakho kuyasebenza yi-fomula eyaziwa njenge-AIDA. Ukuqapha - ukuthola ukunakwa ngabangaba ngamakhasimende - ukusetshenziswa kwemibala, amahlaya, izithombe njalo njalo. Ukuba nothando - okuqukethwe yisikhangisi kumele kugcine uthando lwekhasimende. Ukufisa - isikhangisi kumele sakhe ukufisa kumakhasimende ukuthi athenge imikhiqizo yakho. Ukwenza - Isigaba sokugcine se-AIDA ukubonisa amakhasimende akho ukuthi bangenza kanjani ukuthenga umkhiqizo wakho - ngamanye amazwi, loku ukwenza. Ukukhangisela ibhizinisi elincane kungabiza kakhulu njengethuluzi lokuqhubekisa. Kodwa, kungadingeka ukuthi ukhangise ukufika ezingeni elithile ukukhuphula amandla okwazi ukwazi ngebhizinisi lakho.

Ngayo yonke indlela, izingane zinelungeelo lokunakekelwa abazali bazo nokwazi ukuthi abazali bazo bangobani. Ohulumeni bayavuma ukuhlonipha ilungelo lokuthi izingane zigcine ububona bazo. Ukuba negama kanye nobuzwe (ukuba isakhamuzi sezwe) kubizwa ngokuba nokwehluka kobuwena. Enye into elandelayo oyifundayo ukuthi ungowamuphi umndeni nokuthi uneminyaka emingaki yobudala. Uma ngabe ukuzalwa kwakho kurejistiwe, unikezwa igama obizwa ngalo kanye nesibongo nosuku lwakho lokuzalwa. Ubuzwe bakho nabo bubhalwe phansi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungubani. Izingane zinelungelo lokungahlukaniswa nabazali bazo noma umndeni wazo uma zingafuni. Kodwa-ke kwesinye isikhathi izinkantolo zinganquma ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa yiyona nto enhle kakhulu elungele ingane. Mhlawumbe abazali basuke beyilimaza ingane noma bengayinakekeli ngendlela efanele. Noma mhlawumbe abazali abahlali ndawonye manje inkantolo kufanele inqume ukuthi ingane izohlala namuphi. Ngaphambi kokuba inkantolo yenze isinqumo, wonke umuntu kufanele akwazi ukusho ukuthi kumphatha kanjani lokhu. Ohulumeni kufanele bahloniphe ilungelo lengane ehlukaniswe noyedwa kubazali noma nabo bobabili abazali ukuthi iqhubeke nokubabona bobabili abazali njalo (ngaphandle-ke uma lokhu kungekuhle kakhulu kulokho okulungele ingane). Ezimeni ezidumaza kakhulu, isizathu sokwahlukanisa kungaba ukuthi uhulumeni uvalele ngaphandle kwesigwebo, ubophe, udingise, noma ubuyisele ezweni lakubo noma mhlawumbe ubulele umzali oyedwa noma abazali bengane bobabili. Ezimeni ezinjalo uhulumeni kufanele anikeze abazali kanye nengane ulwazi ngomunye nomunye ngaphandle uma ngabe lokho kuzoyilimaza ingane. Ukucela ulwazi akufanele kubange ingozi kunoma yiliphi ilungu lomndeni.

Kungithokozisa kakhulu ukwamukela ezindlini zephalamende labo abadlala indima ngo 1956 uma abomama bekhononela odompasi, nalabo ababekhona uma kuvukelwa umbuso wamabhunu ngo 1976 abahlezi endaweni elungiselwe umongameli. Ngi ngakhohlwa omashanhliziyo zezwe lakithi eziphakemeyo eziphuma kuwo wonke amaphrovinsi ngokukhethwa yizikhulumi zamaphrovinsi ukuthi bahlanganyele nezivakashi ezimqoka eziphakathi kwethu. Uhulumeni wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika engibakhulumelayo lapha namhlanje, njengoba ngabusiswa ukuthi ngenze njalo eminyakeni adlulile wabunjwa ngonyaka ka 2004 emva kokhetho olwenzeka ngalowomnyaka. Embizweni eyenzeka njalo ngonyaka, ngenyanga ka Masingana, isigungu sikahulumeni wezwe lonke, esisesiqongweni sombuso, sithole isikhathi sokuzindla ngukuthi umhlangano waso uqopha ukuthi sekusemkhathini lohulumeni abusa soloku akhethwa ngonyaka ka 2004. Angisho bakithi ukuthi thina sizithola sinenhlanhla yokuthi sihole lesigungu. Ekuzwisiseni loku, kubonakele kulungile ukuthi sizibuze lombuzo - ikhona yini inqubekela-phambili esiyenzile ekuhlwayeni ukufezekisa izinhloso esatshela umphakathi ukuthi sizakuzifeza Ngalezithembiso esazenza, abantu bakithi basinika igunya lokubusa izwe lethu kusukela ngonyaka ka 2004 kuze kufike isikhathi sokhetho olulandelayo ngonyaka ka 2009?

Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi kubantu abangenamali eyanele yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo. Kodwa-ke, lezi zinguquko azizange zibe lula. Abantu abaningi babebhekene nezinselelo ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekutholeni izinzuzo ezihambisana nezigaba zabo. Abanye babengazi kahle ukuthi bangabhalisela kanjani lezi zinsizakalo, kanti abanye babengazi ukuthi bangakwazi yini ukufaka amalungu ancike kwabanye. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemibuzo eminingi, futhi kwavula ithuba lokuthi kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa abantu mayelana nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Njengoba i-GEMS iqhubeka nokukhula, kwavela izidingo ezithile zokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile nolwakhiwe kahle. Ukuze abantu bazi kahle izigaba zabo, kwakudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinsiza ezahlukene, kuhlanganise nezikhangiso, ama-workshops, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezikhethekile. Ngale ndlela, abantu baqala ukuqonda kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo ezihambisana nezigaba zabo, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle empilweni yabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye kwavula amathuba okwenza izinqumo ezibalulekile. Abantu bangaqonda kahle ukuthi bangakhetha kanjani izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo, futhi lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle ekwandeni kwemfundo nokwazi. Ukuhlukaniswa kwaba yindlela yokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphathe kahle izinsiza zabo, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle.

UJustice Today ululandelele lolu hlelo ecacisa ukuthi kungani lufuneka nemiphumela ezokuluveza. ingamaGatsha ezingama-24 zibe yizinkantolo ezinikeza izinsiza zonke, kusho ukuthi izinsiza zobulungiswa sezi- sondela eduzane namakhaya ezakha- muzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingakwazi ukuzimela. Ngokusho kukaNgqongqoshe weZobulungiswa nokuThuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo U-Enver Surty, lesi sinyathelo sizoqinisekisa ukulungiswa kwendlela izakhamuzi, ikakhulukazi abesimame, abathola ngayo izinsiza zobulungiswa. Lokhu kuhlelwa kabusha kusho ukuthi iziNkantolo ezingamaGatsha ezingama- 24 zizoshintshwa zibe yizinkantolo eziphelele; zibhekana nemibandela efana nesehlukaniso emshadweni, isibonelelo sezingane, kungabalwa amacala obele- lesi ahlale njalo kubhekenwe nawo. Ekhuluma eNkantolo Ephakeme eBloem- fontein onyakeni odlule, ~Ngqongqoshe uSurty, uthe lezi zinkantolo esezihlelwe kabusha zizokwenza kube lula kakhulu kwabesifazane ngoba sebezokwazi uku- thola izibonelelo zezingane zazo eduzane nalapho behlala khona. Esebenzisa umphakathi wase-Alexandra njengesibonelo, ~Ngqongqoshe uchaze wathi lo mphakathi oyingxenye enkulu yeNdawo uye uhambe ibanga elide uya eRandburg ukuze ubonelelwe ngezin- siza zenkantolo yomphakathi. ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo olusha oselusunguliwe, sebezokwazi manje ukusebenzisa inkantolo yase-Alexander ukuze bafinyelele kulezi zinsiza.

Izindleko and Umnotho Uma sizama ukuthola imoto, uToyota ungowokuhlola, ngenxa yokuba nezindleko ezilinganiselwe. U- Toyota uhlale engcono umkhiqizo uma kuziwa enhliziyweni yokuhamba. Lokhu kudala umnotho okhukhulayo, njengoba imoto yeToyota izoba yinketho eqhelelekile ezithuthweni ezithile. Ukuze utholakale isikhathi eside, ezinhlobonhlobo zenzile ukwakha imoto yeToyota, kanti lokhu kudalula indlela yokwabelana nomphakathi wabo. Kuthokozisa Uthando Lwangempela Ngaphandle kokuba uToyota ungumkhiqizo, ungumndeni. U- Toyota ushintshe umbono wami wokuhamba, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo esiyihambayo iyathokozisa. Ngoba kube yinzima ku-prodigy, ingase idalule umuzwa wokuhamba, kodwa iToyota iphethe noxolo kabani enhliziyweni. Ukuze uthole isipiliyoni esihambisanayo namabhizinisi, u- Toyota uvuma ukuthanda, ukuxhumana nangesipho samadoda nabesifazane ngobuqotho. Isiphetho Ngokubuka kwakho, uToyota akuphathe kahle umqondo wokuhamba. U- Toyota ungumkhiqizi wezimoto osiza abantu ngezindlela eziphusile, ezikhuthazayo futhi ezihlala zihlanzekile. Ukuthokoza kwabo ekwakheni imoto efanelekile, okwakhetha umphakathi ophelele, kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Ngakho, usuku lonke, uma uhamba neToyota, uyawuhlonipha umnyama wezimoto, uhlezi uhamba phambili. Kaningi sithola umbono ophumile wekhono eliyinhloko, uToyota ungumgibeli ophumelelayo, thina bonke rero sithimele izinkinga ezisiza ukuhamba kahle.

Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa ukufinyelela komkhiqizo, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa isithombe sendawo yebhizinisi. Ngakho, njengabathandi bezamabhizinisi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlale buthuthuka. Uma sithanda ukuba phambili, kumele sihlale sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana namakhasimende. Ukuze sithuthukise imikhiqizo nemisebenzi, lokho kudinga ukuba siqhubeke sifunda, sibe nokuzimisela, futhi sithathe izinyathelo ezikhuthazayo. Kodwa akukhona nje ubuchwepheshe obuyisihluthulelo. Izinselelo ezihlobene nezinsizakusebenza, izindlela zokuphatha, kanye nezikhwama zezimali zidinga ukuba siqaphele. Kumele sibuye siphendule izinselelo zokuphatha ezithinta izinkampani, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zethu zisebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezilungile zokuphatha abantu, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani zidinga ukuba nezinqubomgomo ezicacile zokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Lokhu kumayelana nokunika indawo yokusebenza ekhuthazayo, lapho abasebenzi bezwakala benesithakazelo emsebenzini wabo. Izinqubomgomo ezinhle zokusebenza zingaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kahle, kube nezinga eliphezulu lokwaneliseka kubasebenzi. Ngaleso sikhathi, lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo. Ngemuva kokwakha ibhizinisi eliqinile, kufanele sihlole indlela yokubambisana. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, amabhizinisi kufanele axhumane nabanye ukuze athole ukufinyelela ezinsizeni nezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kubambisana kungaholela ekwakheni izixazululo ezintsha, kuhlanganyele izinsiza, futhi kulethe izinzuzo kubo bobabili.

indlela yokuhlola zonke izinhlelo ezimbandakanya ukusetshenziswa kwemali ngaphambi kokuthathwa kwesinqumo ngalolo hlelo. UMkhandlu kufanele uqinisekise ukuthi kuyahlangatshezwana nezidingo zesigatshana 2 futhi ziyaphumeleliswa ngendlela. Noma imuphi umuntu othikameza uNobhala noma uMkhandlu ekufezeni izidingo zesigatshana 2 no 3 uyakuba necala kanti uma elahlwa yicala uyakukhokha inhlawulo noma ahlale ejele isikhathi esingeqile eminyakeni emibili noma kokubili inhlawulo nokubhadla ejele. Umhlengikazi ongungoti ngumuntu owufundele umsebenzi onekhono lokunquba umsebenzi ngokuzimela ngokugcwele ngendlela nangeqophelo elinqunyiwe okwaziyo futhi ukuthwala umthwalo nokubika kulowo msebenzi. Umbelethisi ngumuntu okufundele lokhu nonekhono lokubelethisa ngokuzimela ngokugcwele ngendlela nangeqophelo elinqunyiwe okwaziyo futhi ukuthwala umthwalo nokubika kulowo msebenzi. Umhlengikazi ongusitafu ngumuntu ofundele ukuqhuba umsebenzi oyisisekelo sobuhlengikazi ngendlela nangeqophelo elinqunyiwe. Umsizi womhlengikazi noma umsizi wombelethisi ngumuntu ofundele ukunikeza usizo lokuqala lokunakekela kobuhlengikazo ngendlela nangeqophelo elinqunyiwe. UNgqongqoshe anganquma indima yomsebenzi wobuhlengikazi abangongoti nenqubo yeminye imikhakha yobuhlengikazi okukhulunywa ngayo esigabeni 31 2. e umsizi mbelethisi. UNgqongqoshe, ngemuva kokubonisana noMkhandlu, angakhipha isaziso ePhephabhukwini loMbuso iGazethi akhe noma amise eminye imikhakha yabantu abangabhalisela ukusebenza njengabahlengikazi uma ebona kufanele ukuze kuzisakale umphakathi.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. Ngokubambisana, lezi zinhlaka zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile nolufanele, oluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze zifake ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-inthanethi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu abaningi sebekhuluma nge-inthanethi, futhi ukufinyelela kolwazi lwezempilo nge-inthanethi kungasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zisebenza ekwakheni imikhankaso yokwazisa umphakathi. Lezi mikhankaso zihlala ziqhakambisa ukubaluleka kokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ukuvikelwa kwezifo, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi izinqumo zabo zempilo zingaba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabo. Kodwa-ke, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nokufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo. Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ububha, obuvimbela abantu abaningi ekutholeni izinsiza ezidingekayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo ezisemaphandleni zidinga ukuxhaswa okwengeziwe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensiza efanele. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa.

Izikhala zomsebenzi emaphandleni nasemaphandleni zifakwe ngokufuna abasebenzi ngokumema abantu ukuthi bafake izicelo, kulabo abangasebenzi kuhulumeni. Izikhala zomsebenzi ezindaweni eziphezulu, emkhakheni wokuphathwa okuphezulu, kumele zikhangiswe ngokwezifunda kokubili ngaphakathi nangaphandle kweSevisi yoMphakathi. Izikhala zikhangiswa kwiSikhangiso seMisebenzi yoMphakathi, esihlanganiswa masonto onke nguMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi Nokuphathwa. Ngesikhathi sokufuna abantu abangasebenzi kuhulumeni, lowo mnyango kazwelonke noma wesifunda uzokhangisa lezi zikhala zomsebenzi ezimidiya. Iwebhusayithi ebizwa ngokuthi: Isikhangiso seMisebenzi yoMphakathi ibika abasebenzi bakahulumeni ngama-position atholakalayo ngaphakathi kweSevisi yokusebenza kukahulumeni. Abantu abangasebenzi kuhulumeni kodwa abanentshisekelo ezikhala ezikhangisiwe kufanele baphendule kuMnyango okhangisayo ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo. Imininingwane yokuxhumana noMnyango okhangisayo inikezwa kwiSikhangiso. Ezinye izikhungo ezifana noMnyango Wezokuvikela zingase zidinge ukuthi udlule ekuhlolweni kwezempilo ngaphambi kokuthi isicelo sakho sithathwe sibe sithathelwe phezulu. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi, vakashela iwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezikhungo Zomphakathi Nokuphathwa. Ungathola incwadi eqinisekisa ukufaka kwakho isicelo, kodwa lokhu kuncike kumnyango. Inqubo yokufuna abasebenzi nokukhetha iyahluka phakathi kweminyango kahulumeni futhi ingaqedwa ngesikhathi esifushane. Ifomu lesicelo alikhokhiswa.

Ngokwesigaba 15 soMthetho (uma ukhona) kudingeka ukuthi isaziso sishicilelwe kuleli bhukwana. Ngesikhathi sokushicilelwa kwaleli bhukwana, besingakabi bikho isaziso esinjalo esase sishicilelwe. nasenhlanganweni ngaphandle kwemali. Ezigabeni ezingezansi ezibhekene namarekhodi aphethwe isekela lomsebenzi wolwazi ngalinye, kwenziwe wonke umzamo wokunikezela ngalolu lwazi kunanoma yisiphi isimo. Njengenhlangano enamagunya nemisebenzi ehlukene, inhlosongqangi yoMnyango yenziwa amayunithi amaningi enhlangano, amahhovisi esifunda kanye nezimishini zamazwe angaphandle. Imisebenzi ilethwa kumaklayenti ngamahhovisi esifunda/esigodi kanye nezindawo zemisebenzi, amayunithi ahambayo kanye namahhovisi aphesheya. Uhlelo lwesu loMnyango lukhombisa ukuthi le misebenzi ehlukene, neshintshwaniswayo ibhekelwa ukuthi yeseka izinhloso zoMnyango. Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo okubalulekile okuqhubekayo eMnyangweni, ikakhulukazi ukubekwa koMthethosivivinywa ozayo, ikakhulukazi ukudluliselwa kwezinye izindawo kwemisebenzi yezindaba zomphakathi ezinhlanganweni zamazinga amathathu kaHulumeni kanye nokuqalwa ukusetshenziswa kwendlela entsha yomazisi yoMnyango Wezasekhaya i-Home Affairs National Identification System, kuyodinga ukuthi kuphinde kwenziwe ngokungenakuvinjelwa isakhiwo senhlangano yomnyango kanye nohlelo lwebhizinisi. Imisebenzi ihlala njalo ibalulekile kunesakhiwo kanti i-DHA iyaqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo luhlala lulungiswe ngokwezidingo zomsebenzi. Ngakho-ke uhlelo olufakwe Ohlelweni Oluyisu lwe-DHA, yize lukhombisa kakhulu isakhiwo samanje, lungolwesimo sezinguquko futhi kufanele lubhekwe ngesimo soguquko esiphilayo esesiqalile eMnyangweni.

Umdlalo wezemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika awubandakanyi kuphela amaqembu amakhulu, kodwa futhi kunezinqola ezincane ezithokozisayo. Amaqembu afana ne-Black Leopards, i-TS Galaxy, ne-SuperSport United nawo anomlando omuhle, futhi abalandeli bawo bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Lezi zinqola zikhombisa ukuthi ibhola alikona nje umdlalo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, yokuhlanganyela, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika liye laba yinsika yokuhlanganyela nemiphakathi. Amaqembu ahluke-hluke aphesheya kwezilwandle, ahlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ibhola lihlala linomthelela omkhulu empilweni yabantu, futhi liwumthombo wokujabula, ukuncintisana, nokuhlanganyela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ibhola eNingizimu Afrika liye laba yindawo yokukhuthaza abasha. Amaqembu amaningi abamba imicimbi yokukhetha abadlali abasha, ahlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa, futhi abavula amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile, futhi kuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhola lihlala likhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNingizimu Afrika ibonakale iyindawo yokuthokozisa, lapho amaqembu ebhola engumongo wempilo yomphakathi. Amaqembu afana neKaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, neMamelodi Sundowns abamba izindima ezinkulu, kodwa futhi abanye abancane bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Ibhola akusikho nje ukudlalwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlanganyela, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokwakha umphakathi. Ekugcineni, ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika lihlala linethemba, futhi abalandeli bazoqhubeka nokukhuthaza amaqembu abo.

Kudingeka kutholakale imvume ebhaliwe yabasunguli uma umuntu efuna ukwenzelwa amakhophi ento ethize. Umtapo onezincwadi ezevile ezi-3000 eziphathelene nemboni kaqedisizungu, waqala kudala ngezikhathi zeBhodi Kazwelonke Yamafilimu kanti okungaphathi akubolekisi nhlobo kusetshenziselwa khona ngenxa yokuba yigugu kwemiqingo ekuwo. Kodwa-ke, zonke izincwadi ezisekumtapo zingabhekelwa khona emagcekeni eNqolobane Kazwelonke Yamagugu, kanti kungagaywa amakhophi ngentengo ephansi. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo lamaphosta amafilimi angejwayelekile angalinganiselwa enkulungwanweni, asukela ngezikhathi ze-De Voortrekkers , okuyifilimu endala kunawo onke aseNingizimu Afrika. Iningi lala maphosta awavamile ngempela futhi aphathelene nayo yonke inhlobo yefilimu kwawasezweni lakithi. Inhloso yenqolobane ngala maphosta ukuba aqoshwe ngobuchwepheshe agcinwe eqoqweni lapho engasetshenziswa ngaphandle kokuthathwa. Njengeqoqo lamaphosta, iNqolobane ineqoqo lezithombe eziphathelene namafilimu akuleli. Izithombe cishe zawo onke amafilimu akhiqizwa kuleli kusukela ngo-1916 angatholakala lapha. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo lamaskripthi amafilimu elicishe libe yinani le-1200 amafilimu akhiwe kuleli. Iningi lala maskripthi awesigaba sokuhlelwa kwefilimu ngakho-ke ehluke kakhulu kumkhiqizo osuphothuliwe nosulungele ukubukelwa.

Lokhu kuveza ukuthi uhulumeni uzimisele ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bonke, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahluphekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Abamele izinkampani baphakamisa iziphakamiso zokuthi izinguquko zomthetho zingasiza kanjani ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, kanti abamele izakhamizi bagcizelela ukuthi imithetho kufanele ibheke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimo zempilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umphakathi uqonda kahle ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho azihambisani kuphela nezinqubomgomo, kodwa zidinga ukubandakanya wonke umuntu. Ukwengeza, umcimbi ubuyekeza izinhlelo ezikhona zokuphatha. Abaholi bephakamisa ukuthi izinqubo zokuphatha kufanele zibe lula, ziqinise ukwethembeka, futhi zikhuthaze ubumbano phakathi komphakathi nezikhungo zomthetho. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukufinyelela kalula emthethweni, bazi ukuthi bangabamba kanjani iqhaza, futhi bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani usizo uma bephula umthetho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko zomthetho zikhuluma ngempilo yomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta ubuhlanga, ubulili, kanye nezimo zokuhlala. Abaholi baphakamisa izinhlelo ezizokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumalungelo abantu, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokuvikela abesifazane nezingane. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uhulumeni uzimisele ukuvikela amalungelo abantu bonke, futhi akekho ozoshiywa ngaphandle. Umcimbi ugcizelela ukuthi izinguquko zomthetho azifanele kube yinto eyenziwa nguhulumeni kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube neqhaza labantu. Abantu baphakanyiswa ukuba baphathe izinkulumo, baveze imibono yabo, futhi babambe iqhaza ekwakheni umthetho.

Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni umnotho ozinzile, ophumelelayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe. Ngokuhlanganisa, amalungelo abasebenzi awasiyona into engathathwa kalula. Lokhu kube usizo olukhulu kubantwana nabantu abadala abahamba emsebenzini, ngenxa yokuthi bakwazi ukufika endaweni yabo ngemizuzu embalwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izithuthuthu zikhanga abafuna ukuzijabulisa, ngoba ukuhamba ngebhayisikili kungase kube nzima kwabaningi, kanti izithuthuthu zenza kube lula ukuhamba.

I-GEMS, njengephrojekthi ephethwe nguhulumeni, kufanele iqinise amasu ayo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwabathengi luhlala lukhona kuphela ezandleni eziphephile. Lokhu kumele kuhlanganise ukwenza kahle izinqubomgomo zokuvikela, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, nokwakha ubuhlobo obusondele phakathi kwabathengi nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Enye yezindlela ezibalulekile zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kungenzeka ukuthi kube nomsebenzi ophumelelayo wezobuchwepheshe. I-GEMS kufanele igxile ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iwufanele futhi ivikelekile. Lokhu kudinga umgomo ophakeme wokuphepha okuhlanganisa ukuqapha okuhlanganyelwe nokuphathwa kwesimo sephepho. Uhlelo lokuphepha kumele lube nezinqubomgomo ezihambisanayo ezinikeza indlela yokuhlonza, ukugwema, nokuphendula ezimweni zengozi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukufaka ubuchwepheshe bokuvikela obuhlasela amabutho. Izinhlelo ezifana nezokuphepha kwedatha ezisebenzisana ne-GEMS zingathuthukiswa ukuze kuqhutshekwe phambili imisebenzi yokuvikeleka. Kulolu hlobo, ukusetshenziswa kwemiyalo yokugcina izimfihlo, izinhlelo zokubika, nemisebenzi yokuhlola ingadlala indima enkulu. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukwephula umthetho akusona isimo esijwayelekile. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeke nokukhuthaza ukuba abantu baqonde izinqubo zokuvikela. Lokhu kufanele kube yinsiza elula yokufinyelela, okuzokwenza kube lula kubasebenzisi ukuqonda indlela ulwazi lwabo lwezempilo olunakekelwa ngayo. Ngokusho kohlelo olukhalipha ubuchwepheshe, kungasetshenziswa izinhlelo zokuphendula ezihloniphekile, zibe nomthelela omuhle emizamweni yokuvikela ulwazi lwempilo.

Zonke izinhlobo zezithelo zinebhande lokushisa elingaphezu kwalokho okukhona, ziba nezinselelo zokukhula kahle. Sidinga ukwazi ukuthi izinga lokushisa nezinga lokubanda kuzoba kanjani unyaka wonke, nokuthi lapho kuzoqala khona ukushisa. Uma sesinayo yonke le mininingwane, singakhetha ukuthi yisiphi uhlobo lwezithelo oluhambisana nesimo sezulu nobude besikhathi sokukhula endaweni esilima kuyo. (Khumbula ukuthi isikhathi sokukhula siqala ngesikhathi sokufaka imbewu futhi siqhubeke kuze kube yisikhathi sokuvuna - isikhathi lapho kuqala khona ukushisa sizokutshela ukuthi isikhathi sokukhula siphelile). Kubalulekile kakhulu ukwazi ukuthi imvula iyenzeka kangakanani unyaka nonyaka endaweni lapho ulima khona, nokwazi ukuthi yisiphi isikhathi esivame ukuba nomoya. Sonke siyazi ukuthi asikwazi ukusho isimo sezulu lapho kufanele kube nemvula, kodwa uma sibheka izindlela zemvula unyaka nonyaka, singacabanga ukuthi kufanele silime kanjani unyaka ozayo. Namuhla, ukubikezela kwesimo sezulu kuyaqhubeka nokuba ngokunembile futhi kusitshela ukuthi sizolindela izimo ezimanzi nezomoya ezinyangeni ezizayo - kufanele sisebenzise le mininingwane ngendlela efanele. Ukukala inani lemvula akukhathazi (izinsiza zokukala eziphathekayo zingatholakala kalula futhi kufanele zibekwe ezindaweni ezahlukene emapulazini akho). Ngemuva kokuba imvula, kufanele ukale futhi ubhale phansi inani. I-millimeter eyodwa yemvula engena emhlabeni ithambisa umhlaba kancane - kufanele ukale inani lemvula ukuze wazi ukuthi umhlaba uthambiswe kangakanani. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukufaka inani elifanele lembewu ngehektare ukuze uthole umkhiqizo ofanele. Inani elifanele lezitshalo lihlukile ezindaweni ezahlukene futhi lingahluka endaweni eyodwa ngoba kungase kube nezinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlaba.

- Ukuhlola izibalo: Izibalo zokuphendula zihlolwa njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ama-ambulensi aphendula ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola izikhathi ezithathwa ama-ambulensi ukusondela ezindaweni eziphuthumayo. - Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa: Uma izikhathi zokuphendula zingahambisani nezidingo, iziphathimandla zisebenza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokuphendula. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukwandisa inani lama-ambulensi, ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana, noma ukuhlela izindlela ezihamba kahle. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa izikhathi zokuphendula Ukuze kuthuthukiswe izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi e-Gauteng, izinyathelo ezithile zingathathwa: - Ukukhulisa inani lama-ambulensi: Ukwanda kwenani lama-ambulensi ezindaweni ezidinga usizo oluphuthumayo kungasiza ekunciphiseni izikhathi zokuphendula. - Ukuqeqesha abashayeli: Ukuqeqesha abashayeli ukuze bakwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha nangempumelelo kungasiza ekwandiseni izikhathi zokuphendula. - Ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana: Izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo zingasiza ekutholeni ama-ambulensi ngokushesha, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezikhathi zokuphendula. - Ukubambisana nezindawo zomphakathi: Ukuhlela imicimbi yokwazisa umphakathi mayelana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kungasiza abantu ukuba baqonde ukuthi bangabiza kanjani ama-ambulensi ngesikhathi esiphuthumayo. Isiphetho Izikhathi zokuphendula kwama-ambulensi e-Gauteng zibalulekile ekuphathweni kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele, kubalulekile ukuqonda izici ezithinta lezi zikhathi, ukuhlola izibalo, nokuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphendula.

Lezi zindlela zomgunyathi wenkohliso zisetshenziswa ngabe-419 scam ukuphuca abantu ababakhohlisayo izimali. Ukuthola olunye ulwazi ngalo mgunyathi wenkohliso, ungaluthola kumaPhoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika kwi-website, kanti kunezindlela laba bakhohlisi bomgunyathi abasebenza ngazo, kwisikimu sabo, sokukhwabanisela abantu izimali zabo, kanye nezindlela zokuzivikela ongazithatha. Ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi olunabile, ngena kwi-website yamaPhoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika. Uma uthola incwadi yenkohliso yomgunyathi ihambise incwadi, nolwazi kwabe-Interpol. Nikeza imininingwane yokuxhumana nawe kanye nezinombolo zocingo, noma zalowo muntu abathintekayo. Uma kunokuxhumana phakathi kwesikimu se-"419" kanye neNingizimu Afrika, chaza lokhu kahle nayo yonke imininingwane efanele. Nikeza imininingwane yokuxhumana nawe kanye nezinombolo zocingo, noma zalowo muntu abathintekayo. AbeNkonzo yamaPhoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika yibona ababeka isikhathi esizothathwa ekwenzweni komsebenzi, sokukhipha umbiko wokuthi kuqhubekeka kanjani ngomsebenzi. Imibiko ivamise ukukhishwa njalo emavikini amabili kuye ngesimo sodaba nodaba. Imibiko ngokuthi umsebenzi uqhubeka kanjani ngeke yanikezwa abantu ziqu, uma kungekho kulahlekelwa okwenzekile. Kodwa-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abeNkonzo yamaPhoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika banikezwe amakhophi ezincwadi zomgunyathi wenkwabaniso yesikimu se-"419", ukuze bazifakele kwi-database yabo. Le nkonzo ngeyamahhala ayikhokhelwa. Awekho, kodwa kubalulekile ukukhombisa kumadokhumende uma kube nokuhlahlekelwa zimali okwenzekile.

Umphakathi uphikelela ukuthi kufanele kube nesikole esisha esikhundleni salokho okukhona, okugcwele kakhulu futhi okuphakeme. Amaphoyisa aqale ukusishaya, asiphushela ukuba sihlakaze odongeni, abanye bethu basiphushela. Lokhu kuholele ekubambisaneni phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene nokusungulwa kwezinyathelo ezithile ezihlobene nokugcina izindawo ezihlukene. Abasebenzi besikole abakhubazekile banethuba lokukhuluma bodwa nezikhulu eziphethe izifundo ukuze kuqinisiwe izindlela zokweseka. Izikhalazo zingafakwa ngeConsumer Help-Line (CHL), ngezingcingo, amafeksi, ama-imeyili, noma ngamakhasimende afika ngqo. Noma yisiphi ukuhlasela ezikhungweni zase-Iran kuzokwandisa inkinga, usho. Naphezu kwemizwa yakhe, kwakukhona ukuqonda okufanayo mayelana nezizathu zezimo ezahlukene ezihilelekile. Kubalulekile ukuthi uma isimo sokubulawa kwabantu abaningi ezweni noma ukusilela okukhulu kuvela, izwe elibhekene nalokhu kufanele livumele ukusebenza kwezinsiza zokuthula ze-UN. Amaphoyisa nezisebenzi zokuphepha baya lapho bekubizelwe khona ukuze balandele abasolwa ababalekela. Phakathi kwezinto ezitholakala ezihlotshaniswa nokuhweba ngezidakamizwa bekukhona ama-akhawunti amabili ezinkampani, i-VW Polo Playa eyodwa, nezinto eziningi ezibizayo ezitholakele ezindlini. I-centre ihlinzeka ngeluleko ku-Joint Investment Scheme mayelana nokwakhiwa komkhiqizo oyisisekelo wokutshalwa kwezimali ukuze kushintshwe lokho okungahlinzekwa ngaphansi kweMthetho. Ulwazi lokukhishwa kwamanzi angaphansi komhlaba kanye namanzi angaphansi, kuhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwabo nokuhlanzwa, kunikeza umbono wezabelomali zamanzi endaweni.

Lungisa umthetho weGauteng Constitution Amendment Act ka-2001 mayelana nezinsiza zokuhamba, ukuze ubuyekezwe futhi uhlanganise incazelo ethile; ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo adingekayo wokusebenzisa umhlaba mayelana neziteshi kanye namandla adingekayo kuMEC ukuze angene ezivumelwaneni zokwakha izivumelwano zomgwaqo nezokuhamba ngezitimela; ukuhlela inqubo mayelana nokumemezela umgwaqo; ukwenza ucwaningo lwesibili endaweni esigabeni somgwaqo wokuqala noma umgwaqo wezitimela lapho umbuso ungathola ukuthi ucwaningo endaweni kuleli gumbi lokumemezela luyadingeka; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezinkinga ezincane. Igama elithi 'umgwaqo wezitimela' libhekisela kumathuluzi omgwaqo asetshenziselwa umgwaqo onzima noma olula, futhi lapho isimo sikhombisa njalo, ilungelo lokuhamba, [lapho umgwaqo onzima noma olula usebenza, njengoba kukhombisiwe noma kumiswa ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho] noma phezulu noma phansi komhlaba futhi kufaka phakathi umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nokuphambukiswa kwawo okwethenjelwe. Ekuthatheni umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela, ukulungiswa okukhishwe komgwaqo ngokwesigaba noma okucatshangwa ukuthi kukhishwe ngokwesigaba, noma ukulungiswa komgwaqo wesifunda okukhona, uMEC kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi amalungiselelo omgwaqo wokuqala enziwe, ngokuhambisana nebhuku elibhalwe njengoba kuchaziwe futhi kuhlanganise nezincomo mayelana nomgwaqo, bese uMEC kufanele alandele inqubo echazwe kulolu sigaba.

Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhala sokuxhumana, sikhaza umthetho ophumelelayo, sithola ithuba lokukhuluma, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ama-social media akhulisa umuzwa wokubambisana, uduku, nokuqonda ukuphila kwabanye. Ngokubuka esikhathini esizayo, amandla ethu akhulu. Ngakho-ke, masithathe ithuba lokuxhumana ngokugqugquzela, siqonde, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophumile, ophumelelayo nokuhambisana nezinga eliphezulu lokuphila. Lo mcimbi uzobalulekile ekuvezeni lezi zinto njengomkhiqizo wempilo yesimanje, futhi sizodinga sonke sikwazi ukuziqonda nezidingo zethu, ukuze sidonse phambili kulezi zinkundla ezisemqoka.

Ikhansela yaboSosayensi bendalo yaseNingizimu Afrika iyavuma ukuthi abanye abantu abazange balithole ithuba lokufunda baze bafike ezingeni eliphakeme elidingwa ikhansela ebhalisa abantu abafundele umsebenzi othile. Kodwa-ke labobantu kutholakala ukuthi badlale indima ebalulekile kakhulu kumphakathi woSosayensi eminyakeni eminingi edlule kanti bangaqubeka benze njalo eminyakeni eminingi ezayo. Ikhansela ithathe isinqumo sokuthi inikeze labo Bantu ithuba lokufaka isicelo sokubhalisela ukuba ngoSosayensi bendalo abawufundele lomsebenzi ngaphansi kwemigomo ethile. Wonke umuntu ongenawo amaphepha omsebenzi avunyelwe noma aziwa yikhansela angasifaka isicelo. bahlonishwe ngabasebenza nabo ngolwazi abanalo kulomsebenzi wabo abawukhethile kube nendima ethile abayidlalile kumphakathi waboSosayensi babe nolwazi oluyilona abalufundele olungekho ngaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi angezona izincamu ngaphambi kokuba bafake izicelo kulowomsebenzi abasifakela wona isicelo. Isicwayiso: uma ngabe uke washiya lomsebenzi wakho owufundele eminyakeni eyishumi eyedlule, ungeke uvunyelwe ukubhalisa ngaphansi kwaloluhlelo. Gcwalisa ifomu elisemthethweni lokubhalisa.

Izehlakalo eziningi ezithinta imishini zenzeka ngesikhathi sokukhandwa kwemishini. Abasebenzi baqeqeshwe ngokwanele ukwenza umsebenzi. Amathuluzi enele nemiyalelo yokusebenzisa imishini ihlinzekwe ukuze imishini iphathwe, ihlonzwe futhi ivulwe. Amandla abekiwe, ukwenza isibonelo, aqhamuka ezimpahleni ezicindezele iziphethu noma amandla aqhamuka emanzini, ibekwa esimweni esilungele ukusebenza ngaphambi kokuqala umsebenzi. Imishini esebenzisa amandla amanzi ivinjwa ukwehla ngokusebenzisa isu lokukhanda njengezivimbo nojeke uma abantu besebenza ngaphansi kwayo. Bayakwazi ukucisha imishini ngaphambi kokuyidumisa. Baqala ukuyidumisa ime ngendlela. Zonke izivimbo zifakwe ngendlela futhi zisebenza kahle. Indawo ezungeze umshini ihlanzekile futhi ayinalutho olungaphazamisa ukusebenza komshini. Induna iyatshelwa ngokushesha uma umshini ungasebenzi ngendlela. Bagqoka izingubo zokuvikela azifanele. Usebenzise umshini ngaphandle uma unemvume noma uqeqeshelwe ukwenza lokho. Uzame ukuvula ukuvaleka kwamapayipi noma ukuhlanza umshini ngaphandle, uma unezinwele ezinde ezingagaxela ezinsimbini ezinyakazayo. Wehle kugandaganda ohambayo noma emshinini ozishintsha wona. Uphazamise abantu abasebenzisa imishini. Enye into edala izingozi kwezolimo ngogandaganda abagingqikayo. Izingozi ezinkulu nezibulalayo zijwayelekile, izehlakalo zibandakanya abashayeli, abanye abasebenzi nabahamba ngezinyawo. Ezinye izingozi zenzeka uma abantu beshiya izimoto bengenzanga isiqiniseko sokuthi ngeke zihambe noma zidale ingozi. Abashayeli baqeqeshiwe nokuthi abantu abangenamvume abavunyelwe ukushayela. Izimoto nabahamba ngezinyawo bayahlukaniswa uma kungenzeka. Imithwalo izinzile futhi iphephile. Abashayeli bavikelekile ezintweni eziwayo.

Amaqembu Ebhola AseNingizimu Afrika Ezweni elinothile ngezamasiko nezemidlalo, iNingizimu Afrika iyaziwa kakhulu ngempumelelo yayo emkhakheni wezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi ebholeni. Ibhola, elaziwa ngokuthi "football" emhlabeni jikelele, liyinsika yokuhlanganyela nokubumbana kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika ahlukaniswe ngezinga, izifunda, kanye nezikhungo zokuqeqesha, futhi ahlale enezigigaba ezithokozisayo ezikhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana. Ekuqaleni, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika lathuthuka kakhulu ngemva kokuphuma kweMpi Yezwe Yesibili, lapho umphakathi waqala ukubona ibhola njengendlela yokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi njengendlela yokubuyisela emuva izinkinga zomphakathi. Amaqembu amaningi aqala ukuvela, futhi ngaleso sikhathi, i-PSL (Premier Soccer League) yasungulwa, yenza kube lula ukuhlela imidlalo nokwandisa ukuthandwa kwebhola. Omunye wamaqubu amakhulu eNingizimu Afrika nguKaizer Chiefs, owaziwa njenge "Amakhosi." Lo mqeqeshi ube nomlando omuhle, uqale ngo-1970, futhi ube neziqu eziningi, kuhlanganise ne-PSL titles. Amakhosi abamba umoya wempumelelo, futhi abalandeli bawo bahlala bekhuthazekile, bekhombisa uthando olukhulu emidlalweni. Umdlalo wabo ophakathi kweKaizer Chiefs ne-Orlando Pirates, owaziwa ngokuthi "The Soweto Derby," uhlala uthokozisa izinkulungwane zabalandeli, uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, i-Orlando Pirates, eyasungulwa ngo-1937, iyinhlangano enomlando omude futhi ophumelelayo.

Nginxusa futhi abaphathi Bohlelo lwe-Incubator ukuthi bagcine ukuxhumana nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme abakuzona, ikakhulukazi ngonyaka wabo wezifundo wokuqala emanyuvesi. Iningizimu Afrika ibone ukuzalwa kwesilwane sayo sokuqala esizalaniswe ngokuthatha iseli eyodwa yesilwane esingumzali (cloned), inkonyane elibizwa ngokuthi uFuthi. Isikhulumi asizwakali, isikhulumi asisebenzisi umbhobho. Leli qoqo lihlanganisa ukushicilelwa kwamaphephandaba, amajenali kanye nemibhalo ephuma ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile eziphathele nezobuchwepheshe kanye nezinye izinto jikelele, ezihlanganisa amajenali ezohwebo, amahlaya, njl. Ukwenza imithi efana nemithi ebulala amagciwane ngaminingi isb. i-penicillin kanye ne-insulin yabantu ukuze kwelashwe abantu abanesifo sikashukela. Ngokusebenza bengakhathali, banikela ngako konke abanakho ekwakheni, ekugqugquzeleni kanye nasekugxiliseni umdlalo omkhulukazi waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuphrintwa kanye nokulamineyithwa kwenani elithile lezinsiza okwenziwa Kwisikhungo Sezinsiza Zezempilo kwenziwa uma kudingeka. Ngemuva kokukhethwa, amalungu Ekhomishani azofunga ngeqiniso ukuthi azokwenza imisebenzi yawo ngaphandle kokuchema nangokuthembeka. Uma wonke umuntu ethatha umlayezo wokuzithiba, ukwethembeka noma ukusebenzisa ikhondomu ngeqiniso futhi kwenziwe, singakwazi ukuzuza esikuphokophele okungukwehlisa kakhulu izinga labathelelekayo. Ingabe lokho bekuzosetshenziswa yilabo abaphenya, bafune bese benza umbiko?

a okuyokalwa ngayo iqophelo lomoya ozungezile, b okuyokalwa ngayo isisi esikhiqizwe yindawo ngayinye eqondakalayo noma engaqondakali. Ngesaziso kwiGazethe, Ungqongqoshe angasungula Ikomidi likaZwelonke Lokweluleka Ngeqophelo Lomoya eliyoluleka Ungqongqoshe ngokusebenza kwalo Mthetho.. e noma yiluphi udaba oluphathelene neKomidi. Ungqongqoshe kufanele akhethe isiphathimandla eMnyangweni esiyoba yisisebenzi sikazwelonke seqophelo lomoya lapho siyoxhumanisa khona izindaba eziqondene nokuphatha iqophelo lomoya kuhulumeni kazwelonke. Ungqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni kufanele akhethe isiphathimandla emkhandlwini wesifundazwe esiyoqhuba umsebenzi weqophelo lomoya nesiyoxhumanisa izindaba eziqondene neqophelo lomoya esifundazweni. Umasipala ngamunye kufanele ukhethe ngaphakathi isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya esiyoqhuba umsebenzi wokuxhumanisa izindaba eziqondene nokusingatha iqophelo lomoya kumasipala. Isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya kufanele siqhube imisebenzi noma sisebenzise amandla agidlabezwe sona ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho. Isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya singedlulisa amandla noma umsebenzi ophawulwe esigatshaneni 4 aye kumuntu osebenza ehhovisi laleso siphathimandla, kuphela ngaphansi kwemibandela nezimo ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe, ngokulandela isigaba- 46. Iziphathimandla zeqophelo lomoya kufanele zixhumanise imisebenzi yazo ngendlela enganqunywa wuhlaka lukazwelonke noma nguNgqongqoshe ngomthetho ohambisana nesigaba- 46.

Lokhu kudinga ukuba amaphoyisa babe nesibindi, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabhekana kanjani nezimo ezinzima. Kubalulekile ukuthi bahlale bephila impilo enempilo, ukuze bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini wabo. Ekugcineni, amaphoyisa adlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Umsebenzi wabo awugcini nje ekutheni bavikele abantu, kodwa futhi babhekelele ukugcina umthetho, ukuvikela impilo, nokuthuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uqonde umsebenzi wabo, futhi ubabheke njengabanye abantu ababalulekile empilweni yabo. Amaphoyisa akhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeke nokusebenza ngempumelelo, ukuze bakwazi ukuvikela umphakathi, futhi baqhubeke nokwakha izixhumanisi ezinhle phakathi kwabo nabantu. Umsebenzi wabo ungavula amathuba amaningi, futhi ungakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobudlelwano obuhle, nokuphepha okungapheli.

Umdanso: Umsebenzi Wokudlulisa Isiko Nezizathu Zokuhlanganyela Umdanso, njengomsebenzi wezokwakha, ubonakala njengengxenye ebalulekile yamasiko amaningi emhlabeni. E-Afrika, umdanso unomlando ocebile, uphinde ube yindlela yokudlulisa izindaba, imizwa, nezifundo ezibalulekile ezizweni ezahlukahlukene. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umdanso akuwona nje umsebenzi wokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi unomthelela omkhulu empilweni yamasiko. Emazweni amaningi, umdanso uhlanganisa abantu, udala ubudlelwano phakathi kwezizukulwane. Izinkolo, imicimbi yokugubha, kanye nemikhosi yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi zempilo ziba yizizathu ezibalulekile zokudansa. Ngokwesibonelo, eNingizimu Afrika, umdanso weZulu, owaziwa ngokuthi yi-'Indlamu', ubonisa ubuhlakani bamasiko kanye nemigubho yokuhlonipha. Umdanso weZulu ubalulekile emicimbini efana neziqholo, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze baphinde baqhakambisa izithethe zabo. Ngaphandle kokuba umdanso ubonisa isiko, unikeza nethuba lokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezikhona emphakathini. Njengoba umdanso uvame ukusebenzisa izincazelo ezithile, abaculi bangasebenzisa le ndlela ukuze baphakamise izwi labo, baveze imizwa yabo, futhi baphendule ezinkingeni ezithinta umphakathi. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emidansweni ethinta izindaba zokuhlukunyezwa, ubuphofu, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlalisana. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ohlanganisa izindlela eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukudansa ngokwezinkanyezi, ukudansa kwesiko, kanye nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umdanso ungashintsha futhi uthuthuke, uhambisane nezinguquko ezisemphakathini.

Phinda Uhlola Ibhethri: Qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri isebenza kahle futhi uyayigcina. Hlanza i-Drone: Susa uthuli noma amanzi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi i-drone yakho ihlanzekile. Beka Indawo Ephephile: Gcina i-drone endaweni ephephile ukuze ivikeleke. Isiphetho Ama-drone ayithuluzi elinamandla elingasetshenziswa ngezindlela eziningi. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakwazi ukujabulela ukuhamba nge-drone yakho ngendlela ephephile futhi enempumelelo. Khumbula njalo ukuhlonipha imithetho nemigomo yokusebenzisa ama-drone, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uyawasebenzisa ngendlela efanele. Ngale ndlela, ungathola ulwazi olujabulisayo nolwakha, futhi ube neziqephu ezinhle nezikhumbuzo ezinhle.

Sebenzisa umouse wakho, gcina shift bese uchofoza ku-link yedokhumenti ofuna ukuyigcina. Vula i-Acrobat Reader, bese uvula izincwadi ofuna ukuzilanda kukhompyutha yakho. Uthanda usizo ngezinkinga obhekana nazo kule webhusayithi? Sicela uxhumane nathi nge-imeyili: uma unenkinga ngewebhusayithi.

Ucabanga ukuthi izinzuzo zikhona noma izinkinga? Lokhu kuyinkinga engaphendulwa, futhi ngithanda ukwazi ukuthi ubona kanjani. Ngiyabonga ngokuba nathi kulolu hambo lokuphila emadolobheni. Ngiyethemba ukuthi sithole izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu, futhi sithole indlela yokuphila kahle. Ngabe ukhona omunye umbono ofuna ukwabelana ngawo? Ngiyabonga!

Ishadi leMvume yokukhuluma komphakathi lihlose ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zokukhuluma zomphakathi isikhathi esingamashumi amane. Lingavuselelwa, uma ufaka isicelo sokuvuselelwa kwemvume okungaphansi kwezinyanga eziyisithupha futhi okungaphezulu kwezinyanga ezintathu ngaphambi kosuku lokuphela kwemvume ekhona. Lingavuselelwa kuphela uma abanikazi bemvume behlonipha imiqathango ebekwe yiziphathimandla zemvume. Imvume inikezwa emiphakathini efuna ukusungula inkampani yeSigaba 21, iTrust, inhlangano yokuzithandela, noma yimuphi omunye umzimba ovunyelwe umthetho ongasebenzi ngenhloso yokwenza inzuzo. Iphromotha ilungelo lokuxhumana kanye nenkululeko yokukhuluma imibono ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona imikhakha ehlukahlukene yokukhuluma embonini, kubandakanya imiphakathi njengababproduci, abakhulumeli, nabalaleli ekwakheni ukuxhumana nokuxhumana ukuze kube nevoce yemiphakathi ekukhiqizeni izinhlelo ezikhombisa izintshisekelo ezikhethekile nezidingo ezithile zomphakathi, kuhlanganise namasiko, ulimi, inkolo, nezidingo zokuhlela imikhakha ehlukene yomphakathi. Imvume iyasebenza isikhathi esingamashumi amane. Umnyango wezokuxhumana uxhasa abanikazi bemvume iminyaka emine ngezinsiza zokukhuluma nokukhiqiza, kodwa kuphela uma behlonipha izidingo zomnyango. I-ICASA izokhipha isikhumbuzo sokufaka izicelo zezinsizakalo zokukhuluma komphakathi futhi ihlinzeke ngezinsiza ezikhona ezindaweni ezahlukene. Susa iqembu elisebenzayo elizophatha inqubo yokufaka izicelo futhi lisebenze njengomfaki-sicelo egameni lomphakathi.

Esikhathini esedlule, isampula eqoqwe kumahhactha ayishumi kuyo yonke i-block yomhlaba yayibhekwa njenganele. Nokho, kuyas recommended ukuthi uthenge noma uboleke ithuluzi lokumba (auger) ukuze wenze imihla ukusuka phezulu phansi kulolo mhlaba nabantu ababili, omunye ethwele ibhagi yesampula ngayinye futhi ethatha i-core yomhlabathi efika ejulile phakathi kuka-15 no-20 cm kodwa ingadluli ku-20 cm. Ibhokisi lesampula kufanele libe nelayisense ecacile enombolo yefield, igama, ikheli lefama, izinombolo zokuxhumana, nosuku lokuqoqwa kwesampula, ukuze kugwenywe noma yikuphi ukudideka e-lab. Kungcono ukwenza yonke le misebenzi kahle emhlabeni ukuze kugwenywe ukungqubuzana ezisampuleni eziqoqwe. Amasampula omhlabathi akufanele aqoqwe ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ezifana nomhlaba ophuma olwandle, imifula eyomile, izindawo ezigcina izihlahla ezindala ezindaweni, izintaba eziphansi, noma izindawo eziphukile. Manje sekukhona ithuba lokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokubeka (Global Positioning System) ohlelweni lwe-grid ezindaweni ezikhethiwe eziphakathi kuka-0.5 no-4 meters, noma ukuhlela ukuqoqa amasampula ohlelweni lwe-grid. Amasampula azobe eqhathaniswa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nezinguquko ezenzakalayo ezingeni lokuvuthwa komhlabathi zingatholakala kahle ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

Nokho, kunezimo eziningi ezithinta iphesenti lokukhulelwa kwezinkomo, kodwa isimo senkomo uqobo siyinto ebalulekile (eminye imingcele ingabandakanya impilo yeqembu, inani lezinkomo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinkomo, ikhono lokufuya izinkomo, njll.). Izinkomo ezingakhuleli njalo ngonyaka akufanele zigcinwe eqenjini - ziyizivakashi kuphela futhi azinikele emalini yokufuya. Inhlanzi eshayiwe, esanda kuzalwa iyisiqalo esihle, kodwa ukuze le nhlanzi ikhiqize imali, kufanele ikhuliswe ibe semnyakeni lapho ingathengiswa khona. Inhlanzi kufanele ikhululwe ikhululekile futhi iqinile ukuze ikwazi ukuzimela ngokushesha emama wayo futhi iqale ukukhula. Isimo sokudla kw mama sibalulekile kakhulu. Uma inkomo isesimweni esihle futhi idliwa kahle, izoba nesimo esihle sokuphatha nokukhulisa inhlanzi enempilo. Izinkomo ezifa ngaphambi kokukhululwa zimele ukulahlekelwa kumlimi. Kufanele kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuze kukhululwe u-100% wezinkomo ezizalwayo. Izinkomo eziningi ezikhululiwe zithengiswa ngesisindo, ngakho uma isisindo somzimba sikhulu, intengo ezotholakala nayo izoba phezulu. Usayizi wezinkomo uvame ukuhlobana nesimo sokudla senkomo kanye naleyo nhlanzi ngonyaka kanye nohlobo lwenkukhu. Uma inhlanzi ekhulelwe ivela kuyo yonke inkomo ikhululekile, njalo izokwenza imali ethile ethuthukise le msebenzi. Njengoba kushiwo, abalimi abaningi abakhiqiza izitshalo baphinde babe nezingxenye zokufuya ezisebenzayo - izinkomo (noma ezinye izilwane) zisebenzisa amapulazi emvelo, izinkundla (ezibhalwe ezindaweni ezinezinga eliphansi lokufuya), nezindawo ezinezimfucuza zomumbu.

Lokhu kwenza kube nzima kubalimi abasha abafuna ukungena kwezolimo ukuthola umhlaba wokulima ngokushesha futhi bakhokhe ngenzuzo engatholakala. Nokho, lokhu kuyahluka uma umhlaba ungatholakala ngezinhlawulo (LRAD), noma ifakwe, noma ngemali ebolekiwe ngenzalo ephansi (njengoba kwenzeka njengamanje ngehlelo elisha elethulwe uMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba elibizwa ngokuthi iProactive Land Acquisition Scheme (PLAS)). Ukuqashwa komhlaba sekushintshile; kwakuwayindlela yokungena kwezolimo kubalimi abasafufusa, kodwa manje sekuphenduke indlela yokuthi abalimi bezomnotho bathole umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze bathuthukise ukulima kwabo. Sidinga ukucabanga kahle ngalokhu ngoba kukhona umhlaba owanele ezandleni zomphakathi wonke ongasebenzisa, futhi kukhona abalimi abaningi abanobuchwepheshe abadinga umhlaba owengeziwe ukuze balime ngendlela ezokhiqiza inzuzo. Ukuqashwa kunikeza abalimi ithuba lokwandisa umsebenzi wabo kodwa akudingi imali eningi ehambisana nokuthenga nokuba nomhlaba. Khumbula: Kukhona izindlela zokungena kwezolimo ngaphandle kokuba umnikazi wombuso; ungakwazi ukuqasha ipulazi, usebenzise umhlaba womphakathi, noma wabelane ngalowo mhlaba nabanye abalimi.

I-adopshini isho ukwamukela ukuba ngumgadi ngokomthetho wengane, ngokulandela inqubo yosiko nesemthethweni yengane engeyabanye abazali ngokuzalwa. Ubaba ngokuzala wengane ezalelwe ngaphandle komendo. Umyalelo we-adopshini ukhishwa yinkantolo yezingane ekudistriki lapho ingane ehlala khona. Inkantolo yezingane ingakhipha umyalelo ngemuva kokubunelela umbiko obekiwe owenziwe ngusonhlalonhle ogunyaziwe ngokomthetho. Yenza isicelo somyalelo we-adopshini enkantolo yezingane ekudistriki yalapho ingane ezothathwa ngokothemthetho ehlala khona. Ngoba zonke izinkantolo zomantshi zisebenza njengezinkantolo zezingane, ungenza isicelo kumabhalane wenkantolo yezingane. Umsizi wenkantolo uzothi, uma lokhu kungakenziwa, acela usonhlalonhle ogunyaziwe ukuthi aphenyisise ngesicelo. Ekugcineni kwesiphenyisiso, usonhlalonhle uzonkeza umbiko kwinkantolo yezingane lapho okwenziwe khona isicelo. Ngaphandle kokuba kudingwa yinkantolo, umbiko ngeke wadalula ukuthi ngobani nokuthi bakuthi abazali abafuna ukuthatha ingane ibe ngeyabo ngokomthetho - noma ingane, uma isivele ingakubo - ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe. Uma inkantolo yeneliseka ngombiko, kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi ngabazali abafuna ukuthatha ingane ngokomthetho bayenze eyabo, ingathi ngokubona kwayo, ibonelele isicelo ebese ikhipha umyalelo we-adopshini ngaphandle kokulalela omunye umuntu. Kodwa ingenza lokho kuphela uma kungekho ophikisa isicelo. Uma isicelo singakaphethwa, noma singeke saphethwa, kuyobekwa usuku lokulalela udaba lwesicelo enkantolo yezingane.

Ukuze uqophele imicimbi, sikhuthaza bonke ukuthumela izicelo zabo zokubamba iqhaza. Lokhu kuzokwakha isikhala sokukhuluma ezimeni ezithinta intuthuko yezokuthengisa, kanti ukuthola izixazululo ezinqala kuzoba yindlela eyodwa yokukhweza izinyathelo zokuthengisa ezisezingeni eliphezulu. Umcimbi uzobe ubukeka njengethuba lokubambisana okukhuthazayo, sibambisene ukuze sithuthukise umqondo wezezimali nezokuthengisa. Thina, kulindeleke ukuba sibe maphakathi nokuhlangenwe nakho kwemisebenzi emisha, bekhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obutsha nezinkulumo eziphumelela ngemibono ehluke ngokuphelele nezindlela ezithinta izokuthengisa. Sibheke phambili ekuthokoziseni abaphumelelayo futhi sizobona impumelelo aleli thuba. Kuhle kakhulu ukuba khona. Hamba nathi ukuze sikhule, sithuthuke, futhi sikhulume ngezinto ezithinta ubuhlakani bezokuthengisa ezikhanya. Izinhlelo, izixazululo, kanye nosizo olukhulu kufanele kuhlangane okukhuthazayo, futhi lokhu kuzokwakha ikusasa elihle, eliphumelelayo ekuthengiseni.

Ngakho-ke, yonke imisebenzi yokulima ezoba nomphumela omuhle noma ophansi ihlotshaniswa nemibewu etshaliwe. Ukuze ufinyelele umkhiqizo omuhle, kufanele utshale imbewu yekhwalithi enhle. Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola imbewu yekhwalithi enhle, kufanele uthenge imbewu eqinisekisiwe - noma ngabe ama-hybrids noma ama-OPVs. Imbewu eqinisekisiwe inezinga lokukhula elingafika ku-98% (akukho okungahambi kahle) futhi umkhiqizo wayo ungafinyelela ku-90%. Izindleko zemibewu eqinisekisiwe akufanele zibe yinkinga ekugcineni ngoba uzothola umkhiqizo ophakeme. Abalimi abakhiqiza ezindaweni ezincane noma abalimi bokuphila bahlushwa izinselelo zezimali, bavame ukutshala ummbila osele unyaka owedlule. Uma benza lokhu ngemibewu eseleyo lapho ama-hybrids abekwe khona, umkhiqizo ungashintsha kakhulu (uphakeme kuze kube ngu-50% uma kuqhathaniswa nemibewu emisha). Nokho, uma betshala imbewu eseleyo lapho ama-OPVs abekwe khona, abalahlekelwa umkhiqizo omningi. Yini i-hybrid? I-hybrid ivela lapho izinto ezimbili ezihlukile ngokuphelele (njengabazali abahlukene), enye yowesifazane nenye yowesilisa, zixubana. Ukuvuleka kokupollinate kusho ukuthi isitshalo esisodwa sithatha ipholeni sithole imbewu yaso. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuzalanisa." Lapho ummbila uqhubeka usebenzisa ipholeni yawo, izitshalo nemibewu ekhiqizwayo - izizukulwane - iyalahlekelwa amandla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi - lokhu kubizwa ngama-line aphindwe kabili.

Kodwa-ke, abantu abaningi babenokucabanga ukuthi "izinkantolo zamakhosi" zingaphansi ngokwezinga. Izinkantolo zikaKhomishani zaqedwa ngonyaka we-1986 ngaphansi komthetho wenkantolo eziyisipesheli zabantu abantu abamnyama ka 1986 (Umthetho 34 ka 1986), kanti "izinkantolo zamakhosi nezinduna" zagcinwa. Lokhu kwalandela iziphakamiso zeKhomishani kaHoexter ngonyaka we-1983. Ukwakhiwa kwezabelo nezindawo ezinozibuse kwaletha ushintsho ohlelweni lwezinkantolo zendabuko. Izabelo nezindawo ezazinozibuse zazinikwe amandla okuziphathela zona izinkantolo zazo. Lokhu kwaholela ezabelweni ziba nezinhlelo ezehlukene "zezinkantolo zamakhosi" kuye ngokuthi amasiko nemikhuba yakuleyo ndawo kusebenza kanjani. Ezindaweni ezazaziwa ngokuthi yiTranskei neKwaZulu "izinkantolo zamakhosi" zazinamandla acishe afane nawezinkantolo zeziMantshi. Ukwedluliselwa kwamacala endaweni eyayaziwa ngokuthi yiTranskei esuswa kubaholi bendabuko kwakuyiswa kubaholi beziyingi lapho amakhosi nezindlovukazi babemelwe khona. Endaweni eyayaziwa ngeBophuthatswana, ngokwenkambiso yomthetho wezinkantolo zendabuko zaseBophuthatswana ka1979 (Umthetho 29 ka 1979), igunya lokulalela amacala egazi nawombango lanikezelwa ezinhlakeni (amakhosi ezigodi) hhayi kumholi wendabuko ngamunye. Ukwedluliselwa kwamacala esuswa kulezi zinhlaka zendabuko kwakuya enkantolo eyisipesheli kuleso naleso sikhungo sikamantshi namalungu amabili ongeziwe (ongoti basezizweni ezakhele leso siyingi).

Izinhlelo Zokuphatha Izigameko Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Ngiyabingelela, ngithanda ukukhuluma ngendaba ebalulekile, eyaziwa kakhulu, kodwa engathathwa kalula – izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela. Kulabo abangakaze babe nesipiliyoni sokuhlangabezana nezimo eziphuthumayo, kungaba nzima ukuqonda ukuthi yini okufanele yenziwe. Kukhona izindlela ezithile ezilungiselelwe ukusiza abantu abadinga usizo ngokushesha. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi yini ezimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kungabandakanya izinto ezifana nokuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo, ukushaywa, ukulimala okukhulu, noma izimo ezinjalo. Uma umuntu efika esibhedlela enezimo ezinjalo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile ezilungiselelwe ukuze kuncishiswe isikhathi sokulinda, futhi usizo lufike ngokushesha. Uma uhamba esibhedlela, kumele uqaphele ukuthi iziguli zihlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlukaniswa kwezimo" noma "triage." Abahlengikazi nabodokotela bazobheka isimo somuntu ngokushesha, bahlukanise iziguli ezidinga usizo oluphuthumayo kulabo abangenalo. Lokhu kusiza ekwenzeni isiqiniseko sokuthi abantu abadinga usizo oluphuthumayo bahlala bephuthumekile. Ngemuva kokuhlukaniswa, iziguli ezidinga usizo oluphuthumayo ziya phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma unokuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo, ungase ube phezulu ohlwini, ngenkathi abanye abantu, abangekho engcupheni enkulu, bahlala belindile. Lokhu kusebenza kahle, ngoba kusiza ukunciphisa amathuba okuthi kube nezinkinga ezengeziwe. Ngemuva kokuthi iziguli zihlukaniswe, kudingeka ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukukwazi ukusiza iziguli ngokushesha.

Ukusebenza kwabo akugcini nje ngokukhiqiza ukudla, kodwa futhi kubandakanya ukugcina amasiko ethu, imikhuba, kanye nezindlela zokuphila ezihlukahlukene. Abalimi bethu bahlala bejolise ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, onokuthula, futhi ophumelelayo. Ukuvikelwa okujwayelekile: Izindawo okwakulwelwa kuzona izimpi, izindawo okwakuhlalwa kuzona emandulo, izindawo ezinamadwala aqoshiwe, nezindawo ezinezinto ezabunjwa emandulo, izindawo ezinezigaxa zamadwala eziwa esibhakabhakeni kanye nomthelela wazo 48. ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe yoMkhandlu emva kokufakwa kwesicelo eMkhandlwini. Uma kutholakala izimpahla zendawo okwakuhlalwa kuzona emandulo noma zendawo enezinto ezabunjwa emandulo ngayinoma yimuphi umuntu, yonke imisebenzi noma okwenziwa lapho kukhona lezo zimpahla kumele kumiswe khona manjalo futhi umuntu ozitholile kumele alethe umbiko obhaliwe eMkhandlwini ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi. UMkhandlu, emva kokubonisana nomnikazi noma nomaziphathe olawulayo, ngesaziso esiqondiswa kumnikazi noma kumaziphathe olawulayo, ungavimbela noma yimuphi umsebenzi uMkhandlu obona ukuthi awufanelekile owenziwa emamitheni angama-50 endawo enamadwala aqoshiwe. Akukho muntu ongavumbulula, asuse noma endaweni yayo noma aphazamise, adale umonakalo, acekele phansi noma athathe into noma impahla ehambisana indawo okwakulwelwa kuyona izimpi, indawo okwakuhlalwa kuyona emandulo, indawo enamadwala aqoshiwe, indawo enezinto ezabunjwa emandulo, izindawo ezinezigaxa zamadwala eziwa esibhakabhakeni kanye nomthelela wazo ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe yoMkhandlu emva kokufakwa kwesicelo eMkhandlwini.

Ubumfihlo Bolwazi Lwabancikile (GEMS Dependent Information Confidentiality) eNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi nolwazi lwabancikile kudlala indima enkulu empilweni yomuntu. Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwabancikile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abathola izinzuzo zokwelapha kanye nezimali, kubalulekile ukuze kudalwe isisekelo sokwethembeka nokuhlonipha. Lokhu kudinga ukuqonda okujulile, njengoba izimo zokuphila zidinga ukwenziwa ngokucophelela. Abancikile, nabanye abavela ezigabeni ezifana nababhalisile, bathola ithuba lokusebenzisa izinsizakalo zeGEMS (Government Employee Medical Scheme), kodwa lokhu kudinga ukugcina ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Ukuvikela le mininingwane kubalulekile ekwakheni umuzwa wokuqinisekiswa nokuphepha kumuntu. Umcimbi wethu uhlose ukuxoxa ngemicabango nezinqubomgomo ezithinta ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izindlela zokuvikela idatha, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo igcinwa iyimfihlo, nokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo aluphumi ngaphandle kokuhlola. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo zifundise abathola izinsizakalo mayelana nezici zobalo nokubaluleka kokuba nemininingwane efanele yokuphila kwabo. Umthetho kanye nezinqubomgomo zenkampani kumele ziqinisekise ukuthi ubumnyama bemininingwane busebenza kahle. Ukuze lokhu kuqinisekiswe, kudingeka kube nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlangano ezahlukene, kuhlanganisa osomabhizinisi, othisha, nabaphathi bezempilo. Ukuze siphumelele kulokhu, kudingeka uhlelo oluqinile lokufundisa abanicikile nabakhiqiza ulwazi.

Uma ufuna ukungenisa izimoto ezithengiswa okwesibili noma esezike zasetshenziswa eNingizimu Afrika, udinga imvume yesipesheli ebuya kuNgqongqoshe waboMnyango wezoHwebo neZimboni noma ama-agent akhe. Ihhovisi likaNgqongqoshe lizothatha isinqumo ngokubonelela isizwe ngezimoto ezithengwa okwesibili noma esezike zasetshenziswa ukuthi zingeniswe ngaphakathi ezweni. Kumele ufakele ifomu elichaziwe ukwenza isicelo sezimvume zokungenisa ngaphakathi ezweni. Izimvume zokungenisa impahla ngaphakathi zidingeka kuzo zonke izimpahla ezingaphansi kolawulo lwezimpahla ezingeniswayo. Izimvume ziyadingeka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi impahla ethengiswa okwesibili engeniswayo, ngeke yacikela phansi imboni ye-South African Customs Union . Le nkonzo ithuthukisa ukulandelwa kwenqubo kwezokuphepha kanye neqophelo. Nikeza ngekhophi yesitifikedi esiqinisekisiwe sikaMazisi wakho. Nikeza aboMnyango ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yesitifikedi sobhaliso yemoto. Kungathatha izinsuku ezintathu ukubhekana nesicelo sakho. Le nkonzo ngeyamahhala ayikhokhelwa.

Ilunga lekomiti eliphethe okukhulunywa ngalo kusigatshana 1 c no f kufanele likhethwe amalunga oMkhandlu. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi amavoti awalingani mayelana nondaba lapho ikomiti eliphethe kufanele lithathe isinqumo , usihlalo uyakuba nevoti elingumqamulajuqu ngaphezu kwevoti lakhe. Isikhathi sokuphatha isikhundla samalunga ekomiti eliphethe kuyakuba izinyanga ezingama-20. Ikomiti eliphethe lingasebenzisa amandla ngale kwamandla okukhulunywa ngawo esihlukweni 3 futhi lingenza noma imuphi umsebenzi woMkhandlu esikhathini esiphakathi kwemihlangano yoMkhandlu kodwa alinawo amandla okuchitha noma ukuchibiyela isinqumo somkhandlu, ngaphandle uma uMkhandlu uyala nokunye, nangokuhambisana neziyalo zoMkhandlu. Noma isiphi isenzo esenziwe noma isinqumo esithathwe ikomiti eliphethe isibopho ngaphandle uma sichithwe noma sichitshiyelwe uMkhandlu emhlanganweni wawo olandelayo. UMkhandlu ungasungula amanye amakomiti, okubalwa ikomiti lokuziphatha ngobuchwepheshe nekomiti lezemfundo, uma ubona kufanele ukuze lenze uphenyo futhi lenzele uMkhandlu umbiko nganoma iluphi undaba olusendimeni yomsebenzi wawo.

Lesi yisimo engingeke ngasibekezelela. Uma abantu bedinga usizo (ukulethelwa izidingo) ababuzi ukuthi iyiphi inhlangano yezombusazwe ebalethele lezo zodingo. Ngibashayela ihlombe labo masipala abakubeke eceleni ukuchema ngokombusazwe ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo. Kuyacaca ngalolu hlelo ukuthi singakwazi ukusheshisa ukulethwa kwezidingo futhi silethe impilo engcono emiphakathini yethu uma sisebenzisana njengezinhlaka zikahulumeni. Umthetho omusha owaziwa ngele-Inter-governmental Relations Act, usinikeza incazelo noholo lokuthi singasebenzisana kanjani. Nginxenxa wonke umuntu okhona lapha namuhla ukuba awasebenzise amathuba anje ngalawa. Imiphakathi ifuna I-proper sanitation. Ayikugqizi qakala ukuthi iliphi iqembu lezombusazwe eliphethe. Uma ingayiboni intuthuko (ubungcono) ezimpilweni zayo izibona injengabantu abashaywe indiva nguhulumeni. Ngiyazi ukuthi uhlelo lokusetshenziswa kwamathoyilethe amabhakede lusekhona eZakheni, okuyindawo engaqhelile kakhulu ukusuka lapha. Izakheni ayingeni ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-Project Consolidate. Kodwa-ke ngiyethemba ukuthi I-PMU izolandela izindlela namasu afanayo okubonakala kusebenza ekubhekaneni nale nkinga naseZakheni. Namuhla ngokusho ngaphandle kokunanaza ukuthi ukuzibophezela okwenziwe uhulumeni wethu ekuletheni impilo engcono kuzo zonke izakhamuzi sekuyafezeka.

Ngakhoke Ukwakhiwa/ ukunikezwa kwamandla, kolwazi ezifundazweni kubalulekile. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi abaqhamuka ezinqolobaneni zaseMpumalanga kanye nasezifundazwei eziseNingizimu Afrika, isibonelo ezisuka Ebotswana. Umsebenzi wokuqala: ukusatshalaliswa kwemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwemininingwane / yamarekhodi ukuze kuxhaswe ukusebenza kwekhomishana yamaqiniso nokubuyisana. Ubunyoninco bokwakha izimpawu nobuhlukile baseNingizimu kuhlanganisa / izimpawu eziningi ezithaththwe emasikweni ahlukahlukene omphakathi, sekuze kwaba uphawu emazweni omhlaba entuthukweni yokwakha izimpawu. Ngo-2000 lengosi yaba nempendulo ohideni lwemibuzo mayelana nefulegi kanye nezinto ezithinta ukuhlangana kwezizukulwane ngaphakathi eNingizimu Africa kanye naPhesheya. Ukuxhumana namazwe omhlaba. Ukuxhumana namanye amazwe kuhlale kukhona mayelana nezimpawu , ifulegi kanye nezinye izikhulu emhlabeni ezibhekene nezimpawu. Ngakho ukunikezwa kwezeluleko ezimpawini nokuhambisana nakho ezinhlanganweni eziphesheya kuwumsebenzi walengosi. Umsizi womgcini wezwe wathamela umhlangano womhlaba kwelase-France, yilapha ethula khona iphepha mayelana nohlelo olusha lwezifundazwe kanye nezwe lonke kweze- Coat of Arm. Ngombiko wonyaka usozimpawu wezwe wathatha umhlalaphansi, kodwa wacelwa ukuba aqhubeke kulelozinga ngasese kuze kuqokwe owayezomlandela. Umgomo wolimi kanye nohlelo lweNingizimuAfrika kanye nomthetho sivivinywa wezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika.
