Ngokusho kwesigaba 82, umgwaqo noma isigaba singashintshwa kuphela nguMEC ngemuva kokuhlanganisa izinqubo ezibekwe ezigabeni 81 kuya ku-8 futhi izinguquko zomgwaqo kufanele zishicilelwe esigabeni 11. Isigaba 7 soMthetho oyinhloko silungiswa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". a ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 1 noma kuphi lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 611". b ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 2 noma kuphi lapho amagama "isigaba 611" futhi ukufaka amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "61 kuya ku-11". a umbiko wendawo obhekiswe esigabeni 4b noma isigaba 63a, uma kudingeka; futhi f ngokufaka esigabeni 8 amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "isigaba 611." Isigaba 10 soMthetho oyinhloko silungiswa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" kunoma yisiphi isigaba lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6".

Ukusebenzisa ingane okungavunyelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 141; kanye f nokuhlukumeza izingxenye zomzimba ezithile. UMthetho Wokuxazulula Ezinye Izindaba Zokuhlukanisa uchaza uMthetho ophathelene nokuxazulula izindaba eziphathelene nokuhlukaniswa kwabantu abashadile be-1987 uMthetho No. udala umhloli wezempilo obhalisiwe noma owamukelekile njengobhalisiwe ukwenza umsebenzi wezokwelapha ngaphansi koMthetho Wobuchwepheshe Bezempilo ka-1974 uMthetho No. ukwazisa mayelana nanoma yisiphi isaziso, incwadi noma enye indlela ephathelene nezinhlinzeko zalesi Mthetho, uchaza ukwethulwa kwalokho kuzaziso, incwadi noma enye indlela ngokuhambisana nenqubo enikezwe yokwethulwa kwenqubo ngaphansi koMthetho Wezinkantolo ZamaMagistrate ka-1944 uMthetho No. umprofeshinali wezokuxhumana ufaka abasebenzi abaphethe umuntu ongagcwele, abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa, abasebenzi abaphethe izingane nentsha kanye nabasebenzi bezokuphepha komphakathi abhaliswe ngalolu hlobo ngaphansi koMthetho Wobuchwepheshe Bezokuxhumana ka-1978 uMthetho No. Isisekelo seMvumelwano yeZizwe Ezihlangene Sokuvikela Ukuhweba Ngabantu sichaza indlela yeZizwe Ezihlangene evimbela, icindezela futhi ibhujise Ukuhweba Ngabantu, ikakhulukazi abesifazane nezingane, isekela iMvumelwano yeZizwe Ezihlangene ka-2000 ngokumelene Nobugebengu Obuhlanganisiwe ezwenikazi, umbhalo ofanayo owatholakala kuSheduli 3.

Uma kudingeka, dweba uhlu lukuma kwezikhundla(i-organogram) ebonisa ukuthi umuntu ngamunye wenzani nokuthi ubika kubani. Ukuhlaziya izimboni kanye nezimakethi ulwazi olusemqoka oludingekayo ukuhlola isikhathi esizayo sebhizini lakho. Ukuhlaziya kwemboni kumele kufake ulwazi jikelele ngemboni yezokuvakasha eNingizimu afrika-Abadlali abasemqoka, inkambiso nezehlakalo kanye nezingxenye ezahlukene zomthetho ezingathelela ibhizinisi lakho. Ukuhlaziywa kwemakethe, ngakwelinye icala, okufaka ulwazi olucacile ngengxenye ethile yemakethe yezokuvakasha ekukhona kutyo ibhizinisi lakho, isibonelo umphatheli wezokuvakasha, indawo yekhonferensi njll.- izimo zemakethe esikhona, ukunikezwa izintengo kwemikhiqizo kanye nezinsizakalo ezinikezwayo, abangaba ngamaklayenti/izivakashi nokuthi uzakuqinisekisa kanjani ukuthi ungakwazi ukuncintisana nabanye. Uhlelo lwakho lokuthengisa nokumaketha lichaza ukuthi uzoliqhubekisa kanjani ibhizinisi lakho. Isimo sokubeka izintengo(imali engenayo) yomkhiqizo wakho kumele ifakwe lapha kanye namathuba okumaketha azokusiza ukuba ufinyelele emalini engenayo ohlose ukuyithola. Amathuba okumaketha angafaka: Izincwadi ezikhishiwe ezikhonazokukhangisa ngemboni, amapheshana okwazisa, imibukiso noma ukuvakashela ngqo kulabo abangaba ngamakhasimende. Zama ukubeka izinsuku eziyimigomo zaloku ofuna ukukufinyelela. Ngenhlanhla, uhlelo lokumaketha yinto ozoyisebenzisa njalo futhi izokukhula iguquke nebhizinisi lakho. Ngaloko ungesabisi yimizamo yakho yokuqala.

Koboekae ugcizelele ukuthi kuzoba nemihlangano yokwabelana ngolwazi ezoqhubeka ngababambiqhaza abaqeqeshiwe ukuze baqeqeshe labo abazohileleka ngaphambi kokuba umkhosi omkhulu uqale. Imiphumela yalezi zinhlelo ibonisa ukuthi isisekelo sokuhlanganyela nababambiqhaza sikhulisiwe. Amalungu azokwazi ukuthi umhlangano wokulungiselela owenziwe kubabusi obubanjwe eBali, e-Indonesia muva nje wenze intuthuko enkulu ekufinyeleleni esivumelwaneni sokuthi kwenzeke ini ukuze kuthuthukiswe. I-graphite engakadalwanga; i-graphite ye-colloidal noma ye-semi-colloidal; amalungiselelo esekelwe ku-graphite noma ezinye izinto ze-carbon ezifana namabhlogo, amapuleti, noma izinto ezingakhi. Sithole imibiko eminingi yokuthunjwa kwabo abatholakele ezinxushunxushwini, ukuhlolwa kwabo phambi kwabantu bezokuphepha, nezinqumo zempilo, njengoba uBetty echaza, zazivame ukuthathwa ngokusekelwe kulokho okwakudingeka ukuze kuphumelele ukuphepha. Kubalulekile ukuthi kukhunjulwe ukususa utshani ukuze kudaleke indawo eqinile endaweni yayo. Lokhu kuhluka emibonweni evela kwiPolokwane Conference futhi akuyona into engajwayelekile enhlangano enomlando ojabulisayo wokuphakamisa izingxoxo zamandla. Umphakathi uthi kufanele kube nesikole esisha esikhundleni sokukhona, esigcwele kakhulu futhi esigcwele. Amaphoyisa aqale ukusishaya, asiphushela ukuba siqhekeze odongeni, abanye bethu basiphushela. Lokhu kuholele ekubambisaneni phakathi kwezigaba ezahlukene kanye nokuqalwa kwezenzo ezithile ezihlobene nokugcina izindawo ezahlukene. Abasebenzi besikole abakhubazekile banethuba lokuxoxa bodwa nabaphathi abaphethe izifundo ukuze baqinise izindlela zokweseka.

Amakhanda ezitshalo ezithintekayo ancane kunezempilo. Ukuwa kwehlisa inani lembewu, ikakhulukazi ngoba imbewu ilula. Izitshalo ezithintekayo zehla kalula uma kunomoya omkhulu. Lokhu kuvame ukubonakala lapho izimbali ziqhamuka noma ngemuva kwalolo sikhathi, kubonakala ngaphakathi noma eduze komqolo. Kuqala kubonakala njengombala omnyama noma ophuzi-oluhlaza opholile. Bese umqolo ubamba ikhanda, izindawo ezithintekayo ziba namanzi futhi zibe nsoft. Umqolo uvame ukuphuka uma kukhona ukuwa, futhi konke okungaphezulu komqolo kufa. Imvamisa i-mycelium emhlophe kanye nama-sclerotia azovela ngaphandle nangaphakathi komqolo, ikakhulukazi uma kunemvula. Ekugcineni, izindawo ezithintekayo ziba mhlophe futhi ziyaqala. Ukuwa komqolo kungaqhubeka phansi ethishelweni noma kungakhuphuka phezulu kwekhanda. Ngezinye izikhathi leaf ingathola i-Sclerotinia futhi i-fungus izoqhubeka nokungena nokubola umqolo. Izimpawu zokuqala ezibonakalayo ziwukuthi: i-fungus emhlophe (mycelium) ibonakala ezitshalweni noma izindawo ezithwele amanzi ngaphansi kwekhanda. I-fungus ikhula ngokushesha kulowo mhlaba, ibola ikhanda bese i-mycelium emhlophe kanye nezindawo eziningi ze-sclerotia ezimnyama zivele. Ikhanda livame ukubonakala limhlophe, libonakala ngokushesha. Ikhanda lonke lingabola futhi indawo lapho kukhona imbewu yehla, ishiyela ikhanda elimhlophe elibolile eline-sclerotia. Lezi zikhanda ezim

Uhlanga noma umxube. Lokhu kunikezwa umuntu onesifo se-cholera: Faka amathisipuni ayisishiyagalombili kashukela engilazini yamanzi ahlanzekile, kanye nethisipuni elilodwa lesawoti. Hlanganisa bese unika umuntu ophuma emathunjini futhi onenhliziyo yokuphuma, njengoba lokhu kubuyisela amanzi emzimbeni. Ukuvuselela amanzi emzimbeni kubalulekile; zonke izinkomba ze-cholera zidinga ukuthi umuntu abuyiselwe amanzi ngokushesha. Ungawashisi izingubo ezingcolile noma uvumele abantu badlale, baqhamuke emanzini omphakathi afana nezinsimu. Uma beshonile, kufanele babekwe ebhokisini elivulekile lapho bephuma endaweni eyodwa beyisa kwenye. Batha emanzini afudumele aneshampu bese umisa elangeni. Izimpawu zivele phakathi kwamahora ambalwa kuya ezinsukwini ezinhlanu. Ukulimala kwemithambo, kulandela ukulahleka kwegazi okuholela ekufeni. Abantu abangenamanzi ahlanzekile afana nalawo asuka emtapweni. Abantu abasebenzisa amanzi atholakala emifuleni, emadams, noma emifuleni. Uma uthatha amanzi emfuleni, kufanele uwahlanze kuqala ngaphambi kokuwasebenzisa. Hlanza imifino ngamanzi ahlanzekile noma amanzi aphekiwe. Hlanza izandla ngaphambi nangemva kokudla. Hlanza izitsha ngamanzi ahlanzekile noma amanzi aphekiwe. Hlanza izandla njalo uma ubuya esikhathini. Gcina ukudla endaweni ehlelekile. Ukudla kufanele kuphakelwe ngamanzi ahlanzekile futhi kudliwe ngesikhathi esishisayo. Gwema umkhuba wokudla esitsheni esisodwa ngasikhathi sinye. Ukudla okuphekiwe akufanele kuhlangane nokudla okungaphekiwe ukuze kugwenywe ukuhlanganiswa. Ukulahla udoti kufanele kwenziwe ngendlela engaphuli amanzi emithonjeni efana nemifuleni. Gwema ukuheha izinyoni.

UMthethosivivinywa, ophathelene nemisebenzi ebalwe ohleni kulaSheduli 4 noma eshiwo esigabeni 76(3), ngaphandle koMthethosivivinywa ophathelene nemali, ungethulwa eMkhandlwini kaZwelonke weziFundazwe. Yilungu, noma yikomidi loMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe kuphela elivunyelwe ukwethula uMthethosivivinywa phambi koMkhandlu. UMthethosivivinywa owamukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke kufanele udluliselwe kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe uma kufanele ucwaningwe uMkhandlu kaZwelonke; uMthethosivivinywa ovunywe uMkhandlu kaZwelonke kufanele uyiswe kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke. Mkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe wesekwe yivoti okungenani lezifundazwe eziyisithupha. Mkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe wesekwe yivoti okungenani lezifundazwe eziyisithupha. IPhalamende alivunyelwe ukwemukela uMthethosivivinywa wokushintsha uMthethosisekelo futh ophathelene nemandla, imingcele kanye nemisebenzi yezifundazwe, ngaphambi kokuba udluliselwe kwisishayamthetho sesifundazwe esithintekile ukuze sinikeze imibono yaso. lithule, ngokulandela imitheshwana kanye nezinqumo zoMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe, leyo mininingwane eMkhandlwini ukuze kuphikiswane ngawo obala, uma isichibiyelo esihlongozwayo kungesona isichibiyelo esidinga ukuba samukelwe nguMkhandlu. mayelana nezichibiyelo okuphawlwe ngazo kwisigatshana (1), (2), noma (3)(b), ku Sihlalo woMkhandlu sikazwelonke sezifundazwe ukuze zethulwe kuMkhandlu.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yahlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuhlola ukufaneleka. Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuthi baqonde ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zifaneleka kubo yini. Umphakathi wawudinga ukwazi ukuthi izinzuzo ezifana nezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokuhlola, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa zikhona yini kubo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlelo ezithile zokuhlola, ezazisiza abasebenzi ukuthi baqonde kahle izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi banolwazi olufanele. Izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezithuthukisiwe zafaka phakathi ama-workshops, izifundo, kanye nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezazihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile. Lokhu kwathuthukisa ukwazi kwabantu mayelana nezinsizakalo ze-GEMS, futhi kwavumela abantu ukuba bakwazi ukusebenzisa izinzuzo ezitholakalayo. Nokho, nakuba i-GEMS yayihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezinhle, kwavela izinselelo ezithile. Abanye abantu babebhekene nezithiyo ezithile zokufaneleka, okuholela ekutheni bangakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo ezazifunwa. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwemigomo ethile yokuhlola, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene banethuba lokuthola izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Kodwa-ke, i-GEMS yahlala ihlola izinqubomgomo zayo ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi izinzuzo zifinyeleleka kubantu abaningi. Ukuhlola njalo izinqubomgomo zayo kwavumela i-GEMS ukuba ibheke izidingo zomphakathi, futhi yenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezihambisana nezidingo zabo.

Sonke siyazi ukuthi uhlelo lwamathoyilethe asebenzisa amabhakede aluhambisani nenhlanzeko yezempilo kanye nokuphepha kwabantu bakithi. Ayikho incazelo ezwakalayo enganikezwa lo mphakathi ngokuthi kungani ungawatholi amanzi kanye namathoyilethe asebenzisa amanzi esimanjemanje. Lo mphakathi uyazi kunomakhelwane abaqhelelene abalapha eduzane nje ngamamitha angama-200 abakwaziyo ukuthola amanzi nezinsiza zokuthutha indle. Uma ubuka ingozi ubungozi obulethwa wuhlelo lwamathoyilethe asebenza ngamabhakede ezimpilweni zabantu, uzobona ukuthi isibalo sabantu ababulawa ngendluzula nguhulumeni wobandlululo sincane uma usiqhathanisa nesibalo sabantu ababulawa yizifo ezifana nohudo kanye nezinye. Lezi yizifo ezingaxhunyaniswa ngqo nokungabi khona kwamanzi kanye namathoyilethe. Imiphakathi esihlupheke kakhulu yileyo yabantu abamnyama njengalapha eNdaka. Okubuhlungu kakhulu ukuthi abesifazane kanye nezingane yibona abathwala kanzima kakhulu ngenxa yalesi simo. Njengoba sigubha inyanga eqondene nomama, sibheka ukuzinikela kwabesimame ababephambili emzabalazweni. Kuyinjabulo ukuba size nezindaba ezimnandi zokuthi abesifazane nezingane, okuyibona abebesengozini yokungenwa yizifo nokuthunazeka isithunzi ngenxa yamathoyilethe asebenzisa amabhakede, okuyibona ababelahlekelwa abathandiweyo babo, okuyibona osekuyiminyaka bengumtshingo ubethwa ngubani uma kuziwa ngasekulethweni kwezidingo ezifana namanzi namathoyilethe ashaywayo, namuhla bazobuyelwa yisithunzi ngokuhlinzekwa ngamathoyilethe afanele abanikeza leso sithunzi njengabantu. Ngolwazi engilutholile, isimo bese sisibi ngale ndlela yokuthi iningi lemindeni bese lizichithela yona amabhakede.

Yilowo nalowo muntu onamalungelo athintwe yisinyathelo sokuphatha, unelungelo lokunikezwa izizathu ezibhaliwe zaleso sinyathelo. ukhuthaze ukuthi kubenombuso osebenza ngokukhuthala. Wonke umuntu unelungelo lokuthi noma yiyiphi ingxabano engaxazululwa ngokusebenzisa umthetho, inqunywe yinkantolo yomthetho ecaleni eligculisayo elivulekele umphakathi noma, lapho kulungile, leyo ngxabano ingaxazululwa yinkundla ezimele nengavuni hlangothi. lokukhululwa ekuvalelweni uma izidingo zobulungiswa zivuma, kodwa ngemibandela efanelekile. udokotela oqokwe nguye. lokufaka isicelo sokudlulisa icala noma ukuhlaziywa kwalo yinkantolo enkulu. Lapho lesi sigaba sidinga ukuba umuntu aziswe okuthile, lolo lwazi kufanele lowo muntu alunikwe ngolimi aluqonda kahle. Ubufakazi obutholakale ngendlela ephambene nanoma yiliphi ilungelo elikuMqulu wamaLungelo kufanele bungangeniswa njengobufakazi ecaleni uma ukungeniswa kwalobo bufakazi bungenza ukuthi icala lingagculisi noma kungakhinyabeza ukuphathwa kobulungiswa. ezinye izindlela ezinezihibe ezingaphansi ezingafeza injongo efanayo. Ngaphandle uma kwenziwe ngendlela ehlinzekelwe kwisigatshana (1) noma esinye sezimiso zoMthethosisekelo awukho umthetho onganciphisa noma yiliphi ilungelo elihlinzekelwe kuMqulu wamaLungelo. isimemezelo sesimo esibucayi sidingekile ukuze kubuyiselwe uxolo nokuthula. isikhathi esingeqile ezinsukwini ezingu 21 kusukela osukwini lwesimemezelo ngaphandle uma uMkhandlu kaZwelonke unquma ukwelula isikhathi sesimemezelo. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke unganquma ukwelula isikhathi sokusebenza kwesimemezelo sesimo esibucayi ngesikhathi esingeqile ezinyangeni ezintathu.

a uhlu lwabo bonke abanikazi abathole ukubuyiselwa, labo ababuyelelwe, kanye nalabo abathole ukuncipha ngonyaka odlule ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1; futhi b isitatimende esibonisa imali etholelwe umphakathi odlule ngemuva kokubuyiselwa, ukubuyiselwa, nokuncipha. b imisebenzi yezomnotho engapheli kulowo maphakathi; noma c ukuhamba kwezimpahla ngaphakathi kwelizwe, ukuthumela kwezidingo, imali, noma abasebenzi. h Okungenani inani lokuqala le-R15,000 lenani lezakhiwo zonke lapho zakhiwe futhi zihlala khona, ngaphandle kokuthi kutholakale ukuthi uNgqongqoshe, ngokuxhumana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali, angakhulisa le mali ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ukuze ihambisane nezinga lezomnotho ngaleso sikhathi; futhi i Impahla/umhlaba noma izigaba zezakhiwo/umhlaba njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 3, noma inani lentela yezindlu elibekwe enanini elibekwe njengemikhawulo empahleni/indawo noma esigabeni sezakhiwo noma indawo. i izindawo zomnotho ii izindawo zezimboni; noma iii izindawo zokulima izinga elikhulunywe esigabeni 1 b lingashicilelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali. UNgqongqoshe angase, ngokubambisana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali nangesaziso, abeke umkhawulo kumaphesenti lapho inani lentela yezindlu kufanele likhuphuke unyaka nonyaka. a kanye nezinhlobo zamamasipala angase, kulandela lesi sigaba, achazwe esazisweni njengokuhambelana nezigaba noma izinhlobo zamamasipala ngaphansi kokuchazwa komthetho wezakhiwo zamamasipala nakwezinye izindlela; noma b izinhlobo zomphakathi/izigaba uma kukhona isizathu esihle, uNgqongqoshe angavuma ukubuyiselwa kumamasipala ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ebekwe kulandela isigaba 1.

Amalungu ezindaba anconywa ukuba alungiselele izinhlelo zabo zokuhamba ngesikhathi sokuhlonishwa. Ingabe ubone ukuthi udonga lwangaphandle lwalupaintwa phansi ngalesi sikhathi noma ingxenye yalo? Ingxenye enkulu yalolu shintsho igxile eCape Town. Umongameli, yonke le misebenzi ingxenye yesu elikhulu lokwenza uMbuso wethu uphephe ezinkampanini, abathengisi bezidakamizwa, kanye nezono. Sibe nezinkulumo eziphumelelayo futhi sijabule ngomsebenzi owenziwayo kulolu hlangano. Izimo ezinzima zamahhovisi abaphathi abakhulu esakhiweni esivunyiwe ehhovisi elikhulu ziyadingeka. Umhloli uzokwazi kangcono ukwenza isinqumo ngalokhu. Usizo lwezobuchwepheshe lwas visiting indawo futhi lwathola nolwazi ngamanzi kanye nezinsiza zokuphuma kwemfucumfucu. Uthe imboni yezokuvakasha idinga ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekani emphakathini ezinqubweni zayo zebhizinisi njengoba izivakashi zamazwe omhlaba ziqaphela okwenzekayo. Ukuze sithole imiphumela enengqondo esikhathini esiphakathi naphakathi nesikhathi eside, kubalulekile ukuhlela izinhlelo zezentengiselwano ngendlela edala umzamo ohlelekile phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nabalingani bawo emphakathini. Umnyango Wokuhlola weDolobha laseCape Town usuqalile ukulungiselela isigaba sesithathu sokuhlola okukhomba ukukala. Umnyango awunikezi igunya kokuqukethwe kwanoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi engase ihlanganiswe nale. Uhlu lwemali okumele ikhokhwe kwiwebhusayithi yeElsenburg noma lungatholakala elabhorethri. Ngizokwenza ukuqala ngokukhuluma ngezindaba ezibalulekile esibhekene nazo nsuku zonke. Senza imizamo ebonakalayo yokuzama ukuthola izixazululo eziningi ezibhekene neProvinsi yethu.

Umbuzo 10: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lokuvikela ezikhukhuleni KwaZulu-Natal? Ngokubona kwami, ikusasa lokuvikela ezikhukhuleni KwaZulu-Natal linokukhanya. Uma abantu, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele bamba iqhaza, sizokwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezikhukhula. Ukukhuluma, ukufundisa, nokwakha izinhlelo eziqhubekayo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela abantu ezikhukhuleni ezizayo. Ubufakazi bokubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi nabaholi bukhombisa ukuthi singakwazi ukwakha indawo ephephile. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sonke sithathe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izikhukhula zingathinti impilo yethu ngendlela engafanele. Ngale ndlela, singenza kube lula ukuhlala kahle KwaZulu-Natal.

U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. Njengoba uNandi ehlola izinsizakalo, wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe badinga ukuxhumana, ngakho-ke izibhedlela ziqinisekisa ukuthi kukhona izinhlelo zokuxhumana, ezihlanganisa izifundo zokukhulisa izingane, izifundo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zikhona ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bahlala bejabulile, futhi lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. Ngesikhathi esebenza nezinhlaka ezahlukene, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nokuhlinzwa uma kudingeka. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bangathola izinsizakalo zokwelashwa ezikhethekile, ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphumula, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana nezingane. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu.

Eziwombeni zezinto ezihamba phambili nokuntuleka ulwazi ngazo, ukuhlaziya okunzulu nokugxile emongweni kufanelekile (Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /8 no 1 /9 emibandeleni yemboni ethile). Ulwazi oluqoqwa ngeSigaba sokuHlaziya lufanele kakhulu labo ababambe iqhaza kwinqubo ezayo yokuhlela nokuthatha izinqumo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele lufingqwe ukuze lusetshenziswe eSigabeni 2 (Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /10). Ukuguqula impikiswano: Kunomqondo ukuqoqa ulwazi oluyosetshenziswa esikhathini esizayo sokuhlela inqubo ye-IDP. Ngakho, umbuzo wabaphathi uthi Yini inhloso yokwazi lokhu Futhi kumele uhlahle indlela yayoyonke imisebenzi eSigabeni 1? Esikhundleni sokuqoqa ulwazi olukhona (1 /1) nokuhlaziya isimo somphakathi nababambe iqhaza ngokwehlukana nangendlela engaxhumene , omasipala kumele bazame ukulumbanisa inqubo. Ukuhlaziya akusiyo inqubo ebanzi yokuvundulula isimo njengoba sinjalo sakudala nesiwukusaphaza. Ukuhlaziya kuchazwa futhi kuqondiswe noma kuthathelwa ezidingweni ezisungulwe ngaphansi kohlelo lwe-IDP. Isigaba sokuhlaziya I-IDP singahlinzeka izimo eziningi njengoba zinjalo nemibandela evamile (njengomehluko okhona ebantwini, isimo sabathengi, ukuhlaziya izici zokwentuleka kwemali nabantu bokusebenza). Lezi zinto ezibukeka zingaphindeka lapho kuhlelwa imboni kumele zifakwe ngaphansi komsebenzi "Ukuqoqa ulwazi oselukhona" (1 /1) kanjalo nokuqagula amagebe emisebenzi yomphakathi encike embonini.

Imibhalo elandelayo itholakala mahhala, uma ngabe ikhona. Ingakwazi futhi ukufundisiswa emahhovisi akhethiwe nakhona futhi uma ngabe ikhona. Uma kudingeka, amakhophi angenziwa okuyilapho izindleko zekhophi zingabizwa njengelevi. Isicelo sitholwe ngu (yisho isikhundla, igama nesibongo se-ofisa yolwazi/usekela we-ofisa yolwazi) ngomhlaka (usuku) e... Izindleko Zokucela (uma zikhona): R... Izindleko Zokufinyelela: R... B. Imininingwane yomuntu ocela ukufinyelela kurekhodi a Imininingwane yomuntu ocela ukufinyelela kurekhodi kumele inikezwe ngezansi. b Ikheli kanye noma inombolo yefeksi eNingizimu Afrika lapho ulwazi kumele luthunyelwe khona kumele linikezwe. c isiqinisekiso sesikhundla ofaka isicelo ukuso, kumele sixhunywe uma ngabe kufanelekile. Amagama aphelele kanye Nesibongo:... Lesi sigaba kumele sigcwaliswe KUPHELA uma isicelo solwazi senzelwa omunye umuntu. Amagama aphelele nesibongo:... D. Imininingwane yamarekhodi a Nikeza imininingwane ephelele yerokhodi ocela ukufinyelela kulo, ufake nenombolo yereferensi uma uyazi, ukuze irekhodi likwazi ukutholakala. b Uma isikhala esinikeziwe singalingani, uyacelwa ukuba uqhubeke ekhasini elehlukile lephepha bese ulixhuma kuleli fomu. Ocelayo kumele asayine wonke amaphepha ongeziwe. Incazelo yamarekhodi noma izingxenye ezifanele zerekhodi:... Eminye imininingwane yamarekhodi:... E. Izindleko a Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi, ngaphandle kwerekhodi eliqukethe ulwazi ngomuntu, lizokwenziwa kuphela emva kokuba inkokhelo isikhokhiwe.

Imibuzo ebuzwa kakhulu - kungani kufanele kube nomthetho ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezilwandle ngqo - ingabe izilwandle azihlanganisiwe nemithetho eyamukelwe yokubheka imvelo? Imibuzo le izotholakala ngezansi. Izilwandle ziyingxenye ehlukile yemvelo. Yindawo lapho umhlaba uhlangana nolwandle, indawo engakhululekile kodwa ixhasa izidingo eziningi zabantu. Izilwandle ziyisistimu enezici eziningi esingazibala, isistimu yesayensi yezinhlanga eziphilayo zezilwandle, ukuvikelwa, ukuhamba, kanye nokuxhumana kwalezi zici okudinga ukubhekwa nokucatshangelwa mayelana nokuphathwa kwezilwandle. Izilwandle kufanele ziphathwe kahle ukuze kukhuphuke izinga lezinzuzo ezivela kuzo zonke amathuba atholakala ezilwandle. Nokho, le ndlela yokuphatha nokubhekwa ayikasebenzi kahle kuze kube manje ngoba izakhi ezahlukene zikahulumeni ziqhuba kuphela izinto eziphathelene nezindawo zabo ezithile ezifana nokusetshenziswa komhlaba, ezolimo, amanzi, ukuvikelwa kwemvelo, nezinye. Iphromotha indlela ebhekelela zonke izigaba ezithuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezilwandle. Le sistimu ibonisa izilwandle njengendawo okufanele ibonakale njengokubalulekile futhi kufanele iphathwe ngokufanele. Phambilini, ukubaluleka kwezilwane nemvelo endaweni yezilwandle njengokudingeka okubalulekile kokuthuthukiswa akukabhekwanga kahle ezinqumweni ezithathwe eNingizimu Afrika. Umbiko osemthethweni kahulumeni ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokubona izinzuzo ezivela ezilwandle. Inani lezinsiza ezitholakala ezilwandle, ngonyaka ka-1998, lalilinganiselwa ku-R168 billion ngonyaka, okuyinzuzo elinganiselwa ku-35% yomkhiqizo kazwelonke wezomnotho wezilwandle.

Lo mshayeli ubukeka engazi lutho ngama-wheels aphephile! Uyalungile! Noma ubani ophuthelwa amawheels akhe udlala ngokufa. Ngisho, amawheels angaphephile angabangela izingozi! Izikhathi eziningi amawheels afakwe ngendlela engafanele, noma anobquality ophansi! Kufana nokuba nama-wheels ahlanzekile! Amawheels angaphephile angabiza ukuphila kwethu! Uma kuphela bonke abashayeli bengafunda ngokuqinisa nokugcina amawheels. Uyalungile. Emasontweni edlule ngashaywa yitayi, ngiyabonga, akekho owalimala, kodwa ama-tires amasha abiza imali eningi. Ngakho! Uthole inhlanhla. Abantu bafa njalo ngesonto ngoba abashayeli nab owners beTaxi abafaki amawheels ngendlela efanele futhi abathathi isikhathi sokuwagcina. Ingabe ufuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awuyona imbangela yezingozi - ngisho nokufa? Ingabe ufuna ukusindisa imali? Uma ufuna ukuhlola amawheels akho! Funda ukugcina amawheels akho? Kufanele sazi amawheels ethu, sithole ukujwayela ukuwabheka, silungise lokho okungahambi kahle ngokushesha, futhi sigcine kahle, esimeme, esidala, nasezindaweni ezingazinzile amawheels angabangela izingozi! Amawheels akho afana nezinyawo zezimoto zakho. Uma izinyawo zakho zihlanzekile, zihlala, ungaziphonsa phansi futhi uzilimaze. Amawheels awakwazi ukukhuluma. Ngakho, kuncike kithi, abanikazi beTaxi, nabashayeli ukuba sihlolisise ukulimala futhi silungise ngaphambi kokuthi kubangele izinkinga! Amawheels ezimoto asetshenzisiwe ahluke kuma-wheels ajwayelekile. Amawheels ajwayelekile awaqinile ngokwanele ukuthwala abagibeli beTaxi.

Kumele futhi ibike ngemicimbi yayo ezindaweni kumazinga asezindaweni. Ngokuhambisana neMthethosisekelo njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, i-PSC inamalungu alishumi nane: amaKomishina amahlanu avela ePretoria kanye nelungu elilodwa elivela esifundazweni ngalinye. I-PSC ixhaswa yiHhovisi leKomishini Yezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, elikhokhelwa nguMqondisi-Jikelele (ongumsebenzi ophethe). Njengoba kudingeka, uMongameli uthumela amalungu alishumi nane. Isakhiwo sokuphatha se-PSC sihlela ukulandela izinhloso zayo ezicacile nezindawo zayo zokusebenza. Umsebenzi weKomishini uhlelwe ube yizigaba zayo eziyisithupha zokusebenza njengoba kuchaziwe ngaphansi kwenqaku 1 ngenhla. Ibhange: Izinsizakalo Zomphakathi Nokuxhumana linikeza ukuphathwa okuphelele kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali; ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu nezinsizakalo zokuxhasa, ukuxhumana, kanye nobuchwepheshe bolwazi kwi-O/PSC. Ibhange: Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Kwezinsizakalo Zabasebenzi kuvumela iKomishini ukuba ithuthukise ukuphathwa kobudlelwano babasebenzi, yenze ukuhlolwa kwamahhovisi, futhi ihlole futhi iphakamise ukulwa nobugebengu; kanye nokubuyekeza ukwenzeka kwemigomo yabasebenzi ezisebenzelana nohulumeni. Ibhange: Ukuhlola Nokubheka kusekela izinga eliphakeme lokuhola emisebenzini yeHulumeni, kuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhishwa ngendlela efaka phakathi ukubandakanywa komphakathi. UMqondisi-Jikelele we-OPSC, uNkk. Odette Ramsingh, ungumsebenzi weLwazi ngokweMthetho Wokuphakanyiswa Kwefayela Lokufinyelela Kulwazi. Imininingwane yokuxhumana noNkk.

Uma umthwalo unheavy futhi amathayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele, ithayi izophenduka ohlangothini futhi imiphetho yethayi ingaguga futhi ithayi izophuka njengoba ihamba. Amathayi e-bias noma e-crossply ajwayele ukuphenduka ohlangothini uma umthwalo unheavy kakhulu futhi ingcindezi iphansi uma amavhili edonswa kanzima, umzimba wonke wethayi uzonakaliswa. Ithayi engekho nengcindezi eyanele ingaphuma emgqonyeni futhi i-bead ingaphuka, futhi lapho ithayi ibamba khona emgqonyeni kuzonakaliswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi: uma ithayi inengcindezi eningi kakhulu, iba qinile kakhulu, okwenza ithayi lithinte kuphela umgwaqo ngaphakathi futhi liguge lapho. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi ithayi lonke alithinti umhlaba, futhi alikwazi ukubamba kahle, lizophuma futhi lihlasele umhlabathi. Uma kudingeka ukusebenza ngamathayi ezimo lapho kudingeka khona, amathayi azohamba kalula. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukulungisa ingcindezi ngokuya ngezimo zokusebenza, njengokuhambisa ithreyi noma emshinini, noma ukushayela emgwaqweni ophukile. Inani lengcindezi yamathayi libalulekile, kodwa ukusebenzisa ithayi enengcindezi ehlukile kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekubambeni kwamavhili nasecingweni sayo emhlabeni. Ezindaweni lapho kukhona izitshalo nezimpande ngaphansi komhlaba, kungaba kuhle ukusebenza ngethayi elibanzi elinengcindezi ephezulu kakhulu. Lokhu kuzovumela imishini ukuthi ithwale umthwalo ofanayo njengethayi elincane ngobubanzi kodwa eliqinile emoyeni - leli thayi lizojwayela ukunyakaza kalula emhlabeni futhi liqinise umhlabathi.

Isicelo sokufinyelela kumarekhodi aphethwe yileli Bandla Labaqondisi Eliphezulu lingaqondiswa kuselela le-ofisa yolwazi, omininingwane yalo yokuxhumana ibekwe esigabeni - 8.3.2. Nokugcinwa nokuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Zomphambo Ophakathi. ISIKHUNDLA Umqondisi Omkhulu: Izinsizakalo Zezakhamuzi. Leli bandla LABAQONDISI Eliphezulu linesibopho sokugcina irejista yezakhamuzi, ukugcinwa ngokuphepha kwamarekhodi okuzazisa, izindaba eziphathelene nezakhamuzi, izincwadi zokuvakasha kanye namaphasiphothi, omazisi kanye nokuzazisa. Ukunikezwa kwama-visa, izimvume zokuhlalela safuthi endaweni, izimvume zokuhlala okwesikhashana, izindaba eziphathelene nababaleka emazweni akubo kanye nabafuna indawo yokukhusela, ukuphathwa nokugcina izinhlelo zokuphatha ukuphuma nokungena ezweni, ukuphatha ukungena ezweni ngokungemthetho kanye nezindaba zamazwe ngamazwe. Umthethosivivinywa Ngokuhambela Kumazwe Ngamazwe. Ibandla Labaqondisi lokuxhumana lishicilela amaphepha okundiziswa, amabhrosha, amamanyule, amaphaphabhuku, kanye namaphosta njengoba kudingwa yi-DHA. Imibhalo elandelayo itholakala mahhala, uma ngabe ikhona. Ingakwazi futhi ukufundisiswa emahhovisi akhethiwe nakhona futhi uma ngabe ikhona. Uma kudingeka, amakhophi angenziwa okuyilapho izindleko zekhophi zingabizwa njengelevi.

(1) Izinhlinzeko zalo Mthetho zisebenza ezindabeni zamagugu, okubandakanya kokubili amagugu aphathekayo kanye naphilayo noma aphathekayo esifundazweni. Uma lo mthetho ungalawuli udaba oluphathelene nokuvikelwa noma nokuphathwa kwamagugu esifundazweni, izinhlinzeko zoMthetho wamaGugu kaZwelonke, 1999 (uMthetho No. 25 ka 1999), kanye noMthetho woMkhandlu wamaGugu kaZwelonke, 1999 (uMthetho No. 11 ka 1999), ziyosebenza esiFundazweni futhi noma iyiphi inkomba "kumaziphathe wesifundazwe wezamagugu" eMthethweni wamaGugu kaZwelonke, 1999, kumele, ngaphandle uma kubonakala kungafanele, ithathwe njengenkomba eMkandlwini. ILungu loMkhandlu oPhethe kanye noMkhandlu kumele lisekele imigomo ejwayelekile okukhulunywe ngayo kwiNgxenye 1 yeSahluko 1 soMthetho wamaGugu kaZwelonke, 1999 (uMthetho No. 25 ka 1999), esebenza ezenzweni zezinhla zikahulumeni wesifundazwe nezohulumeni basekhaya maqondana nokuphathwa kwamagugu esiFundazweni. Iqhaza leLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezamagugu 4. (1) Ngokuhlonipha iqhaza lokudidiyela likahulumeni kazwelonke kwezamagugu, iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe kumele, ukugqugquzela umoya wokusebenza ngokubambisana okukhulunywe ngakho eSahlweni 3 soMthethosisekelo, uyokhuthaza ukuphathwa kwezamagugu kanye nezinsiza esiFundazweni ngokulawulwa wuhlaka lwenqubomgomo kazwelonke kanye nezinhlelo eziphathelene nezamagugu kanye nezinsiza.

Inhloso yalo Mhlahlandlela ukuthi unikeze ohlushwayo ulwazi aludingayo ukuthi alethe incwadi yesicelo soMyalelo Woku-vikeleka ngokulandela Umthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa kwemindeni. Bobabili abesifazane nabesilisa bangaba necala, baphuinde babe ngabahlushwayo Odlameni Lwemindeni. Ngenhloso yalo Mhlahlandlela kodwa, siye safanekisa ukuhlukunyezwalinygzwa oku-maqondana nabesifazane ngoba lokhu yikhona okujwayelke ukwenzeka kakhulu. owabelane naye ngesethembiso somshado, ukuthandana ngokwesiko noma ngokuvakashelana, okufaka ukuthandana kwangempela noma okwakubon-akala, okunokwazana kakhulu noma kokuya ocansini nganoma yisiphi isikhathi umuntu owabelana naye noma oye wabelana naye kungekudala indawo efanayo Le ndaba ingahlehliswa ibekelwe olunye usuku lokuya enkantolo. UNobhala Wenkantolo uzokusiza noma akuqondise emuntwini ozokusiza ngokubhala impendulo. Ngosuku lokulalela icala iMantshi izozama ukwenza isinqumo esesekwe ngeZifungo ezi-fayilwe yibo bobabili. Imantshi ingacela oyedwa wenu noma nina nobabili ngencazelo yenu yezindaba ezithile. Imantshi ingathatha isinqumo sokuqinisekisa Umyalelo ibekele eceleni Umyalelo bese iphoqelela ukuthi kulalelwe ubufakazi bomlomo. Khumbula ukuthi ngokoMthetho, Amaphoyisa ku-mele akusize nganoma yiyiphi indlela echazwe kuMy-alelo Wokuvikeleka, isibonelo ekuthathweni kwezinto okungezakho, incwadi yakho yomazisi, izincwadi noma izimpahla zabantwana njll. Uma uthola ukuthi Iphoyisa alikusizi noma liyenqaba ukusebenzisana nawe ngokulandela Umyalelo, ungakwazi ukuku-bika lokhu eBandleni leziphathimandla Lomgondisi Elizimele (Indepedent Complainysa Directorate).

Ukuqondanisa uhlaka lwenhlangano kumasu kanye nokuqeda umthelela we-silo. Nalapho kukhona izinsiza zasekhaya ezihlinzekwayo, izinhlobo zezimpahla, umsebenzi kanye nezinsiza kuhlinzekwa umuntu ongaphandle ukuze kuxhaswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Ungalali ngesikhathi uhamba ngamatekisi noma ngamabhasi. Izimpahla ezingatholakali noma kuphi, ikakhulukazi ngokwenziwa umbukiso, zisetshenziselwa ukwazisa kanye nokufundisa umphakathi ngamafa ase-Afrika. Wathi ukwakha izinhlangano zamatekisi ezisebenzisanayo ngaphakathi kososeshini bamatekisi kuzokwenza ukuthi kube lula ukuthi uhulumeni axhase ngezimali imboni yamatekisi, njengoba kunjalo kwimboni yamabhasi. Izindawo zama-picnic zihlinzekwe ngezindlu zangasese futhi kulula ukuthi zisetshenziswe nangabantu abahamba ngama-wheel chair. Isivumelwano kwinsiza yeposi elihanjiswayo kanye ne-memorandum of understanding ngekuvikeleka kweposi elithunyelwayo. Uhulumeni uzokwengamela ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kusungulwe izinhlaka ze-IEP kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umgomo wamandla. Uma babecelwe ukuthi bavele enkentolo ngaphandle kokuthi kuthathathwe isitatimende kubona, angeke ngikwazi ukusho lutho ngalokhu. Sabuyela emuva eGoli ngosuku olufanayo ngakho kufanele kube kwakuwusuku olufanayo, yebo. Uhulumeni uzozama ukuvimbela noma iziphi izenzo zombuso zokushintsha amanani. IJalimani ingelinye lamazwe aphambili ekusebenzisaneni neNingizimu Afrika kwezohwebo, njengoba kubonakala ekukhuleni kohwebo kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali phakathi kwalamazwe womabili. Lokhu kusebenza kunomthelela ekwakhiweni kwalo mzimba noma izinsiza. Imiphumela ye-LFS kaSephthemba isizokhishwa ekupheleni kwale nyanga.

Ukubaluleka kokugcina umswakama womhlabathi kuyinto esizokhuluma ngayo njalo. Lo msebenzi kufanele uqale ngokushesha ngemva kokuvuna. Okwesibili ukuvuka kwamanzi emhlabathini nokuphuma komoya - lokhu kwenzeka uma umhlabathi uba hard futhi umanzi. Kumele uphathe izinkambu zakho kusukela ngesikhathi uphothula ukuvuna kuze kube ngesikhathi sokutshala kabusha izimpande ezintsha. Ukuvuna okuhle kusezandleni zakho kuphela!

UMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ka-1996 (Umthetho No. 8 ka-1996) uthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokufinyelela kulwazi oluphathwa nguhulumeni nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi oluphathwa omunye umuntu oludingekayo ukuze asebenzise noma avikele noma yiziphi zezimfanelo zakhe, futhi ukuthi umthetho kazwelonke kumele usungulwe ukuze ufeze leli lungelo. Ngokwezinhlinzeko zalo Mthetho kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela unqunyelwe njengomphathi wolwazi (IO), kanti uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli ophakathi (RA) weMnyango Wezokuvikela. Abaphathi Bezesekeli Nabantu Bahlonishwa Njengabaphathi Bezimali (DIOs). Lezi zikhala zizohlinzeka ngosizo olwamukelekayo kumalunga omphakathi ekufinyeleleni kulwazi uma kudingeka amarekhodi avela eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. IKomidi Lezeluleko Lwemininingwane (IAAC) lisunguliwe ukuze linikeze izeluleko kumphathi wolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso ezenziwe ngababambiqhaza bezezimali mayelana nezicelo zolwazi nokusiza umphathi wolwazi kanye nomgibeli ophakathi mayelana nokucubungula izikhalazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amaKomidi Amancane Ezeluleko Lwemininingwane (IAASC) nawo asunguliwe ukuze anikeze izeluleko kubaphathi bezezimali mayelana nezicelo zolwazi. I-Centre Yemininingwane yeMnyango Wezokuvikela isunguliwe njengendawo yokuphatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. I-Centre Yemininingwane izosiza labo abathumele izicelo mayelana nezinqumo ezenziwe ngezicelo zolwazi.

Uhlelo olubekwe kwingxenya A kuSheduli 3 lusebenza nalapho kukhethwa uSomlomo nesekela likaSomlomo. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke ungasusa uSomlomo noma iSekela likaSomlomo esikhundleni ngokuthatha isinqumo sokwenza njalo Iningi lamalungu oMkhandlu kufanele abekhona lapho kuthatha lesi sinqumo. Ngokusho kwemitheshwana nezibopho, UMkhandlu kaZwelonke ungakhetha phakathi kwamalungu awo abanye abangangamela imihlangano yoMkhandlu ukuze basize uSomlomo neSekela likaSomlomo. isinqumo ngazo zonke izinto ezibekwe phambi koMkhandlu kufanele sithathwe ngokwesekwa yiningi lamavoti afakiwe. lingafaka ivoti elejwayelekile uma udaba kufanele lunqunywe ngokwesekwa okungenani yinani lamavoti eliyingu-2/3 kumalungu oMkhandlu. ungasungula noma ulungise umthetho ngaphandle kweMithethosivivinywa yemali. noma yiyiphi ingxenye yombuso. ungemukela izicelo, imibono noma iziphakamiso ezivela kunoma yimuphi umuntu othintwa wudaba noma eminye imikhakha. wenze imitheshwana nezibopho maqondana nomsebenzi wawo ube ubhekelele ukuqhuba ngenqubo yentando yeningi eyazisa ukumeleka komphakathi nokubamba kwawo iqhaza, ukuphendula, ukusebenzela obala nokuthintwa komphakathi. ukwamkelwa, komholi weqembu elikhulu kunawo wonke eliphikisayo elisePhalamende njengomholi weqembu eliphikisayo. yanoma yini evelile ngenxa yalokho akushilo, akuvezile akunikeze uMkhandlu noma ikomidi lawo noma yiliphi. Ezinye izibonelelo nokuvikeleka koMkhandlu kaZwelonke amalungu eKhabinethi, kanye namalungu oMkhandlu kaZwelonke kungabekwa ngumthetho kazwelonke.

Isizathu sikhathazekile kakhulu ngoxolo nokuphepha ezingeni lomhlaba wonke nguM.E kanye nendawo yePheresiya. Le moto ihlinzekwe ngezici ezikhethwayo phakathi kwakho, ukudluliswa kweziteshi zedijithali ezisezingeni eliphezulu zohlobo lweTetra, amakompyutha anama-imeyili, i-inthanethi, kanye ne-fax. Kungagcina futhi kugcine amarekhodi ngendlela eyisimanga. Imishini idlala indima ebalulekile ekudluliseni lokhu ngehlelo elifanele kulabo abathakazelelayo. Futhi kulolo suku olubalulekile, ezindaba zaseNingizimu Afrika zaziphazamiseka futhi zaphazamiseka nguhulumeni ngesikhathi semisebenzi yazo. Usizo oluvela kubantu ngqo emphakathini noma, ngaphandle kwalokho, kulabo abavela ezimweni ezingajwayelekile, kubafundi bezimali, noma ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lokwakha nokusebenza. Ingabe lezi kungenzeka izinto ezisetshenziswa umgibeli we-cricket mayelana nenani lamabhola abholayo? Eziklasi zothisha, bazokwazi ukuphatha, ukusetshenziswa kwabo kokwesekwa kwezimfundiso, izinsiza zabo, nokufundisa kwabo kuzothintwa ngochwepheshe abaqeqeshiwe. Omunye wabo ukuthuthukiswa kwamazwe ethu njengoba sizama ukuthola uxolo, ubud democracy, kanye nokungabandakanyi ubuhlanga okuphumelelayo. Umsulwa wacindezelwa ngamandla futhi wabekwa endaweni yokugijima lapho wahlukunyezwa. Amaphoyisa afinyelela endaweni yobugebengu ababona umsolwa eduze kwesitolo. Ngakho-ke, sithuthukise ikhono elithile lokuqapha nokuphepha ezingeni lendawo. Ukuxhumana phakathi kwalabo abazuza ngaphambili nalabo abangazange baphumelele kanye nesici sokugcina sokuthuthukiswa kwezimali. Idizayini ehleliwe ngempela isetshenziswe ngandlela thile, incike enanini lemali elitholakalayo ebhizinisini.

Izincwadi Zabasebenzi Abasha (GEMS New Employee Letters) Izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha, eziyaziwa nangokuthi ama-GEMS new employee letters, zibalulekile ekwakheni umbono omuhle wokwamukela abasebenzi abasha emsebenzini. Lezi zincwadi ziwusizo ngoba zikhombisa indlela inkampani ebheka ngayo abasebenzi bayo, ikakhulukazi labo abasha, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuthi baqonda izinqubo, izimiso, nezidingo zomsebenzi. Kubalulekile ukuthi lezi zincwadi zibhale ngendlela ecacile futhi enobungane ukuze abasebenzi abasha bazizwe bemukelekile futhi bejabulile ngokungena kwabo enkampanini. Izincwadi kufanele ziqale ngokubingelela okuhle, zikhombise ukwazisa nokuhlonipha umkhiqizo omusha ozojoyina ithimba. Lokhu kudala umoya opholile, okwenza kube lula kubasebenzi abasha ukujwayela indawo entsha. Ngemuva kokubingelela, kufanele kufakwe imininingwane ethile mayelana nezinsuku zokuqala zomsebenzi, izinqubo zokufika, kanye nezidingo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kuzobasiza baqonde kahle lokho okulindelekile, futhi bazokwazi ukuhlela izinsuku zabo zokuqala ngokufanele. Izincwadi kufanele ziqukathe nezincomo ezicacile ngezinsuku zokuhlangana, izifundo ezizobanjwa, kanye nezinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze kube lula kubo ukujwayela indawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izincwadi zabasebenzi abasha kufanele zikhulume ngamasiko enkampani, izimiso, kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi abasha baqonde isiko lenkampani, futhi bakwazi ukuhamba phambili ngokuhambisana nezimiso ezibekwe. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa komsebenzi, izifundo ezitholakalayo, kanye nezindlela zokuxhumana nabaphathi, kuzobasiza ukuhlela ikusasa labo enkampanini.

Amaqembu afana neKaizer Chiefs, Orlando Pirates, neMamelodi Sundowns abamba izindima ezinkulu, kodwa futhi abanye abancane bahlala bejabulisa umoya wokuncintisana. Ibhola akusikho nje ukudlalwa, kodwa kuyindlela yokuhlanganyela, yokwakha ubudlelwano, nokwakha umphakathi. Ekugcineni, ibhola laseNingizimu Afrika lihlala linethemba, futhi abalandeli bazoqhubeka nokukhuthaza amaqembu abo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi uqhubeka nokukhula, ubumbene, futhi ubambisene ukuze uthokozise umoya wobumbano. Amaqembu ebhola aseNingizimu Afrika azokwenza izinkumbulo ezinhle, futhi umoya wokuncintisana uzohlala uqhubeka.

Ukuvula izimakethe zemikhiqizo emisha ezoba nomthelela emnothweni. Ukubuyisela ubunjalo bomphakathi ngezinto ozenzayo. ukuvuselelwa komphakathi kwezomnotho, imvelo, nenhlalo. Ukuvuselela nokufukula ubunjalo bomphakathi ngokusebenzisa izinto ozenzayo njengethuluzi loguquko oluletha ukwelapheka nokuvuseleleka. Ukusungula ukusebenzisa ubuciko njengonto ebalulekile ekubhekeleni izindaba zomphakathi. Ukuhlonza futhi kwandiswe ukubambisana ekwandiseni izinhlelo kanye nezimpahla ezidingakalayo. Ucwaningo ngomthelela wemidlalo yeshashalazi ekuxhumaniseni abasengozini ngokomqondo kanye nokuveza amakhono empilo. Ukusungula indawo yentsha ebikade incintshwe amathuba ngesikhathi yakha namathuba okubheka abazibukela phansi kanye namandla angenanhloso. Ukucubungula okungenziwa abakhombisa ngobuciko njenge-thuluzi elingavimbela izingane ebungozini bokuguqukela ebugebengwini. Ukuthuthukiswa kobuciko kanye namasiko. Ukucwaninga kanye nokushicilelwa. Ukugqugquzela ukushintshisana ngamasiko. Itshe lesikhumbuzo labesifazane. Ngo-April 2000 uNgqongqoshe uNgubane wajuba ithimba longoti ukuba laluleke ngesu likazwelonke ngokuqoqwa, ngokulondolozwa, ngokuvikela, ngokuthuthukiswa kanye nangokugqugquzelwa komculo waseNingizimu Afrika. Lelithimba lathintana nezifundazwe kanye nabanye abanentsisekelo / abathintekayo. UNgqongqoshe ungubane waleseka isu elalibekiwe. Okubalulekile okwavela kulezizincomo ukuba kubenohlelo lokucwaninga ngenhloso yokuthola nokuqoqa umculo weiNtu. Ziyishumi nambili izilimi esisemthethweni ngokomthetho sisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika.

izithunywa ezigcwele eziyisithupha eziqokwe ngokusho kwesigaba 61(2). UNdunankulu wesiFundazwe, noma uma engekho, ilungu lezithunywa zesifundazwe eliqokwe nguNdunankulu, lihola izithunywa. Amaqembu amelwe kwisishayamthetho sesifundazwe anelungelo lokuba nezithunywa eqenjini lezithunywa zesifundazwe ngokulandela indlela yokubala ebhalwe kwiNgxenye B ekuSheduli 3. siqokele esikhundleni lezo zithunywa ezigcwele ngendlela elandela iziphakamiso zamaqembu ezombusazwe. Umthetho kazwelonke ovezwe kwisigatshana (2) (a) mawuqhakambise ukubanjwa kweqhaza kwamaqembu amancane ezombusazwe emikhakheni yomibili yabaqokwe ngokugcwele kanye namalungu ayisipesheli akhe ithimba elimele amaqembu ezombusazwe ngendlela evumelana nentando yeningi. Isishayamthetho, ngokuvumelana noNdunankulu kanye nabaholi bamaqembu abanegunya lokuba yizithunywa zezeiFundazwe, mabaqoke izithunywa ezikhethiwe ezidingekayo ngezikhathi ezahlukahlukene, phakathi kwamalungu eSishayamthetho. Umuntu ophakanyiswe njengesithunywa esimile kufanele abengumuntu ovunyelwe ukuba yilungu lesishayamthetho sesifundazwe. Uma umuntu oyilungu lesishayamthetho sesifundazwe eqokelwe esikhundleni sokuba yisithunywa esigcwele, lowo muntu uyayeka ukuba yilungu lesishayamthetho. Izithunywa ezigcwele ziqokelwa ezikhundleni kuze kube yisikhathi ngaphambili nje kokuhlala kokuqala kwesishayamthetho sesifundazwe emuva kokhetho olulandelayo. ephutha kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe engenamvume esimweni lapho imitheshwana nezibopho zoMkhandlu zibeka ukuthi kufanele alahlekelwe yisikhundla sokubayisithunywa esimile.

I-Memorandum yeMthetho 136 yeMithetho Yesifunda saseGauteng. Incazelo entsha ye-"isiteshi" ifakiwe ukuze ibandakanye indawo esetshenziselwa imisebenzi ehambisana ngqo nokusebenza nokuphathwa kohlelo lwezitimela kanye nokuthuthwa kwabagibeli abafika nabahamba esiteshini. Isiteshi sizobandakanya izindawo zokupaka, ama-garage okupaka, izindawo zokulahla nokuthola abagibeli, izimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi, nezinsiza ezifanayo. Kubonakale ukuthi kuvunyelwene nezinsizakusebenza zomphakathi ezifanele ngemva kokuxoxisana ukuthi ukusetshenziswa komhlaba okuthile endaweni yesiteshi akufanele kulawulwe yizinhlelo zokwakha ezisemadolobheni futhi akufanele kube ngaphansi koMthetho, okungavimbela izinqubo ezithatha isikhathi eside ekushintsheni izinhlelo zokwakha ezisemadolobheni. Lokhu kubandakanya imisebenzi ethile yezohwebo ehambisana ngqo nokuphathwa kahle kwabagibeli, kubandakanya ukukhangisa, ukuthengiswa kokudla neziphuzo, amaphephandaba nezincwadi, imishini yokuthengisa ethengisa izinto ezithengiwe, izingcingo zomphakathi, nemishini yokubhanga (lezo ezamukela amakhadi futhi zikhokhe imali). Nokho, kubhekwa ukuthi ezindaweni eziningi zesiteshi, kungase kube nesidingo semisebenzi yezohwebo ezindaweni eziseduze nesiteshi. Njengoba le misebenzi yezohwebo ingase ithinte izindawo eziseduze neziteshi futhi ingase iphinde ithinte izakhiwo zomphakathi, kudingeka ukuthi amalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba ahlotshaniswe nokusetshenziswa kwawo kwezomnotho kulawulwe ngohlelo olusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokwakha esisemadolobheni.

Kwakha amacebo okuthi izimbiwa- iphansi zingathunyelwa kwamanye amazwe zeseseluhlaza, kodwa kwakhiwe khona lapha ekhaya izimpahla esingazisebenzisa, kwakhiwe namesu okuthuthukisa ezolimo nokulungisela okuvuniwe ukuba kungasetshenziswa, nokuthuthukisa imboni yabasebenza ngezimpahla ezithize ezingakajwayeleki kanye nemboni yabantu abaziqambela imisebenzi emihle, nemisebenzi yomphakathi kanye nezamapilisi. Loku kufuneka ukuthi kube nokuzimisela okukhulu ukuthi sikhicize izimpahla esingazisebenzisa ukuze sakhe okunye njengemishini emikhulu yokubaza noma yokukhanda okuthize. Embonini yamadayimane, singabumbha ibandla lesizwe elizothenga u 10% wamadayimane kulabo abawembhayo, siwathengisele labo abazowasika bakhe izindandatho zemishado. Siyabonga ukuthi abakwa De Beers bavumile ukwelekelela, ngaphandle kokukhokhelwa, ngokuphatha lomsebenzi, nokufundisa amakhono okusebenza ngedayimane kanye nokunikeza ngalo idayimane eminyakeni emithathu ezayo. Kwakha izinhlelo ezizakusiza ekutshaleni kwezimali ezimbonini ezizokusithengisela izimpahla esizidingayo ekwakheni izindawo zokusetshenziswa ngumphakathi, loku kufaka phakathi izimpahla ezimayelana nokuthintana, ezokuthutha kanye namandla kagesi. Sizakuphinde sigqugquzele ukuthi imisebenzi yethu incike kakhulu kuloku okubizwa ngokuthi phecelezi yiNuclear energy, nokusamoya esingakubasa sothe noma sipheke, nezinye izinhlobo zikagesi ezivuselelekayo. Mayelana nezokuthintana, kuyangithokozisa ukunibikela ukuthi igatsha likahulumeni lezokuthintana lisebenzisana nezinkampani zabomakhalekhukhwini, kanye neTelkom sebasemaphethelweni ohlelo lokungasaphide bakhokise abantu uma bashaya icingo besebayajubeka. Leyo yindlela yokubacabangela abantu.

Kuvame ukuba ngumuntu onentshisekelo ofaka isicelo enkantolo. Ngemuva kokuthola isicelo, inkantolo iqoka umgadi--mafa ngenhloso yokuvikela amalungelo engane engakakwazi ukuzimela ukuze aphenye isimo nokuthi sifanele kanganani isicelo. Umgadimafa noMphathi weNkantolo kufanele bethule imibiko enkantolo. Uma inkantolo isicubungule isicelo yase iqoka umeluleki, Umphathi weNkantolo kufanele aqalise isinqumo senkantolo ngokukhipha Izincwadi Zomeluleki nokumgunyaza ukuba aqale njengomeluleki. Umbhalo ofanayo wesicelo sasenkantolo ohambisana nemibiko ekhishwe wumgadimafa nokaMphathi weNkantolo. Isinqumo senkantolo sokuqoka umeluleki. Ifomu le- J242 equkethe inani lezimpahla namafa engane. Isibophezelo nesibambiso sesiqiniseko someluleki oqokiwe esiqukethwe yifomu le- J262 ngaphandle uma exolelwe yinkantolo ekwethuleni leso sibambiso. Ukusingatha amafa abantu abashonile abangakwazi ukuziphathela izindaba zabo. Abantu abachazwe yinkantolo njengabasaphaza impahla. Ukusingatha amafa abantu nempahla esemthethweni edliwe wuPhiko oluXhwitha Impahla ngomyalelo wenkantolo. Ukusingatha amafa omuntu ongekho (umuntu ongaziwa ukuthi ukuphi nongenaye ummeli wakhe eNingizimu Afrika). Akuyona inkundla yoMphathi weNkantolo ukuqoka umuntu obheka ingane noma lowo ogade isimo nempilo yengane. Inkantolo Ephakeme ingaqoka umuntu ngaphandle kwesihlobo sengane njengomuntu oyosiza ingane. Ngokufanayo, inkantolo ePhakeme ingephuca lowo muntu osiza ingane ilungelo lokuba wumsizi waleyo ngane.

Lapha, sithuthukise uhlelo lokuxhumana olusebenzayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. Sihlele imihlangano yokubambisana evamile, lapho abaholi bezikhungo bahlola khona izinhlelo zabo zokuphendula. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi uma kwenzeka isimo esiphuthumayo, wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi uzothatha isinyathelo esithile. Umhleli: Lokhu kubonakala kuyindlela ephumelelayo. Kodwa, kudinga ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele. Ucabanga ukuthi imithombo yokuxhasa ibalulekile? Mnu. Zulu: Impela, imithombo yokuxhasa ibalulekile. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula, kudinga ukuthi kube nezinsiza ezanele, kungaba ngezinsiza zezimali, abantu abaqeqeshiwe, noma izinsiza zokuxhumana. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezisheshayo futhi eziphusile. Umhleli: Ngabe ukhona umbono wakho mayelana nokuthi abantu bangakwazi kanjani ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni lezi zinhlelo? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, abantu bangaba neqhaza elikhulu. Ukuze sibe nezinhlaka eziphumelelayo, abantu kufanele baqeqeshwe futhi bazi kahle izinqubo zokuphendula. Kubalulekile futhi ukubandakanya umphakathi, ukuze abantu bazi izinhlelo zokuzivikela, bahlale beqaphele izingozi, futhi bazi ukuthi kumele benze kanjani uma kwenzeka isimo esiphuthumayo. Umhleli: Lokhu kuhle kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu. Ngabe unayo imiphumela ethile yokuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, imiphumela ibonakala ngokushesha. Uma sithuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula, izinga lokuphila komphakathi liphucukile. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezingozi, ukunciphisa ukulimala, nokwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu. Futhi, uma umphakathi uzwa ukuthi uhlinzekwa kahle, kuba nokwethenjelwa okukhulu ezikhungweni ezithintekayo.

(8)(a) Amaminithi omhlangano odlule kumele afundwe ekuqaleni kwayo yonke imihlangano. Amaminithi kungathathwa ngokuthi afundiwe uma amakhophi awo enikezwe amalungu oMkhandlu ngaphambi komhlangano. Usihlalo angasayina amaminithi kuphela uma sekudingidwe imibono noma sekwenziwe ushintsho. Usihlalo kumele anqume ngemibuzo nangendlela okuzoqhutshwa ngayo: Kuncike ekutheni uma noma yiliphi ilungu liphikisana nanoma yisiphi isinqumo, umbuzo kumele uvotelwe kuthi isinqumo seningi lamalungu sibe ngujuqu futhi kube yisona esamukelwa nguMkhandlu. Ilungu loMkhandlu elinentshisekelo mayelana nanoma yiluphi udaba oludingidwe emhlanganweni woMkhandlu, okungathi lucutshungulwa, lulivimbela ekwenzeni umsebenzi walo ngendlela efanele, engachemile nelungile, kumele lihoxe kulowo mhlangano. (11)(a) IsiKhulu esiPhezulu singathamela noma sibambe iqhaza, kodwa angeke savota, emhlanganweni woMkhandlu. Ilungu labasebenzi boMkhandlu, uma limenyiwe, lingathamela imihlangano yoMkhandlu. 16. (1) UMkhandlu ungaqoka ikomidi elilodwa noma ngaphezulu kungagcini nje ngamalungu awo ukuba asize ekusebenziseni amandla nasekwenzeni imisebenzi yawo. Ikomidi elihlongozwe esigatshaneni (1) kumele lenze leyo misebenzi yoMkhandlu njengoba uMkhandlu unganquma. UMkhandlu, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ungahlakaza noma ubumbe kabusha lelo komidi. ungachibiyela, ubukeze noma uhoxise noma yisiphi isinqumo sekomidi. Noma yimaphi amandla adluliselwe asetshenziswa noma umsebenzi odluliselwe owenziwa yikomidi kuthathwa ngokuthi asetshenziswa noma wenziwa nguMkhandlu.

ukusekela imizamo yobudlelwane obakhayo ezisebenzini zikahulumeni. Ukukhuphula inhlonipho elinganayo phakathi kwabaqashwa naphakathi kwabaqashi nabaqashwa. Ukuqikelela ukuthi abaqashi nabaqashi banokuqonda okufanayo mayelana nempatho embi kanye nempatho eqinileyo. Ukukhuphula indlela eyamukelekile yokuphatha. Ukunikeza abaqshi nabaqashwa izwi lempatho elisheshayo nelilula lesicelo sempatho eqinileyo. Nokugwema ukunganaki umthetho noma ubandlululo lwabaqashwa kubaphathi. impatho eqinileyo iyisinyathelo esilungisayo hayi esijezisayo. Impatho eqinileyo kumele yenziwe ngendlela esheshayo, eyamukelekile, elandelekayo nenenqubekela phambili. Impatho eqotho iwumsebenzi wokuphatha. Inhlanganisela yemithetho idingeka ekuthumeleni okusheshayo kwemisebenzi kanye nempatho elinganayo kubantu, kanye nokuqiniseka ukuthi abaqashwa. a. banethuba elilinganayo lokukhuluma ngezinhlelo ezihlelekile nakulezo ezingahlelekile. b. Bahlale baziswa ngezingomela zempatho embi eyenzeka kubo. c. Bathola izizathu ezibhaliwe zesinqumo esibhaliwe, kanye d. Nokuba nelungelo lokuphikisa nanoma isiphi isinqumo. Kuzokwenziwa konke okusemandleni ukuthi ukuqondiswa kezigwegwe kwenzeke endaweni yomsebenzi futhi kucaciselwe zonke izisebenzi. Uma umqashwa eziphathe kabi. Lokho kungubugebengu, icalaobugebengu. Kenye nezinyathelo zokuqondisa izigwegwe zizokwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ukujeziswa ngokwenqubo yasemsebenzini akuyiphazamisi indlela yasenkantolo. Lemigomo nemigudu ziyinkomba nje zingashintshwa kubhekwa izimo ezifanele.

Ukusingatha impahla yengane engakakwazi ukuzimela nabanye abangakwazi ukuphatha izindaba zabo. Umeluleki ngumuntu oqokwe wuMphathi weNkantolo noma yiNkantolo ukuba asingathe impahla yengane engakakwazi ukuzimela. Izingane zithathwa njengabantu abanokukhubazeka ngenxa yokuthi umthetho uthatha ngokuthi abakwazi ukuziphathela izindaba zabo. Uma benempahla laba bantu, kubalulekile ukuba othile abagcinele ifa. Ngokuvamile, ingane inabazali abagada impahla yayo nezindaba ezithinta yona, ngakho asikho isidingo sokubaqoka ngoba bayigazi layo. Kodwa kuyenzeka izingane zingabi nabantu abazigadile noma abazali bese kuba nesidingo sokuqoka umeluleki wengane ozoyigadela ifa noma impahla. Noma ingane inaye umgadi wemvelo, inkantolo isenganquma ngenye indlela. Uma impahla yengane ibandakanya imali efakwe esikhwameni somqaphi, asikho isidingo sokuqoka umeluleki wokugada impahla nakuba kungenzeka aqokwe umeluleki. Ukuqokwa komeluleki ezindabeni zengane kudlala izindima ezimbili ngaphansi kwalesi simo. Ukunakekela isimo nempilo yengane engakakwazi ukuzimela. Isimo saseNingizimu Afrika siqonda ukuthi umntwana ongakakwazi ukuzimela wumuntu oneminyaka engaphansi kwengama-21 nongakhululiwe yisimo somshado noma wumyalelo wenkantolo. Isikhalo esifakwa eNkantolo. Ifomu le-J243 echaza izimpahla zomntwana ongakakwazi ukuzimela. Ukuqokwa komuntu ofanele ukuba wumeluleki, eqokwa yisihlobo sengane (imvama abaqokiwe bethulwa emhlanganweni obizwe wuMphathi weNkantolo ngenhloso yokudingida lolu daba). Isicelo sokuqokwa njengomeluleki ngefomu-le- J197.

Le nsizakalo inikeza ulwazi lokuthi ungafaka kanjani isicelo sokubuyiselwa kwentela kanye nosizo lwezezimali oluvela kwiMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukubuyiselwa kwentela kuyancipha enteleni ekhokhwayo ezimpahleni ezingenisiwe uma uthenga izimpahla. Umfaki-sicelo, hhayi umuntu wesithathu, kumele aqedele ifomu lesicelo; kungenjalo, isicelo ngeke processed. Esiqeshini sezinhlobo zamakhasimende, bhalisela ibhokisi lokubuyiselwa kwentela esigabeni sokubhaliswa. Ikhodi yomgwaqo wesigaba lapho ibhizinisi likhona. Esiqeshini seMvume yokufaka isicelo, kumele sigcwaliswe ngumfaki-sicelo uma efaka isicelo sokubhaliswa njengomsebenzisi wokubuyiselwa. Igama lomfaki-sicelo noma igama lokubhaliswa kwebhizinisi, hhayi igama lenhlangano ethengisa ibhizinisi, kumele kube igama elivela kulesi sigaba. Lapho kukhona le uphawu, susa okungafanele. Izimpahla ngaphansi kwezibalo zokubuyiselwa 3, 4. Incazelo yezimpahla ezingenisiwe. Indawo lapho isicelo sigunyazwe khona. Umfaki-sicelo kumele athumele ifomu lesicelo eliphelele ehhovisi leMnyango Wezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika eliseduze. Ifomula uma ufaka isicelo ngaphansi kwento yokubuyiselwa 607.04.10, 607.04.10, 607.04.10, kanye no 607.04.10. Abatshalizimali, Izinkampani Ezinqunyiwe, kanye Neziqinisekiso - Bonke Ozakwethu/Abatshalizimali/Abaphathi. Inkampani - Bonke abaphathi, kuhlanganise noMphathi Omkhulu kanye noMphathi Wezezimali.

a Isidingo sokuthola kanye nokusebenzisa izindlela ezingeke ziphazamise imvelo yasolwandle. Izinto ezenziwa umnyango ekuncedeni ukukhishwa kwamalungelo. Ukwenza noma ukwenza komuntu ocelayo: Umthetho kanye nokwenza komuntu onesicelo abanezimvume bayobukwa. Kanye nalabo abazamayo ukwenza kahle bayobukwa. Okunye ke kuyobukwa ngokuthi izikhalo zifakwe ngama email. Ukukhishwa kwama fomu okungenela kanye nendlela yokukhokha. Umnyango awunayo inkinga yokusetshenziswa kwabameli, ama consultant , ngakho ke umnyango uzosebenzisa awayo ama application form kanye namanye ama documente ukuze kungabi nomuntu wesithathu. Isimemo sokungenela Izimemo ziyokhishwa kwi Government Gazette. Umnyango uzoqokela ukuthi ibekwa kwi website, emaphepheni kanye nezindawo eziphethe ukudoba. Isimemo ngeke sifakwe kwi General policy futhi. Abanezicelo bazonikezwa amakhophi uma becela. Yize umnyango ungenayo inkinga kokusetshenziswa kwama c onsultants noma abamelis, umnyango uzozenzela awabo amafomu , imigomo kanye nezi izii documente ukuze banciphise ukuthembela kubantu besithathu.. Umnyango uncamela ukuthi kusetshenziswe usizo lwabo ngaphambi kokuthi umuntu asebenzise ama consultant. Uhla lwabantu abenze izinqumo. Umnyango ulindele izicelo eziningi ukucela amalungelo. Abanye bayonqatshwa. Indlela yokukhetha kuzobukwa labo abanam score amaningi.. Lokhu akusho ukuthi labo abazonatshwa ingoba bengafanele. Ngakho kufuneka abantu abanama score aphezulu. okokuqala isicelo sizobukwa ngokuthi sifakwe ngendlela yini.. Uma sitholakale sekudlule isikhathi, uma umuntu engayikhokhanga imali noma alhokhe kungeneli, noma ifakwe ngendlela engafanele njengokuyifaka nge faxnoma nge fomu elingafanele.

Zonke izinqolobane / izindawo zokugcina imininingwane ezakha izinqolobane zangena ezinhlelweni zokwandisa ulwazi eziningi ngonyaka ka-2000. lezinhlelo zazifaka amahora engeziwe ukulungiselela abantu abasebenzayo, ukuvakashela amaqembu, imibukiso, izifundo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme, ukwethula amapepha (Conference Papers) ama-workshops. Izinqolobane zenza izinsiza ezisiza ekwethuleni abafundi basezikoleni ezinqolobaneni zesizwe. Ngonyaka ka-2000 Isinsiza zokufundisa zanikwa isivivinyo ezikoleni ezahlukene ezifundazweni ezimbili. Okwamanje loluhlelo lwenziwa ngokubambisana noMnyango weZemfundo. Kucatshangwa ukuthi lomgodla izoqaliswa ekupheleni konyaka ka-2001. Umthetho ufuna ukuba izinqolobane zigcine amaregista kazwelonke. Ngo- 2000 kwaphethwa izaluleko eziyisishiyagalombili, kwi-rejista kazwelonke, amatshe aqoshiwe amane , kanye nohla lwezincwadi eziyisishiyagalolunye . Lokhukukhiswa kwezincwadi kwenza ngcono umsebenzi wokuqhathanisa kanye nokotholakala kwemininingwane. Izinkinga ezatholakala ekuqaliseni igunya elisemthethweni lokubuyiselwa kwezinqolobane zolwazi olungumlando yizona zingqinamba ezinkulu/ ezibalulekile. IziNqolobane zikazwelonke zintula amandla okusebenzisa ukuphathwa kwemininingwane aemazingeni esifundazwe kanye nasemakhaya. Ngakhoke Ukwakhiwa/ ukunikezwa kwamandla, kolwazi ezifundazweni kubalulekile. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzi abaqhamuka ezinqolobaneni zaseMpumalanga kanye nasezifundazwei eziseNingizimu Afrika, isibonelo ezisuka Ebotswana. Umsebenzi wokuqala: ukusatshalaliswa kwemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwemininingwane / yamarekhodi ukuze kuxhaswe ukusebenza kwekhomishana yamaqiniso nokubuyisana.

Ama-afidavithi aphuma kubantu ababili abakufakazelayo baphinde baqinisekise ukuthi lomsebenzi othi uyawazi ngepela kunjalo. Ukubhalisa kungathatha amaviki angu 6 kuya ku 8 kuya ngokuthi amaphepha adingekayo aphelele yini. Abantu ababili abakhethwe yikomidi elilulekayo lalowomsebenzi bazokuhlaba ngemibuzo ehambelana nesicelo sakho. Umphumela wokuhlolwa kwakho uzokwaziswa emva komhlangano omkhulu wekhansela. Imininingwane yeComputer yasebhange kanye nokufaka imali ngokuya ebhange: Sicela usebenzise amaletha okuqala amagama akho kanye nesibongo sakho ukuze ubonakalise inkokhelo yakho e-akhawuntini yethu ebhange ubese ufekisa ubufakazi bokukhokha nekhasi lokuqala lesicelo sakho ku 841 1057.
