Amele ubuhlakani, amandla, ubumnene kanye nobungunaphakade. Linemisebenzi emibili: ukukhombisa ubuqobo kanye nokuvikela ngokomoya. Liqukatha uphawu elikhulu lezwe. Lokhu kokubili kumele ukuvikeleka kanye nobuphathimandla. Futhi kumele imilenze enamandla okungeyenyoni intinginono. Umkhonto newisa kulele phansi, okumele uxolo. Esesimweni sokundiza - ngokwemvelo kukhumbosa ukukhula kanye nesivinini. Lena inyoni enamandla kakhulu omilenze yayo - ibekwe yafanekiswa nomkhonto newisa - eyisiza kakhulu ekuzingeleni kanye nasekuzivikeleni. Iyisithunywa esivela ezulwini futhi yehlisele ubumnene bayo bulapha emhlabeni, ngalowo mqondo-ke ingumfanekiso wobukhosi basezulwini. Izimpiko zayo eziphakeme zibonakalisa ukuphakama kwesizwe sethu, okuhambisana nokusinikeza ukuvikeleka. Isibonakaliso sokugqama kanye nobukhazikhazi. Kungumfanekiso wesethembiso sokuzalwa kabusha, amandla abhidlangile okucabangisisa, ulwazi, ukuthatha isinqumo esiyiso kanye nokuzimisela okukhulu. Kuyisibonakaliso somthombo wempilo, wokukhanya kanye nokuphelela kweSintu okuphelele. Isakhiwo esiphelele seSiphandla Sezwe sihlanganisa ingxenye engenhla nengezansi yakhe isiyingi somumo weqanda okufanekisa ingunaphakade. Ukuhlangana konqenqema lombhalo olungezansi, namazinyo endlovu, nokomkhathizwe okuqhamuka kuwo ilanga likhuphuke, kwakha isimo seqanda okuqhamuka kulo intinginono. Lomfanekiso unomqondo osho ukuzalwa kabusha ngokomoya kwesizwe sethu esikhulu futhi esinobuqhawe.

Uthando namandla abathokozisayo ababebekhona kuze kube sekugcineni kwela mcimbi, lapho uhlelo lukasizo lwakhasimende lukhombisa ngendlela eqinile yokuphakela umphakathi. Ngale ndlela, umcimbi wezinhlaka ezikhiphayo unikeze ithuba elihle lokulima, ukhuthaza ukuzibophezela okwengeziwe ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi nabalimi abahlanganyela umqondo ofanayo wokukhulisa impilo yezolimo. Noma kanjani, izigaba zomcimbi weNkundla Yezolimo ziqinisekisa ukuthi ukulima kube yingxenye ebalulekile yezenhlalakahle. Ubulili obunamandla, imfundo, nokuxhumana phakathi kwemindeni nakweminye imiphakathi kuzohlinzeka ngomphumela ophumelelayo nokuqhubekayo kwalowo mcimbi.

Nakuba kunjalo, inkosi isenamandla amakhulu, isahlonishwa abantu bomphakathi, isakwazi ukuqondisa izigwegwe. Amakhosi nemikhandlu yendabuko anwebe amandla awo aba ngaphezu kokubheka izindaba zobukhosi, ezomndeni, ezezimpahla, izehlukaniso, nokuthi ubani ozothatha izingane emva kwesehlukaniso nemibango yomhlaba. Banquma ikakhulu amacala abizwa ngokuthi awangasese nawemibango ukunalawo egazi. Izinto ezibalulekile ngalolu hlelo lwemithetho yendabuko ukuthi luyinto esemqoka kakhulu ezweni laseGhana, nemithetho ephathelene namasiko iyaqiniswa esifundeni nasezinkantolo, lokho kuncike ohlotsheni lwento edala ukungezwani. Ijaji elikhulu lasezweni laseGhana, uJaji George Kingsley Acquahwakhumbuza ababemlalele ukuthi "amakhosi yibona bagadi bezwe, nokuthi axazulula izinkinga eziningi zemibango yezwe. Ngakho-ke amakhosi ahlala 'ethandeka ngokwemisebenzi yawo' ezakhamuzini eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Babuye baxazulule izinkinga eziningi zemibango yemindeni ezindaweni zabo. Ukungabi namithetho emileyo kulezi zinkantolo kwenza ukuthi zithandeke futhi zisebenziseke kalula nabantu bazibuke njengezabo, hhayi njengento abaxhilwa ngayo." Abaholi bendabuko basawagcinile amandla abo okuthetha amacala abaqhubeka nokuwasebenzisa nakuba kwaqedwa izinkantolo zendabuko ngeminyaka yokuqala wenkululeko. Nakuba uMthethosisekelo ungazigunyazi izinkantolo zomdabu, abaholi bendabuko nemikhandlu yendabuko sebezandisile izindawo lapho bebusa khona badlula nezinto eziphathelene nemindeni nemibango yezimpahla, lapha singabala nezehlukaniso, ukuthi ubani ozothola ukuhlala nezingane nezemihlaba.

Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqhubeka Nokufunda Ukugcina amanzi ahlanzekile akupheli kuphela ekutholeni amanzi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqhubeka nokufunda. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile: - Ukwazi izitayela ezintsha: Funda ngezindlela ezintsha zokuhlanza amanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlanzekile. Bheka izincwadi, izifundo, nemithombo ethokozisayo. - Yabelana ngolwazi: Qinisekisa ukuthi uthumele ulwazi lwezokuhlanzeka kwamamzi kubangani, emndenini, nasemphakathini. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvuselela abanye. Isiphetho Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungathola amanzi ahlanzekile futhi uvikele imithombo yakho. Amanzi ahlanzekile akubalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi ukwenza imizamo yokukwenza kube neqhaza elikhulu ekuvikelekeni komphakathi nasemvelo. Yiba nomthombo omuhle, uvikele, futhi ube nomthelela omuhle. Amanzi ahlanzekile akho uyafaneleka!

Isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya kufanele siqhube imisebenzi noma sisebenzise amandla agidlabezwe sona ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho. Isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya singedlulisa amandla noma umsebenzi ophawulwe esigatshaneni 4 aye kumuntu osebenza ehhovisi laleso siphathimandla, kuphela ngaphansi kwemibandela nezimo ezinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe, ngokulandela isigaba- 46. Iziphathimandla zeqophelo lomoya kufanele zixhumanise imisebenzi yazo ngendlela enganqunywa wuhlaka lukazwelonke noma nguNgqongqoshe ngomthetho ohambisana nesigaba- 46. Umnyango ngamunye kazwelonke noma nesifundazwe esinesibophezelo sokulungisa isu lokusebenza komthetho noma isu lokuphatha imvelo ngokulandisa kweSahluko- 3 soMthetho kaZwelonke Wokuphatha Ezemvelo kufanele ufake njengengxenye yesu, iqhinga lokuphatha iqophelo lomoya. Eqhingeni Lentuthuko Edidiyele elihlonzwe ngaphansi kwesigaba -25 soMthetho Wezinhlaka zoMasipala, umasipala ngamunye kufanele uxube isu lokusingatha iqophelo lomoya. c lihambisane nanoma yimuphi omunye umbandela ongase unqunywe nguNgqongqoshe ngomthetho ongaphansi kwesigaba -46. d Imisebenzi yokuqapha iqophelo lomoya. b indawo idinga isenzo esithile sokuphatha iqophelo lomoya ukulungisa isimo esikhona. b indawo yenabela ngaphesheya komngcele wesinye isifundazwe; noma c indawo iwela ngaphansi kwesifundazwe lapho leso sifundazwe sicele khona uNgqongqoshe ukuba adalule leyo ndawo njengekleliswe phambili. Ngokwesigatshana 1, uNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni angadalula indawo esesifundazweni njengendawo ekleliswe phambili.

Udlame olubhekiswe kwabezizwe luyisenzo sobugebengu! Uhulumeni ngeke aluvumele nakancane nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lodlame olubhekiswe kwabanye abantu! Masibambisane ukuze sakhe impilo engcono kubo bonke abantu abahlala eNingizimu Afrika. Masibambisane ukuze sithuthukise amakhono ethu futhi sivule amathuba emisebenzi. Uma unolwazi mayelana nesenzo esihlelwayo sokuhlasela abezizwe abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, uyacelwa ukuthi ushayele isiteshi samaphoyisa esiseduze nawe noma uma kunesimo esiphuthumayo uyacelwa ukuthi ushayele le nombolo yocingo ku-10111. Ukuhlaselwa ngesihluku kwabantu bakwamanye amazwe abahlala eNingizimu Afrika ngeke kusize muntu. Kuvamise ukuthi kube ngabantu abamsulwa abayizisulu zalokhu - izigebengu zona ziyaphunyula. Uma unolwazi oluphathelene nesenzo sobugebengu - bikela iziphathimandla. Ungathathi umthetho uwubeke ezandleni zakho. Uhulumeni ucela imiphakathi ukuthi ihlale iqaphile futhi ibike izigameko eziphathelene nodlame nenzondo eqondiswe kwabezizwe. Ukusingathwa ngempumelelo Kwendebe Yomhlaba ye-FIFA ka-2010 se-kwenze iNingizimu Afrika kanye nezwekazi kubukeke kahle emazweni omhlaba. Kube nokudlondlobala okukhulu kwinani lezivakashi ezifike kuleli lizwe futhi lokho kuwaphuculile amathuba okutshalwa kwezimali, kanti futhi lokho kuzovula amathuba emisebenzi. Nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lodlame ezweni lethu luzocekela phansi konke esikuzuzile ngenkathi sisingethe Indebe Yomhlaba. Manje umhlaba ususi-bheke ngamehlo okhozi kakhulu kunakuqala.

Kwakungekho ukulangazelela, bezithanda izinqubo ezithokozisayo, futhi bakhumbula ukuthi lezi zinguquko zazididiyela ebuhleni bomphakathi. Ubuqotho busizayo, kanti umthethosisekelo waba yisithombe salokho abantu abafisa ukukwenza. Ekugcineni, umthethosisekelo waba umthombo wezimo ezinhle, ukwakha ukuvuma phakathi kwabantu. Kombuso wabantu, kwenza kube sobala ukuthi umphakathi unamandla okwakha. Kwathi sengathi izinkanyezi zikhanya, umthethosisekelo wanikeza izinhlelo ezinkulu zempilo yethu. Kwakungekho ukungabaza, umphakathi uya phambili. Ngaleyo ndlela, umthethosisekelo wakulethela uhlelo oluhlukile lokuphila, lapho wonke umuntu ebamba iqhaza. Ngakho, kufanelekile ukuhamba phambili, sizigcine ukuze siphile, sithande, sihlanganyele, sizithande. Lokhu kwakungukwakha umthethosisekelo, okuyindida yokuhamba kwesikhathi, eyakha izandla zethu, hamba phambili ukuze uNtlama umthethosisekelo. Abantu babebambene, bahamba phambili, kwathi umthethosisekelo waba ukwakha ubumbano — lesi yisandla esihlanganisa izinkanyezi phakathi kwethu sonke.

Uma kungaphumeleleki ukuthola amakhotheshini amathathu, izizathu zokweqiwa okunje kuzorekhodwa Yimenenja Yezezimali futhi kuzawuvunyelwa NguMenenja Wezezimali futhi kuzakuvunywa Yi-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu ngaphambi kokuvuma ikhotheshini. Ihambisane nanoma yimuphi umbhalo odingwa yi-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu (i-CFO). Uma ngabe nganoma yisiphi isizathu, le nqubo ayilandelwa, izizathu zaloku kwehluka zizawubhalwa nguMenenja Wezezimali bese zivunywa yi-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu. Izincasiselo zebhidi zizawulungiselelwa ngokukodwa kokwenza okuboniswe esigabeni se- 7. Ukuze ibhidi ibhekwe kuzomele ilandele zonke izidingo zemibhalo yebhidi (njengoba ibekiwe esigabeni se- 5.1) bese ifakwe ebhokisini lebhidi elisemthethweni elibekwe njengoba kukhangisiwe. Ibandla libiza idiphosithi engabuyiselwa yokunikezwa kwemibhalo yamabhidi. Inani ledipozithi leyeme ekutheni liyabuyekezwa njalo ngonyaka. I-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu noma i-ofishali egunyaziwe izakuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhokisi ebhidi avaliwe aze avulwe ngokusemthethweni aqinisekise nokuthi aphephe ngemfanelo. Ngesikhathi sokukhangisa, ibhokisi lebhidi lizawuvulwa livalwe ngama-ofishali amabili: oyedwa ovela Emnyango Wezinsiza Wezezimali kanye noyedwa ovela Emnyango Wezinsiza Zokubumbana, lapho kufaneleke khona, i-ofisa evela kumnyango owenzelwa ibhidi. Ibhokisi lizovulwa ngaphambi komphakathi, okusho ukuthi kukhona amabhida namaqembu anomnako.

Noma yimiphi imininingwane yokuthinta abanye abantu abanokufakazisa ngalezi zinsolo. Imininingwane yokukuthinta efayelini isemqoka, kwenzela uma kunesidingo sokuthi usonhlalkahle akuthinte malungana neminye imidanti yalolu daba. Indlakadla: Kungaba imihuzuko, izibazi, izenyelo, ukusha, ukulunywa ngamazinyo, nokunye. ukuhlukunyezwa emoyeni: Kungaba ukwehluleka ukufeza izidingo zengane zokuyikhombisa uthando, ukuyinaka, ukuyakha nokukhuluma nayo ngendlela enesihluku, ukuyishaya indiva, ukuyesabisa ngesihluku, kumbe imizamo yokuyethusa. Ukungayibhekeli: Ukuba yilokhu wehluleka ukuvikela ingane ezingozini noma iziphi, emakhazeni, ekulambeni, nokungenzi okufanele okuhambisana nokuyinakekela, nokunye. USonhlalakahle uzokuyivakashela ingane nomndeni wayo ukuze ayobhekisisa isimo anqume noma ingane iyadinga yini ukunakekelwa nokuvikelwa. Lapho osolwa ngokuhlukumeza ehlala ndlini yinye nengane, kungenzeka acelwe ukuba asuke ayohlala engxenye. Uma lokhu kungenzeke, ingane ingahlala kwamakhelwane, umngane, isihlobo kumbe endaweni yokukhoselisa izingane okwesikhashana. Chabo, kuphela nje lapho impilo yengane isengozini. Isimiso mgomo sokugcina ingane nomndeni wayo siyigugu kakhulu. Lapho kuthathwa isinqumo, kuye kubhekelwe njenegnto esemqoka ukuba ingane izuze ngaso sonke isikhathi. Imindeni nezingane ziyingxenye yokuthathwa kwanoma yisiphi isinqumo ngesimo ababhekene naso. Chabo, kuphela nje ukufakwa kodaba ohlwini ngokwakho akuwathinti amalungelo esibopho enganeni omzali kumbe umnakekeli wayo.

Imikhandlu yomasipala ingasebenzisa amasu okuhlela ajulile anobuhlakani bamakhompuyutha. Omasipala abasesigabeni B bangaqhuba inqubo yokuhlela efanayo kodwa basebenzise indlela esobala. Omasipala abasezingeni eliphezulu bangasebenzisa amasu athuthukile okuhlaziya ulwazi nemininingwane, (isibonelo, izinhlelo zokuhlaziya imibiko nolwazi lwendawo), abanye bangethembela ekuqageleni nenqubo yokubuyekeza ngokushesha. Umphumela walokhu wukuthi indlela ye-IDP encike ezigamekweni njengoba yethulwe ebhukwini isebenza kuzo zonke izigaba nezinhlobo zomasipala. Bonke kufanele baphendule imibuzo efanayo ngokwedlula ohlelweni olufanayo lokubonisana nomgudu wokuthatha izinqumo ngokuxoxisana. Amasu okuhlela kuphela ayokwehluka. Ukugwema ukudida iNdlela ye-IDP namasu athile aqondile nezikhali ezifanele, kungabunjwa amasu nezikhali zezinhlobo ezehlukene zomasipala kwelinye ibhuku (Umhlahlandlela IV: "Ibhokisi lezikhali"). Ukuhlinzekela izindlela ezimbili zamasu namaqhinga okuhlela kanjalo nokwenza izinguquko ngokwehluka kwezingqikithi emkhandlwini ngamunye. Indlela ye-IDP igxile emgomweni wokusebenzisana, ukumelwa nokubamba iqhaza ngamalunga omphakathi, izakhamuzi nabathile abanentshisekelo ngaphakathi kumasipala, kanjalo nabamele ezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni, ochwepheshe bemboni nabantu abanezinsiza. a ukubamba iqhaza okuhlelwe yizinhlangano nabaqokwe njengabammeli isibonelo ngabamele amathimba nemiphakathi eyayicindezelwe noma engahlelekile, b ukuveza imigomo namathuba okubamba iqhaza, ngale kokukhuthaza nokuhlela isimo sokubamba iqhaza kohulumeni bomasipala.

Okwesibili, singasebenzisa izithako ezilula nezitholakalayo. Ukupheka akudingi ukuba kube nzima; singakha izidlo ezimnandi neziphilile ngama-ingredients ambalwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abahlushwa yisikhathi, futhi kubavumele ukuba bakhe ukudla okunempilo. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukupheka kuyinqubo ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Nakuba kunezinselelo ezihambisana nakho, izinzuzo zokupheka ekhaya zikhulu kakhulu. Ukupheka akusizi kuphela ekwakheni ukudla okunempilo, kodwa futhi kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwemindeni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sithuthukise izindlela zokupheka, sithole izinsiza ezitholakalayo, futhi sifundise abantu izindlela zokupheka ezilula. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukupheka kube lula, kube mnandi, futhi kube yindlela yokuphila enempilo. Ukupheka akuyona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, futhi kufanele sithokozise le msebenzi.

a uhlelo lwezinga lokwakha kanye nombiko obhalwe phansi kufanele kulungiswe; futhi b uphenyo lwezemvelo kanye nombiko obhalwe phansi ngakho kufanele kwenziwe njengoba kukhombiswe yisikhungo esifanele esigabeni 22 se-ECA, noma isikhungo esikhonjiswe ezigabeni ezifanele ze-NEMA, uma lezi zigaba zisebenza, zingathatha isinqumo, futhi iMEC kufanele ilandele inqubo echazwe kulesi sigaba. d ngezindlela zokuphatha ezenzeka ngaphansi kwesigaba 9 lapho ukuvunywa kwezinga lokwakha kukhishwa ngaphansi kwesigaba -; futhi e ithuba, ngesikhathi nangendlela efanele, yokudlulisa imibono mayelana nohlelo lwezinga lokwakha kanye nombiko wezempilo. Izaziso ezikhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 7, noma izingxenye zayo, zingashintshwa yiMEC futhi uma lokhu kwenzeka, imithetho yezigaba 6 kuya ku- izosebenza, kanye nezinguquko ezidingekayo, uma kungenjalo uma lezi zinguquko zihluka ezingeni lokwakha elikhuluma ngale ndlela yokuthi kokubili imingcele echazwe yendlela noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi yezi zinguquko ibonakale ngaphandle kwemingcele echazwe yezi zinga, ukubekwa kwendlela ngokuhambisana nezigaba 6 kuya ku- k kufanele kuqala kwenziwe ngendlela yokuthi imingcele echazwe yalesi sikhathi noma indlela yokuhamba yomphakathi ezingeni lokwakha elishintshiwe ibonakale ngaphandle. Ngokukhishwa kwesaziso esikhonjiswe esigabeni 7, noma yisiphi isaziso esikhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 69 mayelana nendlela ethathwe izinga lokwakha yiMEC, izothathwa njengokukhansela mayelana nendlela ethathwe izinga lokwakha yiMEC ngaphansi kwesigaba 6. kuphathwa yisikhungo esigunyaziwe sokwamukela izinguquko ekusetshenzisweni komhlaba, ngokuhambisana nenqubo yokuhlela efanele, kufanele sithumele lezi zibonelo,

UMthethosisekelo ubeka ngokucacile ubugugu kanye nemithetho okuyisisekelo okumele kwengamele ukuphathwa komphakathi. Futhi ngokushintsha umqondo womuntu ngendlela umuntu ebuka ngayo izinto, ungashintsha umuntu. Kuqinisekiswe ama-Ivoirian kanye nomphakathi wamazwe omhlaba ukuthi kuzokhishwa izitifiketi zikazwelonke. UKasserchun uphinde wengeza ukuthi zonke izindawo zokuhlala komphakathi zizolungiswa eduze kwensika yamatshe kanye nezindlela zakamuva zamalambu okukhanyisa ebusuku. Amahekthare angamashumi amahlanu ukuya kumashumi ayisikhombisa angaphinde athengwe kwi-ryegrass clover ukuze anikezwe ithafa lomsoco, ngaphambi futhi okungenzeka kube ngemuva kwesikhathi sokuzalisana kwezilwane. Isebenzisana nezikhungo zomphakathi ezisungulwe ngaphansi komthetho kanye noMthethosisekelo ogqugquzela intshisekelo yomphakathi. I-Registrar isebenza imisebenzi eyidlanzana yayo, ehlanganisa iwebhusayithi ye-Inthanethi esebenzayo. Ilungu elingeyena usihlalo, kumele lazise usihlalo ngokumbhalela ngokwesula kwalo. Kungenzeka ukuthi kuthathe imvelo yomuntu efiswayo ngaphezu kokwenza kwakho, ngenhlonipho. Akukho ukusebenzisana phakathi kukaHulumeni kanye nababambe iqhaza abangekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni futhi naphakathi kwezikhungo ezinamagunya zasekhaya nezendabuko. Ngakho baqondwa ngalowo mbiko futhi banikezwa ithuba lokuchaza izimo kanye nemininingwane abeyidlulisile. Ukuvakasha kuhambisana nohlelo oluhleliwe lwe-WCPP njengesikhungo esingesabantu, ukulungisela ukuzibandakanya komphakathi, ukwenza ngcono ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi kanye nokukhangisa ngalokho esikwenzayo.

Lokhu kubhekisela kwimibhalo eyakhiwe ukuze isetshenziswe emphakathini, ehlelelwe ukukhiqizwa nokusabalalisa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika, egcina noma idlulisa ulwazi olubhalwe, ulwazi lwezithombe, ulwazi olurekhodiwe lokulalela, olufundwa ngama-mishini, noma lwethulwa kunoma iyiphi enye ifomethi ehlolwe noma esanda kushicilelwa ehlukile kakhulu kulokho okwakukhona ngaphambili ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi luhlukile noma indlela nesimo sokuthi luthunyelwe kulolu shicilelo eNingizimu Afrika noma ehlelelwe ukusetyenziswa emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukugcinwa kwemfihlo ebhalwe phansi kanye nemvelaphi ye-rekhodi kusiza ukufinyelela kwabantu emisebenzini yonke eshicilelwe eyakhiqizwa ezweni labo. Ngakho-ke, ukugcinwa kolwazi ngokomthetho kuyisici esisodwa semigqa yokukhululeka kolwazi. Kusiza izwe lethu ukuba ligcine izibopho zayo ezimbili zokwethembeka kubantu bonke, kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wombhali awulahleki futhi uyatholakala ukuze uphenywe esikhathini esizayo, kuvumela indawo yokugcina ukuba ikhulise ukuqwashisa phakathi kwabantu bonke balo msebenzi mayelana nalokho okukhishwe nokushicilelwe njengesisekelo sokwakhiwa kwemibhalo kazwelonke nezinye iziqoqo zolwazi ezazisa abasebenzisi-bokugcina nalabo abazozisebenzisa ezwenikazi nasemhlabeni jikelele ngezincwadi ezikhona neminye imibhalo, ngaleyo ndlela kukhuthaza ukusabalala kwayo nokuthengwa, kuba isisekelo sokuhlanganiswa kwezibalo ezikhiqizwa yi-UNESCO emhlabeni jikelele, okuyinsiza ewusizo yolwazi emsebenzini wezincwadi nezohwebo. Lokhu kungase kube nenzuzo nakwezinye izindlela.

Ukufaneleka nezidingo ze-GEMS Ngaphakathi kwezinsuku eziningi, umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezempilo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlangano ezahlukene ezazihlose ukusiza abantu, ikakhulukazi labo abahluphekayo. Phakathi kwalezi zinhlangano, i-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) yaziwa kakhulu. Le mfundiso yempilo yadalwa ngenhloso yokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubasebenzi bakahulumeni, futhi yathola ukwamukelwa okukhulu. I-GEMS yasungulwa ngonyaka ka-2005, ngesikhathi lapho uhulumeni efuna ukwandisa ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kubasebenzi bakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi, izinkinga eziningi zempilo zazikhona, futhi abantu abaningi babengenayo indlela yokuthola usizo lwezempilo olufanele. I-GEMS yabe isiza ukuxazulula lezi zinkinga, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzi abahlala ezindaweni ezikude, lapho izinsiza zezempilo zazingatholakali kalula. Ukuze umuntu akwazi ukujoyina i-GEMS, bekudingeka ukuthi ahlangabezane nezidingo ezithile. Okokuqala, umgomo wokuqala wukuthi umuntu kumele abe ngumsebenzi kahulumeni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni komphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abasebenzi bakahulumeni bekwazi ukuthola izinsizakalo ezinhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibhekelele izidingo ezithile ezihlobene nezempilo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abathola izinsiza banelisekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathuthukisa izinhlelo zayo ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo zomphakathi. Kwakukhona izinhlelo ezahlukene ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha.

Inhloso yeMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiNgcaciso ukuqinisa ukuthi abantu bangasebenzisa ilungelo labo leMthethosisekelo lokufinyelela ulwazi oluphathwa nguhulumeni, kanye nolwazi oluphathwa abanye abantu, oludingekayo ukuze umuntu akwazi ukwenza noma ukuvikela ilungelo elithile. Umgomo ophambili wokwenza kube nokufinyelela kolwazi ukuhlinzeka ngamasiko okucacisa ngendlela izinto ezenziwa ngayo nokuchaza izenzo zohulumeni nezizimele, kanye nokuthuthukisa umphakathi lapho abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bengafinyelela ulwazi ukuze bakwazi ukwenza noma ukuvikela amalungelo abo onke. Ingabe kukhona ulwazi olukhona ngaphakathi kweMnyango Wezobulungiswa noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano yomphakathi engatholakala? Ungafinyelela wonke amadokhumenti noma amarekhodi avela kwiMnyango, kubaphathi bawo, noma kunoma iyiphi inhlangano kahulumeni. Akubalulekile ukuthi ulwazi lukhona nini. Amarekhodi omuntu kwiMnyango noma enhlangano kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngamaqembu wesithathu noma amarekhodi kuphela ngokuvuma kweqembu lesithathu elithintekayo, ikakhulukazi uma amadokhumenti aqukethe ulwazi oluyimfihlo noma ulwazi lomuntu siqu. Ulwazi olungavunyelwe lutholakala ngokulandela iMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ukufinyelela KwiNgcaciso. Ukufinyelela kolwazi kuthintwa yizithiyo ezithile, ngokwesibonelo, uma irekhodi liceliwe ukuze lisetshenziswe ezinqubweni zomthetho eziphikisanayo noma ezingezona eziphikisanayo noma uma izinqubo zomthetho eziphikisanayo noma ezingezona eziphikisanayo seziqale, lapho ulwazi lungasetshenziswa khona enkantolo, ikakhulukazi uma inkantolo ikholelwa ukuthi kungalimaza inqubo yobulungiswa. Amarekhodi wekhabhinethi noma amaqembu ayo. Amarekhodi ahlobene nokusebenza kwezinkantolo kanye nezijaji.

Izizinda zisungulwe wuMnyango ukuba zibe izithunywa zokuletha izinguquko, intuthuko kanye nokuthuthukisa ubuciko. Seziphinde futhi zengezelwa umthwalo wokuba zabe izimali zikaHulumeni kwezobuciko, ukudayisa izwe emazweni omhlaba kanye nokudala ukutholakala kwamathuba kwezobuciko kwayo yonke imiphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Uhlaka lukazwelonke lwezokuboniswa kwamaciko asamdlalo. Ingqikithi yomgomo wobuciko ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinguquko eziyisibopho/ eziphoqayo ziyafezeka futhi zihlala zikhona njalo. Okwamanje uMnyango uthintana nababonke abathintekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imibono iyatholakala ukuze kuphothulwe inqubo mgomo. Isigungu Sikazwelonke saMaciko (National Arts Council) yenze indlela entsha yokuxhasa ngezimali neyibeka ohleni lokuxhasa imisebenzi kazwelonke enohlonze. AmaWorkshop ayechaza futhi ecacisa ngalendlela enziwa kuzozonke izifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye. Ezinye izingcezu zokuxhumamanisa komthethosisekelo zisebenza ndawonye nomthetho wokudweba/ wokufanekisa kanye nokuchaza ngomgudu wezinqolobane zomphakathi zezwe . Ngonyaka ka 2000 kwamenyezelwa umthetho omaqondana nofakwa kwezimali okusemthethweni, inqolobane kazwelonke kanye nokubusa ngentando yabantu evulelekile. Izindawo zokubeka kanye namasenta okuqopha / okushicilela. Ukudlulisela kwemininingwane yomphakathi. Ngezizathu ezibikwe ngenhla izinqolobane zomlando zihlangabezana nobunzima ekuphatheni ngokukhalima ukudluliselwa kwemininingwane yomphakathi okuhlelekileyo. Ngezizathu esizithinte ngenhla. Ukudluliselwa okuningi kuze kwahlehliswa ngenxa yenkinga yendawo.

Isinqumo kufanele senziwe kube umyalelo wenkantolo ukuze sisebenze kahle. Asikho isicelo esiyofakwa enkantolo- kungavunyelwana ngokuthi kufakwe isicelo ngabanye abalamuli. Isinqumo singathathwa ngokucutshungulwa yiNkantolo eNkulu. Kujwayeleke ukuthi kube nomphumela wokunqoba/ukwehluleka. Lowo olahlwe yicala ukhokha izindleko ezivezwe ukusetshenziswa kwabameli. Inkokhelo yabalamuli iyokhokhwa yizinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zizisombululela inkinga ngokwazo. Alukho usizo lokusombulula inkinga oluvela kumuntu wesithathu. Inqubo ilawulwa yizinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Uhlangothi ngalunye oluthintekayo lungasebenzisa abeluleki bezomthetho, kodwa lokho akudingekile. Umphumela uncike emandleni kanye nasekhonweni lezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Azikho izindleko zomthetho ngaphandle kwezindleko zomeluleki wezomthetho uma esetshenzisiwe. Izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zizisombululela inkinga ngokwazo. Umuntu wesithathu uyasiza ukusombulula inkinga. Inqubo ilawulwa umlamuli ngokuthi abonisane nezinhlangothi ezithintekayo. Abeluleki bezomthetho bohlangothi ngalunye oluthintekayo abadingeki uma kwenziwa lolu hlelo. Umphumela ungaba yisifiso somlamuli kodwa akuyena othatha isinqumo. Umphumela esikhathini esiningi kuba wukunqoba/ukunqoba. Izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zikhokha izindleko zomlamuli uma zikhona. Le yindlela lapho okudingeka khona umuntu wesithathu, umlamuli/umuntu oletha uxolo, ukusiza izinhlangothi ezithintekayo ukuthi zisombulule izinkinga zazo. Ingachazwa njengokuxoxisana okusizanwayo kukho.

Ikhwalithi yokugunda utshani iholela ekutholeni kahle lokho okomile kwezilwane. Kukhona okuthile okulindelwe ukuthi kwenzeke uma iziqondiso zokungcoliswa komoya ziphulwa. Izigaxa zingaba uphawu lwezifo, noma umphumela wokudla okungafanele. Kucacile ukuthi umthetho ohlosiwe ugcizelela ukuthi izindaba zokungcoliswa komoya azikhokhiswa kuphela ngumlomo. Kulokhu, kokubili okuqukethwe kanye nesimo noma indlela esetshenziselwa ukusabalalisa ulwazi kufanele kubhekwane. Namuh

Le mali ingasetshenziswa kangcono emfundweni, empilweni, nasemakhaya. Khumbula ukuthi iziphuzo ezahlukene zineziphuzo ezihlukene. Ungakhetha ukuthi iyiphi ofuna ukuyiphuza phakathi kwalezi ziphuzo. Akufanele uphuze lutho ngaphandle kokwazi ukuthi utshwala bungakanani obukhona. Lokhu kungaba yingozi kakhulu! Ukuphuza nje ukuze ujabule nokweqa umkhawulo wezinyanga ezimbili zoshukela nsuku zonke, ngenye indlela, akufanele kube yisiko lakho ukuphuza ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa iziphuzo zakho. Phuza uhlobo olulodwa lutshwala ngasikhathi sinye futhi ungaphuzi ngaphambi kokushayela noma ukuhamba emgwaqweni. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyodwa kuya kwezimbili: Uxoxa kakhulu futhi awumisi, isivinini senhliziyo yakho sikhuphuka. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezintathu: Ukushayela kwakho kuba kubi kakhulu, awukwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungase uzizwe unokukhathazeka. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezinhlanu: Ungase ungaboni kahle; uma ukhuluma, uyaphazamiseka; awukwazi ukwenza izinto ngokushesha. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili: Awukwazi ukuhamba ngqo futhi kubonakala sengathi uyawela; ubona izinto kabili. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyi-15 kuya kwezingu-20: Uyaqandwa kakhulu futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungase uphume. Lokhu kukhombisa kahle ukuthi akufanele uphuze ngokweqile ngaphezu kwezinyanga ezimbili. Izinyanga ezintathu zidalela ushintsho em behavior yakho futhi awukwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo. Ungakuphuzanga utshwala uma... Ungavumeli abantu bagcwalise iglasi yakho ngaphambi kokuyiqeda. Uzophela ungazi ukuthi uphuze kangakanani. Ungahlanganisi utshwala obuphuza. Phuza kancane. Ngaphambi kokuphuza iglasi elandelayo yotshwala, phuza iglasi yamanzi.

Intsha ikwenza kube nesibopho sokwenza izinqumo ezifanele ukuze kugwenywe izimo ezingezinhle, ezinjengezithiyo, ukuswela, noma izinkinga zempilo. Kudala, umphakathi ubona ukukhulelwa kwentsha njengento enezithako eziningi. Ngenkathi abanye bebheka ukuthi ikhuluma ngothando, abanye bathi ukuthola ubandlululo. Lokhu kuthinta izimvelo zomndeni nomphakathi, okwenza uzive bekhuthalele ukuthola izixazululo ezinokwenzeka. Umonakalo omkhulu ungavela uma umntwana ekhulela ngaphandle kokuxhaswa, okwandisa amathuba okuba nezingqinamba eziningi empilweni yakhe. Izinyathelo Zokuxhasa Intsha Kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uhlinzeke ngesiqondiso esifanele nokuqondiswa kwabantu abasha. Izikhungo zabantu, njengezikole nezikhungo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, zidinga ukwesekwa ukuze ziwuphathe lo mzila ukuze zikwazi ukuxhasa intsha. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwezemfundo, ukuvikelwa kwezempilo, kanye nesibindi sokuxhumana nezinsizakalo zempilo, kuyinto efanele ukuba yenzeke, ivuselele umqondo wokukhula kwentsha enempilo. Ukukhuluma nezinsiza, izikhungo zokwelapha zingabahlinzeka ngolwazi lolwazi lokuphumelela kwezindawo ezibalulekile. Izinkulumo ezinhle, okuhloswe ngazo abachwepheshe, kufanele ziqhutshelwe phambili, ukuze abantu abasha baqonde kangcono ukuthi yini okudingeka bazilungiselele, nangendlela yokukhuluma. Ukubamba Isandla Eunhlalweni Ngenxa yomthelela emiphakathini, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uphathe umoya ohloniphekile phakathi kwentsha. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana kwamalungu omphakathi, abahlengikazi, nezikhungo zemfundo.

Nakuba kuneMisebenzi Yokuhlela eyizigameko zokuhlela okumele yenziwe ngokulandelana okuthile, eminye incikene nezindlela namasu okubhekela izinto ezithile nemibandela yokuhlela ngesikhathi sezigameko ezithile zokuhlela (isibonelo, indlela yokubhekana nesimo sezendalo, ukuhlelwa kwendawo noma ezomnotho lapho kubunjwa amaqhinga abhekele ikusasa). Ngamanye amazwi, Imisebenzi Yokuhlela ingaba yizinyathelo noma izigameko okumele zihlelwe (isibonelo yizifundo ezihleliwe, ukuqoqa ulwazi) noma ingasho indlela yokucabanga izinto ezithile ngesinyathelo noma isigameko esenzekayo. c Imisebenzi Yokuhlela eyenabela ezintweni okumele zicatshangwe ngenqubo. Lokhu kuyosiza osebenzisa Umhlahlandlela ekumnikeni isithombe esibanzi ngenqubo nangohlobo lweMisebenzi Yokuhlela. Elwazini oluqondile nokuqondisisa izici ezinomthelela entuthukweni yomasipala. Ukuhlaziya okujulile okuphathelene nezinto eziphawuliwe izinguquko, imithelela, izinsiza, njalonjalo. Ulwazi ngezinsiza ezikhona nalezo ezingatholakala (kuhlangene nohlaka oluhlongozwayo lwezimali). INHLOSO: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuyoba nenkulumo-mpikiswano egamanxe kwezinye izimboni mayelana nezindlela namasu afanele okubhekana nezidingo-nqangi, ngokulandela umhlahlandlela wenqubo-mgomo, imigomo, izinsiza ezikhona, ukuxhumana, imibandela yokuncintisana nombono owodwa. Inkulumo-mpikiswano yokuhlahla indlela ngeqhinga elibhekele ikusasa iyosiza ekugwemeni indlela evamile yokunqamulela lapho kuvele kubhekwe imisebenzi evame embonini, kukhohlwe yimisebenzi eqhakambiswe njengezidingo zomphakathi.

a kuyizindleko ezingagunyaziwe , i zigunyazwa uma selukungiswa isabelo; noma ii ziqinisekiswa uMkhandlu, ngemuva kuphenyo olwenziwe yikomiti loMkhandlu njengenakubuyiseleka nokufanele isulwe emabhukwini nguMkhandlu; futhi b kuyizindleko ezingafanele nezingenazithelo noma eziyincithakalo, ngemuva kophenyo yikomiti loMkhandlu, eqinisekiswe yikomiti loMkhandlu njengezingenakubuyiseleka zisulwe emabhukwin inguMkhandlu. Uma uNobhala enolwazi lokuthi uMkhandlu, usihlalo noma ikomiti eliphethe, uthathe isinqumo okuzothi uma sisebenza sibe nomphumela wezindleko ezingagunyaziwe, ezingalungile, ezingenazithelo neziyincithakalo, uNobhala angeke abobephezeleka ngezindleko ezingagunyaziwe, ezingalungile, noma ezingenazithelo noma ezyincithakalo, iqobo nje uma uNobhala ezise uMkhandlu, usihlalo noma ikomiti eliphethe ukuthi lezi zindleko ngezingagunyaziwe, ezingalungile noma ezingenazithelo nezyincithakalo. i ukubuyisa noma ukulungisa lezo zindleko; kanye ii nokuvimbela ukungena ezindlekweni ezifana nalezi futhi. Kuyovulwa icala lobugebengu noma kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuqondiswa izigwengwe kulowo muntu omangalelwe icala lokungena ezindlekweni ezingagunyaziwe, ezingaqondile noma ezingenazithelo neziyincithakalo ngale kokuthi zesuliwe noma ezengesulwanga ngokwesigatshana 2. a izindleko ezingaqondile ezingavulelwa icala lobugebengu; kanye b nokweba nokukhwabanisa okwenzekayo eMkhandlwini.

16085, yomhla ka-23 kuNovemba ka- 1994 noma kumthetho olandelayo. Noma yisiphi isici esicacisiwe ngokulandela ukuthi yimaphio amaphuzu anikeziwe izakucaciswa kuzimemo zokuthi kufakwe amathenda. Umasipala uzakuthi ngokujwayelekile anikeze amakontileka ache kwabafaka amathenda amathola amaphuzu aphezulu kakhulu. Uma kungenjalo, umasipala kumele akwazi ukuveza izici senhloso, kulezo ezicatshangwe ngenhla, ukufakazela ukunikeza kwakhe ithenda komunye ofake isicelo sethenda. Izinhloso ezicacile ezitholwe ngumasipala ngenqubomgomo yakhe yokutholisa okukhethwayo kumele ikwazi ukulinganiswa, inikezwe amanani bese ihlolelwa ukulandela umthetho. iziboniso zokulinganisa ukunikeza amandla kwezomnotho kwabansundu ngokwesekwa okubanzi; kanye nesici sokulinganisa isisindo seziboniso zokunikeza amandla ezomnotho kwabansundu ngokweseka okubanzi okuchazwe ngenhla. Ukuthuthukisa izici zokuhlanganyela nesigaba sangasese. UNgqongqoshe uzakuphinde anikeze isu lokunikeza amandla ezomnotho kwabansundu elesekwe ngobubanzi. thuthukisa uhlelo lokuxhasa ngezimali ukunikeza kwamandla ezomnotho kwabansundu okwesekwe ngobubanzi; kanye nokunikeza uhlelo lapho izitho zombuzo, izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye namanye amabhizinisi angalungisa izinhlelo zokunikeza amandla ezomnotho kwabansundu ngokwesekwe ngobubanzi kanye nombiko wokuhlonipha kwabo izinhlelo ezinje.

Umsizi womhlengikazi noma umsizi wombelethisi ngumuntu ofundele ukunikeza usizo lokuqala lokunakekela kobuhlengikazo ngendlela nangeqophelo elinqunyiwe. UNgqongqoshe anganquma indima yomsebenzi wobuhlengikazi abangongoti nenqubo yeminye imikhakha yobuhlengikazi okukhulunywa ngayo esigabeni 31 2. e umsizi mbelethisi. UNgqongqoshe, ngemuva kokubonisana noMkhandlu, angakhipha isaziso ePhephabhukwini loMbuso iGazethi akhe noma amise eminye imikhakha yabantu abangabhalisela ukusebenza njengabahlengikazi uma ebona kufanele ukuze kuzisakale umphakathi. Umqashi angeze aqasha noma agcine emsebenzini wakhe umuntu owenza umsebenzi ophathelene nomsebenzi wobuhlengikazi, ngaphandle komuntu onezifundo ezifanele zobuhlengikazi nobhalisile ngaphansi kwezigatshana 1 no 2. Akekho umuntu ungasebenzisa noma iliphi igama kulawo abalwe kusigatshana 1 noma 2 ngaphandle uma ebhalise kanjalo ngokwalesi sigaba. e nezinye izincwadi noma imibhalo nolwazi oluphathelene nesicelo sakhe olufunwa nguNobhala ngokuthunywa uMkhandlu. Uma uNobhala anelisiwe ukuthi ulwazi nezincwadi ezithunyelwe ezisekela isicelo sokubhaliswa ziyahlangabezana nezidingo zaloMthetho futhi esethole nemali enqunyiwe yokubhalisa, uNobhala angakhipha isitifiketi sokubhaliswa esigunyaza lowo ofake isicelo, ngokuhambisana nalokho okushiwo kusigatshana 1, ukuba asebenze noma anqube umsebenzi wanoma yiluphi uhlobo okukhulunywa ngalo kusigatshana 1 ngaphakathi eRiphablikhi. UNobhala angabhalisa umuntu ngokwesigatshana 1 kuphela uma anelisekile ukuthi lowo muntu ofake isicelo sokubhaliswa ufunde ngokufanele noma uMkhandlu nawo wanelisekile.

"uMnyango kaMgcinimafa kaZwelonke" kusho uMnyango kaMgcinimafa kaZwelonke osungulwe yisigaba 5 soMthetho wokuPhathwa kweziMali zikaHulumeni, 1999 uMthetho No. "kohulumeni basekhaya abahleliwe" kusho inhlangano yesifundazwe emele omasipala KwaZulu-Natali, eyaziwa ngokwesigaba 163 soMthethosisekelo kanye nesigaba 2 soMthetho koHulumeni baseKhaya abaHleliwe, 1997 uMthetho No. "lo Mthetho" ubandakanya imithethonqubo. (1) Ngalokhu lapha kusungulwa isikhungo ezogqugquzela ezohwebo kanye nokutshalwa kwezimali esiFundazweni nezokwaziwa ngokuthi isiKhungo sezoHwebo nokuTshalwa kweziMali saKwaZulu-Natali. IsiKhungo singumuntu ngokomthetho. IsiKhungo siwuhlaka lukahulumeni wesifundazwe ngokweyame kuMthetho wezokuPhathwa kweziMali zikaHulumeni, 1999 (uMthetho No. 1 ka 1999). nokusebenzisa amandla, nokwenza imisebenzi okubalulwe esigabeni 4. silondoloze siphinde sigcine imininingwane kwikhompyutha yamathuba ezokutshalwa kwezimali esiFundazweni ukuze ngaleyo ndlela kuhlomule yonke imikhakha yezomnotho. singenza noma yiphi enye into noma singenelele kunoma yiluphi udaba iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali elibona lunesidingo ukuze kuqaliswe ngendlela efanele lo Mthetho. Ukongeza emandleni okukhulunywa ngawo esigatshaneni (2), isiKhungo, sinamandla okukhulunywe ngawo esigabeni 34, naku Hlelo 2 kuMthetho weziNkampani, 1973 (uMthetho No. 61 ka 1973). nesiKhulu esiPhezulu, esibhekele, njengalokhu kuhlongoziwe esigabeni 18(5). namakhono nesipiliyoni sokuhlela noma kwezentuthuko.

uma iNational Council inquma ukwandisa isimo sokuphuthuma. kungadluli ezinyangeni ezintathu. kwenziwe ngesinqumo esamukelwe iningi labalawuli beCouncil. kuthathwe ngemva kokuxoxwa kwiCouncil. ukuze kulungiswe leso simo sokuphuthuma. ezingeni elikhuluma ngaphezulu kwesigaba engxenyeni 3 yohlu. imvelaphi, ubulili, inkolo, noma ulimi. Isithunzi somuntu. Ngaphandle kokuthi. ngama-15 nangaphansi. njengoba kungenzeka ngokushesha lapho lowo muntu ethunjwa. hlola ukuboshwa kwakhe. nokuthi kudingeka ukuthi lowo muntu aboshwe futhi. ngamazwe mayelana nokuboshwa kwalabo bantu. kanye nenhlangano efaka isicelo ngenhloso yokuzuza amalungu ayo. ingabheka emthethweni wamanye amazwe. umoya, inhloso, nezinto ezihlosiwe zeBill of Rights. igcina izinga layo lokuhambisana neBill of Rights. kanye nezindawo, ezihlukile, ezihlobene, nezixhumene. isigaba futhi kumele senze imisebenzi yayo ngokuhambisana nomkhankaso onikezwe lesi sigaba. ngokugwema ukufaka amacala phambi komthetho. zezingxabano phakathi kukamasipala abahlukene; futhi. zezingxabano phakathi kukamasipala. enkantolo ukuze ixazulule le ngxabano. ingabuyisela le ngxabano kulolo hlobo lukamasipala oluthintekayo. kanye neNational Council yeMali yesifunda. ekwenzeni imithetho ngendlela enikeziwe kule Mthethosisekelo. nokuhlola nokubheka izenzo zembuso. kazwelonke mayelana nokuhlola izindaba ezithinta izifunda ngaphambi komphakathi. isikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi ongajwayelekile. samukelwe yiNational Council. isifunda noma izwe lonke. mayelana namandla aphathelene nanoma yisiphi isihloko esibhalwe kuSheduli 4. noma noma iyiphi ikomidi esunguliwe ngokuhambisana nesigaba (b).

Izikhungo zezempilo zingaba yizikhangiso ezinkulu zokuhlanganisa imiphakathi, futhi zinhle kakhulu uma zigijima ngokubambisana. Ukusebenza ngasikhathi sinye kuyaqinisekisa ukuthi wonke umuntu uyaziswa futhi ubalulekile, okuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni. Ngendlela, izindawo zezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zithinta impilo yethu, ngempela. Zithanda ukweluleka abantu, zibhale izindlela zokuphila eziphusile, futhi zedlulisela ulwazi olubalulekile kumphakathi. Njengoba sizama ukwengeza lezi zikhungo, sinesibindi sokulahla izithiyo ezivaleleka, sigqugquzela ukufinyelela kwezempilo. Konke lokho kuncike kuphela kumphakathi wethu. Ngamanye amazwi, umehluko ubalulekile ngenxa yokusebenza kwethu ngabanye. Izikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72 zidinga usizo lwethu, futhi uma sihamba phambili, lapho izinkinga zempilo zingaba neqhaza elincane empilweni yethu. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze ukuhlinzeka ngokuphila okubushelelezi nokukhula kwemiphakathi yethu. Ngakho, khumbula, izikhungo zezempilo zingama-72 akusikho kuphela ngaphandle kwempilo, kepha zinhle zikhona ngempela. Izindawo ezinjalo zidinga ukusekelwa, zidinga ukukhuthazwa, futhi zidinga ubumbano lwethu. Njengabantu, ngeke sizame ukufunda nokuhlola izindlela ezingama-72 ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyavuma. Ukuba kudinga ukuba tenga nathi, sizogcina sithokozile ekuphileni, kuba nethuba lokwakha umphakathi ozinzile nohlanganyele.

Imfashini: Umhlaba Wokugqoka Nobuciko Imfashini iyinsika ebalulekile empilweni yokwakha ubuqotho komuntu, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini yanamuhla. Ihlanganisa izindlela zokugqoka, izitayela, nemikhuba ethinta ukuziveza kwabantu. Ukuze siqonde ngempela imfashini, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi iyini, izakhi zayo, nezizathu ezenza abantu bakhethe izitayela ezithile. Ukwakhiwa KweMfashini Imfashini ibonisa indlela abantu abaziveza ngayo, futhi ihlale ibonisa izimo zomphakathi, izinkolo, nezinkolelo. Isiko, ubuciko, kanye nezimo zempilo zidlala indima enkulu ekwakhiweni kwemfashini. Isibonelo, imfashini yesikhumbuzo ibonisa izikhathi zomlando, njengokugqokwa kwezimpahla ezithile ezazisetshenziswa ezikhathini ezedlule. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi imfashini akukhona nje okugqokwayo, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nemvelo, izinkolelo, kanye nezinkumbulo. Izinto Eziyinhloko Zokugqoka Ngokuvamile, imfashini ibandakanya izinto ezahlukene zokugqoka, okuhlanganisa izingubo, izicathulo, nezinsiza zokuhlobisa. Izingubo zingahluka kakhulu, zisukela ezikhethelwe imicimbi emikhulu, njengezihlahla zomshado, kuya ezimeni ezijwayelekile, ezifana nezikhumbuzo zansuku zonke. Izicathulo nazo zibalulekile, njengoba zikhombisa isitayela somuntu, futhi ziba nesithakazelo kumphakathi. Ukuze umuntu akhethe kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi ahloniphe izimo zomphakathi, izimo zezulu, kanye nezidingo zakhe. Izitayela Nemikhuba Izitayela zihlala zishintsha, ziqhamuka nezinto ezintsha, futhi ziqhubeka nokuhlangana nezinto ezedlule.

Uma sithuthukisa isikhathi sokuphendula, izinga lokuphila komphakathi liphucukile. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni kwezingozi, ukunciphisa ukulimala, nokwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabantu. Futhi, uma umphakathi uzwa ukuthi uhlinzekwa kahle, kuba nokwethenjelwa okukhulu ezikhungweni ezithintekayo. Umhleli: Lokhu kubonakala kuyinzuzo enkulu. Ngabe unayo imiyalelo ethile kubaphathi bezikhungo eziphuthumayo? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, ngincoma abaphathi ukuthi bahlale beqaphile futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izinhlelo zabo zihlala zisesikhathini. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezisebenzayo, ukuhlela imihlangano, nokuxhumana nabantu. Futhi, kufanele bahlale beqeqesha abasebenzi ukuze bazi kahle ukuthi benzeni ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Umhleli: Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Zulu, ngalezi zinkulumo ezibalulekile. Ngabe unayo imiyalezo yokugcina kubafundi bethu? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga. Ngifuna ukufundisa abantu ukuthi bahlale beqaphele, bazi ukuthi izimo eziphuthumayo zingavela nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula kudinga ukubambisana, ukuqeqeshwa, nokuxhumana. Njengomphakathi, kufanele sibe necebo eliqinile lokuphendula ukuze sikwazi ukusiza omunye nomunye. Umhleli: Ngiyabonga kakhulu, Mnu. Zulu, ngalesi sikhathi sokukhuluma. Ukuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo kuyisihloko esibalulekile, futhi izeluleko zakho zizoba usizo olukhulu. Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, umhleli. Ngithemba ukuthi sizokwazi ukusebenzisa lezi zifundo ukuze sithuthukise umphakathi wethu.

Qaphela: Uma yimuphi wemibuzo lezi zibuza impendulo "yebo", umsebenzi kufanele anikeze incazelo eningiliziwe okufanele ifakwe lapha kanye nezimo zakho. Igama nendawo yokuhlala kwanoma ubani: a owabuka le ngozi... b Owayazi ukuthi kwenzeka ingozi ngaleso sikhathi... Bangaki abanye abasebenzi abalimala kule ngozi... Uma kuhlolwe ngupholisa, hlinzeka ngegama lesiteshi somphakathi kanye nenombolo yezehlakalo... Uma imoto ibibandakanyeka kule ngozi, hlinzeka ngenombolo yokubhaliswa kwayo... Umsebenzi: Usuku lwe-engozi... Qhubeka nendawo 35 ekhasini elilandelayo. Ezinye izici eziholele kule ngozi. (Phakamisa izindawo ezifanele ku-A no-B). Uma kukhona olunye uhlobo lomshini, chaza... le mbiko yokulimala ethi yenzeke emsebenzini, ngokwazi kwami, iqiniso ngokuphelele. Lokhu kubhalwe kulolu suku lweminyaka... Ukubhalwa... Inombolo yefoni ()... Indawo yebhizinisi noma farm... Inombolo yephasiwedi 16. Usuku lokuzalwa... Inombolo yefoni ()... Isikhathi esisebenze eminyakeni/ezinyangeni/... Indawo lapho kwenzeka khona le ngozi... Yini umsebenzi ayebenza ngesikhathi sokulimala...? Bangaki ubude besikhathi abawenza lo msebenzi... Iminyaka Izinyanga... Babenza ngesikhathi sokulimala okuhlobene nomsebenzi wakho noma ibhizinisi lakho? Uma kungahlangene nebhizinisi lakho noma umsebenzi, bhala izizathu zakho ekhasini lesithathu le ngxenye A. Incazelo emfushane yokuthi le ngozi yenzeka kanjani. Phakamisa izindawo ezifanele ngemuva kwekhasi lesithathu ingxenye A, yenza okufanayo uma unikeza incazelo... Ingabe le ngozi yenzeka emgwaqweni womphakathi? Uhlobo lokulimala olwenziwe.

Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. I-Operation Vulindlela ibuye ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani, uhulumeni ubonise ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlanganyelwe, ezihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukugxila ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokufunda. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuhamba phambili emsebenzini, uhulumeni usebenzise izinhlelo zokufundisa ezihlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okudingekayo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu banamakhono adingekayo ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini, okwandisa amathuba okukhula komnotho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. I-Operation Vulindlela ibuye ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani, uhulumeni ubonise ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo.

Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emidansweni ethinta izindaba zokuhlukunyezwa, ubuphofu, kanye nezinkinga zokuhlalisana. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ohlanganisa izindlela eziningi, ezihlanganisa ukudansa ngokwezinkanyezi, ukudansa kwesiko, kanye nezindlela ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umdanso ungashintsha futhi uthuthuke, uhambisane nezinguquko ezisemphakathini. Izinkampani zomdanso zihlala zikhona, zikhuthaza abaculi abasha ukuba baveze ubuchwepheshe babo, futhi ziqinisa umoya wokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu. Ngokwenyuka komdanso, izigidi zabantu ziya ziqonda ukuthi umdanso ungaba yindlela yokuphila. Abantu abaningi baphila ngokuqhubeka nokudansa, bejabulisa abanye futhi bephinde bephakamisa imizwa yabo. Umdanso ungaba yindlela yokuphumula, yokukhulula ingcindezi, futhi ungaba yindlela yokuzithokozisa. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umdanso unamandla okukhulisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, uhlanganise izizukulwane ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umdanso ungenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwamazwe. Umdanso wezemidlalo, njengokudansa kwezemidlalo, ungathokozisa abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene, udala umoya wokuhlanganyela nokuhloniphana. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umdanso ungathuthukisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe, ube yindlela yokwakha ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu. Ekuqaleni, umdanso wawusetyenziswa njengendlela yokukhumbula izinkanyezi zempilo, kodwa manje usuphenduke umkhakha ongenamkhawulo. Abaculi baphakathi komdanso bahlala bephokophele ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo, bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi beveza izifundo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umdanso ungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi, ube yindlela yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi zempilo eziphilayo.

UThandi wathola ukuthi uNandi wayengumuntu onamandla, futhi wayefuna ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. UThandi waqala ukuqonda ukuthi abantu abafuduki bahlala bephila impilo enobunzima, kodwa bahlala bejolisa emaphusheni abo. U-Sipho, uNandi, noThandi babebonisa ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuwumsebenzi wokwakha impilo engcono. UThandi wathola ukuthi abantu bahlala bejabulile, bejabulela ubuhlobo obusha, futhi bephila impilo enothile. Njengoba usuku luhamba, uThandi wathola ukuthi ukufuduka kwabantu bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika akukhona nje kuphela izinkinga, kodwa futhi kuyithuba lokwakha ubuhlobo obusha, ukufunda, nokwakha impilo engcono. UThandi waphuma eGoli, kodwa wathola ukuthi ubuhlobo abawakhile noSipho, noNandi, nabanye abafuduki, bahlala bukhona. Wazi ukuthi ukufuduka akukhona nje kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuwumsebenzi wokwakha impilo engcono, ubuhlobo obusha, nokuphila impilo enothile. UThandi wathola ukuthi izifundo azitholile zihlala zikhona, futhi zizoqhubeka zikhanya empilweni yakhe.

Izinsiza ezingafanele zisetshenziswa (khumbula ukusebenzisa i-nozzle enobumba uma uphuzisa phezu kwezithako, futhi i-nozzle ye-fan elula uma uphuzisa phezu komhlabathi). Umshini ungase ungakahlanzwa kahle ngonyaka odlule - izinto eziningi zingavala, futhi ngeke usebenze kahle uma kukhona okushiywe okungahlanzwanga. Ingxenye yekhemikhali idinga imvula emva kokuphuzisa ukuze isebenze kahle - uma kunganaki, i-herbicide ayikwazi ukuqala ukusebenza. Izimo zezulu ezishisayo kakhulu nezomile zingase futhi zivimbe i-herbicide ekusebenzeni kahle. Imvula eningi ngemva kokuhlanza ingabangela ukuhlanya 'ukuqala kabusha.' Ukuphatha nokulawula ukuhlanya kubaluleke kakhulu - uma singakwenzi kahle, asizukuzuza umkhiqizo omuhle. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zokungaphathi ukuhlanya kahle esikhulume ngazo ngenhla - kodwa ekugcineni, kubonakala ukuthi ukuphatha yonke imisebenzi yakho yokulima ngaphambi kokuba kube khona izinkinga kubalulekile. Lo nyaka ububhalwe kakhulu ekulungiseni lezi zinkinga, kodwa lokho esikufundile kungasisiza siqhubeke ngonyaka ozayo. Iziphakamiso ezindala esizenzile esikhathini esedlule kufanele zifundise ukuthi singaziphindi emhlabeni; kungcono ukwenza amaphutha amasha!

Lolu lwazi lusiza kakhulu abasebenzi abasebenzela uhulumeni wendawo eVryheid. Lizoba lusizo futhi kunoma ngubani osebenza emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo nomnotho. Lokhu kumbandakanya abasebenzi bakahulumeni wendawo, beSifundazwe kanye nabakaZwelonke, abaxhasi bendawo nabomhlaba-jikelele, abahlanganyeli emabhizinisini, kanye neZinhlangano Ezingekho ngaphansi kukaHulumeni (NGOs). UMasipala wendawo (iVryheid) unguMasipala Womklamo Odidiyelwe osuhlangabezane nokusilela emumva ekubuseni nasekuphatheni, okube nomthelela ekukwazini kwawo okwenza imisebenzi yawo ngokomthethosisekelo. Ngale kwalokhu kusilela emumva, uMasipala ukwazile ukwenza ukubuyekeza okufanele koHlelo Lwentuthuko Edidiyele (IDP), kanye noHlaka Lokuthuthukisa Indawo (SDF). Uphinde wayalela ukuba kwenziwe amalungiselelo Esu Lokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo. Ukwehla kwezimboni zomnotho. Ukwentuleka kwamakhono ayisisekelo nawezomnotho. Ezingeni lesifunda, uMasipala WeSifunda saseZululand (ZDM) ususungule uPhiko lwe- LED ukuba lweseke amabhizinisi kubo bonke oMasipala bendawo abangaphansi wawo. Lolu phiko lusebenza ngokubambisana nomasipala bendawo bese luhlinzeka ngohlaka olubanzi kukho konke ukweseka kwamabhizinisi ngumasipala. Ukuhlelwa ngokuqondiswa kwe- IDP phakathi kukaMasipala WeSifunda saseZululand kanye noMasipala wasebaQulusi kuyenzeka ngokusebenzisa iSithangamu Sabahleli esasungulwa nguMasipala Wesifunda saseZululand (ZDM). Lesi Sithangamu sihlangana kabili ngenyanga futhi sigxile ekuhleleni ngokuqondisa izindaba zamasu okusebenza, izinhlelo kanye nemiklamo.

Lokhu kuholele ekuveleleni kwama-platforms anjengokuthi MySpace, aphawulekayo ngalo lonke ubukhulu bawo. Nokho, ukuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-social media asithandwa kakhulu, afika ezikhathini eziningi, abangela ushintsho olukhulu. Umsebenzisi owodwa angaba nezithameli eziningi, kanti amathuba okuthi umyalezo ufinyelele abantu abaningi kakhulu, akhula kakhulu. Ukwazisa Nokuqwashisa: Izinzuzo Nezingozi Zokuxhumana Ukuze sihloniphe futhi siqonde kahle ama-social media, kubalulekile ukuthi siwazise izinzuzo nezingcuphe ezihambisana nawo. Njengoba abantu bexhumana, bathola ulwazi olusemqoka, babambisane, futhi benze izinqumo ezibalulekile. Noma kunjalo, izingozi ezifana nokuphepha kokuphila kwabantu, ama-bots, nezihloko ezingezinhle zikhona, futhi kubalulekile ukuziqonda kahle. Ukuxhumana Ngobuchwepheshe: Amathuba nemiphumela Ama-social media awagcini nje ngokusiza abantu ukuba baxhumane, kodwa anikela ngamathuba amahle nempumelelo emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Amabhizinisi nezinkampani zisebenzisa ama-social media ukuze zikhulise imikhiqizo, zithole abathengi, futhi zindlebe izifiso zabavakashi. Lokhu kwenza ukuba abantu babe nengxenye yokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, nokuphuma kwabo komunitini kube ukwakha umnotho onempumelelo. Ubuhlakani Nempilo: Ukuziphatha Kwethu Kwi-Online Njengoba siqhubeka nokusebenzisa ama-social media, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izenzo zethu zikwazi ukushintsha umphakathi. Ukuziphatha kahle, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile, futhi ukuvikela abanye kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sispirela isikhala esihle sokuxhumana. Ukudala indaba yangempela, ehloniphekile, nokuqwashisa nabanye, kuyinto ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo.

Uma isinqumo singakatholakali kusekela lomsebenzi wolwazi ngesikhathi esibekwe ngokusemthethweni, kungathathwa ngokuthi isicelo asivunywanga. Uma ocelayo enokukhubazeka okumvimbela ukuthi afunde, abheke, noma alalelele irekhodi lelo elifanele elikufomu elisenhlanganweni yomphakathi, isekelo lomsebenzi wolwazi lizokwenza wonke umzamo wokuthi libe khona kufomu engafundwa, engabhekwa noma izwiwe. Ayikho enye imali engaphezulu eyobizwa. kuzoba yingozi ekugcinweni kwemibhalo; noma angeke kukwazeke ukwenza amakhophi ombhalo njengoba ilungelo lokushicilelwa kungesilo elikahulumeni. Izizathu ezibalwe ngenhla zizincazelo okuhloswe ngazo ukuthi kwenziwe lula ukuqonda. Ekucabangeni ukufaka isicelo sangaphakathi noma ukuthatha isinyathelo somthetho, kufanele kucatshangwe ngesigaba lapho lezi zimpendulo zivela khona. Esimeni lapho kufakwa khona isikhalo sangaphakathi noma kufakwa isicelo enkantolo, ukutholakala kombhalo kungenzeka kuphela lapho sekuqinisekiswe isinqumo sokugcina. Izikhalo zasekhaya angeke zifakwe abantu abacelayo nje kuphela abangavunyelwanga ukuthola ulwazi, kodwa nezinhlangano zesithathu uma abafaka isicelo benikezwa ulwazi. Izikhalo zangaphakathi kufanele zilungiswe ngokwesimo esishiwo ngokomthetho ngokwezimiso zomthetho. Le fomu iyatholakala kusekela lomsebenzi wolwazi owemukela isicelo, noma nanoma yiliphi elinye isekela lomsebenzi wolwazi, noma ocelayo angasebenzisa ifothokhophi yeFomu B, okufanele itholakale ezimisweni zomthetho ezishicilelwe ngokweSaziso sikahulumeni No. R 187 sangomhla ka-15 Februwari 2002.

Bayi- 5.71 % abahlali baseBaqulusini abanezitifiketi zikamatikuletsheni. Ngale kwaseVryheid, baningi kakhulu abantu abangafundile esifundeni sisonke. Ukungabibikho kwemisebenzi yiyona nkinga enkulu ebhekene noMasipala weSifunda saseZululand kanye noMasipala Wendawo yaseBaqulusini. Bangama- 15.41 % kuphela abantu baseBaqulusini abasebenzayo. Ama- 93.89 % abantu ababandekanyekayo emnothweni baqashwe emikhakheni eyisithupha kuphela yomnotho osimamayo, lokhu kuveza ukuntuleka kwezisebenzi enhlobonhlobo, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphisa amathuba omsebenzi. Ngokuhambisanayo nezibalo eziphansi zabasebenzayo, ukungena kwemali emindenini kuvame ukuba kuncane kakhulu, bangama- 20 % abantu okubikwe ukuthi abanayo nhlobo imali engenayo futhi bangama- 11% abahola ngaphansi kwezi -R2400 ngonyaka. Kanjalo ngamgokuhambisanayo nesimo jikelele sikamasipala wendawo, abantu abasemathubeni ezomnotho yilabo abahlala emadolobheni kunalabo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Lokhu akusho ukuthi abantu abahlala emadolobheni abakhungethwe ububha. Yize kunemifula eminingi enqamula kumasipala wendawo, ukutholakala kwamanzi ahlanzekile kuyivelakancane. Maqondana nokuhlinzekwa kokuthuthwa kwendle, umehluko uyavela futhi phakathi kwamadolobha namakhaya. Cishe bangama- 0.4% abahlali basemakhaya abanezindlu zangasese ezishaywa ngamanzi, kube ngama -90.1% abahlali basemadolobheni abahlinzekwa ngalokhu. Nakuba u-Eskom usunyuse izinga lokuhlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni eziningi, baphakathi kwama- 38% nama- 43% abantu bakumasipala wendawo yasebaQulusini abanogesi emakhaya abo.

Kwaqhamuka iziphakamiso zokubuyekezwa, ukuhlela kwesiSekeli, izikhumbuzo zeMali, izinsizwa zafuna ukwenza umehluko. Uhlanga lwezinkanyezi lwaba yingxubevange yokwakha umthethosisekelo. Imithetho ehlukene yayihamba kancane, bese ibhalwa ngendlela ekhangayo ukuze ibheke phakathi kwezinkanyezi. Umthethosisekelo waba uthembiso, i-promise ephakeme yokuthi abantu bangenza umehluko. Kwathi umphakathi, njengoba benezizukulwane ezahlukene, wathola inkanyezi enqamula ubuhlobo. Ngesikhathi isivumelwano phakathi kwezinkampani nezinhlangano sashiwo, abaphathi behlelwa kakhulu. Kwakulimaziswa abantu besebenzisa izindlela nokulandela izinyathelo. Abantu bezindla ngezikhathi ezimbi, kodwa umthethosisekelo waba uphawu lwezithombe ezinhle. Abaphathi baphakamisa izwi elilodwa, benza umphakathi ube nesithakazelo esijulile. Kwathi sekuphela isikhathi sokulindela, iNhlangano Yentando Yabantu yatha ukwakha umthethosisekelo. Abantu bakhumbula izinsuku ezinzima, kodwa umoya ophuma kumabandla waba umoya omusha. Kwathi umphakathi wathola amandla okwakha nokukhulisa ezizindeni zawo. Imithetho, izigaba nezinsizakusebenza zathelela isimo esisha sokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu nezinhlelo ezazithile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isivumelwano saziwa njengomthombo wezinto ezintsha, umthethosisekelo ubumba inhlonipho, ukulingana nezinsiza zokwakha. Kwakungekho ukulangazelela, bezithanda izinqubo ezithokozisayo, futhi bakhumbula ukuthi lezi zinguquko zazididiyela ebuhleni bomphakathi. Ubuqotho busizayo, kanti umthethosisekelo waba yisithombe salokho abantu abafisa ukukwenza. Ekugcineni, umthethosisekelo waba umthombo wezimo ezinhle, ukwakha ukuvuma phakathi kwabantu.

Isiphandla Sezwe wuphawu olubonakalayo, olukhulu kwedlula zonke izimpawu ezweni. Isiphandla Sezwe yinxenye ephakathi nendawo yesisicilelo esikhulu, ethathwa ngokosiko, ngokuthi iyisibonakaliso esiphakeme kunazozonke ezweni. Iphepha elinesibonakaliso esiphakeme linikezwa amandla amakhulu ngoba loku kusho ukuthi livunyelwe nguMongameli waseNingizimu Afrika. Isiphandla Sezwe saseNingizimu Afrika sethulwa esizweni ngoSuku Lwenkululeko, lika 27 April 2000. Lokhu kukhombisa inhloso kahulumeni yokugqamisa ushintsho lwentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika kanye nothando elisha lezwe lethu. Isiphandla Sezwe yinxenye yezinto ezilandelanayo ezihlelwe zakha isiyingi somumo weqanda esibekwe ngendlela yokuthi okunye kuphezu kokunye. Isangqumo sokuqala yisaga esingumgomo esiphakathi kwendingilizi enguhafu eluhlaza. Kubekwe ngokufanana nxazombili, amazinyo endlovu amabili abheke phezulu, ukuze kugcwaliswe uhafu wendingilizi. Esifanekisweni esithi asifanane neqanda esakhiwa ngamazinyo endlovu, kunezindlebe ezimbili zikakolweni ezakhela ihawu legolide eliphakathi nendawo. Umfanekiso wehawu uphathelene nesigubhu kanti unabantu ababili abadalwe ngobuciko bamatshe babantu bohlanga lwamakhoisan. Lababantu bavezwe bebhekene, bebulisana ngokuzwana. Ngaphezu kwehawu, kunomkhonto kanye newisa zibekwe zakha isiphambano. Lezangqumo zibekwe ngokufanelana ukuze kuqondiswe ehawini kugcwaliswe umfanekiso wesisekelo ongaphansi ofana neqanda. Inyoni yemilenze emide ibekwe ngaphezu kwehlathi eliluhlaza, izimbali zakha isifuba salenyoni. Inyoni yemilenze emide imise izimpiko zayo ngendlela yobukhosi.

Kungabe lo muzi yila uhlala khona? UMBUZI MIBUZO: mfundele konke okukhona umphenduli mibuzo. Kuhlalwa mahhala kuwo... Uma umnini [wena] ungawudayisa namuhla lo muzi, ungacishe ube yiliphi inani (ungabiza malini)? Sebenzisa imali yalapha. Lendlu inamakamelo amangaki esewonke, ungabali izindlu zokugezela namaphasiji? Kungabe linjani iphansi lomuzi wakho? Kungabe lunjani udonga lomuzi wakho? Kungabe yini umthombo omkhulu wamanzi okuphuza amalungu aleli khaya? Q0506a. Niwathathaphi amanzi okwenza ezinye izinto njengokuwasha ngezandla? Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukufinyelela lapho, kutholwe amanzi bese kubuywa? Amanzi akhona esakhiweni... Q0507a. Ubani ovame kuya konilandela amanzi kulo mthombo ningabahlali baleli khaya? Kusetshenziswa luhlobo luni lwendlu yangasese la ekhaya? Kungabe lendawo niyihlanganyela neminye imizi? Kungabe nisebenzisa maphi amandla ekhaya lakho uma nipheka? Nisebenzkisa luhlobo luni lwesitofu emzini wakho? UMBUZI MIBUZO: bonisa okusebenza kakhulu. UMBUZI MIBUZO: Ingxenye yokuqala yalesi sigaba kuhloswe ngawo ukuba kuqoqwe imininingwane ephathelene nemithombo yokudlulisela phakathi endlini okuqhamuka kulabo abangahlali khona. Imibuzo elandelayo iphathelene nomndeni wakho nabangane, ikakhulukazi labo abangahlali nawe kulo muzi. Imindeni nabangane kwenye inkathi iyelekelelana ngezindlela ezinhlobo nhlobo, kanti lolo nalolo lusizo lungaba mqoka. Ingxenye yalolu cwaningo lwethu imbandakanya ukuthola ukuthi ikwenza kanjani lokhu.

Ama-Social Media - Umcimbi Wokuxhumana Kwethu Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, umhlaba wethu usushintshe kakhulu. Emhlabeni wamanje, ukuxhumana akusashadiwe kuphela ezikhathini, i-imeyili noma esontweni. Izingqapheli zesimanje zifaka phakathi ama-social media, okuyizinkundla zokuxhumana ezivumela abantu ukuba baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe ubudlelwane. Lo mcimbi uzogqugquzela ingxoxo ebalulekile mayelana nomthelela wezokuxhumana ezimpilweni zethu, okuholela ekwenzeni umhlaba ube indawo ethokozisayo, kepha engazwakali. Umqondo Wokuqala: Ukuqonda ama-Social Media Ama-social media akha isakhiwo esisha sokuxhumana phakathi kwababukeli, ababhali, nabathandi bezindaba. Noma ngabe uthanda ukukhangisa, ukuyekethisa izithombe, noma ukwabelana ngemicabango, lezi zinkundla ziza nemininingwane ebanzi, ezihambelana namagugu nezifiso zethu. Imithombo efana ne-Facebook, Twitter, Instagram kanye ne-YouTube ibalulekile kakhulu, njengoba ithuthukisa indlela esibuka ngayo izindaba, sigcina ubudlelwane, futhi sabelane ngaphezulu kwemizwa yethu. Ukusebenza Kwama-Social Media: Ekuqaleni Nokuthuthuka Ithuna lokuqala lama-social media laqala lapho abantu beqala ukuhwebelana ngobuchwepheshe. Lokhu kuholele ekuveleleni kwama-platforms anjengokuthi MySpace, aphawulekayo ngalo lonke ubukhulu bawo. Nokho, ukuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-social media asithandwa kakhulu, afika ezikhathini eziningi, abangela ushintsho olukhulu. Umsebenzisi owodwa angaba nezithameli eziningi, kanti amathuba okuthi umyalezo ufinyelele abantu abaningi kakhulu, akhula kakhulu.

Iningi lamaphosta lawo ngempela alingabazekayo futhi ahlobene nawo wonke amakhono amafilimu akhiqizwe ezweni lethu. Inhloso ye-archive ngala maphosta ukuwurekhoda ngokuqondile futhi uwagcine eqoqweni lapho angasetshenziswa khona ngaphandle kokuthathwa. Njengokuqoqwa kwamaphosta, i-Archive ineqoqo lezithombe ezihlobene namafilimu kuleli zwe. Izithombe zezifilimu ezingama-1916 ezikhiqizwe kuleli zwe zingatholakala lapha. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo leziqu zezifilimu ezedlule cishe eziyi-1200 ezikhiqizwe kuleli zwe. Iningi leziqu lisesigabeni sokukhiqiza, ngaleyo ndlela lihluke kakhulu kumkhiqizo ophelile olungile ukubukwa. I-NAFVSA iphinde ibe umgcinimafa wezirekhodi zamaphephandaba, okuhlanganisa imibhalo, iziqeshana ezikhethiwe ezivela kumaphephandaba, izithombe, izinhlelo, nezikhumbuzo ezihlobene nezindawo zokusebenza, umculo, ubuciko, nezandla. Iningi lezi zinto kulesi sigaba laqala ngokuqhamuka kwabantu kanye nezikhungo ezizimele ezinomsebenzi wezobuciko nezandla. I-NAFVSA iyingqayizivele ngoba ingesinye sezikhungo ezincane emhlabeni ezigcina amafilimu, ividiyo, nezirekhodi ezilalelwayo ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa. Ukufinyelela kulolu hlobo lolwazi olukhombisa umlando wesizwe sethu eNingizimu Afrika ngezithombe kube usizo futhi kuzokwenza kube umthombo omkhulu wezizukulwane ezizayo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Baphinde bakwazi ukubheka kalula emuva kulokho okwenzeka esikhathini esedlule, futhi lokhu kungab placing them in a position to speculate on what the film and tape industry will look like in the future.

Lesi sinyathelo sibalulekile ngokombono wokungabi khona kokuphikiswa ekuhlukahlukaneni kwezilimi kanye nemiphumela yokuthi "ukusebenza kwezilimi eziningi kuyindaba yokukhokha" njengoba kubonakala kwezinye izingxenye zomphakathi wethu, kanye nezikhalazo ezikhulayo ezivela kubanikazi bezilimi mayelana nokubusa kolimi olulodwa eNingizimu Afrika. I-National Language Policy Framework isekelwe emiphumeleni yokubambisana ngokubonisana, isebenzisa kokubili iLANGTAG nezinsiza zeMnyango ngokuhlanganyela neLanguage Policy Advisory Group. Lesi sikhungo senqubomgomo sibalulekile ekuphatheni izinsiza zethu ezihlukahlukene zolimi nokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kukahulumeni ezinjongo zokukhuthaza ubud democracy, ubulungiswa, ukulingana, kanye nobunye bezwe. Kulesi simo esihle, ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni zelizwe lethu, njengoba kuvezwe yiSisekelo, kube nendawo ebalulekile kule nqubomgomo. Le Nqubomgomo futhi igcizelela ukuthi ukubaluleka kwezilimi zethu kubonakala kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwazo kwezomnotho, kwezokuxhumana, nasezombusazwe. Lapho ulimi lungalahlekelwa ukubaluleka kulezi zimo, isimo sawo siyancipha. I-nqubomgomo iphinde ibonise ukuthi sibhekene nezinselelo zokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele futhi ukuthi izilimi zethu zomdabu kumele zibe yingxenye yeziqubu ezishintshashintshayo zobuchwepheshe. Ngakho-ke, kuzobhekelelwa ukusimama kwesimo nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu eNingizimu Afrika. Ngithemba ngenhlonipho ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazokwamukela le Nqubomgomo yeSizwe Yolimi njengabo.

Lokhu kusho ukuthi ohulumeni kumele bavumelane ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi, uma izingane zithathwe ngale ndlela, zizobuyiswa ngokushesha. Uhlobo lwale nto lungenzeka uma ngabe omunye umzali efuna ukuthatha ingane komunye umzali noma ngabe inkantolo ithe angamthathi. Lokhu kufana nokweba ingane. Izingane zinelungelo lokusho lokho ezikucabangayo ngezindaba ezinemicabango ngazo. Kufanele imibono yazo ilalelwe. Leli ithuba lakho lokusho lokho okucabangayo. Ucabanga ukuthi uyakwazi ukwenza umbono ngezindaba ezikuthintayo Kwesinye isikhathi yizinto ezincane kabi lezi. Kodwa kwesinye isikhathi zibaluleke kakhulu. Isibonelo, bewuzophatheka kanjani uma ngabe bewuzohlala nomzali oyedwa noma omunye Noma bewuzophatheka kanjani ukuba bewesaba umuntu okulimazayo ngandlela thize? Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi abantu abadala ngesinye isikhathi bazi ukuthi izingane zinento ebalulekile eziyishoyo. Uma bengalaleli, kuyohlala njalo kunomuntu ozozilalela. Imicabango nemizwa yakho kubalulekile. Kufanele ukhulume ngakho. Uma kukwazeka, xoxa ngalokhu ekilasini noma nabangane bakho. Kubaluleke kabi ukuthi izingane zinikwe ithuba lokulalelwa enkantolo noma nanoma iyiphi enye indawo lapho kuxoxwa khona ngekusasa lazo. Kuya ngomthetho wezwe ezikulo, izingane kufanele zivunyelwe ukuthi zikhulume noma ingane ikhulunyelwe ngomunye umuntu. Izingane zinelungelo lokukhuluma ngokukhululeka. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izingane zinelungelo lokusho lokho ezikucabangayo kanye nokuzwa noma nokufunda lokho okucatshangwa ngabanye abantu. Lokhu kungenziwa ngezindlela eziningi ezahlukene: ngokulalela nokukhuluma; ngokubhala noma nokufunda; ngokudweba noma ngokupenda; noma nganoma iyiphi enye indlela ingane eyikhethayo.

Ukufakwa Kwezikhungo Zolwazi lweZempilo: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezinsiza Zokunakekelwa Kwezempilo eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zibe yinsika ebalulekile ekunikezeni abantu ulwazi olufanele nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezempilo. E-Ningizimu Afrika, ukufakwa kwezikhungo ezinjalo kubonisa isinyathelo esibalulekile sokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kuhloswe ngakho ukunciphisa umehluko phakathi kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo ezindaweni ezahlukene, nokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi lwezempilo kubantu bonke. Izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo zifaka phakathi izikhungo zokwelapha, izikhungo zokucwaninga, kanye nezikhungo zokufundisa. Lezi zikhungo zisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bathola ulwazi oluqondile nolwakhiwe kahle mayelana nezifo, izindlela zokuvikela, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba ulwazi olufanele lungasiza abantu ukuba benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile mayelana nezempilo yabo. Ukwakhiwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kudinga ukuxhaswa okuqinile kuhulumeni, izikhungo ezizimele, kanye nemiphakathi. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nokubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izikhungo zemfundo, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. Ngokubambisana, lezi zinhlaka zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi oluqondile nolufanele, oluhambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziye zathuthukiswa ukuze zifake ubuchwepheshe obuphambili.

Ibhodi lezakhamuzi leMapungubwe - lenziwe futhi labonwa emathunjini egolide ohlangothini lwezimbobo - okuyinto eyodwa yezinto ezenziwe futhi zatholakala emathunjini abacwaningi abawahlola kule ndawo (indawo yokuhlola). Ibhodwe elihlotshisiwe lokungcwaba igolide - isimo sebhodwe esibonakala ebhodweni lokungcwaba igolide sikhombisa ubuciko obunothile, isayensi, kanye nekhono lokuthuthukisa, okuyisibonakaliso sempumelelo yasendulo ekukhiqizeni insimbi. Ilanga eliphakamisayo - limele ukukhanya okusha e-Afrika. Isikhungo sokungcwaba insimbi - ukujabulisa nokuthuthukisa impilo ngokuqhuma, okusetshenziswe kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, kanye nempumelelo eqhubekayo nobuciko kuzo zonke izindawo. Le emblem inikezwa kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngomsebenzi wabo ophakeme. Lezi zisebenzi akufanele zibe imisebenzi ejwayelekile kuphela kodwa zidlule ezijwayelekile, futhi zenzelwe abantu hhayi kuphela ukuze bakhokhelwe kodwa ukuze badlule kulokho okujwayelekile nokulindelekile. Ukukhuthazwa kwezobuchwepheshe, nokukhonza imiphakathi. Singomuthi obalulekile kwezolimo. Sihlinzeka ngama-fibers ezindwangu nezintambo, izithelo, nomlilo, kanye nezinye izinto eziningi ezisebenzisekayo. IBaobab (Baobab noma i-Adansonia Digitata) - iyaziwa ngamagatsha ayo nezimpande zayo ezinde. Sihlinzeka ngensimu nokuhlalisana, futhi siphinde sibe nomthelela omkhulu ekuxhaseni imiphakathi lapho sitholakala khona.

Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubo ukuqonda ukuthi yini okufanele bayilindele. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela ziye zashintsha. Imikhuba emisha, ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kanye nezindlela ezintsha zokuphatha iziguli ziye zafika. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba kusiza ekwenzeni isiqiniseko sokuthi iziguli zithola usizo oluphuthumayo ngokushesha nangendlela efanele. Ngokuphetha, izinqubo zezimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zibalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu bathola usizo oludingekayo ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuhlukaniswa kwezimo, ukuphatha iziguli, ukuxhumana, kanye nezinsiza ezanele, konke kubalulekile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nesithakazelo kulolu daba, ukuze sikwazi ukusiza abanye uma bephakathi kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Ngiyabonga!

Ukuphepha kwezwe kulawulwa yiPhalamende nomkhandlu wokuphatha kazwelonke. Umbutho wokuvikela yiwona wodwa umbutho ohlomile osemthethweni eRephabhliki. noma amaziko ahlomile, zingamiswa njengokusho komthetho kazwelonke. umthetho osungamasiko wamazwengamazwe ezibophezela iRephabhliki. esiphambene nomthetho ngokusobala. ngendlela eqhuba izinjongo zeqembu lepolitiki elithile, ngendlela evuna leloqembu. yimitheshwana noma izinqumo zePhalamende. Ilungu leKhabinethe kumele libhekelele ukuvikela. ukugcwalisa isibopho9 somthetho wamazwe ngamazwe. isikhathi okulindelwe ukuthi umbutho uzosetshenziswa ngaso. oludingekile kwisigatshana (3) ekomidini elifanele. wombutho wokuvikela, futhi kumele aqokele esikhundleni abakhuzi bempi bombutho wokuvikela. kwelungu leKhabinethe elibhekelele ukuvikela. Inani labantu abathintekayo. eziyisikhombisa senziwe isimemezelo. yiPhalamende phakathi kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ezenziwe. yilungu lekhabinethe elibhekelele ukuphepha. emikhakheni kazwelonke, yezifundazwe neyezifundazwe neyezindawo. umsebenzi wawo ngendlela enempumelelo, enaka isidingo zezifundazwe. nokuphakamisa nokuphoqelela umthetho. eyabelwe kuyona ngokwenqubo yokuphoyisa kazwelonke. yenze izincomo elungwini leKhabhinethi elibhekele ukuphoyisa. sokungaziphathi kahle, noma icala elenziwe, yilungu labasebenzela amaphoyisa esifundazweni. nokulawulwa komsebenzi wamaphoyisa kamasipala. efanele phakathi kwamaphoyisa neminye imikhakha kahulumeni. kwaso noma yinoma yiliphi elinye lamakomidi akhe ukuphendula imibuzo. ukuze alawule futhi aphathe amaphoyisa.

Ukusebenzisa ulwazi olutholakala singakakhishwa isigwebo, lapha sibala nemibiko ngezicelo zebheyili, ukusiza kuthathwe isinqumo esiyiso. Uhulumeni nezinhlangano ezizimele unika usizo nenduduzo kumakhasimende akhe, nokuvula amathuba okuhlumelelisa izimilo. Izimantshi ezilalela amacala enkantolo aba nokuzwana nemisinsi yokuzimilela kulowo mphakathi, okusiza ukuletha ulwazi ngezindaba ezenzeka kulowo mphakathi okuholela ekukhishweni kwezigwebo eziyizo. Ukusebenza kwezinkantolo zemisinsi yokuzimilela, kuveza umbono ngokufanele izinkantolo zemiphakathi zaseNingizimu Afrikha zibe yikho, ukufana kwazo nezinkantolo zendabuko kugxile ekutheni zombili izinkantolo zifukamele amasiko, ukuthi abantu abazethamelayo babamba iqhaza futhi bahlale bevuselela imithetho. Ukuvuselela imithetho kuhlinzeka ngesimo esisha sokususa ingcindezelo kubantu bakulowo mphakathi. Bafuna ukusuka ezimweni zobulungiswa ezingezwakali kahle, ezibibiyelwe nezenziwa yonke indawo neziwusiko lwaseYurophu oluchaza ubulingiswa ngendlela abanolwazi ngayo, imikhuba nemigomo yabo. Lolu hlobo lwemithetho lumayelana nokufunda 'ngokufanele sibe yikho' kanye 'nokufunda kabusha okubheke kithi ngokosiko' lokhu kubukeka njengokwelapha ngoba izinxushunxushu nobugebengu kubukeka kuyizifo zomoya, zomphefumulo, zomzimba nomqondo kubantu abaphila kulowo mphakathi okumele zelashwe ngendlela yesintu. Ingxenye yalolu hlelo ifaka ukubuyisana kommangalelwa nonembeza wakhe nokunikwa iziyalo yizibonda zendawo noma amanye amalungu omphakathi. Lokhu kunika amandla futhi kusize lowo muntu athole ubulungiswa emphakathini.

Izinkulumo ezinhle, okuhloswe ngazo abachwepheshe, kufanele ziqhutshelwe phambili, ukuze abantu abasha baqonde kangcono ukuthi yini okudingeka bazilungiselele, nangendlela yokukhuluma. Ukubamba Isandla Eunhlalweni Ngenxa yomthelela emiphakathini, kubalulekile ukuthi umphakathi uphathe umoya ohloniphekile phakathi kwentsha. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana kwamalungu omphakathi, abahlengikazi, nezikhungo zemfundo. Njengoba intsha ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa, kumqoka ukuthi kekukhiqizwe ukugqugquzela ukusekelwa kwabantu abasha, ukuze bakhule bezazi futhi benza izinqumo ezinhle. Isiphetho Ukukhulelwa kwentsha kusemqoka futhi kudinga ukucabangela okujulile. Kungaba ukuphila okuhle, okugcwele ezinjabulo, uma kuphela umphakathi usiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezifanele. Ukukhuluma ngalezi zindaba kufanele kube yinto evulekile, ukuze ingane weza ikhulile, ibe nekhono lokubhekana nezithiyo. Ngaleyo ndlela, sizoqinisekisa ukuthi intsha yethu ibambisene futhi ikhululekile, iphila kahle empilweni. Ukukhulelwa akusilutho olunye, kodwa kuyindlela esizokwakha ngayo ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Uhlelo lukazibambele luwuhlelo olubheka izinselelo omasipala ababhekene nazo ezweni lonke. Ngikhuluma nje bangu-136 omasipala abakhonjiwe kuzwelonke ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo. Afrika kwisidingo esiphuthumayo sokuthola izindlela ezintsha zokuqinisekisa umphumela obonakalayo ezinhlelweni zohulumeni basekhaya kanye nokuqinisa ukudidiyelwa kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke, ezesifundazwe nezohulumeni basekhaya ezindaweni ezisemqoka zokulethwa kwezidingo (nesibambisene nabo) Ngamafuphi, uhlelo lukazibambele luqondene nokwakha ubambiswano oluzoholela ekwenziweni ngcono kwezinga lempilo kubantu emazingeni ezindawo.. Umasipala wendawo waseNdaka ungomunye womasipala abakhnjwe ukuba babambe iqhaza ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo olubalulekile lokuqinisa ingqalasizinda yomasipala bethu. Njengohulumeni sanquma ukuthi sidinga ukubambisana nomasipala ngokubahlinzeka ngosizo olwengeziwe ukuze sizokwazi ukusheshisa ekususeni izingqinamba ekulethweni kwezidingo. Iqiniso esesilibonile elokuthi ukuntuleka kolwazi namakhono obuchwephese kungezinye zezizathu zokuhamba ngonyawo lonwabu kokulethwa kwezidingo komasipala bethu. Omasipala abafana neNdaka bangomasipala abasha ababhekene nezinselelo ezinkulu ekunciphiseni igebe ekulethweni kwezidingo eladalwa wubandlululo emiphakathini. Nakuba bezama ukuqeda umonakalo owadalwa wubandlululo, babhekana nenkinga ekusebenzeni ngokugcwele. wukushoda kwamakhono adingekile kwabanye omasipala. Uhulumeni usethuthukise uhlelo oluzokhulisa futhi lwenze ngcono ukusebenza komasipala lubuye futhi lusize ekudluliseleni amakhono anqala ekuhlomuliseni abantu.

Izivumelwane ziyolawula lokho okumele kungene kwinqubo ye-IDP nezinye izinhlelo ezingeke zixhumane. Umsebenzi wokuHlela (1 /9 - ojotshelelwe) unika umhlahlandlela ngalokhu. INHLOSO: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bonke ababandanyekayo ngenqubo yokuhlela bawazi kahle onke amaqiniso nezibalo eziphathelene nesimo samanje, izinkomba nezinguquko. Lokhu kuyoba nomthelela ekuqaguleni izisombululo ezifanele ngemuva kokubhekela izidingo ezibalulekile nezinsiza ezikhona. Ukuqoqa ulwazi nemininingwane enqala yenqubomgomo. Ukuhlola isikhathi samanje kuphelela ekuqoqeni ulwazi noma ukuvuselela lolo oselwaqoqwa. Ulwazi lwamagebe abucayi kumele luqagulwe. Abadingekile abeluleki lapho kuqoqwa ulwazi olulula. Kuvamile ukuba isikhathi esibekelwe izinqumo silinganiswe ngokweqile. Izinguquko ebantwini zingabanzima ukuzilinganisa ngokuphelele. Sebenzisa ibalazwe ngolwazi lokuhleleka kwezindawo nalapho kukanise khona imisebenzi yomphakathi. INHLOSO: Ukufaka igalelo esimweni lapho imisebenzi kamasipala iyodingida khona izidingo zabantu ezihamba phambili bese ihlinzekela lokho abazisungulela khona. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, inqubo yokubambisana kumele isize izakhamuzi ekuqondeni ukubaluleka kwama-IDP ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izimpilo. Izinsiza ezifingqiwe zezakhamuzi, umphakathi namathimba anentshisekelo nemizamo yokuxazulula lezidingo ngokwehlukana ngezindawo, izigaba zenhlalonhle nobulili.
