Babekhulisa ngezandla futhi bazama ukuvimbela izifo ngezindlela ezitholakalayo futhi bavuna ngezandla - bengazi ukuthi bangaki amahektare abebefake imbewu futhi bengazi ukuthi bangakanani umkhiqizo abazovuna. Babekuhlosile kuphela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umkhiqizo uzokwanela ukuhlinzeka ngokudla etafuleni nasokukhulisa izinkomo unyaka ozayo. Kodwa manje izinto seziye zashintsha... Okwamanje, kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nokukala - ukwanda kokukala nokubala kusilethele ikhono lokuqondisa nokwandisa indlela esiphatha ngayo umsebenzi wethu wokulima. Kulesi sithombe, sizohlola, sixoxe, futhi sithinte izinto esidinga ukuzikala njengezabalimi. Sidinga ukwazi usayizi wezindawo esihlosile ukuzifaka. Zonke izibalo zomquba, inani le-diesel, inani lembewu, inani lomquba, kanye nezinto zokwakha kufanele zihambisane nosayizi bezindawo ezizofakwa. Umhlaba uhluka ngezindlela eziningi: njengokujula nesimo. Kumele sazi uhlobo lomhlaba kanye nokujula kwawo endaweni ngayinye lapho sifuna ukufaka - ungacabangi ukuthi umhlaba wakho ufana kuwo wonke amakhaya! Uhlobo nokujula komhlaba kubalulekile kakhulu lapho ukhetha uhlobo lwezithelo okufanele ufake - ezinye izinhlobo zezithelo azinakufakwa emhlabeni ophakathi.

Ngokwe-NICD, kunezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-flu virus ezivela ngezikhathi ezihlukahlukene uma kuqhathaniswa ne-swine flu ezweni kuleli sikhathi. Isizathu sokuthi i-swine flu ibangele ukukhathazeka ukuthi iyivirus entsha. Abantu abavikeleki kwi-swine flu virus njengoba benza kwezinye izinhlobo ze-flu virus, abake bahlaselwa. Nokho, njengokwe-flu yesizini, i-swine flu akufanele ithathwe kalula. I-swine flu ivele njenge-flu yesizini enezimpawu eziningi ezifana ne-fever, headache, ubuhlungu bezitho zomoya, ukuhuhuma, nokuba nenhliziyo ephumayo. I-swine flu iphinde ihluke kwi-flu yesizini kwezinye izimpawu; njengezimpawu zesisu, ukuhamba, nokushaywa kwenhliziyo okukhulunywe ngakho. Abanye abagulayo baphinde babe nezimpawu ezinzima, kuyilapho abaningi bahlongoza isifo esincane. Uma unalezi zimpawu ezingenhla, vakashela udokotela wakho ngaphambi kokuphuthuma esibhedlela noma ngaphambi kokuthenga i-oseltamivir (Tamiflu), imithi ye-swine flu. Nakuba abanye odokotela beqoka i-Tamiflu kubagulayo ngaphandle kokuvuma ukuthi umuntu uthintekile, abanye bavuma ukuthi ukuthatha imithi uma ungathintekile nge-swine flu kwenza kube lula ukuyithola esikhathini esizayo - uma ujwayele ukuthatha le mithi, i-virus ingase ibe ne-resistance kuyo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma uqobo uthola i-swine flu virus futhi udinga i-Tamiflu, ngeke isisebenze kahle. Ukuze isebenze kahle, ngokufanayo, udokotela onolwazi angaphakamisa ukuthi isiguli

Imifelandawonye emincane, isb. leyo eyakhiwe ngabantu abangekho ngaphansi kweshumi nanye inhloso yazo ukuhlinzeka ngomsebenzi noma izidingongqangi kumalungu awo. Imifelandawonye emikhudlwana, isb. yileyo eyakhiwe imifelandawonye emincane emibili noma ngaphezulu ukuze ihlinzeke ngezidingongqangi kumalungu awo. Imifelandawonye emikhulu, isb. Yileyo amalungu awo angawemifelandawonye emikhudlwana kuyona yomibili imifelandawonye emincane nemikhudlwana futhi inhloso yawo ukuhlinzeka ngezidingongqangi kumalungu awo. Imifelandawonye emikhulu kakhulu, lona ngumfelandawonye omkhulu onhloso zawo ifaka ukubhekana nezintshisekelo kanye nenhlalakahle yamalungu ayo emazingeni esifunda, esifundazwe, kazwelonke kanye nawomhlabajikelele. NgokweMenenja yoPhiko lwemifelandawonye oluseMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Nezokuvakasha esiFundazweni okuyilona olubhekele indawo, ukwesekwa okwehlukahlukene kuyahlinzekwa ezinhlanganweni ezahlukene eSifundeni saseZululand ngobubanzi. I-DEDT ihamba ize ifinyelele emingceleni yesifunda ekuhlinzekeni ngokulekelela imifelandawonye. Kulesi sifunda kukhona imifelandawonye emincane nemikhulu. Emazingeni aphansi, ukuthuthukiswa kwekhono lebhizinisi kanye nekhono lokuzidayisa nokwesekwa kuhlinzekwa kwimifelandawonye esezimbonini yeZolimo, yeZindwangu kanye neyezeMikhiqizo. Ukukhiqiza kuncane kakhulu endaweni kamasipala, futhi lokho okukhona kugxile kakhulu eVryheid.

Izinkantolo zendabuko zisebenza ngokulingana nezinkantolo zezimantshi. Lezi zinkantolo zakhiwa ngokohlelo lukaNgqongqoshe woHulumeni wezaseKhaya ngaphansi komthetho wezinkantolo zendabuko ka1974. Izinkantolo zihlukaniseke izigaba ezintathu: iKhomishani yezinkantolo zendabuko, inkantolo yokwedlulisela amacala, kanye nezinkantolo zomthetho ophathelene namasiko. Emazingeni aphansi alolu hlelo lokuxazulula izinkinga kukhona umndeni, oba nendoda, unkosikazi nezingane. Abantu abathintekayo kulokho kushayisana ngemibono bavamise ukuxazulula izinkinga zabo zomndeni ngaphakathi emndenini. Uma lokhu kungasebenzi, bangalethwa phambi kwengqoqo, eba nabantu abasondele bomndeni abahlala enxulumeni elilodwa. Elinye izinga kuba yingqoqo enabantu abahlala esigodini esisodwa. Uma imindeni engaphezu kowodwa ihlala ndawonye endaweni ephethwe ngohlelo olubonakalayo lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi yiwadi. Amawadi angaphansi kwenduna esikhundla sayo sitholakala ngokuzalana. Ezizweni ezinkulu njengoBangwaketse noBamangwato, izinduna zihlukaniswa ngamazinga (kusukela ku A kuya ku G kulesi sizwe sokuqala bese sisukele ku A siye ku K kulesi sesibili). Kwezinye izizwe ezinjengaBakwena, aBatawana namaBamalete, kukhona izinduna namasekela amakhosi. Esizweni saBakwena, la masekela amakhosi abekwa emazingeni asukela ku A aye ku C. Yileso naleso sikhulu somthetho sinamalungelo omthetho okulalela amacala, okwenza bakwazi ukuxazulula ukungezwani. Izinkantolo zezinduna zibizwa ngokuthi izinkantolo zokuxolelana , okungenzeka ukuthi umthetho we-12 wezinkantolo zemithetho yesintu waba nomthelela ekuqalweni kwalolu hlelo.

Uma sekuvunyelwene ngeSivumelwano, izwe nezwe kufanele liye ePhalamende lalo bese kuvunyelwana ngeSivumelwano lapho. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuqinisa Isivumelwano. IPhalamende kufanele livotele ukuthi lizoyihlonipha imithetho yeSivumelwano. Uma ngabe iPhalamende lezwe selivumile ukusiqinisa Isivumelwano, uhulumeni walelo zwe kufanele ahloniphe imithetho yaso. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi akusiwo wonke amazwe avumelana nazo zonke Izivumelwano. Ngonyaka ka-1995, uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika wavuma (waqinisa) Isivumelwano Samalungelo Engane. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uhulumeni kufanele ahloniphe imithetho yeSivumelwano. Inhlangano Yezizwe inekomiti elikhethekile labantu okufanele bacele ukuthi amazwe abatshele ukuthi enzani ukuhlonipha le mithetho. Ngesikhathi iNingizimu Afrika isayina Isivumelwano, benza isithembiso esiyisipesheli ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika sokuthi izingane zizohamba phambili kukho konke abakwenzayo. Isivumelwano sithi ingane umuntu ongaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18. Kodwa ngezinye izikhathi izwe lingaba nomthetho ovumela ukuthi ingane ibe ngumuntu omdala ngaphambi kwesikhathi. Ungacabanga ngesizathu esenza ukuthi izwe livumele ukuthi ingane ibe ngumuntu omdala ingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 Isibonelo, kwamanye amazwe abantu abangaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18 bavunyelwe ukuthi bashade. Ingabe ucabanga ukuthi umuntu oneminyaka engaphansi kweyi-18 ubudala kufanele aphathwe njengengane? Izwe ngalinye kufanele liqiniseke ukuthi onke amalungelo akulesi Sivumelwano asebenza enganeni ngayinye kulelo zwe. Ayikho ingane okufanele isale ngaphandle ngenxa yobuzwe bayo, ibala, ubulili, ulimi noma inkolo.

Imicimbi Yomphakathi: Ukuhlanganyela Nokuhlangabezana Kwezakhamuzi Ngomhlaka 15 kuNhlolanja 2023, umphakathi waseMbombela ubebuthene ndawonye emcimbini omkhulu obuhlanganisa abantu abaningi ezindaweni ezahlukene zedolobha. Lo mcimbi, owawubanjelwe emaphandleni eThekwini, wawuhloselwe ukuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwezindawo zomphakathi, ukuxhumana kwabantu, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezahlukene ezidingekayo emphakathini. Umcimbi uqale ngekhonsathi yezenzo ezahlukene zamasiko, lapho izinkampani zomculo nezithakazelo zomdabu zedlula phambili zikhombisa ubuciko bazo. Abasolwazi bezamasiko baphinde baqhakambisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuthuthukisa amasiko endawo, okuhlanganisa, phakathi kokunye, imidlalo yendabuko, izinkulumo ezikhanyisayo, kanye nezifundo zezenhlalo. Abantu basemphakathini babebonakala bejabule, besebenzisa leli thuba ukuze bahlanganyele, baxoxe, futhi benze ubudlelwano. Umlingani wombiko, uNksz. Nandi Mthethwa, uthe: "Lo mcimbi ubaluleke kakhulu ngoba ubufaka bonke abantu bethu ndawonye. Sidinga ukuhamba phambili njengomphakathi, futhi izenzakalo ezifana nalezi ziyasiza ekwakheni imiphakathi eqinile." Ubuye wabhala ukuthi imicimbi eyanelisayo ibalulekile ukuze abantu baziqhenye ngamasiko abo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi onezinhlelo ezihluke-hluke ezithuthukisayo. Ngemuva kokuphela kokuhlangana, umphakathi wathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela emisebenzini ethile ebanzi, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuzithandela, imifundaze, nezinhlelo zemfundo. Lokhu kube yithuba elihle lokuthi abantu abasha basebenze ndawonye, bajule emsebenzini wokuthuthukisa izindawo zabo.

Waqonda ukuthi umama nomntwana badinga ukuxhumana ukuze bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. UZanele wathola ukuthi ukuxhumana komzimba, njengokubamba, ukuxoxa, nokuhamba, kube yindlela yokwakha uthando phakathi kwakhe noSipho. Ekugcineni, uZanele waphuma esibhedlela, esebenzisa konke akufundile. USipho wayesebenza kahle, futhi wayenobuso obujabulisayo. Waqonda ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa akukhona nje kuphela umsebenzi, kodwa kuyisifundo esiyingqayizivele sokuphila. Wafunda ukuthi uthando, ukunakekelwa, nokuxhumana kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yomntwana. Ngaleso sikhathi, uZanele waba umama ophumelelayo, futhi wayezithokozisa ngempilo yakhe. Waqhubeka nokufunda, nokukhulisa uSipho ngendlela efanele, futhi waba isibonelo esihle kwabanye abesifazane. UZanele wathola ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisanda kuzalwa kuhlala njalo, kuze kube phakade. Waqonda ukuthi ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane bukhula ngothando, futhi lokhu kwakuwumgomo wakhe empilweni. Ngakho, uZanele waphila impilo enothando, eqinisa imindeni, futhi eqinisa umphakathi. Uthando lwakhe noSipho lwaba yisibonelo sokuthi, nakuba izinsuku zokuqala zingaba nzima, ukuphila kungaba mnandi uma sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazana. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esikhulu, esashiya umphakathi unothando, unokuxhumana, futhi unokuthula. UZanele wayazi kahle ukuthi uthando lungabamba zonke izinkinga, futhi lokho kwaba yisifundo esiyigugu empilweni yakhe noSipho.

Okwahlonzwa njengembangela yalokhu kuvalwa kwalezi zimboni ngukwehla kwenzuzo kanye nokungalawuleki kwemvelo. Izimayini ezincane zamalahle alukhuni kuphela ezisaqhubeka nokusebenza njengamanje. Khona manjalo, uthando lwezimayini zamalahle seluvuselelekile ngenxa yabantu abasebenzisa amalahle, nezimayini eziningi zamalahle seziphinde zavulwa. Ezohwebo Nokongiwa KwaZulu-Natali zenza ucwaningo ngale mboni ngokubheka ukuthi kusengalunga yini ukuvuselelwa kabusha kwezimayini zamalahle endaweni. Okwaqapheleka kakhulu ukuthi umbiko wabheka amandla ale mboni yezezimayini eBaqulusini ukuthi ingakwazi yini ukuhlinzeka izimboni ezakha insimbi nezinye izinhlobo zensimbi ngomthamo omkhulu wamalahle aqinile nalawo okupheka asezingeni eliphezulu. UMasipala wendawo yasebaQulusini unengqalasizinda efanele yezokuthutha exhumanisa umnotho kuzo zombili izindawo, ogwini nasezweni elimaphakathi. Kulindelekile ukuthi okunye ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Durban-Richards Bay Corridor kanye ne-King Shaka Airport esanda kuvulwa kanye ne-Dube Tradeport kube nomthelela omuhle kule ngqalasizinda yezokuthutha, njengoba izindlela zokuthutha zenziwe zaba ziningi. Ukusabalala kwabantu endaweni engaphansi kukamasipala wendawo yasebaQulusini akulingani, ama- 63% abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezakhele izindwo zasemakhaya , bese kuthi ama -15% abantu bahlala eVryheid. Umndeni ulinganiselwa kubantu aba- 3.8 , emakhaya khona kulinganiselwa ku 8. bangama -22.31% abantu abangakaze balubhade nhlobo esikoleni , bayi- 5.71% kuphela abanesitifiketi sikamatikuletsheni kanti ngama- 2. Ama-20% abantu abika ukuthi abaholi lutho nhlobo kanye nama-11% abahola ngaphansi kwezi R2 400 ngonyaka.

Amalungu abacosheli bezindaba amenywa Kumhlangano Wokuqala we-Durban Metropolitan Unicity Council. Ngokombiko otholakele, umsolwa ubeqoqa iminikelo kumabhizinisi esebenzisa i-letter head yamaphoyisa enza sengathi le minikelo eyesikhwama Sabashonelwe ababeshade nabo ababengamaphoyisa. Ukuthembeka okukhonjisiwe, lokhu kuchaza, ukwethamela ukuvakashela umtholampilo wabaphila negciwane lesandulela ngculazi kathathu noma kaningana okuhleliwe. Abesifazane bazibandakanya kwimisebenzi yesisa ukuze babhekelele izidingo zezenhlalo eziphathelene nobhubhane lwegciwane lesandulela ngculazi kanye nesifo sengculazi, ubumpofu, ukuxhaswa kwabasinde kwizenzo zobugebengu, njl. Akufanele bazame ukukhipha isibhamu kwisisefo saso noma ngabe, kuyenzeka, bathole ukhiya wesisefo. Abasolwa abathathu abangaziwa baphuma esikhotheni behlula ngamandla izithandani. Sadingida ukuthi ingabe isikrini esikhulu sizobekwa yini e-North Parklane. Umbuzo ubusekelwe kulokho akubuzwa abalandeli be-Pirates, ngimbuza lokho-nje. Kudingeka impela indlela entsha yokudunga amacebo futhi kumele siqinisekise ukuthi noma iziphi izinyathelo ezithathelwa i-Iran ne-Syria azisebenzi nokuthi zidala izingqinamba kunokuthi zilethe izisombululo. Kodwa kuzodingidwa izinto ezimbalwa mayelana nokuxazulula ukungqubuzana, okwenzeka ngemuva kokhetho kanye nokwakha kabusha ngemuva kokungqubuzana. Ngiyathokoza ukusho ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibambe iqhaza kuwo wonke amalungiselelo emihlangano yongqongqoshe. Thokozela isidlo sasekuseni esilungiswe ekhaya kule ndawo yesihambi esendaweni esemakhaya ehlinzeka ngamagumbi okulala ahamba ngamabili.

Wamtshela ukuthi akukhathalekile ukuthi ubani, bonke abantu banelungelo lokuthola usizo. UMama Thandi wathola ukuthi udokotela wayenolwazi olunzulu, futhi wayezimisele ukusiza. Wamtshela ukuthi ukukhwehlela kwakhe kungenzeka kube ngenxa yokuphefumula umoya ongcolile, futhi wanikeza izeluleko ezinhle zokuphila kahle. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, uMama Thandi wathola imishanguzo, futhi udokotela wamtshela ukuthi kufanele abuyele ukuze abone ukuthi imishanguzo iyasebenza. Lokhu kwenza uMama Thandi azizwe ethokozile, ngoba wayezwa ukuthi usizo lukhona. Wabuyela emakhaya, enethemba lokuthi impilo yakhe izophila kahle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uMama Thandi waqala ukuvakashela izibhedlela zikahulumeni njalo. Waqonda ukuthi lezi zibhedlela zazingezabo bonke abantu, futhi zazinikeza ithuba lokuthola usizo lwezempilo. Waqala nokukhuthaza abanye emzaneni wakhe ukuba bavakashele izibhedlela, ngoba wayefuna wonke umuntu abe nempilo engcono. Kodwa, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zazihlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Kwakukhona ukuntuleka kwezinsiza, abanye odokotela babenganele, futhi iziguli zazilindele isikhathi eside ukuze zithole usizo. Lokhu kwenza uMama Thandi acabange ukuthi kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi abantu baphile kahle uma izibhedlela zingasebenzi kahle. Waqala ukucabanga ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela, futhi wathola ukuthi abantu bangenza umehluko. UMama Thandi wanquma ukuhlela umcimbi emzaneni wakhe, lapho abantu bezokwazi ukuhlanganisa izinsiza zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela. Waqasha abanye abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi bonke bavuma ukusiza. Umcimbi waba yimpumelelo enkulu, abantu bejabulile, bephakela izinsiza ezahlukene, futhi bexoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa izibhedlela.

Ezentela: Izigaba Eziyinhloko Zokuhleleka Kwezentela Isingeniso Ezwenikazi lethu, ezentela zidlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukukhokha intela ngendlela efanele, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinqubo zomthetho ezihambisana nalezi zinyathelo. Lezi zinyathelo zizosisiza bonke abantu, kanye nezinkampani, ukuba bazi kahle izidingo zabo zokuhlinzeka ngezentela. Isinyathelo 1: Ukuqonda Izinhlobo Nezincazelo Zezentela Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izinhlobo ezahlukene zezintela. Zikhona izintela eziningi ezifana ne-intela yemihla-nemihla, intela yezimpahla, kanye ne-intela yokudluliswa. Umuntu ngamunye nesikhungo sakhe kufanele aqonde ukuthi iyiphi intela efanele kumkhiqizo wabo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekubhaleni nasekukhokheni intela ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuhlela Izikhumbuzo Zokukhokha Ngemva kokuthi umuntu eqonde kahle, kubalulekile ukuhlela izikhumbuzo zokukhokha intela. Lokhu kungaba ukufaka izikhumbuzo ezibhaliwe, ukuze umuntu abe nesibopho sokukhokha ngaphezu kwezinsuku ezithile. Lokhu kuzovikela izinkinga ezingase zivele ngenxa yokuhoxiswa kwemali. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlela Imibiko Ngomthetho Ngemuva kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuhlela imibiko yezintela. Umuntu kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi imibiko ibonisa kahle zonke izimali ezitholakele nezindleko ezikhokhelwe, futhi ibhalwe kahle. Ukubhalwa kwamadokhumenti kufanele kuhambisane nemithetho yokubhaliswa kwamabhizinisi, ukuze kugwenywe izinkinga esikhathini esizayo. Isinyathelo 4: Ukubala Intela Yakho Manje sekuvele isikhathi sokubala intela. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukubala umholo, imithombo yezimali, nezindleko ezihambisana nomsebenzi.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi noSipho baqala ukuhamba emiphakathini, befundisa abanye abantu isiNgisi. Bafunda ukuthi ukufunda izilimi eziningi akukhona nje ukufunda, kodwa kuyindlela yokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono. Abafundi bahlala bejabulile, behlanganyela emicimbini yokufunda, futhi bezwakalisa izilimi zabo. Ekugcineni, uMsizi waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho abantu behlanganyela khona, bezokhuluma izilimi ezahlukene. Uthisha waphinde wathola umklomelo wokuba uthisha ophumelelayo, futhi bonke abafundi baphakamisela uMsizi izandla, bebonga umsebenzi wakhe omuhle. UThandi, uSipho, noMaya bahlala bejabulile, bazi ukuthi ukufunda izilimi eziningi kwavula iminyango emisha. Bafunda ukuthi izilimi azikhulumi nje, kodwa zihlala zixhumanisa abantu, zenza umhlaba ube yindawo engcono. Ngale ndlela, isikole se-Isizotha sahlala sikhula, sithokozisa izilimi eziningi, futhi sakhuthaza abafundi ukuba baphokophele phambili, bejabulisa izilimi zabo. Uthando lokufunda lwalukhona, futhi abafundi babefunda ukuthi izilimi eziningi zikhona ukuze zixhumanise abantu, zikhuthaze ubuhlobo, futhi zikhulise umphakathi. Ngaleso sikhathi, uThandi noSipho baqonda ukuthi ukufunda izilimi eziningi akukhona nje umsebenzi, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Futhi, le ndaba yaphenduka isifundo esikhulu sokuthi izilimi eziningi zingasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo.

Ngifisa ukuniqinisekisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemndleni emhlabeni wonke besebenzisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola ikhambi. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, ikhambi elifana naleli lingakhona ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Kodwa, kunesindingo esikhulu kabi sekhambi nokukhiqizwa obukhulu bako bunganele - ubukhulu obungekho e-Afrika. Ngifisa ukunibobonga ngesikhathi enibe naso sokufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiphinde ngibonge ukubamba kwenu iqhaza okulindelekile ekudluliseni ulwazi nasekwehliseni imiphumela yalokhu kufa.

Ama-98% ezitshalo zikabhontshisi wesoya e-U.S asetshenziselwa ukondla imfuyo. Ufulawa kabhontshisi wesoya ngubhontshisi wesoya osuswe amafutha wacolisiswa ngokwenele ukuze ukwazi ukwedlula esihluzweni esinesikrini esiyi-100 noma ngaphansi kwalokho lapho kuye kwacoshelelwa ngesikhathi kumuncwa (kungagazingwa) ukuze kuncitshiswe ukuguqulwa kwesimo semvelo samaphrotheni khona kuzogcineka iSilinganiso Sokusaphazeka Kwamaphrotheni esiphezulu (i-Protein Dispersibility Index - i-PDI), ukuze sisetshenziselwe ukupheka ngokukhipha amaphrotheni emifino ezwakala kamnandi esandleni. Ufulawa wesoya utholakala ezingcwecwaneni ezikhishwe amafutha neziqukethe uwoyela ongaphansi kwe-1%. Ufulawa wesoya onamafutha aphelele wenziwa ngobhontshisi ongamuncwanga amafutha nohlutshiwe futhi uqukethe cishe uwoyela oyi-18% kufike kuma-20%. Ufulawa wesoya onamafutha asezingeni eliphansi wenziwa ngokuphinda kubuyiselwe uwoyela kufulawa wesoya osuswe amafutha. Amafutha aqukethwe ayehlukahlukana ngokwezilinganiso, ezivame ukuba phakathi kwe-4,5% ne-9%. Ufulawa wesoya onamafutha asezingeni eliphezulu nawo ungakhiqizwa ngokwengeza uwoyela kufulawa ongamuncwanga amafutha ngokwezinga eliyi-15%. Ukudla kwabantwana okunesoya (i-Soya-based infant formula) (i-SBIF) kusetshenziswa ezinganeni ezinegazi elingezwani namaphrotheni obisi lwenkomo olubulewe amagciwane ngokushiswa. Lokhu kudla kuthengiswa ngezinhlobo eziyimphuphu, elungele ukudliwa kanye nangezinhlobo eziluketshezi olushubile.

Ohlelweni, isigaba ngesigaba kulindeleke ukuba siqale ukukhuphula ukugcwalisa ukungafani kolimi. Ulwazi lwemvelo/ lwasekhaya ngakwelinye icala lungaba umyombo wokukhula kanye nentuthuko. Ngakwelinye icala lusengozini yokuthi luxhashazwe ngamazwe angaphandle angenaluzwelo ngokulusebenzisa okunganikinzuzo emphakathi olwazi lungolwawo. I-Ethnomedicine kanye ne-enthopharmacology, kuqiniseka ukusebenziswa kwezitshalo, izilwane kanye nomcebo wezamasiko kanye nokuhlonipheka kwezinkampani, imvelo yokudla izitshalo, indlela amasiko aphathwa ngayo kanye nokudalwa/ ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezithile. Kunesikhwama sokothuthukisa ucwaningo lolwazi lwezemvelo kanye nemithetho ebekiwe ngaphansi komthetho we- Human Research Council ukuze kuthuthukiswe kuphinde kuvikelwe ulwazi lwemvelo/lwasekhaya. Ubudlelwane namazwe omhlaba ukuthula kanye namaqoqo ezokuvikela. Lemibono yashitsha kanjani yaba yizenzo ngonyaka odlule? Umnyango ususungule indlela yezokuphatha eqinile eholwa ngungqongqoshe, nesekela likangqongqoshe kanye nomQondisi Jikelelele. Indlela yemihlangano yabaphathi kanye nendlela yokwethula izethulo kanye nokuphathwa kwezamakhono abantu sekuthole ukunakekelwa okukhulu ngenxa yomsebenzi weqembu elisha lezokuphatha i-HR. Njengoba kusho umbiko we- Human Resource zonke izinhloso zokumelwa kwabaphathi sezifeziwe. Sikholwa ukuthi inhloso ebalulekile yazo zonke izingxenye ezixhaswe yi-DACST (isayensi, ubuciko, amagugu, izilimi) ukuba zihlanganise indlela yokuphatha nesuselwe kumbono ofanayo nentshisekelo ukuhloniphnana kanye nokuthembeka. Ulwazi kanye noMnyango.

Omni wokuhlola uhambisana neqembu labantu, umphakathi, kanye nezidingo ezithile zomhlaba, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imigomo emisha. Kulesi sikhathi esibucayi, ukuhlinzeka ngembono engcono kulapho izimo ezisemqoka zikhukhula khona, okungenza izinqumo ezintsha zibe nohlu olusha. Ngakho-ke, le theory yesigaba se-GEMS major member classification iyasiza ekwakheni izinkulumo ezignele nezisizo, ubonisa indlela eqinile yokuthola izixazululo zokuphila okukhululekile kumuntu wonke. Ngalolu hlobo, umphakathi uzuza kakhulu okuwusizo.

Amanye alamandla awedluliselwa kubo, lawa yilapho ezenzela ngokwakhe umaziphathe ngokusizwa ngamakomidi avame ukubunjwa ngamakhansela aqokiwe. Amakomidi amaningi akhethiwe adingida izinto ezithinta imvelo, njengekomidi lokuhlela nje. Lamakomidi enza izincomo ekomidini eliphakeme nokuyilo elithatha izinqumo ezingujuqu. Uma ufuna ukufaka isikhalo ngomonakalo kwimvelo emakomidini abhekele lenkinga, okokuqala kumele uthole ukuthi yimaphi Ungathola ngokubuza kubasebenzi bakamasipala noma ekhanseleni lesigceme. Ikomidi ephakeme ivame ukulandela izincomo zamakomidi, ngakho kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngqo namakomidi ngokushesha. Esilandelayo yisibonelo sokusebenzisa iNEMA lapho uyokhuluma nomasipala? Isibonelo: Umasipala noma umkhandlu ulungiselela ukuthatha isinqumo ngentuthuko ehlongozwayo neyoba nomthelela omkhulu kwimvelo endaweni yangakini. Imigomo nemibandela Yokusingatha okuBumbene kweMvelo njengoba kulandiswa eSahlukweni 5 seNEMA asikalandelwa ngokugcwele ezinhlelweni zokuhlela futhi wesabela ukuthi intuthuko izovunyelwa iqhubeke. Ufuna isiqiniseko sokuthi imvelo iyophepha. Okokuqala, kumele uye kubasebenzi bomkhandlu abasebenza ngokugcwele, njengaseMnyangweni Wokuhlela iDolobha bese uyabachazela ngenkinga yakho. Bacele ulwazi lwentuthuko nokuthola kabanzi ngamakomidi ayobhekana nokuthatha isinqumo ngohlelo. Yiya emakomidini. Kungenzeka kube yikomidi eliqondene nokuhlela noma elezemvelo. Bhala futhi wenze uhlelo lokubonana nekomidi eliphakeme uma ikomidi eliqondene lehluleka ukuphendula izincomo zakho.

Ithebula 6: Inamba yabafundi abaye eGauteng ngonyaka ka-2009 (Bheka isigaba 2 ithebula 6 sezikole ezejwayelekile ngenhla). Khombisa inamba yabafundi ngokwebanga abalihambayo ukuya esikoleni. Lokhu kubandakanya abafundi abahlaliswe emahositela. Inamba yonke yabafundi kuleli thebula kufanele ihambisane nenamba yonke yabafundi abasethebulini 2, 5 no-8. Ithebula 8: Inamba yabafundi Iphrofayili yaBazali/yaBabheki babo engena ngaphakathi kwale ndlela. Khombisa inamba yabafundi maqondana nesimo sabazali/sababheki babo njengeoba behlinzekelwe kuNqubomgomo Yokwamukela. Leli thebula lisebenza kubazali/kubabheki abafundi abahlala nabo. Ungabali uphinde kabili lapho umzali ehlala futhi asebenze endaweni. Umfundi ngamunye kufanele abalwe kanye kuleli thebula. Inamba yonke yabafundi kuleli thebula kufanele ihambisane nenamba yonke yabafundi kuthebula 2, 5 no-7. Khombisa inamba yabasebenzi abaqashwe nguhulumeni esikoleni ngobulili, isikhundla kanye nohlobo lomsebenzi. Izinga lesikhala somsebenzi kathishomkhulu kufanele likhonjiswe. Khombisa inamba yabasebenzi abaqashwe ngasese esikoleni ngobulili, izinga nohlobo lomsebenzi.

Sesifikile ekupheleni kwezinsuku ezinde zebusika, futhi kulokhu, sithole ukuhlolwa ngezimo zezulu ezibandayo zeHighveld, imvula ethule eCape Town, kanye nezinhlobo ezintsha zeflu eziphumelelayo ezidale ukuthi abantu badinge ukwelashwa emhlabeni jikelele. Kusukela ekuqaleni kwayo, i-GEMS ibenze umsebenzi wayo wokuhlinzeka ngezinsiza zempilo eziphezulu ezithengekayo futhi ezitholakala kalula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. Amathiphu okuphila kahle: - Ukubhekana nokukhathala kwengqondo - Izindlela zokudla eziphilile - Thatha Isinyathelo! Kulobu busika, sithole futhi ugqozi ezindabeni ezithokozisayo ezivela kubalungu bethu ezweni lonke njengengxenye yokuncintisana kwe-GEMS Sisonke. Siyabonga ngalezi zindaba ezinhle eziningi enizabelane nathi. Izindaba ezithokozisayo ezivela kini ziwufakazi wokuthi i-GEMS idlala indima ebalulekile ezimpilweni zabantu nasempilweni yabalungu bayo. Kulungile ukwazi ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeka nokunakekela abalungu bayo lapho bedinga khona. Sizojabula ukwabelana ngalezi zindaba nani esikhathini esizayo emaphephandabeni afana ne-facets. Ubushushu buhlale buhamba nezinto ezintsha kanye nokuphila okulethwa yentwasahlobo! Phakathi kwalezi "zinto ezintsha zempilo," ngiyajabula ukulethela abalungu bethu iphephandaba lesithathu lesigaba se-facets. Ngiyethemba ukuthi nizojabulela ukwengeza kwe-facets. Usizo lwe-AIDS (AfA) yinkampani ephatha ukuxhumana kwe-HIV/AIDS esebenza ne-GEMS ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso oluyimfihlo oludingayo ngenkathi uphila ne-HIV. Bangakusiza futhi uma udinga olunye ulwazi ngalesi sifo.

Ukuhamba phambili kwawo kuholele ekuxhumaneni nezinye izinhlobo zomculo, njengemizwelo ye-gospel, i-jazz, ne-kwaito, okwakha imisebenzi emisha ethokozisayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakheni umculo ogcwele injabulo, okwazi ukudansa abantu ezikhathini eziningi. Njengoba ama-Amapiano ekhula, abantu basemakhaya nabafudukela emadolobheni baqala ukusebenzisa lezi zindlela zokuphila ukuze baphile izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kuholele emicimbini emikhulu, lapho abantu behlangana, behudulela izinyathelo, behlanganyela imizwa futhi bejabulela ubudlelwane. Lokhu kwenza ama-Amapiano abe ngumculo odumile, kanti izinkanyezi ezivela kulo mkhuba zandisa umphakathi, zikhombisa izindlela zokuphila ezinhle. Ukwanda kwama-Amapiano akuphezu komculo kuphela, kodwa kukhombisa nezinguquko ezinkulu emiphakathini. Abaculi abavela kwezinye izindawo, ikakhulukazi eZimbabwe, eZambia, naseBotswana, baqala ukuvuselela ama-Amapiano, behlanganisa izitayela zabo zomculo ukuze bakhe umculo ophathekayo, ohambisana nezimo zabo. Lokhu kwenza ama-Amapiano abe yinkanyezi yokuhlanganyela phakathi kwamazwe. Eminyakeni edlule, ama-Amapiano aqhubeke nokukhula emhlabeni jikelele, futhi abaculi abasha baqala ukuveza imisebenzi emisha, behlanganisa ama-Amapiano nezitayela ezahlukene, okwenza umculo uthokozise abantu abaningi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokujabula, lapho abantu bekwazi ukujabulela iziphuzo, ukudla, nokuhlanganyela ngezindlela ezihlukene. Njengoba ama-Amapiano eqhubeka nokukhula, aqhubeka nokubamba abalandeli abaningi, abathanda umculo, nezizukulwane ezintsha.

i uma umphakathi uqobo noma omunye umphakathi ungumnikazi; noma ii njengoba kuxoxiwe esigabeni b encazelweni yendawo noma impahla esigabeni 1; noma iii lapho ilungelo lokuba umnikazi lendawo lingavikelwa ngokomthetho ngenxa yemithetho yokucwasa edlule noma ezinye izizathu ezenza kube nzima noma kungenzeki ukuthola inani; noma b ukuvimbela umphakathi ekunikezeni amalungelo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14 mayelana nezimali zokubuyiselwa, noma ukukhokha okweqile noma ukunciphisa ekukhokheni intela yezindlu ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1. b ukusetshenziswa okukhuthazwayo kwempahla noma indawo; noma c indawo lapho impahla ikhona. Inani lentela yezindlu ohlelweni lwendawo lapho yakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela endaweni eyodwa kufanele iklanywe ngendlela ehlukile ngokuya ngosayizi waleyo ndawo okufanele ibophelelwe yalesi sistimu futhi hhayi iklanywe njengemali eyodwa ehlanganisa yonke indawo. a kufanele kube inani elisekelwe ekuthuthukisweni kwenani lentela yezindlu yaleyo mpahla njengoba kuboniswe ephepheni lokuhlola lezakhamuzi ngaleso sikhathi; noma b intela efanayo empahleni noma endaweni esigabeni esithile esibekwe, kuye ngokuthi leyo ndawo ingaphansi kwenani lokuhlola elisemthethweni. Inani lentela yezindlu elifanayo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1 b akufanele lidlule inani okufanele likhokhwe empahleni noma emhlabeni ezingeni eliphansi lokuhlola ngokuhambisana nokuhlola ukuthi inani lakhiwe ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1 a. Intela yezindlu ingaklanywa ngamasipala ngaphezu kweminyaka eyodwa yezezimali ngaphandle kokuba ivunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe wezamasipala.

Isithombe 1: Izimpawu zezitshalo ezithintekayo zikhombisa ukuhamba kwalolu bhubhane. Bheka ama-sclerotia amnyama kanye ne-mycelium emhlophe. Isitshalo esinempilo singase sibe ngakolunye uhlangothi. Isithombe 2: I-mycelium emhlophe (fungus) ethishelweni lesitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 3: Ama-sclerotia ngaphakathi kwesitho sesitshalo esithintekayo. Isithombe 4: Ukuwa ngaphakathi komqolo. Isithombe 5: Ukuwa kwekhanda - lokhu kubonakala ngaphambi kokuba ikhanda lehle. Isithombe 6: Ukuhamba kwalolu bhubhane - ukuwa kwekhanda kanye naphakathi komqolo. Ama-sclerotia abuyiselwa emhlabathini ngesikhathi sokuvuna nasekulimeni. Kulesi sithombe, sizogxila kakhulu kulolu bhubhane olubalulekile oluthinta i-canola - Izifo ze-Sclerotinia. Kukhona izifo ezintathu, ukuwa (ukubola) okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia, ukuwa ngaphakathi komqolo, nokubola kwekhanda. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kubangelwa yifungus ehlala emhlabathini ebizwa nge-sclerotia, engena ezimpandeni ze-canola. Lokhu kubola kuhlukile ngoba kuqala ezimpandeni. I-Sclerotinia ebola ikhanda nomqolo ihamba emoyeni ngama-spores. Lezi yizifo ezibeka ingozi phezulu komhlaba kodwa zonke zifana engozini ezidalayo. Zonke ezintathu zibangelwa yisifo esisodwa esibizwa nge-Sclerotinia sclerotiorum, ifungus eliyingozi kakhulu elivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "i-mold emhlophe." Le fungus ifana naleyo ebangela i-mold emhlophe kuma-soybeans, ama-beans omisiwe, i-canola, nezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo ezivame ukuthinteka.

Ngemvume yenu, ngingathanda ukuthi ngubuyele emuva nginikhumbuze ukuthi sathini ngonyaka ka 2004, njengababhekeli besizwe, nangaphambi kwezihlobo zethu ezivela kwamanye amazwe, sihlangane endaweni yokuhlanganela kukahulumeni eUnion Building eTshwane ngelanga lenkululeko, ngosuku lokukhumbula inkululeko yethu yomnyaka weshumi, kanti futhi sahlanganyela nesizwe sibeka umongameli wokuqala embusweni wantando yeningi, owayeqokwe yiphalamende lethu, ngokuhlonishwa kwentshisekelo yesizwe okwakhonjiswa ngokhetho luka 2004. Sekuyisikhathi eside izwe lethu liqukethe ngaphakathi kwalo, kanti futhi lisebenzela okubi nokunyanyekayo emphakathini. Bokuyindawo lapho uthola ukuthi uma uzelwe wabansundu, uzuze ifa lesiqalekiso sempilo yakho yonke, uma uzelwe wabamhlophe, bowuthwele ukwesaba nentukuthelo efihliweyo... Bokuyindawo lapho ukungcola, iphunga lobumpofu, indle ehamba ebaleni, imbucumbucu yokubola, izixuku ezigcwele usizi, izwe elibanzi elisakazwe ngenfucumfucu budlabha, lendawo ibukela kanti futhi yengezela ubuhle belinye izwe elinezindlela ezicolile, nezimbali eziqhakazile ziphazamise ubuluhlaza botshani obuhlabelelayo, nezinyoni, nezindlu ezilungele amakhosi nezindlovukazi, nomculo omtoti kanye nothando. Bokuyindawo lapho ukuhlala endaweni ethize kuwukuzibizela abanye ukuthi bakugqweleze, noma ukuphendula umphangi, lapho abomakhelwane bazokugqilazwa wutshwala nezidakwamizwa ukuze bangabuzwa ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu abaziyo ukuthi impilo yabo ingeke ijwayeleke uma kungekho ukubulalana phakathi kwabo, ukudlwengulana kanye nezimpi zonya phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo.

ukulawulwa nokuphathwa kwezimali zebhodi ngokuhambisana noMthetho wezokuPhathwa kweziMali zikaHulumeni, 1999 uMthetho No. nokuqinisekiswa kokuhlangabezana kweBhodi nezihlinzeko zoMthetho wezokuPhathwa kweziMali zikaHulumeni, 1999 (uMthetho No. 1 ka 1999), kanye nanoma yimiphi eminye imithetho esebenzayo. Uma isiKhulu esiPhezulu nganoma yisiphi isizathu singakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yaso, iBhodi kumele, ngokubonisana neLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali, liqoke omunye umuntu ozoba yiBamba lesiKhulu esiPhezulu kuze kube isiKhulu esiPhezulu siyakwazi ukuba siqale ukwenza leyo misebenzi. ngenkathi, ngokoMthetho weziNkampani, 1973 uMthetho No. lapho sixoshwa esikhundleni ngokwesigatshana (2). IBhodi ngokubonisana neLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali inganqamula umsebenzi wesiKhulu esiPhezulu ngokuhambisana noMthetho wokuQasha nowabaSebenzi osebenzayo. nokusiza iBhodi ngomsebenzi othintana nokwenziwa yiBhodi emisebenzini yalo. IBhodi kumele, ngokweyame esigabeni 25(4), linqume inqubomgomo yezindaba eziphathelene nabasebenzi kumalungu abasebenzi besiKhungo, kubandakanya isiKhulu esiPhezulu. Ngokwezinhloso zokudalulwa kokuhlomula ngakwezezimali okunye ukuhlomula, nangokweyame esigabeni 18(1)(e), izihlinzeko zesigaba 7(3), (4) kanye no (5) zifakwa noshintsho oludingekile kumalungu abasebenzi besiKhungo. IsiKhungo singasebenzisa usizo lwabantu abasisiwe noma abadluliselwe besuka enyangweni kahulumeni ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zoMthetho wemiSebenzi kaHulumeni, 1994 (Isimemezelo No.

Uma kungekho i-Ofisa Egunyaziwe lomsebenzi unganikezwa UMqondisi: Wezinsiza Zomphakathi noma i-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu. I-Ofisa enegunya izakumisa ikomiti lokuhlola ibhidi ukwenza imisebenzi yokuhlola ebekwe ku-4.7 ukuya 4.9 ngenhla. Umgcinisihlalowekomiti lokuhlola ibhidi uzakukhethwa yi-Ofisa Enegunya futhi uzakushintshwa shintshwa njalo ngonyaka. (Kodwa, umgcinisihlalo akumele kube ngumuntu ozimele). Ilungu elilodwa kunguMenenja: Wezinsiza Zokubumbana noma Inhloko Yesigaba: Ezanaholo (osesikhundleni sokuba yisisebenzi sokuphatha ukunikezelwa kwemisebenzi), bese kuthi omunye kube ngumuntu ozimele. Uma umuntu ozimele engekho, I-ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu izawukhetha ozommela ozoba ngobukele ozimele. Inani eliwubukhulu belungu elengeziwe elilodwa elivela kumnyango ngamunye okutholiswa kuwo impahla nezinsiza (amalungu anje angafaka amalungu angaguquki). Uma kwenzeka amalungu anje omnyango angabikhona, isihloko(izihloko) zizawube sezidluliselwa emhlanganweni olandelayo. Amalungu akakwazi ukusebenza kunoma yiliphi ikomiti lokunquma elinquma nganoma yisiphi sezihloko ezike zabhekwa ekomitini lokuhlola. Uma kungekho i-CFO, uMenenja Kamasipala uzakusebenza njengomgcinisihlalo, uma nje iMenenja: Yizinsiza Zezezimali ikhona. Uma bengekho bobabili i-CFO kanye noMenenja Kamasipala, i-CFO izawukhetha enye i-ofishali ephezulu ukuthi isebenze njengomgcinisihlalo, uma nje umseebnzi wokuphatha ukunikezela imisebenzi, ekhethwe yi-CFO, ikhona.

Amathebula emali yokufaka ka-2010 afakiwe kulomhlahlandlela, ukuze ubone ukuthi ukukhuphuka kuzothinta kanjani iphakheji yakho. Ngithanda ukubonga ngokuqhubeka kokwesekwa kwakho futhi ngikufisela impilo enhle ngo-2010. Khumbula ukuthi i-GEMS iyinsizwa yakho empilweni enhle. Ekupheleni konyaka ngamunye, sinika amalungu ethu ithuba lokushintsha ukuya kwenye inketho yeziqu. Ukuze ukhethe, kudingeka ucabange ngezidingo zakho zokunakekelwa kwezempilo, izinzuzo ezitholakalayo kuyo yonke inketho, kanye nemali yokufaka ngayinye. Sicela uthathe lokhu kubalulekile njengoba uvunyelwe ukushintsha inketho yakho kanye kuphela ngonyaka. Uma ufuna ukushintsha inketho yakho ngo-2010, sicela ulandele lezi zinyathelo ezintathu ezilula ngezansi. Khumbula ukuthi ifomu lakho le-"Khetha" kumele lifike kithi ngaphambi noma ngemuva kosuku lwe-30 Novemba 2009. Lolu mhlahlandlela luhlanganisa izici ezihlukahlukene ze-GEMS. Luhloselwe ukuba kube isikhumbuzo esisheshayo kuphela futhi aluhlanganisi imithetho yeSchem. Uma kwenzeka ukungavumelani, imithetho ebhalwe phansi izothatha indawo.

Isaziso sikhishwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c), (e), (h) kanye (i) soMthetho Wezobuchwepheshe Bezempilo (Umthetho No. 35 ka-2004) ("okuzobizwa ngokuthi Umthetho"), sisho ukuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo uyamenywa abantu ukuba bathumele amagama abantu abazobekwa njengezithunywa zeBhodi Yesikhashana Yezempilo (okuzobizwa ngokuthi "iBhodi"). Isigaba 7 soMthetho sisho ukuthi iBhodi izokwakhiwa ngamalungu angama-22 abekwe nguNgqongqoshe. Isigaba h sesigaba 7 soMthetho sisho ukuthi abantu abathathu abamele umphakathi kumele babekwe njengezithunywa zeBhodi; kanti isigaba i sesigaba 7 sisho ukuthi ummember owodwa kumele abekwe emkhakheni wezempilo ngamunye, okungukuthi: umthandazi, umphakathi wezokwelapha ngempahla yemvelo, kanye nodokotela. Umuntu obekwe njengezithunywa zeBhodi ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(c) kanye (i) zoMthetho kumele ube sebenza njengochwepheshe bezempilo okungenani iminyaka engu-5 emkhakheni wezempilo ofanele. Iziphakamiso zabantu abazobekwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7(c) zoMthetho kumele zithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe wesifunda noma ilungu leBhodi elibhekelele ezempilo esifundeni lapho umphakathi usebenza khona, ngokukhethekile. Iziphakamiso zabantu abazobekwa ngaphansi kwezindawo 7(e), (h) kanye (i) zoMthetho kumele zithunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe Wezempilo. Iziphakamiso kumele zithunyelwe ngendlela echazwe emqulwini ofakwe ohlobene nokubekwa kwamalungu eBhodi ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho.

Ngelanga lokuhlakazwa kweNkampani okuhlongozwe esigatshaneni (1), zonke izimpahla, izikweletu, amalungelo, imisebenzi kanye nezibopho, kubandakanya noma iyiphi ingxenye engasetshenzisiwe yezimali eziyinzuzo noma ezitholwe yiNkampani zidluliselwa, futhi zitshalwa, esiKhungweni sezoHwebo kanye nokuTshalwa kweziMali ezisungulwe ngokwesigaba 2. IsiKhungo sezoHwebo kanye nokuTshalwa kweziMali saKwaZulu-Natali, maqondana nezimpahla, izikweletu, amalungelo, imisebenzi kanye nezibopho nezimali okukhulunywe ngazo esigatshaneni (2), ngazo zonke izinhloso singundlalifa kwezomthetho, kanye nondlalifa egameni, leNkampani. Amalungu eBhodi yeNkampani kumele asebenze njengamalungu eBhodi yesiKhungo agunyaziwe kuze kube yisikhathi lapho iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali ngokwesigaba 5(2) liyoqoka khona iBhodi ngokwalo Mthetho. Onke amalungu abasebenzi beNkampani kumele, ezinyangeni eziyisithupha kuqale ukusebenza kwaloMthetho, banikwe izikhala zomsebenzi yiLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali ukuthi badluliselwe esiKhungweni ngosuku olunqunywe yiLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali. Amaholo, imihlomulo kanye nezibonelelo ezinikezelwa yiLungu lomkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali, ngokuhambisana nesigatshana (1), akungabi ngaphansi kwalokhu okumele kukhokhelwe ilungu labasebenzi beNkampani, ngokushesha ekudluliselweni kwalo kwenye indawo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Nandi wanquma ukuhamba edolobheni elikhulu eliseduzane, lapho kuthiwa khona imithi iyatholakala. Waqala uhambo lwakhe, emoyizela izinyathelo zakhe. Wafika edolobheni, kodwa wathola ukuthi imithi ibiza kakhulu. U-Nandi wayengenamali eyanele, futhi lokhu kumshiya edidekile. Ngemva kokuhlala edolobheni, wahlangana noSizwe, umngane wakhe owayesebenza ezibhedlela. USizwe waphendula, "Nandi, ngiyazi ukuthi kudinga imithi, kodwa kufanele siqhubeke sikhuluma ngalezi zinkinga. Akukhona nje ukushoda kwemithi, kodwa kudinga ukuba sikhulume ngempilo yethu, nendlela yokwenza izibhedlela zisebenze kangcono." U-Nandi wathola umqondo omusha. Wavuma ukuthi kufanele kube nezinyathelo ezinkulu ezidingekayo ukuze kutholakale izixazululo. Bahlangana nabanye abantu bendawo, benza umhlangano wokukhuluma ngezinkinga ezibhekene nezibhedlela. Baphakamisa iziphakamiso, bafuna ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane emisha ukuze kube nokuthuthukiswa. Ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningana, uNandi wabona ukuthi abantu bezibhedlela bakhuluma kakhulu. Bahamba besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlinzeka ngemithi, basebenzisa izinsiza zomphakathi, nezinhlelo zokubambisana. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abantu bezwe bahlala bejolile, bephokophelela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ekugcineni, uGogo wathola imithi edingekayo. U-Nandi waba nomuzwa wokwaneliseka, ngoba wayebona ukuthi ukuxhumana nabanye abantu bekuyindlela yokuthola izixazululo. Wazi ukuthi ukushoda kwemithi akukhona kuphela, kodwa kuyinselele yokwakha umphakathi onamandla. U-Nandi waphinde waphuma esibhedlela, kodwa manje wayenokholo. Wayazi ukuthi imizamo yabo yayizokwenza umehluko.

Ukwenza - Isigaba sokugcine se-AIDA ukubonisa amakhasimende akho ukuthi bangenza kanjani ukuthenga umkhiqizo wakho - ngamanye amazwi, loku ukwenza. Ukukhangisela ibhizinisi elincane kungabiza kakhulu njengethuluzi lokuqhubekisa. Kodwa, kungadingeka ukuthi ukhangise ukufika ezingeni elithile ukukhuphula amandla okwazi ukwazi ngebhizinisi lakho. Ukukhangisa kuvela ngezinhlobo eziningi, ezifana nomabionakude, umsakazo, amaphosta, amaphephandaba kanye namaphephabhuku. Ukuthola ukwaziswa ephephandabeni kungaba yithuluzi eliyigugu kakhulu lokuqhubekisa. Imisebenzi ye-PR ayibizi kakhulu uthi ithembeke kakhulu ukwedlula ukukhangisa. Leli thuluzi lisebenza ngokufanele ukwakha ukwenziwa komsindo ukukuzungeza futhi yinhle kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni amakhasimende. Kanye futhi nokuthi ayikho into eyenelisa njengokufunda okubhaliwe ephephandabeni lendawo noma likazwelonke ngebhizinisi okungelakho. Mema umsakazo wendawo noma ababhali bezindaba ze-TV ukuzobazisa ngomkhiqizo wakho. Uma ungenayo imali yokukhiqiza amabhulosha noma izincwajana zokwazisa ngokobungcweti ngaloko ungasebenzisa okokwenza okuthambile okuqukethwe yikhompyutha uzenzele ngokwakho. Kodwa imali oyisebenzisayo kunesizathu sokuthi uyisebenzise kuleli thuluzi lokuxhumana ukukhiqiza ibhulosha elibukeka liwubungcweti. Uma ufanekisa ibhulosha zama ukuyenza ibe yimfushane futhi ibe lula.

Waqala ngokuhamba ngezinyawo nokubamba izimota ezindala, ezemoto eziyinqaba zashintsha pungwe imibono emisha yokuthi abantu bangaba nosizo lwezithuthi emalokishini. Ubuqotho nokuqamba kwakhe kuye kwaholela ekukhuleni kwenani labantu abaqala ukwenza izinkampani zabo zokuthutha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sashintsha izinkanyezi zempumelelo ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi abavamile ukuba nemibono eqondile. Njengoba abantu baphila bejolise ezingeni lokuphila elijwayelekile, izinto baziheha ngezinhloso ezicacile. UPhindile Mthembu, kwazise uyinxusa lendawo, waba ngonoya eqhelisile obaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni umnotho oyindlunkulu emalokishini. Wavula ibhizinisi elincane lokudayisa ukudla ukuze ahlinzeke abantu abahamba-mgodi. Imiqondo yezezimali nemigomo ayekungeniswe emalokishini nayo yahola ekuphuhliseni izitolo ezincane ezikhiqiza imikhiqizo yendawo. Abantu banikela isikhathi, basebenzisa amakhono amaningi anothi, ukwenza imikhiqizo efana nezithako zezindawo zomdabu. Lokhu kwaba ukuhlaziywa okukhangayo nolimi lokukhuthaza olunempumelelo. Njengoba amabhizinisi emalokishini eqhubeka nokukhula, abanikazi bangabantu abaphuma ezinkampanini ezinkulu zaphesheya. Izifundo zabo zifundisa ukuthi abantu bangakhulisa izinkampani zabo uma behlakanipha ekuxhumaneni, befunda ezicini ezihlukahlukene. umkhiqizo, ukuphatha impahla, nokubambisana phakathi kwamaqembu amancane. Izifundo zabasunguli bamabhizinisi babukeka zingaphezulu kwezifundo – bezibophezela emiphakathini yabo, behlinzeka ngemisebenzi, futhi begcizelela umoya wokubambisana.

g eminye imibandela ebalulekile ukuvikela iqophelo lomoya. noma yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathiwe noma ezizothathwa ukunqanda isimo sokuphindeka kwalokho kwehluleka noma amalinge okunciphisa umthelela wokwehluleka. Imvume yokukhiqiza isisi emoyeni ingedluliselwa komunye umuntu ngumnikazi wayo, ngokuthola imvume yomkhandlu okhipha izimvume. Leso sicelo siyokwenziwa emkhandlwini kuleyo ndawo lapho kuqhutshwa khona isenzo esisohlwini. b yizincwadi noma imibhalo nolwazi olunganqunywa ngumkhandlu wemvume, ngokuhambisana nemithetho yangaphakathi esikhungweni. Uma ucubungula isicelo semvume yomkhiqizo wesisi emoyeni, umkhandlu wemvume kufanele ubhekele zonke izinhlangothi zodaba, kuhlangene nokuthi umuntu okudluliselwa kuye imvume ukulungele futhi ufanele yini njengoba umhlahlandlela wesigaba- 42 ubika. d ngesicelo esibhaliwe somnikazi wemvume. c ukususa isimo noma umbandela; noma d ukuchibiyela isimo noma umbandela. Noma ngubani ofuna ukugcina inyathi, kumele aqale abhalise umhlaba noMnyango weZoLimo. Thola ifomu lesicelo kwi-website, ebese uligcwalisa ngokuprinta. Lingatholakala nakwihhovisi lendawo yempilo wezilwane kahulumeni. Cela udokotela wezilwane kahulumeni oseduzane nawe ukuthi ahlole umhlaba kanye nothango , kanye nokuqinisekisa isimo sezifo senyathi. Inhloko yezinkonzo zempilo yezilwane kwisifundazwe kumele ufakezele ukuthi kukhona imithombo efanele yokuqapha isimo epulazini njalo-njalo, nokuthi ukuhamba-hamba kwenyathi epulazini kanye nangaphandle kwepulazi kungaphathwa kahle ngendlela efanele nokuthi kuzokwazeka ukuthi kulandelelwe ngokushesha yonke into okungenzeka ihambe ngendlela engavamile. isitifikedi esigunyazisiwe sokubiyelwa kahle ngendlela efanele, esikhishwa ziphathimandla zokugcinwa kwemvelo/kwendalo ikhophi yemephu ekhombisa umkhawulo wawo wonke umhlaba okwenziwa isicelo sobhaliso lwawo. Isikhathi esithathwayo ukubonelela isicelo nokwamukelwa kwaso kuyahluka kusifundazwe ngesifundazwe . Uma isicelo sesamukelwe, sithunyelwa kuMnyango kazwelonke wezoLimo. Izikhulu kumnyango kazwelonke, zinikeza ngenombolo yobhaliso , zingezela ulwazi kwirejista yezinyathi kuzwelonke kanye nokuprinta isitifikedi serejistreshini esinikezwa umnikazi womhlaba. Le nqubo ingathatha izinsuku ezilishumi zokusebenza. Le nkonzo ngeyamahhala ayikhokhelwa.

UNovak Djokovic: Umphakathi Wokudlala Itennis Emhlabeni UNovak Djokovic, umdlali odumile we-tennis, wazalwa ngoJulayi 22, 1987, eBelgrade, eSerbia. Uhlanga lwakhe luhlanganisa izimpande zamasiko aseYurophu, kodwa impilo yakhe ibingeyona eyomndeni kuphela, futhi ibingeyona eyomphakathi. Wakhulela ezweni elibhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi seMpi Yezwe Yesibili, kodwa lokhu akukavumi ukuvimba ekufezekiseni amaphupho akhe. Umdlalo wakhe we-tennis waqala esencane, lapho enza khona izifundo ezijabulisayo, efuna ukufunda umdlalo. UNovak wathola uthisha odumile, uMarjan Vajda, owamsiza ukuba aqonde kahle imithetho ye-tennis nokuthi angathuthukisa kanjani imidlalo yakhe. Ngemva kokuzikhandla, uNovak waqala ukujabulisa izithameli ngezindlela zakhe ezihlukile zokudlala, ezamthuthukisa ekubeni isikhumbuzo emlandweni. Ukunqoba kwakhe kokuqala kwenzeka ngo-2003, lapho enqoba umqhudelwano we-ATP e-Amersfoort, eNetherlands, okuwukuhamba kwesinyathelo sokuqala endleleni yakhe yokuba ngumdali ophumelelayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, uNovak waqhubeka nokukhula emkhakheni we-tennis, wathola iziqu eziningi ezibalulekile, kuhlanganise neGrand Slam, okuyizindlalifa ezinkulu zomhlaba. Umdlalo wakhe ubukeka unamandla, ubonisa ubuchule obuphezulu, kanye nekhono lokuphendula ezimeni ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-2011, uNovak wathola impumelelo enkulu, waba ngumdlali wokuqala ukuncintisana noRoger Federer noRafael Nadal, abanye bama-greats emlandweni we-tennis. Uqhubekile nokudlala kahle, wathola iziqu eziningi, futhi waba nguMphakathi Wokudlala Itennis.

Ilungu lesiGungu esikhulu sesifundazwe elijutshwe nguNdunankulu. Ilungu lesiGungu esikhulu elijutshwe ngamanye amalungu esiGungu. IBamba likaNdunankulu linezibopho, amandla nemisebenzi kaNdunankulu. uMthethosisekelo, njengokubeka kukaSheduli 2. esishayamthetho aqokwe nguNdunankulu amahlanu noma ngaphezulu kodwa angeqile eshumini. nemisebenzi, futhi angawasusa esikhundleni. yesigungu abethweswe yona nguNdunankulu. nanjengelungu ngalinye kwisishayamthetho mayelana namandla okwenziwa kwemisebenzi yawo. maqondana nezindaba ezilawulwa yiwo. lowo muntu okhethwe yisishayamthetho esilandelayo. athobele uMthethosisekelo, ngokuhambisana neSheduli 2. ehambisana nohlelo lokuziphatha olubekwe ngumthetho kazwelonke. ukuzenzela inzuzo noma ukwenzela omunye inzuzo engafanele. amandla noma umsebenzi onikezwe elinye ilungu ngokomthetho. kugcinwe ubumbano lomnotho. futhi senze noma yiziphi izincomo ezilungile kwisiGungu esikhulu sesifundazwe. Umthetho kazwelonke ungalawula uhlelo olumiswe kulesi sigaba. lowomthetho uyingxenye unomphumela osemthethweni. esikhulu uma leso sinqumo sixhumene nomsebenzi owabelwe lelo lungu. yesifundazwe kufanele umphakathi ukwazi ukufinyelela kuyo. yamukelwe yisishayamthetho sesifundazwe. yiningi lamalungu esiGungu, uNdunankulu kufanele asakhe kabusha iSigungu. namanye amalungu esiGungu esikhulu kufanele bashiye isikhundla. bamalungu aso bevote beseka uMthethosichibiyelo. Okuqukethwe ngumthethosisekelo wesifundazwe. loMthethosisekelo eNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo ukuze uqinisekiswe.

Umregistrar kumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi esibhekiswe esigabeni (2)(b) ngenhla, athumele udaba kumphathi ophakanyisiwe, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyisikhombisa ngemuva kokwamukela wonke amadokhumenti ahlobene nalolo daba, akhiphe isinqumo sokuthi udaba luzophakanyiswa enkantolo noma luthunyelwe kwenye iforamu. Uma umphathi ophakanyisiwe ethatha isinqumo sokuthi udaba kufanele luphakanyiswe enkantolo, kumele athumele udaba kumregistrar, okumele, phakathi nezinsuku ezintathu ngemuva kokwamukela lolo daba, abeke usuku lokulalelwa kwalolo daba. Umregistrar kumele, ngemuva kokubeka usuku lokulalelwa kwalolo daba, wazise umfaki-sicelo nomphenduli ngaleso sikhathi sokulalelwa besebenzisa ifomu efana neFomu 4 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Bangase benze iziphakamiso noma imibono ebhaliwe abacabanga ukuthi ifanele ukuba icatshangelwe yile nkantolo besebenzisa ifomu efana nesigaba 2 seSigaba A seFomu 5 ehlanganiswe ne-Anexure. Kumele bazise zonke izigaba ezithintekayo kulolu daba ngamadokhumenti athunyelwe kule nkantolo abhekiswe esigabeni (a). Ngemuva kokuthi inkantolo ezokulalela udaba itholile amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni (8)(a), le nkantolo kumele ikhiphe isikhumbuzo esibhaliwe esazisa zonke izigaba ezithintekayo ngalolu daba nomregistrar wenkantolo ngokuqinisekiswa kokwamukelwa kwalolu daba. I nkantolo ethunyelwe udaba kumele, phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-60 ngemuva kokwamukela amadokhumenti abhekiswe esigabeni (8), ithumele umbiko kumregistrar wenkantolo, ibika ngentuthuko eyenziwe kulolu daba.

Izitshalo zikabhontshisi wesoya zitheleleka kalula yizifo zamagciwane athile, izifo zokukhunta, izifo zamagciwane ayi-virus nezifo zezidalwa eziphila ngokudla umzimba wezinye. Ubhontshisi wesoya wawuyisitshalo esibalulekile eMpumalanga Eshiya kudaladala ngaphambi kokuthi abantu bakwazi ukubhala. Useyisitshalo esiphuma phambili eShayina, eJapan naseKorea. Ngaphambi kokuba khona kwemikhiqizo evezwe ngokwendlela yembiliso enjengesinongo seSoy sauce, i-tempeh, i-natto ne-miso, isoya yayithathwa njengesitshalo esingcwele ekushintshanisweni kwayo nezinye izitshalo njengendlela yokuvuselela i-nitrogen. Izitshalo zazilinywa ngaphansi ukuze kuvulwe isikhala sezitshalo eziletha ukudla kwabantu. Isoya yethulwa kwelaseYurophu ekuqaleni konyaka khulu we-18 nase-United States ngo-1765, lapho yaqala ukulinywa njengokudla kwezilwane. Ubhontshisi wesoya awuzange ubaluleke kangako e-Eshiya kwaze kwaba ngu-1910. EMelika, isoya yayithathwa njengomkhiqizo webhizinisi kuphela kodwa ingasetshenziswa njengokudla kwaze kwaba yiminyaka yowe-1920. Isoya ifike e-Afrika ivela eShayina ngasekupheleni konyaka khulu we-19 kanti manje isisabalele kulo lonke leli zwekazi. Idlozi lasendle likabhontshisi wesoya yi-Glycine soja (eyayaziwa ngokuthi yi-G. ussuriensis), isitshalo esingumdumba sakwelangaphakathi neShayina. Ubhontshisi wesoya usetshenziswe kwelaseShayina eminyakeni eyi-5 000 njengokudla nanjengengxenye yokwakha imithi yokwelapha.

Amaqembu athintekayo axazulula udaba lwabo. Akukho ukusiza ekuxazululeni udaba oluvela kumuntu wesithathu. Le nqubo ibhekwa ngamaqembu athintekayo. Iqembu ngalinye elithintekayo lingasebenzisa abeluleki bezomthetho, kodwa lokho akudingekile. Umphumela uncike kumandla nobuchule bamaqembu athintekayo. Azikho izindleko zomthetho ngaphandle kwezindleko zomeluleki wezomthetho uma zisetshenziswe. Amaqembu athintekayo axazulula udaba lwabo. Umuntu wesithathu angasiza ekuxazululeni udaba. Le nqubo ibhekwa ngumxhumanisi ophendula kumqondisi. Abeluleki bezomthetho bamaqembu athintekayo abadingeki uma le nqubo yenziwa. Umphumela ungaba yifiso yomxhumanisi kodwa abenzi izinqumo. Umphumela uvame ukuba yisimo sokuwina/ukulahlekelwa. Amaqembu athintekayo akhokha izindleko zomxhumanisi uma zikhona. Le ndlela ibonisa ukuthi umuntu wesithathu, umxhumanisi/umuntu olethe ukuthula, udingeka ukusiza amaqembu athintekayo axazulule izinkinga zawo. Kungachazwa njengokuxoxisana okusekelayo. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi ukulethela udaba kumxhumanisi ngamaqembu athintekayo kwenziwa ngenhloso, kodwa ngokomthetho, isiko noma isivumelwano kungadinga ukuthi amaqembu athintekayo alethe udaba lwabo kumxhumanisi. Kuyahlonishwa ukuthi umxhumanisi abe ngumuntu owamukelekayo kumqondisi womabili amaqembu athintekayo, umuntu ongaxhunywanga nganoma iyiphi indlela kumqondisi noma udaba. Umxhumanisi akumele athathe izinkanyezi. Umxhumanisi akwenzi izinqumo kumqondisi athintekayo. Indima yomxhumanisi ukusiza amaqembu athintekayo axazulule izinkinga zabo.

Isiphetho Ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni kahulumeni kubalulekile ukuze abathola impesheni bathole izinzuzo zabo ngendlela efanele. Izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe inombolo yempesheni, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi abathola impesheni bazi izinkinga ezivamile ezihambisana nale nqubo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuthi umsebenzisi ahlale eqaphile futhi alandele izinqubo ezisemthethweni. Ngokwenza lokhu, abathola impesheni bangakwazi ukujabulela izinzuzo zabo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka, futhi kuholele ekuthuthukiseni impilo yabo.

Manjena ke sengizokufundela uhla lwemiithombo yemali ongase kuba uyayisebenzisa. Uma ubuka ezinyangeni ezingu 12 ezedlule, ungangitshela nje ukuthi imali eyenziwe ngokusendimeni ekhaya ibe ngakanani ngeviki noma ngenyanga noma ngonyaka Siza ungitshele noma isiphi isithuba esilula kuwe? Uma kungu- yebo, yisho inani. Ungahlawumbisela selilonke lemali engenile ekhaya esikhathini esingaba [faka inkathi uyithathela kwikholamu eyedlule]? a. Inkokhelo ngokusebenza, iholo lasemsebenzini? b. Imali oyithola ngokudayisa, ngokuhweba noma ngokudayisa kukamahambanendlwana? c. Imali oyithola ngokuqashisa indawo yokuhlala? Uma kungu- yebo, yisho inani. Ungahlawumbisela inani selilonke lemali engenile ekhaya esikhathini esiyi- [faka inkathi] esedlule? d. Shono imali yomhlalaphansiy (yasemsebenzini) impeshini, isikhwama sempesheni osifakela imali, imali ozihlinzeke ngayo ngomshuwalense noma eyesondlo sikahulumeni senhlalakahle? e. Inzalo, isabelo samasheya (isibonelo, ku-akhawunti yokonga kumbe imali elondolozwe isikhathi esinqunyiwe)? Ngakho-ke, ukuhlola le mininingwane, ungayilinganisela kumalini isiyonke imali eniyithole kuyo YONKE imithombo ezinyangeni ezingu 12 ezedlule? Bangaki abantu abethembele kule mali? UMBUZI MIBUZO: Leli nani kufanele ibale nomphenduli mibuzo - ngalokho ke faka "01" uma kungumphenduli mibuzo kuphela owethembele/owesekwa yile mali. Kungabe amalungu omuzi kumbe ekhaya lakho kukhona izikwenetu anazo njengamanje noma ezemali ebolekisayo? Q0726a. Singakanani lesikwenetu sesisonke nesemali ebolekiwe?

Kunokwehluka phakathi kokwahlulela uma kukhona ukungaboni ngaso linye nokusiza amaqembu athintekayo ekuxazululeni. Ekwahluleleni, umuntu ongengxenye yokungaboni ngaso linye uthatha isinqumo mayelana nokungaboni ngaso linye, futhi leso sinqumo kumele sibe sihlose amaqembu athintekayo. Uma umuntu ongengxenye yokungaboni ngaso linye esiza la maqembu ekuxazululeni, sithi lokho kuyisixazululo noma ukuvuselela. Uma amaqembu athintekayo exazulula izinkinga zawo ngaphandle kokungenelela komuntu wesithathu, lokhu kuyisiphumo senqubo yokuxoxisana phakathi kwamaqarhu amabili. Abaphathi bezomthetho ezinkantolo bathola amandla abo okwahlulela ngokuba baqokwe ngokwezimiso zomthetho. Kuphinde kube nokwenzeka ukuthi amaqembu athintekayo alethe izinkinga zawo ukuze zihlulelwe ngumuntu abavuma ukuba kube umlandeli. Ezivumelwaneni eziningi, amaqembu afaka isigaba esivuma ukuthi noma iyiphi ingxabano ephuma phakathi kwabo ezivumelwaneni zawo izodluliselwa kumxhumanisi. Umxhumanisi angabizwa noma isigaba singachaza ukuthi umxhumanisi uzokhethwa kanjani, njengomthetho okhethwe yiBar Association. Isivumelwano sokuhamba kumxhumanisi asidingi ukuba sibhale. Emiphakathini ethile noma emindenini, kungase kube nesivumelwano sokuthi ingxabano izodluliselwa kumholi womphakathi noma kumholi wemindeni ngoba lokho kuyisiko elalandelwa isikhathi eside. Ingxabano ithathwa njengokwenziwa ngumuntu ophathiswe nguhulumeni. Amaqembu athintekayo awakwazi ukukhetha ukuthi ubani umuntu ophathiswe. Le nqubo ibhekwa ngemicimbi, imithetho, noma izivumelwano zenkantolo. Kungaba nzima kumaqembu athintekayo ukuqhubeka ngaphandle kokwethulwa komthetho. Isinqumo kumele sibe sihambisana nesibonelo esisebenzayo.

Le nkonzo isebenza kuphela kubantu abanamakhono noma amakhwalifikheshini anqabile. Izicelo zingenziwa ehhovisi laboMnyango wezaseKhaya noma kwinxusa laseNingizimu Afrika noma i-mission uma kwenziwa isicelo ngaphandle. Asikho isidingo sokukhombisa ukuthi unikezwe umsebenzi ezweni. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo, i-BI-947 no-BI-29. Ukuze ukhombise aboMnyango ukuthi unamakhono noma amakhwalifikheshini anqabile , kumele ufakele incwadi evela kumkhakha kahulumeni wangaphandle noma waseNingizimu Afrika, noma kwisikhungo semfundo esemukelekile nekudala sikhona saseNingizimu Afrika, isikhungo sezamasiko, noma inhlangano yebhizinisi eqinisa ukuthi unamakhono noma amakhwalifikheshini ayinqayizivela nanqabile. Fakela i-curriculum vitae kanye nobunye ubufakazi bamakhono kanye/noma amakhwalifikheshini anqabile. Ukuze uqinise isicelo sakho, ungafakela nama-testimonial abuya kubaqashi bakho bakudala. Asikho isikhathi esibekiwe sale nkonzo. Power of attorney in respect of an application/extension of immigration permit or temporary residence maqondana nesicelo kwimvume yokuhlala isikhashana noma yokuhlala unomphela.

Ukuze kwenziwe kangcono ikhwalithi kanye nokusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele kwamakhemisi ngemigomo yamaphilisi ehlanganisiwe kazwelonke. Amasela eba ithusi awuvanzi emphakathini asusa uhlelo lonke lwamapayipi amanzi emizini. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ngoba udokotela uchazile ukuthi yibaphi abasebenzi nokuthi mangaki ama-ambulensi anawo. Faka amaphaneli asebenza ngelanga kuphahla ukuze ahlinzeke ngogesi ozokwenza ukuthi ugesi udliwe kancane yizinto ezisebenza ngogesi ezifana nethelevishini, imisakazo, amalambu kagesi kanye nesiqansidi. Indawo ehlanzekile nenempilo ixhumene ngokungehlukaniswe nokwenziwa ngcono kwezenhlalo nomnotho kwabo bonke abantu, kusho uNgqongoshe u-Essop. Abezindaba bayamenywa ukuthi bazocoshela izindaba ekusayinweni kwalesi sivumelwano. Inhloso ye-MIP ukunika umfutho ukutshalwa kwezimali ngaphakathi embonini eyakha imikhiqizo. Isitolo esithengisa uphuzo oludakayo sashiswa futhi sasisendleleni eya ekhaya. Uma singenabo phakathi kwethu abathatha isitatimende namhlanje, kungenxa yengcindezi yomsebenzi ehhovisi. Lokho osekudlulile kuba okwedlule njengoba isikhathi sisusa kwinkumbulo lokho okwakwenzeke empilweni. Kulungile, umbuzo wami wokugcina umayelana nalokho owakusho ngesikhathi uya eLusaka. Isitatimende sithe uKonare ubelandela ngokukhathazeka okukhulu lokho obekwenzeka eZimbabwe. Uhulumeni weSifundazwe uzoqinisekisa ukuthi uyahambisana nesinqumo sawo ngayo yonke indlela. Ingqumbi kamanyolo ihlinzeka ngendawo lapho lolu hlelo lwemvelo lungenzeka khona ngokushesha. Uma kungenzeka okungamaqiniso kuphikwe, iKomidi lizophoqeleka ukuthi libambe umhlangano wokulalela ukuze kuhlonzwe amaqiniso. "

I-WHO inikeze iseluleko ukuthi amazwe afanele agxile ekunciphiseni umthelela wale gciwane emphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Leli gciwane lisabalala ngeziphuzo zokuphefumula, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu othintekile ekhwehlela noma ekhala, uphonsa lezi ziphuzo ezikhiphayo noma ezingavikelwanga. Nakuba bengavikela umlomo wabo, ungase uphumelele umoya lapho bekhipha khona lezi ziphuzo. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele banezimpawu ezilula futhi abadingi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ubani ongezimpawu ezilula noma ezinzima kufanele afune futhi athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa eNational Institute for Communicable Diseases eGauteng, esivule isikhungo eWestern Cape. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngesiphakamiso sikadokotela. Abaguli abadinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lwezempilo lukamasipala akufanele bacela ukuhlolwa ezikhungweni zocwaningo. Siyazi ukuthi lokhu kwenzekela ezikhungweni zezempilo ezizimele, kodwa akukhona okudingwa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele baphathe amacala aphakanyisiwe ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso zokudluliswa kolwazi (protocol) ezinikezwe uMnyango Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa okukhethwayo nguTamiflu. Ukwelashwa okujwayelekile ngeTamiflu kuzoholela eziphethweni zokwelashwa ezingcono uma le mithi isetshenziswa futhi kungavimbela labo abangase bafe. Ulwazi olutholakala emhlabeni jikelele lukhombisa ukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikhungo zemfundo kanye nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, izitolo, nezindawo zokusebenza akusebenza ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwale gciwane. Nokho, lokhu kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu emphakathini.

Ngalesi, ngifaka isicelo sesikhundla esikhulunywe ngenhla kwiMasipala futhi ngiqinisekisa ukuthi izimpendulo zami ezibuzwe ngenhla ziqinile ngokuphelele. Ngiyakuqonda ukuthi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane engaqondile noma engaqondile kungaba yisisusa sokuxoshwa kwami.

Sikhuluma nje kusenokusilela emuva okukhulu ekuhlinzekweni kwabantu bakithi ngezindlu zangasese ezinenhlazeko, futhi lokhu kugqama kakhulu ezindaweni ezifana nalena yaseNdaka lapho khona iningi labantu elalithathwa uhulumeni wobandlululo njengezitha -lihlala khona. Okwakukubi ngobandlululo ukuthi lwadala ukungalingani emphakathini, hhayi nje ngokobuhlanga kodwa nangasekuhlinzekweni ngezindingo ngqangi zempilo. Uzothola ukuthi umakhelwane ongale komgwaqo wayenamanzi, enethoyilethe elishaywayo futhi enogesi, bese kuthi omunye umakhelwane aphile ngaphansi kwezimo ezehlisa isithunzi nezingenayo inhlanzeko. Ngokusobala lokhu kusatshalaliswa kwezidingo (kwezinsizasidingo) ngendlela engenakho ukulingana kwakwenziwa ngamabomu emzameni kahulumeni wobandlululo wokwehlisa abantu bakithi isithunzi. Ngesikhathi singena esikhathini senqubo yentando yeningi sazibophezela njengohulumeni wabantu ukuba sisilungise lesi simo. Umsebenzi wethu obalulekile owokuqinisekisa ukuthi izigidi zalabo ababengalethelwa izidingo phambilini bayazithola futhi bayahlomula. Sathatha izinqumo eziningi kule ngqungquthela. Kodwa-ke sonke savumelana ngokuthi indlela yokusebenza okumele siyilandele kohulumeni basekhaya kumele kube ngeyokuzibambela mathupha. Lokhu kwabe sekuba yingqikithi yengqungquthela yethu. Sabuye savumelana futhi ukuthi lezi zinqumo zizolandelwa. Ngamanye amazwi savumelana ngokuthi singabi nezimbizo nezingqungquthela zokukhuluma kwenziwe nemibiko nje kuphela. Savumelana ngokuthi sizolandela indlela yokuzibambela ekwenzeni umsebenzi wethu wokuletha izidingo njengohulumeni wasekhaya.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, amaPirates aqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi ophilayo. Abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uthando lwezemidlalo lungaphezu kokuphumelela; luwumoya ophilayo, umoya ohlanganyela abantu abaningi. Uhambo lwama-Orlando Pirates luhlala lukhumbuleka, luhlala luhamba phambili. Abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uthando lwezemidlalo lungaphezu kokuphumelela; luwumoya ophilayo, umoya ohlanganyela abantu abaningi. Ngakho-ke, ama-Orlando Pirates awaqhubeki nje kuphela njengamaqembu, kodwa njengomndeni, umndeni owawuhlanganyela ngothando lweqembu. Uhambo lwabo luhlala lukhumbuleka, luhlala luhamba phambili, futhi abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kuyisibonelo sokuthi uthando lwezemidlalo lungaphezu kokuphumelela; luwumoya ophilayo, umoya ohlanganyela abantu abaningi. Ngakho-ke, uma ubona amaPirates edlala, khumbula ukuthi akukhona nje ukudlala, kodwa kuyisiko, kuyisiko elihlanganyela abantu, elihlanganyela umphakathi, elihlanganyela uthando. Ama-Orlando Pirates, iqembu elidume kakhulu, lihlala lukhumbuleka, luhlala luhamba phambili, futhi abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo.

Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni izinkampani zinciphe imisebenzi, zinciphise abasebenzi, futhi kube nomthelela omubi emnothweni jikelele. Okwesibili, ezokuxhumana ziba yinkinga enkulu uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi. Izinhlelo ezithinta ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlaka zikahulumeni, izikhungo zomphakathi, kanye nezinkampani zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsizakalo eziphumelelayo. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, abantu bangase bangatholi ulwazi oludingekayo, okwenza kube nzima kubo ukuthola izinsizakalo ezisemqoka. Lokhu kungaholela ekuphazamisekeni kokuphathwa kwezinhlelo, okungaholela ekwandeni kwezikhalazo, nokwehla kokwaneliseka kwabantu. Okwesithathu, ukuphathwa kwemithombo kuyinkinga enkulu uma izinhlelo ze-SITA zingasebenzi. Izinhlelo zokuphatha imithombo, njengezinhlelo zokuphatha abasebenzi, izinsiza, nezinsizakalo, zidinga ukuba zisebenze kahle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imithombo iyasetshenziswa kahle. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, imithombo ingase ingasetshenziswanga kahle, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwemali, isikhathi, kanye nezinsiza. Lokhu kungaba nomthelela omkhulu ekusebenzeni kwezinhlaka zikahulumeni, njengoba imithombo ingase ingafinyeleli ezindaweni ezidinga usizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umthelela wokungasebenzi kwezinhlelo ze-SITA ungaholela ekwandeni kokungathembeki. Uma izinhlelo zingasebenzi, abantu bangase baphendule ngokungathembeki, okungaholela ekwandeni kokukhwabanisa. Lokhu kungaholela ekulahlekelweni kokwethembeka emiphakathini, uma abantu bengakholwa ekutheni izinhlelo zikahulumeni zisebenza kahle.

Abasebenzi bavamise ukuba nemibono ephusile, egxile ezintweni ababhekana nazo emsebenzini yabo yemihla, ngakho kuhle ukuthi ubafake nabo ezinqumweni ozithathayo. Emva kokuba usunqumile ukuthi yikhuphi okumele kwenziwe, kumele uhlele ukuthi uzokwenza kanjani futhi nini lokho. Ukubhala phansi kuyokusiza ukuphumelelisa leli su. Kuyomele ubuyekeze ukuhlola kwakho uma kube noshintsho olukhulu endleleni osebenza ngayo noma uma unezizathu zokucabanga ukuthi kukhona okungasalungile. Ukusebenza endaweni enesimo sezulu esishintshashintshayo, umsindo noma ukungqangqazela. Ukuqukula amafulaha asindayo nokusebenza ungamile waqonda kungadala ubuhlungu bemisipha. Lobu buhlungu emilenzeni, emajoyintini naseqolo bungadalwa ukunyenuka kwemisipha. Gwema ukuqukula amafulaha asindayo uma kungenzeka noma ukusebenza ngokukhanda. Qukula izinto ngendlela okuyiyo - beka izinyawo zakho ngendlela, gcina umhlane wakho uqondile futhi ugcine imithwalo oyitatamisayo iseduze nomzimba wakho. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokusebenzela iqoqwe ngendlela yokuthi izinto zokusebenza nomkhiqizo kungafinyeleleka kukhona ngaphandle kokwelula imisipha kakhulu futhi zama ukushintshashintsha imisebenzi okumele yenziwe noma ukunyakaza ukuze kusebenze imisipha ehlukahlukene emzimbeni. Izithuthi ezisetshenziswa ngezandla indawo ende, zezitshalo nembewu kumele zigwenywe uma kungenzeka, ukuvikela izimpilo zabasebenzi. Izingozi eziningi emapulazini zifaka imishini. Ezinye zenzeka ngoba umshini usetshenziselwe umsebenzi ongawulungele, ezinye zenziwa wukuthi okokuvala akukho noma kususiwe. Kumele kube nohlelo lokuhlola ukuthi izinto zokusebenza esingabala kuzo nemishini, ziphephile ukuthi zingasetshenziswa.

Ubudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba bokuthula nokuvikela iziqoqo. Lezi zicabango zashintsha zaba izenzo ngonyaka odlule? Umnyango usungule indlela eqinile yokuphatha eholelwa ngumenzi, ixhaswe ngumsizi wemenzi kanye noMphakathi-Jikelele. Indlela yokuhlangana kwabaphathi nendlela yokwethula iziphakamiso nokuphatha izinsiza zabantu ithole ukunakwa okukhulu ngenxa yomsebenzi weqembu elisha lokuphatha izinsiza zabantu. Njengoba umbiko wezinsiza zabantu uthi, zonke izinhloso zokwakhiwa kwabaphathi zifeziwe. Sikholelwa ukuthi inhloso eyinhloko yezinhlaka zonke ezixhaswe yi-DACST (isayensi, ubuciko, ifa, izilimi) ukuhlanganisa izindlela zokuphatha ezisekelwe kumbono owabelwana ngawo nentshisekelo yokuhloniphana nokwethembeka. Ulwazi nomnyango. Lezi zinsimu kufanele zithuthukise izinqubomgomo ezizokwamukela futhi zithuthuk

Masixoxe ngemva kokuvuna izitshalo zakho ze-maize zonyaka ka-2010, ukuhlela okunembile kwesizini yonyaka olandelayo kuqala. Lesi yisikhathi esihle sokuhlaziya okwenzekile esikhathini esedlule nokuhlola izinto ezahlukene ezithinta ukuphathwa nokukhiqizwa kwezitshalo ezathuthukisa isimo nokukhiqizwa okutholakele ekupheleni kulezi zitshalo. Uma imibiko yomlando ingagcinwanga kuyo yonke imifula, manje yisikhathi esihle sokusebenzisa idatha yonyaka odlule ukuqala uhlelo lokugcina imibiko yomlando. Uma uhlelo lwebhizinisi lwenziwe oluhlanganisa ukuhlela lokho kuzosebenza kuyo yonke isitshalo ngonyaka olandelayo, izinga lokufaka kanye nezindleko ezitholakele kufanele ziqhathaniswe ngokucophelela nebhajethi eyabekwa ekuqaleni. Izinto ezithinta lezi zinputh ezimo zezimali kanye nezimo zezulu ezadlala indima empumelelweni noma ekwehlulekeni kwezithombo ezithile kufanele zicatshangelwe futhi zihlolwe ukuthi zishintshile noma zathuthuka. Imibiko eyisisekelo mayelana nezimo zomhlabathi kufanele igcinwe futhi ivuselelwe minyaka yonke: igama lefama, isifunda sefama, indawo ephelele, izindawo ezivunyiwe, izindawo zokulawula, izindawo ezithuthukisiwe, ukuhlinzwa, umuzi, izinqaba zefama, nezakhiwo. Iphakheji ngalinye lendawo kuyo yonke ifama ingaqhathaniswa mayelana nezinputh ezisetshenziswe lapho: indawo yomhlaba, ukujula komhlabathi, uhlobo lomhlabathi, ukuvuthwa komhlabathi, izinguquko zezulu eminyakeni eminingi.

Isiphetho Ezentela ziwusizo olukhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho. Ukwazi izinyathelo ezihambisanayo kubalulekile ukuze abantu bazicabangele ngokuqondile. Ngalezi zinyathelo ezichazwe kahle, ungakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni uthola okwakhe, futhi unika isandla ekwakheni umnotho wenhlalakahle. Ngakho, qhubeka uzibophele ukuze ube qotho ekubhalisweni nasekukhokheni ezentela, ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela empumelelweni enkulu.

Uma i-asosiyeshini, inkampani noma i-close corporation ingasakwazi ukukhoha izikweledu zayo, noma ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zayo , uDirector-General wezoHwebo neZimboni angabhekana nokuchithwa nokuhlakazwa kwempahla yenkampani noma ukuvalwa kwebhizinisi kanye nokwaba nokuthengiswa kwempahla yayo. I-asosiyeshini noma i-asosiyeshini yesikhashana , noma yiluphi ilunga le-asosiyeshini noma omunye umuntu othintekayo, angenza isicelo enkantolo sokuthi i-asosiyeshini noma i-asosiyeshini yesikhashana impahla yayo ihlakazwe ngu-Director-General noma ivalwe kanye nokuthengiswa kwempahla yayo . Inkantolo elalela isicelo kumele kube yidivishini yeNkantolo ePhezulu noma iNkantolo kaMantshi enamandla okubhekana nenqubo yobulungisa endaweni lapho i-asosiyeshini etholakala khona noma esebenzela khona. Izinkantolo zingakhipha umyalelo kanjena uma kuyinto engcono nelungele isimo. zonke izinto ezifanele okumele kubhekwane nazo ngaphambi kokukhipha kuhla lobhaliso, ezibandakanya indlela impahla nezikweledu ze-asosiyeshini noma ze-asosiyeshini yesikhashana okuzobhekwana nazo ngayo, noma okuye kwabhekwana nazo ngayo. Uma inkantolo ithatha isinqumo sokuvala i-asosiyeshini, noma i-asosiyeshini yesikhashana, izonquma ngokuthi impahla ye-asosiyeshini noma ye-asosiyeshini yesikhashana kuzobhekwana kanjani nayo ngendlela elinganayo nelungile. Inkantolo izobheka noma yiziphi izincomo ezenziwe ngu-Director-General maqondana nokwabiwa kwempahla.

Umsizi womgcini wezwe wathamela umhlangano womhlaba kwelase-France, yilapha ethula khona iphepha mayelana nohlelo olusha lwezifundazwe kanye nezwe lonke kweze- Coat of Arm. Ngombiko wonyaka usozimpawu wezwe wathatha umhlalaphansi, kodwa wacelwa ukuba aqhubeke kulelozinga ngasese kuze kuqokwe owayezomlandela. Umgomo wolimi kanye nohlelo lweNingizimuAfrika kanye nomthetho sivivinywa wezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso yenqubomgomo yolimi kanye nohlaka lweNingizimu Afrika ukulekelela ukuhlomisa umuntu ngamunye nezwelonke, ngokuthi ithuthukise ukusetshenziswa kwazozonke izilimi ezisemthethweni, nokuqiniseka ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika banenkululeko yokusebenzisa ulimi abazikhethele lona. Ungqongqoshe waketha abeluleki ukuba balungise uhleka lwenqubomgomo yolimi kanye nohlelo lweNingizimu Afrika olwethulwa , kanyekanye nomthethosivivinywa, kubobonke abathintekayo emhlanganweni owabizwa ngokuthi I-Second Language Indaba owawuseThekwini ngo- March 2000. Emva kokufakwa / kokungeniswa kwemibono yabo iNqubo mgomo yezilimi kanye nohlaka lwaseNingizimu Afrika (Language Policy) lwethulwa kwi -Khabhinethi yophiko lwezenhlalakahle ngo-13 September 2000. Ikomidi lenza iziphakamiso zokuba kuqhutshwe izingxoxo ezintweni ezazilethiwe kanye, beqikelele ubumqoka bezwe kanye nomthelela obanzi ezimalini. Emva kwaleziziphakamiso kwenziwa ukuhlola okunohlonze/ okugcwele eminyangweni kahulumeni kazwelonke kanye nasezifundazweni ukuze kubonakale isimo sezakhiwo/ sezingqalasizinda zolimi ezikhona.

Izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo Umbuzo 1: Yini izikhukhula? Izikhukhula zenzeka lapho izinga lamanzi emifuleni, ezilwandle, noma emathafeni liphakama kakhulu, kudala ukuwa kwamanzi emhlabeni. Lokhu kungabangelwa ukuna kwemvula, ukuncipha kwemvelo, noma izimo zezulu ezinzima. KwaZulu-Natal, izikhukhula zenzeka kaningi ngenxa yemvula enkulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi nezinyanga zokuqala zonyaka. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izizathu ezibangela izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal? Izikhukhula KwaZulu-Natal zidalwa yizimo eziningi. Okokuqala, imvula enkulu engapheli, ikakhulukazi phakathi nezinyanga zehlobo, ibalulekile. Okwesibili, izindawo ezinamathafa amakhulu nezintaba zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwamanzi, okungaholela ekwakhekeni kwezikhukhula. Okwesithathu, ukungcoliswa kwemvelo, njengokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo nezakhiwo, kunciphisa amandla emvelo okuphatha amanzi. Umbuzo 3: Izikhukhula zineziphumo ezinjani? Izikhukhula zineziphumo ezinzima. Zingenza umonakalo omkhulu emakhaya, ezikoleni, nasemiphakathini. Abantu bangaphila engozini, futhi izimpahla zabo zingonakaliswa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zingaholela ekupheleni kwemithombo yokuphila, njengamanzi nezinye izinsiza. Lokhu kubangela izinkinga ezinzima zomnotho, njengoba imisebenzi ithinteka kakhulu. Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenziwa ukuvikela abantu ezikhukhuleni? Ukuze kuvikwe abantu ezikhukhuleni, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlala ezikhukhuleni, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokuhlala eziphuthumayo.
