Lawa maKomidi umsebenzi wawo wukubheka wonke umsebenzi ophathenelene nezinkinga zentsha futhi kumele abhekane nokuphathwa komthetho othinta abantu abasha.

Inqubo eyolandelwa uma kuqokwa amalunga eSikhungo kuyoba impumelelo evelele ekuthuthukiseni noma ukusentshenziswa kwesayensi. Abantu abaphakanyiswe ukuba babe ngamalunga amasha eSikhungo bayophakanyiswa futhi baklonyeliswe ngesitifiketi esinqunyiwe sasayindwe ngamalunga angekho ngaphansi kwamalunga amane, okungenani amabili kulamalungu kufanele abe nolwazi ngokwawo qobo mayelana nomsebenzi wesayensi nendima ebonakalayo edlalwe yilowo muntu kwezesayensi. Lesi sitifiketi kufanele siqukathe umbhalo owuhlaka ochazayo ukuthi ukuqokwa kwalowo muntu ukuba abe yilunga leSikhungo kuzoziqhubela kanjani phambili izinjongo zeSikhungo. Isitifiketi kufanele siphelekezelwe isitatimende esinqunyiwe esivela kulo muntu esikhombisa ukuzinikela kwakhe ekubeni aqokwe ukuba abe yilunga leSikhungo, futhi kufanele siphelezelwe umbhalo ochaza ngomlando wakhe wezemfundo nokusebenza curriculum vitae. UMkhandlu weSikhungo kufanele njalo ngonyaka ucubungule zonke izicelo ezintsha ezifakiwe onyakeni owedlule, ngokulandela inqubo emisiwe yobulunga. Wonke amalunga akhona eSikhungo kuyodingeka ukuba avote, ngokwevoti eliyimfihlo, asho ukuthi ayamamukela noma awamamukeli umuntu othile odluliswe nguMkhandlu noma akhombise uma esesimweni sokungavuni muntu noma ukungakhethi muntu neutral. Amalunga eSikhungo angavotanga athathwa njengafake ivoti lokungavuni muntu. Umuntu oyoba namavoti okungenani aphindwaphindwe kathathu uyothathwa njengoseqokiwe njengelunga leSikhungo, inqobo nje uma okungenani ingxenye yamavoti beyamukele yena.

Izifundo ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi emalokishini Kusukela kumakhono okuphila kwabantu, emalokishini aphesheya kwenyakatho ye-Afrika, ubuhle bokubambisana nomqondo wokwakha amabhizinisi siqu kude kwazise, kungaziwa. Izifundo ezenzakalayo ezitholakala phakathi kwalezi zindawo, zikhombisa ukuthi abantu abahlala emalokishini bavele banamandla, baziqhenya ngempumelelo yabo, nakuba beziphila ezimweni ezinzima. Lokhu kuhamba phambili kube nemiphumela eminingi, higlazisa ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi abavela emalokishini, abafundisile uxolo, ubuhlakani, nokuqamba. Ngokubheka emuva, sithola ukuthi abagibeli be-Taxi nezokuthutha ezintsha babebambe izintambo zezezimali emalokishini. Phakathi neminyaka yokokubusa kwe-apartheid, abantu abaningi babezithola bedinga izinsizakusebenza eziyisisekelo, izimpahla, nezinye izidingo. Ukuze bazigcine, kwabakhona abavula amabhizinisi amancane, ngaphandle kokuxhaswa nguhulumeni, ukuze baphathe amakhasimende futhi baziqhenye ngalokho abakwenza. Izifundo zabo zakhombisa ukuthi ubuhlakani bangempela buvela ngaphakathi kwezimo ezinzima. UMichael “Sizwe” Ndlovu, ungomunye wabantu abavela emalokishini abezenza isibonelo sokuphumelela. U-Ndlovu waqala umsebenzi wakhe emhlabeni wezimoto, ewina ikhefi ngokuqoqa imali kancane emalini. Waqala ngokuhamba ngezinyawo nokubamba izimota ezindala, ezemoto eziyinqaba zashintsha pungwe imibono emisha yokuthi abantu bangaba nosizo lwezithuthi emalokishini. Ubuqotho nokuqamba kwakhe kuye kwaholela ekukhuleni kwenani labantu abaqala ukwenza izinkampani zabo zokuthutha. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sashintsha izinkanyezi zempumelelo ngabasunguli bamabhizinisi abavamile ukuba nemibono eqondile.

Izinqumo ezinhle angeke zincike kuphela emibonweni noma ezibalweni kodwa kufanele kubhekwe kokubili ngokuhlanganyela ukuze kutholwe incazelojikelelei nengaba nomthelela onegalelo elikhulu Bona Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /3. Kunesidingo sokubheka isimo ngombono obanzi kamasipala kungagcini kuphela ngeso lomphakathi nalabo ababambe iqhaza. Izindaba ezibucayi kumasipala zingaphezulu kwenhlanganisela yezidingo zamathimba omphakathi nababambe iqhaza abayizakhamuzi zomasipala. Ziningi izinto ezigamanxayo ezikhona, njengokuthutheleka kwabantu emadolobheni, ukwehla kwesimo somnotho, izinkinga zesandulela-ngculazi/ingculazi, inkambiso ekhathazayo yokuphatha nezinkinga zendalo ezingeke zavezwa ukuhlaziya isimo sendawo. Ngakho, senza izincomo zohlelo olwehlukile ezisezingeni likamasipala lapho kuyocwaningwa futhi kuhlaziywe khona lezi zinto. Akufanele ukuhlaziya kumiselwe kuphela lemboni. Uma kucatshangwa ngemboni, umphumela kungaba wuhlu olude lwezinto kunokugxila kakhulu ezintweni eziphuthumayo nezithinta abantu. Kudingekile ukuhlaziya isimo somnotho nenhlalo, ikakhulu isimo sobuphofu, ukwehlukana ngobulili, izinto eziphathelene nesandulela-ngculazi/ingculazi njengeqhinga lentuthuko elididiyele nelihambisana nemihlahlandlela yenqubomgomo kazwelonke ekulweni nobuphofu kanye nokulingana ngobulili (Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /6). Abanye omasipala (ikakhulu beSigaba A noC) banganquma ukulandela uhlelo lokuhlaziya okuhlelekile nokugamanxayo embonini kanjalo okubandakanya izinguquko zomnotho, inhlalonhle nemvelo (Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /4a -c).

Kumele sibathumele endaweni abazophila khona ngokuthula, endaweni abakhululekile kuyo (hhayi lapho sithanda khona ukuthi bame)? Inhloso yabantu abaningi ivame ukuba: "okuningi kungcono." Iqiniso, nokho, ukuthi umuntu othile kumele aqale endaweni ethile, noma ngabe kuwumsebenzi omncane. Kunabalimi abaningi abaqonda kuphela ezolimo njengendlela yokuphila - abanandaba nokukhiqiza ukudla okuningi ukuze kuthengiswe - futhi lokhu kulungile. Bese kuba nabanye abalimi abakhuluma kahle futhi bafisa ukuba abalimi abakhulu esikhathini esizayo. Bese kuba abalimi abakhulu abaqhubeka nomsebenzi wabo ngendlela efanele (kodwa nabo baqala ezingeni eliphansi futhi baqhubeka nokukhula). Uma imizamo yethu yokuthuthukisa abantu izoba namandla futhi ibe nezinzuzo esikhathini esizayo, kumele sithole labo bantu ezindaweni abakhona futhi siqale lapho - akukhathazi kakhulu (anginankathazo ngalokhu) ukubona abaqashi abakhulu abangena emhlabeni kodwa balima, babheke izitshalo, baphumelele, futhi baphinde baphawule ukuthi benza umsebenzi "wokuthuthukiswa kwabalamli" - cha! Lokhu akukhulisi; bangangena kuphela kulezo zindawo. Eqinisweni, abalimi bangase bahlale kulezo zindawo ngoba izindleko zamanje ziphezulu - bese abaqashi bethatha ingxenye yenhlalakahle (badla kabili kanti umalimi udla lutho). Ake sibuyisele ezibalulekile futhi siqonde ukuthi singawathuthukisa kanjani abantu. Uma izinkundla zakho zilimwa umqashi omkhulu, cabanga kahle ukuthi ufuna ukufika kuphi ekugcineni - ufuna ukuba umalimi noma ufuna ukuba umqashi wezolimo?

Izici Ze-Smartphone Ama-smartphone akhiwe ngezici eziningi ezizenza zihluke kwi-foni yendabuko. Okokuqala, kukhona isikhombimsebenzisi esihambisana ne-touchscreen esivumela abasebenzisi ukuthi baphathe izinhlelo zokusebenza ngokuthinta kuphela. I-touchscreen ibhekwa njengomsebenzi ophawuleka kakhulu wama-smartphone, phakathi nezizathu eziningi zokuthi kungani zaziwa kakhulu. Okwesibili, ama-smartphone anama-processor akhuphukayo, okwenza kube lula ukuphatha imisebenzi eminingi ngasikhathi sinye. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu bakwazi ukusebenza, baphule imidlalo, kanye nokuxhumana nabangani baphinde bazithokozise. Ikhamera yama-smartphone nayo ibalulekile. I-smartphone yanamuhla ibikhiqiza izithombe eziphakeme kakhulu, ezivumela abantu ukuba bathathe izithombe ezizwakalayo nezibukwayo. Njengoba imithombo yezokuxhumana isiphenduke indawo yokwabelana ngezithombe, isikhathi sokuthatha isithombe sibe lukhuni, bakeshe imithombo yokuxhumana ingasekho, ihlaba umxhwele. Ukubaluleka Kwe-Smartphone Ama-smartphone awasiyena kuphela amathuluzi okuxhumana, kodwa asebenza futhi njengama-hub ahlakaniphile empilweni yethu. Ngaphezulu kokuzenzakalelayo, ama-smartphone ahlinzeka ngendawo yokufunda, yokusebenza, kanye nezokungcebeleka. Abantu bangakwazi ukufinyelela emakhasi e-inthanethi, baxhumane nabangani, futhi bathuthukise izifundo zabo ngale ndlela. Ukwengeza, ama-smartphone asiza ekuxhumaneni kwempilo yansuku zonke. Ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhona, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlela izibopho, balandele impilo yabo, noma baphathe imisebenzi ehlukahlukene eyahlukeneyo. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubekele phambili kabili futhi baphendule emaso.

Isimo esisheshayo sithathwa njengaleso esingalindelekile kanye nesiyisehlakalo esenzeka ngokungazelele esiphathelene nokokwenza okulimazayo noma okungaba namandla okulimaza, okuyimiphumela yomasipala futhi kudinga okwenziwayo okusheshayo. Uma i-ofisa enegunya ibona ukuthi kunzima ukumema amabhidi anokuncintisana, njengangesikhathi sokutholiswa esisheshayo, noma lapho kukhona umnikezeli oyedwa kuphela, angakwazi, ngokuxhumana ne-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu, ukutholisa impahla nezinsiza ngezinye izindlela, njengokuthola ikhotheshini yentengo noma ngokuxoxisana, noma ngokwehlisa isikhathi esidingekayo sokukhangisa ukusuka osukwini lwe-14 kuze kube yisikhathi esibekiwe. Izizathu zokwehluka kumabhidi okuncintisana ezimemo zizakurekhodwa zivunywe Yi-Ofisa Elinegunya. Uma kungaboniswa ukuthi umnikezeli wensiza oyedwa uyakwazi ukunikeza insiza ecacisiwe, ngalokho ke i-Ofisa Enegunya anganikeza ikontileka kulowo mnikezeli wezinsiza uma nje kuvume ikomiti Lokunquma lebhidi. Kodwa, imakethe izawuvivinywa njalo eminyakeni emibili ukuthola ukuqiniswa kwesici kwamanje. I-Ofisa Enegunya izakurekhoda izizathu zokwehluka. Inqolobane yemininingwane Yomcwaningi Zimali Kazwelonke ezokuhlolwa ngaphambi kokunikezwa yinoma yiyiphi ikontileka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ayikho inkampani yebhidi ephakanyisiwe, noma yinoma yiyiphi yabaqondisi, eyenziwe uhlu njengomuntu ovinjelwe ukwenza ibhizinisi esigabeni somphakathini.

Uma umasipala sewuqonda kahle izinkinga zabantu abawakhele kanye nembangela, sekumele uqhamuke nezisombululo zokubhekana nalezinkinga. Umbono - umbono yisitatimende esikhomba isimo esifiswa wumasipala noma iphupho alifisela isikhathi eside esizayo. Lesi yisimo umasipala ayozithola ekuso ngesikhathi esexazulule zonke izinkinga ezikhona neziphawulwe esigabeni 1. Izinjongo zentuthuko - uma izidingonqangi seziphawuliwe esigabeni 1, kufanele ziguqulelwe ezinjongweni. Izinjongo zentuthuko yizitatimende zalokho umasipala afuna ukukuzuza esikhathini esimaphakathi esizayo ukuze abhekane nezinkinga nokufaka isandla ekufezeni iphupho eliwumbono. Ngamanye amagama, izinjongo kumele zibe yibhuloho elixhumanisa isikhathi samanje nombono. Amaqhinga entuthuko - uma sewazi umasipala ukuthi ufuna ukuya kuphi (umbono) nokuthi yini okufanele uyenze ukuze uhlangabezane nombono, kubalulekile ukusungula amaqhinga. Amaqhinga entuthuko ethula izimpendulo embuzweni ofana nokuthi; umasipala uyophumelela kanjani ukuhlangabeza izinjongo? Ukuphothula amaqhinga okusebenza kulandelwa wukuqoka imisebenzi uqobo. Iqhaza elibanjwa wumphakathi lenzeka esigabeni 2 lapho kuba khona inkulumompikiswano ngezindlela ezehlukene ezingasetshenziswa ekuxazululeni izinkinga. Isigaba 3 sikhuluma ngokuhlela nemininingwane ngemisebenzi eqokelwe ukwenziwa. Umasipala kumele aqiniseke ukuthi imisebenzi ekhethiwe inobudlelwane obuqondile nezinto noma nezinkinga ngokunjalo nezinjongo eziphawulwe esigabeni sokuqala. Makucace emathimbeni aqokiwe ukuthi umsebenzi oyokwenziwa ukuphi, uyoqala nini futhi uphele nini, inani lawo nokuthi imali iyovela kuphi.

Ubulalayo obuqondiswe kubantu bangaphandle buwumbango! Uhulumeni ngeke avumele noma iyiphi indlela yobudlova eqondiswe kwabanye abantu! Masisebenze ndawonye ukuze sakhe impilo engcono kubantu bonke abahlala eNingizimu Afrika. Masibambisane ukuze sithuthukise amakhono ethu futhi sakhe amathuba emisebenzi. Uma unemininingwane mayelana nokuhlaselwa okukhulunywa ngakho kwabantu bangaphandle abahlala eNingizimu Afrika, sicela ubize isiteshi samaphoyisa esiseduze noma uma kuyiphuthumayo, sicela ubize le nombolo ku-10111. Ukuhlasela abantu bangaphandle abahlala eNingizimu Afrika ngeke kuzuze muntu. Kuvame ukuba abantu abangenacala ababa yizisulu zalokhu - abasolwa bayabalekela. Uma unemininingwane mayelana nomsebenzi wobugebengu - bika kumaphoyisa. Ungathathi umthetho ezandleni zakho. Uhulumeni ukhuthaza imiphakathi ukuba ihlale ibheke phansi futhi ibike izigameko ezihlobene nobudlova nempilo enobugagu eqondiswe kubantu bangaphandle. Ukuphumelela kokusingathwa kweFIFA World Cup 2010 kube nomthelela omuhle eNingizimu Afrika nasemhlabeni jikelele. Kukhule kakhulu inani labavakashi abavakashela leli zwe, okuthuthukisile amathuba okutshala imali, futhi lokho kuzovula amathuba emisebenzi. Noma iyiphi indlela yobudlova ezweni lethu izophula konke esikufezile ngesikhathi sokuqhuba iWorld Cup. Manje umhlaba usibheka ngenhlonipho enkulu kunangaphambili.

Izingozi eziningi emapulazini zifaka imishini. Ezinye zenzeka ngoba umshini usetshenziselwe umsebenzi ongawulungele, ezinye zenziwa wukuthi okokuvala akukho noma kususiwe. Kumele kube nohlelo lokuhlola ukuthi izinto zokusebenza esingabala kuzo nemishini, ziphephile ukuthi zingasetshenziswa. Uma izinto zokusebenza zisetshenziswa ezimweni ezingezinhle, kumele uhlolwe njalo ukubheka ukuthi yini engakuholela ezingozini, uma kunesimo esingejwayelekile, esingenza ukuthi izinto zokusebenza zingabi ngeziphephile. Ifakwe izivalo ezibekwe wumthetho. Amathuluzi okutshala izihlahla kumele akhelwe leso sidingo. Amathuluzi okulima awavamile ukuba alungele ukutshala izihlahla. Izibambo zamathuluzi okutshala kumele zivalwe ukuvikela ukushokheka kwesandla uma ukudla kwethuluzi kushaya idwala elicashile noma impande. Uma uthenga noma uboleka imishini umthetho uthi kumele umthengisi-mpahla alethe izivalo eziyizo zokuvikela. Yenza isiqinisekiso sokuthi wena nabasebenzi bakho. Nisebenza imishini njengokwemiyalelo ebhalwe kuyo. Gcinani izivimbo zisezindaweni zazo futhi zisebenza ngendlela. Nibheka ukuthi izinkinobho zokuvimba zibhalwe ngokucacile ukukhombisa ukuthi zenzani nokuthi zihambelana namiphi imishini, futhi zakhiwe, zabekwe ngendlela yokuthi zingathinteki ngephutha. Abasebenzi baqeqeshiwe ukusebenza ngokuphepha nokuthi bahlinzekwe ngezingubo zokubavikela. Izehlakalo eziningi ezithinta imishini zenzeka ngesikhathi sokukhandwa kwemishini. Abasebenzi baqeqeshwe ngokwanele ukwenza umsebenzi. Amathuluzi enele nemiyalelo yokusebenzisa imishini ihlinzekwe ukuze imishini iphathwe, ihlonzwe futhi ivulwe.

Ubuchwepheshe besimanje buwenza kube lula kumaphoyisa ukuhlanganisa abantu nendawo kanye nezinto. Ukuze kusebenze ubuchwepheshe, izindawo zokwenziwa kobugebengu kumele zigcinwe futhi zivikelwe ekungeneleleni okungadingekile okungaphazamisa ubufakazi. Ngokugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, amaphoyisa azokwazi ukuqoqa ubufakazi obuqondile. Ukuphazamiseka endaweni yokwenziwa kobugebengu kudala isimo lapho ubufakazi obungatholakala futhi obuwusizo buncipha. Ukugcina indawo yokwenziwa kobugebengu, "indawo engcwele," kuyinto ebalulekile ozoyenza. Ungawuthinti noma ukhiphe izinto endaweni, njengezinto zokuhlala, izingubo, noma ukudla. Ungasebenzisi nefonini yakho; okungenani cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane wakho. Sebenzisa enye indlela, hhayi leyo esetshenziswa ababulali. Uma kungenzeka, buyela ekhaya. Cela ukusebenzisa ifoni yomakhelwane noma enye indawo ukuze ubike lesi sehlakalo. Linda amaphoyisa. Lapho ubika ubugebengu, nikeza ulwazi oluphelele lokuthi ungatholakala kuphi, uma amaphoyisa edinga olunye ulwazi ngaphambi kokufika endaweni. Khombisa indlela noma indlela oyisebenzisile. Bonke abakwi ndawo noma eduze bangaba ngofakazi. Tshela amaphoyisa konke owazi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ukubona kwakho kubonakala kungabalulekile. Bhala konke phambi kokuxoxa nabanye ngoba ungakhohlwa noma uphazamiswe.

Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondiswa kuhulumeni kazwelonke nasezindabeni eziphathelene nenhlonipho noma ekuxosheni kwabo, okungabandakanya imfundo noktraining yamaJaji amasha kanye nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphakathi kwamaJaji amadala, izimo zokusebenza nezimo zesevisi zamaJaji, ukuhlelwa kabusha kwemingcele yeZigaba Eziphezulu, nokunye. Ukuhlanganisa uhlu lwabafakizicelo bokunikezwa izikhundla zamaJaji eNkantolo yeMthethosisekelo, oluthunyelwe ngemigqa emithathu yokukhetha futhi lwethulwa kuMongameli, uma kukhona abafakizicelo abangamukeleki kuMongameli, amagama engeziwe kufanele engezwe. Ukuhamba phambili ekuxoxeni ngezinsolo zokuziphatha kabi noma ukungafaneleki ukuba uJaji, ukuthola umphumela mayelana nocwaningo nokwazisa iNhlangano Yezwe ngempumelelo uma kutholakala ukuthi uJaji unenkinga yokwenza imisebenzi yabo, uyaphumelela emisebenzini yabo noma uxoshwa ngenxa yokuziphatha kabi. Ukuhlinzeka iPhalamende ngombiko obhaliwe wonyaka mayelana nemisebenzi eyenziwe ngaleso sikhathi. IKomidi Lezinsizakalo Zobulungiswa liqukethe amaKomishina angama-25 (kuhlanganisa noMongameli noMphakathi) kanye noSekela. Uma udaba oluthinta iZigaba Eziphezulu luphathwa, uJaji Omkhulu waleyo Nkantolo kanye noMphakathi ofanelekile noma abathunyelwe babo bayabandakanywa. Uma inani labantu abafakizicelo besuka ezikhungweni zokwakha umthetho noma emkhakheni wezomthetho ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1 e noma f lingama-vacancies okufanele zigcwaliswe, uMongameli kufanele abakhethe.

Lezi zindlela zenzelwe ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo ezinsukwini zethu, lapho ubungozi bokwephulwa kolwazi buye bukhula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibeka phambili ukuqwashisa nokuqeqesha abasebenzi bayo mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo. Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kubalulekile ukuze baqonde ukuthi bangavikela kanjani ulwazi lwezempilo lwabanye, kuhlanganisa ukufundiswa ngezindlela zokuphatha ulwazi, izinqubo zokubika izigameko zokwephulwa kolwazi, kanye nezindlela zokuphatha izinsiza ezitholakalayo. I-GEMS iphinde ibambisane nezinhlaka ezahlukene, ezifana nohulumeni, izikhungo zezempilo, kanye nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kolwazi lwezempilo. Lezi zinhlelo zokubambisana zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi oludingekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqubo zokuvikela zisebenza kahle. Lokhu kubambisana kuhloswe ngokuqinisa izinqubo zokuvikela, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo luhlala luvalekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akuyona nje into yokugcina, kodwa kuyinqubo eqhubekayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinqubo zokuvikela kumele zihlale zihlaziywa futhi zithuthukiswe ukuze zikwazi ukuhambisana nezinguquko ezisheshayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe. I-GEMS ibheka phambili ekwakheni izinqubo ezizokwazi ukuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo, ngenkathi ibheka izidingo zabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS ibona ukuthi ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo akukhona kuphela ukuvikela ulwazi, kodwa futhi kuhlobene nokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwabantu.

lokufaka isicelo sokudlulisa icala noma ukuhlaziywa kwalo yinkantolo enkulu. alunikwe ngolimi aluqonda kahle. bufakazi bungenza ukuthi icala lingagculisi noma kungakhinyabeza ukuphathwa kobulungiswa. ezinye izindlela ezinezihibe ezingaphansi ezingafeza injongo efanayo. isimemezelo sesimo esibucayi sidingekile ukuze kubuyiselwe uxolo nokuthula. uma uMkhandlu kaZwelonke unquma ukwelula isikhathi sesimemezelo. esingeqile ezinyangeni ezintathu. kwenziwe ngesinqumo esivunjwe yiningi lamalungu oMkhandlu. sithathwe ngemuva kwenkulumompikiswano eMkhandlwini. kwaleso simemezelo sesimo esibucayi. ngezinga elivezwe ngaphesheya kwesigaba engxenyeni 3 yoluhla. imvelaphi, ubulili, inkolo noma ulimi. Isithunzi somuntu. Ngokuphelele. engu- 15 nabangaphansi. ngokushesha okungase kwenzeka ngokuvalelwa kwalowo muntu. ibuyekeze ukuvalelwa kwakhe. nesidingo sokuthi lowo muntu aphinde avalelwe. ngamazwe mayelana nokuvalelwa kwalabo bantu. nenhlangano efaka isicelo ngenhloso yokuzuzela amalungu ayo. ingabuka umthetho wezinye izizwe. umoya, inhloso kanye nezinjongo zoMqulu wamaLungelo. kugcine ezingeni lokuhambisana kwayo noMqulu wamalungelo. kanye neyezindawo, engafani, enobudlelwano nokuhlobana. sahluko futhi kumele yenze imisebenzi yayo ngokulandela uhlaka olunikezwa yilesi sahluko. ngokugwema ukwethwesana ngamacala phambi komthetho. kwezingxabano phakathi kohulumeni abehlukahlukene; futhi. kwengxabano phakathi kohulumeni. enkantolo ukuba ixazulule leyo ngxabano. ingayibuyisela leyo ngxabano kuleyo ngxenye yombuso ethintekile.

Ukuhlola Ibhethri: Qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri igcwele futhi ilungile. Ukuhlola Izimpahla: Bheka ukuthi zonke izingxenye zisebenza kahle, kuhlanganise nezimpahla ezihambayo. Ukubhalisela Uhlelo Lokusebenza: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-drone lukhona futhi luthuthukisiwe. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuphatha i-Drone Uma usulungele, ungakwazi ukuqala ukuhamba. Landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Thola Indawo Efanele: Khetha indawo enokuthula, ngaphandle kwabantu abaningi, ukuze uqinisekise ukuphepha. Qala i-Drone: Vula i-drone yakho futhi ulungise izilawuli. Thola Isikhala Sokuhamba: Qiniseka ukuthi awuphumi emkhawulweni wezindiza noma ezindaweni ezivulekile. Qala Ukuhamba: Sebenzisa izilawuli ukuze uqale ukuhamba. Qaphela izimo zomoya, njengoba umoya onamandla ungathinta ukuhamba kwe-drone. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuthwebula Izithombe Uma uhlose ukuthwebula izithombe, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Lungisa Ikhamera: Qiniseka ukuthi ikhamera isethwe kahle. Thola Isikhala Esifanele: Khetha indawo enezindawo ezinhle zokuthwebula. Thwebula Izithombe: Sebenzisa izilawuli ukuze uthwebule izithombe ezinhle. Ungasebenzisa izilungiselelo ezahlukene ukuze uthole umphumela omuhle. Isinyathelo 6: Ukubuyisela i-Drone Ngemva kokuphothula ukuhamba, kubalulekile ukubuyisela i-drone yakho ngendlela efanele: 1. Phinda Uhlola Ibhethri: Qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri isebenza kahle futhi uyayigcina. Hlanza i-Drone: Susa uthuli noma amanzi ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi i-drone yakho ihlanzekile. Beka Indawo Ephephile: Gcina i-drone endaweni ephephile ukuze ivikeleke.

Uhlu luzakufakelwa imininingwane ngekwata ngokubonisa isaziso emabhodini abekelwe loku kanye nakuwebhusayidi yebandla. Izimemo zokwenziwa kohlu lwabanikezeli abavunyiwe luzakukhangiswa kanye ngonyaka kumaphephandana endawo ajwayelekile2. Izaziso ezinje zizakumema abanikezeli ukuthi bafake izicelo zokuhlolwa kanye nokwenziwa uhlu kwabanikezeli abavunyelwe. Okungaba ngabanikezeli abavunyiwe kudingeka ukuba bangenise amagama abo kanye neminye imininingwane efanele, kufakwa nohlu lwempahla nezinsiza abakwazi ukuzinikeza. Uma uhlu selwenziwe ngempahla ngayinye kanye nohlobo lwensiza ngalunye, amakhotheshini entengo azakumenywa ukusuka kubanikezeli. Izimemo zizawukhuliswa ngendlela yokuqhubekisa ukuncintisana okuqhubekayo, okufaka izimemo ezizungezayo, futhi izawulungiselelwa nguMenenja Wezezimali futhi ivunyelwe Yikomiti Lokunquma njalo ngonyaka. Ukufakwa kwanoma yimuphi umnikezeli kunqolobane yemininingwane yabanikezeli akukhipheli ngaphandle umnikezeli onje kukugunyazwa kokuphendula ngendlela ebekiwe kuzaziso zikamasipala zezidingo zokuphatha ukunikezela ngemisebenzi. Abanikezeli abafisa ukufakwa ohlwini lokuba ngabanikezeli abavunyiwe ngaphandle kokulinda isimemo esilandelayo bangaqonda Esigabeni Sokutholiswa ukuze bafakwe, uma nje banikezela ngemibhalo efanele nolwazi lokuhlolwa. Emva kokuba lezi sidingo sezigculisiwe, isigaba Sokutholisa sizakuqinisekisa ukuthi okungaba ngabanikezeli bayahlolwa bese kuthi ezinsukwini eziyi-14 bazokwaziswa abanikezeli ukuthi ukuhlolwa kuvunyiwe noma cha. Okungaba ngabanikezeli abasoze bakwazi ukunikeza amakhotheshini baze bavunyelwe njengabanikezeli abavunyiwe.

Hlola umoya kuma-tires akho nsuku zonke esontweni lokuqala ngemuva kokufaka ama-tires amasha. Ngemuva kwalokho, hlola umoya kuma-tires akho njalo. Njalo umshayeli kufanele abe ne-air pressure gauge yakhe. Ama-air gauges atholakala ezigaraji angase angasebenzi. Umoya ongafanele we-tire ungumthombo wezingozi eziningi zeTaxi. Faka umkhuba wokuhlola umoya kuma-tires akho. Qinisa ama-bolts kuma-wheels akho. Izingxenye eziningi zezingozini zenzeka ngoba umshayeli ucabanga ukuthi bazodlula noma ama-bolts aphukile. Ungazami ukuhamba ngemoto enama-bolts aphukile noma alahlekile. Ingabe lokhu akukhona nje ukugcinwa kwe-tire okuyisisekelo? Ungafaka ama-tires abiza kancane futhi ungawagcini - kodwa lokhu kungakubiza ukuphila kwakho. Lokhu kubiza kakhulu kunezithayi ezinhle ezigcinwe kahle. Ungacabangi ukuthi okuncane kungcono! Ama-tires abiza kancane - njengezithayi eziphindwe kabili, noma eziphindwe kabili noma ezibuyisiwe - angakubiza ukuphila kwakho kanye nabagibeli bakho. Ungazami ukufaka ama-tires aphindwe kabili noma abuyisiwe. Ama-tires abiza kancane ekugcineni - ngoba adinga ukugcinwa okuningi futhi awahlali isikhathi eside njengama-tires amasha. Ama-tires anekhwalithi ephezulu angabiza kakhulu kodwa abiza kancane ekugcineni ngoba kulula ukuwagcina futhi ahlala isikhathi eside. Ukulayisha ngokweqile kwe-vehicle kubangela ukugqoka kwe-tire futhi kungabangela ukuphuma, okuholela ezingozi nasekufeni. Ungacabangi ngentengo ye-tire. Cabanga ngokusindisa kuma-tires nasekuphepheni kwabagibeli bakho. Cabanga ngokusindisa kuma-tires?

Indima yomfundisi Ngakho-ke, indima yomfundisi ibalulekile. Umfundisi onekhono akavuli nje umnyango wokufunda, kodwa futhi udala isimo esikhuthazayo. Umfundisi kufanele abe khona ukuze akhuthaze, ahlolisise, futhi abheke ukusebenza kwabafundi. Lokhu kudinga ukuphawula okusezingeni eliphezulu, ngoba abafundi bahlala bephendula kahle uma bezwa ukuthi umfundisi uyabakhathalela. Umfundisi odlala indima efanele uyavula amathuba okuphumelela, futhi uthuthukisa ukuzethemba kwabafundi. Izimo zomndeni Ngaphandle kokufundiswa, izimo zomndeni nazo zinemphumela omkhulu. Abafundi abaphuma emindenini enezinkinga, njengokushoda kwemali, ukungalali kahle, noma ukungabi khona kokusekela, bavame ukuba nemiphumela emibi ekufundeni. Ubulili, ubuhlanga, kanye nezimo zokuhlala nazo zingaba nomthelela. Uma umndeni udinga ukuxhasa, kufanele kubekhona uhla lwezindlela ezihlukene zokweseka, ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukufeza amaphupho abo. Lokhu kuyadingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umfundi uthola ithuba elifanele lokufunda. Ubuchwepheshe bokufunda Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bube nomthelela omkhulu ekufundeni. Amathuluzi afana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda, izifundo ezikwi-intanethi, nezinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi ziye zathuthukisa indlela abafundi abafunda ngayo. Lokhu kudale ukuthi ukufunda kube lula, futhi kube nemiphumela emihle. Kodwa-ke, kufanele kucaciswe ukuthi ubuchwepheshe abukhona njengokuphela kwendlela yokufunda. Kubalulekile ukubhekisisa ukuthi kungani abafundi behluleka ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza, futhi kuthiwani uma umphakathi ungakabi nesiqiniseko sokuthi ukuthola ubuchwepheshe kuyatholakala kubo bonke.

i-NEMA ayikusizi nje kuphela lapho umuntu ephule umthetho, kodwa nalapho umuntu enesibophezelo sento ehluleka ukuyenza. Isibonelo, uma uhulumeni onesibophezelo sokumisa abantu banganukubezi umfula bese ehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe, uhulumeni wephula umthetho, ungamthathela izinyathelo ezimphoqa ukuba ayivikele imvelo. Ungacela uMqondisi-Jikelele ukwenza uphenyo. Uma othile enomsebenzi wokwenza into, njengokuhlanza isimo sokunukubeza imvelo, ungaya enkantolo umphoqelele kuleso senzao. Isibonelo: Umakhelwane wakho, unebhizinisi lokukhanda izimoto, uchitha uwoyela nopende osekusebenzile emfuleni ongasekupheleni kwesitaladi sakho. Wephula isiGaba 151 soMthetho kaZwelonke waManzi, futhi lokhu kuyicala. Ukukhetha umgudu ofanele, Bona isifundo 1 eNgxenyeni 9. Ungacela uMqondisi-Jikelele enze uphenyo. Ibeke eceleni isinqumo esithathwe wuhulumeni nesingekho emthethweni. Isibonelo: uhulumeni uhlela ukwakha umgwaqo onqamula endaweni esogwini lolwandle nebucayi. Uhlongoza nokuthuthukisa isiza sezimboni kwenye ingxenye yalendawo. Akayicabanganga imigomo yentuthuko evelele neyohlala isikhathi eside ngesikhathi edweba loluhlelo. Lokhu kungaba wukwephula umgomo weNEMA. Bona isifundo sesigameko esingu 2 eNgxenyeni 9. Ukungenzi uphenyo olwenele ngohlaziyo lomthelela emvelweni lapho kuthuthukiswa indawo noma kuqaliswa umsebenzi othile nokungaba nomthelela omkhulu kwimvelo. Bona isifundo ngesigameko, esingu 2 eNgxenyeni 9. Kungacelwa uMqondisi-Jikelele enze uphenyo.

Ngamanye amagama, ubumbano angeke lugqugquzelwe nguhulumeni yedwana, sifanele ukuthi sonke kanye-kanye singabaseNingizimu Afrika sikhulume ngokuthi sikhululekile ekufuneni nasekwenzeni amanyala, sisebenzele ukuzuza injabulo ezanobumbano. Ngiyethemba ukuthi siyavumelana sonke ukuthi ukusebenza ngokubumbana ukuze sizuze injabulo elethwa yinkululeko, kusho ukuthi sifanele ukubambisana ukubhekana nenselele yobugebengu. Ukugqugquzela ukuthula nokulondolozeka kungumsebenzi ka wonkewonke. Kuzakuqinisa umfutho wesizwe wokuzifunela uxolo nokulwa nokukhahlamezeka ohlasele umphakathi.. ngokubeka iso elibukhali ekuhlukubezekeni kwamakhosikazi.. "Uxolo nokusimama kwezombusazwe kumqoka ezinhlelweni zikahulumeni ukuze kubelula ukuthi abatshali zimali beze ezweni lethukuzawuthathwa izinyathelo ezinzima ukuqeda ukuphulwa komthetho, ukuthengiswa kwezidakwamizwa, nezibhamu, ubugebengu ikakhulu ukuphathwa kabi kwamakhosikazi nabantwana". Angeke sicishe konke loku okubi, nokwenyanyekayo ukuze sithole ukujabula okuza nenkululeko uma kusenabantu abahlezi ovalweni, bazifihle emuva kwamabonda aphakeme nocingo olunogesi, bahlezi ngokwethuka emizini yabo, emigwaqweni, bengakwazi ukuhlala banethezeke ezindaweni zomphakathi. Kusobala ukuthi kufanele siqhubeke silwe nobugebengu. Noma sesidlulile kulelinani lamaphoyisa elalibekiwe lika 152, 000 embuthweni wamaphoyisa kanti futhi izinga lokufundisa amaphoyisa lithuthukisiwe, siyabona ukuthi imiphumela yaloku ayikafinyeleli ebantwini ukuthi bangaze bazizwe balondolozekile.

Ngaleso sikhathi kwakumele uye enkantolo kuphela uma impilo yakho noma impahla ilinyazwa. I-NEMA ithi ungaya enkantolo ngisho noma impilo okanye impahla kungathintekile. Izenzo ezithile ngentshisekelo yokuvikela imvelo. Noma kunjalo, ukuze ukwazi ukusebenzisa iNEMA, kumele uqiniseke ngokuthi isikhalo sakho siyabhekeleka. Ingxenye 3, 4 no 5 izokusiza ukwenza lokhu. Uma unesiqiniseko sokuthi inkinga yakho iyingxenye neNEMA, izingxenye 7 no 8 zizokuchazela kabanzi ngemigudu elula uNEMA ayikhombisayo ekuthatheni izinyathelo zomthetho nezinye nje. Izinhlobo zezinyathelo zomthetho ongazithatha zenekwe eNgxenyeni 6. INEMA ayigodlile nje kuphela izinyathelo zikahulumeni kodwa nezezifundazwe, ezikahulumeni wendawo kanjalo nezimboni zikahulumeni njengo Eskom. Ezinye izingxenye zikaNEMA zisebenza kuphela kuhulumeni bese kuba nalezo ezisebenza kubantu ngabanye, ezesithathu yilezo ezisebenza ndawo zombili. Qiniseka ukuthi uyavunyelwa ukuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho kwezinye zalezi zigaba ezibaliwe. Buza ummeli uma udinga usizo ngalokhu. Isibonelo: ungamshushisa umuntu ngamunye ngenxa yokwephula umthetho wezemvelo kodwa kuvame ukuba lukhuni ukushushisa uhulumeni ngasese. Ukushushisa ngasese noma ngokuzimela kuzoxoxwa ngakho kabanzi eNdimeni 3.7, 6.7, 7.11 kuyo lencwajana. INGXENYE 2: Wubani ongafaka isikhalo (afune usizo lwabaxazululi, afake isikhalo noma athathe izinyathelo zomthetho) ngaphansi kweNEMA? Umuntu kuhlangene nohulumeni bephula umthetho wezemvelo. Uhulumeni ehlulekile ukushushisa umuntu ophula umthetho wezemvelo, nalapho unenkolelo khona yokuthi lowomuntu unecala.

kufanele kukhuthazwe futhi kugcinwe izinga eliphezulu lobungcweti. ikhono, yokonga, nenomphumela omuhle. Umsebenzi wokuphathwa kombuso, kufanele uphokophele ukuthuthukisa. ubambe iqhaza lapho kwenziwa imigomo. Umbuso kufanele ukwazi ukubikela umphakathi ngendlela ophethe ngayo. ngolwazi olutholakala ngokushesha, nakuyilona. ngenhloso yokuthi abantu benze imisebenzi yezinga eliphezulu. izinhlobo zabantu zimelwe. izinkampani nemisebenzi kaHulumeni. nemigomo ebalulwe kwisigatshana (1). ngaleso sikhathi njengoba kuhlinzekwe umthetho kaZwelonke akunqatshelwe. kwemikhakha eyahlukene nezikhungo ezikhona zombuso. bombuso kuyizinto ekufanele zicatshangwe uma kuhanjiswa kahle ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi. nokukhuphula amazinga obuciko bokwethembeka emsebenzini womphakathi. isebenze ngokomthetho kazwelonke. ngendlela elindelekile kweKhomishani. yemisebenzi yabaqashwa emsebenzini womphakathi. IKhomishani ibikela iPhalamende ngokusebenza kwayo. nokumayelana nokwenzeka esifundazweni, kwisishayamthetho saleso sifundazwe. Umthetho wePhalamende kufanele wakhe inqubo yokuqashwa koKhomishani. ekuphatheni, nokudidiyela umsebenzi womphakathi. ngesiphakamiso sokususwa kukaKhomishani. okufanele zigcine imigomo ehambisana nomthetho kaHulumeni wangaleso sikhathi. ingahanjiswa kahle ngumthetho kazwelonke. muntu weseka iqembu noma inkolelo yepolitiki. okumiselwe abasebenzi bakahulumeni. umthetho wamazwe ngamazwe. Ukuphepha kwezwe kulawulwa yiPhalamende nomkhandlu wokuphatha kazwelonke. Umbutho wokuvikela yiwona wodwa umbutho ohlomile osemthethweni eRephabhliki. noma amaziko ahlomile, zingamiswa njengokusho komthetho kazwelonke.

Sikhulise amathuba okuthi izingane ziye ezinkulisa, loku kuyindlela yokuthuthukisa lonke uhlelo lwenfundo kazwelonke kanye nohlelo lwemisebenzi kahulumeni. Sikhulise ukufundisa nokuqasha abahlengikazi, nabononhlalakahle nabancedisi babo, sikhulise inani lamakolishi okufundela sithuthukise izinga lemfundo siphinde siqale uhlelo lomfundaze. Siqhubeke nomsebenzi wokulwisana nezindlela azibanga ukufa okungekona kwemvelo emphakathini, nezifo ezibangwa yindlela abantu abaziphatha ngayo, umalaleveva, nezinhlobonhlobo zesifo sofuba (TB), izingozi zomgwaco nobugebengu obuhlukumezayo. Uhulumeni uyazibopha ukuthi uzakulwisana negciwane elibanga ingculaza kanye nengculaza nokuthuthukisa indlela asebenza ngayo ukugqugquzela ukuvikela kanye nokunakekela abagulayo basekhaya kanye nokubahlenga. Sizakuqinisekisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obakhiwe eminyakeni edlule buyaqiniswa nokuthi uhlelo kanye namacebo kazwelonke okulwisana nengculaza kanye nezifo zocansi luyaqedelelwa ngokuphazima kweso. Kulomnyaka esikuwona sizakuqedelela amasu okufezekisa izinhlelo zomhlaba wonkana zokuthi kutholakale amanzi ngo 2008, ukuhanjiswa kahle kwendle ngo 2010 nokutholakala kwegesi ngo 2012. Sizokuqedelela amasu nezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukunamathelana kwemiphakathi kanye necebo elifaka phakathu yonke imibono yokulwisana nobumpofu esesikhulume ngalo kanye nezindaba ezimayelana nokubumbhana kwesizwe, nesimilo sesizwe nokuthi abantu bazazi ukuthi bangobani. Yonke lemizamo, Nkosikazi Mongameli wephalamende, ifanele ukuthi ihambisane kanye kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukuphepha nokulondolezeka kwesizwe.

Ekuqaleni, umdanso wawusetyenziswa njengendlela yokukhumbula izinkanyezi zempilo, kodwa manje usuphenduke umkhakha ongenamkhawulo. Abaculi baphakathi komdanso bahlala bephokophele ukufaka izinkanyezi zabo, bephakamisa izwi labo, futhi beveza izifundo ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umdanso ungaba yindlela yokwakha umphakathi, ube yindlela yokuhlonipha izinkanyezi zempilo eziphilayo. Umdanso, njengendlela yokuzijabulisa, ungaba yisikhumbuzo sokuhlanganyela, sokuphila, nokwakha ubudlelwano. Ubonisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhle, nokuhlakanipha kwezakhamuzi. Njengoba umdanso uqhubeka nokwakha izinkumbulo ezinhle, kubalulekile ukuthi siwuhloniphe, siwugubhe, futhi siwuthokozise. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ongenamkhawulo, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sithokozisa, sithokozise, futhi sibe nokuqonda okujulile ngalesi siko esiyigugu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umdanso uzophinde ube yindlela yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihlangene, nelinobungane. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sithandazela umdanso, siwufake emhlabeni wethu, futhi siwuthokozise. Umdanso ungumsebenzi ongenamkhawulo, futhi kufanele siqhubeke sithokozisa, sithokozise, futhi sibe nokuqonda okujulile ngalesi siko esiyigugu.

Kube, kusukela ngo 1994 uHulumeni wakhipha izimali ezinkulu zokuba kufakwe inqgalasizinda kwatholakala ukuthi oKhahlamba amasu awabangakhona. Mhlawumbe uhlelo lwentuthuko oludidiyelwe luzisiza ngokwakha umqondo ngokudingeka kwenqgalasizinda. Umgomo wendlela yokuhlela ukusungulwa kwamaweb. Amaweb achaziwe ngaphansi kwesihloko somkhakha wokuhlelwa kwendawo. Ukuqhuba umsebenzi wokufaka inqgalasizinda kancanekancane esemazingeni azofinyeleleka ngokomnotho azodala ukusimama ukuze amazinga empilo abe ngcono kuzona zonke izakhamuzi zoKhahlamba. Ezolimo yiwona mkhakha oqinile ekuhlengeni isimo somnotho kuloMasipala. Kunomkhakha oqinile wezohwebo kwezolimo namathuba akhona okuqhubela phambili intuthuko kulomkhakha nokukhuthaza ukuthelelana phakathi kwezindawo ezisohlelweni lwezinguquko kwezomhlaba kanye nezindawo ezingaphansi kwamaKhosi lapho kunomhlaba ongakhululelwa ukulima.. Uhwebo kwezolimo luthatha indawo elinganiselwa ku 70 kokungu 100. Lendawo iyalinywa impela ngokwenelisayo. Kulinywa lokhu okulandelayo (umbila, ubhontshisi nokolo- kuniselwa ngenkasa kanye nezitshalo ezidinga umhlaba owomile), izitshalo eziluhlaza, kuyasengwa futhi kukhiqizwa inyama yenkomo neyemvu. Uhwebo ngezingodo lwenzeka endaweni encane elinganiselwa koku 1.9 kokungu100. Indawo esele elinganiselwa koku 30 kokungu 100 , ngaphandle kwamadolobha amancane , igcwele abantu abakhe ezabelweni kanye nezindawo zamaKhosi lapho imikhiqizo yezolimo ngeyokondla imindeni kuphela.

Uhulumeni weNdawo uneqhaza eliphakeme ezinhlelweni zentuthuko lapha eNingizimu Afrika. Uhlelo lwezinguquko zokusungula omasipala abangabandlululi nabaphokophelele intuthuko wumnyakazo oqavile ekusizeni ohulumeni bendawo bafake igalelo elifanele entuthukweni. Ukwethula uhlaka olucacile lwenqubomgomo ekhuthazayo ngokwethula Umthethosivivinywa woHulumeni beNdawo. Ukwethula uhlaka olusha lomthetho wohulumeni bendawo ngokuphakamisa Umthetho weziNhlaka zoMasipala kanye noMthetho weziNhlelo zoMasipala. Ngemuva kokhetho lohulumeni bendawo olwabanjwa ngomhlaka 5 Disemba 2000, isigaba soguquko sesiphelile kanti uhlelo lohulumeni bendawo selungaqala ukusebenzela esizeni esiqinile. Uhlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele (IDP) ngelinye lamathuluzi kahulumeni wendawo okubhekana neqhaza lokuletha intuthuko. Ngale kweqhaza lokuhlela olwenziwe phambilini, uhlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele selubonakala njengomsebenzi wokusingatha omasipala nanjengengxenye yeqhinga lezinhlelo ezididiyele nokwethula imisebenzi emphakathini. Uhlelo lwe-IDP luqonde ukufinyelela ezinqumeni ngezinto ezifana nesabelo-zimali zomasipala, ukusingathwa komhlaba, ukuqhakambisa intuthuko yomnotho ezindaweni nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokubonisana, ehlelekile neqonde phambili. Izinhlelo zeNtuthuko eDidiyele ngeke isize kuphela impatho yomasipala kodwa kufanele ihlahle indlela yemisebenzi yezikhungo noma imikhakha esondelene nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhumene nohulumeni, abasiza abezimboni, kanjalo nemboni ezimele ezindaweni zomasipala.

Imigwaqo yethu, imizila yezitimela kanye neyamabhasi izohlinzeka ngohlelo lwezokuthutha oluhlangene. Lokhu kubandakanya izinguquko ezifana ne-Rapid Rail ne-Bus Rapid Transit Systems, ezihlinzeka ngemizila yezithuthi zomphakathi eziyisipesheli kanye nezindawo zokushintsha kubagibeli abashintsha kwesinye isithuthi baye kwesinye. INdebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA yowezi-2010 izohola ukusetshenziswa kwamathikithi e-elekthronokhi okuhlanganisiwe okuzokwenza ukuthi abagibeli basebenzise ithikithi elilodwa ukufinyelela emabhasini, emabhasini, ezitimeleni nasematekisini. Ingqalasizinda yendawo yokuxhumana eyisathelayithi kanye neyezokuxhumana yeNdebe Yomhlaba izokweseka amandla okudluliswa kwama-gigabhayithi angama-40 ngomzuzwana futhi kuzosetshenziswa emva kuka-2010 ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ze-broadband. Isikhungo Sezokusakaza Samazwe Omhlaba eGoli sizoba yinsika yabezindaba eyamukela ukudluliswa kokusakaza ikususa ezinkundleni zezemidlalo ikusabalalisa kuwo wonke amazwe omhlaba. Isikhungo esiyinsika yabezindaba sibandakanya "ifamu" lezindishi zesathelayithi ezikhava indawo engama-5 000 m2. Ababukeli bakamabonakude abanqwabelanayo bemicimbi ka-2010 bazofika kumabhiliyoni angama-26,9. Isiqubulo sethu se-Ndebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA yowezi-2010 sithi KE NAKO. (ISIKHATHI. Halalisela ubuntu be-Afrika). " Ke Nako" igama lesiSuthu nesiTswana elisho ukuthi "sekuyisikhathi". Kuwubizo lokuhalalisela i-Afrika emvelaphini yobuntu bayo nanjengomfaki sandla kuyo yonke imizamo yobuntu.

Ukuhlela umsebenzi wezisebenzi zeNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso lwezemfundo kubo bonke amalunga eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela kanye nezincike zabo nokukhuthaza ukukhula komoya, ukwesekwa komphakathi, nokwenza okuhle. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuqondisa okuvela enhlanganweni yempi. Ukusungula inqubomgomo yokuxhumana kwezokuphepha, isu, nezinhlelo ngokuhambisana nepolitiki yeMnyango Wezokuvikela kanye nenqubomgomo yokuxhumana kazwelonke (GCIS) futhi ibe yindawo yokuxhumana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okusebenzayo, okucophelela, nokubambisana phakathi kweMnyango Wezokuvikela nezithakazelo zayo. Ukuhlinzeka inhlangano ngosizo lwezomthetho olukhethekile, usizo olugunyaziwe nolusekela ngokuhambisana nezidingo zeMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukusiza iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngolwazi namakhono mayelana nezokuxhumana kwangaphandle nezinsiza ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezempilo yezenhlalakahle kuMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka iMnyango Wezokuvikela ngentuthuko yezobuchwepheshe ukuvimbela nokwakha amathuba okufunda ngokuqashwa. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo oluphelele kubasebenzi kanye neMnyango Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo olungahlangene nokulwa kumalunga eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo ekuphathweni nasekudluliseni kolwazi nezinsiza ezihlobene kuMnyango Wezokuvikela nokweseka lokho okwenziwa yiMnyango Wezokuvikela.

Umdlalo wakhe ubukeka unamandla, ubonisa ubuchule obuphezulu, kanye nekhono lokuphendula ezimeni ezinzima. Ngonyaka ka-2011, uNovak wathola impumelelo enkulu, waba ngumdlali wokuqala ukuncintisana noRoger Federer noRafael Nadal, abanye bama-greats emlandweni we-tennis. Uqhubekile nokudlala kahle, wathola iziqu eziningi, futhi waba nguMphakathi Wokudlala Itennis. UNovak ubonisa isibonelo esihle sokusebenza kanzima, ukuzikhandla, nokuzimisela, okwenza abanye baphuphe ngempumelelo efana neyakhe. Ngaphezu kokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, uNovak ubonisa uthando lwakhe emiphakathini. Uthanda ukusiza abanye, ikakhulukazi izingane, ngokusebenzisa imifundaze yakhe. Uhlanganisa imizamo yokuthuthukisa imfundo, impilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uNovak akagcini nje ngokuba umdlali ophumelelayo, kodwa futhi ungumuntu onomoya omuhle, ofuna ukusiza abanye. UNovak Djokovic akafuni ukuba umphakathi umcabangele njengomuntu ophumelelayo kuphela, kodwa futhi njengomuntu onobuntu. Uhlonipha imindeni yakhe, abahlobo, nabalandeli, futhi ubona ukubaluleka kokuxhumana nabanye. Lokhu kuhlonipha kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinhliziyweni zabantu, futhi uNovak ubonakala engumuntu osebenzayo, onobuhlakani, futhi onobuqotho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNovak uqhubeka nokukhula, efunda ezintweni ezintsha, futhi eqhubeka nokuthuthukisa umdlalo wakhe. Uhlale eqhubeka nokusebenza kanzima, efuna ukufinyelela phezulu, futhi akavumi ukuhamba phansi. Uhlale efuna izindlela zokwenza ngcono, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi uNovak ungumuntu onomoya wokuphumelela. UNovak Djokovic ungumlingani omkhulu, umphakathi, nomphakathi.

Akudingekile ukusebenzisa imihlahlandlela ngokulandelana njengoba ibekwe ngenhla. Okusemqoka wukwenza ixhumane ngezigaba ezithile ohlelweni. Baningi abantu ababambe iqhaza kwinqubo ye-IDP, lowo nalowo unomsebenzi nesibophezelo esiqondene naye. Eminye imihlahlandlela iqondiswe kwabathile ukwenza izinto ezinqunyiwe kodwa bonke kumele babe nethuba lokufinyelela ezinkombeni uma bedinga okuthile noma ulwazi olugcwele ngengqikithi yayo. i UMHLAHLANDLELA I: Umhlahlandlela ovamile nge-IDP. Inhloso yoMhlahlandlela wokuqala wukunika ulwazi olugcwele ngenhloso nenkambiso yohlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele. Abaphathi bomasipala nama-IDP badinga ulwazi olunzulu nolucacile ngenkombandlela yokuqala ukuze bakwazi ukuhlanganisa nokwengamela uhlelo kanti abahleli nabagqugquzeli badinga ulwazi lokushayela uhlelo. Abanye badinga ulwazi, umsuku wohlelo nokuthi qhaza lini abangalibamba ohlelweni? Ngaphambi kokuba umasipala aqale lenqubo yokuhlela, kumele enze amalungiselelo athile. Ukusiza omasipala ekuhleleni inqubo ngendlela ehambisana nezidingo zoMthetho weziNhlelo zoMasipala. Kulomhlahlandlela, amathimba aqokiwe: uMphathi-masipala namaIDP - ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela nokwengamela uhlela ngendlela efanele, abahleli abangochwepheshe - ukuze bakwazi ukulusebenzisa ngemfanelo, baluguqule lapho kudingeke khona, abanye abantu - ukuthola incazelojikelele ngenhloso yokufeza leyomisebenzi abelwe yona. Kubalulekile ukwazi umhlahlandlela wesibili ngaphambi kokuqala inqubo yohlelo. Lolu lwazi lusiza omasipala ekwenzeni amalungiselelo enqubo nohlobo lwesakhiwo okuyodingeka lulandelwe noluyisisekelo sokuqalisa uhlelo.

Indlela ye-IDP encikene nezigameko nengaxubi amasu okuhlela ilindelwe ukwenza ngcono, ibeke obala inqubo ejulile yokubonisana, ukwakha iqhinga elibhekele ikusasa nenqubo eqhakambisa impumelelo yomsebenzi osuqaliwe. Umuntu akufanele aze abe wuchwepheshe wokuhlela ukuze aqonde indlela nokuhlela inqubo ye-IDP ngendlela efanele. Okuphawulekayo wukuthi uchwepheshe noma umgqugquzeli angasetshenziswa ngezigaba ezithile zomsebenzi lapho engasiza khona ngokuqagula nokuveza amasu okuhlela nezikhali ezifanele. a Ehlukanisa ulwazi ngeminyombo nokubeka ulwazi ngamaqoqwana abhekiswe emathimbeni athile abantu, isibonelo, imihlahlandlela eyisithupha ezimele b) Ukwethula ngendlela enomfaniswano iqhinga lokuhlela (ikakhulu uMhlahlandlela III ehlukanisa indlela "yemiSebenzi yokuHlela" nechazwe ngendlela efanayo neyenza kube lula ukuthola ulwazi oludingekayo. Ikunika iseluleko esinqala ngenhloso, okuqukethwe nemibandela yenhlangano nge-IDP nengaphezulu kwemibandela emincane ebekwe eMthethweni weziNhlelo zikaMasipala. Inqubo enconyelwa ukukufundisa ngayo yonke inqubo. Ikhombindlela ngomgudu wokuncikisa eminye imigomo ejwayelekile noma eqondene nemboni neye-IDP. Kungani kwenziwa isibonelo, incazelo yenhloso yomsebenzi wokuhlela? Yini okufanele ibe khona ngenxa yomsebenzi wokuhlela? Kufanele umgomo, inqubo ibe njani ukuze kufinyelelwe emphumeleni olindelwe? Ngubani okufanele asingathe umsebenzi noma abambe iqhaza? Kuyothatha isikhathi esingakanani?

Isigaba 1 asisebenzi kubaphakathi bokushada ab placed ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. a ukuthi umuntu ngamunye ohlanganiswayo uveze ubunikazi bakhe obutholwe ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zomthetho weMazisi; noma b ukuthi umuntu ngamunye uhlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngesitatimende esifungwayo njengoba kuchaziwe; noma c ukuthi omunye wamaqabane abafuna ukuhlanganiswa uveze ubunikazi obukhuluma ngesigaba a kumphakathi wokushada kanti omunye uhlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngesitatimende esifungwayo njengoba kuchaziwe ngesigaba b. Umuntu angaba ngumlingani kuphela kubudlelwano obubhalisiwe ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umuntu oshadile akakwazi ukubhalisa ubudlelwano. Umuntu ozoba ngumlingani kubudlelwano babantu obekade eshadile noma obekade eyingxenye yobudlelwano obunye kufanele kuqala uveze ikhophi eqinisekisiwe ye-decree yokuhlukanisa noma isitifiketi sokufa somuntu abeshade naye noma owayengumlingani wakhe, njengoba kufanelekile, kumphakathi wokushada njengobufakazi bokuthi ubudlelwano buphelile. Umphakathi wokushada angaphumelela emcimbini futhi abhalise ubudlelwano ngaphandle kokuthi kuqala anikezwe imibhalo ethile ekhulumayo ngesigaba 3. Ubudlelwano babantu bungabhaliswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa uma, ngaphandle kokuthi babe ngabesilisa nabesifazane, kungekho ezinye izithiyo zomthetho ezivimbela ukujola. Noma ubani ofuna ukuveza ukuphikiswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa njengabangane kufanele akhiphe lokho ebhalwe phansi kumphakathi wokushada ozohola umcimbi walobo budlelwano.

Lehlukanisa ngokucacile phakathi kweNqubo evamile ye-IDP (Umhlahlandlela III) esebenza kuzo zonke izinhlobo zomasipala namacebo aqondile okuhlela kanye nezikhali (Umhlahlandlela IV) nengase yehluke kakhulu kumasipala ngamunye. Lihlose ukusebenzisa ulimi olulula ngokugwema amagama amakhulu nanzima asetshenziswa ngabahleli. Izigameko zokuhlela zivame ukuba yimihlangano noma yizifundo zesakhiwo senhlangano esilawula inqubo ye-IDP (Isigungu sabaMmeli boMphakathi, Ikomidi lokweNgamela I-IDP, Ithimba leMisebenzi) kanti kwezinye iziwombe kungaba yimisebenzi eyenziwa ngabathile (njengabaqoqa ulwazi, ucwaningo, njalonjalo). Isigameko ngasinye kumele sibe nomphumela othile. Lowo mphumela ungaba wuhlobo oluthile lolwazi noma isinqumo. Eminye imiphumela incike ezidingweni zomthetho, ethile iyimithelela yomqondo ovamile nesiza ekulandeleni inqubo enesiphetho. Esigamekweni ngasinye sokuhlela kwenziwa izincomo ngohlobo lwenhlangano nabantu okumele babambe iqhaza ngenhloso yokuqiniseka ukuthi uhlelo lubandakanya wonke umuntu ofanele futhi kuboniswene. Indlela yokuhlela ayisho lutho kakhulu ngezikhali eziqondile zokuhlela nokufanele zisetshenziswe esigamekweni ngasinye. Lezi zikhali zehluka komasipala ngabanye. Imikhandlu yomasipala ingasebenzisa amasu okuhlela ajulile anobuhlakani bamakhompuyutha. Omasipala abasesigabeni B bangaqhuba inqubo yokuhlela efanayo kodwa basebenzise indlela esobala. Omasipala abasezingeni eliphezulu bangasebenzisa amasu athuthukile okuhlaziya ulwazi nemininingwane, (isibonelo, izinhlelo zokuhlaziya imibiko nolwazi lwendawo), abanye bangethembela ekuqageleni nenqubo yokubuyekeza ngokushesha.

Umphakathi kufanele uhlaziye lokhu ukuze uhlonze izixazululo ezinhle zalesi simo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinselelo zokuphila zomphakathi, okuhlanganisa ububha, ukungalingani kwezomnotho, kanye nemithetho eqinile yokusiza, nazo zibalulekile. Inani elikhulu labantu abasha abahlala ezindaweni ezinjengama-township alahlekelwe yithuba lokuthi baphumelele emsebenzini. Lezi zimo ziqhubeka ziqinisa ukungasebenzi kwentsha, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuhlola okukhulu kogesi kwabazwelonke nezifunda ezibalulekile. Umphakathi wezepolitiki unendima enkulu ekukhiqizeni izixazululo. Imibono yesikhumbuzo nemfundo kukhombisa ukuthi njengoba izinhlelo zomphakathi nezezimali ziqhubeka, kubalulekile ukuyekethisa izinqubomgomo ezikhethekile ezigxile ekufundeni nasekuqeqesheni. Lokhu kuzokwenyusa amathuba okusebenza सहज. Ukuze kubaluleke, kufanele kube nokuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlelo zamasiko nezomnotho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imfundo iyahambisana nezidingo zempilo. Ngaphezu kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiz resources, ukuhweba nokukhuthaza ukuba abantu basendaweni basize bazakhele amakhono. Ukuze lokho kudluliselwe empilweni yabo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngeziqu nezinhlelo ezihlinzekwa ngamathuba angcono okusebenza. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kuncishiswe impi yokungasebenzi. Imali ethile kufanele ihlinzeke izifunda ezinomthelela omkhulu, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantwana nabantu abasha bahlala bejolise emgibeni wokusebenza. Izinhlelo zokuphatha, ezinjengokuhlinzeka ngezinyathelo zokuqapha, kudinga ukuthi zibukwiswe ngokukhalipha. Umphakathi wezomnotho uzoba nesandla ekwakheni umsebenzi, uma kubhekwa izindlela ezizokwazi ukwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubantu abasha futhi baphinde bakwazi ukuxhuma nezinhlelo ezinhle zokwenza abatekenya.

Kudingeka kubhekisiswe amanani ezimali zoxhaso lwezenhlalakahle nolwazi lokuthi zitholakala kanjani lutholakale. Ukukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuqwashisa ngamathuba omnotho nokwakha izizinda ezinikeza usizo lobuchwepheshe nezeluleko ngentuthuko. Ngokwemiphumela yokubalwa kwabantu ngonyaka ka 1996 kubikwa ukuthi umphakathi Okhahlamba ulinganiselwa ku 119319 iningi labo lihlala ezindaweni zamaKhosi ezingaphandle kwamadolobha nasezabelweni kanye nasezindaweni ezihlelelwe ukuhlaliswa kwabantu. Kubikwa nokuthi kunesilinganiso sokuthi umndeni ngamunye Okhahlamba unamalungu ayisikhombisa. Umphakathi omningi walapha yintsha okutholakale ukuthi inamazinga aphansi emfundo namathuba amancane okuthola imivuzo. Lesisimo siqhubela phambili ubuphofu namazinga aphansi empilo. Umbono womkhakha nezinjongo ezihambisana nawo. Ukubhekana nembangela yobuphofu ngokuletha amathuba enhlalakahle nawomnotho eduze kweningi lomphakathi. UMasipala abhekisise amanani ezimali zoxhaso lwezenhlalakahle enze nolwazi lokutholakal kwazo lutholakale. Inqgalasizinda imbandakanya ukutholakala kwamanzi ayisamba nalawo asehlelelwe ukuya ezindaweni ezehlukene, ukulahlwa kwendle, ukuthutha, ukuqoqwa nokulahlwa kwemfucuzal, amandla kagesi, nokuxhumana nezakhiwo okutholakala kuzona izidingo zenhlalakahle. Kube, kusukela ngo 1994 uHulumeni wakhipha izimali ezinkulu zokuba kufakwe inqgalasizinda kwatholakala ukuthi oKhahlamba amasu awabangakhona. Mhlawumbe uhlelo lwentuthuko oludidiyelwe luzisiza ngokwakha umqondo ngokudingeka kwenqgalasizinda. Umgomo wendlela yokuhlela ukusungulwa kwamaweb.

Ngesikhathi esebenza nezinhlaka ezahlukene, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zifaka phakathi izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa nokuhlinzwa uma kudingeka. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi abesifazane abakhulelwe bangathola izinsizakalo zokwelashwa ezikhethekile, ezibandakanya izifundo zokuphumula, ukwelashwa kwezokwelapha, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana nezingane. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. Ekugcineni, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ukuphila kwezingane kubalulekile, futhi lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha akukhona kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, kodwa futhi zifaka phakathi ukwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi komama nezingane zabo. Lokhu kwenza uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi abesifazane badinga ukwesekwa, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abesifazane abakhulelwe bazizwa bekhululekile. Ngalesi sikhathi, uNandi waba nesithakazelo esikhulu ekutholeni ulwazi olungaphezulu, futhi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ukuphila kwezingane kubalulekile.

Kubalulekile futhi ukwazi ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo ze-herbicides ozosebenzisa ukuze ukwazi ukuhlela umshini wokuphonsa kusenesikhathi kulonyaka. Ama-herbicides angafakwa ngemuva kokutshala kodwa ngaphambi kokuthi izitshalo zivele, futhi ungafaka ama-herbicides ngemuva kokuthi izitshalo zivele emhlabathini noma ngemuva kokutshala uma umhlabathi ulungiswe kahle. Umhlabathi olungisiwe kahle ubonisa umhlabathi omuhle onokwakhiwa okungathathi izikhemikhali. Uma ama-herbicides ephonswa ngesikhathi sokutshala noma ngokushesha ngemuva kokutshala, umkhiqizi angakhetha ukufaka i-herbicide kabanzi kuyo yonke imikhakha lapho zikhona noma endaweni encane ngaphezulu komugqa owodwa. Enye indlela yile: umshini ophonsa ungafakwa emkhakheni ngokushesha ngemuva kokutshala. Ngale ndlela, kuzoba nesikhathi esanele sokwenza umsebenzi wokuphonsa ngemuva kokuthi izihlahla zivele. Indlela yokusebenza izoncika kakhulu kumatshina kanye nezinye izinto umkhiqizi anazo noma azithengile. Uma uthuthukisa izinqubo zomsebenzi, kufanele kubhekwe izinto eziningi, njengokuthi kube nesikhathi esifushane sokuphothula ukuphonsa ngoba imvula enzima ilindelwe. Izibonelo zezinhlanganisela zezikhemikhali ezitholakalayo emakethe zikhonjiswa ngezansi. Uma ungumkhiqizi noma umphathi wepulazi, thola ulwazi mayelana nezikhemikhali ezibalulekile. Emakethe, kukhona ama-herbicides ahlukahlukene anamagama amahle amaningi, kodwa wonke anohlu olufanayo lwezingxenye ezisebenzayo. Uma uqhathanisa amanani ezinhlobo ezahlukene ze-herbicides, cabangela futhi ukusebenza kahle kwalawa mahlanganisela bese uthola intengo emakethe ukuze uqhathanise nayo ingxenye esebenzayo ukuze unqume izindleko ngehektare. Ikakhulukazi ngezihlahla zonyaka.

Iphakela ukuqashelwa okubanzi kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi, ubulungiswa bezokuxhumana, ukufinyelela okufanele ezinhlelweni nasemithonjeni yomphakathi, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo ezilimi. Leli documet linikeza isikhungo esingasetshenziswa yibhodi yokukhuluma izilimi eziningi ehlanganisiwe ngaphakathi kwemigomo yeSisekelo. Kusukela ekusungulweni kokuqala kwabantu baseDashi eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1652, ngezikhathi ezilandelanayo zokubusa kweNgilandi, i-Union of South Africa, kanye nohulumeni we-apartheid, kuze kube sekupheleni kokwakhiwa kukahulumeni wenkululeko ngo-1994 nokuhlanganiswa kokukhuluma izilimi eziningi emthethweni, inqubomgomo yolimi kahulumeni nezikhungo zokuqondisa azikaze ziqaphele ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika. Umphumela walolu simo kube ukungalingani, lapho ubuholi be-English kanye ne-Afrikaans kudala ubudlelwano obungalingani phakathi kwezilimi zabo zomdabu nalezi zilimi. Ngakho-ke, inqubomgomo yolimi yeziqhingi kanye ne-apartheid, ezihlanganiswe nezinhlelo zomphakathi, zomnotho, nezombusazwe, zaveza ubuholi bezilimi, ukungalingani okukhonjiswe ezakhiweni zobuhlanga nezamakhono ezakha umphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Zonke lezi zimo zehlisa isimo sezilimi zomdabu kanye nezinhlobo zezizilimi zabantu bomdabu nezinye izigaba ezaziphikisiwe, kuhlanganisa neKhoi kanye neSan - okuqhubeka nokwakha umbono omubi wezilimi ezimnyama, okungabangelwa kuphela ngababhalisi be-Afrikaans kanye ne-English, kodwa futhi nabanye abakhuluma izilimi zomdabu uqobo.

Lokhu kuhambisana nemizamo yokuvikela imvelo, okuvusa umuzwa wokunakekela ihlathi lethu. Ukusebenza kwabo kwezobuchwepheshe obuphambili kulethe izimoto ezikhumbulekayo ezibanjwe ngamakhasimende emazwe amaningi, ngenxa yokonga ugesi nokunciphisa ama-sustainability. Imiphumela Yempilo Elokhu iToyota isiza ekwakhiweni komphakathi. Izenzo zayo zikhuthaza umbono wokuhamba onobulungiswa, okubandakanya izinqubo zokuphepha ezithuthukile. Ukuze uToyota ahlangabezane nezidingo zamakhasimende, bakwazile ukuthuthukisa amamodeli anokwakhiwa okukhulu, izinhlelo zokuphepha ezinzima, nezithuthi ezihlangabezana nezidingo zezwe lesimanjemanje. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola imoto efanelekile kumuntu ngamunye, okwenza umphakathi ubambe iqhaza elibanzi kulezi zinhlelo. Ubuqotho Bekhwalithi U- Toyota uthanda ukuhamba phambili nezinga elikhulu lokwakhiwa, okwenza kube lula ukuba nempilo ende ngemoto yabo. Lokhu kuqinisekiswa yizibuyekezo ezinhle ezivela kumakhasimende, okusho ukuthi ikhasimende lithembekile futhi lizitholele ividiyo eyodwa, yaMrs. Ndelu, ogcine imoto yakhe yaqala Mhlobo 1999 iyasebenza kahle. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, uma usukele imoto yeToyota, ungakwenzi kuphela ukuze uhambise, kodwa ungakwenza futhi njengengxenye yempilo yakho yansuku zonke. Izindleko and Umnotho Uma sizama ukuthola imoto, uToyota ungowokuhlola, ngenxa yokuba nezindleko ezilinganiselwe. U- Toyota uhlale engcono umkhiqizo uma kuziwa enhliziyweni yokuhamba. Lokhu kudala umnotho okhukhulayo, njengoba imoto yeToyota izoba yinketho eqhelelekile ezithuthweni ezithile.

Inselele ebhekene ne-Unicity ukwakha isisekelo esiqinile sokuphathwa ngendlela efanele lapho kungakhiwa khona ukuthi kusebenziseke ngokuphindelela izinhlaka ezintathu, ukuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho, ukuhleleka kwezenhlalo kanye nokuphilisana kwemvelo. Kumele kulungiswe indawo lapho ukudla okubolayo kuzolungiselwa khona bese kudayiswa ezimotweni ezifana nalezo. Umatikuletsheni oyikhwalithi uzovumela ukuthi iizngane eziningi zingene kwimfundo yamazinga aphakeme. Ngalesi sikhathi esibaluleke kangaka kumlando wethu, angeke sisakwazi ukuthi senze engathi asiboni ukuthi indlela yethu yokuziphatha kanye nendlela esiphila ngayo kunomthelela ongemuhle endaweni yethu. Bathi babezoyoyifuna kodwa abayitholanga. Ngaleso sikhathi wawungazi mayelana nokuthunyelwa kwabantu ezindaweni ezahlukene nokuthi yini ababeyenza ohlangothini ngalunye ngenxa yokungatholakali kolwazi. Kuzothuthukiswa uhlelo oluqukethe okuningi lwe-NHISSA noluzoba uhlelo oluyinhloko jikelele oluqukethe izingxenye ezahlukene. Kuyathokozisa ukubona intshisekelo enkulu emhlabeni wonke mayelana Nebhola le-FIFA Lendebe Yomhlaba lokuqala e-Afrika,' kwasho uDkt. Jordaan. Kumele sichaze izindba zethu ezilandayo ezingena kwingqikithi yobuciko bethu bomlomo bendabuko kanye nezindaba zasendulo.

Isabelo esingakhokhi intela esiwukheshi iminyaka emibili kwesekwa ngezindleko zokuzalisa imali ngamabhilidi, amafenisha, izisesthenziswa kanye nezinqola. Ungasifaka kanjani isicelo? Imiphakathi yasemaphandleni esikhathini esiningi iyizindawo ezihlupheka kakhulu ezweni. Loku kuhlanganyela kuqhubekisa ezokuvakasha eziphathelene nemiphakathi yasemaphandleni ekuthuthukiseni, ekuphatheni nasekubeni ngabanikazi bamabhizinisi asekwa yimiphakathi athuthukisa navuselela umnotho wasemaphandleni ngokusebenzisa imithombo yemvelo neyamasiko. Ezokuvakasha ezesekwa ngumphakathi zihlose ukungenisa ulwazi ngezempilo lwamasiko oluyingqayizivele nolukhethekile oluzofaka ukwehluka ekuheheni nasolwazini ngempilo lwemboni. Iyunithi Yebhizinisi Yezokuvakasha ye-IDC ixhasa ngezimali imali eqongelelweyo enkulu kumabhizinisi ezokuvakasha ngezimo semali mboleko. Ukufakela komnikazi okungacishe kube ngama- 40% enani selilonke lephrojekthi edingekayo. Umnyango Wokuthuthukisa Amabhizinisi Amancane wakwa-Eskom unemishani yokumisa Amabhizinisi Amancane, Aphakathi Nendawo kanye Namakhulu (ama-SMMEs) azokwazi ukuthuthukisa Ukunikeza Amandla Ezomnotho Kwabamnyama (i-BEE) bese kukhuphula ukuthengiswa kukagesi ezindaweni i-Eskom enikezela kuzo ugesi. I-SBD yase-Eskom ayinikezeli izimali kumabhizinisi, kodwa iqinisekisa ingxenye yemalimboleko ezuziwe ngokusebenzisa Isikhwama Sokunikeza Amandla. Abahlanganyeli Bebhizinisi yinkampani engiwa uhlu yomphakathi elungiselela ukuzalisa imali kanye nezinkinga ezinenani ukufinyelela izidingo ezicacile zamabhizinisi azimele.

Kumele unike lolulwazi ngendlela efanele. Ngendlela efanele, kuchazwa ukuthi malwedluliswe ngemigudu efanele njengokulandisa kweNEMA. Eminye imininingwane ngalokhu iyochazwa kangcono endimeni 7. Ekuxoshweni, isijeziso, inkolelo engenaqiniso noma ukuhlukunyezwa. Yini "isehlakalo sengozi ephuthumayo"? Isehlakalo sengozi ephuthumayo ngaphansi kweNEMA, yinto eyenzeka ngokushesha nengalindelekile. Kungaba yiqubula lomlilo omkhulu, ukuqhuma noma intuthu enkulu eyingozi emphakathini noma engadala ukunukubezeka okunqala noma umonakalo emvelweni njengamanje noma esikhathini esizayo. Ukuvuza kobuthi lapho kuphehlwa khona amandla kagesi nokudala ingozi emphakathini owakhele lendawo. Isehlakalo sezingozi eziphuthumayo zingaba yingozi enkulu empilweni yomphakathi neyemvelo. Kwezinye iziqubu, abantu baphoqeka ukushiya indawo ngesidumo ukuze bagweme lengozi. Kuthi kwesinye isikhathi, kube nabantu abaningi abadinga ukwelashwa ngokusheshayo, isibonelo abantu abagulayo, abadala kanye nezingane. Kungenzeka futhi kubaluleke ukuzokanisa imishini eminingi yokunqanda ukunukubezeka ukuze inhlekelele ingakhuli ngamandla. Yingakho kusemqoka ukuthola ulwazi ngesigameko ngokushesha ngemuva kokuba senzekile. Ukuvikela umphakathi nemvelo, abahlali, abasebenzi bezempilo kanye nohulumeni kufanele baziswe ngokushesha ngezinto noma ngoketshezi oluchithekile. Kungenzeka kube nobungozi bobuthi obukhiqizwa yisisi esiyingozi, okumele selashwe ngendlela eyisipesheli noma kususwe abantu. Maduzane ngemuva kwesehlakalo, atshele umphakathi neziphathimandla ngohlobo lwekhemikhali echithekile, indlela engaba yingozi ngayo empilweni nasempahleni nokuthi umthelela walokhu ungancishiswa kanjani?

Inyanga kaMashi yisikhathi esingabizi kakhulu uma kuziwa ekutholeni umumbu, kodwa yisikhathi sokulungiselela umkhiqizi ophumelelayo. Kubalimi bomumbu, isikhathi sehlobo sokuvuna sesidlulile, futhi manje sekuyisikhathi sokuphumula emumbini. Nokho, abaningi abalimi bomumbu banokukhiqiza izinkomo ezidlala indima ekusetshenzisweni okuphelele kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo emvelweni futhi kunciphisa ubungozi obuhambisana nokuvuna. Kukhona amaphuzu ambalwa abalulekile ahlobene nokuba ngumlimi wezinkomo zenyama, okuyindlela evamile yokufuya izilwane ezisetshenziswa abalimi bezitshalo. Lawa maphuzu ahlobene kakhulu nesimo nempilo yezinkomo. Ukukhulisa izinkomo ukuze kwandiswe inani lezinkomo esikhathini esizayo kubiza kakhulu, njengoba kuze kube yilapho inkomo inezinkomo zayo zokuqala, ayikhiqizi imali. Abakhiqizi abavumelani ngempela ngesimo esifanele sokukhulelwa kwezinkomo zokuqala, kodwa kulungile ukusho ukuthi kufanele kwenzeke phakathi kweminyaka emibili kuya kwemithathu. Uma inhlanzi ingadli kahle, izoba ncane kakhulu (izoba neqholo) futhi lokhu kuzokwehlisa usuku lokukhulelwa kwayo kokuqala. Empilweni yenkukhu, inhloso ukuhlinzeka ngenkukhu njalo ezinsukwini eziyi-365 (kwesinye isikhathi ngonyaka enyangeni efanayo). Uma iminyaka yenkukhu idlule lapho ikhulelwa okokuqala, kusho ukuthi izoba nezinkomo eziningi kuyo yonke impilo yayo. Inkomo ingabhekwa njengefektri yokukhiqiza izinkomo. Isikhathi sokukhulelwa kwenkukhu sithatha izinyanga eziyisishiyagalolunye futhi isuswa emadodeni ezinyanga ezimbili ezilandelayo ukuze umzimba wayo uphumule ngenkathi ikhiqiza ubisi lwezinkomo (izinkomo ziphila ngobusisi kuphela ezinsukwini zokuqala zokuphila kwazo).

Ngicela usizo lwakho nokubandakanyeka kwakho kanye nehhovisi lakho elihloniphekile ekuxhumaneni kahle nemiyalezo ebalulekile mayelana ne-pandemic influenza A (H1N1) 2009 ebhizinisini lakho nasemphakathini owusebenzela. Igama lesayensi elisemthethweni leli gciwane nguPandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Laqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngoMsombuluko walo nyaka. Ekuqaleni, kwaziwa ngokuthi i-swine flu ngoba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi ivela ezinkukhu. Manje sekuqondwa ukuthi imvelaphi yayo ivela kubantu nasezinyoni. Ngakho-ke, leli gciwane alihlangene nokudla inyama yenkukhu noma imikhiqizo yenkukhu. Manje sekuhlonishwa ngokuthi i-pandemic influenza noma ngegama layo elisemthethweni A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngoMsombuluko walo nyaka, leli gciwane lisabalalise ngokushesha ezweni elingu-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje, leli gciwane lisabalalise ezweni elingu-16 kuphela. Ngesikhathi ngibhala le ncwadi, leli gciwane selithinte abantu abangu-177,457 (oqinisekisiwe yizikhungo zocwaningo) emhlabeni jikelele, phakathi kwabo abangu-1,457 bafe. eNingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile amacala angu-2,844 kanye nezingozi eziyisithupha. Ngemuva komhlangano wesine weKomidi Lokuphendula Okusheshayo owawubanjwe ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi Lomhlaba Wezempilo (WHO) lathola ukuthi izinqubo zokumemezela leli gciwane njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke sezifeziwe, futhi uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, usememezele ngokusemthethweni lesi simo njengePandemic (izinga 6).

Inhloso yaleli bhukwana ukuqondisa abaholi bendabuko emsebenzini wabo wokubhekela ukuthi ukwenziwa kobulungiswa kutholakala kakhudlwana uma besebenza njengokhomishina abafungisayo kanye nokubeka izinqubo okufanele zilandelwe ekuphathweni kwesifungo noma kokuqinisekiswa, ukuthathwa kwesifungo esisemthethweni noma esiqinisekisiwe kanye nokufakaziswa kwemibhalo. a Amandla okubopha ngaphandle kwencwadi yemvume: umuntu owenza noma ozama ukwenza ubugebengu; ocabanga ukuthi weqile noma ozame ukweqa ekuvalelweni komthetho; umuntu ophethe impahla yokugqekeza izindlu kanye/noma yokugqekeza izimoto; umuntu otholakala ephethe izinto okusolwa sengathi zebiwe noma zitholakale ngezindlela ezingathembekile; umuntu otholakale ebusuku ezimeni ezinesisekelo sokusola ukuthi umuntu wenze noma usezokwenza ubugebengu; umuntu osolwa ukuthi unezinkomo ezebiwe, njll. kanye b Amandla okusebenzisa incwadi yemvume yokubopha. Bonke abaholi bendabuko bangabasebenzi abagcina ukuthula, ngakho-ke ngenxa yezikhundla zabo (ex officio) - bangokhomishina bokufungisa. Ngokwesikhundla sehhovisi - ukhomishina wokufungisa umuntu okuthi ngenxa yehhovisi lakhe noma yesikhundla sakhe, avele abe ngukhomishina wokufungisa. Lapho abanye abantu kufanele bafake izicelo kuNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa kanye Nokwenziwa Komthethosisekelo ukuthi baqokwe njengokhomishina bokufungisa, lona akafaki sicelo. Lapho okhimishina bokufungisa abaqokiwe benikezwa izitifiketi zokuqashwa, ngokwesikhundla ukhomishina wokufungisa akasidingi isitifiketi, ngoba unesitifiketi sehhovisi noma lesikhundla akuso. Ukhomishina ofungisayo uqokelwa indawo ethile futhi usebenza kuleyo ndawo aqokelwe kuyo.

Umbono wethu njengoHulumeni wukubona yonke imiphakathi iphila impilo engcono ngendlela elinganayo. Siyagcizelela emigomeni yethu ukuthi, abantu bakithi abakhelwe izindlu ezindaweni eziseduze namadolobha, ngokunjalo nasezindaweni zasemakhaya, sifuna nabantu bakithi baphile impilo efana neyabo bonke abantu, babe nezindlu ezinhle, ugesi, nemgwaqo. Thina njengoHulumeni wabantu asikholelwa wukuthi ukuze abantu bakithi bathole intuthuko kufanele baze baye emadolobheni, sifuna intuthuko abantu bakithi bayithole ezindaweni abahlezi kuzona futhi ilethwe ngaphandle kokuphazamisa indlela yabo yokuphila. Ukusilela ngemuva ngentuthuko yezindlu kuloMasipala walapha kusekuningi kakhulu ngenxa yokuthi izindawo eziningi ezihlala abantu bakithi lapha zazishiywe ngaphandle kohlelo lwentuthuko. Inselelo yethu njengoMnyango ukuguqula sonke lesisimo. Isivinini esihamba ngaso ekuhlinzekeni imiphakathi yakithi emakhaya ngezindlu sekwenze uHulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke nasezingeni lesifundazwe wabona ukuthi mayandiswe imali esetshenziswa nguMnyango wethu ukwakhela abantu bakithi izindlu. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi sikwazi ukunabela ngokushesha nakwezinye izindawo esingakafinyeleli kuzona. Sesizokwazi manje ukusheshisa uhlelo lwethu lokubhekana ngqo nokuqedwa kwemijondolo(slum clearance) nokwakhela abantu izindlu ezindaweni zasemakhaya ezifana nalapha, sibuyise nesithunzi sabantu bakithi emahhostela. UMnyango wezeZindlu uyazi ukuthi unzima umsebenzi obhekene noMasipala wokusheshisa intuthuko. Noma kunjalo siyabakhuthaza oMasipala ukuba babhukule bafake izicelo eMnyangweni ukuze imisebenzi enjenganalena yenabele kwezinye izindawo. Abantu ezindaweni zamakhosi yibona abasantula kakhulu intuthuko.

Uthe, “Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba awuwona umkhiqizo kuphela, kodwa ungumthombo wezimpilo zethu.” Umcimbi waphinde waba nezinkulumo ezivela kubantu abathintekayo, okuhlanganisa abanikazi bomhlaba, izinkampani ezithintekayo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. UMsizi Mkhize, ongumholi weqembu labanikazi bomhlaba, wabelane ngolwazi lwakhe mayelana nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo lapho umhlaba wabo uthathwa. Uthe, “Siyazama ukuvikela amalungelo ethu, kodwa imithetho ibonakala ingasithathi kahle. Sifuna ukwazi ukuthi singazithola kanjani izixazululo eziphumelelayo.” Ngemuva kwezinkulumo, kwaba nesikhathi sokuxoxa, lapho abantu bekhuthazwa ukuba babelane ngemibono yabo. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezimpikiswano ezinzima, kodwa eziphumelelayo, mayelana nezindlela zokuthuthukisa imithetho yokuthathwa komhlaba. Abanye babebonisa ukukhathazeka ngokuqhubeka kokuthathwa komhlaba ngaphandle kokuhlanganyela kwabantu abathintekayo, kanti abanye baphakamisa iziphakamiso zokuthi kudingeka kube nezinhlelo ezicacile zokubuyisela umhlaba kubanikazi bawo. Umcimbi uphinde waba nethuba lokwazisa umphakathi ngamalungelo abo. Izikhungo ezahlukene, ezifana ne-Advocacy Group for Land Rights, zabelana ngemininingwane yokuthi abantu bangazithola kanjani izinsiza zomthetho uma bephikisana nokuthathwa komhlaba. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu bazi kahle amalungelo abo, futhi bazi ukuthi bangabathola kanjani usizo uma kudingeka. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ubonakale uphumelele ekwakheni indawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, okuhlanganisa iziphathimandla, izazi, kanye nomphakathi.

Umuntu noma umphakathi onelungelo lomhlaba elintengantengayo ngokomthetho ngenxa yomthetho noma izenzo zesikhathi esedlule ezibandlulula ngobuzwe, unelungelo ngendlela eshiwo ehlinzikelwe ngumthetho wePhalamende, lokuthola ilungelo elime laqina emthethweni noma lokunikezwa usizo olungafaniswa nokuqiniswa kwalelolungelo.

Luhlanganisa ukuhlakanipha, amandla, ubumnene, nokuphila okuphakade. Lunezisebenzi ezimbili: ukubonisa ubunikazi nokuvikela ngomphefumulo. Luhlanganisa uphawu olukhulu lwezwe. Uphawu lokuphakama nobuhle. Iyisithombe sesithembiso sokuphinduka, amandla okucabanga okujulile, ulwazi, ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile, kanye nokuzimisela okukhulu. Isakhiwo esiphelele sebhande lesizwe sihlanganisa izingxenye zaso eziphezulu nezisezansi zibe sesimweni se-oval esimele ukuphila okuphakade. Inkokhelo eyenziwe ngelungelo lokusebenzisa impahla, izinkokhelo zezinye izinto ezakhiwe esikhathini esedlule ezifana nokubhaliswa kwezimali nezinye, noma izinkokhelo zokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani, ukwakhiwa, amalungelo emikhiqizo, amalungelo okwakha imibhalo noma ulwazi, noma yokudlulisela ulwazi oluhambisana nokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani bezinto ezithile ezakhiwe. Incazelo ye-uniti noma impahla yezezimali ingumkhiqizo wezinto noma impahla edliwayo, inani liyisilinganiso seziqu ezidliwayo, inani eliphelele elitholwe kulezi zimpahla ezidliwayo yinzuzo ngemuva kokukhishwa kwezindleko ezifanele noma ukulahleka okuhambisana nalezi zimpahla ezidliwayo. Zonke izitshalo zezimboni, izinkuni, izinkomo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, imayini, kanye nezinsimbi ezingezona ezibalulekile ezitholwe ngawe ngokuthenga noma ukushintshanisa ngezimpahla. Zonke izitshalo zezimboni, izinkuni, izinkomo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, imayini, kanye nezinsimbi ezingezona ezibalulekile zithengiswa ngawe njengomthengisi wombhali. Zonke izitshalo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, noma imayini, zethulwa ngawe njengomthengisi ophatha izimpahla zomkhiqizi ziye kubathengi ngaphandle kweRiphabhulikhi. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe. Uma inkantolo yeneliseka ngombiko, kanye nanoma yiluphi olunye ulwazi ngabazali abafuna ukuthatha ingane ngokomthetho bayenze eyabo, ingathi ngokubona kwayo, ibonelele isicelo ebese ikhipha umyalelo we-adopshini ngaphandle kokulalela omunye umuntu. Kodwa ingenza lokho kuphela uma kungekho ophikisa isicelo. Uma isicelo singakaphethwa, noma singeke saphethwa, kuyobekwa usuku lokulalela udaba lwesicelo enkantolo yezingane. Umabhalane wenkantolo yezingane uyokhipha inothisi kwi-Form 1A Notice to prospective adoptive parents ukwazisa abazali abafuna ukuthatha ingane ngokomthetho ukubazisa ngokulalelwa kodaba. Abazali bokuzala bengane ngeke babakohna enkantolo ngesikhathi sokulalelwa kodaba lwe-adopshini yengane yabo, ngaphandle kokuba inkantolo, ngokubona kwayo ibavumela ukuthi babekhona, uma inkantolo ibona ukuthi ukubakhona kwabo kuzobonelela isidingo sengane. Inkantolo ingacela abazali noma umgadi wengane ukuthi bakhiphe imvume ebhaliwe. Inkantolo ingacela nemvume ebhaliwe yengane uma ingaphezulu kweminyaka engu-10, kanti inkantolo yeneliseka ukuthi ingane iyaqondisisa ngodaba nokubaluleka kokuvuma. Uma kunoma yisiphi isigaba sokulalelwa kodaba, inkantolo ibona ukuthi kukhona izizathu ezibambekayo zokuthi ingaceli imvume ebhaliwe yabazali ngokuzala ingane, inkantolo ingacela umabhalane wenkantolo yezingane ukuthi akhiphe inothisi noma i-Form 22 ye-Notice to parent to advance reasons in terms of regulation 21 , 21 kulowo mzali. Inothisi izocela umzali ukuthi avele enkantolo yezingane uma efuna ukunikeza izizathu zokuthi kungani ukuvuma kwakhe kumele kungabekelwa eceleni.

Uma umuntu ethola imali ethintwa yintela kodwa engakhishwa kuyo intela ye-SITE noma ye-PAYE, kufanele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kulowo msebenzi. Intela yesikhashana ikhokhwa njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha. Inhloso yentela yesikhashana ukusiza abakhokhi bentela ukuhlangabezana nezibopho zabo zentela ngokwenza ukukhokha kusenesikhathi kunokukhokha imali enkulu ekupheleni konyaka lapho kubalwa khona inani lentela elikhokhwayo. Intela yesikhashana izokwenyusa inani elikhokhwayo uma kuqhathaniswa nemali yonke umuntu okufanele akhokhe intela kuyo kulonyaka wezezimali ofanele. Umuntu okumele akhokhe intela yesikhashana kufanele, ezinsukwini eziyi-30 ngemuva kokuba esebenzela, athumele isicelo esibhalwe phansi sokubhaliswa ehhovisi le-South African Revenue Service. Ukwehluleka ukwenza lokhu kuzoholela ekutheni kube nezintshisekelo nezijeziso zokukhokha sekwedlule, kanye nentela eyengeziwe ehlobene nezinkokhelo eziphuthumayo. Usuku lokukhokha intela yesikhashana esikhathini sokuqala lukhona ezinyangeni eziyisithupha ezisuka ekupheleni konyaka wentela. Intela yokuqala yesikhashana kufanele imele ingxenye yesibili yentela ephelele ekhokhwayo sonke unyaka, emva kokukhipha intela yabasebenzi ekhishwe ngaleso sikhathi kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izimali ezivunyelwe ngaphandle ngaleso sikhathi. Khipha le mali usebenzisa ifomu lokukhokha lentela elingu-IRP6, ngaphambi kosuku lokukhokha. I-SARS izothumela abakhokhi bentela yesikhashana ababhalisiwe amafomu afanele. Intela yesikhashana ingakhokhwa ehhovisi lesigaba sentela esiseduze kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu phakathi kwe-8:00 AM no-3:00 PM, ngaphandle kwezinsuku zokuphumula zomphakathi.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-DACST ithuthukisa izinhlelo zezenzo ezihambisanayo zokuthuthukisa futhi ziqguqguzele ezokuvakasha ezicike emasikweni akuleli. Maqondana nokulondolozwa kwengane ethintekayo, uMthetho wokuNakekelwa kweZingane WeNo- 74 ka- 1983 uhlinzeka ukuthi Ukhomishani weNhlalakahle yeZingane esifundeni esihlala ingane aqoke umuntu oyogcina ingane engakakwazi ukuzimela, uma kutholakala ngemuva kophenyo ukuthi leyo ngane idinga ukunakekelwa. Lowo oqokwe yiKhomishani yezeNhlalakahle ngumuntu onakekela ingane zonke izinsuku. Noma kunjalo, ogada ingane akanalo ilungelo lokusingatha amafa engane engakabi nawo amandla okuzimela.

Bokuyindawo lapho ukuhlala endaweni ethize kuwukuzibizela abanye ukuthi bakugqweleze, noma ukuphendula umphangi, lapho abomakhelwane bazokugqilazwa wutshwala nezidakwamizwa ukuze bangabuzwa ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu abaziyo ukuthi impilo yabo ingeke ijwayeleke uma kungekho ukubulalana phakathi kwabo, ukudlwengulana kanye nezimpi zonya phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo. Bokuyindawo lapho kukhomba ukuthi uma uhlala kwezinye izigodi ezithize kuwukuhlala ngokuphepha, ngoba ukuphepha kusho ukubiyelwa ngamabonda aphakeme, ucingo olunogesi, izinja ezigadile, amaphoyisa aqhaphile, kanye namasotsha alungele ukuvikela labo abangobasi bethu ngezibhamu, nezibhamu eziqhoywe kogandaganda, namabhanoyi azonisa imvula yokufa kulabo abaphazamisa obasi... Kuyasikhuthaza ukuthi ukhetho lwethu olwenzeke amaviki amabili adlulile, lunike isiqiniseko sokuzimisela kwabantu bethu, ngaphandle kokukhetha ibala, nohlobo lomuntu lokusebenzisana ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labo bonke abantu elifanayo. Izinkinga ezisihaqile zenhlalakahle yabantu azingeke zisombululwe uma singeke sidale amathuba emisebenzi, nokuhliswa noma ukuqedwa kobumpofu phakathi kwethu.

Qaphela: 1. Imibhalosifungo eyenziwe ngabanye abantu noma amanye amaphepha okufakazela udaba kufanele kuxhunyelwe kuleli fomu. Uma isikhala esinikeziwe singanele, thumela imininingwane uyinamathisele kule fomu, usayine wonke awakhasi. kuNgxenye C: IMINININGWANE KAMMANGALELWA/ABAMANGALELWA lemininigwane elandelayo kufanele inikezwe ngalowo nalowo mmangalelwa. Uhlobo lwesikhalo: uyacelwa ukuba unikeze imininingwane ephelele, usuku okwenzeka ngalo isehlakalo izehlakalo kanye nemininigwane yabo bonke labo okungenzeka babe ngofakazi. Inkantolo ingakhipa isinqumo sesikhashana, noma inqume ukuba kukhokhwe inhlawulo, noma inqume ukuba ummangalelwa axolise ngokungenambandela noma isiphi esinye isinqumo.
