Sivumelana nesu lokuthuthukiswa elinophiko olubanzi futhi investa izinsiza kubantu bethu bonke. Ukulungiselela umhlaba kube kubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukusungulwa kwesistimu nokuzuza izinzuzo ezibalulekile. Futhi yilabo abakhathazekile kakhulu abahluphekile kakhulu.

Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola amaphutha ongawazi, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi okuqukethwe kwakho kuhlelekile futhi kulungile. Isinyathelo 6: Yabelana Ngokuqukethwe Uma usuhlele futhi uhlolile okuqukethwe kwakho, sekuvele isikhathi sokwabelana. Sebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana, amabhulogi, noma amawebhusayithi ukuze ufinyelele ababukeli abaningi. Qiniseka ukuthi uthumela izixhumanisi ezithokozisayo, izithombe ezikhangayo, nezincazelo ezikhuthazayo ukuze uthole ukunakwa. Ungasebenzisa izikhangiso noma izikhangiso ezikhokhelwayo ukuze uthole ukufinyelela okukhulu. Isinyathelo 7: Thola Impendulo Ngemuva kokwabelana, thola impendulo kubabukeli bakho. Lokhu kuzokwenza uqonde ukuthi okuqukethwe kwakho kuthokozisa kangakanani, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zakho zokwakha okuqukethwe esikhathini esizayo. Ungasebenzisa izibalo, izimpendulo, noma izibuyekezo ukuze uthole umbono wokuthi abantu bacabangani ngakho. Isiphetho Ukuba abadali bokuqukethwe akulula, kodwa uma ulandela lezi zinyathelo, ungakha okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okuhlelekile, nokuhambisana nezidingo zababukeli. Khumbula, umgomo wakho uwukuhlanganyela nabantu, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokwakha umphakathi. Qhubeka ufunde, uthuthukise, futhi ube nesibindi sokwabelana ngemicabango yakho. Ngale ndlela, ungaba umdali ophumelelayo, futhi uthuthukise impilo yabanye.

Noma yisiphi isenzakalo esiqhubekayo esivela ngemuva kokusebenza koMthetho Wezobulungiswa Wezingane ka-1929 uMthetho 9 ka-1929, uMthetho Wokuhlukanisa, uMthetho Wokunakekela, uMthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwendlu ka-1998 uMthetho 116 ka-1998 kanye noMthetho Wokushada Ngokwenkolo ka-1998 uMthetho 120 ka-1998, lapho lezi zMthetho eziphathelene nezingane zingakhulunywa ezinkantolo zezingane. Umthetho ojwayelekile, ukhuthaza isimo sokuvikela nokuthuthukiswa kwezingane lezi. Umthetho wezakhamuzi, izingxabano kufanele zixazululwe ngokulandela isigaba 156 seMthethosisekelo. Ngaphandle kokuthi umthetho ulandele indlela efanele yokuphatha isigaba 2b, ngokuhambisana nesigaba 1466 seMthethosisekelo, uNgqongqoshe kufanele akhombise zonke izimo ezibekwe ngaphansi kwalolu Mthetho ezithinta isifunda kwiNational Council of Provinces ukuze kuvunywe. Umthetho ophathelene nenqubo eyenzeka ezinkantolo zezingane ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 52. Lo Mthetho kufanele uqhutshwe ngamasu kahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke, ezingeni lesifunda, uma kukhona izakhiwo zikamasipala ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko ezithile zalesi Mthetho nezimo ezazihilelekile ngokwehlukana nezibopho. Ngokubheka ukuthi kukhona izidingo zomphakathi nezomnotho ezikhona, ngesikhathi sokusebenza kwalolu Mthetho, uhulumeni kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezifanele ngokuhambisana nezinsiza ezikhona ukuze athole izindlela zokufinyelela nokufeza izinhloso zalesi Mthetho.

Ngeqhaza layo I-IDP ekuletheni uhlaka oluhlelekile lokuxazulala izinkinga nenqubo yokuthatha izinqumo ngendlela esobala, isiza ekutholeni izisombululo ezemukelekayo ngesikhathi esinqunyiwe, bese kuxazululeke izinkinga eziningi ezibambezela inqubekelaphambili. Ngaphezulu kwenqubo nendlela ehlelekile ehlongozwa kuleli qoqo lamabhukwana, kuyodingeka abagqugquzeli abanekhono ukuba bashayele uhlelo lokubonisana nokwenza izinqumo ngokubambisana. Okunye okubalulekile wukuthi izisombululo ezifanele zingafuna izingxoxo ezibanzi nezibandakanya abantu abavela ngaphandle kanye nakwezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni. Ngenxa yalesi sizathu, izinga lesiFunda liphakanyiswa ukuba yinkundla ebucayi yenqubo yokuthatha izinqumo eziklama ikusasa. Lenkundla ilungele ukuhlanganisa abantu, izimboni nesihloko nendawo yokuhlanganisa ulwazi lwendawo nolochwepheshe. Izinhlelo zentuthuko edidiyele zinhle, kuphela uma ziwusizo ekuphathweni komasipala nokwenza ngcono izinhlelo zokwethula imisebenzi nentuthuko. Ukuhlela kumele kube yingxenye yokuphatha umasipala ngokuthatha izinqumo ngendlela eziguqulela ezenzweni. Lolu lwazi ngezinqumo ze-IDP luchaza imibandela ethile mayelana nohlobo kanye neqophelo lenqubo yokuhlela. a Iziphakamiso zemisebenzi kufanele zibe nesisekelo futhi ziqonde maqondana nomphumela ohlosiwe, iqophelo lomsebenzi, isikhathi, indawo, izindleko nabayoqhuba umsebenzi. e Kufanele kube nokuvumelana okwenele phakathi kwabantu abawusebenzisayo, amathimba athintekayo nabanye abathintekayo ngemisebenzi ehlelwayo ukuze kugwenywe ukubambezeleka okungadingekile nengxabano.

Umphakathi wendawo kufanele wamukele ukuthi imithetho yamasipala ibamba iqhaza ekusebenzeni nasekuphumezeni inqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. a ngezizinda ezahlukene zezakhiwo nezindawo; futhi b ngezizinda ezahlukene zabaphathi abaphethekile ukukhokha intela yezindlu. Uma umphakathi unquma ukuklama intela yezindlu, kufanele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1, akhe intela yezindlu kuzo zonke izakhiwo noma ezindaweni ezibophelelwe intela yezindlu ngaphakathi komphakathi noma endaweni ngaphansi kokuphathwa komphakathi wendawo obophelelwe intela yezindlu. i uma umphakathi uqobo noma omunye umphakathi ungumnikazi; noma ii njengoba kuxoxiwe esigabeni b encazelweni yendawo noma impahla esigabeni 1; noma iii lapho ilungelo lokuba umnikazi lendawo lingavikelwa ngokomthetho ngenxa yemithetho yokucwasa edlule noma ezinye izizathu ezenza kube nzima noma kungenzeki ukuthola inani; noma b ukuvimbela umphakathi ekunikezeni amalungelo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 14 mayelana nezimali zokubuyiselwa, noma ukukhokha okweqile noma ukunciphisa ekukhokheni intela yezindlu ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1. b ukusetshenziswa okukhuthazwayo kwempahla noma indawo; noma c indawo lapho impahla ikhona. Inani lentela yezindlu ohlelweni lwendawo lapho yakhiwe khona ngokuhlanganyela endaweni eyodwa kufanele iklanywe ngendlela ehlukile ngokuya ngosayizi waleyo ndawo okufanele ibophelelwe yalesi sistimu futhi hhayi iklanywe njengemali eyodwa ehlanganisa yonke indawo.

Sebenzisa imephu yaseNingizimu Afrika ukukhombisa ukuthi kuphi iNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape. Isithombe 1: Iqembu Lokufunda iKhanyayo emhlanganweni walo. Isithombe 2: Umongameli weqembu lokufunda iKhanyayo, uMnu. Magidela, phambi kwemifino yakhe. Le nqembu yokufunda itholakala kuphi? Le nqembu yokufunda itholakala endaweni yasemaphandleni lapho kungelamigwaqo emihle nezitolo. Itholakala cishe ngamakhilomitha angama-60 ukusuka eBizana eNingizimu Mpumalanga Cape. Kukhona amalungu angama-100 kule nqembu. Kukhona amahektare angama-100 angakhuliswa ukuze akhiqizwe. Yini eyenza kungakhuliswa yonke imhlaba engavunwa? Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza zokutshala. Ukuntuleka kwezinto zokwakha izithiyo. Izimo zezulu - ekuqaleni kwesizini yokutshala ngo-2010, imvula yayinzima kakhulu, yenza kube nzima ukutshala. Ubudlelwano obude bokuxhumana nalabo abanikeza izinsiza zokutshala, njengezithako, imbewu, nezinto zokwakha. Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kangakanani? Iqembu lokufunda lihlangana kanye ngenyanga neGrain SA, futhi lihlangana njalo ngesonto ukuze lixoxe ngezindaba zokulima. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda? Ikakhulu, izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leqembu lokufunda zifaka ukwabelana ngolwazi, ukuxoxa namanye amalungu eqembu, nokuhlonza izindlela ezifanele zokusebenza ezifana nokuthatha amasampula omhlabathi, ukutshala, ukufaka izithako, nokuhlola izindlela ezintsha. Iqembu lokufunda iKhanyayo linethuba lokuh attend the First Training Session on Maize Planting. Ingabe kukhona ukubambisana phakathi kweqembu lokufunda nabanye abalimi bezomnotho? Okwamanje, akukho abalimi bezomnotho kule ndawo!

Umfuyi ophuma eFouriesburg uphumelele, ungumkhiqizi ophawulekayo! Umfuyi ophumelele emncintiswaneni yeGrain SA Farmer of the Year ubikwe eThe Theatre on the Track eKyalami, ngo-Okthoba 9, 2009. U-Shimi Makoka ophuma eVanderbijlpark, eGauteng. Umkhiqizi Osafufusa Wezinyoni Zonyaka ophumelele kulo nyaka nguSamuel Moloi ophuma eFouriesburg eNyakatho Nentshonalanga. Sifuna ukusho "Hooray!" kuSamuel nakubanye bonke abaphakanyisiwe.

UMBUZI MIBUZO: faka inombolo yekholamu yomuntu kuthebhula le-rosta ngenhla. Sifuna ukwazi noma sekuke kwashonwa yini kulelikhaya/muzi ezinyangeni ezingu 24 ezedlule. Kungabe likhona yini ilungu lallendlu elashona ezinyangeni ezingu 24 ezedlule? UMBUZI MIBUZO: (hlonza isikhathi okuyisona sona - isibonelo, "kusukela ngo- September 2003")? Kwashonwa kangaki la ekhaya ezinyangeni ezingu 24 ezedlule? Walugubha eneminyaka emingaki usuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lokugcina. Maqondana nezingane ezingaphansi konyaka owodwa , faka "00". Umbuzi mibuzo: kuleli zinga ke- uzoqoka umhlinzeki mininingwane ukugcwalisa izigaba ezisasele zephepha-mibuzo ngokwasekhaya kanye nomphenduli mibuzo wephephap mibuzo lomuntu ngayedwana. Umhlinzeki mininingwane nomphenduli mibuzo ngayedwana kungenzeka kungabi umuntu oyedwa. Sifuna ukufaka imibuzo bonke abantu abaneminyaka yobudala engu 50 nangaphezulu abasekhaya ngosuku lwemibuzo, kepha umuntu ominyaka yakhe yobudala ingaphansi kwengu 50 angaligcwalisa iphepha-mibuzo ngokwasekhaya. Maqondana nesampula labaphenduli mibuzo abaminyaka yabo ingu 18-49 kuphepha mibuzo lomuntu ngayedwana, sebenzisa imigomo yethebula likaKish ukuqoka lowo muntu oyedwa kubantu basekhaya abafanelekile. UMBUZI MIBUZO: Maqondana nomhlinzeki mininingwane, khetha umuntu ekhaya owazi kangcono kunabanye ngekhaya nesimo sempilo sabahlala kulo, isimo sabo somsebenzi, sezimali, izindleko nemishuwalense yezempilo. Kungenzeka kudingeke kukhulunywe nedlanzana labantu ekhaya ukuze kutholakale lokhu.

ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe yoMkhandlu emva kokufakwa kwesicelo eMkhandlwini. Ukuvikelwa okujwayelekile: Izindawo zokungcwaba zendabuko 47. lingekho emathuneni aphethwe ngumaziphathe wendawo, elingonakaliswa, elingashintshwa, elingavunjululwa, elingasuswa endaweni yalo, noma linyakaziswe ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe yoMkhandlu emva kokufakwa kwesicelo eMkhandlwini. umfakisicelo kanye nemiphakathi efanele noma nabantu abafanele sebefike esivumelwaneni mayelana nethuna. Ukuvikelwa okujwayelekile: Izindawo okwakulwelwa kuzona izimpi, izindawo okwakuhlalwa kuzona emandulo, izindawo ezinamadwala aqoshiwe, nezindawo ezinezinto ezabunjwa emandulo, izindawo ezinezigaxa zamadwala eziwa esibhakabhakeni kanye nomthelela wazo 48. ngaphandle kokuthola imvume ebhaliwe yoMkhandlu emva kokufakwa kwesicelo eMkhandlwini. Uma kutholakala izimpahla zendawo okwakuhlalwa kuzona emandulo noma zendawo enezinto ezabunjwa emandulo ngayinoma yimuphi umuntu, yonke imisebenzi noma okwenziwa lapho kukhona lezo zimpahla kumele kumiswe khona manjalo futhi umuntu ozitholile kumele alethe umbiko obhaliwe eMkhandlwini ngaphandle kokuchitha isikhathi. UMkhandlu, emva kokubonisana nomnikazi noma nomaziphathe olawulayo, ngesaziso esiqondiswa kumnikazi noma kumaziphathe olawulayo, ungavimbela noma yimuphi umsebenzi uMkhandlu obona ukuthi awufanelekile owenziwa emamitheni angama-50 endawo enamadwala aqoshiwe.

Mabili amathuba entuthuko acacile ahlobene noHlelo Lokubuyekezwa Komhlaba ebaQulusini, ikwezolimo nezokuvakasha. Amathuba okubuyekezwa komhlaba kumele ahlelwe aqondaniswe kanye namanye amathuba entuthuko ahlonziwe. Indawo yasebaQulusini isemathubeni amahle okuveza amathuba ezimakethe zezokuvakasha futhi lokhu kumele kuhlolwe ngokwamathuba omklamo wokubuyekezwa komhlaba. I- Ithala Game Reserve yakhiwe ngaphandle kancane kweNyakatho nendawo kamasipala iLouwsburg. Ihlinzeka ngezilwane zasendle, izindawo ezinobuhle bemvelo ezingabukwa kanye nendawo yokuhlala, embandakanya izikhungo zezokuvakasha zezinga eliphezulu, enezindlu zokulala ezingama-240 nama-bush camps amane. INgome Forests imbandakanya indawo iThendeka Wilderness, ethathwa ngomasipala bendawo njengeyisimangaliso kuneTsitsikamma esogwini oluseMpulanga Kapa. Le ndawo yodwa inezinhlinzamfuku zomdabu ezingama-84 futhi inezindawo zokukhempa kanye nemizila eminingi yokuhamba ephakathi kwamakhilomitha ayisi-7 nangama-21. Amapulazi endawo nawo ambandakanya izindawo ezinhle ezinobuhle bemvelo. Ukungabi nomfutho kwabasebenzi abadingekayo eziqiwini zezolimo uma kuqhathaniswa nomkhiqizo wezolimo kuthathwa njengenhlanhla kubalimi abathintekayo mayelana nokulawulwa kokugcwala kwabasebenzi abanamandla. Njengezokuvakasha, ezolimo zinikezela ngamathuba angempela entuthuko. Nakuba indawo yasebaQulusini ithathwa njengengalimeki, wonke amathuba okulima kumele asetshenziswe.

Uma senza imisebenzi yaso ngokwesigaba salo Mthetho, isiKhungo kumele siqalise ukusebenza koHlelo lokuTshalwa kweziMali neMpahla ePhumayo lwesiFundazwe. 24. (a) ILungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali linganquma imikhombandlela yamasu okufezekisa izinjongo zesiKhungo futhi linganikezeka imiyalelo yenqubomgomo eBhodini. ILungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali lingahoxisa noma lichibiyele noma yimuphi umyalelo wenqubomgomo okhishwe ngokwendima (a). nenzuzo etholakale ngokusemthethweni kunoma yimuphi umthombo ogunyazwe nguMthetho wokuPhathwa kweziMali zikaHulumeni, njengokuchitshiyelwa kwawo. nokuqhutshwa kwemisebenzi kanye nokusebenza kwesiKhungo nokuthi isiKhungo sisebenzise amandla aso ngokwalo Mthetho. sivule i-akhawunti egameni lesiKhungo esikhungweni esibhaliswe njengebhange ngokoMthetho wamaBhange, 1990 uMthetho No. sifake lapho yonke imali etholwe ngokwesigatshana (1). yesiKhulu esiPhezulu kanye namanye amalungu abasebenzi besiKhungo. IsiKhungo singatshala izimali ezifakwe kwi-akhawunti yaso ezingadingi ukusetshenziswa ngokushesha: Kuncike ekutheni iBhodi kumele lithathe izinyathelo ezifanele ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukutshalwa kwezimali akukona kohlobo olungaqondakali lokuzalanisa imali.

Ukushisa kakhulu kungenza ukuthi izithombo zome zife. Isithwathwa masinya onyakeni singabulala izithombo. Kungenzeka futhi ensimini lapho kwatshalwa khona ubhekilanga kwase kwafika imvula eqinise umhlabathi. Uma uzama ukufocoza umhlabathi oqinile ngehhala ungalimaza izithombo. Ukufa kwezitshalo lapho zisakhula. Izimpahla ezidla utshani zingaba inkinga ezindaweni eziningi. Ukuhlakula ngemishini kungalimaza izishalo - lapho izikali zingalinganiswa kahle, noma umshayeli engaqondisi kahle (lapho imisele yezitshalo ingalingani kahle futhi ingaqondi kungalimaza izitshalo). Izifo zingadala ingozi. Lapho ukhula lukhona kakhulu lungabulala izitshalo zakho. Singaphumelela kanjani kule nkinga yenani yezitshalo elingaphansi? Uma sekukhona isikhathi, ungaphinda utshale (kodwa lokhu kusho ukuthi kuzobakhona eziningi ezinsha). Uma kubonakala ukuthi kukhona umsele owodwa ozange uhlanyelwe (ngoba ipulantela belingasebenzi kahle), lowo msele ungaphinda uhlwanyelwe. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukuthi izinkinga ezivelile ngenxa yenani yezitshalo eliphansi zihlolwe zilungiswe ukuze lawo maphutha angaphindi enzeke ngonyaka ozayo.

IKOMISHINI YOKWENZA KUPHUMELELA KWESIKHATHI SOKUFIKELA KULWAZI NENDAWO YEKOMISHINI YOKWENZA KUPHUMELELA KWESIKHATHI SOKUFIKELA KULWAZI. Ngokwesigaba 14 soMthetho Wokuphakanyiswa Kwefayela Lokufinyelela Kulwazi, uMthetho No. IKomishini Yezinsizakalo Zomphakathi (PSC) iyisikhungo somphakathi esizimele esisunguliwe ngokweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. I-PSC inenhloso yokuhlola, ukubheka, nokuhlola ukuhlela nokuphatha imisebenzi kahulumeni. Le mthethosisekelo ifaka phakathi ukuhlola ukusebenza kahle noma okungasebenzi kahle kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni. Ngaphezu kwamandla akhuluma ngenhla, i-PSC inenhloso yokuphakanyiswa kwezindlela zokwenza imisebenzi yeHulumeni ibe nekhono nelungelo, nokuphakanyiswa kwemigomo nemigomo yokuphatha umphakathi njengoba ibhalwe kwiMthethosisekelo kuyo yonke imisebenzi kahulumeni. IKomishini ithola amandla ayo ezigabeni 195 no-196 zeMthethosisekelo ka-1996. Isigaba 195 sichaza izimiso nemigomo ephethe ukuphathwa komphakathi okumele iKomishini iphakamise. Izinga eliphakeme lezemfundo. Ukusetshenziswa kahle, okungabizi, nokusebenza kahle kwezinsiza. Ukuphathwa komphakathi okuhloswe ukuthuthukiswa. Izinsizakalo kumele zinikezwe ngendlela engakhethi, ngendlela efanele, ngendlela efanele, futhi ngaphandle kokwehluleka. Kumele ziphendule ezidingweni zabantu, futhi umphakathi kumele ukhuthazwe ukuba ube nengxenye ekwenzeni izinqumo. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kumele kube nekhono. Ukuveza kufanele kuphakanyiswe. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu okuhle kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi kumele kukhuthazwe.

Ukuntuleka Kwemisebenzi Emiphakathini Yasemakhaya Emiphakathini yasemakhaya eNingizimu Afrika, ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi sekuphenduke inkinga enkulu, ezwakalisa izinselelo eziningi kumphakathi. Izinsuku zethu zikhombisa ukuthi imisebenzi iyisisekelo sokuphila kahle, kodwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwayo, abantu baningi abakhubazekile ukudla okwaneleyo, izindlu ezifanele, kanye nemfundo ezayo. Kuqala, kudingeka kuqondwe ukuthi le nkinga igqamile emiphakathini eminingi. Izizathu eziningi zenza ukuthi le miphakathi ibhekane nezithiyo ezinkulu ekutholeni imisebenzi. Ukuntuleka kwezimali zokutshala, ukwehla kwemisebenzi yokukhiqiza, kanye nezinselele ezinkulu kwezokuthutha, ziza phambili njengemithombo yalesi simo. Iziphathimandla zikhuluma ngale miphakathi, zikhuthaza ukusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi, kodwa imiphumela ivele ibonakale kancane. NgokweZibalo, inani labantu abavela emiphakathini yasemakhaya abangu-60% baphila ngaphansi kwemigomo yokuphila emaphakathini aanhlamvu omnotho, okwenza ukuba kube nzima ukuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Abantu abaningi bakhuluma ngempilo elindeleke kabi, okukhombisa ukuthi bahlushwa ukuntuleka kwemali, ukungabi nemisebenzi, nokwehla kwezinga lokuphila. Lokhu kudala umoya wokukhathazeka emindenini, lapho kukhula khona umuzwa wokwehluleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi imfundo eyanele ikhalipha abantu ekutholeni imisebenzi, kodwa emiphakathini yasemakhaya, ukuqeqeshwa kwemicabango namakhono akabikhona. Izikhungo zemfundo azitholi ukweseka okuningi, futhi abantwana balahleka ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezinsiza ezidingekayo.

Ingane kufanele iboshwe, ihlale ejele ngaphandle kwesigwebo noma ibekwe ejele uma kungekho okunye okungenziwa futhi kufanele ibekwe isikhathi esifushane esinokwenzeka. Nanoma iyiphi ingane ebekwe ejele kufanele iphathwe ngobuntu noma ngenhlonipho nesithunzi. Ingane kufanele iphathwe ngendlela ecabangela izidingo zeminyaka yayo yobudala. Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ingane ihlukaniswe kubantu abadala (ngaphandle uma lokhu kungesilo usizo enganeni ngenxa yezizathu ezithile). Ingane inelungelo lokuvakashelwa nokuthola izincwadi ezivela emndenini wayo, ngaphandle uma kunesizathu sokuthi kungani kungeke kube yinto enhle lokhu. Yonke ingane eboshiwe noma ebekwe ejele kufanele inikezwe usizo lomthetho olusheshayo kanye nolunye usizo. Kufanele ibe nelungelo lokuya enkantolo ukuyobuza ukuthi ingabe ukuboshwa noma ukugwetshwa kuyiqiniso yini futhi inelungelo lokuthola impendulo esheshayo kulo mbuzo. Ucabanga ukuthi yini engaholela ekutheni ingane yenze ubugebengu Uke wabenza ubugebengu Ucabanga ukuthi impilo yasejele ingamenzani umuntu osemncane. Yini engenziwa ukusiza abantu abancane ukuthi baphenduke ebugebengwini baphile impilo elungile? Kunemithetho eminingi yamazwe omhlaba ephathelene nezingane eziphila ezindaweni lapho kunezimpi khona futhi kuliwa ngezikhali. Ohulumeni bayavuma ukuyihlonipha le mithetho kanye nokuzama ukuqiniseksia ukuthi nabanye bayayihlonipha. Enye yezinto uhulumeni okufanele ayenze ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kweyi-15 azizilwi izimpi. Lokhu kusho ukuthi akufanele ukuthi bavumele izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-15 ukuthi zijoyine umbutho wabo wezempi. Uma ubheka umabonakude uzobona amasotsha ayizingane kwezinye izingxenye zamazwe omhlaba.

Ngokuvamile, abanye abahlinzeki bagesi badinga amakhasimende ukuthi asayine isivumelwano sokukhokha isikweletu sabo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esithile. Ukusebenzisa ugesi ngokucophelela kuzokusiza unciphise ukusetshenziswa kwakho nezindleko zanyanga zonke. Ungakwenza kanjani lokhu? Amashubhu, izifudumezi zamanzi (ama-gizmos), kanye nezifudumezi (ama-radiators) ziwabathengi bagesi abakhulu futhi zandisa ibhili lakho likagesi. Uma unesi fudu seziwasha, qiniseka ukuthi i-thermostat ayibekwe phezulu. Ungabeka i-thermostat cishe kuma-60 degrees. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuze uthole izeluleko ngalokhu. Ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kukagesi esifudumezini zamanzi: uma unamandla, unganciphisa izinga likagesi eliya esifudumezini zamanzi, futhi lokhu kungaphinde kwenziwe kumapayipi ahambisa amanzi. Le ndlela inciphisa izindleko zikagesi kakhulu kodwa kuza nemali ethile uma ufuna ukuyisebenzisa. Isitofu: qiniseka ukuthi awuvuli wonke amaplethi esitofu ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izeluleko zithi unciphise ukushisa ephethe uma iphunga lakho liphume. Ungasebenzisi i-oven njengendlela yokufudumeza ngoba i-oven isebenzisa ugesi omningi. Izifudumezi: izifudumezi zikagesi zisebenzisa ugesi omningi. Uma unesi fudu sikagesi, kunconywa ukuthi uvule kuphela isifudumezi esisodwa. Kodwa uzokwazi ukuthi lokhu kuzokwandisa isikhathi ngaphambi kokuba indlu yakho ifudumale. Ukuvala amawindi: enye indlela yokunciphisa ukulahleka kokushisa ukuvala amawindi endlini yakho. Ukukhanya: ilambu elivaliwe ngengilazi linika ukukhanya okuningi kanti lisetshenziswa kagesi okuncane. Ungaxhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuze uthole olunye ulwazi.

Ngifisa ukuniqinisekisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemndleni emhlabeni wonke besebenzisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola ikhambi. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, ikhambi elifana naleli lingakhona ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Kodwa, kunesindingo esikhulu kabi sekhambi nokukhiqizwa obukhulu bako bunganele - ubukhulu obungekho e-Afrika. Ngifisa ukunibobonga ngesikhathi enibe naso sokufunda le ncwadi, futhi ngiphinde ngibonge ukubamba kwenu iqhaza okulindelekile ekudluliseni ulwazi nasekwehliseni imiphumela yalokhu kufa.

amandla noma umsebenzi onikezwe elinye ilungu ngokomthetho. ukwenza lowo msebenzi. kuqala ukusebenza emva kokumenyezelwa nguMongameli. ezinye izifundazwe noma izwe lonke. ezithile futhi senze noma yiziphi izincomo ezilungile isiGungu esikhulu. Umthetho kazwelonke ungalawula uhlelo olumiswe kulesi sigaba. eKhabhinethi uma leso sinqumo sixhumene nomsebenzi owabelwe lelo lungu leKhabhinethi. kufanele umphakathi ukwazi ukufinyelela kuyo. oMkhandlu, uMongameli kufanele alakhe kabusha iKhabhinethi. amalungu eKhabhinethi kanye nanoma yiliphi iSekela likaMongameli kufanele bashiye isikhundla. Imingcele yezifunda yileyo ekhona ngesikhathi uMthethosisekelo uqala ukusebenza. bamalungu aso, singacela iPhalamende ukuthi lishintshe igama laleso sifundazwe. okuhambisana nalokho okubekwe ngumthethosisekelo nalowomthethosisekelo wesifundazwe. udaba olukuluhlu lukaSheduli 4, ungumthetho maqondana nodaba olukuluhlu lukaSheduli 4. okubusa kulo, umthetho wePhalamende ngaphezu komthetho wesifundazwe. olunomphumela, jikelele, wokumelwa okuhambisana nenani lamavoti elitholiwe. ngaphansi kwalesigaba kuphela eminyakeni emihlanu emuva kokuqedwa kwesigwebo. lesiShayamthetho, ngaphansi kwemibandela noma isimo esimiswe wumthetho kaZwelonke. zesiShayamthetho zibeka ukulahlekelwa wubulungu. nangokuthobela uMthethosisekelo, ngokuhambisana noSheduli 2. Isishayamthetho sesifundazwe sikhethelwa iminyaka emihlanu. kwesishayamthetho, noma ngemuva kokuphela kwesikhathi sokusebenza kwaleso sishayamthetho. ezingu 90 ngemuva kokudlula kwalesosikhathi noma kosuku ukhetho olwamiswa ngalo. iminyaka emithathu isidlulile emuva kokukhethwa kwalesosishayamthetho.

Lokhu kudinga ukuthi siqaphele izinkinga ezithinta izinsiza zokudla emiphakathini ethile. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi umphakathi udinga ukuxhumana futhi ubambisane ukuze kutholakale izixazululo. Abantu kumele bazi ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinsiza ezithile, okungaba kuhle uma kukhona izinhlelo zomphakathi ezisiza emindenini empofu. Kukhona futhi impatho yokudla. Inhlalakahle iyasiza, kodwa uma izinsiza zingekho, abantu baphuma ezindaweni ezinzima. Udaba lwezindawo zokudla, ezinjengezikhungo zokudla, luhamba phambili. Lokhu kusho ukuthi uma umndeni ungakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni zokudla, noma uma lezi zindawo zikhona, kudinga ukuba zibe nezinsiza eziwusizo. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sibe nezinhlelo ezithile zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokudla emiphakathini. Ngokubambisana, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izinkinga zokudla zenzeka ngenxa yezizathu ezihlukahlukene. Ukuntuleka kwemali, izinsiza ezingekho, kanye nezindlela zokuphila, konke lokhu kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni izinkinga zokudla emindenini empofu. Kudingeka ukuba sibe nezinqubomgomo ezithile ezisiza ukwakha umphakathi onempilo, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuphila impilo engcono. Ngasolwazi, sikhuluma nangokubaluleka kokufundisa. Abantu kufanele bafundiswe ngokudla okunempilo, ukuze baqonde ukuthi yini okufanele bayidlayo. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi uma abantu bazi kahle, bazokwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezilungile. Ngempela, uma umphakathi jukujabulela ukufunda, lokho kuzokwenza kube nokuthula. Kudingeka ukuba kube nezinhlelo zokufundisa ezithinta ukudla, ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukukhula. Ekuqaleni, sikhuluma ngempilo, kodwa ekugcineni, sikhuluma ngothando. Umndeni ophilayo uthanda ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zokudla, futhi lokhu kubalulekile.

Izinsuku eziyi-16 zoKulwa nokuHlukunyezwa kwaBesifazane neZingane ziwumkhankaso kazwelonke oba minyaka yonke kusukela zingama-25 kuLwezi (usuku lomhlaba wonke lokulwisana nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane) kuya ziyi-10 kuMasingana (usuku lwamalungelo abantu emhlabeni wonke). Kulesi sikhathi, uHulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika uba nomkhankaso weZinsuku eziyi-16 zoKulwa nokuHlukunyezwa kwaBesifazane neZingane, okuhloswe ngawo ukuqwashisa ngomthelela ongemuhle wodlame kwabesifazane nezingane. Lokhu kuhlose ukusebenzisa lo mkhankaso ukuvusa yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ukuthi ilwisane nokuhlukunyezwa. Uhulumeni uzinikele ukwakha umphakathi onakekelayo nonokuthula, ovikela abesifazane nezingane kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuhlukumezeka. Nakuba uMkhankaso weZinsuku eziyi-16 zoKulwa nokuHlukunyezwa kwaBesifazane neZingane uba zingama-25 kuLwezi kuya ziyi-10 kuMasingana minyaka yonke, Izinhloso zawo zivuselelwa ngohlelo lonyaka wonke olwaziwa ngeloHlelo lweZinsuku ezingama-365 kanjalo noHlelo lukaZwelonke. Minyaka yonke, uhulumeni, ebambisene nezinhlangano zemiphakathi nomkhakha wezamabhizinisi, bayaqhubeka nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukwandisa umthelela womkhankaso. Ngokweseka lo mkhankaso, izinkulungwane zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika usize ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa ngokuhlukunyezwa nokwakha ukweseka labo abahlukumezekile nalabo abasinde ekuhlukunyezweni. Yeseka umkhankaso ngokugqoka iribhini elimhlophe ngesikhathi sezinsuku eziyi-16: Iribhini elimhlophe liwuphawu loxolo lumele ukuzinikela kwalowo oligqokile ukungashayi indiva udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane.

Sivumelana nesu lokuthuthukiswa elinophiko olubanzi futhi investa izinsiza kubantu bethu bonke. Ukulungiselela umhlaba kube kubalulekile ekuqinisekiseni ukusungulwa kwesistimu nokuzuza izinzuzo ezibalulekile. Futhi yilabo abakhathazekile kakhulu abahluphekile kakhulu. Kucacile ukuthi iTshwane iyidolobha elinikeza amathuba amaningi okuxhumana kwezomnotho, ukuxhumana kwezok education, kanye nezamasiko, ezokuvakasha, nezokuxhumana. Izifunda ezingaphandle kwalesi sifunda zizophoqeleka ukuba zihlolisise izinhlelo zazo zokuthuthukiswa. UMbutho Wezokuphatha Wasekhaya uqeqeshwe ukwenza ukuhlola kwedatha nokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi. Uma ungumthuthukisi wephrojekthi, umema ukuba uthumele ifomu lesicelo ukuze ubonise ukuthi unentshisekelo yokubhalisela iphrojekthi yakho. Lezi zindawo ngokuvamile zikhululwa ngaphansi kwedamu, lapho ikhwalithi yamanzi iphansi futhi ingase ibe yingozi ezidalweni eziphilayo emanzini. Lo mphakathi unabantu abaningi abaxhumene nabo abathatha izinto kalula emhlabeni wonke, kuhlanganise nabapolitiki. Ngithanda ukuqaphela intuthuko eyenziwe wezweni lonke. Ungangiqinisekisa ukuthi kudlule isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokuba uvalwe? Ekhulumeni kwakhe kokugcina njengoMongameli ngoSepthemba unyaka odlule, wakhombisa ukuzithoba kwelizwe lakhe futhi wabeka lokho elizweni elifuna phambili kokuthi yena ofuna. Ikhwalithi yokugunda utshani iholela ekutholeni kahle lokho okomile kwezilwane. Kukhona okuthile okulindelwe ukuthi kwenzeke uma iziqondiso zokungcoliswa komoya ziphulwa. Izigaxa zingaba uphawu lwezifo, noma umphumela wokudla okungafanele.

Kanye nokubambisana okulindelekayo, ukuhlobana komphakathi nezinhlelo ezibucayi zaphinde zavuma izigaba ezihlukahlukene. Abesifazane, izinsizwa, ubuhlakani bezifunda, nezindlalifa zaba phakathi kwezingxenye eziyinhloko zendaba ebalulekile yezehlakalo. Lezi, zaqhubeka zikhula zodwa, zibhalela izimvo ngezindaba ezahlukahlukene ezibandakanya ubumqoka bezombusazwe, izinsiza, nezinsiza. Izinqumo ezithathiwe zabathintekayo kwavuma ukuveza izici ezintsha ezikhombisa ukuqondiswa kwemigomo eyenzekile. Lokhu kuboniswe ngokukhuluma ngokucacile, ukugqugquzela kuphakamisa udumo lokuzigcina. Ukujula kwezincazelo zemithetho ezichaza umphakathi, kuveza ubunzima bokubambisana nezindlela ezizinzile. Lokhu kuveza umkhuba osemtshali emhlabeni jikelele ukuze umphakathi uzimele ekwahlukaniseni. Ukuze umphakathi uphumelelise izinjongo zawo, uhlelo lokubamba iqhaza ludinga ukuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kudinga abadlali abaningi, abathintekayo, abasanda kuhlangana nezici zomphakathi, nasesikhathini esizayo. Izinkinga ezihlobene nezombusazwe, umthetho, nobuhlakani bempilo zidinga ukuqaphela ukungqubuzana okukhona, ukuze umphakathi uqhubeke ubonisa amandla okuletha izinguquko ezibalulekile. Isidingo senqubo yokubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuchibiyelweni komthethosisekelo sibe nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni isidakamizwa esiphezulu, ngokuhlanganisa izwi ofuna ukudala igugu elisha. Futhi, lokhu kuholele emsebenzini omusha wokwakha umthetho ofanele nezindlela zokuphatha ezikhiqiza umphakathi ophilayo.

Umnumzana Jabu, owayedlala indima enkulu ekugqugquzeleni abantu, wathi, “Sizokwakha izikhungo zemfundo. Sizokwakha iziteshi zamanzi, ukuze wonke umuntu athole amanzi ahlanzekile. Sizobambisana nezinkampani ezikhiqiza ukudla, sikhuthaze ukuzimela.” Ngaleso sikhathi, abantu baqala ukukholelwa emandleni abo, bazi ukuthi bangazuza uma behlanganyela. Izinhlelo zathuthuka, izikhungo zemfundo zakhuliswa, futhi izingane zakhuluma ngokuthokozisa ngemfundo abayitholayo. U-Phumzile, uthisha, wathola ukuba neqhaza elikhulu. “Ngiyaziqhenya kakhulu ngalezi zinsuku,” esho. “Abafundi bethu bahlala bejabulile, bazi ukuthi balindelele ikusasa elihle.” Ngemva kwesikhathi, uMkhumbane wahamba phambili, izinhlelo zathuthuka, abantu bahlala bezithokozisa. Iziteshi zamanzi zenzeka, zikhanyisa izimpilo zabantu. Abantwana babedla umhlaba, begijima bezijabulisa. Izinsiza zempilo zazitholakala kalula, abantu banikezwa ithuba lokuba neqhaza, bahlala bejabulile. Nokho, ukuphila akuhambanga kahle njalo. Kwakukhona izinselelo, nezinkinga ezazivela. Uhlelo olusha lwakha izinxenye eziningi, kodwa abanye abantu babengathandi. “Kungani kufanele sishintshe?” abanye babuza. “Uhlanga lwasekuqaleni lungakha izinkinga.” Kodwa uMama Nandi waphendula ngothando, “Ukukhula kudinga ushintsho. Sihamba phambili, asibuyele emuva.” Umoya wokubambisana waba yikhono elikhulu. Abantu baqala ukuqonda ukuthi izinselelo zikhona, kodwa zikhona nezixazululo. Baphakamisa amaphuzu, bahlanganyela, benza imihlangano, bekhuluma ngempumelelo. Umoya wabo wawufana nemvula ebusika, ulethela uMkhumbane isivuno esikahle.

Kwake kwaba nomuzi omncane obizwa ngeMkhumbane, lapho abantu babephila impilo ejabulisayo, begcwele imidlalo nezinsuku ezimnandi. Kule ndawo, kwakukhona umgibeli ophumelelayo odlalela abanye iCheckers. Igama lakhe linguSipho, umfana oneminyaka eyishumi nane. U-Sipho wayeyintokozo emzaneni, enobungane, futhi wayaziwa kakhulu ngezinsuku azichitha edlalela abanye. Njalo ngempelasonto, uSipho wayehamba ehlathini eliseduze nomuzi, elandela umphakathi wabelusi nabantwana ababejabulile. Uhlanga lwemithi lwalufana nendawo yokudlala, imithi emikhulu ihlukaniswe izindawo zokudlala ezahlukene. Abantwana babedlala iCheckers, behlukanisa amaphakethe amancane abewathola ezitolo, besebenzisa izinto ezitholakala endaweni, njengamapulangwe noma amathoyizi. U-Sipho wayehamba phambili, ethokozisa abanye ngekhono lakhe lokudlala. Lokhu kwenza abanye bezwa umdlandla wokuhlangana ukuze babone umdlalo, njengoba bekhumbula ukuthi uSipho uhlala edlala ukuze enze ubungani, hhayi ukuze anqobe. Ngempela, umdlalo wawungaphezu kokuphumelela; wawukhombisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngelinye ilanga, uSipho wahlangana noThandi, intombazane ethokozisayo enothando lokudlala. UThandi wayenobuchule bokuhlola amasu amasha, okwakuholela ekwakheni umphakathi omusha, lapho bonke bahlala beyindlalifa. U-Sipho noThandi badlala imidlalo ethokozisayo, behlakanipha ngendlela evelele. Bafuna izinkanyezi eziphuma phezulu, bezama ukufaka izinhlelo ezahlukene ukuze baphumelele. Njengoba bedlala, bahlola izinkambo ezintsha, benza izinqumo ezinzima, bezama ukuqonda izindlela zokuqeda izitha zabo.

Emcimbini we-jazz, abaculi baphinde babe nabaxhumanisi. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umculi usuka eNew Orleans, eChicago, noma eCape Town, bonke bazihlanganisa ukuze benze umculo ophilayo, okhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kungenza umoya wokubambisana, futhi ukufakwa kwezinqubo ezahlukene kungaholela ekuphumeleleni okukhulu. Njengoba umculo uhamba phambili, izithameli zikhuthazwa ukuba ziveze izimvo zabo, zibe yingxenye yezenzakalo ezithokozisayo. Umgubho we-jazz ulethe umoya wokukhumbula abaculi abaphumelele, njengama-legends afana noLouis Armstrong noElla Fitzgerald. Ukuhlonishwa kwemisebenzi yabo kudalula indlela umculo we-jazz uthinteka ngayo empilweni yansuku zonke. Abaculi baphinde bahloniphe lezi zinsakavukela ngezindlela zabo, bejolisa emculweni nasemikhulumweni, benza umoya oncomekayo obamba wonke umuntu ukuba abambe iqhaza. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, izethameli zibe nezinye izigcawu ezihlukile, ezifana ne-Jam Sessions, lapho abaculi behlangana khona ukuze babelane ngemicabango nemigubho. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kuhlobene kakhulu nokuxhumana okukhululekile, okwakha imizwelo eqinile phakathi kwabaculi nabalaleli. Ukuze umculo uqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuba kube khona ukubambisana, futhi umcimbi we-jazz ubona lokhu kuphila, kwenza kube yindawo yokwakha ubungane obuqinile. I-Jazz iyindlela yokuziveza, futhi umcimbi lo ubonisa kahle ukuthi umculo ungakha kanjani ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kubonakala ezintweni ezincane, njengokuhlangana kwasemakhaya, lapho umndeni uphumeza izigcwalisiso ezihlukahlukene zomculi.

Isivumelwano sokudlulisela udaba kumxhumanisi asidingi ukuba sibhale, kodwa isivumelwano esibhaliwe singasiza njengoba sisiza ukuhlela inqubo yonke elandelwayo ngababonisi. Umxhumanisi unomthwalo wokugcina ubumfihlo bamaqembu athintekayo. Ngaphandle kokuthi, umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika awunikezi abaxhumanisi ilungelo lokwenqaba ukuveza ubufakazi enkantolo ngokusekelwe kulwazi olutholwe ngesikhathi sokuxhumana. Uma izindaba zomphakathi ziqhutshwa, ilungelo elisebenzayo kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezisetshenziselwa ukuxazulula izinkinga lingasetshenziswa. Amaqembu athintekayo angasebenzisa lokhu ngokuvuma ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezihlanganisiwe nenqubo yokuxhumana zingasetshenziswa. Uma kubhekwa ubumfihlo, ilungelo elinjalo alizokwenziwa uma umxhumanisi ebizwa ukuveza ubufakazi. Ngokuvamile, ngokomthetho, umxhumanisi akadingeki ukuba neziqu ezithile zemfundo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi umxhumanisi aqonde izimiso ezihlobene nomxhumanisi kanye nemithetho ephatha ukuziphatha njengomthetho owaziwa ngokuthi 'audi alterem partem'.

Izincomo zalengqungquthela njengamanje zenziwa uhlelo oluphelele lokuthuthukisa, nokuguqula umkhakha wezamagugu eminyakeni emithathu kuya kwemihlanu ezayo. Lezikhungo zethula imibiko egcwele minyaka yonke; etholakala khona ezikhungweni futhi. I-DACST ixhasa lezizikhungungo unya nonyaka. Ukuhlanganisa kanye nokubeka imigomo yokwakha ikomidi lokuqanjwa kwamagama kwisifundazwe ngasinye. Ukwamukela, ukuphenya kanye nokwenza izincomo ngokuqanjwa kwamagama amasha nangezinguquko emagameni akhona okulethwe ama- PGNC kanye namanye amaqembu ukuze agunyazwe nguNgqongqoshe. Ukuqoqa nokushicilelwe uhla olosemthethweni lwamagama agunyaziwe. Emhlanganweni ngamunye umkhandlu ucwaninga amagama alethwe kuwo ukuze agunyazwe, elethwa iposi, ohulumeni basekhaya , abathuthukisi bezindawo kanye nabanye abanentshisekelo. Angu -142 amagama asegunyazwe nguNgqongqoshe futhi aseshicilelwe kosomqulu bakahulumeni elandelayo. Isigungu sesiqalise uhlelo lokubuyekeza amagama ayengalethwanga ngaphambilini ukuzogunyazwa. Amagama atholakala evusa uhlevane futhi enokucwasa ngokobuhlanga adluliselwe kubantu abaqondene nasemiphakathini ukuthola uvo lwabo nokubheka angangena ezikhundleni zawo. Izinkomba zemisebenzi edluliselwa kubantu. Ingqungquthela yokugqamisa iqhaza elabanjwa abantu abamyama empini. Ukubekwa kwamasu okuvikela , okuqhakambisa kanye nokuthuthukiswa komculo wasekhaya. ukuqokwa kwethimba elinegunya lokwakha isu likazwelonke. Kwabakhona i-Nationl Heritage Indaba eyayigqugquzela izindaba zoguquko ukulinganisa kanye nokulungisa. Ukugunyazwa nokushicilelwa kusomquluu kahulumeni amagama angu 142.

Umculo we-Jazz: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwezizukulwane Ngemva kokuhamba kwesikhathi, umculo we-jazz usuphenduke uphawu lokuhlangana kwezizukulwane ezahlukene, uhlanganisa izindlela zomculo, izinkolelo zamasiko, nezifiso zabantu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukene. Lokhu kuvele kakhulu emcimbini wokuhlanganyela umculo we-jazz, ogujwa eGoli, lapho izithameli zifika zikhathele, kodwa zinejabuliso ezikhanyayo. Lo mcimbi uhlanganisa abaculi abahamba phambili abavela kuzo zonke izindawo zalesi siko, behlanganyela emculweni owaziwa ngokuba nezinhlobonhlobo ezintsha nezikhumbuzo zomlando. Umsindo we-jazz uqala ukudala umoya wezinhlobonhlobo, lapho izigubhu, i-saxophone, ne-piano ziqala ukudlala. Njengoba abaculi behlangana, imisindo ibonisa ubuciko, isithombe somoya wobudlelwano, nempilo ebonakala. Umdlalisi we-saxophone uthola ithuba lokudlala solo, okwenza izithameli zizwe zixhumene nezinhliziyo zabo, zikhumbula izikhathi ezinhle nezimfihlo zempilo. Umculo we-jazz uveza imizwa ehlukahlukene, kusukela ekujabuleni kuya ekudabukeni, futhi zonke lezi zimo zikhombisa ubudlelwano obujulile phakathi komculi nomlistener. Emcimbini we-jazz, abaculi baphinde babe nabaxhumanisi. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi umculi usuka eNew Orleans, eChicago, noma eCape Town, bonke bazihlanganisa ukuze benze umculo ophilayo, okhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kungenza umoya wokubambisana, futhi ukufakwa kwezinqubo ezahlukene kungaholela ekuphumeleleni okukhulu.

Thina, njengomnyango wezindlu, sikholwa ukuthi ukwakhiwa nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlu kufanele kusebenzele wonke umuntu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya noma emadolobheni. Sikholwa ukuthi abantu bethu, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya, kufanele bakwazi ukufinyelela usizo lukahulumeni nezinsiza, ezifana nezindlela, amanzi, nogesi. Indlu inika umuntu ubuqotho, iyindawo abizwa ngayo ngekhaya, indawo yokuphepha, futhi imnika ubunikazi. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, oNgqongqoshe, kanye noBuholi Bendabuko, ikhaya yindawo esivela kuyo, lapho sisebenza khona, futhi lapho sibuyela khona ntambama. Izindlela ezivela ezindlini zixhumanisa nathi ezindaweni eziningi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi zokuthenga, lapho sisebenza khona, emithini, nakwezinye izinsiza esizidingayo. Ngibone ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinkinga zokulungiswa kwezindlela, ikakhulukazi eziholela ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko. Ohlelweni lomnyango wethu lokwakha izindlu ezindaweni zabaholi bendabuko, ngishilo ukuthi kumele kube nokubambisana okuqinile phakathi komkhandlu nezindlu zabaholi bethu bendabuko. Abaholi bendabuko babe yingxenye yezinhlelo zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa okuhlelekile kubantu babo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi uma lezi zindlu seziqediwe, akukho okuzosivimbela ekuletheni ukuthuthukiswa ngoba wonke umuntu uzoba yingxenye yezakhiwo zikahulumeni zokuletha ukuthuthukiswa kubantu. Njengoba ngichazile ngenkathi ngethula inkulumo yami, izikhumbuzo zethu zigcizelela ikhaya, ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nezwe. Ngichazile ukuthi indlu iyisisekelo sokwakha

a iqala ekuqaleni kweminyaka yezezimali noma ngosuku olukhuluma ngalo njengoba lokhu kungase kubonise isinqumo esixoxiwe esigabeni 13 mayelana nokwakhiwa kwenani lentela yezindlu; futhi b ayikwazi ukuklanywa ukuba ibuyiselwe emuva. Inani lentela yezindlu liklanywa ngamasipala kulandela isinqumo esithathwe yibhodi lezakhamuzi esekelwa ukuvota kwenqwaba yamalungu ale bhodi. i ukuthi ibhodi lamukele isinqumo sokwakha inani lentela yezindlu; futhi ii ikhophi yesinqumo kufanele itholakale ukuze icubungulwe emphakathini phakathi nezinsuku zokusebenza ehhovisi elikhulu lokuphatha lelo masipala nakwezinye izindawo ezichaziwe kulolu chungechunge. a uhlu lwabo bonke abanikazi abathole ukubuyiselwa, labo ababuyelelwe, kanye nalabo abathole ukuncipha ngonyaka odlule ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1; futhi b isitatimende esibonisa imali etholelwe umphakathi odlule ngemuva kokubuyiselwa, ukubuyiselwa, nokuncipha. b imisebenzi yezomnotho engapheli kulowo maphakathi; noma c ukuhamba kwezimpahla ngaphakathi kwelizwe, ukuthumela kwezidingo, imali, noma abasebenzi. h Okungenani inani lokuqala le-R15,000 lenani lezakhiwo zonke lapho zakhiwe futhi zihlala khona, ngaphandle kokuthi kutholakale ukuthi uNgqongqoshe, ngokuxhumana noNgqongqoshe wezezimali, angakhulisa le mali ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo ukuze ihambisane nezinga lezomnotho ngaleso sikhathi; futhi i Impahla/umhlaba noma izigaba zezakhiwo/umhlaba njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 3, noma inani lentela yezindlu elibekwe enanini elibekwe njengemikhawulo empahleni/indawo noma esigabeni sezakhiwo noma indawo.

Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Isingeniso Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant sathuthukiswa nguHulumeni ukuze sinikeze usizo lwezezimali kubantu abathintekile kakhulu yileli gciwane. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kuhlose ukucacisa indlela lesi sibonelelo esisetshenziswe ngayo, izinzuzo ezitholakele, kanye nezinkinga ezitholakele ekuphathweni kwalesi sikhwama. Uhlaka lwezibonelelo Isibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant satholakala kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi labo abalahlekelwe yimisebenzi yabo, abangenayo imali yokuphila, noma abahlala ezindaweni ezinzima. Uhlelo lwaluhloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, ukunciphisa ubumpofu, nokwakha umnotho ophilayo. Izindlela zokufaka izicelo Abantu baye bafaka izicelo nge-inthanethi, ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zokuxhumana, noma ngokuqhuba izinhlelo ezikhethekile ezindaweni ezithile. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela esiboneleleni, ikakhulukazi kubantu abangenayo indlela yokufinyelela ezinsizeni zendabuko. Ukusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kube nokuhlaziywa kokuthi abantu basebenzisa kanjani lesi sibonelelo. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi iningi labathola lesi sibonelelo lalisisebenzisa ukuze lithenge ukudla, izimpahla zokuhlala, nezinsiza ezisemqoka. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela omuhle ekuphuculeni izimo zokuphila zabantu abaningi. Izinzuzo ezitholakele Ukwamukelwa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant kube nomthelela omkhulu ekunciphiseni ubumpofu. Abantu abaningi bakwazi ukuthola ukudla okwakudingeka ukuze baphile, futhi lokhu kwandise umuzwa wokuphepha phakathi kwabantu.

Yonke lemisebenzi esishiwo ingagamanxelana. Isibonelo, umuntu odala umonakalo omkhulu ngokunukubeza umoya kungenzeka abe necala lokwephula umthetho ovikela imvelo. Kodwa kulencwajana, sizozama ukwenza izinto zibe lula ngokuhlale njalo sikhuluma ngalezizimo ezingu 7 esizisho ngasenhla, futhi zizohlaziywa ngokwehluka kwazo. Wazi kanjani ukuthi ungazithatha nini izinyathelo zomthetho noma ucele usizo lomxazululi ngokulandisa kweNEMA LesiSahluko kanye neSahluko 4 sizokutshela kabanzi? Yini imithetho evikela imvelo? Yini ukwephula imigomo yezemvelo? I-NEMA inika imigomo engu 20 ewumhlahlandlela kahulumeni noma yinini lapho enza okuthile okungaba nomthelela omkhulu kwimvelo. Uhulumeni kumele ahloniphe futhi agcine umthetho. Imigomo ikhombisa uhulumeni ukuthi kumele ayisebenzise kanjani imithetho ukuze kuvikeleke ngokugcwele imvelo. Imkhombisa indlela okufanele adwebe ngayo izinhlelo namaqhinga, ikhomba indlela abaxazululi abangabalamuli uma izinhlangothi ezimbili zinengxabano. Okunye futhi, uma uhulumeni engalandeli lemigomo esimweni esivumelekile lapho kunento entsha ehlongozwayo noma ezokwenzeka nengaba nomthelela omkhulu emvelweni, lesi simo nesenzo siyoba wukwephula umthetho kanjalo ungathatha izinyathelo zomthetho noma uqalise isinyathelo sokumisa lolohlelo. Intuthuko kufanele igamanxe emkhakheni wenhlaliswano, ezemvelo kanye nomnotho, ivelele nasesikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi lezinto ezilandelayo kumele zicatshangwe ngaphambi kokuba kuqaliswe intuthuko;. Impatho yezemvelo kufanele iditshaniswe.

Umthetho 247 uthi abantu bangathuthwa kuphela ngemuva kwemoto yezimpahla uma le ndawo abahamba kuyo ivikelwe ngezinto eziqinile ukuze ivimbele ukuwa kwabo. Abashayeli bezinhlaka nezithuthi bavame ukugcwalisa izimoto zabo. Sivame ukuzwa ezindabeni "I-taxi noma ibhasi elalilodwa eligcwele libe nengxabano". Kumele kube nesaziso ebhasini/taxi esikhombisa inani labagibeli abavunyelwe ukuhlala nokuma emotweni. Umshayeli othuthwa abantu nezimpahla kufanele ahlolwe ngalolo msebenzi futhi kufanele afundiswe ukuthi angashayela kanjani. Abashayeli kufanele basebenzise lesi saziso ukuze balahle imoto zabo. Ungayibona kanjani imoto egcwele? Ihamba kancane uma ihamba phezulu. Yini enye ongayibona ukuthi igcwele emotweni? Isimo sayo esiyisisekelo. Londoloza isikhathi: Akukho ukulibaziseka, ngokwesibonelo, uma ulayisha noma udayisa impahla. Izinkinga ze-inshurensi uma ubandakanyeka engxabanweni futhi kutholakala ukuthi imoto igcwele. Ukuhamba ngebhayisikili sekuphenduke umkhuba ophumelelayo nendlela yokuhamba eNingizimu Afrika. Abantu abaningi bayajabulela ukuphumula okuvela ekugibeleni ezimpilweni zabo zansuku zonke. Kubantu abaningi, ibhayisikili iyindlela ehlukile yokuhamba kunemoto yokuhamba nsuku zonke. Ibhayisikili iyindlela yokuhamba njengemoto. Nokho, ibhayisikili ayifani nezinye izinhlobo zezimoto, ibhayisikili iphakathi kwamandla abantu. Unamalungelo, imithwalo, nemisebenzi efanayo nabanye abashayeli. Khumbula, abagibeli abavunyelwe emigwaqweni engamakhanda. Ngaphambi kokuhamba ngebhayisikili emgwaqweni womphakathi, kufanele uqonde imithetho eyisisekelo yomgwaqo futhi ube nekhono lokuhamba ngebhayisikili ngokuphepha emgwaqweni.

Ngingaphinda kuphela uktuhi angikholelwa ukuthi ungacindezela abantu nge-avionic equipment. Ukukuze kusombululwe ukususwa kwekati eziko kanye nokungathuthukiswa ngokwenele ngokugxila kwizinsiza zabo bonke ohulumeni basezindawei ezisemadolobheni. Ukuvinjelwa kokungagunyaziwe, okungekho emthethweni futhi nokungatheli izithelo kanye nokulahlekelwa okusukela ekungaziphathini kahle. Thatha uhambo lokuphumula uluya ngasentshonalanga olusuka ekuphithizeleni kwaseGoli noma kwasePitoli futhi kungakapheli ihora uzothola indawo ezokuthatha. Ukuba ngusomabhizinisi sekwaziswe kakhulu ngokuphindelela emhlabeni njengenjini yokuthuthuka kwezomnotho. Lokhu kuthiwa kwenzeke ngemuva kokuba abeba ithusi besuse amapayipi onke ekhaya emini kwabha. Kumele futhi kuhlonishwe ababambe iaingxoxo abamele amaqembu ezepolitiki aseZimbabwe kuhlelo lwezingxoxo ngenxa yokungazibeki kwabo phambili kanye nekhono lokwenza umsebenzi abalikhombise kuhlelo lonke. Ngiyathokoza ukuba yingxenye yalo mcimbi wenjabulo ngalobu busuku. Siyabonga ngamazwi okusamukela owasho kithina. Yile ndlela yokuziphatha eholela ekukhishweni inyumbazana ngokwezenhalo kanye nokubekwa eceleni kwabantu abaphila nokukhubazeka. Ukuvimbela lezi zimpi akuselona udaba lokuvikela amazwe noma imifelandawonye, kodwa kungukuvikela abantu uqobo Izinguquko ezifana nalezo zingenzeka uma izakhiwo zihlukaniswa, zihlanganiswa noma zidilizwa. Uma inhlangano ifaka umbiko wezezimali wangonyaka odlule ongahlolwanga abacubungula amabhuku, ayikho inkokhelo noma izibonelelo ezizokhokhwa kuze kube kutholakele imibiko ehlolwe abacubungula amabhuku.

Iphinde ibaluleke ekwakheni umphakathi, lapho abantu behlangana khona, bejabulela izigcawu ezithokozisayo, futhi behlanganyela izinkumbulo ezizohlala zikhumbuleka. Imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsiza engapheli, ehlangene nezidingo zomuntu, futhi ibalulekile ekwakheni izimo ezinhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yeshashalazi iyinsiza ebalulekile emlandweni, futhi iyasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Ngaphezu kokuba yinsiza yokuzijabulisa, iyindlela yokufundisa, yokuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhamba phambili, kubalulekile ukuqhubeka sikhumbula umthelela omuhle wemidlalo yeshashalazi empilweni yethu.

Ukuhlaziywa Kohlelo Lokondla Ezikoleni Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luhlala luhamba phambili emizamweni yokuthuthukisa impilo nekhwalithi yokufunda kwabafundi. Nokho, uma sihlola lokhu kuhlelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi impumelelo yalo ayikhawulelwanga ekunikezeni ukudla kuphela, kodwa futhi nasekuthuthukiseni izimo zokuphila zabafundi. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sithathe isikhathi sokuhlola izinzuzo nezinkinga ezihambisana nalolu hlelo. Okokuqala, ake sikhulume ngezizathu ezinhle zokuthi kungani uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni luyadingeka. Abafundi abanokudla okunempilo bathola amandla okusebenza kahle, okwandisa ukukwazi kwabo ukufunda. Lokhu kuhlelwe kahle, njengoba izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukudla okunempilo kuthuthukisa igazi, okwenza kube lula ukufunda nokugxila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlelo lokondla lunciphisa izinga lokungondleki phakathi kwabafundi, okungaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza kwabo esikoleni. Nokho, izinselelo azikhi kuphela. Uhlelo lokondla ezikoleni lidinga izinsiza eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukudla, izindawo zokupheka, kanye nabantu abaqeqeshiwe. Lokhu kuholela ezindlekweni ezinkulu, futhi ezikhathini ezinzima zomnotho, izikole eziningi ziba nezinselelo zokuhlinzeka ngalezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ezinye izikole zidinga ukusiza ngemali ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi sokondla, okwenza kube nzima ukuhlinzeka ukudla okunempilo. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zokudla, kubalulekile ukuthi kudliwe ukudla okunempilo, futhi izikole zidinga ukucabangela izidingo zabafundi.

Sihlinzeka ngama-fibers ezindwangu nezintambo, izithelo, nomlilo, kanye nezinye izinto eziningi ezisebenzisekayo. IBaobab (Baobab noma i-Adansonia Digitata) - iyaziwa ngamagatsha ayo nezimpande zayo ezinde. Sihlinzeka ngensimu nokuhlalisana, futhi siphinde sibe nomthelela omkhulu ekuxhaseni imiphakathi lapho sitholakala khona. Isimo sezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalolunye - isimo se-geometry sezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalolunye limele imikhakha eminingi ehlukene lapho imisebenzi ehlukahlukene ingaqhutshelwa ukuze kwakhiwe isizwe esizinzile nesithuthuke. Le simbala iphinde imele izifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye zezwe lethu. Le emblem inikezwa kubabusi bamazwe angaphandle (Amakhosi Wamazwe Nezikhungo, nabanye abantu abahlonishwa kakhulu abakwamanye amazwe) ukuze kubonakale ubudlelwano neNingizimu Afrika. Yingakho siba yisibonakaliso sokuthula, ukubambisana, kanye nesibonakaliso sokuhlanganyela nokuxhasana. Le emblem iyisibonakaliso esibalulekile sobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba. Imiklomelo emibili yokuqala ihlanganisa izigaba ezine: iphendenti, ibhajethi yentamo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel rosette. I-emblem yokugcina inezigaba ezintathu: ibhajethi yentamo, i-emblem encane, kanye ne-lapel pin. Umjola (uthuli olutholakala ebusheni) - Uthuli oluvakashela izingane ezisanda kuzalwa. Alulimazi ingane noma amalungu omndeni, futhi indlela yokukhipha uthuli ukuthi umama wengane aphuze. Lolu thuli luvakashela ingane ukuze luyilungiselele ikusasa eliqhakazile neliphephile ebusheni bayo. Lufika njengesihlobo nomvikeli.

Ngesikhathi sokushisa okukhulu, njalo kube nesikhathi esinzima sokuphothula umsebenzi ngesikhathi esitholakalayo. Ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sokushisa kwangonyaka odlule, imvula yafika sekwedlule, ngakho isikhathi esitholakalayo sasingaphezulu kokubaluleka kunanoma yisiphi isikhathi esedlule. Kuyajwayeleka ngesikhathi sokucindezeleka ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwemishini namathuluzi akhishwe kuhlelo lwezinto ezibalulekile okufanele zenziwe. Njengoba isikhashana sesidlule, thola isikhathi sokunakekela amathuluzi akho.

Kuyoba nesidingo sokubandakanya zonke izikhungo zemboni kwinqubo yokuhlela I-IDP, ukufakwa kwezimali nokuqhutshwa kwemisebenzi esiqaliwe. Inqubo ye-IDP: Imboni ihlobene kakhulu nezinto ezikleliswe phambili nezivunjululwe ngenqubo yohlaziyo lwe-IDP. Zincane izingxenye zemibandela yokuhlelwa kwemboni ezingahambisana ngokugcwele nezinto eziphawulwe wuhlelo lwe-IDP nokuyofanela zisetshenzizwa ngenye inqubo. Inqubo ye-IDP: Kunengxenye ehlobene nezidingo-nqangi nesuselwe kwi-IDP. Isibonelo, izinto zokuthutha abantu zingaba semqoka kodwa kwenzeke ukuthi ukulungiswa komgwaqo kungabaluleki. Umnyango wemboni uyodweba izinhlelo zezithuthi zomphakathi njengengxenye yenqubo ye-IDP kanti amalungiselelo emigwaqo ayoqhutshwa ngezinye izinhlaka ezingahlobene nenqubo ye-IDP. Inqubo ye-IDP: Ukugamanxa phakathi kwemibandela yohlelo lwemboni nezidingo-nqangi yinto encane. Esiwombeni lapho kwenzeka khona, abasebenzi bemboni bayocelwa ukufaka isandla ngezinto eziqondile neziphawulwe kwinqumo ye-IDP. Indlela ye-IDP encikene nezigameko nengaxubi amasu okuhlela ilindelwe ukwenza ngcono, ibeke obala inqubo ejulile yokubonisana, ukwakha iqhinga elibhekele ikusasa nenqubo eqhakambisa impumelelo yomsebenzi osuqaliwe. Umuntu akufanele aze abe wuchwepheshe wokuhlela ukuze aqonde indlela nokuhlela inqubo ye-IDP ngendlela efanele. Okuphawulekayo wukuthi uchwepheshe noma umgqugquzeli angasetshenziswa ngezigaba ezithile zomsebenzi lapho engasiza khona ngokuqagula nokuveza amasu okuhlela nezikhali ezifanele.

Okubalulekile empumelelweni yalezi nhlelo ukuzimisela kwababambiqhaza ngoba phela yibo abaqhuba lolu hlelo. Ngakho-ke , ukuzimbandakanya ngqo kwabanikazi bomhlaba abasha nabadala kusemqoka kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga ukwesekwa ngokubamba iqhaza koMnyango Wezindaba Zomhlaba, Ezolimo, Ezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho Nezokuvakasha, kanye neziphathimandla zendawo. Imininingwane yabambiswano izokwehluka ngendawo ngendawo, kodwa-ke umphumela ongenakuncishiswa ukuthi abanikazimhlaba abasha bangakazi ukungenisa imali ngempahla entsha abayitholile, kube ngaso leso sikhathi bethuthukisa amakhono abo ngempumelelo. UMasipala Wendawo uphethwe yiKomidi LeMeya LeSigungu Esiphezulu elinamalungu esigungu esiphezulu ayisikhombisa omunye wawo IMeya, kanye noMkhandlu onaMakhansela angama- 33 asebenza neKomidi LeSigungu Esiphezulu. Angamashumi amabili amaKhansela ezigceme, bese kuthi lawa ayi-19 abe Ngamakhansela Amele uMkhandlu. Kunamakomiti ayisithupha emisebenzi ethile, lilinye limbandakanya ilungu le- EXCO elisebenza njengeKhansela Lekomidi Lomsebenzi Othile. UHulumeni useka intuthuko emazingeni kazwelonke, esifundazweni nawendawo, ngokusebenzisa iminyango ehlukahlukene, izinkampani zikahulumeni kanye nabanye ababambiqhaza embonini yezomnotho. Ukuqinisa ubumbano phakathi kosomabhizinisi abancane. Ukunikezela ngezinkundla zokuxhumana phakathi kwamabhizinisi amakhulu namancane ngokunjalo naphakathi kwamabhizinisi asedolobheni nawasemakhaya. Ukulungiselela amabhizinisi amancane ukuba akwazi ukumelana nezinselelo ezibhekene nomnotho womhlabajikelele.

Maqondana nale Sahluko, "oshadile" kumThetho Wefa kufanele kuthathwe njengokubala uphathini orejistiwe. Uphathini okubuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe akakhishelwa ngaphandle ukuthi angathatha izinyathelo zokufuna isinxephezelo ngokufa kukaphathini wakhe ngendlela eyicala ngoba naku kuthiwa bebengashadile ngokusemthethweni. Uma kwenzeka kuba nengxabano maqondana nokwehlukaniswa kwempahla yobuhlobo oburejistiwe uma sebuphelile ubuhlobo, omunye kumbe bobabili ophathini bangalufaka enkantolo udaba ukuze kuphume isinqumo senkantolo maqondana nokwehlukaniswa kwemphahla yabo ehlangene kumbe eseceleni, kumbe ingxenye yempahla eseceleni yomunye bophathini abarejistiwe. Uma udaba lokwehlukaniwa kwempahla yabo bobabili, inkantolo kufanele ikhiphe isinqumo sokwehlukaniswa kwaleyo mpahla okufanele kube yileso esibona sinobuqiniso futhi sifanelekile uma kubhekwa zonke izinto. e Ukuba khona kwesivumelwano esirejistiwe sobuhlobo oburejistiwe nesiqukethe, uma sikhona; kanye f nanoma yiziphi ezinye izinto ezingafuna ukubhekwa. Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo esikhishiwe kwisigatshana 3 kufanele izanelise ngokuthi esinobuqiniso nesifanelekile ngenxa yokuthi uphathini orejistiwe nokhishelwa isinqumo esimvunayo ufakile ngqo nangenyezinye izindlela ukwakha umnotho wempahla yabo kumbe kwingxenye yempahhla kaphathini wobuhlobo oburejistiwe.

Abasebenzi baqala ukuhlanganisa izinyunyana ukuze bathole amandla okuphikisa, bakhe imithombo yokuxhasana, futhi babonise ubunye babo. Isigaba 3: Ukukhula Kwezinyunyana Zabasebenzi Njengoba izinyunyana zandise amaqembu, zaba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinqubomgomo zomsebenzi. Izinyunyana zafaka izicelo zokuthi kube nezivumelwano ezicacile mayelana nezimo zomsebenzi, izinkokhelo, kanye nezinsiza. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwezinhlaka eziningi, ezifana nezinhlangano zabasebenzi ezikhethekile, ezazihlanganisa abasebenzi bezimboni ezithile. Izinyunyana zaba nomthelela omkhulu ekwenzeni izinguquko ezinkulu, njengezivumelwano zokusebenza ezihlonipha amalungelo abasebenzi. Isigaba 4: Izinkinga Nezithiyo Noma izinyunyana zaba namandla, zaphinde zaba nezinselelo ezinzima. Abanikazi bezimboni, kanye nohulumeni, bavame ukungavumi izicelo zezinyunyana, baphinde baqhuba izinyathelo zokuzama ukuvimba ukukhula kwazo. Lokhu kwaholela ezimeni zokuphikisana, lapho abasebenzi babebhekene nezingozi zokulahlekelwa yimisebenzi, noma ngisho nokuhlukunyezwa. Nokho, lezi zinkinga zakhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baqhubeke bephikisa, befundisa abanye ngamalungelo abo. Isigaba 5: Izinselelo Zamanje Nezikhathi Zokuphumelela Namuhla, izinyunyana zabasebenzi zibuye zibe nezinselelo ezintsha, ezifana nezinguquko zobuchwepheshe, ukuhamba kwemisebenzi, kanye nezimo zomnotho. Nokho, zisagcizelela ukubaluleka kokubambisana phakathi kwabantu emisebenzini. Izinhlangano eziningi zikhuthaza ukufundiswa nokukhuthazwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimo zokusebenza zihlala zikhona.

UNgqongqoshe, ngemuva kokubonisana noMkhandlu, kufanele aqoke elinye lamalunga oMkhandlu eliqokwe ngokwesigaba 5 (a) njengoSihlalo woMkhandlu. b Emhlanganweni wokuqala woMkhandlu amalunga kufanele akhethe isekela likaSihlalo kulolohlobo okukhulunywa ngalo esigabeni 31 1 a no b. c UNgqongqoshe angahoxisa ukuqokwa kwelunga njengosihlalo noma isekela likasihlalo uma lokho kuzosiza umphakathi noma uma ilunga lingakwazi noma lehluleka ukunquba umsebenzi walo njengosihlalo izinyanga ezingaphezulu kwezintathu. Usihlalo nesekela likasihlalo kufanele baphathe isikhundla leso isikhathi esilingana naleso abaqokelwe sona njengamalunga omkhandlu ngaphandle uma usihlalo noma isekela lakhe esulwa noma engaseyilo ilunga loMkhandlu ngaphambi kokuphela kwesikhathi sokuba sesikhundleni sobulunga noma esuswa esukhundleni nguNgqongqoshe ngokwesigaba 8. Uma engekho uSihlalo noma ngezizathu ezithile engakwazi ukuqhuba umsebenzi njengosihlalo, isekela likasihlalo, ngokuhambisana nokushiwo kusigatshana 1, unegunya lokwenza yonke imisebenzi futhi asebenzise amandla kasihlalo. Uma usihlalo nesekela lakhe bengekho emhlanganweni, amalunga akhona emhlanganweni angakhetha elinye ilunga ukuba lengamele umhlangano lenze wonke umsebenzi kasihlalo futhi lisebenzise amandla kasihlalo kuze kube usihlalo noma isekela lakhe liqhuba umsebenzi walo. Uma isikhundla sikasihlalo singenamuntu, uNgqongqoshe kufanele aqoke njengosihlalo, ngokubona kwakhe, noma imuphi umuntu kulawo malunga oMkhandlu asele, noma ngomunye umuntu ngokwesigaba 5 1 no 2, futhi lowo muntu oqokiwe kufanele aphathe isikhundla isikhathi esisale kulowo muntu amlandelayo.

Ngaphandle-nje kwesigatshana-5, umkhandlu wezimvume ungafuna ukubuyekeza imvume yokukhiqiza isisi emoyeni esilawulwa yisigaba-39 noma uguquko oluhlinzekwe yisigaba-38 ngaphambi kokukhipha imvume yokukhiqiza isisi ehlonzwe esigatshaneni sesi-5. Kusalindwe ukuba kuqagulwe izenzo ezisohlwini ezihlonzwe ngaphansi kwesigaba-20, inqubo etholwe kwiSheduli-2 yoMthetho Onqanda Ukunukutshezwa Komoya kufanele ithathwe njengezenzo ezisohlwini. Kusalindwe ukunqunywa kwamazinga okuqondiswe kuwo esigabeni-6, imihlahlandlela yeqophelo lomoya wemvelo equkethwe nguMthetho Onqanda Ukunukutshezwa Komoya iyoqhubeka isebenze. Lo Mthetho ubizwa; Ukuphathwa Kwemvelo kuZwelonke: Umthetho Weqophelo Lomoya we- 2003, uyoqala ukusebenza ngosuku oluyonqunywa nguNgqongqoshe ngesaziso seGazethe.

Umuntu akavunyelwe ukuhambisa izinto eziyingozi ezikhulunywa esigabeni 21 soMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezinto Eziyingozi, 1973 Umthetho No. 15 ka-1973, ngaphakathi kweziphathimandla zokuhlela, ngaphandle [kwendlela etholelwa ngaphansi kwesigaba h so sub-section 2, lapho le ndlela itholiwe futhi yakhishwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 291 futhi noma yimuphi umuntu owenza njalo ubopheleke] indlela evinjelwe ekhombisa kuhlelo lokuhamba oluhlanganisiwe olukhulunywa esigabeni 291, oluhambisana nomgomo noma uhlelo olujwayelekile olukhulunywa esigabeni 223l. Noma yimuphi umuntu ophula noma engahambisani nesigaba 5 ubopheleke. Kuze kube isikhathi lapho izimoto zokuhamba zomphakathi zibuyiselwa ezweni ziye kwenye ikilasi likahulumeni, umgomo nezinhlelo ezikhulunywa esigabeni 19 (b) [ku] kanye (g), ngokuhambisana, kumele kuthunyelwe kuNgqongqoshe ukuze kuvunywe umgomo nezinhlelo zezithuthi zokuhamba zomphakathi, ngendlela efanele futhi ethile. Ngemuva kokuvunywa komgomo wezokuhamba komhlaba, umgomo wezokuhamba wesifunda, uhlelo lokuhamba komphakathi noma uhlelo lokuhamba oluhlanganisiwe, uNgqongqoshe noma iziphathimandla ezifanele, njengoba kudingeka, kumele kushicilelwe kuGazethi yeSifunda, noma mayelana nomgomo wezokuhamba komhlaba, kuGazethi yoHulumeni imininingwane ethile yalezi zinhlelo, okumele ifake imininingwane yezindlela zokuthola izimvume ngaphansi kwesigaba 27 (h) 27. b ukufaka esigabeni 2 so sub-section d yesigaba elandelayo: "d akukho okumele kwenziwe okuzoholela ekunciphiseni kwenani noma ukufinyeleleka kwezinsiza noma izinsizakalo

Ukubuyekeza akufanele kube yinto eyodwa kuphela, kodwa kufanele kube yinqubo eqhubekayo, ethuthukisa indlela yokufunda. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, imiphumela yezivivinyo iyisithombe esikhombisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi, izikole, kanye nomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphumela ibhekwane ngokucophelela, futhi izinyathelo zidinga ukuthathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe izimo zokufunda. Umgomo wethu kufanele kube ukusiza abafundi baphumelele, baziqhenye ngempumelelo yabo, futhi bakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngale ndlela, imiphumela yezivivinyo izoba yinsika yokwakha umphakathi ozinikele, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sikhuthaza abafundi bethu, sithuthukise izinhlelo zethu, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi imiphumela yezivivinyo iyinsiza yokwakha ikusasa elingcono.

Izindawo ezingaphansi koBuholi Bomdabu, ezinjengeHlahlindlela kanye neKhambi, ziyizindawo zokuhlala ezahlukene ezithuthukisiwe ezingahleliwe ngendlela. Lezi zindawo zokuhlala ziyasebenzisana futhi naseVryheid ngokukhethekile, kodwa zisebenza ngokwehlukana. Ukuthuthukiswa kwalezi zindawo kwenziwa ngezikhathi ezimiselwe kona kodwa futhi kugqamile ukuba khona kwezinsiza ezingasimeme kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda. Okuhambisana ngqo nezinselelo zokusungulwa kwezinhlelo zokunikezelana kwezindawo kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwezidingo ezingeni lomphakathi, ngukuthuthukiswa kweZikhungo Zokunikezela Ngezidingongqangi Ezindaweni Zasemakhaya ezisezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu eMondlo, eKhambi naseCoronation/ eHlobane. Lezi zikhungo zasedolobheni kumele indawo yazo iseZikhungweni Zokunikezela Ngezidingongqangi Ezindaweni Zasemakhaya nezingaba nomthelela ezinhlakeni. Izindawo zokuhlala abantu ezindaweni ezakhele izindawo zasemadolobheni emizileni yezikhungo zokunikezela ngezidingongqangi ezindaweni zasemakhaya ezinjengoMondlo noKhambi sezinabantu abaningi futhi zingabalwa njengezindawo eziqubukayo uma kubhekwa ngokobuningi babantu, izinhlobo zezindlu kanye nokuhlukahlukana kwemisebenzi. Ububanzi nokuthuthuka kwalezi zindawo kuthanda kwenzeka ngendlela engahlelekile kanti futhi akunahlaka. Ukwabiwa komhlaba kumuntu ngamunye noma emindenini okwenziwa nguBuholi Bomdabu kwenziwa ngaphandle kokubheka amaqophelo okuhleleka kwendawo futhi kuphikisana nokwenziwa kube semthethweni. Kusemqoka kakhulu ukuthi lezi zindawo zihlinzekwe ngezidingongqangi nengqalasizinda kepha lokhu akwenzeki ngokufanele. Kudingeka kube nokungenelela ekuhlelweni kwedolobha ukuze kubhekwane nale nkinga.

a ekunukubezeni umoya okweqa umngcele wezwe; noma ekunukubezeni umoya okuphambene noma okungenzeka kuphambane nesivumelwane esisezingeni lomhlaba esibophezela iNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokunqanda, ukulawula noma ukulungisa isimo sokunukutshezwa komoya okuwumphumela wesici esithile noma izici ezichithwe emoyeni zisuka esikhungweni esithile. Uma kwenzeka ngemuva kophenya Ungqongqoshe enombono wokuthi ukukhiqizwa kwesici esithile emoyeni okudabuka eNingizimu Afrika kunomthelela omkhulu eqophelweni lomoya, kwimvelo noma empilweni yabantu ezweni elingumakhelwane neNingizimu Afrika, ngokulandisa kwesigaba-46, uNgqongqoshe anganquma imigomo ehlose ukunqanda, ukulawula noma ukulungisa isimo somkhiqizo ngaphakathi ezweni laseNingizimu. noNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni esithintekayo. e nezimo, inqubo yesivivinyo nemikhuba yaselabholethi okummele ilandelwe ekuthatheni ingxenyana eyisibonelo seqoqo lento, ukuhlaziya, uhlola, ukalwa noma ukulandelela ingxube yezici zomkhiqizo. Ngegama lelunga elimmele izindaba zangaphandle, uNgqongqoshe angeluleka uhulumeni welinye izwe elithintekayo noma elihlomulayo ngalokho okuqaguliwe, ngesaziso noma ngomgomo ngaphambi kokuba ushicilelwe. e ephambana noma ehluleka ukuhambisana nesimo anikwe ngaso igunya lokushwelezelwa ekuhambisaneni nombandela othile walo Mthetho, ngokulandisa kwesigaba- 51.

Uma engekho uSihlalo noma ngezizathu ezithile engakwazi ukuqhuba umsebenzi njengosihlalo, isekela likasihlalo, ngokuhambisana nokushiwo kusigatshana 1, unegunya lokwenza yonke imisebenzi futhi asebenzise amandla kasihlalo. Uma usihlalo nesekela lakhe bengekho emhlanganweni, amalunga akhona emhlanganweni angakhetha elinye ilunga ukuba lengamele umhlangano lenze wonke umsebenzi kasihlalo futhi lisebenzise amandla kasihlalo kuze kube usihlalo noma isekela lakhe liqhuba umsebenzi walo. Uma isikhundla sikasihlalo singenamuntu, uNgqongqoshe kufanele aqoke njengosihlalo, ngokubona kwakhe, noma imuphi umuntu kulawo malunga oMkhandlu asele, noma ngomunye umuntu ngokwesigaba 5 1 no 2, futhi lowo muntu oqokiwe kufanele aphathe isikhundla isikhathi esisale kulowo muntu amlandelayo. Uma isikhundla sesekela likasihlalo singenamuntu, amalunga kufanele emhlanganweni wawo wokuqala ngemuva kokuvela kwesikhala leso noma ngokushesha ngemuva kokuvela kwesikhathi akhethe omunye wawo njengesekela likasihlalo kanti lelo lunga elikhethiwe liyokuba kuleso sikhundla isikhathi esisale kulowo owayeqokelwe leso sikhundla. d jikelele, aqinisekise ukuthi uMkhandlu wenza umsebenzi wawo futhi ufeza izinjongo zawo ngokwaloMthetho nokuthi ulandela noma ikuphi okushiwo yiloMthetho; futhi e aqinisekise ukuthi imali eyabelwe uMkhandlu yenziwe ngendlela enqunyiwe nokuthi uMkhandlu uwugudluki kuleso sabelo. UNobhala kufanele ngemuva kokubonisana nosihlalo abize umhlangano woMkhandlu oyoba sendaweni nangesikhathi nosuku olumiswe uMkhandlu futhi kufanele enze uhla lokuzoxoxwa ngakho alungise nemibhalo ezosetshenziswa kulowo mhlangano.

Umsebenzi kaMvikeli-woMphakathi wukuphenya ukuthi uhulumeni ngabe wenze kahle noma udale ukubandlululeka ngandlela thize. Izibonelo zokungaqhubi kahle wukukhwabanisa, ukwenza into ngesizathu esingafanele noma ukuchema. Ukwenza ngokubandlulula wuhlobo lomonakalo olungavunyelwe noma olungemukelekile emthethweni. Uma uthola okunye kwalokhu kwenzekile kuwe, ungalubikela uMvikeli-woMphakathi loludaba noma ushayela ihovisi lakhe ucingo. Isibonelo: Uthola ukuthi kukhishwe imvume yendawo yokulahla udoti ngemuva kophenyo lokuhlaziya umthelela. Kutholakala ukuthi ambalwa amalunga omphakathi abeyingxenye noma amenywa ukubamba iqhaza ngalenqubo. Unolwazi lokuthi kwaphuma umvuzo omkhulu wokugqiba isiphathimandla sikahulumeni ngesikhathi kukhishwa imvume. Uthola nokuthi amanye amakhansela kahulumeni wendawo ayeyingxenye yekomidi lokuhlela atshale izimali ezinkulu enkampanini eqashelwe ukusingatha indawo yokulahla udoti. Wethula umbiko ngaloludaba kuMvikeli-woMphakathi. Umthetho-sisekelo uhlinzekela ukubunjwa kweKhomishani yamaLungelo eSintu. Umsebenzi wekhomishani wukukhuthaza inhlonipho yamalungelo esintu. Elinye lamalungelo ngelezemvelo nelichazwe kulomthetho-sisekelo. Ikhomishani inamandla okuphenya lapho iqhuba umsebenzi wayo. Uma unesikhalo ngomonakalo owenziwa kwimvelo nohambisana nokwephula ilungelo lesintu, ungabhala noma ushayele leKhomishani ucingo uyicele yenze uphenyo ngodaba. Uvule icala ngomuntu owephule umthetho wezemvelo kanti umthetho uyakuvuna uthi lesosenzo siyicala. Usuwabikele futhi amaphoyisa ngalesenzo.

Okwesine, nakuba wonke umuntu efuna ukuthi zonke izingane zikhule zijabule futhi ziqoqekile, Inhlangano Yezizwe iyazi ukuthi, emazweni omhlaba jikelele, izingane eziningi ziphila ezimeni ezinzima kakhulu. Ngenxa yalezi kanye nezinye izizathu, kwenza umqondo omuhle ukuthi kube neSivumelwano esikhethekile ngamaLungelo Engane. Lesi Sivumelwano sikhuluma ngabo bonke ubunzima kanye nezinkinga izingane zomhlaba ezingabhekana nazo kanye nawo wonke amalungelo akhethekile izingane okufanele zibe nawo. Lesi isivumelwano sakho futhi kubaluleke kabi ukuthi wazi ngaso nokuthi sikhuluma ngani. Sakhiwe izingxenye ezahlukene (Inhlangano Yezizwe ezibiza ngokuthi ama-"athikili"). Sibhalwe ngolimi lomthetho ukuze sikwazi ukuthi sisetshenziswe ezinkantolo ukukuvikela. Kodwa lokhu kwenza ukuthi kube nzima kabi ukusiqonda. Yingakho nje sikubhalele sona ngolimi olulula kule ncwadi. Kodwa-ke okokuqala nje, sifuna ukukuchazela ngokuthi yini Isivumelwano, njengoba sisetshenziswe lapha, nokuthi sivele kanjani. Njengoba sichazile, Inhlangano Yezizwe uhlobo lukahulumeni womhlaba. Lo hulumeni uhlangana endlini enkulu esakhiweni seNhlangano Yezizwe eNew York. Kulapha lapho bexoxa khona ngezindaba zomhlaba ezibalulekile njengeSivumelwano Samalungelo Engane. Khumbula ukuthi lesi Sivumelwano isivumelwano esenziwa phakathi kwamazwe omhlaba. Uma sekuvunyelwene ngeSivumelwano, izwe nezwe kufanele liye ePhalamende lalo bese kuvunyelwana ngeSivumelwano lapho. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuqinisa Isivumelwano. IPhalamende kufanele livotele ukuthi lizoyihlonipha imithetho yeSivumelwano.

Abantu abaningi bathola ukuthi ukuxhumana nomoya kubasiza ukuba baphile impilo enempilo, bahlale bejabulile, futhi baphile impilo enenjongo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekwa izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nabantu namuhla. Isiphetho Inkolo nomoya kuyizinto ezibalulekile empilweni yabantu, zidlala indima enkulu ekwakheni umqondo, izimiso, nemikhuba yokuphila. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkolo nomoya bukhombisa ukuthi lezi zinto azihlukanisiwe, kodwa zixhumene kakhulu. Umthelela wazo empilweni yomuntu ungumqondo obanzi, ophathelene nezici eziningi, futhi kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi inkolo nomoya zihlala zikhona, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enenjongo, bahloniphe abanye, futhi bakhe umphakathi onempilo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke sifunda, sihlola, futhi sikhuthaze lezi zinto empilweni yethu.

Ukwakha amasu ukuze abalimi bazokwazi ukuthola imishini. Ukwakha amasu ukuthola amagranti kuleyo minyango. Kulukhuni kimi lapho ngizwa ukuthi abantu balimela abakhiqizi abamnyama. Kukhona abantu nezinhlangano ezisebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama ukuthola inzuzo, bese bathi lokhu "kungukuthuthukisa abakhiqizi abamnyama". Uma ungumkhiqizi omhlophe osebenzisa umhlaba wabantu abamnyama - qasha lowo mhlaba, khokha imali efanelekile, vuma ukuthi uqasha umhlaba futhi uyazilimela. Sicela ukuthi ungenzi ngathi usiza abanye abakhiqizi.

I-Load Shedding Nomthelela Wayo Emnothweni I-Load shedding, noma ukuhoxiswa kukagesi, yinto esiyaziyo kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Le nqubo, eyenzeka lapho umphakathi ubhekene nezinkinga zokukhiqiza ugesi, ibonakala njengomphumela wokungabi khona kokuphathwa kahle kwezinsiza. Ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wayo emnothweni, kubalulekile ukubheka izigaba ezithile zomlando ezihambisana nale nqubo. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-2000, i-Escom, okuyinkampani eyinhloko yokusabalalisa ugesi eNingizimu Afrika, yathola ukuthi izinsiza zayo zokukhiqiza ugesi ziqhubeka zincipha. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga ezinkulu zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, okwaholela ekutheni kube nezikhathi zokuhoxiswa kukagesi. Ngaleso sikhathi, umnotho wawusakhula, kodwa izinkampani eziningi zathola ukuthi zikhungathekile ngenxa yokungabi nokwaneliseka kokuhlinzekwa kukagesi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Load shedding yaba yinto evamile, ikakhulukazi phakathi kweminyaka ye-2015 kuya ku-2020. Lokhu kwaholela ekwehliseni ukukhiqizwa kwezimpahla, okwakuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo ezinkampanini. Izinkampani ezincane, ikakhulukazi, zathinteka kakhulu, njengoba zazingakwazi ukukhokhela izinkonzo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi ezinzima. Lokhu kwagcina kuholela ekwandeni kwenani labantu abangasebenzi, okwakukhathaza kakhulu uhulumeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi wathola ukuthi i-load shedding ayisiyona nje inkinga yokuhlinzeka ngogesi, kodwa futhi ibonisa izinkinga ezinzima zempilo yomnotho. Izimboni eziningi, ikakhulukazi ezincike kakhulu kumshini, zathola ukuthi zidinga ukwenza izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba phambili.
