Uyazi ukuthi kufanele kusetshenzwe kanjani, izitshalo zakhe zinhle futhi imishini yakhe isaphila kahle. Unamashede amahle neshabhu. Amandla - Unawo umhlaba (amasimu), unayo imishini, unabafana ababili abasebenza naye futhi unobungcweti obuvela eminyakeni eminingi emsebenzini wokulima. Amandla - Ukulima ngezinto ezahlukene ezihlangene: ummbila, ubhekilanga, izimvu nezinkomo. Ungumkhiqizi ozimisile onobungcweti beminyaka eminingi. Unogandaganda nemishini yokusebenza epulazini okwanele, futhi unamashede amahle neshabhu lokusebenza elihle. Unolwazi mayelana nomsebenzi wokulima futhi uyazi ukuthi wenzani futhi uyazazi izizathu zokwenza umsebenzi othile. Usebenzisa ulwazi walabo abanikeza izinto zokuqala ukulima - izimbewu, umanyolo namakhemikeli. Okungaqini - Le ndoda seyilahle konke okungaqini, ulima ngendlela eletha inzuzo futhi nakusasa. Okuphakanyiswayo - Umkhiqizi lo wenza konke ngendlela efanelekile futhi ufikela lapho kubakhiqizi bezomnotho. Amandla - Unobungcweti mayelana nokulima futhi unolwazi oluhle mayelana nokulima. Unamasimu (umhlabathi) amahle asetshenziswa ngokufanelekile futhi unogandaganda nemishini okwanele. Okuphakanyiswayo - Qhubeka ngalo msebenzi omuhle! Amandla - Unobungcweti obuhle, umhlabathi onothile, imvula enhle futhi unogandaganda nemishini okuphilile. Okungaqini -Ukuphatha ukhula kufanele kuqashelwe - kakhulukazi i-kweekgras. Ukumaketha kwakhe kungaba ngcono. Okuphakanyiswayo - Qhubeka ukwandisa amandla kagandaganda lapho kwanda amasimu. Hlola ukuthola amasimu okufafaza. Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle mayelana nomsebenzi wakhe.

Isiphathimandla sikazwelonke seqophelo lomoya kufanele sikhiphe isiqiniseko esibhaliwe kubanini balezo zitifiketi zokubhalisa ngezinguquko zesimo segunya labo ngokukhiqiza isisi, lokhu kummele kwenziwe zingakapheli izinsuku ezingama-90 ngemuva kokuqala kwalo Mthetho. Abanini-siqiniseko esibhaliwe nesichazwe esigatshaneni-2 kufanele bafake isicelo semvume yokukhiqizi isisi ungakapheli unyaka ngemuva kokuqala kwalo Mthetho. Ukwehluleka ukufaka isicelo esifanele singakapheli isikhathi esihlinzekwe ngaphansi kwesigatshana-3 kuyoholela ekuthathweni kwemvume yesikhashana yokukhiqiza isisi okuqondiswe kuyo esigatshaneni-1 njengento eyize nengasebenzi. Umnini wemvume yesikhashana yokukhiqiza isisi emoyeni ophawulwe esigatshaneni 1, unelungelo lemvume yokukhiqiza isisi uma isikhungo esikhishelwe imvume sihambisana ngokugcwele nemibandela yemvume yesikhashana yomkhiqizo wesisi emoyeni. Ngaphandle-nje kwesigatshana-5, umkhandlu wezimvume ungafuna ukubuyekeza imvume yokukhiqiza isisi emoyeni esilawulwa yisigaba-39 noma uguquko oluhlinzekwe yisigaba-38 ngaphambi kokukhipha imvume yokukhiqiza isisi ehlonzwe esigatshaneni sesi-5. Kusalindwe ukuba kuqagulwe izenzo ezisohlwini ezihlonzwe ngaphansi kwesigaba-20, inqubo etholwe kwiSheduli-2 yoMthetho Onqanda Ukunukutshezwa Komoya kufanele ithathwe njengezenzo ezisohlwini. Kusalindwe ukunqunywa kwamazinga okuqondiswe kuwo esigabeni-6, imihlahlandlela yeqophelo lomoya wemvelo equkethwe nguMthetho Onqanda Ukunukutshezwa Komoya iyoqhubeka isebenze.

(Uma kutholakala kumphumela wokuhlola umhlabathi), ukujikeleza kwezitshalo nokuhlela ukujikeleza kwezitshalo kufanele kucatshangelwe, kuhlanganise nezinsuku zokutshala, izitshalo ezihlanganisiwe, izinga lokutshala imbewu, imvula ephakathi, imvula etholelwe phakathi nesikhathi ngaphambi kokuba isitshalo sithunyelwe, imvula etholelwe phakathi nesikhathi sokukhula kwesitshalo, ukulawula izihlahla ezisetshenzisiwe (kuhlanganise namakhemikhali nezinga lawo lokufaka), ama-pesticides asetshenzisiwe nemiphumela yawo, ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo okutholakele nesimo sawo. Izindleko ze-fertilizer zikhona phakathi kwezindleko ezinkulu ze-inputs ezisetshenziswa ngqo ohlelweni lokulima izitshalo. Ukusebenzisa kahle uhlelo lokufaka i-fertilizer njalo ngesizini kanye nesizini yokutshala ezayo kuzokhiqiza ukukhiqizwa kwekhwalithi ephezulu. Kubalulekile ukwazi isimo somhlabathi wakho ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokukhiqizwa okuphezulu kwezitshalo nangemva kwemvula eningi etholelwe ezindaweni ezithile, okungase kube sekwathulile izakhamzimba eziningi ezibalulekile ezitshalo. Ukuvela kokuphuma okuphuma ngenxa yokushoda kwe-nitrogen ne-sulfur kubonwe ezindaweni eziningi ezithintekile kule nkathi yakamuva. Uma kukhona izitshalo eziphakeme kunokujwayelekile, izakhamzimba ezidingekayo ezikhiphwe kufanele zibuye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izitshalo ezilandelayo zingathola ukukhiqizwa okulindelekile. Ngokukhumbula lokhu, amasampula omhlabathi kufanele athathwe kuyo yonke imifula ye-maize ezokwenziwa futhi athunyelwe endaweni ezotholwa khona. Izinyathelo eziningana kufanele zithathwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi inqubo yokufaka i-fertilizer nokuhlola izokwenza umsebenzi wefama yakho.

Ingabe ukulungele ukuqhubeka nokukhokhela emva kwezinyanga ezintathu zokuqala ezilandelayo? Uma usukhokhele umsebenzi imali, bhala inani R... Inani lezinsuku/amahora ngesonto abawasebenzelayo... Usuku lapho umsebenzi eyeka ukusebenza... Ingabe baphothule ukushintsha ababephakathi ngosuku abeyeka ukusebenza...? Usuku ababuya ngalo emsebenzini... Uma umsebenzi kufanele aziswe ngezinsuku zokuphumula emsebenzini, umbiko ophathelene nalokho kufanele uthunyelwe njalo ngenyanga ngefomu W.CI. Uma umsebenzi efela kule ngozi, bhala igama nendawo yokuhlala kwabaxhomekeki. Uma umsebenzi enenkinga yokukhubazeka noma ehlupheka ngokufa okuthile ngaphambi kwengozi noma esekuthole enye imali yokukhokha yokukhubazeka, hlinzeka ngemininingwane ephelele... Ingabe bathole usizo lokuqala...? Uma umsebenzi uphathwa esibhedlela, hlinzeka ngelagama labo... Ingabe le ngozi yenzeka ngenxa: (a) ukungalandeli indlela ebekiwe ngenhloso? Cha b Ngenxa yokungabi nenhlonipho ekulandeleni imithetho yokuphepha noma ukuvimbela izingozi? Cha c Babe sebenza ngaphansi kwemiphumela yokuphuza utshwala noma izidakamizwa? Qaphela: Uma yimuphi wemibuzo lezi zibuza impendulo "yebo", umsebenzi kufanele anikeze incazelo eningiliziwe okufanele ifakwe lapha kanye nezimo zakho. Igama nendawo yokuhlala kwanoma ubani: a owabuka le ngozi... b Owayazi ukuthi kwenzeka ingozi ngaleso sikhathi... Bangaki abanye abasebenzi abalimala kule ngozi... Uma kuhlolwe ngupholisa, hlinzeka ngegama lesiteshi somphakathi kanye nenombolo yezehlakalo... Uma imoto ibibandakanyeka kule ngozi, hlinzeka ngenombolo yokubhaliswa kwayo... Umsebenzi: Usuku lwe-engozi... Qhubeka nendawo 35 ekhasini elilandelayo. Ezinye izici eziholele kule ngozi.

Ngemvume yenu, ngithanda ukubuyela emuva futhi ngikhumbuze lokho esakukhuluma ngo-2004, njengabaholi benhlangano, phambi kwabokufika bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, sabuthana endaweni yokuhlangana kukahulumeni e-Union Building eTshwane ngosuku lokukhululeka, usuku esikhumbula ngalo inkululeko yethu eminyakeni eyishumi, futhi saphinde sajoyina isizwe ekubekeni umongameli wokuqala wombuso wentando yeningi, owakhethwe yiphalamende lethu, ukuze kuhlonishwe iz interests zesizwe ezikhonjiswe kokhetho luka-2004. Sekuphele isikhathi eside iNingizimu Afrika yethu ibe nekhaya elinokuphila, futhi iphinde yakhombisa kahle futhi ibhujiswe emphakathini. Iphakathi lapho uthola khona ukuthi uma uzalwa omnyama, uthola isiqalekiso sonke isikhathi sokuphila kwakho, uma uzalwa omhlophe, uthwala ukwesaba nokucasuka okufihlekile... Iphakathi lapho udoti, iphunga lobubha, udoti uhamba ezitaladini, ukuguguleka kwemfucumfucu, izixuku ezigcwele usizi, umhlaba omkhulu ogcwele udoti, le ndawo ibheka phansi futhi ifaka ubuhle komunye umhlaba onemigwaqo ehlanganayo, nezimbali ezivuthayo ziphazamisa ubuhlalu bokhula obuhlaza, nezinyoni, nezindlu ezifanele amakhosi namakhosikazi, nomculo opholile nothando. Iphakathi lapho ukuphila endaweni ethile kuyindlela yokubiza abanye ukuze bakuphathise, noma ukuphendula kumakhelwane, lapho amakhelwane ezophathwa ngotshwala nezidakamizwa ukuze bangazweli ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu bayazi ukuthi ukuphila kwabo ngeke kube kuhle uma kungekho ukubulawa phakathi kwabo, ukuhlinzwa nokulwa okungenasizathu phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo.

Lokhu kuboniswa ku-Isithombe 2 ngezansi. Lokhu akusiyo umsebenzi olula ngoba kunezinto eziningi ezingaphandle kokulawula komphathi wepulazi ezingashintsha umkhondo webhizinisi. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kuyinselelo enkulu kumnikazi/umphathi webhizinisi lezolimo. Ngokwazi umsebenzi, kufanele uhlale ucabanga ngezindaba zezimali eziphathelene nemali engenayo nezindleko (izindleko) lapho wenza noma yini ebhizinisini lakho. Ekuphetheni, singasho ukuthi ukuze ibhizinisi lezolimo libe nenzuzo, kumele lihlinzeke abathengi ngezimpahla/imikhiqizo abayidingayo. Ngemuva kwalokho, abaphathi bamabhizinisi ezolimo kufanele baqinise imizamo yabo ukuze baqhubeke benza inenzuzo esikhathini esizayo, ukuze umsebenzi wabo uhlale uthuthuka.

Ngaphandle uma kubekiwe kule sigaba, isicelo esifakiwe enkantolo sokuthi kukhishwe isinqumo ngaphansi kwesigaba 34 kufanele senziwe ingakapheli iminyaka emibili kusukela buqediwe ubuhlobo oburejistiwe. Noma yingasiphi isikhathi, emveni kokudlula kwesikhathi okukhulunwa ngaso kwisigatshana 1, inkantolo ingasivumela isicelo ukuthi sikamkhalazi enkantolo ngaphanssi kwesigaba 33, uma yaneliseka kuzo zonke izinto, ukuthi umkhalazi uzobhekana nobunzima obukhulu kakhulu uma singamukeleki isicelo sakhe kunalobo azobhekana nabo okuwuye isicelo nesinqumo senkantolo esizobe sibhekiswe kuye. Uma oyedwa kumbe bobabili ophathini befa, uphathini osaphila orejistiwe kumbe umphathi wefanwanoma yimuphi uphathini orejistiwe kufanele akhiphe isaziso esibhaliwe asithumele kubantu abanentshisekelo. Inkantolo ecubungula isicelo ngaphansi kwale Sahluko kufanele ibhekelele umthengi, kumbe omunye umuntu onentshisekelo kumbe ilungelo kwimpahla edingidwayo. Inkantolo ingakhipha noma yisiphi isinqumo esifanelekile ukuvikela amalungelo abantu abanentshisekelo. Oyedwa kumbe bobabili ophathini, emva kokuphela ngokufa kumbe ukwehlukana kobuhlobo obungarejistiwe, bangasifaka isicelo ukuthola isinqumo sesondlo, sokwabiwa kwefa elingayo incwadi kumbe sokwehlukaniswa kwempahla. h indlela obaziwa ngayo ubuhlobo kumphakathi; kanye i indlela ababubuka ngayo abantu bangaphandle ubuhlobo obungarejistiwe. Akudingi ukuthi kube nomphumela wezinto okukhulunywa ngazo kwisigatshana 2, kumbe nenhlanganisela yazo, ngaphambi kokuthi inkantolo ithathe isinqumo ngaphansi kwale Sahluko, futhi kungase kudinge ukuthi kubhekwe nezinye izinto ezingase zibonakale zifanelekile ukuthi zibhekwe kwisimo sodaba.

Abasebenzi bethu sebandile sekukhona 17 abasebenza sonke isikhathi kule phrojekti, futhi kukhona 13 abasebenza ngenkontilaki. Ibhajethi lalonke iphrogramu selifika ku- R14 miliyoni (iminyaka yezimali yamaphrojekti ayifani neminyaka yezimali yeGrain SA, kodwa leli nani licishe lishaye khona). EBothaville, sinoJane McPherson (Umphathi wePhrogramu), uDkt Willie KotzÃƒÂ© (Ingcweti: Ukuqeqesha nokuThuthukisa), uMnz Danie van Den Berg (Ingweti: Imisebenzi Yangaphandle), oMs Debbie Boshoff noAnnemarie de Beer (ukusekela ngokuphatha). Ngonyaka odlule sidabukile ukuvalelisa uNkz Jacinta Motloang wasehovisi laseLadybrand ohambe ukuyofundisa eManyatseng, noMnz Piet Potgieter ojoyine iVKB, ungumphathi wesigaba sabo sokuthuthukisa abakhiqizi. Siyathokoza ukusebenzana noPiet Potgieter kulo msebenzi wakhe omusha. Thina siyazibona njengabantu abangamalunga ethimu lokuthuthukisa abalimi eNingizimu Afrika jikelele asebenza nabanye ekuthuthukisweni. UMnz Jan de Villiers waseFicksburg uvumile ukuphatha iWinter Cereals Trust project eFreyistata Mpumalanga. UJan uyindoda eyaziwayo, usuthathe umhlalaphansi kodwa unolwazi olukhulu ekulimeni nokutshala ukolo, futhi unenhliziyo yokunikeza lo lwazi ukuze abanye abalimi bakwazi ukukhula. UMnz Arthur Clayton waseSannieshof usaqhubeka ukuphatha iSorghum Project. Lonke iphrogramu lisekelwa yizinhlangano ezilandelayo: iGrain Trust, iMaize Trust, iWinter Cereals Trust, iOil and Protein Seeds Development Trust neSorghum Trust. Ukusekela kwala maThrasti kukhulu kabi. Ngaphandle kwawo akungeke kwenzeke lutho ekuthuthukisweni kwabalimi bokudla okuzinhlamvu.

Ukhomishina ofungisayo akavunyelwe ukubhekela isifungo noma ukuqinisekisa okuphathelene nodaba akaluthandayo nolumthintayo. Isizathu ukuthi umuntu oqinisekisa i-afidavithi kufanele kube ngumununtu ongenzeleli nongachemile maqondana nodaba oluku-afidavithi ukuze umuntu ofakazayo ezokhululeka kunoma yimuphi umthelela wesihloko esiku-afidavithi. Lo msebenzi owenziwa ukhomishina ofungisayo wenza ukuthi kungabi nasidingo sokuthi abantu bahambe ibanga elide beya eziteshini zamaphoyisa eziseduze noma ehhovisi likamantshi ukuthi bayothola usizo. Uma umholi wendabuko, ngenxa yezinto okufanele azenze noma ngenxa yezinye izizathu, engakwazi ukusebenza njengokhimishina wokufungisa, unobhala noma nanoma yimuphi umholi womphakathi ogunyazwe umholi wendabuko, angaba ukhomishina ofungisayo waleyo ndawo, kuphela ngokuqokwa uNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa kanye Nokwenziwa Komthethosisekelo. Amafomu okufaka isicelo (J5) ayatholakala ehhovisi lemantshi. Le fomu inamakhasi ayisithupha. Amakhasi amahlanu okuqala kufanele agcwaliswe ofaka isicelo kanti ikhasi lokugcina lidinga ukuthi ligcwaliswe imantshi ezokwenza izincomo ngesicelo. Ngokomthetho, lokhu kusho ukuthi ofake isicelo uzoba nezingxoxo zemibuzo nemantshi, ezihlelwe uMabhalane Wenkantolo Yomphakathi. Lapho kungunobhala womholi wendabuko noma omunye umholi womphakathi ogunyazwe umholi wendabuko, kuyadingeka ukuthi kube nencwadi yokuncoma ebhalwe ngumholi wendabuko, ukuthi iphelezele isicelo. Imantshi izobe seyithumela ifomu yesicelo kanyekanye nencwadi yokuncoma kuMnyango Wezobulungiswa kanye Nokwenziwa Komthethosisekelo.

Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkanyezi futhi nabalandeli bukhulu, kubonisa isitayela sokuqhuba imidlalo esiphumelelayo. Lokhu kudala isiko elihlangene, elijabulisayo nelihloniphekile phakathi kwamaqembu noma izigaba. Isigaba Sokuncintisana Uma sibheka isigaba sokuncintisana, amaPirates aphokophele phezulu kakhulu kuzo zonke izingeniso. Kwezinsuku zakamuva, lokhu kugudluza izithombe ezinkulu zokuheha abalandeli, abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, laba abathanda ibhola. Lokhu kudala uhlobo lwezikanathi phakathi kweqembu nomphakathi, kudalula imiphumela emihle. Ithuba Lokuthola Ukuthola Imiphumela Ekuhlakanipheni AmaOrlando Pirates naye ajabulela ukuthola amalungelo okuthola emiphumeleni ebucayi ngaphakathi kokuhlelekile. Ngokuqhubeka nokucishe kwenziwa kubaluleke kakhulu endaweni yokuhlonipha nezinkanyezi zabafana abasha. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi okuhamba phambili kuza kutholakala emakethe yezezimali - ngakho-ke nokuthola impumelelo okukhulu. Isiphetho Kuphinde kube nokubungaza ukunqoba okukhulu okuwufaneleke kakhulu, futhi ama-Orlando Pirates angaba yimfuno yebhola elahlukile eNingizimu Afrika. Kwabaningi, umoya ophakathi kwabo uyazwakala, futhi ubharia eliheha ibhizinisi elikhanya phansi nezinyathelo zenhliziyo. Isiphetho ukuthi la maqembu kumele ahlale eqhubekayo, edlula emkhakheni omkhulu. Abalandeli bazothokozisa okusunguliwe, okungakhetha ukwenza ukuba amaPirates ahlale phambili kumakhono nomphakathi, ngaleyo ndlela kuvuleka amathuba amaningi ezintweni ezingakaze zenzeke phambilini.

UThandiwe, oneminyaka engama-38, wajoyina abanye abahambi bephuma emakhaya baye emadolobheni. Bahamba ngezinyawo, baphuma emzansi eMpumalanga, baye eThekwini. Ubuya nezinkumbulo ezinhle nezinsizi ezinzima. Uhambo lwabo lwalunezikhathi zokukhathazeka, kodwa futhi nemizwelo yokuthokozisa. Ukufuduka akusiyo nje impilo, kodwa kuyingxenye yesiko lokuphila kwabantu. Izifundo Ezitholakele E-Joburg, uThandiwe wathola izifundo eziningi. Wenza imisebenzi emincane yokuhlanza nezinsiza zokudla, kodwa wahlangabezana nezinselelo eziningi. Abantu bejolise kumsebenzi ophakeme, kodwa uThandiwe wahamba phambili. Wafunda ukuthi ukuhamba emadolobheni kudinga ukuthembela emandleni akho. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, waqonda ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona — impilo ayilula, kodwa iyasebenza. Imiphumela Yokufuduka Njengoba isikhathi siqhubeka, uThandiwe wathola umsebenzi osezingeni eliphezulu. Noma kunjalo, ukuphila emadolobheni kwaba nezinkinga. Abantwana bakhe bahlala bezama ukufunda ezikoleni, kodwa uThandiwe ubona ukuthi kunezinkinga eziningi abavela emakhaya abahlangabezana nazo. Ubuye azwe ubuhlungu bokuphila ngaphandle kwendlu yabo, kudinga isinyathelo sokwakha imiphakathi. Izindlela Zokuphila Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe waba nephupho lokwakha umphakathi wezakhamizi ezivela emakhaya. Waqala ukuhlanganyela nezinye izimuli, benza imihlangano yokuxoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile. Ucabanga ukuthi abantu abavela emakhaya bangenza umehluko kumphakathi. Bazokwakha imiphakathi eqinile, bahlale besekela omunye nomunye, baphinde bahlanganyele. Isiphetho UThandiwe Mthembu uyisibonelo esihle sokuthi abantu bangakwenza kanjani ukufuduka emakhaya baye emadolobheni.

Ukuvela ku-Ndebe yeNhlangano ye-FIFA: Kanye. Abadlali abavelele: u-Hossam Hassan, Ahmed Hassan, Amr Zaky, Mohamed Zidan. Indlela abahlasela ngayo nesu labo elihlangene libenza bafaneleke ukuzibiza ngamaqhawe ase-Eshiya. Umqeqeshi: uJorvan Viera, Ukukalwa ngokwezinga le-FIFA: 77. Ukuvela ku-Ndebe yeNhlangano ye-FIFA: Kanye. Abadlali abavelele ngu-Younis Mohmoud, Noor Sabri, Bassim Abbas, Nashat Akram. I-Spain okwamanje siyithimba elikalwe njengelokuqala ezingeni lokukala le-FIFA elisemthethweni lomhlaba. Umqeqeshi: u-Vincente Del Basque. Ukukalwa kwezinga le-FIFA: Ngeyokuqala. Ukuvela ku-Ndebe yeNhlangano ye-FIFA: kanye. Abadlali abavelele: Fernado Torres, Xabi Alonso, Iker Casillas, Sergio Ramos. Ngokungena kumathonamenti amahlanu edlule ku-Ndebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA nangemuva kokuvikela ngempumelelo ithayithili ye-CONCACAF Gold Cup 2007 ngokushaya i-Mexico ngo-2-1, i-USA ithathwa njengezingqungqulu eziqubisile emhlabeni webhola lezinyawo. Umqeqeshi: uBob Bradely. Ukukalwa ezingeni le-FIFA: 21. Ivele ku-Ndebe yeNhlangano ye-FIFA: 3. Abadlali abavelele: uDamarcus Beasley, Landon Donovan, Clint Dempsey, Tim Howard. Alikho iqembu emlandweni elike lathokozela impumelelo njengeBrazil. Ike yakhiqiza abanye abadlali bamagama amakhulu emidlalweni abanjengo-Pele no-Ronaldihno. Yiyona kuphela ithimba esilike ladlala kuyo yonke imidlalo yeNdebe yoMhlaba ye-FIFA. Umqeqeshi: uDunga. Ukukala kwe-FIFA.

Ngokwesigaba -14 soMthetho, izinhlangano zomphakathi ezinjenge-DHA kufanele zihlanganise ibhukwana elizosiza ukuthi abantu bathole ulwazi olukulenhlangano. Isigaba- 14 izibeka zicace izidingo eziphansi zalelo bhukwana. Ngokuvumelana nomthethosisekelo kanye nomthetho, i-DHA yethula leli bhukwana ngomzamo wokuphoqelela isiko lokwenzela izinto obala kanye nokubusa okuhle. Inhloso yaleli bhukwana ukunikeza ocela ulwazi oluserekhodini izinqubo kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana edingekayo ukuthola ulwazi oluqonde ngqo ku-DHA. Ibhukwana linikeza futhi umuntu ocela ulwazi incazelo ecacile yesakhiwo, amagunya kanye nemisebenzi ye-DHA, kanye nokuhlelwa kolwazi lwabo ngezigaba zabo, ukuze ocela ulwazi ezokwazi ukubona kalula ukuthi ulwazi olufunekayo lunotholakala kuphi. Isigaba- 10 soMthetho sidinga ukuthi iKhomishini yaamalungelo Abantu yaseNingizimu Afrika (South African Human Rights Commission) ("SAHRC") ihlanganise ibhukwana eliyisiqondiso lokuthi usetshenziswa kanjani uMthetho, ngazo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni kanye nesakhiwo okulula ukusifunda, ngoJulayi ngo-2003. Ngesikhathi okwabhalwa ngaso leli bhukwana, ibhukwana eliyisiqondiso le-SAHRC lalingekho. Imininingwane yokuthinta wonke umsebenzi wolwazi kanye nephini lomsebenzi wolwazi wayo yonke inhlangano yomphakathi. Ulwazi lokuthi usifaka kanjani isicelo sokuthola amarekhodi ezinhlangano zomphakathi nezizimele. Usizo olutholakalayo kumsebenzi wolwazi lwenhlangano yomphakathi ngokomthetho.

Uhulumeni uzosebenza ephokophele ekusungulweni kanye nasekwamukelweni kwamazinga abanzi alokho okuphokophelwe kuzwelonke kokwehlisa kokukhishwa kwentuthu ephathelene namandla eyingozi kwindawo kanye nasezimpilweni zabantu. UBusi wayeyintombazanyana ejabulile, wayehlale ecula, ehleka futhi edlala ngomfomwabo omncane. Kwisikali sikazwelonke, iGauteng iyindawo lapho kudlulana khona ngokwendawo ukusebenza kwezomnotho kanye nobumpofu. Uwonkewonke uyakholwa ukuthi ngesikhathi nilwa nomzabalazo owathatha isikhathi eside, nakwenza lokhu ngoba naniphikisana nobandlululo, ukucwaswa ngokobuhlanga, udlame olubhekiswe kwabokufika kanye nokunye okuhambisana nakho yonke indawo. Ngokuphathelene nohlelo loxolo, Osiza kwizingxoxo kanye nabaholi Besifunda bazoqhubeka nokuxoxisana nabaholi be-PALIPEHUTU-FNL ngethemba lokuthi bazobuyela kwi-JVMM. Ukubengulwa komsoco ngokujwayelekile kungumphumela wamazinga aphakeme kakhulu ama-carbohydrate ekudleni, noma kusukela ekudleni ngokweqile. Isikhathi esiningi le miphambo ekhiqiza ulwazi ihambisana ne-inthanethi, futhi isabalala kumazwe kanye nakumazwekazi ahlukene. Iziqhephu zombhalo kanye nezithombe zingakopishwa kumaphepha angawodwa kuphela uma kuzokwaziswa umthombo. Amaphoyisa athatha iselula umangali athi ngeyakhe. Yindawo yokuqala yezindawo ezinigni ezithathwa njengezamagugu emvelo kanye nezindawo zokuvakasha zezivakashi ezithanda imvelo. Ngiyethemba ukuthi izikhulu zinilungiselele uhlelo lohambo oluhle kakhulu, okuhlanganisa uhambo oluya kwizingqalasizinda kanye nezikhungo zethu zesayensi ezinhle kakhulu.

Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezigcina lezi zirekhodi. I-NAFVSA inegumbi lokucwaninga lapho abacwaningi bengathola usizo lwezinhlobo zonke uma befuna ulwazi, futhi bangakwazi futhi ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe kumakhompyutha mahhala. Ukubuka nokulalela izinto ezishicilelwe kumele kuhlelwe kusenesikhathi. Udinga ukwazisa isikhungo okungenani ezinsukwini ezintathu ngaphambi kokulungiselela lokho ofuna ukukusebenzisa futhi ufake kumishini efanele. Lezi zinto zingasetshenziswa kuphela ezindaweni ze-NAFVSA futhi kuzokwenziwa imali ethile ethathwe nguMnyango Wezezimali. Abafundi nabafundi bangasebenzisa lezi zinto mahhala, kodwa badinga futhi ukuhlela ngaphambi kokulalela nokubuka. Imvume ebhalwe phansi evela kubadali iyadingeka uma othile efuna ukukopisha into ethile. Ibhuku lethu linamabhuku angama-3000 ayinqaba ahlobene nomkhakha wefilimu, oqalwe kudala ngesikhathi seNational Film Board, futhi izinto ezingahlangene azikhiphwayo nhlobo ngenxa yokubaluleka kwazo. Nokho, wonke amabhuku ebhuku angabukwa ku-Archive yeNational Heritage, futhi amakhophi angakhiqizwa ngentengo ephansi. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo lamaphosta amafilimu ahlukaniswe cishe ayizinkulungwane, aqala ngesikhathi sikaDe Voortrekkers, okuyifilimu endala eNingizimu Afrika. Iningi lamaphosta lawo ngempela alingabazekayo futhi ahlobene nawo wonke amakhono amafilimu akhiqizwe ezweni lethu. Inhloso ye-archive ngala maphosta ukuwurekhoda ngokuqondile futhi uwagcine eqoqweni lapho angasetshenziswa khona ngaphandle kokuthathwa. Njengokuqoqwa kwamaphosta, i-Archive ineqoqo lezithombe ezihlobene namafilimu kuleli zwe.

Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila nezindaba ezintsha, bephendula ezimweni ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana zenza kube lula ukusabalalisa ama-podcast, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba babelane ngama-podcast abawathandayo nabanye. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendawo yokukhuluma ngezindaba ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izihloko ezithinta ubuciko, ezemidlalo, ezempilo, nezokwakha. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bahlala bejolise ezindabeni ezithinta impilo yabo, futhi ama-podcast anikeza izixazululo, izeluleko, kanye nezifundo ezivela kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwenza ama-podcast abe yinsiza ebalulekile ekwakheni ulwazi nolwazi. Ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika akukhona kuphela ngenxa yokutholakala kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokuhlangenwe nakho kwabantu. Abantu abaningi baveza izindaba zabo, izifundo, kanye nemicabango yabo kumama-podcast, okwenza kube lula kubanye ukuba bafunde futhi bakhule. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, okwenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast akhuthaza abantu ukuba baphendule ezimweni ezinzima. Njengoba abantu bephila emhlabeni ogcwele izinselelo, ama-podcast ahlinzeka ngendawo yokuxoxa ngezinto ezinzima, okwenza kube lula ukuba abantu babone ukuthi abakhulumi bodwa. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuxhumana, okwenza abantu bazizwe bekhululekile ukukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokufunda. Abantu bangafunda ngezinto ezintsha, izindlela zokuphila, nezindlela zokwenza izinto ngendlela engcono.

Namuhla sikhona eNseleni ukuze sithintane nani ngezindlela esingazisebenzisa ukuvimbela izifo ezingasithinta lapho kungekho isidingo. Le mkhankaso esiyingxenye yayo namuhla ibonisa kahle ukuthi abaholi baleli zwe bayakhathazeka ngokuqhubeka kokwanda kwe-TB kuleli. Le mkhankaso, esayiyinayo ngaphambili endaweni yaseMsinga ekuqaleni konyaka, iyalandelwa nathi emzini ophakathi kweDolobha laseThekwini, futhi iphelile ezindaweni zemidlalo zedolobha laseMpumalanga eHammarsdale ekuqaleni kukaAugust. Masicacise ukuthi abahlali balendawo banjengama-130,000, futhi okwamanje, kuphela abangu-700 kubo abavakashele ezikhungweni zethu zokuhlolwa kwe-TB. Njengomnyango, sinezinkinga ezincane zokwelapha bonke laba bantu abathintekayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi bonke abakhona lapha bazi futhi bakhumbuze labo abangaphumelelanga ukuthi ukuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwe-TB kwenziwa mahhala. Ukwelapha lowo muntu kusiphatha ngaphezu kuka-R24,000, futhi umuntu ophakathi kwalolu suku angase athole ukuthi uchitha isikhathi eside esibhedlela, kude namalungu omndeni wakhe. Lezi zimpawu zidinga ukuthi uphuthume uye esikhungweni sezempilo ngoba ungakwazi ukusiza empini yokulwa ne-TB. Labo abahlala nomuntu onayo, labo abangakwazi ukunakekela izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu, abantu abahlala ne-HIV, abantu abaphuza utshwala, abantu abasebenzisa imishanguzo, abantu abakhathazekile, kanye nalabo abahlala ezindaweni ezingaventilated kahle baphakathi kwezingozi eziphezulu. Labo abathatha ama-ARVs kufanele bazi ukuthi imishanguzo ye-TB ayithinti amaphilisi abo. Ukuhluka ukuthi ukwelashwa kwe-TB kuhlala izinyanga eziyisithupha kanti ama-ARVs athathwa impilo yakho yonke.

Iphakathi lapho uthola khona ukuthi uma uzalwa omnyama, uthola isiqalekiso sonke isikhathi sokuphila kwakho, uma uzalwa omhlophe, uthwala ukwesaba nokucasuka okufihlekile... Iphakathi lapho udoti, iphunga lobubha, udoti uhamba ezitaladini, ukuguguleka kwemfucumfucu, izixuku ezigcwele usizi, umhlaba omkhulu ogcwele udoti, le ndawo ibheka phansi futhi ifaka ubuhle komunye umhlaba onemigwaqo ehlanganayo, nezimbali ezivuthayo ziphazamisa ubuhlalu bokhula obuhlaza, nezinyoni, nezindlu ezifanele amakhosi namakhosikazi, nomculo opholile nothando. Iphakathi lapho ukuphila endaweni ethile kuyindlela yokubiza abanye ukuze bakuphathise, noma ukuphendula kumakhelwane, lapho amakhelwane ezophathwa ngotshwala nezidakamizwa ukuze bangazweli ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu bayazi ukuthi ukuphila kwabo ngeke kube kuhle uma kungekho ukubulawa phakathi kwabo, ukuhlinzwa nokulwa okungenasizathu phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo. Iphakathi lapho kukhombisa ukuthi uma uhlala ezindaweni ezithile, kuyindlela yokuphila ngokuphepha, ngoba ukuphepha kusho ukuba nezingadi eziphakeme, imigoqo kagesi, izinja zokuvikela, amaphoyisa aqaphelayo, nezinsizwa ezilungele ukuvikela labo abawubaba bethu ngezikhali, nezikhali ezifihliwe ezihlahleni, kanye namahhelikopta azoshaya ukufa kulabo abaphazamisa ubaba... Kusikhuthaza ukuthi ukhetho lwethu olwenziwe ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule lunikeza ukuqinisekiswa kokuzimisela kwabantu bethu, kungakhathaliseki ngesizathu, nendlela yomuntu yokubambisana ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labantu bonke abafanayo. Izinkinga eziphuthumayo zokuphila kwabantu ngeke zixazululwe uma singakhethi amathuba emisebenzi, nokunciphisa noma ukususa ubuphofu phakathi kwethu.

Ukuze ibhizinisi lezolimo libe nenzuzo, kumele likwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo efunwa ngabathengi. Ngemuva kwalokho, le nenzuzo kufanele iqhubeke ibe khona esikhathini esizayo, ngakho ukuphathwa kwebhizinisi lezolimo kufanele kukhule futhi kuthuthuke ngokuqhubekayo esikhathini esizayo. Ezinsukwini zokuqala zomuntu, umuntu wayedinga izinto ezizomsiza ukuze aphile. Ukudla kwakubalulekile, bese edinga nezingubo nezindawo zokuhlala. Ekuqaleni, abantu bathola izinto ezidingekayo ngok hunting, ukuqoqa ukudla ezitshalweni zemvelo, ukuhwebela izingubo zabo, nokuzivikela ezimeni. Njengoba umuntu eqhubeka phambili, izidingo zawo ziqhubeka zishintsha zibe sezingeni eliphezulu kunezamanje. Umuntu uphinde udlule ekuzimeleni ukuya endaweni lapho konke okudingekayo kuthengwa. Singasho ukuthi empilweni yezenhlalo yanamuhla, amabhizinisi ahlinzeka ngazo zonke izinto ezidingekayo, kodwa zikhokha imali. Ngakho, namuhla sidinga imali ukuze sithenge izinto ezibalulekile zokuphila. Njengoba singabantu abafuna ukuthenga lezi zinto, singathola imali kuphela ngokusebenza kuyo. Ungasebenza ngokwakho noma usebenze komunye umuntu ukuze uthole umholo. Uma ukhetha ukusebenza ngokwakho ngokuphatha ibhizinisi lezolimo, leli bhizinisi kufanele likulethe inenzuzo - kumele uphumelele kwezezimali. Ekulimaleni, kungaba nempumelelo kuphela uma ibhizinisi lakho lihlinzeka abantu ngezinto abazidingayo - ngaleyo ndlela umnikazi wale bhizinisi uzokwenza inenzuzo. Uma ibhizinisi lenza inenzuzo, umnikazi uzokwazi ukukhipha umholo. Uma ibhizinisi lingakwenzi inenzuzo, umnikazi uthola lutho. Izinto ezidingekayo zikhona ezinkampanini, futhi abathengi bazithenga.

Indima yomxazululi kungaba wukuthola indlela lapho uhulumeni engakhipha khona imvume yokwakhiwa kwedamu ngaphansi kwemibandela ethile, engagcina futhi ivikele lezizakhiwo. Imiphakathi ingamsiza uhulumeni ukuqhamuka nezisombululo okuyomele zicaciswe kulemibandela. uma kunempikiswano ngokuvikela imvelo ngemuva kokufakwa kwesicelo sokwedlulisa udaba. Isibonelo: Kukhishwa imvume yokwakha imboni yamafemu endaweni ebucayi esogwini lolwandle nalapho kunomthelela wokunukubezeka komfula oseduze nosetshenziselwa ukunisela. Abalimi bakhononda ngokuthi uhlaziyo ngomthelela ezitshalweni nasekudwebeni awuzange wenziwe ngokugcwele. Bafaka isicelo sokwedlulisa udaba ngemuva kokuqedwa kophenyo lokuhlaziya. Isicelo sabaxazululi singenziwa ngemuva kokufakwa kwesicelo sokwedlulisa udaba. Isinyathelo sokwehlulela senzeka lapho umuntu ongachemile nozimele ethatha isinqumo ngengxabano phakathi kwabantu ababili. Uma sesenziwe isinqumo, kumele silandelwe. Ngokulandisa kweNEMA, uma zehluleka izinhlangothi zombili ukufinyelela esivumelwaneni, umxazululi angizibuza izinhlangothi ukuthi zifuna udaba lwedluliselwe kumehluleli yini. Isinqumo esikhishwa ngumehluleli singujuqu. Uphenyo iNEMA inika uhulumeni amandla amakhulu okuphenya ngomonakalo owenzeka kwimvelo. Uphenyo kungaba ngolwekhomishana yokuthola imininingwane. Uma uphenyo lukhomba ukwephulwa komthetho wezemvelo, uhulumeni unomsebenzi wokumisa lesenzo nokulungisa umonakalo. Isibonelo: Unolwazi ngobugebengu obuhleliwe bokunyenyisa izimpondo zikabhejane obenzeka ezifundazweni ezimbalwa nangaphandle kwezwe.

Ukuphepha kwezimali nabanganikazi bezempilo kudinga ukuhlanganiswa ukuze kuzuze impumelelo. Uma ubumnyama bolwazi lungalandelwa kahle, imiphumela engalindelekile ingase ibekhona, okudinga ukuqapha ngokucophelela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi idatha iphephile, izinkampani zidinga ukuvuma ukufundisa abancikile ngokuqondile mayelana nokuphatha ubumfihlo, ukuze babe nemithetho yokuvikela. Ukuze baphumelele, izixazululo eziningi zidinga ukufakwa, nezindlela zokuxhamazela zidingeka ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukukhanya. Ubumfihlo bolwazi abuqhamuki kuphela, kodwa kudinga ukuqhubeka, ikakhulukazi uma kubhekelwa izinguquko zesimanjemanje. Ekugcineni, uma singazisa abancikile ngezidingo zokuqonda ubumnyama bolwazi lwabancikile, sizosiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi. Ukuphathwa kahle kolwazi lwabancikile kuyisici esiyinhloko sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umcwaningi kufanele aqhubeke ukuhlaziya imithetho, ahlaziye izinguquko, futhi abheke phambili ekwakheni isikhala esihlonishwayo senhlangano, okuhlanganisa ubumfihlo bolwazi lwabancikile. Inhloso yethu iwukwakha umphumela osiza abantu bonke, kusetshenziswa ubumfihlo ukuze kutholakale ushintsho nokuphila okungcono.

Ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ku-GEMS kubalulekile ukuze baqonde ukuthi imininingwane yomuntu ayiyona nje into ethile, kodwa iyingxenye yokuphila kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuziphatha okuhle, ukucophelela, nokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Ukuze lokhu kwenzeke, i-GEMS kumele iqhubeke nokuxhumana nabantu, ibanikeze ulwazi olucacile nolunembile mayelana nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuvikela imininingwane yabo. Lokhu kuzokwakha ukwethembana, futhi abantu bazozizwa bekhululekile ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yabo, bazi ukuthi ivikelekile. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinselelo ezihambisana nobuchwepheshe ziyaqhubeka nokukhula. Izinsongo ezivela kwi-cybercrime zikhula, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi i-GEMS iqhubeke ibuyekeza izinqubomgomo zayo zokuvikela imininingwane. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinyathelo ezithathwayo zihlala zisebenza, kubalulekile ukuba nezinqubo zokuhlola nokuhlaziya, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi i-GEMS iyakwazi ukuvikela imininingwane ngendlela efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-GEMS kumele ibheke phambili, ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela imininingwane. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njenge-blockchain, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imininingwane ayishintshiwe futhi ivikelekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abangenamvume ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ubuchwepheshe obubalulekile; abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi baphila emhlabeni lapho ubumfihlo bukhulu. Ukuze i-GEMS iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile.

Ngaphandle kwazo zonke lezi zinqinamba, bonke abantu ababambe iqhaza kulendima bahlomule kakhulu ngolwazi abaluzuzile. Kunomaziphathe abambalwa asebehlabele phambili kakhulu ekusunguleni izinhlelo ezisiza ekusingatheni imisebenzi nezinhlelo esezisebenza. Amabhukwana eziNkomba ze-IDP, nasungulwe yithimba elinolwazi olwehlukile leDPLG ngokwesekwa yiGTZ, luhlongoza inqubo ehloliwe yokuhlela nokusingatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukusetshenziswa. Kunohlelo lokuqeqesha ezingeni likazwelonke kubaphathi bomasipala, kubasebenzi abangochwepheshe, emakhanseleni nakochwepheshe bokuhlela. Lolu qeqesho lubandakanya bonke abavela komasipala. Uhlelo lukazwelonke lokweseka izinhlelo komasipala bezindawo (PIMSS) luyasungulwa kanti luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zomaziphathe. Isibalo esikhulu somasipala, SALGA, iminyango yezifundazwe kohulumeni bendawo neminyango eminingi yezimboni zikahulumeni ezweni zibe yingxenye yalolu hlelo nokuholele kuleli Qoqo lamaBhukwana amasha e-IDP. Nginethemba elikhulu lokuthi leli qoqo lamabhukwana ashicilelwe liyoba wumhlahlandlela owusizo nomthombo wolwazi oluyonika ugqozi kinina nonke eninegalelo ohlelweni lwe-IDP nasemizamweni yenu yokwenza I-IDP isikhali sokubhekana nezidingo zenhlalonhle nomnotho emiphakathini yethu ngendlela ehlonze ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Amapheshana okwazisa ayindlela esizayo yokudlulisela umalayezo wakho kulabo abangaba ngamakhasimende. Yenza ukuthi kube lula ukuthi amakhasimende axhumane nawe. Amakhadi ebhizinisi awabizi kakhulu ukuwakhiqiza futhi ayithuluzi elishibhile ukulikhiqiza futhi ayithuluzi lokumaketha elisebenzayo ngoba amakhasimende awanikeza nabangane babo, umndeni nalabo abasebenza nabo. Qinisekisa ukuthi uphethe amakhadi ebhizinisi acishe agcwale isandla lapho ukhona ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuze uwanikeze okungenzeka babe ngamakhasimende ikakhulukazi uma ungenele izingqungquthela kanye nezehlakalo zemisebenzi. I-EMIA iwumhahiso wokusa kwamanye amazwe okhokhela ingxenye yezindleko zokusa kwamanye amazwe kumabhizinisi (isib. : ukuya emibukisweni, ucwaningo lwezimakethe). I-EMIA iphinde futhi ibe nemihahiso yokubutha ukuzalisa okusha kwamazwe angaphandle eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze uthole imininingwane eyengeziwe uyacelwa ukuba ushayele isikhungo sokunakekela amakhasimende se-dti lapha 0861 843 384 noma uvakashele iwebhusayidi ethi www.thedti.gov.za. I-THETA, Iziphathimandla Zezokuvakasha, Ukuphatheka kahle kanye Nemidlalo yemfundo Nokuqeqeshwa Iyisigabas Seziphathimandla Zemfundo Nokuqeqeshwa (i-SETA) emiswe ngaphansi Komthetho Wokuthuthukisa Amakhono(Weno.- 97 ka-1998) wesigaba Sokuphathwa Kahle Nomnotho Wemidlalo kanye Nokuphathwa kahle. Umsebenzi osemqoka we-SETA ukunikezela ekukhushulweni kwamakhono - ukuletha amakhono kubaqashwa, noma labo abafuna ukuqashwa, esigabeni sabo.

Ngakho, iSpaceX iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi uma sishintsha umqondo wethu, sizokwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni elikhulu lokuphila emhlabeni nakumkhathini. Ngale ndlela, iSpaceX iyingxenye enkulu yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuphumelela okukhulu, futhi izophinde ibonise ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukufezekisa amaphupho abo uma bephikelela. Njengoba sibheke phambili, sizobona izimanga ezenzakalayo emkhathini, futhi iSpaceX izoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi imizamo yezenhloso ezinhle iyasivumela ukuba sithuthuke siqhubeka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kulindeleke ukuthi iSpaceX izokwenza izinqumo ezibalulekile, ezizothuthukisa amandla okuphila emkhathini, ikakhulukazi uma sikhumbula ukuthi lokhu akukhona kuphela okuhlangene nomhlaba, kodwa futhi ngokuvumelana nezimo ezithile ezizovuleka. Ijolise ekuthuthukiseni ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, futhi izosiza ukwakha amaphupho ezizukulwane ezizayo. ISpaceX, ngalesi sikhathi, ibonisa ukuthi impumelelo ayipheli, futhi kufanele ube nesibindi sokuhamba ngezinyathelo ezinzima ukuze ufinyelele izinjongo ezinkulu. Ngakho-ke, iSpaceX ayigcini nje ngokuthuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi uma abantu besebenza ndawonye, bayakwazi ukufinyelela phezulu, bahlanganyele impumelelo emkhakheni wezokuhamba emkhathini. Lokhu kuqhuba ibhizinisi elisha, elikhuthaza abanye, futhi linika ithemba lokuthi impilo yethu izoshintsha ngendlela emangalisayo.

Uma uMthethosivivinywa oyiswe kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke njengokusho kwengaba (g) no (h) ngenhla, ungemukelwa nguMkhandlu, lowoMthethosivivinywa uphelelwa yisikhathi, kodwa uMthethosivivinywa owawamukelwe nguMkhandlu ekuqaleni ungaphinde futhi wamukelwe nguMkhandlu kodwa wesekwe yivoti okungenani lababili kwabathathu bamalungu awo. UMthethosivivinywa owamukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke njengokusho kwesigaba (e), (i) noma (j) ngenhla kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. UMthethosivivinywa owamukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke njengokubeka kwesigaba (a)(i) ngenhla kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. Uma uMkhandlu kaZwelonke wamukela uMthethosivivinywa oshintshiwe, uMthethosisekelo oshintshiwe kufanele uyiswe eMkhandlwini kaZwelonke; futhi uma uMkhandlu wamukela uMthethosivivinywa oshintshiwe, lowo Mthethosivivinywa kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. enye inhlobo yoMthethosivivinywa. Uma iKomidi Labalamuli lingakwazi ukuvumelana phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-30 emva kokuyiswa koMthethosivivinywa kulona, uMthethosivivinywa uphelelwa yisikhathi. Uma iKomidi Labalamuli livumelana ngoMthethosivivinywa njengoba wamukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke, uMthethosivivinywa kufanele uyiswe eMkhandlwini kaZwelonke, kuthi uma iKomidi liwamukela lowoMthethosivivinywa, uMthethosivivinywa kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume.

Imihlangano yoMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe ugabanjwa kwezinye izindawo ngaphandle kwesihlalo sePhalamende kuphela ngezizathu zezidingo zomphakathi, zokuphepha noma ubulula, futhi uma imitheshwana nezinqumo zesiGungu kukuvumela loku. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe singakhetha usihlalo namaSekela amabili kaSihlalo phakathi kwezithunywa. USihlalo nomunye wamaSekela kaSihlalo ukhethwa phakathi kwezithunywa ezimile ekhethelwa isikhathi esingangeminyaka emihlanu ngaphandle uma isikhathi sabo njengezithunywa siphela ngaphambi kwaleso sikhathi. Elinye iSekela likaSihlalo likhethelwa isikhathi esingangonyaka owodwa, futhi kufanele lilandelwe yisithunywa esivela kwesinye isiFundazwe, ukuze isifundazwe ngasinye sithole ithuba lokumelwa. UMongameli weNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo kufanele engamele ukhetho lukaSihlalo, noma aqoke elinye ijaji elizokwenza loko USihlalo wengamela ukhetho lweSekela likaSihlalo. Inkambiso ebekwe kuSheduli 3 iyasebenza ekukhethweni kukaSihlalo neSekela likaSihlalo. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe ungamsusa usiHlalo noma iSekela likaSihlalo esikhundleni. Ngokumaqondana nemitheshwana kanye nezinqumo, uMkhandlu kazwelonke weziFundazwe ungaqoka phakathi kwezithunywa esinye isikhulu esengamele ukhetho ukulekelela uSihlalo kanye namasekela kaSihlalo. zonke izindaba eziphambi koMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe zisuke zemukelwe uma okungenani izifundazwe eziyisihlanu zivote ngokulweseka udaba.

Indlela okuhlanganiswa ngayo isampula locwaningo kubaluleke kakhulu ekukholekeni kolwazi. Siyazi futhi ukuthi ubumpofu, ukungathuthuki ngokwenele, ukungabikho kozinzo, impi kanye nezinhlekelele zemvelo sekudlange kwizwekazi isikhathi eside. IMinyango yezemfundo ibeka ngamaqoqo amahlanu izikole okubizwa ngokuthi ama-quintile, ngokubekwa kumazinga okuba mpofu. Ukukhishwa kwama-toilet paper, amaphinifa eplastiki, amaplastiki kanye nezinsiza zokuhlanza kwesikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu. Ngiyethemba ukuthi abangenele umncintiswano kanye nalabo abazowina umncintiswano wokubhala izindaba ezimfushane namhlane bazothatha kokubili umoya kanye nezifiso zokubhala kukaSteve Biko. Kuyadabukisa ukuthi okuphakanyiswe Wumkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka akuzange kwenziwe yilawo maqembu ayebandakanyeka. Kuzothuthukiswa isephulamthetho futhi kuzobhekwa indlela ezifanele zokwelapha. Kulawa maqembu, iqembu lokugcina kuphela elingakwazanga ukuhlala ngenxa yokungabikho kwesikhathi. Abanini mikhumbi baseNingizimu Afrika abatholi okuhle ngokuncintisana okufanayo nemikhumbi eminingi evela emazweni angaphandle kwakuleli. Isimo sethu sanamhlanje sikhombisa umphumela wobugqila kanye nokubuswa abantu abasuka kwamanye amazwe kwizwekazi lethu, osekubhebhezele ukungalingani, ubumpofu, ukungathuthukiswa ngokwenele kanye nokuxhashazwa. Ungala ukwenza umsebenzi uma ngobuqotho lokhu kuchaza ukuthi uma ngeqiniso futhi ukholelwa ukuthi umsebenzi ungabeka indawo engozini enkulu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ngokuphindaphinda ngokunye okungundabuzekwayo kwintuthuko. Ingabe lokhu kwenzeka cishe ngemuva kwehora lesishiyagalolunye noma ngaphambi kwehora lesishiyagalolunye?

Kodwa lena incwadi yakho... Inhlangano Yezizwe United Nations UN yenziwa emva kweMpi Yesibili Yomhlaba. Ngomhla ka-24 Okthoba, amazwe angama-51 ahlangana ngomzamo wokwenza uxolo ngokuhlanganyela kwamazwe omhlaba kanye nokuvikeleka ngokuqoqana. Namhlanje, cishe isizwe ngasinye singaphansi kweNhlangano Yezizwe. Lapho Amazwe eba amalungu eNhlangano Yezizwe, ayavuma ukwamukela izibophezelo zoMqulu we-UN, isivumelwano samazwe omhlaba esibeka imigomo eyisisekelo yobudlelwano bamazwe omhlaba. NgokoMqulu, i-UN inezinhloso ezine: ukugcina ukuthula nokuvikeleka kwamazwe omhlaba, ukwenza ubudlelwano obunobungane ezizweni, ukuhlanganyela ekwenzeni izinkinga zamazwe omhlaba nokukhuthaza inhlonipho yamalungelo abantu, nokuba umongo wokuxolelanisa izenza zezizwe. Amalungu e-UN amazwe azibusayo. Inhlangano Yezizwe ayisiyena uhulumeni womhlaba, futhi ayishayi imithetho. Kodwa-ke iyasiza ngezindlela zokuxazulula izingxabano zamazwe omhlaba nokwenza izinqubomgomo ngezindaba ezisithinta sonke. Ku-UN, onke Amazwe AngamaLungu -amakhulu namancane, acebile nampofu, anemiqondo yezepolitiki eyahlukene kanye nezindlela zenhlalo yomphakathi - anezwi futhi ayavota kulolu hlelo. Inhlangano Yezizwe inezingxenye ezibalulekile eziyisithupha. Ezinhlanu zazo - Umbuthano Ojwayelekile, Umkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka, Umkhandlu Wezomnotho Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi, Umkhandlu Wokubhekela kanye noMnyango Wobubhalane - baseHhovisi Elikhulu le-UN eNew York.

Izinkulumo zomthetho eziphathelene nokuthathwa komhlaba Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umphakathi waseMkhumbane uhlela umcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nezinkulumo zomthetho mayelana nokuthathwa komhlaba. Lo mcimbi, obubanjelwe emnyangweni wezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi, wawuhloselwe ukudala ithuba lokuxoxa, ukuxhumana, nokwabelana ngemicabango phakathi kwabantu abathintekayo, izikhulu zikamasipala, kanye nezazi zomthetho. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo kaMnu. Thabo Mthembu, umholi wesifunda, owakhumbuza bonke abebekhona ngobaluleka kokuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo ezindabeni zokuthathwa komhlaba. Uthe, “Ukuthathwa komhlaba akuyona into elula; kudinga ukucabangela izimpilo zabantu, izinsiza, kanye nezidingo zomphakathi.” Ngemuva kwalokho, izazi zomthetho zabelana ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezinsiza zomthetho ezikhona eziphathelene nokuthathwa komhlaba. UProf. Zanele Khumalo, ongumlawuli wezifundo eNyuvesi yaseThekwini, waphawula ngokuqonda okubalulekile kokuhlonipha amalungelo abantu, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa ekuthathweni komhlaba. Uthe, “Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi umhlaba awuwona umkhiqizo kuphela, kodwa ungumthombo wezimpilo zethu.” Umcimbi waphinde waba nezinkulumo ezivela kubantu abathintekayo, okuhlanganisa abanikazi bomhlaba, izinkampani ezithintekayo, kanye nezikhungo zomphakathi. UMsizi Mkhize, ongumholi weqembu labanikazi bomhlaba, wabelane ngolwazi lwakhe mayelana nezinkinga abahlangabezana nazo lapho umhlaba wabo uthathwa. Uthe, “Siyazama ukuvikela amalungelo ethu, kodwa imithetho ibonakala ingasithathi kahle.

Kungenzeka ukuthi umshinwana wepulantela obizwa i'ticker' ingaba nenkinga bese ucofoza izimbewu. Emapulanteleni asebenza ngomoya, kungenzeka ukuthi umoya odonsayo awunamandla okwanele ukubamba imbewu endaweni efanelekile kuze ihlanyelwe. Ngokwejwayelekile amapulantela angalondolozwanga kahle avama ukudala izinkinga ngoba ahlwanyela izimbewu esincane noma ayazifocoza. Ubunjani (ikhwalithi) bezimbewu bungaba phansi - izmbewu ezimbi, ezinezifo ezingafeci kahle. Kungenzeka ukuthi izulu line kakhulu bese izimbewu zimanzi kakhulu, azitholi umoya (i-oksijeni) emhlabathini ukuze zihlume. Kanjalo-ke ukoma kungenza ukuthi izimbewu zingatholi umswakamo okwanele ukuqala ukuhluma. Kungenzeka ukuthi bekusekhona amakhemikhali asale emhlabathini ngonyaka odlule abulala izitshalo. Kungenzeka ukuthi kutshalwe masinya onyakeni ngesikhathi umhlabathi ubebanda kakhulu ukusiza izimbewu ukufeca. Kungenzeka futhi ukuthi izimbewu zihlwanyelwe ngokujula okukhulu zasezahluleka ukumila zivele ngaphezulu (isithombe 3). Izilokazane, izinyoni noma ezinye izilwanyane ezincane zingadla izimbewu ngaphambi kokufeca (kokuhluma). Inkinga evama ukwenzeka njalo yizilokazane ezilimaza izithombo - kakhulukazi umswenya odla isitshalo lapho sivela emhlabathini (isitombe 4). Izinyoni zingadla izithonjana (kodwa lokhu akusiyo inkinga enkulu). Esihlabathini esomile, umoya (ukukhukhuleka) ungembesa izithombo ngesihlabathi lapho zizama ukumila. Ukushisa kakhulu kungenza ukuthi izithombo zome zife. Isithwathwa masinya onyakeni singabulala izithombo. Kungenzeka futhi ensimini lapho kwatshalwa khona ubhekilanga kwase kwafika imvula eqinise umhlabathi.

Abantu abaningi babebona ukuthi uPistorius wayengumuntu ophumelelayo, kodwa lokhu akukhombisi ukuthi wayengavikeleki. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu, njengoba abantu bephikisa ukuthi izimo zomthetho kufanele zihlale ziqinile, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abavumelekile ukwenza izenzo ezinjalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi senzo saphinde savula izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezobudlelwane. U-Pistorius noReeva babephila ebudlelwaneni obunokuphikisana, futhi lokhu kwavusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezimo ezinzima ezithinta ubudlelwane. U-Pistorius waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu abaninzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kokukhathazeka, futhi lokhu kwavusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezokuphepha. Inkohlakalo Kuhulumeni Ekuqaleni kwalesi sikhathi, kwakukhona idolobha elikhulu elibizwa ngokuthi uMzimkhulu. Leli dolobha laliphezulu ngezinto eziningi, kodwa lalinokuhlupheka okukhulu okubhekene nezakhamuzi zakhona. Abantu bahlala impilo enezinkinga ngenxa yokungabi nempilo, izinsiza ezincane, kanye nezinhlelo eziphukile. Lokhu kwenzeka ngenxa yezenzo ezimbi zabaholi ababephatheka kahle, kodwa besebenzisa amandla abo ngendlela engafanele. UThandi, intombazane encane enomoya ophakeme, wayehlala eMzimkhulu. Wayenothando lokuphila futhi efuna ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Nokho, wayebona ukuthi izinto zazingahambi kahle. Umama wakhe, uNandi, wayephindaphinda ukuthi inkohlakalo kuhulumeni iyinkinga enkulu. "UThandi, uma ungakwenzi kahle, ubuhlungu bethu buzokhula," wayekhuluma njalo. UThandi wayeziqhenya ngempilo yakhe, kodwa wayefuna ukuqonda ukuthi kungani abantu abaningi behlupheka. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noMnumzane Dlamini, umphakathi ophatha izinsiza zomphakathi. Wafunda ukuthi uMnumzane Dlamini ubengumuntu onamandla, kodwa wayephinde abe nezinhloso ezingalungile. Wayehlela izinhlelo ezazibonakala ziwusizo, kodwa empeleni, wayefuna kuphela ukuzuza imali. UThandi, onobuhlakani, wabona ukuthi kufanele enze okuthile. Ubugebengu bukhona!" UThandi wabakhumbuza ukuthi ubuhlakani bethu buhle kakhulu kunobubi, futhi uma besebenzisana, bangakwazi ukwenza umehluko.

Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela omuhle ekuphuculeni izimo zokuphila zabantu abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi, njengoba abanye abantu beqale amabhizinisi amancane ukuze basebenzise imali abayitholile. Izinkinga ezitholakele Nokho, kube nezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nokuphathwa kwesibonelelo. Kukhona abanye abantu abathi bahluleka ukufinyelela esiboneleleni ngenxa yezinkinga zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokufaka izicelo ezinzima, noma ukungabi khona kolwazi olucacile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu onelungelo lokuthola lesi sibonelelo uyakwazi ukusifinyelela. Izinyathelo zokuthuthukisa Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olucacile kubantu mayelana nezindlela zokufaka izicelo, izidingo, kanye nezikhathi zokuhlinzeka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kubaphathi bezinhlelo kuzokwenza kube lula ukuphatha lesi sibonelelo. Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant kukhombisa ukuthi lesi sibonelelo sibe nomthelela omuhle ekuphuculeni izimo zokuphila kwabantu abaningi.

Inqubo edidiyele nedinga umcabango nokubuka izinto ngeso elibanzi nelisabalela kweminye imingcele yemboni. Uhlelo oludidiyele lokuqhuba ngempela umsebenzi nefuna ukuchaza okuqondile izindleko, isikhathi, inani, izibophezelo, indawo, iqophelo lomsebenzi nendawo okuyodiliviwa kuyo umsebenzi. Lokhu kwedlulela ohlwini lwamagama emisebenzi eyokwenziwa. Inselelo yeqhinga lokuhlela I-IDP wukuhlanganisa lezidingo ezintathu ngenhloso yokufinyelela ohlelweni lokuthatha izinqumo ngendlela yokubonisana, ukucabanga ngendlela ejulile ngeqhinga nehambisa phambili impumelelo ngempela yomsebenzi lapho usuqaliwe. Ihlanganisa inqubo eqhakambisa isigameko lapho kuhlelwa I-IDP, akuqhakambiswa isikhali noma iqhinga. Ukucabanga uhlelo njengochungechunge lwezigameko kulula kunokucabanga uchungechunge lwezikhali zokuhlela. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, likhuthaza inqubo yokubonisana nokucabangela phambili ngezinto ezikleliswe phambili. Lehlukanisa ngokucacile phakathi kweNqubo evamile ye-IDP (Umhlahlandlela III) esebenza kuzo zonke izinhlobo zomasipala namacebo aqondile okuhlela kanye nezikhali (Umhlahlandlela IV) nengase yehluke kakhulu kumasipala ngamunye. Lihlose ukusebenzisa ulimi olulula ngokugwema amagama amakhulu nanzima asetshenziswa ngabahleli. Izigameko zokuhlela zivame ukuba yimihlangano noma yizifundo zesakhiwo senhlangano esilawula inqubo ye-IDP (Isigungu sabaMmeli boMphakathi, Ikomidi lokweNgamela I-IDP, Ithimba leMisebenzi) kanti kwezinye iziwombe kungaba yimisebenzi eyenziwa ngabathile (njengabaqoqa ulwazi, ucwaningo, njalonjalo).

Intuthuko kufanele igamanxe emkhakheni wenhlaliswano, ezemvelo kanye nomnotho, ivelele nasesikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi lezinto ezilandelayo kumele zicatshangwe ngaphambi kokuba kuqaliswe intuthuko;. Impatho yezemvelo kufanele iditshaniswe. Makube namathuba alinganayo okufinyelela ezinsizeni nasemthonjeni yezemvelo, imihlomulo nasemisebenzini lapho kuhlangatshezwana nezidingo zabantu. Kumele kukhuthazwe umphakathi ukubamba iqhaza ngezinqumo ezithathwayo ngezemvelo. Iqhaza lamathimba azwela kakhulu nakade encishwe amathuba kumele kuqinisekiswe,. Izinqumo kumele zicabangele izifiso, izidingo, isiko lalabo abathintekayo nabanentshisekelo. Makuhlonishwe ilungelo labasebenzi abenqaba ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo zomsebenzi oyingozi empilweni yabantu noma yemvelo. Izinhlelo zemvelo nendalo ezizwelayo noma eziqhakambisiwe kumele zinakekelwe kakhulu ngesikhathi kuhlelwa. Lokhu kudingekile ikakhulu uma kungenzeka zingene ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokusetshenziswa kakhulu noma kube nesidingo sentuthuko esungulwayo. Uhlelo lokuHlaziya Umthelela kwimvelo wumsebenzi wokuthola ukuthi monakalo muni ongenziwa yintuthuko emvelweni. Uhlobo ngalunye lomonakalo lubizwa "umthelela". Izindlela zokunciphisa izinga lomonakalo ziyatholakala. Uma zikhona ezinye izindlela zokuletha intuthuko 'ezinye izindlela', nazo ziyacwaningwa. Ucwaningo luvame ukwenziwa wuchwepheshe ongahlangene nomsebenzi owenziwayo noma ohlongozwayo, kanti ubizwa ngo "meluleki ozimele. Umphakathi uyatshelwa ngomsebenzi bese uvunyelwa ukwethula imibono yawo.

Ukuwa kwekhanda kanye naphakathi komqolo akuvamile ukwenzeka; kuvame ukuvela ngemuva kwemvula enkulu. Lezi zifo azivamile ukwenzeka ngezikhathi zomoya omile. Ukuwa kwekhanda kwehlisa ukuvuthwa kwembewu, inani lembewu, kanye nokuqukethwe kwe-oli. Uma kukhona ama-sclerotia embewini, kwehla isikhwama kanye nokuthengiswa kokukhiqiza. Amakhanda athintekayo avame ukuwa ensimini, futhi imbewu ilahleka emhlabathini. Futhi, uma umshini wokuvuna uthinta ikhanda, imbewu iyahlakazeka futhi ayingeni emshinini. Ukuwa kwekhanda kuyinkinga lapho kukhiqizwa imbewu emisha ezothengwa abalimi ukuze ifakwe ngonyaka olandelayo ngoba azivuthi kahle futhi spread the sclerotia disease, creating new work to clean the seeds before obtaining a certificate stating that the seeds are healthy. Azikho izithako ezikhiqizwa yi-Sclerotinia embewu ye-canola, kodwa uma kukhona ama-sclerotia amaningi, akufanele adliwe ngabantu noma izilwane. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi lolu bhubhane lungangena ezindaweni ezimpilweni futhi kudale ingozi esikhathini esizayo. Ngokuvamile, izimpawu ezivela ngokushesha ziwukubola kwemifanekiso, ukuwa kwezimpande, kanye nesitho somqolo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuwa kwezitshalo kuqala kubonakala ezindaweni ngaphambi kokuba izitshalo ziqhakaze, kodwa izitshalo ezine lolu bhubhane zingabonakala uma ziqala ukukhula. Ekuqaleni, isitshalo ngasinye sibonakala ngokuhlukile, kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ziyaqhagamshelana. Lolu bhubhane luvame ukuvela ezindaweni ezithile zensimu. Ngoba izitshalo zingabola ngokushesha ngemuva kwezinsuku eziningi zokungena kololu bhubhane, izimpawu zingabonakala ngokushesha.

Ku-UN, onke Amazwe AngamaLungu -amakhulu namancane, acebile nampofu, anemiqondo yezepolitiki eyahlukene kanye nezindlela zenhlalo yomphakathi - anezwi futhi ayavota kulolu hlelo. Inhlangano Yezizwe inezingxenye ezibalulekile eziyisithupha. Ezinhlanu zazo - Umbuthano Ojwayelekile, Umkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka, Umkhandlu Wezomnotho Nenhlalakahle Yomphakathi, Umkhandlu Wokubhekela kanye noMnyango Wobubhalane - baseHhovisi Elikhulu le-UN eNew York. Eyesithupha, Inkantolo Yamazwe Omhlaba Yezobulungiswa, ise-The Hague, eNetherlands. Isivumelwano sisho isivumelwano phakathi kohulumeni esivunywe Umbuthano Jikelele weNhlangano Yezizwe. Ngonyaka ka-1948, Inhlangano Yezizwe yamemezela Isimemezelo Somhlaba Samalungelo Abantu (Universal Declaration of Human Rights). Isimemezelo Somhlaba sisho amalungelo ayisisekelo kanye nenkululeko abesifazane namadoda kanye nezingane okufanele bawathole - phakathi kwawo ilungelo lempilo, inkululeko nobuzwe, inkululeko yokucabanga, umuzwangedwa nenkolo, ukusebenza, ukufundiswa, ukubamba iqhaza kuhulumeni. La malungelo ayabophana ngokomthetho ngokweZivumelwano Zamazwe Omhlaba ezimbili, Amazwe amaningi ayingxenye yazo. Isivumelwano esisodwa sibhekene nezomnotho, ezenhlalo yomphakathi kanye namalungelo amasiko kanye namanye amalungelo abantu nawezepolitiki. Sekuhlangene kokubili neSimemezelo, kwenza Umthetho Wamalungelo Abantu Wamazwe Omhlaba (International Bill of Human Rights).

Thola ukudla okunempilo nezidingo zempilo. Izidingo zokuphepha nezokuxhumana. Ukunakekela abasebenzi bezempilo. Ulwazi ngempilo nokunakekelwa ngendlela umntwana angayiqonda kalula uma kufanelekile. Ukuhlonipha ubuntu, ubumfihlo, ukuthembeka, isithunzi, ukuphila ngokomoya, nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ngemvume yomguli, thola ulwazi ngokuqhubekayo mayelana nokwelashwa komguli kusuka kuzihlobo zabo. Ukwelapha lokhu ngokuhlonipha nangokuthobeka ngokucabangela izidingo zomoya nokukholwa emikhubeni. Ukukhombisa ukukhathazeka nokuthola izincazelo ngokuphuthumayo. Ukuqonda ngezehlakalo ezingajwayelekile ezenzeka ngenkathi umguli elashwa, njengokwehla embhedeni nokunye. Ilungelo lokungena ukuze ubone umguli ngezikhathi ezingekho ezokuvakasha uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sikhulu. Ukusekelwa ngokomoya, nolwazi uma isimo siphuthumayo noma sikhulu. Ukusekelwa ngokomoya, nolwazi lokuthi ungathola kanjani usizo ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle kwesibhedlela. Ukuhlinzeka ngolwazi olufanele mayelana nempilo nokwelashwa komguli ngaleso sikhathi uma kudingeka. Ngemuva kokukhishwa komguli esibhedlela, umndeni ubandakanyeka, uqinisekisa ukuthi bathatha imithi, futhi babuyele ngendlela efanele ukuze baqhubeke nohlelo lokwelashwa njengoba kuzobe kuhlelwe. Ukuhlonipha abanye abaguli, izivakashi, nabasebenzi besibhedlela. Ukuqonda ukuthi izidingo zabanye abaguli nemindeni zingase zibe ziphuthumayo kunalezo zabo. Ukuqonda nokuhlonipha izinsiza, imishini, nokuhambisana nemithetho. Ukuqonda isibhedlela ngezinguquko kulwazi lomguli njengokuhamba, inombolo yocingo, nezinye. Ukuhlinzeka ngezimali zokwelashwa komguli njengoba kulindelekile.

Ukuhlinzekela izindlela ezimbili zamasu namaqhinga okuhlela kanjalo nokwenza izinguquko ngokwehluka kwezingqikithi emkhandlwini ngamunye. Indlela ye-IDP igxile emgomweni wokusebenzisana, ukumelwa nokubamba iqhaza ngamalunga omphakathi, izakhamuzi nabathile abanentshisekelo ngaphakathi kumasipala, kanjalo nabamele ezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni, ochwepheshe bemboni nabantu abanezinsiza. a ukubamba iqhaza okuhlelwe yizinhlangano nabaqokwe njengabammeli isibonelo ngabamele amathimba nemiphakathi eyayicindezelwe noma engahlelekile, b ukuveza imigomo namathuba okubamba iqhaza, ngale kokukhuthaza nokuhlela isimo sokubamba iqhaza kohulumeni bomasipala. Ngamanye amazwi, izakhamuzi namalunga omphakathi abavamile ukulindelwa ukufaka isandla ngokubamba imihlangano, ikakhulu endaweni kamasipala onabantu abalinganiselwa ku 100 000. Lenqubo ithathelwa ohlelweni lweqhaza elimiswe yinhlangano nalapho Isigungu samaMmeli boMphakathi kuyisona esimiselwe umsebenzi wokuxhumana nomphakathi ngaphambi kokudingida izindaba eSigungwini sabaMmeli boMphakathi. Ukubonisana nokubamba iqhaza kumele kwenzeke kuzo zonke izigaba, hhayi nje kuphela ngesikhathi sokuhlola nokuqhakambisa izidingo noma izinkinga esiGabeni sokuHlaziya. Esigabeni 5, kuvezelwa imiphakathi nabathintekayo ithuba lokuveza imibono ngohlaka lwe-IDP. Lendlela yeqhaza elimiselwe inhlangano, igalelo elihlelekile nokubonisana ilindelwe ukwenza ngcono amathuba okubamba iqhaza elifanele ngaphandle kokuchitha amandla nezindleko zokubiza imihlangano yomphakathi kuhulumeni kamasipala.

Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72 Ngiyakwemukela, mngani! Namuhla sizokhuluma ngendawo ezibalulekile kakhulu empilweni yethu — izikhungo zezempilo. Kukhona izikhungo ezingama-72 ezahlukene, futhi ngizokutshela ngazo ukuze uqonde kahle ukuthi zisebenza kanjani, zikhona kuphi, futhi ziwusizo kanjani emphakathini. Ukuqala, akukhona nje izikhungo zezempilo ezidumile, kodwa zikhona ezincane ezikahle kakhulu. Lezi zikhungo zihlala zisebenza ngokubambisana nezinhlelo zempilo zomphakathi, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baqonde ukuthi impilo yabo ibaluleke kangakanani. Ngabe uyazi ukuthi izikhungo ezinjalo zihlala zikhona ezindaweni eziningi? Zivame ukutholakala ezindaweni ezikude, lapho abantu bengenakho ukufinyelela kalula ezikhungweni ezinkulu. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu basendaweni ezisemakhaya badinga usizo lwezempilo, futhi lezi zikhungo zikhona ukuze zibasize. Ngokwesibonelo, uma sikhuluma ngezikhungo zezempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi zikhona ezihlinzeka ngempilo yengqondo, ezokwelapha, nezokunakekela. Izikhungo ezihlinzeka ngempilo yengqondo zibalulekile, njengoba zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphume ezinkingeni zabo. Abantu abaningi bahlupheka ngezinkinga zempilo yengqondo, futhi lezi zikhungo zikhona ukuze zibe usizo. Zihlinzeka ngokuqondisa, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Izikhungo zezempilo zihlala ziqhuba izinhlelo zokuvikela, njengokuhlolwa kwezifo ezithathelwana, izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha izifo ezithile.

Umbiko: Ukuhlukaniswa kwelungu elikhulu (GEMS Major Member Classification) Isingeniso Ukuhlukaniswa kwezinga labalungu elikhulu, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-GEMS major member classification, kubalulekile ekuqondeni kahle izimo zomhlaba kazwelonke, ikakhulu emkhakheni wezokuphatha, wezokwakha, nezokuhlalisana. Lesi sihloko sihloselwe ukufaka isibani kulokhu kuhlukaniswa, sihlinzeke ngemininingwane enembile mayelana nezifundo, izizathu, nezindlela ezisetshenziswayo ekwakheni lezi zigaba. Izinhlobo Zezinga Labalungu Elikhulu I-GEMS major member classification ihlukaniswa ngezindlela ezahlukene, ezibandakanya imikhakha ehlukene efana nezintaba, izindawo zasemadolobheni, nezindawo eziyinxenye ezinkulu. Umkhakha wezemvelo, ovelayo, ungomunye wezinto ezibhekwa kakhulu, njengoba uhambisana nemiphumela yokwakhiwa kanye nezinselele ezihambisana nokugcina izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhlukaniswa kukhombisa ukuthi imboni iyakwazi yini ukulawula izinsiza zayo ngendlela efanele. Izizathu Zokuhlukaniswa Izizathu zokuhlukaniswa kwezinga labalungu elikhulu zifaka phakathi ukunikeza umbono oyingqayizivele nosudinga ukuze uba nethezekile. Lokhu kuvumela abaphathiswa nabasebenzi bokuqonda imisebenzi ehlobene nemikhakha yabo ngendlela ecacile. Ukuhlukaniswa kusebenziseka kakhulu emzamweni wokuhlonza izindawo ezihlala inzima, ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi benze izinqumo ezifanele. Izinyathelo Zokuhlukaniswa Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu kuhlukaniswa, izinyathelo ezithile kufanele zilandelwe. Lokhu kudinga ukufaka phakathi ukuqoqa idatha ethile, ukuhlaziya le datha, kanye nokwakha izigaba ezihlukene.
