81 ka-1987. A & B = abazali bomufi; E = umufi; C no-D = abalingani emshadweni wesiko womufi. Ngokwesigaba 1(a) se-Intestate Succession Act No. 81 ka-1987, njengoba kaguqulwa yiNkantolo yeZomthetho esinqumweni se-Bhe nabanye v The Magistrate of Khayelitsha nabanye, abalingani ababili bomufi (C no-D) bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo, ngaphandle kokubandakanya omunye umndeni. Uma umufi ethokoziswa ngababazi abangaphezu kwababili ngaphansi komthetho wesiko futhi engashiyi izizukulwane, khona-ke bonke abashadikazi bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo. Uma umufi engashiyi umngane kodwa eshiya izizukulwane - izizukulwane zifaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla njenge-stirpes futhi ukumeleka kuyavunyelwa. Izingane zomufi, u-D, E, no-F bazofaka isicelo sokuhlala impahla ngokulinganayo. Njengoba u-E efa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, izizukulwane zakhe, u-J no-K bazomela yena futhi bafake isicelo sokuhlala impahla yakhe ngokulinganayo. Zonke izingane zomufi zinegunya lokuhlala. Akukhathalekile ukuthi zikhule emshadweni wezimali, wesiko, noma ukuthi zikhule ngaphandle komshado. Ngokwesigaba 1 se-Intestate Succession Act, abaphumelelayo be-intestate abalahlekelwa amalungelo abo okuhlala empahleni yomufi ngaphandle kwesivumelwano esivela ebudlelwaneni bobulili. Uma umufi eshiya umngane noma abalingani nezizukulwane - umngane noma abalingani bazothola ingxenye enkulu ka-R125,000 ngayinye noma ingxenye yezingane, kanti izizukulwane zizothola impahla esele, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi noma yiziphi izizukulwane zikhona.

Ukuhlonza izingozi nezinkinga ezizidalayo kubalulekile Ngaphandle kokuba wazi izingozi ezikhona emagcekeni akho, nobungako bengcuphe okubekeka kuyo abasebenzi bakho, ngeke wazi noma zidinga ukuthathelwa izinyathelo yini, nokuthi lokho ungakwenza kanjani. Ukuhlola ubungozi kusho ukubheka ngokuqaphelisisa ukuthi yini ebhizinisini lakho engalimaza abantu, ukuze ukwazi ukubheka ukuthi uthathe izinyathelo ezifanele yini noma kumele wenze okunye. Uma sewunqumile ngezinga lobungozi, kumele wenze izinto ezizovikela ukwenzeka kwezingozi. Ziningi izindawo lapho ungathola khona izeluleko kulabo asebenesikhathi bekwenza lokhu uma uhlola ubungozi, ungasebenzisa lezi zindlela eziyisihlanu ezilandelayo ukukusiza. Buka indawo yokusebenzela ubheke nokuthi abantu basebenza kanjani. Futhi hlola imininingwane egciniwe mayelana nezehlakalo ezike zenzeka ngaphambilini, izingozi noma izinkinga zezempilo. Inhloso yalokhu ukuthola izingozi ezingaba nkulu ezingaholela ekulimaleni kwabantu abaningi. Hlonza abantu abangase babe sengozini, ubabale ukuthi bangaki. Uma ucabanga ngokuthi uzokwenza "kanjani" lokhu, ungakhohlwa ungakhohlwa yimisebenzi engaba nobungozi. Bheka ukuthi izinto ezinobungozi zinagadwa kanjani. Izindlela zokugada lobu bungozi zingaba ngezale noma kube khona okunye okudinga ukwenziwa. Abasebenzi bavamise ukuba nemibono ephusile, egxile ezintweni ababhekana nazo emsebenzini yabo yemihla, ngakho kuhle ukuthi ubafake nabo ezinqumweni ozithathayo. Emva kokuba usunqumile ukuthi yikhuphi okumele kwenziwe, kumele uhlele ukuthi uzokwenza kanjani futhi nini lokho. Ukubhala phansi kuyokusiza ukuphumelelisa leli su.

Lokhu kubalulekile phakathi kwe-amino acids kanye ne-proteins. Ngoba kudingeka ekukhuleni kwesitshalo, kuba ingxenye yesakhiwo sesitshalo. Ukushoda kwalokhu kuyabonakala uma amaqhwa amasha emhlophe, ngokuvamile wonke amahlamvu esitshalo avame ukuba nombala ophuzi oluhlaza - akukho mehluko omkhulu phakathi kwamahlamvu amasha namadala. Lokhu kungakwenza ukushoda kwe-sulfur (S) kube kufana kakhulu nokushoda kwe-nitrogen (N). Kodwa ukushoda kwe-nitrogen kubonakala kuqala kumahlamvu amadala. Ukushoda kwe-sulfur kungavela uma umanyolo ongena i-sulfur, njengalowo onophosphorus ophakeme, ufakwa isikhathi eside. Ukushoda kwe-potassium kuyabonakala uma izitshalo zingakhuli kahle futhi amahlamvu anemikhawulo ebonakala sengathi ashisiwe. Ngoba i-potassium ihamba ngaphakathi kwesitshalo, ukushiswa kuqala kubonakala kumahlamvu amadala. Enye indlela yokukhombisa ukushoda lokhu: izimpande ezithambile ziwela ngokushesha, izifo zifaka kalula izitshalo, futhi zikhula zibe namandla ngaphansi kokubanda ebusika. Ukuhlola inani le-potassium emhlabathini akuvamile ukuba kuqinisekiswe, ikakhulukazi emhlabathini ongena, ngoba ivame ukuhamba phansi futhi ifake emhlabathini ophansi. Umbala ophuzi ophuzi. Umbala ophuzi kwezinye izindawo zesitshalo. Ukuncipha kokwakhiwa kwezimbali nezithelo. Ukuthatha isikhathi sokuphuma.

Abafuni ukulinda amatekisi ukuze athwale imikhiqizo evunyiwe. Bakhokhelwa ngokuya ngamahektare abavunile, hhayi ngokuya ngebhande umlimi ozokwamukela. Bahlala bephakathi kwengozi yokuphuka kwemishini yabo - okuchitha isikhathi sabo sokusebenza - abazi ukuthi imishini izophuka nini. Konke lokhu kukhombisa isithombe esinzima, kodwa kumele sazi ukuthi kukhona izinkinga ezizovela, futhi kufanele sibheke phambili ezindleleni zokuzinqoba ngempumelelo. Kumele bazilungiselele ngokungena ezivumelwaneni nabaphakeli kusenesikhathi ngenkathi kusasele isikhathi. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi umphakeli akathathi umsebenzi ongaphezu kwamandla akhe. Kumele baqinisekise ukuthi awekho amahlanga amaningi enkambini yabo angalimaza imishini yokuvuna. Kumele balungiselele amatekisi anele ukuze athwale umkhiqizo ukuze umsebenzi ungabambezeli isikhathi eside. Kumele balungiselele indawo lapho imikhiqizo izogcinwa uma bengakwazi ukufika ezilondolozweni ngesikhathi ngemuva kokushiya inkambu. Kumele bahlangane nabaphathi bezilondolozo ukuvumelana ngesikhathi imikhiqizo kufanele igcinwe uma kudingeka. Kukhona izinto ezimbili ezithokozisa inhliziyo ngesikhathi sokuvuna - umsebenzi wokukhiqiza walo nyaka uphelile, futhi sesicabanga ngonyaka ozayo. Abalimi abakhiqiza imikhiqizo eFree State, konke okuhlobene nokugcina umswakama womhlabathi, kubalulekile uma ufuna ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo ehlobo. Ukubaluleka kokugcina umswakama womhlabathi kuyinto esizokhuluma ngayo njalo. Lo msebenzi kufanele uqale ngokushesha ngemva kokuvuna. Okwesibili ukuvuka kwamanzi emhlabathini nokuphuma komoya - lokhu kwenzeka uma umhlabathi uba hard futhi umanzi.

Lona uyindodakazi kaNkosi Albert Luthuli owaba ngowokuqala ukwamukela umqhele wokugqugquzela ukuthula emhlabeni jikelele. Ukufa kabuhlungu kuka Nkosi Luthuli eminyakeni engamashumi amane adlulile, kukhunjulwe ngawo lomnyaka, kwakukhunjulwa usizi lwalelolanga uma saziswa ukuthi wachifizwa yisitimela emasimini omoba kwaDukuza. Ukufa kwakhe kwakuyomfihlakalo kanti futhi kwahlasimulisa umzimba, kodwa-ke impilo yakhe kwakuyisibonelo esihle esasiholela kulenkululeko esiyithokozelayo namhlanje. Ngiyaziqhayisa kakhulu ngokuthi iNingizimu Afrika ekhululekileyo ibenomqondo ohluzekile wokubonga okwenziwa nguAlbert Luthuli no Oliver Tambo ezweni lethu ngukwetha izimiselo ezimbili zikazwelonke ngawo lamaqhawe - Isimiselo sikaLuthuli nesimiselo sabahlobo baka O. R. Tambo. Ngiyazi futhi nokuziqhayisa kwalabo abamukelwe kuzo lezimiselo eziphakemeyo zikazwelonke. Kungithokozisa kakhulu ukwamukela ezindlini zephalamende labo abadlala indima ngo 1956 uma abomama bekhononela odompasi, nalabo ababekhona uma kuvukelwa umbuso wamabhunu ngo 1976 abahlezi endaweni elungiselwe umongameli. Ngi ngakhohlwa omashanhliziyo zezwe lakithi eziphakemeyo eziphuma kuwo wonke amaphrovinsi ngokukhethwa yizikhulumi zamaphrovinsi ukuthi bahlanganyele nezivakashi ezimqoka eziphakathi kwethu. Uhulumeni wabantu baseNingizimu Afrika engibakhulumelayo lapha namhlanje, njengoba ngabusiswa ukuthi ngenze njalo eminyakeni adlulile wabunjwa ngonyaka ka 2004 emva kokhetho olwenzeka ngalowomnyaka.

Ivumela amamasipala ukuba akhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwendawo; futhi kulandela ukuhlaziywa okujulile mayelana nezindleko nezinhlelo zokubuyisela, zonke izakhiwo noma izimpahla ezingase zingafakwa ngaphansi kwesistimu yokuhlola ngenhloso yokwakha intela yezindlu. Noma iyiphi imali yokubuyiselwa, yokubuyiselwa, noma yokunciphisa okukhulunywe ngesigaba 2 futhi kubhekwa enhlanganweni yenqubomgomo eyamukelwe ngumasipala kufanele ihambisane nezinga likazwelonke elingase lilawulwe ukuze lisetshenziswe. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele lihlole zonke iziphakamiso ezamukelwe nezibhalwe ezithunyelwe kulo ngesikhathi sokucubungula isikhala senqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. Ibhodi lezakhamuzi kufanele ibuyekeze unyaka nonyaka, futhi uma kudingeka, ihlele inqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. Izigaba 3 no-4, zifundwe ndawonye nezichibiyelo ezidingekayo njengoba kuxoxiwe, zisetshenziselwa noma yiziphi izinguquko zenqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. Umphakathi wendawo kufanele wamukele ukuthi imithetho yamasipala ibamba iqhaza ekusebenzeni nasekuphumezeni inqubomgomo yokuhlanganiswa kwentela yezindlu. a ngezizinda ezahlukene zezakhiwo nezindawo; futhi b ngezizinda ezahlukene zabaphathi abaphethekile ukukhokha intela yezindlu. Uma umphakathi unquma ukuklama intela yezindlu, kufanele, ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba 1, akhe intela yezindlu kuzo zonke izakhiwo noma ezindaweni ezibophelelwe intela yezindlu ngaphakathi komphakathi noma endaweni ngaphansi kokuphathwa komphakathi wendawo obophelelwe intela yezindlu.

inkantolo ingakhipha isinqumo kuphela ngaphansi kwale Sahluko maqondana nobuhlobo uma oyedwa okungenani kulobo buhlobo eyisakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika kumbe enesitikiketi sokuhlala isikhathi esize samenza waba uwaseNingizimu Afrika. Inkantolo, emveni kokwehlukana kobathini omunye wabo wafaka isicelo kumbe bobabili bafaka isicelo, ingasikhipha isicelo esinobuqiniso nokufanelekka maqondana nesondlo somunye wophathini abangarejistiwe kube esesikhathi esithize esibekiwe. e isimo sobunye ubudlelwano obungarejistiwe kumbe umshado ngokosiko womunye wabo kumbe bobabili, nanoma yisiphi esinye isimo inkantolo esibona sifanele ukubhekelelwa. Uphathini ongarejistiwe ophilayo emveni kokushona komunye uphathini obengarejistiwe, angasifaka isicelo sesondlo enkantolo esizophuma kwifa likamufa kuze kube uphathini ohilayo uyafa, uyashada futhi kumbe urejista obunye ubuhlobo bomndeni, kube ngangokungakwazi kwakhe ukuzondla. Uphathini osaphila ongarejistiwe akanalo ilungelo lokufuna inkokhelo yesondlo kunoma imuphi umuntu ophethe imali kumbe impahla kamufi ngokwesigaba 3411 noma 3512 somthetho Wolawulo Lwezamafa Administration of Estates Act, kumbe ngokomyalelo kamasta ngokwesigaba 183 noma 251aii salowo mThetho.

Ngenhlanhla, yize lokhu kunje, iphinde yasho ukuthi abantu abaningi abatheleleke ngevayirasi bazoba nezimpawu ezingconywana. Yize njengabasebenzi bezempilo, bomhlaba jikelele nabalapha ekhaya, sikhathazekile ngokufa okuvelile kuze kube manje (okungama-0,8% emhlabeni nama-0,2% abantu abesulelekile eNingizimu Afrika). Ivayirasi isulela abantu abaphakathi kweminyaka eyi-10 ukuya kwengama-29 - iningi labo ngabafundi noma ngabasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. I-WHO yeluleke ngokuthi amazwe afanele agxile ekwehliseni umthelela walokhu kufa emiphakathini. Ukwenza lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Lokhu kufa kusatshalaliswa yithonsi lokusuleleka ngokufa okungukuthi uma umuntu osulelekile ekhohlela noma ethimula bese wena uhogela umoya abawuthimulele noma abawukhohlelele. Ngisho noma ngabe bakhohlelela endaweni eqinile, wena wabe usuhogela umoya olapho ungasuleleka. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni banalezi zimpawu ezingcono futhi abadingi noma ngabe yikuphi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ngabe ngubani onezimpawu ezingconywana noma ezimbi kufanele afune aphinde athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa isiKhungo Sikazwelonke Sezifo Ezithelelanayo esiseGauteng esesivule uphiko eNtshonalanga Kapa. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngesincomo sikadokotela. Iziguli ezidinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lukahulumeni lezempilo akufanele zicele ukuhlolwa kwasendlini yocwaningo lwesayensi. Siyazi ukuthi yilokhu okwenzeka njengamanje emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akukhokona okufunwa yi-WHO.

Zonke amandla omphakathi wokushada ngaphansi kwesigaba 4 kufanele abhalwe emqulwini futhi kufanele ahlanganise usuku lokuqala kwala mandla kanye nemikhawulo enikezwe kuyo efakiwe kulolo mqulu. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphakathi wokushada ophumelelwe, uma ethola isicelo esibhaliwe kumuntu ophumelelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 4, bangathathela emuva igunya lalo muntu lokushada ngokubhalela mayelana nekhono labo lokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Le ngxenye, ngokuhambisana nesigaba, ayiphoqeleli umphakathi wokushada ukuba ahole umcimbi wokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu: Kuqinisekiswa ukuthi bamenyezelile kuNgqongqoshe ngencwadi ukuthi imizwa yabo iyaphikisana nokuhlanganisa amaqembu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Isigaba 1 asisebenzi kubaphakathi bokushada ab placed ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. a ukuthi umuntu ngamunye ohlanganiswayo uveze ubunikazi bakhe obutholwe ngaphansi kwezinhlinzeko zomthetho weMazisi; noma b ukuthi umuntu ngamunye uhlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngesitatimende esifungwayo njengoba kuchaziwe; noma c ukuthi omunye wamaqabane abafuna ukuhlanganiswa uveze ubunikazi obukhuluma ngesigaba a kumphakathi wokushada kanti omunye uhlinzeka umphakathi wokushada ngesitatimende esifungwayo njengoba kuchaziwe ngesigaba b. Umuntu angaba ngumlingani kuphela kubudlelwano obubhalisiwe ngesikhathi esisodwa. Umuntu oshadile akakwazi ukubhalisa ubudlelwano.

Uhlu lwemali okumele ikhokhwe kwiwebhusayithi yeElsenburg noma lungatholakala elabhorethri. Ngizokwenza ukuqala ngokukhuluma ngezindaba ezibalulekile esibhekene nazo nsuku zonke. Senza imizamo ebonakalayo yokuzama ukuthola izixazululo eziningi ezibhekene neProvinsi yethu. Abaphathi bamaphoyisa abane babulawa kule ndawo kanti ababili bafa endleleni beya esibhedlela. Khetha isifunda ukuze ubheke ulwazi olubalulekile ngaleso sifunda. Ukwamukela nokuhlonipha ukuhlukahluka kwabafundi ngokweminyaka, ubulili, isizwe, ulimi, isimo somphakathi, ukukhubazeka, noma isimo sokuba ne-HIV negative. Kodwa kunezindaba eziyinqaba engifuna ukuba ibandla libheke kuzo. Sizosebenzisana ukusiza ukusombulula ezinye zezinkinga esibhekene nazo. I-Integrated Energy Center iyindawo ehlanganisa konke okusetshenziswa futhi okungasetshenziswa emphakathini. Kubalulekile ukubona ukuthi abadala kwesinye isikhathi bacabanga ukuthi izingane zinezinto abazifuna ukusho. Umphakathi wezokutshalwa kwezimali emhlabeni jikelele usicelile thina njengezizukulwane zesiAfrika ukuthi siqinisekise ukuthi izimo zivumela izinqumo zokutshalwa kwezimali ezihlakaniphile zesikhathi eside e-Afrika. Sibheka isixazululo, sendawo, esifundazweni, kanye nokubamba iqhaza esifundeni njengendlela yokubhekana nesimo. Idolobha elikhulu elingu-9 eNingizimu Afrika lakhe amanethiwekhi okuxhumana ukuze wabelane ngemininingwane futhi uthole izixazululo ezintsha zokushintsha ezindaweni. Ezingxoxweni ezandulele, kwacaca ukuthi ukuphathwa kanye nokukwazi ukuphatha kubalulekile ekwenzeni inzuzo emikhiqizweni yobisi.

Isigatshana- 2 asidingi ukusetshenziswa ezinguqukweni ezincane zesaziso. Ungqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe kufanele ammise amazinga okukhiqiza isisi anoma yimuphi umshini okhiqizayo noma isenzo esidalulwe njengesikhiqizi-sisi ngokulandisa kwesigaba -22. b ingxube yalokho okwakha isikhiqizi-sisi esiphawulwe njengento enukubeza umoya. Ngokubhalisa ngaphansi kwesigaba- 46, uNgqongqoshe kufanele anqume indlela okufanele isisi esikhiqizelwa emoyeni sikalwe ngayo noma kuqhutshwe ngayo lolu hlelo lokukala. b angafuna labo bantu abawela esigabeni esichazwe esazisweni ukuba balungise futhi balandele amasu okunqanda ukunukubezeka kwemvelo maqondana nesici noma isikhiqizi-sisi esidalulwe sakleliswe phambili ngokulandisa kwesigaba a. Ngesaziso esibhaliwe nangegunya lesigaba- 20 esibandakanya isici noma umkhiqizo odalulwe njengokleliswe phambili , isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya singafuna lowo muntu othintekayo ukuba alungise futhi aqhube isu lokunqanda ukunukubezeka kwemvelo, akukhathalekile ukuthi lowo muntu uwela esigabeni esichazwe ngaphansi kwesigatshana- 1 b. Amasu okunqanda ukunukubezeka kwemvelo kufanele ahambisane nezidingo ezingase zichazwe nguNgqongqoshe ngomthetho obekwe esigabeni- 46. g noma yiluphi udaba oluphathelene nemvelo. Isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya singasungula uhlelo lokuhlonipha umphakathi ngegalelo elibonakalayo lokunqanda ukunukubeza imvelo endaweni.

Emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kunezinkomba ezibalulekile okufanele sizibandakanye nazo ezingeni eliphakathi njengelizwe. Ibhajethi enkulu yonyaka yokwakha ubuchwepheshe edinga ukuxhaswa ibhalwe phansi ngama-R1.5 billion. Emkhakheni wezobuciko namasiko, kunezidingo eziphuthumayo zokuthi uhulumeni asihole. Isidingo sesithombe esisha sezobuciko, esisekelwe ekuxhumaneni kwezinsiza ezingashintshi. Ukuguqula imicabango ibe izenzo ngokwenza izimboni zamasiko zidalwe amathuba emisebenzi. Mayelana nezilimi, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngenkomba efanele ngokomthetho yokukala izilimi nokuhlukahluka kwazo, ngesikhathi lapho umhlaba ungumuntu owodwa futhi isimo sezimali siba sikhulu. Unyaka odlule wabona izinguquko ezibalulekile ekubukeni kwe-DACST. Iphakathi elisebenzisa okungenani ama-90% wezimali zayo (ama-R1 billion) ezinhlelweni zangaphandle uma kuqhathaniswa nezinhlelo zangaphakathi, nezinsiza zangaphandle ezixhaswe yi-DACST zithola uxhaso kule 90%, okuhlanganisa nezinhlangano ezisebenza ocwaningweni lwesayensi, amabhodi ahlobene nezilimi zesiZulu, iminyango, nemikhakha ehambelana nokuboniswa kobuciko. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlelo ezihlangene emikhakheni enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze kuqale ukuthuthukisa inqubo yokuphatha nokuphatha efanayo. E-Cabinet Lekgotla kaJanuwari 2001, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi esikhathini esizayo, izinsiza zamasiko ezifana nezandla, umculo, nezinkonzo, kanye nezithombe, zizofakwa ezinhlelweni zomnotho ngezindlela ezimbili: ukuthuthukiswa/ukukhula nokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi.

Isingeniso Ukupheka, njengomsebenzi wokudala, kudlala indima ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Abantu abaningi bakubona njengomsebenzi ojwayelekile, kodwa empeleni, ukupheka kunomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zethu, ezempilo, nasemiphakathini. Kukhona abavuma ukuthi ukupheka kuyindlela yokukhulisa ubudlelwano, kuyilapho abanye bephikisa ukuthi kudinga isikhathi esiningi, okungaholela ekutheni kube nzima kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphakeme okuphila. Kulokhu, sizobheka izinzuzo zokupheka ekhaya, izinselelo ezihambisana nakho, kanye nezindlela zokwenza ukupheka kube lula. Izinzuzo Zokupheka Ekhaya Okokuqala, ukupheka ekhaya kunikeza ithuba lokulawula izithako esizisebenzisayo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi uma sikhuluma ngempilo. Izithako ezitholakala ezitolo zihlala zinezakhamzimba eziphansi, futhi zihlala zinezinye izinto ezingeziwe ezingenza kube nzima emzimbeni. Ngokupheka ekhaya, sikwazi ukukhetha izithako eziphilile, ezinjengemifino, izithelo, nemikhiqizo ye-organic. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni ukudla okunempilo, okungasiza ekugcineni isisindo esifanele, kanye nokuvikela izifo ezihlobene nokudla okungafanele. Okwesibili, ukupheka ekhaya kudala ithuba lokuxhumana nomndeni. Lapho sithokozisa umndeni wethu ngezinsuku ezikhethekile, noma ngabe yisiphi isikhathi sokudla, sithuthukisa ubudlelwano bethu. Lokhu kudala imikhuba emihle, lapho izingane zifunda khona ukubaluleka kokupheka, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Ukupheka ndawonye kungaba yindlela yokwakha imikhuba emihle, futhi kudala izinkumbulo ezinhle. Izinselelo Zokupheka Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle.

ngokubhaliwe, zichaza ngokucacile uhlobo nenani/isikhathi sempahla nezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ukulungiselelwa kokucacisiwe okuhlose ekutholisweni impahla noma izinsiza zabanikezeli abathize kanye/noma amagama ohlanga kumele angasetshenziswa. Kuqinisekiswe ngokuphelele yinhloko yomnyango ephathekayo, noma umuntu ogunyaze ubuphathimandla, ukuthi umbandela owanele uye wenziwa kubhajethi yokutholiswa okunje. IMenenja Yezezimali izawuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo olufanele lokuphatha izimfuno luba khona, olunikezela izidingo zokutholiswayo kumasipala. Izidingo ezinje zizawufaka ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izimpahla ziyethulwa bese nezinsiza ziyanikezwa ngesikhathi okudingeka ngaso, endaweni edingeka ngayo, ngentengo okuxoxiswane ngayo, kanye nezinga nenani elifanele. Uma ukutholiswa kunemibandela yebhajethi yesikhathi esizayo, isigaba sama- 33 se-MFMA ngokuphathelene namakontileka sizawulandelwa. Ngokulandela ukutholwa Yibandla kwale nqubomgomo, isigaba sama- 33 asisoze sahambisana namakontileka ayinani elingaphansi kwe-R1miliyoni noma njengoba kubekwe Ngumcwaningi Zimali Kuzwelonke. Izijobelelo ezilandelayo zifaka izigaba-19 nama-33 ze-MFMA. b Ikhotheshini yentengo ebhaliwe enenani elilinganisiwe elingaphakathi kuka-R5,000 kanye ne-R100,000; kanye c Nenqubo yokuncintisana ngokubhida nenani elilinganisiwe eledlula ama-R100,000. Izimpahla nezinsiza azisoze zahlukaniswa ukuba yizingxenye noma zenziwe iqembu njengezinto zenani eliphansi ukuze kugwemwe izidingo zenqubomgomo.

Kulokhu, uzophosa imali uma uphonsa izitshalo. Ukuhlola ngqo inkinga yokukhula kwezihlahla kuzokusiza ngezindleko zakho uma ulawula izihlahla. Kubalulekile ukwazi ukuthi i-pH yomhlabathi ikuphi kuyo yonke imikhakha epulazini lakho. Izinga lokusebenzisa izikhemikhali lihambisana ne-pH yomhlabathi - lapho i-pH ikhula, inani lezikhemikhali lenyuka. Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba i-pH ithola ingxenye ye-ingxenye esebenzayo, futhi isitshalo sezihlahla asitholi i-herbicide eyanele yokubulala. Kuyiphutha ukufaka inani elinganele le-herbicide ngehektare ngoba ufuna ukunciphisa izindleko zamanje ngehektare. I-herbicide engasebenzi kahle izoholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu kokukhiqiza kulo nyaka. Uma i-herbicide enganele ifakwa, ezinye izinhlobo zezihlahla zingaphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lezi zihlahlana zizodinga i-herbicide/ingxenye esebenzayo ezobe x 100 ukuze zibulale. Ngakho-ke, zonke izindlu zokulima (zonke izifunda) zizothola inzuzo uma umyalezo wokufaka i-herbicides ngendlela efanele ulandelwa. Kubiza imali eningi (nangesikhathi) ukuthola ama-herbicides amasha nezikhemikhali uma i-herbicide ethile ingasebenzi kahle. Isibonelo esilandelayo sikhombisa ukuthi inani le-herbicide lishintsha kanjani uma i-pH yomhlabathi ishintsha. Lapha sikhuluma nge-'acetochlor', i-herbicide elawula izitshalo ezifana nezitshalo. 'Acetochlor' ivamise ukusetshenziswa lapho ihlanganiswa ne-'safener'. Uma le nhlanganisela ne-'acetochlor' ifakwa, 'acetochlor' ingase ingabulali izitshalo zomkhiwane - khumbula: umkhiwane uyisitshalo esifana nezitshalo.

Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphepha ezisebenzayo. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izikhungo zomthetho zisebenza nabo, bazoba nokuzethemba okukhulu, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela umphakathi. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle, ubudlelwano obuhle, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile, ezifaka phakathi ukuqeqeshwa, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ephephile, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukudala imiphakathi ephephile, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ephephile futhi enelungelo lokuphila impilo egculisayo. Ukuphepha akuyona nje indaba yomuntu ngamunye, kodwa kuyindaba yomphakathi wonke.

Ukhomishina wokufungisa oqinisekisa i-afidavithi kudingeka ukuthi angachemi, angenzeleli futhi azimele ehhovisi lapho kwenziwe khona i-afidavithi. Esimeni lapho ummeli esebenza njengokhimishina wokufungisa kumlingani wakhe, kwatholakala ukuthi akakwazi ukuzimela ngokuphelele futhi unothando. Inkantolo yayalela ukuthi i-afidavithi iqinisekiswe ukhomishina wokufungisa okwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe kahle. Uma amakhophi emibhalo engafakazisiwe njengamakhophi ayiqiniso ombhalo wokuqala, ukhomishina wokufungisa ofakazise leyo mibhalo, angazithola naye qobo esesenkantolo njengobekwe icala ngokusiza umuntu ukuthi akhwabanise noma njengofakazi onikeza ubufakazi ngemibhalo eyiphutha. Izigxivizo esezilungele ukusetshenziswa ezisetshenziswa umholi wendabuko njengokhomishina wokufungisa, kanjalo noyinki odingekayo, angeke kulethwe uHulumeni. Lokhu kufanele kutholwe umholi wendabuko ngezindleko zakhe. S v Bacela 1988 SA 665. Ukuqokwa njengokhomishina ofungisayo: Isigaba 51 soMthetho Wezobulungiswa Bezokuthula kanye noKhomishina Bokufungisa, 1963 Umthetho No. 16 ka-1963. Isikhundla sokhimishina bokufungisa ngokwesikhundla: Isigaba 6 soMthetho Wezobulungiswa Bezokuthula kanye noKhomishina Bokufungisa, 1963 Umthetho No. 16 ka-1963. Ukuboshwa ngumgcini wokuthula ngaphandle kwencwadi yemvume: Isigaba 40 soMthetho Wenqubo Yobugebengu, 1977 Umthetho No. 51 ka-1977.

Izenzakalo zokuphepha nemisebenzi ye-ofisi... Ukuhlela kwezimali ngaphakathi. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zamasiko. I-ofisi ephethe ukudalwa kwezimpawu. Ukuqonda okuphelele kokuhlanganiswa kwesiko, isayensi, nobuchwepheshe ekuthuthukiseni, inhlalakahle yokuxhasa ubunikazi nasekukhuthazeni amanani ahlukahlukene ezwe lethu. Emculweni, ifa lesiko, kanye namavalue, ngokuhlonipha ukuhlukahlukana, nangezinhlelo zokuxhasa umnotho. Ukuhlukahluka kwezilimi ezweni lethu njengendlela yokuphakamisa wonke umZulu ukuba athathe ingxenye empilweni yokuxhumana, yezepolitiki, kanye nomnotho. Ukuthuthukiswa okulinganiselwe ukuze kugcinwe, kugcinwe, kuvikelwe, futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umlando wethu, izimpawu zethu zomhlaba, ifa, namavalue kuyavunywa. Ukubheka emuva konyaka odlule, kube nempumelelo ebonakalayo ezinhlelweni ezihlelwe ngomhla we-DACST. Kusukela ekubonakaliseni/ukufinyeleleka kwezinsiza zamasiko okuholela ekwakhiweni kwemisebenzi, kuya ekwakhiweni kwezikhungo zocwaningo ezisezingeni lomhlaba. Indlela imiphakathi noma umkhakha wezobuciko ongakhelwa ngayo nokuthi singanikeza kanjani emaphakathini aholelwa uhulumeni ngezinhlelo zokubambisana nezihlanganisiwe, esibiza ngokuthi izinhlelo ze-cluster. Emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, kunezinkomba ezibalulekile okufanele sizibandakanye nazo ezingeni eliphakathi njengelizwe. Ibhajethi enkulu yonyaka yokwakha ubuchwepheshe edinga ukuxhaswa ibhalwe phansi ngama-R1.5 billion. Emkhakheni wezobuciko namasiko, kunezidingo eziphuthumayo zokuthi uhulumeni asihole.

Izinkonzo zokuhlenga zinikezwa abant abakhubazekile ukuze bakwazi ukuzisiza ukufinyelela izinga lokuthi bakwazi ukusebenza ngendlela okungafinyeleleka kuyo. Izinkonzo zokuhlela zeprayimari ngezezinkonzo zokuvimbela ezakha ikhono leklayenti ukuthi ikwazi ukuzenzela. Lokhu kubandakanya i-therapeutic counselling , izinkonzo zokunakekelwa emakhaya, amaqembu ezosekelo kanye nokuthi abantu bakwazi ukuzenzela, ukuqwashisa ngolwazi kanye nezinhlelo zokumela nokugqugquzelela. Uhlengo lwezinga lesekondari, nguhlelo lwezinga lasekuqaleni lokungenelela okwenziwa izinhlelo ezingenisa imali, kanye namaprojekthi ezokuphungula inhlupheko, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsana ezincane kanye nezinkonzo zokuphumula kancane ebunzimeni. Vakashela endaweni eseduzane nawe yonakekelo lwezempilo noma ikliniki ecubungulayo , kanti khona uzothunyelwa endaweni yohlengo esibhedlela noma kwenye indawo yohlengo lwesiphesheli, lwesekondari noma lwezinga le-tertiary. Kungathatha cishe izinyanga ezingu-3 ukubhekana nesicelo sakho. Kwezinye izindawo, abantu bafakelwa kuhla lokulinda izinyanga ezingu-6. Kwezinye izimo, imali yosizo lukahulumeni kwabakhuzekile efinyelela ku-75% ithathwa njengengxenye yezindleko. Ezinye izindleko zibekwa ngamafasilithi ngokwawo. Amanye amafasilithi akala izindleko ngokuya ngalokho umndeni ongakwazi ukukukhokhela. Zonke lezi zindleko zihlukile kuye ngesifundazwe. Amafomu esicelo okumele agcwaliswe abekwa yisikhungo sohlengo , noma isikhungo sezemilo sonakekelo lweprayimari.

Akekho umuntu ongasesha ikhaya, izimpahla noma afunde izincwadi zanoma iyiphi ingane ngaphandle kwesizathu esiqotho. Njengawo wonke omunye umuntu, ingane inelungelo lokuhlonishwa. Ohulumeni bayavuma ukuthi umabonakude, umsakazo, abashicileli bezincwadi kanye nabanye kufanele bakhiqize izinhlelo ezizosiza futhi zifundise izingane emhlabeni wonke jikelele. Ohulumeni kufanele benze konke okusemandleni abangakwenza ukwenza ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi bobabili abazali banomsebenzi olinganayo wokukhulisa nokuthuthukisa izingane. Abantu abanomsebenzi omkhulu kakhulu wokuthuthukisa nokukhulisa izingane abazali bazo kanye nalabo abazibhekile. Uyavuma ukuthi bobabili abazali banomsebenzi wokukhulisa izingane zabo ngokulingana Kwenzeka kangaki lokhu Ingabe kufanele ukuthi umzali oyedwa ashiywe nawo wonke umsebenzi ngesikhathi lona omunye engenzi lutho Ingabe kuliqiniso lokho Ingabe uyavuma ukuthi uma abazali beletha izingane emhlabeni kufanele kube yibona ababhekana nomsebenzi walezo zingane? Ohulumeni kufanele basize abazali nabanakekeli bezingane ukuthi babheke izingane ngokusemandleni kwabo wonke. Ohulumeni kufanele futhi baqinisekise ukuthi kunezikhungo ezinhle, izindawo kanye nezinsizakalo zokunakekela izingane ezidinga usizo olwengeziwe. Ohulumeni kufanele benze konke abangakwenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zabazali abasebenzayo ziyasizakala ezinsizakalweni zokunakekela izingane kanye nezindawo ezinelungelo lazo. Ucabanga ukuthi ohulumeni kufanele benzeni ukusiza izingane? Isivumelwano siphakamisa ukuthi abanye abazali kanye abantu ababheka izingane badinga usizo nokuthi izingane zabazali abasebenzayo kufanele zibe nezinzuzo. Ngokucacile, kunezingane futhi ezidinga ezinye izinhlobo zosizo. Ohulumeni kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi kunabantu abalungile kanye nezindawo zezingane ezingenawo amakhaya kanye nabantu abazinakekelayo.

Izindlela Zokuthuthukisa Ukuphepha Ukuze sithuthukise ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini, kudingeka izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu mayelana nezokuphepha kubalulekile. Lokhu kungahlanganisa izifundo zokuvikela, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo. Uma abantu benolwazi olufanele, bangakwazi ukuzivikela futhi baphendule kahle ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Okwesibili, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala ephephile kubalulekile. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izindawo zokuhlala eziphephile, ukwandisa izinsiza zomphakathi, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuvikela ezibandakanya umphakathi. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi banendawo ephephile yokuhlala, bazoba nokuzethemba okukhulu emiphakathini yabo. Ubudlelwano Bomphakathi Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu emiphakathini busemqoka ekwakheni ukuphepha. Ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenza ndawonye, kudingeka kube nokuxhumana okuhle. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi imihlangano yomphakathi, izinhlelo zokuxhumana, kanye nezinhlelo zokubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo zomphakathi. Uma abantu bejabulela ubudlelwano obuhle, bazoba nesifiso sokuvikela umphakathi wabo. Ukubambisana Nezikhungo Zomthetho Ukubambisana phakathi komphakathi nezikhungo zomthetho kubalulekile ekwakheni ukuphepha. Izikhungo zomthetho, ezifana namaphoyisa, zidinga ukuxhumana nabantu ukuze baqonde izinkinga ezikhona. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuphepha ezisebenzayo. Uma abantu bezwa ukuthi izikhungo zomthetho zisebenza nabo, bazoba nokuzethemba okukhulu, okwenza kube lula ukuvikela umphakathi. Isiphetho Ekugcineni, ukuphepha kwabantu emiphakathini kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impilo enhle, ubudlelwano obuhle, kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho.

Isingeniso Ama-drone, noma ama-quadcopters, ayizindiza ezincane ezilawulwa kude, ezithokozisa abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele. Zisetshenziswa ezindaweni eziningi, kusukela ezithombeni, ezokuphepha, kuze kube ezokuthutha. Kulokhu, sizobheka indlela yokusebenzisa ama-drone, izinyathelo zokuwathenga, nokuthi ungawasebenzisa kanjani ngendlela efanele. Isinyathelo 1: Ukukhetha i-Drone Okokuqala, kufanele uqonde ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zama-drone ezikhona. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene, ezifana neziqondisi ezilula, ama-drone okuthwebula izithombe, kanye nama-drone anemisebenzi ethuthukile. Uma ungumqondisi, ungakhetha i-drone elula, kodwa uma uhlose ukuthwebula izithombe, khetha i-drone enekhamera esezingeni eliphezulu. Qiniseka ukuthi uhlole izibuyekezo nezilinganiso ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uthola umkhiqizo ofanele. Isinyathelo 2: Ukuze Uthole Imvume Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-drone yakho, kubalulekile ukuqonda imithetho nemigomo yokusebenzisa ama-drone endaweni yakho. Ezinye izindawo zidinga imvume yokusebenzisa ama-drone, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zomphakathi noma eziseduze nezikhumulo zezindiza. Qiniseka ukuthi ufunda imithetho yendawo yakho ukuze ugweme izinkinga zomthetho. Isinyathelo 3: Ukulungiselela Ukuhamba Ngaphambi kokuba uqale ukuhamba, qiniseka ukuthi i-drone yakho ilungile. Lokhu kufaka phakathi: 1. Ukuhlola Ibhethri: Qiniseka ukuthi ibhethri igcwele futhi ilungile. Ukuhlola Izimpahla: Bheka ukuthi zonke izingxenye zisebenza kahle, kuhlanganise nezimpahla ezihambayo. Ukubhalisela Uhlelo Lokusebenza: Qiniseka ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-drone lukhona futhi luthuthukisiwe.

Nokuhambisana negunya lawo, uMnyango Wezasekhaya usebenzisa umsebenzi obalulekile Wemisebenzi Yomphakathi kanye Nokuhambela Kwamanye Amazwe. Lesi sigaba sinikezwe umsebenzi wokwenza ngcono izinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokwenza umsebenzi ngokubonisana noMnyango Wezinkonzo Zikahulumeni kanye Nokuphatha. Unikeza uMqondisi Jikelele ngokuhlaziya kobungcweti, ngokuhlola, ngokuhlela kanye nosizo lokuxhumanisa, futhi kubalulekile ekuphatheni ngempumelelo kanye nakahle kwemisebenzi ehlukene yekhethelo yoMnyango. Lo Mnyango Wokuqondisa Omkhulu uncike ehhovisi likaMqondisi Jikelele. Ukwenziwa kangcono kwemisebenzi kuyinto yokuqala ephambili kuzwelonke, futhi kunezinto ezilindelekile kakhulu ngokwezepolitiki kulokhu. Ukuhlanganiswa komzamo we-DHA wokwenza umsebenzi omunye wemisebenzi yalo Mnyango Womqondisi Omkhulu. Ngenxa yokubaluleka kobudlelwane phakathi kohulumeni ekubhekeleni inqubomgomo ebalulekile nehlelwe kahle kanye nangemisebenzi eyenziwayo, amahhovisi Ezifunda okwamanje abika eHhovisi Elikhulu ngokusebenzisa lomnyango Womqondisi Omkhulu. Ibandla Labaqondisi Abakhulu: Abantu okwamanje linezingxenye zabaqondisi abathathu: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwabantu, Ukuphathwa Kwabantu kanye Nobudlelwane Emsebenzini. Ibandla Labaqondisi Eliphezulu libheka abantu emnyangweni, emizameni yezinguquko njengokuqasha labo ababencishwe amathuba ukuphathwa koMthetho wezoBudlelwane Emsebenzini, 1995, Umthetho Wokulingana Emsebenzini, 1998, Umthetho Wokuthuthukisa Amakhono, 1998 kanye nomunye umthetho ophathelene nabantu. Libhekela nomthetho Wemisebenzi Yomphakathi, 1994, kanye neZimiso Zemisebenzi Yomphakathi, 2001. Ukuhlela ngendlela ekahle kwezindaba zabantu, isibonelo ukuhlela kabusha kanye nokwakhiwa kabusha kwenhlangano.

Emphakathini othile, noma emndenini kungaba khona isivumelwano sokuthi ingxabano iyohanjiswa isiwe kumholi womphakathi noma umholi womndeni ngoba lokho kuyisiko osekunesikhathi lilandelwa. Ingxabano enqunywa yisikhulu sezomthetho esikhethwe umbuso. Izinhlangothi ezithintekayo azikwazi ukuzikhethela ukuthi kufanele kube ngubani isikhulu sezomthetho. Inqubo igunyazwa yimithetho, imitheshwana noma isiko lasenkantolo. Kungaba nzima ezinhlangothini ezithintekayo ukuqhubeka ngaphandle kokwethulwa komthetho. Isinqumo kumele njalo sihambisane nesibonelo esilandelwayo. Isinqumo siqinisekiswa yinqubo esemthethweni noma engekho emthethweni. Isinqumo singavama ukuthathwa ngokuthi kufakwe isicelo enkantolo ephakeme. Izinqumo zenkantolo encane zingathathwa ngokuthi zicutshungulwe. Kujwayeleke ukuthi kube nomphumela wokunqoba/ukwehluleka. Lowo olahlwe yicala ukhokha izindleko ezivezwe ukusetshenziswa kwabameli. Azikho izindleko zenkantolo ezikhokhwa ekuqaleni ngaphandle kwezitembu. Qaphela: inkantolo encane yehlukile ngokuthi inqubo inquisitorial futhi izinhlangothi ezithintekayo akuphoqelekile ukuthi zimelwe ngabameli. Izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zikhetha umahluleli (umlamuli). Umahluleli kungaba umuntu onolwazi olunzulu kulowo mkhakha. Izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zinokuzikhethela njengenqubo yakhona. Isidingo sokuthi kwethulwe ngokomthetho siyoya ngokuthi yiyiphi inqubo ekhethiwe. Isinqumo kufanele senziwe kube umyalelo wenkantolo ukuze sisebenze kahle. Asikho isicelo esiyofakwa enkantolo- kungavunyelwana ngokuthi kufakwe isicelo ngabanye abalamuli. Isinqumo singathathwa ngokucutshungulwa yiNkantolo eNkulu.

IShoprite - Izinzuzo Nezinselelo Zayo IShoprite iyindawo yokuthenga ehlonishwayo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ibhekwa njengomunye wezitolo ezinkulu kakhulu kuleli. Kulolu chungechunge, sizobheka izinzuzo nezinselelo ezihambisana nale ndawo yokuthenga, futhi sizohlola ukuthi iziphi izindlela ezithinta impilo yabathengi. Izinzuzo Zokuthenga E-Shoprite Okokuqala, iShoprite inikeza izintengo eziphansi, ezilungele umphakathi ophakathi nendawo. Lokhu kuhloswe ukusiza abathengi bamaNingizimu Afrika, njengoba kudingeka izimakethe ezingabizi. Izintengo ezikhangayo zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba bavakashele iShoprite, okwenza kube nezithombe ezinhle ngezinsizakalo zayo. Okwesibili, iShoprite inikela ngempahla ebanzi, okuvumela abathengi ukuba bathenge izinto ezidingekayo emakhaya. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukudla, iziphuzo, nezimpahla zansuku zonke, okwenza kube lula ukuthola konke abakudingayo endaweni eyodwa, ngaleyo ndlela kunciphise isikhathi sokushiya emsebenzini. Okokugcina, iShoprite ihlinzeka ngocingo olwenziwe ngababambiqhaza bezimakethe ezahlukene. Lokhu kuveza ukuhlanganyela ukuze kutholakale imininingwane ethile, njengeminyango yezezimali nezokuthengisa. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola izipesheli nemikhankaso ethokozisayo, okwandisa ulwazi lwabathengi. Izinselelo Zokuthenga E-Shoprite Nokho, kunezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nabathengi. Okokuqala, izindleko zomsebenzi ezihambisana nezokuthenga ziya zikhuphuka, okwenza kube nzima kubathengi abathile. Kubonakala sengathi abanye abathengi kufanele baqaphele izindleko ezithile ezikhuphukayo, okwenza kube necala.

Imincintiswano Yezemidlalo: Ukuhlola Izici Nezinzuzo Imincintiswano yezemidlalo ibaluleke kakhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi emhlabeni. Lezi zenzakalo zihlala zikhanga izixuku ezinkulu, zikhuthaza umoya wokuncintisana, futhi ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Kubalulekile, nokho, ukuhlola izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nemincintiswano ukuze siqonde kahle umthelela wayo emphakathini. Okokuqala, imincintiswano yezemidlalo ikhulisa umoya wokubambisana. Lapho abantu behlangana ngenhloso yokuwina, bakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwakha umuzwa wokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ozinikele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imincintiswano ivula amathuba okukhuluma ngezinkinga zomphakathi, ezifana nokuhlukumezeka, ubuhlanga, nezinkinga zezemidlalo ezihlobene nezomnotho. Lokhu kwenza imincintiswano ibe yindawo yokuxoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile, okuhlinzeka ngethonya elihle emphakathini. Nokho, imincintiswano ingaholela ekucindezelweni kwabathandi bezemidlalo. Abantu abaningi bazimisele kakhulu ukuze baphumelele, okungaholela ekucindezelweni okukhulu. Abadlali bangazizwa bedinga ukwenza kahle ukuze bagcine izithameli zabo zijabule, okungaholela ekuphathweni kabi. Lokhu kucindezelwa kungaba nemiphumela emibi empilweni yabo, kuhlanganise nokukhathala, ukucindezeleka, noma ukuhlukumezeka. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bemincintiswano baqaphele lezi zingozi futhi banikeze ukwesekwa kwabathandi bezemidlalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imincintiswano ingaba nomthelela omuhle emnothweni. Izinkampani ezinkulu zikhuthazwa ukuba zixhase imincintiswano, lokhu kuholela ekutheni izindawo zithole imali eningi.

Ezinye izinto zibekwe ebhakedeni elibonisa ubufakazi obungakaze buvulwe ukuze kuhlolwe ehhovisi lendawo elithola impahla. Ukuhlanza Kwenzeka Ekupheleni Kwenqubo Yokuphuma: Ukuhlanza okungcolile ekupheleni kwenqubo, ngokwesibonelo, nge-solvents, ama-catalysts, kanye ne-scrubbers, esikhundleni sokuvimbela ukuvela kwalokhu kokungcola. Ngesikhathi ngikhula, ngalways ngifuna ukuba ngu-Olympian, kusho uPhelps. I-Thai Baht ne-US dollar yizinto ezisetshenziswa ezindaweni eziningi. U-Nibsuzimela uyena kuphela kwi-Flowers in the Rain. Kufana nokudlula emirror emangalisayo uye emhlabeni wezindawo eziluhlaza nokuthula. Umphathiswa wezokuphepha nokuphuma komphakathi, uLeonard Ramatlakane, kanye noMkomishana wezepolitiki wesifunda uMzwandile Petros bahlangane namalungu ezikhungo zokuthumela ngaphandle ezisemthethweni eziseCape Town. Isihloko esinobungane obuhle bokukhombisa ukuqala ukuqeqeshwa ngezinsimbi kulabo abafuna ukwakha imisipha yabo, futhi sinikeza iziqondiso ezidingekayo nezizayo mayelana nokuqeqeshwa. Ngithanda ukuveza ukubonga okukhulu ikakhulukazi kulabo bababili abaphathwayo bezokuxhumana, uFesty Nyamate noPalesa Mpuru, ngokuzimisela kwabo nokujabula. Umphathiswa weSAPS Station eSydenham, uMphakathi Omkhulu uGlen Nayager, waphakamisela abathintekayo futhi waqinisekisa umphakathi ukuthi amaphoyisa azokuqhubeka nemikhankaso yokuthola imithi ezoholela ekuboshweni kwabo abangaphezu kwalokhu. Ithimba elikhethwe ukusebenza e-Ivory Park emsebenzini wokuphanga umuzi eliholwa nguCaptain Evert Grobler lenze ucwaningo ngokushesha ngemva kokwenzeka kwalesi sehlakalo.

Igama elithi 'umgwaqo wezitimela' libhekisela ezinsizeni zomgwaqo ezisetshenziselwa umgwaqo onzima noma olula, futhi lapho isimo sikhombisa njalo, ilungelo lokuhamba, [lapho umgwaqo onzima noma olula usebenza, njengoba kukhombisiwe noma kwasungulwa ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho] noma phezulu noma phansi komhlaba futhi kufaka phakathi umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nokuphambuka kwawo okwesikhashana. Ekuthatheni umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela, ukulungiswa okushicilelwe komgwaqo ngokwesigaba noma okucatshangwa ukuthi kukhishwe ngokwesigaba, noma ukulungiswa komgwaqo wesifunda osevele ukhona, uMEC kumele aqinisekise ukuthi amalungiselelo omgwaqo wokuqala enziwa, ngokuhambisana nebhukwana elibhaliwe njengoba kuchaziwe futhi kufake iziphakamiso eziphathelene nomgwaqo, bese uMEC emva kwalokho kumele alandele inqubo echazwe kulolu sigaba. Ngaphambi kokuthi athathe umgwaqo noma umgwaqo ophumelele, uMEC kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lendawo kanye nebika kwenziwa njengoba kubhekwa umphakathi owazi ngemisebenzi esigabeni 22 ye-ECA, noma umphakathi obheka izigaba ezihlobene ze-NEMA uma lezi zigaba zisebenza, angakwazi ukuhlela. kanye nokumemezela izinyathelo zokulawula ezisungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 11. UMEC kumele axhumane nazo zonke izifunda lapho umgwaqo uzobe khona futhi acela, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe, ukuthi zithumele imibono ebhaliwe ngombiko wokuqala womgwaqo nendawo ekhombisa umthelela ozoba khona umgwaqo ophakanyisiwe kunoma iyiphi isikhala noma enye uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi oluhlelekile lwezinhlelo zomphakathi ezithintekayo.

Kuyokwenziwa isilinganiso semiphumela esithathelwa ezinqumeni zesikhashana ngesakhiwo somsebenzi. UKUPHAWULA: Nakuba inqubo ye-IDP igxile kakhulu kulezo zinto ezikleliswe phambili, miningi imisebenzi yeminyango evamile futhi ebalulekile kodwa engakleliswa phambili (isibonelo, ukugcina isimo sezinto, njengomgwaqo). Lezi zinto kufanele zicatshangwe esigabeni 3, zibuyekezwe ngokulandela imibandela yezimali lapho sekukleliswa izidingo, izinhlelo nemisebenzi encikile. INHLOSO: Ukunika isiqiniseko sokuthi imiphumela yokuhlela imisebenzi iyoxilongwa ukuthi iyahambisana nombono, izinhloso, amaqhinga nezinsiza nokuthi isebenza ngokudidiyela. Inqubo yokudidiyela iyoholela ohlakeni olubumbene lokuhlelwa kwezindawo, izimali nesakhiwo enhlanganweni nesiqalo esihle ekuqhubeni umsebenzi ngemfanelo. Ukuqoqela ndawonye iziphakamiso ezenziwe. Izinhlelo zokweNgamela iNhlekelele. INHLOSO: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngaphambi kokwemukelwa wuMkhandlu kaMasipala, bonke abathintekayo namathimba anentshisekelo kuhlangene nezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni zinikiwe ithuba lokubeka imibono ngohlaka lwepulani nokuyokwenza lwemukeleka, lwesekelwe futhi lube sobala. Ukudidiyela ezingeni leziFunda. Ukwemukelwa okugcwele ngumasipala. Umbhalo we-IDP owesekelwa ngumasipala, yizakhamuzi zikamasipala, wumkhandlu wendawo nazo zonke izikhungo ezifanele nezibambe iqhaza ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo nemisebenzi endaweni kamasipala neliphasiswe wuMkhandlu kaMasipala.

Ukuphathwa komphakathi kumele kube nekhono. Ukuveza kufanele kuphakanyiswe. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zabantu okuhle kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukiswa kwemisebenzi kumele kukhuthazwe. Ukuphathwa komphakathi kumele kuqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu unelungelo lokusebenza futhi uphatha abasebenzi ngokwekhono, ukucabanga okuzimele, ubuqotho, nokulungisa ububi obudlule. Ukuphakanyiswa kwemigomo nemigomo yokuphathwa komphakathi njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 95 soMthethosisekelo kuyo yonke imisebenzi yeHulumeni. Ukuhlola, ukubheka, nokuhlola ukuhlela, ukuphatha, nokusebenza kwabasebenzi bezinsizakalo zomphakathi, ikakhulukazi ukulandela izimiso nemigomo echazwe esigabeni 195, kanye nasekusebenzeni kukahulumeni. Ukuhlinzeka ngokuqondisa ezikhungweni zikahulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke nelasezindaweni mayelana nezindaba zabasebenzi. Ukuveza imiphumela nezincazelo okungenani minyaka yonke kwiZigaba Zikazwelonke noma kwiZigaba Zasezindaweni njengoba zenzeka. Ukuveza izindaba eziphuthumayo ezihlobene nomsebenzi kumaphoyisa afanele abhekelele. Ukuhlola izikhalazo zabasebenzi nokwenza iziphakamiso ezifanele zokulungisa. Ukwenza umsebenzi nokuqinisekisa izinga. Lezi zingxenye zihlelwe zibe yizinhlelo ezimbili, okungukuthi: Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Okuxhumene Nabasebenzi; kanye Nokubheka Nokuhlola Umsebenzi Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Ezinye zezincwadi ezikhiqizwe yi-PSC zifaka phakathi, phakathi kokunye, Isimo Sezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, Ucwaningo Lokwaneliseka Kwabantu, Ukulinganisa Ukusebenza Kwe-National Anti-Corruption Hotline, kanye Nokuhlaziywa KweMikhankaso Yokuphatha i-HIV/AIDS ne-TB Ezinsizakalweni Zomphakathi.

Ukuze kubizwe ngokunukubeza, kufanele kushintshe imvelo njengamanje noma esikhathini esizayo ngendlela ephazamisa impilo yakho noma inhlalonhle, noma kulimaze imvelo uqobo. I-NEMA ayikusizi kuzo zonke izimo lapho kwenzeka khona ukunukubezeka. Yilezo zimo ezinkulu kuphela ongathola usizo kuzo. Incazelo yokunukubeza okunqala yencike ebungozini bamakhemikhali noma oketshezini okukhulunywa ngalo, enani lamakhemikhali/loketshezi nomthamo wobungozi obungadaleka manje noma esikhathini esizayo. Kuchaza ukuthini " umsebenzi oyingozi emvelweni" noku "shaya ikhwela"? iNEMA ivikela abasebenzi abenqaba ukwenza leyomisebenzi elimaza imvelo. Umsebenzi uthathwa njengoyingozi emvelweni uma umuntu osebenza ngokwethembeka nokuthe ngokubona kwakhe ngesikhathi enqaba ukwenza lowomsebenzi wabona ingozi enkulu noma umthelela ongaba mubi emvelweni uma engaqhubeka nawo lomsebenzi. Kungenzeka ngaleso sikhathi ungabi namthelela omubi kodwa kube nezinkomba zobungozi esikhathini esizayo. Wethenjiswa umhlomulo ongakusiza uma ungaqhubeka nokusebenza. Kubalulekile ukuba wazi ukuthi kukhona okuthile olindelwe ukukwenza ngaphambi kokuba iNEMA ikuvikele. Lemibandela ichazwa kabanzi endimeni 7. Ukushaya ikhwelo, noma ukuhlaba umkhosi wukunikezela ngolwazi ngento ethile ebucayi noma ewubugebengu eqhubekayo. I-NEMA ikuvikela uma uhlaba umkhosi ngomuntu othile owenza umonakalo emvelweni. Kumele wethembeke futhi kube yinto enomqondo ebantwini bomphakathi ekuholele enkolelweni yokuthi lolulwazi lungobungozi noma lungomonakalo emvelweni. Kumele unike lolulwazi ngendlela efanele. Ngendlela efanele, kuchazwa ukuthi malwedluliswe ngemigudu efanele njengokulandisa kweNEMA. Eminye imininingwane ngalokhu iyochazwa kangcono endimeni 7.

Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwesibonelelo se-COVID-19 Social Relief Grant Ngokwezimo zomnotho emhlabeni, iCOVID-19 ibangele ukuhamba phambili kokungasebenzi, ukwanda kwezindleko zokuphila, kanye nezimo ezinzima kubantu abaningi. Ukuze lezi zinkinga zibhekwane, uhulumeni wakwaZulu-Natali kanye nohulumeni baseNingizimu Afrika, baphakamise isibonelelo seSocial Relief Grant. Lo mbhalo uzobheka indlela lesi sikhwama esisetshenziswa ngayo, imiphumela yaso, kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nezindleko zokuphila. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda umgomo waleli sikhwama. Isibonelelo seSocial Relief Grant siphakanyiswa ukusiza abantu abathintekayo ngqo yiCOVID-19, kanye nezindawo zempilo zomphakathi. Lezi zibonelelo zafaneleka kumaphesheya aphansi, kubantu abahola kancane, kanye nabathintekile kakhulu ezimeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kube nomphumela omuhle, njengoba kuvele kwanda abantu abahola kahle. Naphezu kokuba isibonelelo sikhona, abanye abantu basenobunzima ekukufinyeleleni. Lokhu kubonisa izinkinga ezivela ekutholeni lesi sikhwama. Imingcele Yokufinyeleleka: Ukuze umuntu akwazi ukuthola lesi sikhwama, umphakathi kufanele uhambisane nemigomo ethile, efaka phakathi izidingo zokubhaliswa, ezivame ukuba nzima kubantu abangenazo izinsiza ezifanele. Lokhu kuveza inkinga yokuthi abantu abaningi abakwazi ukufinyelela lesi sikhwama ngenxa yokuntuleka kolwazi noma izinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphathwa kwesibonelelo kudinga ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi amafomu ahlanzekile, ukuhamba kwezimali kuhamba kahle, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi iyaziswa kahle. Ubululelwe bokuphatha buvame ukuba yinkinga, lapho imiphakathi ethile ibonwa ingatholi kahle ezindaweni ezithile.

Ekuzwiseni lokhu, kubonakala kufanelekile ukuthi sibuze lo mbuzo - ingabe kukhona intuthuko esiyenzile ekutshaliseni ukuze sifeze izinhloso esakhuluma ngazo emphakathini ukuthi sizofezani ngezithembiso esizenzile, ukuthi abantu bethu basinikeze amandla okuphatha izwe lethu kusukela ngo-2004 kuze kube sekukhethweni okulandelayo ngo-2009? Ngemvume yenu, ngithanda ukubuyela emuva futhi ngikhumbuze lokho esakukhuluma ngo-2004, njengabaholi benhlangano, phambi kwabokufika bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, sabuthana endaweni yokuhlangana kukahulumeni e-Union Building eTshwane ngosuku lokukhululeka, usuku esikhumbula ngalo inkululeko yethu eminyakeni eyishumi, futhi saphinde sajoyina isizwe ekubekeni umongameli wokuqala wombuso wentando yeningi, owakhethwe yiphalamende lethu, ukuze kuhlonishwe iz interests zesizwe ezikhonjiswe kokhetho luka-2004. Sekuphele isikhathi eside iNingizimu Afrika yethu ibe nekhaya elinokuphila, futhi iphinde yakhombisa kahle futhi ibhujiswe emphakathini. Iphakathi lapho uthola khona ukuthi uma uzalwa omnyama, uthola isiqalekiso sonke isikhathi sokuphila kwakho, uma uzalwa omhlophe, uthwala ukwesaba nokucasuka okufihlekile... Iphakathi lapho udoti, iphunga lobubha, udoti uhamba ezitaladini, ukuguguleka kwemfucumfucu, izixuku ezigcwele usizi, umhlaba omkhulu ogcwele udoti, le ndawo ibheka phansi futhi ifaka ubuhle komunye umhlaba onemigwaqo ehlanganayo, nezimbali ezivuthayo ziphazamisa ubuhlalu bokhula obuhlaza, nezinyoni, nezindlu ezifanele amakhosi namakhosikazi, nomculo opholile nothando.

Ukubambisana nokusizana ezindaweni ezingaphakathi komngcele owodwa kuyasiza kunokusebenza ngokwehlukana. Lesi simo sinomthelela enqubeni ye-IDP. Ngokulandisa koMthetho weSakhiwo sikaMasipala noMthetho weziNhlaka zikaMasipala, zombili izinhlaka zohulumeni bendawo kumele zenabe ngama-IDP njengengxenye ebucayi nesikhali sokwengamela nokwethula izidingo zomphakathi. Ngenhloso yokugwema ukuphindeka komsebenzi, inqubo yombili yokuhlela mayilumbaniswe. Ukuhlaziya nokuqhakambisa izidingo nezinkinga eziphambili. Uhlaziyo malwenziwe ngokulandela inqubo yokubambisana ebandakanya umphakathi nabantu abathintekayo. Ulwazi ngamagebe okwethula umsebenzi nezidingo ezingavela esikhathini esizayo kumele lucatshangwe. Ngakho, lokhu kumele kwenziwe wuMasipala weNdawo nosondelene nezakhamuzi. Omasipala beNdawo nabesiFunda badinga eyabo inqubo yokuhlela nemibhalo yabo yokuhlela uma behlose I-IDP eyofaka negalelo ezinguqukweni zenhlangano noma befuna isimo esiyohlomulisa ngolwazi isabelo sezimali nohlelo lwebhizinisi kumasipala. Uhlelo lwezinga lesifunda esisodwa ngaphakathi kwesifunda alenele ukwenza I-IDP isikhali esinomfutho kuhulumeni wentuthuko yendawo. Kunenqubo yamaqhinga okubhekela ikusasa nawokuthatha izinqumo afanayo kubo bonke omasipala nadinga ukugqugquzelwa okusezingeni eliphezulu nekhono lochwepheshe kanjalo nokubandakanya ongoti bemboni abavela ezingeni lezifundazwe. Ngakho, ukwenaba ngamaqhinga ekusasa kungenziwa kangcono ngokuhlanganyela ngoMasipala beNdawo beneziFunda kanye nabasebenzi bezifundazwe ezingeni lesiFunda.

Lokhu kubandakanya imisebenzi ethile yezohwebo ehambisana ngqo nokuphathwa kahle kwabagibeli, kubandakanya ukukhangisa, ukuthengiswa kokudla neziphuzo, amaphephandaba nezincwadi, imishini yokuthengisa ethengisa izinto ezithengiwe, izingcingo zomphakathi, nemishini yokubhanga (lezo ezamukela amakhadi futhi zikhokhe imali). Nokho, kubhekwa ukuthi ezindaweni eziningi zesiteshi, kungase kube nesidingo semisebenzi yezohwebo ezindaweni eziseduze nesiteshi. Njengoba le misebenzi yezohwebo ingase ithinte izindawo eziseduze neziteshi futhi ingase iphinde ithinte izakhiwo zomphakathi, kudingeka ukuthi amalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba ahlotshaniswe nokusetshenziswa kwawo kwezomnotho kulawulwe ngohlelo olusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo sokwakha esisemadolobheni. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kubhekwane nomnikelo womphakathi walesi sikhala, kanye nesinqumo somasipala, ngaphambi kokuthi la malungelo anikezwe ngokuhambisana nemithetho yokwakha yalesi sikhala. Le misebenzi izokwenziwa esiteshini, futhi kumele yenziwe ngokuhambisana namalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba endaweni kanye nemithetho efanele yokwakha. Mayelana nokukhuluma ngendlela entsha yephakathi kanye nomgwaqo wezitimela, isigaba 4 soMthetho Wokukhuthaza Ubuqotho Bezemisebenzi, 2000 (Umthetho No. 3 ka-2000) ubhekisisa izinqubo ezimbili ezishintshashintshayo lapho umphathi wehhovisi kumele akhiphe isinqumo esingase sithinte amalungelo omphakathi kahle noma kabi, eshilo nje ukuhlohla komphakathi noma inqubo yokuphendula. Isigaba esikhona 6 sikhetha inqubo yokuhlola umphakathi.

Uma kungaphumeleleki ukuba uthole okungenani amakhotheshini amathathu, isizathu saloku kweqiwa kuzkurekhodwa nguMenenja Wezezimali, futhi izizathu ezinje zizawubikwa ku-Ofisa Lezezimali Eliphezulu okungenani njalo nje ngekwata. Izimpahla kanye nezinsiza ezilinganisiwe kuzindleko ezingaphakathi kwama- R5,000 kanye nama-R100,000 angatholiswa ngokumema amakhotheshini entengo abhaliwe avela kubanikezeli abavunyiwe okungenani abathathu. Isicelo samakhotheshini sizawulungiselelwa Yisigaba Sokutholiswa Somnyango Wezinsiza Zezezimali. Kuzindleko zempahla nezinsiza ezilinganiswe kuzindleko ezingaphezu kwama-R30,000 sezaziso zekhotheshini zizakuboniswa kubhodi yezaziso kamasipala enikezelwe izinhloso zokubonisa amakhotheshini namabhidi, nakuwebhusayidi kamasipala futhi kungaziswa nganoma yiyiphi enye indlela ebonwa ingefanele nguMenenja Wezezimali. Izaziso ezinje zizakuboniswa okungenani izinsuku eziyi-7 ukusuka ngosuku ezibekwe ngalo futhi zizakubonisa usuku lokuvala lokungeniswayo, ngaphandle kwalapho imibandela yesiqephu se-10 ifanelekile. Uma kungaphumeleleki ukuthola amakhotheshini amathathu, izizathu zokweqiwa okunje kuzorekhodwa Yimenenja Yezezimali futhi kuzawuvunyelwa NguMenenja Wezezimali futhi kuzakuvunywa Yi-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu ngaphambi kokuvuma ikhotheshini. Ihambisane nanoma yimuphi umbhalo odingwa yi-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu (i-CFO). Uma ngabe nganoma yisiphi isizathu, le nqubo ayilandelwa, izizathu zaloku kwehluka zizawubhalwa nguMenenja Wezezimali bese zivunywa yi-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu.

Kenye nezinyathelo zokuqondisa izigwegwe zizokwenzeka ngezindlela ezahlukene. Ukujeziswa ngokwenqubo yasemsebenzini akuyiphazamisi indlela yasenkantolo. Lemigomo nemigudu ziyinkomba nje zingashintshwa kubhekwa izimo ezifanele. qubo efanayo kuyo yonke imikhandlu ephathelene nokusebenzela umphakathi, noma equkethwe umthethosisekelo noma imigomo. Imithetho , imigomo kanye nezilinganiso zamazinga. Ukuziphatha komsebenzi okungadinga ukuba umsebenzi athathelwe izinyathelo zokuqondisa izigwegwe, zilotshwe ku-Annecture A. Loluhla aluphelele. Abaphathi bangamqondisa isigwegwe umsebenzi ngokuziphatha kwakhe, inqobo nje uma ebazi, noma kufanele ukuba ubazi ukuthi lokho kuziphatha kunesisekelo sokuba angathathelwa lezizinyathelo. a. izinsolo zokungaziphathi kahle zinegalelo elingakanani emsebenzini kahulumeni, ophikweni labasebenzi, kanye nasemphakathini. Imigudu yokuqondisa izigwegwe. Isaluleko sokulungisa okonakeleyo. Ezikhathini lapho ukubaluleka kokungaziphathi ngendela kudinga ukwakulekwa, komsebenzi, Umphathi womsebenzi kumele enze lokhu. a. azise unsebenzi ngokungaziphathi kahle kwakhe. b. Acacisele umsebenzi ngecala athweswa lona, bese emnikeza nethuba lokuba azikhulumele ngecala abekwa lona. d. Athathe izinyathelo zonkwenza okuvunyelwene ngakho. Isexwayiso somlomo. Umangabe owonile edinga isexhwayiso, isexwayiso singenziwa ngokukhuluma, Uphathi kumele amshele umsebenzi ukuthi uma ephinda engaziphathi kahle angase athole isijeziso, futhi isexwayiso siyoshicilelwa phansi. Isexwayiso esibhaliwe.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, ithenisi iyinsiza yokwakha umphakathi. Imicimbi ye-ithenisi ivame ukuheha abantu abaningi, kubandakanya abathandi bomdlalo, osaziwayo, nezinkanyezi. Lokhu kudala amathuba okuxhumana, okuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Umdlalo ungumthombo wokuthokozisa, ukujabulisa, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, okukhuthaza umoya wokubambisana. Ekugcineni, ithenisi akugcini nje ngokuba umdlalo, kodwa kuyinsiza yokwakha ubudlelwano, ukuthuthukisa impilo, nokukhuthaza umphakathi. Umphakathi we-ithenisi uqhubeka nokukhula, uthokozisa abantu ngezizathu eziningi. Ngakho, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze abanye ukuba badlale ithenisi, ukuze sibe nomphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, futhi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Ithenisi, ngempela, iyinsiza ebalulekile empilweni yethu, futhi kufanele sithokozise ngokujabula.

Ukushoda kwemithi ezibhedlela zikahulumeni Kwakungokwesibili ekuseni, uNandi wayevuka ekuseni, ehlangabezana nezinkinga ezinzima. Umama wakhe, uGogo, wayengaphilile kahle, enezimpawu ezinzima zokugula. U-Nandi wayezama ukuthola usizo ezibhedlela zikahulumeni, kodwa wayazi ukuthi lezi zinsuku, izibhedlela zazihlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yokushoda kwemithi. U-Nandi wahamba waya esibhedlela esiseduzane, enethemba lokuthi kuzotholakala imithi edingekayo. Lapho efika, wathola umphakathi omkhulu abantu abahlala bezilindele. Abanye babebonakala bephoxekile, abanye bephuza amanzi, bekhuluma ngezinkinga ezibhekene nezibhedlela. U-Nandi wathola umgibeli, umphakathi ubonakala ungenamandla, uthwele izinkinga ezinzima. "Ngiyaxolisa, kodwa imithi ayitholakali," kusho udokotela omncane, ebuka uNandi ngamehlo anokukhathazeka. "Sizama konke okusemandleni ethu, kodwa imithombo yethu iphelile." U-Nandi waphendula, "Kodwa kungani? Kungani umphakathi wethu ungatholi imithi edingekayo? U-Gogo udinga imithi yokwelapha." "Ngiyazi, kodwa izinkinga ezinkulu zikhona. Ukushoda kwemali, izinkinga zokuhlinzeka, konke lokhu kudala ubunzima," kuchaza udokotela. U-Nandi waphuma esibhedlela, enezinyembezi emehlweni akhe. Wayazi ukuthi uGogo wayengakwazi ukulinda. Wazi ukuthi kufanele athole indlela yokusiza, noma ngabe kunzima kangakanani. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, u-Nandi wanquma ukuhamba edolobheni elikhulu eliseduzane, lapho kuthiwa khona imithi iyatholakala. Waqala uhambo lwakhe, emoyizela izinyathelo zakhe. Wafika edolobheni, kodwa wathola ukuthi imithi ibiza kakhulu.

Uhulumeni weSifundazwe uzoqinisekisa ukuthi uyahambisana nesinqumo sawo ngayo yonke indlela. Ingqumbi kamanyolo ihlinzeka ngendawo lapho lolu hlelo lwemvelo lungenzeka khona ngokushesha. Uma kungenzeka okungamaqiniso kuphikwe, iKomidi lizophoqeleka ukuthi libambe umhlangano wokulalela ukuze kuhlonzwe amaqiniso. " Kodwa sidinga ukwenza ngcono amasu kahulumeni, ndawonye nezikhungo ezinesibophezelo sokuphepha emigwaqweni, ekufundiseni abashayeli ngemiphumela yokushayela bedle amanzi amponjwana." Indiza yasuka ngemuva kwehora noma isikhathi esingaphezu kwalokho eTaipei, ngenxa yezizathu ezingazange zichazwe ngokugcwele ngendlela enelisayo noma ezingazange ziqondwe. Ikhomishani izoba namandla ukushicilela umbiko wesikhashana. Impela, izindawo eziningi kwisifunda ziqanjwe ngamalungu omndeni wasebukhosini wase-Norway asasishiya emhlabeni. Isabiwomali esivela kubantu futhi sabantu esisekelwe kwisitatimende esisodwa esiyisisekelo sezepolitiki sesikuphokophele okungokwentando yeningi futhi nokushisekela izwe ngokweqiniso. Idolobha laseKapa lithanda ukuthatha leli thuba ukufisela ababambe iqhaza kumqhudelwano wezikebhe zikaseyili umqhudelwano ophephile nomnandi. Ukulungiselelwa ukusebenza kwezinsiza zokucisha umlilo kwizibhedlela zesifunda kanye nasemitholampilo, eBoland Overberg. Lokho esijwayele ukukwenza kanye nalokho okwenziwe uNksz. Yasmin Sooka, ukuthi uma kuqedwa ukulalelwa kwaleli cala, ukunikezela ngefayela kwicandelo lezophenyo bese bengena kulolu daba.

Umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi imiphumela yokuhlolwa izoshintsha indlela amabhuku aphathwa ngayo kumasipala. Ukuhlolwa kuzoholela ezifundweni ezithile ezizothathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wokuhlolwa kwamabhuku komasipala uzoba isibonelo esihle sokuthi ukuphathwa kwezimali kungathuthukiswa kanjani. Ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwezinqubomgomo ezinzima, ezizokwenza ukuthi umphakathi uthole izinsiza ezingcono. Ekupheleni komcimbi, uNkk. Mkhize wakhumbuza bonke abathintekayo ukuthi imiphumela yokuhlolwa iyinsika yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Uthe: “Siyavuma ukuthi kunezinkinga, kodwa sizimisele ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze sithuthukise ukuphathwa kwemali kumasipala. Sifuna ukwakha isiko lokubambisana, ukuze sithole izixazululo ezizokwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.” Umcimbi ugcine uhlelwe kahle, futhi abavakashi bahlonipha imizamo yokuphatha izimali kumasipala. Imiphumela yokuhlolwa izoba yisisekelo sokwakha ikusasa eliqinile, lapho umphakathi uzokwazi ukuthemba ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzoholela ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwane phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni, futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bakwazi ukuthola izinsiza abazidingayo.

Ukungabi nomfutho kwabasebenzi abadingekayo eziqiwini zezolimo uma kuqhathaniswa nomkhiqizo wezolimo kuthathwa njengenhlanhla kubalimi abathintekayo mayelana nokulawulwa kokugcwala kwabasebenzi abanamandla. Njengezokuvakasha, ezolimo zinikezela ngamathuba angempela entuthuko. Nakuba indawo yasebaQulusini ithathwa njengengalimeki, wonke amathuba okulima kumele asetshenziswe. Njengoba le ndawo ingenye enabantu abaningi abafake izicelo zokubuyiselwa komhlaba ezweni, kubalulekile ukuba abafake izicelo balekelelwe ukuba bazalanise imali ngokusebenzisa lezi zindawo; ngale kwalokho ukuphuma kwabahwebi baphambilini kuzokwenyusa amathuba okufadabala komnotho wendawo. Selokhu kuqaliswe ukusebenza uhlelo lokubuyekezwa komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika, amapulazi abaziwa ngokuba nomkhiqizo omningi asemane akhathala nawo, futhi namathuba amaningi abanikazi bomhlaba abasha ayashabalala. Kusemqoka impela ukuthi abanikazi bemihlaba ebuyekeziwe banikezwe izisombululo ezizobalekelela zisuka amagqozo nje. Izinhlelo ezinthsa ezisemqoka seziqalisiwe KwaZulu-Natali ukubhekana nalezi nkinga ezinkulu ezintathu eziphazamisa ukubuyekezwa komhlaba, okuyilezi, ukuntuleka kwamakhono phakathi kwamaqembu amakhulu abantu abafake izicelo okuba bazalanise imali eningi ngokwabo; ukushiya kwabalimi abamhlophe nabanekhono ezindaweni ezithintekayo; kanye nokungakwazi kwabanikazi bendawo abasha ukuthenga nokugcina imishini nezinsiza ezidingekayo ngendlela ukuze kwenziwe inzuzo ngezolimo.

a Aye wathatha isinqumo, ngesisekelo esicatshangiwe, ukuthi impahla enjena ayidingeki ukunikezela ileveli eliwubuncane lezinsiza eziyisisekelo zikamasipala; kanye b Nokuthi uye wanaka inani elifanele lezimakethe lempahla enjena kanye nenani lezomnotho nelo mphakathi elizotholakala uma kushintshiselwana ngempahla. Isinqumo ngebandla likamasipala sokuthi impahla yemali eqongelweleyo ethile ayidingeki ukunikeza ileveli eliwubuncane lezinsiza zikamasipala eziyisisekelo engakwazi ukuguqulwa ngumasipala emva kokuthi impahla enje iye yathengiswa, yadluliselwa komunye noma yalahlwa ngandlela thize. Ibandla likamasipala linganikeza i-ofisa enegunya kamasipala amandla alo okuthola athintekayo esigatshaneni sesi-2 a kanye no-b ngokuphathelene nempahla eqongelelweyo eshukumayo ngaphansi kwenani elitholwe yibandla. Noma yikuphi ukudluliswa kobunikazi kwempahla eqongelelweyo ngokwesigatshana se-2 noma se-4 kuzakuba ngokufanele, okulinganisiwe, okusobala, okunokuncintisana nokungaguquki ngokuhambisana nenqubo yokuphatha ukunikezelwa kwemisebenzi kumasipala, okuzogcinwa ngumasipala ngokwesigaba se- 111. b iphrojekthi, kufakwa nezindleko sezizonke iye yavunyelwa yiBandla c isigaba- 33 siye salandelwa, kwaze kwafinyelelwa ekutheni isigaba singafaneleka ephrojekthini; futhi d imithombo yokunikezwa imali iye yatholwa, itholakala ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi ayisetshenziselwanga ezinye izinhloso.

Ngaphambi kokunikeza ibhidi, umasipala angachitha ibhidi ngenxa yokuguquka kwezimo, noma izimali zokuxhasa ezingenele zokuqhubeka, noma uma kungekho ibhidi evunyiwe etholakele. Emva kokuthi umnyango ofanele usuyiolungisile incwadi edingekayo, umgcinisihlalo wekomiti lokunquma lebhidi uzakwazisa ababhidi abaphumelele ngokubabhalela abazise ngomphumela webhidi yabo ngokushehsa emva kokuba Ikomiti Lokunquma Lebhidi livumele ibhidi. Asikho isidingo sokulinga ukuvunywa kwamaminithi omhlangano Wekomiti Lokunquma Lokubhida. Wonke amabhidi avunyiwe azenziwa uhlu kuwebhusayidi kamasipala nakumabhodi ezaziso (athintekayo kuzigaba zama-3.2 kanye no-3.3 ngenhla) evikini elilandela ukuvunywa, isikhathi esiyzinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Isimo esisheshayo sithathwa njengaleso esingalindelekile kanye nesiyisehlakalo esenzeka ngokungazelele esiphathelene nokokwenza okulimazayo noma okungaba namandla okulimaza, okuyimiphumela yomasipala futhi kudinga okwenziwayo okusheshayo. Uma i-ofisa enegunya ibona ukuthi kunzima ukumema amabhidi anokuncintisana, njengangesikhathi sokutholiswa esisheshayo, noma lapho kukhona umnikezeli oyedwa kuphela, angakwazi, ngokuxhumana ne-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu, ukutholisa impahla nezinsiza ngezinye izindlela, njengokuthola ikhotheshini yentengo noma ngokuxoxisana, noma ngokwehlisa isikhathi esidingekayo sokukhangisa ukusuka osukwini lwe-14 kuze kube yisikhathi esibekiwe. Izizathu zokwehluka kumabhidi okuncintisana ezimemo zizakurekhodwa zivunywe Yi-Ofisa Elinegunya.

Kubhalwe kahle ukukhokha izindleko zakho zikagesi. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ungaphuthelwa. Njalo, amakhasimende akhokha ingxenye yebhili elizokhokhwa ngoba acabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzovimbela ugesi wabo ekuphunyukeni. Uma ingxenye oyiphuthumayo ingakhokhwa ngenyanga ezayo, uzokhula kakhulu futhi ungase ungakwazi ukuhamba phambili. Qaphela ukuthi ukukhokha njalo kuphela izingxenye zenani okufanele ukhokhe kungaholela ekuphunyukeni kukagesi wakho. Uma ubona ukuthi uphuthumile kakhulu emathubeni akho, xhumana nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi ukuze uxoxe ngendlela yokulungisa lesi simo. Kuzokwenziwa izintshisakalo ngenani olikhokhayo uma ikhasimende lingakhokhi ngokuphelele noma likhokha ngamanani amancane noma likhokha ngemuva kosuku lokugcina. Le simo sokungakhokhi kahle kuholela ekwandeni kwenani lokukhokha njalo ngenyanga. Uma usayine isivumelwano sokukhokha nomhlinzeki wakho kagesi, gcina leso sivumelwano. Uma uphumelela, ugesi wakho uzophunyukiswa. Kodwa uma isimo sakho siba sibi kakhulu ngemuva kokusayina isivumelwano, kufanele uqinisekise umhlinzeki wakho kagesi ngokushesha. Ungase udinge ukuhlinzeka ngobufakazi besimo sakho esishintshile. Uma unemitha kagesi yokukhokha ngaphambi, qaphela ngenani likagesi olisebenzisayo. Kuwo wonke amabhili, kufanele kube nenani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga kanye nenani lokuvala ekupheleni kwenyanga. Lokhu kukunika ithuba lokwazi inani eliphelele olisebenzisile kule nyanga. Kufanele uhlole ukuthi inani elivuliwe ekuqaleni kwenyanga lihambisana nenani lokuvala elivela enyangeni edlule. Uma lezi zilinganiso zingahambisani, funa ukucaciselwa kumhlinzeki wakho kagesi. Ngezinye izikhathi, labo abafunda imitha kagesi benza amaphutha.

b ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 69 esigabeni 2 noma kuphi lapho amagama "isigaba 611" futhi ukufaka amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "61 kuya ku-11". a umbiko wendawo obhekiswe esigabeni 4b noma isigaba 63a, uma kusebenza; futhi f ngokufaka esigabeni 8 amagama "isigaba 61 kuya ku-9" ngamazwi "isigaba 611." Isigaba 10 soMthetho oyinhloko sishintshwa lapha ngokufaka amagama "isigaba 6" kunoma yisiphi isigaba lapho kubonakala khona ngamazwi "isigaba 6". f ukuhlanganiswa kohlelo lwezitimela, umgwaqo wezitimela nezinye izinsizakalo ezihlobene kuhlanganiswe nezinsizakalo zezikhumulo zezindiza, kanye nendawo ezungezile yomphakathi nezinye izinsiza zokuhamba. UMEC unamandla, ngaphandle kokulimaza eminye imithetho, ukuhamba noma ukuhlinzeka ngokuqhuba, lokho akwenza egameni lezinye izinhlangothi noma eziningi zalabo abathintekayo esivumelwaneni esishiwo esigabeni 1, noma noma ilungelo lokuhamba emhlabeni womunye noma elinye ilungelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi libhalisiwe noma alibhaliswanga, kodwa ezandleni zikaMEC noma zePhondo, ngenjongo noma mayelana nanoma yisiphi isivumelwano njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni 1 nangokuhambisana nesikhathi salo sivumelwano.

Umgcini-hhovisi kufanele khona manjalo irejista ayithumele kumgcini-hhovisi wakwahulumeni onikwe umsebenzi wokurejista abantu kwisifunda abekwe kuso. Kubalulekile kakhulu ukufaka inani elifanele lembewu ngehektare ukuze uthole umkhiqizo ofanele. Inani elifanele lezitshalo lihlukile ezindaweni ezahlukene futhi lingahluka endaweni eyodwa ngoba kungase kube nezinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlaba. Isizathu sokubaluleka kwenani lezitshalo sithi: isitshalo esisodwa sidinga inani elithile lezinto ezidingekayo namanzi ukuze sikwazi ukukhula ngokuphelele - uma inani lezitshalo liphansi kakhulu, umkhiqizo uzoba phansi, futhi uma kukhona izitshalo eziningi kakhulu, zizokhuphukana ngamanzi nezinto ezidingekayo, futhi umkhiqizo uzophinde ube phansi. Umkhiqizi kumele azi kahle ukuthi ubude bokuhlukanisa phakathi kwemigqa kufanele kube kanjani nokuthi izitshalo kufanele zibe seduze kangakanani komunye nomunye emigqeni - lokhu kubalulekile ekukhiqizeni izithelo zokudla. Izitshalo zidinga izinto ezidingekayo ukuze zikwazi ukukhula nokukhiqiza izithelo zokudla. Inani lezinto ezidingekayo lihambisana nomkhiqizo olindelekile (inani elijwayelekile umkhiqizi angalithola endaweni ethile kanye nezithelo ezithile). Umphumela wamasampula omhlaba uzokhombisa isimo sezinto ezikhona emhlabeni ngesikhathi esithile. Mayelana nalokhu, inani lezinto ezidingekayo lingakalwa. Umquba ubalulekile kakhulu uma sifuna ukukhiqiza umkhiqizo omuhle, kodwa ubiza kakhulu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukubala nokuthola inani eliqondile lomquba esizowufaka emhlabeni. Lokhu kuyindawo enye lapho ukukala kubalulekile kakhulu. Zonke lezi zinto zokwakha ziza nelebuli ekhombisa inani elifanele lokufaka. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu.

Izinkumbulo ezinhle zathuthukiswa, abantu baziwa ngezigameko ezinjalo. Kwakukhona imizamo yokugcina ubudlelwano, ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kwabaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinzima, kodwa ezidingekayo. Imibono emisha yahlala ikhula, futhi abantu baqonda ukuthi iPhalamende yindawo yokubambisana, yokwakha, nokuphila. Izinsuku zishintsha, izikhathi zishintsha, kodwa iPhalamende lasendaweni yalo luhlale lukhanya njengenkanyezi. Abantu bazi ukuthi akukhona nje ukuveza izikhalazo, kodwa futhi ukujolisa ezixazululweni. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwePhalamende njengendawo yokubambisana, yokuxhumana, nezinhlelo ezinhle. Amalungelo abantu aqhubeka nokukhula, izwi labo liyavuma, kwazulu ukuba nemikhankaso yokuphila. Ekugcineni, iPhalamende yaseNingizimu Afrika yaba isibonelo esihle sokuthi abantu bangabambisana kanjani, baphumelele ngezifiso zabo. IPhalamende akusiyo nje indawo yokuxoxa kodwa iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umuntu ngamunye ungaba neqhaza. Isikhathi siqhubeka, kodwa izifiso zabantu zihlala zikhanya. Le ndaba ihlale ibhalwe emlandweni, iqhubeka, ihamba phambili, futhi ibonisa ukuthi ukwazi kwakhiwa, ukuxhumana, nokuhlanganyela kuyasiza ekwakheni ikusasa elingcono. IPhalamende iseNingizimu Afrika, le ndawo eqhakazile, iyinsika yokwakheka komphakathi, futhi imbono yokuhlanganyela ibalulekile. Izindaba zaphakanyiswa ezinkulu, umoya wokuphila uqhubeka, futhi iPhalamende iyasikhumbuza ukuthi amandla ethu akhula lapho sixhumana, sabelana, futhi sikhuthazelana. Lokhu kuhlangana kwenza iPhalamende ibaluleke kakhulu emiphakathini yethu, futhi izifiso zethu zihlale ziphila, zikhanya njengezinkanyezi ezisemkhathini.

Lokhu kungenza kube lula ukwakha izakhiwo ezingcono ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo olwenziwa ezindaweni zokwakha lungaholela ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokuhlanganisa izinsiza eziningi, okungaholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokwakha. Futhi, ezocwaningo idinga ukuba ibe nobumbano. Ukwenza ucwaningo olunembile, abacwaningi badinga ukusebenzisana nabanye emikhakheni ehlukene. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuthola izixazululo ezihlangene ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Umphakathi uqobo kufanele ubambe iqhaza, ukuze uthole umbono ohlangene. Njengoba sithuthukisa imikhakha yethu, kudinga ukuba sikhumbule ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwabacwaningi, iziphathimandla, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ekutholeni imiphumela eyanelisayo. Ekugcineni, izocwaningo zibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqinile. Kuzo zonke izinkinga nezinkumbulo esibhekene nazo, ubuchwepheshe bokucwaninga buzohola ekutholeni izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Uma sikhuluma ngempumelelo yezocwaningo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imiphumela ayikhombisi kuphela ubuchwepheshe bethu, kodwa futhi ibonisa ukuthi singabantu abaphumelelayo uma sisebenzisana. Ngakho, asikho isidingo sokubona izocwaningo njengomsebenzi ophathekayo kuphela, kodwa njengendlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onolwazi, nosizo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha izizukulwane ezizayo ezizokwazi ukumelana nezinselelo zomhlaba wethu.

Umphakathi wokushada angaphumelela emcimbini futhi abhalise ubudlelwano ngaphandle kokuthi kuqala anikezwe imibhalo ethile ekhulumayo ngesigaba 3. Ubudlelwano babantu bungabhaliswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa uma, ngaphandle kokuthi babe ngabesilisa nabesifazane, kungekho ezinye izithiyo zomthetho ezivimbela ukujola. Noma ubani ofuna ukuveza ukuphikiswa kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa njengabangane kufanele akhiphe lokho ebhalwe phansi kumphakathi wokushada ozohola umcimbi walobo budlelwano. Kumele kube ukuthi uma umphakathi wokushada ethola lokho ukuphikiswa, kufanele afune izizathu zalo ukuphikiswa ngokuphikisana nenhlangano kuze kube athola ukwaneliseka ukuthi awekho amaphikiso omthetho kulabo abafuna ukuhlanganiswa, bese angaphumelela ukuhlela umcimbi wobudlelwano. Uma futhi enganeliseki, kufanele aphikise ukuhlanganiswa kobudlelwano futhi abhale phansi izizathu zalo.

Ikhono lokwenza okulungile - ukwenza lokhu ngendlela efanele. Ukukhiqiza okuphumelelayo akuhambisani nomkhiqizo otholakalayo ekugcineni, kodwa kukhombisa ikhono lomlimi lokulinganisa okokufaka (izindleko) nokuthi yini etholwa (futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okokufaka kukhiqiza inzuzo ekugcineni). Lokhu kufanele kukalwa ngokukhula kokutholwayo (ukukhiqiza); kodwa kufanele kubhekelele zonke ezinye izici ezinganciphisa ukukhiqiza: indlela yokusebenza kahle, ukuphatha abasebenzi kahle, ukuthola ulwazi ngembewu, izimo zezulu, futhi ekugcineni: inhlanhla! Uma ubona ukuthi okokufaka (izindleko) ezifana ne-diesel, umanyolo, nemishini zikhuphukile kakhulu, kufanele usebenze ngokuhlakanipha ukuze ufinyelele inzuzo. Ukwanda kokukhiqiza okuphumelelayo kukhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buphambili futhi ukusebenza ngokuhlakanipha kuqhubeka - lokhu kuholela ezinzuzweni ezinhle kodwa hhayi okokufaka okweqile. Lokhu kusho futhi ukuthi kufanele usebenze ngokuhlakanipha, hhayi nje ukusebenza ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ukulinganisa konke lokhu kuyinselelo ngoba kufanele ubheke zonke okokufaka nezokukhipha (umkhiqizo) bese ulinganisa ukuze ubone ukuthi isimo sakho simele kuphi kulokhu. Kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi mangaki umsebenzi owenziwe ukukhiqiza ngonyaka odlule ngaphambi kokucabanga ukuthi yisiphi isisebenzi esifanele ukuba senzeke ngonyaka ozayo.

Kumele sihloniphe le midlalwa, ukuze sibe nesithakazelo esiqinile sokubambisana. Ekupheleni komcimbi, imiphakathi ikhethe umqeqeshi ohloniphekayo, uthokozisa izindlela ezizondekayo zokwenziwa nezenzo ezenza abalandeli bahlale benelisekile. Umonakalo wokudlalwa kweqembu uyashona, umoya ophakathi komphakathi ubonisa ukuzihlanganisa ngempela. Umcimbi we-rugby uhloswe kahle ukuba umphakathi uthokozise, uhambisane nemiphakathi ehlukahlukene, futhi ube nesithakazelo sokuthi ibhola lombhoxo luhlale lungumoya ohlelekile nokuqhubeka. Ngakho, uma uhamba phakathi komcimbi wesimanje sebhola lombhoxo, okukhombisa lesi sikhumbuzo sokubambisana, umoya obonakalayo ubangela ubuhlobo obukhulu phakathi kwabantu. Abadlali, abalandeli, nabaphathi behlangana ngezinkumbulo ezithokozisayo, izinjabulo ezivela ezinkundleni, nezingqophamlando ezinquma isikhathi sabo sokuhlala behlezi, bese lokhu kube umphakathi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wobuchwepheshe. Ngalesi sikhathi, ibhola lombhoxo lihlala luhlaza amakhono, lukhumbuza abanye bonke ukuthi umphakathi omuhle uhlanganisa abantu abahlanganyela izinjongo ezifanayo, okwenza izikhathi zibe zezinhloso eziphakeme. Emva kokuphumelela, kumnandi ukuvuma ukufinyelela empumelelweni, umphakathi uqhubeka phambili. Umbono wempumelelo ubonisa kahle umoya wendawo eyaziwayo, futhi ugcwalisa umoya wezilimi ezihlekisayo ezivumelanayo. Iqhaza lokuqopha le midlali liveza ubuncane bokuhlonishwa, okwenza izinkumbulo ezihlala njalo.
