Njengoba le ndlela ivame ukuhlinzeka ngethuba lokugcina amanzi uma ijikeleza kahle. Njengoba zonke izindlela zokujikeleza, lapha futhi izinga lokumuncwa komhlaba kufanele lihlolwe njalo futhi kufanele ujikeleze kuphela uma amanzi edingeka. Ngale ndlela uzokwazi ukugcina amanzi namandla ngesikhathi izitshalo zikhula. I-header ejikayo ibiza imali eningi futhi ibekwe ngaphandle emasimini, ngakho-ke abalimisi abaningi bayakhohlwa ukuthi kunezinto ezidinga ukuhlolwa njalo nokugcinwa. Uma uhlinzeka ngomshini wakho, cabanga ngezinto ezibalulekile ezilandelayo. Khipha uwoyela kuzo zonke izigubhu ezisebenzayo ezinsikeni nasemashalofini e-header bese ufaka uwoyela omusha. Sebenzisa uwoyela ophakanyiswe umkhiqizi womshini. Ngemuva kwalokhu, ungashintsha uwoyela njalo eminyakeni emithathu uma umshini usebenza kahle. Uma umshini usebenza ngaphezu kwamahora angu-1,000 ngonyaka, ungashintsha uwoyela njalo ngonyaka noma eminyakeni emibili. Hlola ibhodi eliqoqayo le-sand bese ulisula uma kukhona isihlabathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi umshini ume ngokuqinile emhlabeni. Khipha amanzi wonke ku-header nasemaphaketheni axhunywe ku-header. Kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi uma umshini uphuka ngesikhathi udingeka ukuze ujikeleze, kungadala ingozi enkulu.

Kanjani okufanele kwenzeke? Ukuba nekhono lokuhlela izicwangciso kudinga ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zibhalwe phansi futhi ziphathwe ngokuqinile. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kuyo yonke impilo yakho. Ungabhalela izicwangciso zakho encwadini, ebhodini, noma kukhompyutha, noma kuphi. Ngokwandisa ukubhalwa, lokhu kuzokusiza ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoba uzoba nedatha yomlando yokukusiza uma ubheka phambili. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlela isu kwenzeka minyaka yonke - kuzokwenzeka ini ngonyaka ozayo epulazini. Kodwa kufanele kube nesu lesikhathi eside elibheka ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini epulazini esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuyisu elibanzi elikhombisa ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini esikhathini esizayo - leli thuba lingaba yiminyaka emihlanu noma ngaphezulu. Isibonelo: ukutshala izitshalo ezikhiqizayo kumahhektare angama-500, ukukhiqiza inyama emapulazini, nokukhulisa izinkukhu. Lokhu kuzokhombisa imisebenzi ejwayelekile okufanele yenziwe ngonyaka ozayo, njengokupenda indlu ethile, ukwakha ucingo oluthile, ukulungisa izakhiwo, ukuthenga imishini emisha, ukuya ezinsukwini zokuqeqesha abalimi, njll. Kuzokhiqizwa ini ngonyaka ozayo, malini kuzokhiqizwa, futhi kuzothengiswa kanjani? Tshalani amahektare angama-400 ommbila ukuze asetshenziswe epulazini, okusele kuzothengiswa ngenkontileka endaweni eseduze ekhiqiza ukudla kwezilwane. Tshalani amahektare angama-100 amabhontshisi ukuze athengiswe ngenkontileka. Khiqiza izinkomo ezingu-200 ezineminyaka engama-20 ezivela emapulazini ezizothengwa yiYYY Supermarket. Khiqiza izinkukhu ezingu-40,000 zenyama ngenyanga ezizothengwa yiXXX Chicken Wholesaler. Penda iworkshop ne-tractor shed.

I-NAFVSA ihlose ukufinyelela emiphakathini yasemakhaya engazi ukuthi le archive ingakwenza kanjani njengoba nayo inamalungelo okuthola ulwazi. I-NAFVSA ihlose ukusebenzisa Izikhungo Zobuciko Bomphakathi, ezisungulwe nguMnyango Wezobuciko namasiko, ukuze ifinyelele le njongo. Izikhala zomphakathi, izikole, nezindawo zomphakathi nazo zizosebenza. Siphakamisa umphakathi nanoma ubani ofisa ukwazi ngomlando kanye nomlando waleli zwe ukuthi axhumane nathi uma efisa ukucela ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zalesi sikhungo sokugcina, i-NAFVSA. I-NAFVSA inengxenye egxile ekuqinisekiseni umlando orekhodwe osevele ugcwalise izikhala endabeni yethu yomlando. Kuxoxiswane nabantu abanolwazi ngezihloko ezihlukene ezihlobene namasiko, ubuciko, umlando, kanye nokwakhiwa kwesizwe. Ukuqoqwa, ukugcina, nokusabalalisa umculo wendabuko kuyakhuthazwa ngohlelo lwethu olubizwa ngokuthi i-Traditional Musical Instrument Exhibition. Ukuqoqwa kwezinto ezirekhodiwe ze-audio nezibukwayo (zomphakathi nezingezona zomphakathi) nezinye izenzo ezihlobene ezikhiqizwe noma ezihlobene neNingizimu Afrika. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika zifinyelela kulezi zirekhodi futhi zikhuthazwe ukuthi zisetshenziswe nguwo wonke umuntu. Ukuze kukhuthazwe ukubambisana phakathi kwezikhungo ezigcina lezi zirekhodi. I-NAFVSA inegumbi lokucwaninga lapho abacwaningi bengathola usizo lwezinhlobo zonke uma befuna ulwazi, futhi bangakwazi futhi ukufinyelela ulwazi olugcinwe kumakhompyutha mahhala. Ukubuka nokulalela izinto ezishicilelwe kumele kuhlelwe kusenesikhathi.

Ungumuntu omangalisayo. Sibe nenhlanhla ngokuthi kuqokwe yena. Uletha umusa kulo msebenzi ngendlela asebenza ngayo ebonisana nab0 bonke abathintekayo, uchaze kanjalo uSekela Ngqongqoshe De Lange. Sifuna ukubonga ngomthelela omkhulu owenzile kumndeni wezoBulungiswa, kuqhubeka usekela Ngqongqoshe, washayelwa ihlombe ngabalaleli abaqukethe iziphathimandla zobu- lungiswa, iziphathimandla zohwebo namalunga oMnyango woBulungiswa ababekhona. IPhini IikaNgqongqoshe libabaze lan- coma amajaji nomantshi abebekhona kulo mcimbi wegalofu. "Kumajaji ala, ngifuna ukuthi siyabuncoma ubukhona benu. Siyazi kunzima ukuphuma ez- inkantolo, ukuthola umuntu ozokumela isikhala sakho, nokuhlela ngokusha. Bubalulekile ubukhona benu la ngoba bunika abantu abezile ithuba lokuhlan- gana baxoxe ngokukhululekile namajaji. Lokhu kusemqoka ekubumbeni um- phakathi ozwanayo." UMnu Williams uchaze ukuthi nokuba bengathanda ukuthi zonke iziphathi- mandla zomnyango ezithanda ukudlala kodwa izikhala zinomkhawulo bebe bebheka nokuthi baqale bameme izipha- thimandla eziphezulu zophiko Iwezobu- lungiswa. UMphathi oyinhloko kwihhovi- si IikaSekela ngqongqoshe naye ubonge kakhulu iziphathimandla zobulungiswa ezenze konke okusemandleni ukuthi leli langa libe yimpumelelo. Mthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 waphoqa ukuba kubekwe umthetho wokuba kug- wenywe noma kungavunyelwa ukucwasana okunga- lungile kungakapheli ngisho iminyaka emithathu uqalile ukusebenza. Ngenxa yalokho, iphalamende laphasisa uMthetho Wokulingana Nokugwenywa Kokucwasana Okungalungile onguNo. 4 wango-2000 (UMthetho Wokulingana).

Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zidingo zingase zibonakale njengokuphazamiseka, kodwa ziwusizo ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha abasebenzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobulungiswa, lapho bonke abantu behlonishwa futhi bejabuliswa. Uma izinqubo zikhona, izinkampani zikwazi ukuvikela izithombe zabo, ziqinise ubudlelwano phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi bonke abantu bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwemigomo efanele. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, kufanele sikhulume ngokuqonda ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo zingase zibe nzima kwabanye abantu, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Kunezimo lapho abantu bangase babe nezithiyo ezithile, njengokungabi nezinsiza ezanele zokuhlinzeka ngale mibhalo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi izinkampani zibe nesineke futhi ziqonde izimo zabo, ziqinisekise ukuthi zikhona izindlela zokuxhasa abasebenzi abasha ukuze bakwazi ukufaka le mibhalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngendaba yokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Uma izinkampani ziqonda izidingo nezinkinga ezibhekene nabantu abasha, zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngoxhaso olufanele. Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobungane, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi bayahlonishwa futhi bahlonishwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuhlola izidingo zemibhalo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zifaneleka ezimweni ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani nezabasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zihlala zikhona, kodwa futhi zihlala zikhanga kubantu abasha.

Umongameli angabiza umhlangano weSikhungo oyisipesheli noma yingasiphi isikhathi okufanele ubanjelwe endaweni nangesikhathi esiyomiswa ngumongameli. Wonke amalunga kufanele aziswe ngokubhaliwe ngemihlangano yeSikhungo ngaphandle kwemihlangano yekomiti. Inani labakhona emhlanganweni abangaqhubeka nomhlangano bathathe izinqumo kuyakuba yingxenye yokune quarter yamalunga eSikhungo. Noma isiphi isinqumo seSikhungo siyothathwa ngokwesekelwa iningi lamalunga eSikhungo akhona emhlanganweni weSikhungo, uma kwenzeka kuba namavoti alinganayo mayelana nodaba oluthile, umuntu okunguyena ophethe umhlangano uyakuba nevoti elingumnqamula juqu ngaphezu kwevoti lakhe njengelunga leSikhungo. Ilunga leSikhungo lingeze lavota noma lizimbandakanye nokuqhutshwa komhlangano weSikhungo noma libe khona endaweni lapho kubanjwe khona umhlangano uma ngabe linokuthinteka ondabeni oluphambi kweSikhungo okungalenza lingakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi walo njengelunga leSikhungo ngobuqotho, nokungenzeleli nangendlela eyiyo. b umgomo wokuziphatha wamalunga eSikhungo; kanye c noma iluphi undaba oludingekile noma olufanele ukunqunywa ukuze kufezwe futhi kuphathwe lo Mthetho. UMkhandlu kasosiyeshini obizwa ngeSikhungo soCwaningo kwezeSayensi eNingizimu Afrika ngaphambi kokuqala ukusebenza kwalo Mthetho uyakuba nguMkhandlu wokuqala weSikhungo isikhathi esingeke sibe ngaphezulu kweminyakeni emithathu kusukela ngosuku lokuqala ukusebenza kwalo Mthetho. Bonke abantu abebengamalunga eSikhungo soCwaningo kwezeSayensi eNingizimu Afrika ngaphambi kokuqaliswa kwalo Mthetho okukhulunywa ngawo kulesi sigatshana sesi-6, kuthathwa ngokuthi baqokwe ngokuyikho iSikhungo ngokwesigaba sesi-5.

Kufanele ubhalise ku-VAT uma imali yakho yokuthengisa izimpahla noma izinsizakalo idlula u-R300,000 ngonyaka noma kulindeleke ukuthi idlule le mali. Umuntu angazibhalisela ngokwakhe uma imali yakhe yenyanga yezi-12 idlula u-R20,000 noma kulindeleke ukuthi idlule u-R20,000. Izicelo zokubhaliswa okungokwenkolo noma okuzithandela kufanele zenziwe usebenzisa ifomu le-VAT 101, elitholakala ku-inthanethi esigabeni seziqu, noma litholwe ehhovisi lendawo lempahla. Ifomu kumele lithunyelwe ehhovisi le-SARS lendawo phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-21 kusukela ngosuku okufanele ubhalise ngalo. Uma kuyibhizinisi langaphandle, imininingwane yomuntu okhethwe ukuba temsilise le bhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika iyadingeka. Isitatimende sebhange esisha, i-cheque ethulwe, noma incwadi evela ebhange eqinisekisa imininingwane yakho yokubhanga eNingizimu Afrika. Uma i-akhawunti yebhange ingekho egameni lesithengisi, ifomu le-VAT 119i kufanele liqedwe. Ikhadi lokusebenza lebhizinisi, uma likhombisa lelo bhizinisi, isibonelo, ikhadi lokuthengisa utshwala noma lokudlala. Uzokwazi uma isicelo sakho singavunywa. Linda okungenani ezinsukwini eziyi-10 ukuze ihhovisi lendawo processing isicelo sakho. Isitifiketi sizothunyelwa kule ndawo oyinikezile esicelweni sokubhaliswa futhi sizotholakala phakathi kwezinsuku ezimbili uma isicelo sakho sivunywa. Abasebenzi be-SARS abavunyelwe ukukwazisa ngokuqondile ngenombolo yakho ye-VAT. Le nsizakalo ayikhokhiswa futhi ayikhokhiswa.

Ithuluzi lokudoba liyithuluzi elinikezelwe ukudoba, noma elinokwakhiwa kokudoba, noma lokuvuna izinhlanzi noma ukusiza emisebenzini ehlobene nokudoba. Lokhu kufaka phakathi noma iyiphi ithuluzi elisiza elinye noma ngaphezulu kwamathuluzi olwandle abamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokudoba evumelekile - lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuhlela izinhlanzi, ukuhamba kwazo, ukuzigcina, nokuzibeka eqandisini. Inhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika ephethe ukuphepha kolwandle, i-SAMSA, kanye nomnyango ophathelene nezindaba zomphakathi nezokuvakasha, kumele ikhiphe imvume yokuthi ithuluzi likwazi ukudoba. Akukho thuluzi elizobhaliswa ngaphandle kwesikhungo sokudoba kanye nemvume yokwenza imisebenzi ehlobene nokudoba. Hlela ukuthi ithuluzi lihlolwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lilungele ukuhamba olwandle, emva kwalokho i-SAMSA izokhipha isitifiketi sokuphepha. Lesi sitifiketi sizohambisana nemibhalo yakho yokubhaliswa. Gcwalisa ifomu lakho ngesandla usebenzisa izinhlamvu ezinkulu futhi unikeze izizathu lapho kudingeka. Thumela isicelo sakho kanye nezikhungo zakho zokudoba noma isivumelwano sakho nomnikazi wethuluzi sokusebenzisa ithuluzi labo uma ungenazo izikhungo zokudoba. Isicelo sakho singathatha ezinsukwini ezintathu noma ngaphezulu kuye ngokuthi imibhalo igcwele.

Umphathi Wohlelo, uhulumeni wethu ubaluleka kakhulu kumakhosi, hhayi ngoba bangabaphethe bezamasiko nezindlela zendabuko, kodwa futhi ngoba bamele ingxenye ebalulekile yokwakhiwa kwethu kokhetho olusemthethweni olususelwa kumthethosisekelo. Kuye kwaba njalo kubalulekile kuhulumeni wethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko ziqiniswa. Uhulumeni weKwaZulu-Natal ukholelwa ukuthi kudingeka ukuvikelwa, ukuthuthukiswa, nokuthuthukiswa kokuba khona kwabaphathi bendabuko kanye nezikhulumi ezikhethwe ukuze kuthuthukiswe impilo yabantu bethu. Iqiniso ukuthi njengelizwe kanye nephondo, sithwele izinguquko ezinkulu kwezomnotho nasemphakathini. Siphila eNingizimu Afrika lapho idemokhrasi nentuthuko seziqhubeka phambili. Noma ungumholi bendabuko, umphakathi, noma ilungu lePhalamende, unendima ebalulekile futhi edingekayo ekufezeni umgomo wethu wokuphula bezokuphepha, ukungabi namsebenzi, nendlala. Ukugcotshwa kwamaOndabezitha uMapholoba namuhla kwenzeka ngesikhathi lapho uhulumeni egxile kakhulu ekubuyiseleni ithemba kubantu bethu ezikhungweni zezakhamuzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusungulwa kweziteshi zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo zezakhamuzi nezakhiwo zobuholi bendabuko. Akukho shwa ukuthi ukusungulwa ngempumelelo kweziteshi zokubambisana phakathi kwezinga lempilo yomphakathi kuzoholela ekuhlinzekweni kwezidingo ezibalulekile futhi kuzosheshisa ukuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi yokuphila kwabantu basemakhaya. Lokhu kusikhuthaza ukuba sibe sobala kwiSigaba 211 no-212 soMtheth

"Usuku lwezinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe zeqembu elithintekayo esigabeni 1(c) kuya (g) kumele lixhunywe kumgomo wezokuhamba wesifunda futhi kumele uvunywe ngamaMEC." Okuqukethwe kwemigomo nezinhlelo ezithintekayo esigabeni (c) kuya (g) kumele, njengoba kudingwa yile mthetho, kodwa uNgqongqoshe angase, ngokuxhumana noMEC ofanele noma amaMEC, ahambise izidingo zalezi zinhlelo, ngendlela ethile, mayelana nezindawo zasemaphandleni ezindaweni ezithile. Iziphathimandla zokuhlela ezisungulwe nguMEC ukuze zenze lokhu kumele zihlomule ngezinhlelo zokuhamba ezifanele kubhodi futhi zenze iziphakamiso kulowo bhodi mayelana nokuhlela kabusha izimvume zokusebenza, njengoba kudingwa nguSigaba 9.; nokususa isigaba 6. (a) UNgqongqoshe kumele, minyaka yonke ngosuku oluzokhethwa nguNgqongqoshe ngemva kokuxhumana noMEC, azise umphakathi kuGazethi yoHulumeni, ukuze ahlele kabusha umgomo wezokuhamba komphakathi wesizwe isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu ehambisana nesikhathi semali seminyaka emihlanu soMnyango, ngokuhambisana nesigaba (b). UNgqongqoshe kumele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethuthukisiwe kumgomo wezokuhamba komphakathi wesizwe njalo eminyakeni emibili. I-MEC ngayinye kumele [minyaka yonke] ihlele kabusha umgomo wezokuhamba komphakathi wesifunda isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu ngokuhambisana nezidingo ezibekwe nguNgqongqoshe ngemva kokuxhumana nazo zonke amaMEC futhi kumele kushicilelwe njengesaziso kuGazethi yoHulumeni ngosuku olusethwe nguNgqongqoshe.

Mthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 waphoqa ukuba kubekwe umthetho wokuba kug- wenywe noma kungavunyelwa ukucwasana okunga- lungile kungakapheli ngisho iminyaka emithathu uqalile ukusebenza. Ngenxa yalokho, iphalamende laphasisa uMthetho Wokulingana Nokugwenywa Kokucwasana Okungalungile onguNo. 4 wango-2000 (UMthetho Wokulingana). Ngakho-ke, uMthetho Wokulingana unikeza isigaba 9 soMthethosisekelo amandla. lsigaba 9 sihlinzekela ukulingana kwabo bonke abantu nokug- wenywa kokucwasana okungalungile. UMthetho Wokulingana wenza kube lula uhlelo loku- guqukela ohlobeni lomphakathi okhululekile, obum- bene yize wehlukahlukene, obonakala ngobudlelwano babantu abanakekelanayo nabacabangelanayo, baphinde baphile ngokuholwa yimigomo yokulingana, ukwenza izinto ngokulunga, ukungachemi, impumelelo yabantu, ubulungiswa, isithunzi kanye nenkululeko. Lokhu kwenza ukuba kusebenzeke ngempumelelo kuHulumeni kanye nakubantu bon ke (kubandakanywa nezikhungo) ukugqugquzela Ukulingana. lzinjongo ezinkulu zalo Mthetho yilezi: Ukungavumeli kanye nokugwema ukucwasana okungalungile; Ukungavumeli kanye nokugwema inkulumo enen- zondo; Ukugwema ukuhlukumezana; Ukugqugquzela ukulingana; kanye Nokuhlinzeka izisulu zokucwaswa okungalungile, zen kulumo enenzondo nezokuhlukumezeka intuba yokuphunyula. Ukucwaswa okungalungile ngukuphathwa ngendlela eyahlukile uma uziqhathanisa neminye imikhakha yabantu, bese isithunzi sakho njengomuntu silulazeke ngenxa yokuphathwa kanjalo.

Ingabe usho ukuthini lo mbono? Umbono ubeka abantu, izimpilo zabo, amandla, kanye namathuba entuthuko yabo njengesisekelo sokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ezofaka isandla ekunciphiseni ubumpofu. Kukhomba i-DWAF njengenhlangano eholayo engxenyeni yenkampani ekwenzeni indawo evumayo yomnotho kanye nokuthuthuka komphakathi ngamahlathi anakelekekayo. Lokhu kubhekela bobabili labo abaqashwe ngqo emisebenzini yezamahlathi (eHhovisi elikhulu kanye nasezingeni leNhlangano) kanye nabanye abasebenzi enhlanganweni yonke ye-DWAF labo amaqhaza abo kanye nemisebenzi enomthelela ezintweni zendawo evumayo. Ibhekela lapho inqubomgomo kanye nomthetho okufanele kukhuthaza khona imiphumela emihle kwabampofu, kufinyeleleka futhi zenziwe zafaneleka kanjani izinhlelo ezihamba ngezigaba ezithile eziphathelene nalokhu, futhi isakhiwo semakethe kanye nendlela kuvuleleke kangakanani ezidingweni zabangenayo abasha kanye nabakhiqizi abancane. Kuhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene ukubhekelwa kwamahlathi (kanye nezinhlelo ezihlangene nakho ezisezansi) kungaba nomthelela ezinhlelweni ezahlukene zentuthuko yomnotho neyomphakathi njengengxenye yohlelo lokulwa nobumpofu. Lokhu kubona izinto eziphathelene nokungena kwemali kanye nezinye izinto zobuphofu bomphakathi kanye namandla amahlathi okwenza ngcono izimpilo. Kugxiliswe ukunaka ekuhlanganiseni indlela "yamahlathi abantu" ekuhleleni, ekuxhaseni ngezimali kanye nasezinhlelweni zokuqala ukusebenza kwabantu bezinhlangano ezenza imisebenzi emazingeni asekhaya.

Ngale kweqhaza lokuhlela olwenziwe phambilini, uhlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele selubonakala njengomsebenzi wokusingatha omasipala nanjengengxenye yeqhinga lezinhlelo ezididiyele nokwethula imisebenzi emphakathini. Uhlelo lwe-IDP luqonde ukufinyelela ezinqumeni ngezinto ezifana nesabelo-zimali zomasipala, ukusingathwa komhlaba, ukuqhakambisa intuthuko yomnotho ezindaweni nokuguqula izikhungo ngendlela yokubonisana, ehlelekile neqonde phambili. Izinhlelo zeNtuthuko eDidiyele ngeke isize kuphela impatho yomasipala kodwa kufanele ihlahle indlela yemisebenzi yezikhungo noma imikhakha esondelene nohulumeni, izikhungo ezingaxhumene nohulumeni, abasiza abezimboni, kanjalo nemboni ezimele ezindaweni zomasipala. Esikhathini esidlule, omasipala besikhashana base bevele bemdibi munye ekulungiseni izinhlelo zama-IDP. Lokhu kwenziwa ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Ngalesi sikhathi lwalungekho uhlaka lomthetho. Omasipala bezindawo abaningi (ikakhulu iMikhandlu yesiKhashana) babengenazo izinsiza namandla okusingatha umsebenzi wenqubo yokuhlela. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ayengekho amaqhinga okuhlela asevivinyiwe ngalesimo ngokunjalo nezinhlelo ezinqala nezihloliwe zokuqeqesha. Ngaphandle kwazo zonke lezi zinqinamba, bonke abantu ababambe iqhaza kulendima bahlomule kakhulu ngolwazi abaluzuzile. Kunomaziphathe abambalwa asebehlabele phambili kakhulu ekusunguleni izinhlelo ezisiza ekusingatheni imisebenzi nezinhlelo esezisebenza. Amabhukwana eziNkomba ze-IDP, nasungulwe yithimba elehlukile leDPLG ngokwesekwa yiGTZ, luhlongoza inqubo ehloliwe yokuhlela nokusingatha umsebenzi ngendlela elula ukusetshenziswa.

Ukuhlaziywa kwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan Ingxoxo noMnumzane Mthembu, Uchwepheshe Wezomnotho Umxoxi: Mnumzane Mthembu, ngiyabonga ngokuvuma ukungihlangabeza namuhla. Singaqala ngenkulumo engajulile mayelana nohlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan? Yini leli phrojekthi elikhulu? Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngale ndaba. Uhlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan luhloselwe ukusiza umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi uvuselelwe ngemva kwemiphumela emibi ye-COVID-19. Lolu hlelo luthinta zonke izigaba zomnotho, ikakhulukazi ezokwakha, ezemfundo, nezokuthuthukiswa komphakathi. Umxoxi: Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi izigaba ezahlukene zomnotho kufanele zisebenze ndawonye. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kunamathuba, yini izinselelo ezibhekene nalolu hlelo? Mthembu: Impela, izinselelo ziningi. Okokuqala, sikhuluma ngezinsiza. Uhlelo lufuna izinsiza ezinkulu, kodwa kunobunzima ekutholeni lezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ziningi izinhlelo ezikhona, futhi kudinga ukuhlela kahle kwazo ukuze zifinyelele empumelelweni. Umxoxi: Yiqiniso, futhi umphakathi uthanda ukubona ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhuluma kanjani nezinye izinqubomgomo. Ingabe uhlelo luhlelekile kahle ukuze luhambisane nezinqubomgomo ezikhona? Mthembu: Yebo, uhlelo lwenziwe ngokucophelela ukuze luhambisane nezinye izinqubomgomo zikamasipala, zikazwelonke, kanye nezomhlaba. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinqubomgomo ezihlangene ukuze sithole impumelelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokufunda, ukuthuthukisa izinsiza, kanye nokuphucula imisebenzi.

aNoma imuphi umuntu ongekho ngaphansi kwemithetho elawula abasebenzi bombuso kuyofanele aholelwe iholo kumbandakanya nezimfanelo zokuhamba nokudla angene kuzo uma esebenzisa amandla , noma enza umsebenzi noma efeza izibopho abelwe zona noma azithweswe nguMqondisi-Jikelele, ezimiswe uNgqongqoshe ngokubonisana neNgqongqoshe weziMali. bNoma yiliphi elinye iholo okungakhulunywa ngalo noma elingabaliwe endimeni a kufanele likhokhwe uMkhandlu. c Noma iliphi ilunga elingaphansi kwemithetho elawula abasebenzi bombuso kufanele lithole isikhathi sokuphumula esikhethekile noma ilivu ukuze lenze umsebenzi woMkhandlu. Uma kukhona noma yini eyenziwe ngaphansi kwaloMthetho okumayelana nokuqokwa kwanoma iliphi ilunga noma okungenziwanga ngesikhathi noma ngendlela yaloMthetho, uNgqongqoshe angayala ukuba kuthathwe izinyathelo ezidingekayo ukulungisa lokho okungenziwanga noma iphutha noma alungise noma yini eyenziwe ngendlela engalungile ukuze kufezwe injongo yaloMthetho. UNgqongqoshe kufanele, ngemuva kokubonisana noMkhandlu, aqoke uNobhala woMkhandlu ukuba enze umsebenzi ngaphansi kwaloMthetho kanti futhi uNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokubonisana noMkhandlu angaxhosha uNobhala. Ukuqokwa kukaNobhala kuyoncika ekusayidweni kwesivumelwano phakathi koMkhandlu naye uNobhala, okuyofanele samukelwe nguNgqongqoshe. Isikhathi sokuphatha isikhundla sikaNobhala kuyakuba iminyaka emihlanu, kodwa uNgqongqoshe ngemuva kokubonisana nomkhandlu, angabuye asibukeze asandise isikhathi ngokubona kwakhe.

Umbuzo 7: Yini engakwenziwa ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula? Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izinqwaba zamanzi, ukulawula ukuhamba kwamanzi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokulawulwa kwemvula. Ukuthuthukisa imvelo, njengokutshala izihlahla, kubalulekile, njengoba izihlahla zinciphisa ukuhamba kwamanzi. Umbuzo 8: Kanjani izikhukhula zishintsha impilo yabantu KwaZulu-Natal? Izikhukhula zishintsha impilo yabantu KwaZulu-Natal ngezindlela eziningi. Abantu abavame ukuhamba emikhakheni ethile, futhi izikhukhula zingabavimbela ekutholeni izinsiza ezibalulekile. Lokhu kubangela ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, okuthinta umnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhukhula zishintsha umqondo wabantu mayelana nezindawo abahlala kuzo, njengoba bezokwenza izinqumo ezinzima uma kuziwa ekukhetheni izindawo zokuhlala. Umbuzo 9: Yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwa nguhulumeni? Uhulumeni uthatha izinyathelo eziningi ukuze avikele abantu ezikhukhuleni. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphendula eziphuthumayo, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kanye nokwenza izinhlelo zokuhlola izimo zezulu. Umphakathi kufanele ubambisane nohulumeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinhlelo zisebenza kahle. Umbuzo 10: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lokuvikela ezikhukhuleni KwaZulu-Natal? Ngokubona kwami, ikusasa lokuvikela ezikhukhuleni KwaZulu-Natal linokukhanya. Uma abantu, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele bamba iqhaza, sizokwazi ukunciphisa umthelela wezikhukhula.

Uhlelo lukazwelonke lokweseka izinhlelo komasipala bezindawo (PIMSS) luyasungulwa kanti luzogxila kakhulu ezikhungweni zomaziphathe. Isibalo esikhulu somasipala, SALGA, iminyango yezifundazwe kohulumeni bendawo neminyango eminingi yezimboni zikahulumeni ezweni zibe yingxenye yalolu hlelo nokuholele kuleli Qoqo lamaBhukwana amasha e-IDP. Nginethemba elikhulu lokuthi leli qoqo lamabhukwana ashicilelwe liyoba wumhlahlandlela owusizo nomthombo wolwazi oluyonika ugqozi kinina nonke eninegalelo ohlelweni lwe-IDP nasemizamweni yenu yokwenza I-IDP isikhali sokubhekana nezidingo zenhlalonhle nomnotho emiphakathini yethu ngendlela ehlonze ikusasa eliqhakazile. Umhlahlandlela VI: Ukusingatha umsebenzi osuqaliwe b Ukuqhakambisa izidingo ezimbalwa kuleso naleso sigaba seqhinga lokusebenza, ngaleyondlela wehlukanise ngokucacile phakathi kokumele kwenzeke lokho okudingwa wumthetho nenqubomgomo nezincomo ezingaphoqi kulabo abadinga izeluleko zokubhekana nomsebenzi othile wokuhlela. a. Kungani kwenziwa? b. Yimuphi umphumela olindelwe emsebenzini wokuhlela? c. Inqubo noma uhlelo kumele lubukeke kanjani ukuze luzuze umphumela ofanele? e. Kuyothatha isikhathi esingakanani? Incazelojikelele yendlalela iqoqo lamabhukwana ezinkomba ze-IDP. Ukwazisa amathimba abambe iqhaza ngemisebenzi elindelwe kuwo kanjalo nokuzikhandla okufanele ngenqubo. Lokhu kubandakanya iminyango yezifundazwe nekazwelonke. Ukunika incazelojikelele nesithombe esisheshayo ngenqubo yeIDP ebantwini abanesibophezelo sokusingatha inqubo.

Noma ngabe awukho umthetho ovikela ingxenye ethile yezemvelo, kodwa kuhlale kukhona ilungelo elisemthethweni-sisekelo ongalisebenzisa ukuvikela impilo yakho nenhlalonhle nokuqikelela ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu baziphatha ngendlela efanele ukuvikela imvelo. INEMA wumthetho osemusha nokusiza ukuba ukwazi ukuvikela kangcono amalungelo akho ezemvelo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngokudalwa kwemigomo yemvelo ebonisa uhulumeni ukuthi kufanele enzeni. Isibonelo, ukutshela uhulumeni ngalokho okubizwa "ngentuthuko emile", nechazwa ngokuthi wena njengomphakathi noma ilunga lawo kumele ubambe iqhaza lapho kuthathwa izinqumo ezithinta imvelo. Usiza ukuvikela imvelo ngokwenza ukuthi uhulumeni abhekele yonke imithelela (umthelela emvelweni) engadalwa yintuthuko ngaphambi kokuyigunyaza ukuba iqhubeke. Ukuvikela labo basebenzi abenqaba ukusebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezingalimaza imvelo, nabantu abashaya ikhwela (abanika ulwazi) ngabanye abalimaza imvelo. Wenza kubelula kithina ukuxazulula izinkinga nokungaboni ngeso elilodwa (ukuxazulula ukushayisana kwemibono nokulamula). Okokugcina, kunciphisa izinga lobungozi lokuzithola usuvela phambi kwenkantolo ukuyovikela amalungelo akho uma ezinye izindlela zokuxazulula izinkinga zehlulekile. INEMA ichaza imvelo njengento yendalo kanye nezinkomba ezibonakalayo, ezesiko, ukuheha okuthile okunomthelela empilweni yomuntu noma kwinhlalonhle. Usetshenziswa kanjani lomhlahlandlela? Indlela yokufaka isikhalo, ukufuna umxazululi noma ukuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho ngokuthile okuzokwenzeka noma osekwenzekile nokulimaza imvelo.

Mnumzane Ohloniphekile, uMeya weGu District, uNgqongqoshe S. Mphathi, umnyango wami ugcizelela ukubaluleka kwekhaya nokulethwa kokuthuthukiswa ezweni. Yingakho noma kuphi sihamba khona, sikhombisa ukuthi "umuntu ungumuntu ngenxa yekhaya." Ikhaya lingachazwa njengesisekelo somuntu wonke. Ikhaya yindawo lapho izingane zikhuliswa khona ngokuphepha, zithola zonke izinto ezidingekayo ezizovumela ukuba zakhe izwe lesikhathi esizayo. Kukhona ubudlelwano obubalulekile phakathi kwekhaya, ukuthuthukiswa, kanye nezwe elinempilo. Ngamanye amazwi, uma singakheki izindlu, asizukuba nezwe. Kukho okuningi okwakha ikhaya, kodwa iphuzu lokuqala lokwakha ikhaya "yindlu." Ubuqotho bomuntu kanye nazo zonke izinto azidingayo ukuze aphumelele buphazamiseka kakhulu uma engenayo indlu yokuhlala ngaphansi. UManzankosi uhlolile izinga lokushoda kwezindlu emindenini ukuze kuncishiswe ngokushesha ubuphakathi bezindlu kule ndawo. Ngemva kokubuyekeza imiphumela, kwavela ukuthi kusekhona umsebenzi omningi okufanele wenziwe ngaphambi kokuthi abantu bethu babe nezindawo abangazibiza ngekhaya futhi baphile izimpilo ezingcono. Thina, njengohulumeni onothando, sathatha isinqumo sokusebenza kanzima ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi abantu bethu bathola izindlu, okuyilungelo labo ngokomthethosisekelo. Ngamanye amazwi, lo mnyango uzinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi wonke umuntu unendawo enobuqotho yokuhlala, kungakhathaliseki ngesimo sabo somnotho. Leli lungelo liphakathi kwabantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala emadolobheni noma ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi kule ndawo, sinezinkulungwane zabantu abahluphekayo.

Alulimazi ingane noma amalungu omndeni, futhi indlela yokukhipha uthuli ukuthi umama wengane aphuze. Lolu thuli luvakashela ingane ukuze luyilungiselele ikusasa eliqhakazile neliphephile ebusheni bayo. Lufika njengesihlobo nomvikeli. Ubudlelwano obumele, obusekelwe emnqopheni omuhle, busekelwe emoyeni wokukhombisa ukweseka kanye nenhloso yokuphakamisa nokukhuthaza impumelelo yesikhathi esizayo yentsha kanye namalungu omphakathi akhulayo. Lolu thuli luhlale luwumlando wabantu ngenxa yesaga esidumile esibhaliwe kudala esibizwa ngokuthi: Uthukuthelo Lwabokhokho, obhalwe ngu-AC Jordan. Le ndaba iphikisa umbono wokuthi uthuli luyisidalwa esiyingozi futhi esilimazayo, kodwa ibonisa umbono ocebile we-Afrika, iqonda uthuli njengomngane nolwazi oludingekayo lokuhlala ndawonye. Umjola - indwangu eyakhelwe, eyenziwe ngama-fibers amnyama, ivela emthini wase-Afrika, iyisibonakaliso sobungane ekusekeleni nasekubambisaneni okuboniswayo ngabangane, futhi iphinde imele ukuzibophezela kokweseka nokuma nabantu abasisekelayo.

Iphondo lezeMisebenzi Yangaphandle kanye nabameli baseNingizimu Afrika kwamanye amazwe benza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimali, imibhalo nezinto zokufunda, kanye nemithi zifika eziboshweni ngokushesha. Nokho, imisebenzi ebalulekile ye-ofisi ye-embassy ibekwe phambili. Isimo salelo zwe singavimbela ukufika kwezinto eziboshwe. Ukugxila kubekwa ekuthuthukiseni izinkantolo zamazwe ngamazwe ukuze kutholwe ummeli noma ukunikeza izeluleko zomthetho ukuze kube lula ukukhululwa, noma imali yokukhululwa ezindaweni eziphephile noma ejele ukuze kuhlolwe icala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimo zokuphila ejele z better compared to others ngaphandle kokulandela imithetho yamazwe ngamazwe ephathelene nokuboshwa kweziboshwa. Abantu abakhuluma izilimi ezimbili bahlala ejele ezweni lesibili lapho futhi bengabakhulumi khona futhi abakwazi ukusizwa ngabameli baseNingizimu Afrika. Uma abantu abakhuluma izilimi ezimbili bahlala ejele kwamanye amazwe lapho bengabakhulumi khona, futhi bahambe ngepasipoti evela ezweni lesibili, kufanele baxhumane ne-embassy yalelo zwe abahambile ngale pasipoti. Izinga lokusebenza liyahluka ukusuka ezweni ukuya ezweni futhi lincike esimweni sezwe eliboshwe umuntu.

Izinsizakalo Zokubeletha Ezibhedlela Kwakukhanya kahle emini, izinyoni zibhakabhaka phezulu, zikhuluma ngothando nosuku olusha. Ekhaya, uNandi wayethokozisa umndeni wakhe, ethokozisa umama wakhe, uGogo, ngenkanyezi encane ezobe izalwa. Kwakungesikhathi sokukhumbula nokulindela, njengoba uNandi wayezokhuluma nezinsizakalo zokubeletha ezibhedlela, ezithinta impilo yakhe kanye nezingane ezizayo. Ngemva kokuhamba, uNandi wathola ukuthi isibhedlela esisedolobheni sakubo sitholakala emuva kweminyaka eminingi, sinesipiliyoni esikhulu sokubeletha. Kwakukhona odokotela abaqeqeshiwe, ababejolise ekunakekeleni abesifazane abakhulelwe, beqinisekisa ukuthi izinsizakalo zabo zihlala ziphezulu. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha zifaka phakathi ukuhlolwa kwempilo, ukuqondiswa kokukhulelwa, kanye nezinsiza ezithile ezifana nezokwelapha nezokwelashwa. Njengoba uNandi ehlola izinsizakalo, wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zihlala zikhumbula ukuthi ukukhulelwa akukona ukuhamba komjaho kuphela, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umndeni. U-Nandi wakhumbula izikhathi lapho abesifazane bejabulisa izinsiza ezithile, njengezikhumbuzo zokubeletha, izifundo zokukhulisa izingane, kanye nezinsiza zokuxhumana nezinsizakalo zabazali. Lokhu kwenza uNandi wacabanga ukuthi akufanele kube nezinselelo, kodwa kufanele kube nesikhathi sokujabula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNandi wathola ukuthi izinsizakalo zokubeletha azigcini nje ngokubeletha kuphela, kodwa zifaka phakathi ukwelashwa kokuphila kwengane. U-Nandi wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikhumbula ukuthi ingane iyisibusiso, ngakho-ke ziqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinsizakalo zikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ingane izalwa iphilile.

Injongo ngezinkonzo ze-website yeNingizimu Afrika wukutholakala komthombo owodwa wolwazi ngezinkonzo eziphakelwa nguhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Injongo wukuphungula igebe elikhona phakathi kwabanamandla kanye nabangenamandla, kwabomnotho womkhakha wokuqala nabomnotho womkhakha wesibili. I-website iyimizamo ebalulekile yokungenela nokusiza ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izakhamizi zikwazi ukuxhumana nohulumeni. Abasebenzisi okuqondiswe kubo, yizakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika kuzo zonke izingxenye zezwe, amabhizinisi akhona manje nawekusasa aseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezinhlangano nezakhamizi noma izinhlangano zakwamanye amazwe ezidinga izinkonzo kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. I-website iqukethe ulwazi ngezinkonzo zikahulumeni ezinikezwa nguhulumeni emkhakheni kazwelonke. Izinkonzo kubantu bamazwe angaphandle: ulwazi oluqondene nezakhamizi zakwamanye amazwe ezidinga izinkonzo eziqondene nazo kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Omunye nomunye wale mikhakha, uphinde wahlelwa ngendlela ehambisana nezinto ezenzeka empilweni ngokulandelana kwazo izinto ezenzeka kwimpilo yesakhamuzi noma yebhizinisi. Izinto ezenzeka empilweni ziphinde zahlelwa ngokulandela izigaba zempilo. Ulwazi kwinkonzo nenkonzo luhlelwe ngokulandela imikhakha eyisikhombisa ebalulekile, okuyilena: izincazelo, izinyathelo okumele zilandelwe, imithetho nemigomo, amazinga okwenziwa komsebenzi nesikhathi sokwenziwa komsebenzi, izindleko, amafomu okumele agcwaliswe kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Ngenxa yokuthi ulwazi lwaqala lwabhalwa nge-English kwathi emuva kwalokho lwaseluhunyushelwa kwezinye izilwimi. Ulwazi ngezinkonzo kwezinye izilwimi lufakelwa kwi-website ngemuva kokuba seluhunyushiwe.

Enye indaba okufanele ifakwe yisivumelwano esiphakanyisiwe se-WUA. UMthetho Wezamanzi Kazwelonke uchaza zonke izindaba okufanele zixazululwe esivumelwaneni se-WUA. Lo Mthetho (Isheduli 5) uphinde uhlanganise imodeli yesivumelwano esingasetshenziswa njengesisekelo sokuthuthukisa isisekelo somthetho. Nakuba isisekelo somthetho se-WUA singabandakanya imisebenzi ehlukahlukene, lokhu akusho ukuthi i-WUA izoba nazo zonke lezi zisebenzi uma isunguliwe. Abafaka isicelo sokusungula i-WUA kufanele, njengengxenye yenqubo yokusungula, bacela ngokusemthethweni ukuba bathunyelwe ku-WUA. Lokhu kungafakwa emqulwini ohambisana nephakamiso uma ithunyelwa. UNgqongqoshe angase afune ukuthi izindaba ezengeziwe zibe khona esivumelwaneni se-WUA. Lezi zindaba kufanele zamukelwe ngamalungu enhlangano futhi ziqinisekiswe nguNgqongqoshe ngaphambi kokuthi i-WUA ikwazi ukusebenzisa noma yiziphi izikhono noma ukwenza noma yiziphi izisebenzi. ngokuchaza indawo yokusebenza ngokuya ngesimo nenani lamanzi okufanele aphathwe, kanye nezikhono nemisebenzi ezodingeka ukuthi zidluliselwe ku-WUA. Emiphakathini engekho namandla okuhlela nokwenza amalungiselelo adingekayo enhlangano. Ikakhulukazi, usizo lungahlinzekwa lapho ukuthuthukiswa kudingeka ukukhuthazwa ngokusungula i-WUA (njengoba kwenzelwa abalimi abasha). Zonke izikhungo zokulima namabhodi amanzi abekade ekhona ngaphambi kokuqala komthetho kufanele aguqulwe zibe yi-WUA. Amabhodi amanzi athile asunguliwe ngaphansi koMthetho Wamanzi ukuze akwazi ukulima nawo azoguqulwa abe yi-WUA.

10. (1) ILungu loMkhandlu oPhethe kumele, ngesaziso kwiGazethi nasemaphephandabeni okungenani amabili afundwa kakhulu esifundazweni, limeme iziphakamiso zabantu abazoqokelwa eMkhandlwini. nosuku isiphakamiso okumele sifinyelele ngalo kwiLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe. abazocubungula zonke iziphakamiso futhi benze nezincomo mayelana nabaphakanyisiwe. Ipulantela lilinganiswa kanjani ukutshala ngendlela efanelekile? Thola zonke izakhi zepulantela ezikwazi ukushintsha ukulinganisa (amasphrokete, amagiya namapuleti). Qonda ukuthi ipulantela litshala kanjani mayelana nezimbewu nomanyolo ngesilinganiso samanje. Linganisa ububanzi ngaphakathi kwamayuniti epulantela ukuze uthole ububanzi bemisele yokutshala - lokhu kuzokusiza ukubala inani lemisele ezotshalwa ehektheleni (Isibonelo: ububanzi behektheli bungamamitha angu-100, uma ububanzi ngaphakathi kwemisele bungu-0,9 m, bese 100 m /0,9 m = 111 yemisele ehektheleni). Beka ibala endaweni engu-10 m. Qinisa ukuthi kukhona izimbewu nomanyolo emabhokisini (amahophela) - qinisa futhi ukuthi ubukhulu bezimbewu bulingana nezimbobo emapuletini - kufanele kungene imbewu eyodwa njalo ngasikhathi sinye. Bopha ipulastiki ethunjwini elithela umanyolo ukuze uzokwazi ukuthola ukusinda kwamanyolo emva kwesikhathi. Hambisa ugandaganda kuleyo ndawo engu-10 m (yenza ngokuthi uyatshala manje, bheka ukuthi amasondo altha amandla athintana kahle nomhlabathi). Bala inani lezimbewu eziphumile kule ndawo engu-10 m. ku-100 m (khumbula ukuthi ihektheli lilingana na-100 m x 100 m). sethu ububanzi beku-0,9 m, kusho ukuthi bekukhona imisele engu-111 ku-100 m. Isibonelo: sithola ukuthi kuchitheke izimbewu ezingu-30 ku-10 m. nezimbewu ezingu-300 ku-100 m. phindaphinda: x 300 = 33 300 yezitshalo ehektheleni. amasphrokete ukuze umphini ugijime kakhudlwana.

Umuntu ongavunyelwe ukuba yilungu loMkhandlu kaZwelonke ngokusho kwezigatshana (1)(a) noma (b) angalumela ukhetho loMkhandlu, uma kuhambisana nemikhawulo noma imbandela emiswe ngumthetho kazwelonke. ephuthe eMkhandlwini ngaphandle kwemvume kuleso simo esibekwa yimitheshwana nezinqumo ukuthi kufanele alahlekelwe ngubulungu. Ngaphambi kokuba ilungu loMkhandlu kaZwelonke liqale ukwenza imisebenzi yoMkhandlu, kufanele lifunge noma lethembise ukwethembeka kwiRiphabhuliki kanye nokuthobela uMthethosisekelo, ngendlela ebekwe kwiSheduli 2. Uma uMkhandlu kaZwelonke uhlakazwe njengoba kubekiwe esigabeni 50, noma emva kokuphelelwa yisikhathi sawo, uMongameli, kufanele abize ukhetho ngesimemezelo esishicilelwe futhi asho kuleso simemezelo ukuthi luzobanjwa ngaziphi izinsuku lolo khetho, kodwa kufanele lubanjwe phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-90 kusukela ekuhlakazweni koMkhandlu noma ekuphelelweni kwawo yisikhathi. Uma umphumela wokhetho loMkhandlu kaZwelonke ungamenyezelwanga phakathi kwesikhathi esibekwe kwisigaba 190 noma uma ukhetho luchithwe yinkantolo, uMongameli, kufanele abize abeke nezinsuku zolunye ukhetho ngesimemezelo esishicilelwe phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu 90 kusukela ekweqeni kwesikhathi sokumemezela umphumela noma kusukela ngelanga ukhetho olwachithwa ngalo. UMkhandlu kaZwelonke uyaqhubeka nokubanamandla okusebenza kusukela esikhathini ohlakazwe ngaso, noma ophelelwe ngaso yisikhathi, kuze kube yilanga elingaphambi kwelanga lokuqala lokuvotela uMkhandlu olandelayo. sekwedlule iminyaka emithathu emva kokukhethwa koMkhandlu.

Isikhathi sokusebenza kwamanye amalungu eKomidi, uMphakathi, kanye nama-vacancies. Uma ilunga elithile lishiya isikhundla sawo ngokuhambisa isicelo esibhaliwe sokwazisa ngenyanga eyodwa kuMongameli. Ilunga leKomidi elithunywe ngale ndlela ngaphansi kwesigaba-178 1 e, f, g, h, kanye i yeMthethosisekelo lizoshiywa isikhundla sawo ngokushesha uma iziqu zawo zemfundo zingasasebenzi ukufakazela isikhundla ababeqashwe kuso. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezibekwe esigabeni-178 1 yeMthethosisekelo, noma ilunga eliphelelwe isikhathi singabuyiselwa ukuze siqhubeke nokusebenza. IKomidi izokhetha amalungu ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza ngokuhambisana nesigaba-105 1 b, c, e, f, g, kanye i yeMthethosisekelo njengoba uMphakathi engakatholakali, uMphakathi uzothatha indawo kaMongameli. I-vacancy ekhona kwiKomidi a ngeke iphazamise izinqubo eziphakathi noma izinqumo ezenziwe yiKomidi ngenkathi ihleli; b izogcwaliswa ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zesigaba-178 1 yeMthethosisekelo, ilunga elithunywe ngale ndlela lihlala esikhundleni isikhathi esithile esisele salowo ophume esikhundleni esandulele. Ngenxa yokungabi khona komuntu osebenza ngokuphelele kwiKomidi Lezinsizakalo Zobulungiswa, umsebenzi ophawulekayo ophazamisa iKomidi wenziwa ngabasebenzi boMnyango Wezobulungiswa abaqashwe nguMphakathi-Jikelele: uMnyango Wezobulungiswa. UMs. I Greenstein ungumholi we-secretariat. Umhlahlandlela uzotholakala kwiKomidi Yezimfanelo Zomuntu waseNingizimu Afrika kungakapheli umhla ka-31 December 2003.

Zikhawulela isikhathi sokuhamba, ziqhuba ngesivinini esikhulu, futhi zingafinyelela ezindaweni ezikude ngokushesha. Lokhu kube usizo olukhulu kubantwana nabantu abadala abahamba emsebenzini, ngenxa yokuthi bakwazi ukufika endaweni yabo ngemizuzu embalwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izithuthuthu zikhanga abafuna ukuzijabulisa, ngoba ukuhamba ngebhayisikili kungase kube nzima kwabaningi, kanti izithuthuthu zenza kube lula ukuhamba. Kodwa-ke, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi ukuhamba ngezithuthuthu kuhilela izingozi eziningi, njengoba ubungozi bokushayisana bukhona kakhulu. Lokhu kudinga abanikazi bezithuthuthu ukuba babe neziqu eziphezulu zokuphepha, ezifana nezibuko kanye nemaski yokuphepha. Ngaphandle kokubheka izinzuzo, kufanele sikhulume ngempilo. Amabhayisikili aphumelele kakhulu ekuvikeleni imvelo. Awathathi amanzi amaningi, awakhiphi imikhaza engcolisa umoya, futhi akhuthaza umoya opholile. Lokhu kwenza amabhayisikili kube yindlela ephumelelayo yokuhamba endaweni ezinezinkinga zokungcoliswa. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zikhangisa ekongeni isikhathi, kodwa zikhumbula ukuthi zikhupha imikhaza eminingi emoyeni, okwenza kube nzima ukubaluleka kokuhamba kwezithuthuthu. Uma sikhuluma ngensizakalo, amabhayisikili angatholakala kalula. Abantu bangawathola kalula ezitolo noma online, futhi akudingeki ukuthi babe nemali eningi. Lokhu kuveza ithuba elikhulu lokuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinjengama-townships bangabathola kalula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zidinga ukugcinwa okuhle, okusho ukuthi abanikazi bazo kufanele babe nezezimali ezinzima ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhayisikili awadlalisi kuphela indima yokuhamba kodwa futhi ahlanganisa imiphakathi.

Uma uNobhala enolwazi lokuthi uMkhandlu, usihlalo noma ikomiti eliphethe, uthathe isinqumo okuzothi uma sisebenza sibe nomphumela wezindleko ezingagunyaziwe, ezingalungile, ezingenazithelo neziyincithakalo, uNobhala angeke abobephezeleka ngezindleko ezingagunyaziwe, ezingalungile, noma ezingenazithelo noma ezyincithakalo, iqobo nje uma uNobhala ezise uMkhandlu, usihlalo noma ikomiti eliphethe ukuthi lezi zindleko ngezingagunyaziwe, ezingalungile noma ezingenazithelo nezyincithakalo. i ukubuyisa noma ukulungisa lezo zindleko; kanye ii nokuvimbela ukungena ezindlekweni ezifana nalezi futhi. Kuyovulwa icala lobugebengu noma kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuqondiswa izigwengwe kulowo muntu omangalelwe icala lokungena ezindlekweni ezingagunyaziwe, ezingaqondile noma ezingenazithelo neziyincithakalo ngale kokuthi zesuliwe noma ezengesulwanga ngokwesigatshana 2. a izindleko ezingaqondile ezingavulelwa icala lobugebengu; kanye b nokweba nokukhwabanisa okwenzekayo eMkhandlwini. UMkhandlu kufanele ubhale umhlahlandlela wenqubomgomo okufanele uMkhandlu uwulandele noma usebenze phansi kwawo uma uphethe izimali ezisezandleni nezitshaliwe, futhi utshale izimali ezingakadingeki ngaleso sikhathi. a uma kunezizathu ezizwakalayo zokuthi leyo mpahla ayisadingeki ekuqhubeni umsebenzi woMkhandlu ; nokuthi b kuzotholakala imali efanele leyo mpahla.

Ukwamukelwa kwezinkantolo zabaholi bendabuko, njengoba iningi licabanga, kwakuyinto efanele, njengoba lokhu kwakwenziwa kuncikiswe ezinhlelweni zomthetho ezejwayelekile kulowo mphakathi. Ukufika kwengcindezelo kwaletha ushintsho oluphelele ekuphathweni kwemithetho ngabaholi bendabuko. Ohulumeni bengcindezelo nowobandlululo bangenelela ezinhlakeni zezinkantolo ngokuqala izinkantolo eziseceleni zabantu abamnyama. Ukwamukelwa kwe "zinkantolo zamakhosi" ngesikhathi sengcindezelo kwakubonakala njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuphatha ngokucindezela ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yomthetho wesi-5. Inqubomgomo yomthetho ongagunyaziwe, ngaphandle kokuthi yayiyisidingo esibalulekile sokuphatha ukuze kuphumelele ukuhlola ukusebenza kwayo ngabengcindezelo, yayisuselwe ephuzwini lokuthi kwakunokushayisana kwamasiko phakathi kwabacindezeli nomphakathi wabomdabu. Lokho okwakudinga ukuthi izindaba zabomdabu ziphathwe ngokwahlukana nalezo zezikhungo nezinhlaka ezazibekelwe abaMhlophe. Ngokuka Olivier, ngasekupheleni kokucindezelwa kwaboMdabu ngamaNgisi (phakathi kuka 1957 no 1967), imithetho yayisisebenza yomibili ngokulingana. Lolu hlelo lwezinhlaka ezimbili zazihlanganisa imithetho yokufika (owaseNtshonalanga) kanye nomthetho omayelana nendabuko. Nakuba abomdabu babesazisebenzisa lezi zinkantolo ngalesi sikhathi, kwakungakhululekisi ukusebenza kwazo. Lezi zinkantolo, njengazo zonke izingxenye zemiphakathi yabomdabu, zazenganyelwe abesilisa. Ukucwasa ngokobulili ekwakhiweni kwalezi zinkantolo kwakungundabamlonyeni.

Iphrojekthi ye-DNS seyikhule yaze yafaka neminye imizamo yokwenza ibhizinisi ebalulekile. Isikhwama sisebenza emhlabeni wonke futhi sivuleleke kwingozi yokushintshwa kwezimali zamazwe ngenxa yokuvuleleka kwizimali zamazwe ahlukene, ikakhulukazi nge-dollar lase-US kanye ne-Euro. Umbuzo kwakuwukuthi, loluya phenyo olwenziwa Ngonjiniyela Bendiza, kuthiwa bawufuna uphenyo luyekwe kanye ne-Margo. Omongameli baphinde baqinisa ukuzinikela kwabo kuzinzo kanye nobuqotho be-Sudan. Yizindaba ezimnandi kosomabhizinisi abangenaso isikhathi sokuma emigqeni emide. Kuzoba isifundo sokuxoxisana sokugcina sephrojekthi ngakho-ke, sizoba esisezingeni eliphezulu kakhulu. Umbiko omfushane owethulwe kahle uholela kwisivumelwano esihle okuchazwe kuso okumele kwenziwe, isikhathi esibekwe ngokwezigaba, izimali, izabelomali kanye nezikhathi ezihlelelwe ukukhokha. Njengabantu base-Afrika, sibhekene nenselele eecindezelayo yokuqeda ubumpofu kanye nokungathuthuki ngokwenele kwizwekazi lethu. Ukuhlangana okufana nalokhu kakusheshwe kuchithwe ngokusebenzisa udlame olusekelwe phezu kokuthi kwakungekho emthethweni. Empeleni, cishe kwakuthule kwaze kwaba ingalelo sikhathi lapho isisi esikhalisa unyembezi siqhuma khona futhi yilokho okwadala inkinga. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana neNhloko yoMnyango, amantombazane athokozela ukuzitika ngokuya ethunjini nowayebasingathile. Yebo, mhlawumbe kuzomele uyibeke kwiqoqo layo bese uyibalula yodwa njengengxenye yokwenzekayo.
