I-nqubomgomo iphinde ibonise ukuthi sibhekene nezinselelo zokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele futhi ukuthi izilimi zethu zomdabu kumele zibe yingxenye yeziqubu ezishintshashintshayo zobuchwepheshe. Ngakho-ke, kuzobhekelelwa ukusimama kwesimo nokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu eNingizimu Afrika. Ngithemba ngenhlonipho ukuthi bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bazokwamukela le Nqubomgomo yeSizwe Yolimi njengabo. Ngikholelwa ukuthi ngokubambisana, kumele siqinisekise ukuthi le nqubomgomo iba yimpumelelo ezimpilweni zethu, futhi isenze siqhenye ngempilo yethu ehlukile yaseNingizimu Afrika. SAQA Ibhodi leziqu laseNingizimu Afrika. Kukhona cishe izilimi eziyi-25 ezahlukene ezikhuluma eNingizimu Afrika, kanti eziyi-11 zikhishwa isimo esisemthethweni ngokuhambisana neSigaba 6 seSisekelo sika-1996 (Umthetho No. 108 ka-1996), ngokusekelwe esidingweni sokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwazo kufanele kube ngu-98% wabantu bonke. Izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni yizona isiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu, kanye ne-siSwati (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeNguni); isiSesotho, isiSepedi, kanye neSetswana (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeSotho); isiVenda, isiTsonga, isiNgisi, kanye ne-Afrikaans. ENingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinokukhuluma izilimi eziningi.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezinhlelo zomphakathi nezikhungo ezizimele, kuboniswe njengomgomo obalulekile. Ngaphakathi kwemihlangano, abaholi baphinde bakhuthaze abantu ukuba babe neqhaza elikhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza ezitholakala emphakathini. Lokhu kuba isixhaso sokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, lapho zonke izakhamizi ziba neqhaza elibucayi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, imicimbi efana nale ibaluleke kakhulu ekwakheni izinsiza ezithuthukisayo zomphakathi. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu bahlale bejabule, benze ubudlelwano, futhi baqhubele phambili imisebenzi ethuthukisa izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ngezinhlelo eziphumelelayo. Ekugcineni, umphakathi waseMbombela uthole ithuba lokubumba ikusasa labo, baqinisekisa ukuthi imicimbi efana nale izoqhubeka nokubumbana nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezindawo zomphakathi. Imicimbi yomphakathi iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi abantu bangakwazi ukuhlanganisa izinsiza, baqhakambise izimpilo, futhi banikeze ithuba elihle lokuhlangana. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlangana, ukufunda, nokukhula njengomphakathi, okubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni izimpilo zabantu. Ngokwenza lokhu, umphakathi ubonisa ukuthi uhlala unamandla, futhi uzimisele ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elihambisana nezinjongo zomphakathi. Imicimbi efana nale iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi imisebenzi yokubumbana ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu, ikakhulukazi uma ibanjwa ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kubonisa indlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onobudlelwano, kanye nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzayo.

Izikhungo ezingekho phansi kwezomnotho ziyizinkampani eziqoshwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo noma ukuthuthukisa izidingo zomphakathi futhi azihlosile ukwenza inzuzo noma ukwenza imisebenzi yokwenza inzuzo. Izikhungo eziningi ezingaphansi kukahulumeni, ezifana nezinhlangano ezizimele, izikhungo zezinsizakalo, nezikhungo zokupha noma zokwelapha, zifaka kuleli qembu. Ngokuvamile, izikhungo ezingekho phansi kwezomnotho zihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihlukene emiphakathini, njengezinhlelo zokudla zezingane, izikhungo ezibhekelela abantwana abanogogo ngenxa ye-AIDS, izikhungo zokholo, nezinye. Nakuba zingase zibe nemali ethile futhi zibe nezimali ngemva kokuhlanza izindleko zazo zokusebenza, lezi zisetshenziselwa ukwandisa nokuthuthukisa izinsizakalo zazo. Lezi zikhungo ngokuvamile zithola uxhaso oluvela eziphandleni nasezikhungweni zezimali zangaphandle futhi ziqoshwe ngaphansi kweSigaba 21 seMthetho Wokwakha, 1973. Inkampani ngaphansi kweSigaba 21 inamalungu angaphansi kwezimbili futhi okungenani abaphathi ababili (kuhlanganise nomgibeli). Qedela amafomu ahlukene atholakala eMnyangweni Wezohwebo Nezimboni. Uhlu lwamafomu adingekayo ukuthi aqedwe lunikezwa ngezansi. Kungathatha izinsuku ezinhlanu ukuze processing yesicelo sakho.

Lungisa umthetho weGauteng Constitution Amendment Act ka-2001 ophathelene nezinsiza zokuhamba, ukuze ubuyekezwe futhi ufake incazelo ethile; ukuhlinzeka ngamalungelo adingekayo okusebenzisa umhlaba mayelana neziteshi kanye namandla adingekayo nguMEC ukuze angene ezivumelwaneni zokwakha izinhlelo zomgwaqo nezemizila; lungisa inqubo ephathelene nokumemezela umgwaqo; ukwenza ucwaningo lwesibili endaweni esigabeni somgwaqo wokuqala noma umgwaqo wezitimela lapho umphakathi ungathola ukuthi ucwaningo endaweni kuleli gumbi lokumemezela luyadingeka; futhi ukuhlinzeka ngezinkinga ezincane. Igama elithi 'umgwaqo wezitimela' libhekisela ezinsizeni zomgwaqo ezisetshenziselwa umgwaqo onzima noma olula, futhi lapho isimo sikhombisa njalo, ilungelo lokuhamba, [lapho umgwaqo onzima noma olula usebenza, njengoba kukhombisiwe noma kwasungulwa ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho] noma phezulu noma phansi komhlaba futhi kufaka phakathi umgwaqo wezitimela kanye nokuphambuka kwawo okwesikhashana. Ekuthatheni umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela, ukulungiswa okushicilelwe komgwaqo ngokwesigaba noma okucatshangwa ukuthi kukhishwe ngokwesigaba, noma ukulungiswa komgwaqo wesifunda osevele ukhona, uMEC kumele aqinisekise ukuthi amalungiselelo omgwaqo wokuqala enziwa, ngokuhambisana nebhukwana elibhaliwe njengoba kuchaziwe futhi kufake iziphakamiso eziphathelene nomgwaqo, bese uMEC emva kwalokho kumele alandele inqubo echazwe kulolu sigaba.

Ukulahlekelwa komhlabathi nomvundo wawo. Ukulahleka kwamanzi agelezayo angasetshenziswa. Ukonakala kwamasimu nomhlabathi ongenamandla ukukhiqiza ukudla. Izikhukhula (zamanzi amaningi) nokoma kakhulu. Ukwehla kwenani lokuthengisa umhlaba. Ukwehla kwenani lenzuzo ekulimeni. Amasimu angasalinywa, ayekiwe. Izitshalo ezingamili kahle. Kukhona kakhulukazi izinto ezinto ezintathu ezidala ukuguguleka komhlabathi: amanzi, umoya nesithwathwa. Lapha eNingizimu Afrika sibhekene kakhulu nokugugula kwamanzi, bese sibheka ukugugula komoya. Ukuguguleka komhlabathi ngamanzi kwenzeka ngezindlela ezimbili: ukugezeka komhlabathi ongaphezulu nokudala amadonga. Ngokwejwayelekile, umhlabathi lapho kuzotshalwa khona wayelungiswa kahle, wayecoliweyo wayebusheshelezi, wayeqekile. Ngokwamanje sesisebenzisa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi (minimum till) - umhlabathi awusalungiswa ngendlela ejwayelekile ukuvimba ukulahleka komhlabathi ongaphezulu. Isikhathi sokutshala futhi yisikhathi semvula eningi. Lapho imvula ina kakhulu kulo mhlabathi olungisiwe umhlabathi uvama ukucina, kodwa kaningi kuzobakhona izinhlamvu ezincane zomhlabathi ezizogezeka zihambe namanzi. Emva kokuqala ukuna, amanzi amaningi kakhulu aqala ukuhlangana bese ayageleza lapho kukhona ukwehla ahambise umhlabathi nokunye okusemhlabathini kwemuke. Lokhu kungenzeka kuqhubeke ngesikhathi eside kungabonakali kalula. Ekugcineni umlimi uzobona nje ukuthi sekulahleka umhlabathi ongamathani amaningi njalo ngonyaka. Kaningi amasimu awalingene, awabushelezi - amanye asekukhuphukweni, amanye asekwehleni, futhi isimo somhlabathi asifani kuzo zonke izindawo.

Inhloso yewebhusayithi yezinsizakalo zik 정부 yaseNingizimu Afrika ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane eyodwa mayelana nezinsizakalo ezinikezwa uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Inhloso wukuxhumanisa phakathi kwabantu abanamandla nabangenamandla, phakathi komnotho wokuqala nowesibili. Le webhusayithi iyisimanga esibalulekile sokubandakanya nokusiza ngenhloso yokwenza ukuthi bonke abantu bangaxhumana nohulumeni. Abasebenzisi abaqondile ngabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zezwe, amabhizinisi akhona kanye namabhizinisi azayo eNingizimu Afrika, kanye nezikhungo nezakhamuzi noma izikhungo zangaphandle ezidinga izinsizakalo kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Abasebenzisi ababalulekile bahlanganisa izikhungo zokuxhumanisa umphakathi ezifana nezikhungo zomphakathi eziningi, abasebenzi bokuthuthukiswa emiphakathini, nezikhungo zokuxhumana zikahulumeni ezifana nezikhungo zokushayela zeBatho Pele Gateway, ezizosisiza abantu ekusebenziseni le webhusayithi kulabo abangakwazi ukufinyelela i-inthanethi ngqo. Le webhusayithi innehla ngemininingwane mayelana nezinsizakalo zikahulumeni ezinikezwa uhulumeni ezingeni likazwelonke. Izinsizakalo zabantu bangaphandle: imininingwane efanele abantu bangaphandle abadinga izinsizakalo ezithile kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Izigaba ngasinye kulolu hlelo nazo zihlelwe ngendlela ehambisana nezikhathi empilweni yomuntu noma ibhizinisi. Izikhathi zokuphila zihlelwa ngokulandela izigaba zokuphila.

Ingxenye yokuvula umhlabathi lapho i-fertilizer ibekwe khona imide futhi ikha phezulu. Ingxenye ebeka imbewu ifushane futhi ibekwe ngasohlangothini, futhi imbewu ibekwe kancane ngaphezulu komhlabathi. Ingxenye yomhlabathi ingawa phezu kwembewu ngemuva kokutshala, kodwa kungase kube nezikhala phakathi kwemibewu nezicucu zomhlabathi. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imbewu nomhlabathi kukhona ukuxhumana okuhle (okubalulekile ngoba imbewu idinga ukufaka umswakama ukuze iqale ukuvutha), kuzodingeka ucindezele kancane umhlabathi. Lokhu kucindezelwa kwenziwa ngalezi zinqola ezibizwa ngokuthi izinqola zokucindezela.

d unganika ofake isicelo ithuba lokummelwa kunoma yimuphi umbiko ongemuhle noma ekuchithweni kwesicelo. Isigaba -24 soMthetho kaZwelonke Wokusingatha Ezemvelo usebenza kuzo zonke izicelo zemvume yokukhiqiza isisi emoyeni kanti ofake isicelo nomkhandlu okhipha imvume kufanele bahambisane nemibandela yaleso sigaba. Ofake isicelo kufanele athathe izinyathelo ezifanele zokwazisa zonke izinhlaka ezifanele zikahulumeni, abantu abanentshisekelo kanye nomphakathi ngesicelo sakhe. siqukathe eminye imininingwane engadingwa ngumkhandlu wemvume. f noma yimiphi imihlahlandlela ekhishwe nguNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni maqondana negalelo lemikhandlu ekhipha izimvume ngemisebenzi yayo. a ungakhipha isicelo; noma b wenqabe isicelo. f namazinga eqophelo lomoya noma umkhiqizo wesisi onqunywe ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho. c unike izizathu ezibhaliwe ngesinqumo noma wazise umphakathi ngezizathu, lapho ucelwa yilowo ophawulwe endimeni a noma b. Lapho isicelo semvume yokukhiqiza isisi siphumelele ngokwesigaba- 33 (a), umkhandlu wemvume kufanele ukhiphe imvume yesikhashana yokukhiqiza isisi ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokufaka noma ukuqalisa isenzo esibhalwe ohlwini. b ezingase zinqunywe nguNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni esithintekayo ngaphansi kwemigomo yesigaba- 46 no- 47 wezenzo ezisohlwini nokuphawulwe ngazo.

Isinyathelo esilandelayo ukukhalaza kuMqondisi Jikelele, ozokwenza ukuthi isikhalazo lezo siphenywe bese kuthathwa izinyathelo zokulungisa ezidingekayo uma isikhalazo sizwakala. Isinyathelo esilandelayo ukuthumela isikhalo kuMvikeli Womphakathi. Lapho kufanele khona, njengesinyathelo sokugcina, kungayiwa enkantolo yomthetho ukuze inikeze usizo olufanele, njengokubukeza noma yisiphi isenzo sokuphatha soMnyango noma umyalelo ophoqelela ukuthi uMnyango wenze esinye isenzo lapho kuke kwaba khona ukwehluleka ukwenza okuthile. njengokumemezela ukuphikisa ngaphansi komthetho Wobudlelwane Emsebenzini; kanye iii nanjengelungelo lokudlulisela isikhalo kuNgqongqoshe, lapho exoshwa ngenxa yokungaziphathi kahle. Ukuqondanisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo ngaphakathi komNyango. Ukuphatha nokulungisa amahhovisi ayi-10 esifunda. Ukunikeza inqubo yokuhlela kanye nenqubo yokuphatha kumNyango. Ukuhlola nokulinganisa izinhlelo zomnyango. Imibiko Yezibalo Zezimali. Ibandla Lesiphathimandla: Ukuphatha Ezezimali yisibopho sokuhgambisa nokuphatha izindaba zezimali zomNyango. Ukuphatha Izimali, okusho ukuthi Ukunikeza izinsizakalo zokukhokha nokwezibalo zama-akhawunti zomNyango wonke, okufaka ukugcina izincwadi nokuphatha ama-akhawunti, ukukhokhwa kwamaholo kubasebenzi kanye nkwenza ukudonsa okufanele kuzikhungo ezifanele. Ukuphatha ukunikezela, okusho ukuthi ukutholwa kwempahla, izinsizakalo, ukwesekwa ngamalojistiki kanye nokuphathwa kokukhona. Ukuphatha Impahla Yonke, okusho ukuthi ukugcinwa ngokuphephile kwempahla yonke okufaka ukwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo kanye nenqubo.

I-ISS isizana nabantu ngamunye kanye nemindeni abanezinkinga umuntu ngamunye siqu noma zemiphakathi, abadinga usizo lokusebenzisana phakathi kwamazwe. Lulu sizo lutholakala kunoma yimuphi umuntu oseNingizimu Afrika noma phesheya. Yenza isishwankathelo sodaba ngokulandela indlela ebekwe ngabe-ISS. Isishwankathelo sodaba sizochaza izimo kanye nezicelo zosizo ezidingeka kuzwe langaphandle. Abathunyelwe kubhekwana nabo ngokulandela ukwamukelwa kwezicelo. Lapho kutholakala isicelo sokuthunyelwa esivela kumnyango weprovinsi, I-ISS SA izodlulisela isicelo sosizo kwabe-ISS Affilliated Bureau noma omele yona kuzwe langaphandle. Impendulo izoncika kuzimo zendawo. Lapho kwamukelwe isicelo sokuthunyelwa esibuya ezweni langaphandle, abe-ISS SA badlulisela udaba kummeli wesifundazwe wendawo ozokwenza amalungiselelo nosonhlalonhle ukuphenyisisa ngalo kanye nokunikeza umbiko kwabomnyango wesifundazwe. Uma umbiko usuwamukelwe, uthunyelwa kwabe-ISS SA, okuyibona abawuhlaziyayo kanye nokudlulisela umbiko kwabathintekayo , umbiko ozohambisana nokuphawula kwabo, imibuzo noma ukuphengulula. ENingizimu Afrika, inkonzo inikezelwa mahhala. Kwamanye amazwe, ungakhokhiswa imali yezinye izinkonzo. Lezi zimali ezikhokhelwayo ziyahluka kuzwe nezwe. Awekho amafomu okumele agcwaliswe.

Izinkampani eziningi zaphazamiseka, zadinga ukuvala iminyango ngenxa yokungabi namathuba okuthengisa. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokungasebenzi, okwakuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka. Abantu abaningi baphinde bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka. Ukwehla kokutshalwa kwezimali Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zashiya umthelela omkhulu ekutshalweni kwezimali. Abatshalizimali baphendule ngokukhathazeka, bephinde bahlala bephikisana nokutshalwa kwezimali ezweni. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kokutshalwa kwezimali okuvela kwamanye amazwe, okwakuholela ekunciphiseni amathuba okukhula komnotho. Izinkampani eziningi zathola ukuthi kunzima ukuhamba phambili, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokungabaza phakathi kwabantu. Izinyathelo zokuvuselela umnotho Ngemuva kwezibhelu, uhulumeni weNingizimu Afrika wathatha izinyathelo ezithile zokuvuselela umnotho. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezisemqoka, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Uhulumeni uphinde waphinde wakhuthaza abatshalizimali ukuba babuyisele izimali zabo ezweni, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnotho uyavuselelwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokusebenza zathuthukiswa, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abantu abaningi bangathola amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu kuhloswe ngokuqinisa umnotho, nokwakha izinsiza ezisemqoka ukuze abantu baphile kahle. Isiphetho Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika.

a engahoxisa noma yiliphi igunya lokuxolelwa wumthetho okukhishwe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba uma kungahanjiswana nombandela okukhishwe ngaphansi kwawo igunya lokuxolelwa; noma d engabuyekeza izikhathi ngezikhathi igunya lokushwelezelwa noma umbandela okukhishwe ngaphansi kwawo igunya lokuxolelwa. Umthetho Onqanda Ukunukutshezwa Komoya uyashintshwa lapha. Noma yini eyenziwe noma ethathwa njengaleyo eyenziwe ngaphansi kombandela othathelwe indawo yisigatshana- 1 nengase yenziwe ngaphansi kombandela walo Mthetho, kufanele ithathwe njengeyenziwe ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho. Ngesikhathi sokuqala kwalo Mthetho, zonke izitifiketi zokubhalisa ezikhishwe maqondana nenqubo eqagulwe kwiSheduli ye- 2 yoMthetho Onqanda Ukunukutshezwa Komoya kufanele uthathwe njengemvume yesikhashana yokukhiqiza isisi emoyeni ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho, isikhathi esiyiminyaka emibili kusukela ekuqaleni kwalo Mthetho. Isiphathimandla sikazwelonke seqophelo lomoya kufanele sikhiphe isiqiniseko esibhaliwe kubanini balezo zitifiketi zokubhalisa ngezinguquko zesimo segunya labo ngokukhiqiza isisi, lokhu kummele kwenziwe zingakapheli izinsuku ezingama-90 ngemuva kokuqala kwalo Mthetho. Abanini-siqiniseko esibhaliwe nesichazwe esigatshaneni-2 kufanele bafake isicelo semvume yokukhiqizi isisi ungakapheli unyaka ngemuva kokuqala kwalo Mthetho. Ukwehluleka ukufaka isicelo esifanele singakapheli isikhathi esihlinzekwe ngaphansi kwesigatshana-3 kuyoholela ekuthathweni kwemvume yesikhashana yokukhiqiza isisi okuqondiswe kuyo esigatshaneni-1 njengento eyize nengasebenzi.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kuvumela abathengi ukuthi bathenge noma nini, okuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu ezimpilweni zabantu abanokusebenza okuningi. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini enomsebenzi ongapheli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kulula futhi kusebenza kahle. Abathengi bangakwazi ukufinyelela emakethe yomhlaba wonke, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo ethile engatholakali ezindaweni zabo. Lokhu kukhuthaza umnotho, njengoba kudala amathuba amasha kubakhiqizi nabathengisi. Izinjini zokusesha zenza kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwezinketho ezahlukene, futhi amapulatifomu amaningi anikeza izinhlelo zokuhamba ezizwakalayo, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo efanele. Nokho, kunezinselelo ezihambisana nokuthenga online. Enye yeziqhamuka ezinkulu yokuqinisekiswa kokuphepha. Abathengi bavame ukukhathazeka ngokuqinisekiswa kwemali nemininingwane yabo siqu. Ukuphulwa kwemithetho yokuphepha ku-inthanethi kungaholela ekulahlekeni kwemali noma ekubeni abathengi babhekane nezinkinga ezinkulu. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abathengi babe nekhono lokuhlola izimakethe ezahlukeneyo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bazithola ezitolo ezithembekile. Enye inkinga ethinta ukuthenga online ukufana nokwakhiwa komkhiqizo. Abathengi abakwazi ukubona, ukuthinta noma ukuhlole umkhiqizo ngaphambi kokuwuthenga, okungaholela ekuthengeni imikhiqizo engahambisani nezilindelo zabo. Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukwakha ukholo phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, njengoba abathengi bezithola besebenzisa izithombe ezithile neziqubulo ezingase zingakhombisi kahle imikhiqizo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kwenza kube nzima ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezithile, njengoba abathengi bengenakho ukubona umkhiqizo ngokwakhe.

I-NYDA wuhlelo olwasungulwa nguhulumeni ukuze luphendule ngqo izinselelo zezomnotho ezibhekene nabantu abasha, iphinde futhi ibe wuphiko lokuthuthukisa isikhwama sezimali, yakhelwe ukusungula inkundla yokwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, kanye nokudluliselwa kwamakhono entsheni yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuphakamisa isiqubulo:"IPhalamende elinakekelayo elenza ngcono intuthuko yentsha ukuze ifinyelele enkululekweni yezomnotho," iPhalamende lisungule izinkundla eziningi ezibhekene nezinkinga intsha ebhekene nazo. Lawa maKomidi umsebenzi wawo wukubheka wonke umsebenzi ophathenelene nezinkinga zentsha futhi kumele abhekane nokuphathwa komthetho othinta abantu abasha. IPhalamende lisungule amasu ahlukene emikhakheni eyahlukene, isibonelo, iPhalamende leNtsha (eliba ngeNyanga yeNtsha) lapho izindaba eziphathelene nentsha zidingidwa khona. Abantu okufanele babambe iqhaza yintsha, kanti futhi okuqhubekayo kubhekiswe kubo. UMthethosisekelo ubophezela iPhalamende ekubandakanyeni umphakathi ezintweni elizenzayo, ngakho-ke intsha njengengxenye yomphakathi iyamenwa ukuthi izobamba iqhaza emaswini ePhalamende, afana nemihlangano yoMphakathi, iNkulumo kaMongameli ngeSimo seZwe kanye nezinye izinhlelo zokufinyelela kanye nokubandakanya umphakathi. Bangaphinde bazwakalise izimvo zabo ngokwenza iziphakamiso zomlomo noma ezibhaliwe. Intsha iphinde ibe yingxenye yomphakathi ozohambela imihlangano yamaKomidi lapho umsebenzi omningi wePhalamende wenziwa khona, nabantu abasha bengakuhambela ukuhlala kwephalamende ukuze bezozibonela, bathole ulwazi bakwazi ukuzihlomisa.

Ukuze kusizakale le nhlelo, kufanele kwenziwe ukuhlola okufanele nokuhlola (isibonelo, ukubheka phambili) ngokubambisana neNational Advisory Council for Development. Ukuqinisekiswa ukuthi ibhajethi eyinhloko yonyaka ye-R2.5 billion kufanele ibe okungenani kabili eminyakeni eyishumi ezayo. (Kufanele kuqashelwe ukuthi ayihambisani naleyo yeziqukathi ezizimele). Okwamanje, sigcina uxhaso lwe-GDP kazwelonke ku-0.7%, okuyingxenye yesithathu se-OECD average futhi encane uma kuqhathaniswa nenani eliphelele lamazwe athuthukile afana neSouth Korea neFinland. Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obuphambili kunezimpempe ezinkulu zokunciphisa izindleko emnothweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukudala izindlela ezizinzile zokudlulisa ulwazi nobuchwepheshe ezinkampanini (ikakhulukazi kuma-SMMEs). Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zamasiko. Izinhlelo zezimali zomnyango zonyaka ka-2000/2001 zifaka izenzakalo ezahlukene ezindaweni zomphakathi. Singachaza ukuqwashisa komphakathi ngocwaningo, ukusungulwa kohlelo lokubhekana ne-HIV/AIDS ekuthuthukiseni inqubomgomo yolimi lwesizwe, nokusungulwa kohlelo lweMlando Wokhuluma. Ukugcina nokuthuthukisa ifa. Ifa liyingxenye ebalulekile yobunikazi. Iningi leNingizimu Afrika linemigomo yefa eyathuthukiswa ngokwanele nakuba ingaxhaswanga kahle (njengeminyango, imikhakha yokulawula). Ukuguqulwa kwalezi zinsiza kubalulekile emnothweni nasemasikweni. Ukuhlanganiswa nokwakha izimnyango ezinhlanu zomlando ezimnyangweni ezithile nezithombe ezintathu eKapa: umlando wemvelo, umlando wesiko, kanye nomlando wezempi, kubonise inzuzo enkulu. Kuphakanyiswe futhi kwethulwa kwiCabinet.

Omasipala kufanele babhekelele lezo zilimi ezisetshenziswayo nezikhethwa ngabahlala kumasipala ngamunye. Uhulumeni kazwelonke nabezifundazwe, kufanele balawule futhi baqaphe ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ngaphandle kokususwa lokho okubekwa yisigatshana (2), zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni kufanele zihlonishwe ngendlela elinganayo futhi zithathwe ngendlela efanele. isi-Arabhu, isiHebheru, isiSanskrit nezinye izilimi ezisetshenziselwa ezenkolo ngokwejwayelekile yimiphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika. Lomqulu wamalungelo uyisisekelo sombuso wenqubo yentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika. Ugcizelela amalungelo awowonke umuntu ezweni lethu futhi uqinisa inkolelo yenqubo yentando yeningi yokwazisa isithunzi somuntu, ukulingana nokukhululeka. Umbuso kufanele uhloniphe, uvikele, uphakamise, futhi uphelelise amalungelo akuMqulu wamaLungelo. Amalungelo akuMqulu wamaLungelo angakhawulwa ngemikhawulo equkethwe noma okukhulunywe ngayo kwisigaba 36, noma kwezinye izingxenye zoMqulu. UMqulu wamaLungelo usebenza kuyo yonke imithetho futhi uphoqa isishayamthetho, isigungu sokuphatha sikahulumeni, abaphethe izinkantolo, nazozonke izingxenye zombuso. Isimiso kuMqulu wamaLungelo sibopha abantu bemvelo nalezozakhiwo ezithathwa ngumthetho njengabantu uma, futhi kungadluli ezingeni okungenzeke ngakho lokhu, uma kubhekwe uhlobo lwelungelo nanoma yiziphi izibopho ezibekwa yilelo lungelo. Uma isebenzisa izimiso zoMqulu wamaLungelo kubantu bemvelo nakulezozakhiwo ezithathwa ngumthetho njengabantu, ngokubeka kwesigatshana (2), inkantolo-B.

(2)(a) Ilungu loMkhandlu kanye nelungu lekomidi loMkhandlu, maqondana nemisebenzi yalo njengelungu, lingabuyiselwa izindleko zokuhamba ngomsebenzi okudalwe ngukwethamela umhlangano woMkhandlu noma wekomidi loMkhandlu. ILungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali kumele linqume inqubo, kubandakanya nezindlela zokulawula nezokuphatha izimali zokukhokhelwa izindleko zokuhamba ngomsebenzi okuhlongozwe endimeni (a). 20. (1) ILungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezamagugu kumele, emva kokubonisana oMkhandlu, liqoke umuntu oqeqeshwe ngokwanele, onekhono kanye nonesipiliyoni njengesiKhulu esiPhezulu soMkhandlu. (2)(a) IsiKhulu esiPhezulu siqokwa isikhathi esingeqile eminyakeni emihlanu. (b) IsiKhulu esiPhezulu singaphinde siqokelwe elinye ihlandla. (3)(a) Ukuqokwa kwesiKhulu esiPhezulu kuncike ekusayinweni kwesivumelwano sokusebenza phakathi kwalowo muntu noMkhandlu. UMkhandlu kanye nesiKhulu esiPhezulu, ngokubhalwe phansi nangokuvumelana, bangachibiyela isivumelwano sokusebenza. (4)(a) Ngezinhloso zokudalula ukuhlomula ngokwezezimali noma okunye, izinhlinzeko zesigaba 11 zisebenza ngezinguquko ezifanele kwisiKhulu esiPhezulu ngaphandle kokuthi isiKhulu esiPhezulu kumele sidalule ukuhlomula kwaso eMkhandlwini. UMkhandlu kumele ugcine irejista yokuhlomula ngokwezezimali noma okunye okudalulwe yisiKhulu esiPhezulu. IsiKhulu esiPhezulu siyilungu loMkhandlu ngokwesikhundla kodwa asinalo ilungelo lokuvota emihlanganweni yawo. Isigatshana (1) sincike ezinhlelweni zesikhashana okukhulunywe ngawo esigabeni 66. 21.

108 ka-1996), ngokusekelwe esidingweni sokuthi ukusetshenziswa kwazo kufanele kube ngu-98% wabantu bonke. Izilimi eziyi-11 ezisemthethweni yizona isiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu, kanye ne-siSwati (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeNguni); isiSesotho, isiSepedi, kanye neSetswana (ezaziwa ngokuhlanganyela njengeqembu lezilimi zeSotho); isiVenda, isiTsonga, isiNgisi, kanye ne-Afrikaans. ENingizimu Afrika iyizwe elinokukhuluma izilimi eziningi. Isici esivelele sokukhuluma izilimi eziningi eNingizimu Afrika ukuthi izilimi eziningi zomdabu zidlula imingcele yezifunda, zikhuluma phakathi kwemiphakathi yaleso silimi ezivela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwenza kube lula ukuthuthukiswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezaziphikisiwe ngaphambili futhi kukhuthaze ukukhuluma izilimi eziningi, uma kuphela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bekhululekile ukweseka izilimi ezingezona ezomdabu njengokubalulekile, okuyizilimi ezisemthethweni zalesi sikhungo. Ukuphathwa kokuhlukahluka kwezilimi eNingizimu Afrika bekukhona izinkinga emlandweni ngenxa yokungabi khona kwenqubomgomo yolimi echazwe kahle, okuholele ekusetshenzisweni kwe-English kanye ne-Afrikaans njengamazwi aphakeme athonya izici zomphakathi, zomnotho, nezombusazwe zomphakathi wethu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili kuhulumeni wenkululeko, eNingizimu Afrika ifike endaweni ebalulekile emlandweni wayo. Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kumele baphendule ekuhlukahlukaneni kwabo kolimi namasiko kanye nezinselelo zokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, yingakho le Nqubomgomo yeSizwe Yolimi ithuthukiswa.

Anginako ukungabaza ukuthi uzoyithola le ncwadi iyisikhalo esisizayo emizamweni yakho yezebhizinisi, futhi ngikufisela ngokwempela impumelelo ekumiseni ibhizinisi lezokuvakasha elandayo nelinenzuzo. Nginombono Omuhle kakhulu! Ngiyitholaphi Imali Yokuqalisa Ibhizinisi Lami? Imibuzo - Nginako yini okungangenza ngibe Ngumhwebi? Kumele Ngikhethe Siphi Isakhiwo Sebhizinisi? Siyakwamukela kulo mhlaba omuhle wezokuvakasha. Sethemba ukuthi uzothola loku kukhishwa kwencwadi kunosizo. Le ncwadi izokunikeza ulwazi olusizayo ukukusiza kumizamo yakho yokumisa ibhizinisi elihlobene nezokuvakasha. Le ngamela izihloko ezisuka ekubhaleni izinhlelo zebhizinisi ukuya ekufuneni ukuxhaswa ngezimali kanye nasekunikeni imininingwane yokuxhumana esemqoka. Uyacelwa ukuba ukhumbule ukuthi lona ngumqondo jikelele ngakho-ke siphakamisa kakhulu ukuthi ubheke eminye imithombo yolwazi. Eyodwa yezimpawu zale ncwadi esemqoka, ukuthi inikeza ulwazi kuko konke ukuqalisa okukhona ukukusiza ukumisa ibhizinisi elisha noma ukukhulisa ibhizinisi eselikhona. Sebenzisa uhlu lokuxhumana ukuthola ukuthi ngubani ozokuba ngcono kakhulu kuwe bese uxhumana nabo ngqo. Khumbula ukuth eziningi zezikhungo zinikeza izinsizakalo kanye nosizo olwahlukile. Ukuze sikwazi ukulondoloza isikhala kule ncwadi, asyiphindanga imininingwane yabo kodwa sikunikeza ikhasi elifanele ongabheka kulo. Izifundazwe eziningi zinokuqalisiwe kwazo kanye nezincwadi ezikhishiwe ezinhle kakhulu. Xhumana nabo ngqo emininingwaneni yokuxhumana enikezwe Esahlukweni sesi-5. Ukumisa ibhizinisi lakho akuwona umsebenzi olula futhi kuthatha ukusebenza kanzima kakhulu kanye nokuzinikela.

Imiyalelo yokufaka ikhemikhali kufanele ibhalwe phansi futhi isayinwe ngumfaki. Abalimi kufanele babe nenhlonipho uma beshaya amakhemikhali ngoba amakhemikhali angahamba. Kungaba nesixwayiso esikhulu ezitshalo eziseduze ezingalimala ngamakhimikali. Kubalulekile ukuthi amakhemikhali angathinti ukudla. Ukufaka amakhemikhali ngendlela efanele nokugcina amarekhodi kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukudla kuhlala kuphephile.

Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo ngokubekiwe kwisigatshana 3 kungathi lapho uphathini ongarejistiwe okuwuye isinqumo sibhekiswe kuye, ikhipe isinqumo sokuthi makuhlehliswe usuku lokugcinwa kwesinqumo senkantolo ngokwemibandela, okungafaka neyokukhipha isibambiso, ukukhokha inzalo, ukukhokha kancane kancane nokuhanjiswa kwempahla ethize echaziwe, inkantolo kufanele ikhiphe isinqumo esibona sifanelekile nesilungile. Inkantolo ingakhipha noma yisiphi isinqumo esibona sifanelekile ukuvikela amalungelo abantu abanentshisekelo. Ngaphandle uma kubekiwe kule sigaba, isicelo esifakiwe enkantolo sokuthi kukhishwe isinqumo ngaphansi kwale Sahluko kufanele senziwe ingakapheli iminyaka emibili kusukela ukufa kubuqedile ubuhlobo oburejistiwe. Noma yingasiphi isikhathi, emveni kokudlula kwesikhathi okukhulunwa ngaso kwisigatshana 1, inkantolo ingasivumela isicelo ngaphansi kwale Sahluko, uma yaneliseka kuzo zonke izinto, ukuthi umkhalazi uzobhekana nobunzima obukhulu kakhulu uma singamukeleki isicelo sakhe kunalobo azobhekana nabo okuwuye isicelo nesinqumo senkantolo esizobe sibhekiswe kuye. Noma imuphi umgcini-hhovisi osingatha umcimbi wobuhlobo ebe engenalo igunya ngaphansi kwalo mThetho kumbe uma enolwazi lokuthi ophathini abuvumelekile emthethweni ukuhlanganiswa, futhi noma ubani othi engesiyena umgcini-hhovisi ongumshadisi kepha asingathe umcimbi owakha ubuhlobo, uyobekwa icala uma limlahla agwetshwe inhlawulo yemali, uma engayikhokhi, aboshwe isikhathi esingeqile kwizinyanga eziyishumi nambili.

Ubuchwepheshe Belwazi: Ukuxhumana Komphakathi Ukuze umphakathi uthole indlela efanele yokuxhumana, kubalulekile ukuthi kube nezinsizakusebenza ezitholakalayo. Ubuchwepheshe belwazi, obuhlanganisa i-inthanethi, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nemithombo yabezindaba, bunika umphakathi ithuba lokuhlaziya, ukufunda, nokuxhumana ngempumelelo. Lokhu kuphakamisa ukuqonda kwezesayensi, kuvula amathuba amasha okuxoxa ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwemiphakathi ehlukene. Ezinye izinkampani sezisebenzise lezi zinsiza ukuze ziqhube izinkampani zazo, zikhuthaze ukuhweba, kanye nokuthuthukisa amakhono okuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Izeluleko Eziyinhloko: Qhubekani Nokuqonda Kubalulekile ukuthi siyazi ukuthi yonke lezi zinsizakusebenza, ezithandwa kakhulu, zidinga ukusizwa ngabantu. Ukugqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe, ukubamba iqhaza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemicabango, kunceda ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Okwamanje, izazi zesayensi zikhuthaza wonke umuntu ukuthi abambe iqhaza, athuthukise ulwazi lwakhe, futhi azibandakanye ezenzakalweni ezibalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umuntu ngamunye angaba nomthelela kule migudu, asize ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. Isiphetho: Ukukhanya Kwezenzakalo Zesayensi Ngaphezu kwazo zonke lezi zinsiza, kucacile ukuthi izesayensi zinemiphumela emikhulu empilweni yansuku zonke. Ukuze umphakathi ube nekhono lokuphendula izinselele ezenzakalweni ezinzima, kudingeka ukuthi ubambe iqhaza ngokugcwele ukufunda, ukwenza, futhi azizise izinsiza zesayensi ezintsha. Lokhu kudinga isimo sokubambisana, ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezizinda ezahlukene, nokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo ukuba ziqhubeke nokufunda.

Empeleni, cishe kwakuthule kwaze kwaba ingalelo sikhathi lapho isisi esikhalisa unyembezi siqhuma khona futhi yilokho okwadala inkinga. Ngemuva kokuxoxisana neNhloko yoMnyango, amantombazane athokozela ukuzitika ngokuya ethunjini nowayebasingathile. Yebo, mhlawumbe kuzomele uyibeke kwiqoqo layo bese uyibalula yodwa njengengxenye yokwenzekayo. Okuphokophelwe yindikimba yokuthuthukiswa kwengcebo engabasebenzi ukwandisa isisekelo samakhono abantu ababencishwe amathuba ngaphambilini abakule ndawo, kanye nokunyusa izinga lamathuba okuqashwa. Ukwandisa insiza yethu esiyisebenzisela ukukhononda ngokuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza okungekho sezingeni elifanele eziteshini zamaphoyisa. Abancintisanayo abehlukene, izethameli kanye nabesekayo bancome i-SAPS ngokuzinikela kanye nokubanekhono lokwenza umsebenzi kwayo. Kusukela ngemuva kokukhululeka, abantu basemazweni womabili elase-Vietnam kanye nelase-Afrika baxakekile ngezindaba zentuthuko, ukulwa nobumpofu kanye nokwakha futhi izizwe zethu. Noma bethwaliswe kanzima ubumpofu kanye nokungathuthukiswa ngendlela efanele, abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlala ezindaweni ezisemakhaya, abavumi ukunqotshwa izimo abakuzona. Lokhu manje kunika umhlaba ithuba lokuqeda okunye kokushuba kwesimo okukhulu kakhulu. Igumbi lizongena umoya oqhamuka ngaphandle ngokwanele ngama-louver noma ezinye izindlela ezamukelekile. Ukwakha umkhanya ekubhekeni ukuhanjiswa kwezinsiza ngohulumeni kulona lonke loluthathu uqimba ezindaweni ezikhonjiwe. Abasolwa abane ababoshwe ngozankosi babebukele ngesikhathi kulayishwa emotweni amakhebuli ethusi kanye nempahla okwebiwe.

Eminyakeni edlule, ama-Amapiano aqhubeke nokukhula emhlabeni jikelele, futhi abaculi abasha baqala ukuveza imisebenzi emisha, behlanganisa ama-Amapiano nezitayela ezahlukene, okwenza umculo uthokozise abantu abaningi. Lokhu kudala umoya wokujabula, lapho abantu bekwazi ukujabulela iziphuzo, ukudla, nokuhlanganyela ngezindlela ezihlukene. Njengoba ama-Amapiano eqhubeka nokukhula, aqhubeka nokubamba abalandeli abaningi, abathanda umculo, nezizukulwane ezintsha. Lokhu kusikhumbuza ukuthi umculo uhlanganisa abantu, ubasukela ezimpilweni zabo, ubakhiphe emithini yobuhlungu, futhi ubathokozise. Ama-Amapiano akhombisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokuphila, yokuzijabulisa, yokukhumbula, kanye nendlela yokuthokozisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-Amapiano azogcina engumkhiqizo oholayo, usetshenziswa emicimbini emikhulu, ezinkundleni, nakwezinye izindawo ezithokozisayo. Lokhu kuzovumela umculo ukugcina ubukhona bawo, nokuhlanganisa abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngakho, uma sikhuluma ngama-Amapiano, sikhuluma ngempilo, uthando, nokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi umculo ungaphezulu kwekhono lokudansa; ungumkhiqizo wezifiso, izifundo, kanye nemizwa esishukumisayo. Ama-Amapiano akhuthaza umculo, avusa umoya wokubambisana, nokuhlanganyela, futhi azoba yingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko nezenzakalo ezizayo, aqhubeke nokwakha izixhumanisi phakathi kwabantu, futhi agcine engumthombo wokujabula nempilo.

Mthembu: Yebo, izinhlelo zokwakha zibalulekile. Uhlelo luhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwakha izindlu, izikole, nezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kuzohlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, ukufunda, nokunakekelwa kwezempilo, okuyizinto eziyisisekelo kubantu. Umxoxi: Ngabe zikhona izinhlelo zokuxhumana nomphakathi ukuze abantu bazi ngemiphumela yalo hlelo? Mthembu: Impela, sizobe sikhuluma nomphakathi ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi bazi ngalezi zinhlelo. Lokhu kuzofaka izifundo, imihlangano, nezinkundla zokuxhumana. Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi bangabamba iqhaza kanjani, futhi bazise ngempumelelo ezitholakala. Umxoxi: Lokhu kuveza ukuthi ubumbano luyisihluthulelo. Ngabe ukhona umbono owodwa ofuna ukusho kubafundi? Mthembu: Yebo, ngifuna ukuveza ukuthi ukuvuselela umnotho akukhona nje umsebenzi wombuso kuphela; udinga ubambiswano phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni. Sidinga ukufaka izandla zethu ndawonye ukuze uthole impumelelo. Uhlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan lungaba yimpumelelo uma sisenza ngokubambisana. Umxoxi: Ngiyabonga, Mnumzane Mthembu, ngempela le ngxoxo ibe yinsiza enkulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuhlanganyela nathi! Mthembu: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Le ngxoxo ibonisa ukuthi uhlelo lwe-Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan luhloselwe ukuvuselela umnotho, kugqugquzela imisebenzi, futhi kukhethiwe ukuthi kubhekwane nezidingo zomphakathi. Ukusebenza ngokubambisana kwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi uhlelo lube yimpumelelo, futhi umphakathi uzothola izinzuzo ezinkulu.

zethweswe ngokulinganayo izibopho nemithwalo ehambisana nobuzwe. Umthetho kazwelonke kufanele uhlinzekele ukutholakala, ukulahlekelwa nokubuyiselwa kobuzwe. Iculo lesizwe laseRiphabhuliki liyonqunywa nguMongameli ngesimemezelo ephephandabeni likaHulumeni lomthetho. Ifulegi lesizwe linombala omnyama, osagolide, oluhlaza okotshani, omhlophe, obomvu noluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, njengoba lichazwe futhi ladwetshwa kuSheduli 1. Izilimi ezisemthethweni eNingizimu Afrika yisiPedi, isiSuthu, isiTswana, isiSwazi, isiVenda, isiTsonga, isiBhunu, isiNgisi, isiNdebele, isiXhosa kanye nesiZulu. Ngokubuka umlando wokwehliswa kokusetshenziswa nezinga lezilimi zendabuko zabantu bethu, umbuso kufanele uthathe izinyathelo ezingasebenza nezinenqubekelaphambili zokuphakamisa izinga nokuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zilimi. Uhulumeni kazwelonke kanye nohulumeni wezifundazwe angasebenzisa izilimi ezithile ezisemthethweni emsebenzini kahulumeni, ecabangela ukusetshenziswa kwalezo zilimi, ubunzima bokusebenzisa ezinye izilimi, izindleko, isimo sesifundazwe, kanye nokuqhathaniswa kwezidingo nokukhethwa ngumphakathi uwonke noma kwisifundazwe esithintekile; kodwa uhulumeni okazwelonke noma owesifundazwe kumele usebenzise izilimi ezimbili ezisemthethweni. Omasipala kufanele babhekelele lezo zilimi ezisetshenziswayo nezikhethwa ngabahlala kumasipala ngamunye. Uhulumeni kazwelonke nabezifundazwe, kufanele balawule futhi baqaphe ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezisemthethweni. Ngaphandle kokususwa lokho okubekwa yisigatshana (2), zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni kufanele zihlonishwe ngendlela elinganayo futhi zithathwe ngendlela efanele.

Ukuhlinzekela ukuhlonipha izinqubo zokwakha ubuhlobophakathi kwabantu; umphumela kwezomThetho ngobudlelwano babantu; ukuhlonishwa ngokusemthethweni kobudlelwano basekhaya; ukusebenza komThetho kubudlelwano basekhaya; nokuhlinzekela izinto ezihambisana nako. NANGOKUQAPHELA ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenza komThetho wezomndeni emva kokuqala kokusebenza komThethosisekelo akuzange kusihlinzekele isimo sobudlelwano bezithandani eziwubulili obubodwa ukuthi zibe nesikhundla nezinzuzo ezihambisana nomthwalo womshado okunikezwa inhlonipho kwizithandani zobulili obungefani. a ukulawula umcimbi wokuhlangananisa nokurejista ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi; kanye b nokuhlinzeka umphumela womcimbi kwezomthetho kanye nokurejistwa kobudlelwano bezakhamuzi. Umphathi-hhovisi ongumshadisi angawusingatha umcimbi wokuhlanganis abantu abadala abawubulilil obubodwa ngokuhambisa ngemigomo yale Sahluko. Ngokuhambisana nale Sahluko, umphathi-hhovisi unawo wonke amandla awanikezwe umthetho woMshado ukusingatha umcimbi ngokwale Sahluko. Noma yiliphi ibandla kumbe inhlangano bangambhalela uNgqongqoshe bafake isicelo sokubekwa babe yibandla elingasingatha ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi. UNgqongqoshe angalinikeza amandla ibandla kumbe inhlangano ukuthi bakwazi ukusingatha imicimbi yokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi ngaphansi kwalo mThetho, futhi, kufanele kuthi njalo emva kwezikhathi ezithize, ashicilele imininingwane yazo zonke izikhundo ezinikwe laow Mandla kwiGazethi.

Ingxenye encane yaloku ngamathuba emisebenzi ehlala isikhathi eside evela kuhlelo lukahulumeni olubizwa ngokuthi "Wuhlelo lemisebenzi kahulumeni olwendlalelwe wonkewonke" (Expanded Public Works Programme). Kodwa asingabazi ukuthi loluhlelo kufanele luqhutshwe luye phambili singabuyeli emuva. Kanti futhi asingabazi ukuthi singaqhubeka sifake umfutho wokuthi sidale amathuba okuthi abantu bazisebenze ngokuvula amabhizinisi amancane. Singakhohlwa ukuthi intsha yiyona eningi esibalweni sabantu abantula imisebenzi, singafaka umfutho enhlanganweni yentsha ukuthi ithole amakhono okuzisebenza. Siyaziqhenya ngokuthi kusukela ngonyaka ka 2004 senze ubungcno ekusebenzeleni umphakathi nasekukhuphuleni iholo labantu njengoba sathembisa ukuthi sizakwakha umphakathi onozwelo. Ngonyaka ka 2004 abantu abathola imali yesondlo sabantwana babengu 8 million, kodwa manje sebengu 11 million abantu abampofu ezweni lethu abathola lemali yesondlo. Kuyakhuthaza ukubona ukuthi inani labantu ababhalisela imali yesondlo sabantwana likhula ngokulingene amandla kahulumeni njengoba lezinhlelo sezikhombise ukuvuthwa. Loku kuzakuqinisekisa ukuthi lohlelo luzakubanathi isikhathi eside kanti futhi uhulumeni uzakukwazi ukuthi angeze imali yokusimamisa lezinhlelo ukuze kudaleke amanye amathuba emisebenzi namathuba okuvula amabhizinisi. Ohlelweni lokwakha izindlu, uhulumeni ufake imali yokwelekelela ekwakheni izindlu ezingu 300, 000 eminyakeni emibili edlulile. Kodwa siyaqhubeka sithuthukisa izinga lezindlu ezakhiwayo siphinde sivulele labo abashiyekayo kulezihlelo zikahulumeni nenhlelo eziphuma kumabhizinisi azimele. Umsebenzi awuhambi ngezing besifuna ngalo. Kufuneka sisebenze ukuze silungise loludaba.

Kulomhlahlandlela, amathimba aqokiwe: uMphathi-masipala namaIDP - ukuze bakwazi ukuhlela nokwengamela uhlela ngendlela efanele, abahleli abangochwepheshe - ukuze bakwazi ukulusebenzisa ngemfanelo, baluguqule lapho kudingeke khona, abanye abantu - ukuthola incazelojikelele ngenhloso yokufeza leyomisebenzi abelwe yona. Kubalulekile ukwazi umhlahlandlela wesibili ngaphambi kokuqala inqubo yohlelo. Lolu lwazi lusiza omasipala ekwenzeni amalungiselelo enqubo nohlobo lwesakhiwo okuyodingeka lulandelwe noluyisisekelo sokuqalisa uhlelo. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, umhlahlandlela wesibili uwumthombo okungathathelwa kuwo lapho kuqhutshwa umsebenzi we-IDP. Inhloso yomhlahlandlela wesithathu wukusiza umasipala ngeqhinga lokusebenzisa I-IDP. Ingqikithi iqukethwe ngokufingqiwe esiGabeni 4, iNqubo yoHlelo. Umhlahlandlela III uqondiswe emaqenjini adinga imininingwane egcwele nolwazi lwenqubo ye-IDP ngenxa yohlobo lweqhaza abalibambile. Umphathi wohlelo lwe-IDP kufanele abe nolwazi oluphelele ngomhlahlandlela wesithathu ukuze ahlele futhi aluphathe ngempumelelo. Abahleli abangochwepheshe kanye nabagqugquzeli badinga ulwazi olucacile ukuhola inqubo nokukhiqiza imibhalo aqondene. Ungacatshangwa ngasikhathi sini senqubo ye-IDP? Lomhlahlandlela uwumgogodla wesigaba sokuhlela inqubo. Kumele usetshenziswe esigabeni ngasinye sohlelo. Umhlahlandlela IV yibhokisi lamathuluzi elinezikhali ezehlukene zokucwaninga nokusiza ekuthatheni izinqumo kanjalo namasu angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sohlelo. Izikhali aziphoqelelwe futhi ehluka isimo ngesimo somasipala.

Kwakukhona izinhlelo ezahlukene ezazihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokwelashwa, izinhlelo zokuvikela, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubasebenzi bakahulumeni ukuthi bathole usizo lwezempilo olufanele, futhi kwavula amathuba amaningi okuthuthukisa impilo yabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola izimpendulo ezinhle ezivela kubasebenzisi bayo. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni baqala ukubona izinzuzo ezinkulu zokuba ne-GEMS, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokwaziswa ngale mfundiso. Qhubeka uye ekhasini elilandelayo kuphela uma uqinisekile ukuthi yonke imininingwane eqoqiwe yalelo khasi ethile ifakiwe, njengoba imininingwane kuthebula ngalinye izoqinisekiswa ngaphambi kokuthi ukwazi ukuyigcina nokuphrinta. Uma ufuna ukufaka ifomu lokuhlola ngesandla ngaphandle kwefomu elingenalutho, chofoza inkinobho ethi "ifomu elingenalutho" kukhasi eliyinhloko. Le nqubo izoprinta ifomu lokuhlola elingenalutho. Uma usuphelelisa ukuhlola, chofoza inkinobho ethi "Gcina futhi Phrinta ulwazi lwesikole" kukhasi eliyinhloko, uhlelo luzoprinta ifomu lokubala nolwazi olufakile. Uma uphendula "yebo" emcabangweni mayelana nokugcina imininingwane eqoqiwe kwiZikole kwenye ifomu ngendlela engasuswa, isibonelo, i-CD noma i-memory stick, uhlelo luzokhuthaza ukuthi ukhethe indawo. Ikhophi ephephile ingasayinwa kanye nendlela yokugcina ifayela lolwazi oluqoqiwe oluthunyelwe ehhovisi lesifunda. Izikole ezikhethekile: Amathebula 2, 5, 7, no-8 kumele abe nezinombolo eziphelele nolwazi lwezikole olugcwaliswe kuzo zonke izifundo lapho kubhaliswa khona. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi izinombolo kuthebula ngalinye ziqondile ukuze izinombolo eziphelele zihambisane. Izikole ezijwayelekile: Amathebula 3, 7, no-8 kumele abe nezinombolo eziphelele nolwazi lwezikole olugcwaliswe kuzo zonke izifundo lapho kubhaliswa khona. Sicela uqinisekise ukuthi izinombolo kuthebula ngalinye ziqondile ukuze izinombolo eziphelele zihambisane. Uma udinga noma yiluphi uhlobo losizo noma ukwesekwa, sicela uqondise imibuzo yakho ehhovisi elifanele.

Kubhalwe kulo mbhalo futhi kuchazwe kulo mbhalo kwizigaba ezilandelayo. Eminye imiyalelo yami ukuthi uMnu. Houston uyalelwe ukuthi avele phambi kwekhomishani, futhi uzoba ufakazi, lapha uzonikeza noma ibuphi ubufakazi obudingwa kuyena yile khomishani. I-Millennium Declaration ihlinzeka ngethuba lezepolitiki ezisezingeni eliphezulu ezingaphansi kohlaka lokuthuthukiswa kanye nemigomo yokuzinikela enqunyelwe isikhathi. Sizama ukuqala nomkhandlu omele omuntu uthweswe amacala amaningi ngendlela ekubukeka ngayo. Ukuze kufike kwizinga eligunyazwe umthetho kazwelonke, ezinye izintela, nemali yokuthelisa izimpahla. Ingxenye yokuhlola kwethu ukuthi seyihambe ibanga elingakanani imizamo yokuhlanganisa, kumele kube okokubheka ukuthi ingabe ukusebenza kwezohwebo kwesifunda sekushintshe ngendlela ebonakalayo yini. Wonke amazwe ayaqonda ukuziphatha ngokwezomnotho ngendlela yawo njengoba wonke ezibandakanya ekutholeni lokho okuhle ngawo uma kuqhathaniswa nomhlaba ohlangene. Uhulumeni uzobona ukuthi ingabe zikhona yini izigaba zamakhasimende ezingafakwanga kule ntela nokuthi ingabe kumele yini ukuthi intela iqedwe ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile. Amalungu ezinkampani ezicoshela izindaba ayamenywa ekuhlanganeni komhlangano kwesidlo sasekuseni nethimba losomabhizinisi base-New Orleans abaze eThekwini ukuze bafunde okuthile. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukubheka ibanga eselihanjwe iphrojekthi eqaliswa ngaphakathi yiqembu le-ABM, kanye necandelo loMnyango kaMasipala. Kupenda isithombe sempilo sezinhlobo zabantu, ezenhlalo kanye nezomnotho zaseNingizimu Afrika.

Ibandla Labaqondisi Eliphezulu libheka abantu emnyangweni, emizameni yezinguquko njengokuqasha labo ababencishwe amathuba ukuphathwa koMthetho wezoBudlelwane Emsebenzini, 1995, Umthetho Wokulingana Emsebenzini, 1998, Umthetho Wokuthuthukisa Amakhono, 1998 kanye nomunye umthetho ophathelene nabantu. Libhekela nomthetho Wemisebenzi Yomphakathi, 1994, kanye neZimiso Zemisebenzi Yomphakathi, 2001. Ukuhlela ngendlela ekahle kwezindaba zabantu, isibonelo ukuhlela kabusha kanye nokwakhiwa kabusha kwenhlangano. Ukuqashela Umnyango abasebenzi abadingekayo, ukufuna abasebenzi nokubakhetha. Ukusebenzisa kanye nokunakekela abantu, ukuhlola kanye nokubhekela ukwenziwa komsebenzi wabasebenzi, ukuhola kanye nokuqondisa bonke abasebenzi ekwenzeni imisebenzi yabo. Ukuqinisekisa impilo nokuphepha emsebenzini kwabasebenzi eMnyangweni. Ukugcina amarekhodi emininingwane yabasebenzi, isib. Isimo sezimali zabo, isimo somshado, imfundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa. Ukuthola umbhalo wenkantolo, okungamasamanisi, isaziso ngokuzokwenzeka noma isicelo, okuqondene nakho noma ngenye indlela. ukubhekelwa kobuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu obuhambisana nabo obunjengeNdlela Yokukhomba Imibhalo Yeminwe Okuzenzekelayo kanye nobuchwepheshe baMakhadi Ahlakaniphile (Smart Card). ukufakwa kanye nokunakekelwa kwendlela egcwele ye-elekhtronikhi yokulawula ukuhamba yaseHhovisi Eliyinhloko, Amanxusa aseNingizimu Afrika asemazweni aphesheya kanye nasemachwebeni okungena eNingizimu Afrika. wokuthuthwa kwezimpahla kanye nemisebenzi yokwelekelela kumaklayenti angaphakathi.

Sikhumbulile ukuthi ibhola lizongena kanjani enethini? Kunemali eningi ekhokhwa yiMnyango Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe, iMnyango Wezolimo, ama-trusts ahlukene ezitshalo, amabhizinisi ezolimo, izinkampani ezithengisa izinto zokwakha, kanye nezinhlangano ezahlukene ezizama ukuthuthukisa ezolimo eNingizimu Afrika. Kodwa singabuza futhi: yisiphi isiphumo? Ukuthuthukisa nokukhulisa abalimi kuhambisana nokuthuthukisa abantu emhlabeni. Abantu, ikakhulukazi labo abafanele, kumele baphumelele, bakhule, bafunde, futhi bathole ulwazi. Lapho sibheka ukuthuthukisa abalimi, asibheki kuphela ukuthi ubani okhiqiza ukudla okuningi kunezinye; sigxila ekusizeni abanye abalimi ukuba bathole ulwazi oluzobasiza ukuba baqhubeke nokulima ngendlela esekela ukuphila kwabo futhi kulethe inzuzo esikhathini esizayo. Uma sifuna ukwenza umehluko ezimpilweni zabantu, kubalulekile ukubheka umuntu oyedwa ozama. Futhi kumele sibheke labo abasemaphandleni, umphakathi, futhi siqonde ukuthi yiziphi izinsiza zemvelo ezizobasiza - kumele sithuthukise lokhu. Kulula nje ukungena endaweni ethile bese ukhombisa izinto ezingadingekile, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi uzobasiza ukwenza konke abakuthandayo. Kuzokwenzeka ukuthini uma ungaphumeleli ukubasiza? Kumele sithathe izandla zabantu lapho bekhona manje futhi sibakhombise indlela phambili ngokucophelela, kancane, ukuze bajwayele ukuthi imithetho nokuphila kuyashintsha. Kumele sibathumele endaweni abazophila khona ngokuthula, endaweni abakhululekile kuyo (hhayi lapho sithanda khona ukuthi bame)? Inhloso yabantu abaningi ivame ukuba: "okuningi kungcono." Iqiniso, nokho, ukuthi umuntu othile kumele aqale endaweni ethile, noma ngabe kuwumsebenzi omncane.

Zingaba khona nezinye izindlela ongakwazi ukuzisebenzisa. Kubalulekile ukucabanga ngayo yonke imigudu ekhona kuhlangene nebhalwe phansi nengaqoshiwe. Izinhlangano eziningi zinemigudu yazo eziyilandelayo ukufaka izikhalo. Amabhizinisi amaningi ethembele kakhulu ekuzixhumaniseni kahle nomphakathi. Ukukhulumisana nezinhlangano, ukubhalela abamaphephandaba endawo, ukweseka lawo mabhizinisi akhombisa ukunakekela imvelo ngenye yezinto engakunika umphumela owufunayo. Kumele uthathe isinqumo ngalokho ofuna kwenzeke ngaphambi kokuthatha ezinye izinyathelo. Ingxube yalokhu okuchazwe ngenhla. Kubalulekile ukuqiniseka ngokuthi ohlose kufezeke akubukeki njengephupho, akumele uzikhohlise ngento oyibonayo ukuthi iphezulu kakhulu, ayinakwenzeka. Alikho ikhambi lokuthola okufunwayo. Kuyothatha isikhathi esingakanani? Kungenzeka ngikuthole engikufunayo? Yiluphi olunye usizo engingaluthola ngaphandle kolwemali, sikhuluma ngolufana nokunikwa ulwazi lokuqiniseka ngomphumela oyiwo? Kuvame ukuba wusizo ukubuza abanye abantu ngezinye izindlela ezitholakalayo zokusombulula inkinga. Kungenzeka ukuthi abanye abantu sebeke bahlangabezane nesimo esifuze lesi futhi banemibono emihle. Buza amammeli bezemvelo noma abantu abasebenza endaweni yokuvikela imvelo. Ummeli wezemvelo angakusiza ukuqoka umgudu omuhle kakhulu ohambisana neNEMA. Abammeli bangakusiza futhi uma ufuna ukuya enkantolo. Uma unquma ukuthatha izinyathelo, kungaba ngezomthetho noma olunye uhlobo, ngokwakho noma ngokusizwa wubungoti babathize, kubalulekile ukukhumbula ukuthi yisikhalo sakho lesi futhi nguwe okumele uthathe izinqumo ngenqubo. Ukuthola ulwazi nemininingwane eminingi kukubeka esimweni esilula sokuthatha izinqumo.

Umculo - Uhlanga Oluhle Lokuhlanganyela Nempilo Umculo ungumkhakha obalulekile empilweni yomuntu, unikeza amandla, uthokozisa, futhi uvuselela imizwa. Kusukela ezinsukwini zokuqala zomphakathi, umculo ube yindlela yokuxhumana, ukuxoxa izindaba, nokuhlonipha izinkolo. Ngalesi sikhathi, umculo ungaphezu kokukhuthaza; ungumthombo wokwelapha, ubuchwepheshe bokukhuluma, nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umculo Njengendlela Yokuzwakalisa Imizwa Ukuzwakalisa imizwa kuyinto eyinhloko yomculo. Imizwelo ehlukahlukene iboniswa ngezingoma ezithile, ezithinta inhliziyo yomlistener. Umculi, ngokusebenzisa izwi lakhe, amathoni, namazwi, udala umhlaba ophilayo lapho abathandi bomculo bengakwazi ukuzifaka khona. Izinkanyezi zomculo ezifana noMiriam Makeba noHugh Masekela zikhombisa ukuthi umculo ungaba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezinzima, njengezinkinga zomphakathi, uthando, nokuphila. Ubuciko Bokuhlanganisa Izinhlobo Zomculo Umculo ungumkhakha ogcwele izinhlobo ezahlukene. Kukhona umculo wesintu, umculo wepop, nezinye izinhlobo eziningi. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kwezinhlobo zenza umculo ube yinkanyezi, uhlanganisa izizinda ezahlukene. Umculo wesintu, ngokwesibonelo, ubonisa ubuciko bendabuko, lapho izinsimbi zesiZulu zisetshenziswa khona ukudala umculo ophilayo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, umculo wepop uhlanganisa izitayela ezithokozisayo, ezivame ukudlalwa emicimbini nasematheni.
