Loludaba sizalubhekisisa kuwo lomnyaka ukuze senze umsebenzi wamaphoyisa ubelula siphinde sikhuthaze ukusebenzisana phakathi kwabonogada namaphoyisa ukuze umphakathi uthole ukulondolozeka njengemfanelo. Sizakuqhubeka sifake umfutho ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwezinkantolo zethu, siphinde senze ukuthi amacala amile angathethwa aphuthunywe athethwe.

Ngenxa yalokho, isoya ingumthombo olungile wamaphrotheni, phakathi kwezinhlobo eziningi zokudla, ikakhulukazi ukubonelela abantu abangayidli inyama kepha abadla imifino yodwa noma abantu abafuna ukunciphisa inyama abayidlayo. Amaphrotheni esoya empeleni ayafana nembewu yeminye imidumba. Ngaphezu kwalokho ubhontshisi wesoya uyakwazi ukukhiqiza okungenani amaphrotheni aphindaphindwe kabili ngehekthari ngalinye kunanoma yisiphi isitshalo esingumfino noma esiyizinhlamvu esivamile. Ngehekthare ngalinye amaphrotheni lawa aba ngaphezulu ngokuphindaphindwe kahlanu kuye kokulishumi ngomhlaba obekelwe ukuba ngamadlelo ezilwane ezisengwayo futhi amaphrotheni ngehektare ngalinye aphindaphindwa ngokuyi-15 kunomhlaba obekelwe ukukhiqiza inyama. Ukusetshenziswa kwesoya kunganciphisa nengozi yokungenwa ngumdlavuza ohlasela ithumbu elikhulu. Ubhontshisi wesoya uyisitshalo esibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele, esinika uwoyela namaphrotheni. E-United States, ubuningi balesi sitshalo buhluzwa kwisincibilikisi kusetshenziswa i-hexane, kuthi impuphu yesoya esuswe amafutha "egazingiwe" (ama-50% amaphrotheni) inikeze ikhono lokuthi isetshenziselwe ukukhulisa izilwane zasepulazini (isib. izinkukhu, izingulube namakalikuni) okwenzeka ngokwezinga lebhizinisi elingakaze libonakale ngaphambilini. Ingxenye encane impela yesitshalo lesi edliwa ngabantu. Imikhiqizo kabhontshisi wesoya, iyatholakala ezinhlotsheni ezahlukahlukene zokudla okucolisiwe.

Iqembu libizwa ngokuthi Uphuzane. Le ndawo yePhuzane itholakala enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal uma uhamba amakhilomitha angama-25 usuka ePaulpietersburg, eduze komfula obizwa ngeBivane River. Lapha ngempela kusemaphandleni futhi akukho okukhuluma ngakho ngesiNgisi njengezinsiza (amathuluzi okutshala nokulima, ukuthutha, ukuthenga nokuthengisa, noma yini). Abalimi nabo abanamakhono nolwazi lokulima bodwa. Kuleli qembu lokufunda, kukhona abakhiqizi besilisa nabesifazane abakhuthalele ukufunda nokwandisa inzuzo yabo, okuzothuthukisa impilo yabo futhi kube nomthelela omuhle ezinsizeni zemvelo ezikhona. Okwamanje, abakhiqizi basebenzisa amahektare angama-70 angalimiwa, kodwa kusekhona izindawo eziningi ezingalimiwe ezingenza umkhiqizo. Kungani kukhona izinkundla ezingalimiwe? Izizathu zokungaklami kulezo zindawo zihlala zikhona ezomnotho, ngoba izinkundla eziningi zikhona ezwenikazi, futhi amabhange nabanye abanikazi bezikweletu bayazithoba ukunikela le mali ngoba abanakuqinisekisa ukuthi bazoyithola le mali emuva kokuphuma. Enye inkinga imishini; abalimi abanamatractor nezinye izinto. Iqembu lihlangana nini? Iqembu lihlangana kanye ngenyanga ukuze lixoxe ngezinkinga zamalungu nezindlela zokusebenzisa izinsiza zawo ezincane. Yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba yilungu leli qembu lokufunda? Ngithole ukumangala okukhulu lapho ngiya ukubona lokho abakwenza; ngathola ukuthi basebenzisa izindlela zokulima zesimanje ukuze bakhiqize (ukulima ngaphandle kokulima) ngempumelelo ngo-2009/2010. Lo nyaka baqala ukutshala ngaphandle kokulima besebenzisa indlela yokulima ngaphandle kokulima futhi bathola umkhiqizo ophakeme kunowonyaka odlule.

Bamba iqhaza ngokuxhumana nomphathi wakho wesigaba, ukuze wenze indawo yakho yokuhlala iphephe. Kubizwa osomabhizinisi bendawo, amabandla, izinhlangano zabahlali kanye nabaholi bomphakathi ukubamba iqhaza emizamweni yokubhekana nezimpawu ezifake okuthile ebugebengwini esigabeni sakho. I-NAFVSA inoHlangothi Lokusiza umphakathi, oluhlinzeka zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi lezo ezibuya emiphakathini ebikhishwe inyumbazana ngaphambilini ngolwazi nezidingo. Ngokwakha ubudlelwano nezinye izikhungo ezenza amafilimu, lo mnyango uzama ukufinyelela kubona bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Inqolobane kazwelonke egcina ulwazi lwamafilimu, amavidiyo, nokulalelwayo okuqoshiwe ibambe iqhaza emikhankasweni eminingana. Izikhungo zemfundo ziyamenywa ukuba zibuke amafilimu bese kuxoxwa nganoma isiphi isihloko ezicabanga ukuthi kunesidingo sokuba sidingidwe. Lokhu kuye kwenziwe ngokuxhumana nothisha nabafundisi. Inhloso enkulu yalolu hlangothi olusiza umphakathi ukuletha "izindawo ezibukisa ngamafilimu kubantu", okuyoba yinzuzo emiphakathini. Lokhu kwenziwa ngokusebenzisana nezinye izinhlaka njengezikole, izimboni ezifanelekile, amabandla, izinhlangano zomphakathi kanye nomphakathi jikelele. I-NAFVSA iphokophelela ukufinyelela emiphakathini yasezindaweni zasemakhaya engazi ukuthi le nqolobane eyokwenzani njengalokhu nayo inamalungelo okuthola ulwazi. I-NAFVSA iqonde ukusebenzisa Izikhungo Zobuciko Zomphakathi, ezakhiwa nguMnyango Wobuciko Namasiko ukugcwalisekisa le njongo.

Isithombe 1: I-header ejikayo emaphakathi ibonisa ukuthi kukhona ukujikeleza okuningi okwenzeka ekugcineni lapho amanzi ehla khona. Khumbula ukuthi ingaphandle kwe-header ihamba ibanga elide ngaphambi kokufika lapho iqala khona, ngakho amanzi amaningi aphonswa ekugcineni kwezinsika. I-sprinkler yokuqala eyayikwazi ukuhamba yona ngokwayo yatholakala ngo-1948 futhi yapatentwa ngo-1952 nguFrank Zybach e-Eastern Colorado e-United States of America. Lokhu kwaba isisekelo semishini yamanje enama-header ajikayo nalawo ahamba ngokuqonda. Zingakwazi ukujikeleza amanzi ngendlela elawulwayo. Zisebenza ngamandla azo ngaphandle kokudinga abantu abaningi ukuba zisebenze. Zijikeleza izindawo ezinkulu kahle. Zingajikeleza ngendlela eshibhile futhi zingafaka umanyolo ohlangene namanzi ukuze izinhlobo ezahlukene zomhlabathi zikhululwe. I-header ejikayo inama-framing nezinsimbi ezisekelwa njalo emametheni angu-50 ngama-framing ahamba ezinsikeni ezimbili. Lokhu kuqinisa i-header endaweni ethile ngoba zonke ezinye izingxenye ezihambayo zixhunywe kule header. I-header ikakhulukazi yakhiwe ngensimbi enkulu ethumela amanzi, i-framing esekela insimbi, kanye nemishini ehambisa konke. Ubude be-span abudingi ukuba bube yinto efanayo ngoba kuzodingeka bube bufushane noma bube bukhulu kuye ngesisindo somhlaba noma isimo somhlabathi. Le nsimbi encane inama-sprinkler aqinile axhunywe ngamakhebuli athambile ekugcineni kwe-span ukuze kukhuphuke indawo ejikelezwayo. Ama-sprinkler aphumelela kakhulu angafakwa nasekugcineni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukujikeleza kahle ngisho nasezikhoneni. Ama-header ajikayo angadlula ubude obungama-1,000 metres.

Ukuhlela kabusha umthetho wezwe wezemigwaqo ukuze kuqondiswe amagama futhi kuhlelwe kabusha incazelo ethile ukuze kwandiswe ulwazi olungafakwa ezinhlinzweni ezitholakala kumgomo wezwe wezemigwaqo; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lokuhlela; ukunciphisa inani lezinqubo ezidingekayo ngumthetho; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukukhetha iziphathimandla zokuhlela ezidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuhamba eziboardini ezifanele; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezokuhamba lwezwe kanye nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezokuhamba zamaphondo; ukususa izimo eziphathelene nezikhumbuzo zomphakathi zamanje; izindlela zokulawula ezisebenzayo, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngemicabango ethile nezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe; ukwengeza izikhathi ezithile; ukuhlinzeka ngamacategori amasha ezimoto angasetshenziswa ezinsizeni zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukwengeza ukuhlinzekwa kwemvume yokusebenza, ukwengeza imisebenzi yeziphathimandla zokulawula ukusebenzisa izimvume; ukujula ezimotweni ezingasetshenziswa ohambweni olude; ukuhlinzeka ngoshintsho lwezimvume zokusebenza; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukusetha izindinganiso zamamitha ezitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha nokuvumela amaMEC ukuthola izakhiwo zokukhokha izitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha, ukudala izimo zokwabelana ngemvume yokusebenza kwezinsizakalo zabavakashi; ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yesikhashana yezimoto ezithile; ukudala amacala amasha; nokwenza izinguquko kumadokhumenti; ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. "Ibhasi" lisho imoto eyakhelwe, noma eyakhelwe ngokomthetho ukuze ifanele, ngumkhiqizi obhalisiwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1989 Umthetho No. 29 ka-1989; "Umimporter" ubonisa umuntu obhalisiwe ukuze athumele ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1996 Umthetho No.

Kodwa, akukho gunya lokubhekana nebhidi enjena. Uma ibhidi inakwa, bobabili abacwaningi Bezimali kuZwelonke Nakusifundazwe bazokwaziswa bese benikezwa izinsuku ezingama-60 ukuthi bafake imibono ebhalwe phansi kanye neziphakamiso, ezizobhekwa ngaphambi kokuba umasipala enze izinqumo sanoma yikuphi ukuzimisela. Ukusuka kunoma yiziphi iziphakamiso Zomcwaningi Zimali kuZwelonke, kanye nezizathu zokusuka, zizokwaziswa emhlanganweni webandla olandelayo. Kunganayeki ukubhekwa kwanoma yiziphi izidingo ezibekiwe ngezansi, umasipala akaphoqelelwe ukuvuma noma yiyiphi ikhotheshini noma ibhidi etholiwe. Amanani afaka i-VAT. Wonke amakhotheshini ayinani eliphakathi kwama-R5,000 kanye nama-R100,000 lizakunqunywa yi-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu (i-CFO). I-CFO izakwenza njengokwemibiko ebhaliwe elungiselelwe nguMenenja Wezezimali, kumakhotheshini ayinani elingaphezu kwama-R30,000, emva kokubheka intengo yohlelo lwamaphuzu akhethiwe Okunikeza Amandla Kwabansundu Kwezomnotho Okwesekwe Ngokubanzi. Ikhotheshini ehambisana nencasiselo izakuvunywa, uma nje i-Ofisa yezezimali Ephezulu, ngokuxhumana nenhloko yomnyango ofanele, yenelisekile ukuthi inikeza inani eligcono kakhulu lemali yomasipala nokuthi imali eyanele ikhona ebhajethini elifanele. Uma kwenzeka ukuthi kungabikho khotheshini efanelekile yencasiselo.

Ukuhlangabezana nezinkinga, kungagcini kuphela ngokwaba isamba esikhulu semali sokuvala umonakalo. Kuthuthuka izinga lentando yeningi, kanjalo nezinguquko esikhungweni ngoba izinqumo zithathwa ngendlela yentando yeningi nengafihlekile. Lesi simo asifani nalapho izinqumo zithathwa khona yidlanzana. Ukugqugquzela ukuhlanganiswa kwezindawo zasemakhaya nezasemadolobheni, iqhaza lamathimba ehlukene abhekene nenhlalonhle, indawo okuhlala nokusebenza kuyo abantu, njalonjalo. Ukukhuthaza inqubo yokwaba kabusha izinsiza ngendlela yokubonisana. Ukukhuthaza izinga lokubambisana nezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni. Ukugqugquzela uhlelo lokuxhumana nokusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlaka zezindawo, izifundazwe nezikahulumeni kazwelonke. Izinsiza eziningi zezimali emisebenzini zitholakala eminyangweni ehlukene. Uma ingekho I-IDP, umasipala uyosebenza njengesizinda sesikhashana, ngendlela engekho emthethweni nengahlelekile kahle nengaholela ekuphindekeni nasekusaphazekeni kwezinsiza ezivele ziyindlala. Ngaphezu kwalokhu, ukwentuleka kwesikhali esingumasipala esilawula intuthuko kungaholela kwezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni ukuba ziphoqelele ezazo izinhlelo zentuthuko. Kungenzeka lesi senzo singaqhakambisi lokhu okuyizidingonqangi zaleyondawo. Ngubani okufanele abambe iqhaza, futhi kungani? Amakhansela kufanele abe ngamakhanda enqubo ye-IDP. I-IDP ayisiso nje kuphela isikhali sokuthatha izinqumo kodwa iqukethe izidingo zemiphakathi ewavotele nezifiso zayo. Amakhansela kumele abambe iqhaza ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izindaba ezithinta imiphakathi ayimele ziyacutshungulwa futhi zibhekelwe.

Izinselelo Zokuthenga E-Shoprite Nokho, kunezinselelo ezithile ezibhekene nabathengi. Okokuqala, izindleko zomsebenzi ezihambisana nezokuthenga ziya zikhuphuka, okwenza kube nzima kubathengi abathile. Kubonakala sengathi abanye abathengi kufanele baqaphele izindleko ezithile ezikhuphukayo, okwenza kube necala. Okwesibili, kukhona impikiswano mayelana nephalethi yeShoprite nezimpahla ezibizayo ezithengiswa. I-Shoprite ikhuluma kakhulu ngalesi sihloko, kodwa abanye bahlongoza ukuthi izimpahla zikhuphuka kanjani eminyakeni ethile, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola imikhiqizo engabizi. Okokugcina, ubukho beShoprite emiphakathini yezezimali bunomthelela omubi ezitolo ezincane. Njengoba iShoprite iqhubeka nokwethula imikhiqizo emisha, izitolo ezincane ziba sengozini yokuntuleka. Lokhu kuholela empikiswaneni emiphakathini yethu, njengoba izitolo ezincane zikhuthaza ukuhweba okuhlukahlukene. Isiphetho Ngokuvamile, iShoprite iyindawo ebalulekile yokuthenga, kodwa iphakamisa imibuzo eminingi. Yize inezinzuzo ezinkulu, njengezintengo eziphansi nezimpahla eziningi, ubukhona bayo buveza isidingo sokuxazulula izinselelo ezithile, njengezindleko eziphakeme nezinqwaba ezithile. Lokhu kuqonda kubalulekile ukuze sithole indlela eziteshi ezinkulu ezithinta ngayo izitolo emiphakathini yethu. Ngakho, sizoba nekhono lokuhola imikhankaso ehlukanisayo ekuphileni kweShoprite.

Ngeshwa, umThetho waseNingizimu Afrika awubaniki abalamuli ilungelo lokwenqaba ukuveza ubufakazi enkantolo ngolwazi abaluthole ngesikhathi belamula. Uma kuqhutshwa izinto zomphakathi ilungelo elisebenza kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana ezisetshenziswa ukuqeda izinxushunxushu lingasetshenziswa. Izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zingakusebenzisa lokho ngokuthi zivume ukuthi zonke izinhlobo zokuxhumana eziyingxenye yenqubo yokulamula ezingayisebenzisa. Uma kubhekwa ubulelesi ilungelo elinjalo angeke lisebenze uma umlamuli ebizwa ukuthi azothula ubufakazi. Ngokuvamile, ngokomthetho umlamuli akudingekile ukuthi abe neziqu ezithile zemfundo, kodwa kubalulekile ukuthi umlamuli ayiqonde kahle imigomo ephathelene nokulamula kanjalo nemithetho eyengamele ukuziphatha njengomthetho obizwa ngokuthi yi 'audi alterem partem'.

Sibheka isixazululo, sendawo, esifundazweni, kanye nokubamba iqhaza esifundeni njengendlela yokubhekana nesimo. Idolobha elikhulu elingu-9 eNingizimu Afrika lakhe amanethiwekhi okuxhumana ukuze wabelane ngemininingwane futhi uthole izixazululo ezintsha zokushintsha ezindaweni. Ezingxoxweni ezandulele, kwacaca ukuthi ukuphathwa kanye nokukwazi ukuphatha kubalulekile ekwenzeni inzuzo emikhiqizweni yobisi. Sizibophezele ekuqhubekeni nokugxila ezokuphepha, ukuthuthukisa ukuthuthwa kwezimoto nezinye izinsiza, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, ukuhamba komoya, okuhlangenwe nakho kwezamasiko, kanye nokuhlukahluka kwemikhiqizo. Abasolwa baphathe ithuba lokudubula umphathi uma engakhiphi umfundi. Ngithumele isicelo sokukhokha ngesikhathi esithile futhi saphakanyiswa, kwathi ngemuva kwalokho ngakhipha imali. Abamnyama nabamhlophe bakhethwe kulokho, kangangokuthi izilwane ezibomvu zakhishwa ngesikhathi sokubhaliswa. Ngokufanayo, kuphela iNkantolo Ephakeme engavimba ingane ukuba ibhekwane nomgibeli wayo. Waphuma ngemuva kwesango elikhulu, wama okwesikhashana, wabe esangena ngaphakathi. Kodwa ekugcineni, kwakhuluma ngokuthi ukuhamba kwephutha kuhlehliswe kusuka eTaipei. Ngicabanga ukuthi kujwayelekile emidlalweni yezeMidlalo ukuthola amathikithi endaweni. IKabinet izobamba umhlangano ukuze ichaze isikhungo somsebenzi kahulumeni ezokhulumela kuZwelonke. Umpetha ophakeme kuleli cala elihlobene nokuphikiswa uthole udumo olukhethekile njengokuhlonishwa. Amasteshini amaningi emsakazo eNtshonalanga Kapa asiza ukukhuthaza ukuhweba futhi lokho kufanele kusekelwe.

Umbuzo 4: Yini eyenziwa ukuvikela abantu ezikhukhuleni? Ukuze kuvikwe abantu ezikhukhuleni, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuphendula ezisheshayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlala ezikhukhuleni, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuhlala, kanye nokwakha izikhungo zokuhlala eziphuthumayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu kufanele baqeqeshelwe izindlela zokuphuma ezindaweni ezithintekile, futhi kube nezinhlelo zokwazisa umphakathi ngezikhathi zokukhukhula. Umbuzo 5: Kanjani umphakathi ungabamba iqhaza ekuvikelweni ezikhukhuleni? Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuvikelweni ezikhukhuleni. Kubalulekile ukuba abantu babe nolwazi ngezingozi ezihambisana nezikhukhula. Lokhu kungafinyelelwa ngokwenza imihlangano yokwazisa, ukwakha amaqembu okusebenza, kanye nokuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa. Umphakathi kufanele ube nezinqubomgomo zokuphila eziphephile, futhi uthumele izixwayiso uma kunemvula enkulu. Umbuzo 6: Yini okufanele ikwenziwe ukuze kuhlale kuqinisekiswa ukuvikeleka kwabantu? Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvikeleka kwabantu, kubalulekile ukuba kube nezinhlelo eziqhubekayo zokuhlola izimo zezulu. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka zomphakathi, uhulumeni, nezikhungo ezizimele kubalulekile. Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile mayelana nezimo zezulu, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo ezinzima zokuphendula, kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela umonakalo omkhulu. Umbuzo 7: Yini engakwenziwa ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula? Ukuze kuncishiswe umthelela wezikhukhula, kubalulekile ukwakha izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwakha izinqwaba zamanzi, ukulawula ukuhamba kwamanzi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokulawulwa kwemvula.

Ekugcineni, ukuhlukaniswa kwamalungu ancike kwabanye ku-GEMS kube yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yabantu abaningi. Kule ndaba, sithole izifundo eziningi, futhi sikhumbula ukuthi izinsizakalo zempilo zibalulekile, kodwa ukufundisa abantu nokuhlinzeka ngolwazi olunembile kubalulekile kakhulu. Njengoba siqhubeka nokwakha umphakathi onempilo, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuxhumana, sifundise, futhi sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphathe kahle izinsizakalo zabo. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni impilo engcono kubo bonke, futhi kuzokwenza umphakathi wethu ube ngcono.

Ukunqunywa kwezinzuzo nokufaneleka kwe-GEMS Ekuqaleni kweminyaka ye-2000, izinhlelo zokwelashwa zashintsha ngokukhulu. Umphakathi wawudinga izixazululo ezithile ezizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abaningi. Ngaleso sikhathi, kwavulwa i-Government Employees Medical Scheme (GEMS), uhlelo lokwelashwa olwakhelwe ngempela ukuze lusebenze kubasebenzi bakahulumeni. I-GEMS yayihloselwe ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zempilo ezithuthukile, ikakhulukazi kubasebenzi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yathola udumo olukhulu ngenxa yokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kodwa lokhu kwaholela ekubeni nemibuzo eminingi mayelana nokufaneleka kwabantu kanye nezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Abasebenzi bakahulumeni babefuna ukuqonda kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo ezithile, futhi lokhu kwaholela ekwakhekeni kwemigomo ethile yokunquma ukufaneleka. Ukwenziwa kwemigomo yokunquma ukufaneleka kwe-GEMS kwaba yisinyathelo esibalulekile. Kwakudingeka ukuthi kube nezindlela ezicacile ezizokwazi ukusiza abantu ukuthi baqonde kahle ukuthi bangathola kanjani izinzuzo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kwamadokhumenti ahlukanisayo, aphakamisa izimfuno ezithile okufanele zifezekiswe ukuze umuntu akwazi ukujabulisa izinzuzo ze-GEMS. Lokhu kwahlanganisa izinga lemfundo, iminyaka yokusebenza, kanye nezinye izimo ezithinta ukufaneleka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-GEMS yahlanganisa izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene zokuhlola ukufaneleka. Lokhu kwavumela abantu ukuthi baqonde ukuthi izinsizakalo ezitholakalayo zifaneleka kubo yini. Umphakathi wawudinga ukwazi ukuthi izinzuzo ezifana nezokwelapha, izinsizakalo zokuhlola, kanye nezinsizakalo zokwelashwa zikhona yini kubo.

Sineqoqo lesibili lemibuzo esizokubuza yona maduzane nje, yona ke egxile kakhulu empilweni yakho. Ingabe bekukhona omunye umuntu ngesikhathi sengxoxo mibuzo? Ukubone kunjani ukucophelela komhlinzeki mininingwane ekuphenduleni? Yimiphi imibuzo umhlinzeki mininingwane ayithole ilukhuni, imbangela amahloni kumbe imdida? Yimiphi imibuzo wena mbuzi mibuzo oyithole ilukhuni, kubangela amahloni kumbe ikudida?

Ukuphikiswa иkuhlelo lwe-Common Agricultural Policy, umthetho ophathelene nezolimo kanye nezinsizakusebenza, kudala ubunzima ekuphathweni kwezimali zakwa-EU. Kulokhu, izinkampani nezwe lonke kumele ziqhube izinhlelo eziphumelelayo ukuze ziphumelelayo ezicini zemvelo. I-EU ibuye ibe neqhaza elikhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthokoziswa kokubambisana kwabantu. Izinselelo zomhlaba, njengezinguquko zesimo sezulu, zithinta wonke umuntu, ngakho wonke amazwe adinga ukusebenza ndawonye ukuze kuqedwe lezi zinto ezimbi. Lokhu kudinga ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezizwe, ukuze kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokuhlala bekhuthazwa, nokuthuthukisa umsebenzi oyinsakavukela. Ngenhloso yokwandisa indawo yokusebenza, i-European Union ibeke izijobelelo ezithile, njengezinhlelo zokwakha umphakathi ezenzakalayo, ezibhekiswe ekwandiseni izinga lezempilo, imfundo, nobuchwepheshe. I-‘Digital Single Market’ iyisibonelo esihle salokhu, ibhekisa kokukwamukelwa kwezinsizakalo ze-inthanethi zokuhweba nokuxhumana. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi abantu basebenzisane kalula, cushioni izithiyo ezizwakalayo, futhi kuthuthukiswe ubumba bemiphakathi. Ekugcina, i-European Union ibalulekile ngezinhloso zayo zokuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazwe, umnotho, namalungelo abantu. Ngeke nje isebenzise izimali, kodwa iphinde ihlaziye kunoma yikuphi ukuphikisana okukhona phakathi kwamazwe. Ukuzama okuhle kwabazali bayo kugxila ekuthuthukiseni umphakathi oswazini, okuqinisekisa ukuthi umphakathi waneliseka ngezidingo zawo. Isikhathi esizayo se-European Union sikhombisa ukusagejiswa ezinhlelweni ezivuma izidingo zami nezilwane, nokuthuthukiswe ngqa umhlaba kubantu bonke.

Impuphu esele kabhontshisi wesoya isetshenziswa kakhulukazi njengokudla kwezilwane. Impuphu kabhontshisi wesoya iba yinsalela etholakala ngemuva kokumuncwa kukawoyela ezingcwecwaneni zikabhontshisi wesoya ngesincibilikisi, kanti iba nama-50% amaphrotheni esoya. Impuphu "iyagazingwa" (okuyigama elinganembi nse ngoba ukushiswa lokhu kwenziwa ngesisi esimanzi) bese igaywa ngensimbi yokugaya. Impuphu kabhontshisi wesoya ingumkhiqizo obalulekile wendlela yokukhiqiza yabaseMelika yokukhulisa izilwane zasepulazini ezifana nezinkukhu nezingulube ngokwesilinganiso sezimboni ezikhiqizayo ezaqala ngeminyaka ye1930; kanti esikhathini esisanda kwedlula ibalulekile nasekwandisweni kwezinhlanzi ezingathi zinamadevu amade. Ama-98% ezitshalo zikabhontshisi wesoya e-U.S asetshenziselwa ukondla imfuyo. Ufulawa kabhontshisi wesoya ngubhontshisi wesoya osuswe amafutha wacolisiswa ngokwenele ukuze ukwazi ukwedlula esihluzweni esinesikrini esiyi-100 noma ngaphansi kwalokho lapho kuye kwacoshelelwa ngesikhathi kumuncwa (kungagazingwa) ukuze kuncitshiswe ukuguqulwa kwesimo semvelo samaphrotheni khona kuzogcineka iSilinganiso Sokusaphazeka Kwamaphrotheni esiphezulu (i-Protein Dispersibility Index - i-PDI), ukuze sisetshenziselwe ukupheka ngokukhipha amaphrotheni emifino ezwakala kamnandi esandleni. Ufulawa wesoya utholakala ezingcwecwaneni ezikhishwe amafutha neziqukethe uwoyela ongaphansi kwe-1%.

Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene, kubandakanya uhulumeni, othisha, abazali, kanye nomphakathi, kubalulekile ukuze sifinyelele imigomo yethu. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemfundo yezingane ezisencane kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile nelinempilo. Izinyathelo Ezilandelayo - Ukuphakanyiswa kokwakhiwa kweqembu elihlanganisa bonke abathintekayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuhle. - Ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yokusebenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izinguquko zenqubomgomo zisebenza. - Ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi wonke umuntu uyazi ngalezi zinguquko. Ngalezi zinguquko, sizobe sihlose ukwakha uhlelo lwezemfundo oluqinile noluhambisana nezidingo zezingane ezisencane, ukuze zibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yomphakathi.

Inhloso yalombiko kanye nokusebenza kwengqalasizinda yokuphatha izilwandle ephakanyisiwe kuxhomeke kumaphuzu akhulunywe ngemininingwane ngenhla. Lesi sigaba sichaza imigomo nezivumelwano, futhi siphinde sibe umthetho ozosiza ekuhumusheni kwalombiko, sikhanyisa indima kahulumeni ekuphathweni kwezilwandle, futhi sichaze ukuthi lo mbiko uhambelana nani futhi ubathinteka kanjani. Lo mthetho ophumelele kufanele ufundwe kanye nomthetho wezokuphatha imvelo kazwelonke, futhi lo mbiko uphinde uchaze ukuthi kufanele kwenziwe kanjani uma kungahambisani nalomthetho nakwezinye. Lo mthetho uhambelana nokusungulwa komthetho ophathelene nokusetshenziswa kwezilwandle ngumphakathi, kanye nemithetho ethinta izilwandle. Indawo yezilwandle ichazwa ngemininingwane ephathelene nendawo yokuqala (isigaba sokuqala), indawo esesigabeni sezilwandle esisetshenziswa umphakathi ukuze azijabulise futhi athole inzuzo ezilwandle (indawo yokuvikela yezilwandle). Kukhona nezindawo ezivikelwe ezilwandle. Phakathi nendawo yezilwandle, kukhona indawo eyinsundu nol

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uhlelo lwePhalamende lwaqala ukuveza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Kubalulekile ukuveza ukuthi iPhalamende alikhona nje kuphela njengendawo yokuxoxa, kodwa futhi njengesikhungo sokwakha. Ngalesi sikhathi, abanye abantu baqala ukufuna ukufaka izwi labo emigomeni, ukuze baqhamuke nezixazululo. IPhalamende laqala ukuba yindawo yokuhlanganyela, lapho izinkulumo zikhula zaba izimpendulo, ziqhamuka nemibono emisha. Nokho, akukhona konke okulungile. Izinkinga zaba khona. Abantu bahlala bephikisana, bekhuluma ngezinkinga ezinzima, bezama ukuthola izixazululo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwakhiweni kokuxoxisana okujulile, lapho abantu behlangana bezama ukuqonda izikhala eziphakathi kwabo. IPhalamende lasendaweni yalo waba yindawo yokuxoxa ngaphezulu kwezinkinga, kuhlangana izimvo ezahlukahlukene ezazivela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwenza kube lula abantu ukuba babone ukuthi, nakuba bekhona amanxeba, ubuhlobo phakathi kwabantu bokuqala baphinde bukhule. Njengoba izinkanyezi ziqhubeka nokukhanya, abantu baqala ukubona izinzuzo. Izinhlelo ezintsha zaziphuma, imikhankaso yayiqala, abantu bahlala bephakamisa izwi labo. Ukuze iPhalamende iyenze kahle, kwadingeka ubuhlakani, lapho izinsiza ezikhethiwe zenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle. Ngenxa yalokho, abaphathi bahlala bephokophele ukwenza okungcono, behlola izindlela zokwakha ukuxhumana okuhle. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iPhalamende yathola izifundo zempilo. Izinkumbulo ezinhle zathuthukiswa, abantu baziwa ngezigameko ezinjalo. Kwakukhona imizamo yokugcina ubudlelwano, ukuhamba phambili. Lokhu kwabaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezinzima, kodwa ezidingekayo.

Njengoba lolu hlelo luqhubeka, ngithemba ukuthi sizoletha usizo nempilo engcono kubaningi. Ngithanda ukuvakashela olwandle nokukhuluma nabangane bami. NJENGOBA uMnyango uzame ngazo zonke izindlela ukunciphisa ukungondleki kule ndawo, kubalulekile ukuzivikela uma uhamba, ikakhulukazi engxenyeni enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal. Ukuvikelwa okuhle kakhulu yikho okungakwenza ngokwakho ngoba izimpukane zisebenza kakhulu ebusuku. Kukhona amaphilisi ongawath

Uma isicelo sakho sihlangabezana nazo zonke izimfuneko zokubhaliswa, uzonikezwa usuku lwesicelo sakho nenombolo. Zonke izingxoxo nehhavisi zizobhekisela kulenombolo yesicelo. Nakuba kungathatha kuze kube yizinyanga eziyi-18 ukubhaliswa komkhiqizo, ungakwazi ukuwusebenzisa njengoba uthola inombolo yesicelo sakho. Uma uphawu lwakho lwamukelwa ngaphandle kokuphikiswa, ungakwazi ukukhangisa ngalo kwi-Patent Journal, ephephandabeni elikhishwa ngenyanga nguMphakathi Wezokuphrinta. Abantu emphakathini banikezwa izinyanga ezintathu zokuphikisa isicelo. Ungaxhumana nezikhungo zokuxhumana ze-dti ngenombolo elandelayo:. Khokha ebhange usebenzisa ikhodi yokubhekisela. Kungathatha iminyaka emibili ukuze kubhaliswe uphawu.

Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Kwakukhanya ilanga elihle eMphakathini waseMzimkhulu. Umoya wawupholile, futhi abantu bejabulile, bekhuluma ngezinto ezinhle ezenzakalayo emsebenzini. UThandi, umphakathi wezokwakha, wayephakathi kwalezi zinsuku ezijabulisayo. Waziwa njengomsebenzi oncomekayo, onobuchule obukhulu, futhi engakaze aphuthelwe ithuba lokwenza kahle. Njengoba uThandi ehamba emsebenzini, wayecabanga ngempumelelo yakhe. Wazi kahle ukuthi imiklomelo ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela ukuze uthole imali, kodwa futhi ukuze uqashelwe ngempela. UThandi wayenombono wokuthi abantu kufanele bahlonishwe ngemisebenzi yabo, futhi lokhu kwaba yisizathu sokuthi azame njalo ukwenza kahle. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingu-30 zokusebenza kanzima, umphakathi wathi uzokwenza umcimbi wokuhlonipha abasebenzi abavelele. UThandi wayejabule kakhulu, ngoba wayeziqhenya ngempumelelo yakhe. Umphakathi wawuhlela imiklomelo ezahlukene, kuhlanganise neziqu ezihloniphekile, izitifiketi, kanye nemali yokwengeza. Umcimbi wenzeka endaweni enkulu, lapho abantu behlangana khona ukuze bajabulele. UThandi wayebona abanye abasebenzi bejabulile, bejolisa emiklomelweni yabo. Kwakukhona uNandi, owayengumsebenzi wezokupheka, noMusa, owayengumsebenzi wezokwakha. Bobabili babevele bahlonishwa ngempumelelo yabo, futhi uThandi wayejabula ngokubona abanye behlonishwa. Lapho umcimbi uqala, umphakathi wakhuluma ngezinto ezinhle ezenzakalayo. Umholi wendawo, uMnumzane Khumalo, wakhuluma ngokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi. Wathi: “Abasebenzi bethu bayisibopho sokwakha umphakathi onempilo. Ngaphandle kwabo, asizukwazi ukufinyelela phezulu.

Kwenzakani uma Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka wephulwa? Uma uMmangalelwa ephula Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka ngok-uphinda ahlukumeze ngokomzimba noma ngokomlomo ngendlela echazwe ekuqaleni kwale ncwajana, ungakwazi uk-ufaka isikhalazo esiteshini samaphoyisa bese unikezela Incwadi Yokubopha kumaphoyisa azobe esebopha Ummangalelwa. Isinqumo sokusebenzisa Incwadi Yokuboshwa emva kokweqiwa koMyalelo singesakho ngokuphelele. Emva kokuba eseboshiwe, uMmangalelwa uzobhekana namacala obugebengu bese equliswa icala eNkantolo Yezobudlova ngokwephula Isifungo Sokuzivikela. Ungakwazi, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, ukufake isicelo ukuze Umyalelo wakho ubekelwe eceleni, kodwa, kungumbono kaMantshi ukuthi Isifungo asibekele ecelene noma cha. Loku kuzokusho ukuthi Umyalelo wokuzivikela uzothathwa njengongasasebenzi. Umthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa Kwemindeni We-116 Ka-1998 uvumela ukuthi ohlushwayo ngohlukunyezwa umndeni noma olinyazwayo afune Umyalelo Wokuvikeleka Enkantolo Yemantshi maqondana nomuntu omhlukumezayo. Inhloso yalo Mhlahlandlela ukuthi unikeze ohlushwayo ulwazi aludingayo ukuthi alethe incwadi yesicelo soMyalelo Woku-vikeleka ngokulandela Umthetho Wokuhlukunyezwa kwemindeni. Bobabili abesifazane nabesilisa bangaba necala, baphuinde babe ngabahlushwayo Odlameni Lwemindeni. Ngenhloso yalo Mhlahlandlela kodwa, siye safanekisa ukuhlukunyezwalinygzwa oku-maqondana nabesifazane ngoba lokhu yikhona okujwayelke ukwenzeka kakhulu.

Kuyathokozisa ukubona intshisekelo enkulu emhlabeni wonke mayelana Nebhola le-FIFA Lendebe Yomhlaba lokuqala e-Afrika,' kwasho uDkt. Jordaan. Kumele sichaze izindba zethu ezilandayo ezingena kwingqikithi yobuciko bethu bomlomo bendabuko kanye nezindaba zasendulo. Ngemininingwane egcwele ngokuthi ungasifaka kanjani isicelo zokuthola umazisi, vakashela iwebhusayithi yoMnyango Wezasekhaya. Kulolu daba, uHulumeni udlala ikakhulukazi indima yokuvumelaukuthi kwenzeke kanye neyokuthi kwenzeke, ngesikhathi umkhakha ongekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni ubekeke endaweni enhle yokuthi uxhase imicimbi efana nalena. INingizimu Afrika ithumela eCuba ikakhulukazi amaminerali, amakhemikhali okuchela izitshalo kanye nezibulali zinambuzane, kanye nemishini enezinjini zikadizili. Le mpumelelo ingaphindwa uma singaqinisa ukuqinisa umthetho nokungabi nozwelo emigwaqweni. Ikwenza lokhu ngokuhlinzeka ngenethiwekhi equkethe izinto eziningi yezinsiza zokuthuthukisa kwezenhlalo ezivumela isimo, ezinika amandla nezisebenziseka ngokuphindaphindeka. Kukhona isidingo sokuthi kwakhiwe izinkundla zezemidlalo ezindaweni ezisemqoka ngesikhathi sokuhlela. Abantu bokuqala eNingizimu ne-Afrika benza izindaba eziphathelene nelanga nenyanga futhi babethandaza izinkanyezi. Isikhwama singokunye ukuzibonakalisa kokuzinikela kwethu ekuvuselelweni kabusha kwe-Afrika. Ngakho-ke kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ulandele ngokucophelela amalebuli emithi yokuchela izitshalo. Obekukuhle kakhulu ngaleli qembu ukuthi bobabili abazali kanye nothisha babo basebebalahlile ngenxa yokuzibandakanya kwabo kubugebengu kanye nenye indlela yokuziphatha yokuba yimidlwembe.

Lezi yizifo ezibeka ingozi phezulu komhlaba kodwa zonke zifana engozini ezidalayo. Zonke ezintathu zibangelwa yisifo esisodwa esibizwa nge-Sclerotinia sclerotiorum, ifungus eliyingozi kakhulu elivame ukubizwa ngokuthi "i-mold emhlophe." Le fungus ifana naleyo ebangela i-mold emhlophe kuma-soybeans, ama-beans omisiwe, i-canola, nezinye izinhlobo zezitshalo ezivame ukuthinteka. Ukuwa okubangelwa yi-Sclerotinia kwenzeka lapho i-canola ifakwe emhlabathini onama-Sclerotinia, kuholela engozini enkulu yokulimala. Kungenzeka ukuthi insimu yonke ithinteke kulolu bhubhane. Ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuhambisana nenani lezitshalo ezithintekayo kanye nesikhathi sokufika kololu bhubhane; uma inani lezitshalo ezithintekayo liphezulu futhi lolu bhubhane lungena ngokushesha, ukulahleka kokukhiqiza kuzokwandisa. Ngokuvamile, isitshalo esithintekayo sinikeza kuphela u-50% wokudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, okuqukethwe kwe-oli kwehla uma isitshalo sikhuluma. Enye into ebalulekile ukuthi ukuvela kwalolu bhubhane kukhuphula inani le-Sclerotinia emhlabathini. Lokhu kungakwenza kube nzima ukufaka i-canola ezindaweni ezine lolu bhubhane iminyaka eminingi. I-Sclerotinia yehlisa ukukhiqiza futhi ingavimba i-canola ekukhiqizeni esikhathini esizayo, kuholele ekulahlekelweni kwemali okujwayelekile okuhlobene ne-canola. Ukuwa kwekhanda kanye naphakathi komqolo akuvamile ukwenzeka; kuvame ukuvela ngemuva kwemvula enkulu. Lezi zifo azivamile ukwenzeka ngezikhathi zomoya omile. Ukuwa kwekhanda kwehlisa ukuvuthwa kwembewu, inani lembewu, kanye nokuqukethwe kwe-oli.

Izibungu zezimbaza ezimhlophe zikhula kucwaningo lwezesayensi olwenziwe bese izibungu zithunyelwe kumapulazi lapho kukhuliswa khona izilwane zasemanzini ukuthi zidliwe. Kwesabisa kakhulu kumele kulungiselwe ukudlalwa ngamaqoqo amaqembu. Kuqukethe ukuqikelelwa kwenani labantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezindlela ezisetshenziselwe ukuqoqa lokhu kuqikelela. Njengoba bekulindelekile, Uhulumeni ususebenze nabaphathi bakwa-Volkswagen ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi kuxazululwa inkinga edalwe abantu abathile abangaziphathanga ngendlela elindelekile. Kwenziwe uhlelo oluqinisa ukubamba iqhaza komphakathi ekuqanjweni kwamagama amasha emigwaqo. Uphenyo olwenziwe kwindawo okwenzeke kuyo isehlakalo seluveze ukuthi amadoda amabili aya kuZulu kwase kwaba nokuphikisana okwaholela kwimpikiswano kanye nokugwazwa kohlaselwe. Bandakanyani icandelo lamabhizinisi azimele nangekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni njengebaphatheli bentuthuko kuzwelonke. Mangiphethe ngokuhalalisela yonke intsha yethu ephumelele ukuhlolwa kwayo kumamatikuletsheni bese ngibafisela okuhle ngesikhathi beqhubeka nokuzithuthukisa. Imihlangano seyiphethe ngobudlelwane kwizinto eziyidlanzana, ikakhulukazi kwi-information technology. Njengoba senivele nazi, i-Afrika ichumise ingcebo yayo yemvelo, eseyixhashazwe abantu abavela ngaphandle ukuze kuzofika manje. Ukuya nokubuya esikhumulweni sezindiza, ukuya kwizindawo zokuhlala kanye nasezinkundleni zezemidlalo ngamabhasi ahlonyiswe ngezinsiza zokugibeza nokwehlisa ama-wheelchair.

Akukho ukugunyazwa okungenziwa komunye umuntu ongeyona i-ofishali enjena. Ikomiti ikhansela noma umqondisi wanoma yimuphi umasipala eyilungu lalo. I-Ofisa uzakudlulisa igunya ngokubhalela Ikomiti Lokunquma ukuthi linikeze amabhidi ayinani lama-R7,500,000 (kufakwae ne-VAT). I-Ofisa Enegunya inganikeza amabhidi edlula leli nani emva kokubheka iziphakamiso ZeKomiti Lokunquma. Uma kwenzeka Ikomiti Lokunquma noma i-Ofisa Enegunya, emva kokuxoxisana ne-ofisa elinegunya, lithatha isinqumo sokunikeza ibhidi kumbhidi okungeyena ophakanyiswe Yikomiti Lokuhlola noma Ikomiti Elinqumayo ngokuhambisanayo, i-Ofisa enegunya kumele ezinsukwini eziyisikhombisa zokusebenza yazise iMeya ngaloku ngokumbhalela. I-Ofisa elinegunya kumele lazise Ikomiti Yesigungu, Umcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele, Umcwaningi Zimali Wesifundazwe kanye Nomcwaningi Zimali Kuzwelonke ngezizathu zokungalandeli iziphakamiso ezinjena. Igunya elisemqoka lebandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-Ofisa Elinegunya lisebenzisa le nqubomgomo ngaphakathi kwemithetho esetshenziswayo. I-Ofisa enegunya izakungenisa umbiko wonyaka ngonyaka ebandleni nokusetshenziswa Kwenqubomgomo Yokuphatha Ukunikezela Imisebenzi ngomhla ka-30 kuJulayi enyakeni ngamunye. Lo mbhalo uzofaka umbiko wenqubekela phambili ekufinyelelweni kwezinhloso ezibekwe kunqubomgomo Yebandla NoHulumeni kuZwelonke. Uma kuba khona izinkinga zokokwenza nezinzima kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwenqubomgomo yokuphatha ukunikezwa kwemisebenzi, i-Ofisa Enegunya izakubika izinkinga ezinje ebandleni ngokushesha.

Ngifisa ukwazi noma unomhlaba kumbe ubucwebe okungokwakho - nesihlawumbiselo senani (inani). Ngiyazi ukuthi imininingwane ebucayi lena futhi ngeke ngayinikeza abanye abantu abangekho sethimbeni locwaningo. Siza usitshele noma unomhlaba kumbe ubucwebe okungokwakho nenye impahla eyigugu. Uma kungu- yebo, yisho inani. Umhlaba noma impahla? Enye impahla eyigugu, njengobucwebe, amabhuku, ubuciko noma enye impahla eyigugu? Ngakho-ke, okwamanje kuzoba nzima ukucela imali ukuze isetshenziswe isikhathi eside - lokhu kudala ezinye izinkinga lapho umkhiqizi ezama ukuqhubeka ngebhizinisi lakhe. Kuyiqiniso elidabukisayo, kodwa abakhiqizi bacindezelwa ukuba bacele imali ukuze baqhubeke - ukukhokhela imbewu, ukudla kwezilwane, nezinye izinto ezidingekayo ukuze bangenise izitshalo emhlabeni ukuze zikhule. Ngenxa yokungazinzi kwamaholo emakethe nokuhlangana nezinkinga ezihlobene nezingozi zezulu, iqiniso lelo mali elitshalwe alinaso isiqinisekiso. Izinhlangano ezivame ukuhlinzeka abalimi ngemali manje zikhathazekile ukuhlinzeka abalimi ngemali futhi zibamba imali yabo ngokuqinile. Ngakho-ke, kufanele siqhubeke sicele uhulumeni ukuthi asekele abakhiqizi ngemali ebolekiwe ngendlela eqinile, enhle, futhi esebenzayo lapho ukudla kukhiqizwa. Amanani emakethe emakethe ayengazinzi - ayanda futhi ehla - lapha sikhuluma ngamanani okudla nezindleko zokukhiqiza ezifana nezithako, imbewu, ukudla kwezilwane, nezinye izinto ezidingekayo emasimini, kubeka umkhiqizi esimweni esinzima sezezimali ngoba akanawo amandla okuphatha izindleko ezibonakalayo nezifihlekile zokudla okukhiqizwayo emasimini. Uma intengo yemakethe yokudla okukhiqizwayo ngumlimi yehlile, ngeke uyibone lokhu ezitolo - lokhu kukhuphula ukungabaza ukuthi kuphela abathengi bokudla nabanye abazuza, hhayi abakhiqizi nabathengi bokudla. Abaholi bezikhungo zezempilo baphinde banikezwa ithuba lokwabelana ngempumelelo yabo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo eziphumelelayo zokwelapha, izindlela zokuphatha iziguli, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana phakathi kwezikhungo. Umcimbi uphinde waba nezingxoxo ezibucayi phakathi kwabathintekayo, okuhlanganisa abamele izikhungo zezempilo, iziphathimandla, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele. Lezi zingxoxo zakhuthaza ubudlelwano obusha phakathi kwezikhungo, okwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, kanye nezinsizakalo. Abahlanganyeli baphinde bakhuthazwa ukuba baphendule ezinkingeni ezithile ezibhekene nezikhungo zabo, futhi bahlanganyele izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi waphinde waba nezingxoxo ezimnandi phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile, okwakwenza kube lula ukwabelana ngolwazi nokuhlanganyela izinsiza. Abahlanganyeli baphinde banikwe ithuba lokubona izibonelo eziphumelelayo zokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo ezithuthukisiwe zokuxhumana nezinsizakalo. Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi abahlanganyeli baphuma bejabule, bephuma nemibono emisha yokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo. U-Dkt. Lolu phiko lusebenza ngokubambisana nomasipala bendawo bese luhlinzeka ngohlaka olubanzi kukho konke ukweseka kwamabhizinisi ngumasipala. Ukuhlelwa ngokuqondiswa kwe- IDP phakathi kukaMasipala WeSifunda saseZululand kanye noMasipala wasebaQulusi kuyenzeka ngokusebenzisa iSithangamu Sabahleli esasungulwa nguMasipala Wesifunda saseZululand (ZDM). Lesi Sithangamu sihlangana kabili ngenyanga futhi sigxile ekuhleleni ngokuqondisa izindaba zamasu okusebenza, izinhlelo kanye nemiklamo. Kepha-ke, nakuba iSithangamu sisebenza, ukudluliswa kolwazi kuvame ukuphazanyiswa yizingqinamba eziphathelene nomsebenzi. Kulindelekile ukuthi uPhiko Lokulawulwa Komklamo olusanda kusungulwa, olungaphansi koPhiko Lwezemisebenzi Yokuhlela Nokuxhumana lukaMasipala wasebaQulusi, luzoqalisa ukusebenza kohlelo lokuxhumana nokuphatha olubanzi olubhekene nezingqinamba zokuxhumana okusebenzayo phakathi kukaMasipala WeSifunda kanye nalo. Ngaphansi kwe- LED, kunezinhlangano ezahlukene ezisebenza ngaphansi kwabaQulusi, nakuba zizimele ngazinye futhi zihambisana nokusebenza kwazo okunqala. Akukho nhlangano yezamabhizinisi emelwe ngokugcwele ezingeni likamasipala. Inselelo enkulu kuMasipala ukuthi awunawo amandla anele ngaphakathi okulekelela nokuqinisekisa ukuhlanganyela namanye amabhizinisi nababambiqhaza bemboni yezomnotho. UPhiko Lokulawulwa Komklamo olusanda kusungulwa, njengengxenye yokuthuthukisa amakhono, luzobhekana nokuvala amagebe amakhono nezikhungo okuyikona okuvimbe ukusebenzisana kwamabambiqhaza basembonini yezomnotho. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukusebenzisa amandla ezinhlaka ezinjenge Vryheid Business/ Besigheid ukwelekelela.

Ngesicelo semindeni engaboni ngasolinye, iFamily Advocate inxusa usizo lukasonhlalakahle benze ucwaningo bezwe imibono yamacala wonke babuye babheke izimo abantu ababangayo abaphila phansi kwazo nesandulela noma insusa yombango. AbeFamily Advocates babuza izingane ukuze bazwe imicabango nemibono yazo. Lokhu kusindisa ingane ekuyeni enkantolo, ubufakazi bunikwe ngabazali. UMnyango ukubona kusemqoka ukuthi kuqeqeshwe abammeli bemindeni abaningana. lnani elingu 25 lamahhovisi ezweni jikelele asayasebenza ekunyuseni izinga lokutholakala kwabammeli bemindeni. UMnyango ubone ukuthi umkhuba wemindeni wokuxazulula izinkinga awunasisombululo ugcina uletha inzondo nezisongelo, umn- deni uhlakazeke. Lokhu kugcina sekuphazamisa izingane ngokomqondo, ikakhulukazi idivosi. Umzali osele ngemuva kuza kufuneka agcwalise ifomu eqoki- we esetshenziswa yilaba bammeli emacaleni anje kumazwe ekusetshenziswana nawo ngokwesivumelwano. uthi angathola zonke izincwadi ezifunekayo abheke okumayelane nomthetho kwisicelo nanokuthi izwe ingane ethunjelwe kulo liyisimakanjani. Uma izwe ingane ethunjelwe kulo yizwe elisayine isivumelwano, kwabe konke okomthetho kume ngomumo, ummeli uqoqa konke enze umqulu athumele isicelo kulo mmeli wezwe lokuthumba acele ukubuyiselwa kwengane ngokushesha . Lolu hlelo alukwazi ukuqhubekeka ngale ndlela urna izwe lokuthumba lingelol- unga IeConvention. Bonke abammeli ababhekene nalenhloko yamacala bayacel- wa yi Convention bathathe izinyathelo zokuzama ukubuyiswa kwengane ngumthumbi ngentando nokuzwana. Lokhu kwen- ziwa ngokuxoxisana ngokwemingcele.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi sikhungo singathumela imiyalezo yokwazisa uma kwenzeka izimo zokuphuthuma, kuchaza uNtsobi. Ingxenye enkulu yezingcingo ezitholakala kulesi sikhungo ivela kubantu abafuna ulwazi nosizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, kanti abanye bafuna ulwazi mayelana nemithi. "Kuyajabulisa ukubona ukuthi lesi sikhungo singasiza ngokuhlinzeka ngolwazi kubantu abafuna usizo mayelana ne-HIV ne-AIDS, okusho ukuthi siphinde sibe nesandla ekufundiseni umphakathi. Lokhu esikubonile ukuthi abantu abaningi bafuna ukwazi ngesimo sezempilo kulesi sifunda ngoba befisa ukuvakashela futhi bathi sinesandla ezivakashi," kuchaza uNtsobi. Izinhlobo zezingcingo ezitholakala kulesi sikhungo zifaka phakathi lezo ezivela kubantu abafuna ukuveza izinkinga ezifana nokukhwabanisa, amacala okuhlukumeza, udlame lwasekhaya, abantu abalahlekile, imibiko yokwenzeka kwezehlakalo, izikhalazo ngezisebenzi, nokho nakuba abanye befaka izikhalazo. Zonke izikhalazo zilandelwa futhi zihlolwa. Njengoba sisondele isikhathi seholide, kubonakala ukuthi lesi sikhungo sizoba nomthelela omkhulu ekuhlinzekeni ngosizo lwezempilo kumphakathi nasekuletheni usizo lokuxhumana uma kwenzeka izimo zokuphuthuma ngalesi sikhathi. Khuluma nathi. Lalela nathi. Amahora angama-24 ngosuku. UKhuzwayo akazange abambezele njengoba athatha ithuba lokuba phakathi kwabokuqala kulesi sikhungo ukuthola imithi ye-antiretroviral ye-HIV. Nakuba impilo kaKhuzwayo kanye naleyo yabanye abavakashi abayi-506 kulesi sikhungo ibonisa umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabo kusukela baqala ukuthola imithi, ub faced with great difficulties at home as his husband does not want to hear anything about HIV.
