Vama ukuhambisa umntwana wakho ekliniki yabantwana ukuze athole ukuxilongwa okwejwayelekile nemigomo edingekayo. Bonana nekliniki yokuhlela umndeni noma ukuze uthole ukuthi yini okumele uyisebenzise ukuvikela ukukhulelwa.

Sithatha isinyathelo endleleni eya esikhathini esizayo. Yebo, uhulumeni kanye nasemkhakheni wokuzimela. Sigxila empilweni yethu futhi siphila ngendlela efanele. Ngale ndlela, umgomo wethu ukuveza izimanga kubalingani bethu. Sifaka isandla ekunakekeleni nasekuvikeleni imvelo nendawo esikuyo, okungavela ekubhekeni phambili ngokuqonda. Sihlonipha amalungelo abanye abaguli nabapheki ngokuphelele. Siphikisa ukuphila kahle ngoba sigcizelela ukuthi amathuluzi okusebenza awaphelele. Ukufisa ngaphakathi kwethu ukuhamba phambili. Sisebenzisa zonke izinsiza zempilo ngokuphelele ngaphandle kokuchitha noma ukungabaza ukuze siphumelele ngaphezu kokulinganiswa, njengamaphiko asenza sibhakabhake njengenkanyezi. Ukufisa kwethu ukuthuthukisa. Siqinisekisa ukuthi siyazi ngezinhlelo zempilo eziseduze nempilo, ngolwazi, nangokufundisa umphakathi esikuyo, futhi ukuthi banakekela thina ngendlela ephelele, lokhu kuhambisana. Sinikeza abasebenzi bezempilo ulwazi olufanele kanye nokwesekwa komzimba, kokomoya, nakokwengqondo. Sizibophezele ekusizeni ocwaningweni, ekwelapheni, nasekuthuthukiseni umuntu ngamunye ngendlela eqotho, ekuhloleni, ekwelapheni, ekubuyiseleni, nasezingeni eliphezulu lokwazi. Sazisa abapheki bezempilo ngenkani yethu yokwenza okudingekayo kumuntu ngamunye, sigxila esimweni sabo nasekufeni komuntu ngamunye, ubulili babo, ubudala, kanye nokukholwa kwabo. Ukukholwa okujwayelekile ukuthi. Sihambisana nemithetho yokwelapha nangesikhathi esithi "wenza kwabanye njengoba ungathanda ukuthi benze kuwe" okuhlobene nokubuyiselwa. Sizoletha induduzo kulabo. Sibuza ukuthi izindlela zokwelapha noma zokubuyiselwa zibhujiswe noma zaphukile. Zimi kanjani?

Sihalalisela laba abaphumelele ukudlula abanye futhi sibafisela impumelelo kwizikhundla zabo ezintsha. Imifanekiso eqoshwe ematsheni yabane baseNingizimu Afrika abathola Imiklomelo Yendondo Yokuthula izoma umumo wenyanga ewucwezu, ngemuva kwayo kubonakala indawo yaseKapa edumile i-Table Mountain. Wathweswa icala lokuzama ukubulala kanye nokutholakala nesibhamu kanye nempahla yokudubula okungekho emthethweni. Ekulekelweni Kwentuthuko Okusemthethweni, sicela ukuthi kubhekelelwe lokho okuphokophelwe okungukuqeda ubumpofu kanye nokungathuthukiswa ngokwenele, ukwenziwa lula kwemigomo elandelwayo kanye nokungafihli lutho ekunikezweni kwezimali eziyisibonelelo sikahulumeni. Sihalalisela iqembu labaseshi, okungumsebenzi wabo ukususa imigulukudu ehlomile emphakathini. Nginentokozo enkulu yokuvula le ndawo entsha yomtapowolwazi wethu kazwelonke. Ukubhala, ukuhlanganisa imidlalo (producing), ukuhlela ukuma kwamalambu, ukulingisa, bakwenza konke, bethatha uhambo ezweni iminyaka emihlanu, bethola ikhono lokwenza umsebenzi futhi bephila njengozulane. Uhlelo lwezinto zokuhamba luzohlanganisa umphambo wezinto ezithutha umphakathi, amatekisi akhokhisa ngamakhilomitha, ukuqashwa kwezimoto kanye nezinsiza zamakhasimende anezidingo ezikhethekile. Ngenxa yokufunwa kakhulu kwezinhlelo zamaqembu athile, lawa mathikithi angeke esatholakala kmimidlalo yeNgilandi, IBrazil, I-Argentina, I-Australia kanye neRiphabhuliki yase-Ireland neNetherlands. Njengoba ozakwethu bese beshilo ukuthi ubandlululo lwaletha ukuhlukana phakathi kwamasonto kanye nabefundisi.

Ukuvikela umphakathi nemvelo, abahlali, abasebenzi bezempilo kanye nohulumeni kufanele baziswe ngokushesha ngezinto noma ngoketshezi oluchithekile. Kungenzeka kube nobungozi bobuthi obukhiqizwa yisisi esiyingozi, okumele selashwe ngendlela eyisipesheli noma kususwe abantu. Maduzane ngemuva kwesehlakalo, atshele umphakathi neziphathimandla ngohlobo lwekhemikhali echithekile, indlela engaba yingozi ngayo empilweni nasempahleni nokuthi umthelela walokhu ungancishiswa kanjani? Isibonelo: ukuqhuma kungadala intuthu noma amafu egesi enobuthi. Abahlali banxuswa emisakazweni ukuba bazivalele ezindlini bashude namafasitela. Labo abanesifo sofuba bexwayiswa ngokuthola ukwelashwa emitholampilo noma kodokotela. Bayatshelwa nokuthi nhloboni yegesi echithekile. UMnyango wezempilo nengosi yesimo sezingozi eziphuthumayo kumasipala itshelwa ukwelapha abantu abaguliswa yilesimo. Imizamo eyenziwe ukunqanda ukuthi singaphindi isehlakalo. Uma lombiko noma uphenyo lungenziwa, ungathatha izinyathelo zokuvikela imvelo noma umphakathi nganoma yisiphi sesinye salezigaba. Eminye imininingwane iyokwethulwa endimeni 7. Yini ukushushisa okuzimele noma kwangasese? Emithethweni eminingi yezemvelo, kuyicala ukwephula umthetho. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi umuntu owephula umthetho angayiswa enkantolo ukuyoshushiselwa lelocala, kuthi lapho etholakala enalo agwetshwe ukukhokha inhlawulo noma abhadle ejele. Kwesinye isikhathi uhulumeni uyawashushisa lamacala, kodwa kuyenzeka aqoke ukuyekela. Isibonelo, uma ebona bungekho ubufakazi obenele ukumthola enecala umuntu. Wena ungazikhethela ukuqhuba icala ngoba ubona kusemqoka ukumshushisa lowomuntu.

Ukuvikelwa kolwazi lwezempilo lwe-GEMS (GEMS medical information protection) Emhlabeni wanamuhla, lapho ubuchwepheshe bukhula khona ngezinga elikhulu, ukwazi ukuvikela kolwazi lwethu lwezempilo kuba wumsebenzi obalulekile. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-GEMS (Government Employees Medical Scheme) ziza nezidingo ezinkulu zokuvikela ulwazi lwethu lwezempilo. Njengomuntu ophila phakathi kweziqubu zempilo, ngithanda ukukhipha umbono mayelana nezindlela ezibalulekile zokuvikela ulwazi lwempilo, ikakhulukazi uma kuziwa kwi-GEMS. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lungumkhiqizo wokuthula owenza ukuthi sikwazi ukuphila kahle. Lokhu ulwazi lubalulekile, ngoba kudinga ukuvikelwa okubhekiswe ekukhanyeni kwezinto ezimbi ezingase zenzeke uma kudingeka. I-GEMS, njengomhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zempilo, ineqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ukuqonda nezinyathelo zokuvikela ulwazi lwabantu. Ukubona ukuthi ulwazi lwazempilo lungagcinwa kanjani, kulindeleke ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze siluvikele. Ocwaningweni olwenziwe ngonyaka owedlule, kuboniswe ukuthi abantu abaningi abakuvumeleli ukuthi ulwazi lwabo lwezempilo luphume ngaphandle. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuzwelana nokuvikela okungekuhle. I-GEMS, njengephrojekthi ephethwe nguhulumeni, kufanele iqinise amasu ayo ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi ulwazi lwabathengi luhlala lukhona kuphela ezandleni eziphephile. Lokhu kumele kuhlanganise ukwenza kahle izinqubomgomo zokuvikela, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqwashisa, nokwakha ubuhlobo obusondele phakathi kwabathengi nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo. Enye yezindlela ezibalulekile zokuvikela ulwazi lwezempilo kungenzeka ukuthi kube nomsebenzi ophumelelayo wezobuchwepheshe.

Ukuqinisa umnikelo weHlelo Lokudla Esikoleni. Ukuze ubhalise ukuze uthole usizo lokudla. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imiphakathi ingafinyelela ukudla okunempilo okunothile ngamavithamini nezimayini. Izingane, ikakhulukazi ezikhokhelayo emakhaya: amajazi nezinsizwa ezithintekayo yi-HIV/AIDS nemindeni yazo zizothola kakhulu. Kwamanye amazwe, ezindaweni nasemakhaya, lezi zinsiza zisebenzisana; uMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi, uMnyango Wezempilo, uMnyango Wezolimo, uMnyango Wezemfundo, iKhansela Lokucwaninga Ngezobuchwepheshe Nezimboni (CSIR), uMnyango Wezibalo eNingizimu Afrika, iNational Development Agency (NDA), kanye ne-Independent Development Trust (IDT). Izinhlangano ezahlukene zenkolo, izakhiwo zomphakathi, izinhlangano zomsebenzi, nezinkampani zisebenzisana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abathintekayo bathola ukuphepha kokudla. Imisebenzi eminingi ihlelwe ukuze kwandiswe ukuqwashisa ngehlelo lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo kuzo zonke izifunda. Ubuphofu buyisitha esiyinhloko sabantu bonke eNingizimu Afrika. Kumele sisebenze ndawonye njengabaholi bezepolitiki, abaholi bendabuko, izinhlangano zenkolo, amaqembu emisebenzi, imiphakathi, nezinkampani uma sifuna ukuphumelela. Ukuxhumana nokubambisana phakathi kwezimboni ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze siphumelele. Le hlelo lokuphepha kokudla nokudla okunempilo lwenziwa nguHULUMENI.

Umnotho ugxile ekuthuthukiseni inhlalakahle, okuhlanganisa ukubambisana kukamasipala. Ngakho ke ngemva kwezinyanga ezinzima, ikhanda laphakanyiswa ngezimpande zokuvikela. Ekuhlonzeni kobuchwepheshe, lokhu kungenza kube nezinsizakalo ezinkulu, kanti umphakathi uthola umsebenzi omningi. Ngokuphetha, izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zitshengisa ukuthi umnotho awubheki abanjani, kodwa kubalulekile ukuba babe nabantu abavumayo. Uthando lomphakathi lubalulekile, futhi kumele sithathe izinyathelo ezakhelwe ukuvikela umnotho. Ukungaboni ngaso linye akuthandi, kodwana umhlaba uthanda, kanti umaphepha ahlanganiswe imizamo, olumkumbulo nempumelelo ehlangene. Izigigaba zithakazelelwa, kanti izifundo ziphakamisa umnotho, okwenza kube yinsakavukela enhle, emnothweni.

Akukho imali eqongelelwayo yokusebenza enikezwayo. Isikhwama Sokunikeza Amandla Sikazwelonke samiswa Umthetho wwe-105 Wesikhwama Sokunikeza Amandla SikaZwelonke ka-1998 ukunikeza amandla ebantwini ababndlululiwe esikhathini esedlule ngemisebenzi yokunikeza nokuzalisa imali. Isikhwama sizonikeza imali elinganayo kanye nekungathi kuyalingana kuzimali zokunikeza amandla omnotho ngemisebenzi ephathelene Nabantu Ababebandlululwa Esikhathi Esedlule (ama-HDP). Ama-HDP achazwa njengabantu noma izibaya zabantu okwathi ngaphambi kombuso wentando yeningi owaphawulwa ukuqala ukusebenza Komthethosisekelo Womthetho waseRephabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, ka-1996(Umthetho weno. Ye-108 ka-1996), babe bebandlululwa ngokunganakekelwa ngenxa yobuhlanga babo. Ukuzalisa kusuka kuma-R250 000 ukuya ku-R1 Yeboigidi. Inhloso yomkhiqizo ukwenza kusheshe ukwakhiwa kwamabhizinisi amasha angawabamnyama futhi aphetrhwe yibo anamandla okwazi ukuzimela njengamabhizinisi amancane/aphakathi nendawo. Izimali ezizoba ngohlobo lwesikweletu nemali esetshenziswayo, izawusetshenziswa ukuthola izisetshenziswa, ukunikeza izimali zemali eqongelelwayo esebenzayo, imali ephungulwayo, ukutholwa kwamalayisense noma amfrenshayisi kanye nawokulungiswa ukuziphatha, ukuqasha kanye namabhondi asebenzayo. Ifemu efanela lesi sikhwama kumele ibe yi-Nhlangano Evaliwe(i-Close Corporation), Inhlangano, noma i-(Pty) Ltd futhi kumele ama-75% abe futhi aphathwe ngabamnyama. Ukuzalisa kusuka ku-R1 yezigidi kuye ku-R3 yezigidi.

Usayizi wezinkomo uvame ukuhlobana nesimo sokudla senkomo kanye naleyo nhlanzi ngonyaka kanye nohlobo lwenkukhu. Uma inhlanzi ekhulelwe ivela kuyo yonke inkomo ikhululekile, njalo izokwenza imali ethile ethuthukise le msebenzi. Njengoba kushiwo, abalimi abaningi abakhiqiza izitshalo baphinde babe nezingxenye zokufuya ezisebenzayo - izinkomo (noma ezinye izilwane) zisebenzisa amapulazi emvelo, izinkundla (ezibhalwe ezindaweni ezinezinga eliphansi lokufuya), nezindawo ezinezimfucuza zomumbu. Ukuba umkhiqizi ophumelelayo wezilwane kuhlobene kakhulu nekhono lokuhlinzeka ukudla okwanele, okuphakeme ngonyaka. Phakathi nezinyanga zehlobo, abakhiqizi abaningi bangathembela kumapulazi nezinkundla ukuze badle izilwane zabo, kodwa abakhiqizi abahle balungiselela izilwane zabo ezinyangeni ezibandayo nezomile. Njengoba ukuphela kwehlobo kuza, abalimi abaningi baphonsa ukudla okuluhlaza (ngokuvamile bekuwumumbu wokudla (ama-oats) phakathi kwemigqa yomumbu). Ngemuva kokuvuna umumbu, izinkomo nezimvu zivunyelwe ukugaya ezinkundleni lapho zidla izimfucuza zomumbu, amahlamvu omumbu adilika, nokudla okuluhlaza. Abanye abalimi baphonsa i-seradella phakathi komumbu. I-seradella iyisitshalo esinothile ngemifino esinokudla okuhle, okungahlinzeki kuphela ukudla okuhle kodwa futhi kwakha i-nitrogen emhlabathini ukuze isetshenziswe emvuthwandaba elandelayo. Inyanga kaMashi ingemuva kwesikhathi sokuphonsa umumbu wokudla (ama-oats) kanye ne-seradella, kodwa kusasele isikhathi sokuphonsa uhlobo lwe-rye.

Igumbi lizongena umoya oqhamuka ngaphandle ngokwanele ngama-louver noma ezinye izindlela ezamukelekile. Ukwakha umkhanya ekubhekeni ukuhanjiswa kwezinsiza ngohulumeni kulona lonke loluthathu uqimba ezindaweni ezikhonjiwe. Abasolwa abane ababoshwe ngozankosi babebukele ngesikhathi kulayishwa emotweni amakhebuli ethusi kanye nempahla okwebiwe. Uhlu lokwephulwa kwamalungelo ayisisekelo eziboshwa ngokugcwala kwamajele lwalulude kakhulu. Ukwandiswa kwezolimo ezindaweni ezingakulungele, ngenxa yengcindezi yezomnotho kanye nokuphila. Izihambeli ezivela emhlabeni wonke kanye nasezweni lonke kulindeleke ukuthi zethamele le micimbi. Inkinga yekhwalithi yamanzi e-False Bay, eqhamuka ezindaweni eziphakelwa amanzi, kuyindaba egudwini. Ukuhlolwa kwendawo kumele kubhekele imiphumela yesifunda kanye nemithelela yokuxhaswa komnotho, kanye nokungenzeka kube yimiphumela yezimo zomnotho ngokubanzi. Lokhu kuzohlanganisa ukufakwa kwezimakethe zezezimali kanye nezezimali zokuqala ibhizinisi kanye nokwandiswa kohwebo lwangaphakathi kanye lolwesifunda oluthe xaxa. Lokhu kusikhumbuza ngokuhlupheka kanye nokucekela phansi okungakhulunywa ngakho okubangelwa yimpi. Kungathathwa izinqumo eziyizinkulungwane, kodwa angeke ziqaliswe ngempumelelo uma sala uxolo. Umndeni wendoda yaseFreystata eyabulawa kwimizamo yokuphanga endaweni engasolwandle eThekwini ngonyaka odlule, usamukele isigwebo esinikezwe ababulali bayo. Ukufundiswa komphakathi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekwaziseni umphakathi, kukwethembeka kanye nokuba semthethweni kohlelo lokuvota.

Umnikazi wempahla ebhalisiwe kumele ahlinzeke ngemininingwane ethinta leyo mpahla, izinqumo zenkantolo zokuvimbela ezinye izenzo mayelana nempahla, inani lemali emakethe lempahla, imigomo ye-title deed eyingxenye yempahla, ikhophi yesivumelwano esenziwe ngaphambi kwe-deed, ilungelo lokudlulisela impahla komunye umuntu, inani lesikweletu sokuthenga impahla, kanye neminye imibhalo efanele. Ikhophi ye-title plan eyingxenye yempahla, noma imigomo yokuphathwa kwe-Title Scheme eyingxenye yempahla, kodwa ikhophi yokuhloswe yokuthola ulwazi mayelana nokwakhiwa kwesigaba sokuhlala sabantu abaxhumene nempahla noma itayitile. Amagama aphelele noma inombolo yokukhomba yomnikazi wempahla, noma okungenani usuku lwabo lokuzalwa. Inombolo ye-erf kanye nenombolo ye-towship, noma igama lefamu nenombolo, kodwa hhayi ikheli lomgwaqo. Hamba kunoma iyiphi ihhovisi lemidlalelo, uye ehhovisi lolwazi, lapho umphakathi ozosiza ekugcwaliseni ifomu elibekiwe futhi echaza inqubo. Cela umtapo wolwazi we-data ukuthi useshe ulwazi ngempahla, noma ukhokhe imali efanele ehhovisi lezezimali bese uthatha umphumela emuva kumphakathi ehhovisi lolwazi. Inombolo yomphumela izobanjwa nekhophi yakho ye-title. Ukusesha ulwazi kungathatha imizuzu engama-30 kuya kwengama-60. Ezinye ehhovisi ezinkulu, ikhophi ye-title ingathunyelwa ngeposi, noma kufanele iqoqwe ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile. Umphakathi ehhovisi leMidlalelo uzokunikeza ifomu okufanele ugcwalise.

UThandiwe ungumfundi onothando lokuthuthukisa ulwazi lwakhe ngemvelo. Uthanda ukufunda izincwadi eziphathelene nemvelo, ezimfundisa ngempilo yezinyoni, izitshalo, nezilwane. Ubuye abe neqhaza ekwenzeni izinhlelo zokuhlola imvelo, ezihlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene ukuze bazihlanganise nemvelo. Uhlanga lwezinyoni, izitshalo, nezilwane zikhombisa ubuhle obungapheli, futhi uThandiwe uyaziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yalokho. UThandiwe ubonisa indlela yokuphila ehlonipha imvelo. Ubuye abe nomthelela omuhle emphakathini, efundisa abantu ukuthi imvelo iyinsika yokuphila. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandiwe uqhubeka nokufundisa abanye ngothando nemvelo, ethokozisa abanye ngezikhathi ezinhle. Ubuhle bemvelo buhlale bukhanya emhlabeni wakhe, futhi uThandiwe uyaziqhenya ngokuba yingxenye yemvelo.

Ukuze uthole imininingwane eyengeziwe uyacelwa ukuba ushayele isikhungo sokunakekela amakhasimende se-dti lapha 0861 843 384 noma uvakashele iwebhusayidi ethi www.thedti.gov.za. I-THETA, Iziphathimandla Zezokuvakasha, Ukuphatheka kahle kanye Nemidlalo yemfundo Nokuqeqeshwa Iyisigabas Seziphathimandla Zemfundo Nokuqeqeshwa (i-SETA) emiswe ngaphansi Komthetho Wokuthuthukisa Amakhono(Weno.- 97 ka-1998) wesigaba Sokuphathwa Kahle Nomnotho Wemidlalo kanye Nokuphathwa kahle. Umsebenzi osemqoka we-SETA ukunikezela ekukhushulweni kwamakhono - ukuletha amakhono kubaqashwa, noma labo abafuna ukuqashwa, esigabeni sabo. Ama-SETA enza loku ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bafunda amakhono adingwa ngabaqashi kanye nomphakathi. Inhloso Yohlelo Lokuthuthukisa Abanikezeli Bamabhizinisi Abamnyama i-BBSDP ukuqhubekisa ukukhula kwamabhizinisi abamnyama ngokusiza ukwakha ukuxhumana kwamabhizinisi phakathi kwama-SMME abamnyama, izinhlangano kanye nesigaba somphakathi. Ukuxhuman kusemqoka ikakhulukazi kuma-SMME ukuze ancintisane ekutholeni amathenda kuzinhlangano kanye nezinkampani zomphakathi ezingazinye. I-BBSDP izakunikeza okungaba ngamabhizinisi abamnyama isabelo sokuhlukaniselana izindleko ukuze zikwazi ukuthola ukuqeqeshwa nokwelulekwa ukubhekana nesikhala samakhono ababhekene naso. I-BBSDP izawusiza ekunikezeni imali yokuphatha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha, ukulungiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha, amakhono acacile ebhizinisi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokumaketha kanye nokokwenza.

Abahlengikazi kumele babe neziqu eziphezulu nezifundo eziqondene nezimo eziphuthumayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele. Ukusebenza Kweqembu Ukuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo kudinga ukuba abantu basebenze njengeqembu. Abahlengikazi, odokotela, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo kumele basebenzisane, baxhumane, futhi bahloniphe imisebenzi yomunye nomunye. Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokufundisa abasebenzi bazo mayelana nokubaluleka kokubambisana. Ukuqeqeshwa Nokuqhubeka Kwezemfundo Ukuze abasebenzi bezempilo bahlale bekwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokuqeqesha eziphindaphindwayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo, izifundo, kanye nezifundo ezikhethekile. Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinsiza ezanele zokuxhasa lezi zinhlelo. Ukubuyekezwa Kwezinhlelo Izibhedlela kufanele zihlale zibuyekeza izinhlelo zazo zokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo, ukuthola impendulo kubasebenzi, kanye nokwenza izinguquko lapho kudingeka. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuhlola ezisebenzayo. Isiphetho Izimo eziphuthumayo ezibhedlela zidinga ukuphathwa ngokucophelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuze lokhu kube yimpumelelo, izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinhlelo ezicacile, zisebenze njengeqembu, futhi ziqhubeke ziqeqesha abasebenzi bazo. Ngale ndlela, izibhedlela zingakwazi ukuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo ngempumelelo, zinciphise ubungozi, futhi zandise amathuba okuphila kweziguli.

Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvimbela ukungcoliswa. - Ukuhlanza ngemuva kokuphosa: Uma udinga amanzi ahlanzekile, ungawaphosa ngentambo yokuhlanza ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ubulukhuni bamanzi abuphazamiseki. Isinyathelo 3: Ukuhlola Izinga Lokuhlanzeka Ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi amanzi akho ahlanzekile, kufanele uhlale uhlole izinga lokuhlanzeka. Lokhu kungenziwa ngezindlela ezilandelayo: - Ukusebenzisa izivivinyo: Thola izivivinyo zamakhemikhali ezitholakalayo ezizokwazi ukukwazisa ngokuqondile ngezinga lokuhlanzeka kwamamzi akho. Lezi zivivinyo zingatholakala ezitolo zamakhemikhali noma kumasipala wakho. - Ukukhuluma nochwepheshe: Uma ungazi kahle ukuthi ungazithola kanjani izivivinyo, xhumana nochwepheshe bendawo abanolwazi ngendaba yokuhlanzeka kwamamzi. Isinyathelo 4: Ukuvikela Amanzi Ahlanzekile Ukuba namanzi ahlanzekile akupheli lapho udinga ukuwathola. Kubalulekile futhi ukuvikela lezi zinsiza. Lokhu kungenziwa ngezinyathelo ezilandelayo: - Ungaphumeli amanzi emithonjeni engcolile: Qinisekisa ukuthi awuphumi amanzi emithonjeni engcolile, ngenxa yokuthi lokhu kuzothinta amanzi owatholayo. - Gcina imithombo yethu: Ungakusebenzisa amanzi alinganiselwe ukuze uvikele imithombo yethu. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukusebenza ngendlela efanele, futhi kuqinisekise ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile ayatholakala isikhathi eside. Isinyathelo 5: Ukuqhubeka Nokufunda Ukugcina amanzi ahlanzekile akupheli kuphela ekutholeni amanzi, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuqhubeka nokufunda. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile: - Ukwazi izitayela ezintsha: Funda ngezindlela ezintsha zokuhlanza amanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlanzekile. Bheka izincwadi, izifundo, nemithombo ethokozisayo.

Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokugoma; abanye abantu bahlala bephikisa ngenxa yokungaqondi kahle noma izimangalo ezingelona iqiniso. Lokhu kudinga ukukhulumisana okuhle ukuze sabelane ngemininingwane efanele. Kumele siqonde ukuthi ukugoma kudinga ukubhekelelwa, futhi kunezindlela ezinhle zokuphendula imibuzo yabantu abangenalo ulwazi olucacile. Futhi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukukhetha ukuvuma ukugoma kubandakanya nemigomo ethile. Ukugoma akuphuli amalungelo abantu, kodwa kuwumkhankaso ophakathi kokunikeza ukuvikeleka. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abantu baqonde imiphumela engaba khona uma behluleka ukuvuma ukugoma. Kukhona izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezibhekene nezinkinga ezithile, futhi abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukugoma kunciphisa lezi zinkinga. KwaZulu, umoya wokuhlalisana nokubambisana ungumgogodla wempilo. Ukugoma kufanele kube yisinyathelo esisodwa esihamba phambili ukuze sithole umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlangana, ukuxhumana, nokwakha ubudlelwano obuphumelelayo phakathi kwabantu. Okokugcina, kubalulekile ukunikeza ukuqonda okuthile ngezinto ezahlukene ezihambisana nokugoma. Umqondo wokugoma uhilela izinqubo ezithile, njengokubhalisela ukugoma, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uyagoma ngesikhathi esifanele, nokulandela izeluleko eziphathelene nempilo. Kumele siphinde siqonde ukuthi kulandela izinyathelo ezifanele, sizokwazi ukuvikela abanye, siqinisekise ukuthi umphakathi uhlala uphephile. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuluma ngalezi zinto, siphinde sabelane ngalezi zimiso ezizokwenza impilo yethu ibe ngcono.

Abaningi bazi ukudla uphuthu bezikhandla nezithako ezithile, bakha izithako eziphumelelayo. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi uthokozise ukusinda. Kodwa-ke, kufanele bafake ingqondo endaweni lapho kudalwa khona izimo ezihle. E-West Africa, ukudla uphuthu okuhamba phambili kuxhaswa izithembiso, okuthola izinzuzo ezinkulu ezimpilweni zabantu. Khumbula, ukuphila kwesimanje kudinga ukwenziwa okuncane, kuquiwe ekudleni ukuze siphepheke. Ukuze uphuthu lungalethi imiphumela emibi, kubalulekile ukujwayela izindlela eziphumelelayo zokulawula ukwenzeka. Ngesikhathi sokukhiqiza, okumele kubalulelwe ukuhloza izimpawu zephuthu ezikhankanyisiwe. Ukubheka Izenzo Zokuthinta Uhlanga LwePuthu Uphuthu uwumkhiqizo ophephile, kodwa umphakathi unokufaneleka ekusizeni uhambile. Amazingnazo uma kwenzeka kudlalwa ngamaqhinga akudala, akusizi. Umuntu noma imiphakathi kumele ibone ukuthi izinsiza ezithile ziyasebenza kanjani. Uhlanga lwephuthu luhlobene kakhulu nomphakathi, kulandela izinkolelo, kuthinta ubudlelwane bezimpilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi uphuthu uyibhalansi ebaluleke kakhulu. Abantu base-Afrika bahlala benalo lonke ulwazi olunembile nolwakudala lokugcina uqondiso eceleni kwezinsuku zanamuhla. Ukuxhumana, ukwenziwa, kanye nokuhlonishwa kwezinhlanga zempilo kube nomthelela omkhulu emiphakathini. Isiphetho Uphuthu, obalulekile emiphakathini yethu, uhlanganisa imfihlo ekahle yokuphila kahle. Ngamafuphi, izinzuzo zawo zikhula phansi kwezinsiza ezahlukene. Ukuwa nogwadule lwezinkanyezi kuzoletha ukujabuliswa nokwenziwa kwezinto eziyinqaba.

Lokhu kwaba yisifundo esiyingqayizivele sokuthi umphakathi ungakha umhlaba ophumelelayo uma wonke umuntu edlala ndawonye. Ngakho-ke, izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga, kodwa umgibeli owayethanda iCheckers wahamba phambili. U-Sipho noThandi bahlala bejabule, bephokophela phambili, bathe izinkanyezi zihamba, bezama ukuhamba ndawonye, ukuze umphakathi ube ngcono. Futhi, bahlala bejabulile emzaneni, baqhubeka bedlala, bezindla izikhathi ezinhle, bejabulisa abanye ngothando lwabo lokukhuthaza. Lokhu kwaba yisifundo seCheckers esikhulu - lapho ukudlalela, ubuhlobo, nokuhlanganyela kuhlonishwa, umphakathi ubuyisela umphakathi. ICheckers yabe isibonelo sokuthi ukuxhumana kwethu kwenza umphakathi ube ngcono.

b siqukathe ulwazi olwenele ukunika amalunga omphakathi ithuba elenele lokwethula iziphakamiso nokuphikisana nesinqumo. Uma sifanele isimo, uNgqongqoshe kazwelonke noma wesiFundazwe engavumela umuntu noma umphakathi ukuba wethule iziphakamiso noma impikiswano ngomlomo kuNgqongqoshe kazwelonke noma wesiFundazwe, noma kulowo ojutshwe nguNgqongqoshe kazwelonke noma wesiFundazwe. Ungqongqoshe kazwelonke noma wesiFundazwe kufanele acubungule kahle zonke iziphakamiso zokuvuma noma zokuphikisa ezitholiwe noma ezethuliwe ngaphambi kokusebenzisa la mandla. Ngesicelo esibhaliwe, noma yimuphi umuntu noma uhlaka lukahulumeni lungafaka isicelo sokuxolelwa emibandeleni yalo mthetho kuNgqongqoshe kazwelonke. c engasenqaba isicelo. a engahoxisa noma yiliphi igunya lokuxolelwa wumthetho okukhishwe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba uma kungahanjiswana nombandela okukhishwe ngaphansi kwawo igunya lokuxolelwa; noma d engabuyekeza izikhathi ngezikhathi igunya lokushwelezelwa noma umbandela okukhishwe ngaphansi kwawo igunya lokuxolelwa. Umthetho Onqanda Ukunukutshezwa Komoya uyashintshwa lapha. Noma yini eyenziwe noma ethathwa njengaleyo eyenziwe ngaphansi kombandela othathelwe indawo yisigatshana- 1 nengase yenziwe ngaphansi kombandela walo Mthetho, kufanele ithathwe njengeyenziwe ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho.

ugcizelele izinhlinzeko zezigatshana (1) no (2). wazisa labo bantu ukuthi bangenza iziphakamiso ezibhaliwe mayelana nokwenziwa kwendawo iNdawo eyiGugu ngokomlando esikhathini esingeqile ezinsukwini ezingamashumi amathathu emva kokuthola isaziso. Ngaphandle uma uMkhandlu ubona kungafanele, zonke iziNdawo ezingamaGugu kumele zibe nophawu olukhombisa lokho. Umbhalisi wamatayitela njengoba kuchazwe esigabeni 102 soMthetho wokuBhaliswa kwamaTayitela, 1937 (uMthetho No. 47 ka 1937), kumele ubhale lokho okubona kubalulekile kunoma iyiphi irejista, kunoma yisiphi isitifiketi noma kunoma yimuphi umbhalo ofanele okusehhovisi lakhe noma okubekwe phambi kwakhe ukuze kubonakale ukuba yiNdawo eyiGugu ngokomlando kwanoma yimuphi umhlaba noma kwanoma iyiphi ingxenye yomhlaba onikezwe lelo gunya ngokwalesi sigaba. (8)(a) UMkhandlu ungahoxisa iNdawo eyiGugu ngokomlando ngesaziso kwiGazethi. Uma uMkhandlu unquma ukuhoxisa iNdawo eyiGugu ngokomlando, izinhlinzeko zezigatshana (3), (4) no (5) ziyosebenza ngezinguquko ezidingekayo. Uma indawo iNdawo eyiGugu ngokomlando isinikezwe lelo gunya, iba yindawo yoMkhandlu noma kamaziphathe wasekhaya, indawo kusukela ngosuku lokudluliselwa kokubhaliswa, ithathwa njengeyenziwe iNdawo eyiGugu ngokomlando. Indawo eyiGugu ngokomlando ithathwa njengesiGaba II samaGugu okukhulunywe ngawo esigabeni 7(1)(b) soMthetho wezamaGugu kaZwelonke, 1999 (uMthetho No. 25 ka 1999).

Yini egodlwe yiNEMA? Wubani ongafaka isikhalo ngaphansi kweNEMA? Kungabe isenzo noma isinyathelo okukhalwa ngaso sephula amalungelo lakho ezemvelo agodlwe yiNEMA? Likhona yini ikhambi lezikhalo ngaphansi kweNEMA? Yini eyenzekayo ngemuva kokuthatha izinyathelo zokuvikela amalungelo akho ezemvelo ngaphansi kweNEMA? Funda lapha kuqala. Ukusebenzisa Umthetho kaZwelonke Wezemvelo (NEMA) kungaba lula. Akudingekile ukuthi uze ube nommeli ukufaka isikhalo ngomuntu olimaza imvelo njengamanje noma lowo osola sengathi angayilimaza esikhathini esizayo. Awumdingi futhi uma ufisa ukubamba iqhaza njengelunga lomphakathi ngezinqumo ezimayelana nemvelo. Kuyiqhinga elihle ukuxhumana nomuntu onolwazi ngeNEMA ngaphambi kokuthatha isinyathelo. Umthetho ungaba nzima futhi udide. Inkinga yakho ingajula. Zingaba ngaphezulu kweyodwa izindlela zokuyixazulula. Ungadinga nokubuza omunye umuntu onesipiliyoni ngalezo zinto noma izinkinga ezingabalulwanga kulomhlahlandlela. Kungenzeka ufune isiqiniseko sokuthi okwenzayo kusendleleni efanele. Uhlu lwezingosi zikahulumeni nemithombo yabomthetho neminye ewusizo iyatholakala ngasekugcineni kwalomhlahlandlela. Bangakunika usizo mahhala ngokuvikela imvelo yakho. Uma inkinga onayo ibandakanya ezinye izinto, bangakwedlulisela endaweni efanele ukuze uthole usizo. Yini amalungelo ezemvelo? Ngonyaka ka1994, umthethosisekelo omusha wabeka ilungelo lemvelo njengelungelo-nqangi ebantwini. Uma umthetho uthi into iyilungelo-nqangi kuchaza ukuthi konke okwenziwa wuhulumeni kumele kuhambisane nalokho okubalulwa yilelo lungelo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa umthetho imithetho eshaywayo nezinyathelo ezithathwayo.

Amabhizinisi Amancane - Ingxoxo Nendoda Ethuthukisa Umnotho Isingeniso Namuhla, sithokozile ukuba nezingxoxo nomnqobi wempumelelo emkhakheni wamabhizinisi amancane, uMnu. Sipho Mthembu. U-Sipho ungumuntu ophumelele kakhulu, futhi ubambe iqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni amathuba emisebenzi emphakathini wakhe. Sizobe sikhuluma ngempumelelo yakhe, izinselelo abhekane nazo, kanye nezifundo azifundile endleleni. Ingxoxo Umbuzo 1: U-Sipho, ungakuchaza kanjani ukuthi waqala kanjani ibhizinisi lakho? U-Sipho: Ngiyabonga, ngiyajabula ukuba lapha. Ngathanda ukusungula ibhizinisi lami ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo zami. Ngibone ukuthi umphakathi wami udinga izinsiza ezithile, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokudla. Ngakha umqondo wokuvula isitolo sokudla esinikeza ukudla okuphumelelayo, okwenziwe ngempela ngezithako ezisemqoka. Ngathola uxhaso oluncane oluvela kubangani bami, futhi ngaqala ngenkampani encane. Umbuzo 2: Yiziphi izinselelo obhekane nazo ekuqaleni? U-Sipho: Kunezinto eziningi ezinzima. Okokuqala, kwakunzima ukuthola imali yokwakha ibhizinisi. Ngabe ngidinga ukuhamba ngokuqhubekayo, ngikhuluma nabantu abahlukene ukuze ngithole uxhaso. Okwesibili, kwakunzima ukuheha amakhasimende. Ngafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yami iyathandwa, ngakho ngasebenzisa izindlela zokumaketha ezahlukene, njengezikhangiso ezincane emiphakathini. Umbuzo 3: Ucabanga ukuthi yiziphi izinzuzo zokuba nebhizinisi elincane? U-Sipho: Izinzuzo ziningi. Okokuqala, ungakwazi ukuphatha ibhizinisi lakho ngendlela oyithandayo, okuvumela ukuba ube nezinqumo ezisheshayo.

Ukuze ikwazi ukusithola isimo esibekwe kwisigatshana 1 inkantolo ingase inqume ukuthi kube nomuntu ovela phambi kwayo futhi ingase ikhiphe sinqumo sokuthi omunye wophathini kumbe bobabili mabakhokhe izindleko zophenyo nokuvela phambi kwekantolo. Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo esiqeda ubuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe, maqondana nesondlo nemfundo yengane esadinga ukondliwa okuyingane yobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe, kumbe maqondana nomphathi wayo, kumbe ingane esencane yobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe, kumbe ukuyibona ingane, inkantolo ingase ikhiphe isinqumo leso esibona sifanele futhi kwesinye isikhathi, uma ibona kuyito efanelekile kumntwana ukukwenza lokho, ikhiphe isinqumo sokuthi omunye wabazali abe umphathi kumbe umgadi wengane, inkantolo inganquma futhi ukuthi uma kwenzeka omunye wabazali onikezwe ubuphathi yedwa eshona, omunye umuntu ngaphandle komzali osaphila okuzofanele abe umphathi womntwana, yena yedwa kumbe ngokubambisana nomzali osaphila. Ngaphandle uma inkantolo isho okunye, amalungelo nomsebenzi kaphathini orejistiwe ngaphansi iwanoma yimuphi umthetho awashintshi ngenxa yokuqedwa kobudlelwano. Maqondana nale sigaba inkantolo ingase iqoke ummeli ozoyimela ingane enkantolo futhi ikhiphe isinqumo sokuthi omunye kumbe bobabili abarejistiwe bakhokhe izindleko zommeli. Uma kunengane ezelwe kubuhlobo oburejistiwe kubantu bobulili obungefani, owesilisa kulobo buhlobo uthathwa njengobaba ozala leyo ngane futhi unamalungelo nemisebenzi emaqondana naleyo ngane ebeyingaba eyakhe ukube ubeshade nomama oyizalayo ingane.

Kodwa umphakathi wawungazi ukuthi uThabo wayenobuhlungu obukhulu. Ngemuva kokuphosa ibhola, wathola ukuthi umgibeli ophikisanayo, uMandla, wayemkhumbuza ngezinkumbulo ezinzima. UThabo wayekade edlala ibhola, kodwa kwenzeka ingozi eminyakeni edlule, wathola ukulimala okukhulu. Lokhu kwashiya umoya wakhe uphansi, kodwa wayezimisele ukulwa. Umdlalo uqhubeka, futhi uThabo wayezama ukugcina umoya wakhe uphansi. Umdlalo wawuhamba kahle, kodwa uMandla wayephikisana naye, efuna ukumnqanda. Ngemuva kwesikhathi eside, umphakathi wawujabule, kodwa uThabo wayezwa ubuhlungu. Wazi ukuthi kufanele akhumbule ukuthi umphakathi ubheke kuye, futhi wayefuna ukuveza ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo. Ekugcineni, umphakathi wawujabule, uThabo waba yinkanyezi emkhakheni. UThabo noSipho baphuma emkhakheni, bejabulile, umphakathi wawujabule, futhi uThabo wayezimisele ukuveza ukuthi ungumgibeli ophumelelayo.

Izindlela zokonga ngokusebenzisa nokwakha izakhiwo zomdabu ezifana nezinkampani zokungcwaba nez stokvels. Ukwakha imboni yezezimali esebenzayo encane eNingizimu Afrika. Ukuxhaswa kwezezimali ukuze kwakhiwe amandla omthetho ezinhlelweni ezibamba iqhaza kanye namakhasimende azo ukuze kube lula ukubamba iqhaza kwabo emisebenzini yezezimali ephumelelayo. Ukonga njalo nokuhlinzekwa kwemali kubalulekile kokubili izinhlangano kanye neziqu zezezimali ezithengiswayo (RFIs) njengendlela yokwandisa nokujulisa ukufinyelela ezinsizeni zezezimali kubantu abampofu futhi kuthuthukise isimo sabo sezezimali ukuze baphile kahle. Ukubazi kahle ngokuqonga akusiyo ukukhethwa kokwakhiwa, kodwa ukuqala nezindlela ezihlukahlukene ezisekelwe kulwazi lwezimpilo kuyakhuthazwa. Imali yokubolekwa yezezimali encane: Le nqubo ihlinzeka ngemali yokubolekwa efika ku-R10,000 kumakhaya nakwabanye abaqalayo abanguye amalungu ezinkampani ezincane ukuze bazinakekele. Iziqu zezimali ezincane zezimboni ezincane. Imali yokwehlisa amazinga obuphofu kumakhasimende avela kumakhaya athola ngaphansi kwe-R1,500. Inhlangano ebamba iqhaza izosebenzisa ithuluzi lokuhlola ubuphofu. Ukwakha amandla omthetho: Ngaphansi kwalesi siphakamiso semali, kunikezwa ukwesekwa ukuze kuqiniswe isikhungo futhi kuqinisekiswe ukwesekwa kwaso kwesikhathi eside. Ukonga njalo: Lokhu kusiza ekuthuthukiseni nasekukhuthazeni ukusungulwa kwezinhlelo zezezimali nezinye izikhungo zokonga zomdabu ezifana nezinkampani zokungcwaba nez stokvels ukuze kuqoqwe ingcebo yasendaweni.

Ukuthuthukiswa komnotho wezolimo ozofinyelela ezingeni lokusimama komnotho nesimo sendawo futhi uvuleleke kulabo abazongena kulomkhakha abasezindaweni zamaKhosi nasezabelweni. Ukuzabalazela ukwakha isimo sokuhambisana kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. Uhlumeni kazwelonke ubona umkhakha wezokuvakasha kuyiwona odinga ukuthuthukiswa kakhulu. Lomkhakha awukathuthukiswa ngokwenele ngasezintabeni zoKhahlamba kanti kunamathuba okuba uthuthukiswe. Ukuvula umkhakha wezokuvakasha ukuze izindlalifa zendawo ngobuningi bazo zibe yingxenye ngaphakathi kohlelo lomhlaba wonke jikelele nolwangaphakathi. Ukuzabalazela ukwakha isimo sokuhambisana kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. Umnotho yisamba semikhiqizo yonke yokuxhumana komuntu nendawo aphila kuyona. Uphathelene nokwazi ukukhiqiza ingcebo nokuthi leyongcebo yahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo futhi iphathwe ngendlela ezokwenza ukuba isimame. Uphathelene nentuthuko yomnotho wangaphakathi endaweni kanti ushiya ngaphandle imikhakha yomnotho kwezokuvakasha nezolimo ukuba izimele emibikweni yayo. Ukuqiniswa komnotho ukuze ukwazi ukubhekana nezimakethe ezintsha namathuba ngendlela ezokwandisa imikhiqizo yesifunda namazinga empilo yazo zonke izakhamuzi. Ukuzabalazela ukwakha isimo sokuhambisana kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. Ukufeza izidingo zemfundo zabantu bendawo ukuze kusunguleke amathuba okukhula nokusimama komnotho. Isimo sendawo kulombiko sisho ikakhulukazi isimo sendawo mayelana nemvelo nesakhiwo sendawo nakuba kungasho ukuthi siphelela kulezizinhlangothi kuphela. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukongiwa kwemvelo kuyasimama ukuze intuthuko yakhelwe phezu kwakho.

Mnu. Polsen, ingabe unakho ukuphikisana nesinqumo esicelwe uMnu. Vally esenziwe? Empeleni, ngemvume ye-Union Home Ministry, uNksz Vaish washo. Ikakhulukazi, ukungabi nezindlu kwabesifazane kukhombisa ukungalingani okukhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nabesilisa. Ukuze sibeke iNingizimu Afrika endaweni enhle kakhulu njengethuluzi elisebenzayo kubudlelwane bamazwe omhlaba. Inhloso yale phrojekthi bekuwukugcina isimo semvelo kanye nokuphilisana kwemvelo kwendawo engenela olwandle. Kulindelekile futhi ukuthi kunike umfutho ukuzibandakanya kumkhakha ongekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni kumkhakha wezamandla. Lesi simo sibeka umkhawulo izindawo zokuhlala izindiza zasekhaya kulabo okumele baxhume ngezindiza eziya emazweni aphesheya. Insiza yamabhasi yakudala ihlangabezane nezinkinga ezinkulu zokugcina amabhasi esebenza futhi ibingakwazi ukugcina uhlelo olubonisa kumabhasi oludingekayo. Lokhu okumangazayo okuvelile gnokuphathelene nokwezengqondo kobugebengu kuvusa umbuzo kithina sonke esisemphakathini wokuthi yini esiyenzayo ukumisa ubugebengu obuhambisana nesihluku esikhulu. Gwema ukushayela ngamathayi anomoya omncane ngoba umoya wamathayi omncane kakhulu awukhuphuli kakhulu ukudleka kwalo, kuphinde kwehlise kakhulu isikhathi ebesizohlalwa ithayi. Noma sekukuningi okwazisiwe ngokuphathelene nezinto ezibandakanya ukuqoqwa kwemininingwane ngokuphathelene nokunikwa kabusha inani kwezindawo ezihlala abantu eThekwini. Ake siphinde sizinikele kwimpilo engcono yabantu bonke kwi-Afrika engcono kanye nasemhlabeni ongcono. Amaphoyisa ase-Kirstenhof abambe abasolwa ababili abebehamba bezungeza kule ndawo ngemoto eyebiwe. Mnu.

Njengoba amalungu ahloniphekile azi, silikhulisile inani lezikole lapha kufundwa ngaphandle kokukhokha imali. Ekufezekiseni lezinhlelo sizabe sinenkumbulo yokuthi sizinikele ekuthini siqinisekise ukuthi lomdlalo webhola ka FIFA oka-2010 ube sezingeni eliphakeme. Angithathe lelithuba ukuthi ngibonge ikomodi lakithi elisihlelela lomdlalo kanye nababambisene nabo ngomsebenzi omuhle ebawenzayo. Kuyacaca ukuthi, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sonke lapha eMzansi siyazuza phinde sithokozele ukukhula komnotho, yonke lemizamo idinga ukuthi iphelezelwe yizinhlelo ezizolwisana nobulukhuni esibhekene nabo emabhizinisini asakhasayo. Siqinisekise ukuthi uhlelo lokuthuthukisa izimboni ezisafufusa lusebenza kahle. Siqedelele umthetho osavivinywa wezinkampani owamukelwa yisigungu sikahulumeni ukuthi amalungu omphakathi aphawule ngawo ngolwesithathu odlulile okuyimizamo yethu yokuthi sinciphise imitheshwana eminingi ekhinyabeza ukusebenza kwamabhizinisi amancane nokunika amandla abanamashezi amancane emabhizinisini kanye nezisebenzi. Njengoba sesidlulile ku 10, 000 okuyiyona besizibekele yona, sizakukhulisa inani labantu abasha abasebenza nomkhandlu wentsha yezwe liye ku 20, 000 ngaphansi kwamagatsha kahulumeni ayishumi neshiyagalombili asawenzile amalungiselelo aloluhlelo. Sizakubhalisa intsha engu 30, 000 ezosebenza nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umphakathi ngaphandle kokukhokhelwa siphinde siqashe abantu abasha abangu 5000 ehlelweni lemisebenzi kahulumeni ukuthi bavuse izakhiwo zikahulumeni esezindala noma balungise konke okonakalayo ezakhiweni zikahulumeni.

Ngenhlanhla, yize lokhu kunje, iphinde yasho ukuthi abantu abaningi abatheleleke ngevayirasi bazoba nezimpawu ezingconywana. Yize njengabasebenzi bezempilo, bomhlaba jikelele nabalapha ekhaya, sikhathazekile ngokufa okuvelile kuze kube manje (okungama-0,8% emhlabeni nama-0,2% abantu abesulelekile eNingizimu Afrika). Ivayirasi isulela abantu abaphakathi kweminyaka eyi-10 ukuya kwengama-29 - iningi labo ngabafundi noma ngabasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. I-WHO yeluleke ngokuthi amazwe afanele agxile ekwehliseni umthelela walokhu kufa emiphakathini. Ukwenza lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Lokhu kufa kusatshalaliswa yithonsi lokusuleleka ngokufa okungukuthi uma umuntu osulelekile ekhohlela noma ethimula bese wena uhogela umoya abawuthimulele noma abawukhohlelele. Ngisho noma ngabe bakhohlelela endaweni eqinile, wena wabe usuhogela umoya olapho ungasuleleka. Abantu abaningi emhlabeni banalezi zimpawu ezingcono futhi abadingi noma ngabe yikuphi ukwelashwa okukhethekile. Noma ngabe ngubani onezimpawu ezingconywana noma ezimbi kufanele afune aphinde athole ukwelashwa ngokushesha. Ukuhlolwa okusemthethweni kwenziwa isiKhungo Sikazwelonke Sezifo Ezithelelanayo esiseGauteng esesivule uphiko eNtshonalanga Kapa. Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngesincomo sikadokotela. Iziguli ezidinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lukahulumeni lezempilo akufanele zicele ukuhlolwa kwasendlini yocwaningo lwesayensi. Siyazi ukuthi yilokhu okwenzeka njengamanje emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akukhokona okufunwa yi-WHO.

Njengoba siphakathi kwephondo leKwaZulu-Natal, sijabule ukubona intuthuko esiyenzile emizamweni yokubuyisela isithunzi sobuholi bendabuko kanye nokubamba kwabo iqhaza kuzo zonke izici zokuphatha, ikakhulukazi ezingeni lezakhamuzi. Umphathi wohlelo, ovela emphakathini waseMalangeni, ubonisa ukuthi ukuba lapha kusinika injabulo enkulu ngoba indawo yaseMalangeni inenhlonipho enkulu emlandweni. Le ndawo iyindawo yokuzalwa kweNkosi uShaka kaSenzangakhona. Sazi futhi ukuthi amaqhawe amaningi avela eMalangeni. Futhi le ndawo yindawo lapho imindeni eminingi ibhujiswa emhlabeni wabo ocebile. Nakuba kunezihloko ezingezinhle emlandweni wale ndawo, ilanga liqhubeka likhanya eMalangeni. Ngakho-ke, ukufakwa kwenkosi yethu lapha kwenzeka ngaphansi komlando omkhulu futhi ngesikhathi esibalulekile lapho ubuholi bendabuko bushintsha, buhamba phambili kunangaphambili. Lezi zinguquko zifaka phakathi ukubuyiselwa kobuholi bendabuko kanye nokuphatha kwabo ezimpandeni zabo, ngokwezifiso zendabuko. Siphakathi lapha namuhla siqonda kahle ukuthi nakuba ukujabuliswa kwenkosi yethu kuyisigameko esibalulekile esihlobene nenjabulo nokuqhakambisa isiko, kuhlanganisa nomthetho, ukuphatha ngendlela efanele, kanye nokubaluleka kokugcina isiko. Isakhiwo sobuholi bendabuko sikhishwe kakhulu yimithetho ehlukene kahulumeni eyayikhona ngaphambili. Kodwa manje lesi simo sishintsha. Uhulumeni wesifunda omusha uhlose ukuhlinzeka abaholi bendabuko ngamathuba okwakha uhlelo lokukhulula umthelela wemigomo yokucindezela nokwahlukanisa esakhiweni sobuholi bendabuko. Sisebenza ngokubambisana ukuze sifinyelele lapho sikhona namuhla.

Lesi sethulo esilethwe kithi u-Nadel ngokuphathelene nokuthi zasetshenziswa kanjani lezi zigaba. Ngiqale ngokuthi sihlangen lapha e-Addis ukuze sizofakazela ukuzalwa kwento entsha. Abanye abalimi basebenzisa ukubhekwa kwamankonyane ngezinye izinkomazi ezingezona onina, lapho inkomazi eyodwa ibheka khona amankonyane amabili noma ngaphezulu ngesikhathi ezinye izinkomazi zisengwa. I-traffic circle ekhona njengamanje izosuswa ukuze ivulele endawo enye entsha ethe ukuphakama. Lesi sigaba esilandelayo sikhuluma ngomthelela kwi-SADF kanye nangaphakathi kwi-SADF. Kuzohlinzekwa ngokuqeqeshwa emsebenzini kwinsiza yamaphoyisa asNingizimi Afrika. Yebo ngichaza ukuthi njengamanje sikhuluma ngokwenza ubufakazi bungabi iqiniso obubgasetshenziselwa ukushushisa isigebengu. Empeleni, kune-spotter room ngempela kwindawo ephakeme enkundleni yezemidlalo ngakwicala lasenyakatho mpumalanga. Abaphumelele umklomelo wokuqala, wesibili kanye nowesithathu bazothola ama-hamper emikhiqizo. Ingabe ngaleso sikhathi kwakukade kuyiphunga elimandla noma elizwakala kancane? Kungaba okudingekayo kwintuthuko futhi ngokulinganayo kungaba yindlela yokuvimbela ukunikwa amandla kwabesifazane. Idolobha kuzomele lishintshanise izinsiza kukhangisa ezehlukene ukuze kunikwe amathuba abaxhasi abahlukene. Ukuqondanisa uhlaka lwenhlangano kumasu kanye nokuqeda umthelela we-silo. Nalapho kukhona izinsiza zasekhaya ezihlinzekwayo, izinhlobo zezimpahla, umsebenzi kanye nezinsiza kuhlinzekwa umuntu ongaphandle ukuze kuxhaswe ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza. Ungalali ngesikhathi uhamba ngamatekisi noma ngamabhasi.

Abancane ngokomthetho, ngabantu abangaphansi kweminyaka engu-21, abangakaze bashade ngaphambilini. Ngokulandela umthetho, abantu abake bashada ngesikhathi esedlule, okanti imishado yabo ihlakazwe wukushona noma idivosi, ngeke besathathwa ngokuthi ngabancane ngokomthetho. Bafakele incwadi yokuvuma ebhaliwe, yabo bobabili abazali kanye/noma umnakekeli osemthethweni, ngokugcwalisa ifomu lesicelo elingu-BI-31. Ungenza isicelo sokwamukelwa nguKhomishana wenhlalakahle yezingane uma abazali bangeke batholakala noma kungazeki ukuthi singamukelwa kanjani isitifikedi. Ungenza isicelo sokwamukelwa eNkantolo ePhezulu kwindawo ohlala kuyo uma abazali bakho kanye/noma uKhomishana enqaba ukwamukela umshado. Abantu abadivosile abafuna ukushada futhi, kumele benze okulandelayo babe nomyalelo wedivosi obuya enkantolo. Bafakele isitatimende esifungelwe emthethweni i-afidavithi, uma kukhona isizathu esibambekayo sokuthi kungani ungeke wakhona ukukhipha umyalelo wedivosi, noma uma wadivosa kwelinye izwe langaphandle, nakhona ungeke wakwazi ukuthola umyalelo wedivosi. I-afidavithi kumele ichaze ukuthi umenzi wesicelo udivosile ngokomthetho, igama lenkantolo kanye nosuku lwedivosi. Abantu abashonelwe abafuna ukushada futhi, kumele benze okulandelayo bakhiphe isitifikedi sokushona kowakwabo owashona. Bafakele isitatimende esifungelwe kwabomthetho i-afidavithi, uma isitifikedi sokushona singekho. I-afidavithi kumele iqinise igama nesibongo somuntu oshonile, kanye nosuku ashona ngalo. Isitifikedi esifingqiwe somshado: Sikhishwa masishane. Isitifikesi esingafingqiwe: Izicelo zingathatha amaviki ayisithupha ukuya kwangu-8.

Abantu abangalinganiselwa ezigidini eziyishumi nane bazoba yingxenye yomphakathi wendabuko kuzo zonke izifundazwe zaseNingizimu Afrikha ngaphandle kwaseNtshonalanga Kapa. Isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko sidlala indima ebalulekile ekwenyuseni izinga lezokuhlalisana komphakathi, uxolo nokuxhumana emphakathini. Kulesi sikhundla sokuphathwa kwemithetho yobulungiswa, abaholi bendabuko baxazulula izimpikiswano ezinkantolo zendabuko (Inkundla). Ukubaluleka kwezinkantolo zendabuko kusukela ephuzwini lokuthi zisondelene kakhulu nemiphakathi kanti futhi zisebenzisa ulimi nezindlela umphakathi oziqonda kangcono ukunezinhlelo ezisetshenziswa ezinkantolo zezimantshi. Umholi wendabuko nabeluleki bakhe bahlala ngokuhlanganyela, balalele ubufakazi babamangali kanye "nabamangalelwa" baxazulule izingqinamba njengokwemithetho yamasiko akulowo mphakathi. Izinkantolo zendabuko azinalo uhlu lwemithetho ezilulandelayo olubhalwe phansi. Ziqondiswa amasiko nemikhuba yakulowo mphakathi ezisebenza kuwo. Ngaleyo ndlela, ubulungiswa benziwa ngendlela elula nesheshayo. Esikhathini esingemuva kokhetho lwentando yeningi lonyaka we-1994 lezi zigaba ezilandelayo zobuholi zemukelwa. Leli thebhula elilandelayo likhombisa ukusabalala esifundazweni kwamazinga amathathu obuholi bendabuko kuleli zwe. Indlu yabaholi bendabuko kuzwelonke yakhiwa ngaphansi komthetho weNdlu yabaHoli beNdabuko kaZwelonke ka 1997 futhi usebenza kuzwelonke, leli thebhula elilandelayo likhombisa isimo esikhona esithinta iziNdlu zezifundazwe nezasekhaya ezifundazweni. Kulowo nalowo mphakathi ongaphansi komholi wendabuko, umkhandlu wendabuko kumele wakhiwe futhi wamukelwe.

Ungqongqoshe angabeka namandla nemisebenzi ka-Director-General, u-Registratin IHhovisir , i-asosiyeshini, amalunga noma abanye abathintekayo kulezi zimo. Kwisimo senkamapni noma i-close corporation , noma yibaphi abantu abathintekayo, u-director , umhloli wamabhuku ezimali, noma abophiki lwezimali ezingenayo i-South African Revenue Service noma u-Registrar of Companies, bangenza isicelo sokuthi inkampani ikhishwe kuhla lobhaliso lwezinkampni noma ama-CC. Inkampani ebhalisiwe, i-asosiyeshini noma iCC, kumele zibhale incwadi zenze isicelo sokukhishwa kuhla lobhaliso. Ichaze isizathu sokuthi kungan inkampani noma i-CC yenza isicelo sokukhishwa kuhla lobhaliso. Lapho kukhonakala khona, ikhombise inombolo yentela yenkampani noma ye-CC. Bonke o-director kanye namalunga enkampani noma be-CC kumele basayine incwadi uma kuyisicelo sokukhishwa kuhla lobhaliso abazenzela bona ngokuvuma kwabo ukuthi inkampani ikhishwe kuhla lobhaliso. Ukukhishwa kuhla lobhaliso kuthatha cishe izinyanga eziyisithupha. Le nkonzo ngeyamahhala ayikhokhelwa. Awekho amafomu okumele agcwaliswe.

Ngakho-ke, igama lebrand liyigama noma ukuhlanganiswa kwamagama. Isiqubulo siyi-phrasi noma umusho omfushane kanye nesithombe esithile se-logo esihlukaniswe nezinye noma uphawu. Lokhu kukhombisa ubunikazi obuhlukile obuhlobene naleyo nkampani emakethe futhi kusebenza nakumikhiqizo nasezinkampanini. Uma uphawu lwasungulwa, akekho omunye ongasebenzisa lelo phawu noma elinye elifana nalo. Uma lokhu kwenzeka, kungathathwa izinyathelo zomthetho. Kube nezimo ezidumile ezinkantolo zaseNingizimu Afrika, njengokuthi inkampani yeMcDonald's e-USA yaphosa icala enkampanini yaseNingizimu Afrika eyayisebenzisa uphawu olufana ne "M" yabo. Thola ifomu le-TM1 ulenze ngamasethi amathathu. Amakhophi amabili azosetshenziswa ehhovisi, kanti elinye kufanele uligcine njengobufakazi besicelo sakho. Khokha imali yokubhaliswa ngaphambi noma lapho uthumela isicelo sakho. Bhala phansi imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ofuna ukuzenza usebenzisa uphawu emkhakheni 57 wefomu le-TM1. Qaphela kakhulu ungafaki imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ezivela kwezinye izigaba ngaphansi komkhiqizo owodwa esicelweni. Uma wenza njalo, uzonconywa ukuba uhlele incazelo ukuze ifake kuphela lezo zimpahla noma izinsizakalo ezichazwe kulowo mkhakha kuphela. Ngaphandle kwalokho, kuzodingeka ukuthi uthumele isicelo esihlukile futhi. Uma isicelo sakho sihlangabezana nazo zonke izimfuneko zokubhaliswa, uzonikezwa usuku lwesicelo sakho nenombolo. Zonke izingxoxo nehhavisi zizobhekisela kulenombolo yesicelo. Nakuba kungathatha kuze kube yizinyanga eziyi-18 ukubhaliswa komkhiqizo, ungakwazi ukuwusebenzisa njengoba uthola inombolo yesicelo sakho.

Ngaphambi kokuthi athathe umgwaqo noma umgwaqo ophumelele, uMEC kumele aqinisekise ukuthi ucwaningo lendawo kanye nebika kwenziwa njengoba kubhekwa umphakathi owazi ngemisebenzi esigabeni 22 ye-ECA, noma umphakathi obheka izigaba ezihlobene ze-NEMA uma lezi zigaba zisebenza, angakwazi ukuhlela. kanye nokumemezela izinyathelo zokulawula ezisungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 11. UMEC kumele axhumane nazo zonke izifunda lapho umgwaqo uzobe khona futhi acela, ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe, ukuthi zithumele imibono ebhaliwe ngombiko wokuqala womgwaqo nendawo ekhombisa umthelela ozoba khona umgwaqo ophakanyisiwe kunoma iyiphi isikhala noma enye uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa komphakathi oluhlelekile lwezinhlelo zomphakathi ezithintekayo. a ibhekisela kumgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela; noma b ngokusebenzisa izigaba 6 kuya ku-9, thumela udaba noma izinkinga ezivela kumabhuku okukhuluma noma imibono kwi-commission ukuze kwenziwe ukuxhumana komphakathi okukhuthaza lezi zindaba ngqo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esichaziwe nguMEC futhi, ngemva kokubheka lezi ziphakamiso, kumemezele umgwaqo wesifunda noma umgwaqo wezitimela. h umuntu angaba ngumholi onemfundo efanele ongaba omunye walabo abakhuluma ezigabeni a kuya ku-g; futhi i umholi kanye namalungu amane kufanele benze i-quorum ngenhloso yokusebenza kwe-commission. e usuku nendawo yokuxhumana komphakathi; futhi f ukumemezela izinyathelo zokulawula ezisungulwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 7 ekukhishweni komgwaqo ngokwesigaba 12. futhi b phatha ukuxhumana ngokuhambisana nenqubo echaziwe.

Eziwombeni ezifuze lezi, izindleko, isabelo sezimali kumele kwenziwe ngokucophelela nangobuchwepheshe. IDP nokuHlela iMboni i-IDP yinqubo egamanxe nezimboni kodwa igxile kakhulu enqubeni yokuhlela nokungenzeka ukuba ibandakanye imboni ngayinye. Kungenzeka yenabele ezinhlelweni zokuhlelwa kwemboni, kuye ngokukleliswa kwezidingo zendawo. Izikhungo zemboni ngaphakathi kumasipala kanjalo nalezo zezinye izinhlaka zikahulumeni zinemibandela yazo yokuhlela kanti eminye ichazwa wumthetho. Inqubo ye-IDP njengoba yethulwe kuleli qoqo lamabhukwana ilumbaniswe nemibandela yokuhlelwa kwemboni ngendlela yokuba yingxenye yenqubo ye-IDP. Ngenxa yalokhu, imibandela yohlelo lwemboni iyofezwa yinqubo ye-IDP njengoba ihlongozwe kuleli qoqo lamabhukwana lapho imibandela yokuhlela iphathelene nezindaba ezigamanxile (isibonelo, izindaba zokuhlelwa kwenhlalo nezemvelo) nalapho imboni ibhekene nezidingo-nqangi neziwumphumela wenqubo ye-IDP. Imibandela yezinhlelo zemboni nengaphathelene nezinto ezikleliswe phambili kuyomele ibhekelwe ngokwehlukile kwinqubo ye-IDP. Kuyoba nesidingo sokubandakanya zonke izikhungo zemboni kwinqubo yokuhlela I-IDP, ukufakwa kwezimali nokuqhutshwa kwemisebenzi esiqaliwe. Inqubo ye-IDP: Imboni ihlobene kakhulu nezinto ezikleliswe phambili nezivunjululwe ngenqubo yohlaziyo lwe-IDP. Zincane izingxenye zemibandela yokuhlelwa kwemboni ezingahambisana ngokugcwele nezinto eziphawulwe wuhlelo lwe-IDP nokuyofanela zisetshenzizwa ngenye inqubo.

Kungathathwa izinqumo eziyizinkulungwane, kodwa angeke ziqaliswe ngempumelelo uma sala uxolo. Umndeni wendoda yaseFreystata eyabulawa kwimizamo yokuphanga endaweni engasolwandle eThekwini ngonyaka odlule, usamukele isigwebo esinikezwe ababulali bayo. Ukufundiswa komphakathi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekwaziseni umphakathi, kukwethembeka kanye nokuba semthethweni kohlelo lokuvota. Ukwelashwa kweziguli ezilaliswayo kulungele abantu abathembele kwizidakamizwa, noma abakwisimo esisondele ekuthembeleni kuzona. Ababandakanyekayo bavuma ukusungula ngokushesha Iqembu LikaMongameli Eliqondene Nabezindaba. Baphinde bathatha nezinye izinto ezehlukene okukholelwa ukuthi zebiwe. Ukuhlanganisa kanye nokugcina isikhungo esinezikhungo ezahlukene iminyaka eyahlukene kanye nezinhlaka kanye nezinhlelo ezikhombisa lokhu kanye nokubuka ngalokhu. Amanani akhonjiswe kumathebula awashintshi futhi ayaqhathaniseka unyaka nonyaka. Impilo yomhlambi ihlolwa nyanga zonke ngudokotela wezilwane, futhi acebisa ngakho kuyenziwa. Ihlole indlela amakhaya angena kumaqoqo ahlukene asebenzisa ngayo imali. Kubalulekile ukuthola izindlela kanye nezimo zokunquma eziveza konke ngokusobala ngokuklanywa kwendawo yokundiza izindiza kanye nokuhlinzekwa kwama-ATS kwindawo yokundiza izindiza efana nalena. Ngokuqinisekile abenza imigomo abafana nami kanye nabanye abadlala indima kulokhu sidinga imininingo ephathelene nesilinganiso kanye nokuqhathanisa ukuze siqonde uhlobo lwento etsha okuqhanyukwe nayo nokuthi ishintsha kanjani ngemuva kwesikhathi. Kuzoba iphutha elikhulu kimina ukuthi ngiphethe ngaphandle kokwazisa umsebenzi omuhle owenziwe Ukhomishani Wamalungelo Esintu kanye Nehhovisi Lobubhalane lakhe.

Ubhontshisi wesoya - isitshalo esiyisimangaliso nesiwukudla okuyisimangaliso! Kuningi okukhulunywayo ngobhontshisi wesoya nokubaluleka kwawo ekushintshanisweni kwezitshalo nommbila. Njengezinye izitshalo esekukade zilinywa emakhaya, ubudlelwane bukabhontshisi wesoya wesikhathi sanamuhla nezinye izinhlobo ezizikhulela endle akusakwazeki ukulandela umkhondo wabo ngokwanoma yiliphi izinga lokuqiniseka. NjengoHlelo lwe-Grain SA Lokuthuthukiswa Kwabalimi, sinethemba lokusungula uhlelo neNhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Kukawoyela Nezimbewu Zamaphrotheni (i-Oil and Protein Seeds Development Trust) ukuze abalimi abasafufusa bakhuthazwe ukulima ubhontshisi wesoya - njengesitshalo sokuhweba, nanjengomthombo wezwe lakuleli wohlobo oluphambili lwamaphrotheni. Isoya iyahlukahluka ngokukhula nangendlela eziphatha ngayo. Ubude besitshalo buyehluka busuke ngaphansi kwama-20cm buye kumamitha ama-2. Imidumba, iziqu zesitshalo namacembe kwembozwe uboya obumayephuyephu obunsundu noma obumpunga. Amacembe anamahlumela amathathu ukuya kwamane ngecembe ngalinye, kanti amahlumela lawo anobude bamasentimitha ayi-6 ukuya kwayi-15, nobubanzi bamasentimitha ama-2 ukuya kwayi-7. Amacembe ayawa ngaphambi kokuvuthwa kwembewu. Izimbali ezinganakeki, ezizivundisa zona ngokwazo zithwalwa emgqeni osenkabeni yecembe futhi zingaba nombala omhlophe, ophinki noma obunsomi (o-purple).

I-IDP izama ukuphakamisa imiphakathi. Khumbuza iqembu ukuthi I-IDP isithintiwe esahlukweni 14. Bese ubuza iqembu, ukuthi iyini indima yamakomidi ezigceme kwi-IDP Khomba kunombolo 4.1.3 esahlukweni? Nikeza incazelo yeLED - Khomba kunombolo 4.2.1. Nikeza izibonelo zezinhlelo ze-LED - bheka kunombolo 4.2.4. Bese ubuza iqembu ukuthi lingacababga yini ezinye izinhlelo ze-LED ezisezindaweni zabo ezingashiwongo. Ukuhlinzekwa ngarnanzi amahhala - Chaza kafushane nombolo 5.1. Nikeza iqembu izibalo zokubonisa isimo sendaba - bheka kunombolo 6. lziphi izindlela ezahlukene zokuxhumana? Ukuxhumana buthule - nikeza izibonelo zokuxhumana buthule. Umsebenzi osamdlalo owokwenza amalungu eqembu ukuthi akhombise uhlobo lokuxhumana buthule bese uyekela iqembu lonke liqagele ukuthi lowo okhuluma buthule uzama ukuthini. Yenza umsebenzi ekugcineni kwesahluko ngamaqoqo o 4 noma 5. Funda amaphuzu anohlamvu kunombolo 2.3 wesahluko. Kungenziwa kanjani ukuthi ukuxhumana kusebenze kahle? Funda amaphuzu anohlamvu kunombolo 2.4. Funda amaphuzu 3.1 kuya ku 3.10. Chaza kafushane ukuthi iphuzu nephuzu lingasetshenziswa kanjani uma kuxhunyanwa, futhi nobani. lngabe wonke umuntu eqeniini sewake wakhuluma yini esidlangaleni Buza-ke abaqeqeshwayo ukuthi kungani becabanga ukuthi ukukhuluma esidlangaleni kubalulekile kumakomidi ezigceme? lsho amathiphu okukhuluma esidlangaleni - kafushane thinta amaphuzu a-h. Yenza umsebenzi ngaphansi kwesingeniso sesahluko ngamaqoqo o 4 noma 5.

UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphathi-hhovisi wakwahulumeni ogunyaziwe nguNgqongqoshe, uma ethola isicelo esibhalwe phansi somuntu ogunyaziwe ngaphansi kwesigatshana 4, angawaqeda amandla alowo muntu okushadisa ngokubhala phansi maqondana nokuthi ahlanganise ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi ngaphansi kwale Sahluko. Le sahluko, inqobo ngokuhambisana nesigatshana , asimphoqi umshadisi ukuthi asingaqhe umcimbi wokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano bezakhamuzi: Inqobo nje uma emazisile uNgqongqoshe ngokubhala phansi ukuthi unembeza wakhe uyaphikisana nokuhlanganisa ophathini ngokwale Sahluko. Isigatshana 1 asisebenzi kubashadisi ababekwe ngaphansi kwale Sahluko. a kokuthi lowo nalowo muntu ohlanganiswayo akhiphe umazisi wakhe awuthola ngaphansi kwemigomo yomthetho kaMazisi; noma b lowo nalowo muntu anikeze umshadisi isitatimende esifungelwe ngokubekiwe; noma c omunye wabafuna ukuhlanganiswa akhiphe umazisi okukhulunywa ngawo kwisigaba a awukhombise umshadisi bese lona omunye enikeza umshadisi isitatimende esifungelwe nokukhulunywa ngaso kwisigaba b. Umuntu angaba uphathini wobuhlobo obubodwa ngesikhathi. Umuntu oshadile akakwazi ukurejistela ubuhlobo. Umuntu ozoba uphathini kubuhlobo bezakhamuzi oseke washada ngaphambilini kumbe oseke waba uphathini kobunye ubuhlobo kufanele aqale akhiphe ikhophi efakazelwe yokudivosa kumbe isitifiketi sokufa kwabeshade naye kumbe obengumhlobo wakhe, loko nje okuqondene, anikeze umshadisi njengobufakazi bokuthi lobo budlelwano sebuqediwe. Umshadisi angeqhubeke nomcimbi nokurejista ubudlelwano ngaphandle kokuthi aqale anikezwe le mmiqulu okukhulunywa ngayo kwisigatshana 3.

Sezakhiwe izinhlelo zokungenelela ezizovuselela eminye imikhakha yezomnotho ukuze kwakheke amathuba emisebenzi kanye nokungena kwemali. Lokhu kungenelela okuletha inguquko okulindeleke ukuthi ukukhuthaze ukuThuthukiswa Komnotho Wendawo kudinga ubuholi besikhungo obukhethekile, obugxile ekwakheni isimonhlalo esizovumela ukuba indawo kamasipala wendawo iphenduke ihabhu lesifunda saseZululand KwaZulu Natali. Ukuhlala kwabantu okuyiphethini elandelanayokanye nezindawo zokusebenza ezisemzileni ofaka iMondlo-Vryheid-Hlobane- Coronation-Nyathi-Louwsberg kubeka kokubili, izinselelo namathuba okuhlonza izinhlelo zokungenelela okuletha inguquko. Ukufezekiswa kombono wokuthi indawo yasebaQulusini iphenduke ihabhu lesifunda elisemqoka kuzodinga imiklamo egqamile nenamandla. Izindlela eziqokiwe zidinga lezi zinto ezilandelayo. Izinsiza zezimali zakho konke okudingwa ngumklamo kanye nokulekelelwa kwezobuchwepheshe. Isikhathi esibekiwe esicacile nesikholekayo kanye nezihlinzeko zokuqapha. Ukuba nesibopho sokubika esimile. Ubani ozosizakala ngaleli bhukwana? Leli bhukwana lihlose ukwabelana ngolwazi olufanele nabasebenzi abaningi be-LED kanye nababambiqhaza abambandakanyekayo ebaQulusini. Lolu lwazi lusiza kakhulu abasebenzi abasebenzela uhulumeni wendawo eVryheid. Lizoba lusizo futhi kunoma ngubani osebenza emkhakheni wezokuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo nomnotho. Lokhu kumbandakanya abasebenzi bakahulumeni wendawo, beSifundazwe kanye nabakaZwelonke, abaxhasi bendawo nabomhlaba-jikelele, abahlanganyeli emabhizinisini, kanye neZinhlangano Ezingekho ngaphansi kukaHulumeni (NGOs).

Ekusungulweni kwe-NER (Umphakathi Wezokuhlinzeka Ngamandla) ngoMsombuluko 1995, i-NER yazibophezela ekwenzeni izinga lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi (ESI). Izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zabe seziqokonyiswa futhi zafaneleka nguMphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bonke abahlinzeki bamanzi bagcina abathengi bethola izinga elamukelekayo lezinsizakalo. Enye indima esebenza ngayo i-NER okwamanje ukuqapha iminikelo yabahlinzeki bamanzi ngokubabeka uma kuqhathaniswa nezindinganiso ezibekwe. Umphakathi uphinde uqaphele ukuthi abathengi banendima yokudlala ohlelweni lokulawulwa. Kukholwa ukuthi uma abathengi beqonda izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhona, bazokwazi ukuvusa izinkinga kubahlinzeki bamanzi futhi babe nezwi ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokuhlinzeka ngogesi. Ngakho-ke, abathengi kufanele bazi ngezindinganiso zokuhlinzeka abazifanele. Kuze kube manje, i-NER isungule idokhumenti elula ukufundwa futhi eyamukelekayo kubathengi. Le dokhumenti isekelwe kulokho okukhona ngaphandle kokushintsha umqondo wayo. I-National Electricity Regulator (NER) isivele yaqaphela isidingo sokusungula izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo embonini yokuhlinzeka ngogesi; izindinganiso zokuhlinzeka ngogesi zingalindelwa ngabathengi bempahla ehlukahlukene kanye nezinga okufanele lihlangabezane nalokho okukhona. Abahlinzeki bamanzi kufanele babike ku-NER ngezinga labo lokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo uma kuqhathaniswa nezindinganiso ezibekwe. Lokhu kwenziwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi abahlinzeki bayalandela izindinganiso.

Ulwazi olunesiqiniseko nezibalo ngohlelo lwenhlangano, isimo somnotho nezinto zemvelo kumele zibe yingxenye yolwazi oselukhona. (1 /1). Inselelo enkulu eSigabeni sokuHlaziya wukuthatha isinyathelo esithathelwe ezicucwini zokuhlaziya okwenziwe emazingeni nasezindaweni ezehlukene nezenziwe ngamaqhinga anhlobonhlobo nokuholela ohlwini olubumbene lwezidingo-nqangi lapho wonke umuntu obambe iqhaza ebona ubulungiswa. Isinyathelo esiphambili wukuqoqa ulwazi, ukuluhlanganisa nokubuyisana ngalo ngaphambi kokuba iSigungu sabaMmeli boMphakathi sikwazi ukudweba uhlu olufanele lwezinto ezingakleliswa phambili. (Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /7). Ngemuva kokuvumelana ngezinto eziyokleliswa phambili, kungenzeka kutholakala ukuthi isimo sezinto noma izinguquko aziphethekile kahle. Singakuqonda ukuthi izakhamizi azinawo amanzi aphuzwayo kodwa singazi noma lokho kudalwa wukwentuleka kwezinsiza zokuletha lensiza-nqangi ebantwini, wukwentuleka kobuchwepheshe, wuhlelo olungenele lokuphathwa kwamanzi, yisakhiwo senkokhelo efanele nesikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa noma ukwentuleka kwezimali. Lolu lwazi lumqoka ekutholeni izisombululo ezifanele. Eziwombeni zezinto ezihamba phambili nokuntuleka ulwazi ngazo, ukuhlaziya okunzulu nokugxile emongweni kufanelekile (Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /8 no 1 /9 emibandeleni yemboni ethile). Ulwazi oluqoqwa ngeSigaba sokuHlaziya lufanele kakhulu labo ababambe iqhaza kwinqubo ezayo yokuhlela nokuthatha izinqumo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele lufingqwe ukuze lusetshenziswe eSigabeni 2 (Umsebenzi wokuHlela 1 /10).

Uhlelo lwe-Just Energy Transition lugxile ekwakheni izinhlelo ezithuthukisa amandla ahlanzekile, ukunciphisa ukufudumala komhlaba, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. U-Sipho ufuna ukuthi lezi zinguquko zifinyeleleke kuwo wonke umphakathi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezinomnotho ophansi, ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinga lempilo. Ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezithuthukisa amandla amasha, uSipho usebenza kanzima ekwandiseni uhlelo lokutshala imali kulolu hlelo. U-Sipho ungumholi ophokophelelayo ekwakheni imithombo ye-energising eyenza umphakathi uzitholele izinzuzo ezihlanzekile. Ubuye abambe iqhaza emikhankasweni yezoMnotho Ezemvelo, eqhubeka nokuqonda izindlela zokusebenza ezinhle. U-Sipho ukholelwa ukuthi uhlelo lokutshala imali luyisihluthulelo sokuguqula amandla, futhi u-Just Energy Transition uhlanganisa amalungelo abantu, ucwaningo lwezobuchwepheshe, nezinsiza zokwakha ibhizinisi. Uhlaka lokugcina ilungelo lokuphuma kokunciphisa izindleko zamandla lusebenza kumalungelo abantu bonke. Naphezu kokuba esencane, uSipho uhlanganyela emisebenzini yokukhuthaza izinhlelo zokwakha amandla ahlanzekile. Uthanda ukuphila okukhona, ulwa nokudla kwesizinda, futhi umkhiqizo wakhe, i-Just Energy Transition, ubonisa ukuzimisela kwakhe ekwakheni umphakathi ophumelelayo. U-Sipho ubonisa impumelelo, ukhuthaza imikhankaso yokusebenza, futhi unakekela izinkinga zamandla. Uhlala edinga ukwakha ubudlelwane phakathi kwabantu, abaphakathi, nezinkampani ukuze kuthuthukiswe izixazululo ezihlanzekile. U-Sipho uyisibonelo esihle, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uzokwakha ikusasa elihlanzekile nelihle.

Idokhumende ngenhloso yokuhamba ikhishwa kubenzi bezicelo abakwisimo sokuhlala unomphela kodwa abangakwazi ukuthola ipasipoti ezweni abavela kulo, noma abangenalizwe noma abangababaleki abadinga isiphephelo. Gcwalisa ifomu lesicelo le-BI-73 kunoma yiliphi ihhovisi lezaseKhaya eNingizimu Afrika. Yenza isicelo kwinxusa noma imission uma ungaphandle kwezwe. Khipha ubufakazi bokuthi ungumhlali wanomphela lapho wenza izicelo. Akuthathwe izigxivizo zeminwe yakho ukuze irekhodwe kuhla lwabantu bezwe. Fakela nezithombe ezimbili zosayizi wepasipoti. Le nkonzo ingathatha ukufinyelela kumaviki angu-6.

Umphakathi wawujabule, futhi abalandeli babenokholo olukhulu. Umdlalo wabo wawuhambisana nezinkanyezi ezinkulu, njengabathandekayo abanjengoTeko Modise, Pitso Mosimane, noKhama Billiat. Lezi zinkanyezi zashintsha umqondo wabantu, zakhuthaza abasha ukuba babe nezifiso ezinkulu. Nakuba beface izinselelo, uSundowns waphendula ngokuqinile, wathola izixazululo, futhi wakhuthaza umphakathi. Kwakukhona umoya wokubambisana, lapho wonke umuntu, kusukela kubadlali, abaqeqeshi, nabalandeli, babephakathi kokusebenza ngokuhlanganyela. Lokhu kwaba yindlela yokuphila, futhi kwaba yisibonelo esihle sokuthi umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza emqondweni. I-Sundowns yathola izifundo eziningi; umdlalo wabo wawungaphezu kokuphumelela, wawuwumoya, nokuhlanganyela. Abalandeli baziqhenya ngalesi qembu, umphakathi wawukhula, futhi iSundowns yathola ithuba lokuhlanganyela nemiphakathi ehlukene, iyazisa imiphakathi eyayikade ingaziwa. Namuhla, amaMamelodi Sundowns akhombisa ubuhlakani obukhulu emhlabeni wezemidlalo. Akukhona nje umphakathi ophilayo, kodwa kuyisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza ekuphumeleleni. Abalandeli baziqhenya ngempela, futhi leli qembu lihlala lishaya izigigaba ezintsha, lishintsha izimpilo zabantu. Ngesikhathi sokuphumelela, iSundowns iyakha izinkanyezi ezizayo, ikhulisa abasha, futhi ibakhuthaza ukuba baphumelele. Lokhu kuhlanganyela kubonisa ukuthi ibhola akusikho nje ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, umoya, nokubambisana. Ngakho, uma ubona amaMamelodi Sundowns edlala, khumbula ukuthi akukhona nje umphakathi ophilayo, kodwa kuyisibonelo sokuthi umphakathi ungabamba kanjani iqhaza emhlabeni wezemidlalo.

Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezikhethekile zokuxhasa abantu abahluphekayo, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi lwezempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo ezisemaphandleni zidinga ukuxhaswa okwengeziwe ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngensiza efanele. Ngokubheka ikusasa, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo ziqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukwakha izikhungo eziningi ezisemaphandleni, ukuhlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa okuqhubekayo kubasebenzi, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinhlaka ezahlukene. Ngokwenza lokhu, sizokwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu bathola ulwazi lwezempilo olufanele, oluthuthukisa impilo yabo. Ekugcineni, ukufakwa kwezikhungo zolwazi lwezempilo kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kudinga ukubambisana, ukuxhaswa, kanye nokuzinikela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola ulwazi olufanele nolwakhiwe kahle. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho abantu bethu bazi kahle ngezempilo zabo, futhi benza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile.

eNingizimu Afrika, kuze kube manje, siqinisekisile amacala angu-2,844 kanye nezingozi eziyisithupha. Ngemuva komhlangano wesine weKomidi Lokuphendula Okusheshayo owawubanjwe ngoJuni 11, 2009, iHhovisi Lomhlaba Wezempilo (WHO) lathola ukuthi izinqubo zokumemezela leli gciwane njenge-pandemic yomhlaba wonke sezifeziwe, futhi uMphakathi-Jikelele, uDkt. Margret Chan, usememezele ngokusemthethweni lesi simo njengePandemic (izinga 6). Lokhu kusho ukuthi leli gciwane lisabalalise ezweni zonke ezindaweni ze-WHO futhi lenze ngokushesha. Nokho, ngifuna ukugcizelela ukuthi ukumemezela i-pandemic akusho ukuthi leli gciwane linamandla. Lokhu kusho ukuthi liqhubeka lisabalala yonke indawo. NgoJulayi 6, i-WHO ichaze ukuqhubeka kwale pandemic ezweni ezithintekile kanye nezwe ezintsha njengokungamukeleki nokungabambeki. Ngaphandle kwalokho, nakuba kunjalo, iphinde yathi abantu abaningi abathintekile ngaleli gciwane bazoba nezimpawu ezilula. Nakuba thina njengabasebenzi bezempilo, emhlabeni jikelele nasekhaya, sikhathazekile ngalezi zingozi ezikhona kuze kube manje (okungama-0.8% emhlabeni jikelele kanye nama-0.2% abantu abathintekile eNingizimu Afrika). Leli gciwane liba nomthelela ikakhulukazi kubantu abaphakathi kweminyaka engu-10 kuya kwengu-29 - iningi labo lingabafundi noma ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme. I-WHO inikeze iseluleko ukuthi amazwe afanele agxile ekunciphiseni umthelela wale gciwane emphakathini. Ukuze kwenziwe lokhu, ukuxhumana kahle kubalulekile. Leli gciwane lisabalala ngeziphuzo zokuphefumula, okusho ukuthi uma umuntu othintekile ekhwehlela noma ekhala, uphonsa lezi ziphuzo ezikhiphayo noma ezingavikelwanga.

Ngemuva kokwakha ibhizinisi eliqinile, kufanele sihlole indlela yokubambisana. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, amabhizinisi kufanele axhumane nabanye ukuze athole ukufinyelela ezinsizeni nezinhlaka ezahlukene. Lokhu kubambisana kungaholela ekwakheni izixazululo ezintsha, kuhlanganyele izinsiza, futhi kulethe izinzuzo kubo bobabili. Ukubambisana kungenza kube lula ukuncintisana emakethe futhi kudale amathuba amasha. Kodwa futhi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ezamabhizinisi akupheli ekwakheni kuphela, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukusiza umphakathi. Ukuze sizuze impumelelo, kufanele sithathe izinyathelo ezihlobene nokubaluleka kokuhlinzeka izinsizakalo ezithuthukisayo kubantu. Amabhizinisi kufanele abheke ukuthi angawathuthukisa kanjani amathuba emisebenzi, anikeze imiholo efanele, futhi abe nesandla ekuthuthukiseni imiphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izimfundiso ezivela ezamabhizinisi ziqinisekisa ukuthi akukhona kuphela ukuhweba, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuba siyiqonde impilo yomphakathi. Ibhizinisi elinobuhlakani alikhulisi kuphela inzuzo, kodwa futhi linikela ekuthuthukiseni isimo sokuphila sabantu. Lokhu kuyindlela engcono yokwenza umphakathi ube namandla, nokwakha ikusasa eliqinile. Ekugcineni, ezamabhizinisi zinhle kakhulu uma zisebenza kahle, zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, ziqinisekise abasebenzi, zisebenzisana, futhi zikhathalela umphakathi. Ngamafuphi, izifundo zokuphumelela ezivela ezamabhizinisi zikhombisa ukuthi ukuphumelela akukhona nje ngenkulu yokuthengisa, kodwa futhi kubalulekile ukuhamba phambili ngendlela efanele, enobuntu, futhi eqondile. Lokhu kuzoholela emiphumeleni emihle, hhayi kuphela kubanikazi bamabhizinisi, kodwa nasezimpilweni zabantu abahlala emiphakathini yethu.

Umnyango Wezemihlaba unabasebenzi abangenele okwamanje kanti izidingo zomphakathi zinkulu ikakhuklukazi ezabasebenzi bamapulazi. Ukusetshenziswa kezinhlelo zezinguquko kwezomhlaba njengethuba lokukhuthaza intuthuko kwezolimo phakathi kwabalimi abasafufusa nokuhlela kabusha ubunini bomhlaba ngokwabiwa kwawo. Ukuzabalazela ukwakha isimo sokuhambisana kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo. UMasipala abhekisise izindlela zokwabiwa kwezimali zoxhso lwezenhlalakahle azise nezindlela zokutholakala kwalo. Ziyisithupha izinhlaka ezahalanganiswa ngenkathi kwakhiwa uMasipala Okhahlamba. Okhahlamba kunamawrd angu 13, I ward ngayinye ineKhansela elakhethwa ngumphakathi bese kuba namaKhansela angu amele izinhlangano 13 aseMkhandlwini kaMasipala. Amakomidi esikhashana ayasungulwa lapho kunesidingo. Kunezikhala ezingu 25 kuMasipala ezinabantu okwamanje, kuyacatshangwa ukuthi lapho uMkhandlu sewusunguleke kahle kuyoba khona ezinye izikhala ezingu18 ezisukela esikhundleni soMqondisi kwehla kuya emazingeni ababenzi abanjengomabhalane bamaKomidi. ILungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali, ngemuva kokunika ilungu ithuba lokubeka udaba lwalo, noma ngasiphi isikhathi linganqamula isikhathi sokusebenza esikhundleni kwalelo lungu uma, ngokubona kwalo, kunezizathu zokwenza lokho. Ilungu kumele lishiye isikhundla uma liphutha emsebenzini, ngaphandle kokunikezwa imvume yokuphutha yiBhodi, emihlanganweni emibili ilandelana yeBhodi lapho isexwayiso esanikezwa kulelo lungu noma ngeposi. Ilungu lingesula esikhundleni ngokuthi libhale ngokunikeza isaziso sezinsuku ezingekho ngaphansi kwezingama-30 iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali: Kuncike ekutheni iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhwekele ezezimali lingasiziba leso saziso sokwesula. Noma nini lapho kuvela khona isikhala somsebenzi eBhodini, iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali kumele, ngokuncike esigabeni 5, liqoke umuntu ozovala leso sikhala somsebenzi kwingxenye engakaphelelwa isikhathi yokusebenza esikhundleni selungu okuzoqokwa kuso lowo muntu. isibalo esiningi samalungu eBhodi, lokho kumiswa okungenza ukuthi iBhodi ingakwazi ukusebenza. iLungu loMkhandlu oPhethe elibhekele ezezimali, ngokususela kwisigaba 5, liyoqoka amalungu eBhodi ezinsukwini ezingama-90 zokuqokwa okuhlongozwe kwisigatshana (7).

Le nkohliso isungulwa ngumkhohlisi ngokuxhumana nenkampani ethize ngokuyithumela ifekisi, incwadi noma i-email. Abakhohlisi baqamba amanga bathi banesamba semali yebhajethi eningi ngokweqile, imvamise bathi ingamadola aseMelika. Isiphakamiso sebhizinisi sivame ukuchaza ukuthi banesamba semali eningi ngokweqile, abafuna ukuyikhipha ezweni lakubo bayifakele ebhangi langaphandle kwalelo lizwe evela kulo. Lowo ovumayo ukusebenzisana nabo uyaye acelwe ukuthi afakele imali kwi-akhawunti yebhangi elithize yokusiza ukubhekana nezindleko zokudlulisa le mali. Uma esekhokhele leyo mali, uvamise ukutshelwa ukuthi kuvele "isixaka-xaka" thizeni, ngakhoke kumele afakele enye imali futhi. Kuvamise ukuthi kwenziwe amalungiselelo omhlangano nalowo muntu kwelinye izwe, kanti uma lowo muntu eselapho kulelo lizwe, uthathelwa ipasipoiti yakhe, naye abanjwe ukuze enze amalungiselelo okufakelwa kwenye imali kwi-akhawunti yezigelekeqe. Kungasetshenziswa ama-letterhead abonakale engawangempela kanti awambumbulu ukufakela imininingwane yeBhangi, ukudlulisela imali yalowo muntu obanjwa inkunzi esuka kwi-akhawunti yakhe ifakelwa kwi-akhawunti yezigelekeqe.

Uma uqala ukulima, kusho ukuthi usenkampanini, ngakho kufanele uqoqe ulwazi mayelana nezinto ezichaza isimo sakho. Kuzofika isikhathi lapho uzodinga imali, bese uya ebhange noma kwenye indawo ukuyoboleka imali. Lezi zindawo zidinga ulwazi oluningi mayelana nesimo sakho kanye nesimo sebhizinisi lakho. Ngezansi kukhona amatafula anemininingwane yezinto ezizodingeka (kufanele kube nekhophi ye I.D. yakho kanye nekhophi ye I.D. yomkakho). Lokhu kubalulekile. Ngaso sonke isikhathi nikeza ulwazi mayelana nalezi zinto: lapho wazalwa khona, nini, lapho ukhulele khona, ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi uqale ukufisa ukulima. Lokhu kungasiza lapho uya ezifundweni ngoba bazokwazi ukukhuluma ulimi oluhambisana nawe. Khumbula ukuthi ukulima kudinga ukunakwa kwakho nsuku zonke nangasikhathi sonke. Uma unomfuno oqinile wokulima, kufanele ube khona epulazini lakho ngaso sonke isikhathi. Kuthiwa "amehlo omqashi akhuthaza isilwane," futhi "ukufaka okungcono kakhulu yizinyathelo zomkhiqizi emhlabeni." Ukulima kuhlobene nezinto eziphilayo, izitshalo - zidinga ukunakwa okuqhubekayo. Ukushisa okwandayo, imvula engapheli, kanye nezimo ezimbi zomoya, kudala ukungabikhona kwamanzi emithonjeni ethile. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlupheke, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni, lapho imithombo yamanzi ingatholakali kalula. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinguquko zesimo sezulu zikhombisa ubudlelwane phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni. Kumele sikhulume ngamasu okuxazulula lezi zinkinga. Ukuze sithole izixazululo ezisebenzayo, kudingeka ukuthi sisebenzisane, sihlanganise imizamo yethu. Imibono yokusebenzisa amanzi ngendlela efanele, njengokulima okungcono, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokulondoloza amanzi, kanye nokwakha izinhlelo zokuhlanza amanzi, iyadingeka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthola amanzi ahlanzekile, futhi kuthuthukise izinga lempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa abantu ngokuqonda ukubaluleka kokuhlanzeka kwamanzi nokusebenzisa kahle lezi zinsiza, kuyadingeka. Umphakathi kufanele uqonde ukuthi amanzi awawona umkhiqizo ongatholakala kalula, kodwa kufanele aqashelwe njengento ebalulekile empilweni. Izikhungo zemfundo zidinga ukwakha izinhlelo ezizokhuluma ngalezi zinkinga, ukuze abantu bazi kahle ukuthi bangawagcina kanjani amanzi. Ekuphetheni, izinkinga zamanzi zidinga izinyathelo ezinzima. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi, ukungcoliswa, kanye nezinguquko zesimo sezulu, kudinga ukuhlolwa kwezindlela zokuxazulula. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi amanzi ayisisekelo sempilo, futhi kufanele siwasebenzise ngendlela efanele. Ukubambisana, ukuqonda, kanye nokusebenza ngokubambisana, kuzokwenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Sifuna ikusasa elingcono, futhi lokho kudinga izinyathelo namuhla. Amanzi awawona nje umkhiqizo, kodwa empeleni, ayimpilo yethu.

Noma kunjalo, isisusa sezofuzo se-RR sandiswe saba yizihlanganisela eziningi ezahlukehlukene zikabhontshisi wesoya, kangangokuthi ukuguquguqulwa kofuzo akukwehlisanga ukwehlukana kwezofuzo, njengoba kubonakele ocwaningweni lwangonyaka we-2003 maqondana nokwehlukana ngokwezofuzo. Ubhontshisi wesoya uhlelwa ngokubanzi njengezinhlobo eziyimifino (yasengadini) noma ngokwezinhlobo zasemasimini (uwoyela). Izinhlobo eziyimifino ziphekeka kalula, zinokunambitheka okuthi akube okwamantongomane, zibambeka kamnanjana esandleni, zinkulu, zinamaphrotheni amaningi, kodwa uwoyela wazo mncane kunowohlobo lwasemasimini. Abakhiqizi be-tofu nabakhiqizi bobisi lwesoya bakhetha izinhlanganisela zezinhlobo zamaphrotheni amaningi aqhamuka kubhontshisi wesoya owafika kwelase-United States ngasekupheleni kweminyaka ye-1930. Izinhlanganisela ezenzelwe ingadi, ngokubanzi azikufanele ukuvunwa ngokuhlanganiswa nemishini ngoba kungenzeka ukuthi imidumba ibhudluke lapho isifinyelela ekuvuthweni. Phakathi kwemidumba, ubhontshisi wesoya, obuye uhlelwe ngaphansi kwembewu kawoyela, ugqamile ngamaphrotheni aphezulu aqukethwe (38 - 45%) nangowoyela wawo ophezulu oqukethwe (20%). Ubhontshisi wesoya ubamba indawo yesibili ngemuva kommbila phakathi kwemikhiqizo ebalulekile yolimo ethunyelwa ngaphandle yi-United States. Ingxenye enkulu yesitshalo sikabhontshisi wesoya ilinyelwa umkhiqizo kawoyela, kanti amaphrotheni aphezulu asuswa amafutha ukuze impuphu yesoya egazingiwe isetshenziselwe ukondla imfuyo.

Inqubo enqala yeqhinga nedinga umqondo ohluzile, ukuhlaziya okuhlelekile ukuze kutholakale izisombululo ezifanele, ukubhekela izinsiza ezikhona nokucabanga imigomo nemihlahlandlela ebekiwe. Lokhu kungaphezulu kokudweba uhlu lwezinto eziklele phambili nokuziguqulela eziphakamisweni zesabelomali. Uhlelo oludidiyele lokuqhuba ngempela umsebenzi nefuna ukuchaza okuqondile izindleko, isikhathi, inani, izibophezelo, indawo, iqophelo lomsebenzi nendawo okuyodiliviwa kuyo umsebenzi.
