Ukwazisa amathimba abambe iqhaza ngemisebenzi elindelwe kuwo kanjalo nokuzikhandla okufanele ngenqubo. Lokhu kubandakanya iminyango yezifundazwe nekazwelonke. Ukunika incazelojikelele nesithombe esisheshayo ngenqubo yeIDP ebantwini abanesibophezelo sokusingatha inqubo. Indaba efingqiwe yenzelwe ukusiza abantu ukuze baqonde imvelaphi nenqubo yoHlelo lweNtuthuko eDidiyele ngale kokugxila kakhulu ebhukwini. Uma ababambe iqhaza befuna imininingwane egcwele, kufanele babheke leyomihlahlandlela abanentshisekelo kuyo. Uhlelo lweNtuthuko eDidiyele yinqubo lapho omasipala belungisa khona iqhinga lentuthuko leminyaka emihlanu. UHlelo lweNtuthuko eDidiyele (IDP) wumthelela wenqubo yokuhlela intuthuko edidiyele. I-IDP yitulo elinqala lokuhlela umgomo nelihlahla indlela futhi lazise kabanzi ngokuhlela, isabelo sezimali, ukusingatha nokuthatha izinqumo emkhandlwini noma kumasipala. Sithini isimo somthetho ngama-IDP? Ngokulandisa koMthetho weziNhlelo zoMasipala ka 2000, bonke omasipala (labo abakhulu bamadolobha, abomaziphathe kanye nezindawo) kumele balandele inqubo yohlelo lwentuthuko edidiyele ukuze bakhiqize ama-IDP. Njengoba I-IDP iyisidingo somthetho, inamandla asemthethweni futhi ingaphezulu kwamanye amaqhinga ahola intuthuko emazingeni ohulumeni basekhaya. Ngokomthetho weziNhlelo zoMasipala, wonke umkhandlu omusha novula amahovisi ngemuva kokhetho lohulumeni basekhaya, kumele uzilungisele I-IDP eyohlala iminyaka emihlanu.

Isivumelwano siphakamisa ukuthi abanye abazali kanye abantu ababheka izingane badinga usizo nokuthi izingane zabazali abasebenzayo kufanele zibe nezinzuzo. Ngokucacile, kunezingane futhi ezidinga ezinye izinhlobo zosizo. Ohulumeni kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi kunabantu abalungile kanye nezindawo zezingane ezingenawo amakhaya kanye nabantu abazinakekelayo. Ucabanga ukuthi kufanele kube zinhlobo zini lezi zezindawo kanye nabantu? Uhulumeni kufanele enze konke angakwenza ukuvikela izingane kubazali kanye nabanye abantu abazilimazayo. Uhulumeni kufanele azame ukuvikela izingane kuzo zonke izinhlobo zodlame lomzimba noma lwengqondo, ukulimala noma ukuhlukumeza (kubandakanya nokuhlukumeza ngokocansi), ukuphathwa kabi noma ukuxhaphaza. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele kuphasiswe imithetho futhi kwenziwe izinhlelo zokuthi lezi zinto zingabe zisenzeka. Ngezinye izikhathi kunezizathu zokuthi kungani izingane zingasahlali nemindeni yazo. Lokhu kungaba ngokwesikhashana noma kube ngokonomphelo. Kwesinye isikhathi lokhu kuba yinto enhle kakhulu enganeni. Uma lokhu kwenzeka uhulumeni kufanele enze izinhlelo eziyisipesheli zokunakekela ingane. Kungenziwa izinto eziningi ezahlukene. Izingane zingafunelwa abazozinakekela, zinikezwe abantu abafuna izingane noma zibekwe ezindaweni ezihlala izingane. Noma yini eyenziwayo, kubalulekile ukuthi kucatshangwe ngezidingo zengane, umlando wayo kanye nenjabulo yayo. Ohulumeni kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi ukutholwa kwezingane ngokusemthethweni kwenzeka ngendlela ebhekela ingane. Kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi abantu ababhekana nalo msebenzi ngabantu abaphethe. Kufanele baqinisekise ukuthi kukhethwa abantu abalungile ukuthi bamukele izingane ukuthi bazikhulise.

Isaziso esikhishwe ngaphansi kwesigaba-15 sichaza izinhlobo zamadokhumenti ezikhungo ezikhona ezingadingi umuntu ukuthi athumele isicelo esivunyelwe ngumthetho. Iziphakamiso ezithunyelwe kuMongameli. Ukufinyelela kumadokhumenti akwenqabiwe ngenxa yezizathu ezishiwo emthethweni. Umfaki-sicelo kufanele asebenzise ifomu elishicilelwe kwiGazethi Yombuso [Isaziso SoMnyango R187-15 sikaDisemba 2002] (Ifomu-A). Umfaki-sicelo kufanele akhombise uma isicelo singekho isithombe sedokhumenti noma uma umfaki-sicelo efuna ukufaka idokhumenti ehhovisi lenhlangano yomphakathi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, uma idokhumenti ingeyona incwadi, ingafundwa ngendlela efunwayo, uma kukhona indlela esigabeni -292. Uma umuntu efuna ukufinyelela kuhlobo oluthile lwefomu, umfaki-sicelo uzofinyelela ulwazi ngendlela abacela ngayo. Ngaphandle kwesimo lapho imvume ingaphazamisa ukusebenza kahle kwenhlangano yomphakathi ethintwayo, ukonakala kwedokhumenti noma ukuphazamiseka kwezinto ezikhethekile zokuphathwa kwedokhumenti yoMnyango. Uma kukhona izizathu ezinkulu zokungamukeli isicelo ngendlela efunwayo kodwa kukhona enye indlela, izindleko zokuhambisana nesicelo zizobalwa ngokuhambisana nesicelo sokuqala esenziwe ngumuntu ngaphansi kwesigaba -293 kanye 4.

Izibhedlela Zikahulumeni: Indaba Yezempilo Kwakungokwesikhathi eside, emzaneni omncane obizwa ngokuthi uMkhumbane, izibhedlela zikahulumeni zaziyingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu. Abantu bahlala bezama ukuthola izinsiza ezitholakala kulezi zibhedlela, njengoba zaziwa ngokunikeza usizo lwezempilo olufanele, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangenamali yokuhamba ezibhedlela ezizimele. UMama Thandi, umama oneminyaka engama-45, wayengomunye wabantu abavakashela izibhedlela zikahulumeni. Uhlale ethanda ukusiza abanye, kodwa wayenokukhathazeka okukhulu ngempilo yakhe. Ngelinye ilanga, ngesikhathi esebenza emakhaya, wathola ukuthi unokukhwehlela okungajwayelekile. Wazi ukuthi kufanele aye ezibhedlela, kodwa wayesaba, ngoba wayekwazi ukuthi izibhedlela zikahulumeni zinezinkinga zazo. Noma kunjalo, uMama Thandi wathola isibindi. Wavakashela esibhedlela esiseduzane, esaziwa ngokuthi iZibhedlela Zikahulumeni eMkhumbane. Lapho efika, wathola ukuthi izibhedlela zikhona ukuze zisebenze, futhi abantu abaningi babekhuluma ngempilo yabo. Kwakukhanya ubuso babantu, bejabulile, bejabulisa, futhi bephila kahle. Lokhu kwenza uMama Thandi azizwe ethokozile. Ngemva kokubhaliswa, wathola ithuba lokuhlangana nodokotela. UDokotela Mthembu, odokotela abahloniphekile, wamamukela ngenhlonipho. Wamtshela ukuthi akukhathalekile ukuthi ubani, bonke abantu banelungelo lokuthola usizo. UMama Thandi wathola ukuthi udokotela wayenolwazi olunzulu, futhi wayezimisele ukusiza. Wamtshela ukuthi ukukhwehlela kwakhe kungenzeka kube ngenxa yokuphefumula umoya ongcolile, futhi wanikeza izeluleko ezinhle zokuphila kahle.

Izikhwama zokutshala noma amahhashi nezinye izitsha zokuthutha nezitshalo ezinomuthi endaweni yokusebenzela kumele zihlanzwe, ngokuthululwa ziwashwe zonke izinsuku. Izingozi eziningi emsebenzini wezolimo namahlathi zingumphumela wokusheleleka, ukukhubeka nokuwa. Qaphela ukuthi izindawo zokusebenzela azinazo izinto ezingakhuba abantu njengezintambo zikagesi, amasaka noma imibhede endlalwe ngotshani nokuthi kunesikhala esanele sokubeka amathuluzi nezimpahla. Gcina amabhilidi akho ekhandiwe qinisekisa ukuthi iphansi alinazo izimpahla eziningi ngokweqile, ikakhulukazi emabhilidini amadala. Nciphisa ingozi yokuwa, ukukhubeka nokusheleleka. Izitamukoko ezisebenzayo lapho kunamaxhaphozi khona njengezindawo zokugeza izitshalo nasemadeleni. Izinga lokushisa elanele nokungena komoya ezindaweni zokusebenzela. Izimpawu zokuphepha lapho kunobungozi bempilo nokuphepha emva kokuba usubuhlolile ubungako bengozi. Njengoba kujwayelekile ukuthi abasebenzi basemahlathini nakwezolimo besebenze ngamaqenjana amancane ezindaweni ezahlukene, umsebenzi ngamunye kumele aqeqeshwe ngokosizo lokuqala. Lolu qeqesho kumele lubandakanye nokwelashwa kwezilonda ezivulekile nokuvusa abaqulekile. Ezindaweni lapho umsebenzi engahogela amakhemikhali noma intuthu, kunezinyoka, ukulunywa izinambuzane noma izicabucabu nezinye izingozi, ukuqeqeshwa ngokosizo lokuqala kumele kwenziwe umuntu oqeqeshiwe. Amabhokisi osizo lokuqala anezinto zakhona kumele ahlale ekhona endaweni yokusebenzela futhi avikelwe ekonakalisweni wumswakama. Kumele kuhlinzekwe izintuba zokuphuma ngokushesha uma kukhona olimele noma ogulayo odinga ukwelashwa.

Irenti ekumele ikhokhwe ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sokuqasha ifakwa kwimali ngqo esikhathini sesikhathi sesivumelwanoo sokuqasha esifanele. Ukuthi ukwakhiwa komgomo kazwelonke wokwengamela izikhumulo zezindiza kanye nezindawo yokundizela izindiza. Kusetshenziswa ukuthatha amasempula kumaqembu ayisilinganiso sesibili sezimboni eziphakathi nendawo, kanye nakwizimboni eziyisilinganiso sesithathu kanye nesesine. Kuwudaba olungacacile, Sihlalo, ngaphandle uma kuyimina owenza iphutha. Akukho emthethweni ukubulala omunye umuntu ngenhloso nangaphandle komthetho Mnumzana. Ukufundiswa kwabafundi ngemisebenzi, kugcizelelwa imisebenzi edinga izibalo kanye nesayensi. izicelo zokuthi kubuyekezwe izigwebo sezihlanganise izicelo zokungenelela odabeni, ukucela ushwele, ukwehliswa kwezigwebo, izivumelwano zokudluliselwa kwenye indawo kweziboshwa, njl. Lokhu kufaka izinhlangothi zombili - ukuzifaka ecaleni kanye nelungelo lokuthula. Uhulumeni waseBhrithane wawubonakala noxhasa ikakhulukazi uhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, okuyisizathu sokuthi kukhethwe izindlu zamanxusa zaseBhrithane njengendawo yokubhikisha. Ukwakhiwa Kwesizwe kuhlanganisa amasiko amaningi ehlukene, ukubuyisana kuzwelonke, ukwaziwa njengesizwe kanye nokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Kudinga izinga eliphezulu lokubumbana phakathi kwawo wonke amazwe asathuthuka. Ngiyathokoza ngomsebenzi owenziwe amaphoyisa noma esebenza ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima. Yingakho kudingeka ukuthi kuthathwe izinyathelo zokulungisa zokuqinisekisa ukuthi awelulwa umthelela wezomnotho kulawa mafestivali.

Ungala ukwenza umsebenzi uma ngobuqotho lokhu kuchaza ukuthi uma ngeqiniso futhi ukholelwa ukuthi umsebenzi ungabeka indawo engozini enkulu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ngokuphindaphinda ngokunye okungundabuzekwayo kwintuthuko. Ingabe lokhu kwenzeka cishe ngemuva kwehora lesishiyagalolunye noma ngaphambi kwehora lesishiyagalolunye? Ukuthuthukisa imihlahlandlela yenqubo okumele ilandelwe kanye namazinga okulethwa kwezidingo alindeleke kwabahlinzeka ngezinsiza kuMnyango. Baphumile base bebopha abantu abahlanu ngokuphathelene nokugqekeza, ukweba ezitolo kanye nokushayela udle amanzi amponjwana. Kusolwa ukuthi umsolwa uye endlini ngezinyawo wafike wangqongqoza emnyango. Ziyavuka ezobuciko ngo-Ephreli ngesikahthi Intshonalanga Kapa igcwala imicimbi eminingi eyenza isifundazwe sibe yikhaya lezinto zamasiko ezintsha nezinesasasa. Abasolwa abayisithupha ababedutshulwe balimala balaliswe esibhedlela ukuze balashwe ngokwezempilo. Amaqhawe angempela anakekela abanye abafunda nawo okungenzeka ukuthi abanako okuya ethunjini. Amagugu Amazwi Okubika Amasu Ezemfundo esisanda kuwethula ayimizamo futhi yokugxilisa ukubekezelelana eminyakeni yobuntwana, ezohlala impilo yonke. Umnyango Wezokuvikeleka, kanye noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni, izoxoxisana, iphathe iphinde yengamele zonke izinhlelo zokubandakanyeka kwezokuvikeleka ngaphakathi kuleli kanye nangaphandle. Isikhathi sokuvela lomzabalazo wezikhali ngamaqembu alwela inkululeko kwakungumphumela wokulangazelela ushintsho kanye nokuhlambalazwa kobubi bohlelo lwengcindezelo.

Kanjani okufanele kwenzeke? Ukuba nekhono lokuhlela izicwangciso kudinga ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zibhaliwe futhi ziphathwe ngokuqinile. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kuyo yonke impilo yakho. Ungabhala izicwangciso zakho kwidiyari, ebhodini, noma kukhompyutha, noma kuphi. Ngokwandisa imibhalo, lokhu kuzokusiza esikhathini eside ngoba uzoba nedatha yomlando ezokusiza uma ubheka phambili. Ngokuvamile, ukuhlela isu kwenzeka minyaka yonke - kuzokwenzekani ngonyaka ozayo emasimini. Kodwa kufanele kube nesu lesikhathi eside elibheka ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini emasimini esikhathini esizayo. Lokhu kuyisu elibanzi elikhombisa ukuthi kuzokhiqizwa ini esikhathini esizayo - leso sikhathi singaba yiminyaka emihlanu noma ngaphezulu. Isibonelo: ukutshala izitshalo ezithengiswayo kumahhektare angu-500, ukukhiqiza inyama emasimini, nokukhulisa amaqanda. Lokhu kuzokhombisa imisebenzi ejwayelekile okufanele yenziwe ngonyaka ozayo, njengokupenda indlu ethile, ukwakha udonga oluthile, ukulungisa izakhiwo, ukuthenga imishini emisha, ukuya ezinsukwini zokuqeqesha abalimi, njll. Kuzokhiqizwa ini ngonyaka ozayo, kuzokhiqizwa kangakanani, futhi kuzothengiswa kanjani? Tshalani amahektare angu-400 ommbila ukuze asetshenziswe emasimini, okusele kuzothengiswa ngenkontileka endaweni eseduze ukukhiqiza ukudla kwezilwane. Tshalani amahektare angu-100 wezinhlanzi ukuze athengiswe ngenkontileka. Khiqiza ama-calves angu-200 aneminyaka engu-20 ezivandeni ezizothengwa yiYYY Supermarket. Khiqiza amaqanda angu-40,000 ngenyanga azothengwa yiXXX Chicken Wholesaler. Penda umgwaqo wokusebenza kanye nesikhala se-traktor.

Othisha: Abaholi Bezemfundo Othisha bahlala beneqhaza elibalulekile empilweni yomphakathi, njengoba beqinisekisa ukuthi izingane zikhula zibe nefuture ecacile. Ngenkathi befundisa, bahlomisa abafundi ngolwazi, amakhono, nemigomo ebalulekile yokuphila. Umsebenzi wabo awugcini nje ekufundiseni izifundo ezisemqoka, kodwa futhi ubandakanya ukufundisa izimiso zokuziphatha, ubudlelwano, kanye nokuhlonipha. Indima Yabo Emphakathini Othisha bahlala bejolise ekuthuthukiseni izinga lemfundo. Ngaphandle kokuba yizifundiswa, baphinde babe ngabathuthukisi bomphakathi. Bafundisa abafundi ukuthi bahloniphe abanye, basebenzisane, futhi babe nezinhloso eziphakeme. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba umphakathi ophumelelayo udinga abantu abakhululekile, abahlakaniphile, nabazimisele ukufunda. Ubuchwepheshe Bokufundisa Othisha basebenzisa izindlela eziningi zokufundisa ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi abafundi bayakuqonda kahle lokho abakufundisayo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezifana nezincwadi, amavidiyo, nemidlalo yokufunda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, othisha bahlala bejolise ekwakheni imvelo yokufunda ethokomele, lapho abafundi bezizwa bekhululekile ukuveza imibono yabo. Ukwakhiwa Kwezinhloso Zokufunda Othisha bahlala beqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi bazi kahle ukuthi yini okufanele bayifinyelele. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abafundi bakwazi ukuzibophezela emsebenzini wabo. Othisha bahlala bephakamisa izinjongo ezicacile, ezithuthukisa ukuzimisela kwabafundi, ukuze bakwazi ukugxila futhi bafinyelele ezingeni eliphezulu. Ukwesekwa Kwabafundi Othisha bahlala beqonda ukuthi abafundi bahlukile, futhi banemibono ehlukene. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi othisha bahlale bejolise ekusekeleni abafundi abahlukene.

Uhlelo lwezinkantolo zabantu lwaqalwa eGujarat ngoNdasa kowe-1982 kanti manje selusabalale kulo lonke izwe. Ukushintsha kwalolu hlelo kwakuyingxenye yobuciko bokuphungula imithwalo yamacala alindele ukulalelwa ezinkantolo. Lezi zinkantolo zakhiwa ukuze zibhekane namacala asalinde ukuthethwa futhi zihlinzeke ukukhululeka kulabo ababasela izikweletu. Iphalamende lase-India lamisa umthetho wokuphatha imithetho obizwa nge-Legal Services Authorities, ka1987, enye yezinhloso zalo mthetho kwakuwukuhlela izinkantolo zabantu (Lok Adalat) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukusebenza kohlelo lomthetho oluphakamisa ubulungiswa obakhelwe phezu kwamathuba alinganayo kuwonke wonke. Lo mthetho unikeza amandla ekuxazululweni kokungaboni ngaso linye ngokuhlangabezana nokukhokhelana kwabantu enkantolo yabantu. Lo mbono usukela ohlelweni olubizwa nge-Panchayats, unezimpande emlandweni nasemasikweni ase-India. Abaqoqi bezikweletu bathola inzuzo eningi ezinkantolo zabantu (Lok Adalat). Akukhokhwa mali noma ngabe icala bese liqalile sekudingeka ukuthi kukhokhwe imali iyabuyiswa uma kufinyelelwe esivumelwaneni ezingeni "lapho kungadingeki kukhokhwe khona". Ayikho indlela ephoqelela ukuthi imithetho isetshenziswe ngendlela ethile, noMthetho woBufakazi ngesikhathi kusabhekwa amaphuzu abalulekile ecaleni. Abathintekayo odabeni, noma bemelwe abammeli basemajajini, kodwa basangaya enkantolo yabantu, bafike bachaze isimo sabo nokuyinto engenzeki ezinkantolo zezimantshi. Izinkinga zingalethwa ngqo phambi kwenkantolo yabantu esikhundleni sokuthi kuqalwe kuyiwe ezinkantolo zezimantshi.

I-ASSAF iyisikhungo esizimele, kanti amalunga ayo ayokhethwa ngokwezinga eliphezulu ngokwemicabango yesayensi nolwazi kanye nendima ebonakayo ekusizeni isizwe sonkana. I-ASSAF iyosebenza njengethuluzi elizimele elizosiza imiphakathi yesayensi ukuba ibambe iqhaza alibonakalayo ekwalulekeni ngezenqubomgomo, izikhungo ezizokwenza umsebenzi, ngendlela ehlelekile futhi enokumelelwa kwabantu ngokufanele. I-ASSAF iyosungula ezokuxhumana kuleli kanye naphesheya nezinye izikhungo ezenza umsebenzi ofana nowaso ukuze baqiniseke ngokushintshisana ngolwazi, imibono kanye nokungazuzwa izwe noma izakhamuzi zalelo zwe zonkana. UMnyango kanye nabaluleki boMbuso ngezoMthetho babona ukuthi lo mthethosivivinywa kufanele udingidwe ngendlela emiswe esigabeni 75 soMthethosisekelo weRiphablikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika , ka 1996 (uMthetho ongunombolo 108 ka 1996) ngoba awuqukethe imibandela okufanele kulandelwe kuyo inqubo okukhulunywa ngayo esigabeni 74 noma 76 soMthethosisekelo.

Uma isitsha noma umshini othile osebenza ngogesi noma isenzo siholela emkhiqizweni wesisi onezinhlayiya noma ingxube yazo, ubuthi obudaleka elabholethi noma yini echithekayo enobungozi noma engaletha ubungozi empilweni noma kwimvelo, uNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya angadalula esazisweni seGazethe lowo mshini noma isenzo kuleso sigaba esithintekayo njengesikhiqizi-sisi esilawulwayo. noma yiziphi izinyathelo zokuhlaziya ubungozi; kanye iv nezibophezelo zeNingizimu Afrika ngezivumelwane ezikhona ezisezingeni lomhlaba. Isigatshana- 2 asidingi ukusetshenziswa ezinguqukweni ezincane zesaziso. Ungqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe kufanele ammise amazinga okukhiqiza isisi anoma yimuphi umshini okhiqizayo noma isenzo esidalulwe njengesikhiqizi-sisi ngokulandisa kwesigaba -22. b ingxube yalokho okwakha isikhiqizi-sisi esiphawulwe njengento enukubeza umoya. Ngokubhalisa ngaphansi kwesigaba- 46, uNgqongqoshe kufanele anqume indlela okufanele isisi esikhiqizelwa emoyeni sikalwe ngayo noma kuqhutshwe ngayo lolu hlelo lokukala.

Ingane eyafela phambilini yomufi enezizukulwane eziphilayo eyodwa noma ngaphezulu ibonisa kuphela i-stirpes eyodwa. Ukumeleka kwenzeka uma umphakathi ofanele engakwazi noma engafuni ukufaka isicelo sokuhlala, kuthathwa ngelinye noma ngaphezulu kwezizukulwane. Esibonelweni esingenhla, u-D no-F bazomela ingane eyafela phambilini yomufi. Ngemuva kwesigaba (f) se-Intestate Succession Act ka-1987 njengoba kuguqulwe ngesinqumo ku-Bhe, ingxenye yengane ibalwa ngokuhlukanisa inani eliphelele lempahla ngenani le-stirpes zomufi (okukhuluma ngenani lezingane eziphilayo zomufi noma lezo ezafela ngaphambi kwakhe ezisaphila ezizukulwaneni) kanye nenani labashadikazi abaphilayo bomufi. Ake sithi inani eliphelele lempahla yomufi ngu-R500,000 futhi unezingane ezimbili eziphilayo nezifuba ezimbili zomthetho. R100,000. Ngakho-ke, ingxenye yengane izoba ngu-R100,000. Ngokwesigaba 1(d) se-Intestate Succession Act, izinga lobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bomndeni bomufi kanye nomufi lingahlukaniswa laba ngamaphuzu amabili, okungukuthi izinga lobudlelwano ekwehlukaneni okuqondile kanye nezinga lobudlelwano ekwehlukaneni okungaqondile. Ekwehlukaneni okuqondile, izinga lobudlelwano lilingana nenani lezizukulwane phakathi kwabazali nomufi noma isizukulwane nomufi (njengoba kumile). Ekwehlukaneni okungaqondile, izinga lobudlelwano lilingana nenani lezizukulwane phakathi kobudlelwano bobulili kanye nezizukulwane eziseduze ezihlobene nazo zonke, kanye nenani lezizukulwane phakathi kwabazali bomufi. Ukwabiwa kwempahla ngokuhambisana ne-Intestate Succession Act No.

Izinzuzo Zokubhukuda Ubufakazi bukhombisa ukuthi ukubhukuda kunenzuzo enkulu empilweni. Abahlali baveza ukuthi ukuhamba emanzini kubasiza ukuphumuza ingqondo, kwenze bazise ukuthi baphila kahle, ngokwenyama nangokwengqondo. Lo mkhuba ukhuthaza abasebenzisi ukuba babe nomoya opholile, bajabulele ubuchwepheshe obutholakala ezikhungweni zokubhukuda. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iNingizimu Afrika iyazisa kakhulu kokubhukuda, njengoba ithola izindondo eziningi emiqhudelwaneni yamazwe omhlaba. Lokhu kudala umoya wezinga eliphezulu phakathi kwezingane nabantu abadala, kuholela ekwakhiweni kwemikhankaso efana ne-‘Swimming for All’, eyenzelwe ukwenza izifundo zokubhukuda zifinyelele kubo bonke, kungakhathaliseki isimo sempilo, ukudlala, noma ukuphuza amanzi. Imicimbi Yokubhukuda ehlukene Imicimbi yokubhukuda iqhubeka ivela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Ngaphandle kwemijaho yendabuko, kunezinhlelo ezithokozisayo ezihlanganisa imidlalo yokubhukuda, okuqukethe ukukhetha izigaba ezahlukene, ukusuka ebhukuweni elijabulisayo lokuziqeqesha, kuya ezinhlelweni zokuqeqesha ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ibhukuda labesifazane libonise ukukhula okukhulu, njengoba izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi abesifazane balandela izifundo zokubhukuda, beshaya amamaki amasha emiqhudelwaneni. Lokhu kudala isikhala sokukhuthaza izizukulwane ezizayo ukuze zisebenzisane futhi zihambisane nemithetho yokuphila. Izinselelo Zokubhukuda Nokho, nakuba sikhula, kunezithiyo ezibhekene nababhukudi.

Nokho, umphakathi wawungavumi lezi zinsolo, futhi izinkulumo zaba ziningi. Abantu abaningi babebona lokhu njengokungafanele, futhi baphikisa ukuthi uPistorius wayenokwazi okukhulu ngalesi sikhathi. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, uPistorius wathola isijeziso sokuvalelwa emzini, esikhundleni sokuba aboshwe. Lokhu kwavusa ukungabaza okukhulu phakathi kwabantu, njengoba abaningi bebebona lokhu njengokungafanele. U-Pistorius waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu abathile bangathola izinzuzo ezikhethekile ngenxa yokudumisa kwabo, futhi lokhu kwavusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezinga lokuphila kwabantu abajwayelekile uma bephakathi kwezinkantolo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, isinqumo sikaPistorius saguqulwa, futhi wathola isijeziso esinzima sokuboshwa. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlola umthetho, njengoba abantu bephikisa ukuthi uPistorius kufanele abhekane nezimo ezinzima, njengoba abanye abantu abavumelekile ukwenza izenzo ezinjalo. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu zomthetho, njengoba izinkantolo zidinga ukucacisa ukuthi ubani ofanele ukuvikelwa, nokuthi izimo zomthetho kufanele zisebenze kanjani. Uhlanga lwezokuphepha lwalubhekwa kakhulu kulolu daba. U-Pistorius waba yisibonelo sokuthi abantu abaninzi bahlala bephila ngaphansi kokukhathazeka, futhi lokhu kwavusa izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezokuphepha. Abantu abaningi babebona ukuthi uPistorius wayengumuntu ophumelelayo, kodwa lokhu akukhombisi ukuthi wayengavikeleki. Lokhu kwavula umnyango wezinkinga ezinkulu, njengoba abantu bephikisa ukuthi izimo zomthetho kufanele zihlale ziqinile, futhi ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu abavumelekile ukwenza izenzo ezinjalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, lesi senzo saphinde savula izinkulumo ezinzima mayelana nezobudlelwane.

Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi. I-Operation Vulindlela ibuye ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni ubudlelwano phakathi kukahulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nezakhamuzi. Ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana phakathi kwalezi zinkampani, uhulumeni ubonise ukuthi ukuxhumana okuhle kubalulekile ekwakheni umnotho onempilo. Lokhu kuholele ekwakheni izinhlelo ezihlanganyelwe, ezihlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Noma yiluphi uhlangothi oluthinteka ngokuqonde ngqo ngombiko, lungacela uktuhi indikimba yombiko idalulwe. Lokhu kuyokwenziwa ekulalelweni kodaba. Ukhomishana oqondene nodaba, uyochaza ngokucacile kuhlangothi oluthintekayo imiphumela yokuhluleka ukuphikisa umbiko kanye nokuphikisa izitatimende ezivela kumbiko. Ekulalelweni kwesicelo, umenzi wesicelo kanye nomzali okhishelwe inothisi, bayoba namalungelo afanayo kanye namandla njengomuntu osodabeni lwesinyathelo senkantolo kamantshi engeyona eyamacala obugebengu ngokulandela ukupheqululwa nokuphequlula ngemibuzo ofakazi , ukunikeza ubufakazi kanye nokukhuluma nenkantolo. Isikhathi sokubonelela isicelo sincike kusixaka-xaka sesicelo. Inothisi yomzali wengane ezothathwa ngabanye izonikeza imininingwane eyenele noma izizathu zokungaceli imvume yabo yokukuthi ingane ithathwa ngabanye ukuyenza eyabo. Inothisi izonikezwa okungenani ezinsukwini ezingu-21 ngaphambi kosuku lokulalelwa kodaba. Uma umama wengane enqaba ukunikeza ukuvuma, kuyokwenziwa isicelo enkantolo yezingane kungakapheli izinsuku ezingu-14. Ubaba wengane ngokuzala, ezalelwe ngaphandle komshado, uyothi kungakapheli izinsuku eziyisikhombisa, zokukhishwa komyalelo wenkantolo, enze isicelo sokushintsha imininingwane yakhe kumadokhumende okubhalisa ukuzalwa kwengane. Ngemuva kokufakela isicelo sesichibiyelo, ubaba wengane ngokuzala, ezalelwe ngaphandle komshado, uyokwazisa umabhalane wenkantolo yezingane lapho okwenziwe khona isicelo se-adopshini yengane. Kumele enze lokho ngokubhala, achaze nosuku, nendawo lapho enze khona isicelo sesichibiyelo.

Ibhuku elibukeziwe lizokwethulwa kwi-Khabhinethi ngo- September 2001. Ekuvumelaneni nenqubomgomo yolimi kanye nohlaka / nesu / labasebenza ngezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika kwalungiswa umthetho-sivivinywa ngokuhlanganyela yezilimi zomdabu/ zemvelo/ zesintu zaseNingizimu Afrika (PANSALB) futhi kwabanenkulumo mpikiswano kwi- Indaba yezilimi yesibili ngo-March 2000.
