Ngaphansi kokuhlelwa kwezilimi ucwaningo maqondana "nokusetshenziswa nobudlelwano bezilimi eNingizimu Afrika" lwayelekelela iBhodi ukuthi isiqonde kangcono isimo sezilimi yakwazi nokuhlanganisa ngokucacile izinqubongqangi nenqubo migomo yolimi, ukusetshenziswa nokulandelwa. Kwashicilelwa incwadi emayelana nenqubongqangi engujikelele ukwelekelela izikhungo eziphezu komsebenzi wokwakha imithethomigomo yezilimi. Ucwaningo olwaxhaswa ngezimali kulokhu kanjalo nalolo olusaqhubekayo luzoba wusizo kwiqembu elisha lapho selihlaziya amasu eBhodi ukwenza iincomo ezibhekiswe kuhulumeni nezikhungo zakhe maqondana nomthethomgomo wezilimi. Nakuba kungenzekanga ukuthi kuphembeke ubudlelwano bokusebenzisana phakathi kweBhodi neHhovisi likaNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ngesikhathi thina sisasesikhundleni, siyethemba ukuthi le Bhodi entsha izokwazi ukwenza lobo buhlobo. Lokho kuyoqinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yocwaningo nemikhankaso ebeyixhaswe ngaphansi kwezilimi maqondana nezemfundo kule minyaka emihlanu edlule kuyabelwana ngayo nalabo abasezikhundleni kwezemfundo kuzwelonke nasezifundazwe. Kungakwazi ukuthi kusetshenzwe ngemikhankaso enokuba yimpumelelo ukuthi umthethomgomo wolimi kwezemfundo ukwazi ukusebenza kugwemeke nokuphindaphinda into eyodwa okudla umnotho, kanjalo nobudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwemigwamanda.

Ibandla lizakuphinde libhekele inani elifanele lempahla kanye nenani lezomnotho nomphakathi oluzotholakala ngokushintshiselana ngempahla. Ikomiti Ivume Ukuphatha Izikhali Eziguquliwe KuZwelonke kanye nokulahlwa kwezibhamu kuZwelonke; kanye nokuthi kutholwe izintengo eziphathelene nezimakethe ezitholakala ngenqubo yokubhida enokuncintisana. Uma umhlaba namabhilidi ethengiswa ngenani lezimakethe, inani lezimakethe lizawukwazi: (a) ukuthola onikeza amanani ozibhalisile novunywe yi-Ofisa Enegunya esenanini lama-R100,000 noma (b) uma inani ledlule ama-R100,000, ukuba lithunyelwe Yibandla lokuvunyelwa ngaphansi kwesigaba sama- 14 se-MFMA. Isikhangisi, ukuhlola kanye nezinqumo zokunquma ezihambisana nokutholiswa ngaphansi kwesigaba- 2 senqubomgomo izakufaneleka kulesi sigaba, kufakwa nesicelo Somthetho Wenqubomgomo Yokutholiswa Okukhethwayo kanye Nemithetho. Noma yiyiphi impahla ingadluliselwa kunoma yisiphi isitho sombuso enanini lezimakethe noma, uma kufanele, mahhala. Impahla izakubhidlizwa uma ukubulala okunje kuthathwa njengokuzokusiza ukunaka okusemqoka kakhulu komphakathi. Umnyango wemfundo wesifundazwe uzakunikezwa ukhetho lokuqala uma kuhanjiswa izisetshenziswa ezingamakhompyutha. Ukuthengiswa kwempahla ngokuseebnzisa ukubhida okuncintisanayo noma indali kuzalandela inqubo yokuxhumana efanayo ebekelwe amabhidi esigabeni- 3. Ukwengeza, okungaba ngabathengi/ababhidi bazokwaziswa ngendawo lapho banagabona khona impahla kanye nouku nesikhathi nendawo yendali.

Ekugcineni, ukukhula kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika kubonisa izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abantu bayafuna izindlela zokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokuzijabulisa. Ama-podcast anikeza ithuba lokuthi abantu bakhulume ngezinto ezibalulekile, futhi lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana. Njengoba ama-podcast eqhubeka nokukhula, kubalulekile ukuthi abenzi bama-podcast bahlale bephendula ezindleleni ezahlukene, ukuze baqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngama-podcast anekhwalithi ephezulu. Ngakho-ke, uma ubheka ukuhamba phambili kwama-podcast eNingizimu Afrika, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zikhona ukuze zixhumane, zifundise, futhi zikhuthaze abantu. Njengoba sikhula, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ama-podcast awukuphela kwezindlela zokuxhumana, kodwa ziwusizo olukhulu empilweni yethu. Lokhu kukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke nokulalela, ukufunda, nokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile.

enkulu yokudlulisela amacala ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo omusha. yokudluliselwa kwamacala ngaphansi koMthethosisekelo omusha. ukudidiyelwa okulindelwe ku(6), ngezansi. ngenhloso yokumisa uhlelo lwezinkantolo oluhambisana nezimiso zoMthethosisekelo omusha. kudidiyela okushiwo ku(a), ngenhla. izidingo zobulungiswa zimisa ukuthi kungabinjalo. koMphakathi njengokusho kwesigaba 179. kube kubhekelelwe okushiwo ngu (1), ngehla. iBhodi yezilimi zonke zaseNingizimu Afrika. ukuhambisana noMthethosisekelo omusha. uMthetho wePhalamende owamukelwe njengokusho kwesigaba 75 soMthethosisekelo omusha. ezikhundleni amalungu ashiwo kwisigaba 178(1)(i) soMthethosisekelo omusha. ukuhambisana noMthethosisekelo omusha. kwesikhathi esamukelekile emuva kwelanga uMthethosisekelo owaqala ukusebenza ngalo. olindelekile kuleso sigaba. kwezinyanga ezintathu emva kokushaywa komthetho elindelekile kulesi sigaba. kuphoqelelwe izimiso ezishiwo kwisigaba 217(2). (umthetho 34 ka 1995), njengoba uguquliwe, kubandankanya nenhloso yokumiswa kwawo. kusukela ngelanga uMthethosisekelo omusha owaqala ngaso ukusebenza. uma amalungelo ethinteka noma esatshiswa kusukela ngelanga lapho uMthethosisekelo omusha uqale ukusebenza. lokho okushintshiwe kulezo zigaba ezibekwe kwisiJobelelo. ukuhambisana noMthethosisekelo omusha. owamukelwe ngendlela ebekwe kwisigaba 75 soMthethosisekelo omusha. ukuhambisana noMthethosisekelo omusha. kuyaphela eminyakeni emihlanu emuva kokuqeda isigwebo. kuze kube umthetho wePhalamende usho okwahlukile kunalokhu.

Umnyango wemfundo wesifundazwe uzakunikezwa ukhetho lokuqala uma kuhanjiswa izisetshenziswa ezingamakhompyutha. Ukuthengiswa kwempahla ngokuseebnzisa ukubhida okuncintisanayo noma indali kuzalandela inqubo yokuxhumana efanayo ebekelwe amabhidi esigabeni- 3. Ukwengeza, okungaba ngabathengi/ababhidi bazokwaziswa ngendawo lapho banagabona khona impahla kanye nouku nesikhathi nendawo yendali. Uma ususa impahla eshukumayo, Ikomiti Lokunquma Lebhidi lizakuthola izindlela zokuthengisa ezinhle kakhulu ezinikeza inani elihle kakhulu lemali kumasipala. Ikomiti lizokulandela izidingo zokuxhumana ezibekelwe ikhotheshini. Uma kudingeka, isaziso singaba ngendlela yokukhangisa ephephandabeni lendawo elethulwa indawo yonke. Ngokuthengisa ngokwangasese Ikomiti Lokunquma Lebhidi lizakunquma livume amakhotheshini atholiwe. Ukunqunywa kuzofaka imibandela Yamaphuzu Okushiwo Ngokukhethayo, njengoba kuxhunywe ekhadini lamanani, empahleni enenani eledlula ama-R30,000. Ikomiti Lokunquma lebhidi ligcina ilungelo lokunikeza noma yiyiphi ibhidi enikezwayo. Ikomiti Lokunquma Lebhidi lizakunquma amabhidi wonke okuthengiswa kwempahla engagudluki ngesivumelwano sangasese. Ukuthengiswa kwempahla kuzakunqunywa ngokulandela izigaba ze-4 kanye neze-8 sale nqubemgomo. Umasipala ugcina ilungelo lokwenqabela noma yimaphi amabhidi anikeziwe. Impahla engashukumi kumele iqashiswe ngentengo elingana nezimakethe, ngaphandle uma umcwaningi zimali wesifundazwe evumela ngandlela thize. Zonke izindleko eziphathelene nokuqashwa kwempahla kamasipala kuzakubukezwa unyaka ngonyaka.

k qasha, sinqume iholo noma sixoshe abasebenzi besikhungo; futhi l senze noma yini engaholela ekufezekiseni izinhloso, futhi kufanele ngezikhathi ezithile sibukeze isakhiwo, inhlangano kanye nezinhlelo. c senze imisebenzi ephathelene nokufezekisa izinhloso esizithunywe nguNgqongqoshe. d sihlole izinhlaka zaso, inhlangano nezinhlelo izikhathi ngezikhathi. ISikhungo singathi ngokuhambisana neMithetho emayelana nobundlelwane emhlabeni, ukuze kufezeke izinjongo zaso, sinikeze usizo oludingekayo kunoma isiphi isakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika esikwelinye izwe ngaphandle kweRiphablikhi. Lo Mthetho uyakusentshenziswa yiSikhungo uma usebenziseka neziguquko lapho kudingeka khona mayelana nokwenza umsebenzi okukhulunywa ngawo kusigatshana 1 kube sengathi leli zwe okwenziwa kulo lowo msebenzi liyingxenye yeRiphablikhi. Umhlangano wokuqala weSikhungo uyobanjelwa endaweni nangesikhathi esiyoqokwa nguNgqongqoshe, kanti imihlangano elandelayo isiyobanjelwa endaweni nangesikhathi esiyomiswa ngumongameli. ISikhungo kufanele sibambe umhlangano okungenani kanye ngonyaka. Umongameli angabiza umhlangano weSikhungo oyisipesheli noma yingasiphi isikhathi okufanele ubanjelwe endaweni nangesikhathi esiyomiswa ngumongameli. Wonke amalunga kufanele aziswe ngokubhaliwe ngemihlangano yeSikhungo ngaphandle kwemihlangano yekomiti. Inani labakhona emhlanganweni abangaqhubeka nomhlangano bathathe izinqumo kuyakuba yingxenye yokune quarter yamalunga eSikhungo.

Sekuphele isikhathi eside iNingizimu Afrika yethu ibe nekhaya elinokuphila, futhi iphinde yakhombisa kahle futhi ibhujiswe emphakathini. Iphakathi lapho uthola khona ukuthi uma uzalwa omnyama, uthola isiqalekiso sonke isikhathi sokuphila kwakho, uma uzalwa omhlophe, uthwala ukwesaba nokucasuka okufihlekile... Iphakathi lapho udoti, iphunga lobubha, udoti uhamba ezitaladini, ukuguguleka kwemfucumfucu, izixuku ezigcwele usizi, umhlaba omkhulu ogcwele udoti, le ndawo ibheka phansi futhi ifaka ubuhle komunye umhlaba onemigwaqo ehlanganayo, nezimbali ezivuthayo ziphazamisa ubuhlalu bokhula obuhlaza, nezinyoni, nezindlu ezifanele amakhosi namakhosikazi, nomculo opholile nothando. Iphakathi lapho ukuphila endaweni ethile kuyindlela yokubiza abanye ukuze bakuphathise, noma ukuphendula kumakhelwane, lapho amakhelwane ezophathwa ngotshwala nezidakamizwa ukuze bangazweli ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu bayazi ukuthi ukuphila kwabo ngeke kube kuhle uma kungekho ukubulawa phakathi kwabo, ukuhlinzwa nokulwa okungenasizathu phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo. Iphakathi lapho kukhombisa ukuthi uma uhlala ezindaweni ezithile, kuyindlela yokuphila ngokuphepha, ngoba ukuphepha kusho ukuba nezingadi eziphakeme, imigoqo kagesi, izinja zokuvikela, amaphoyisa aqaphelayo, nezinsizwa ezilungele ukuvikela labo abawubaba bethu ngezikhali, nezikhali ezifihliwe ezihlahleni, kanye namahhelikopta azoshaya ukufa kulabo abaphazamisa ubaba... Kusikhuthaza ukuthi ukhetho lwethu olwenziwe ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule lunikeza ukuqinisekiswa kokuzimisela kwabantu bethu, kungakhathaliseki ngesizathu, nendlela yomuntu yokubambisana ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labantu bonke abafanayo.

Ngokubhalisa ngaphansi kwesigaba- 46, uNgqongqoshe kufanele anqume indlela okufanele isisi esikhiqizelwa emoyeni sikalwe ngayo noma kuqhutshwe ngayo lolu hlelo lokukala. b angafuna labo bantu abawela esigabeni esichazwe esazisweni ukuba balungise futhi balandele amasu okunqanda ukunukubezeka kwemvelo maqondana nesici noma isikhiqizi-sisi esidalulwe sakleliswe phambili ngokulandisa kwesigaba a. Ngesaziso esibhaliwe nangegunya lesigaba- 20 esibandakanya isici noma umkhiqizo odalulwe njengokleliswe phambili , isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya singafuna lowo muntu othintekayo ukuba alungise futhi aqhube isu lokunqanda ukunukubezeka kwemvelo, akukhathalekile ukuthi lowo muntu uwela esigabeni esichazwe ngaphansi kwesigatshana- 1 b. Amasu okunqanda ukunukubezeka kwemvelo kufanele ahambisane nezidingo ezingase zichazwe nguNgqongqoshe ngomthetho obekwe esigabeni- 46. g noma yiluphi udaba oluphathelene nemvelo. Isiphathimandla seqophelo lomoya singasungula uhlelo lokuhlonipha umphakathi ngegalelo elibonakalayo lokunqanda ukunukubeza imvelo endaweni. Ungqongqoshe kaZwelonke nowesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya angashaya umthetho ngaphansi kwezigaba -46 no- 47, lapho enganquma khona izinyathelo zokulawula umsindo nokuzamazama. b amaqophelo aphezulu omsindo nokuzamazama. Ongumnini noma ohlala egcekeni lapho kwenziwa khona okuthile akavunyelwe ukudala noma ukuvumela umkhiqizo ophazamisayo nonukayo.

Ukwenza umsebenzi nokuqinisekisa izinga. Lezi zingxenye zihlelwe zibe yizinhlelo ezimbili, okungukuthi: Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Okuxhumene Nabasebenzi; kanye Nokubheka Nokuhlola Umsebenzi Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Ezinye zezincwadi ezikhiqizwe yi-PSC zifaka phakathi, phakathi kokunye, Isimo Sezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, Ucwaningo Lokwaneliseka Kwabantu, Ukulinganisa Ukusebenza Kwe-National Anti-Corruption Hotline, kanye Nokuhlaziywa KweMikhankaso Yokuphatha i-HIV/AIDS ne-TB Ezinsizakalweni Zomphakathi. Uhlu oluhlanganisa zonke lezi zincwadi ezikhiqizwe yi-PSC lutholakala esigabeni 15 se-PSC/OPSC futhi lutholakala futhi kwi-website ye-PSC, www.psc.gov.za. IKomishini isunguliwe ngokweSigaba 196 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996. IMthethosisekelo ifuna iKomishini eyodwa yeZinsizakalo Zomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika enamalungu alishumi nane, amahlanu awo athunyelwe nguMongameli ngokuhlonishwa kweZigaba Zikazwelonke, kanti ilungu elilodwa elivela esifundazweni ngalinye lithunyelwa nguMphakathi wesifunda. IKomishini ibophelelwe kwiZigaba Zikazwelonke okufanele ibike okungenani minyaka yonke. Kumele futhi ibike ngemicimbi yayo ezindaweni kumazinga asezindaweni. Ngokuhambisana neMthethosisekelo njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla, i-PSC inamalungu alishumi nane: amaKomishina amahlanu avela ePretoria kanye nelungu elilodwa elivela esifundazweni ngalinye. I-PSC ixhaswa yiHhovisi leKomishini Yezinsizakalo Zomphakathi, elikhokhelwa nguMqondisi-Jikelele (ongumsebenzi ophethe).

Ngaphezu kweminye imisebenzi athweswe yona umongameli ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho uyakuba ngumcwaningimabhuku othweswe umthwalo wokuqapha izimali ezitholakele nokusentshenziswa kwazo futhi uyakuba nomthwalo wokuqapha impahla yeSikhungo. i dlulisela kwelinye ilunga loMkhandlu amandla anikwe umcwaningimabhuku ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho noma yilo Mthetho; noma ii agunyaze lowo muntu ukuba enze imisebenzi ethweswe isikhulu esingumcwaningimabhuku ngaphansi kwalo Mthetho. b Ukwedluliswa kwamandla ngaphansi kwesigatshana a akuvimbeli ukusentshenziswa kwalawo mandla noma ukwenza lowo msebenzi uMcwaningimabhuku. ISikhungo singaqasha abasebenzi ngaphansi kwemibandela ethile uma sibona kudingekile ukuze iSikhungo sikwazi ukwenza umsebenzi waso, ngokuhambisana nokushiwo isigatshana (b). b ISikhungo kufanele ngezimali zaso sikhokhe imiholo , izimfanelo nemixhaso kanye nezinye nje izinsizakalo ezinganqunywa uMkhandlu. c Isikhungo kungathi uma sibona kufanele emva kokuvumelana nomsebenzi sidlulisele noma sesekele lowo msebenzi ukuba ayokwenza umsebenzi othile noma isikhathi esithile eMnyangweni kaHulumeni, inhlangano noma isikhungo siseRiphablikhi ngaphansi kwemibandela efana nokuthi amalungelo kanye nezimfanelo zalowo msebenzi ngeke kuthikamezeke ngokwesekelwa kwakhe. b singaboleka umsebenzi imali engasiza lowo msebenzi ukuze akwazi ukuba yilunga noma angenele isikhwama sempesheni esinconywe yiSikhungo noma ake athi ukuma ukusebenza ngokuvunyelwa athole ilivu engakhokhela ethathwa njengosizo lwempesheni.

Izithombe cishe zawo onke amafilimu akhiqizwa kuleli kusukela ngo-1916 angatholakala lapha. I-NAFVSA ineqoqo lamaskripthi amafilimu elicishe libe yinani le-1200 amafilimu akhiwe kuleli. Iningi lala maskripthi awesigaba sokuhlelwa kwefilimu ngakho-ke ehluke kakhulu kumkhiqizo osuphothuliwe nosulungele ukubukelwa. I-NAFVSA ibuye ibe ngumgcini wamarekhodi asephepheni, okuyimibhalo, iziqephu zezindaba ezisikiwe emaphephandabeni, izithombe, izinhlelo kanye neziqeshana zokwazisa ezimayelana nezindawo zemibukiso yemidlalo, umculo, imibhalo kanye nobuciko bezandla. Iningi lempahla ekulo mkhakha yaqala ngeminikelo eyayilethwa abantu kanye nezikhungo zangasese ezabe zinentshisekelo kwezobuciko bezandla. I-NAFVSA ungowokwahluka ngenxa yokuthi ungenye yezinqolobane ezimbalwa emhlabeni wonke zalolu hlobo ezigcina amafilimu, amavidiyo, kanye nokuqoshiwe okungalalelwa ngaphansi kophahla olulodwa. Ukufinyelela kulwazi lwalolu hlobo olungandile olwethula umlando wezwe lakithi eNingizimu Afrika ngezithombe sekube wusizo futhi kusazoqhubeka kube usizo olukhulu ezizukulwaneni zabaseNingizimu Afrika. Bangalela babuye babuke kalula okwenzeka esikhathini esingaphambili futhi lokho kungababeka esimweni sokuqagela ukuthi imboni yezamafilimu namatheyiphu izoba njani esikhathini esizayo. Ngenxa yezinguquko ezisheshayo zobuchwepheshe, imishini eyayisetshenziswa eminyakeni engama-20 eyedlule, isiphelelwe yisikhathi manje, kodwa isingasetshenziselwa ukuhlinzeka ulwazi lomlando, kanye nokukhombisa intuthuko nezinguquko embonini yezamafilimu, amavidiyo abukwayo namatheyiphu angalalelwa.

Lokhu kungaba ukuhlinzeka ngohambo, imali, noma izikhumbuzo ezikhethekile, okwenza abasebenzi bazizwe bebalulekile futhi kukhuthaze abanye ukuba bakhuphule izinga labo lokusebenza. Izinhlelo Zokuhlonipha Izinhlelo zokuhlonipha zihlala zinezinzuzo eziningi. Izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa izinhlelo ezihlelwe kahle ukuze ziqashele abasebenzi, okuhlanganisa imiklomelo yokusebenza, izinhlelo zokuhlonipha ezibhalwe phansi, kanye nemikhosi yokwazisa. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abasebenzi ukuba baphumelele futhi zibhala izinqumo ezinhle. Ukwaziswa Nokuqashelwa Kwezimpumelelo Ukwaziswa nokuhlonishwa kwezimpumelelo kwabasebenzi kudinga ukuba kube nokuqonda okujulile, kucace futhi kube nokuhlonipha. Abaphathi kufanele baqonde izimpumelelo ezithile zabasebenzi futhi baveze lokhu emphakathini, okwenza abasebenzi bazizwe bebalulekile. Izinzuzo Zokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kuholela ezinzuzweni eziningi, okuhlanganisa ukukhulisa ukuzinikela, ukwandisa umkhiqizo, nokwakha isimo esihle emsebenzini. Abasebenzi abazizwa behloniphekile bazama ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo, okwakha ithimba elikhuthazayo. Ukubaluleka Kokuziphatha Okuhle Ukuziphatha okuhle phakathi kwezisebenzi kubalulekile ekukhuthazeni imiklomelo nokuqashelwa. Uma abasebenzi bebonisa ukuziphatha okuhle, baveza ukuzimisela ukufinyelela izinhloso, okudingeka ukuqashelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe umoya omuhle. Izinselelo Zokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Nokho, zikhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi. Abanye abaphathi bangase bangakwenzi lokhu ngendlela efanele, noma babe nezinkinga zokwahlulela, okungaholela ekungahambisani.

Iphakathi lapho ukuphila endaweni ethile kuyindlela yokubiza abanye ukuze bakuphathise, noma ukuphendula kumakhelwane, lapho amakhelwane ezophathwa ngotshwala nezidakamizwa ukuze bangazweli ubuhlungu bokuphila, abantu bayazi ukuthi ukuphila kwabo ngeke kube kuhle uma kungekho ukubulawa phakathi kwabo, ukuhlinzwa nokulwa okungenasizathu phakathi kwabo ngaphandle kwezizathu eziphilayo. Iphakathi lapho kukhombisa ukuthi uma uhlala ezindaweni ezithile, kuyindlela yokuphila ngokuphepha, ngoba ukuphepha kusho ukuba nezingadi eziphakeme, imigoqo kagesi, izinja zokuvikela, amaphoyisa aqaphelayo, nezinsizwa ezilungele ukuvikela labo abawubaba bethu ngezikhali, nezikhali ezifihliwe ezihlahleni, kanye namahhelikopta azoshaya ukufa kulabo abaphazamisa ubaba... Kusikhuthaza ukuthi ukhetho lwethu olwenziwe ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule lunikeza ukuqinisekiswa kokuzimisela kwabantu bethu, kungakhathaliseki ngesizathu, nendlela yomuntu yokubambisana ekwakheni iNingizimu Afrika elandela iphupho labantu bonke abafanayo. Izinkinga eziphuthumayo zokuphila kwabantu ngeke zixazululwe uma singakhethi amathuba emisebenzi, nokunciphisa noma ukususa ubuphofu phakathi kwethu. Lokhu kuhlangana nokuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zabantu, ukunciphisa izinga lobugebengu, ukufundisa abantu ukufunda nokubhala, nokuvula amathuba okufunda nezindlela zamasiko... sithi kuzo zonke iziqhawe zethu nezifazane ezithobekile ezazinikele ekufezeni inkululeko, kanye nawe bangane bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, ngeke sikhokhele ithemba elibekwe kithi ngenkathi nisekela ukusiguqula iNingizimu Afrika ibe yintando yeningi, umhlaba wokuthula, lapho kungabikho ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga, noma ngohlobo, umhlaba ophumelelayo, ozinikele ezithakazelweni zokuhlanganiswa kwabantu.

Kusukela ezikhathini zasendulo, abaholi bendabuko benze imisebenzi ebalulekile ezindaweni zabo nasemazweni abo. Ingxoxo lapha igxile kakhulu kwenye yale misebenzi: ukugcina umthetho ngababusi bendabuko. Namuhla, ukuphathwa komthetho ezindaweni zasemaphandleni kuphathwa kakhulu ngamaKhosi noma Abaholi Bendabuko. Lezi yizinkantolo zamaKhosi nabaholi bendawo, futhi zigcina umthetho ikakhulu ngokuqhuba imikhuba yendabuko. Ngaphansi kwesigaba 211 soMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, umthetho wendabuko uyavunywa njengomunye wezinhlelo zomthetho ezihambisana nomthetho ojwayelekile (owatholakala eNtshonalanga). Lokhu kusho ukuthi izinkantolo azikwazi ukuhoxisa umthetho wendabuko njengoba kwenzeka ngaphambi kokwethulwa komthethosisekelo omusha, kepha lo mthetho kufanele usebenze lapho kudingeka futhi ngokuhambisana nemithetho ekhona kanye nomthethosisekelo uqobo. Izinkantolo ezikhona zakhangwa ngaphansi kwento 16 yeSheduli 6 yoMthethosisekelo, enikeza ukuthi zonke izinkantolo ezihlobene neNkantolo Yendabuko eyayikhona ngesikhathi umthethosisekelo uqala iyaqhubeka nokusebenza futhi izisebenze amandla ayo omthetho njengoba anikeziwe. Ukusebenza kwalezi zinkantolo kulawulwa yimithetho eminingi. Le mithetho ihlanganiswe nezinye ezazishiwoyo ngaphambi komthethosisekelo, ezindaweni ezazizimele. Ukuqhubeka kwale mithetho yomlando eNingizimu Afrika kuvunywa yiSheduli 6 yoMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho 108 ka-1996. Ngokuqinisekiswa komthetho, uMongameli wezwe udlulisele le mithetho ezindaweni ngokuhambisana nento 14 yeSheduli 6 yoMthethosisekelo.

(1) UMkhandlu ungahlangana njalo uma kunesidingo, kodwa okungenani kathathu ngonyaka, kulezo zindawo nangalezo zikhathi ezinganqunywa nguMkhandlu. ILungu loMkhandlu ngalinye kumele laziswe ngomhlangano ngamunye ngokubhalwe phansi, okungenani ezinsukwini eziyishumi nane ngaphambi kwalowo mhlangano, futhi leso saziso kumele sibe nohlelo lomhlangano ohlongozwayo. Uma usihlalo woMkhandlu engekho emhlanganweni woMkhandlu, amalungu akhona angaqoka ilungu elilodwa lawo ukuthi ahole umhlangano. samalungu amabili kwamathathu oMkhandlu ngesinxuso esibhalwe phansi, uma usihlalo kumele, ngokubhalwe phansi, azise ilungu loMkhandlu ngalinye ngesikhathi nangendawo yomhlangano. Ikhoramu yomhlangano woMkhandlu yiningi lamalungu awo. Noma yisiphi isinqumo soMkhandlu kumele sithathwe ngesixazululo seningi lamalungu akhona kunoma yimuphi umhlangano woMkhandlu futhi, uma kuba nokulingana kwamavoti nganoma yiluphi udaba, ilungu elihola umhlangano okukhulunywa ngawo liyokuba nevoti elingujuqu ngaphezu kwevoti lalo elijwayelekile njengeLungu loMkhandlu. Okudingidwa kuyona yonke imihlangano kumele kuqoshwe futhi kubhalwe emaminithini. (8)(a) Amaminithi omhlangano odlule kumele afundwe ekuqaleni kwayo yonke imihlangano. Amaminithi kungathathwa ngokuthi afundiwe uma amakhophi awo enikezwe amalungu oMkhandlu ngaphambi komhlangano. Usihlalo angasayina amaminithi kuphela uma sekudingidwe imibono noma sekwenziwe ushintsho.

(Isu lesonto nezicwangciso zalolo suku zixubene etafuleni 1). Susa ama-calves angu-100 ezivandeni, ubabhalise, ubaphathe ngomedicine, bheka isisindo sazo. Lapho sihlela izicwangciso zesikhathi esifushane, kufanele kufakwe imininingwane eminingi. Khumbula futhi ukuthi izicwangciso azinakuma, ikakhulukazi ezinkampanini zokulima emasimini. Kunezinto eziningi ezingalindelekile ezingavela, ezifana nezikhukhula ezinkampanini, ukuwa kwezakhiwo, izifo ezilwaneni, njll. Ukuhlela isu kuyinto yokuphatha ngoba kuyisisekelo sokuphatha nokuhlinzeka okuzoxoxwa ngakho emibhalweni ezayo. Ngaphandle kokuhlela isu, ngeke kube nokuphathwa kahle ngoba izicwangciso ziyiwo umsebenzi ophambili wokuphatha; ngezicwangciso, singaphatha umsebenzi kahle. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa, ukuhlinzeka, nokulawula okuqinile, umphathi kumele abe nezenzo eziphumelelayo ekwenzeni eminye imisebenzi yokuphatha efana nokuhlela, ukuxhumana nabasebenzi bakhe, ukubakhuthaza ukuba basebenze kahle, ukuwasekela, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ukuthatha izinyathelo, nokuphatha ngokuqinile. Ukunakwa kuyo yonke le misebenzi kuzohambisana nosayizi webhizinisi.

Umlimi kufanele avune ngaphezu kwamathani amabili ngehektare ukuze akwazi ukuthenga lezi zibhamu ezibizayo. Imbewu emisha kufanele ithengwe minyaka yonke. Imigqomo evunyiwe yonyaka odlule ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa njengemibewu yonyaka olandelayo. Kungenzeka ukuthi umlimi angatholi imbewu lapho kusasele isikhathi. Ama-hybrids avame ukuhamba kancane uma izimo zezulu nezinye izinto ziba nzima (ukuphuma kwe-tassel). Lapho ukukhiqiza nokulima kuphathwa kahle futhi izimo zezulu zibi, ama-hybrids awakhiqizi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nama-OPVs. Yini i-variety evulekile yokupollinate (OPV) efana? I-OPV ikhiqiza imbewu ngokuvuleka kokupollinate kuzo zonke izindawo, futhi izinhlobo zixubana (okukhuluma ukuthi ukuvuleka kokupollinate akuphathwa nganoma iyiphi indlela). Ipholeni yezitshalo endaweni ethile ayiphathwa, ngakho umkhiqizo / izitshalo azikwazi ukuba yizifanekiso; isibonelo: ukuphakama kwezitshalo akuzukuba yizifanekiso, umbala wecobho awuzukuba yizifanekiso, usayizi wezindlebe awuzukuba yizifanekiso, nezitshalo azizukufinyelela ngesikhathi esifanayo. Imbewu ibiza kancane noma ayidingi ukuthengwa. Umlimi angasebenzisa ezinye zezimveliso ezivunyiwe ukuze atshale unyaka olandelayo. Izindleko zokuthenga imbewu zingaba phansi kakhulu kunezindleko zokuthenga ama-hybrids. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umlimi uzoba nemali yokukhokha umanyolo nokulawula izilokazane. Imbewu ingaphindwa. Imigqomo yonyaka wamanje ingatshalwa unyaka olandelayo. Akukho sidingo sokutshala ama-hybrids ezindaweni ezingenamandla.

Imfundo ikusiza ukuthi ufunde ukuhlonipha umndeni wabantu sonke esingena ngaphansi kwawo. Imithetho yalowo mndeni ukuthi onke amazwe nabantu kufanele bahlale ngobungane, uxolo kanye nokuqonda. Imfundo kufanele ithuthukise inhlonipho yezingane kubazali bazo, ukwazi amasiko, ulimi namagugu, amagugu esizwe ezwe lapho ingane ihlala khona kanye nezwe evela kulo. Kufanele ithuthukise nenhlonipho yengane yabantu abahlukile nabavela emasikweni nasezizweni ezahlukile. Nakuba imfundo ikusiza ukuthi uhloniphe umndeni wakho, isiko kanye nezwe, iyakusiza futhi ukuthi uhloniphe amanye amasiko kanye nezizwe. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu uma kufanele sibe ngamalungu omndeni wabantu. Imfundo kufanele izingane izilungiselele ukuphila ngendlela efanele emphakathini okhululekile. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sizwisise, kufanele sibe nokuthula futhi kufanele sibekezele. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele sisebenzele ukuthi kube nokulingana phakathi kwamadoda nomama kanye nabafana namantombazane. Lokhu futhi kusho ukuthi kufanele sisebenzele ubungane phakathi kwabo bonke abantu. Imfundo kufanele ithuthukise inhlonipho yezingane yezwe eziphila kulo - yendawo yemvelo. Njengoba ubona nje imfundo iyinto enkulu kunokuhlala nje ekilasini noma ukwenza umsebenzi wesikole owenziwa ekhaya noma ukubhala ukuhlolwa. Kusho ukuzilungiselela impilo. Imfundo isho ukuba ngumuntu ophelele. Xoxa ngalokhu ekilasini noma nabangane bakho. Emazweni amaningi, kunamaqembu abantu abangakhulumi ulimi olufanayo noma abangaveli eqenjini lohlanga olufanayo noma abangakhulumi ulimi olulodwa kube iqembu elikhulu. Izingane ezivela kula maqembu amancane (angemaningi) kufanele zivunyelwe ukuthi zithokozele isiko, ukwenza inkolo yazo nokukhuluma ulimi lwazo.

Iyi-rekhodi yezincwadi zonke ezikhiqizwe yizwe. Iqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani ikhophi eyodwa yezisebenzi ezishicilelwe igcinwa futhi itholakala ukuze ibolekwe. Igcina umsebenzi wababhali nabashicileli ukuze usebenze ngocwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo. Isetha isisekelo sokuhlanganisa iNgqungquthela Yomlando YaseNingizimu Afrika, ethumele abasebenzisi bayo kulo lonke izwe ngama-ziphakamiso akhona, ngaleyo ndlela ithuthukisa ukusatshalaliswa kwabo kanye nokumaketha. Inombolo yokuxhumana yokusiza itholakala eMnyangweni Wezincwadi ZaseNingizimu Afrika ukuze icacise izinto eziphathelene nokubhaliswa okusemthethweni.

“Sizokwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yakho yempesheni. Lokhu kuzothatha izinsuku ezimbalwa, kodwa sizokuthumelela imiphumela.” U-Mthembu wathokoziswa, kodwa waba nokukhathazeka. “Ngabe ngizokwazi ukuthola impesheni yami?” wayecabanga. U-Mnu. Khumalo wamkhumbuza ukuthi le nqubo iyajwayelekile, futhi kufanele alinde. U-Mthembu wanquma ukuba nesineke, waphuma ehhovisi enethemba. Izinsuku zedlula, uMthembu wathola incwadi ethokozisayo evela ku-GEMS. Wayezokwazi ukuthola impesheni yakhe! Wazizwa ejabule, kodwa waba nesithakazelo sokwazi ukuthi inombolo yakhe yempesheni iqinisekisiwe kanjani. Wabuyela ehhovisi, lapho uMnu. Khumalo emtshela ukuthi inombolo yakhe yempesheni ibhalwe kahle futhi iqinisekisiwe. “Ngiyabonga, Mnu. Khumalo,” kusho uMthembu, enomoya ophakeme. “Ngiyabonga ngokungisiza.” U-Mnu. Khumalo wamphendula, “Siyajabula ukusiza. Lokhu kuyinsiza kubantu abanjengawe.” U-Mthembu waphuma ehhovisi, enethemba elisha, futhi wafunda ukuthi impesheni yakhe izomnika ithuba lokuphila impilo engcono, nokuthi uzokwazi ukusiza umndeni wakhe. Waqonda ukuthi ukuqinisekiswa kwenombolo yempesheni akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uMthembu wathola impesheni yakhe yokuqala, wazizwa ejabule, futhi wathokozisa umndeni wakhe. Waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa impilo yabo, nokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile. U-Mthembu waba nesifiso sokwabelana ngalesi sihloko nabanye, ukuze nabo bakwazi ukuqinisekisa izinhlelo zabo zempesheni.

Ithenisi: Umlando, Izimiso, Nezindlela Zokudlala Ithenisi, umdlalo owenziwa phakathi kwabantu ababili (singles) noma phakathi kwezixuku ezimbili (doubles), unomlando omude futhi uthokozisa abantu emhlabeni jikelele. Umdlalo uqala emakhulwini ambalwa edlule eFransi, lapho abathandi bokuqala bezama ukujabulisa abantu ngokudlala umdlalo ophakathi kokuphonsa ibhola nokuqhubeka nokulibamba. Ngemuva kwalokho, ithenisi lathuthuka laba umdlalo owaziwa kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi namuhla, luhlala lunomthelela omkhulu ezimpilweni zabantu abaningi. Umdlalo we-ithenisi udlalwa emkhakheni obizwa nge-court, ophakathi kwama-rectangle amabili ahlukaniswe ngentambo. Abadlali baphonsa ibhola phezu kwentambo, bejolise ekutholeni amaphuzu. Zikhona izinhlobo ezahlukene ze-court, njenge-grass court, i-clay court, kanye ne-hard court, ngayinye inezinhloso zayo ezithile nezindlela zokudlala ezihlukile. Izimiso zethenisi ziqala ngokuthi umphakathi kufanele uqonde kahle imithetho eyisisekelo. Umdlalo uqala ngokuphosa ibhola, umphosa kufanele aqinisekise ukuthi ibhola lidlula entanjeni, uma engaphumelelanga, umphakathi uthola iphuzu. Umdlalo uqhubeka ngalendlela, futhi umphakathi kumele uqinisekise ukuthi ubamba ibhola ngaphambi kokuba lihambe phansi kabili. Lokhu kuhilela ubuchwepheshe, ukuzithiba, kanye nesineke. Ithenisi idinga amakhono ahlukahlukene, okufaka phakathi ukushaya, ukujolisa, nokuhamba. Abadlali badinga ukukwazi ukujolisa kahle ibhola ukuze baphumelele. Ukushaya ibhola ngendlela efanele kudinga ukuqonda okuhle kwezobuchwepheshe, njengokubamba ibhola ngendlela efanele, ukuhamba kahle emkhakheni, nokusebenzisa amandla ngendlela efanele.

Ukuxhuman kusemqoka ikakhulukazi kuma-SMME ukuze ancintisane ekutholeni amathenda kuzinhlangano kanye nezinkampani zomphakathi ezingazinye. I-BBSDP izakunikeza okungaba ngamabhizinisi abamnyama isabelo sokuhlukaniselana izindleko ukuze zikwazi ukuthola ukuqeqeshwa nokwelulekwa ukubhekana nesikhala samakhono ababhekene naso. I-BBSDP izawusiza ekunikezeni imali yokuphatha izinhlelo zokuqeqesha, ukulungiswa kwezinhlelo zokuphatha, amakhono acacile ebhizinisi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokumaketha kanye nokokwenza. Ukunikezwa kwezimali zokukhulisa ibhizinisi noma ukwandisa indawo yakho kungatholakala ngaphansi kolwazi olunikeziwe ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi, "Ngiyitholaphi imali yokuqalisa ibhizinisi lami" (Isahluko sesi-3) kule ncwadi? I-BBSDP izawunikeza isabelo sokuhlukaniselana izindleko esingama-80 - 20, okusho ukuthi i-BBSDP izawukhokhela ama-80% ezindleko zebhizinisi zokuqeqesha bese ibhizinisi likhipha ama-20% ezindleko. Isabelo esiphezulu kakhulu esikhishwa yi-BBSDP ngama-R100 000. Ibhizinisi lingafaka isicelo sokwenza amaphrojekthi amaningi uma nje izabelo ezinikezwayo uma sezihlangene zingafinyeleli ngaphezu kwama-R100 000. Nanoma yimuphi umsebenzi osunikezwe imali ngesinye isikimu sikahulumeni noma isikhungo esiyingxenye kahulumeni noma othola noma yikuphi ukwesekwa ngezimali kunoma yimuphi omunye umuntu ngaphandlke kwebhizinisi. Ifomu lokufaka isicelo kuNobhala weKomidi Eliphethe le-BBSDP. I-ASATA igcizelela uhwebo olukhululekile elingenako ukweqiwa kwemithetho nemiyalo.

Lokhu kungaholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobungane, lapho abantu bezwa ukuthi bayahlonishwa futhi bahlonishwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuhlola izidingo zemibhalo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zifaneleka ezimweni ezithile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nokuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwezinkampani nezabasebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo zihlala zikhona, kodwa futhi zihlala zikhanga kubantu abasha. Ekugcineni, ngiyakholelwa ukuthi izidingo zemibhalo yabasebenzi abasha, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni weGEMS, zibalulekile ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokuphatha abasebenzi. Lokhu kudinga ukuba izinkampani ziqonde izidingo zazo, zibe nesineke, futhi ziqhubeke nokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Njengomuntu osebenza emkhakheni wezinsiza zabantu, ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza enobulungiswa, lapho wonke umuntu ezwa ukuthi uyahlonishwa futhi uzwakala. Ngakho-ke, ngikhuthaza izinkampani ukuthi ziqhubeke nokuhlola izidingo zemibhalo yabasebenzi abasha, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zikhona, zikhanga, futhi ziqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabaphathi nabasebenzi. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza engcono, enobungane, futhi enempilo, lapho bonke abantu bezwa ukuthi bayahlonishwa.

Inqubekela phambili ye-Operation Vulindlela Operation Vulindlela, ehlanganisa izinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika, ibonisa inqubekela phambili ebalulekile emizamweni yokukhuthaza ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza, kanye nokwenza ngcono izinga lokuphila kwabantu. Le msebenzi, eqale ngonyaka ka-2020, ibheke ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokukhula komnotho, ikakhulukazi ngemuva kokuhlupheka okubangelwe yiCOVID-19. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise izimpumelelo eziningi ezibalulekile. Okokuqala, izinhlelo zokwakha izinsiza ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngogesi, amanzi, kanye nezokuthutha. Lokhu kuhlangene nezinhlelo zokwakha izikhungo zokusebenza ezizokwakha amathuba emisebenzi, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezisemaphandleni. Lokhu kubonisa ukuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekwakheni umnotho onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolungile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise inqubekela phambili ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo zokuphatha. Ukuze kube nokuphumelela, uhulumeni usebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizeni, okwenza kube lula kubantu ukufaka izicelo zezinsiza ezithile. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokwaziswa nokwaziswa kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-Operation Vulindlela ibonise ukuthi inhloso yayo yokwakha umnotho ophumelelayo iyaphumelela. Izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ziye zathuthukiswa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, okukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqale amabhizinisi abo. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okwandisa amathuba okuphila kwabantu abaningi.

Ukuthuthukiswa Kwesikhathi Sokuphendula Ezimeni Eziphuthumayo Ingxoxo NoMnu. Zulu, Umphakathi Wokuphendula Eziphuthumayo Umhleli: Sanibonani, Mnu. Zulu. Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha ukuze sixoxe ngendaba ebalulekile yokuthuthukiswa kwesikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Ungabelana ngombono wakho ngalolu daba? Mnu. Zulu: Ngiyabonga, umhleli. Ukuze sithuthukise isikhathi sokuphendula ezimeni eziphuthumayo, kubalulekile kakhulu. Izimo eziphuthumayo, njengezinhlekelele zemvelo, izifo ezibulalayo, noma izimo zokuphila, zidinga izinhlelo ezibambekayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlela kahle, ukuqeqesha abantu, kanye nokuxhumana ngendlela efanele. Umhleli: Lokhu kuhle, kodwa ungakuchaza kabanzi ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo ezithathwayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe lesi sikhathi sokuphendula? Mnu. Zulu: Impela. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlaka ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izikhungo zomphakathi, izikhungo zezempilo, nezokuphepha kumele zisebenzisane. Ukuze sikwazi ukuphendula ngokushesha, kudinga ukuhlolwa kwezinsiza ezitholakalayo, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokuxhumana, kanye nokuba nezinhlelo ezicacile. Umhleli: Ngabe kukhona izibonelo ezithile zendlela lezi zinyathelo ezisebenza ngayo? Mnu. Zulu: Yebo, ngithanda ukufaka isibonelo seMphakathi Wokuphendula Eziphuthumayo eGoli. Lapha, sithuthukise uhlelo lokuxhumana olusebenzayo phakathi kwezikhungo ezahlukene. Sihlele imihlangano yokubambisana evamile, lapho abaholi bezikhungo bahlola khona izinhlelo zabo zokuphendula. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi uma kwenzeka isimo esiphuthumayo, wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi uzothatha isinyathelo esithile.

I-Ofisa Yezezimali Ephezulu noma i-ofishali egunyaziwe izakuqinisekisa ukuthi amabhokisi ebhidi avaliwe aze avulwe ngokusemthethweni aqinisekise nokuthi aphephe ngemfanelo. Ngesikhathi sokukhangisa, ibhokisi lebhidi lizawuvulwa livalwe ngama-ofishali amabili: oyedwa ovela Emnyango Wezinsiza Wezezimali kanye noyedwa ovela Emnyango Wezinsiza Zokubumbana, lapho kufaneleke khona, i-ofisa evela kumnyango owenzelwa ibhidi. Ibhokisi lizovulwa ngaphambi komphakathi, okusho ukuthi kukhona amabhida namaqembu anomnako. I-Ofisa Yokuphatha Ukunikezelwa Kwemisebenzi izavula imibhalo yamabhidi (endaweni ecacisiwe embhalweni wamabhidi) kukhona i-ofisa evela EMnyango Wezinsiza Ezibumbene, umnyango ofanele kanye nanoma yimaphi amaqembu anomnako. Uma nje inqubo efanele yokukhangisa isikhathi nendawo kulandelwe, ibhokisi lamabhidi lingavulwa noma amalungu omphakathi engekho. Amagama ababhidi namanani okubhida azokufundwa bese erekhodwa erejisteni yokubhida, ezokwenziwa ukuthi umphakathi ukwazi ukuyihlola uma ucela. Irekhodi yokuqala izawugcinwa ehhovisi LikaMenenja Wezezimali, bese ikhophi lerekhodi kumele linikezwe i-ofishali yomnyango ofanele. Ezehlakalweni zezamba ezinkulu zamabhidi ezithatha isikhathi eside ukufundwa, yilabo babhidi abaceliwe kuphela abazafundwa, bese isheduli eqediwe izakunikezwa ngokushesha okungaphumelelwa ngako. Imiphumela yebhidi izakushicilelwa kuwebhusayidi noma ibhodi yesaziso kamasipala.

Ukuvuleka kokupollinate kusho ukuthi isitshalo esisodwa sithatha ipholeni sithole imbewu yaso. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuzalanisa." Lapho ummbila uqhubeka usebenzisa ipholeni yawo, izitshalo nemibewu ekhiqizwayo - izizukulwane - iyalahlekelwa amandla ngokuhamba kwesikhathi - lokhu kubizwa ngama-line aphindwe kabili. Izitshalo ezivela kulezi zixhumanisi eziphindwe kabili zincane, zineziqu ezincane, futhi umkhiqizo wazo uphansi. Nokho, uma umgqa ophindwe kabili uxubana nomgqa ophindwe kabili, amandla abuyiselwa emibewwini ezokhula, futhi umkhiqizo waleyo mitshalo uzokhula. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi "ukuphila kwe-hybrid." Kwenzeka lapho ukwakheka kwezakhi zofuzo kwezi line kuhlanganiswa futhi kuhlanganyela. I-hybrid ethile ingakhethwa ngoba inokuqina ezifo, kanti enye ingaba nekhono lokubekezelela ukushoda kwamanzi. Ngokuvamile, ama-hybrids anemikhiqizo edlula leyo ye-OPVs. Ama-hybrids ayafana ngemibala, ukufinyelela, nezinye izici, avumela umlimi ukuthi enze imisebenzi eminingi ngasikhathi sinye (njengokufaka umanyolo, ukuwasha, nokuvuna). Ukuvumelana kwemigqomo evunyiwe kungaba usizo uma ummbila uthengiswa noma uthengiswa kubathengi abanezimfuneko ezithile zokuhlola. Ama-hybrids ngokuvamile akhiqiza umkhiqizo ophakeme ngama-18% uma kuqhathaniswa nama-OPVs. Umlimi kufanele avune ngaphezu kwamathani amabili ngehektare ukuze akwazi ukuthenga lezi zibhamu ezibizayo. Imbewu emisha kufanele ithengwe minyaka yonke. Imigqomo evunyiwe yonyaka odlule ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa njengemibewu yonyaka olandelayo.

Siyakhathazeka ukuthola ukuthi abanye othisha basebenza ezinyangeni ngaphandle kokukhokhelwa, kusho uMvimbi. Le ndawo yayimele ngaphambili i-Adelaide Residents Association. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi umnyango wezilimi zesiZulu uzokuqhubeka ube yisikhungo esaziwayo esizohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokulawula umoya ngokuhambisana nezindinganiso ze-ICAO kanye nezindlela ezinconywayo. Isixazululo se-framework siphinde sidinge ukuthi iZizwe eziHlangene zibe nengxenye ezindabeni zezimali. Uhlelo lokuphinda lubize amagama emigwaqo yaseDurban luyaphambili futhi umphakathi uthinteka ekukhetheni amagama amasha. Ingabe umuntu angakutshela ngokuphepha ukuthi abangenayo ikhanda ngaphansi kwaleyo yeStallion? Ucwaningo lwezibhedlela luqinisekisile ukuthi bekukhona icala le-meningitis ye-meningococcal. Izikhala ezinkulu phakathi kwezinsika zizovimba ukudluliswa kwezifo futhi kuzoba nendawo yokwelashwa kumuntu ngamunye walabo abangenayo i-catheter. Izinhlangothi eziningi zamabhizinisi amancane eCape Town zilungiselela umcimbi obalulekile owaziwa kakhulu kubanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane ezweni. Le ndawo ifaka izimpawu ezibhalwe, ezihlanganiswe, noma ezikhiqizwe ngamabhola noma ezinye izindiza ezinganikiwe igama. Ososayensi baseNingizimu Afrika bakwi phambili kuzo zonke izinhlelo zocwaningo eziphathelene nemvelo futhi izwe lidlala indima ebalulekile ekuguqulweni. Amalungu ezindaba anconywa ukuba alungiselele izinhlelo zabo zokuhamba ngesikhathi sokuhlonishwa. Ingabe ubone ukuthi udonga lwangaphandle lwalupaintwa phansi ngalesi sikhathi noma ingxenye yalo? Ingxenye enkulu yalolu shintsho igxile eCape Town.

Uma kwenzeka lokho, kufanele ummeli noma isazi sengqondo senze isinqumo emva kokuhlola ukuthi umqondo wengane ukhulile ukuze ak- wazi ukuzicabangela akunathonya lomu- nye omuntu ukuze inkantolo ikwazi uku- fikelela kwisinqumo.lzizathu zengane zokuphikisa isicelo ziyaphenywa nazo ukuze kukhitshwe ngaphandle ifuthe angahle abenalo umzali ongumthumbi enganeni. Ezinye izigwebo ezikhona zibonisa ukuthi ukuthathwa kwengane kwakun- gelona icala, nokuthi umzali osele ngemuva wayenganakile engasebenzisi amalungelo obuzali ngesikhathi so- kuthathwa noma sokuthunjwa kwen- gane, noma umzali osele ngemuva wayevumile noma waphela evumelana nokubalekiswa Iukuthunjwa kwengane. Elinye iqiniso eliye livele kukuthi ingane isihlezi kahle kubume bendawo entsha, inkantolo ayingeniki isinqumo sokuthi mayibuyiswe. Kwisicelo lapho ukubuyiselwa kwen- gane kuphikisana nemigomo ye- sisekelo somthetho selizwe ebhekene nokukhuselwa kwamalungelo kwabantu nesisekelo senkululeko inkantolo azikho phansi kwengcindezi yokunquma uku- buyiselwa kwengane. Uma ingane ithunjwe ngokungemthetho ukudlula isikhathi sonyaka, kufakwa isicelo sokubuy- iswa kwengane kodwa uma isihleli kahle kwindawo entsha yaye kunobufakazi bokuthi isiyithanda, inkantolo isinganquma ukuthi angabuyiselwa. Inkantolo ingazin- qumela ukuvuma noma ukwala ukubuyisela ingane. lconvention isebenza kuphela kulabo abasuswel bathunjwe ngokungemthetho emva kokuba isivumelwano siqalile ukusebenza phakathi kwamazwe asayinile.. imilayezo yezinqumo eziphuma kubafiki ezabhaliswa noma zaqinisekiswa. nyango uthole ezingu 34,831 izikhalo malunga nesigaba 6 soMthetho.

Ngokwezinhlinzeko zeMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezentengiselwano Kwamazwe Ngamazwe, uMthetho 71 ka-2002, uNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezimboni angase, uma kubhekwa ukuthi kuyadingeka noma kuyinzuzo kulomphakathi, ngesenzo esithunyelwe kwiGazethi yoHulumeni, akhombise ukuthi akukho goods ngaphandle kwalokho okukhuluma ngohlobo oluthile noma uhlobo oluthile olungangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika; noma lungangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika kuphela ngenkululeko yakhe noma ngokuhambisana nezimo ezibekwe kumvume onikezwe yena noma ngumuntu onikezwe igunya nguye. Izicelo zemvume zokungenisa goods, goods eziphethwe ngaphansi kokulawulwa kwezimpahla kufanele zithunyelwe kufomu elibekiwe. Inhloso yalesi sevisi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezisetshenzisiwe ezingenisiwe aziphuli umkhakha weSouthern African Customs Union. Le nqubo iphinde iqinisekise ukuthi kukhona ukulawulwa kwezempilo kwemvelo kanye nezizathu zokuphepha, ukuphepha, nokuhambisana nezindinganiso, kanye nokuphathwa ngenhloso yokuhambisana nezizathu zemvelo. Amafomu wezicelo kufanele agcwaliswe futhi athunyelwe. Akukho sikhathi esibekiwe salolu sevisi. Le sevisi iyamahala.

Inselele enkulu u-PANSALB abhekene nayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izilimi ebezinokubuyiseleka emuva esikhathini esidlule, ikakhulukazi izilimi ezisemthethweni zendabuko zosishiyagalolunye, ziyathuthukisa. Lokhu kuyozelekelela le zilimi ukuthi nazo zikwazi ukusebenza njengezisemthethweni. Ukusungulwa kweziMpiko zeziChazamazwi kungenye yalezo zinyathelo. Eminye futhi imizamo eqalwe yiBhodi ibala ukuqeqeshwa kwababhali bemidlalo kamabonakede, umsakazo nevidiyo kule zilimi, kanjalo nokusombulula amasu azosheshisa ukushicilelwa kwezincwadi zendabuko. Lona ngomunye wemikhakha ofanele ukuthi kugxilwe kuwo ukuze kusetshenziswe amasu azokwelekelela ukuthuthukisa nokukhuthaza le zilimi, kanjalo nabanye abalingani ababambe iqhaza kwizimpokophelo ezifana nalezi. IBhodi yabuye futhi yenza uphenyo lwezikhalazo ezimbalwa ezethulwa phambi kwalo. Ngeshwa-ke, lo msebenzi usadinga ukulolongisiswa ukuze usetshenziswe ngempumelelo ukwelekelela ukulandelwa kwezilimilimi futhi kukhuthazwe izikhungo ukuthi nazo zakhe imithetho migomo yezilimi ezokwazi ukulungisa ukungalingani kwesikhathi esidlllule. Kuyisifiso sika-PANSALB ukubona abakhulumi bezilimi zendabuko besebenzisa amalungelo abo ezilimi. Isu lokubonelela ukuthi amaKomidi eziLimi eziFundazwe akhuthaza ulwazi ngezilimi kulao abakhuluma izilimi ezinomlando wokucindezelwa liyasetshenziswa. Impumelelo yalo izobonakala kule minyaka embadlwana ezayo bese kusetshenzelwa phezu kwayo, uma kunesidingo, ukwenza ngcono isimo. U-PANSALB uphinde wabambisana nemigwamanda eminingi eyahlukene ukuze akwazi ukuphumelela.

Amalungelo Abasebenzi: Ukubaluleka Nokuhlola Namuhla, amalungelo abasebenzi awasiyona into engasafunwa; kunalokho, ayisisimangalo esidinga ukugxilwa. Uhlanga lwezisebenzi, olwakha umnotho, luthinteka kakhulu uma amalungelo abasebenzi engavikeleki. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuhlola ubucayi balokhu, kanye nezizathu ezithile zokuhlonishwa nokuvuselelwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi. Okokuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi aqukethe izinto eziningi, okuhlanganisa amalungelo okusebenza ngezimo ezifanele, amalungelo okukhuluma, amalungelo okwakha izinhlangano, nokuvikelwa ekuphathekeni kabi. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukusebenza kahle, baphile impilo enempilo, futhi bezizwe beyingxenye yomphakathi. Uma lokhu kungafinyelelwa, abasebenzi bangase baphatheke kabi, baphume emsebenzini, noma bazizwe bengabalulekile. Isibonelo, uma sithatha izimo zokusebenza ezinzima, njengezindawo eziphakeme, kudinga ukuqashelwa izimo ezithile. Abasebenzi badinga indawo yokusebenza ephephile, amathuluzi adingekayo, kanye nezinsiza zokwelapha uma kudingeka. Lokhu akukhona nje ukuvikelwa kwabantu, kodwa kuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenziwa kahle, okugcina kuholela ekuthuthukiseni umkhiqizo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukungahlonishwa kwamalungelo abasebenzi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi amalungelo abo awahlonishwa, lokhu kunganciphisa umoya wokusebenza, okungaholela ekunciphiseni umkhiqizo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amalungelo abasebenzi awazwakali kuphela ezindaweni zokusebenza, kodwa ahambisana nomnotho jikelele. Uma abasebenzi bezwa ukuthi bahlonishwa, bazokwenza ngokuzikhandla, okwandisa imiphumela emihle. Ngokuphathelene nezinhlelo zabasebenzi, kubalulekile ukuhlola izinzuzo zokuba nezinhlangano zabasebenzi.

Umbuzo 7: Yiziphi izindlela zokufunda isiZulu? Impendulo: Ukuze ufunde isiZulu, ungasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene. Ungabhalisela izifundo ezisemthethweni, ufunde ngezincwadi, noma usebenzise izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikhethekile. Ukuxhumana nabantu abakhuluma isiZulu, nokuzijwayeza ukukhuluma, kuyindlela ephumelelayo yokuthuthukisa amakhono akho. Ukubuka amafilimu, ukulalela umculo, nokufunda izincwadi zesiZulu nakho kuyasiza. Umbuzo 8: Yini engakwenza ube ngcono ekukhulumeni isiZulu? Impendulo: Ukuze ube ngcono ekukhulumeni isiZulu, kubalulekile ukuzijwayeza njalo. Zama ukukhuluma nabantu abakhuluma isiZulu, futhi ungazithokozisa ngezincwadi, izinkulumo, noma ama-podcast. Futhi, ungazama ukufunda izaga nezisho, ngoba lokhu kuzokwenza ukhulume kahle futhi uqonde kangcono umongo wezinkulumo. Ukuzimisela nokuzikhandla kuzokwenza umehluko omkhulu. Umbuzo 9: Yini eyenza izilimi zibe yinsiza ebalulekile? Impendulo: Izilimi ziwusizo olukhulu empilweni yethu. Zisiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano, ekuxhumaneni, nasekudluliseni ulwazi. Ngaphandle kwezilimi, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu bungeke buphumelele. Izilimi zikhombisa ubuciko bethu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi izinkolelo nemikhuba yethu zihlala zikhona. Ngakho-ke, ukufunda nokukhuluma izilimi ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze sibe nekhono lokuxhumana emhlabeni wanamuhla. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele siyenze ukuze sigcine izilimi zethu zendabuko? Impendulo: Ukuze sigcine izilimi zethu zendabuko, kubalulekile ukuzigcina zikhuluma, zifundiswa, futhi zisetshenziswe ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke.

Izinsizakalo zabantu bangaphandle: imininingwane efanele abantu bangaphandle abadinga izinsizakalo ezithile kuhulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Izigaba ngasinye kulolu hlelo nazo zihlelwe ngendlela ehambisana nezikhathi empilweni yomuntu noma ibhizinisi. Izikhathi zokuphila zihlelwa ngokulandela izigaba zokuphila. Imininingwane ngezinsizakalo nokulethwa kwezinsizakalo ihlelwe ngokwezindawo eziyisixhenxe ezibalulekile, ezihlanganisa: incazelo, izinyathelo okufanele zilandelwe, imithetho nemigomo, amazinga okulethwa kwezinsizakalo nezikhathi zokulethwa kwezinsizakalo, izindleko, amafomu okufanele agcwaliswe, kanye nemininingwane yokuxhumana. Le ngxenye yewebhusayithi, ekhombisa isandla esikhaleni sokudla esiqondisa indlela okufanele uhambise ngayo, ixhumanisa nawe kwezinye amawebhusayithi ahlobene, mayelana nalokho okwenzekayo empilweni. Le webhusayithi ilungiselelwe ngolimi olukhuluma ngolimi olukhulu: isiNgisi, isiAfrikaans, isiNdebele, isiXhosa, isiZulu, isiPedi, isiSotho, isiTsonga, isiVenda, isiSwati, kanye nesiTswana. Ngoba imininingwane ibhalwe kuqala ngesiNgisi bese ihunyushwa kwezinye izilimi. Imininingwane ngezinsizakalo kwezinye izilimi ifakwa kwiwebhusayithi ngemuva kokuhunyushwa. Sebenzisa ikhasi lokuxhumana nathi ukuze uphawule noma ubuze ngale webhusayithi yezinsizakalo zikahulumeni. Ikheli lewebhusayithi yokuxhumana nohulumeni ngu: www.gov.za elikuvumela ukuthi ufike futhi uxhumane nekhasi lokuthi ungene kwiwebhusayithi kahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika, ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokungena, kanye newebhusayithi yolwazi lukahulumeni.

Siyizwe lesibili emhlabeni elike lasingatha umdlalo wekhrikhethi, i-rugby kanye nezindebe zebhola lezinyawo zamazwe omhlaba. Izinkundla zemidlalo ezintsha yizona ezibukeka kakhulu emhlabeni kanti seziqoqene zonke zizohlala abantu abangaphezu kwezi-570 000. Inkundla Yezemidlalo i-Moses Mabhida e-Durban inegobela (arch) lensimbi eliwu-105 ngaphezu kwaphakathi nendawo nenkundla. Ngokusebenzisa imoto yekhebuli, ababukeli bayozithokozisa ngombono omuhle kakhulu wolwandle lwaseThekwini i-Indian Ocean. I-Soccer City eGoli yona ithathe ukuma kweselwa okwenziwa ngayo inkezo yendabuko yesiNtu yokuphuza amanzi. Ngaphandle siyindawo ewu-43 000 m2 futhi sizokwakhiwa ngezinto zokwakha okungezemvelo ngokuphelele ezisebenzisa kahle amandla kagesi. Inkundla yezemidlalo enkulu kunazo zonke e-Afrika ehlala abantu abacishe babe yizi-95 000. Inkundla yezemidlalo iMbombela eNelspruit isesifundeni esaziwa kakhulu ngobuhle bayo basendle kanye nezilwane, iseduze kwe-Kruger National Park. Uphawu lwayo ebonakala ngalo isisekelo esinophahla olukuphakama kwalo kuyi-18 olufana nezindlulamithi. Amazinga ezinkundla zemidlalo emalokishini enziwa ngcono, ezinye ziyoba yizindawo zokuzilolonga kwamaqembu. I-Olympia Park Stadium eRustenburg. Kuzotshalwa izigidi ezinga-R25 ekuthuthukisweni kwamakilabhu kumakhodi onke ezemidlalo, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini empofu, ukuze kutholakale futhi kunakekelwe amathalente ethu ezemidlalo, futhi sense ngcono ukuncintasana kwethu kwezemidlalo. Izigidi ezungama-R212 zitshalwa esikoleni nakwezimidlalo emphakathini kuleso sikhathi ukufika ku-2010.

UMBUZI MIBUZO: Lokhu AKUMBANDAKANYI usizo olukhokelwayo. Ngaphezu kokuhlinzeka usizo olubalile ngenhla, sifisa ukwazi noma wena kumbe omunye umuntu ekhaya lakho uye wahlinzeka noma iluphi uhlobo losizo kumbe unakekelo lwezempilo kwabanye abantu. Khumbula ukuthi lokhu kumaqondana nabantu abangaphandle kwekhaya lakho. Ezinyangeni ezingu 12 ezedlule, kungabe wena noma umuntu wasekhaya lakho nihlinzeka usizo kusihlobo kumbe umngane (esidala noma sengane), ngoba lo muntu unesigulo esinzima emzimbeni noma engqondweni kumbe ukukhubazeka, noma ugugile futhi ubuthaka? Ungalinganisa isikhathi esimaphakathi ngesonto ezinyangeni ezingu 12 ezedlule? a. Kusizwe umuntu uqobo lwakhe, njengokumyisa endlini yangasese, ukumgeza, ukumgqokisa, nokumdlisa? b. Kusizwe ngonakekelo lwezempilo, njengokushintsha amabhandishi nokuphuzisa imithi? c. Baqashelwe njengalo ukwenza kwabo kungathikameza noma kube yingozi kubo nakwabanye? Ngifisa ukukubuza eminye imibuzo embalwa mayelana nekhaya lakho nezimpahla eningaba nazo ekhaya lakho. Khumbula ukuthi noma imiphi imininingwane oyihlinzekayo izogcinwa iyimfihlo. Zingaki izimoti ezikhona ekhaya lakho? Kungabe ikhaya lakho linawo uGesi? Kungabe ikhaya lakho kumbe omunye wasekhaya lakho unalokhu? Umshini wokugeza izitsha? Ngifisa ukwazi noma unomhlaba kumbe ubucwebe okungokwakho - nesihlawumbiselo senani (inani). Ngiyazi ukuthi imininingwane ebucayi lena futhi ngeke ngayinikeza abanye abantu abangekho sethimbeni locwaningo. Siza usitshele noma unomhlaba kumbe ubucwebe okungokwakho nenye impahla eyigugu.

Ubulungiswa bokwakha umculo, izinkinga zokuphathwa kwemali, kanye nezinguquko zamasiko zenza kube nzima kubaculi abasha. Umculo wokwakha ungaba nezinselelo eziningi, njengoba abaculi behluleka ukuthola izinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze bakhe umculo ophumelelayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi kube nezinhlelo ezithile zokuxhasa abaculi, ukuze umculo uqhubeke uthokozisa. Isiphetho: Umculo Njengomthombo Wokuphila Ngokuphetha, umculo ungumthombo ophilayo, onamandla okwakha, ukuxhumana, nokwelapha. Uhlanga oluhle lokuhlanganyela nempilo, umculo ubalulekile ekwakheni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Njengoba umculo uqhubeka nokuthuthukiswa, kubalulekile ukuthi siwuhloniphe, siwusebenzise, futhi siwufake ezimpilweni zethu nsuku zonke. Umculo awuwona nje umculo; ungumthombo wempilo, uthando, kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudinga ukuba sonke sibe nomthwalo wemfanelo wokugcina umculo uphilile, ube yinsiza yokuhlanganyela, nokuba yindlela yokukhuluma ngezinto ezibalulekile empilweni yethu.

Ukuhlolwa kuzokwenziwa ngesincomo sikadokotela. Iziguli ezidinga ukwelashwa ohlelweni lukahulumeni lezempilo akufanele zicele ukuhlolwa kwasendlini yocwaningo lwesayensi. Siyazi ukuthi yilokhu okwenzeka njengamanje emkhakheni wezempilo wangasese, kodwa akukhokona okufunwa yi-WHO. Odokotela kufanele belaphe izimo ezisolekayo ngokwamazinga okwedlulisa ulwazi (protocol) ahlinzekwe nguMnyango Kazwelonke Wezempilo. Ukwelashwa onelungelo lokuzikhethela kona yi-Tamiflu. Ukwelashwa kukawonke wonke nge-Tamflu kuzoholela ekuqabeni kokulapheka uma kusetshenziswa lo muthi futhi kungenza ukuthi ungasebenzi nakulabo ongahlenga izimpilo zabo. Ulwazi olutholakale emhlabeni wonke ngukuthi ukuvalwa kwezikole nezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, amamoli okuthenga nezindawo zokusebenzela akusebenzi kusukela ekusabalaleni kokufa. Kodwa, lokhu kudala ukuthikamezeka okukhulu enhlalweni. Seluleka ukuthi noma ngabe yimuphi umfundi, umfundisi noma umsebenzi onezimpawu ezingcono ukuba ahlale ekhaya. Uma bebaningi abafundi futhi/noma abafundisi abaphuthayo, isikhungo esithintekayo kuzofanele sithinte uMnyango Wezemfundo, ozobe ngokuhlanganyela neziphathimandla zezempilo usululeka ngokufanele kwenziwe ukuqhubekela phambili. Uma unezimpawu ezingcono, hlala ekhaya futhi nqanda ukuhlangana nabantu. Ngifisa ukuniqinisekisa ukuthi ososayensi benza konke okusemndleni emhlabeni wonke besebenzisana ne-WHO ukuzama ukuthola ikhambi. Uma konke kuhamba kahle, ikhambi elifana naleli lingakhona ezinyangeni ezimbalwa. Kodwa, kunesindingo esikhulu kabi sekhambi nokukhiqizwa obukhulu bako bunganele - ubukhulu obungekho e-Afrika.

Iningi lentuthuko efunwa ngabantu ayidingi mali ukuze ibe khona, njengokumoyizela, ukuphatha abantu ngenhlonipho ukwethembeka uma unikeza abantu ulwazi kanye nokuxolisa uma wenze iphutha. Lezizinto azidingi mali - zidinga ukuguqula indlela abantu baziphatha ngayo. Ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi eyenzelwa abantu wukuhlela kabusha indlela ophatha abantu ngayo. Ukufezekisa uhlelo lwe-Batho Pele akuwona umsebenzi owenziwa kanye ubese uphela, kanti kuwuhlelo oluqhubeka njalo, olunamandla oluzoqhubeka iminyaka eminingi luthola umfutho sonke isikhathi.

I-Truth and Reconciliation Commission: Ukubuyisana Nokuqonda I-Truth and Reconciliation Commission (TRC) iyisikhumbuzo esibalulekile emlandweni wezwe lethu, iNingizimu Afrika. Le nkampani yasungulwa ngemuva kokuphela kokubusa kobandlululo, ngenhloso yokubuyisana phakathi kwabantu abahlukene, nokwakha isizwe esisha esihlonipha amalungelo abantu. Ngalesi sikhathi esinzima, umphakathi wawudinga ukuvuma izigameko ezinzima ezedlule, ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ikusasa elingcono. Ngokubona kwami, i-TRC ibalulekile ngoba yayingumzamo wokubuyisana, hhayi kuphela phakathi kwabantu, kodwa futhi phakathi kwezizwe ezahlukene. Ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi izigameko ezedlule zishiya izilonda ezinzima. Ukuxoxa ngalezi zinto, nokuvuma ukuthi zenzeka, kubalulekile ukuze sikwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obunempilo. I-TRC yabe iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba sikhuluma ngempilo, kudingeka sikhumbule izinkumbulo ezinzima. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, i-TRC yaphenduka indawo yokuxoxisana, lapho abantu bephuma phambili ukuze babelane ngezindaba zabo. Lokhu kwavula amathuba okuthi abantu baziqonde, bahloniphe, futhi bakhumbule abanye. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lezi zindaba zazingezinzima, kodwa zazingaphezu kokukhumbula ubuhlungu; zazikhombisa amandla okuphila, nokuthi abantu bangakha kabusha izimpilo zabo. Lokhu kwenza kube sobala ukuthi, ukuze sibe nesizwe esiqinile, kudingeka sibe nezinhlaka ezivumela abantu ukuba bakhulume, baphinde bakhumbule. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. I-TRC ibhekane nezinselelo eziningi. Abanye abantu babengafuni ukuvuma izigameko ezithile, noma babengafuni ukuphendula imibuzo ethile.

I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela inikezwa ukuvikela ubukhosi, izwe, kanye nabantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuze kuqinisekiswe indawo ethule futhi ethuthukayo kubo bonke. Iphinde ibheke noma iyiphi iminyango kahulumeni ngenhloso yokuthuthukisa izimo zomphakathi nezomnotho. I-Mnyango Wezokuvikela ihlanganisa uNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela, uNobhala Wezokuvikela, kanye neNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika (SANDF). UNgqongqoshe Wezokuvikela ungumgibeli onamandla, uNobhala Wezokuvikela ungumuntu ophathisa ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye nomphathi weMnyango Wezokuvikela, kanti umphathi weMpi unomsebenzi wokuyala nokulawula iMpi. Ukuba yi-Centre Yemininingwane yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ezophatha izicelo zolwazi nezindaba ezihlobene. Ukuhlinzeka ngosizo lwezimali lukamasipala kuMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphatha Izimali Zomphakathi (PFMA), Izimiso Zesikhwama, nezikhangiso ezithunyelwe kubo bonke. Ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba zezinqubomgomo zokuphepha kwazwelonke nokuhola indlela yepholisi yeMnyango Wezokuvikela ngokusungula, ukuthuthukisa, nokubhekelela izinqubomgomo zokuvikela, isu, kanye nesakhiwo ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zikazwelonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, okucophelela, nokuphumelelayo komsebenzi wokuvikela. Ukuqinisekisa ubulungisa nokwethembeka ekuphathweni kolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvikela. Umdidiyeli ungumphathi Wethuba Elilinganayo Nokwesekwa Kwabantu Abandile. Ukuphatha nokulawula iNhlangano Yezokuvikela YaseNingizimu Afrika.

Lokhu kuzoba yithuba elihle! Kodwa kufanele siqaphele ukuthi umhlaba ungasinika noma ungasidela.” Kwathi ngosuku olukhulu, bonke abathanda ukuthola izinsiza bahlangana edwaleni elikhulu. Umoya opholile wawukhona, futhi abantu babejabulile. UThandiwe noSipho banquma ukujoyina leli qembu. Bafaka izigqoko zabo zokuvikela, behlola izindawo ezahlukene, bagxila ezindaweni ezinje nezibhekene nezinsizwa ezikhanya. Njengoba bejula, baqala ukuthola izinto ezimangalisayo. Babona amatshe amakhulu, izinsimbi ezizwakalayo, nezinto eziningi ezazingaziwa. Kodwa ngesikhathi bejula kakhulu, baqala ukuzizwa bephazamisekile ngenxa yezwi elijulile elibuhlungu elalibabiza. “Hamba! Hamba! Ungekho umhlaba okhonjisiwe,” lasizwa. UThandiwe noSipho babephazamisekile, kepha bahamba phambili, becabanga ngempilo engcono. Kwathi lapho befika endaweni ethile, baqala ukubona umgudu omkhulu, ophakathi kwendawo engaziwa. “Kukhona okuthile lapha, Sipho,” kusho uThandiwe, enza izinyathelo zokuqala. Kodwa njengoba bejula, umhlaba waba mnyama, wabavulela umgudu omkhulu, owawuthokozisa impilo yabo. Bahlaselwa yizimo ezinzima, kodwa uThandiwe wathi, “Asizoyeka! Sizobona ukuthi umhlaba ungenza kube lula.” Ngemva kwezinsuku ezithile, uThandiwe noSipho bathola igolide elikhulu nelikhazimulayo. Babegcwele injabulo, becabanga ngemiphumela yalo mgudu. Nokho, ngesikhathi besathokozisa impumelelo yabo, baqala ukuzizwa bejulelwe yizinto ezimbi. Umhlaba wawusiphendulela, ubabulela izinkinga ezinzima. Babona ukuthi ukujula phansi kwenza kube nzima, futhi umhlaba waba izingxaki ezinkulu.

Lithini igama eligcwele lomhlinzeki mininingwane? Lithini ikheli lomphenduli mibuzo? Kungabe lomhlinzeki mininingwane/indlu unawo utelefoni? Ithini inombolo yocingo? Uma singakwazi ukuthintana nawe nganoma isiphi isizathu, ukhon ayini omunye umuntu esingamthinta owaziyo ukuthi singakuthola kanjani kumbe omunye enihlala naye ekhaya? Q0306a. Ubani igama lalo muntu, ubudlelwano nawe kanye nekheli lakhe? Umbhekeli cwaningo angahle akushayele ucingo kumbe akuvakashele futhi ukuzohlola le ngxoxo mibuzo kanye nokuzoqoqa imininingwane eyengeziwe esikhathini esizayo. UMBUZI MIBUZO: FAKA ikhodi yemiphumela yokugcina kusigaba 0000: Ikhasi elingaphandle, Q0007. Ukuze sinqume ukuthi ubani esizokumfaka imibuzo, Ngidinga ukwazi ukuthi ubani ohlala kuleli kheli. Angikunikeze isiqiniseko sokuthi noma imiphi imininingwane oyihlinzekayo igcinwa iyimfihlo. Uma ngibuza ukuthi "ubani ohlala la ekhaya", Ngichaza labo abadla ndawonye ('amadlelandawonye') futhi bahlala la okungenani izinyanga ezine ngonyaka? Ngifisa ukwazi ubudala, ubulili, ukushada, izinga lemfundo kanye nobudlelwano belungu nelungu lalo muzi elihlala kuwo. Siza ubale nabantu okungase kube abkho manje ngoba ngoba yempilo besendaweni enjengesibhedlela kumbe baboshiwe noma ekhaya labadala okwesikhashana. Bangaki sebebonke abantu bahlala kulo muzi? Sifuna ukuqala ngomuntu oyinhloko yekhaya. Ngoyinhloko yekhaya-ke sichaza umthathi zinqumo ongungqa phambili ekhaya. INhloko kungaba owesilisa noma owesifazane. Uma abantu ababili belingana ngokuthathwa kwezinqumo, kuthathwa omdala kubo. Ngubani igama loyinhloko yekhaya?

Ngamanye amazwi, lo mnyango uzinikele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi wonke umuntu unendawo enobuqotho yokuhlala, kungakhathaliseki ngesimo sabo somnotho. Leli lungelo liphakathi kwabantu bonke, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi bahlala emadolobheni noma ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Umphakathi Wokuphathwa Kwezimali, ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi kule ndawo, sinezinkulungwane zabantu abahluphekayo. Kukhona inani eliphezulu labantu abangenamsebenzi kule ndawo, futhi ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abantu bethu akukabhekiwe. Ukuphazamiseka kokuthuthukiswa kule ndawo kukhombisa kahle ukunganaki kukahulumeni we-apartheid, owangazange unake ukuphuculwa kwezimpilo zabantu bethu lapha. Akumangalisi ukuthi kule ndawo sinezinga elingu-61% labantu abangenamsebenzi. Ngisho nalabo esithi bayasebenza bathola imali encane kakhulu. R800.00 ngenyanga. Lokhu kukhombisa kahle ukuthi lo mphakathi udinga usizo lukahulumeni ngezindlu nokuthuthukiswa kwezinye izinsiza, ngoba uma kungenjalo, ngeke bakwazi ukuzisiza ngenxa yesimo sabo somnotho esiphansi. Njengoba ngishilo, konke kuqala ngekhaya. Nakuba umcimbi wethu ungase ungahlangene ngqo nokwethulwa kwezinye izinsizakalo zomphakathi, kufanele ngikhulume ngalokho okubalulekile ukwenza ikhaya libe nolwazi futhi lizinze ezimpilweni zabantu. Enye yezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi kule ndawo wamanzi. Kukhona izizathu eziningi zalokhu, kuhlanganise nezomiso ezivame ukuhlasela le ndawo. Kodwa kuze kube namuhla, uhulumeni wethu usebenza noMkhandlu weGu ukuze kwenziwe konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bethu lapha banokufinyelela emanzini ahlanzekile. Umnqopho wethu njengohulumeni uwukuthi wonke umuntu abe nendawo ephephile yokuhlala.

Uphenyo kungaba ngolwekhomishana yokuthola imininingwane. Uma uphenyo lukhomba ukwephulwa komthetho wezemvelo, uhulumeni unomsebenzi wokumisa lesenzo nokulungisa umonakalo. Isibonelo: Unolwazi ngobugebengu obuhleliwe bokunyenyisa izimpondo zikabhejane obenzeka ezifundazweni ezimbalwa nangaphandle kwezwe. Uzwile futhi ngokubandanyeka kwamaphoyisa kulesisenzo. Ngakho awuthandi ukubika loludaba emaphoyiseni. Ungethula lombiko kuNgqongqoshe uqobo. Uma ukhathazekile ngomonokalo emvelweni kodwa ungenawo amandla okukhokhela izindleko zophenyo lwalenkinga, ungaqonda kuNgqongqoshe umcele aqoke umphenyi. Zama ukuqoqa ubufakazi obenele ngaphambi kokubika ukuze nohulumeni abone ukuthi kunezizathu ezinqala zokuqalisa ngophenyo. Ukuvikela abasebenzi abenqaba ukwenza umsebenzi oyingozi emvelweni. Ungenqaba ukwenza umsebenzi othile okholwa wukuthi uyingozi noma ungadala umonakalo omkhulu emvelweni. Isibonelo: Usebenzela udokotela kanti umsebenzi wakho ubandakanya ukuhlanza nokulahla udoti. Ngolunye usuku udokotela ukushiyela isaziso sokuthatha umthamo omkhulu wokungcola uyowulahla esigangeni esiseduze nalapho kungavunyelwe khona ukulahla lodoti. Wena sewuyenqaba ukwenza lokhu. Ngosuku olulandelayo udokotela ufika emsebenzini akwesabise ngokukuxosha. Ubuyekeza isiGaba 29 seNEMA usumtshela ukuthi akanalo ilungelo lokukuxosha. Umqashi wakho noma omunye umuntu akavunyelwe ukwethembisa noma yini ewusizo ngenhloso yokukuncenga ukuthi wenza lowomsebenzi. Uma uthathelwa izinyathelo, njengokuxoshwa, unelungelo lokuthatha izinyathelo zomthetho. Ukushaya ikhwela/ukuhlaba umkhosi ngezenzo ezingadala umonakalo emvelweni.

Ukuze ibhizinisi liphumelele, kumele liphathwe kahle. Ukuba nezicwangciso ezicacile kubalulekile ngoba ziyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zokuphatha ibhizinisi. Ukuphathwa kahle kusho ukuthi imisebenzi emine yokuphatha ibalanced ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ibhizinisi liyaqhubeka nokuphumelela ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, lifinyelela ezinhlelweni zalo ezifunwayo futhi lenze inzuzo. Imisebenzi yokuphatha ibandakanya: ukuhlela isu, ukuhlanganisa isu, ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo, nokuhlola ukusebenza okuqhubekayo (ukugcina ukulawula). Ukuhlela isu kuyinto ebalulekile kumkhiqizi ngoba kuyisisekelo sazo zonke izenzo zabo zokulima. Singathi ukuhlela isu kuzokhombisa indlela eya phambili nezinyathelo ezidingekayo ukuze kufezwe izinhloso ezibekiwe ezinhlelweni zakho zokuhlanganisa lezi zenzo. Njalo sithi asikwazi ukuhlela izicwangciso ezicacile ekulimaleni. Izizathu zalokhu zimi kanje: kunezinto eziningi ezingalawulwa, ezifana nezimo zezulu, izifo, ukuguquguquka kwemakethe, nezinguquko ezintengo zokufaka nezokukhipha. Lezi zingozi zingavela ekulimaleni; zikhona, futhi sibhekana nazo lapho sizama ukwakha ibhizinisi lokulima. Nokho, siphinda sithi isu eliphukile lingcono kunokungabi naso nhlobo. Kungcono ukuhlela izicwangciso mayelana nonyaka ojwayelekile, bese singakwazi ukuhlela lezi zicwangciso uma izimo zishintsha phakathi kwalonyaka. Yini okufanele kwenzeke? Kuphi okufanele kwenzeke? Nini okufanele kwenzeke? Kanjani okufanele kwenzeke? Ukuba nekhono lokuhlela izicwangciso kudinga ukuthi lezi zicwangciso zibhaliwe futhi ziphathwe ngokuqinile. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe kuyo yonke impilo yakho.

Isihloko sesikhombisa: sinesiphetho esinika isithombe sokukade kudingidwa ohlelweni lokufakana imilomo olwenziwa ukuze kuqhanyukwe nalolu hlaka lwenqubomgomo. Isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko ngesikhathi sombuso wengcindezelo. Indima edlalwa yizikhungo zendabuko ekuphathweni kwemithetho isuka endulo. UBennet3 uyachaza ukuthi isikhungo sobuholi bendabuko saqala ezikhathini zasendulo lapho abantu babenezinkolelo ezifanayo, benamakhosi awodwa lapho babesikelwa umhlaba wokuhlala namadlelo. Umholi wayeyinhloko yomphakathi, ngaphansi komholi bese kuba nezigaba ezimbili zomphathi womphakathi kanye nenhloko yomndeni. Umholi wayedlala indawo yokuhola kuzo zonke izinhla zomphakathi, kusukela ekuthuthukisweni kwezindawo zasemaphandleni kuye ekuholeni amabutho eya empini nasekuxazululeni ukungaboni ngaso linye emphakathini. Uhulumeni wendabuko wawehlukile ukunowentando yeningi wamanje. Wawungabhekeli ukwabiwa kwamandla nemisebenzi ephathelene nemithetho yokugweba, ukuphatha nokwenziwa kwemithetho.4 Indima yesikhungo ibalulekile ekuqondeni izinselelo ezibhekene nesikhungo ngaphansi kohlelo lwentando yeningi. Ukwamukelwa kwezinkantolo zabaholi bendabuko, njengoba iningi licabanga, kwakuyinto efanele, njengoba lokhu kwakwenziwa kuncikiswe ezinhlelweni zomthetho ezejwayelekile kulowo mphakathi. Ukufika kwengcindezelo kwaletha ushintsho oluphelele ekuphathweni kwemithetho ngabaholi bendabuko. Ohulumeni bengcindezelo nowobandlululo bangenelela ezinhlakeni zezinkantolo ngokuqala izinkantolo eziseceleni zabantu abamnyama.

Ama-Orlando Pirates: Uhambo Lwenjabulo Nezinkanyezi Zomhlaba Ekhaya lemidlalweni, lapho umoya wezemidlalo uthokozisa khona, khona lapho sithola khona ama-Orlando Pirates, iqembu elidume kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zinkanyezi zikaMhlaba ziqale uhambo lwazo eminyakeni engama-1937, lapho abalandeli bejabulisa khona izinkanyezi ezazizokwakha umlando omkhulu. Ngaleso sikhathi, abalandeli baziwa ngokuthi "amaBuccaneers," igama elihambisana nesibindi, ubuhlakani, kanye nomoya wokulwa. Uhambo lwamaPirates lwalugcwele izinselelo, kodwa futhi lwalugcwele nezinselelo ezinkulu. Kwakukhona izikhathi lapho iqembu lalahlekelwa yizicoco, kodwa abalandeli bahlala bejabulile, bephakamisa izandla zabo phezulu, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Lokhu kwaba yisibonelo sokuthi uthando lwezemidlalo lungaphezu kokuphumelela; luwumoya ophilayo, umoya ohlanganyela abantu abaningi. Ngonyaka ka-1995, amaPirates akhombisa amandla awo emhlabeni jikelele. Ngaleso sikhathi, aqhuba umjaho ophakeme, abamba iCAF Champions League, okuyinto eyayiyinsakavukela. Lokhu kwaba yisikhathi sokuhlonishwa, lapho abalandeli behlabelela, bejabulisa izinkanyezi zabo. Kwakungesikhathi lapho umoya wokuhlanganyela wawubhalwe phansi emlandweni, futhi abalandeli baziwa ngokuthi "iPirates Family," umndeni owawuhlangene ngothando lweqembu. Ngesikhathi amaPirates edlula eminyakeni, kwavela izinkanyezi eziningi ezazizokhumbuleka. UBenni McCarthy, uTico Tico, noThabo Matlaba, bonke babengabalingisi abakhulu abashaya izinkanyezi emkhakheni wezokudlala.
