Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole Isingeniso Ukuhlolwa kokwakhiwa kwengqalasizinda yezikole kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izikole zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokufundisa, zikhuthaza ukufunda, futhi ziqinisekisa ukuphepha kwabafundi. Le ndatshana ibheka izinqubo, izinqubomgomo, nezindlela zokuhlola ukuthi ingqalasizinda yezikole iyahlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, izidingo zemfundo, kanye nezindinganiso zokuphepha. Inhloso Inhloso yokuhlola ingqalasizinda yezikole iwukuhlola izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukusebenza kwezikole, okuhlanganisa: 1. Ukuphepha: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikole zinezindawo zokufunda eziphephile, ezivikelekile, futhi ezihlangabezana nezindinganiso zokwakha. Ukufinyelela: Ukuhlola ukuthi izikole zifinyeleleka kalula kubafundi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezimfanelo ezikhethekile. Izinsiza: Ukuhlola ukuthi izikole zinazo izinsiza ezifanele zokufundisa, ezifana nezincwadi, amathuluzi, nezobuchwepheshe. Ukwaneliseka kwabafundi: Ukuhlola izinga lokwaneliseka kwabafundi nezisebenzi ezikhona ezikoleni. Izindlela Zokuhlola Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwengqalasizinda kuyaphumelela, izinyathelo ezilandelayo zizothathwa: 1. Uphenyo Lwabafundi: Ukuqoqa imibono yabafundi mayelana nezindawo zokufunda, izinsiza, nezimo zokuphepha. Uphenyo Lwezisebenzi: Ukuhlola imibono nezinkinga ezibhekene nezisebenzi ezikoleni, okuhlanganisa othisha, abaphathi, nabanye abasebenzi. Ukuhlola Izakhiwo: Ukuhlola izakhiwo ezikhona ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zikhona ezingeni eliphezulu lokwakhiwa, zihlala zisebenza, futhi zifanele izidingo zemfundo.

U-Sipho noThandi badlala imidlalo ethokozisayo, behlakanipha ngendlela evelele. Bafuna izinkanyezi eziphuma phezulu, bezama ukufaka izinhlelo ezahlukene ukuze baphumelele. Njengoba bedlala, bahlola izinkambo ezintsha, benza izinqumo ezinzima, bezama ukuqonda izindlela zokuqeda izitha zabo. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, uSipho uthola ukuthi ukudlala iCheckers akukhona nje ukudlala, kodwa kuyindlela yokufunda. Ubuqotho, ubuhlobo, nokubambisana kwenzeka ngenhliziyo, okwenza umdlalo ube mnandi kakhulu. Izinsuku zaphuma, zashintsha izinyanga. Umphakathi wabe unokukhanya okukhulu, njengoba abantwana baphokophela phambili, befunda futhi begcina ubudlelwano obubanzi. U-Sipho noThandi baqala ukuhlela umjaho omkhulu weCheckers wendawo, bahlola ukuthi abantu bayakuthokozela yini. Umjaho wawuhloswe ukuxhumanisa wonke umphakathi, ukwakha ubudlelwano obukhudlwana phakathi kwabantu. Ngesikhathi sokubamba umjaho, uSipho noThandi babebonisa ukuthi umphakathi ungakhula uma ubambisana. Abantu behlangana, behlukanisa iziphuzo nezitsha, bejabulisa imindeni eminingi. U-Sipho wanikela ngeziqhamo, uThandi wanikela ngezinsuku ezimnandi ezithokozisayo. Umjaho wabe ubuyisa imizwa emihle, ukuncintisana kwaba yinto eyenzeka, kodwa umphakathi wawumkhumbula, ubudlelwano bukhula bese kudlula imidlalo. Ngemuva komjaho, uSipho noThandi bahlala phansi, behlangana nabantu abavela kwaMkhumbane. Babebonisa ubufakazi bokuthi iCheckers ingaba umphakathi owodwa. U-Sipho waphakamisa ingxenye ethakazelisayo - "Umdlalo akukhona nje ukuwina, kodwa ukuhamba ndawonye. Lokhu kudlula impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuba nabantu abavuma ukusiza."

Uma abasebenzi bebonisa ukuziphatha okuhle, baveza ukuzimisela ukufinyelela izinhloso, okudingeka ukuqashelwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe umoya omuhle. Izinselelo Zokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Nokho, zikhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi. Abanye abaphathi bangase bangakwenzi lokhu ngendlela efanele, noma babe nezinkinga zokwahlulela, okungaholela ekungahambisani. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi baqonde izidingo zabasebenzi ukuze imiklomelo ihambisane nezinjongo zebhizinisi. Isiphetho Imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kudlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni indawo yokusebenza ephumelelayo. Ukuqonda izimpumelelo, ukuhlinzeka ngemicabango, nokuhlonipha abasebenzi kudala umoya wokuzinikela, kukhuphule umkhiqizo, futhi kugqugquzele ukuthuthukiswa. Izinkampani kufanele ziqhubeke nokuhlonipha abasebenzi bazo ukuze bonke baziswe futhi bakwazi ukukhula emikhakheni abawuthandayo, okuholela ekuzuzeni okukhulu kubo nakwizinhlangano.

Kumele usetshenziswe esigabeni ngasinye sohlelo. Umhlahlandlela IV yibhokisi lamathuluzi elinezikhali ezehlukene zokucwaninga nokusiza ekuthatheni izinqumo kanjalo namasu angasetshenziswa ngesikhathi sohlelo. Izikhali aziphoqelelwe futhi ehluka isimo ngesimo somasipala. Amathimba aqokelwe umhlahlandlela IV ngabahleli abangochwepheshe kanye nabagqugquzeli abasebenzisa amathuluzi. Ungacatshangwa ngasikhathi sini senqubo ye-IDP? Umhlahlandlela IV kufanele usetshenziswe ngokubambisana nomhlahlandlela wesithathu. Amatulo asetshenziswa ezigabeni ezehlukene zenqubo kanti kwezinye iziwombe isikhali esisodwa singasebenza ezindaweni eziningi. Inhloso yomhlahlandlela V wukuqwashisa omasipala ngenkambiso nezinhlelo zezifundazwe nozwelonke okumele zicatshangwe lapho kwenziwa amalungiselelo ezinhlelo zentuthuko edidiyele. Ungacatshangwa ngasikhathi sini senqubo ye-IDP? Umhlahlandlela V kufanele usetshenziswe ngokubambisana nomhlahlandlela wesithathu. Amathimba aqokiwe yilawo anikwe umsebenzi wokuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wenzeka ngempela futhi uhambisana nenkambiso nenhloso yama-IDP, ngumphathi masipala, ophethe izimali, izinhloko zeminyango nabasebenzi abathile ababhekele ukwengamela izinhlelo eziqaguliwe zomsebenzi. Umhlahlandlela kumele ucatshangwe ngesikhathi sezisebenza izinhlelo nasesigabeni sokubuyekeza. Ikunika izeluleko ezinqala ngenhloso, ingqikithi nezici zokwakhiwa kwe-IDP, ukwengezela emibandeleni ebekwe eMthethweni weziNhlelo zoMasipala. Ukuqaphela nokubuyekeza - ngesikhathi kuhlelwa, kusungulwa izinkomba zokukala iqophelo lezithelo zomsebenzi, izinga lawo uqobo nemithelela.

b indawo idinga isenzo esithile sokuphatha iqophelo lomoya ukulungisa isimo esikhona. b indawo yenabela ngaphesheya komngcele wesinye isifundazwe; noma c indawo iwela ngaphansi kwesifundazwe lapho leso sifundazwe sicele khona uNgqongqoshe ukuba adalule leyo ndawo njengekleliswe phambili. Ngokwesigatshana 1, uNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya esifundazweni angadalula indawo esesifundazweni njengendawo ekleliswe phambili. UNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe ongamele iqophelo lomoya ezifundazweni ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezencikene anganquma ngesikhathi esisodwa ukudalula indawo engaphansi kwalezo zifundazwe njengezindawo ezikleliswe phambili. Ngaphambi kokushicilela isaziso ngaphansi kwesigatshana -1, uNgqongqoshe kaZwelonke noma wesiFundazwe kufanele alandela inqubo yokubonisana ehambisana nezigaba- 49 ne- 50. Ukunqunywa kwendawo njengekleliswe phambili kufanele kudwetshwe uma indawo ihambisana namazinga eqophelo lomoya endaweni. a silungise isu lokuphatha laleyo ndawo mayelana neqophelo lomoya ngemuva kokubonisana neziphathimandla zamaqophelo omoya ezifundazweni ezithintekayo nomasipala b zingakapheli izinyanga eziyisithupha idaluliwe indawo noma singakapheli isikhathi esivunywe nguNgqongqoshe, sethule isu kuNgqongqoshe ukuze ligunyazwe. b zingakapheli izinyanga eziyisithupha leyo ndawo idaluliwe noma singakapheli isikhathi esinganqunywa nguNgqongqoshe wesiFundazwe, ethule isu kuNgqongqoshe ukuze ligunyazwe.

Ingxenye 4: Ukubambisana Komphakathi Abantu basebenzisa kanjani amakhono abo ukuze basebenze ndawonye? Kubalulekile ukubheka ukuthi imiphakathi iyakwazi kanjani ukubambisana ukuze ibuyisele amandla kulesi sikhala. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinsiza nezinsizakusebenza kusiza ekwakheni udumo nolwazi, okwenza ukuba kube neqhaza elikhulu. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi kuphi, usizo lokubambisana lungakhuphula izinga lokuphila. Ingxenye 5: Ukuphathwa Kwezinhlelo Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu akupheli nje ekwakheni izakhiwo, kubalulekile futhi ukuphatha kahle izinhlelo uma zikhona. Kuze kube manje, izinkinga ezidlangile ziletha ukusindwa kumaphrojekthi. I-RDP kudinga ukubhekwa ngendlela ebanzi, kungebanga lokuthi abantu badinga izindlu ezigungeni, kodwa kudinga ukuthi kubhekelwe izinsiza ezifanele. Ingxenye 6: Izikhumbuzo Nezixazululo Sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi izikhumbuzo zohlelo lwe-RDP zibaluleke kangakanani. Iziphumo ezitholakalayo zikhombisa ukuthi izinkinga ezijwayelekile zikhona, kodwa futhi zikhona nezixazululo. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqinisa umphakathi kubalulekile ukuze siqhubeke phambili. Kodwa-ke, asikwazi ukweqa izinqumo ezihlakaniphile nezihambisanayo. Ingxenye 7: Izifinyezo Zokugcina Ukwakhiwa kwezindlu ze-RDP akukhulumi nje ngokwakha izindlu, kodwa kuyingxenye enkulu yokuphila kwabantu. Ukuhlanganyela kwethu kumaphrojekthi akwemukelekanga kuzodingeka. Asiphambukeli kulokhu, sibheka phambili, sithuthukisa ubuchwepheshe, nezinsiza, ukuze kube nezinto ezizokwenziwa ngeqiniso. Ingxenye 8: Ukuphetha Siyavuma ukuthi lezi zindlu ze-RDP zingasiza ukuvuselela umphakathi, kodwa kudinga ukuba nesivumelwano phakathi kwabantu, uhulumeni, kanye nezinkampani.

Uma ibhizinisi lenza inenzuzo, umnikazi uzokwazi ukukhipha umholo. Uma ibhizinisi lingakwenzi inenzuzo, umnikazi uthola lutho. Izinto ezidingekayo zikhona ezinkampanini, futhi abathengi bazithenga. Imali engenayo evela ekuthengiseni izinto ezidingekayo iyinenzuzo yebhizinisi. Uma ibhizinisi likhiqiza noma lihambisa izinto ezidingekayo, libhekana nezindleko ezithile. Izindleko zokukhiqiza - imbewu, amafutha, amakhemikhali ezifo, imithi, ukuvuna, nezindleko zokumaketha. Izindleko eziphezulu - izimali zebhange, izindleko zendawo yokusebenza, izindleko zokubhaliswa kwezimali, nezindleko zemoto nezithuthi. Izindleko eziyisisekelo - amalayisense ezimoto, amaholo çalışan abaqashiwe, ukuncipha kwezithuthi nezakhiwo, nezindleko ze-inshurensi. Izindleko zangaphandle - intshontsho yemali ebolekiwe, amaholo abaphathi, nokurenta izindlu noma umhlaba. Zonke izindleko zizofana nalokho okukhuluma ngenhla (uma sizihlanganisa zonke). Inenzuzo ifana nalokho okusele ngemuva kokukhipha zonke izindleko. Uma kukhiqizwa, abakhiqizi bangaba abathengi bezintengo (imali engenayo) nezindleko. Kokubili, amanani nezindleko, akhula ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kodwa ezingeni elihlukile. Isibonelo: ngoMashi 26, 2010, uJ Willemse wabhala kuLandbouweekblad ukuthi ngonyaka ka-2009, inenzuzo yamabhizinisi ezolimo emhlabeni jikelele yakhula ngo-2.6% kulonyaka, kodwa izindleko zakhula ngo-8%. Lezi zilinganiso zihluka minyaka yonke kodwa zakha okuthiwa "ukucindezela kwezindleko-nani."

Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthuka ngokulinganayo kanye nokugcina, ukongiwa, ukuvikeleka, ukuthuthukisa kanye nokwenza waziwe umlando wethu sonke, izimpawu zikazwelonke kanye namagugu. Ukuthuthukisa uhlaka lokusebenza olufanayo lwenzelwe amaBhodi ezikhungo zobuciko okusamdlalo. Ukuqinisekisa ubukhona beNingizimu Afrika ezingeni lomhlaba lobuciko kanye namasiko, futhi kuphinde kunakekeklwe izivumelwano nezwe ngalinye kanye nezamazwe onke, kanye nokushinsthwana ngubuciko namasiko okuvela ezivumelwaneni. I-Cultural Industries Growth Strategy (CIGS) yaqala ngonyaka ka-1997 ukuze iphenye futhi izame ukusebenzisa amandla emisebenzi yezandla, umculo, amafilimu kanye nomabonwakude (tv), kanye nezimboni zokwazisa ukuze zibambe iqhaza ekuthuthukeni komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuthuthukiswa kokubambisana phakathi komphakathi kanye nabazimele. Ukuthuthukisa kwezindawo zokudayisela. Izinhlelo eziqgamile zemisebenzi zezimboni ezine. Ukusetshenziswa kwesiko njengethuluzi lokuvuselela impilo yesemadolobheni. Ukusungulwa komkhandlu wezimboni zokubhala eziwuxhaxha. Ukusungulwa kwesonto lonke lezomculo wakuleli. Ukukhanda isisekelo sokuthuthukiswa kwemikhandlu yezokuhwebelana namanye amazwe ezimbonini ezithintana namasiko. Ukuxhasa inhlangano kazwelonke ebhekene nokuthuthukiswa nemisebenzi yezandla. Ukwenza ucwaningo oluhlanganisa ukushicilelwa kwencwajana yabantu abenza imisebenzi yezandla, ukwenza ucwaningo ekwakheni ubuhlalu obuyingilazi kanye nomthelela obekhona ngenxa yesonto lezomculo waseNingizimu Afrika.

Ukuze kube nezinguquko ezithile ezidingekayo, abahluleli kufanele babe nekhono lokuhlola izimo ezithile, bahlolisise izimo ezihlukene, futhi bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngesisombululo esihambisana nomthethosisekelo. Ekugcineni, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onobulungiswa. Isebenza njengesikhumbuzo sokuthi sonke sinesibopho sokuhlonipha amalungelo omunye nomunye. Ukuze le nkantolo iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise ukufinyelela kwayo, sithuthukise izinqubo zayo, futhi siqinisekise ukuthi abahluleli bayo banobuholi obuqinile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwakha umphakathi ophilayo, onobulungiswa, nolwazi oluqinile ngamalungelo abantu. Ngakho, asiqhubeke sikhuluma, sikhuthaza, futhi sithuthukise iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo, ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza njengesikhungo sokuzimela, ukuvikela amalungelo, kanye nokukhuthaza ubulungiswa emiphakathini yethu. Lokhu kudinga imizamo eminingi, kodwa uma sisebenzisana, singakha ikusasa elingcono, elinobulungiswa, nelivumelanayo.

Kuyasiza futhi ukusho ukuthi yiliphi ihhovisi elinaluphi ulwazi. Ukukhonjwa kwamlungu abantu abakhona ezweni, ukunikeza amalungelo kanye namandla athize, ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezezimali okukahle kanye nokunikeza imisebenzi yokusiza ekuphatheni. Ukulawula ukwamukelwa kwabantu bangaphandle eNingizimu Afrika, ukufika kwabo kanye nokuhamba kwabo. Ukulawula ukukhishwa kwezinto ezithile ezishicilelwe, izinto, amafilimi kanye nokokuthokozisa umphakathi. Ukurejistwa kokuzalwa, kokufa kanye nemishado. Ukukhishwa kwezitifiketi zokuzalwa, zokufa kanye nemishado. Ukukhishwa komazisi kanye nomazisi besikhashana. Ukukhishwa kwezitifiketi zobuzwe kanye nezokwamukela njengento eyimvelo. Ukuchibiyela imininingwane yomuntu uqobo kurejista yabantu abakhona ezweni. Ukukhipha izitifiketi zokuhambela amanye amazwe eziphuthumayo, amaphasiphothi esikhashana kanye namaphasiphothi. Ukukhishwa kwamaviza, izimvume zokuhlala isikhashana kanye nesikhundla sokuhlala unomphelo. Ukukhipha izimvume zokufuna abantu abacashile kanye nezababaleke emazweni abo ukuthi bezocasha kwamanye amazwe. Ukubhekelwa kwendlela yokulawula ukuhamba kanye nokuhambela kwamanye amazwe okusemthethweni kanye nokungekho emthethweni. Amahhovisi ezifunda anikezela ngenhlanganisela yemisebenzi yayo yonke iminyango, kusukela emisebenzini yomphakathi ukuya ekuphathweni kokuhambela kwamanye amazwe, neminye imisebenzi okujwayeleke ukuthi ibe ngaphakathi kwemisebenzi abagunyazwe ukuyenza. La mahhovisi ezifunda aphinde ahlukaniswa futhi aba amahhovisi angaphansi kwezifunda kanye namahhovisi ezigodi lapho umphakathi ungathola khona izindaba zokuhambela kwamanye amazwe kanye nezemisebenzi kaHulumeni ye-DHA.

Isibonelo: Iqulu labantu belishisa ingqwaba yamathayi endaweni esiyiganga ukuze bathole izinsimbi ezitholakala emathayeni ngenhloso yokuyozidayisa. Umasipala wendawo uthi akakwazi ukubamba labantu noma ukunqanda lesi senzo sokushiswa kwamathayi. Umnikazi wendawo naye uthi uyehluleka ukunqanda ukushiswa kwamathayi. Faka isikhalo kuMqondisi-Jikelele nongakwazi ukulayela umnikazi womhlaba ukumisa yonke imililo, ukukhuculula umlotha wamathayi noma yinini uma kubikwa umlilo. Umqondisi-Jikelele angalayela nomasipala ukuba akhuculule ukungcola bese ekhokhisa umnikazi wendawo zonke izindleko zokwenza lokhu. Uma ungenelisiwe yizinyathelo ezithathwe ngumasipala noma umnyango wesifundazwe ofake kuwo kuqala isikhalo, nalapho kumbandanyeka khona ukunukubezeka okukhulu nokudicilelwa phansi kwemvelo, kumele ubhalele uMqondisi-Jikelele noma iNhloko yoMnyango wesifundazwe. Uma wethula isikhalo ngokunukubeza okukhulu, uMqondisi-Jikele noma Inhloko yoMnyango wesifundazwe kumele yenze uphenyo bese ilayela lowo odala umonakalo ukuba athathe izinyathelo ezifanele lungakedluli usuku olunqunyiwe. Abakwazise ngokubhaliwe ukuthi sekwenziwe konke lokhu okulayelwe yiziphathimandla. Uma bengakwenzi kusenesikhathi, ungacela inkantolo ibaphoqe. Kodwa kubalulekile ukubazisa ngezinyathelo zokubayisa enkantolo kusasele isikhathi esiyizinsuku ezingu30. Ungafaka isikhalo kuMqondisi-Jikelele noma eNhlokweni yomnyango wesifundazwe ngaphansi kwezimo eziningi eziseNgxenyeni, inqobo nje uma isikhalo sibandakanya ukunukubeza okukhulu noma ukudicilelwa phansi kwemvelo.

Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi sifuna ukuyibona yonke intuthuko Ihleliwe. Ngamanye amazwi, sifuna ukubona izindlu kanye nohlelo lonke lwentuthuko oludingwa ngabantu abazokwakhelwa lezozindlu okuhlanganisa nezinye izidingo zomphakathi. Kufanele sizanelise ngokuthi abantu bazoyithola intuthuko emikhakheni eyahlukene yempilo. Uma kwakhiwa izindlu ngaphandle kokubhekela ezinye izigaba neminye imikhakha yentuthuko, lezo zindlu angeke zibe amakhaya afudumele. Ikhaya yikhaya uma izidingo zabantu abahlezi kulo zibhekelwa. Umuntu ongakaze abuzwe ubuhlungu bokungabi nakhaya angakuthatha kancane ukubaluleka kosuku olufana nalolu lwanamhlanje. Kodwa labo kithina abalwaziyo usizi nobuhlungu bokungabi namakhaya, bazokuqonda ukubaluleka kwalolusuku ezimpilweni zabantu bakithi lapha eSimahla namuhla. Mphathi Wohlelo, izindawo zasemakhaya yizindawo ezisondelene kakhulu nenhliziyo yami. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi ngiyaphikisana kakhulu nokuhlinzekwa kwezinhlelo zentuthuko ngendlela eshiya imiphakathi yakithi emakhaya nasemalokishini ngaphandle nokwakwenziwa nguHulumeni wobandlululo. Selokhu sanikezwa lomsebenzi, wokuphatha uMnyango wezeZindlu, oHulumeni baseKhaya neziNdaba zeNdabuko intuthuko ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zasemakhaya siyayiletha ngokushesha. Sifuna izingane zethu zibe nekusasa eliqhakazile. Uma ubuka ikusasa labantwana kwezemfundo, abantwana abakhuliswe emakhaya akheke kahle anezidingongqangi ezinjengamanzi nogesi, bathola imiphumela emihle esikoleni. Lokhu akwenziwa ukuhlakanipha nje kuphela, kodwa yingoba bephila kangcono. Izingane zethu lapha emakhaya ziyaphazamiseka kakhulu zingakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi yesikole ebusuku ngenxa yokuntula ugesi nezinye izidingongqangi.

Lokhu kuhlangana nokuthuthukiswa kwezimpilo zabantu, ukunciphisa izinga lobugebengu, ukufundisa abantu ukufunda nokubhala, nokuvula amathuba okufunda nezindlela zamasiko... sithi kuzo zonke iziqhawe zethu nezifazane ezithobekile ezazinikele ekufezeni inkululeko, kanye nawe bangane bethu abavela kwamanye amazwe, ngeke sikhokhele ithemba elibekwe kithi ngenkathi nisekela ukusiguqula iNingizimu Afrika ibe yintando yeningi, umhlaba wokuthula, lapho kungabikho ukuhlukaniswa ngokobuhlanga, noma ngohlobo, umhlaba ophumelelayo, ozinikele ezithakazelweni zokuhlanganiswa kwabantu. "Umsebenzi wokwakha le Ningizimu Afrika uqale. Lo msebenzi uzoqhubeka kulesi sikhathi sesibili sokukhululeka kwethu." Emashumini eminyaka adlule, ngenkathi silungiselela umhlangano omkhulu wabantu owawamukela i-charter yokukhululeka, izindaba eziphonsa inhliziyo zalolo suku zathi Masikhulume sonke, ama-Afrika, labo abavela eYurophu, amaNdiya kanye nabantu abamnyama, bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, masikhulume sonke ngokukhululeka, masikhulume ngenjabulo evela kubantu abaphila ezweni elikhululekile. Namuhla kufanele sibuye sithumele isithembiso sethu, kufanele sikhulume sonke ngokukhululeka, kufanele sisebenze ezikhulumweni ukuze

Izindawo Zezikhungo Zezempilo Ezingama-72: Isidingo Esibalulekile Somphakathi Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kubonakala ukuthi impilo yempilo yomphakathi ibaluleke kakhulu. Izikhungo zezempilo ziyingxenye ebalulekile yalesi simo, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni lapho kutholakala izinsiza ezinzima. Kwaze kwaba nezikhungo eziyi-72 ezisemthethweni ezweni lethu, futhi ngempela lezi zindawo zenza umehluko omkhulu empilweni yabantu abaningi. Uma sikhuluma ngezikhungo zezempilo ezingama-72, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzekwa kwezokwelapha, kodwa futhi kuyingxenye yesithunzi somphakathi. Izindawo ezinjalo zenzelwe ukuhlinzeka ngomsabalalisi wezinsizakalo, ziqinisa imiphakathi yokuvikela, futhi zisebenza njengemithombo eyisisekelo yokufundisa abantu ngempilo yabo. Ngokuvamile, izikhungo zezempilo zinekhamphani yokuhlanganyela phakathi kwabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Lokhu kuhlangana kuholela ekubeni kwenziwe izinqumo ezihlakaniphile nezinzuzo ezithinta izifundo eziphathelene nezempilo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, lezi zikhungo zikhuthaza abantu ukuba babambe iqhaza ekwakheni imibono ethokozisayo mayelana nezigameko zezempilo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kwavela izinselelo eziningi. Imishini yokusebenza ibalulekile, kodwa izinsiza ezingama-72 azikaze zibe nenkinga yokufinyelela. Ngalesi sikhathi, kubalulekile ukuthi izikhungo zisebenze ngokubambisana nezimboni zendawo ukuze ziqinise ukufinyelela kwezempilo. Lokhu kungenza kube nokuthula emiphakathini nasezindaweni ezithintekayo ngezindawo ezingama-72. Ngaphandle kokuthi izikhungo zezempilo zisetshenziswe kanjani, abasebenzi bezempilo nabo banendima ephawulekayo.

Khumbula ukwenza ukuthi inkampani yakho ifakwe ohlwini lenqolobane yemininingwane Yeboifunda ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uthole izimemo. Ukuqhubekisa ukuthengisa yimisebenzi Yeboikhathi esincane ehlose ukugqugquzela uthando emkhiqizweni nakubhizinisi lakho. Kungenzeka ukuba uthathe izinqumo sokunikeza ukuphungulelwa noma izipho ezifana nohanbo olungakhokhelwa, ibhodlela lewayini. Ukwehliswa kwezintengo, ukungenela imincintiswano, 'okubili ngentengo yokukodwa' ngenye yezibonelo zemisebenzi yokuqhubekisa ukuthengisa. Kusemqoka kakhulu ukuthi ukwazi ukuthengisa ibhizinisi lakho. Ezokuvakasha ziyibhizinisi eliphathelene nabantu futhi udinga ukuba yingxenye yebhizinisi lakho ebonakalayo. Imisebenzi yokumaketha eqondile ifaka ukuthathwa kwezithombe zeposi, ukuthengiswa kocingo kanye/noma uthengisa ungena umuzi ngomuzana. Kuzomele uthole uhlu lwalabo abangaba ngamakhasimende. Ukuthola lolu luhlu lokuposa kungabiza kubhizinisi eqalisayo. Ukumaketha ngqo kufaka futhi namapheshana okwazisa angakwazi ukuhanjiswa ngesandla, ngeposi noma afakwe kumaphephabhuku noma amaphephandaba endawo. Amapheshana okwazisa ayindlela esizayo yokudlulisela umalayezo wakho kulabo abangaba ngamakhasimende. Yenza ukuthi kube lula ukuthi amakhasimende axhumane nawe. Amakhadi ebhizinisi awabizi kakhulu ukuwakhiqiza futhi ayithuluzi elishibhile ukulikhiqiza futhi ayithuluzi lokumaketha elisebenzayo ngoba amakhasimende awanikeza nabangane babo, umndeni nalabo abasebenza nabo.

Umthetho wezintela zempahla kaMasipala lziphi izindawo ezibalulekile ezidinga ukuhlanganyela komphakathi? Yenzani lomsebenzi ngamaqoqwana angu 4 noma 5. Cela amaqoqo enze uhla lwezindlela umphakathi ongahlanganyela ngazo ezindabeni zikaHulumeni waseKhaya. Tshela iqembu ukuthi lesi cishe isona sahluko esibaluleke kakhulu kulomqulu wokuqeqesha. Yenza umsebenzi kuqala ukuze ukhombe lapho izindawo zabo eziyinkinga zikhona. Benze basebenze ngamaqoqo o 4 noma 5. Bakhombe lsijobelelo 7 - batshengise ukuthi imikhawulo yezinkomba kumele ifakeni. Bakhombe lsijobelelo 2 - betshengise ukuthi indlela yokuziphatha kumele ifakeni. Tshela iqembu ukuthi ihhovisi labo'lika~dmlomo'kumele likwazi ukubahlinzeka ngenkomba yokuthi bangawathola kuphi amakhophi omthetho okhishiwe oqondene nokumele bawazi. Komidi lesigceme - bheka 6. Khansela lesigceme - bheka 6. Amalungu ekomidi lesigceme - bheka 6.4 esahlukweni. IikaSomlomo yayiyini kuloluhlelo Unombolo 7.3 esahlukweni ukhuluma ngokhetho lwamalungu ekomidi lesigceme - chaza kafushane ukuthi ikhansela lesigceme noSomlomo kumele benzeni kuloluhlelo lokukhethwa kwamalungu ekomidi lesigceme? Khumbuza iqembu ukuthi isijobelelo 6 singabanika ulwazi olufingqiwe ngokhetho nezinqubo zokuvota. Kuyini ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla? Ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla noma ukusekela amalungu ukuze akwazi ukusebenzisa amandla awo, enze umsebenzi wawo futhi adlale izindima zawo. Kungani sidinga ukuthuthukisa amandla? Yenza umsebenzi ngamaqoqo o 4 noma 5. Bakhombe kunombolo 5 wesahluko - kafushane nie thinta amaphuzu anohlamvu.

Izindiza: Ukukhula Kwezokuhamba Ngemoya eNingizimu Afrika Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izindiza zibe yindlela ebalulekile yokuhamba, ikakhulukazi eNingizimu Afrika. Lezi zindiza zidlala indima enkulu ekuxhumaneni kwabantu, ezomnotho, nakwezokuthutha. Ukuze sithole umqondo ocacile ngalokhu, sizobheka izici ezihlukahlukene ezihambisana nezindiza, ukuqala ngokukhula kwemakethe, izinkampani ezihamba phambili, kanye nezinguquko ezithinta abahambi. Ukukhula Kwezindiza eNingizimu Afrika Ngokwezibalo ezikhishwe yiSikhungo Sokucwaninga Ngemoya, imakethe yezindiza eNingizimu Afrika ibonisa ukukhula okuqhubekayo. Lokhu kukhula kubangelwa izizathu eziningi, kuhlanganise nokwanda kwabantu abavakasha, ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza zokuhamba, kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izikhumulo zezindiza. Ngokweqiniso, izikhumulo zezindiza ezifana neO.R. Tambo International Airport eGoli, zikhula zibe yizikhungo ezibalulekile zokuhamba, zikhokhela ekwenzeni kube lula ukuhamba phakathi kwamazwe. Izinkampani Zokuhamba Ngemoya Izinkampani ezihamba phambili ezifana neSouth African Airways, kulandela iBritish Airways neKulula.com, zikhona ukuletha izinsizakalo ezihamba phambili kubahambi. Lezi zinkampani ziqinisekisa ukuthi abahambi bathola izinsizakalo ezinhle, okukhona phakathi kwazo izikhumbuzo ezithokozisayo, izikhumbuzo zokuhamba, kanye nezinsizakalo eziphezulu. Izinkampani zikhuthaza umkhankaso wokuhamba ophumelelayo, zifaka izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zabo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuphepha nokwaneliseka kwabathengi. Izinguquko Ezinzima Naphezu kokukhula, umkhakha wezindiza ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile.

Uma imali elungiselwe leso simo ingedluliswa zingakapheli izinsuku ezingama-60 ngemuva kokungena kulezo zindleko, izindleko lezo ziba ngezingagunyaziwe. d Noma iliphi ilunga noma isikhulu soMkhandlu ogunyaza izindleko ezingafanele noma noma eziiyncithakalo noma ngokunganakeleli unesibopho sokukhokha lezo ndleko. a kuyizindleko ezingagunyaziwe , i zigunyazwa uma selukungiswa isabelo; noma ii ziqinisekiswa uMkhandlu, ngemuva kuphenyo olwenziwe yikomiti loMkhandlu njengenakubuyiseleka nokufanele isulwe emabhukwini nguMkhandlu; futhi b kuyizindleko ezingafanele nezingenazithelo noma eziyincithakalo, ngemuva kophenyo yikomiti loMkhandlu, eqinisekiswe yikomiti loMkhandlu njengezingenakubuyiseleka zisulwe emabhukwin inguMkhandlu. Uma uNobhala enolwazi lokuthi uMkhandlu, usihlalo noma ikomiti eliphethe, uthathe isinqumo okuzothi uma sisebenza sibe nomphumela wezindleko ezingagunyaziwe, ezingalungile, ezingenazithelo neziyincithakalo, uNobhala angeke abobephezeleka ngezindleko ezingagunyaziwe, ezingalungile, noma ezingenazithelo noma ezyincithakalo, iqobo nje uma uNobhala ezise uMkhandlu, usihlalo noma ikomiti eliphethe ukuthi lezi zindleko ngezingagunyaziwe, ezingalungile noma ezingenazithelo nezyincithakalo. i ukubuyisa noma ukulungisa lezo zindleko; kanye ii nokuvimbela ukungena ezindlekweni ezifana nalezi futhi.

o lzidingo zengqondo - yenza iqembu likunike izibonelo ezimbalwa. Amagugu angafani - yenza iqembu likunike izibonelo ezimbalwa. Yikuphi okwenziwayo nokungenziwa uma kubhekwana nodweshu? Bese utshela iqembu ukuthi udweshu alulubi njalo. Batshele ukuthi ngesinye isikhathi luyakha. Bese ukhomba emaphuzwini anohlamvu ekupheleni kukanombolo 2 anohlu lokuthi udweshu lakha nini futhi luhliphiza nini. Khuluma ngamakhono okuxazulula udweshu. lsho ukuthi amakomidi ezigceme amele izinhlobo eziningi zamaqembu nokuthi kungeke kwagwemeka ukuthi kuzoke kube nodweshu. Khumbuza iqembu ukuthi udweshu akumele luhliphize njalo nokuthi zikhona izindlela lapho udweshu lungakhushulwa noma luncishiswe. Bheka lezizindlela ezihlukene njengoba zibekwe kunombolo 3 wesahluko. Tshela abaqeqeshwayo ukuthi abasebenze ngababili, bese benza umsebenzi osekugcineni kukanombolo 4.6. Bese ubatshela ukuthi ababheke kunombolo 4 - izindlela ezihlukene ezingasetshenziswa uma kubhekwana nodweshu, babone ukuthi bangabantu abaniani, kungaba ushaka, intshe, upopayi, ujakalase noma isikhova. Tshela amaqoqo ukuthi omunye nomunye akasebenze nalowophathini akade esebenza naye, benze umsebenzi wokuxoxisana osekugcineni kwesahluko. Kafushane nje yenza izinyathelo zokuxoxisana njengoba zihlelwe ngaphansi kukanombolo wesahluko. Ukuqala ukwazi ukufunda nokubhala. Yenza isingeniso sesihloko sokuqala ukufunda nokubhala. Qoqa lsingeniso ekuqaleni kwesahluko. ABET - Uqeqesho lwemfundo oluyisidingo lwabantu abadala itemu esilisebenzisa uma sikhuluma ngamazinga okufunda nokubhala kwabantu abadala eMzansi neAfrica.

Uma umholo ophelele womsebenzi noma inani elifanayo ngonyaka lingaphansi kwe-R2,000, aludluli inani okumele lukhishwe ukuze kube nezinye izinkokhelo. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ifomu le-IT3 kufanele likhishwe, kusekelwe enanini eliphelele elikhokhiwe lapho izinkokhelo zentela zingakhishwanga. Noma iyiphi inkokhelo eyenziwe kumuntu wokuhlinzeka ngesevisi ethile, noma okumele yenziwe, lapho izinkokhelo zentela zingakhishwanga. Izinkokhelo zezinye izinsizakalo zivame ukutholakala emsebenzini wobungcweti, njengodokotela, abameli, abavakashi, ababhali bezincwadi, nabahloli bezimali. Umholo noma inani elifanayo elingadluli kwe-R2,000 emnyakeni wentela. Inkokhelo eyenziwe ngelungelo lokusebenzisa impahla, izinkokhelo zezinye izinto ezakhiwe esikhathini esedlule ezifana nokubhaliswa kwezimali nezinye, noma izinkokhelo zokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani, ukwakhiwa, amalungelo emikhiqizo, amalungelo okwakha imibhalo noma ulwazi, noma yokudlulisela ulwazi oluhambisana nokusebenzisa amalungelo obuhlakani bezinto ezithile ezakhiwe. Incazelo ye-uniti noma impahla yezezimali ingumkhiqizo wezinto noma impahla edliwayo, inani liyisilinganiso seziqu ezidliwayo, inani eliphelele elitholwe kulezi zimpahla ezidliwayo yinzuzo ngemuva kokukhishwa kwezindleko ezifanele noma ukulahleka okuhambisana nalezi zimpahla ezidliwayo. Zonke izitshalo zezimboni, izinkuni, izinkomo, insimbi ehlanganiswe nezinsimbi, imayini, kanye nezinsimbi ezingezona ezibalulekile ezitholwe ngawe ngokuthenga noma ukushintshanisa ngezimpahla.

Imininingwane yokuthinta wonke umsebenzi wolwazi kanye nephini lomsebenzi wolwazi wayo yonke inhlangano yomphakathi. Ulwazi lokuthi usifaka kanjani isicelo sokuthola amarekhodi ezinhlangano zomphakathi nezizimele. Usizo olutholakalayo kumsebenzi wolwazi lwenhlangano yomphakathi ngokomthetho. Okokulungisa okusemthethweni okutholakalayo uma inhlangano yomphakathi noma ezimele yehluleka ukuhambisa ngokwalo Mthetho, kubandakanya ukuthi usifaka kanjani isikhalo sangaphakathi nokufaka isicelo enkantolo (okuyinto yokugcina uma uzama ukusebenzisa noma yimaphi amalungelo ashiwo eMthethweni). Ulwazi lokuthi izikhungo zomphakathi nezizimele ziwahlanganisa kanjani amabhukwana, nokuthi abacela ulwazi bawathola kanjani amarekhodi, kanjalo nasekudaluleni izinhlobo ezithile zamarekhodi ngokuzithandela. Incazelo yezimiso ezenziwe ngokomthetho. Leli bhukwana lokuqondisa lizofakwa ulwazi olusha futhi liphinde lishicilelwe njalo eminyakeni emibili. Imitapo yezincwadi ekhethiwe kusifundazwe ngasinye, ezibekwe "njengezindawo zokufaka ezisemthethweni", ngokoMthetho Wokufaka Osemthethweni (Umthetho Weno. 54 ka-1997). Zonke izikhungo zezemfundo ephakeme ezenziwe ngokusemthethweni. Wonke amahhovisi enhlangano yomphakathi, kubandakanya onke amahhovisi omantshi kanye nawo wonke amaHhovisi oMnyango Wezobulungiswa Nokwenziwa komthethosisekelo. Kufanele futhi litholakale emahhovisi e-SAHRC kanye nakuwebhsayithi ye-SAHRC ku- http://www.sahrc.org.za. Ukwengeza, iyoshicilelwa futhi kuGazethi kaHulumeni. Lingabhekwa mahhala kulezi zikhungo ezingenhla, yize-ke izindleko zokwenza amakhophi zingakhokhwa.

Ikomidi lePhalamende libheka ukuthi izigaba zilandela lokho okukhulunywe. e Kumele anikeze uMholi weMpi imiyalelo eningiliziwe edingekayo ukuze akwazi ukuhlela amalungu emisebenzi efanele kanye namandla okwenza imisebenzi ethile eyabelwe yena nguMsecretary Wezokuvikela njengomholi kanye nomphathi wezezimali kwiMnyango Wezokuvikela. f Kumele aqinisekise ukuhambisana nemithetho ethunyelwe nguNgqongqoshe edluliselwa kuMholi weMpi ophinde athumele umbiko ngalesi kuNgqongqoshe; g Uthwala umthwalo wokuhola izinqubo zokuziphatha nokuphathwa kwezisebenzi, kuhlanganise nokusetshenziswa kwazo kahle nokuqeqeshwa. Leli thuba lokudlulisa noma ukudlulisa amandla njengoba kuchazwe esahlukweni 1 alivimbele uMsecretary Wezokuvikela ekuphatheni izindaba zakhe. Noma ukuphatha noma ukwenza kube ukuphathwe ngokuhambisana nomthetho; noma d Ukwenza uphenyo olwamukelekayo futhi ngemithetho engalandelwa. ekupheleni kwezivumelwano zokuqashwa; noma iii khululwa kwezinye izindlela kwiMpi ngokuhambisana noMthetho; b Akukho siqinisekiso seMpi esingaba namalungu akhona asebenza okwesikhashana ngaphansi kwezivumelwano ngaphandle kokuthi umsebenzi wabo uphumelele emthethweni. i kunoma yisiphi umsebenzi; ii neMpi Esebenzayo noma iMpi Yesikhumbuzo noma kokubili; b UMholi weMpi angasungula umkhakha wesikhashana, iqembu, isigaba noma iyunithi njengoba kudingeka yiMpi, futhi izisekelo zesikhashana zingasungulwa njengoba kudingeka ukuhlangabezana nezidingo ezikhona. UMholi weMpi kufanele abe ngum citizen futhi abe ilungu leMpi Esebenzayo.

Unemishayo emihle kanye ne-workshop. Amandla - Unendawo (amasimu), unemishini, unabasebenzi ababili, futhi unolwazi lweminyaka eminingi kwezolimo. Amandla - Ulimi ngezitshalo ezihlanganisiwe ezahlukene: maize, soybeans, izinkomo, nezinkomo. Ungumkhiqizi ozinikele onolwazi oluneminyaka eminingi. Unemishini yokulima eyanele, futhi unemisindo emihle kanye ne-workshop esebenza kahle. Unolwazi ngolimo futhi uyazi ukuthi wenza ini futhi uyakuqonda ukuthi kungani enza imisebenzi ethile. Usebenzisa ulwazi lwabo abahlinzeka ngempahla zokulima - imbewu, amafutha, nezinto zokwakha. Ubuthakathaka - Lo muntu usuwaphulile wonke ubuthakathaka, ulima ngendlela elethe inzuzo manje nangesikhathi esizayo. Iziphakamiso - Lo mkhiqizi wenza konke kahle futhi ufika lapho abakhiqizi bezomnotho bekhona. Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle ngolimo nolwazi oluhle ngolimo. Unamasimu amahle (umhlaba) asetshenziswa kahle futhi unemishini eyanele nemishini. Iziphakamiso - Qhubeka nalo msebenzi omuhle! Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle, umhlabathi onokuthola, imvula enhle, nemishini eyanele nemishini enempilo. Ubuthakathaka - Ukuphathwa kwezitshalo kufanele kuqashelwe - ikakhulukazi kweekgras. Ukumaketha kwakhe kungaba ngcono. Iziphakamiso - Qhubeka nokwandisa amandla emishini njengoba amasimu ekhula. Phenya ukuze uthole amasimu okuphonsa. Amandla - Unolwazi oluhle ngomsebenzi wakhe. Iziphakamiso - Kumele abambe iqhaza ezinsukwini zomkhiqizi nasemahhovisi ukuze athole ulwazi ngezindlela ezintsha ezinhle. Amandla - ungumuntu omkhulu - unamaqhawe amakhulu - izinyathelo ezilandelwayo.

Imiphumela Yezivivinyo: Ukuhlola, Ukuhlaziya, Nokuhlola Ukuphumelela Ngonyaka wesikole, imiphumela yezivivinyo ibalulekile kakhulu ezimpilweni zabafundi, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Lokhu kuhlola akugcini nje ngokubona ukuthi abafundi baphumelele noma baphumelele kanjani, kodwa futhi kuyisikhumbuzo sokuthi imizamo, ukuzikhandla, nokuzinikela kwabo kudinga ukuhlonishwa. Ukuhlola Imiphumela Lapho imiphumela yezivivinyo ikhishwa, izigaba ezahlukene zikhombisa izinga lokufunda kwabafundi. Abafundi abaphumelelayo bahlonishwa, futhi imiphumela yabo ibonisa ukuthi imizamo yabo ibiyaphumelela. Kodwa-ke, akufanele sikhohlwe nabasebenzi abahlinzeka ngalezi zifundo, abahola abafundi babo ezindleleni ezinzima zokufunda. Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi izifundo zidinga ukwenziwa ngendlela efanele ukuze kuzuze bonke abafundi. Izifundo Ezitholakele Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi imiphumela yezivivinyo ayikhombisi kuphela ukuphumelela, kodwa futhi ibonisa izifundo ezitholakele. Abafundi badinga ukuqonda ukuthi ukuphumelela akukhona kuphela ekutholeni amamaki aphezulu, kodwa futhi ekutholeni ulwazi oluqinile nolwaziyo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abafundi kufanele bakhuthazwe ukuthi bangabheki nje kumamaki, kodwa baphinde baqonde kahle izifundo abahlangabezana nazo. Lokhu kuzobasiza ekwakheni isisekelo esiqinile sokufunda okwandayo. Ukusebenza Kwezemfundo Imiphumela yezivivinyo ibonisa ukuthi izikole zidinga ukucabanga ngempela ngempumelelo yokufundisa. Izikole ezithola imiphumela emihle zihlala zikhuthaza abafundi, zifaka izindlela ezintsha zokufundisa, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabafundi, othisha, kanye nabazali.

Lokhu kudala imikhuba emihle, lapho izingane zifunda khona ukubaluleka kokupheka, kanye nezindlela zokuphila eziphilile. Ukupheka ndawonye kungaba yindlela yokwakha imikhuba emihle, futhi kudala izinkumbulo ezinhle. Izinselelo Zokupheka Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukupheka kungaba yinselelo enkulu, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinamazinga aphakeme okuphila. Abantu abaningi bahlushwa yisikhathi esincane, futhi ukupheka kudinga isikhathi, okungaholela ekutheni bakhethe ukudla okusheshayo, okungase kube nezithako ezingezinhle. Lokhu kudala umjikelezo ongemuhle, lapho abantu bephuma bephuza ukudla okungafanele, okungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangase babe nekhono elincane lokupheka, okwenza kube nzima ukuzenzela ukudla. Lokhu kungaholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe bephoxekile, futhi bakhethe ukudla okuthengwayo, okungase kube nezithako ezimbi. Ukuze sithuthukise ukupheka, kubalulekile ukufundisa abantu, ikakhulukazi izingane, izindlela zokupheka ezilula nezisebenzayo. Izindlela Zokwenza Ukupheka Kube Lula Ukuze sithuthukise ukupheka, kudingeka sithathe izinyathelo ezithile. Okokuqala, singasebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengezinhlelo zokupheka eziku-inthanethi, ezisiza abantu ukuba bafunde izindlela ezilula zokupheka. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abasha, futhi kubavumele ukuba bakhe izinkumbulo ezinhle zomndeni. Okwesibili, singasebenzisa izithako ezilula nezitholakalayo. Ukupheka akudingi ukuba kube nzima; singakha izidlo ezimnandi neziphilile ngama-ingredients ambalwa. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula kubantu abahlushwa yisikhathi, futhi kubavumele ukuba bakhe ukudla okunempilo.

Ngokubheka izinhlelo ezithile, sinesibonelo esihle sephrojekthi ye-‘Solar Water Heater’ ehlanganisa izindlu eziningi, esize abantu banciphise izindleko zokushisa amanzi. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekongeni imali, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza umqondo wokuzimela. Uma abantu bekwazi ukwenza izinto zabo, bayakwazi ukwakha umphakathi ozimele. Nokho, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene namaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo, njengezindleko zokuqala eziphakeme, okwenza kube nzima kumabhizinisi amancane. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi uhulumeni nabaxhasi benze izinhlelo zokuxhasa ukuze zikwazi ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungabi nalwazi olufanele kubantu abaningi eNyakatho Kapa kungaba yinkinga. Abantu badinga ukuqonda kabanzi ngalezi zinhlelo ukuze bakwazi ukuzisebenzisa. Izinhlelo zokufundisa zingasiza ekwandiseni ulwazi, okuzobasiza ukuba babe yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esisha. Kubalulekile futhi ukuthi amaphrojekthi ahlangane nezidingo zomphakathi, okukhombisa ukubambisana phakathi kwabantu bendawo, abahlinzeki, kanye nohulumeni. Ukuze amaphrojekthi aphumelele, kudingeka ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuze bonke abathintekayo bazi ukuthi izidingo zabo ziyaqondwa. Ngibona ikusasa elikhanyayo eNyakatho Kapa, lapho amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo azoba yisisekelo sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi onobuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuzoholela ekwandeni komnotho, ekunciphiseni umthelela emvelweni, nasekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo. Umphakathi onamandla ungakha izixazululo ezinzima ezibhekene nezinkinga zethu. Ngakho-ke, ngiyabiza bonke abathintekayo, kuhlanganise nohulumeni, amabhizinisi, kanye nabantu bendawo, ukuba baphokophele ekwakheni amaphrojekthi wamandla avuselelekayo.

Izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zikhokha izindleko zomlamuli uma zikhona. Le yindlela lapho okudingeka khona umuntu wesithathu, umlamuli/umuntu oletha uxolo, ukusiza izinhlangothi ezithintekayo ukuthi zisombulule izinkinga zazo. Ingachazwa njengokuxoxisana okusizanwayo kukho. Kuyancomeka ukuthi ukulethwa kwenkinga phambi komlamuli yizinhlangothi ezithintekayo kube ngokungaphoqiwe, kodwa ngokomthetho, isiko noma isivumelwano kungadingeka ukuthi izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zihambise inkinga yazo kumlamuli. Kuyancomeka ukuthi umlamuli kube umuntu omukelekile kuzo zombili izinhlangothi ezithintekayo, umuntu ongahlangene nganoma ngayiphi indlela nanoma yiluphi uhlangothi oluthintekayo noma nenkinga. Umlamuli kumele angathathi amacala. Umlamuli akazithatheli izinhlangothi ezithintekayo izinqumo. Umsebenzi womlamuli ukusiza izinhlangothi ezithintekayo ukuthi zizisombululele inkinga yazo ngokwazo. Umlamuli kumele alwele ukuthi zombili izinhlangothi ezithintekayo ziyanqoba ukuze lungabi bikho uhlangothi olugcina luhluliwe. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu uma izinhlangothi ezithintekayo zinobudlelwano obuqhubekayo ngoba ubuhlungu obungazwiwa yilolo hlangothi oluhluliwe bungenza ukuthi bungabibikho ubudlelwano obuhle. Awukho umthetho olawula ukulamula kodwa izinhlobo ezithile zokulamula sekuya ngokuya zihlinzekwa umthetho, isibonelo izinxushunxushu zabasebenzi zihlinzekwa umThetho owengamele ezabaSebenzi bese kuthi izinxushunxushu zezindawo phakathi kwezinhlaka zombuso zihlinzekwe umThetho wezokuPhathwa kweziNdawo we-1998. Uma ungekho umthetho othile oqondene, inqubo kanye nokukhethwa komlamuli kuba sezandleni zezinhlangothi ezithintekayo.

Singaqhubeka nokusho ukuthi namhlanje kungcono kunayizolo, futhi nakusasa kuzoba ngcono kunamhlanje. Manje ngokuphathelene nama-AIN reaction unit ingabe angasatshalaliswe kunqenqema olungaphandle locingo lokubiya? Kubikwa ukuthi usesimweni esizinzile futhi undize wayiswa e-Nairobi ukuze ayolashwa. Uphume umngozimu wase ewuvala nge-tissue ngaphakathi kwamakhala. UTom Thabane uthe noma iqembu lakhe lizophonsela inselele imiphumela enkantolo, uzoyamukela imiphumela yokhetho. Abashayeli bayacelwa ukuthi babe nokubekezela futhi bacophelele ngokweqile uma beshayela kule ndawo. Emasontweni amabili nje adlule, iNingizimu Afrika iqede neMali ingxenye yemiqulu yokulonda imibhalo yasendulo yaseTimbuktu. Eminyakeni eyishumi edlule eNingizimu Afrika sekuye kukhula ukubaluleka kwezikhulu ezibhekelela ukuvivinywa. Imininingo eqoqiwe ingabhekwa ngohlelo olubheka kanye, noma ngemikhakha emithathu kusetshenziswa ukubheka ngezindlela eziningi ezahlukene. Njalo ngonyaka, kubekwa isonto lwekhalenda lezempilo lokuqwashisa ngemigomo. Okwesibili, abesifazane - ngiqonde ukuthi abesilisa, ngokuthukuthela, ngokukhathazeka, ngenzondo, basebenzisa imizimba yabantu besifazane kanye nezingane njengesizinda sawo zokuzabalaza, njengendawo yabo yokulwa impi. Ukuze kwenziwe kangcono ikhwalithi kanye nokusetshenziswa ngendlela efanele kwamakhemisi ngemigomo yamaphilisi ehlanganisiwe kazwelonke. Amasela eba ithusi awuvanzi emphakathini asusa uhlelo lonke lwamapayipi amanzi emizini. Lokhu kuyiqiniso ngoba udokotela uchazile ukuthi yibaphi abasebenzi nokuthi mangaki ama-ambulensi anawo.

Ngokwengeziwe, okufundwayo ku-inthanethi kudinga ukuzikhandla kakhulu. Abafundi banikwe ithuba lokuphendukela emithonjeni engcono ukuzibonela. Lokhu kubavumela ukuba bakhuphule izinga labo lokufunda ngoba bangakhetha lokho abakuthandayo. Njengoba abafundi besebenzisa imeyili, izinkundla zokuxhumana, nemicimbi yeziqu, bangafunda babe nezifundo ezikhethekile kalula, bheka uhlelo lwabo futhi bathole izimpendulo ezithile. Izinkinga Ezingavela Ngokufunda Ngemfundo Ye-Inthanethi Noma kunjalo, ukufunda nge-inthanethi kunezinselelo zayo. Enye yezi zinkinga ezidumile ukuthi abafundi bangenza ukungasebenzi kahle njengoba bekhuthazwa ukwazi ukusebenza ngebhodi yokuxhumana. Ukungabi khona komphakathi wesikole, okuyikhulu elikhulu, kungabanga khona ukuthi abanye abafundi bazizwe begqokile kakhulu. Ukusetshenziswa koshintsho lwezinhlelo zokusebenza nazokuxhumana kungenza kube nzima bacacise imiqondo ethile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imithunzi yamakhono ephezulu iyadingeka ukuze ufunde kahle kulezi zimo. Abafundi badinga amandla okuphatha isikhathi, ukugxila, nokuphendula imibuzo ezothusayo ukuze baphumelele. Lokhu kudinga ukuzimisela cishe okungaphezulu kunokufunda okwenzeka endaweni yebhodi. Ukwengeza: Izingxenye Zokwenza Imfundo Ye-Inthanethi Ikhule Ukuze uthole impendulo efanele kulokhu, kubalulekile ukuthi abafundi bakhuthazwe ukuba badlule imikhawulo, bakhulise amazinga abantu abahlinzeki, futhi benze izivumelwano ezihambelana nezinhloso. Ukuze kube nezifundo eziphumelelayo, kuhloko ezimeni ezikhethekile, kuyasiza ukuhlela izinhlelo ezinqunyiweyo, kugcizelelwe abaphathi bezemfundo. Uhlaka olusebenza kahle kumele luhlanganise zokugcina uhlanga lwezimo ezahlukene nabafundi.

ukucela usizo lwenu nokuzimbandakanya kanye nokwehhovisi lakho elikhulu ekudluliseni kahle imiyalezo ebalulekile ngemfuluwenza i-A (H1N1)2009 ebhizinisini lakho kanye nasemphakathini owusebenzelayo. Igama elisemthethweni lesayensi lalesi sifo yi-Pandemic Influenza A (H1N1) 2009. Yaqala eMexico nase-United States of America ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka. Ekuqaleni yayaziwa njengomkhuhlane wezingulube (i-swine flue) ngenxa yokuthi kwabe kucatshangelwa ukuthi yaqala ngezingulube. Manje sekuyaqondwa ukuthi umsuka wayo uvela kubantu nakuzinyoni. Ngakho-ke, lokhu kufa akunalutho yokwenza nokudliwa kwengulube noma imikhiqizo yengulube. Manje sekubizwa nje kalula njengemfluwenza engubhubhane noma ibizwe ngegama layo elisemthethweni i-A (H1N1) 2009. Kusukela ngo-Ephreli kulo nyaka, le vayirasi isisabalele ngokushesha kumazwe ayi-166. E-Afrika, kuze kube manje le vayirasi isisabalalele emazweni ayi-16 kuphela. Ngalesi sikhathi sokubhala le ncwadi, le vayirasi isisulele abantu abayi-177 457 (abaqinisekiswe yizindlu zokuqhuba ucwaningo lwesayensi) emhlabeni wonke, phakathi kwabo osekufe abayi-1 457 abaqinisekisiwe. ENingizimu Afrika kuze kube yimanje, sesiqinisekise izimo eziyi-2 844 osekufe kuzo abantu abayisithupha.

Suraya Naidoo weza ukuzongazisa ngenhloso eyinhloko yalolu hlelo futhi wakhombisa isifiso sokuthi ngibe yingxenye yalo njengoba sengiyisazi sokudla. Njengengxenye yomsebenzi wami, kufanele ngikwazi ukusiza labo abadinga ukudla nokusiza imindeni ekulweni nendlala ekhaya. Ngemuva kwalokho, njengengxenye yalolu hlelo, saqala uhlelo kulesi sikhungo ngoJulayi walonyaka, futhi ngiyena ophatha ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Abaguli engibabona bangabantu abathunyelwe kimi udokotela, um nurse, noma abanye abasebenzi bezempilo uma bebona isiguli sidinga usizo. Ngikwazile ukubona ubumpofu nokuhlupheka okukhona kulabo abahlala kule ndawo, futhi kuyadabukisa. Ngihlangane nezingane ezinomzimba ophansi ngoba kungekho ukudla ekhaya. Ngibona omama nabababa bephokophele ekuphatheni abantwana babo ababa yizintandane. Uma ngingasiza noma ngabe umuntu oyedwa, ngiyazi ukuthi ngizokwazi ukuqhubeka nalesi sikhungo. Ngiyajabula kakhulu uma ngibona othile owayengaphansi kokudla eqala ukuthola isisindo futhi ehleka ngoba uthole ukudla futhi ubeke okuthile esiswini sakhe. Yebo, kwesinye isikhathi kunzima ukubona ukuthi ubani odinga usizo ngempela nobani ongeyena. Kukhona labo abafikile nekhaya elinokudla kodwa beze bacele ukudla ngoba befuna ukuthola mahhala. Nokho, sizama konke okusemandleni ethu ukufinyelela kulabo abadinga usizo ngempela. Njengoba lolu hlelo luqhubeka, ngithemba ukuthi sizoletha usizo nempilo engcono kubaningi. Ngithanda ukuvakashela olwandle nokukhuluma nabangane bami. NJENGOBA uMnyango uzame ngazo zonke izindlela ukunciphisa ukungondleki kule ndawo, kubalulekile ukuzivikela uma uhamba, ikakhulukazi engxenyeni enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal.

Ukungabibikho Kwezihlelo Zokulawulwa Kokusetshenziswa Komhlaba (LUMS) kuthinta abantu abaningi bendawo kamasipala waseBaqulisini. Osomabhizinisi kanye nabatshalizimali abamnkatshubomvu baxakwe ukwentuleka kwemikhombandlela yokuhlela engasiza ekuthuthukiseni kanye nasekwandiseni imisebenzi ezikhungweni zasemadolobheni, ikakhulu eVryheid. I- IDP yethula imibiko mayelana nendlela enezigaba ezimbili ehlongozwayo ukwakha i-LUMS elungile, ngokuqaphela ukuthi ukusungulwa kwale nqubomgomo kwaba nesandla hlakazekeni koMkhandlu ngoLwezi wezi- 2006. I-IDP iqaphele ukuthi "I-LUMS yokugcina yasebaQulusini izoqukatha izinhlelo eziningi ezizodlondlobala ngokushesha ukuhlanganisa zonke izinhlelo, kusukela emakhaya kuya ohlelweni oluhlelwe ngobubanzi." Lena yinhlosongqangi esemqoka okumele ihlanganiswe nohlaka oluhleliwe olungaguquki. I - IDP yethula imibiko mayelana nesimo samanje ngezinqumo eziningi ezeseka ukutholakala kolwazi ngendlela yemibiko yemikhakha. Le mibiko yemikhakha iyimibhalo esemqoka okuyiyona esiza ekululekeni uMasipala, ngokuqaliswa kohlelo. Uma eminye yale mibiko ingaphelele noma ingacoshelisisiwe, ingalibazisa intuthuko. Ukuhlolwa kwe I-DP kudalula ukuthi ingxenye enkulu yezinhlelo zemikhakha (ngaphandle kwalezo ezimbandakanyeka kwi I-DP uqobo) azenele noma aziphelele. Kubalulekile ukuthi ukuphathwa kolwazi kube yimpumelelo, futhi ulwazi lwelekelele ekuqalisweni kohlelo ngendlela edidiyelwe.

I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo: Isikhungo Sokuzimela Kwamalungelo Nezibopho Zethu I-Nkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu, njengoba iyinhlangano eyinhloko eqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yethu iyahambisana nezimiso zomthethosisekelo. Le nkantolo ibhekelele ukuvikela amalungelo abantu, ukuhlinzeka ngempilo enobulungiswa, kanye nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi umthetho uyaphumelela. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqonde kahle indima yayo, izinselelo ezibhekene nayo, kanye nezindlela zokuqinisa le nkantolo ukuze iqhubeke nokusebenza kahle. Ukuqala, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ayikona nje kuphela indawo yokuxazulula izingxabano, kodwa iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi umthetho awuhambisani nezifiso zomuntu siqu, kodwa uhamba phambili ekukhulumeni ngezinhloso ezinkulu. Isebenza njengomgibeli phakathi kokuphathwa kahle kwezimali zomphakathi nokuvikela amalungelo abantu. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi ezindabeni ezithinta abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, lapho imithetho ingase ingahambisani nezidingo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi. Enye yezinselelo ezinkulu ukuthi abantu abaningi basawubona umthetho njengenhlangano ethile, hhayi njengesikhungo sokuvikela amalungelo abo. Lokhu kudala ukungaqondi kahle nokungaboni ngasolinye phakathi kwabantu nemithetho. Ukuze sithuthukise le nkantolo, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngokuqhubekayo ngezindlela zokwenza abantu baqonde kahle ukuthi iNkantolo Yomthethosisekelo iyinsika yokuvikela amalungelo abo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise ukufinyelela kwale nkantolo.

Zihlinzeka ngokuqondisa, ukwelashwa, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhasa. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okukhuluma ngempilo yengqondo. Izikhungo zezempilo zihlala ziqhuba izinhlelo zokuvikela, njengokuhlolwa kwezifo ezithathelwana, izinhlelo zokukhuthaza impilo, kanye nezinhlelo zokwelapha izifo ezithile. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu badinga ukuqonda izingozi ezihambisana nezifo ezithile, futhi izikhungo zempilo zikhona ukuze ziqinisekisa ukuthi abantu bayazi futhi bayakwazi ukuzivikela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izikhungo zezempilo zisebenza ngokubambisana nezikhungo zemfundo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba imfundo iyisisekelo sempilo. Uma sikhuluma ngempilo, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imfundo iyasiza abantu ukuba baqonde kahle izindlela zokuphila eziphilayo. Izikhungo zezempilo zikhuthaza ukufunda, zifundisa abantu ngezindlela zokuphila eziphilayo, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo. Kodwa-ke, akukhona konke okuhle. Kukhona izinselelo eziningi ezibhekene nezikhungo zezempilo. Ngokuvamile, izinsiza zihlala zincishisiwe, futhi lokhu kuhluphe abantu abaningi. Izikhungo ezincane zihlala zidinga usizo ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma izikhungo zingakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo, abantu bahlupheka. Ngakho, abantu badinga ukuxhasa izikhungo zezempilo, ukuze zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo efanele. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kufanele sikhulume ngendima yomphakathi. Umphakathi unendima enkulu ekuxhaseni izikhungo zezempilo. Uma abantu bephumelela ekuxhaseni izikhungo, izikhungo zikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Lokhu kubalulekile, ngoba uma umphakathi ubambisene, impilo iyathuthuka.

Zama ukubeka izinsuku eziyimigomo zaloku ofuna ukukufinyelela. Ngenhlanhla, uhlelo lokumaketha yinto ozoyisebenzisa njalo futhi izokukhula iguquke nebhizinisi lakho. Ngaloko ungesabisi yimizamo yakho yokuqala. Ukumisa izinhlelo zezezimali kuyethusa, kodwa kuyingxenye esemqoka kakhulu yohlelo lwakho jikelele. Ukuze ibhizinisi lakho libe nempumelelo, udinga ukwazi ukuthi uzothola imali engakanani engenayo nokuthi izindleko zakho zizoba yimalini. Ibhizinisi alikwazi ukuma esikhathini eside esizayo uma izindleko zakho zingaphezu kwemali engenayo. Esikhathini esiningi izitatimende zezimali zifaka amabhajethi okusebenza, izitatimende zokheshi ongenayo kanye namabhalansishiti alinganisiwe iminyaka ewubuncane obuyiminyaka emithathu. Wonke amabhizinisi kumele alandele imithetho kanye nemiyalo. Eminye yale mithetho kanye nemiyalo iyefana kuzo zonke izinhlobo zamabhizinisi (isibonelo ukuzibhalisela ukukhokha intela e-SARS) bese ezinye kube ngezicacile zohlobo oluthile lwebhizinisi. Isibonelo, umholi wezokuvakasha kudingeka abe nephemithi yokuthutha umphakathi kanye nebhali okumele libe nelayisensi yokuthengisa utshwala. Zama ukuthola kunhlangano efanele yemisebenzi ukuthi yini okudingekayo ukuthi uhambise ibhizinisi lakho ngemfanelo. Ukuhlaziywa kwe-SWOT kumi njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni esdlule kodwa manje kumele ibhekwe ngokuphelele (bheka isahluko sesi-5 njengesibonelo).

Ukuhlela kabusha umthetho wezwe wezemigwaqo ukuze kuqondiswe amagama futhi kuhlelwe kabusha incazelo ethile ukuze kwandiswe ulwazi olungafakwa ezinhlinzweni ezitholakala kumgomo wezwe wezemigwaqo; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lokuhlela; ukunciphisa inani lezinqubo ezidingekayo ngumthetho; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukukhetha iziphathimandla zokuhlela ezidinga ukuhlinzeka ngezinhlelo zokuhamba eziboardini ezifanele; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezokuhamba lwezwe kanye nezinhlelo ezihambisana nezokuhamba zamaphondo; ukususa izimo eziphathelene nezikhumbuzo zomphakathi zamanje; izindlela zokulawula ezisebenzayo, izinhlelo zokuhlinzeka ngemicabango ethile nezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukuhlinzeka ngohlelo olusha lwezinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlanganisiwe; ukwengeza izikhathi ezithile; ukuhlinzeka ngamacategori amasha ezimoto angasetshenziswa ezinsizeni zokuhamba zomphakathi; ukwengeza ukuhlinzekwa kwemvume yokusebenza, ukwengeza imisebenzi yeziphathimandla zokulawula ukusebenzisa izimvume; ukujula ezimotweni ezingasetshenziswa ohambweni olude; ukuhlinzeka ngoshintsho lwezimvume zokusebenza; ukuvumela uNgqongqoshe ukusetha izindinganiso zamamitha ezitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha nokuvumela amaMEC ukuthola izakhiwo zokukhokha izitaxi ezisebenzisa amamitha, ukudala izimo zokwabelana ngemvume yokusebenza kwezinsizakalo zabavakashi; ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yesikhashana yezimoto ezithile; ukudala amacala amasha; nokwenza izinguquko kumadokhumenti; ukuhlinzeka ngezindaba ezihlobene. "Ibhasi" lisho imoto eyakhelwe, noma eyakhelwe ngokomthetho ukuze ifanele, ngumkhiqizi obhalisiwe ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1989 Umthetho No. 29 ka-1989; "Umimporter" ubonisa umuntu obhalisiwe ukuze athumele ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1996 Umthetho No. 93 ka-1996; "Umkhiqizi" ubonisa umkhiqizi [umimporter noma umakhi wezimoto] obhalisiwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 5 soMthetho Wokuhamba Emgwaqweni, 1996 Umthetho No.

Ukuze ufake i-smart meter, kuzodingeka ukuthi ube ne-application, kodwa akudingeki ukuthi ukhokhe imali eningi. Futhi, uma usuyifakile, uzothola izinzuzo eziningi.” Ngemuva kokukhuluma noNandi, uSipho wanquma ukuthi kufanele azame le smart meter. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, umakhelwane wakhe, uThandi, wamsiza ukuthi afake i-smart meter. UThandi wayekwazi kahle ukuthi lezi zinsiza zisebenza kanjani, futhi wamchazela ukuthi kuzomnika ithuba lokulawula izindleko zikagesi. Ngemuva kokufaka i-smart meter, uSipho waqala ukubona umehluko. Wathola ukuthi usebenzisa ugesi omningi ngesikhathi esithile sosuku, ikakhulukazi ekuseni nasebusuku. Lokhu kwamnika ithuba lokwenza izinguquko, waphuma ezindaweni ezithile ezazidla ugesi kakhulu. Waqala ukusebenzisa izibani ezincane, waphinde wacisha imishini engasasebenzi. Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, uSipho wathola ukuthi izindleko zakhe zikagesi zinciphile. Wayejabule kakhulu, futhi wathola ukuthi le smart meter yamsiza kakhulu ekulawuleni izindleko zakhe. Waqala ukwabelana ngalesi sihloko nomphakathi wakhe, wathi: “Ningakhethi, niyazithokozisa. I-smart meter iyasiza!” Abanye abantu emzaneni babenokungabaza, kodwa uSipho waba yisibonelo esihle. Waqhubeka nokukhuthaza abanye ukuthi bafake lezi zinsiza, wathi: “Uma sithatha izinyathelo ezincane, sizokwazi ukunciphisa izindleko zethu.” Ngemuva kwesikhathi, umphakathi waseGauteng waqala ukwamukela i-smart meter. Abantu baqala ukujabulisa izindleko zabo, futhi kwavela umoya omusha wokubambisana. U-Eskom naye wathola ukuthi izindleko zawo zinciphile, njengoba abantu beqala ukukhokha izikweletu zabo ngesikhathi.

Ukulima: Umcimbi Wokuhlangana Kwezolimo Kuvulekile umcimbi ongcwele, ogqugquzelwe yizifiso zabaqalayo nabakhokhela umhlaba wezolimo, owaziwa ngokuthi iNkundla Yezolimo. Ucwaningo lwezindlela zokulima, ukuxhumana phakathi kwezizukulwane kanye nokwabelana ngolwazi, kube yizinto eziphawulekayo kulo mcimbi obungcono obubanjwe ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene. Umcimbi uqale ngokubamba umoya, lapho abezindaba bejabulisa izivakashi ngezinkanyezi ezivelele emhlabeni wezolimo. Izimakethe zomkhiqizo wezolimo, ezinjengezithako, izitshalo, nezilwane, zaba yinsika ezintsha zabakwazi ukufinyelela kumakhasimende abasha. Abalimi bavula amavolontiya namaqonga amasha okugcina nokuhlonipha imisebenzi yamanje yokulima, okwakuhlanganisa ukukhuthaza umgwaqo wokukhiqiza ompofu. Ngenkathi emaphethelweni emcimbini, izivakashi zabeziqhelisa ngempilo emhlabeni wezolimo. Ukuze kufudukele emhlabeni wempilo yolwazi, futhi uhlanganyele ngobuchwepheshe, phakathi kokukhulelwa kwezimoto, izinsiza zezimali zafakwa phakathi kwalokhu ukubhekana nobunzima bokuhlala phansi kwesikhumba seplanethi. Abasebenzi bezolimo baphinde badele ukuzwakala kokuthengisa cosekucwaningo nokukhuthaza umnyango owedlula umphakathi, okwakuhloswe ukuyolisiphakela imifino, izithelo, nemifino emisha. Abalimi bakhuluma ngempumelelo nemithwalo ethile yokulima. Izifundo ezenzakalayo, ezifana nezibalo zezimali, ukwenza kahle kwezinsiza, nakho konke okubhalwe phansi, kuxhumene nendlela yokubambisana yokugcina imiphumela. Ubulili buphawulekayo phakathi kokufunda kwezimpawu, ukwakha izindlela ezikahle zokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokulima.

Xoxa ngalokhu ekilasini noma nabangane bakho. Emazweni amaningi, kunamaqembu abantu abangakhulumi ulimi olufanayo noma abangaveli eqenjini lohlanga olufanayo noma abangakhulumi ulimi olulodwa kube iqembu elikhulu. Izingane ezivela kula maqembu amancane (angemaningi) kufanele zivunyelwe ukuthi zithokozele isiko, ukwenza inkolo yazo nokukhuluma ulimi lwazo. Izingane zinelungelo lokuphumula nelokukhululeka futhi zidlale ngezindlela ezifanele iminyaka yazo. Izingane futhi zinelungelo lokubamba iqhaza ngokukhululeka empilweni yamasiko nasebucikweni. Ohulumeni kufanele bahloniphe futhi bakhuthaze ilungelo lengane lokubamba iqhaza empilweni yesiko neyobuciko futhi kufanele baqiniseke ukuthi kunamathuba afanele nalinganayo esiko, obuciko, okudlala nawokuphumula. Yimaphi amathuba okudlala nokuphumula akhona endaweni yakini noma emphakathini noma esikoleni? Yini ongathanda ukuyenza ongeke ukwazi ukuyenza okwamanje Ezemidlalo Ubuciko Idrama Izinkondlo Umculo Mhlawumbe abanye kubazali noma kothisha esikoleni sakho bangakusiza ukuthi kube khona okuqalayo okusha? Sebenzisa amandla emiqondo yakho! Izingane zinelungelo lokuvikelwa ekuphoqelweni ukuthi zisebenzele abanye abantu ukuze zithole imali. Izingane zinelungelo lokuvikelwa ekwenzeni umsebenzi oyingozi noma ozozenza ukuthi zingayi esikoleni noma okuzolimaza izimpilo zazo noma ukukhula. Ohulumeni kufanele benze konke abangakwenza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi leli lungelo livikelwe. Lokhu kusho ukuthi kufanele babeke iminyaka ingane engaphansi kwayo okungavunyelwe ukuthi isebenze. Kufanele babeke imithetho yokuthi ingane kufanele isebenze amahora amangaki nokuthi kufanele isebenze ngaphansi kwaziphi izimo. Kufanele babajezise labo abephula le mithetho.

Imiphumela yokuhlolwa ibonise ukuthi, nakuba kunezinkinga ezithile ekuphathweni kwemali, kumasipala amaningi kube nezinqumo ezinhle ezithathwe. Kukhona amaphuzu abahloli abawafakazile, njengokungabi khona kokubhaliswa kwezimali ezithile, okukhombisa izinkinga ekuphathweni kwemali, okudingeka izinyathelo ezithile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandela kwemithetho. Ubulungiswa bokuphathwa kwemali bukhombisa ukuthi kumasipala amakhulu, ukuphathwa kwezimali kusebenza kahle, kodwa kunezikhala ezidinga ukunakwa. Abahloli bagcizelela ukubaluleka kwemfundo nokwakhiwa kwamakhono ukuze kufezwe izinjongo ezinhle zokuphathwa kwemali. Ngemuva kokuhlolwa, kwaba nezingxoxo phakathi kwabahloli nabaphathi bamabhuku, ezazifaka iziphakamiso zokuthi masipala bahlolwe njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandela kwezinhlelo. Uhlelo lokuhlola luzoba yinsika yokwakha ukwethembana phakathi komphakathi nohulumeni, futhi luzohlinzeka ngesisekelo esiqinile sokuphathwa kwemali. Abahloli baphinde baphakamise ukuthi kube nezinhlelo zokubika ezicacile, ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukufinyelela kulwazi oluhlobene nezimali zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi izinsiza zisetshenziswa kanjani, futhi kuzokwandisa ukwakhiwa kokwethembana. Umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi imiphumela yokuhlolwa izoshintsha indlela amabhuku aphathwa ngayo kumasipala. Ukuhlolwa kuzoholela ezifundweni ezithile ezizothathwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinsiza zomphakathi zisetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni izinga lempilo yomphakathi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umcimbi wokuhlolwa kwamabhuku komasipala uzoba isibonelo esihle sokuthi ukuphathwa kwezimali kungathuthukiswa kanjani.

Inxosongqangi yomthetho sivivnywa - ohlongoziwe ukusungula isigungu esizo hambisa ngomthetho iprofeshini ngokuthi yengamele/ iphathe ukukethwa kanye nokubhaliswa kwabasebenza ngolimi njengabalobi, abahleli, otolika kanye nabahleli mamagama asetshenziswa ezindaweni ezithile. Ukuqwashiswa kwabantu ngokubaluleka kwezilimi. Ungqongqoshe ngokuhlanganela nongoti bezilimi.bajuba/ baqalisa uhlelo lokuthuthukisa ababheka ukuthi amagama abhaleke ngokuyikho yini kwizilimi zesintu eziyishumi. I-Subdiractorate yajuba ukuhlolwa okwakuqhekeza umhlabathi kuqoqwa ulwazi kuzo zonke izilimi ezisemthethweni njenge-Khoe, San kanye nezilimi ze-Nama zaseNingizimu Afrika, kwenzelwa Umbiko Wamazwe Wezilimi (UNESCO) nozoshicilelwa ngo-2001. Inhloso yombiko we- UNESCO World Languages ukuchacisa ukuhlukahlukana ngokwezilimi kwamazwe kanye nokusungula kokwengamela / kokuphathwa kwamagugu ezilimi zomhlaba okufaneleyo. Ukuhlola nokubhekana neninto ezibanzi nezinhlobonhlobo eziphathelene nezilimi eziseshenziswa eNingizimu Afrika, njengolwazi lwejiyogilafu, izingxubevange kanye nezinombolo zabakhuluma ulimi.ngalunye, Ukusetshenziswa emnothweni yimiphakathi kanye nesiko lokufunda. Lolulwazi selufakiwe kwi-Database ephathelene nezilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Lengosi encane yagcina futhi yabuye yaphucula I-Database ecomprehensive ezintweni eziphathelene nezilimi eNingizimu Afrika. I-Database ifaka uhla lwezilimi kanye nomthetho ophathelene nezilimi eNingizimu Afrika, ukuhumusha, kanye nemisebenzi yokutolika/ bureaux, abasebenza ngezilimi abazimele, izizinda zokuqeqesha abahumushi, amaqembu anentshisekelo yezilimi, bonke abathintekayo kanye namakomidi ezilimi.

Phakathi kwezinto ezitholakala ezihlotshaniswa nokuhweba ngezidakamizwa bekukhona ama-akhawunti amabili ezinkampani, i-VW Polo Playa eyodwa, nezinto eziningi ezibizayo ezitholakele ezindlini. I-centre ihlinzeka ngeluleko ku-Joint Investment Scheme mayelana nokwakhiwa komkhiqizo oyisisekelo wokutshalwa kwezimali ukuze kushintshwe lokho okungahlinzekwa ngaphansi kweMthetho. Ulwazi lokukhishwa kwamanzi angaphansi komhlaba kanye namanzi angaphansi, kuhambisana nokusetshenziswa kwabo nokuhlanzwa, kunikeza umbono wezabelomali zamanzi endaweni. Okwesibili, i-Afrika idinga izinsiza ezanele ukuze ihlinzeke ngesisekelo, ukuthuthukiswa kwezimboni, nokuhlanganiswa komphakathi wonke. Izinsiza ezisetshenziselwa ukuqinisekisa ukuvunyelwa kwalokho okuphumelele, kulandela imigqa yokubuyekeza lapho ibamba iqhaza, zikhishwe emhlanganweni olandelayo. Othisha bomculo abaqeqeshiwe banikeza izifundo zomculo ezihlukahlukene ezivela emculweni wendabuko kuya emculweni wesimanje we-jazz. Izinsiza nezokufinyelela ezingeni elithile, umkhakha ongenamkhawulo kukahulumeni wamukelwe futhi ubambisana kahle nezinselelo zokuhlanganisa intsha yethu emnothweni. Izikhungo zezempilo zomphakathi zinezibopho zokuhlinzeka ngophenyo lwezifo ezivela ezimeni ezithile. I-Western Cape yonke ihlinzekwa ngosizo oluvela esikhungweni esisodwa sokubuyiselwa komzimba nokufakwa kwezitho zomzimba ezingezona ezempilo esikhundleni salokho okulahlekile ePinelands, eCape Town. Yiba nomusa, ube nobubele, futhi ube nomusa kubo bonke, kuhlanganise nokubakhumbuza ngokufudumele nokukhuluma nabo ngenhlonipho.

Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni umkhiqizo wokuqala uwoyela ube uphume. Ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukusebenza kuhamba kahle, kwenziwa ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kwezinga lokusebenza, izinga lokuphepha, kanye nezinga lokukhiqiza. Ukuphathwa Kwephrojekthi Uphathwa kwephrojekthi kwenziwa ngokuqinile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izinqubo ziyaqhubeka. Izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezinsiza, izindleko, kanye nezikhathi zokusebenza zaphathwa ngokuqinile. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni iphrojekthi ibhekelele izinjongo zayo. 10. Ukubuyekezwa Nokuhlola Ngemuva kokusebenza kweminyaka emibili, kwenziwa ukubuyekezwa kwephrojekthi. Lokhu kuhilela ukuhlola ukusebenza kweMthombo Oil Refinery, izinga lokukhiqiza, kanye nezindleko. Imiphumela yokubuyekezwa yatholakala, futhi izinyathelo zathathwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza. 11. Ukuthuthukiswa Kwezakhiwo Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iMthombo Oil Refinery yathuthukiswa ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo ezikhulayo. Lokhu kuhilela ukwakhiwa kwezinsiza ezintsha, ukuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokusebenza, kanye nokwandisa ukukhiqiza. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa zathuthukiswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iMthombo Oil Refinery ihlala ibalulekile emnothweni. 12. Isiphetho Umlando wephrojekthi yeMthombo Oil Refinery ubonisa indlela yokwakha isikhungo sokucubungula uwoyela esiphumelelayo. Ngokuqhubeka kokusebenza, le phrojekthi ibonisa ukuthi ingaba yisibonelo sokwakha izikhungo ezihlangabezana nezidingo zomphakathi, ukuhlinzeka ngempumelelo, kanye nokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkampani, iziphathimandla, kanye nomphakathi kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe impumelelo yephrojekthi.

Umkhiqizi uhlanganyela njalo kodwa ngeke umbone esebenzisa umhlaba. Uhlola umhlaba ngaso sonke isikhathi kodwa akakaze abeke. Akafiki ekupheleni kwendawo lapho abeka khona zonke izinhlobo zezitshalo ezikwi ndawo zayo emasimini. Umkhiqizi uyazi kahle ukuthi kufanele enze ukuthini ngoba uNkulunkulu umenze wabona futhi waqonda. UMdali ungumfundisi omuhle onika umkhiqizi ukuhlakanipha. U-Isaya 28:23 - 29? Ukulima kwaba umsebenzi wokuqala emhlabeni futhi kwaba umyalezo ovela kuNkulunkulu. Kubalulekile empilweni. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi thina njengabakhiqizi sibheke emsebenzini wethu ngamehlo ahlukene futhi sibone ukuthi kubalulekile futhi kuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu. Akukwanele ukuthi siqonde nje ukuthi sidinga ukwenza inzuzo (imali) nokwandisa ukukhiqizwa; kungcono ukucabanga ngokukhiqiza izitshalo nokudla kwekhwalithi okuzohlinzeka abanye ukudla okuzondla imizimba yabo futhi kubasize baphile impilo enhle. Umkhiqizi ungena kanjani emnothweni wezwe? Banikeza kakhulu emnothweni wezwe nasebhajethi kazwelonke. Uma abakhiqizi behlangana, bahlinzeka ngemicimbi eminingi kwabantu abaningi ezweni elidinga izindawo zokusebenza ngoba kuneziningi abantu abangenamsebenzi. Abakhiqizi bakha ukudla kwekhwalithi okukhuthazayo futhi kusiza ukuqinisa ukudla kwezwe nakusasa. Ezindaweni eziningi zezwe, abakhiqizi banikeza emnothweni kulo lonke idolobha lapho behlala khona futhi badingeka ngempela empilweni yezezimali yamadolobha asondelene nabo nasemhlabeni jikelele. Abakhiqizi bangabavikeli bomhlaba wethu; bangabasebenzi abakhuthele kakhulu ukuvikela umhlaba, umoya, amanzi, nalapho lezi zinto zihlangana ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi bangakhiqiza ezizukulwaneni ezizayo.

Siyabonga kubalimi abathengisa imikhiqizo yabo abaningi abasebenzisana nathi ukuthi sisombulule izinselele eziningi zenguquko emphakathini wethu. Angeke, impela, ukwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo ngenxa yaleli fomu eligayiwe. Imidwebo akumele ihanjiswe ngeposi kodwa kumele ifakwe kuhlelo umbhali wayo. Ilayisensi yeJalimani yokuthumela imikhiqizo ngaphandle efana nezimoto kanye nezinsiza kusebenza zezimboni zokukhiuqiza seyiyenze yaba sengozini ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi senkinka yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba kanye nokuwohloka kohwebo lamazwe omhlaba. Ubugugu obungumongo wangaphakathi bukhonjiswa kumgomo weNingizimu Afrika wamazwe angaphandle. Sizoqhubeka nokubhekana nezinselele zezifo, ukungakwazi ukufunda nokubhala, ubumpofu, ubugebengu, izinhlekelele zemvelo, kanye nokucekeleka phansi kwendawo ngokubhekelela uhlangothi olulodwa okudingwa isimo sethu. Futhi, kinina nonke, enilalele nenibambe iqhaza, siyanibonga kakhulu ngokubekezela kanye nokulinda kwenu, akukho esikuthatha kancane kulokhu. Izenzo zamasosha akwa-Israel eGaza zenza nje ukubanga inzondo enkulu kwisifunda. Ukuhlinzekwa, ukuhanjiswa, ukuxhunywa kanye nokukhonjiswa kwe-general buck room enomshini we-X-ray olenga phakathi kwaphansi kanye ne-ceiling. Abesifazane abangafuni ukuba baphathwe kabi noma abakhala bangakhushulwa ezikhundleni eziphakeme. Ezinye izinto zibekwe ebhakedeni elibonisa ubufakazi obungakaze buvulwe ukuze kuhlolwe ehhovisi lendawo elithola impahla. Inkantolo ingesikhiphe isinqumo sokuqedwa kobuhlobo bemndeni oburejistiwe ngaphandle uma yaneliseka ukuthi imigomo eyenziwe kumbe ecatshangiwe maqondana nenhlalakahle yezingane kumbe ingane eyondliwayo yobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe iyazenelisa izidingo zaleyo ngane. Ngaphambi kokukhipha isinqumo sokuqeda ubuhlobo, inkantolo kufanele iqale icabangisise izincomo okukhulunywa ngazo kwisigaba 41 somThetho wokuLamula kuMacala Athize kwiDivosi. Ukuze ikwazi ukusithola isimo esibekwe kwisigatshana 1 inkantolo ingase inqume ukuthi kube nomuntu ovela phambi kwayo futhi ingase ikhiphe sinqumo sokuthi omunye wophathini kumbe bobabili mabakhokhe izindleko zophenyo nokuvela phambi kwekantolo. Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo esiqeda ubuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe, maqondana nesondlo nemfundo yengane esadinga ukondliwa okuyingane yobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe, kumbe maqondana nomphathi wayo, kumbe ingane esencane yobuhlobo bomndeni oburejistiwe, kumbe ukuyibona ingane, inkantolo ingase ikhiphe isinqumo leso esibona sifanele futhi kwesinye isikhathi, uma ibona kuyito efanelekile kumntwana ukukwenza lokho, ikhiphe isinqumo sokuthi omunye wabazali abe umphathi kumbe umgadi wengane, inkantolo inganquma futhi ukuthi uma kwenzeka omunye wabazali onikezwe ubuphathi yedwa eshona, omunye umuntu ngaphandle komzali osaphila okuzofanele abe umphathi womntwana, yena yedwa kumbe ngokubambisana nomzali osaphila. Ngaphandle uma inkantolo isho okunye, amalungelo nomsebenzi kaphathini orejistiwe ngaphansi iwanoma yimuphi umthetho awashintshi ngenxa yokuqedwa kobudlelwano.

Izihlahla zihlala zikhanyisa indlela, futhi ungahamba uma ubona uCape Verde, lapho ubudlelwano bezingelosi zikhanyisa kancane. Noma ngabe uhamba phansi, ujabulela ubuhle bezithombe ezimibalabala nezinhlobo zezinyoni. Ezinye izindawo ezifana neMerzouga, uBauz, kanye neChinguetti, zithokozisa izivakashi ngemibono ephawulekayo yeSahara. EMerzouga, ungazithokozisa ngama-sand dunes amakhulu, lapho ungahle uthathe isithombe esihle ngezithombe ezahlukene zenkanyezi. Pandaru lezo zici, ungavakashela ezindaweni ezithokozisayo ezikwenziwa yi-adventure, njengokugibela izinkanyezi nangokwakha ulwazi olujabulisayo ngamasiko endawo. I-Sahara isiphenduke isikhumbuzo semvelaphi yamasiko ahlukahlukene. Abantu abahlala lapha, bakha izinyathelo ezitholakalayo kwezamasiko, izindawo zokuhlola nezinhlelo zokuphila. Lokhu kumangaza kakhulu, indlela abantu abaphila ngayo kule ndawo eyinzima, usebenzisa imvelo ukuze balondoloze impilo yabo. Lokhu kuholela kubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu abasebenza zesaphiwe neziza ekhaya. Ngokuphawula, abavakashi bangakwazi ukufunda ngezinkolelo, imikhuba, nezithakazelo zenhlalakahle yabantu bendawo. Uhambo lweSahara lungaba yinto esikukhumbulayo njengoba uhlangana nabantu baqhakambisa ubuhlobo, ukuphumelela kwezakhamuzi endaweni kanye nemibono yezikhumbuzo ezilula. Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi iSahara akukhulula kuphela, kodwa iphinde ibe ingxenye yezivakashi ezibhalwe emabhukwini wezwe lonke. Nokho, uhulumeni udinga ukuba aqinisekise ukuthi kube nokuvikelwa kwemvelo.

Thina, njengabasebenzi boMnyango wezobuciko namasiko, sithole izinsiza ezahlukene zik government ezibekwe ngaphansi kokuphathwa kwethu ukuze sizibhekele. Ngokuhambisana noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi, izinsiza zik government kumele zihlale zibhalwe; ngakho-ke, kumele sisebenzise imithetho yokuphatha futhi siqambe izinyathelo zokuvikela ukuze sigweme ukulahleka okuhambisanayo. Enye yale mithetho yokuphatha wukusebenzisa imithetho yokuphepha efana nokuhlola zonke izinto zomuntu ezithwalwa ngesandla, izimoto, noma izinto ezithwalwayo. UMthetho Wokufinyelela Ezindaweni Zomphakathi kanye noMthetho Wezimoto, Inombolo 53 ka-1985, unika abasebenzi bezokuphepha amandla okwenza izenzo ezithile ngokuhambisana neSigaba 2 soMthetho Wezimoto ka-1985 (njengokwenza ukuhlola, ukuvimbela ukufika noma ukuhamba, njll.). [Ucelwa ukuthi uhlole izaziso ezikhangisiwe ezindaweni zethu]. Kuyiqiniso futhi ukuthi le ndlela yokuphepha ingaba nzima kubasebenzisi ukuba babe nesipiliyoni esihle. Ukufika kuleli phuzu kudinga ukubambisana nokuqonda kubasebenzi. Uyal encouraged ukuba uzizwe ukhululekile ukuxhumana noMnu. Van Rooyen uma kukhona okungacacile mayelana nemithetho yethu yokuphepha nezindlela.

Abameli bafuna ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izakhamuzi zaleli zwe eziboshwe kwamanye amazwe ziphathwa ngendlela efanele ngesikhathi zisejele. Noma yiziphi izenzo ezihlobene nokuhlukunyezwa noma ukuphathwa okungahlonishwa noma ukuphathwa kabi kufanele kubikwe eziphathimandla zalelo ndawo. Imithetho yamazwe ngamazwe ephathelene nokuphathwa kweziboshwa iyasetshenziswa kulezi zimo. Yisiphi usizo olunikezwa abameli ezakhamuzini zaseNingizimu Afrika eziboshwe kwamanye amazwe? Banika iziboshwa ulwazi ngemicimbi yaleso sikhungo, okungase kufake phakathi imikhawulo yezomthetho yaleso sikhungo, indlela yokufinyelela ohlwini lwabameli uma sebuya ejele, izimo zokukhululwa, nendlela yokuphakamisa icala ukuze iziboshwa zazi amalungelo azo. Bagcina uxhumano olujwayelekile neziboshwa zaseNingizimu Afrika kulowo mhlaba ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi bayahambisana nemithetho yaleso sikhungo. Uxhumano nomndeni nabangane luvunyelwe uma luceliwe yiziboshwa. Akukho xhumano noma ulwazi oluzokwabelwana ngaphandle kwemvume yesakhamuzi saseNingizimu Afrika esiboshwe kwamanye amazwe. Baqinisekisa ukuthi uma udinga usizo lwezempilo, ubika eziphathimandla ejele. Iphondo lezeMisebenzi Yangaphandle kanye nabameli baseNingizimu Afrika kwamanye amazwe benza konke okusemandleni abo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izimali, imibhalo nezinto zokufunda, kanye nemithi zifika eziboshweni ngokushesha. Nokho, imisebenzi ebalulekile ye-ofisi ye-embassy ibekwe phambili. Isimo salelo zwe singavimbela ukufika kwezinto eziboshwe.

Ukubambisana phakathi kwezinkanyezi futhi nabalandeli bukhulu, kubonisa isitayela sokuqhuba imidlalo esiphumelelayo.
