Ukuthenga Online: Ukuhlaziywa Kwezizathu, Izinzuzo Nezinselelo Ukuthenga online, okwaziwa nangokuthi ukuthenga kwe-inthanethi, sekuphenduke umkhuba obalulekile emnothweni wezokuthengisa. Le ndlela yokuthenga ivumela abathengi ukuba bathenge imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo kusuka ezindaweni ezahlukene, ngaphandle kokuba baphume endlini yabo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kuningi okukhuluma ngale ndlela yokuthenga, okuhlanganisa nezizathu zayo, izinzuzo, nezinselelo ezihambisana nayo. Okwokuqala, kubalulekile ukuqonda izizathu zokuthi kungani abantu benza ukuthenga online. Enye yezizathu eziphambili wukutholakala kalula kwemikhiqizo. Abathengi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ezitolo eziningi ze-inthanethi ezihlinzeka ngezinto ezahlukene, ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngendawo yokuhamba noma izinsuku zokusebenza. Lokhu kuphinde kuvumele abantu ukuba baqhathanise amanani nemikhiqizo kalula, okwenza kube lula ukuthola okungcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kuvumela abathengi ukuba benze izinqumo eziphusile, njengoba bekwazi ukufunda izibuyekezo zemikhiqizo nezincomo zabanye abathengi. Izinzuzo zokuthenga online zikhulu. Okokuqala, kunezindleko eziphansi. Ukuze abathengi bathenge online, akudingekile ukuthi bakhokhe izindleko zokuqasha izitolo, izisebenzi, noma izindleko zokugcina impahla. Lokhu kuholela ezindlekweni eziphansi zemikhiqizo, okwenza kube lula kubathengi ukuthola imikhiqizo ngamanani aphansi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kuvumela abathengi ukuthi bathenge noma nini, okuyinto ebaluleke kakhulu ezimpilweni zabantu abanokusebenza okuningi. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emiphakathini enomsebenzi ongapheli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthenga online kulula futhi kusebenza kahle.

Amalungu eKhabhinethi, amalungu ePhalamende likazwelonke kanye namalungu amele uMkhandlu seziFundazwe sikazwelonke anelungelo elilinganayo ngaphambi kwekomidi elihlanganyelwe lePhalamende kanye noMkhandlu njengoba benalo ngaphambi kwePhalamende noma uMkhandlu. oluhlinzekela ukuthi kuvotela abantu abaneminyaka engu 18 kuya kwengaphezulu; futhi (d) olunomphumela, kabanzi, wokumelwa ngokwamanani amavoti atholiwe. Umthetho wePhalamende kumele uhlinzeke indlela yokunquma inani lamalungu oMkhandlu kaZwelonke. noma ngubani okwathi emuva kuthi lesi sigaba siqale ukusebenza, watholwa enecala wagwetshwa isikhathi esingaphezulu kwezinyanga ezingu-12 ejele ngaphandle kwesijeziso semali, lapha eRiphabhuliki noma ngaphandle kweRiphabhuliki uma leso senzo asigwetshelwa sasingaba yicala eRiphabhuliki; kodwa, akekho umuntu oyothathwa ngokuthi ugwetshiwe kuze kubenesinqumo maqondana nokudluliswa kwecala noma kuze kudlule isikhathi sokulidlulisa icala Isithibe ngaphansi kwalesi sigaba siphela eminyakeni emihlanu emuva kokuqedwa kwesigwebo. Umuntu ongavunyelwe ukuba yilungu loMkhandlu kaZwelonke ngokusho kwezigatshana (1)(a) noma (b) angalumela ukhetho loMkhandlu, uma kuhambisana nemikhawulo noma imbandela emiswe ngumthetho kazwelonke. ephuthe eMkhandlwini ngaphandle kwemvume kuleso simo esibekwa yimitheshwana nezinqumo ukuthi kufanele alahlekelwe ngubulungu. Ngaphambi kokuba ilungu loMkhandlu kaZwelonke liqale ukwenza imisebenzi yoMkhandlu, kufanele lifunge noma lethembise ukwethembeka kwiRiphabhuliki kanye nokuthobela uMthethosisekelo, ngendlela ebekwe kwiSheduli 2.

Lokhu kusebenza kuholela ekuthuthukeni kwezimboni ezihlobene, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuthutha, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezobuchwepheshe bokuqapha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imizamo yeSpaceX yokugcina imvelo ithokozisa, ikakhulukazi ekwakhiweni kwemikhumbi engasebenzisi uphethiloli, okuyinto ebalulekile ekulawuleni ukungcoliswa kwemvelo. Ukwesekwa okukhulu okuvela kumphakathi nakumaqembu ezombusazwe, kuhlale kubalulekile emizamweni yeSpaceX. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni isimo esilungele ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, izinkampani, kanye nohulumeni, kuqhubeke nokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe. Umoya wokusebenza ngokubambisana, obalulekile emkhakheni wezokuhamba emkhathini, udinga ukugqugquzela ubuchwepheshe obusha nokwakha amathuba amasha. Ngokubheka phambili, iSpaceX ibonisa ubuqotho bayo ekwakheni ikusasa elihlanzekile, elingabhekeli nje kuphela emkhathini, kodwa futhi nakumhlaba. Le nkampani ibonisa amandla okuthi izinkanyezi zibe yikhaya labantu, futhi ibonisa ukuthi umhlaba ungathuthuka ngokwengeziwe uma abantu bejabulela ukuhamba emkhathini. Ngakho, iSpaceX iyisibonelo esihle sokuthi uma sishintsha umqondo wethu, sizokwazi ukufinyelela ezingeni elikhulu lokuphila emhlabeni nakumkhathini. Ngale ndlela, iSpaceX iyingxenye enkulu yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinokuphumelela okukhulu, futhi izophinde ibonise ukuthi abantu bangakwazi ukufezekisa amaphupho abo uma bephikelela. Njengoba sibheke phambili, sizobona izimanga ezenzakalayo emkhathini, futhi iSpaceX izoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi imizamo yezenhloso ezinhle iyasivumela ukuba sithuthuke siqhubeka.

Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nzima kakhulu kubantu abangenamvume ukufinyelela kulolu lwazi. Kodwa-ke, akukhona nje kuphela ubuchwepheshe obubalulekile; abantu badinga ukuqonda ukuthi baphila emhlabeni lapho ubumfihlo bukhulu. Ukuze i-GEMS iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Lokhu kudinga ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuqonda, nokuhlonipha. Ekugcineni, ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi lwe-GEMS akusikho nje isibopho, kodwa kuyisidingo esibalulekile sokwakha ukwethembana phakathi kwe-GEMS nabantu. Ukuze le nsiza iqhubeke nokuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, kubalulekile ukuthi ibheke phambili, ibheke izindlela ezintsha zokuvikela imininingwane, futhi iqinisekise ukuthi abantu bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile. Ngale ndlela, i-GEMS izokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono, futhi abantu bazozizwa bekhululekile ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane yabo, bazi ukuthi ivikelekile. Ubumfihlo nokuvikelwa kolwazi akusikho nje okubalulekile, kodwa kuyisidingo esiyinhloko sokwakha umphakathi onempilo, onokwethembana, nolwazi. I-GEMS, njengensiza yokunakekela impilo, kufanele iqhubeke nokubeka phambili lezi zinto, ukuze iqinisekise ukuthi abantu baphila kahle, futhi bazi ukuthi imininingwane yabo ivikelekile.

Abenzi abaningi bobisi lwesoya baluthengisa nemikhiqizo enothiswe nge-calcium. Imikhiqizo yesoya ibuye isetshenziswe njengokudla okubiza kancane okungena endaweni yemikhiqizo yenyama neyenkukhu. Ukucolisiswa kakhulu kungaba nomphumela wokunambitheka okwehlisiwe, kepha amafutha ne-cholesterol kuyehla. Ukwengezwa kwamaviithamini namaminerali kuyakwazi ukusetshenziselwa ukwenza imikhiqizo yesoya ilingane ngokwezinga lezondlamzimba neyamaphrotheni ezilwane; isimo samaphrotheni kungashiwo ukuthi sicishe safana nesawenyama. Amaphrotheni emifino enziwe ngesoya athatha isikhundIa senyama asesetshenziswe ngaphezu kweminyaka engama-50 njengendlela engabizi yokwandisa inyama yenkomo egayiwe ngaphandle kokunciphisa izondlamzimba eziqukethe. Ubhontshisi wesoya ubuye usetshenziswe emikhiqizweni yezebhizinisi ebandakanya owoyela, izinsipho, izimonyo, i-resin, amapulasitiki, oyinki, amakhrayoni, izincibilikisi nempahla yokugqoka. Uwoyela kabhontshisi wesoya ungumthombo ophambili kadizili owenziwe ngezinto eziphilayo e-United States, ongama-80% emikhiqizo kadizili okhiqizwa kulelo zwe. Ubhontshisi wesoya ususetshenziswe ukusuka ngonyaka we-2001 njengohlobo lwembiliso, ekwenziweni kohlobo lomkhiqizo we-vodka.

Buza iqembu ukuthi liyazi yini ukuthi iyini imithetho emisiwe ehleliwe. Kafushane kakhulu bachazele ukuthi lomqulu enemithetho yokuthi imihlangano kumele iqhutshwe kanjani. Isibonelo: ngokuthamela umhlangano, indlela yokugqoka, isibalo esivunyelwe sabethamele umhlangano, ukuziphatha emhlanganweni, ukuveza amaqiniso ngobudlelwano, imfihlo yomhlangano, ukuvota, ukubuza imibuzo emhlanganweni, njll. Tshela abaqeqeshwayo ukuthi akusiwowonke amakomidi ezigceme anemithetho emile ehleliwe njengamanje, kanti futhi amaningi alawulwa imikhawulo yezinsiza yabo leyo ebhekana nezinye (hhayi zonke) izindaba ngemithetho emile ehleliwe. Yenza isingeniso ngesihloko sokuphathwa komsebenzi - bheka lsingeniso ekuqaleni kwesahluko. lyiphi indima okumele idlalwe umasipala mayelana nokusekela ukuphathwa komsebenzi kwamakomidi esigceme? Nenza kuphi ukuphathwa komsebenzi ekomidini lenu lesigceme noma emisebenzini yenu engaphandle kwekomidi lesigceme? Ukuphathwa kwamabhuku nokuqondisa ezezimali. Imibiko - tshela iqembu ukuthi ukubhala imibiko kuwumsebenzi wokuphatha obaluleke kakhulu wamakomidi ezigceme njengoba ukhombisa ubufakazi bokuthi kwenziweni, kwavunyelwana ngani, kwaboniswana ngani, njll ekomidini labo lesigceme. Tshengisa abaqeqeshwayo lsijobelelo 78 lapho kunesibonelo sethemplethe yombiko, kanye Nesijobelelo 79 lapho kunesibonelo sombiko wangempela. Uma kuboniswana ngesijobelelo 19, thinta kafushane amaphuzu anohlamvu abhekene nesijobelelo ekugcineni kukanombolo 4.5 kulesisahluko.

Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 emnothweni Ngomhla kaJulayi 2021, izwe laseNingizimu Afrika labhekana nezibhelu ezinkulu ezashiya umthelela omkhulu emnothweni. Lezi zibhelu, ezazihambisana nokuphikiswa, ziqale ngemuva kokuboshwa kukaFormer President Jacob Zuma, kodwa zashintsha zaba yizigameko ezinkulu zokuphikiswa ezazihlanganisa izifunda eziningi, ikakhulukazi eKwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng. Izibhelu zashiya umonakalo omkhulu, hhayi kuphela ezindaweni ezithintekayo, kodwa nasemazweni omhlaba. Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wezibhelu zikhombisa ukuthi umnotho wezwe ubhekene nezinkinga ezinzima, ezihlanganisa ukwehla kokutshalwa kwezimali, ukuncipha kwemisebenzi, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwezokuhamba kwezimpahla. Umthelela emnothweni Izibhelu zangoJulayi 2021 zashiya umonakalo omkhulu ezimbonini ezahlukene. Izitolo eziningi zavalwa, izimboni zaphazamiseka, futhi izinsiza eziningi zalahleka. Lokhu kuholele ekwehleni kokuthengiswa kwezimpahla, okwakuholela ekwehleni kwemali engenayo kumabhizinisi amancane. Abaningi baphinde bahlala bezama ukuvuselela amabhizinisi abo, kodwa imiphumela ibonakala ikhuluma ngokwehla kokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izibhelu zashiya umthelela omkhulu emsebenzini. Izinkampani eziningi zaphazamiseka, zadinga ukuvala iminyango ngenxa yokungabi namathuba okuthengisa. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokungasebenzi, okwakuholela ekwandeni kwezinga lokuhlupheka. Abantu abaningi baphinde bahlala bephila ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola izinsiza ezisemqoka.

Lokhu kuveza ithuba elikhulu lokuthi abantu abahlala ezindaweni ezinjengama-townships bangabathola kalula. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izithuthuthu zidinga ukugcinwa okuhle, okusho ukuthi abanikazi bazo kufanele babe nezezimali ezinzima ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhathi esikhathini esizayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhayisikili awadlalisi kuphela indima yokuhamba kodwa futhi ahlanganisa imiphakathi. Izindawo zokuhamba ngebhayisikili zikhuthaza abantu ukuthi bahlangane, bahlale bejabulile, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano. Lokhu kuhlekelela ekukhuleni kwemiphakathi, okwakha umoya wokubambisana. Izithuthuthu, zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, kodwa azikhiqizi ubudlelwano obufanayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abahamba ngebhayisikili bahlala bezithokozisa ngendlela yokwenza okuthile, okubangela umoya opholile phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, ukukhetha phakathi kwamabhayisikili nezithuthuthu kuncike ezidingweni zomuntu ngamunye. Ukuthi uzofuna ukukhetha amabhayisikili noma izithuthuthu kuncike kakhulu ezicini ezinjengokuthi izinto zikhona, izidingo zempilo, kanye nezinqumo zokudla. Amabhayisikili ahlanzekile, aphumelelayo, futhi akhululekile, kwazise izithuthuthu zinika amandla, isikhathi, nokugxila. Ngakho, ukuhlola lezi zindlela zokuhamba kuyisinyathelo esihle sokuthola ukuthi iyiphi indlela efanele kakhulu kuwe. Ngakho, ngabe amabhayisikili noma izithuthuthu? Impendulo ingahluka kumuntu nomuntu, kodwa okubalulekile ukuthi sithathe isikhathi sokucabanga ngokwazisa kwethu kwempilo, umoya, nezimo. Ngaphakathi kohlanga lwezokuhamba, inhloso yethu yokuhamba ibaluleke kakhulu, futhi udinga ukukhetha okuzokwenza ube nekhono, ukhululekile, futhi ufinyelele izinjongo zakho.

Umphakathi kanye nomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika kwenziwe ukungalingani kokwabiwa komnotho kanye nezinsiza. Womabili amaqembu azinikela ekuxhumaneni okuqhubekayo ngeso lokwakhiwa kobudlelwane obuhle. Ingabe uyazi yini ukuthi umsebenzi we-Security Officers Board ukuqinisekisa ikhono lomsebenzi kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi bezokuqapha? Inhloso yezivimbamgwaqo kwakuwukulwa nobugebengu njengenhloso eziphambili kwalo lonke iphoyisa esiteshini samaphoyisa. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi abaholi bakusasa badinga ngokuphindelela imfundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa okufanele. I-Hydroponic farming - ukutshala izitshalo kwingxube yomsoco kunokuthi zitshalwe emhlabathini. Ekuphakamiseni lezi zinhloso, kubalulekile ukugcizelela eminye imigomo. Ngazi kakhulu ngenkinga yothisha kanye nabazali mayelana nokwethula kwe-FET. Baya ekhaya lapho ehlala khona eBrandwag futhi basesha negumbi lakhe. UNdunankulu, uNgoqngqoshe kanye neMeya bacocela amawadi ukuthi asisize ukuhlanza. Imiklomelo Nokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi: Isingeniso Kulezi zinsuku, abasebenzi banomthelela omkhulu ezinkampanini ezahlukene. Ukuwazisa, ukuhlinzeka ngosizo, nokubakhuthaza kubalulekile ukuze bakwazi impumelelo. Ngakho, imiklomelo nokuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kuyisici esibalulekile sokwakha indawo yokusebenza ephumelelayo nefaka umoya omuhle. Umqondo Wokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Ukuqashelwa kwabasebenzi kubonisa izindlela ezahlukene zokubahlonipha, ukunikela ngemibono, noma ukuhlinzeka ngezikhumbuzo kumuntu noma eqenjini. Kubalulekile ukuthi abaphathi bazi imizamo, ubuhlakani, nezimpumelelo zabasebenzi. Ukuqashelwa kudala umoya omuhle, okwandisa ukuzinikela, futhi kukhuphule impumelelo ezinkampanini. Izindlela Zokuqashelwa Kwabasebenzi Izindlela zokuhlonipha zihluke kakhulu. Zingaba zifushane, njengezincwadi zokuhlonipha ezivela kubaphathi, noma zibe zinde, njengezinhlelo ezihlanganisa imiklomelo emikhulu. Izinkampani ezithuthukile zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene, njengemiklomelo yokusebenza kahle, izinhlelo zokwazisa, noma imikhankaso yokubika izimpumelelo. Imiklomelo Yokusebenza Kahle Imiklomelo yokusebenza kahle iyindlela ethandwa kakhulu yokuhlonipha abasebenzi. Lokhu kungaba ukuhlinzeka ngohambo, imali, noma izikhumbuzo ezikhethekile, okwenza abasebenzi bazizwe bebalulekile futhi kukhuthaze abanye ukuba bakhuphule izinga labo lokusebenza. Izinhlelo Zokuhlonipha Izinhlelo zokuhlonipha zihlala zinezinzuzo eziningi. Izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa izinhlelo ezihlelwe kahle ukuze ziqashele abasebenzi, okuhlanganisa imiklomelo yokusebenza, izinhlelo zokuhlonipha ezibhalwe phansi, kanye nemikhosi yokwazisa.

Sabuye savumelana futhi ukuthi lezi zinqumo zizolandelwa. Ngamanye amazwi savumelana ngokuthi singabi nezimbizo nezingqungquthela zokukhuluma kwenziwe nemibiko nje kuphela. Savumelana ngokuthi sizolandela indlela yokuzibambela ekwenzeni umsebenzi wethu wokuletha izidingo njengohulumeni wasekhaya. Sihlangene lapha namuhla ukuzoqalisa olunye lwalezo zinhlelo, olukhuthaza ukuzibambela ngqo. Ngesikhathi sidingida indlela ebheke phambili ngokuqondene nomasipala abadonsa kanzima ngokubona kwengqungquthela, uhulumeni kazwelonke wayebheka izindlela zokungenelela ezingalandelwa esikhathini esifushane ekusizeni omasipala. Yilapho-ke kwaqhamuka uhlelo lukazibambel. (Project Consolidate). Uhlelo lukazibambele luwuhlelo olubheka izinselelo omasipala ababhekene nazo ezweni lonke. Ngikhuluma nje bangu-136 omasipala abakhonjiwe kuzwelonke ukuba babambe iqhaza kulolu hlelo. Afrika kwisidingo esiphuthumayo sokuthola izindlela ezintsha zokuqinisekisa umphumela obonakalayo ezinhlelweni zohulumeni basekhaya kanye nokuqinisa ukudidiyelwa kwezinhlelo zikazwelonke, ezesifundazwe nezohulumeni basekhaya ezindaweni ezisemqoka zokulethwa kwezidingo (nesibambisene nabo) Ngamafuphi, uhlelo lukazibambele luqondene nokwakha ubambiswano oluzoholela ekwenziweni ngcono kwezinga lempilo kubantu emazingeni ezindawo.. Umasipala wendawo waseNdaka ungomunye womasipala abakhnjwe ukuba babambe iqhaza ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo olubalulekile lokuqinisa ingqalasizinda yomasipala bethu.

Omasipala akufanele bahle ngendlela yokusebenzisa izimali abangenazo. Lokhu kusho ukuthi imali eqoqwa nguMasipala okungenani ayilingane nemali yokuqhutshwa komsebenzi sekuhlangene nokubuya kwemali, abasebenzi, izimpahla zokusebenza nezimpahla zokusebenza nezokwakha, ihhovisi nemisebenzi kaMasipala nokunye. Ukutholakal mahala kwezidingo nakhpo kufanele kubalelwe ngaphakathi kwezindleko zikaMasipala zokuqhutshwa komsebenzi. Ukuxazulula amaphuzu abalulekile eziqondene nentsha nabantu besifazane kuwona onke amazinga okubuswa kwendawo ngokusebenzisa izinhlaka zomphakathi ezilhlekile. Ukukhuthaza ukudidiyelwa kohlelo lwendawo yoKhahlamba ngendlela yokuthuthukiswa kwamaweb nemizila ehlanganisa izindawo. Ukuzabalazela ukwakha isimo sokuhambisana kokukhula komnotho nokusetshenziswa kwabantu nemvelo.

Uma siphuma kulesi simo, sizoba neziphumo ezihlangene, nezinhlelo ezenzakalelayo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuthuthukisa izinga lokuphila kwentsha. Lokhu kuzoletha ushintsho olusemthethweni, oluqinile nolwanelisayo, ukuze kwenzeke ukuguqulwa okudingekayo empilweni yabantu abasha. Ngalokhu, sizodinga ukuqhubeka nokuxoxisana, noma ngabe kuhlelwe imihlangano erhubhulayo nezinhlelo eziphambili, ukuze sizokwazi ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinethuba lokusebenza, noluthokozisayo. Iphalamende kudinga ukuba ibonisane ukuze zenzeke izinxephezelo, ukuze izinkampani, uhulumeni, nemiphakathi ibonakale ixhumene ndawonye ekwandiseni izikhala ezikhona. Ukwakhiwa kwezakhiwo ezinhle zemisebenzi, ezihlonza umsebenzi nenhlalakahle, kuzohlala kusemqoka. Ngakho-ke, ngazo zonke lezi zinkinga, sinesidingo sokuhleleka, ukuphikelela, nokuhlonza izixazululo, ukuze sithumele umyalezo wokuthi intsha yethu ingamaheliwe. Izinqubomgomo ezimfanele nezisizayo kungama-tools, ukuze sithumele izisho ezizokwenza isimo sibe ngcono. Lokhu kuyacaca – sizodinga ukwakha izinkonzo ezinobuhlakani nesizinda esiqinile, ukuze intsha ikwazi ukuwina empilweni, ithola amathuba okwenza kube ngcono futhi yakhe ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Uyabona lokho uma ubheka isikhungo semali esisetshenziselwa ukuhamba komnotho nezinsiza ukuze zisebenze ezingeni eliphezulu. Ibhola Lombhoxo: Umcimbi Ohloniphekayo Nobuchwepheshe Ngemuva kwezinyanga zokulinda, umcimbi omkhulu wehlukile ubuyela emhlabeni: ibhola lombhoxo. Lo mcimbi uheha imiphakathi eminingi eNingizimu Afrika, futhi abantu baphuma ezindlini zabo ukuze bajabulele le midlalwa emangalisayo. Umcimbi uhlanganisa izigaba ezahlukene, uthokozisa abalandeli, abadlali, kanye nezingane, ubukhombisa ubuchwepheshe, ubuhlakani, nokuhlangana kwabantu. Ibhola lombhoxo, elaziwa ngokuthi "rugby" ngesiNgisi, liphakamisa umoya weqhawe, ubuholi, kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwemiphakathi. Abadlali baveza amakhono abo, besebenzisa izindlela ezahlukahlukene zokuphosa, ukushaya, nokuhamba, bahlula izithiyo ezinzima. Umphakathi uthokoziswa ngemizamo yabo, njengoba behlangana nezinselele ezinkulu, futhi bebonisa ukuthi imidlalo emikhulu iyakwazi ukuhlanganisa abantu. Umcimbi uqala ngenkulumo efushane ethokozisayo, lapho abashayi bejabulisa izilaleli. Kulapho kuqala umoya omusha, nokukhuthaza ukuthi wonke umuntu azithokozise emsebenzini. Umphakathi uqala ukujabulisa, kunomoya omuhle kanye nezipho eziphephuliwe. Njengoba umcimbi uqhubeka, abadlali bahlala benezinga eliphezulu, behlola izindlela zabo zokuphosa nezokugijima. Izinkanyezi zomdlalo ziqhakaza ezinkundleni zodumo, abadlali baphumelela, besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe nobuhlakani babo ukuze bahlasele izitha zabo. Akukhona nje ngobuchwepheshe, kodwa futhi nekukhuthazayo okuvela emindenini, abangani, nabalandeli, kuphakamisa umoya wokuwina, okwakha izinkumbulo ezihlala njalo. Ukuphumelela komdlalo akukhathalekile kuphela kumphakathi, kodwa kubalulekile ekwakheni ubuhlobo.

UXolile Dasheka wazalwa efemini endaweni yasePetrusburg. Ubaba wakhe wayesebenza efemini kanti umama wakhe wayengumsebenzi wasekhaya. UXolile unedigri kuMphakathi kanye nezeMali kanye neDiploma kuMphakathi Wobudlelwano. Wathenga ifemu yakhe, iLemoenkloof, endaweni yaseJagersfontein ngo-2006 ngenkampani yeLand Bank. Ifemu yakhe inobukhulu obuyi-1,134 hectares, lapho u-145 hectares kuyindawo yokulima kanti u-989 hectares isetshenziselwa ukugaya izinkomo. UXolile uhlala ekhula ummbila, uphisa izinkomo zenyama, izinkukhu, nezinkuni, futhi uphinde akhule imifino. Uthola kanjani imali yokuphatha izitshalo zakho? Eminyakeni emibili edlule, angikathengisi izitshalo. Ngizisebenzisile ukudla izinkomo zami. Ngisebenzise enye ingxenye yokwenzayo ukuphatha umkhiqizo wonyaka ozayo. Ngenxa yokukhuphuka kwezindleko, ngizozama ukuthola imali ukuze ngisize ngempela kwiLand Bank. Yini imibono yakho ngezimo zezimali kwezolimo? Umkhiqizi kufanele abe yizinto eziningi; isibonelo, kufanele abe uchwepheshe kwezimali, umnotho, umthengisi, nokuningi. Izingxenye zenzuzo ekukhiqizeni izitshalo zincane kakhulu. Sidinga umphakathi ukusiza abakhiqizi baseNingizimu Afrika ngokuthenga imikhiqizo yasendaweni. Sidinga ukuba kube nentela ezimpahleni ezithengiswa ezweni. Izindleko zokufaka njenge-diesel nezinsiza zokulima ziyasibulala. Ezolimo akuyona insimu ethokozisa intsha yabantu abamnyama; abawuboni umbono wesikhathi esizayo kuyo. Uma izindleko nezimpahla ezingenayo zingalawulwa, ukuncintisana okukhona ezimpahleni ezixhaswayo kuzobhubhisa umkhiqizi waseNingizimu Afrika.

efanele phakathi kwamaphoyisa neminye imikhakha kahulumeni. kwaso noma yinoma yiliphi elinye lamakomidi akhe ukuphendula imibuzo. ukuze alawule futhi aphathe amaphoyisa. leKhabinethe elebhekele umsebenzi wobuphoyisa. libonisane namaqembu ezombungazwe. wamaphoyisa njengokusho kwesigatshana (2). izinyathelo zomthetho lowo Khomishani, ngokumaqondana nomthetho kazwelonke. yilungu leKhabhinethe elibhekele umsebenzi wobuphoyisa. kuphela njengokusho komthetho kazwelonke. kwanoma yimiphi yalemisebenzi noma aqoke ilungu leKhabinethi okuyilona elizophendula. noma ukucishwa kwalomthetho noma amasiko. umthetho ophathelene ngqo nomthetho wamasiko. nesandla maqondana nezindaba ezithinta imiphakathi yezindawo. Umthetho kazwelonke ungamisa uMkhandlu sabaholi bendabuko. ngaphandle komthetho wePhalamende. ethile ibekelwe umsebenzi othile. ingakhishwa ngqo esikhwameni semali kazwelonke. ezinye izidingo zesikhashana, kanye nezinye izimo ezinesisekela esifanayo. uhlelo lwezimali lukazwelonke, lwezifunda nolwezindawo lufanele lubenjani. ngayiphi indlela nomthetho kazwelonke. ezizokwandisa izikweletu zomphakathi onyakeni olandelayo. izindlela ezifanayo zokuphathwa kwemali. zephulwe kabi kakhulu noma ngokuphindaphindwa. nalolo olumiswe kwisigaba 76(1) futhi lwamiswa yimitheshwana nezibopho zePhalamende. likazwelonke lokuphatha izimali. sibeke udaba lwaso phambi kwekomidi. olusebenzisa imali ngendlela efanele. kwisigatshana (2) ngenhla. kubhekelelwe noma yiziphi izincomo zeKhomishana yezimali nokusetshenziswa kwezimali. Minyaka yonke uhulumeni ngamunye kufanele ashicilele umbiko ngeziqinisekiso azinikile.

Ngaleyondlela imiphakathi yakithi iye ihlalele ovalweni, inokwesabela izimpilo zayo. Ikhaya yikhaya ngokuba nendlu ephephile, asifuni ukuthi abantu bakithi bahlale njalo bebikelwa ngokungahle kwenzeke uma nje kuke kwashintsha umoya ngenxa yokuthi bahlala ezindlini ezingekho esimeni esifanelekile. Mphathi wohlelo, Umnyango wethu uphume umkhankaso wokubuyisa isithunzi sabantu bakithi ikakhulukazi labo abahlukunyezwa kakhulu wumbuso wobandlululo ngokubahlinzeka ngezindlu. Namuhla sinentokozo enkulu ukuthi umkhankaso wethu wokwakhela umphakathi wakithi izindlu emakhaya usufinyelele kulendawo yalapha eSimahla. Sihamba ngamandla ukusheshisa intuthuko yezindlu kubantu bakithi emakhaya ngoba sifuna kubuyiswe isithunzi sabo esadicilelwa phansi wumbuso wobandlululo. Ukubuyisa isithunzi sabantu kusho ukuthi wonke umuntu akabe nendlu esesimeni esifanele. Akekho umuntu okufanele ahlale ngokwesaba kodwa ebe ethi uhlezi endlini. Ngaphambi kokuba kungene loHulumeni wethu wentando yeningi kwakufana nephupho ukuba abantu bangakhelwa izindlu emakhaya. Umbono wethu njengoHulumeni wukubona yonke imiphakathi iphila impilo engcono ngendlela elinganayo. Siyagcizelela emigomeni yethu ukuthi, abantu bakithi abakhelwe izindlu ezindaweni eziseduze namadolobha, ngokunjalo nasezindaweni zasemakhaya, sifuna nabantu bakithi baphile impilo efana neyabo bonke abantu, babe nezindlu ezinhle, ugesi, nemgwaqo. Thina njengoHulumeni wabantu asikholelwa wukuthi ukuze abantu bakithi bathole intuthuko kufanele baze baye emadolobheni, sifuna intuthuko abantu bakithi bayithole ezindaweni abahlezi kuzona futhi ilethwe ngaphandle kokuphazamisa indlela yabo yokuphila.

Izifundo Zokuphumelela KwezamaBhizinisi: Ukuhamba Phambili Ngobuchwepheshe Nezindlela Zokwakha Ezamabhizinisi zihlala zibhekwa njengenhloso yokwakha izinkampani eziphumelelayo, ezihlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Nokho, empilweni yansuku zonke, abhizinisayo abavela emikhakheni ehlukahlukene bahlala bephikisana nezinselele eziningi. Ukuze sizuze impumelelo, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izinqubo ezihamba phambili, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezindlela zokwakha zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni amabhizinisi. Ukuqala, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhambela phambili. Kulezi zinsuku, ubuchwepheshe buphendule indlela esisebenza ngayo, futhi lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ezamabhizinisi. Amabhizinisi amancane athola ithuba lokukhula ngokusebenzisa amaphakheji e-software avumela ukuhlela kahle, ukuthengisa, nokuxhumana namakhasimende. Ngendlela efanele, ubuchwepheshe bungathuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amabhizinisi ahlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende. Ngezizathu ezinjalo, izinkampani eziningi zisebenzisa ama-plathifomu e-inthanethi ukuze zikhulise ukuthengisa kwazo. Lokhu kuholele ekutheni kubekhona ukwanda kwezinkampani ezisebenzisa amakhasi e-web, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokukhangisa ezithuthukisiwe. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa ukufinyelela komkhiqizo, kodwa futhi kuthuthukisa isithombe sendawo yebhizinisi. Ngakho, njengabathandi bezamabhizinisi, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlale buthuthuka. Uma sithanda ukuba phambili, kumele sihlale sithola izindlela ezintsha zokuhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana namakhasimende.

Ngakho-ke, ukufunda nokukhuluma izilimi ezahlukene kubalulekile ukuze sibe nekhono lokuxhumana emhlabeni wanamuhla. Umbuzo 10: Yini okufanele siyenze ukuze sigcine izilimi zethu zendabuko? Impendulo: Ukuze sigcine izilimi zethu zendabuko, kubalulekile ukuzigcina zikhuluma, zifundiswa, futhi zisetshenziswe ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke. Lokhu kungafaka ukufundisa izingane zethu izilimi zethu, ukuhlela imicimbi yokukhuluma, nokubhala izincwadi ezikhuluma ngamasiko ethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuxhasa izinhlelo zokufunda izilimi zendabuko ezikoleni nakwezokuxhumana kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izilimi zethu zihlala zikhona. Ngokuhlanganisa lezi zihloko, sithola ukuthi izilimi zibalulekile empilweni yethu, ziqinisekisa ukuthi sikhuluma, sabelana, futhi sikhumbula. Ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene akusizi kuphela ekuxhumaneni, kodwa futhi kusivulela umhlaba omusha wezinto esingazithola. Ngakho-ke, masiqhubeke sifunde, sikhulume, futhi sigcine izilimi zethu zendabuko.

Ukwelashwa Kwezifo Zengqondo: Umqondo Ohloniphekile noMsebenzi Oqondile Izifo zengqondo, njengokukhathazeka, umoya ophansi, kanye nezinye izimo ezithinta imizwa, zibe yizinkinga ezinkulu emphakathini wethu. Lezi zifo azithinti kuphela abantu ngabanye, kodwa zinezimpempe ezibanzi ezithinta imindeni, izindawo zokusebenza, kanye nomphakathi jikelele. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhulume ngalezi zifo, siqonde ukuthi zikhona, futhi sithole izindlela zokwelapha ezisebenzayo. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo kudinga ukuqonda okujulile. Abantu abaningi basaba ukuvuma ukuthi banesifo sengqondo ngenxa yokwesaba ukujabulisa, ukucwaswa, noma ukungaqondi kahle. Lokhu kubangela ukuthi abantu bahlale bezama ukubhekana nezinkinga zabo bodwa, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola usizo. Ukuze sikwazi ukusiza, kudingeka sishintshe indlela esibheka ngayo lezi zifo. Akukhona okungajabulisi, kodwa kuyinqubo efanele, futhi kufanele siqonde ukuthi sikhuluma ngezimpilo zabantu. Ukwelashwa kwezifo zengqondo kudinga ukuba kube nezinhlobonhlobo zezindlela. Abanye abantu bangase bacabangele ukwelashwa ngokomzimba, njengokwelashwa kwezokwelapha, kanti abanye bangathanda ukwelashwa ngokomoya, njengokukhuluma nodokotela bezengqondo. Ukuxhumana nomuntu onolwazi, ofana nodokotela noma umeluleki, kungaba yisinyathelo sokuqala esibalulekile. Lokhu akuhlanganisi nje ukwelashwa okujwayelekile, kodwa futhi kudinga ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi komuntu odinga usizo nomeluleki. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umphakathi udinga ukuba neqhaza elikhulu ekwelapheni izifo zengqondo. Ukuze sithole izixazululo, kudingeka sikhuthaze abantu ukuba baphule ukungabaza nokwesaba.

Uma ukhomishina wokufungisa ekungabaza ukungakwazi ukubhala kofungayo, uyodinga ukuthi lokhu kungakwazi kufakaziswe ezansi kwamazwi afungelwayo ngomunye umuntu othembekile. Emva kokuba ofungayo esesayinile noma efake uphawu, ukhomishina wokufungisa uyofakazisa ukuthi ofungayo ukuvumile ukuthi uyakwazi futhi uyakuqonda okuqukethwe amazwi afungelwayo futhi asho INDLELA, INDAWO, kanye NOSUKU lokwenza isifungo. Ukhomishina wokufungisa uyosayina isifungo bese ebhala igama eligcwele kanye nekheli lomsebenzi ngezansi kwesignesha yakhe, futhi asho nesikhundla sakhe kanye nendawo lapho ebebebonanela khona noma ihhovisi akulo. "Ikheli lomsebenzi" kusho ikheli lendawo futhi hhayi ikheli lokuposa. Izigxivizo esezilungile ziyatholakala ukuze zisize okhomishina bokufungisa ukuthi benze umsebenzi wesifungo noma wokuqinisekisa ngale kokubambezeleka. Ikhophi yombhalo okufanele ufakiziswe njengekhophi eyiqiniso yombhalo wokuqala, kufanele iqhathaniswe nombahlo wokuqala futhi kufanele kuqinisekiswe ukuthi imibhalo emibili, eqinisweni, iyefana. Uma ukhomishina wokufungisa eqinisekile ukuthi ngempela ikhophi iyikhophi eyiqiniso yombhalo wokuqala futhi akunazichibiyelo ezingagunyaziwe ezenziwe, ukhomishina wokufungisa kufanele abhale phansi ukuthi uyakufakazela ukuthi umbhalo uyikhophi eyiqiniso yombhalo wokuqala nokuthi akukho zinkomba zokuthi umbhalo wokuqala uke washintshiwa ngabantu abangagunyaziwe. Emva kwalokho-ke ukhomishina wokufungisa kufanele eleke ngesignesha futhi abhale igama, isikhundla, imininingwane yokumthinta kanye nosuku. Isigxivizo esesilungile siyatholakala ukuze kufakazelwe imibhalo.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, inkolo ibamba umphakathi ndawonye, ibasiza ukuba bahlanganyele ezinkolweni zabo, benze imikhuba ethile, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabo. Umoya: Ukukholelwa Nokuhlangenwe Nakho Umoya, ngakolunye uhlangothi, ungumqondo ongenakubalwa, ophathelene nokuhlangenwe nakho komuntu, izinzwa, nemizwa. Umoya ungabhekwa njengokuxhumana komuntu nomhlaba, nemvelo, kanye nezinto ezingaphezu kwemvelo. Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ekutheni umoya unethonya elikhulu empilweni yabo, futhi lokhu kuthonywa kungaba kuhle noma kubi, kuye ngokuthi umuntu ubhekana nani. Umoya ungatholakala ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengemvelo, ezindaweni zokukhulekela, noma ngisho nasezindaweni ezijwayelekile. Abantu bahlala befuna ukuxhumana nomoya, bephendukela ezikhathini zokuzindla, imikhuba yokukhuleka, noma izifundo ezithile ezithinta umoya. Lokhu kuhlanganyela nomoya kuholela ekutheni abantu bazizwe behlangene, bephila impilo enenjongo, futhi bejabule. Ubudlelwano Phakathi Kwenkolo Nomoya Ubudlelwano phakathi kwenkolo nomoya bukhombisa ukuthi lezi zinto azihlukanisiwe, kodwa zixhumene kakhulu. Inkolo ivame ukuhlinzeka ngesisekelo sokukholelwa komoya, kanti umoya unikeza impilo enembile ezinkolweni. Lokhu kubonakala ezinkolweni eziningi, lapho izinkolelo zomoya zihlala zikhona, zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo ethokozisayo, futhi bahloniphe imvelo. Isibonelo, ezinkolweni eziningi, umoya uthathwa njengomthombo wamandla, futhi abantu bahlala befuna ukuwuhlonipha. Lokhu kubonakala ezimisweni zokukhulekela, lapho abantu bencenga umoya ukuze ubasize, ubakhanyisele, noma ubavikele.

Kuyacaca ukuthi loku asingeke sikuvumele kuqhubeke, noma ngabe sivume ukuthi ukucwaningwa kwamabhuku amaphrovinsi kanye nakazwelonke kuqinisiwe kakhulu. Uma sekunje, kufuneka ukuthi kulandelwe umthetho wesivumelwano sokuthi izinga lomsebenzi womuntu, ikakhulu labo abaphethe libhekisiswe kakhulu, uma lingenelisi, athathelwe izinyathelo. Izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa izinga lomsebenzi wabomasipala basekhaya ziyaqhubeka. Emuva kokhetho lukaNdasa ngo 2006, izinhlelo zokufundisa izisebenzi ezisafika emsebenzini zenziwa ngoba futhi bekwaziwa ukuthi abosodolobha abangu 62% basha kulimisebenzi yabo. Okukhathazayo noko, wukuthi kulabohulumeni basekhaya, kusenezikhundla eziningi ezingakagcwaliswa noma ezinye zivuleke manje. Bheka nje ngomnyaka ophelile ngenyaka kaMandulo i27% yabomasipala bebengenayo imenijeni, ephrovinsi yase Northwest izikhundla ezazingenabo abantu zazingu 50% kanti-ke empumalanga kwakuyi 1% kuphela yomenijeni abakhulu abafeza izinjongo nezivumelwano zemisebenzi yabo. Siyaqhubeka sibhekana nalenselele kanti-ke sizakwenza konke okusemandleni ethu okuhambelana nesu lethu leminyaka emihlanu ephathelene nohulumeni basemakhaya okufaka phakathi kwako usizo oluseduzane oluvela kuhulumeni wamaphrovinsi kanye nohulumeni wezwe lonkana. Kuzakuthunyelwa abantu abanamakhono omsebenzi ukuthi bayonceda ohulumeni basemakhaya, loku kufaka phakathi nabantu bomphakathi abazi umsebenzi bayolekelela ngaphandle kokuthola iholo, amakomidi amawadi azakuqiniswa, njengamanje angu 80% asabunjiwe ezweni lonke.

ukuze kutholakale imvume yakhe. Uma uMkhandlu kaZwelonke wamukela uMthethosivivinywa singazange sincome isichibiyelo kuwona, uMthethosivivinywa kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. singawemukela futhi uMthethosivivinywa, noshintsho noma ngaphandle koshintsho; noma (ii) singanquma ukungaqhubeki nalowoMthethosivivinywa. UMthethosivivinywa owemukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke ngokusho kwesigaba (c) ngenhla, kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. udaba lunqunywa ngokuthi iningi lamavoti afakiwe lesekani, uma kunamavoti alinganayo ezinhlangothini zombili isithunywa esengamele umhlangano kufanele sifake ivoti elizoveza isinqumo. wamukele uMthethosivivinywa oshintshiwe; noma (iii) uwuchithe uMthethosivivinywa. Uma uMkhandlu kaZwelonke wamukela uMthethosivivinywa ngaphandle koshintsho, lowoMthethosivivinywa kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. Uma uMkhandlu kaZwelonke wamukela uMthethosivivinywa oshintshiwe, lowoMthethosivivinywa kufanele uyiswe kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke, futhi uma uMkhandlu wamukela loMthethosivivinywa kufanele uyiswe kuMongameli ukuze uthole imvume. ngoMthethosivivinywa oshintshiwe njengoba wemukelwe uMkhandlu; noma (iii) ngenye inhlobo yalo Mthethosivivinywa.

Ekugcineni, umcimbi uphumelele kakhulu, futhi abahlanganyeli baphuma bejabule, bephuma nemibono emisha yokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo. U-Dkt. Mthembu wagcizelela ukuthi, "Umsebenzi wethu awupheli lapha. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzoba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezempilo." Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo zezempilo akukhona nje kuphela ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo, kodwa futhi kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi ophumelelayo, onempilo, nolwazi. Ngokuhlanganiswa kwezikhungo, sizokwazi ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubantu bethu, futhi sithuthukise izinga lempilo ezindaweni ezikude. Umcimbi we-GEMS health facility coordination ubonise ukuthi, ngokubambisana, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezempilo, lapho wonke umuntu ethola usizo olufanele. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzoba yisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, futhi sizokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izikhungo zethu zisebenza ngokubambisana, ukuze sithuthukise impilo yabantu bethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sizobona izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wezempilo, futhi umcimbi we-GEMS health facility coordination uzoba yisikhumbuzo sokuthi, uma sibambisene, singakwazi ukufezekisa izinto ezinkulu. Lokhu kuhlanganiswa kuzokwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezinsizakalweni, futhi kuzokwandisa amathuba okuthola usizo lwezempilo kubantu abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Umcimbi ubonise ukuthi, ngokuhlanganyela, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile, elinempilo, nolwazi.

Wokuhlinzekela ukongiwa, ukuvikelwa kanye nokuphathwa kwamagugu aphathekayo kanye naphilayo noma nangaphatheki esiFundazwe saKwaZulu- Natali; wokusungula uMkhandlu osemthethweni wokuphatha ukongiwa kwamagugu esifundazweni; wokunquma izinhloso, amandla kanye nemisebenzi yoMkhandlu; wokunquma indlela uMkhandlu ozophathwa ngayo, ozobuswa ngayo, nozoqasha ngayo kanye nozoxhwaswa ngayo ngezimali; wokusungula iziGungu zamaGugu zaseKhaya, zeziFunda, zamaDolobha amaKhulu kanye nezesiFundazwe ukusiza uMkhandlu ukuba uqinisekise ukubandakanywa kwemiphakathi ekuphatheni nasekongeni amagugu esiFundazweni; kanye nokuhlinzekela okunye okuphathelene nalokho. Kulo Mthetho noma yiliphi igama noma isisho okunikezwe incazelo eMthethweni wamaGugu kaZwelonke, 1999 uMthetho No. umkhandlu wendabuko osungulwe ngokwesigaba 6 soMthetho wobuHoli bokuBusa kweNdabuko, 2005 uMthetho No. "umasipala" kusho umasipala ohlongozwe esigabeni 155 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996, futhi osungulwe yizigaba 11 no 12 nangaphansi kwezigaba 11 no 12 zoMthetho weziNhlaka zoMasipala woHulumeni baseKhaya, 1998 (uMthetho No. 117 ka 1998), zifundwa nezigaba 3, 4 no 5 zoMthetho wokuNquma iziNhlobo zoMasipala, 2000 (uMthetho No. "isiKhwama seziMali eziNgenayo sesiFundazwe" kusho isikhwama esisungulelwe isiFundazwe saKwaZulu-Natali yisigaba 226 soMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika, 1996 uMthetho No.

INhloko kungaba owesilisa noma owesifazane. Uma abantu ababili belingana ngokuthathwa kwezinqumo, kuthathwa omdala kubo. Ngubani igama loyinhloko yekhaya? UMBUZI MIBUZO: Ngelungu "elisha" lomuzi, sichaza umuntu owayengaselona ilungu lomuzi mhla sivakashele lomuzi ukuzowubuza ngo 2002/2003 njengengxenye yocwaningo i- WHS ye- WHO. Gcwalisa ikholamu eyodwa ngalelo nalelo lungu lomndeni. UMBUZI MIBUZO: khumbula ukufaka abantu abangekho okwesikhashana besesikhungweni ngenxa yesimo sempilo. U [IGAMA] uhlobene kanjani nenhloko yomuzi? Kungabe u- [IGAMA] ungowesilisa noma wesifazane? Kungabe u- [IGAMA] ushadile noma cha? Kungabe u- [IGAMA] wafinyelela kuliphi izinga lemfundo? Kungabe u[IGAMA] unawo umshuwalense? = Cha, akanawo. Kungabe u- [IGAMA] udunga unakekelo ngenxa yesimo sakhe sempilo njnegokugula kweminyaka kumbe ukugula ngengqondo noma ukukhubazeka, noma kungoba eguga futhi eba buthaka? Kungabe u- [IGAMA] usesikhungweni thizeni njengamanje (isibhedlela, ikhaya lokunakekela, ikhaya labadala, esibhedlela sabagulela ukufa) ngenxa yesimo sempilo yakhe? Uma umuntu wayeyilunga lomuzi kwenziwa WHS 2003, kepha manje ENGASELONA ilungu lomuzi, qhubeka no Q0415. Uma umuntu eyilungu ELISHA lomuzi kumbe wabe elilungu lomuzi ngo 2003 futhi eseyilungu lomuzi nanamuhla, MUSA ukuphendula u Q0415 noma u- Q0416 YANA KU Lungu elilandelayo lomuzi, noma uma kuyilungu lokugcina lomuzi YANA KU Q0417. Uyephi u- [IGAMA]?

Bonke abantu nemiphakathi kumele bakwazi ukufinyelela kumvikela womphakathi. kazwelonke nezidinga ukuba umbiko ugcinwe uyimfihlo. UMvikeli woMphakathi uqokelwa inkathi eyiminyaka eyisikhombisa futhi engavuselelwa. iqaphe futhi ihlole izinga lokuhlonishwa kwamalungelo obuntu eRiphabhuliki. ukudla, amanzi, ezenhlalakahle yomphakathi, imfundo, kanye nendawo. noma eminye imikhandlu yomphakathi noma yemiphakathi ethile eNingizimu Afrika. namalungelo amasiko, enkolo nezilimi zemiphakathi. nemisemsebenzi yeKhomishana yamaLungelo oBuntu, ukuze luphenywe. Le webhusayithi izovuleka efasiteleni elisha ukuze uhambise kwezinye amawebhusayithi. Le webhusayithi izoqhubeka ibuyekezwa ngemininingwane emisha. Inhloso yethu ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane noma nini lapho itholakala. Nokho, abaklami nabathuthukisi bewebhusayithi yezinsizakalo zikahulumeni abakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imininingwane evela kwezinye amawebhusayithi esixhumanisa nazo ezishicilelwe lapha izoba neqiniso ngaleso sikhathi. Bheka Izimo Nezimo, isigaba 4.3. Iminyango kahulumeni iyabamba imininingwane yabo kwiwebhusayithi. Le nsizakalo ihlinzekwa kubasebenzi bokuxhumana bamanzi, abawuthintayo imininingwane eshicilelwe kule webhusayithi. Abasebenzi bokuxhumana kukahulumeni bangabantu abaphethe ukuphathwa kokuqukethwe nokuhlanganisa umqondo wokwenzeka okuqukethwe kwiwebhusayithi. Imininingwane ikakhulukazi ihlelwe kule webhusayithi ngefomethi ye-HTML. Nokho, ezinye izincwadi zitholakala ngefomethi ye-PDF, ezihlinzekwe ngendlela yokuthi zigcine uhlobo okumele zibe nalo ukuze zihlale zihlala. Ukuze uvule izincwadi ze-PDF udinga i-Adob Acrobat Reader 4, noma inguqulo ephezulu kukhompyutha yakho. Lokhu kuzokuvumela ukuthi uvule izincwadi ngqo kwi-browser yakho. Ngezinye izikhathi kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuvula izincwadi ze-PDF. Kulokhu, siphakamisa ukuthi ulandele izincwadi kukhompyutha yakho bese uzivula lapho. Sebenzisa umouse wakho, chofoza kwesokudla kudokhumenti ofuna ukuyilanda. Ku-menu yokwehla, khetha 'Save target as'. Ku-'Save as' iwindi, khetha indawo ofuna ukuyigcina kudokhumenti kukhompyutha yakho, bese uchofoza inkinobho ethi 'Save'. Ifayela lizogcinwa endaweni oyikhethile.
