Incazelo Yomcimbi: Umcimbi Wezokuthengisa – "Imisebenzi Nezinhlelo Zokuthengisa Ezintsha" Ngalesi sikhathi, umphakathi wezokuthengisa uzobanjwa umcimbi omkhulu ozoqa umgudu wokuhlanganisa abathengisi, abacwaningi, nezimboni ezahlukahlukene ukuze baxoxe ngezindlela ezintsha, imikhuba, nezinsizakusebenza ezithinta ezokuthengisa. Lo mcimbi, ozoqala ngosuku lwesi-15 kuJanuwari 2024, uzoba seHhotela Lezokuphila eGoli, uhlanganisa abaholi abavela ezinkampanini ezinkulu, abathuthukisi bezobuchwepheshe, kanye nabathengisi abakha izixazululo ezisheshayo nezisemqoka ukuze bathole impumelelo. Umcimbi uzokwenza isikhala sokuxhumana phakathi kwababukeli nabakhangisi, uvula amathuba okudala ubudlelwane obusendabuko nolwakhiwo lwezinhlelo zokuthengisa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izifundo ezihlukahlukene zizoqhutshwa ngochwepheshe abanolwazi, behlola izindaba ezithinta izokuthengisa, njengokuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe, indlela yokwakha umkhiqizo, nokubaluleka kokuxhumana nabathengi. Izingxenye zomcimbi zifaka izingxoxo, izifundo ezibukhoma, kanye nezinkulumo ezivela kubachwepheshe abaphambili emhlabeni wezokuthengisa. Izingxoxo ezizokwenziwa zizoqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abavela ezimbonini ezahlukene bazokwazi ukuthola imibono emisha, befa iziqondisi nezindlela zokuphumelela ezinobuhlakani. NgoMgqibelo, lo mcimbi uzodlulisa ikhethini lokugcina lapho abathengisi bazoba nekhono lokukhuluma ngezinto ezithinta imikhiqizo yabo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuthola izimpendulo ezicacile nemibono emisha ukuze kuxhunywe nemikhiqizo yezinkampani ezihlukene.

Ubuhlakani Nempilo: Ukuziphatha Kwethu Kwi-Online Njengoba siqhubeka nokusebenzisa ama-social media, kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi izenzo zethu zikwazi ukushintsha umphakathi. Ukuziphatha kahle, ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane enembile, futhi ukuvikela abanye kubalulekile ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi sispirela isikhala esihle sokuxhumana. Ukudala indaba yangempela, ehloniphekile, nokuqwashisa nabanye, kuyinto ebalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo. Ukubhekana Nezinguquko: Okuhlangenwe Nakho Kwethu Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, sebe saba nomqondo wokuthola indlela yokuxhumana, izidingo zethu ziye zashintsha. Ukuhlanganyela kulezi zinkundla kuholela ekwenzeni abantu babe witayithi elibalulekile, futhi impilo yabo isiphenduka ibe nobukhulu obukhulu. Umcimbi wethu uzokhuluma ngezindlela ezihlukene abantu abathola ngazo ulwazi, abashukumiseleka, futhi babe nomoya wokubambisana. Isiphetho: I-Impact Yama-Social Media Emiphakathini yethu, ama-social media akha “umjikelezo” wezinto ezahlukene. Lokhu kuveza amandla okuxhumana, ukuqonda, kanye namathuba amasha. Njengabantu, kumele sizigcine sishesha, sihlaziye, futhi sifunde ukusebenzisa lawa mathuluzi ngendlela efanele. Ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhala sokuxhumana, sikhaza umthetho ophumelelayo, sithola ithuba lokukhuluma, ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ama-social media akhulisa umuzwa wokubambisana, uduku, nokuqonda ukuphila kwabanye. Ngokubuka esikhathini esizayo, amandla ethu akhulu. Ngakho-ke, masithathe ithuba lokuxhumana ngokugqugquzela, siqonde, futhi sakhe umphakathi ophumile, ophumelelayo nokuhambisana nezinga eliphezulu lokuphila.

Khumbula ukuthi awuboshelelwe ukuthi usebenzise ibhangi lakho langemihla, futhi kwesinye isikhathi ungathola usizo olungcono kwelinye ibhangi elizama ukuheha ibhizinisi lakho. Yini Isikimu Sokuqinisekisa Isikweletu se-Khula? Ukuthola imisebenzi Yeboikweletu kungabalukhuni kwesinye isikhathi, njengokujwayelekile oxhas ngezimali angafuna impahla efana nendlu ukuqinisekisa imali mboleko. Isikimu Sokuqinisekisa Isikweletu se-Khula samiswa ukunikeza ukufinyelela ezimalini kubantu abafisa ukuqalisa amabhizinisi amancane noma aphakathi nendawo, kodwa babe bengenawo amathuba okuqoqa umnotho noma enye impahla ukuthi bayethule njengokubhanqiweyo (okokuqinisekisa) ebhangi ukuze baqinisekise imali mboleko yebhizinisi. Kulezi zimo amabhangi angakwazi ukufaka izicelo ku-Khula ukuze bathole isiqinisekiso ezizosebenza njengokubhanqiweyo kwama-80% enani selilonke lemali mboleko, (emalini mboleko engama-R1 wezigidi). Iziqinisekiso sesikweletu sikhopna kuko kokubili imisebenzi yebhizinisi elisha noma ibhizinisi eslelikhona elifisa ukwanda. Izimo ezifanayo nazo zingahambisana nawo womabili amacala. Uyacelwa ukuba uqaphele ukuthi Isikimu Sesiqinisekiso Sesikweletu asikwazi ukusetshenziselwa imisebenzi esongozwayo (isib. Uma usomabhizinisi efuna ukuvula ibhizinisi lesibili bese ebeka umenenja ozolibheka). Iklayenti liya ehhovisi Lokweluleka Lesifunda le-Khula ukuze lithole usizo mayelana nohlelo Lwebhizinis noma usizo lokwelulekwa. Umqondisi wesifunda uphakamisa umeluleki emva kokuhlola Uhlelo Lwebhiozinisi noma izicelo sokwelulekwa.

Umphathi weNkantolo Ephakeme akudingi ukuba azibambele ngokwakhe ekuphatheni izindaba zamafa abantu abashonile. Umphathi uyoqoka umuntu ofanele umsebenzi wokusingatha ifa lomuntu oshonile. Ngesikhathi sokuhlela ifa, umuntu usengakwazi ukuzihlelela indlela eliyocazwa ngayo ifa ngaphansi komthetho wamasiko. Lokhu kufanele kuqoshwe phansi kwi-Wili. Umphathi weNkantolo Ephakeme unesibophezelo soMthethosisekelo sokuqinisekisa ukuthi umthetho ophathelene namasiko uyathuthukiswa. Lokhu kufanele kwenziwe ngokuvumela umndeni oshonelwe ukuba uvumelane ngendlela okufanele labiwe ngayo ifa lomuntu oshonile. Akufanele kodwa Umphathi weNkantolo Ephakeme avumele amathimba abuthaka njengezingane nabantu besifazane ukuba bahlukunyezwe ngenxa yesivumelwano somndeni. Kusemqoka ukuba bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika baziqonde lezi zinguquko ukuze bahlele amafa abo ngendlela efanele. Umphathi oMkhulu weNkantolo Ephakeme usesungule inombolo yocingo lapho kutholakala khona usizo.

IPhalamende idinga idokhumenti ezovumela imibono yomphakathi mayelana nezinsiza ezithile ukuba iphume ezincwadini zikamasipala ezinezikhangiso zomphakathi ngaphambi kokuthi lezi zinsiza zethulwe ePhalamende ngenhloso yokwenza kube umthetho obophelelayo owamukelwe yiPhalamende. Lokhu kuhambisana nemithetho kahulumeni eqinisekisa ukuthi uhulumeni angachaza ngemininingwane futhi azibophezele, aphendule ngendlela efanele, futhi abe sobala. Ekwenyukeni kokuqala kukaDisemba 2006, amalungu ePhalamende avumelene ekubhaleni umthetho ophathelene nokuphathwa kwezilwandle ezincwadini zikamasipala ezinezikhangiso zomphakathi, ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukuveza imibono yabo. UNgqongqoshe wezokuphila kwemvelo nezokuhamba, uMarthinus Van Schalkwyk, wamemezela ngoDisemba 8, 2006, ukuthi lo mthetho uzobe utholakala ezincwadini zokukhuluma zomphakathi ngoDisemba 15, 2006. UNgqongqoshe wakhuluma ngokucacile ukuthi ngenxa yezakhi ezahlukene ezenza lo mthetho, umphakathi unikezwa izinsuku eziyi-90 zokukhuluma nokukhombisa imibono yabo ngalolu mthetho. Le dokhumenti itholakala kumapublishers wezincwadi zikamasipala (inombolo yocingo 012-334 4511 noma 012-465 7531) noma kuwebhusayithi kahulumeni http://www.deat.gov.za/. Inhloso yalezi zihloko ezitholakala lapha ukusiza umphakathi ekukhulumeni ngezindaba ezidala incazelo futhi zixhomeke kulwazi olwanele mayelana nalokho umphakathi ofuna ukukukhuluma ngalesi sikhathi esinikeziwe sezi-90. Lezi zihloko zenzelwe ukuchaza umlando owaholela ekushicilelweni kombiko osemthethweni kahulumeni mayelana nokuphathwa nentuthuko yezilwandle eNingizimu Afrika (iWhite Paper on Sustainable Coastal Development in South Africa).

iSpaceX Ngomqolo wenqola-moya ophakamisa umoya, iSpaceX, inkampani yethu esunguliwe nguElon Musk, ibonisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kanye nezinselelo eziphakeme emkhakheni wezokuhamba kwemikhumbi emkhathini. Le nkampani, eyasungulwa ngo-2002, inhloso yayo enkulu wukwenza ukuhamba emkhathini kube lula futhi kube nendlela yokuhlala kwabantu kwezinye izinkanyezi, ikakhulukazi iMars. Eminyakeni edlule, iSpaceX ibonile izimpumelelo ezinkulu ezifana nokukhipha izikhangibavakashi ezisindayo nezigxilile, okwakuvame ukuba yiphutha emlandweni wesayensi. Ukuphumelela kukaFalcon 1, owawukhipha umthwalo wokuqala, kwaba yinsika yokwakha ithemba elisha emkhakheni wezokuhamba kwemikhumbi emkhathini. Lesi sithombe sikhombisa ukuthi imizamo yeSpaceX ayipheli, futhi ngaphakathi kwezinyanga ezingu-10, iSpaceX yathola impumelelo yokwakha iFalcon 9, inqola-moya ephumelelayo enezici eziphakeme zokuphinda isetshenziswe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iSpaceX ibhekene nezinhlelo eziningi ezibangela ukukhumbula, njengokwakha iStarship, inqola-moya enezici eziphakeme zamazinga aphakeme nokuhanjiswa komthwalo omkhulu. I-Starship iyisiqalo esisha, esihlose ukwakha indlela yokuhamba emkhathini evulekile kumuntu wonke, kulandela isifiso sikaMusk sokuhamba kwezesayensi zokuqala eMars. Le mikhankaso ibonisa ukuthi iSpaceX ifuna ukukhipha umkhankaso wezokuhlala kwabantu kwezinye izinkanyezi, ngesidingo sokuhamba kwezesayensi nezokuhlala.

Noma iyiphi ibandla noma inhlangano ingabhala kuNgqongqoshe bese ifaka isicelo sokuba yisikhungo esingahola ubudlelwano babantu. UNgqongqoshe angawagcizelela ibandla noma inhlangano ukuba ihole imicimbi yokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwalolu mthetho, futhi kufanele, ngezikhathi ezithile, iphumelele imininingwane yazo zonke izikhungo ezinikezwe lawa mandla kuGazethi. UNgqongqoshe angawathathela emuva amandla anikezwe kumuntu esigabeni 2, uma ibandla noma inhlangano icela ukuthi ikhululwe futhi lokhu kufanele kushicilelwe kuGazethi. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphakathi wokushada ophumelelwe anganika umuntu ongumfundisi wenkolo, uma ethola isicelo esibhaliwe, igunya lokuba umphakathi wokushada, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi ungumfundisi noma unendawo ethile kulelo bandla, amandla okuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye nangokuhambisana nezindlela zokwenkolo zaleyo nkolo. Zonke amandla omphakathi wokushada ngaphansi kwesigaba 4 kufanele abhalwe emqulwini futhi kufanele ahlanganise usuku lokuqala kwala mandla kanye nemikhawulo enikezwe kuyo efakiwe kulolo mqulu. UNgqongqoshe kanye nomphakathi wokushada ophumelelwe, uma ethola isicelo esibhaliwe kumuntu ophumelelwe ngaphansi kwesigaba 4, bangathathela emuva igunya lalo muntu lokushada ngokubhalela mayelana nekhono labo lokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye. Le ngxenye, ngokuhambisana nesigaba, ayiphoqeleli umphakathi wokushada ukuba ahole umcimbi wokuhlanganisa ubudlelwano babantu: Kuqinisekiswa ukuthi bamenyezelile kuNgqongqoshe ngencwadi ukuthi imizwa yabo iyaphikisana nokuhlanganisa amaqembu ngaphansi kwale ngxenye.

Ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo ziyaqhubeka nokuhlonipha imikhuba yethu, kubalulekile ukufundisa izingane zethu ngezindlela zokupheka, izithako, kanye nezikhathi ezikhethekile. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili, kanti futhi kuzokwenza kube lula ukugcina izinkumbulo zethu zihlala zikhona. Isiphetho Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukudla kwesintu kuqhubeka nokuba yinsika ebalulekile empilweni yethu. Akukhona nje ukudla, kodwa kuyindlela yokuphila, isiko, kanye nendlela yokuxhumana. Njengoba siqhubeka nokuhlangana, sabelana ngezinkumbulo, futhi sikhumbula izimpilo zethu, kudinga ukuthi sihloniphe futhi sigcine ukudla kwesintu, ukuze sikwazi ukuhamba phambili, sikhumbule, futhi sibe neqhaza elikhulu empilweni yethu. Ukudla kwesintu akusizi nje kuphela ukudla, kodwa kudala ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu, imindeni, kanye nemiphakathi, okubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo, nolwazi.

Umendo wenkambiso yezamasiko ungenelwa ngaphansi komthetho wenkambiso yezamasiko . Lapho umyeni egana ngaphansi komthetho womendo wesilungu nakhona ethatha isinqumo sokugana omunye unkosikazi, amanye amakhosikazi bazokwamukelwa ngaphansi komthetho wenkambiso yezamasiko. Umendo kumele kuboniswane ngawo, kube nomgcagco kanti futhi ungenelwe ngokulandela umthetho wezamasiko. Abenzi zicelo abahlala ezindaweni zasemakhaya kumele bakhiphe incwadi evela kumholi wendabuko. Abenzi bezicelo abahlala ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kumele bakhiphe isitatimende esifungelwe kwabomthetho i-afidavithi. Ukuze umendo wenzeke, omabili amaqembu wabagananayo kanye nofakazi bakuyo yomibili imindeni kumele babekhona.

Irestorenti esesitayeleni yomndenmi wonke enokhari omuhle kanye nokudla kwasolwandle. UNksz. Sooka ufuna ukulandela ezinyathelweni ezifanayo uma ngicabanga. Kuhlelo lwasesikoleni, isikhwama sama-Norms and Standards eyabelwa izikole ezikumaqoqo ampofu kuzwelonke (national poverty quintiles) ngeqoqo lezikole ezimpofu kakhulu zithola , ngokulinganisela, izikhathi eziyisithupha ngaphezu kwampofu kakhulu. Uma konke kwenzeka, sifuna ukuthi umzabalazo ube nokuthula kanye nokubuyisana. Ngicabanga ukuthi lokhu kungamaphuzu engingathanda ukuwabeka okwamanje. Isitatimende siMongameli uMbeki sikhombisa umcabango kanye nesisekelo sezepolitiki okwakusekelwe kuyona umbono wethu womzabalazo wenkululeko manje osekuyisisekelo sokwaziwa kweNingizimu Afrika. Lesi simo kumele senziwe sibe ngesijwayelekile, uma kukhona okusha okuzoqala. Into ekhiqiziwe, ephila noma ekhula ngokwemvelo esifundeni esithile. Isibonelelo siyashiyana kusukela ekusizweni ngezimali, ukuqeqeshwa kokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nezinsiza kusebenza. Uhlelo Lwethu Lwezokuphepha lunezinhlaka ezintathu, okuwukuqinisa ukuphepha kwindawo ngokubiya, ama-alarm, i-mesh wire, i-razor wire, izimpawu, njl. Kutholakale cishe amadayimane ayishumi nesithupha phakathi kwabo ngemuba kokuba amaphoyisa ethathe izinyathelo zolwazi alutholile. Kukhona umbhalo ofakiwe futhi kucacile ukuthi isijobelelo ekukhulunywa ngaso kumbhalo wokuqala ofakiwe. Lapho kuvunyelwe khona, i-DOT izogqugquzela ukusetshenziswa kwezikhona zokuqeqesha ezikhona kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezikhungo ezintsha.

Ukusabalala kwabantu endaweni engaphansi kukamasipala wendawo yasebaQulusini akulingani, ama- 63% abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezakhele izindwo zasemakhaya , bese kuthi ama -15% abantu bahlala eVryheid. Umndeni ulinganiselwa kubantu aba- 3.8 , emakhaya khona kulinganiselwa ku 8. bangama -22.31% abantu abangakaze balubhade nhlobo esikoleni , bayi- 5.71% kuphela abanesitifiketi sikamatikuletsheni kanti ngama- 2. Ama-20% abantu abika ukuthi abaholi lutho nhlobo kanye nama-11% abahola ngaphansi kwezi R2 400 ngonyaka. Uhlaziyo lobulili babantu basendaweni kaMasipala waseBaqulusini, luveza okujwayelekile emphakathini waseNingizimu Afrika, lapho inani labesifazane lingaphezulu kwelabesilisa ngama- 5%. Lesi simo siveza umkhuba wokuhamba kwabantu bayohlala futhi basebenze emadolobheni, okuseyimpilo ejwayelekile emakhaya. Bangama - 46.1 % abantu e bendawo kamasipala wase Baqulusini abasesigabeni sabantu asebengasebenza, okungenani abangama-10.7% babo abaneminyaka ephakathi kwe-19 -24. Ingxenye enkulu yabantu basebaQulusini abaphakathi kweminyaka - 0-19. Kusemqoka kakhulu ukuthi kubhekwane nale nselelo yemfundo nokuqeqeshwa ukuze kuthuthukiswe umnotho wendawo yaseBaqulusini. Bangama- 2.54 % kuphela abantu abaneziqu zemfundo ephakeme, bese babe ngama-22.31 % abangakaze balubhande nhlobo esikoleni. Bayi- 5.71 % abahlali baseBaqulusini abanezitifiketi zikamatikuletsheni. Ngale kwaseVryheid, baningi kakhulu abantu abangafundile esifundeni sisonke. Ukungabibikho kwemisebenzi yiyona nkinga enkulu ebhekene noMasipala weSifunda saseZululand kanye noMasipala Wendawo yaseBaqulusini.

Maqondana nokuhlinzekwa kokuthuthwa kwendle, umehluko uyavela futhi phakathi kwamadolobha namakhaya. Cishe bangama- 0.4% abahlali basemakhaya abanezindlu zangasese ezishaywa ngamanzi, kube ngama -90.1% abahlali basemadolobheni abahlinzekwa ngalokhu. Nakuba u-Eskom usunyuse izinga lokuhlinzeka ngogesi ezindaweni eziningi, baphakathi kwama- 38% nama- 43% abantu bakumasipala wendawo yasebaQulusini abanogesi emakhaya abo. Imisebenzi yokuthuthwa kwemfucuza ayibonwa nangalukhalo ezindaweni zasemakhaya, ekubeni abasemadolobheni bethuthelwa imfucuza njalo ngesonto. Ukutholakala kwezidingongqangi zomphakathi kumasipala wendawo yasebaQulusini kunjenganabanye omasipala abahlwempu njengalokhu kunyathela ngonyawo lonwabu futhi kuveza amazinga aphansi entuthuko. Kunesibhedlela esisodwa kuphela somphakathi kanye nemitholampilo eyishumi nambili kumasipala wendawo yasebaQulusini, okuyiyona ehlinzekela abantu abayizi- 224546. Umumo wendawo yasebaQulusini iwugedle kakhulu kodwa inazo zonke izimo zomhlaba. Izintaba ezinezihlahla zameva zitholakala eNingizimu eduze ne- Louwsberg, zisabalalele eMpumalanga cishe ngama- 400m phezu kolwandle. Indawo yasebaQulusini inezintaba kanye nemihosha okunonomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni ingqalasizinda yendawo. Imithombo yamanzi emvelo ikhona, nakuba kungumqansa kubalimi ukuchelela izitshalo zabo. Kunemifula namadamu amaningi aphakela izindawo eziseduze nezifunda ezithuthukile. Ukungavundi kwenhlabathi yisona sizathu esenza ezolimo zingabi sezingeni eliphezulu ebaQulisini.

Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izigameko Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Izimo eziphuthumayo zibalulekile emkhakheni wezempilo, ikakhulukazi ezibhedlela. Lezi zimo zifaka phakathi izigameko ezidinga ukuphathwa ngokushesha ukuze kuvinjwe ukulimala okukhulu noma ukufa. Ukuze iziguli zithole usizo olufanele, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo ezicacile nezisebenzayo zokuphatha lezi zimo. Ukuqonda Izimo Eziphuthumayo Izimo eziphuthumayo zingahlukaniswa ngezigaba ezahlukene, ezifaka phakathi izimo zokulimala, izifo eziphuthumayo, kanye nezimo ezivela emithonjeni yokuphila. Abahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo kumele bazi izimpawu ezihambisana nalezi zimo ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ezisheshayo nezifanele. Izinyathelo Zokuphatha Izimo Eziphuthumayo Izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinyathelo ezicacile ukuze ziqinisekise ukuphathwa kahle kwezimo eziphuthumayo. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukuba nezinhlelo zokubika izimo eziphuthumayo, okuhlanganisa ukwakha indlela yokuxhumana esheshayo phakathi kwabahlengikazi, odokotela, kanye nezisebenzi zokuphuthumayo. Ukuze lokhu kusebenze, izibhedlela kumele zibe nezinsiza ezanele. Okwesibili, izibhedlela kufanele zibe nezinhlelo zokuhlola izimo eziphuthumayo, okuhlanganisa izinqubo zokuhlola iziguli ngokushesha. Abahlengikazi kumele babe neziqu eziphezulu nezifundo eziqondene nezimo eziphuthumayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi iziguli zithola usizo olufanele. Ukusebenza Kweqembu Ukuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo kudinga ukuba abantu basebenze njengeqembu. Abahlengikazi, odokotela, nabanye abasebenzi bezempilo kumele basebenzisane, baxhumane, futhi bahloniphe imisebenzi yomunye nomunye.

Le nqubomgomo iqala ukusebenza ngomhla ka-1 kuJulayi ka-2005 futhi ihambisana nokubuyekezwa ngokulandela amazinga omhlahlandlela ezinqubomgomo zokunikezela imisebenzi zikamasipala ezishicilelwe Ngumcwaningi Zimali Kuzwelonke. Umasipala uzokwakha inqubomgomo yokutholiswa okukhethwayo. Kumakontileka anenani lerandi elilingana noma elingaphansi kwenani elibekiwe, eliwubuningi obungamaphuzu angama-20 anikezwe ngezinhloso ezithile, njengoba kucatshangwe ngezansi, uma nje ithenda ephansi evunyiwe ithola amaphuzu angama-80 entengo. Amanye amathenda avunyiwe entengo ephezulu kumele afake amaphuzu ambalwa, ngokuhambisanayo, abalwa ngezintengo zamathenda awo ngokuqhathanisa nethenda evunyiwe ephansi kakhulu, ngokuhambisana nefomula ebekiwe. Izinhloso zokutholiswa okukhethwayo ezicacisiwe ezibekwe ngumasipala kumele zifake ukwenza amakontileka nabantu noma izinhlobo zabantu, ababekade bebandlululwa esikhathini esedlule ngokuphathelene nobuhlanga, ubulili nokukhubazeka. Izinhloso ezicacisiwe zenqubomgomo zizoqhubeka zifake ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokwakha nokuthuthukisa, njengoba zishicilelwe kuGazethi Kahulumeni YeNo. 16085, yomhla ka-23 kuNovemba ka- 1994 noma kumthetho olandelayo. Noma yisiphi isici esicacisiwe ngokulandela ukuthi yimaphio amaphuzu anikeziwe izakucaciswa kuzimemo zokuthi kufakwe amathenda. Umasipala uzakuthi ngokujwayelekile anikeze amakontileka ache kwabafaka amathenda amathola amaphuzu aphezulu kakhulu.

a ucabangela ulimi abathanda noma olusebenzisa endaweni futhi b ucabangela izidingo ezihlukene zabantu abangakwazi ukufunda nokubhala nabathintekile esikhathini esedlule. c chaza izimo nemigomo ngaphansi kwazo abanye abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zamanzi ngaphakathi nangaphandle kwendawo ephethwe yikhandidethi yamanzi bangakwazi ukufinyelela ingxenye yephrojekthi yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. d lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze ububanzi bomsebenzi nezindinganiso zomsebenzi okufanele zenziwe, futhi sizokhombisa ukuthi uma kuguquka, kuzoguquka ngokuhambisana nezimo zendawo zesivumelwano nezidingo ezithile, kuhlanganise nesikhathi esichaziwe futhi kubalulekile ukuba kube nohlu lwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa zezimali ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezindinganiso zomsebenzi ezibekwe; futhi e chaza lezi zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi ezizoba yingxenye yesivumelwano nephrojekthi ukuze umhlinzeki wamanzi akwazi ukufinyelela lezi zenzo zokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zazo zonke izinhlangothi ekutholeni noma yiziphi izimvume ezidingekayo, ukuze usebenzise amanzi ngaphansi kwesigaba 22 seMthetho Wamanzi Kazwelonke ka-1998 (Umthetho No. 36 ka-1998). b Lesi sivumelwano kumele sihlinzeke ngokubuyekezwa okuphindaphindiwe komsebenzi owenziwayo; kufanele futhi c kuvumele ithuba lokuphinda kuxoxiswane ngezindinganiso zomsebenzi nezinkomba ezihilela labo abangabasebenzisi bamanzi. Lesi sivumelwano kumele sichaze izibopho zekhandidethi ephethe ukuhlinzeka ngamanzi nezimo ezisemqoka okufanele umhlinzeki wezinsizakalo zamanzi ahlangabezane nazo mayelana nokusebenza komsebenzi.

Ukuhlukanisa izigaba kulindeleke ukuthi kuthuthukise uhlelo lwezokuphatha, kokubili emkhakheni ophakeme nasezinhlelweni eziphakathi. Lokhu kudinga ukuqwashisa mayelana nezimo ezithile ezikhona futhi kuhlale kwenziwa izinqumo ezihambisana neemfuno zabantu. Izingcindezi ezivela kwelokuhlalisana koluntu kudinga ukuhlolwa njalo, ukuze kube khona ukwenziwa kwezinhlelo ezithuthukile. Imiphumela Yokuhlukaniswa Imiphumela yokuhlukaniswa kwe-GEMS major member classification ibonisa ukuthi ngokwenza izigaba ezihlukanisiwe, izinkampani zingakwenza kube lula ukuhlola izindawo ezinzima, zisize ukuhlonipha imithetho yendawo, futhi zithuthukise ubumba bomphakathi. Lokhu kunciphisa izingozi nezinkinga ezingavela, futhi kuhlinzeka ngendawo ehlelekile yokwazisa ngempumelelo ngakolunye uhlangothi. Isiphetho Ukuhlukaniswa kwe-GEMS major member classification kusemqoka ezinhlelweni zakuqala nezikhandidawayo. Imiphumela yalokhu kuyavuma ukuba kucace izimo ezahlukene emkhakheni, kunciphise izinkinga ezazikhona, futhi kube nemiphumela ehlukahlukene edingekayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izinto ezithinta bonke abantu. Kodwa-ke, lo mkhiqizo wobuchwepheshe awukwazi ukwakhiwa ngaphandle kokuba nezinhlangano ezisekela. Omni wokuhlola uhambisana neqembu labantu, umphakathi, kanye nezidingo ezithile zomhlaba, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imigomo emisha. Kulesi sikhathi esibucayi, ukuhlinzeka ngembono engcono kulapho izimo ezisemqoka zikhukhula khona, okungenza izinqumo ezintsha zibe nohlu olusha. Ngakho-ke, le theory yesigaba se-GEMS major member classification iyasiza ekwakheni izinkulumo ezignele nezisizo, ubonisa indlela eqinile yokuthola izixazululo zokuphila okukhululekile kumuntu wonke.

Kufanele zisizwe futhi ukuthi zibuye zijoyine umphakathi. Ziningi izindlela izingane ezilinyazwa ngazo. Kwesinye isikhathi azinakwa noma zixhashazwe noma zihlukunyezwe. Kwesinye isikhathi ziyahlushwa noma zijeziswe ngezindlela ezinonya noma ezingenabo ubuntu (njengezilwane). Kwesinye isikhathi zilinyazwa ezimpini noma lapho okuliwa khona ngezikhali. Izingane kufanele zivunyelwe ukuthi zibe ngcon endaweni nangendlela ebuyisela impilo yazo esimeni, ukuzihlonipha kanye nesithunzi. Ake ucabange nje okomzuzwana ukuthi uphatheka kanjani uma ulimele. Kwesinye isikhathi umzimba wakho uba buhlungu ngempela. Kwesinye isikhathi imizwa yakho ilimala kabi kakhulu. Kwesinye isikhathi usuke uphatheke kabi ngempela. Ezinye izingane ziphatheka kabi noma zibone izinto ezimbi kangangokuthi zingabe zisafuna ukukhuluma. Ezinye ziba namaphupho asabisayo. Ezinye ziyazilimaza zona qobo noma zilimaze ezinye. Lezi zingane zidinga usizo oluningi. Zidinga indawo ethule kanye nabantu abanomusa kanye nesikhathi esiningi sokuthi zibe ngcono. Izingane ezibekwe amacala okwephula umthetho noma okwenza ubugebengu zinelungelo lokuphathwa ngendlela ezinikeza umuzwa wokuba nesithunzi nokubaluleka. Indlela eziphathwa ngayo kufanele nazo izisize ukuthi zihloniphe amalungelo abantu kanye nenkululeko yabanye abantu. Futhi zinelungelo lokuphathwa ngendlela efanelene neminyaka yazo futhi zisizakale ukucabanga ukuthi zizokwazi ukujoyina umphakathi futhi zibuye zibambe iqhaza emphakathini esikhathini esizayo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sicabange ngalokhu. Zicabange ubekwe icala lokwephula umthetho.

Ukungcoliswa kwamanzi akukhona nje kuphela okuthinta impilo yabantu, kodwa futhi kuthinta nezilwane nezitshalo, okwenza kube kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe izinyathelo zokuvikela imithombo yethu yamanzi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi zidinga ukuvuselelwa. Emiphakathini eminingi, izinhlelo zokuhambisa amanzi zikhona, kodwa azisebenzi kahle. Ukuphazamiseka kwemithombo, ukungabi bikho kwezinsiza, kanye nezinhlelo ezingasebenzi kahle, konke lokhu kudala izinkinga ezinkulu. Ukuze sithole izixazululo, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi, sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe, futhi sithole izindlela ezintsha zokuphatha imithombo yamanzi. Ngokubheka izixazululo, kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane. Ukuze sithole impumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi abantu basebenze ndawonye, bahlanganyele ezinhlelweni zokuphatha amanzi. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi imikhankaso yokufundisa abantu ngokuqwashisa ngamanzi, ukuhlela izinhlelo zokuhlanzeka, kanye nokwakha imithombo emisha yokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Ukubambisana phakathi kwemiphakathi, ohulumeni, kanye nezikhungo ezizimele kungasiza ekwakheni izixazululo eziphumelelayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kudingeka ukuthi sithuthukise ubuchwepheshe bokuhlinzeka ngamanzi. Izindlela eziphumelelayo zokuhlanza amanzi, njengezinhlelo zokuhlunga, zingasiza ekunciphiseni izinkinga zokungcoliswa. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi, kungasiza ekuphatheni kahle imithombo yamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela, ukulawula, nokuhlola izinsiza zamanzi. Ngokuphetha, izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu.

I-NEMA ikusiza ezikhathini lapho kungaba lukhuni futhi kuthathe isikhathi ukuqongelela ulwazi olufanele. Eziwombeni ezifana nalezi, iNEMA ithi uhulumeni noma lowo olimaza imvelo kumele aphenye noma aveze ulwazi. Kulesi simo, okufanele ukwenze wukufaka isikhalo. Enye ingqikithi izochazwa kabanzi esigabeni 7.5. INGXENYE 6: Likhona yini ikhambi lezikhalo ngaphansi kweNEMA? Lomqulu wehlukanise izehlakalo zokuthatha izinyathelo eziqondene nokulinyazwa kwemvelo noma ukwesabisa ngokuyilimaza izigaba ezingu 7 (Bona ingxenye 2). Kuyenzeka kube nokugamanxelana kulezigaba. Nanka amanye amakhambi ezinye zezikhalo ongazithola ezigabeni ezehlukene. Engxenyeni 1 no 2 sikutshele ukuthi ngubani ongathatha izinyathelo ngokulawula kweNEMA. Lengxenye izochaza kafushane ngemigudu ongayiqoka. Engxenyeni 7 no 8, sizokunika imininingwane eminingi ngesikhathi nokuthi ungayilandela kanjani lemigudu yokuthatha izinyathelo. Kulomhlahlandlela, uma sikhuluma ngoMqondisi-Jikelele noma iNhloko yoMnyango wesiFundazwe, siqonde uMqondisi-Jikelele woMnyango wezeMvelo nokuVakasha noma iNhloko yoMnyango wezeMvelo esifundazweni. i-NEMA ayikusizi nje kuphela lapho umuntu ephule umthetho, kodwa nalapho umuntu enesibophezelo sento ehluleka ukuyenza. Isibonelo, uma uhulumeni onesibophezelo sokumisa abantu banganukubezi umfula bese ehluleka ukwenza umsebenzi wakhe, uhulumeni wephula umthetho, ungamthathela izinyathelo ezimphoqa ukuba ayivikele imvelo. Ungacela uMqondisi-Jikelele ukwenza uphenyo.

U-Ahmed Qureia wamemezela ukuthi izinhlangothi zombili zivumelene emhlanganweni owawungobusuku obendulela lolo suku "ukuqala zibhale ukuthi zime kuphi". Ukuthuthukisa kanye nokugcina ama-Database okudingekela amaWebhusayithi kanye necandelo le-Desktop Publishing. Bekunengcindezi ekhulayo kwizinkambu zamasosha kumasosha alwelwa inkululeko abefuna ukubuyela ekhaya. Abaningi babika ukuthi babethokoze kakhulu ngokubonakala kakhulu kwamaphoyisa nokuthi futhi lokhu kuvimbele ababambe iqhaza ukuthi bahlaselwe yizigilamkhuba endleleni. Mincane kakhulu iMinyango ehlaziya ngokuchaza okuthile ukusebenza kwayo ngokuphathelene nokufanela kwemali esetshenzisiwe. Kodwa kuyiqiniso ukuthi ezweni lakithi saba nodlame lomuntu onsundu komunye umuntu onsundu, lokho kuyiqiniso. Kodwa ngicabanga ukuthi umuntu kumele abhekane nodaba ngalunye ukuze aphendule umbuzo, ibuphi ubufakazi obuqandula ikhanda obabukhona, ngoba buzohluka kumuntu ngamunye. Njengoba kungalindeleka, umoya wawugcwele ithemba lokuhle okungavela kanye nokulahlekelwa ithemba. Somlomo, ngaphansi kwalolu hlelo, sine-Child Rapid Response Unit- icandelo elisphethwe ama-Community Police Forum endawo, uMnyango kanye namavolontiya ethu e-Bambanani. I-Chronic glaucoma iyimbangela yesibili ezihola phambili yokungaboni eNingizimu Afrika. I-Summit izobe seyivuma uhlelo lokusebenza okuzosebenzisana ngalo i-Asia kanye ne-Afrika. Njengoba umbukiso uhamba emadolobheni amakhulu aseNingizimu Afrika abantu abaningi bazokwazi manje ukubona umnotho ohlukene wemibhalo yaseTimbuktu. Izibhedlela akuzolindeleka ukuthi zifake izimali ekuhlukanisweni kwazo kwisabiwo mali esikhona manje kuphela.

Izinhlelo Zezimo Eziphuthumayo Ezibhedlela Isingeniso Izimo eziphuthumayo ziwumthwalo omkhulu empilweni yomuntu, zidinga ukuzinikela okuqondile, okusheshayo, nolwazi olunembile ukuze kugwenywe imiphumela engafuneki. Ezibhedlela, ukunakekelwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo kubaluleke kakhulu, futhi kuthinta iziguli eziningi. Lo mbiko uhlose ukuhlela izinqubo ezisemqoka ezimisiwe endaweni yokwelashwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zonke izimo eziphuthumayo ziqhutshelwa phambili ngendlela efanele. I. Ukuthola Izimo Eziphuthumayo Ukuqonda ukufaneleka kokubiza usizo lwezimo eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Uma isiguli sifika ezibhedlela, kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe ukuhlola isimo saso. Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqonda izimpawu, imvelaphi yokulimala, nezimo zempilo ezikhona. Izisebenzi zezempilo zibhala imibiko enembile, ukuze ukuthola ulwazi olucacile kube lula, futhi kube khona izinqumo ezihloniphekile. II. Izindlela Zokuhlela Ngemuva kokuqinisekiswa kwesimo seziguli, izinqubo zokuhlela ziyaqala. Izibhedlela zinezinqubo ezithile ezisunguliwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi iziguli eziphuthumayo zithola ukwelashwa okuphuthumayo. Lokhu kubandakanya ukulawula izinsiza ezitholakalayo, njengezokwelapha zokushesha, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwelashwa okufanele. III. Ukubika Nokuqapha Ukubika izimo eziphuthumayo kubalulekile. Izinqubo zebhodi zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokubika ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhunyushwa kolwazi olutholakele. Ukulandela izinqubo ezilandelanayo zokubika kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhamba kahle kwenqubo. IV. Ukuqeqeshwa Kwezisebenzi Abasebenzi bezempilo badinga ukuqeqeshwa njalo.

Uma sekufakwe isicelo sokwahlukaniswa kwempahla eseceleni kumbe ingxenye yayo, inkantolo ingase ikhiphe isinqumo esithi impahla eseceleni kumbe ingxenye yayo okungekaphathini ongarejistiwe mayinikwe umfaki wesicelo ngendlela inkantolo eyibona ifanelekile futhi silungile. d amalungelo akhona abanye abantu bangaphandle abanentshisekelo kwimpahla yabo bobabili nanuleyo eseceleni; kanye e nanoma yisiphi esinye isimo esihambisanauo. Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo ngokubekiwe kwisigatshana 3 kufanele yaneliseke ukuthi ikhipha isinqumo esibona sifanelekile nesilungile uma kubhekwa ukuthi uphathini ongarejistiwe wafaka isandla ekwakhiweni komnotho oseceleni kumbe kwingxenye yawo ngesikhathi sobuhlobo bomndeni obungarejistiwe. Inkantolo ekhipha isinqumo ngokubekiwe kwisigatshana 3 kungathi lapho uphathini ongarejistiwe okuwuye isinqumo sibhekiswe kuye, ikhipe isinqumo sokuthi makuhlehliswe usuku lokugcinwa kwesinqumo senkantolo ngokwemibandela, okungafaka neyokukhipha isibambiso, ukukhokha inzalo, ukukhokha kancane kancane nokuhanjiswa kwempahla ethize echaziwe, inkantolo kufanele ikhiphe isinqumo esibona sifanelekile nesilungile. Inkantolo ingakhipha noma yisiphi isinqumo esibona sifanelekile ukuvikela amalungelo abantu abanentshisekelo. Ngaphandle uma kubekiwe kule sigaba, isicelo esifakiwe enkantolo sokuthi kukhishwe isinqumo ngaphansi kwale Sahluko kufanele senziwe ingakapheli iminyaka emibili kusukela ukufa kubuqedile ubuhlobo oburejistiwe.

Maqondana nesampula labaphenduli mibuzo abaminyaka yabo ingu 18-49 kuphepha mibuzo lomuntu ngayedwana, sebenzisa imigomo yethebula likaKish ukuqoka lowo muntu oyedwa kubantu basekhaya abafanelekile. UMBUZI MIBUZO: Maqondana nomhlinzeki mininingwane, khetha umuntu ekhaya owazi kangcono kunabanye ngekhaya nesimo sempilo sabahlala kulo, isimo sabo somsebenzi, sezimali, izindleko nemishuwalense yezempilo. Kungenzeka kudingeke kukhulunywe nedlanzana labantu ekhaya ukuze kutholakale lokhu. Umuntu odunjiwe lapha kungenzeka kungabi siyena umuntu okhethelwe ukugcwalisa iphephamibuzo lomuntu ngayedwana. Uma imininingwane ihlinzekwa abantu abaningi kuphepha-mibuzo ngokwasekhaya, umuntu ohlinzeka imininingwane eminingi kuneyabanye uzofakelwa ikhodi lapha. b Nikeza lowo nalowo muntu ofanelekile inombolo zilandelane, kusukela komdala wesilisa kuya komncane, bese kuba omdala owesifazane kuze kube omncane owesifazane ku Q0410. c Sebenzisa ithebula elifanele lokukhetha bukela kusibonelo esingezansi ukuqoka umphenduli mibuzo. Inombolo eqondene ekwikholamu lesibili kwithebula lokukhetha ikhomba umuntu okhethelwe ukufakwa imibuzo. Thola imvume usebenzisa ifomu lemvume loMhlinzeki mininingwane - ngaphambi kokuqhubekela kusiGaba 0500. Ngifisa ukukubuza imibuzo eyidlanzana mayelana nendlu kumbe ikhaya lakho. Kungabe lo muzi yila uhlala khona? UMBUZI MIBUZO: mfundele konke okukhona umphenduli mibuzo. Kuhlalwa mahhala kuwo... Uma umnini [wena] ungawudayisa namuhla lo muzi, ungacishe ube yiliphi inani (ungabiza malini)?

Ukuqoqa okuqoshiwe okulalelwayo nokubukwayo (komphakathi nokungesikho okomphakathi) nokunye okuhambisana nakho okwenziwe kumbe okumayelana neNingizimu Afrika. Ukwenza ukuthi izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika zifinyelele kula marekhodi nokugqugquzela ukuba asetshenziswe yibo bonke. Ukugqugquzela ubambiswano phakathi kwezikhungo ezigcina la marekhodi. I-NAFVSA inegumbi lokufundela lapho abacwaningi bengathola usizo lwayo yonke inhlobo lapho bethungatha ulwazi, kanjalo banokusebenzisa ulwazi olugcinwe emakhompyutheni mahhala. Ukubuka nokulalela okushicilelwe, kufanele kuhlelwe kuseyisikhathi. Kudingeka usazise isikhungo kusasele izinsuku ezintathu ukuze kulungiswe lokhu ofuna ukukusebenzisa kufakwe nasemishinini yakhona efanelekile. Le mpahla ingasetshenziselwa kuphela emagcekeni e-NAFVSA kukhokhwe imali enqunywe Umnyango Wezezimali. Izitshudeni ezifundayo nabafundi ziyisebenzisa mahhala le mpahla kodwa nazo kudingeka zenze amalungiselelo okulalela nokubuka kusenesikhathi. Kudingeka kutholakale imvume ebhaliwe yabasunguli uma umuntu efuna ukwenzelwa amakhophi ento ethize. Umtapo onezincwadi ezevile ezi-3000 eziphathelene nemboni kaqedisizungu, waqala kudala ngezikhathi zeBhodi Kazwelonke Yamafilimu kanti okungaphathi akubolekisi nhlobo kusetshenziselwa khona ngenxa yokuba yigugu kwemiqingo ekuwo. Kodwa-ke, zonke izincwadi ezisekumtapo zingabhekelwa khona emagcekeni eNqolobane Kazwelonke Yamagugu, kanti kungagaywa amakhophi ngentengo ephansi.

Amanye amalungelomvume nokuvikeleka koMkhandlu kaZwelonke, kwezithunywa zoMkhandlu kanye nabantu abashiwo ezigabeni 66 no 67, zingahlinzekelwa ngumthetho kazwelonke. Amaholo nezinye izinkokhelo ezihambisana namaholo aholelwa amalungu agcwele oMkhandlu kaZwelonke avela ngqo esikhwameni semali sikaZwelonke. ukungena noma ukukhishwa kwanoma yimuphi umuntu. UMkhandlu kazwelonke weziFundazwe awungakhiphi umphakathi inyumbazane, kubandakanya nabasakaza izindaba, ukuba bababekhona emhlanganweni wekomidi ngaphandle uma lokho kufanelekile ukuba kwenzeke emphakathini wentando yeningi. Noma yimuphi uMthethosivivinywa ungethulwa eMkhandlwini kaZwelonke. Yilungu leKhabinethe noma iSekela likaNgqngqoshe, noma ilungu loMkhandlu noma ikomidi loMkhandlu kuphela abangethula uMthethosivivinywa eMkhandlwini kodwa yilungu leKhabhinethe elibhekele izindaba zezimali zikaZwelonke kuphela elingethula uMthethosivivinywa ophathelene nemali eMkhandlwini. UMthethosivivinywa, ophathelene nemisebenzi ebalwe ohleni kulaSheduli 4 noma eshiwo esigabeni 76(3), ngaphandle koMthethosivivinywa ophathelene nemali, ungethulwa eMkhandlwini kaZwelonke weziFundazwe. Yilungu, noma yikomidi loMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe kuphela elivunyelwe ukwethula uMthethosivivinywa phambi koMkhandlu. UMthethosivivinywa owamukelwe nguMkhandlu kaZwelonke kufanele udluliselwe kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke weziFundazwe uma kufanele ucwaningwe uMkhandlu kaZwelonke; uMthethosivivinywa ovunywe uMkhandlu kaZwelonke kufanele uyiswe kuMkhandlu kaZwelonke.

Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, njengezinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi, kungasiza ekuphatheni kahle imithombo yamanzi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuhlela, ukulawula, nokuhlola izinsiza zamanzi. Ngokuphetha, izinkinga zamanzi emiphakathini zidinga ukunakwa okukhulu. Ukuntuleka kwamanzi ahlanzekile, ukungcoliswa kwamanzi, kanye nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwamanzi eziphukile, konke lokhu kudinga izixazululo eziphusile. Kubalulekile ukuthi imiphakathi ibambisane, ithuthukise izinhlelo zokuphatha amanzi, futhi isebenzise ubuchwepheshe obuphambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi wonke umuntu uthola amanzi ahlanzekile. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwakha imiphakathi enempilo, enokuthula, futhi eqinile. Izinkinga zamanzi akusona isimo esingashintsha kalula, kodwa ngokubambisana, singakwazi ukuzenza zibe yinto yempilo engcono.

Iningi lamapulazi liyathinteka odabeni lwemizamo yokubuyekezwa komhlaba ebe kuyiwona anamasimu ezingodo ezidingekayo kanye nezimvume zokutshalwa kwezihlahla- okungummnotho omkhulu kwezolimo. Lokhu kubukeka sengazuthi nalezi zikhalo ezingakaxazululwa zivimbela ukusebenza ngokuphelele kwalezi zindawo. Imboni yezokuvakasha yasebaQulusini ikhula kancane kancane, futhi ikhombisa ukuqhubeka nokudlondlobala ngamandla amakhulu. Ngenxa yalokhu, ingcebo yemvelo ekhona kanye nezinto ezihambisana nezokuvakasha njengezindawo ezisondelene noMzila wase-Battlefields, kwenza kubelula ukulethwa kwentuthuko. Lezi zimboni bezilokhu zibuthakathaka ngenxa yomthelela wokuvalwa kwezimayini, nokwehla kwamandla okuthenga nokutshalwa kwezimali phakathi kwabahlali bendawo kanye nabamabhizinisi. Imisebenzi eminingi ibambe iqhaza ekuletheni izimpahla endaweni eyakhelene ne-Vryheid. Nakuba kunjalo, izindaba ezimayelana nokuntuleka komhlaba kanye nokuklanywa kabusha kwezindawo zezimboni nako kuza nezingqqinamba kubatshalizimali abangaqhamuka. Amabhizinisi abonakala edlondlobala yilawo asebenzela kuma-CBD ezindaweni ezisedolobheni ebaQulusini. Iningi lala mabhizinisi asebenzayo nahlelekile atholakala eVryheid, futhi lawa ambandakanya ezohwebo, ezolimo, ezokuthengisa kanye nemisebenzi yezokukhiqiza, futhi ikakhulu ilawo asebenza ngawodwana. Kudala, lawa ayemelwe yi- Chamber of Business, eseyihlelwe kabusha yaba yi- Vryheid/ Besigheid. Angeke libukelwe phansi igalelo lama-SMME (amabhizinisi amancane, amaphakathi namakhulu) emnothweni wasebaQulusini.

Ubufakazi bokuphila bukaPistorius, izimo ezimkhulumayo, kanye nemiphumela yokushaya kukhombisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezomthetho aluhambisani nezimfuno ezifunwa umphakathi. Ukubaluleka kokuhlinzekwa kobufakazi obanele, obuqinisekisiwe, kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe umehluko obalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo ezilungile. Izinkinga Ezihambisana Nezombusazwe Isinqumo sikaPistorius sibuye saphakamisa izinkinga ezihlobene nezombusazwe. Imiphumela yesinqumo ibonisa ukuthi uhlelo lwezomthetho lungase luhlangabezane nezinselelo zokubhekelwa kwababusi bezomthetho. Ukwaziswa okuphakanyisiwe kuveza izinkinga ezinkulu zokuthi abantu abacebile noma abathandwayo bangathola izinkanyezi ezinkulu, kuyilapho abanye besolwa bephoqwa ukuba bahlale phansi. Umthelela Emphakathini Umphakathi ubona imiphumela yesinqumo sikaPistorius ngokwehlukana. Abanye bakhombisa ukuthanda, bebonisa ukuthi uPistorius ubengumuntu ophambene nezimo ezinzima, kanti abanye bahlola ubulungiswa obuyisisekelo. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi umphakathi ungase ube nezinkolelo ezahlukene ngokwethulwa kwezomthetho nobulungiswa. Izifundo Ezifunwayo Ukuhlaziywa kwalesi sinqumo kukhombisa izifundo ezibalulekile ezitholakala emkhakheni wezomthetho. Lokhu kubalulekile ukuze kwenziwe izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze kuzuzwe ubulungiswa. Ukuqonda indlela umphakathi uphendula ngayo kubalulekile ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izinqumo zomthetho zihlala zihlala zisebenza kahle. Isiphetho Ukuhlaziywa kwesinqumo sikashwele sikaPistorius kuvula indlela yokuhlola izinkinga eziningi ezihlobene nezomthetho, ubulungiswa, kanye nezomnotho. Kudingeka ukuthi umphakathi uqhubeke nokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi izinqumo ezithathwayo zithathwa ngokuqonda, ziqinisa ubulungiswa, futhi zisebenzele wonke umuntu.

Uma lukwa-DHA, isekela lomsebenzi wolwazi elifanele okuyilona elilawula irekhodi liyosebenza isicelo esifakiwe ngokushesha. Uma nanoma yiyiphi inhlangano kaHulumeni noma yomphakathi inolwazi, isicelo siyodluliselwa kumsebenzi wolwazi noma kusekela lomsebenzi wolwazi waleyo nhlangano. Lokho kwedlulisa kuyokwenziwa ezinsukwini eziyi-14 i-DHA ithole isicelo salowo osifakile. Lapho kudliswa, isekela lomsebenzi wolwazi olamukela isicelo, linganikezela futhi nganoma yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe olukhona olungasiza ekusetshenzweni kwesicelo. Lesi sinqumo kuyoxhunyanwa ngaso nofake isicelo ngendlela ekhonjiswe nguye kufomu yokufaka isicelo. Uma esenikiwe ulwazi, isaziso, phakathi kwezinye izinto, sizosho imali okufanele ikhokhwe (bheka izimiso zomthetho) kanye nefomu lapho kutholakala khona ulwazi. Uma kwaliwe nokutholakala kolwazi, kuzonikezwa izizathu zokwala ngokoMthetho. Ocelayo uzokwaziswa futhi ngamanye amalungelo akhe ukuthi afake isikhalazo sangaphakathi noma afake isicelo enkantolo ukuthi asizwe kanye nenqubo okufanele ilandelwe. Lokhu kuchazwe kwenatshwa ngezansi. Uma isinqumo singakatholakali kusekela lomsebenzi wolwazi ngesikhathi esibekwe ngokusemthethweni, kungathathwa ngokuthi isicelo asivunywanga. Uma ocelayo enokukhubazeka okumvimbela ukuthi afunde, abheke, noma alalelele irekhodi lelo elifanele elikufomu elisenhlanganweni yomphakathi, isekelo lomsebenzi wolwazi lizokwenza wonke umzamo wokuthi libe khona kufomu engafundwa, engabhekwa noma izwiwe. Ayikho enye imali engaphezulu eyobizwa.
